		public string ConnectionString
		{
			get
			{
				return connectionString;
			}
			set
			{
				if (connectionString != value)
				{
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
					{
						connectionStringName = null;
					}
					connectionString = value;
					CloseSession();
					Reset(metadataChanged: false);
				}
			}
		}

		[DefaultValue(null)]
		[TypeConverter("DevExpress.DataAccess.Design.XPObjectSourceConnectionStringNameTypeConverter,DevExpress.DataAccess.v23.2, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a")]

		public string ConnectionStringName
		{
			get
			{
				return connectionStringName;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == "(none)")
				{
					value = null;
				}
				if (connectionStringName != value)
				{
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
					{
						connectionString = null;
					}
					connectionStringName = value;
					CloseSession();
					Reset(metadataChanged: false);
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public IConnectionStringsProvider ConnectionStringsProvider
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_008f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0099: Expected O, but got Unknown
				if (connectionStringsProvider != null)
				{
					return connectionStringsProvider;
				}
				ref IConnectionStringsProvider reference = ref connectionStringsProvider;
				object service = GetService(typeof(IConnectionStringsProvider));
				reference = (IConnectionStringsProvider)((service is IConnectionStringsProvider) ? service : null);
				if (connectionStringsProvider != null)
				{
					return connectionStringsProvider;
				}
				if (Site != null)
				{
					connectionStringsProvider = ServiceProviderExtensions.GetService<IConnectionStringsProvider>((IServiceProvider)Site);
				}
				if (connectionStringsProvider != null)
				{
					return connectionStringsProvider;
				}
				if (IsVsDesignTime)
				{
					Type type = XPTypeActivator.GetType("DevExpress.Design.v23.2", "DevExpress.Utils.Design.VSConnectionStringsService");
					connectionStringsProvider = (IConnectionStringsProvider)Activator.CreateInstance(type, Site);
				}
				else
				{
					connectionStringsProvider = (IConnectionStringsProvider)(object)new RuntimeConnectionStringsProvider();
				}
				return connectionStringsProvider;
			}
			set
			{
				connectionStringsProvider = value;
			}
		}

		private bool IsVsDesignTime
		{
			get
			{
				if (Site == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				IDesignerHost service = ServiceProviderExtensions.GetService<IDesignerHost>((IServiceProvider)Site);
				if (service == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return ServiceProviderExtensions.GetService<ITypeDiscoveryService>((IServiceProvider)service) != null;
			}
		}

		private bool IsViewBehavior
		{
			get
			{
				if (properties != null)
				{
					return properties.Count > 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		[TypeConverter("DevExpress.DataAccess.Design.XPObjectSourceEntityTypeConverter,DevExpress.DataAccess.v23.2, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a")]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Category("Data")]
		[Description("")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.Xpo.XPObjectSource.EntityType")]
		public XPClassInfo EntityType
		{
			get
			{
				if (entityType == null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(entityTypeString))
				{
					int num = entityTypeString.IndexOf(',');
					if (num > 0 && num < entityTypeString.Length - 1)
					{
						string className = entityTypeString.Substring(0, num);
						string assemblyName = entityTypeString.Substring(num + 1).Trim();
						entityType = Dictionary.QueryClassInfo(assemblyName, className);
					}
					else
					{
						entityType = null;
					}
				}
				return entityType;
			}
			set
			{
				if (entityType != value)
				{
					entityType = value;
					entityTypeString = ((value != null) ? $"{value.FullName},{value.AssemblyName}" : null);
					if (!isInitializing)
					{
						properties.Clear();
						sorting.Clear();
					}
					Reset(metadataChanged: true);
				}
			}
		}

		[DefaultValue(null)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public string EntityTypeString
		{
			get
			{
				return entityTypeString;
			}
			set
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
				{
					value = null;
				}
				else
				{
					int num = value.IndexOf(',');
					if (num <= 0 || num == value.Length - 1)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(string.Format(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.XPObjectSource_InvalidEntityTypeString), value), "EntityTypeString");
					}
				}
				entityTypeString = value;
				entityType = null;
				if (!isInitializing)
				{
					properties.Clear();
					sorting.Clear();
				}
				Reset(metadataChanged: true);
			}
		}

		bool IListAdapter.IsFilled => isFilled;

		bool IListAdapter.ShouldRefill
		{
			get
			{
				if (((IListAdapter)this).IsFilled)
				{

		protected Session CreateSession(out bool isNewInternalSessionCreated)
		{
			if (this.ResolveSession != null && !IsVsDesignTime)
			{
				ResolveSessionEventArgs e = new ResolveSessionEventArgs
				{
					Tag = Tag
				};
				this.ResolveSession(this, e);
				if (e.Session != null)
				{
					isNewInternalSessionCreated = false;
					return e.Session.Session;
				}
			}
			string value;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(ConnectionString) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(ConnectionStringName))
			{
				value = ConnectionStringsProvider.GetConnectionString(ConnectionStringName);
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(string.Format(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.XPObjectSource_ConnectionStringMissing), ConnectionStringName));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				value = ConnectionString;
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				IDisposable[] objectsToDisposeOnDisconnect;
				SimpleDataLayer layer = new SimpleDataLayer(XpoDefault.GetConnectionProvider(value, (AutoCreateOption)3, out objectsToDisposeOnDisconnect));
				UnitOfWork result = new UnitOfWork(layer, objectsToDisposeOnDisconnect);
				isNewInternalSessionCreated = true;
				return result;
			}
			if (IsVsDesignTime)
			{
				isNewInternalSessionCreated = false;
				return null;
			}
			if (XpoDefault.DataLayer != null)
			{
				UnitOfWork result2 = new UnitOfWork(XpoDefault.DataLayer);
				isNewInternalSessionCreated = true;
				return result2;
			}
			throw new InvalidOperationException(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.XPObjectSource_ConnectionStringIsEmpty));
		}

		private void CloseSession()
		{
			if (session != null)
			{
				if (isInternalSessionUsed)
				{
					session.Dispose();
					isInternalSessionUsed = false;
				}
				else if (this.DismissSession != null && !IsVsDesignTime)
				{
					this.DismissSession(this, new ResolveSessionEventArgs
					{
						Session = session,
						Tag = Tag
					});
				}
				session = null;
			}
		}

		}

		public void Reset(bool metadataChanged)
		{
			isFilled = false;
			if (isInitializing)
			{
				hasChangesDuringInit = true;
			}
			else if (this.listChanged != null)
			{
				if (metadataChanged)
				{
					this.listChanged(this, new ListChangedEventArgs(ListChangedType.PropertyDescriptorChanged, null));
				}
				this.listChanged(this, new ListChangedEventArgs(ListChangedType.Reset, -1));
			}
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				CloseSession();
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		void IListAdapter.FillList(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
		{
			//IL_00ee: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00f5: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_010a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_010f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0119: Expected O, but got Unknown
			ReplaceServiceFromProvider(typeof(ISolutionTypesProvider), serviceProvider);
			ReplaceServiceFromProvider(typeof(IConnectionStringsProvider), serviceProvider);
			if (EntityType == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("EntityType");
			}
			if (IsVsDesignTime && session != null)
			{
				CloseSession();
			}
			if (session == null)
			{
				session = CreateSession(out isInternalSessionUsed);
			}
			if (this.BeforeFill != null)
			{
				this.BeforeFill(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
			IParameterSupplierBase val = ((serviceProvider != null) ? ServiceProviderExtensions.GetService<IParameterSupplierBase>(serviceProvider) : null);
			IEnumerable<IParameter> enumerable = ((val != null) ? val.GetIParameters() : null);
			IEnumerable<IParameter> enumerable2 = ParametersEvaluator.EvaluateParameters(enumerable ?? Enumerable.Empty<IParameter>(), Parameters);
			XPObjectSourceFilterVisitor xPObjectSourceFilterVisitor = new XPObjectSourceFilterVisitor(enumerable2);
			CriteriaOperator criteria = xPObjectSourceFilterVisitor.Process(Filter);
			CriteriaOperator groupCriteria = xPObjectSourceFilterVisitor.Process(GroupFilter);
			SortingCollection sortingCollection = new SortingCollection();
			foreach (SortProperty item in Sorting)
			{
				SortProperty val2 = item;
				CriteriaOperator val3 = xPObjectSourceFilterVisitor.Process(val2.Property);
				sortingCollection.Add(new SortProperty(val3, val2.Direction));
			}
			if (session != null)
			{
				entityType = session.GetClassInfo(entityType.AssemblyName, entityType.FullName);
				if (IsViewBehavior)
				{
					PreparePropertiesForSelect(enumerable2, out var fetchProperties, out var groupProperties);
					List<object[]> list = session.SelectData(entityType, fetchProperties, criteria, groupProperties, groupCriteria, selectDeleted: false, skipReturnedRecords, topReturnedRecords, sortingCollection);
					innerList = new List<object>(list.Count);
					foreach (object[] item2 in list)
					{
						innerList.Add(new XPObjectSourceRecord(item2));
					}
				}
				else
				{
					ICollection objects = session.GetObjects(entityType, criteria, sortingCollection, skipReturnedRecords, topReturnedRecords, selectDeleted: false, force: false);
					innerList = new List<object>(objects.Count);
					foreach (object item3 in objects)
					{
						innerList.Add(item3);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				innerList = new List<object>();
			}
			isFilled = true;
			if (this.AfterFill != null)
			{
				this.AfterFill(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		private void PreparePropertiesForSelect(IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters, out CriteriaOperatorCollection fetchProperties, out CriteriaOperatorCollection groupProperties)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			fetchProperties = new CriteriaOperatorCollection();
			groupProperties = new CriteriaOperatorCollection();
			XPObjectSourceFilterVisitor xPObjectSourceFilterVisitor = new XPObjectSourceFilterVisitor(parameters);
			foreach (XPObjectSourceProperty property in Properties)
			{
				CriteriaOperator val = xPObjectSourceFilterVisitor.Process(property.Property);
				Type type = DevExpress.Xpo.Metadata.Helpers.CriteriaTypeResolver.ResolveType(EntityType, val);
				if (typeof(XPBaseCollection).IsAssignableFrom(type))
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(string.Format(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.XPObjectSource_PropertyCannotBeFetched), val, type.FullName));
				}
				if (property.Fetch)
				{
					((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)fetchProperties).Add(val);
				}
				if (property.Group)
				{
					((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)groupProperties).Add(val);
				}
			}
			if (((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)fetchProperties).Count == 0)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.XPObjectSource_PropertiesCollectionDoesNotContainFetch));
			}
		}

		PropertyDescriptorCollection ITypedList.GetItemProperties(PropertyDescriptor[] listAccessors)
		{
			IXPObjectTypedListProvider provider = GetProvider<IXPObjectTypedListProvider>();
			XPClassInfo xPClassInfo = EntityType;
			if (EntityType != null && provider != null)
			{
				IRemoteXPObjectTypedList result = provider.GetResult(xPClassInfo.ClassType, Properties);
				if (result == null)
				{
					return PropertyDescriptorCollection.Empty;
				}
				return result.GetItemProperties(listAccessors);
			}
			if (!IsViewBehavior)
			{
				if (listAccessors == null || listAccessors.Length == 0)
				{
					return new XPDesignTimePropertyDescriptorCollection(xPClassInfo);
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < listAccessors.Length; i++)
				{
					XPMemberInfo xPMemberInfo = xPClassInfo.FindMember(listAccessors[i].Name);
					if (xPMemberInfo == null)
					{
						xPClassInfo = null;
						break;
					}
					if (xPMemberInfo.ReferenceType != null)
					{
						xPClassInfo = xPMemberInfo.ReferenceType;
						continue;
					}
					if (xPMemberInfo.IsCollection)
					{
						xPClassInfo = xPMemberInfo.CollectionElementType;
						continue;
					}
					xPClassInfo = null;
					break;
				}
				if (xPClassInfo != null)
				{
					return new XPDesignTimePropertyDescriptorCollection(xPClassInfo);
				}
				return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(new PropertyDescriptor[0]);
			}
			PropertyDescriptorCollection propertyDescriptorCollection = new PropertyDescriptorCollection(null);
			if (listAccessors != null && listAccessors.Length != 0)
			{
				return propertyDescriptorCollection;
			}
			int num = 0;
			foreach (XPObjectSourceProperty property in properties)
			{
				if (property.Fetch)
				{
					try
					{
						Type type = DevExpress.Xpo.Metadata.Helpers.CriteriaTypeResolver.ResolveType(EntityType, property.Property);
						propertyDescriptorCollection.Add(new XPObjectSourcePropertyDescriptor(property.Name, type, num));
						num++;
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
			}
			return propertyDescriptorCollection;
		}

			}
			return (T)obj2;
		}

		private XPDictionary GetOrCreateDictionary()
		{
			XPDictionary xPDictionary = null;
			Session session = null;
			try
			{
				if (this.ResolveSession != null)
				{
					ResolveSessionEventArgs e = new ResolveSessionEventArgs
					{
						Tag = Tag
					};
					this.ResolveSession(this, e);
					if (e.Session != null)
					{
						session = e.Session.Session;
						xPDictionary = session.Dictionary;
					}
				}
				if (xPDictionary == null && string.IsNullOrEmpty(ConnectionString) && string.IsNullOrEmpty(ConnectionStringName) && XpoDefault.DataLayer != null)
				{
					xPDictionary = XpoDefault.DataLayer.Dictionary;
				}
				if (xPDictionary == null)
				{
					xPDictionary = new ReflectionDictionary();
					try
					{
						xPDictionary.CollectClassInfos(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies());
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
				return xPDictionary;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (session != null && this.DismissSession != null)
				{
					ResolveSessionEventArgs e2 = new ResolveSessionEventArgs
					{
						Tag = Tag,
						Session = session
					};
					this.DismissSession(this, e2);
				}
			}
		}

		}

		private void LoadParameters(XElement element, IExtensionsProvider extensionProvider)
		{
			Component.Parameters.Clear();
			XElement xElement = element.Element("Parameters");
			foreach (XElement item in xElement.Elements())
			{
				DataSourceParameterBase dataSourceParameterBase = new DataSourceParameterBase();
				ParameterSerializer.DeserializeParameter(dataSourceParameterBase, item, extensionProvider);
				Component.Parameters.Add(dataSourceParameterBase);
			}
		}

		{

			{
				string attributeValue = item.GetAttributeValue("Direction");
				string attributeValue2 = item.GetAttributeValue("Column");

				SortProperty sortProperty = new SortProperty(attributeValue2, val);
				Component.Sorting.Add(sortProperty);
			}
		}

		private void LoadProperties(XElement element, IExtensionsProvider extensionProvider)
		{
			Component.Properties.Clear();
			XElement xElement = element.Element("Properties");
			foreach (XElement item in xElement.Elements())
			{
				string attributeValue = item.GetAttributeValue("Name");
				string attributeValue2 = item.GetAttributeValue("Fetch");

					};

				}
			}
		}

	public abstract class RelationColumnInfoBase
	{
		internal class EqualityComparer : IEqualityComparer<RelationColumnInfoBase>
		{
			public static bool Equals(RelationColumnInfoBase x, RelationColumnInfoBase y)
			{
				if (x == y)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (x == null || y == null || x.GetType() != y.GetType())
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (x.ConditionOperator == y.ConditionOperator && string.Equals(x.ParentKeyColumn, y.ParentKeyColumn, StringComparison.Ordinal))
				{
					return string.Equals(x.NestedKeyColumn, y.NestedKeyColumn, StringComparison.Ordinal);
				}
				return false;
			}

			bool IEqualityComparer<RelationColumnInfoBase>.Equals(RelationColumnInfoBase x, RelationColumnInfoBase y)
			{
				return Equals(x, y);
			}

			int IEqualityComparer<RelationColumnInfoBase>.GetHashCode(RelationColumnInfoBase obj)
			{
				return 0;
			}
		}

		public string ParentKeyColumn { get; set; }

		public string NestedKeyColumn { get; set; }

		public ConditionTypeBase ConditionOperator { get; set; }

		protected RelationColumnInfoBase(string parentKeyColumn, string nestedKeyColumn, ConditionTypeBase conditionType)
		{
			ParentKeyColumn = parentKeyColumn;
			NestedKeyColumn = nestedKeyColumn;
			ConditionOperator = conditionType;
		}

		protected RelationColumnInfoBase(string parentKeyColumn, string nestedKeyColumn)
			: this(parentKeyColumn, nestedKeyColumn, ConditionTypeBase.Equal)
		{
		}

		protected RelationColumnInfoBase()
			: this(null, null)
		{
		}

		internal RelationColumnInfoBase(RelationColumnInfoBase other)
			: this(other.ParentKeyColumn, other.NestedKeyColumn, other.ConditionOperator)
		{
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return (ParentKeyColumn ?? "<null>") + " " + CriteriaToBasicStyleParameterlessProcessor.GetBasicOperatorString((BinaryOperatorType)ConditionOperator) + " " + (NestedKeyColumn ?? "<null>");
		}
	}

		public Type Type
		{
			get
			{
				return type;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(type == value))
				{
					type = value;
					if (!(type == null) && !(type == typeof(Expression)) && ParameterHelper.ShouldConvertValue(this.value, type))
					{
						this.value = ParameterHelper.ConvertFrom(this.value, type, ParameterHelper.GetDefaultValue(type));
					}
				}
			}
		}

		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.DataSourceParameterBase.Value")]
		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.DataSourceParameterBase.Value")]
		[LocalizableCategory(DataAccessStringId.PropertyGridDesignCategoryName)]
		public object Value
		{
			get
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(ValueInfo))
				{
					value = ParameterHelper.ConvertFrom((object)ValueInfo, Type, (object)null);
				}
				return value;
			}
			set
			{
				this.value = value;
				ValueInfo = null;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DXHelpExclude(true)]
		public string ValueInfo { get; set; }

		private bool ShouldSerializeValue()
		{
			return Type == typeof(Expression);
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeValueInfo()
		{
			if (Type == typeof(Expression))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(ValueInfo))
			{
				ValueInfo = ParameterHelper.ConvertValueToString(Value);
			}
			return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(ValueInfo);
		}

		internal static DataSourceParameterBase FromIParameter(IParameter value)
		{
			object obj;
			if (value != null)
			{
				obj = value as DataSourceParameterBase;
				if (obj == null)
				{
					return new DataSourceParameterBase(((IFilterParameter)value).Name, ((IFilterParameter)value).Type, value.Value);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				obj = null;
			}
			return (DataSourceParameterBase)obj;
		}

	[Serializable]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(ExpressionTypeConverter))]
	public class Expression : IFormattable
	{
		private class ExpressionTypeConverter : TypeConverter
		{
			private static readonly ConstructorInfo constructorInfo = typeof(Expression).GetConstructor(new Type[2]
			{
				typeof(string),
				typeof(Type)
			});

			public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
			{
				if (value is string expressionString)
				{
					return new Expression(expressionString);
				}
				return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
			}

			public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
			{
				if (sourceType == typeof(string))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
			}

			public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}

			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (value is Expression expression && destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					return new InstanceDescriptor(constructorInfo, new object[2] { expression.ExpressionString, expression.ResultType });
				}
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}
		}

		[NonSerialized]
		private Type resultType;

		public string ExpressionString { get; set; }

		public Type ResultType
		{
			get
			{
				return resultType;
			}
			set
			{
				resultType = value;
			}
		}

			: this(expressionString, null)
		{
		}

		{
			ExpressionString = expressionString;
			ResultType = resultType;
		}

		{
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return ExpressionString;
		}

		string IFormattable.ToString(string format, IFormatProvider formatProvider)
		{
			return ExpressionString;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (this == obj)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (obj == null || GetType() != obj.GetType())
			{
				return false;
			}
			Expression expression = (Expression)obj;
			if (string.Equals(ExpressionString, expression.ExpressionString, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				return ResultType == expression.ResultType;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		internal static string ConvertToString(Expression value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return "(" + GetResultTypeString(value.ResultType) + ")(" + value.ExpressionString + ")";
		}

		private static string GetResultTypeString(Type resultType)
		{
			if (resultType == null)
			{
				return "null";
			}
			if (resultType.IsGenericType)
			{
				Type[] genericArguments = resultType.GetGenericArguments();
				if (genericArguments.Length == 1 && XtraPropertyInfo.IsPrimitiveType(genericArguments[0]))
				{
					Type genericTypeDefinition = resultType.GetGenericTypeDefinition();
					string text = (IsPrimitiveGenericTypeDefinition(genericTypeDefinition) ? genericTypeDefinition.FullName : genericTypeDefinition.AssemblyQualifiedName);
					return text + "[[" + genericArguments[0].FullName + "]]";
				}
			}
			if (!XtraPropertyInfo.IsPrimitiveType(resultType))
			{
				return resultType.AssemblyQualifiedName;
			}
			return resultType.FullName;
		}

		private static bool IsPrimitiveGenericTypeDefinition(Type type)
		{
			if (!(type == typeof(IEnumerable<>)) && !(type == typeof(IList<>)))
			{
				return type == typeof(List<>);
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static Expression ConvertFromString(string value, IExtensionsProvider extensionProvider = null)
		{
			if (GetTypeByPattern("\\A\\(([\\w\\\\`\\[\\]\\.+*&,]+(?:, [\\w\\.]+(?:, Version=\\d{1,5}\\.\\d{1,5}\\.\\d{1,5}\\.\\d{1,5}, Culture=[\\w-\"]+, PublicKeyToken=(?:(?:(?:[\\da-f]{2}){8,})|(?:null)))?)?)\\)\\((.*)\\)\\Z", value, out var expression, extensionProvider))
			{
				return expression;
			}
			if (GetTypeByPattern("\\A\\(([\\w\\\\`\\[\\]\\.+*&,]+)\\)\\((.*)\\)\\Z", value, out expression, extensionProvider))
			{
				return expression;
			}
			Regex regex = new Regex("\\A(?:[A-Za-z0-9+/]{4})*(?:[A-Za-z0-9+/]{4}|[A-Za-z0-9+/]{3}=|[A-Za-z0-9+/]{2}==)\\Z");
			if (!regex.IsMatch(value))
			{
				return new Expression(value);
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException("Cannot deserialize an expression of the specified type: " + value + ".");
		}

		private static bool GetTypeByPattern(string pattern, string value, out Expression expression, IExtensionsProvider extensionProvider = null)
		{
			expression = null;
			Regex regex = new Regex(pattern, RegexOptions.Singleline);
			Match match = regex.Match(value);
			if (!match.Success)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ITypeResolutionService typeResolutionService = (extensionProvider as IServiceProvider)?.GetService(typeof(ITypeResolutionService)) as ITypeResolutionService;
			string value2 = match.Groups[1].Value;
			expression = new Expression(match.Groups[2].Value);
			if (string.Equals(value2, "null", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
			{
				expression.ResultType = null;
			}
			else
			{
				expression.ResultType = ((typeResolutionService != null) ? typeResolutionService.GetType(value2, throwOnError: false) : SafeTypeResolver.GetType(value2, (bool?)false, (bool?)null));
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

	public abstract class DataConnectionBase : INamedItem
	{
		private string name = "";

			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]

		[Browsable(false)]

		public abstract bool IsConnected { get; }

		public bool HasConnectionString => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(ConnectionString);

		internal static void ProcessException(Exception exception)
		{
			ProcessException(null, exception);
		}

		internal static void ProcessException(string connectionName, Exception exception)
		{
			UnableToOpenDatabaseException ex = (UnableToOpenDatabaseException)(object)((exception is UnableToOpenDatabaseException) ? exception : null);
			Exception ex2 = exception;
			string text = exception.Message;
			if (ex != null && ((Exception)(object)ex).InnerException != null)
			{
				ex2 = ((Exception)(object)ex).InnerException;
				text = ex2.Message;
			}
			if (exception is TargetInvocationException { InnerException: not null } ex3)
			{
				ex2 = ex3.InnerException;
				text = ex3.Message;
			}
			if (exception is TypeInitializationException { InnerException: not null } ex4)
			{
				ex2 = ex4.InnerException;
				text = ex4.Message;
			}
			DataAccessStringId id = ((exception is CannotFindAppropriateConnectionProviderException) ? DataAccessStringId.NoXpoProviderStringId : DataAccessStringId.DatabaseConnectionExceptionStringId);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(connectionName))
			{
				text = string.Format(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.DatabaseConnectionExceptionMessage), connectionName, text);
			}
			throw new DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.DatabaseConnectionException(string.Format(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(id), text), ex2);
		}

		protected DataConnectionBase(string name)
		{
			this.name = name;
		}

		protected DataConnectionBase()
		{
		}

		public void Open()
		{
			if (!IsConnected)
			{
				CreateDataStoreInternal();
			}
		}

		public abstract void Close();

		internal void CreateDataStore(IDataConnectionParametersService dataConnectionParametersService)
		{
			CreateDataStore(dataConnectionParametersService, CancellationToken.None);
		}

		internal void CreateDataStore(IDataConnectionParametersService dataConnectionParametersProvider, CancellationToken token)
		{
			if (!IsConnected)
			{
				CreateDataStoreCore(dataConnectionParametersProvider, token);
			}
		}

		internal Task<bool> CreateDataStoreAsync(IDataConnectionParametersService dataConnectionParametersProvider, CancellationToken token)
		{
			return Task.Run(() => CreateDataStoreCore(dataConnectionParametersProvider, token));
		}

		private bool CreateDataStoreCore(IDataConnectionParametersService dataConnectionParametersProvider, CancellationToken token)
		{
			//IL_0005: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			DashboardTelemetry val = new DashboardTelemetry("DataConnectionBase.CreateDataStoreCore");
			try
			{
				ApplyParameters(dataConnectionParametersProvider);
				Exception exception;
				do
				{
					exception = null;
					try
					{
						CreateDataStoreInternal();
					}
					catch (Exception ex)
					{
						exception = ex;
					}
					if (IsConnected)
					{
						return true;
					}
					token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
				}
				while (ProcessExceptionInLoop(exception, dataConnectionParametersProvider));
				return false;
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private void ApplyParameters(IDataConnectionParametersService dataConnectionParametersProvider)
		{
			if (dataConnectionParametersProvider != null)
			{
				DataConnectionParametersBase parameters = CreateDataConnectionParameters();
				parameters = dataConnectionParametersProvider.RaiseConfigureDataConnection(Name, parameters);
				if (parameters != null)
				{
					ApplyParameters(parameters, serializeCustomConnStrCredentials: true);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool ProcessExceptionInLoop(Exception exception, IDataConnectionParametersService dataConnectionParametersProvider)
		{
			if (dataConnectionParametersProvider == null)
			{
				if (exception != null)
				{
					ProcessException(name, exception);
				}
				return false;
			}
			DataConnectionParametersBase connectionParameters = CreateDataConnectionParameters();
			DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.ConnectionErrorEventArgs e = new DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.ConnectionErrorEventArgs(Name, connectionParameters, exception);
			connectionParameters = dataConnectionParametersProvider.RaiseHandleConnectionError(e);
			if (!e.Handled)
			{
				ProcessException(name, exception);
			}
			if (connectionParameters == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ApplyParameters(connectionParameters, e.SerializeCustomConnectionStringCredentials);
			return true;
		}

		internal XElement SaveToXml()
		{
			XElement xElement = new XElement("DataConnection");
			SaveToXml(xElement);
			return xElement;
		}

		protected internal virtual void SaveToXml(XElement element)
		{
			element.Add(new XAttribute("Name", Name));
			if (ShouldSerializeConnectionStringSerializable())
			{
				element.Add(new XAttribute("ConnectionString", ConnectionStringSerializable));
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void LoadFromXml(XElement element)
		{
			name = element.GetAttributeValue("Name");
			if (name == null)
			{
				throw new XmlException();
			}
			ConnectionString = element.GetAttributeValue("ConnectionString");
		}

		protected virtual void ApplyParameters(DataConnectionParametersBase dataConnectionParameters, bool serializeCustomConnStrCredentials)
		{
			if (dataConnectionParameters is CustomStringConnectionParameters customStringConnectionParameters)
			{
				ConnectionString = customStringConnectionParameters.ConnectionString;
				if (!serializeCustomConnStrCredentials && DataConnectionHelper.HasSensitiveInfo(ConnectionStringSerializable))
				{
					ConnectionStringSerializable = DataConnectionHelper.ClearConnectionString(ConnectionString);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
		}

		public abstract DataConnectionParametersBase CreateDataConnectionParameters();

		public virtual string CreateConnectionString()
		{
			return ConnectionString;
		}

		protected abstract void CreateDataStoreInternal();

		private bool ShouldSerializeConnectionStringSerializable()
		{
			return HasConnectionString;
		}

		public virtual DBSchema GetDBSchema()

			return new DBSchema((DBTable[])(object)new DBTable[0], (DBTable[])(object)new DBTable[0]);
		}

		public virtual DBSchema GetDBSchema(string[] tableList)
		{
			return new DBSchema((DBTable[])(object)new DBTable[0], (DBTable[])(object)new DBTable[0]);
		}

			{
				string text = (string)val.Values[0];
				Type type = DBColumn.GetType((DBColumnType)Enum.Parse(typeof(DBColumnType), (string)val.Values[2]));
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					int num = 1;
					do
					{
						text = string.Format(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.EmptyColumnAliasPattern), num);

		private void SetDataConnection(SqlDataConnection value)
		{
			if (value != null && value != dataConnection)
			{
				if (dataConnection != null && dataConnection is IReferenceCountObject referenceCountObject)
				{
					referenceCountObject.RemoveReference();
				}
				dataConnection = value;
				if (dataConnection is IReferenceCountObject referenceCountObject2)
				{
					referenceCountObject2.AddReference();
				}
				OnDataConnectionSet();
			}
		}

		private bool RaiseTablesRemoving(IEnumerable<DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Data.DataTable> tablesToRemove)
		{
			if (this.TablesRemoving != null)
			{
				TablesRemovingEventArgs e = new TablesRemovingEventArgs(tablesToRemove);
				this.TablesRemoving(this, e);
				return !e.Cancel;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void ApplyCustomFilter(string tableName, SelectStatement selectStatement)
		{
			CriteriaOperator val = RaiseCustomFilter(tableName);
			if (val != null)
			{
				((JoinNode)selectStatement).Condition = val;
			}
		}

		protected virtual CriteriaOperator RaiseCustomFilter(string tableName)
		{
			if (!(((IServiceProvider)this).GetService(typeof(IDataLoaderHelper)) is IDataLoaderHelper dataLoaderHelper))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return dataLoaderHelper.RaiseCustomFilter(tableName);
		}

		private string CreateAutoSql()
		{
			SelectStatement selectStatementForAutoSql = GetSelectStatementForAutoSql();
			return CreateAutoSql(selectStatementForAutoSql);
		}

		private SelectedData GetData()
		{
			//IL_0031: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0037: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0102: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0108: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (DataConnection == null || DataConnection.CommandChannel == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(storedProcedureName))
			{
				return ExecuteSelect(SqlQuery);
			}
			SelectStatementResult val = new SelectStatementResult();
			ISupportStoredProc supportStoredProc = DataConnection.DataStore as ISupportStoredProc;
			OperandValue[] array = ((IEnumerable<IParameter>)Parameters).Select((Func<IParameter, OperandValue>)((IParameter p) => new OperandValue(p.Value))).ToArray();
			SelectedData val2 = CommandChannelHelper.ExecuteSproc(DataConnection.CommandChannel, StoredProcedureName, array);
			if (supportStoredProc == null)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("The specified data provider does not support stored procedures.");
			}
			DBStoredProcedureResultSet storedProcedureTableSchema = supportStoredProc.GetStoredProcedureTableSchema(StoredProcedureName, Parameters, new ConnectionOptions());
			val.Rows = ((IEnumerable<DBNameTypePair>)storedProcedureTableSchema.Columns).Select((Func<DBNameTypePair, SelectStatementResultRow>)((DBNameTypePair c) => new SelectStatementResultRow(new object[3]
			{
				c.Name,
				string.Empty,
				((object)System.Runtime.CompilerServices.Unsafe.As<DBColumnType, DBColumnType>(ref c.Type)/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).ToString()
			}))).ToArray();
			return new SelectedData((SelectStatementResult[])(object)new SelectStatementResult[2]
			{
				val,
				val2.ResultSet[0]
			});
		}

		private void SetDBSchemaInternal(DBSchema value, List<DataLoaderError> errors)
		{
			dbSchema = value;
			locker.Lock();

			{
				LoadDataObjects(errors);
			}
			finally
			{
				locker.Unlock();
			}
			OnChanged();
		}

		protected List<KeyValuePair<string, OperandValue>> GetCustomSqlCommandParameters()
		{
			//IL_0094: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_009e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			List<KeyValuePair<string, OperandValue>> list = new List<KeyValuePair<string, OperandValue>>();
			ICommandParameterNameProvider commandParameterNameProvider = DataConnection.DataStore as ICommandParameterNameProvider;
			foreach (IParameter parameter in Parameters)
			{
				string name = ((IFilterParameter)parameter).Name;
				IEnumerable<string> enumerable2;
				if (commandParameterNameProvider == null)
				{
					IEnumerable<string> enumerable = new string[1] { name };
					enumerable2 = enumerable;
				}
				else
				{
					enumerable2 = from format in commandParameterNameProvider.GetCommandParameterNameFormats()
						select string.Format(format, name);
				}
				IEnumerable<string> enumerable3 = enumerable2;
				foreach (string item in enumerable3)
				{
					list.Add(new KeyValuePair<string, OperandValue>(item, new OperandValue(parameter.Value)));
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected SelectedData ExecuteSelect(string query)
		{
			//IL_0057: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			List<KeyValuePair<string, OperandValue>> customSqlCommandParameters = GetCustomSqlCommandParameters();
			if (customSqlCommandParameters.Count == 0)
			{
				return CommandChannelHelper.ExecuteQueryWithMetadata(DataConnection.CommandChannel, query);
			}
			return CommandChannelHelper.ExecuteQueryWithMetadataWithParams(DataConnection.CommandChannel, query, new QueryParameterCollection(customSqlCommandParameters.Select((KeyValuePair<string, OperandValue> p) => p.Value).ToArray()), customSqlCommandParameters.Select((KeyValuePair<string, OperandValue> p) => p.Key).ToArray());
		}

		private void OnChanged()
		{
			if (!locked)
			{
				if (this.Changed != null)
				{
					this.Changed(this, EventArgs.Empty);
				}
				SchemaChanged();
			}
		}

		internal string CreateAutoSql(SelectStatement selectStatement)
		{
			string result = "";
			if (selectStatement != null && DataConnection.SqlGeneratorFormatter != null)
			{
				SelectSqlGeneratorWithAlias selectSqlGeneratorWithAlias = new SelectSqlGeneratorWithAlias(DataSelection, DataConnection.SqlGeneratorFormatter);
				Query val = ((BaseSqlGeneratorWithParameters)selectSqlGeneratorWithAlias).GenerateSql((BaseStatement)(object)selectStatement);
				result = val.Sql;
			}
			return result;
		}

		{
			if (disposing)

				}
				if (dataConnection != null && dataConnection is IReferenceCountObject referenceCountObject)

					referenceCountObject.RemoveReference();
				}
			}
			((DisposableObject)this).Dispose(disposing);
		}

			return DataConnection.DataStore.SelectData((SelectStatement[])(object)new SelectStatement[1] { selectStatement });
		}

		protected bool Contains(DBTable item)

			DBTable[] tables = Tables;

				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			DBTable[] views = Views;
			foreach (DBTable val2 in views)
			{
				if (((object)val2).Equals((object)item))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected void ExecuteCore()
		{
			if (IsSqlDataProvider && (IsCustomSql || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(storedProcedureName)))

					object dataSchema = (Data = CreateSqlView(val));
					DataSchema = dataSchema;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ExecuteSelection();
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Data.DataTable AddTableToSelection(DBTable table, DataReferences dataReferences)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)table, "table");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)dataReferences, "dataReferences");
			if (!Contains(table))
			{
				throw new DataSourceWizardException($"The data provider does not contain the '{table.Name}' table");
			}
			if (dataReferences.Count == 0)
			{
				throw new DataSourceWizardException("The reference list is empty");
			}
			DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Data.DataTable result = dataSelection.AddTable(table, dataReferences);
			OnDataSelectionChanged();
			return result;
		}

		}

		internal SqlQuery GetQuery()
		{
			string queryName = ((!DataSelection.IsEmpty) ? (DataSelection[0].Alias ?? DataSelection[0].TableName) : null);
			return GetQuery(DataSelection, queryName);
		}

		internal SqlQuery GetQuery(IEnumerable<DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Data.DataTable> tables, string queryName)
		{
			//IL_0172: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_019d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01a4: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			//IL_01fa: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			List<DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter> list = Parameters.Select((IParameter p) => new DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter(((IFilterParameter)p).Name, ((IFilterParameter)p).Type, p.Value)).ToList();
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(StoredProcedureName))
			{
				return new StoredProcQuery(StoredProcedureName, StoredProcedureName, list);
			}
			if (IsCustomSql)
			{
				CustomSqlQuery customSqlQuery = new CustomSqlQuery("CustomSqlQuery", SqlQuery);
				customSqlQuery.Parameters.AddRange(list);
				return customSqlQuery;
			}
			SelectQuery selectQuery = new SelectQuery();
			foreach (DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Data.DataTable table2 in tables)
			{
				Table table = selectQuery.AddTable(table2.TableName);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(table2.Alias) && !string.Equals(table2.Alias, table.Name))
				{
					table.Alias = table2.Alias;
				}
				foreach (DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Data.DataColumn selectedColumn in table2.SelectedColumns)
				{
					Column column = selectQuery.SelectColumn(table, selectedColumn.ColumnName);
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(selectedColumn.Alias) && !string.Equals(selectedColumn.Alias, selectedColumn.ColumnName))
					{
						column.Alias = selectedColumn.Alias;
					}
				}
				IEnumerable<DataReference> references = table2.References;
				if (table2.References.ActionType == DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.ActionType.MasterDetailRelation)
				{
					continue;
				}
				JoinType joinType = (JoinType)((table2.References.ActionType != DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.ActionType.InnerJoin) ? 1 : 0);
				Dictionary<DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Data.DataTable, Join> dictionary = new Dictionary<DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Data.DataTable, Join>();
				foreach (DataReference item in references)
				{
					DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Data.DataTable parentDataTable = item.ParentDataTable;
					ConditionType conditionType = (ConditionType)item.OperatorType;
					if (!dictionary.ContainsKey(parentDataTable))
					{
						string parentTableName = ((!string.IsNullOrEmpty(parentDataTable.Alias)) ? parentDataTable.Alias : parentDataTable.TableName);
						Table parent = selectQuery.Tables.Single((Table t) => t.ActualName == parentTableName);
						Join value = selectQuery.AddRelation(parent, table, joinType, item.ParentKeyColumn, item.KeyColumn, conditionType);
						dictionary.Add(parentDataTable, value);
					}
					else
					{
						dictionary[parentDataTable].KeyColumns.Add(new RelationColumnInfo(item.ParentKeyColumn, item.KeyColumn, conditionType));
					}
				}
			}
			FilterInfo filterInfo = DataSelection.Filters[queryName];
			if (filterInfo != null)
			{
				selectQuery.FilterString = filterInfo.FilterString;
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(queryName))
			{
				selectQuery.Name = queryName;
			}
			selectQuery.Parameters.AddRange(list);
			return selectQuery;
		}

		internal IList<DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Data.DataTable> RemoveDataTableFromSelection(DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Data.DataTable dataTable)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)dataTable, "dataTable");
			IList<DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Data.DataTable> dataTablesToRemove = dataSelection.GetDataTablesToRemove(dataTable);
			if (RaiseTablesRemoving(dataTablesToRemove))
			{
				dataSelection.RemoveDataTables(dataTablesToRemove);
				OnDataSelectionChanged();
				return dataTablesToRemove;
			}
			return null;
		}

		{
			if (dataSelection != newSelection)

				if (refreshData)

				}
			}
		}

		internal DBTable FindTable(Predicate<DBTable> predicate)
		{
			DBTable[] tables = Tables;
			foreach (DBTable val in tables)
			{
				if (predicate(val))
				{
					return val;
				}
			}
			DBTable[] views = Views;
			foreach (DBTable val2 in views)
			{
				if (predicate(val2))
				{
					return val2;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal DBTable FindTable(string name)
		{
			return FindTable((DBTable table) => table.Name.ToLowerInvariant() == name.ToLowerInvariant());
		}

		internal DBColumn FindColumn(string tableName, Predicate<DBColumn> predicate)
		{
			DBTable val = FindTable(tableName);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			foreach (DBColumn column in val.Columns)
			{
				if (predicate(column))
				{
					return column;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal DBColumn FindColumn(string tableName, string columnName)
		{
			return FindColumn(tableName, (DBColumn column) => column.Name.ToLowerInvariant() == columnName.ToLowerInvariant());
		}

		internal string GetFilterString(string filterTableName)
		{
			if (dataSelection.Filters.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!dataSelection.Filters.Contains(filterTableName))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return dataSelection.Filters[filterTableName].FilterString;
		}

		internal void SetFilterString(string tableName, string filterExpression)
		{
			SetFilterString(tableName, filterExpression, raiseChanged: true);
		}

		internal void SetFilterString(string tableName, string filterExpression, bool raiseChanged)
		{
			if (dataSelection.Filters[tableName] != null)
			{
				dataSelection.Filters[tableName].FilterString = filterExpression;
			}
			else
			{
				dataSelection.Filters.Add(tableName, filterExpression);
			}
			if (!IsCustomSql && raiseChanged && ((IDataProvider)this).IsConnected)
			{
				OnDataSelectionChanged();
			}
		}

		internal void OnDataSelectionChanged()
		{
			if (!locker.IsLocked)

				OnDataSelectionChangedInternal();
				if (this.DataSelectionChanged != null)
				{
					this.DataSelectionChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
				}
			}
		}

				}
			}
		}

		void IDataProvider.SaveToXml(XElement element)
		{
			if (dataConnection != null)
			{
				element.Add(new XAttribute("DataConnection", dataConnection.Name));
			}
			if (dataSelection.Count > 0)
			{
				element.Add(dataSelection.SaveToXml());
			}
			if (IsCustomSql && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(sql))
			{
				element.Add(new XAttribute("Sql", sql));
			}
		}

		void IDataProvider.LoadFromXml(XElement element)
		{
			XElement xElement = element.Element("Selection");
			if (xElement != null)
			{
				dataSelection = new DataSelection(this, xElement);
			}
			sql = element.GetAttributeValue("Sql");
			isCustomSql = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(sql);
		}

		void IDataProvider.EndLoading(IDBSchemaProvider dbSchemaProvider, List<DataLoaderError> errors)
		{
			if (DataConnection != null)
			{
				SetDBSchemaInternal(DataConnection.GetDBSchema(dataSelection.Select((DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Data.DataTable dataTable) => dataTable.TableName).ToArray()), errors);
				if (IsSqlDataProvider && string.IsNullOrEmpty(sql) && DataConnection.IsConnected)
				{
					sql = CreateAutoSql();
				}
			}
		}

		bool IDataProvider.CancelExecute()
		{
			if (executeThread == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			executeThread.Abort();
			executeThread = null;
			return true;
		}

		IEnumerable<IParameter> IParameterSupplierBase.GetIParameters()
		{
			return Parameters;
		}

	public class Node<T>
	{
		protected NodesList<T> ChildrenList { get; }

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public T Value { get; set; }

		public Node<T> Parent { get; internal set; }

		public IEnumerable<Node<T>> Children => ChildrenList;

		internal Node<T> this[int index] => ChildrenList[index];

		public Node(T value)
		{
			Value = value;
			ChildrenList = new NodesList<T>(this);
		}

		public IEnumerable<Node<T>> GetParents()
		{
			for (Node<T> node = this; node != null; node = node.Parent)
			{
				yield return node;
			}
		}

		public void AddChildren(params Node<T>[] nodes)
		{
			ChildrenList.AddRange(nodes);
		}

		public void ForEach(Action<Node<T>> action)
		{
			action(this);
			ForEachCore(action, Children);
		}

		public void AbandonChildren()
		{
			ChildrenList.Clear();
		}

		private void ForEachCore(Action<Node<T>> action, IEnumerable<Node<T>> nodes)
		{
			foreach (Node<T> node in nodes)
			{
				action(node);
				ForEachCore(action, node.Children);
			}
		}

		private bool ChildrenEquals(Node<T> other)
		{
			if (ChildrenList.Count != other.ChildrenList.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < ChildrenList.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!object.Equals(ChildrenList[i], other.ChildrenList[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected bool Equals(Node<T> other)
		{
			if (EqualityComparer<T>.Default.Equals(Value, other.Value))
			{
				return ChildrenEquals(other);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (this == obj)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (obj.GetType() != GetType())
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Equals((Node<T>)obj);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return 0;
		}
	}
	public class NodesList<T> : IList<Node<T>>, ICollection<Node<T>>, IEnumerable<Node<T>>, IEnumerable, IList, ICollection
	{
		private readonly Node<T> owner;

		private readonly IList<Node<T>> innerList = new List<Node<T>>();

		public int Count => innerList.Count;

		public bool IsReadOnly => innerList.IsReadOnly;

		public Node<T> this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return innerList[index];
			}
			set
			{
				innerList[index] = value;
			}
		}

		bool IList.IsFixedSize => false;

		bool IList.IsReadOnly => false;

		object IList.this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return this[index];
			}
			set
			{
				Node<T> node = value as Node<T>;
				if (node == null && value != null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException();
				}
				this[index] = node;
			}
		}

		int ICollection.Count => Count;

		bool ICollection.IsSynchronized => ((ICollection)innerList).IsSynchronized;

		object ICollection.SyncRoot => ((ICollection)innerList).SyncRoot;

		public NodesList(Node<T> owner)
		{
			this.owner = owner;
		}

		public void AddRange(IEnumerable<Node<T>> nodes)
		{
			foreach (Node<T> node in nodes)
			{
				node.Parent = owner;
				Add(node);
			}
		}

		public IEnumerator<Node<T>> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return innerList.GetEnumerator();
		}

		public void Add(Node<T> item)
		{
			if (item != null)
			{
				item.Parent = owner;
				innerList.Add(item);
			}
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			innerList.Clear();
		}

		public bool Contains(Node<T> item)
		{
			return innerList.Contains(item);
		}

		public void CopyTo(Node<T>[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			innerList.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		public bool Remove(Node<T> item)
		{
			return innerList.Remove(item);
		}

		public int IndexOf(Node<T> item)
		{
			return innerList.IndexOf(item);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, Node<T> item)
		{
			if (item != null)
			{
				item.Parent = owner;
				innerList.Insert(index, item);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			innerList.RemoveAt(index);
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}

		int IList.Add(object value)
		{
			Node<T> node = value as Node<T>;
			if (node == null && value != null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException();
			}
			Add(node);
			return Count - 1;
		}

		void IList.Clear()
		{
			Clear();
		}

		bool IList.Contains(object value)
		{
			Node<T> node = value as Node<T>;
			if (node == null && value != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Contains(node);
		}

		int IList.IndexOf(object value)
		{
			Node<T> node = value as Node<T>;
			if (node == null && value != null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return IndexOf(node);
		}

		void IList.Insert(int index, object value)
		{
			Node<T> node = value as Node<T>;
			if (node == null && value != null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException();
			}
			Insert(index, node);
		}

		void IList.Remove(object value)
		{
			Node<T> node = value as Node<T>;
			if (node != null || value == null)
			{
				Remove(node);
			}
		}

		void IList.RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			RemoveAt(index);
		}

		void ICollection.CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{
			((ICollection)innerList).CopyTo(array, index);
		}
	}

	[DataContract]
	public abstract class InfoBase
	{
		[DataMember(Name = "a")]
		public int Action
		{
			get
			{
				return ActionName;
			}
			set
			{
			}
		}

		[DataMember(Name = "v")]
		public double Version
		{
			get
			{
				return 2.0;
			}
			set
			{
			}
		}

		[DataMember(Name = "dxv")]
		public string DxVersion
		{
			get
			{
				return "23.2";
			}
			set
			{
			}
		}

		protected abstract int ActionName { get; }

		public string GetJson()
		{
			DataContractJsonSerializer dataContractJsonSerializer = new DataContractJsonSerializer(GetType());
			using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			dataContractJsonSerializer.WriteObject(memoryStream, this);
			return Encoding.Default.GetString(memoryStream.ToArray());
		}
	}
	[DataContract]
	public class PageVisitedInfo : InfoBase
	{
		[DataMember(Name = "p_t")]
		public string PageType { get; set; }

		[DataMember(Name = "m_t")]
		public string WizardModelType { get; set; }

		protected override int ActionName => 0;

		public static PageVisitedInfo FromPage<TModel>(IWizardPage<TModel> page) where TModel : IWizardModel
		{
			if (page == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			PageVisitedInfo pageVisitedInfo = new PageVisitedInfo();
			Type type = ((object)page).GetType();
			pageVisitedInfo.PageType = type.Name;
			pageVisitedInfo.WizardModelType = typeof(TModel).Name;
			return pageVisitedInfo;
		}
	}

	[DataContract]
	public class SqlDataSourceCreatedInfo : DataSourceCreatedInfo
	{
		[DataMember(Name = "prv")]
		public string Provider { get; set; }

		[DataMember(Name = "ccs")]
		public bool CustomConnectionString { get; set; }

		[DataMember(Name = "q_c")]
		public int QueriesCount { get; set; }

		[DataMember(Name = "csq")]
		public int CustomSqlQueryCount { get; set; }

		[DataMember(Name = "sq")]
		public int SelectQueryCount { get; set; }

		[DataMember(Name = "tq")]
		public int TableQueryCount { get; set; }

		[DataMember(Name = "sp")]
		public int StoredProcQueryCount { get; set; }

		[DataMember(Name = "rel")]
		public int RelationsCount { get; set; }

		protected override string DataSourceTypeName => "Sql";

		public static SqlDataSourceCreatedInfo FromDataSource(SqlDataSource dataSource, string platform)
		{
			SqlDataSourceCreatedInfo sqlDataSourceCreatedInfo = new SqlDataSourceCreatedInfo(platform);
			if (dataSource.Connection.ConnectionParameters is CustomStringConnectionParameters customStringConnectionParameters)
			{
				DbConnectionStringBuilder dbConnectionStringBuilder = new DbConnectionStringBuilder();
				dbConnectionStringBuilder.ConnectionString = customStringConnectionParameters.ConnectionString;
				sqlDataSourceCreatedInfo.Provider = dbConnectionStringBuilder["xpoprovider"].ToString();
			}
			else
			{
				sqlDataSourceCreatedInfo.Provider = dataSource.Connection.ProviderKey;
			}
			sqlDataSourceCreatedInfo.CustomConnectionString = dataSource.Connection.HasConnectionString;
			sqlDataSourceCreatedInfo.QueriesCount = dataSource.Queries.Count;
			sqlDataSourceCreatedInfo.CustomSqlQueryCount = dataSource.Queries.OfType<CustomSqlQuery>().Count();
			sqlDataSourceCreatedInfo.TableQueryCount = dataSource.Queries.OfType<TableQuery>().Count();
			sqlDataSourceCreatedInfo.SelectQueryCount = dataSource.Queries.OfType<SelectQuery>().Count();
			sqlDataSourceCreatedInfo.StoredProcQueryCount = dataSource.Queries.OfType<StoredProcQuery>().Count();
			sqlDataSourceCreatedInfo.RelationsCount = dataSource.Relations.Count;
			return sqlDataSourceCreatedInfo;
		}

		public SqlDataSourceCreatedInfo(string platform)
			: base(platform)
		{
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.DataAccess.Wizard

	public class DataComponentCreator
	{
		protected virtual ObjectDataSource CreateObjectDataSource()
		{
			return new ObjectDataSource();
		}

		protected virtual SqlDataSource CreateSqlDataSource()
		{
			return new SqlDataSource();
		}

		protected virtual EFDataSource CreateEFDataSource()
		{
			return new EFDataSource();
		}

		protected virtual ExcelDataSource CreateExcelDataSource()
		{
			return new ExcelDataSource();
		}

		protected virtual JsonDataSource CreateRestDataSource()
		{
			return new JsonDataSource();
		}

		protected virtual MongoDBDataSourceBase CreateMongoDBDataSource()
		{
			return new MongoDBDataSource();
		}

		protected virtual XPObjectSource CreateXPObjectSource()
		{
			return new XPObjectSource();
		}

		protected virtual FederationDataSourceBase CreateFederationDataSource()
		{
			return new FederationDataSource();
		}

		public static void SetupJsonDataSourceGlobal(IJsonDataSourceModel model, JsonDataSource jsonDataSource)
		{
			new DataComponentCreator().SetupJsonDataSource(model, jsonDataSource);
		}

		protected virtual void SetupObjectDataSource(IObjectDataSourceModel model, ObjectDataSource ods)
		{
			try
			{
				ods.BeginUpdate();
				ods.DataSource = model.ObjectType.ResolveType();
				ods.DataMember = ((model.ObjectMember == null) ? null : model.ObjectMember.Name);
				if (model.MemberParameters != null)
				{
					ods.Parameters.AddRange(model.MemberParameters);
				}
				if (model.ObjectConstructor != null)
				{
					if (model.CtorParameters == null || model.CtorParameters.Length == 0)
					{
						ods.Constructor = ObjectConstructorInfo.Default;
					}
					else
					{
						ods.Constructor = new ObjectConstructorInfo(model.CtorParameters);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					ods.Constructor = null;
				}
				ods.EndUpdate();
			}
			catch (DataMemberResolveException)
			{
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SetupJsonDataSource(IJsonDataSourceModel model, JsonDataSource jsonDataSource)
		{
			jsonDataSource.ConnectionName = model.ConnectionName;
			jsonDataSource.AssignConnection(model.DataConnection);
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			model.JsonSchema.ForEach(delegate(Node<JsonNode> node)
			{
				JsonSchemaNode jsonSchemaNode = (JsonSchemaNode)node;
				if ((jsonSchemaNode.Selected.HasValue && !jsonSchemaNode.Selected.Value) || (jsonSchemaNode.Children.Any() && !jsonSchemaNode.HasSelectedChildren))
				{
					string fullName = jsonSchemaNode.GetFullName();
					list.Add(fullName);
				}
			});
			jsonDataSource.Schema = model.JsonSchema;
			jsonDataSource.RootElement = model.RootElement;
		}

		protected virtual void SetupXPObjectSource(IXPObjectSourceModel model, XPObjectSource xpObjectSource)
		{
			ClearCredentials(model);
			SetupXPObjectSourceType(xpObjectSource, model.EntityType);
			if (model.ShouldSaveConnection.HasFlag(SaveConnectionMethod.SaveToAppConfig) || model.ShouldSaveConnection.HasFlag(SaveConnectionMethod.SaveToAppConfigWithCredentials))
			{
				xpObjectSource.ConnectionStringName = model.ConnectionName;
			}
			else if (model.DataConnection != null)
			{
				if (!model.ShouldSaveConnection.HasFlag(SaveConnectionMethod.KeepCredentials))
				{
					model.DataConnection.BlackoutCredentials();
				}
				xpObjectSource.ConnectionString = model.DataConnection.CreateConnectionString();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SetupEFDataSource(IEFDataSourceModel model, EFDataSource efDataSource)
		{
			efDataSource.ConnectionParameters = model.DataConnection.ConnectionParameters;
			ServiceContainerExtensions.AddService<ISolutionTypesProvider>((IServiceContainer)efDataSource, model.DataConnection.SolutionTypesProvider);
			efDataSource.Connection.ConnectionStringsProvider = model.DataConnection.ConnectionStringsProvider;
			efDataSource.Connection.SolutionTypesProvider = model.DataConnection.SolutionTypesProvider;
			ServiceContainerExtensions.RemoveService<ISolutionTypesProvider>((IServiceContainer)efDataSource);
			if (model.StoredProceduresInfo != null)
			{
				efDataSource.StoredProcedures.AddRange(model.StoredProceduresInfo);
			}
			if (model.Filters != null && model.Filters.Length != 0)
			{
				efDataSource.Filters.AddRange(model.Filters);
			}
			if (model.DataMember != null)
			{
				efDataSource.DataMember = model.DataMember;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual void SetupXPObjectSourceType(XPObjectSource xpObjectSource, Type entityType)
		{
			if (entityType != null)
			{
				xpObjectSource.EntityTypeString = entityType.AssemblyQualifiedName;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SetupFederationDataSource(IFederationDataSourceModel model, FederationDataSourceBase federationDataSource)
		{
			federationDataSource.Queries.AddRange(model.Queries.Select((CheckItem<QueryNode> x) => x.Value));
			if (federationDataSource is FederationDataSource federationDataSource2)
			{
				federationDataSource2.Relations.AddRange(model.Relations);
				FederationResultSet federationResultSet = federationDataSource2.RebuildResultSchemaCore();
				federationDataSource2.Result.SetTables(federationResultSet.Tables);
				federationDataSource2.Result.ApplyRelations(federationDataSource2.Relations);
			}
		}

		public virtual IDataComponent CreateDataComponent(IDataSourceModel model)
		{
			//IL_0063: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			string name = Assembly.GetCallingAssembly().GetName().Name;
			if (model.DataSourceType == DataSourceType.Xpo)
			{
				if (((ISqlDataConnectionModel)model).DataConnection == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				ClearCredentials((ISqlDataConnectionModel)model);
				SqlDataSource sqlDataSource = CreateSqlDataSource();
				sqlDataSource.Name = model.DataSourceName;
				sqlDataSource.AssignConnection(((ISqlDataConnectionModel)model).DataConnection);
				((ISqlDataConnectionModel)model).DataConnection.SqlDataSource = sqlDataSource;
				Dictionary<string, string> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, string>();
				DataContext val = new DataContext();
				IEnumerable<SqlQuery> queries = GetQueries(model);
				if (queries.Any())
				{
					foreach (SqlQuery query2 in GetQueries(model))
					{
						string name2 = query2.Name;
						query2.Name = sqlDataSource.Queries.GenerateUniqueName(query2);
						if (query2.Name != name2)
						{
							dictionary.Add(name2, query2.Name);
						}
						sqlDataSource.Queries.Add(query2);
						sqlDataSource.SetResultSchemaPart(query2.Name, ((DataContextBase)val)[model.DataSchema, name2].DataSource);
					}
					foreach (MasterDetailInfo relation in ((ISqlDataSourceModel)model).Relations)
					{
						if (dictionary.ContainsKey(relation.MasterQueryName))
						{
							relation.MasterQueryName = dictionary[relation.MasterQueryName];
						}
						if (dictionary.ContainsKey(relation.DetailQueryName))
						{
							relation.DetailQueryName = dictionary[relation.DetailQueryName];
						}
						sqlDataSource.Relations.Add(relation);
					}
					sqlDataSource.ResultSet.ApplyRelations(sqlDataSource.Relations);
				}
				else
				{
					SqlQuery query = ((ISqlDataSourceModel)model).Query;
					query.Name = sqlDataSource.Queries.GenerateUniqueName(query);
					sqlDataSource.Queries.Add(query);
					sqlDataSource.SetResultSchemaPart(((IDataComponent)sqlDataSource).DataMember, model.DataSchema);
				}
				if (model.DataMember != null)
				{
					sqlDataSource.DataMember = model.DataMember;
				}
				return (IDataComponent)(object)sqlDataSource;
			}
			if (model.DataSourceType == DataSourceType.Entity)
			{
				EFDataSource eFDataSource = CreateEFDataSource();
				SetupEFDataSource(model, eFDataSource);
				eFDataSource.Name = model.DataSourceName;
				return (IDataComponent)(object)eFDataSource;
			}
			if (model.DataSourceType == DataSourceType.Object)
			{
				ObjectDataSource objectDataSource = CreateDataComponent((IObjectDataSourceModel)model);
				objectDataSource.Name = model.DataSourceName;
				return (IDataComponent)(object)objectDataSource;
			}
			if (model.DataSourceType == DataSourceType.Excel)
			{
				ExcelDataSource excelDataSource = CreateExcelDataSource();
				excelDataSource.Name = model.DataSourceName;
				excelDataSource.FileName = model.FileName;
				excelDataSource.Schema.AddRange(model.Schema);
				excelDataSource.SourceOptions = model.SourceOptions;
				excelDataSource.SetResultSchema((DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Data.DataView)model.DataSchema);
				if (model.SourceOptions is ExcelSourceOptions excelSourceOptions && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(excelSourceOptions.Password) && !model.ShouldSavePassword)
				{
					excelSourceOptions.PasswordInternal.Password = excelSourceOptions.Password;
					excelSourceOptions.Password = null;
				}
				return (IDataComponent)(object)excelDataSource;
			}
			if (model.DataSourceType == DataSourceType.Json)
			{
				JsonDataSource jsonDataSource = CreateRestDataSource();
				jsonDataSource.Name = model.DataSourceName;
				SetupJsonDataSource(model, jsonDataSource);
				return (IDataComponent)(object)jsonDataSource;
			}
			if (model.DataSourceType == DataSourceType.MongoDB)
			{
				MongoDBDataSourceBase mongoDBDataSourceBase = CreateMongoDBDataSource();
				mongoDBDataSourceBase.Name = model.DataSourceName;
				mongoDBDataSourceBase.AssignConnection(((IMongoDBDataSourceModel)model).DataConnection);
				mongoDBDataSourceBase.Queries.AddRange(((IMongoDBDataSourceModel)model).Queries);
				mongoDBDataSourceBase.ApplyResultSchemaInternal(model.ResultSchema);
				return (IDataComponent)(object)mongoDBDataSourceBase;
			}
			if (model.DataSourceType == DataSourceType.XPObject)
			{
				XPObjectSource xPObjectSource = CreateXPObjectSource();
				xPObjectSource.Name = model.DataSourceName;
				SetupXPObjectSource(model, xPObjectSource);
				return (IDataComponent)(object)xPObjectSource;
			}
			if (model.DataSourceType == DataSourceType.Federation)
			{
				FederationDataSourceBase federationDataSourceBase = CreateFederationDataSource();
				federationDataSourceBase.Name = model.DataSourceName;
				SetupFederationDataSource(model, federationDataSourceBase);
				return (IDataComponent)(object)federationDataSourceBase;
			}
			throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
		}

		internal static IEnumerable<SqlQuery> GetQueries(ISqlDataSourceModel model)
		{
			return from q in model.Queries
				where q.Checked
				select q.Value;
		}

		public static void ClearCredentials(ISqlDataConnectionModel sqlDataConnectionModel)
		{
			if (!sqlDataConnectionModel.ShouldSaveConnection.HasFlag(SaveConnectionMethod.KeepCredentials) && sqlDataConnectionModel.DataConnection != null && !sqlDataConnectionModel.DataConnection.StoreConnectionNameOnly)
			{
				sqlDataConnectionModel.DataConnection.ClearCredentials(keepUserName: false);
			}
		}

		public static void ClearCredentials(IMongoDBDataConnectionModel dataConnectionModel)
		{
			if (!dataConnectionModel.ShouldSaveConnection.HasFlag(SaveConnectionMethod.KeepCredentials) && dataConnectionModel.DataConnection != null && !dataConnectionModel.DataConnection.StoreConnectionNameOnly)
			{
				dataConnectionModel.DataConnection.ConnectionParameters.ClearCredentials(keepUserName: false);
			}
		}

		public ObjectDataSource CreateDataComponent(IObjectDataSourceModel model)
		{
			ObjectDataSource objectDataSource = CreateObjectDataSource();
			SetupObjectDataSource(model, objectDataSource);
			return objectDataSource;
		}

		public static void SaveConnectionIfShould(IDataComponentModelWithConnection model, IConnectionStorageService storage)
		{
			if (model.DataConnection != null)
			{
				if (model is ISqlDataSourceModel sqlDataConnectionModel)
				{
					ClearCredentials(sqlDataConnectionModel);
				}
				if (model is IMongoDBDataSourceModel dataConnectionModel)
				{
					ClearCredentials(dataConnectionModel);
				}
				SaveConnectionIfShould(model.ShouldSaveConnection, model.DataConnection, model.ConnectionName, storage);
			}
		}

		private static void SaveConnectionIfShould(SaveConnectionMethod shouldSave, IDataConnection connection, string name, IConnectionStorageService storage)
		{
			if (shouldSave.HasFlag(SaveConnectionMethod.SaveToAppConfig))
			{
				if (connection.StoreConnectionNameOnly)
				{
					return;
				}
				storage.SaveConnection(name, connection, shouldSave.HasFlag(SaveConnectionMethod.KeepCredentials));
			}
			connection.Name = name;
		}

		public static void SaveConnectionIfShould(IJsonDataSourceModel model, IJsonConnectionStorageService storage)
		{
			if (model.DataConnection != null)
			{
				SaveConnectionIfShould(model.ShouldSaveConnection, model.DataConnection, model.ConnectionName, storage);
			}
		}

		private static void SaveConnectionIfShould(SaveConnectionMethod shouldSave, JsonDataConnection connection, string name, IJsonConnectionStorageService storage)
		{
			if (shouldSave.HasFlag(SaveConnectionMethod.SaveToAppConfig))
			{
				if (connection.StoreConnectionNameOnly)
				{
					return;
				}
				storage.SaveConnection(name, connection, shouldSave.HasFlag(SaveConnectionMethod.KeepCredentials));
			}
			connection.Name = name;
		}
	}

	public class FederationDataSourceWizardClient<TModel> : IWizardClient where TModel : class, IFederationDataSourceModel
	{
		private IEnumerable<DataComponentBase> dataSources;

		public IEnumerable<DataComponentBase> DataSources
		{
			get
			{
				if (dataSources == null)
				{
					dataSources = ((DataSourcesProvider != null) ? DataSourcesProvider.GetDataSources() : Enumerable.Empty<DataComponentBase>());
				}
				return dataSources;
			}
		}

		public IFederatedDataSourceProvider DataSourcesProvider { get; set; }

		public FederationDataSourceWizardContext Context { get; set; } = new FederationDataSourceWizardContext();

		public virtual void RegisterDependencies(IntegrityContainer container)
		{
			container.RegisterInstance<IFederatedDataSourceProvider>(DataSourcesProvider);
			container.RegisterInstance<FederationDataSourceWizardContext>(Context);
			container.RegisterType<ConfigureFederatedQueryPage<TModel>>();
			container.RegisterType<MultiFederatedQueryConfigurePage<TModel>>();
		}
	}
	public class MongoDBDataSourceWizardClient<TModel> : IWizardClient where TModel : class, IMongoDBDataSourceModel
	{
		private IEnumerable<MongoDBDataConnection> dataConnections;

		public IEnumerable<MongoDBDataConnection> DataConnections
		{
			get
			{
				if (dataConnections != null)
				{
					return dataConnections;
				}
				IEnumerable<MongoDBDataConnection> enumerable2;
				if (MongoDBConnectionStorageService == null)
				{
					IEnumerable<MongoDBDataConnection> enumerable = new MongoDBDataConnection[0];
					enumerable2 = enumerable;
				}
				else
				{
					enumerable2 = MongoDBConnectionStorageService.GetConnections();
				}
				dataConnections = enumerable2;
				return dataConnections;
			}
		}

		public IMongoDBConnectionStorageService MongoDBConnectionStorageService { get; set; }

		public MongoDBSensitiveInfoSavingBehavior? SensitiveInfoSavingBehavior { get; set; }

		public ISolutionTypesProvider SolutionTypesProvider { get; set; }

		public MongoDBWizardOptions Options { get; set; }

		public virtual void RegisterDependencies(IntegrityContainer container)
		{
			container.RegisterInstance<IMongoDBConnectionStorageService>(MongoDBConnectionStorageService);
			container.RegisterInstance<ISolutionTypesProvider>(SolutionTypesProvider);
			if (SensitiveInfoSavingBehavior.HasValue)
			{
				container.RegisterInstance<MongoDBSensitiveInfoSavingBehavior>(SensitiveInfoSavingBehavior.Value);
			}
			container.RegisterInstance<MongoDBWizardOptions>(Options);

	public class UIDataLoader
	{
		private readonly IWaitFormActivator waitFormActivator;

		private readonly IExceptionHandler exceptionHandler;

		private IWaitFormActivator WaitFormActivator => waitFormActivator;

		public UIDataLoader(IWaitFormActivator waitFormActivator, IExceptionHandler exceptionHandler)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)waitFormActivator, "waitFormActivator");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)exceptionHandler, "exceptionHandler");
			this.waitFormActivator = waitFormActivator;
			this.exceptionHandler = exceptionHandler;
		}

		public DBSchema LoadSchema(IDBSchemaProviderEx schemaProviderEx, SqlDataConnection sqlDataConnection, string[] dbItemsList)
		{
			return LoadSchemaInternal(sqlDataConnection, (SqlDataConnection connection, CancellationToken token) => Task.Factory.StartNew(() => LoadSchemaCore(schemaProviderEx, sqlDataConnection, DataObjectTypes.All, includeColumns: true, dbItemsList), token));
		}

		public DBSchema LoadTables(IDBSchemaProviderEx schemaProviderEx, SqlDataConnection sqlDataConnection, bool includeColumns, string[] dbItemsList)
		{
			return LoadSchemaInternal(sqlDataConnection, (SqlDataConnection connection, CancellationToken token) => Task.Factory.StartNew(() => LoadSchemaCore(schemaProviderEx, sqlDataConnection, DataObjectTypes.Tables, includeColumns: false, dbItemsList), token));
		}

		public DBSchema LoadViews(IDBSchemaProviderEx schemaProviderEx, SqlDataConnection sqlDataConnection, bool includeColumns, string[] dbItemsList)
		{
			return LoadSchemaInternal(sqlDataConnection, (SqlDataConnection connection, CancellationToken token) => Task.Factory.StartNew(() => LoadSchemaCore(schemaProviderEx, sqlDataConnection, DataObjectTypes.Views, includeColumns: false, dbItemsList), token));
		}

		private DBSchema LoadSchemaCore(IDBSchemaProviderEx dbSchemaProviderEx, SqlDataConnection sqlDataConnection, DataObjectTypes types, bool includeColumns, string[] dbItemsList)
		{
			DBTable[] array = (types.HasFlag(DataObjectTypes.Tables) ? dbSchemaProviderEx.GetTables(sqlDataConnection) : null);
			DBTable[] array2 = (types.HasFlag(DataObjectTypes.Views) ? dbSchemaProviderEx.GetViews(sqlDataConnection) : null);
			DBSchema result = new DBSchema(array, array2);
			List<DBTable> list = new List<DBTable>();
			if (array != null)
			{
				list.AddRange(array);
			}
			if (array2 != null)
			{
				list.AddRange(array2);
			}
			if (includeColumns)
			{
				dbSchemaProviderEx.LoadColumns(sqlDataConnection, list.Where((DBTable o) => (dbItemsList == null || dbItemsList.Contains(o.Name)) && o.Columns.Count == 0).ToArray());
			}
			return result;
		}

		public DBSchema LoadStoredProcedures(IDBSchemaProviderEx schemaProviderEx, SqlDataConnection sqlDataConnection)
		{
			return LoadSchemaInternal(sqlDataConnection, (SqlDataConnection connection, CancellationToken token) => Task.Factory.StartNew(() => new DBSchema(schemaProviderEx.GetProcedures(connection)), token));
		}

		private DBSchema LoadSchemaInternal(SqlDataConnection sqlDataConnection, Func<SqlDataConnection, CancellationToken, Task<DBSchema>> core)
		{
			CancellationTokenSource cancellationTokenSource = new CancellationTokenSource();
			CancellationTokenHook waitFormObject = new CancellationTokenHook(cancellationTokenSource);
			CancellationToken token = cancellationTokenSource.Token;
			WaitFormActivator.ShowWaitForm(false, true, true);
			WaitFormActivator.SetWaitFormObject((ISupportCancel)(object)waitFormObject);
			WaitFormActivator.SetWaitFormCaption(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.LoadingDataPanelText));
			WaitFormActivator.SetWaitFormDescription(string.Empty);
			WaitFormActivator.EnableCancelButton(true);
			Exception ex = null;
			try
			{
				Task<DBSchema> task = core(sqlDataConnection, token);
				task.WithBackgroundService(token);
				task.Wait(token);
				return task.Result;
			}
			catch (Exception ex2)
			{
				ex = ((!(ex2 is AggregateException ex3)) ? ex2 : ExceptionHelper.Unwrap(ex3));
			}
			finally
			{
				WaitFormActivator.CloseWaitForm();
			}
			if (ex != null)
			{
				exceptionHandler.HandleException(ex);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public ColumnarData LoadData(SqlDataConnection sqlDataConnection, DBSchema dbSchema, IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters, SqlQuery sqlQuery, bool topThousand)
		{
			CancellationTokenSource cancellationTokenSource = new CancellationTokenSource();
			CancellationTokenHook waitFormObject = new CancellationTokenHook(cancellationTokenSource);
			CancellationToken token = cancellationTokenSource.Token;
			waitFormActivator.ShowWaitForm(true, true, true);
			waitFormActivator.SetWaitFormObject((ISupportCancel)(object)waitFormObject);
			Exception ex = null;
			try
			{
				Task<ColumnarData> task = Task.Factory.StartNew(() => new DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.QueryExecutor(sqlDataConnection, dbSchema, null, sourceParameters).Execute(sqlQuery, topThousand, token), token);
				task.WithBackgroundService(token);
				task.Wait();
				if (task.Status == TaskStatus.RanToCompletion)
				{
					return task.Result;
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex2)
			{
				ex = ex2;
			}
			finally
			{
				waitFormActivator.CloseWaitForm();
			}
			if (ex != null)
			{
				if (ex is AggregateException ex3)
				{
					ex = ex3.GetBaseException();
				}
				exceptionHandler.HandleException(ex);
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
