	public sealed class StoredProcedureViewInfo
	{
		private readonly EFStoredProcedureInfo storedProcedure;

		private string displayName;

		public EFStoredProcedureInfo StoredProcedure => storedProcedure;

		public bool Checked { get; set; }

		private string DisplayName
		{
			get
			{
				object obj;
				if (storedProcedure != null)
				{
					obj = displayName;
					if (obj == null)
					{
						return displayName = string.Format("{0} ({1})", storedProcedure.Name, string.Join(", ", storedProcedure.Parameters.Select((EFParameter p) => p.Name)));
					}
				}
				else
				{
					obj = null;
				}
				return (string)obj;
			}
		}

		public StoredProcedureViewInfo(string procedureName)
		{
			storedProcedure = new EFStoredProcedureInfo(procedureName, null);
		}

		public StoredProcedureViewInfo(EFStoredProcedureInfo procedure)
		{
			storedProcedure = procedure;
		}

		public StoredProcedureViewInfo(EFStoredProcedureInfo procedure, bool isChecked)
			: this(procedure)
		{
			Checked = isChecked;
		}

		public static implicit operator EFStoredProcedureInfo(StoredProcedureViewInfo value)
		{
			return value?.StoredProcedure;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (storedProcedure == null)
			{
				return base.ToString();
			}
			return DisplayName;
		}
	}

	public sealed class ParametersViewInfo
	{
		public ParameterInfo[] Data { get; private set; }

		public ParametersViewInfo(ParameterInfo[] data)
		{
			Data = data;
		}

		public static bool Equals(ParametersViewInfo x, ParametersViewInfo y)
		{
			if (x == y)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (x == null || y == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (x.Data == y.Data)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (x.Data == null || y.Data == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = x.Data.Length;
			if (y.Data.Length != num)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				if (x.Data[i] != y.Data[i])
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (Data == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (Data.Length == 0)
			{
				return DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.ParameterlessConstructor);
			}
			return string.Format("({0})", string.Join(", ", Data.Select((ParameterInfo pi) => $"{TypeNamesHelper.ShortName(pi.ParameterType)} {pi.Name}")));
		}
	}
}

	public interface ICustomQueryValidator
	{
		bool Validate(DataConnectionParametersBase connectionParameters, string sql, ref string message);
	}
	public class CustomQueryValidator : ICustomQueryValidator
	{
		public virtual bool Validate(DataConnectionParametersBase connectionParameters, string sql, ref string message)
		{
			bool flag = CustomSqlQuery.IsSqlValid(sql);
			if (!flag)
			{
				message = DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.CustomSqlQueryValidationException);
			}
			return flag;
		}
	}
	public static class QueryValidatorHelper
	{
		public static void Validate(this SqlQuery query, ICustomQueryValidator customQueryValidator, DataConnectionParametersBase dataConnectionParametersBase, DBSchema dbSchema)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)query, "query");
			if (query is CustomSqlQuery customSqlQuery && customQueryValidator != null)
			{
				string message = null;
				if (!customQueryValidator.Validate(dataConnectionParametersBase, customSqlQuery.Sql, ref message))
				{
					throw new CustomSqlQueryValidationException(message);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				query.Validate(dbSchema);
			}
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.DataAccess.Wizard.Presenters

	public class ChooseDataProviderPage<TModel> : WizardPageBase<IChooseDataProviderPageView, TModel> where TModel : class, IDataSourceModel
	{
		private readonly IWizardRunnerContext context;

		public override bool FinishEnabled => false;

		public override bool MoveNextEnabled => true;

		protected ISolutionTypesProvider SolutionTypesProvider { get; }

		protected IEnumerable<SqlDataConnection> DataConnections { get; }

		protected SqlWizardOptions Options { get; }

		[Dependency]
		protected MongoDBWizardOptions MongoOptions { get; set; }

		protected IJsonConnectionStorageService JsonConnectionStorageService { get; }

		protected virtual IWaitFormActivator WaitFormActivator => context.WaitFormActivator;

		protected virtual IExceptionHandler ExceptionHandler => ((IUIRunnerContext)context).CreateExceptionHandler((ExceptionHandlerKind)0);

		[Dependency]
		public IMongoDBConnectionStorageService MongoDBConnectionStorageService { get; set; }

		[Dependency]
		private IFederatedDataSourceProvider FederatedDataSourceProvider { get; set; }

		[Dependency]
		protected DataSourceTypes DataSourceTypes { get; set; }

		[Dependency]
		protected List<ProviderLookupItem> Providers { get; set; }

		[Dependency]
		protected SqlWizardOptions SqlOptions { get; set; }

		[Dependency]
		protected JsonWizardOptions JsonOptions { get; set; }

		[Dependency]
		protected MongoDBWizardOptions MongoDBOptions { get; set; }

		protected string ViewProviderKey => ((WizardPageBase<IChooseDataProviderPageView, IChooseDataProviderPageView>)(object)this).View.ProviderKey;

		public ChooseDataProviderPage(IChooseDataProviderPageView view, IWizardRunnerContext context, IConnectionStorageService connectionStorageService, ISolutionTypesProvider solutionTypesProvider, SqlWizardOptions options)
			: this(view, context, connectionStorageService, solutionTypesProvider, options, (IJsonConnectionStorageService)null)
		{
		}

		public ChooseDataProviderPage(IChooseDataProviderPageView view, IWizardRunnerContext context, IConnectionStorageService connectionStorageService, ISolutionTypesProvider solutionTypesProvider, SqlWizardOptions options, IJsonConnectionStorageService jsonConnectionStorageService)
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseDataProviderPageView, IChooseDataProviderPageView>)(object)this)..ctor(view);
			this.context = context;
			Options = options;
			JsonConnectionStorageService = jsonConnectionStorageService;
			SolutionTypesProvider = solutionTypesProvider;
			DataConnections = connectionStorageService?.GetConnections() ?? Enumerable.Empty<SqlDataConnection>();
		}

		public override void Begin()
		{
			PrepareDataProviders();
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseDataProviderPageView, IChooseDataProviderPageView>)(object)this).View.InitializeDataProviders(DataSourceTypes, Providers);
			DataSourceType initialDataSourceType = GetInitialDataSourceType();
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseDataProviderPageView, IChooseDataProviderPageView>)(object)this).View.DataSourceType = initialDataSourceType;
			if (initialDataSourceType == DataSourceType.Xpo)
			{
				ISqlDataConnectionModel model = ((WizardPageBase<IChooseDataProviderPageView, IChooseDataProviderPageView>)(object)this).Model;
				ProviderLookupItem initialProvider = GetInitialProvider(model);
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseDataProviderPageView, IChooseDataProviderPageView>)(object)this).View.ProviderKey = initialProvider.ProviderKey;
			}
		}

		private void PrepareDataProviders()
		{
			if (Providers == null || !Providers.Any() || SqlOptions.HasFlag(SqlWizardOptions.DisableNewConnections))
			{
				DataSourceTypes.Remove(DataSourceType.Xpo);
			}
			if (!DataSourceTypes.Contains(DataSourceType.Xpo))
			{
				Providers = Enumerable.Empty<ProviderLookupItem>().ToList();
			}
			if (JsonOptions.HasFlag(JsonWizardOptions.DisableNewConnections))
			{
				DataSourceTypes.Remove(DataSourceType.Json);
			}
			if (MongoDBOptions.HasFlag(MongoDBWizardOptions.DisableNewConnections))
			{
				DataSourceTypes.Remove(DataSourceType.MongoDB);
			}
		}

		private DataSourceType GetInitialDataSourceType()
		{
			if (!DataSourceTypes.Contains(((WizardPageBase<IChooseDataProviderPageView, IChooseDataProviderPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataSourceType))
			{
				return DataSourceTypes.First();
			}
			return ((WizardPageBase<IChooseDataProviderPageView, IChooseDataProviderPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataSourceType;
		}

		private ProviderLookupItem GetInitialProvider(ISqlDataConnectionModel sqlDataConnectionModel)
		{
			return Providers.FirstOrDefault(delegate(ProviderLookupItem x)
			{
				string providerKey = x.ProviderKey;
				ISqlDataConnectionModel sqlDataConnectionModel2 = sqlDataConnectionModel;
				object obj;
				if (sqlDataConnectionModel2 == null)
				{
					obj = null;
				}
				else
				{
					SqlDataConnection dataConnection = sqlDataConnectionModel2.DataConnection;
					if (dataConnection == null)
					{
						obj = null;
					}
					else
					{
						ProviderFactory factory = dataConnection.Factory;
						obj = ((factory != null) ? factory.ProviderKey : null);
					}
				}
				return providerKey == (string)obj;
			}) ?? Providers.FirstOrDefault((ProviderLookupItem x) => x.ProviderKey == "MSSqlServer") ?? Providers.First();
		}

		public override void Commit()
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseDataProviderPageView, IChooseDataProviderPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataSourceType = ((WizardPageBase<IChooseDataProviderPageView, IChooseDataProviderPageView>)(object)this).View.DataSourceType;
			if (((WizardPageBase<IChooseDataProviderPageView, IChooseDataProviderPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataSourceType == DataSourceType.Xpo)
			{
				ISqlDataConnectionModel model = ((WizardPageBase<IChooseDataProviderPageView, IChooseDataProviderPageView>)(object)this).Model;
				if (model.DataConnection == null || model.DataConnection.Factory == null || model.DataConnection.ProviderKey != ViewProviderKey)
				{
					model.DataConnection = new SqlDataConnection
					{
						ProviderKey = ViewProviderKey
					};
				}
			}
		}

		public override bool Validate(out string errorMessage)
		{
			errorMessage = string.Empty;
			DataSourceType dataSourceType = ((WizardPageBase<IChooseDataProviderPageView, IChooseDataProviderPageView>)(object)this).View.DataSourceType;
			if (!ValidateDataSourceType(dataSourceType))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return ((WizardPageBase<IChooseDataProviderPageView, IChooseDataProviderPageView>)(object)this).Validate(ref errorMessage);
		}

		protected virtual bool ValidateDataSourceType(DataSourceType dataSourceType)
		{
			return DataSourceTypeHelper.ValidateDataSourceType(dataSourceType, ((WizardPageBase<IChooseDataProviderPageView, IChooseDataProviderPageView>)(object)this).Model, context, SolutionTypesProvider, ExceptionHandler, WaitFormActivator, FederatedDataSourceProvider);
		}

		public override Type GetNextPageType()
		{
			return DataSourceTypeHelper.GetNextPageType<TModel>(((WizardPageBase<IChooseDataProviderPageView, IChooseDataProviderPageView>)(object)this).View.DataSourceType);
		}
	}
	public class ChooseExistingConnectionPage<TModel> : ChooseExistingConnectionPageBase<IChooseExistingConnectionPageView, TModel> where TModel : class, IDataSourceModel

			: base(view, context, connectionStorageService, mongoDBConnectionStorageService, jsonConnectionStorageService)

		}
	}
	public class ChooseExistingConnectionPageBase<TView, TModel> : WizardPageBase<TView, TModel> where TView : class, IChooseExistingConnectionPageView where TModel : class, IDataSourceModel
	{
		protected readonly IWizardRunnerContext context;

		private JsonSchemaNode schema;

		private string root;

		protected ICollection<IDataConnection> connections;

		protected IConnectionStorageService connectionStorageService { get; }

		protected IMongoDBConnectionStorageService mongoDBConnectionStorageService { get; }

		protected IJsonConnectionStorageService jsonConnectionStorageService { get; }

		protected virtual IWaitFormActivator WaitFormActivator => context.WaitFormActivator;

		[Dependency]
		protected SensitiveInfoSavingBehavior DatabaseCredentialsSavingBehavior { get; set; }

		[Dependency]
		protected SqlWizardOptions SqlOptions { get; set; }

		[Dependency]
		protected JsonSensitiveInfoSavingBehavior JsonCredentialsSavingBehavior { get; set; }

		[Dependency]
		protected JsonWizardOptions JsonOptions { get; set; }

		[Dependency]
		protected MongoDBSensitiveInfoSavingBehavior MongoDBCredentialsSavingBehavior { get; set; }

		[Dependency]
		protected MongoDBWizardOptions MongoDBOptions { get; set; }

		[Dependency]
		protected DataSourceTypes DataSourceTypes { get; set; }

		protected IDataConnection DataConnection => connections.FirstOrDefault((IDataConnection c) => c.Name == base.View.ExistingConnectionName);

		public override bool FinishEnabled => ((WizardPageBase<TView, TModel>)this).GetNextPageType() == null;

		public override bool MoveNextEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (((WizardPageBase<TView, TModel>)this).GetNextPageType() == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (base.View.ShouldCreateNewConnection)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return DataConnection != null;
			}
		}

		[Dependency]
		protected UrlResolver UrlResolver { get; set; }

		[Dependency]
		public IParameterService ParameterService { get; set; }

		public ChooseExistingConnectionPageBase(TView view, IWizardRunnerContext context, IConnectionStorageService connectionStorageService, IMongoDBConnectionStorageService mongoDBConnectionStorageService, IJsonConnectionStorageService jsonConnectionStorageService)
			: base(view)
		{
			this.context = context;
			this.connectionStorageService = connectionStorageService;
			this.mongoDBConnectionStorageService = mongoDBConnectionStorageService;
			this.jsonConnectionStorageService = jsonConnectionStorageService;
			InitializeConnections();
		}

		protected virtual void InitializeConnections()
		{
			connections = new List<IDataConnection>();
			foreach (SqlDataConnection item in connectionStorageService?.GetConnections()?.Where((SqlDataConnection dc) => DataConnectionHelper.IsAcceptableSqlConnectionString(dc.ConnectionString)))
			{
				connections.Add(item);
			}
			foreach (MongoDBDataConnection item2 in mongoDBConnectionStorageService?.GetConnections())
			{
				connections.Add(item2);
			}
			foreach (JsonDataConnection item3 in jsonConnectionStorageService?.GetConnections())
			{
				connections.Add(item3);
			}
		}

		public override Type GetNextPageType()
		{
			if (base.View.ShouldCreateNewConnection)
			{
				return typeof(ChooseDataProviderPage<TModel>);
			}
			if (DataConnection != null)
			{
				if (DataConnection is SqlDataConnection)
				{
					if (connectionStorageService.CanSaveConnection || (((SqlDataConnection)DataConnection).HasSensitiveInfo && DatabaseCredentialsSavingBehavior == SensitiveInfoSavingBehavior.Prompt))
					{
						return typeof(SaveConnectionPage<TModel>);
					}
					if (!SqlOptions.HasFlag(SqlWizardOptions.MultiQueryWizard))
					{
						return typeof(ConfigureQueryPage<TModel>);
					}
					return typeof(MultiQueryConfigurePage<TModel>);
				}
				if (DataConnection is JsonDataConnection)
				{
					return typeof(ChooseJsonSchemaPage<TModel>);
				}
				if (DataConnection is MongoDBDataConnection)
				{
					if (!(DataConnection as MongoDBDataConnection).StoreConnectionNameOnly && mongoDBConnectionStorageService.CanSaveConnection)
					{
						return typeof(SaveMongoDBConnectionPage<TModel>);
					}
					return typeof(ConfigureMongoDBQueriesPage<TModel>);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override void Begin()
		{
			base.View.Changed += View_Changed;
			base.View.AllowNewConnection(GetEnabledNewConnection());
			base.View.SetConnections((from x in connections
				select x.Name into x
				orderby x
				select x).ToList());
		}

		protected virtual bool GetEnabledNewConnection()
		{
			if (!DataSourceTypes.Any((DataSourceType x) => x != DataSourceType.Xpo && x != DataSourceType.Json && x != DataSourceType.MongoDB) && (SqlOptions.HasFlag(SqlWizardOptions.DisableNewConnections) || !DataSourceTypes.Contains(DataSourceType.Xpo)) && (JsonOptions.HasFlag(JsonWizardOptions.DisableNewConnections) || !DataSourceTypes.Contains(DataSourceType.Json)))
			{
				if (!MongoDBOptions.HasFlag(MongoDBWizardOptions.DisableNewConnections))
				{
					return DataSourceTypes.Contains(DataSourceType.MongoDB);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void View_Changed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			base.RaiseChanged();
		}

		public override bool Validate(out string errorMessage)
		{
			errorMessage = string.Empty;
			if (base.View.ShouldCreateNewConnection)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (DataConnection is SqlDataConnection)
			{
				return ConnectionHelper.ValidateConnection((SqlDataConnection)DataConnection, ((IUIRunnerContext)context).CreateExceptionHandler((ExceptionHandlerKind)1), WaitFormActivator);
			}
			if (DataConnection is JsonDataConnection)
			{
				return ConnectionHelper.ValidateJsonDataConnection((JsonDataConnection)DataConnection, ((IJsonDataSourceModel)base.Model)?.SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount, ParameterService, ((IUIRunnerContext)context).CreateExceptionHandler((ExceptionHandlerKind)2), WaitFormActivator, UrlResolver, delegate(JsonDataSource ds)
				{
					schema = ds.Schema;
					root = ds.RootElement;
				});
			}
			if (DataConnection is MongoDBDataConnection)
			{
				return ConnectionHelper.ValidateMongoDBDataConnection((MongoDBDataConnection)DataConnection, WaitFormActivator, ((IUIRunnerContext)context).CreateExceptionHandler((ExceptionHandlerKind)2), out errorMessage);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override void Commit()
		{
			base.View.Changed -= View_Changed;
			if (!base.View.ShouldCreateNewConnection && !base.View.ShouldCreateNewConnection)
			{
				if (DataConnection is SqlDataConnection)
				{
					CommitSqlDataConnection();
				}
				if (DataConnection is JsonDataConnection)
				{
					CommitJsonDataConnection();
				}
				if (DataConnection is MongoDBDataConnection)
				{
					CommitMongoDBDataConnection();
				}
			}
		}

		private void CommitSqlDataConnection()
		{
			base.Model.DataSourceType = DataSourceType.Xpo;
			ISqlDataSourceModel model = base.Model;
			model.DataConnection = DataConnection as SqlDataConnection;
			model.ConnectionName = DataConnection.Name;
			model.ShouldSaveConnection = ((DataConnection.StoreConnectionNameOnly || connectionStorageService.CanSaveConnection) ? SaveConnectionMethod.SaveToAppConfig : SaveConnectionMethod.Hardcode);
			if (DatabaseCredentialsSavingBehavior == SensitiveInfoSavingBehavior.Always)
			{
				TModel model2 = base.Model;
				SaveConnectionMethod shouldSaveConnection = model2.ShouldSaveConnection | SaveConnectionMethod.KeepCredentials;
				model2.ShouldSaveConnection = shouldSaveConnection;
			}
		}

		private void CommitJsonDataConnection()
		{
			base.Model.DataSourceType = DataSourceType.Json;
			IJsonDataSourceModel model = base.Model;
			if (model.JsonSchema != null && model.ConnectionName == DataConnection.Name)
			{
				JsonSchemaNode.ApplySelectedState(model.JsonSchema, schema);
			}
			model.JsonSchema = schema;
			model.RootElement = root;
			model.DataConnection = DataConnection as JsonDataConnection;
			model.ConnectionName = DataConnection.Name;
			model.ShouldSaveConnection = ((DataConnection.StoreConnectionNameOnly || jsonConnectionStorageService.CanSaveConnection) ? SaveConnectionMethod.SaveToAppConfig : SaveConnectionMethod.Hardcode);
			if (JsonCredentialsSavingBehavior == JsonSensitiveInfoSavingBehavior.Always)
			{
				TModel model2 = base.Model;
				SaveConnectionMethod shouldSaveConnection = model2.ShouldSaveConnection | SaveConnectionMethod.KeepCredentials;
				model2.ShouldSaveConnection = shouldSaveConnection;
			}
		}

		private void CommitMongoDBDataConnection()
		{
			base.Model.DataSourceType = DataSourceType.MongoDB;
			IMongoDBDataSourceModel model = base.Model;
			model.DataConnection = DataConnection as MongoDBDataConnection;
			model.ConnectionName = DataConnection.Name;
			model.ShouldSaveConnection = ((DataConnection.StoreConnectionNameOnly || mongoDBConnectionStorageService.CanSaveConnection) ? SaveConnectionMethod.SaveToAppConfig : SaveConnectionMethod.Hardcode);
			if (MongoDBCredentialsSavingBehavior == MongoDBSensitiveInfoSavingBehavior.Always)
			{
				TModel model2 = base.Model;
				SaveConnectionMethod shouldSaveConnection = model2.ShouldSaveConnection | SaveConnectionMethod.KeepCredentials;
				model2.ShouldSaveConnection = shouldSaveConnection;
			}
		}
	}
	public class ChooseJsonConnectionPage<TModel> : WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonConnectionPageView, TModel> where TModel : class, IJsonDataSourceModel
	{
		private readonly IEnumerable<JsonDataConnection> dataConnections;

		private JsonSchemaNode schema;

		private string root;

		private IJsonConnectionStorageService JsonConnectionStorageService { get; }

		private IWizardRunnerContext Context { get; }

		[Dependency]
		protected UrlResolver UrlResolver { get; set; }

		[Dependency]
		public IParameterService ParameterService { get; set; }

		[Dependency]
		protected JsonSensitiveInfoSavingBehavior CredentialsSavingBehavior { get; set; }

		protected JsonDataConnection DataConnection => dataConnections.FirstOrDefault((JsonDataConnection c) => ((INamedItem)c).Name == ((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonConnectionPageView, IChooseJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.ExistingConnectionName);

		public override bool MoveNextEnabled => true;

		public ChooseJsonConnectionPage(IChooseJsonConnectionPageView view, IWizardRunnerContext context, IJsonConnectionStorageService jsonConnectionStorageService)
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonConnectionPageView, IChooseJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this)..ctor(view);
			Context = context;
			JsonConnectionStorageService = jsonConnectionStorageService;
			dataConnections = jsonConnectionStorageService.GetConnections();
			UrlResolver = UrlResolver.Instance;
		}

		public override void Begin()
		{
			Dictionary<string, string> dictionary = dataConnections.ToDictionary((JsonDataConnection i) => i.Name, (JsonDataConnection c) => ((INamedItem)c).Name);
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonConnectionPageView, IChooseJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.SetConnections(dictionary.Values);
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonConnectionPageView, IChooseJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.Changed += View_Changed;
			string text = ((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonConnectionPageView, IChooseJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection?.Name;
			if (text != null)
			{
				if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(text, out var value))
				{
					value = ((INamedItem)((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonConnectionPageView, IChooseJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection).Name;
				}
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonConnectionPageView, IChooseJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.SetSelectedConnection(value);
			}
			else
			{
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonConnectionPageView, IChooseJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.SetSelectedConnection(dictionary.FirstOrDefault().Value);
			}
		}

		private void View_Changed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonConnectionPageView, IChooseJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).RaiseChanged();
		}

		public override bool Validate(out string errorMessage)
		{
			if (!((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonConnectionPageView, IChooseJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.ShouldCreateNewConnection)
			{
				errorMessage = null;
				IExceptionHandler exceptionHandler = ((IUIRunnerContext)Context).CreateExceptionHandler((ExceptionHandlerKind)2);
				return ConnectionHelper.ValidateJsonDataConnection(DataConnection, ((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonConnectionPageView, IChooseJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model?.SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount, ParameterService, exceptionHandler, Context.WaitFormActivator, UrlResolver, delegate(JsonDataSource ds)
				{
					schema = ds.Schema;
					root = ds.RootElement;
				});
			}
			return ((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonConnectionPageView, IChooseJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Validate(ref errorMessage);
		}

		public override void Commit()
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonConnectionPageView, IChooseJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.Changed -= View_Changed;
			if (!((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonConnectionPageView, IChooseJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.ShouldCreateNewConnection)
			{
				if (((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonConnectionPageView, IChooseJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.JsonSchema != null && ((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonConnectionPageView, IChooseJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.ConnectionName == DataConnection.Name)
				{
					JsonSchemaNode.ApplySelectedState(((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonConnectionPageView, IChooseJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.JsonSchema, schema);
				}
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonConnectionPageView, IChooseJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.JsonSchema = schema;
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonConnectionPageView, IChooseJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.RootElement = root;
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonConnectionPageView, IChooseJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection = DataConnection;
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonConnectionPageView, IChooseJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.ConnectionName = DataConnection.Name;
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonConnectionPageView, IChooseJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.ShouldSaveConnection = ((DataConnection.StoreConnectionNameOnly || JsonConnectionStorageService.CanSaveConnection) ? SaveConnectionMethod.SaveToAppConfig : SaveConnectionMethod.Hardcode);
				if (CredentialsSavingBehavior == JsonSensitiveInfoSavingBehavior.Always)
				{
					TModel model = ((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonConnectionPageView, IChooseJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model;
					SaveConnectionMethod shouldSaveConnection = model.ShouldSaveConnection | SaveConnectionMethod.KeepCredentials;
					model.ShouldSaveConnection = shouldSaveConnection;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonConnectionPageView, IChooseJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.ConnectionName = string.Empty;
			}
		}

		public override Type GetNextPageType()
		{
			if (((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonConnectionPageView, IChooseJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.ShouldCreateNewConnection)
			{
				return typeof(ChooseJsonSourcePage<TModel>);
			}
			return typeof(ChooseJsonSchemaPage<TModel>);
		}
	}
	public class ChooseJsonSchemaPage<TModel> : WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSchemaPageView, TModel> where TModel : class, IJsonDataSourceModel
	{
		private readonly IWizardRunnerContext context;

		public override bool MoveNextEnabled => false;

		public override bool FinishEnabled => CanMoveForward();

		[Dependency]
		protected UrlResolver UrlResolver { get; set; }

		[Dependency]
		protected IParameterService ParameterService { get; set; }

		[Dependency]
		protected IWizardRunnerContext Context { get; set; }

		public ChooseJsonSchemaPage(IChooseJsonSchemaPageView view, IWizardRunnerContext context)
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSchemaPageView, IChooseJsonSchemaPageView>)(object)this)..ctor(view);
			this.context = context;
			UrlResolver = UrlResolver.Instance;
		}

		public override void Begin()
		{
			if (((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSchemaPageView, IChooseJsonSchemaPageView>)(object)this).Model.JsonSchema != null)
			{
				string rootElement = ((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSchemaPageView, IChooseJsonSchemaPageView>)(object)this).Model.RootElement;
				string rootElement2 = ((!string.IsNullOrEmpty(rootElement)) ? (((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSchemaPageView, IChooseJsonSchemaPageView>)(object)this).Model.JsonSchema.Name + "." + rootElement) : ((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSchemaPageView, IChooseJsonSchemaPageView>)(object)this).Model.JsonSchema.Name);
				string[] roots = ((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSchemaPageView, IChooseJsonSchemaPageView>)(object)this).Model.JsonSchema.RootNames.ToArray();
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSchemaPageView, IChooseJsonSchemaPageView>)(object)this).View.Initialize(((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSchemaPageView, IChooseJsonSchemaPageView>)(object)this).Model.JsonSchema, rootElement2, roots, ((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSchemaPageView, IChooseJsonSchemaPageView>)(object)this).Model.SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount, ((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSchemaPageView, IChooseJsonSchemaPageView>)(object)this).Model.JsonSchema.DiscoveryLimitApplied);
			}
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSchemaPageView, IChooseJsonSchemaPageView>)(object)this).View.AnalyzeAllRecordsRequested += ViewOnAnalyzeAllRecordsRequested;
		}

		private void ViewOnAnalyzeAllRecordsRequested(object sender, AnalyzeAllRecordsArgs e)
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSchemaPageView, IChooseJsonSchemaPageView>)(object)this).View.AnalyzeAllRecordsRequested -= ViewOnAnalyzeAllRecordsRequested;
			IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters = ParameterServiceHelper.GetSourceParameters(ParameterService);
			JsonDataSource dataSource = new JsonDataSource
			{
				SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount = 0
			};
			ServiceContainerExtensions.ReplaceService<UrlResolver>((IServiceContainer)dataSource, UrlResolver, false);
			try
			{
				JsonSchemaNode jsonSchema = ((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSchemaPageView, IChooseJsonSchemaPageView>)(object)this).Model.JsonSchema;
				JsonSchemaNode jsonSchemaNode = AsyncHelper.LoadAsync(delegate
				{
					dataSource.JsonSource = ((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSchemaPageView, IChooseJsonSchemaPageView>)(object)this).Model.JsonSource;
					dataSource.Fill(sourceParameters);
					return dataSource.Schema;
				}, Context.WaitFormActivator, ((IUIRunnerContext)Context).CreateExceptionHandler((ExceptionHandlerKind)2));
				if (jsonSchemaNode != null)
				{
					if (jsonSchema != null)
					{
						JsonSchemaNode.ApplySelectedState(jsonSchema, jsonSchemaNode);
					}
					e.Schema = jsonSchemaNode;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				dataSource.Dispose();
			}
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSchemaPageView, IChooseJsonSchemaPageView>)(object)this).View.AnalyzeAllRecordsRequested += ViewOnAnalyzeAllRecordsRequested;
		}

		public override bool Validate(out string errorMessage)
		{
			errorMessage = null;
			bool flag = CanMoveForward();
			if (!flag)
			{
				context.ShowMessage(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.WizardPageChooseJsonSchema_EmptySelection));
			}
			return flag;
		}

		protected bool CanMoveForward()
		{
			return ((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSchemaPageView, IChooseJsonSchemaPageView>)(object)this).View.Schema?.Any((JsonSchemaNode node) => node.Value.Selected.HasValue && node.Value.Selected.Value) ?? false;
		}

		public override void Commit()
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSchemaPageView, IChooseJsonSchemaPageView>)(object)this).Model.JsonSchema = ((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSchemaPageView, IChooseJsonSchemaPageView>)(object)this).View.Schema.First();
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSchemaPageView, IChooseJsonSchemaPageView>)(object)this).Model.RootElement = Regex.Replace(((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSchemaPageView, IChooseJsonSchemaPageView>)(object)this).View.RootElement, "^" + ((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSchemaPageView, IChooseJsonSchemaPageView>)(object)this).Model.JsonSchema.Name + "\\.?", string.Empty);
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSchemaPageView, IChooseJsonSchemaPageView>)(object)this).View.AnalyzeAllRecordsRequested -= ViewOnAnalyzeAllRecordsRequested;
		}
	}
	public class ChooseConnectionPage<TModel> : ChooseConnectionPageBase<TModel> where TModel : class, ISqlDataSourceModel
	{
		protected override Type SaveConnectionPageType => typeof(SaveConnectionPage<TModel>);

		protected override Type ConfigureConnectionPropertiesPage => typeof(ConnectionPropertiesPage<TModel>);

		[Dependency]
		public DataSourceWizardSettings DataSourceWizardSettings { get; set; }

		protected Type ConfigureQueryPageType
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.Options.HasFlag(SqlWizardOptions.MultiQueryWizard))
				{
					return typeof(ConfigureQueryPage<TModel>);
				}
				return typeof(MultiQueryConfigurePage<TModel>);
			}
		}

		public ChooseConnectionPage(IChooseConnectionPageView view, IWizardRunnerContext context, IConnectionStorageService connectionStorageService, SqlWizardOptions options, SensitiveInfoSavingBehavior databaseCredentialsSavingBehavior)
			: base(view, context, connectionStorageService, options, databaseCredentialsSavingBehavior)
		{
		}

		public override Type GetNextPageType()
		{
			if (!base.DisableNewConnections && ((WizardPageBase<IChooseConnectionPageView, IChooseConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.ShouldCreateNewConnection)
			{
				return ConfigureConnectionPropertiesPage;
			}
			if (base.DataConnection != null && base.DataConnection.StoreConnectionNameOnly)
			{
				return ConfigureQueryPageType;
			}
			if (base.ConnectionStorageService.CanSaveConnection)
			{
				return SaveConnectionPageType;
			}
			if (base.DataConnection != null && base.DataConnection.HasSensitiveInfo && base.DatabaseCredentialsSavingBehavior == SensitiveInfoSavingBehavior.Prompt)
			{
				return SaveConnectionPageType;
			}
			return ConfigureQueryPageType;
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<SqlDataConnection> FilterDataConnections(IEnumerable<SqlDataConnection> sqlDataConnections)
		{
			List<SqlDataConnection> result = sqlDataConnections.Where((SqlDataConnection dc) => DataConnectionHelper.IsAcceptableSqlConnectionString(dc.ConnectionString)).ToList();
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(base.ProviderKey) && DataSourceWizardSettings.UseMergedConnectionTypePage)
			{
				result = result.FilterByProviderKey(base.ProviderKey).ToList();
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	public class ChooseJsonSourcePage<TModel> : WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, TModel> where TModel : class, IJsonDataSourceModel
	{
		private class StubParameter : IParameter, IFilterParameter
		{
			public string Name { get; }

			public object Value { get; set; }

			public Type Type => typeof(string);

			public StubParameter(string name, object value)
			{
				Name = name;
				Value = value;
			}
		}

		private JsonDataConnection dataConnection;

		private JsonSchemaNode schema;

		private string root;

		private IWizardRunnerContext Context { get; }

		private IJsonConnectionStorageService ConnectionStorageService { get; }

		[Dependency]
		public IParameterService ParameterService { get; set; }

		[Dependency]
		protected UrlResolver UrlResolver { get; set; }

		[Dependency]
		protected JsonSensitiveInfoSavingBehavior CredentialsSavingBehavior { get; set; }

		private bool AlwaysSaveCredentials => CredentialsSavingBehavior == JsonSensitiveInfoSavingBehavior.Always;

		public override bool MoveNextEnabled => !IsEmpty();

		public override bool FinishEnabled => false;

		public ChooseJsonSourcePage(IChooseJsonSourcePageView view, IWizardRunnerContext context, IJsonConnectionStorageService connectionStorageService)
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this)..ctor(view);
			Context = context;
			ConnectionStorageService = connectionStorageService;
			UrlResolver = UrlResolver.Instance;
		}

		public override void Begin()
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).View.Changed += ViewOnChanged;
			dataConnection = ((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection?.Clone();
			SetUriParameters(dataConnection);
			JsonSourceBase jsonSourceBase = ((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection?.GetJsonSource();
			if (jsonSourceBase != null)
			{
				if (jsonSourceBase is UriJsonSource uriJsonSource)
				{
					SetConnectionTypeAndUri(uriJsonSource.Uri);
				}
				else if (jsonSourceBase is CustomJsonSource customJsonSource)
				{
					((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).View.ConnectionType = JsonConnectionType.Custom;
					((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).View.Json = customJsonSource.Json;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).View.ConnectionType = JsonConnectionType.Uri;
			}
		}

		private void SetUriParameters(JsonDataConnection connection)
		{
			UriJsonSource uriJsonSource = connection?.GetJsonSource() as UriJsonSource;
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).View.PathParameters = uriJsonSource?.PathParameters;
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).View.QueryParameters = uriJsonSource?.QueryParameters;
		}

		private void SetConnectionTypeAndUri(Uri uri)
		{
			if (uri == null)
			{
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).View.ConnectionType = JsonConnectionType.Uri;
			}
			else if (IsFileUri(uri))
			{
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).View.ConnectionType = JsonConnectionType.File;
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).View.FilePath = (uri.IsAbsoluteUri ? uri.LocalPath : uri.ToString());
			}
			else
			{
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).View.ConnectionType = JsonConnectionType.Uri;
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).View.Uri = uri.ToString();
			}
		}

		private bool IsFileUri(Uri uri)
		{
			if (uri.IsAbsoluteUri)
			{
				return uri.IsFile;
			}
			if (TryGetAbsoluteUri(uri.OriginalString, out var absoluteUri))
			{
				return absoluteUri.IsFile;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool TryGetAbsoluteUri(string uriOriginalString, out Uri absoluteUri)
		{
			try
			{
				absoluteUri = null;
				string uriString = default(string);
				if (!UrlResolver.TryMapPath(uriOriginalString, ref uriString))
				{
					return false;
				}
				absoluteUri = new Uri(uriString, UriKind.RelativeOrAbsolute);
				return true;
			}
			catch
			{
				absoluteUri = null;
				return false;
			}
		}

		public override bool Validate(out string errorMessage)
		{
			errorMessage = null;
			if (IsEmpty())
			{
				return false;
			}
			JsonDataConnection connection;
			try
			{
				connection = GetConnection();
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				Context.ShowMessage(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.WizardPageChooseJsonSource_DataLocationMismatch));
				return false;
			}
			if (!ValidateConnectionType(connection, out errorMessage))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).View.ConnectionType == JsonConnectionType.Uri)
			{
				return true;
			}
			IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters = ParameterServiceHelper.GetSourceParameters(ParameterService);
			JsonDataSource dataSource = new JsonDataSource
			{
				SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount = ((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).Model.SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount
			};
			ServiceContainerExtensions.ReplaceService<UrlResolver>((IServiceContainer)dataSource, UrlResolver, false);
			try
			{
				return AsyncHelper.DoWithWaitForm(delegate
				{
					JsonSourceBase jsonSourceBase = GetConnection().GetJsonSource().Clone();
					jsonSourceBase.RootElement = null;
					dataSource.JsonSource = jsonSourceBase;
					dataSource.Fill(sourceParameters);
					schema = dataSource.Schema;
					root = dataSource.RootElement;
				}, Context.WaitFormActivator, ((IUIRunnerContext)Context).CreateExceptionHandler((ExceptionHandlerKind)2));
			}
			catch (Exception ex2)
			{
				errorMessage = ex2.Message;
				return false;
			}
			finally
			{
				dataSource.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private bool ValidateConnectionType(JsonDataConnection connection, out string errorMessage)
		{
			errorMessage = null;
			if (((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).View.ConnectionType == JsonConnectionType.Uri || ((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).View.ConnectionType == JsonConnectionType.File)
			{
				Uri absoluteUri = ((UriJsonSource)connection.GetJsonSource()).Uri;
				if ((!absoluteUri.IsAbsoluteUri && !TryGetAbsoluteUri(absoluteUri.OriginalString, out absoluteUri)) || (((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).View.ConnectionType == JsonConnectionType.Uri && absoluteUri.IsFile) || (((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).View.ConnectionType == JsonConnectionType.File && !absoluteUri.IsFile))
				{
					Context.ShowMessage(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.WizardPageChooseJsonSource_UnknownFormat));
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override void Commit()
		{
			if (!IsEmpty())
			{
				JsonDataConnection connection = GetConnection();
				if (((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).Model.JsonSchema != null && schema != null)
				{
					JsonSourceBase jsonSource = connection.GetJsonSource();
					JsonSourceBase obj = ((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection?.GetJsonSource();
					if (jsonSource.Equals(obj) && ((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).Model.JsonSchema != null)
					{
						JsonSchemaNode.ApplySelectedState(((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).Model.JsonSchema, schema);
					}
				}
				if (schema != null)
				{
					((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).Model.JsonSchema = schema;
					((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).Model.RootElement = root;
				}
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection = connection;
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).Model.ShouldSaveConnection = ((ConnectionStorageService.CanSaveConnection && ((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).View.ConnectionType != JsonConnectionType.Custom) ? SaveConnectionMethod.SaveToAppConfig : SaveConnectionMethod.Hardcode);
				if (AlwaysSaveCredentials)
				{
					TModel model = ((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).Model;
					SaveConnectionMethod shouldSaveConnection = model.ShouldSaveConnection | SaveConnectionMethod.KeepCredentials;
					model.ShouldSaveConnection = shouldSaveConnection;
				}
			}
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).View.Changed -= ViewOnChanged;
		}

		public override Type GetNextPageType()
		{
			if (((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).View.ConnectionType == JsonConnectionType.Uri)
			{
				return typeof(ConfigureJsonConnectionPage<TModel>);
			}
			if (((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).View.ConnectionType == JsonConnectionType.Custom)
			{
				return typeof(ChooseJsonSchemaPage<TModel>);
			}
			if (ConnectionStorageService.CanSaveConnection)
			{
				return typeof(SaveJsonConnectionPage<TModel>);
			}
			return typeof(ChooseJsonSchemaPage<TModel>);
		}

		protected virtual void ViewOnChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).View.ConnectionType == JsonConnectionType.Uri)
			{
				UpdateResultUriEditor();
			}
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).RaiseChanged();
		}

		private bool IsEmpty()
		{
			switch (((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).View.ConnectionType)
			{
			case JsonConnectionType.Custom:
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).View.Json))
				{
					return true;
				}
				break;
			case JsonConnectionType.Uri:
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).View.Uri))
				{
					return true;
				}
				break;
			case JsonConnectionType.File:
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).View.FilePath))
				{
					return true;
				}
				break;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private JsonDataConnection GetConnection()
		{
			JsonSourceBase jsonSourceBase = dataConnection?.GetJsonSource();
			switch (((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).View.ConnectionType)
			{
			case JsonConnectionType.Custom:
			{
				CustomJsonSource customJsonSource = (jsonSourceBase as CustomJsonSource) ?? new CustomJsonSource();
				jsonSourceBase = customJsonSource;
				customJsonSource.Json = ((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).View.Json;
				break;
			}
			case JsonConnectionType.Uri:
			{
				UriJsonSource uriJsonSource2 = (jsonSourceBase as UriJsonSource) ?? new UriJsonSource();
				jsonSourceBase = uriJsonSource2;
				uriJsonSource2.Uri = new Uri(((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).View.Uri, UriKind.RelativeOrAbsolute);
				PathParameterCollection pathParameters = ((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).View.PathParameters;
				if (pathParameters != null)
				{
					uriJsonSource2.PathParameters.Clear();
					uriJsonSource2.PathParameters.AddRange(pathParameters.ToArray());
				}
				QueryParameterCollection queryParameters = ((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).View.QueryParameters;
				if (queryParameters != null)
				{
					uriJsonSource2.QueryParameters.Clear();
					uriJsonSource2.QueryParameters.AddRange(queryParameters.ToArray());
				}
				break;
			}
			case JsonConnectionType.File:
			{
				UriJsonSource uriJsonSource = (jsonSourceBase as UriJsonSource) ?? new UriJsonSource();
				jsonSourceBase = uriJsonSource;
				uriJsonSource.Uri = new Uri(((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).View.FilePath, UriKind.RelativeOrAbsolute);
				break;
			}
			default:
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
			}
			return new JsonDataConnection(jsonSourceBase);
		}

		private void UpdateResultUriEditor()
		{
			Uri displayUri = GetDisplayUri(((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).View.Uri, ((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).View.PathParameters);
			IEnumerable<StubParameter> queryParameters = ((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).View.QueryParameters?.Select((DevExpress.DataAccess.Json.QueryParameter x) => new StubParameter(x.Name, "{?}")) ?? Enumerable.Empty<StubParameter>();
			Uri uri = null;
			if (displayUri != null)
			{
				uri = UriJsonSource.AppendQuerySegment(displayUri, displayUri?.Query, (IEnumerable<IParameter>)queryParameters, escapeValues: false);
			}
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseJsonSourcePageView, IChooseJsonSourcePageView>)(object)this).View.SetResultUri(uri?.OriginalString ?? string.Empty);
		}

		private static Uri GetDisplayUri(string originalUri, IEnumerable<PathParameter> parameters)
		{
			if (!Uri.TryCreate(originalUri, UriKind.Absolute, out var result))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (parameters == null)
			{
				return result;
			}
			string[] pathSegments = parameters.Select((PathParameter x) => "{" + x.Name + "}").ToArray();
			try
			{
				return UriJsonSource.AppendPathSegment(result, pathSegments);
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
		}
	}
	public class ChooseMongoDBConnectionPage<TModel> : WizardPageBase<IChooseMongoDBConnectionPageView, TModel> where TModel : class, IMongoDBDataSourceModel
	{
		public override bool FinishEnabled => ((WizardPageBase<IChooseMongoDBConnectionPageView, IChooseMongoDBConnectionPageView>)(object)this).GetNextPageType() == null;

		public override bool MoveNextEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (((WizardPageBase<IChooseMongoDBConnectionPageView, IChooseMongoDBConnectionPageView>)(object)this).GetNextPageType() == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!DisableNewConnections && ((WizardPageBase<IChooseMongoDBConnectionPageView, IChooseMongoDBConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.ShouldCreateNewConnection)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return DataConnection != null;
			}
		}

		protected virtual Type QueryBuilderPageType => typeof(ConfigureMongoDBQueriesPage<TModel>);

		protected virtual IExceptionHandler ExceptionHandler => ((IUIRunnerContext)Context).CreateExceptionHandler((ExceptionHandlerKind)1);

		protected IMongoDBConnectionStorageService ConnectionStorageService { get; }

		[Dependency]
		protected MongoDBSensitiveInfoSavingBehavior DatabaseCredentialsSavingBehavior { get; set; }

		protected bool AlwaysSaveCredentials => DatabaseCredentialsSavingBehavior == MongoDBSensitiveInfoSavingBehavior.Always;

		protected bool DisableNewConnections => Options.HasFlag(MongoDBWizardOptions.DisableNewConnections);

		[Dependency]
		protected MongoDBWizardOptions Options { get; set; }

		protected MongoDBDataConnection DataConnection => DataConnections.FirstOrDefault((MongoDBDataConnection c) => ((INamedItem)c).Name == ((WizardPageBase<IChooseMongoDBConnectionPageView, IChooseMongoDBConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.ExistingConnectionName);

		private IWizardRunnerContext Context { get; }

		private IEnumerable<MongoDBDataConnection> DataConnections { get; }

		public ChooseMongoDBConnectionPage(IChooseMongoDBConnectionPageView view, IWizardRunnerContext context, IMongoDBConnectionStorageService connectionStorageService)
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseMongoDBConnectionPageView, IChooseMongoDBConnectionPageView>)(object)this)..ctor(view);
			Context = context;
			ConnectionStorageService = connectionStorageService;
			DataConnections = connectionStorageService?.GetConnections() ?? Enumerable.Empty<MongoDBDataConnection>();
		}

		public override void Begin()
		{
			Dictionary<string, string> dictionary = DataConnections.ToDictionary((MongoDBDataConnection i) => i.Name, (MongoDBDataConnection c) => ((INamedItem)c).Name);
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseMongoDBConnectionPageView, IChooseMongoDBConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.SetConnections(dictionary.Values);
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseMongoDBConnectionPageView, IChooseMongoDBConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.Changed += View_Changed;
			string text = ((WizardPageBase<IChooseMongoDBConnectionPageView, IChooseMongoDBConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection?.Name;
			if (text != null)
			{
				if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(text, out var value))
				{
					value = ((INamedItem)((WizardPageBase<IChooseMongoDBConnectionPageView, IChooseMongoDBConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection).Name;
				}
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseMongoDBConnectionPageView, IChooseMongoDBConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.SetSelectedConnection(value);
			}
			else
			{
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseMongoDBConnectionPageView, IChooseMongoDBConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.SetSelectedConnection(dictionary.FirstOrDefault().Value);
			}
		}

		private void View_Changed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseMongoDBConnectionPageView, IChooseMongoDBConnectionPageView>)(object)this).RaiseChanged();
		}

		public override bool Validate(out string errorMessage)
		{
			errorMessage = string.Empty;
			if (!((WizardPageBase<IChooseMongoDBConnectionPageView, IChooseMongoDBConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.ShouldCreateNewConnection)
			{
				return ConnectionHelper.ValidateMongoDBDataConnection(DataConnection, Context.WaitFormActivator, ((IUIRunnerContext)Context).CreateExceptionHandler((ExceptionHandlerKind)2), out errorMessage);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override void Commit()
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseMongoDBConnectionPageView, IChooseMongoDBConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.Changed -= View_Changed;
			if (!((WizardPageBase<IChooseMongoDBConnectionPageView, IChooseMongoDBConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.ShouldCreateNewConnection)
			{
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseMongoDBConnectionPageView, IChooseMongoDBConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection = DataConnection;
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseMongoDBConnectionPageView, IChooseMongoDBConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.ConnectionName = DataConnection.Name;
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseMongoDBConnectionPageView, IChooseMongoDBConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.ShouldSaveConnection = ((DataConnection.StoreConnectionNameOnly || ConnectionStorageService.CanSaveConnection) ? SaveConnectionMethod.SaveToAppConfig : SaveConnectionMethod.Hardcode);
				if (AlwaysSaveCredentials)
				{
					TModel model = ((WizardPageBase<IChooseMongoDBConnectionPageView, IChooseMongoDBConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model;
					SaveConnectionMethod shouldSaveConnection = model.ShouldSaveConnection | SaveConnectionMethod.KeepCredentials;
					model.ShouldSaveConnection = shouldSaveConnection;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseMongoDBConnectionPageView, IChooseMongoDBConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.ConnectionName = null;
			}
		}

		public override Type GetNextPageType()
		{
			if (!DisableNewConnections && ((WizardPageBase<IChooseMongoDBConnectionPageView, IChooseMongoDBConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.ShouldCreateNewConnection)
			{
				return typeof(ConfigureMongoDBConnectionPage<TModel>);
			}
			if (DataConnection != null && !DataConnection.StoreConnectionNameOnly && ConnectionStorageService.CanSaveConnection)
			{
				return typeof(SaveMongoDBConnectionPage<TModel>);
			}
			return QueryBuilderPageType;
		}
	}

	public class ChooseMongoDBSchemaPage<TModel> : WizardPageBase<IChooseMongoDBSchemaPageView, TModel> where TModel : class, IMongoDBDataSourceModel
	{
		private readonly IWizardRunnerContext context;

		private ResultCollection[] resultSchema;

		public override bool MoveNextEnabled => false;

		public override bool FinishEnabled => true;

		[Dependency]
		protected UrlResolver UrlResolver { get; set; }

		[Dependency]
		protected IWizardRunnerContext Context { get; set; }

		private IExceptionHandler ExceptionHandler => ((IUIRunnerContext)Context).CreateExceptionHandler((ExceptionHandlerKind)0);

		private IWaitFormActivator WaitFormActivator => context.WaitFormActivator;

		public ChooseMongoDBSchemaPage(IChooseMongoDBSchemaPageView view, IWizardRunnerContext context)
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseMongoDBSchemaPageView, IChooseMongoDBSchemaPageView>)(object)this)..ctor(view);
			this.context = context;
			UrlResolver = UrlResolver.Instance;
		}

		public override void Begin()
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseMongoDBSchemaPageView, IChooseMongoDBSchemaPageView>)(object)this).View.Initialize(((WizardPageBase<IChooseMongoDBSchemaPageView, IChooseMongoDBSchemaPageView>)(object)this).Model.Queries.Where((MongoDBQuery q) => q.Schema != null).ToDictionary((MongoDBQuery q) => q.ActualName, (MongoDBQuery q) => q.Schema), ((WizardPageBase<IChooseMongoDBSchemaPageView, IChooseMongoDBSchemaPageView>)(object)this).Model.SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount);
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseMongoDBSchemaPageView, IChooseMongoDBSchemaPageView>)(object)this).View.AnalyzeAllDocumentsRequested += ViewOnAnalyzeAllDocumentsRequested;
		}

		public override bool Validate(out string errorMessage)
		{
			errorMessage = null;
			string[] array = (from p in ((WizardPageBase<IChooseMongoDBSchemaPageView, IChooseMongoDBSchemaPageView>)(object)this).View.QuerySchemas
				where !p.Value.AnySelected
				select p.Key).ToArray();
			if (array.Length != 0)
			{
				context.ShowMessage(string.Format(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.WizardPageChooseMongoDBSchema_EmptySelection), string.Join(", ", array)));
				return false;
			}
			try
			{
				List<MongoDBQuery> list = ((WizardPageBase<IChooseMongoDBSchemaPageView, IChooseMongoDBSchemaPageView>)(object)this).Model.Queries.Select((MongoDBQuery q) => q.Clone()).ToList();
				foreach (KeyValuePair<string, MongoDBSchemaNode> schema in ((WizardPageBase<IChooseMongoDBSchemaPageView, IChooseMongoDBSchemaPageView>)(object)this).View.QuerySchemas)
				{
					MongoDBQuery mongoDBQuery = list.Find((MongoDBQuery q) => q.ActualName == schema.Key);
					mongoDBQuery.Schema = new MongoDBSchemaNode(mongoDBQuery.ActualName, MongoDBSchemaHelper.CreateMongoDBType(mongoDBQuery.Schema));
				}
				resultSchema = DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.MongoDB.QueryExecutor.ExecuteQueries(((WizardPageBase<IChooseMongoDBSchemaPageView, IChooseMongoDBSchemaPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection, list, (IList<IParameter>)(object)new IParameter[0], 100, includeData: false, CancellationToken.None).ToArray();
				if (resultSchema.Length != list.Count)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return ((WizardPageBase<IChooseMongoDBSchemaPageView, IChooseMongoDBSchemaPageView>)(object)this).Validate(ref errorMessage);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				errorMessage = string.Empty;
				ExceptionHandler.HandleException(ex);
				return false;
			}
		}

		public override void Commit()
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseMongoDBSchemaPageView, IChooseMongoDBSchemaPageView>)(object)this).View.AnalyzeAllDocumentsRequested -= ViewOnAnalyzeAllDocumentsRequested;
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, MongoDBSchemaNode> schema in ((WizardPageBase<IChooseMongoDBSchemaPageView, IChooseMongoDBSchemaPageView>)(object)this).View.QuerySchemas)
			{
				MongoDBQuery mongoDBQuery = ((WizardPageBase<IChooseMongoDBSchemaPageView, IChooseMongoDBSchemaPageView>)(object)this).Model.Queries.Find((MongoDBQuery q) => q.ActualName == schema.Key);
				MongoDBSchemaNode schema2 = mongoDBQuery.Schema;
				mongoDBQuery.Schema = schema.Value;
			}
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseMongoDBSchemaPageView, IChooseMongoDBSchemaPageView>)(object)this).Model.ResultSchema = resultSchema;
		}

		private void ViewOnAnalyzeAllDocumentsRequested(object sender, AnalyzeAllDocumentsArgs e)
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseMongoDBSchemaPageView, IChooseMongoDBSchemaPageView>)(object)this).View.AnalyzeAllDocumentsRequested -= ViewOnAnalyzeAllDocumentsRequested;
			MongoDBSchemaNode schema = AsyncHelper.LoadAsync(delegate(CancellationToken token)
			{
				MongoDBQuery mongoDBQuery = ((WizardPageBase<IChooseMongoDBSchemaPageView, IChooseMongoDBSchemaPageView>)(object)this).Model.Queries.FirstOrDefault((MongoDBQuery q) => q.ActualName == e.QueryName);
				if (mongoDBQuery == null)
				{
					return (MongoDBSchemaNode)null;
				}
				mongoDBQuery = mongoDBQuery.Clone();
				MongoDBSchemaNode schema2 = mongoDBQuery.Schema;
				mongoDBQuery.Schema = null;
				ResultCollection resultCollection = DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.MongoDB.QueryExecutor.ExecuteQueries(((WizardPageBase<IChooseMongoDBSchemaPageView, IChooseMongoDBSchemaPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection, new MongoDBQuery[1] { mongoDBQuery }, (IList<IParameter>)(object)new IParameter[0], 0, includeData: false, token).First();
				MongoDBSchemaNode mongoDBSchemaNode = new MongoDBSchemaNode(mongoDBQuery.ActualName, resultCollection.ElementType);
				if (schema2 != null)
				{
					MongoDBSchemaNode.ApplySelectedState(schema2, mongoDBSchemaNode);
				}
				return mongoDBSchemaNode;
			}, WaitFormActivator, ExceptionHandler);
			e.Schema = schema;
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseMongoDBSchemaPageView, IChooseMongoDBSchemaPageView>)(object)this).View.AnalyzeAllDocumentsRequested += ViewOnAnalyzeAllDocumentsRequested;
		}
	}

	public class ChooseXPObjectSourceEntityTypePage<TModel> : WizardPageBase<IChooseXPObjectSourceEntityTypePageView, TModel> where TModel : class, IXPObjectSourceModel
	{
		private static bool? isDesignModeCore;

		private static string[] VSProcessNames = new string[4] { "devenv", "VCSExpress", "VBExpress", "WDExpress" };

		private readonly IWizardRunnerContext context;

		private readonly ISolutionTypesProvider solutionTypesProvider;

		private IProjectTypes projectTypes;

		private static bool IsVsDesignMode
		{
			get
			{
				if (!isDesignModeCore.HasValue)
				{
					Process currentProcess = Process.GetCurrentProcess();
					isDesignModeCore = currentProcess != null && IsVSProcess(GetProcessName(currentProcess));
				}
				return isDesignModeCore.Value;
			}
		}

		protected virtual IWaitFormActivator WaitFormActivator => context.WaitFormActivator;

		protected virtual IExceptionHandler ExceptionHandler => ((IUIRunnerContext)context).CreateExceptionHandler((ExceptionHandlerKind)0);

		private ISolutionTypesProvider SolutionTypesProvider => solutionTypesProvider;

		public override bool FinishEnabled
		{
			get
			{

			((WizardPageBase<IConfigureMongoDBConnectionPageView, IConfigureMongoDBConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.Changed += ViewOnChanged;
			if (((WizardPageBase<IConfigureMongoDBConnectionPageView, IConfigureMongoDBConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection?.ConnectionParameters != null)
			{
				((WizardPageBase<IConfigureMongoDBConnectionPageView, IConfigureMongoDBConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.DataConnectionParameters = ((WizardPageBase<IConfigureMongoDBConnectionPageView, IConfigureMongoDBConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection.ConnectionParameters;
				((WizardPageBase<IConfigureMongoDBConnectionPageView, IConfigureMongoDBConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.PasteConnectionString = !(((WizardPageBase<IConfigureMongoDBConnectionPageView, IConfigureMongoDBConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection.ConnectionParameters is MongoDBConnectionParameters);
			}
		}

		private void ViewOnChanged(object sender, EventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IConfigureMongoDBConnectionPageView, IConfigureMongoDBConnectionPageView>)(object)this).RaiseChanged();
		}

		public override bool Validate(out string errorMessage)
		{
			errorMessage = string.Empty;
			MongoDBConnectionParametersBase parameters = ((WizardPageBase<IConfigureMongoDBConnectionPageView, IConfigureMongoDBConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.DataConnectionParameters as MongoDBConnectionParametersBase;
			if (parameters == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			try
			{
				return AsyncHelper.LoadAsync((CancellationToken token) => ValidateConnection(parameters), Context.WaitFormActivator, ((IUIRunnerContext)Context).CreateExceptionHandler((ExceptionHandlerKind)2));
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				errorMessage = ex.Message;
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool ValidateConnection(MongoDBConnectionParametersBase parameters)
		{
			MongoDBUrlBuilder urlBuilder = parameters.GetUrlBuilder();
			if (urlBuilder != null)
			{
				MongoDBUrlBuilder.Parse(urlBuilder.Url);
				MongoDBClient mongoDBClient = new MongoDBClient(urlBuilder.Url);
				mongoDBClient.CheckConnection(CancellationToken.None);
			}
			return urlBuilder != null;
		}

		public override void Commit()
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IConfigureMongoDBConnectionPageView, IConfigureMongoDBConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.ConnectionName = ((WizardPageBase<IConfigureMongoDBConnectionPageView, IConfigureMongoDBConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.ConnectionName;

			((WizardPageBase<IConfigureMongoDBConnectionPageView, IConfigureMongoDBConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.ShouldSaveConnection = (ConnectionStorageService.CanSaveConnection ? SaveConnectionMethod.SaveToAppConfig : SaveConnectionMethod.Hardcode);
			if (AlwaysSaveCredentials)

				SaveConnectionMethod shouldSaveConnection = model.ShouldSaveConnection | SaveConnectionMethod.KeepCredentials;
				model.ShouldSaveConnection = shouldSaveConnection;
			}
		}

		protected virtual IDataConnection CreateConnection(DataConnectionParametersBase dataConnectionParameters)
		{
			return new MongoDBDataConnection(dataConnectionParameters as MongoDBConnectionParametersBase);
		}

		public override Type GetNextPageType()
		{
			DataConnectionParametersBase dataConnectionParameters = ((WizardPageBase<IConfigureMongoDBConnectionPageView, IConfigureMongoDBConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.DataConnectionParameters;
			if (ConnectionStorageService.CanSaveConnection)
			{
				return typeof(SaveMongoDBConnectionPage<TModel>);
			}
			if (AlwaysSaveCredentials)
			{
				return QueryBuilderPageType;
			}
			if (dataConnectionParameters != null && dataConnectionParameters.HasSensitiveInfo && DatabaseCredentialsSavingBehavior == MongoDBSensitiveInfoSavingBehavior.Prompt)
			{
				return typeof(SaveMongoDBConnectionPage<TModel>);
			}
			return QueryBuilderPageType;
		}

	public class ConfigureFederatedQueryPage<TModel> : WizardPageBase<IConfigureFederatedQueryPageView, TModel> where TModel : class, IFederationDataSourceModel
	{
		private readonly IFederatedDataSourceProvider dataSourcesProvider;

		private readonly IExceptionHandler exceptionHandler;

		protected QueryNode query;

		[Dependency]
		protected FederationDataSourceWizardContext FederationDataSourceWizardContext { get; set; }

		public override bool FinishEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(GetValidationError()))
				{
					return !QueryNodeBuildingValidator.IsEmpty(query);
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public override bool MoveNextEnabled => false;

		public ConfigureFederatedQueryPage(IConfigureFederatedQueryPageView view, IFederatedDataSourceProvider dataSourcesProvider, IWizardRunnerContext context)
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IConfigureFederatedQueryPageView, IConfigureFederatedQueryPageView>)(object)this)..ctor(view);
			this.dataSourcesProvider = dataSourcesProvider;
			exceptionHandler = ((IUIRunnerContext)context).CreateExceptionHandler((ExceptionHandlerKind)0);
		}

		public override void Begin()
		{
			query = GetInitialQuery();
			string validationError = GetValidationError();
			((WizardPageBase<IConfigureFederatedQueryPageView, IConfigureFederatedQueryPageView>)(object)this).View.RunQueryBuilder += OnRunQueryBuilder;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(validationError))
			{
				((WizardPageBase<IConfigureFederatedQueryPageView, IConfigureFederatedQueryPageView>)(object)this).View.SetText(SerializeQuery());
				((WizardPageBase<IConfigureFederatedQueryPageView, IConfigureFederatedQueryPageView>)(object)this).View.Initialize(canRunQueryBuilder: true);
			}
			else
			{
				validationError = DataAccessUILocalizer.GetString(DataAccessUIStringId.WizardPageConfigureFederatedQueryPage_InvalidQuery) + "\r\n\r\n" + validationError;
				((WizardPageBase<IConfigureFederatedQueryPageView, IConfigureFederatedQueryPageView>)(object)this).View.SetText(validationError);
				((WizardPageBase<IConfigureFederatedQueryPageView, IConfigureFederatedQueryPageView>)(object)this).View.Initialize(canRunQueryBuilder: false);
			}
		}

		public override void Commit()
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IConfigureFederatedQueryPageView, IConfigureFederatedQueryPageView>)(object)this).View.RunQueryBuilder -= OnRunQueryBuilder;
			if (!JoinNodeEqualityComparer.Equals(((WizardPageBase<IConfigureFederatedQueryPageView, IConfigureFederatedQueryPageView>)(object)this).Model.Query, query))
			{
				((WizardPageBase<IConfigureFederatedQueryPageView, IConfigureFederatedQueryPageView>)(object)this).Model.Queries.Clear();
				((WizardPageBase<IConfigureFederatedQueryPageView, IConfigureFederatedQueryPageView>)(object)this).Model.Queries.Add(new CheckItem<QueryNode>(query, selected: true, customQuery: true));
				((WizardPageBase<IConfigureFederatedQueryPageView, IConfigureFederatedQueryPageView>)(object)this).Model.Query = query;
				((WizardPageBase<IConfigureFederatedQueryPageView, IConfigureFederatedQueryPageView>)(object)this).Model.Relations.Clear();
			}
		}

		private void OnRunQueryBuilder(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!QueryNodeBuildingValidator.Validate(query) && !QueryNodeBuildingValidator.IsEmpty(query))
			{
				((WizardPageBase<IConfigureFederatedQueryPageView, IConfigureFederatedQueryPageView>)(object)this).RaiseError(DataAccessUILocalizer.GetString(DataAccessUIStringId.WizardPageConfigureFederatedQueryPage_EditingIsNotSupported));
				return;
			}
			FederatedQueryBuilderRunnerBase federatedQueryBuilderRunnerBase = ((WizardPageBase<IConfigureFederatedQueryPageView, IConfigureFederatedQueryPageView>)(object)this).View.CreateQueryBuilderRunner(dataSourcesProvider, exceptionHandler);
			QueryNode queryNode = federatedQueryBuilderRunnerBase.Edit(query, FederationDataSourceWizardContext?.Sources);
			bool flag = query != queryNode;
			query = queryNode;
			string validationError = GetValidationError();
			((WizardPageBase<IConfigureFederatedQueryPageView, IConfigureFederatedQueryPageView>)(object)this).View.SetText(string.IsNullOrEmpty(validationError) ? SerializeQuery() : validationError);
			((WizardPageBase<IConfigureFederatedQueryPageView, IConfigureFederatedQueryPageView>)(object)this).RaiseChanged();
			if (flag)
			{
				((WizardPageBase<IConfigureFederatedQueryPageView, IConfigureFederatedQueryPageView>)(object)this).View.MoveNext();
			}
			else
			{
				((WizardPageBase<IConfigureFederatedQueryPageView, IConfigureFederatedQueryPageView>)(object)this).View.MovePrevious();
			}
		}

		private string SerializeQuery()
		{
			if (!QueryNodeBuildingValidator.IsEmpty(query))
			{
				return QueryNodeSelectSqlSerializer.Serialize(query);
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		private QueryNode GetInitialQuery()
		{
			return ((WizardPageBase<IConfigureFederatedQueryPageView, IConfigureFederatedQueryPageView>)(object)this).Model.Query ?? new SelectNode();
		}

		private string GetValidationError()
		{
			if (QueryNodeBuildingValidator.IsEmpty(query))
			{
				((WizardPageBase<IConfigureFederatedQueryPageView, IConfigureFederatedQueryPageView>)(object)this).View.SetText(string.Empty);
				return string.Empty;
			}
			ValidationError validationError = new QueryNode.Validator(new IndeterminateSourceColumnsProvider()).Process(query);
			if (validationError is NoColumnsValidationError || validationError is RootNullValidationError || validationError is SourceNullValidationError)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return validationError?.Message;
		}

		public override bool Validate(out string errorMessage)
		{
			errorMessage = new QueryNode.Validator(new IndeterminateSourceColumnsProvider()).Process(query)?.Message;
			return string.IsNullOrEmpty(errorMessage);
		}
	}
	internal class QueryNodeBuildingValidator : JoinNodeVisitor<bool>
	{
		private readonly QueryNode node;

		private bool IsRootUnionNode => node is UnionNode;

		private QueryNodeBuildingValidator(QueryNode node)
		{
			this.node = node;
		}

		public static bool IsEmpty(QueryNode query)
		{
			if (query is SelectNode selectNode)
			{
				if (selectNode.Root == null && selectNode.Expressions.Count == 0)
				{
					return selectNode.SubNodes.Count == 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (query is UnionNode unionNode)
			{
				return unionNode.Elements.Count == 0;
			}
			if (query is TransformationNode transformationNode)
			{
				return transformationNode.Rules.Count == 0;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool Validate(QueryNode node)
		{
			QueryNodeBuildingValidator queryNodeBuildingValidator = new QueryNodeBuildingValidator(node);
			return ((JoinNodeVisitor<bool>)queryNodeBuildingValidator).Process((IJoinNode)node);
		}

		protected override bool Visit(SourceNode sourceNode)
		{
			return sourceNode.Source != null;
		}

		protected override bool Visit(TransformationNode transformationNode)
		{
			if (transformationNode != node)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(transformationNode.Root is SourceNode))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool Visit(SelectNode selectNode)
		{
			if (!IsRootUnionNode && selectNode != node)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if ((selectNode.Root as SourceNode)?.Source == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (IsRootUnionNode && selectNode.SubNodes.Any())
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (JoinElement subNode in selectNode.SubNodes)
			{
				if (!base.Process(subNode.Node))
				{
					return false;
				}
				CriteriaOperator criteria = CriteriaOperator.TryParse(subNode.Condition, new object[0]);
				if (!Process(criteria))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool Visit(UnionNode unionNode)
		{
			if (unionNode != node)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (QueryNode element in unionNode.Elements)
			{
				if (!base.Process((IJoinNode)element))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool Process(CriteriaOperator criteria)
		{
			GroupOperator val = (GroupOperator)(object)((criteria is GroupOperator) ? criteria : null);
			BinaryOperator binary = (BinaryOperator)(object)((criteria is BinaryOperator) ? criteria : null);
			if (!Process(binary))
			{
				return Process(val);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool Process(GroupOperator group)
		{
			//IL_0004: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (group == null || (int)group.OperatorType != 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (CriteriaOperator item in (List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)group.Operands)
			{
				BinaryOperator binary = (BinaryOperator)(object)((item is BinaryOperator) ? item : null);
				if (!Process(binary))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool Process(BinaryOperator binary)
		{
			if (binary == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			CriteriaOperator leftOperand = binary.LeftOperand;
			OperandProperty operand = (OperandProperty)(object)((leftOperand is OperandProperty) ? leftOperand : null);
			CriteriaOperator rightOperand = binary.RightOperand;
			OperandProperty operand2 = (OperandProperty)(object)((rightOperand is OperandProperty) ? rightOperand : null);
			if (!Validate(operand) || !Validate(operand2))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool Validate(OperandProperty operand)
		{
			if (operand == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string tableAlias;
			string columnName = ColumnNameHelper.GetColumnName(operand.PropertyName, out tableAlias, enclose: false, mergeTableName: false);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(columnName))
			{
				return tableAlias != null;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

		public override void Begin()
