		}

		public override bool Validate(out string errorMessage)
		{
			errorMessage = null;
			UriJsonSource jsonSource = ((WizardPageBase<IConfigureJsonConnectionPageView, IConfigureJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection.GetJsonSource() as UriJsonSource;
			if (jsonSource == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			jsonSource.AuthenticationInfo.Username = ((WizardPageBase<IConfigureJsonConnectionPageView, IConfigureJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.UserName;
			jsonSource.AuthenticationInfo.Password = ((WizardPageBase<IConfigureJsonConnectionPageView, IConfigureJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.Password;
			jsonSource.HeaderParameters.Clear();
			jsonSource.HeaderParameters.AddRange(((WizardPageBase<IConfigureJsonConnectionPageView, IConfigureJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.HeaderParameters.ToArray());
			IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters = ParameterServiceHelper.GetSourceParameters(ParameterService);
			JsonDataSource source = null;
			try
			{
				return AsyncHelper.DoWithWaitForm(delegate(CancellationToken token)
				{
					((WizardPageBase<IConfigureJsonConnectionPageView, IConfigureJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Commit();
					source = new JsonDataSource
					{
						JsonSource = jsonSource
					};
					token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
					ServiceContainerExtensions.ReplaceService<UrlResolver>((IServiceContainer)source, UrlResolver, false);
					source.Fill(sourceParameters);
					schema = source.Schema;
					root = source.RootElement;
				}, Context.WaitFormActivator, ((IUIRunnerContext)Context).CreateExceptionHandler((ExceptionHandlerKind)2));
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				errorMessage = ex.Message;
				return false;
			}
			finally
			{
				source?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		public override void Commit()
		{
			if (schema != null)
			{
				if (((WizardPageBase<IConfigureJsonConnectionPageView, IConfigureJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.JsonSchema != null)
				{
					JsonSchemaNode.ApplySelectedState(((WizardPageBase<IConfigureJsonConnectionPageView, IConfigureJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.JsonSchema, schema);
				}
				((WizardPageBase<IConfigureJsonConnectionPageView, IConfigureJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.JsonSchema = schema;
				((WizardPageBase<IConfigureJsonConnectionPageView, IConfigureJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.RootElement = root;
			}
		}
	}
	public class ConfigureMongoDBQueriesPage<TModel> : WizardPageBase<IConfigureMongoDBQueriesPageView, TModel> where TModel : class, IMongoDBDataSourceModel
	{
		private ResultCollection[] resultSchema;

		private MongoDBDataConnection Connection => ((WizardPageBase<IConfigureMongoDBQueriesPageView, IConfigureMongoDBQueriesPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection;

		private IWizardRunnerContext Context { get; }

		private IExceptionHandler ExceptionHandler => ((IUIRunnerContext)Context).CreateExceptionHandler((ExceptionHandlerKind)0);

		public override bool FinishEnabled => false;

		public override bool MoveNextEnabled => ((WizardPageBase<IConfigureMongoDBQueriesPageView, IConfigureMongoDBQueriesPageView>)(object)this).View.Queries.Any();

		public ConfigureMongoDBQueriesPage(IConfigureMongoDBQueriesPageView view, IWizardRunnerContext context)
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IConfigureMongoDBQueriesPageView, IConfigureMongoDBQueriesPageView>)(object)this)..ctor(view);
			Context = context;
			view.QueriesUpdated += View_QueriesUpdated;
		}

		public override Type GetNextPageType()
		{
			return typeof(ChooseMongoDBSchemaPage<TModel>);
		}

		public override void Begin()
		{
			Dictionary<string, string[]> serverSchema = new Dictionary<string, string[]>();
			try
			{
				AsyncHelper.DoWithWaitForm(delegate
				{
					Connection.Open(CancellationToken.None);
					List<string> list = Connection.Client.ListDatabaseNames(CancellationToken.None) ?? new List<string>();
					foreach (string item in list)
					{
						IMongoDBDatabase database = Connection.Client.GetDatabase(item);
						List<string> list2 = database.ListCollectionNames();
						if (list2 != null && list2.Count > 0)
						{
							serverSchema.Add(item, list2.ToArray());
						}
					}
				}, Context.WaitFormActivator, ((IUIRunnerContext)Context).CreateExceptionHandler((ExceptionHandlerKind)2));
			}
			finally
			{
				Connection.Close();
			}
			((WizardPageBase<IConfigureMongoDBQueriesPageView, IConfigureMongoDBQueriesPageView>)(object)this).View.Initialize(((WizardPageBase<IConfigureMongoDBQueriesPageView, IConfigureMongoDBQueriesPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection, ((WizardPageBase<IConfigureMongoDBQueriesPageView, IConfigureMongoDBQueriesPageView>)(object)this).Model.Queries, serverSchema);
		}

		public override bool Validate(out string errorMessage)
		{
			errorMessage = null;
			List<MongoDBQuery> list = ((WizardPageBase<IConfigureMongoDBQueriesPageView, IConfigureMongoDBQueriesPageView>)(object)this).View.Queries.Select(MongoDBQuery.CopyWithoutSchema).ToList();
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				Context.ShowMessage(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.MongoDB_NoQueriesMessage));
				return false;
			}
			HashSet<string> hashSet = new HashSet<string>();
			foreach (MongoDBQuery item in list)
			{
				if (!hashSet.Add(item.ActualName))
				{
					Context.ShowMessage(string.Format(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.MongoDB_DuplicateQueryNameMessage), item.ActualName));
					return false;
				}
			}
			try
			{
				resultSchema = DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.MongoDB.QueryExecutor.ExecuteQueries(((WizardPageBase<IConfigureMongoDBQueriesPageView, IConfigureMongoDBQueriesPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection, list, (IList<IParameter>)(object)new IParameter[0], ((WizardPageBase<IConfigureMongoDBQueriesPageView, IConfigureMongoDBQueriesPageView>)(object)this).Model.SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount, includeData: false, CancellationToken.None).ToArray();
				if (resultSchema.Length != list.Count())
				{
					return false;
				}
				return ((WizardPageBase<IConfigureMongoDBQueriesPageView, IConfigureMongoDBQueriesPageView>)(object)this).Validate(ref errorMessage);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				errorMessage = string.Empty;
				ExceptionHandler.HandleException(ex);
				return false;
			}
		}

		public override void Commit()
		{
			MongoDBQuery[] array = ((WizardPageBase<IConfigureMongoDBQueriesPageView, IConfigureMongoDBQueriesPageView>)(object)this).View.Queries.ToArray();
			if (resultSchema == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ResultCollection[] array2 = resultSchema;
			foreach (ResultCollection collection in array2)
			{
				MongoDBQuery mongoDBQuery = array.FirstOrDefault((MongoDBQuery q) => q.ActualName == collection.Name);
				MongoDBSchemaNode mongoDBSchemaNode = ((WizardPageBase<IConfigureMongoDBQueriesPageView, IConfigureMongoDBQueriesPageView>)(object)this).Model.Queries.FirstOrDefault((MongoDBQuery q) => q.ActualName == collection.Name)?.Schema;
				if (mongoDBQuery != null)
				{
					MongoDBSchemaNode mongoDBSchemaNode2 = new MongoDBSchemaNode(mongoDBQuery.ActualName, collection.ElementType, collection.DiscoveryLimitApplied);
					if (mongoDBSchemaNode != null)
					{
						MongoDBSchemaNode.ApplySelectedState(mongoDBSchemaNode, mongoDBSchemaNode2);
					}
					mongoDBQuery.Schema = mongoDBSchemaNode2;
				}
			}
			((WizardPageBase<IConfigureMongoDBQueriesPageView, IConfigureMongoDBQueriesPageView>)(object)this).Model.Queries.Clear();
			((WizardPageBase<IConfigureMongoDBQueriesPageView, IConfigureMongoDBQueriesPageView>)(object)this).Model.Queries.AddRange(array);
			((WizardPageBase<IConfigureMongoDBQueriesPageView, IConfigureMongoDBQueriesPageView>)(object)this).Model.ResultSchema = resultSchema;
		}

		private void View_QueriesUpdated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IConfigureMongoDBQueriesPageView, IConfigureMongoDBQueriesPageView>)(object)this).RaiseChanged();
		}
	}

	public class MultiFederatedQueryConfigurePage<TModel> : WizardPageBase<IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView, TModel> where TModel : class, IFederationDataSourceModel
	{
		private readonly IWizardRunnerContext context;

		private readonly List<SelectNode> selectNodes;

		private readonly List<FederationMasterDetailInfo> relations;

		private readonly IFederatedDataSourceProvider dataSourcesProvider;

		private readonly IExceptionHandler exceptionHandler;

		private readonly List<QueryNode> customQueries;

		private static readonly Source.EqualityComparer sourceComparer = new Source.EqualityComparer();

		private BindingList<MultiQueryItemEx> items;

		private MultiQueryItemEx federatedQueriesNode;

		private const int nodeIdRoot = -1;

		public override bool FinishEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (!selectNodes.Any())
				{
					return GetSelectedCustomQueries().Any();
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public override bool MoveNextEnabled => false;

		public MultiFederatedQueryConfigurePage(IFederatedDataSourceProvider dataSourcesProvider, IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView view, IWizardRunnerContext context)
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView, IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView>)(object)this)..ctor(view);
			this.dataSourcesProvider = dataSourcesProvider;
			exceptionHandler = ((IUIRunnerContext)context).CreateExceptionHandler((ExceptionHandlerKind)2);
			selectNodes = new List<SelectNode>();
			customQueries = new List<QueryNode>();
			relations = new List<FederationMasterDetailInfo>();
			this.context = context;
		}

		public override void Begin()
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView, IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView>)(object)this).View.ItemUpdated += OnItemCheckedStatusChanged;
			((WizardPageBase<IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView, IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView>)(object)this).View.AddQuery += OnRunQueryBuilder;
			((WizardPageBase<IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView, IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView>)(object)this).View.EditRelations += OnRunManageRelations;
			((WizardPageBase<IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView, IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView>)(object)this).View.ConfigureQuery += View_ConfigureQuery;
			((WizardPageBase<IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView, IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView>)(object)this).View.DeleteQuery += View_DeleteQuery;
			((WizardPageBase<IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView, IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView>)(object)this).View.ListStateUpdated += View_ListStateUpdated;
			InitializeQueriesFromModel();
			InitializeItems();
			UpdateSelectedStateAllItems(items);
			((WizardPageBase<IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView, IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView>)(object)this).View.Items = items;
			UpdateUI();
		}

		public override void Commit()
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView, IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView>)(object)this).View.ItemUpdated -= OnItemCheckedStatusChanged;
			((WizardPageBase<IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView, IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView>)(object)this).View.AddQuery -= OnRunQueryBuilder;
			((WizardPageBase<IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView, IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView>)(object)this).View.EditRelations -= OnRunManageRelations;
			((WizardPageBase<IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView, IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView>)(object)this).View.ConfigureQuery -= View_ConfigureQuery;
			((WizardPageBase<IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView, IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView>)(object)this).View.ListStateUpdated -= View_ListStateUpdated;
			((WizardPageBase<IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView, IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView>)(object)this).View.DeleteQuery -= View_DeleteQuery;
			((WizardPageBase<IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView, IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView>)(object)this).Model.Queries.Clear();
			((WizardPageBase<IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView, IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView>)(object)this).Model.Relations.Clear();
			((WizardPageBase<IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView, IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView>)(object)this).Model.Queries.AddRange(PrepareQueriesForModel());
			((WizardPageBase<IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView, IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView>)(object)this).Model.Relations.AddRange(relations);
			selectNodes.Clear();
			customQueries.Clear();
			relations.Clear();
			items.Clear();
		}

		private List<CheckItem<QueryNode>> PrepareQueriesForModel()
		{
			List<CheckItem<QueryNode>> list = new List<CheckItem<QueryNode>>();
			foreach (SelectNode selectNode in selectNodes)
			{
				list.Add(new CheckItem<QueryNode>(selectNode, selected: true, customQuery: false));
			}
			foreach (CheckItem<QueryNode> item in YieldCustomQueries())
			{
				list.Add(item);
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected virtual IEnumerable<CheckItem<QueryNode>> YieldCustomQueries()
		{
			if (customQueries == null)
			{
				return Enumerable.Empty<CheckItem<QueryNode>>();
			}
			return from item in items
				where IsCustomQueryItem(item)
				select new CheckItem<QueryNode>(customQueries.First((QueryNode y) => y.ActualName == item.Name), item.Selected == true, customQuery: true);
		}

		protected void UpdateSelectedStateAllItems(IEnumerable<MultiQueryItemEx> itemsParam)
		{
			IList<MultiQueryItemEx> list = (itemsParam as IList<MultiQueryItemEx>) ?? itemsParam.ToList();
			foreach (MultiQueryItemEx item in list.Where((MultiQueryItemEx x) => x.ParentId == -1))
			{
				UpdateSelectedStateItem(list, item);
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<QueryNode> GetSelectedCustomQueries()
		{
			return customQueries.Where((QueryNode x) => items.Any((MultiQueryItemEx y) => y.Name == x.ActualName && y.Selected == true));
		}

		private void UpdateSelectedStateItem(IEnumerable<MultiQueryItemEx> itemsParam, MultiQueryItemEx itemForUpdate)
		{
			if (IsCustomQueryItem(itemForUpdate) || itemForUpdate.ItemType == QueryItemType.Field)
			{
				return;
			}
			MultiQueryItemEx[] array = itemsParam.Where((MultiQueryItemEx x) => x.ParentId == itemForUpdate.Id).ToArray();
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			bool flag3 = false;
			MultiQueryItemEx[] array2 = array;
			foreach (MultiQueryItemEx multiQueryItemEx in array2)
			{
				UpdateSelectedStateItem(itemsParam, multiQueryItemEx);
				bool? selected = multiQueryItemEx.Selected;
				if (selected.HasValue)
				{
					if (selected == true)
					{
						flag2 = true;
					}
					else
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					flag3 = true;
				}
			}
			if (flag2 && !flag && !flag3)
			{
				itemForUpdate.Selected = true;
			}
			else if (flag2 || flag3)
			{
				itemForUpdate.Selected = null;
			}
			else
			{
				itemForUpdate.Selected = false;
			}
		}

		private bool IsCustomQueryItem(MultiQueryItemEx itemForUpdate)
		{
			return itemForUpdate.ParentId == federatedQueriesNode.Id;
		}

		private void OnItemCheckedStatusChanged(object sender, ItemUpdatedEventArgs args)
		{
			MultiQueryItemEx item = args.Item as MultiQueryItemEx;
			if (item == null || (item.Source == null && (item.ItemType == QueryItemType.Source || item.ItemType == QueryItemType.Query)))
			{
				return;
			}
			if ((item.ItemType ^ (QueryItemType.Source | QueryItemType.Query)) == (QueryItemType)0)
			{
				OnSourceChanged(item);
				UpdateUI();
			}
			else if (item.ItemType == QueryItemType.Source)
			{
				foreach (MultiQueryItemEx item2 in items.Where((MultiQueryItemEx x) => x.ParentId == item.Id))
				{
					OnTableItemChanged(item2);
				}
				UpdateUI();
			}
			else if (item.ItemType == QueryItemType.Field)
			{
				OnColumnItemChanged(item);
				UpdateUI();
			}
			else if (item.ItemType.HasFlag(QueryItemType.Query))
			{
				OnTableItemChanged(item);
				UpdateUI();
			}
		}

		private QueryNode EditQuery(QueryNode query)
		{
			FederatedQueryBuilderRunnerBase federatedQueryBuilderRunnerBase = ((WizardPageBase<IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView, IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView>)(object)this).View.CreateQueryBuilderRunner(dataSourcesProvider, exceptionHandler);
			return federatedQueryBuilderRunnerBase.Edit(query, GetExistingSources());
		}

		private IEnumerable<Source> GetExistingSources()
		{
			IEnumerable<Source> second = customQueries.SelectMany((QueryNode x) => SourceExtractor.Extract(x));
			IEnumerable<Source> source = items.Select((MultiQueryItemEx x) => x.Source).Concat(second);
			return source.Where((Source x) => x != null).Distinct(sourceComparer);
		}

		private void OnRunQueryBuilder(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			QueryNode queryNode = EditQuery(null);
			if (queryNode != null)
			{
				string alias = (queryNode.Alias = GetQueryNodeAlias(queryNode));
				MultiQueryItemEx item = new MultiQueryItemEx(null, QueryItemType.Query, alias, queryNode.ActualName, queryNode.Alias, true, GenerateNextMultiQueryItemId(items), federatedQueriesNode.Id, MultiQueryItemActions.EditRemove);
				items.Add(item);
				customQueries.Add(queryNode);
				UpdateUI();
			}
		}

		private void OnRunManageRelations(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			FederationDataSource federationDataSource = new FederationDataSource();
			federationDataSource.Relations.AddRange(relations);
			federationDataSource.Queries.AddRange(selectNodes);
			federationDataSource.Queries.AddRange(GetSelectedCustomQueries());
			federationDataSource.Result.SetTables(federationDataSource.RebuildResultSchemaCore().Tables);
			federationDataSource.Result.ApplyRelations(federationDataSource.Relations);
			MasterDetailModel masterDetailModel = new MasterDetailModel(federationDataSource.Relations.Select((FederationMasterDetailInfo x) => new MasterDetailInfo(x)));
			if (((WizardPageBase<IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView, IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView>)(object)this).View.CreateManageRelationsRunner().Run(masterDetailModel, new MasterDetailRunnerContext(federationDataSource)))
			{
				relations.Clear();
				relations.AddRange(masterDetailModel.Select((MasterDetailInfo x) => new FederationMasterDetailInfo(x)));
				UpdateUI();
			}
		}

		private void View_DeleteQuery(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			MultiQueryItem query = ((WizardPageBase<IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView, IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView>)(object)this).View.GetFocusedItem();
			items.Remove(items.First((MultiQueryItemEx x) => x.Name == query.Name && IsCustomQueryItem(x)));
			QueryNode queryNode = customQueries.First((QueryNode x) => x.ActualName == query.Name);
			if (queryNode != null)
			{
				customQueries.Remove(queryNode);
			}
		}

		private void View_ConfigureQuery(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			QueryNode queryNode = customQueries.First((QueryNode x) => x.ActualName == ((WizardPageBase<IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView, IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView>)(object)this).View.GetFocusedItem().Name);
			QueryNode item = EditQuery(queryNode);
			customQueries.Remove(queryNode);
			customQueries.Add(item);
		}

		private void View_ListStateUpdated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateUI();
		}

		private void UpdateUI()
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView, IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView>)(object)this).RaiseChanged();
			((WizardPageBase<IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView, IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView>)(object)this).View.SetEditRelationEnabled(selectNodes.Count + customQueries.Count > 1);
		}

		private void OnSourceChanged(MultiQueryItemEx item)
		{
			if (item.Selected != true)
			{
				SelectNode selectNode = selectNodes.FirstOrDefault((SelectNode x) => x.ActualName == item.Name);
				if (selectNode == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				for (int num = selectNodes.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					if (((SourceNode)selectNodes[num].Root).Source.DataSource.Equals(((SourceNode)selectNode.Root).Source.DataSource))
					{
						selectNodes.RemoveAt(num);
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			SelectNode orAddSelectNode = GetOrAddSelectNode(item);
			orAddSelectNode.Expressions.Clear();
			foreach (MultiQueryItemEx item2 in items.Where((MultiQueryItemEx x) => x.ParentId == item.Id))
			{
				if (item2.ItemType == QueryItemType.Field)
				{
					OnColumnItemChanged(item2);
					continue;
				}
				if (item2.ItemType == QueryItemType.Query)
				{
					OnTableItemChanged(item2);
					continue;
				}
				throw new NotSupportedException("ItemType");
			}
		}

		private void SelectTable(MultiQueryItemEx multiQueryItem)
		{
			SelectNode selectNode = GetOrAddSelectNode(multiQueryItem);
			IEnumerable<MultiQueryItemEx> source = items.Where((MultiQueryItemEx x) => x.ParentId == multiQueryItem.Id);
			selectNode.Expressions.Clear();
			selectNode.Expressions.AddRange(source.Select((MultiQueryItemEx x) => new SelectColumnExpression(selectNode.Root, x.Name)));
		}

		private SelectNode GetOrAddSelectNode(MultiQueryItemEx multiQueryItem)
		{
			SelectNode selectNode = selectNodes.FirstOrDefault((SelectNode x) => Source.EqualityComparer.Equals(((SourceNode)x.Root).Source, multiQueryItem.Source));
			if (selectNode == null)
			{
				SelectNode selectNode2 = new SelectNode(new SourceNode(multiQueryItem.Source));
				selectNode2.Alias = GetQueryNodeAlias(selectNode2);
				selectNodes.Add(selectNode2);
				return selectNode2;
			}
			return selectNode;
		}

		private string GetQueryNodeAlias(QueryNode selectNode)
		{
			IEnumerable<string> collection = selectNodes.Select((SelectNode x) => x.Alias).Concat(customQueries.Select((QueryNode x) => x.Alias));
			return QueryNodeCollection.GenerateUniqueName(selectNode, new HashSet<string>(collection));
		}

		private void OnTableItemChanged(MultiQueryItemEx item)
		{
			if (item.Selected == true)
			{
				SelectTable(item);
				return;
			}
			for (int num = selectNodes.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (Source.EqualityComparer.Equals(((SourceNode)selectNodes[num].Root).Source, item.Source))
				{
					selectNodes.RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnColumnItemChanged(MultiQueryItemEx item)
		{
			if (item.Selected == true)
			{
				SelectNode selectNode = selectNodes.FirstOrDefault((SelectNode x) => Source.EqualityComparer.Equals(((SourceNode)x.Root).Source, item.Source));
				if (selectNode != null)
				{
					selectNode.Expressions.Add(new SelectColumnExpression(selectNode.Root, item.Name, item.Name));
					return;
				}
				SourceNode sourceNode = new SourceNode(item.Source);
				SelectNode selectNode2 = new SelectNode(sourceNode);
				selectNode2.Alias = GetQueryNodeAlias(selectNode2);
				selectNodes.Add(selectNode2);
				selectNode2.Expressions.Add(new SelectColumnExpression(sourceNode, item.Name, item.Name));
			}
			else
			{
				SelectNode selectNode3 = selectNodes.First((SelectNode x) => Source.EqualityComparer.Equals(((SourceNode)x.Root).Source, item.Source));
				DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression item2 = selectNode3.Expressions.Where((DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression x) => ((SelectColumnExpression)x).Name == item.Name).First();
				selectNode3.Expressions.Remove(item2);
				if (!selectNode3.Expressions.Any())
				{
					selectNodes.Remove(selectNode3);
				}
			}
		}

		private void InitializeQueriesFromModel()
		{
			foreach (CheckItem<QueryNode> query in ((WizardPageBase<IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView, IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView>)(object)this).Model.Queries)
			{
				if (query.CustomQuery)
				{
					customQueries.Add((SelectNode)query.Value);
				}
				else
				{
					selectNodes.Add((SelectNode)query.Value);
				}
			}
			relations.AddRange(((WizardPageBase<IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView, IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView>)(object)this).Model.Relations);
			((WizardPageBase<IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView, IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView>)(object)this).View.SetEditRelationEnabled(selectNodes.Any() || GetSelectedCustomQueries().Any());
		}

		private void InitializeItems()
		{
			List<MultiQueryItemEx> list = new List<MultiQueryItemEx>();
			IEnumerable<Source> existingSources = ((WizardPageBase<IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView, IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView>)(object)this).Model.Queries.SelectMany((CheckItem<QueryNode> x) => SourceExtractor.Extract(x.Value)).Distinct(sourceComparer);
			IEnumerable<QueryItemInfo> scheme = new SchemeLoader(dataSourcesProvider.GetDataSources(), existingSources).GetScheme();
			foreach (QueryItemInfo queryItem in scheme)
			{
				SelectNode selectNode = selectNodes.FirstOrDefault((SelectNode x) => Source.EqualityComparer.Equals(((SourceNode)x.Root).Source, queryItem.Source));
				list.Add(new MultiQueryItemEx(queryItem.Source, queryItem.ItemType, selectNode?.Alias, queryItem.Name, queryItem.DisplayName, false, queryItem.Id, queryItem.ParentId, MultiQueryItemActions.None));
				SelectNode selectNode2 = selectNodes.FirstOrDefault((SelectNode x) => Source.EqualityComparer.Equals(((SourceNode)x.Root).Source, queryItem.Source));
				foreach (QueryItemInfo column in queryItem.Children)
				{
					bool value = Enumerable.Cast<SelectColumnExpression>(selectNode2?.Expressions).Any((SelectColumnExpression x) => x.ActualName == column.Name) ?? false;
					list.Add(new MultiQueryItemEx(column.Source, column.ItemType, column.Name, column.Name, column.DisplayName, value, column.Id, column.ParentId, MultiQueryItemActions.None));
				}
			}
			federatedQueriesNode = new MultiQueryItemEx(null, QueryItemType.Source, null, "Federated Queries", "Federated Queries", false, GenerateNextMultiQueryItemId(list), -1, MultiQueryItemActions.Add);
			list.Add(federatedQueriesNode);
			foreach (QueryNode customQuery in customQueries)
			{
				SelectNode selectNode3 = ((customQuery is SelectNode) ? selectNodes.FirstOrDefault((SelectNode x) => Source.EqualityComparer.Equals(((SourceNode)x.Root).Source, ((SourceNode)((SelectNode)customQuery).Root).Source)) : null);
				bool value2 = ((WizardPageBase<IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView, IMultiFederatedQueryConfigurePageView>)(object)this).Model.Queries.First((CheckItem<QueryNode> x) => x.Value.ActualName == customQuery.ActualName && x.CustomQuery).Checked;
				list.Add(new MultiQueryItemEx(null, QueryItemType.Query, selectNode3?.Alias, customQuery.ActualName, customQuery.Alias, value2, GenerateNextMultiQueryItemId(list), federatedQueriesNode.Id, MultiQueryItemActions.EditRemove));
			}
			items = new BindingList<MultiQueryItemEx>(list);
		}

		private int GenerateNextMultiQueryItemId(IEnumerable<MultiQueryItemEx> collection)
		{
			return collection.Max((MultiQueryItemEx x) => x.Id) + 1;
		}
	}

		public QueryItemType ItemType { get; private set; }

			: base(name, displayName, selected, id, parentId, actions)
		{
			Source = source;
			ItemType = itemType;
			Alias = alias;
		}
	}

	public class SaveJsonConnectionPage<TModel> : WizardPageBase<ISaveJsonConnectionPageView, TModel> where TModel : class, IJsonDataSourceModel

			((WizardPageBase<ISaveJsonConnectionPageView, ISaveJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this)..ctor(view);
			Context = context;
			ConnectionStorageService = connectionStorageService;
		}

		public override void Begin()
		{
			if (((WizardPageBase<ISaveJsonConnectionPageView, ISaveJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.ConnectionName == null)
			{
				((WizardPageBase<ISaveJsonConnectionPageView, ISaveJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.ConnectionName = ((WizardPageBase<ISaveJsonConnectionPageView, ISaveJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection.Name;
			}
			((WizardPageBase<ISaveJsonConnectionPageView, ISaveJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.ConnectionName = GetInitialConnectionName();
			JsonDataConnection dataConnection = ((WizardPageBase<ISaveJsonConnectionPageView, ISaveJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection;
			((WizardPageBase<ISaveJsonConnectionPageView, ISaveJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.SetCanSaveToStorage(ConnectionStorageService.CanSaveConnection);
			((WizardPageBase<ISaveJsonConnectionPageView, ISaveJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.SetConnectionUsesServerAuth(dataConnection != null && dataConnection.HasSensitiveInfo && SensitiveInfoSavingBehavior == JsonSensitiveInfoSavingBehavior.Prompt);
			((WizardPageBase<ISaveJsonConnectionPageView, ISaveJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.ShouldSaveConnectionString = ((WizardPageBase<ISaveJsonConnectionPageView, ISaveJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.ShouldSaveConnection.HasFlag(SaveConnectionMethod.SaveToAppConfig);
		}

		private string GetInitialConnectionName()
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(((WizardPageBase<ISaveJsonConnectionPageView, ISaveJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.ConnectionName))
			{
				return ((WizardPageBase<ISaveJsonConnectionPageView, ISaveJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.ConnectionName;
			}
			string text = "JsonConnection";
			if (!ConnectionStorageService.ContainsConnection(text))
			{
				return text;
			}
			int num = 1;
			string text2;
			do
			{
				text2 = $"{text} {num++}";
			}
			while (ConnectionStorageService.ContainsConnection(text2));
			return text2;
		}

		public override bool Validate(out string errorMessage)
		{
			errorMessage = null;
			if (!((WizardPageBase<ISaveJsonConnectionPageView, ISaveJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.ShouldSaveConnectionString)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(((WizardPageBase<ISaveJsonConnectionPageView, ISaveJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.ConnectionName))
			{
				ShowMessage(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.WizardEmptyConnectionNameMessage));
				return false;
			}
			if (ConnectionStorageService.ContainsConnection(((WizardPageBase<ISaveJsonConnectionPageView, ISaveJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.ConnectionName))
			{
				ShowMessage(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.WizardDataConnectionNameExistsMessage));
				return false;
			}
			return ((WizardPageBase<ISaveJsonConnectionPageView, ISaveJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Validate(ref errorMessage);
		}

		public override void Commit()
		{
			if (((WizardPageBase<ISaveJsonConnectionPageView, ISaveJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.ShouldSaveConnectionString)
			{
				((WizardPageBase<ISaveJsonConnectionPageView, ISaveJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.ConnectionName = ((WizardPageBase<ISaveJsonConnectionPageView, ISaveJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.ConnectionName;
				((WizardPageBase<ISaveJsonConnectionPageView, ISaveJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.ShouldSaveConnection = SaveConnectionMethod.SaveToAppConfig;
			}
			else
			{
				((WizardPageBase<ISaveJsonConnectionPageView, ISaveJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.ShouldSaveConnection = SaveConnectionMethod.Hardcode;
			}
			if (((WizardPageBase<ISaveJsonConnectionPageView, ISaveJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.ShouldSaveCredentials || SensitiveInfoSavingBehavior == JsonSensitiveInfoSavingBehavior.Always)
			{
				TModel model = ((WizardPageBase<ISaveJsonConnectionPageView, ISaveJsonConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model;
				SaveConnectionMethod shouldSaveConnection = model.ShouldSaveConnection | SaveConnectionMethod.KeepCredentials;
				model.ShouldSaveConnection = shouldSaveConnection;
			}
		}

		public override Type GetNextPageType()
		{
			return typeof(ChooseJsonSchemaPage<TModel>);
		}

		public virtual void ShowMessage(string message)
		{
			Context.ShowMessage(message);
		}

	public abstract class ChooseConnectionPageBase<TModel> : WizardPageBase<IChooseConnectionPageView, TModel> where TModel : class, ISqlDataConnectionModel
	{
		private readonly IWizardRunnerContext context;

		private readonly IEnumerable<SqlDataConnection> dataConnections;

		protected SqlDataConnection validatedConnection;

		public override bool FinishEnabled => ((WizardPageBase<IChooseConnectionPageView, IChooseConnectionPageView>)(object)this).GetNextPageType() == null;

		public override bool MoveNextEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (((WizardPageBase<IChooseConnectionPageView, IChooseConnectionPageView>)(object)this).GetNextPageType() == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!DisableNewConnections && ((WizardPageBase<IChooseConnectionPageView, IChooseConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.ShouldCreateNewConnection)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return DataConnection != null;
			}
		}

		protected IEnumerable<SqlDataConnection> DataConnections { get; private set; }

		protected virtual IWaitFormActivator WaitFormActivator => context.WaitFormActivator;

		protected virtual IExceptionHandler ExceptionHandler => ((IUIRunnerContext)context).CreateExceptionHandler((ExceptionHandlerKind)1);

		protected SensitiveInfoSavingBehavior DatabaseCredentialsSavingBehavior { get; }

		protected SqlWizardOptions Options { get; }

		protected IConnectionStorageService ConnectionStorageService { get; }

		protected SqlDataConnection DataConnection => DataConnections.FirstOrDefault((SqlDataConnection c) => ((INamedItem)c).Name == ((WizardPageBase<IChooseConnectionPageView, IChooseConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.ExistingConnectionName);

		protected bool AlwaysSaveCredentials => DatabaseCredentialsSavingBehavior == SensitiveInfoSavingBehavior.Always;

		protected bool DisableNewConnections => Options.HasFlag(SqlWizardOptions.DisableNewConnections);

		protected string ProviderKey
		{
			get
			{
				SqlDataConnection dataConnection = ((WizardPageBase<IChooseConnectionPageView, IChooseConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection;
				if (dataConnection == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				ProviderFactory factory = dataConnection.Factory;
				if (factory == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return factory.ProviderKey;
			}
		}

		protected abstract Type ConfigureConnectionPropertiesPage { get; }

		protected abstract Type SaveConnectionPageType { get; }

		public override Type GetNextPageType()
		{
			if (!DisableNewConnections && ((WizardPageBase<IChooseConnectionPageView, IChooseConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.ShouldCreateNewConnection)
			{
				return ConfigureConnectionPropertiesPage;
			}
			if (DataConnection != null && DataConnection.StoreConnectionNameOnly)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (ConnectionStorageService.CanSaveConnection)
			{
				return SaveConnectionPageType;
			}
			bool flag = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(DataConnection.ConnectionString) && DataConnectionHelper.HasSensitiveInfo(DataConnection.ConnectionStringSerializable);
			if (DataConnection != null && flag && DatabaseCredentialsSavingBehavior == SensitiveInfoSavingBehavior.Prompt)
			{
				return SaveConnectionPageType;
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected ChooseConnectionPageBase(IChooseConnectionPageView view, IWizardRunnerContext context, IConnectionStorageService connectionStorageService, SqlWizardOptions options, SensitiveInfoSavingBehavior databaseCredentialsSavingBehavior)
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseConnectionPageView, IChooseConnectionPageView>)(object)this)..ctor(view);
			this.context = context;
			Options = options;
			DatabaseCredentialsSavingBehavior = databaseCredentialsSavingBehavior;
			ConnectionStorageService = connectionStorageService;
			dataConnections = ((ConnectionStorageService != null) ? ConnectionStorageService.GetConnections() : Enumerable.Empty<SqlDataConnection>());
		}

		public override void Begin()
		{
			DataConnections = FilterDataConnections(dataConnections);
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseConnectionPageView, IChooseConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.SetConnections(DataConnections.Select((SqlDataConnection c) => ((INamedItem)c).Name));
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseConnectionPageView, IChooseConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.Changed += View_Changed;
			string value = ((WizardPageBase<IChooseConnectionPageView, IChooseConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection?.Name;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				string selectedConnection = ((INamedItem)(DataConnections.FirstOrDefault((SqlDataConnection c) => c.Name == ((WizardPageBase<IChooseConnectionPageView, IChooseConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection.Name && ((INamedItem)c).Name == ((INamedItem)((WizardPageBase<IChooseConnectionPageView, IChooseConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection).Name) ?? DataConnections.FirstOrDefault((SqlDataConnection c) => c.Name == ((WizardPageBase<IChooseConnectionPageView, IChooseConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection.Name)))?.Name ?? ((INamedItem)((WizardPageBase<IChooseConnectionPageView, IChooseConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection).Name;
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseConnectionPageView, IChooseConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.SetSelectedConnection(selectedConnection);
			}
			else
			{
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseConnectionPageView, IChooseConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.SetSelectedConnection(DataConnections.Cast<INamedItem>().FirstOrDefault()?.Name);
			}
		}

		private void View_Changed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseConnectionPageView, IChooseConnectionPageView>)(object)this).RaiseChanged();
		}

		protected virtual IEnumerable<SqlDataConnection> FilterDataConnections(IEnumerable<SqlDataConnection> sqlDataConnections)
		{
			List<SqlDataConnection> result = sqlDataConnections.Where((SqlDataConnection dc) => DataConnectionHelper.IsAcceptableSqlConnectionString(dc.ConnectionString)).ToList();
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(ProviderKey))
			{
				result = result.FilterByProviderKey(ProviderKey).ToList();
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override bool Validate(out string errorMessage)
		{
			errorMessage = string.Empty;
			if (((WizardPageBase<IChooseConnectionPageView, IChooseConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.ShouldCreateNewConnection)
			{
				return true;
			}
			SqlDataConnection dataConnection = DataConnection;
			bool flag = ConnectionHelper.ValidateConnection(dataConnection, ExceptionHandler, WaitFormActivator);
			if (flag)
			{
				validatedConnection = dataConnection;
			}
			return flag;
		}

		public override void Commit()
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseConnectionPageView, IChooseConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.Changed -= View_Changed;
			if (((WizardPageBase<IChooseConnectionPageView, IChooseConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.ShouldCreateNewConnection && ((WizardPageBase<IChooseConnectionPageView, IChooseConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(((WizardPageBase<IChooseConnectionPageView, IChooseConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection.Name) && ((WizardPageBase<IChooseConnectionPageView, IChooseConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection.StoreConnectionNameOnly)
			{
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseConnectionPageView, IChooseConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection = new SqlDataConnection(((WizardPageBase<IChooseConnectionPageView, IChooseConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection.Name, ((WizardPageBase<IChooseConnectionPageView, IChooseConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection.CreateDataConnectionParameters());
			}
			if (validatedConnection != null && !((WizardPageBase<IChooseConnectionPageView, IChooseConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.ShouldCreateNewConnection)
			{
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseConnectionPageView, IChooseConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection = validatedConnection;
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseConnectionPageView, IChooseConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.ConnectionName = validatedConnection.Name;
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseConnectionPageView, IChooseConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.ShouldSaveConnection = ((validatedConnection.StoreConnectionNameOnly || ConnectionStorageService.CanSaveConnection) ? SaveConnectionMethod.SaveToAppConfig : SaveConnectionMethod.Hardcode);
				if (AlwaysSaveCredentials)
				{
					TModel model = ((WizardPageBase<IChooseConnectionPageView, IChooseConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model;

	public class ChooseEFConnectionStringPage<TModel> : WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, TModel> where TModel : class, IEFDataSourceModel
	{
		protected internal class ConnectionStringNamedItemWrapper : IConnectionStringInfo, INamedItem
		{
			internal class EqualityComparer : IEqualityComparer<ConnectionStringNamedItemWrapper>
			{
				public bool Equals(ConnectionStringNamedItemWrapper x, ConnectionStringNamedItemWrapper y)
				{
					//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
					//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
					if (x.Location != y.Location)
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (!string.Equals(x.Name, y.Name, StringComparison.InvariantCulture))
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (!string.Equals(x.ProviderName, y.ProviderName, StringComparison.InvariantCulture))
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (!string.Equals(x.RunTimeConnectionString, y.RunTimeConnectionString, StringComparison.InvariantCulture))
					{
						return false;
					}
					return true;
				}

				public int GetHashCode(ConnectionStringNamedItemWrapper obj)
				{
					if (obj.Name == null)
					{
						return 0;
					}
					return obj.Name.GetHashCode();
				}
			}

			private IConnectionStringInfo source;

			public DataConnectionLocation Location => source.Location;

			public string Name => source.Name;

			public string ProviderName => source.ProviderName;

			public string RunTimeConnectionString => source.RunTimeConnectionString;

			string INamedItem.Name
			{
				get
				{
					//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
					//IL_000c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
					if ((int)source.Location == 1)
					{
						return $"{source.Name}{DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.ConnectionStringPostfixServerExplorer)}";
					}
					return source.Name;
				}
				set
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException();
				}
			}

			public ConnectionStringNamedItemWrapper(IConnectionStringInfo connectionStringInfo)
			{
				source = connectionStringInfo;
			}
		}

		private readonly IWizardRunnerContext context;

		protected List<ConnectionStringNamedItemWrapper> connections;

		protected bool shouldChooseStoredProcedure;

		private bool shouldShowConnectionList;

		private EFDataConnection dataConnection;

		private IConnectionStringInfo connectionInfo;

		public override bool MoveNextEnabled => ShouldShowNextPage;

		public override bool FinishEnabled => !ShouldShowNextPage;

		protected bool ShouldShowConnectionPropertiesPage
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_001a: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				if (((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).View.Mode != ConfigureConnectionMode.New)
				{
					if ((int)SelectedConnectionInfo.Location == 1)
					{
						return ConnectionStorageService.CanSaveConnection;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected bool ShouldShowNextPage => true;

		protected virtual IWaitFormActivator WaitFormActivator => context.WaitFormActivator;

		protected virtual IExceptionHandler ExceptionHandler => ((IUIRunnerContext)context).CreateExceptionHandler((ExceptionHandlerKind)1);

		private IConnectionStorageService ConnectionStorageService { get; set; }

		private IConnectionStringInfo SelectedConnectionInfo => (IConnectionStringInfo)(object)connections.SingleOrDefault((ConnectionStringNamedItemWrapper c) => ((INamedItem)c).Name == ((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).View.SelectedConnectionName);

		private IConnectionStringsProvider ConnectionStringsProvider { get; set; }

		public ChooseEFConnectionStringPage(IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView view, IWizardRunnerContext context, IConnectionStringsProvider connectionStringsProvider, IConnectionStorageService connectionStorageService)
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this)..ctor(view);
			this.context = context;
			ConnectionStringsProvider = connectionStringsProvider;
			ConnectionStorageService = connectionStorageService;
		}

		public override void Begin()
		{
			//IL_013c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0142: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_014f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0155: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			ConfigureConnectionMode configureConnectionMode = ConfigureConnectionMode.Default;
			IEnumerable<string> availableConnections = Enumerable.Empty<string>();
			string selectedConnectionName = null;
			string text = null;
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).View.Changed -= View_Changed;
			dataConnection = new EFDataConnection(((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).Model.ConnectionName, ((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).Model.ConnectionParameters)
			{
				SolutionTypesProvider = ((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection.SolutionTypesProvider,
				ConnectionStringsProvider = ((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection.ConnectionStringsProvider
			};
			if (ConnectionStringsProvider != null)
			{
				IEnumerable<IConnectionStringInfo> source = ConnectionStringsProvider.GetConnections().Union(ConnectionStringsProvider.GetConfigFileConnections());
				connections = source.Select((IConnectionStringInfo csi) => new ConnectionStringNamedItemWrapper(csi)).Distinct(new ConnectionStringNamedItemWrapper.EqualityComparer()).ToList();
				shouldShowConnectionList = connections.Count > 0;
				if (shouldShowConnectionList)
				{
					availableConnections = connections.Select((ConnectionStringNamedItemWrapper c) => ((INamedItem)c).Name);
					if ((int)((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).Model.ConnectionStringLocation == 2 || (int)((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).Model.ConnectionStringLocation == 1)
					{
						INamedItem namedItem = connections.FirstOrDefault((ConnectionStringNamedItemWrapper c) => c.Name == ((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).Model.ConnectionParameters.ConnectionStringName);
						if (namedItem != null)
						{
							selectedConnectionName = namedItem.Name;
							configureConnectionMode = ConfigureConnectionMode.Existing;
						}
					}
					else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).Model.ConnectionParameters.ConnectionString))
					{
						configureConnectionMode = ConfigureConnectionMode.New;
						text = DataConnectionHelper.ObscureConnectionString(((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).Model.ConnectionParameters.ConnectionString);
					}
					else
					{
						ApplySelectedConnectionString(dataConnection);
					}
				}
			}
			else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).Model.ConnectionParameters.ConnectionString))
			{
				configureConnectionMode = ConfigureConnectionMode.New;
				text = DataConnectionHelper.ObscureConnectionString(((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).Model.ConnectionParameters.ConnectionString);
			}
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).View.Initialize(configureConnectionMode, availableConnections, shouldShowConnectionList);
			UpdateCanSaveToStorage();
			if (configureConnectionMode == ConfigureConnectionMode.Existing)
			{
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).View.SelectedConnectionName = selectedConnectionName;
			}
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).View.NewConnectionName = dataConnection.Name;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).View.NewConnectionString = text;
			}
			shouldChooseStoredProcedure = CanChooseStoredProcedures();
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).RaiseChanged();
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).View.Changed += View_Changed;
		}

		private bool TryOpenConnection(EFDataConnection oldConnection, EFDataConnection newConnection)
		{
			EmptyExceptionHandler emptyExceptionHandler = new EmptyExceptionHandler();
			if (oldConnection.IsConnected && EFConnectionParameters.EqualityComparer.Equals(oldConnection.ConnectionParameters, oldConnection.ConnectionParameters))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (OpenConnection(newConnection, (IExceptionHandler)(object)emptyExceptionHandler))
			{
				oldConnection.Close();
				if (emptyExceptionHandler.Exception != null)
				{
					ExceptionHandler.HandleException(emptyExceptionHandler.Exception);
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			Exception ex = new InvalidOperationException("Cannot open a connection");
			ExceptionHandler.HandleException(ex);
			return false;
		}

		public override bool Validate(out string errorMessage)
		{
			errorMessage = string.Empty;
			connectionInfo = null;
			EmptyExceptionHandler emptyExceptionHandler = new EmptyExceptionHandler();
			if (((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).View.ShouldSaveConnectionString)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).View.NewConnectionName))
				{
					ShowMessage(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.WizardEmptyConnectionNameMessage));
					return false;
				}
				if (ConnectionStorageService.Contains(((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).View.NewConnectionName))
				{
					ShowMessage(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.WizardDataConnectionNameExistsMessage));
					return false;
				}
			}
			EFDataConnection eFDataConnection = dataConnection;
			EFDataConnection eFDataConnection2;
			if (((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).View.Mode == ConfigureConnectionMode.Default)
			{
				eFDataConnection2 = new EFDataConnection(((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).Model.ConnectionParameters.ConnectionStringName, new EFConnectionParameters(((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).Model.ConnectionParameters.Source, string.Empty, string.Empty))
				{
					SolutionTypesProvider = eFDataConnection.SolutionTypesProvider,
					ConnectionStringsProvider = eFDataConnection.ConnectionStringsProvider
				};
			}
			else if (((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).View.Mode == ConfigureConnectionMode.New)
			{
				eFDataConnection2 = new EFDataConnection(string.Empty, new EFConnectionParameters(((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).Model.ConnectionParameters.Source, ((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).View.NewConnectionName, ((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).View.NewConnectionString))
				{
					SolutionTypesProvider = eFDataConnection.SolutionTypesProvider,
					ConnectionStringsProvider = eFDataConnection.ConnectionStringsProvider
				};
			}
			else
			{
				eFDataConnection2 = new EFDataConnection(null, new EFConnectionParameters(((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).Model.ConnectionParameters.Source, null, null))
				{
					SolutionTypesProvider = eFDataConnection.SolutionTypesProvider,
					ConnectionStringsProvider = eFDataConnection.ConnectionStringsProvider
				};
				ApplySelectedConnectionString(eFDataConnection2);
			}
			bool flag = TryOpenConnection(eFDataConnection, eFDataConnection2);
			if (flag)
			{
				dataConnection = eFDataConnection2;
			}
			else
			{
				connectionInfo = null;
			}
			return flag;
		}

		protected virtual bool CanChooseStoredProcedures()
		{
			return dataConnection.SourceMethods.Length != 0;
		}

		protected virtual bool OpenConnection(EFDataConnection newConnection, IExceptionHandler exceptionHandler)
		{
			return ConnectionHelper.OpenConnection(newConnection, exceptionHandler, WaitFormActivator);
		}

		public override void Commit()
		{
			if (!EFConnectionParameters.EqualityComparer.Equals(((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).Model.ConnectionParameters, ((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection.ConnectionParameters))
			{
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).Model.StoredProceduresInfo = null;
			}
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection = dataConnection;
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).Model.ConnectionParameters = dataConnection.ConnectionParameters;
			if (((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).View.ShouldSaveConnectionString)
			{
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).Model.ConnectionName = ((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).View.NewConnectionName;
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).Model.ConnectionParameters.ConnectionStringName = ((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).View.NewConnectionName;
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).Model.ShouldSaveConnection = SaveConnectionMethod.SaveToAppConfigWithCredentials;
			}
			else
			{
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).Model.ShouldSaveConnection = SaveConnectionMethod.KeepCredentials;
			}
			if (((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).FinishEnabled)
			{
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).Model.StoredProceduresInfo = null;
			}
		}

		public override Type GetNextPageType()
		{
			if (!shouldChooseStoredProcedure)
			{
				return typeof(ConfigureEFFiltersPage<TModel>);
			}
			return typeof(ConfigureEFStoredProceduresPage<TModel>);
		}

		protected virtual void ShowMessage(string message)
		{
			context.ShowMessage(message);
		}

		private void View_Changed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateCanSaveToStorage();
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).RaiseChanged();
		}

		private void UpdateCanSaveToStorage()
		{
			//IL_003b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0041: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (ConnectionStorageService.CanSaveConnection && ((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).View.Mode != ConfigureConnectionMode.Default)
			{
				IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView view = ((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).View;
				int canSaveToStorage;
				if (((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).View.Mode != ConfigureConnectionMode.New)
				{
					IConnectionStringInfo selectedConnectionInfo = SelectedConnectionInfo;
					canSaveToStorage = ((selectedConnectionInfo != null && (int)selectedConnectionInfo.Location == 1 && ConnectionStorageService.CanSaveConnection) ? 1 : 0);
				}
				else
				{
					canSaveToStorage = 1;
				}
				view.SetCanSaveToStorage((byte)canSaveToStorage != 0);
			}
			else
			{
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView, IChooseEFConnectionStringPageView>)(object)this).View.SetCanSaveToStorage(value: false);
			}
		}

		private void ApplySelectedConnectionString(EFDataConnection connection)
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			IConnectionStringInfo selectedConnectionInfo = SelectedConnectionInfo;
			if (selectedConnectionInfo != null)
			{
				if ((int)selectedConnectionInfo.Location == 1)
				{
					connection.ConnectionParameters.ConnectionString = selectedConnectionInfo.RunTimeConnectionString;
					connection.ConnectionParameters.ConnectionStringName = string.Empty;
				}
				else
				{
					connection.ConnectionParameters.ConnectionString = string.Empty;
					connection.ConnectionParameters.ConnectionStringName = selectedConnectionInfo.Name;
				}
				connectionInfo = SelectedConnectionInfo;
			}
		}
	}
	public class ChooseEFContextPage<TModel> : WizardPageBase<IChooseEFContextPageView, TModel> where TModel : class, IEFDataSourceModel
	{
		private readonly IWizardRunnerContext context;

		private IEntityFrameworkModelHelper modelHelper;

		private ISolutionTypesProvider solutionTypesProvider;

		private EFDataConnection dataConnection;

		public override bool MoveNextEnabled => GetDataConnection() != null;

		protected virtual IExceptionHandler ExceptionHandler => ((IUIRunnerContext)context).CreateExceptionHandler((ExceptionHandlerKind)0);

		protected IWaitFormActivator WaitFormActivator => context.WaitFormActivator;

		private ISolutionTypesProvider SolutionTypesProvider { get; set; }

		private IConnectionStringsProvider ConnectionStringsProvider { get; set; }

		public ChooseEFContextPage(IChooseEFContextPageView view, IWizardRunnerContext context, ISolutionTypesProvider solutionTypesProvider, IConnectionStringsProvider connectionStringsProvider)
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFContextPageView, IChooseEFContextPageView>)(object)this)..ctor(view);
			this.context = context;
			SolutionTypesProvider = solutionTypesProvider;
			ConnectionStringsProvider = connectionStringsProvider;
		}

		public override void Begin()
		{
			modelHelper = ((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFContextPageView, IChooseEFContextPageView>)(object)this).Model.ModelHelper;
			solutionTypesProvider = SolutionTypesProvider;
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFContextPageView, IChooseEFContextPageView>)(object)this).View.BrowseForAssembly += View_BrowseForAssembly;
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFContextPageView, IChooseEFContextPageView>)(object)this).View.ContextNameChanged += View_ContextNameChanged;
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFContextPageView, IChooseEFContextPageView>)(object)this).View.Initialize();
			if (((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFContextPageView, IChooseEFContextPageView>)(object)this).Model.ConnectionParameters == null)
			{
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFContextPageView, IChooseEFContextPageView>)(object)this).Model.ConnectionParameters = new EFConnectionParameters();
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFContextPageView, IChooseEFContextPageView>)(object)this).Model.ConnectionParameters.CustomAssemblyPath))
			{
				try
				{
					modelHelper.OpenAssembly(((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFContextPageView, IChooseEFContextPageView>)(object)this).Model.ConnectionParameters.CustomAssemblyPath, ExceptionHandler);
				}
				catch (FileNotFoundException)
				{
					ShowMessage(string.Format(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.MessageCannotLoadCustomAssembly), ((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFContextPageView, IChooseEFContextPageView>)(object)this).Model.ConnectionParameters.CustomAssemblyPath, ((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFContextPageView, IChooseEFContextPageView>)(object)this).Model.ConnectionParameters.CustomContextName));
					((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFContextPageView, IChooseEFContextPageView>)(object)this).Model.ConnectionParameters.CustomAssemblyPath = null;
				}
			}
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFContextPageView, IChooseEFContextPageView>)(object)this).View.RefreshContextList(modelHelper.Containers);
			if (((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFContextPageView, IChooseEFContextPageView>)(object)this).Model.ConnectionParameters.Source != null)
			{
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFContextPageView, IChooseEFContextPageView>)(object)this).View.ContextName = ((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFContextPageView, IChooseEFContextPageView>)(object)this).Model.ConnectionParameters.Source.FullName;
			}
			else
			{
				SelectFirstContainer();
			}
		}

		private void SelectFirstContainer()
		{
			IContainerInfo val = modelHelper.Containers.FirstOrDefault();
			if (val != null)
			{
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFContextPageView, IChooseEFContextPageView>)(object)this).View.ContextName = ((IDXTypeInfo)val).FullName;
			}
		}

		private void View_ContextNameChanged(object sender, ContextNameChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFContextPageView, IChooseEFContextPageView>)(object)this).RaiseChanged();
		}

		private void View_BrowseForAssembly(object sender, BrowseForAssemblyEventArgs e)
		{
			string assemblyPath = e.AssemblyPath;
			BeforeLoadCustomAssemblyEventArgs e2 = RaiseBeforeLoadCustomAssembly(assemblyPath);
			if (!e2.AllowLoading)
			{
				ShowMessage(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.WizardAssemblyLoadingDisallowed));
				return;
			}
			assemblyPath = e2.AssemblyPath;
			if (modelHelper.OpenAssembly(assemblyPath, ExceptionHandler))
			{
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFContextPageView, IChooseEFContextPageView>)(object)this).View.RefreshContextList(modelHelper.Containers);
				SelectFirstContainer();
				if (!modelHelper.Containers.Any())
				{
					ShowMessage(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.WizardNoEFDataContextsMessage));
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual BeforeLoadCustomAssemblyEventArgs RaiseBeforeLoadCustomAssembly(string path)
		{
			return EFDataSource.RaiseBeforeLoadCustomAssemblyGlobal(null, path, null);
		}

		public override bool Validate(out string errorMessage)
		{
			errorMessage = string.Empty;
			try
			{
				dataConnection = GetDataConnection();
				if (modelHelper.IsCustomAssembly)
				{
					SolutionTypesProvider.AddReferenceFromFile(modelHelper.CustomAssemblyPath);
					List<string> list = new List<string>();
					string[] referencedAssemblies = modelHelper.ReferencedAssemblies;
					foreach (string text in referencedAssemblies)
					{
						if (!SolutionTypesProvider.IsReferenceExists(text))
						{
							list.Add(text);
						}
					}
					if (list.Count > 0)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0} {1}", new object[2]
						{
							"Please add references to the following assemblies to your project:",
							string.Join("; ", list)
						}));
					}
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				ExceptionHandler.HandleException(ex);
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override void Commit()
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFContextPageView, IChooseEFContextPageView>)(object)this).View.ContextNameChanged -= View_ContextNameChanged;
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFContextPageView, IChooseEFContextPageView>)(object)this).View.BrowseForAssembly -= View_BrowseForAssembly;
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFContextPageView, IChooseEFContextPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection = dataConnection;
		}

		public override Type GetNextPageType()
		{
			return typeof(ChooseEFConnectionStringPage<TModel>);
		}

		public EFDataConnection GetDataConnection()
		{
			if (modelHelper == null || ((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFContextPageView, IChooseEFContextPageView>)(object)this).View.ContextName == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IContainerInfo val = modelHelper.Containers.FirstOrDefault((IContainerInfo c) => ((IDXTypeInfo)c).FullName == ((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFContextPageView, IChooseEFContextPageView>)(object)this).View.ContextName);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IEFDataSourceModel model = ((WizardPageBase<IChooseEFContextPageView, IChooseEFContextPageView>)(object)this).Model;
			Type type = ((IDXTypeInfo)val).ResolveType();
			if (modelHelper.IsCustomAssembly && solutionTypesProvider is RuntimeSolutionTypesProvider && type != null)
			{
				model.ConnectionParameters = new EFConnectionParameters(type.FullName, modelHelper.CustomAssemblyPath, model.ConnectionParameters.ConnectionStringName, model.ConnectionParameters.ConnectionString);
				solutionTypesProvider = (ISolutionTypesProvider)(object)new RuntimeSolutionTypesProvider(type.Assembly.GetTypes);
			}
			model.ConnectionParameters.Source = type;
			return new EFDataConnection(string.Empty, new EFConnectionParameters(model.ConnectionParameters))
			{
				SolutionTypesProvider = solutionTypesProvider,
				ConnectionStringsProvider = ConnectionStringsProvider
			};
		}

		public virtual void ShowMessage(string message)
		{
			context.ShowMessage(message);
		}
	}

		private CsvSourceOptions optionsForDetect = new CsvSourceOptions
		{
			DetectNewlineType = true,
			DetectValueSeparator = true,
			DetectEncoding = true
		};

		[Dependency]
		protected UrlResolver UrlResolver { get; set; }

		protected virtual IWaitFormActivator WaitFormActivator => context.WaitFormActivator;

		protected virtual IExceptionHandler ExceptionHandler => ((IUIRunnerContext)context).CreateExceptionHandler((ExceptionHandlerKind)0);

		public override Type GetNextPageType()
		{
