			{
				return typeof(ChooseExcelFileDataRangePage<TModel>);
			}
			return typeof(ConfigureExcelFileColumnsPage<TModel>);
		}

		public override void Begin()
		{
			string fullPath = SafePathHelper.Instance.FixAndValidatePath(((WizardPageBase<IChooseFileOptionsPageView, IChooseFileOptionsPageView>)(object)this).Model.FileName, UrlResolver, dataDirectoryPatchingService, AccessSettings.DataResources);
			documentFormat = ExcelDataLoaderHelper.DetectFormat(fullPath);
			if (documentFormat == ExcelDocumentFormat.Csv)
			{
				DetectOptions((CsvSourceOptions)((WizardPageBase<IChooseFileOptionsPageView, IChooseFileOptionsPageView>)(object)this).Model.SourceOptions);
			}
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseFileOptionsPageView, IChooseFileOptionsPageView>)(object)this).View.DocumentFormat = documentFormat;
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseFileOptionsPageView, IChooseFileOptionsPageView>)(object)this).View.Initialize(((WizardPageBase<IChooseFileOptionsPageView, IChooseFileOptionsPageView>)(object)this).Model.SourceOptions.Clone());
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseFileOptionsPageView, IChooseFileOptionsPageView>)(object)this).View.DetectEncoding += View_DetectEncoding;
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseFileOptionsPageView, IChooseFileOptionsPageView>)(object)this).View.DetectNewlineType += View_DetectNewlineType;
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseFileOptionsPageView, IChooseFileOptionsPageView>)(object)this).View.DetectValueSeparator += View_DetectValueSeparator;
		}

		private void View_DetectValueSeparator(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			DetectOptions(optionsForDetect);
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseFileOptionsPageView, IChooseFileOptionsPageView>)(object)this).View.SetValueSeparator(optionsForDetect.ValueSeparator);
		}

		private void View_DetectNewlineType(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			DetectOptions(optionsForDetect);
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseFileOptionsPageView, IChooseFileOptionsPageView>)(object)this).View.SetNewlineType(optionsForDetect.NewlineType);
		}

		private void View_DetectEncoding(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			DetectOptions(optionsForDetect);
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseFileOptionsPageView, IChooseFileOptionsPageView>)(object)this).View.SetEncoding(optionsForDetect.Encoding);
		}

		public override bool Validate(out string errorMessage)
		{
			errorMessage = null;
			if (!object.Equals(((WizardPageBase<IChooseFileOptionsPageView, IChooseFileOptionsPageView>)(object)this).Model.SourceOptions, ((WizardPageBase<IChooseFileOptionsPageView, IChooseFileOptionsPageView>)(object)this).View.SourceOptions))
			{
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseFileOptionsPageView, IChooseFileOptionsPageView>)(object)this).Model.Schema = null;
			}
			if (documentFormat == ExcelDocumentFormat.Csv)
			{
				Func<CancellationToken, DevExpress.DataAccess.Excel.FieldInfo[]> func = (CancellationToken token) => schemaProvider.GetSchema(GetPatchedFileName(), null, ExcelDocumentFormat.Csv, ((WizardPageBase<IChooseFileOptionsPageView, IChooseFileOptionsPageView>)(object)this).View.SourceOptions, token);
				if (!FieldInfoHelper.GetSchemaFromFile(GetPatchedFileName(), ((WizardPageBase<IChooseFileOptionsPageView, IChooseFileOptionsPageView>)(object)this).View.SourceOptions, schemaProvider, WaitFormActivator, ExceptionHandler, out var schema))
				{
					return false;
				}
				FieldInfoHelper.MergeSchema(((WizardPageBase<IChooseFileOptionsPageView, IChooseFileOptionsPageView>)(object)this).Model.Schema, schema);
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseFileOptionsPageView, IChooseFileOptionsPageView>)(object)this).Model.Schema = schema;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override void Commit()
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseFileOptionsPageView, IChooseFileOptionsPageView>)(object)this).View.DetectEncoding -= View_DetectEncoding;
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseFileOptionsPageView, IChooseFileOptionsPageView>)(object)this).View.DetectNewlineType -= View_DetectNewlineType;
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseFileOptionsPageView, IChooseFileOptionsPageView>)(object)this).View.DetectValueSeparator -= View_DetectValueSeparator;
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseFileOptionsPageView, IChooseFileOptionsPageView>)(object)this).Model.SourceOptions = ((WizardPageBase<IChooseFileOptionsPageView, IChooseFileOptionsPageView>)(object)this).View.SourceOptions;
		}

		private void DetectOptions(CsvSourceOptions options)
		{
			//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0053: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005d: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			if (!options.DetectEncoding && !options.DetectNewlineType && !options.DetectValueSeparator)
			{
				return;
			}
			using Stream stream = new FileStream(GetPatchedFileName(), FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read, FileShare.ReadWrite);
			CsvSpreadsheetSourceOptions val = new CsvSpreadsheetSourceOptions();
			val.AutoDetect(stream);
			if (options.DetectEncoding)
			{
				options.Encoding = val.Encoding;
			}
			if (options.DetectNewlineType)
			{
				options.NewlineType = (CsvNewlineType)val.NewlineType;
			}
			if (options.DetectValueSeparator)
			{
				options.ValueSeparator = val.ValueSeparator;
			}
		}

		private string GetPatchedFileName()
		{
			string text = dataDirectoryPatchingService.PatchPath(((WizardPageBase<IChooseFileOptionsPageView, IChooseFileOptionsPageView>)(object)this).Model.FileName);
			return UrlResolverExtensions.MapPath(UrlResolver, text, "");
		}
	}
	public class ChooseExcelFileDataRangePage<TModel> : WizardPageBase<IChooseExcelFileDataRangePageView, TModel> where TModel : class, IExcelDataSourceModel
	{
		private readonly IWizardRunnerContext context;

		private readonly IExcelSchemaProvider excelSchemaProvider;

		private readonly IDataDirectoryPatchingService dataDirectoryPatchingService;

		private IWorksheetCollection worksheetCollection;

		private ICollection<IDefinedName> definedNamesCollection;

		private ITablesCollection tablesCollection;

		private ListBoxItem[] listBoxItems;

		private ExcelSourceOptions excelSourceOptions;

		private ExcelSettingsBase validatedSettings;

		private string fullPath;

		[Dependency]
		protected UrlResolver UrlResolver { get; set; }

		protected ExcelSourceOptions ExcelSourceOptions
		{
			get
			{
				return excelSourceOptions;
			}
			set
			{
				excelSourceOptions = value;
			}
		}

		public override bool MoveNextEnabled => ((WizardPageBase<IChooseExcelFileDataRangePageView, IChooseExcelFileDataRangePageView>)(object)this).View.SelectedItem != null;

		protected virtual IWaitFormActivator WaitFormActivator => context.WaitFormActivator;

		protected virtual IExceptionHandler ExceptionHandler => ((IUIRunnerContext)context).CreateExceptionHandler((ExceptionHandlerKind)0);

		public ChooseExcelFileDataRangePage(IChooseExcelFileDataRangePageView view, IWizardRunnerContext context, IExcelSchemaProvider excelSchemaProvider, IDataDirectoryPatchingService dataDirectoryPatchingService)
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseExcelFileDataRangePageView, IChooseExcelFileDataRangePageView>)(object)this)..ctor(view);
			this.dataDirectoryPatchingService = dataDirectoryPatchingService;
			this.context = context;
			this.excelSchemaProvider = excelSchemaProvider;
			UrlResolver = UrlResolver.Instance;
		}

		public override Type GetNextPageType()
		{
			return typeof(ConfigureExcelFileColumnsPage<TModel>);
		}

		public override void Begin()
		{
			fullPath = SafePathHelper.Instance.FixAndValidatePath(((WizardPageBase<IChooseExcelFileDataRangePageView, IChooseExcelFileDataRangePageView>)(object)this).Model.FileName, UrlResolver, dataDirectoryPatchingService, AccessSettings.DataResources);
			ISpreadsheetSource val = ExcelDataLoaderHelper.CreateSource(null, ExcelDataLoaderHelper.DetectFormat(fullPath), fullPath, ((WizardPageBase<IChooseExcelFileDataRangePageView, IChooseExcelFileDataRangePageView>)(object)this).Model.SourceOptions);
			try
			{
				worksheetCollection = val.Worksheets;
				definedNamesCollection = ((IEnumerable<IDefinedName>)val.DefinedNames).Where((IDefinedName dn) => !dn.IsHidden).ToList();
				tablesCollection = val.Tables;
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
			listBoxItems = ((IEnumerable<IWorksheet>)worksheetCollection).Select((IWorksheet ws) => new ListBoxItem
			{
				ItemName = ws.Name,
				ItemType = ItemType.Worksheet
			}).Union(definedNamesCollection.Select((IDefinedName dn) => new ListBoxItem
			{
				ItemName = dn.Name,
				ItemType = ItemType.DefinedName
			})).Union(((IEnumerable<ITable>)tablesCollection).Select((ITable t) => new ListBoxItem
			{
				ItemName = t.Name,
				ItemType = ItemType.Table
			}))
				.ToArray();
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseExcelFileDataRangePageView, IChooseExcelFileDataRangePageView>)(object)this).View.Initialize(listBoxItems);
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseExcelFileDataRangePageView, IChooseExcelFileDataRangePageView>)(object)this).View.Changed += ViewOnChanged;
			excelSourceOptions = (ExcelSourceOptions)((WizardPageBase<IChooseExcelFileDataRangePageView, IChooseExcelFileDataRangePageView>)(object)this).Model.SourceOptions;
			ExcelSettingsBase importSettings = excelSourceOptions.ImportSettings;
			if (importSettings is ExcelDefinedNameSettings excelDefinedNameSettings)
			{
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseExcelFileDataRangePageView, IChooseExcelFileDataRangePageView>)(object)this).View.SelectedItem = GetListBoxItem(ItemType.DefinedName, excelDefinedNameSettings.DefinedName);
			}
			else if (importSettings is ExcelTableSettings excelTableSettings)
			{
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseExcelFileDataRangePageView, IChooseExcelFileDataRangePageView>)(object)this).View.SelectedItem = GetListBoxItem(ItemType.Table, excelTableSettings.TableName);
			}
			else if (importSettings is ExcelWorksheetSettings excelWorksheetSettings)
			{
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseExcelFileDataRangePageView, IChooseExcelFileDataRangePageView>)(object)this).View.SelectedItem = GetListBoxItem(ItemType.Worksheet, excelWorksheetSettings.WorksheetName);
			}
		}

		private void ViewOnChanged(object sender, EventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseExcelFileDataRangePageView, IChooseExcelFileDataRangePageView>)(object)this).RaiseChanged();
		}

		public override bool Validate(out string errorMessage)
		{
			errorMessage = string.Empty;
			ExcelSourceOptions excelSourceOptions = (ExcelSourceOptions)((WizardPageBase<IChooseExcelFileDataRangePageView, IChooseExcelFileDataRangePageView>)(object)this).Model.SourceOptions.Clone();
			excelSourceOptions.ImportSettings = CreateImportSettings();
			if (!object.Equals(excelSourceOptions.ImportSettings, ((ExcelSourceOptions)((WizardPageBase<IChooseExcelFileDataRangePageView, IChooseExcelFileDataRangePageView>)(object)this).Model.SourceOptions).ImportSettings))
			{
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseExcelFileDataRangePageView, IChooseExcelFileDataRangePageView>)(object)this).Model.Schema = null;
			}
			if (FieldInfoHelper.GetSchemaFromFile(fullPath, excelSourceOptions, excelSchemaProvider, WaitFormActivator, ExceptionHandler, out var schema))
			{
				if (((WizardPageBase<IChooseExcelFileDataRangePageView, IChooseExcelFileDataRangePageView>)(object)this).Model.Schema != null)
				{
					FieldInfoHelper.MergeSchema(((WizardPageBase<IChooseExcelFileDataRangePageView, IChooseExcelFileDataRangePageView>)(object)this).Model.Schema, schema);
				}
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseExcelFileDataRangePageView, IChooseExcelFileDataRangePageView>)(object)this).Model.Schema = schema;
				validatedSettings = excelSourceOptions.ImportSettings;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override void Commit()
		{
			excelSourceOptions.ImportSettings = validatedSettings;
		}

		private ListBoxItem GetListBoxItem(ItemType itemType, string itemName)
		{
			return listBoxItems.FirstOrDefault((ListBoxItem item) => item.ItemType == itemType && item.ItemName == itemName);
		}

		protected virtual ExcelSettingsBase CreateImportSettings()
		{
			ListBoxItem item = ((WizardPageBase<IChooseExcelFileDataRangePageView, IChooseExcelFileDataRangePageView>)(object)this).View.SelectedItem;
			if (item == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			switch (item.ItemType)
			{
			case ItemType.Worksheet:
			{
				IWorksheet val3 = ((IEnumerable<IWorksheet>)worksheetCollection).First((IWorksheet ws) => ws.Name == item.ItemName);
				return new ExcelWorksheetSettings
				{
					WorksheetName = val3.Name
				};
			}
			case ItemType.DefinedName:
			{
				IDefinedName val2 = definedNamesCollection.First((IDefinedName dn) => dn.Name == item.ItemName);
				return new ExcelDefinedNameSettings
				{
					DefinedName = val2.Name,
					Scope = val2.Scope
				};
			}
			case ItemType.Table:
			{
				ITable val = ((IEnumerable<ITable>)tablesCollection).First((ITable t) => t.Name == item.ItemName);
				return new ExcelTableSettings
				{
					TableName = val.Name
				};
			}
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}
	}

		public override string ToString()

		}
	}
	public enum ItemType
	{
		Worksheet,
		DefinedName,
		Table
	}
	public class ChooseFilePage<TModel> : WizardPageBase<IChooseFilePageView, TModel> where TModel : class, IExcelDataSourceModel
	{
		private readonly IWizardRunnerContext context;

		private readonly IDataDirectoryPatchingService dataDirectoryPatchingService;

		private ExcelSourceOptions actualExcelOptions;

		private FileInfo fileInfo;

		[Dependency]
		protected UrlResolver UrlResolver { get; set; }

		public override bool MoveNextEnabled => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(((WizardPageBase<IChooseFilePageView, IChooseFilePageView>)(object)this).View.FileName);

		protected virtual IExceptionHandler ExceptionHandler => ((IUIRunnerContext)context).CreateExceptionHandler((ExceptionHandlerKind)0);

		private ExcelSourceOptions ActualExcelOptions => (((WizardPageBase<IChooseFilePageView, IChooseFilePageView>)(object)this).Model.SourceOptions as ExcelSourceOptions) ?? actualExcelOptions ?? (actualExcelOptions = new ExcelSourceOptions());

		private ExcelDocumentFormat DocumentFormat { get; set; }

		public ChooseFilePage(IChooseFilePageView view, IWizardRunnerContext context, IDataDirectoryPatchingService dataDirectoryPatchingService)
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseFilePageView, IChooseFilePageView>)(object)this)..ctor(view);
			this.dataDirectoryPatchingService = dataDirectoryPatchingService;
			this.context = context;
			UrlResolver = UrlResolver.Instance;
		}

		public override void Begin()
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseFilePageView, IChooseFilePageView>)(object)this).View.FileName = ((WizardPageBase<IChooseFilePageView, IChooseFilePageView>)(object)this).Model.FileName;
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseFilePageView, IChooseFilePageView>)(object)this).View.Changed += View_Changed;
		}

		public override bool Validate(out string errorMessage)
		{
			//IL_008f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0091: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0097: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			errorMessage = null;
			string text = SafePathHelper.Instance.FixAndValidatePath(((WizardPageBase<IChooseFilePageView, IChooseFilePageView>)(object)this).View.FileName, UrlResolver, dataDirectoryPatchingService, AccessSettings.DataResources);
			if (!File.Exists(text))
			{
				ExceptionHandler.HandleException((Exception)new FileNotFoundException(string.Format(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.ExcelDataSource_FileNotFoundMessage), text), text));
				return false;
			}
			Exception ex3;
			do
			{
				try
				{
					string password = fileInfo.Password;
					DocumentFormat = ExcelDataLoaderHelper.DetectFormat(text);
					if (DocumentFormat == ExcelDocumentFormat.Csv)
					{
						ExcelDataLoaderHelper.TryCreateCsvSource(text);
					}
					else
					{
						ExcelDataLoaderHelper.TryCreateExcelSource(text, password);
					}
					return true;
				}
				catch (EncryptedFileException ex)
				{
					EncryptedFileException ex2 = ex;
					if ((int)ex2.Error == 2)
					{
						ExceptionHandler.HandleException((Exception)ex2.Wrap());
						return false;
					}
					ex3 = ex2.Wrap();
				}
				catch (IOException ex4)
				{
					ex3 = ex4;
				}
				catch (Exception ex5)
				{
					ExceptionHandler.HandleException(ex5);
					return false;
				}
				if (ex3 != null && !((WizardPageBase<IChooseFilePageView, IChooseFilePageView>)(object)this).View.ShowPasswordForm(ex3.Message, ((WizardPageBase<IChooseFilePageView, IChooseFilePageView>)(object)this).View.FileName, out fileInfo))
				{
					return false;
				}
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseFilePageView, IChooseFilePageView>)(object)this).View.FileName = fileInfo.FileName;
			}
			while (ex3 != null);
			return true;
		}

		public override void Commit()
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseFilePageView, IChooseFilePageView>)(object)this).View.Changed -= View_Changed;
			if (((WizardPageBase<IChooseFilePageView, IChooseFilePageView>)(object)this).Model.FileName != ((WizardPageBase<IChooseFilePageView, IChooseFilePageView>)(object)this).View.FileName)
			{
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseFilePageView, IChooseFilePageView>)(object)this).Model.FileName = ((WizardPageBase<IChooseFilePageView, IChooseFilePageView>)(object)this).View.FileName;
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseFilePageView, IChooseFilePageView>)(object)this).Model.Schema = null;
			}
			if (DocumentFormat != ExcelDocumentFormat.Csv)
			{
				ActualExcelOptions.Password = fileInfo.Password;
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseFilePageView, IChooseFilePageView>)(object)this).Model.SourceOptions = ActualExcelOptions;

				{
					DetectNewlineType = true,
					DetectEncoding = true,
					DetectValueSeparator = true
				};
			}
		}

	public class ChooseObjectAssemblyPage<TModel> : WizardPageBase<IChooseObjectAssemblyPageView, TModel> where TModel : class, IObjectDataSourceModel
	{
		private readonly IWizardRunnerContext context;

		private readonly ISolutionTypesProvider solutionTypesProvider;

		private IDXAssemblyInfo[] dxAssemblyInfos;

		private AssemblyViewInfo[] assemblyViewInfos;

		protected virtual IWaitFormActivator WaitFormActivator => context.WaitFormActivator;

		protected virtual IExceptionHandler ExceptionHandler => ((IUIRunnerContext)context).CreateExceptionHandler((ExceptionHandlerKind)0);

		private ISolutionTypesProvider SolutionTypesProvider => solutionTypesProvider;

		public override bool MoveNextEnabled => GetResult() != null;

		public ChooseObjectAssemblyPage(IChooseObjectAssemblyPageView view, IWizardRunnerContext context, ISolutionTypesProvider solutionTypesProvider)
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseObjectAssemblyPageView, IChooseObjectAssemblyPageView>)(object)this)..ctor(view);
			this.context = context;
			this.solutionTypesProvider = solutionTypesProvider;
		}

		public override Type GetNextPageType()
		{
			return ObjectBindingPagesRouter.AfterChooseObjectAssemblyPage<TModel>();
		}

		public override void Begin()
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseObjectAssemblyPageView, IChooseObjectAssemblyPageView>)(object)this).View.Initialize();
			dxAssemblyInfos = GetDXAssemblyInfos();
			AssemblyViewInfo selected = null;
			assemblyViewInfos = dxAssemblyInfos.Where((IDXAssemblyInfo info) => info.TypesInfo.Any()).Select(delegate(IDXAssemblyInfo info)
			{
				AssemblyViewInfo assemblyViewInfo = ConvertToAssemblyViewInfo(info);
				if (((WizardPageBase<IChooseObjectAssemblyPageView, IChooseObjectAssemblyPageView>)(object)this).Model.Assembly != null && string.Equals(info.AssemblyFullName, ((WizardPageBase<IChooseObjectAssemblyPageView, IChooseObjectAssemblyPageView>)(object)this).Model.Assembly.AssemblyFullName))
				{
					selected = assemblyViewInfo;
				}
				return assemblyViewInfo;
			}).ToArray();
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseObjectAssemblyPageView, IChooseObjectAssemblyPageView>)(object)this).View.SetData(assemblyViewInfos, ((WizardPageBase<IChooseObjectAssemblyPageView, IChooseObjectAssemblyPageView>)(object)this).Model.ShowAllState.HasFlag(ShowAllState.Assemblies));
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseObjectAssemblyPageView, IChooseObjectAssemblyPageView>)(object)this).View.SelectedItem = selected;
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseObjectAssemblyPageView, IChooseObjectAssemblyPageView>)(object)this).RaiseChanged();
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseObjectAssemblyPageView, IChooseObjectAssemblyPageView>)(object)this).View.Changed += OnViewOnChanged;
		}

		protected virtual AssemblyViewInfo ConvertToAssemblyViewInfo(IDXAssemblyInfo info)
		{
			AssemblyName assemblyName = new AssemblyName(info.AssemblyFullName);
			Assembly assembly = info.TypesInfo.First().ResolveType().Assembly;
			int priority = (info.IsProjectAssembly ? 2 : (info.IsSolutionAssembly ? 1 : 0));
			return new AssemblyViewInfo(GetCustomAttributesDataSafe(assembly).Any((CustomAttributeData data) => data.Constructor.DeclaringType == typeof(HighlightedAssemblyAttribute)), assemblyName.Name, assemblyName.Version, priority);
		}

		private IDXAssemblyInfo[] GetDXAssemblyInfos()
		{
			WaitFormActivator.ShowWaitForm(false, true, true);
			WaitFormActivator.SetWaitFormCaption(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.LoadingDataPanelText));
			WaitFormActivator.SetWaitFormDescription(string.Empty);
			WaitFormActivator.EnableCancelButton(false);
			Exception ex = null;
			try
			{
				return ((IEnumerable<IDXAssemblyInfo>)SolutionTypesProvider.ActiveProjectTypes).ToArray();
			}
			catch (Exception innerException)
			{
				ex = new CannotGetTypesException(innerException);
				return (IDXAssemblyInfo[])(object)new IDXAssemblyInfo[0];
			}
			finally
			{
				WaitFormActivator.CloseWaitForm();
				if (ex != null)
				{
					ExceptionHandler.HandleException(ex);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnViewOnChanged(object sender, EventArgs args)
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseObjectAssemblyPageView, IChooseObjectAssemblyPageView>)(object)this).RaiseChanged();
		}

		private IList<CustomAttributeData> GetCustomAttributesDataSafe(Assembly asmb)
		{
			List<CustomAttributeData> result = new List<CustomAttributeData>();
			try
			{
				return asmb.GetCustomAttributesData();
			}
			catch
			{
				return result;
			}
		}

		public override void Commit()
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseObjectAssemblyPageView, IChooseObjectAssemblyPageView>)(object)this).View.Changed -= OnViewOnChanged;
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseObjectAssemblyPageView, IChooseObjectAssemblyPageView>)(object)this).Model.Assembly = GetResult();
			TModel model;
			if (((WizardPageBase<IChooseObjectAssemblyPageView, IChooseObjectAssemblyPageView>)(object)this).View.ShowAll)
			{
				model = ((WizardPageBase<IChooseObjectAssemblyPageView, IChooseObjectAssemblyPageView>)(object)this).Model;
				ref TModel reference = ref model;
				ref TModel reference2 = ref reference;
				ShowAllState showAllState = reference.ShowAllState | ShowAllState.Assemblies;
				reference2.ShowAllState = showAllState;
			}
			else
			{
				model = ((WizardPageBase<IChooseObjectAssemblyPageView, IChooseObjectAssemblyPageView>)(object)this).Model;
				ref TModel reference = ref model;
				ref TModel reference3 = ref reference;
				ShowAllState showAllState2 = reference.ShowAllState & ~ShowAllState.Assemblies;
				reference3.ShowAllState = showAllState2;
			}
		}

		public override bool Validate(out string errorMessage)
		{
			errorMessage = null;
			return GetResult() != null;
		}

		protected IDXAssemblyInfo GetResult()
		{
			if (dxAssemblyInfos == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num = assemblyViewInfos.ToList().IndexOf(((WizardPageBase<IChooseObjectAssemblyPageView, IChooseObjectAssemblyPageView>)(object)this).View.SelectedItem);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return dxAssemblyInfos[num];
		}
	}

		{

		private List<TypeViewInfo> GatherViewInfos(out TypeViewInfo selected)
		{
			List<TypeViewInfo> list = new List<TypeViewInfo>();
			selected = null;
			List<IDXTypeInfo> list2 = new List<IDXTypeInfo>();
			List<IDXTypeInfo> list3 = new List<IDXTypeInfo>(dxTypeInfos.Count());
			foreach (IDXTypeInfo dxTypeInfo in dxTypeInfos)
			{
				if (!typeInfoAnalyzer.IsGenericTypeDefinition(dxTypeInfo) && !typeInfoAnalyzer.IsEnum(dxTypeInfo))
				{
					(typeInfoAnalyzer.IsNested(dxTypeInfo) ? list2 : list3).Add(dxTypeInfo);
				}
			}
			foreach (IDXTypeInfo item in list3)
			{
				list.Add(CreateTypeViewInfo(item, ref selected, list2));
			}
			return list;
		}

		private TypeViewInfo CreateTypeViewInfo(IDXTypeInfo info, ref TypeViewInfo selected, List<IDXTypeInfo> nestedTypes)
		{
			TypeViewInfoNodeType classType = typeInfoAnalyzer.GetClassType(info);
			bool highlighted = typeInfoAnalyzer.IsHighlighted(info);
			IEnumerable<TypeViewInfo> nested = Nested(info, nestedTypes, ref selected);
			TypeViewInfo typeViewInfo = new TypeViewInfo(highlighted, info.NamespaceName, ((IHasName)info).Name, info.FullName, classType, nested);
			if (((WizardPageBase<IChooseObjectTypePageView, IChooseObjectTypePageView>)(object)this).Model.ObjectType != null && string.Equals(info.FullName, ((WizardPageBase<IChooseObjectTypePageView, IChooseObjectTypePageView>)(object)this).Model.ObjectType.FullName))
			{
				selected = typeViewInfo;
			}
			return typeViewInfo;
		}

		private IEnumerable<TypeViewInfo> Nested(IDXTypeInfo typeInfo, List<IDXTypeInfo> nestedTypes, ref TypeViewInfo selected)
		{
			List<TypeViewInfo> list = new List<TypeViewInfo>();
			foreach (IDXTypeInfo nestedType in nestedTypes)
			{
				if (typeInfoAnalyzer.IsDeclaringTypeEquals(typeInfo, nestedType))
				{
					list.Add(CreateTypeViewInfo(nestedType, ref selected, nestedTypes));
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected virtual void ViewOnChanged(object sender, EventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseObjectTypePageView, IChooseObjectTypePageView>)(object)this).RaiseChanged();
		}

		public override bool Validate(out string errorMessage)
		{
			errorMessage = null;
			IDXTypeInfo result = GetResult();
			if (result == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Type type = result.ResolveType();
			if (GetNextPageTypeCore() == null)
			{
				try
				{
					object data = ObjectDataSourceFillHelper.CreateInstanceForSchema(type);
					ResultTypedList resultTypedList = ObjectDataSourceFillHelper.CreateTypedList(data, type.Name);
					if (resultTypedList.GetItemProperties(null).Count == 0)
					{
						ShowMessage(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.ObjectDataSourceWizard_CannotGetTypeProperties));
						return false;
					}
					((WizardPageBase<IChooseObjectTypePageView, IChooseObjectTypePageView>)(object)this).Model.DataSchema = resultTypedList;
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					ShowMessage(ex.Message);
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override void Commit()
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseObjectTypePageView, IChooseObjectTypePageView>)(object)this).View.Changed -= ViewOnChanged;
			IDXTypeInfo result = GetResult();
			if (((WizardPageBase<IChooseObjectTypePageView, IChooseObjectTypePageView>)(object)this).Model.ObjectType != null && result != null && !string.Equals(((WizardPageBase<IChooseObjectTypePageView, IChooseObjectTypePageView>)(object)this).Model.ObjectType.FullName, result.FullName))
			{
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseObjectTypePageView, IChooseObjectTypePageView>)(object)this).Model.ObjectMember = null;
				((WizardPageBase<IChooseObjectTypePageView, IChooseObjectTypePageView>)(object)this).Model.ObjectConstructor = null;
			}
			((WizardPageBase<IChooseObjectTypePageView, IChooseObjectTypePageView>)(object)this).Model.ObjectType = result;
			TModel model;
			if (((WizardPageBase<IChooseObjectTypePageView, IChooseObjectTypePageView>)(object)this).View.ShowAll)
			{
				model = ((WizardPageBase<IChooseObjectTypePageView, IChooseObjectTypePageView>)(object)this).Model;
				ref TModel reference = ref model;
				ref TModel reference2 = ref reference;
				ShowAllState showAllState = reference.ShowAllState | ShowAllState.Classes;
				reference2.ShowAllState = showAllState;
			}
			else
			{
				model = ((WizardPageBase<IChooseObjectTypePageView, IChooseObjectTypePageView>)(object)this).Model;
				ref TModel reference = ref model;
				ref TModel reference3 = ref reference;
				ShowAllState showAllState2 = reference.ShowAllState & ~ShowAllState.Classes;
				reference3.ShowAllState = showAllState2;
			}
		}

		protected IDXTypeInfo GetResult()
		{
			if (dxTypeInfos == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			TypeViewInfo viewResult = ((WizardPageBase<IChooseObjectTypePageView, IChooseObjectTypePageView>)(object)this).View.SelectedItem;
			if (viewResult == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return dxTypeInfos.FirstOrDefault((IDXTypeInfo info) => string.Equals(info.FullName, viewResult.TypeFullName));
		}

		protected virtual void ShowMessage(string message)
		{
			context.ShowMessage(message);
		}
	}

		private ColumnarData LoadPreviewData(DevExpress.DataAccess.Excel.FieldInfo[] schema)
		{
			ISpreadsheetSource val = null;
			try
			{
				string fullPath = GetFullPath();
				val = ExcelDataLoaderHelper.CreateSource(null, ExcelDataLoaderHelper.DetectFormat(fullPath), fullPath, ((WizardPageBase<IConfigureExcelFileColumnsPageView, IConfigureExcelFileColumnsPageView>)(object)this).Model.SourceOptions);
				ExcelDataLoaderHelper.PrepareSource(val, schema);
				return ExcelDataLoaderHelper.LoadData(val, schema, ((WizardPageBase<IConfigureExcelFileColumnsPageView, IConfigureExcelFileColumnsPageView>)(object)this).Model.SourceOptions, topThousand: true, CancellationToken.None);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				ExceptionHandler.HandleException(ex);
				return null;
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private string GetFullPath()
		{
			return SafePathHelper.Instance.FixAndValidatePath(((WizardPageBase<IConfigureExcelFileColumnsPageView, IConfigureExcelFileColumnsPageView>)(object)this).Model.FileName, UrlResolver, dataDirectoryPatchingService, AccessSettings.DataResources);
		}

		}

				((WizardPageBase<IConfigureExcelFileColumnsPageView, IConfigureExcelFileColumnsPageView>)(object)this).View.Initialize(schema, LoadPreviewData);

		}

		public override void Begin()

					}

					{
						goto IL_027d;
					}
					continue;
				}
				goto IL_027d;
				IL_027d:
				dictionary2.Add(value2, null);

			if (dictionary2.Any((KeyValuePair<SqlQuery, ResultTable> r) => r.Value == null) && !((WizardPageBase<IMultiQueryConfigureParametersPageView, IMultiQueryConfigureParametersPageView>)(object)this).View.ConfirmQueryExecution(from r in dictionary2
				where r.Value == null

			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<SqlQuery, ResultTable> item in dictionary2)

				if (item.Value != null)

					resultSet.Add(item.Value);

				ColumnarData columnarData = uIDataLoader.LoadData(((WizardPageBase<IMultiQueryConfigureParametersPageView, IMultiQueryConfigureParametersPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection, null, sourceParameters, item.Key, topThousand: false);
				if (columnarData == null)

					return false;
				}
				HashSet<string> hashSet = new HashSet<string>();
				ColumnDescription[] schema2 = columnarData.Schema;
				foreach (ColumnDescription columnDescription in schema2)

			((WizardPageBase<IMultiQueryConfigureParametersPageView, IMultiQueryConfigureParametersPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataSchema = resultSet;
			return true;
		}

		private void ReplaceParametersWithActual(Dictionary<string, SqlQuery> queries)
		{
			IEnumerable<IQueryParameter> parameters = ((WizardPageBase<IMultiQueryConfigureParametersPageView, IMultiQueryConfigureParametersPageView>)(object)this).View.GetParameters();
			foreach (SqlQuery value in queries.Values)
			{
				value.Parameters.Clear();
			}
			foreach (IQueryParameter item in parameters)
			{
				queries[item.QueryName].Parameters.Add(new DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter((IParameter)item));
			}
		}

		private SqlQuery GetQuery()
		{
			IEnumerable<DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter> collection = (from p in ((WizardPageBase<IMultiQueryConfigureParametersPageView, IMultiQueryConfigureParametersPageView>)(object)this).View.GetParameters()
				where p.QueryName == ((WizardPageBase<IMultiQueryConfigureParametersPageView, IMultiQueryConfigureParametersPageView>)(object)this).View.SelectedQueryName
				select p).Select(DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter.FromIParameter);
			SqlQuery sqlQuery = DataComponentCreator.GetQueries(((WizardPageBase<IMultiQueryConfigureParametersPageView, IMultiQueryConfigureParametersPageView>)(object)this).Model).FirstOrDefault((SqlQuery q) => q.Name == ((WizardPageBase<IMultiQueryConfigureParametersPageView, IMultiQueryConfigureParametersPageView>)(object)this).View.SelectedQueryName);
			if (sqlQuery == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			SqlQuery sqlQuery2 = sqlQuery.Clone();
			sqlQuery2.Parameters.Clear();
			sqlQuery2.Parameters.AddRange(collection);
			return sqlQuery2;
		}

		private PreviewData GetPreview()
		{
			SqlQuery query = GetQuery();
			PreviewContext context = new PreviewContext(query, ((WizardPageBase<IMultiQueryConfigureParametersPageView, IMultiQueryConfigureParametersPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection, ParameterServiceHelper.GetSourceParameters(ParameterService), null, DBSchemaProviderEx, CustomQueryValidator, Context.WaitFormActivator, ((IUIRunnerContext)Context).CreateExceptionHandler((ExceptionHandlerKind)0, "Validation"), ((IUIRunnerContext)Context).CreateExceptionHandler((ExceptionHandlerKind)1), ((IUIRunnerContext)Context).CreateExceptionHandler((ExceptionHandlerKind)2));
			return new PreviewData(SqlQueryHelper.LoadPreviewData(context), query is SelectQuery);
		}
	}
	[Flags]
	public enum MultiQueryItemActions
	{
		None = 0,
		Expand = 1,
		Add = 2,
		Edit = 4,

	public class MultiQueryItem : INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		private string displayText;

		private int id;

		private int parentId;

		private string name;

		private bool? selected;

		private MultiQueryItemActions actions;

		public int Id
		{
			get
			{
				return id;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != id)
				{
					id = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("Id");
				}
			}
		}

		public int ParentId
		{
			get
			{
				return parentId;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != parentId)
				{
					parentId = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("ParentId");
				}
			}
		}

		public string Name
		{
			get
			{
				return name;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != name)
				{
					name = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("Name");
					if (displayText == null)
					{
						OnPropertyChanged("DisplayName");
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public string DisplayName
		{
			get
			{
				return displayText ?? Name;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != displayText)
				{
					displayText = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("DisplayName");
				}
			}
		}

		public bool? Selected
		{
			get
			{
				return selected;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != selected)
				{
					selected = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("Selected");
				}
			}
		}

		public MultiQueryItemActions Actions
		{
			get
			{
				return actions;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != actions)
				{
					actions = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("Actions");
				}
			}
		}

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		public MultiQueryItem(string name, string displayName, bool? selected, int id, int parentId, MultiQueryItemActions actions)
		{
			Name = name;
			DisplayName = displayName;
			Selected = selected;
			Id = id;
			ParentId = parentId;
			Actions = actions;
		}

		public MultiQueryItem(string name, bool? selected, int id, int parentId, MultiQueryItemActions actions)
			: this(name, null, selected, id, parentId, actions)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnPropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			this.PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
		}
	}

		}

	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	[DXHelpExclude(true)]
	public class MultiQueryConfigurePageBase<TView, TModel> : WizardPageBase<TView, TModel> where TView : class, IMultiQueryConfigurePageView where TModel : class, ISqlDataSourceModel
	{
		private readonly IWizardRunnerContext context;

		private readonly IDBSchemaProviderEx dbSchemaProviderEx;

		private readonly IResultSchemaProvider resultSchemaProvider;

		private readonly IParameterService parameterService;

		private const int nodeIdRoot = -1;

		public override bool FinishEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (AnySelected())
				{
					return !ShouldShowParametersPage();
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public override bool MoveNextEnabled => ShouldShowParametersPage();

		protected IWaitFormActivator WaitFormActivator => context.WaitFormActivator;

		protected IExceptionHandler ExceptionHandler => ((IUIRunnerContext)context).CreateExceptionHandler((ExceptionHandlerKind)0);

		protected BindingList<MultiQueryItem> Items { get; }

		protected Dictionary<string, SqlQuery> CustomQueries { get; }

		protected Dictionary<string, SqlQuery> GeneratedQueries { get; }

		protected int NodeIdTables { get; private set; }

		protected int NodeIdViews { get; private set; }

		protected int NodeIdStoredProcedures { get; private set; }

		protected int NodeIdQueries { get; private set; }

		protected int NodeIdLastRoot { get; private set; }

		protected DBSchema DBSchema { get; set; }

		private bool IsProceduresReady => DBSchema?.StoredProcedures != null;

		private bool IsTablesReady => DBSchema?.Tables != null;

		private bool IsViewsReady => DBSchema?.Views != null;

		private bool IsTablesAndViewsReady
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsTablesReady)
				{
					return IsViewsReady;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected List<MasterDetailInfo> Relations { get; }

		private void GenerateRootItems()
		{
			BindingList<MultiQueryItem> items = Items;
			string name = DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.ConfigureMultiQueryPage_TableCategory);
			bool? selected = false;
			int id = (NodeIdTables = Items.Count);
			items.Add(new MultiQueryItem(name, selected, id, -1, MultiQueryItemActions.Expand));
			BindingList<MultiQueryItem> items2 = Items;
			string name2 = DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.ConfigureMultiQueryPage_ViewCategory);
			bool? selected2 = false;
			id = (NodeIdViews = Items.Count);
			items2.Add(new MultiQueryItem(name2, selected2, id, -1, MultiQueryItemActions.Expand));
			if (!base.Model.DataConnection.IsStoredProceduresSupported())
			{
				NodeIdStoredProcedures = int.MinValue;
			}
			else
			{
				BindingList<MultiQueryItem> items3 = Items;
				string name3 = DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.ConfigureMultiQueryPage_SpCategory);
				bool? selected3 = false;
				id = (NodeIdStoredProcedures = Items.Count);
				items3.Add(new MultiQueryItem(name3, selected3, id, -1, MultiQueryItemActions.Expand));
			}
			BindingList<MultiQueryItem> items4 = Items;
			string name4 = DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.ConfigureMultiQueryPage_QueryCategory);
			bool? selected4 = false;
			id = (NodeIdQueries = Items.Count);
			items4.Add(new MultiQueryItem(name4, selected4, id, -1, MultiQueryItemActions.Add));
			NodeIdLastRoot = Items.Count - 1;
		}

		protected void UpdateSelectedStateAllItems(IEnumerable<MultiQueryItem> itemsParam)
		{
			IEnumerable<MultiQueryItem> enumerable = (itemsParam as IList<MultiQueryItem>) ?? itemsParam.ToList();
			foreach (MultiQueryItem item in enumerable.Where((MultiQueryItem x) => x.ParentId == -1))
			{
				UpdateSelectedStateItem(enumerable, item);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateSelectedStateItem(IEnumerable<MultiQueryItem> itemsParam, MultiQueryItem itemForUpdate)
		{
			if (itemForUpdate.ParentId > NodeIdLastRoot || itemForUpdate.ParentId == NodeIdStoredProcedures || itemForUpdate.ParentId == NodeIdQueries)
			{
				return;
			}
			MultiQueryItem[] array = itemsParam.Where((MultiQueryItem x) => x.ParentId == itemForUpdate.Id).ToArray();
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			bool flag3 = false;
			MultiQueryItem[] array2 = array;
			foreach (MultiQueryItem multiQueryItem in array2)
			{
				UpdateSelectedStateItem(array, multiQueryItem);
				bool? selected = multiQueryItem.Selected;
				if (selected.HasValue)
				{
					if (selected == true)
					{
						flag2 = true;
					}
					else
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					flag3 = true;
				}
			}
			if (flag2 && !flag && !flag3)
			{
				itemForUpdate.Selected = true;
			}
			else if (flag2 || flag3)
			{
				itemForUpdate.Selected = null;
			}
			else
			{
				itemForUpdate.Selected = false;
			}
		}

		private static bool IsQueryContainsColumns(string columnName, SelectQuery query)
		{
			if (query == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			IEnumerable<AliasedBase> source = query.Columns.OfType<AliasedBase>();
			return source.Any((AliasedBase x) => x.ActualName == columnName);
		}

		public MultiQueryConfigurePageBase(IWizardRunnerContext context, TView view, IDBSchemaProviderEx dbSchemaProviderEx, IResultSchemaProvider resultSchemaProvider, IParameterService parameterService)
			: base(view)
		{
			this.dbSchemaProviderEx = dbSchemaProviderEx;
			this.resultSchemaProvider = resultSchemaProvider ?? new ResultSchemaProvider();
			this.parameterService = parameterService;
			this.context = context;
			DBSchema = null;
			Relations = new List<MasterDetailInfo>();
			CustomQueries = new Dictionary<string, SqlQuery>();
			GeneratedQueries = new Dictionary<string, SqlQuery>();
			Items = new BindingList<MultiQueryItem>();
		}

		protected bool AnySelected()
		{
			return base.View.Items.Any((MultiQueryItem x) => x.Selected == true && x.ParentId != -1);
		}

		protected bool ShouldShowParametersPage()
		{
			return Items.Any((MultiQueryItem x) => x.Selected == true && (x.ParentId == NodeIdStoredProcedures || (x.ParentId == NodeIdQueries && (CustomQueries[x.Name] is CustomSqlQuery || CustomQueries[x.Name].Parameters.Any()))));
		}

		private void LoadColumnsSchema(DBTable table)
		{
			UIDataLoader uIDataLoader = new UIDataLoader(WaitFormActivator, ExceptionHandler);
			uIDataLoader.LoadSchema(dbSchemaProviderEx, base.Model.DataConnection, new string[1] { table.Name });
		}

		public override void Begin()
		{
			base.View.ItemUpdated += View_ItemCheck;
			base.View.AddQuery += View_AddQuery;
			base.View.ExpandNode += View_ExpandNode;
			base.View.ConfigureQuery += View_ConfigureQuery;
			base.View.EditRelations += View_EditRelations;
			base.View.DeleteQuery += View_DeleteQuery;
			base.View.ListStateUpdated += View_ListStateUpdated;
			Items.Clear();
			CustomQueries.Clear();
			GeneratedQueries.Clear();
			InitializeQueriesFromModel();
			BuildItemsTree();
			UpdateSelectedStateAllItems(Items);
			base.View.Items = Items;
			UpdateEditRelationsButtonEnabled();
			base.RaiseChanged();
		}

		protected virtual void InitializeQueriesFromModel()
		{
			foreach (CheckItem<SqlQuery> query in base.Model.Queries)
			{
				if (query.CustomQuery)
				{
					CustomQueries.Add(query.Key, query.Value);
				}
				else
				{
					GeneratedQueries.Add(query.Key, query.Value);
				}
			}
		}

		public override void Commit()
		{
			base.View.ItemUpdated -= View_ItemCheck;
			base.View.AddQuery -= View_AddQuery;
			base.View.ExpandNode -= View_ExpandNode;
			base.View.ConfigureQuery -= View_ConfigureQuery;
			base.View.DeleteQuery -= View_DeleteQuery;
			base.View.EditRelations -= View_EditRelations;
			base.View.ListStateUpdated -= View_ListStateUpdated;
			base.View.Items = null;
			base.Model.Queries.Clear();
			base.Model.Queries.AddRange(PrepareQueriesForModel());
			base.Model.Relations.Clear();
			base.Model.Relations.AddRange(Relations);
			Items.Clear();
		}

		public override bool Validate(out string errorMessage)
		{
			errorMessage = string.Empty;
			if (ShouldShowParametersPage())
			{
				return true;
			}
			IEnumerable<SqlQuery> enumerable = (from x in YieldCustomQueries()
				where x.Checked
				select x.Value).Union(GeneratedQueries.Select((KeyValuePair<string, SqlQuery> x) => x.Value)).ToArray();
			try
			{
				DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.ResultSet resultSchema = GetResultSchema(enumerable);
				if (resultSchema.Tables.Count() + resultSchema.ComplexResults.Count != enumerable.Count())
				{
					return false;
				}
				MasterDetailEditorHelper.ValidateRelations(FieldListDescriptor.ConvertFromResultSet(resultSchema), Relations, checkTypes: false);
				base.Model.DataSchema = resultSchema;
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (ex is InvalidConditionException)
				{
					ex = new Exception(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.ConfigureMultiQueryPage_ValidateRelationError), ex);
				}
				errorMessage = string.Empty;
				ExceptionHandler.HandleException(ex);
				return false;
			}
			return base.Validate(ref errorMessage);
		}

		public override Type GetNextPageType()
		{
			return typeof(MultiQueryConfigureParametersPage<TModel>);
		}

		protected virtual void ShowMessage(string message)
		{
			context.ShowMessage(message);
		}

		private void BuildItemsTree()
		{
			Items.Clear();
			DBSchema = null;
			GenerateRootItems();
			BuildTablesAndViews();
			BuildStoredProcedures();
			BuildQueryItems();
		}

		private List<CheckItem<SqlQuery>> PrepareQueriesForModel()
		{
			List<CheckItem<SqlQuery>> list = new List<CheckItem<SqlQuery>>();
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, SqlQuery> generatedQuery in GeneratedQueries)
			{
				list.Add(new CheckItem<SqlQuery>(generatedQuery.Value, selected: true, customQuery: false, generatedQuery.Key));
			}
			foreach (CheckItem<SqlQuery> item in YieldCustomQueries())
			{
				list.Add(item);
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected virtual void BuildTablesAndViews()
		{
			if (base.Model.Queries.Any((CheckItem<SqlQuery> x) => !x.CustomQuery))
			{
				LoadTablesAndViews(createNodes: false);
				BuildTableItems();
				BuildViewItems();
			}
		}

		protected void BuildTableItems()
		{
			if (IsTablesReady)
			{
				BuildTableItemsCore(DBSchema.Tables, NodeIdTables);
			}
		}

		protected void BuildViewItems()
		{
			if (IsViewsReady)
			{
				BuildTableItemsCore(DBSchema.Views, NodeIdViews);
			}
		}

		private void BuildTableItemsCore(DBTable[] dbTables, int parentId)
		{
			int count = Items.Count;
			List<MultiQueryItem> list = new List<MultiQueryItem>();
			List<MultiQueryItem> list2 = new List<MultiQueryItem>();
			foreach (DBTable dbTable in dbTables)
			{
				MultiQueryItem multiQueryItem = new MultiQueryItem(dbTable.Name, false, count++, parentId, MultiQueryItemActions.Expand);
				list.Add(multiQueryItem);
				SelectQuery selectQuery = GeneratedQueries.Values.OfType<SelectQuery>().FirstOrDefault((SelectQuery x) => x.Tables.Any((Table y) => y.Name == dbTable.Name));
				if (selectQuery != null)
				{
					dbSchemaProviderEx.LoadColumns(base.Model.DataConnection, dbTable);
				}
				foreach (DBColumn column in dbTable.Columns)
				{
					if (column != null)
					{
						bool value = IsQueryContainsColumns(column.Name, selectQuery);
						list2.Add(new MultiQueryItem(column.Name, value, count++, multiQueryItem.Id, MultiQueryItemActions.None));
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (MultiQueryItem item in list.OrderBy((MultiQueryItem x) => x.Name).Union(list2))
			{
				Items.Add(item);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void BuildStoredProcedures()
		{
			if (base.Model.Queries.Any((CheckItem<SqlQuery> q) => q.Value is StoredProcQuery))
			{
				LoadStoredProcedures(createNodes: false);
				BuildStoredProcedureItems();
			}
		}

		protected void BuildStoredProcedureItems()
		{
			if (!IsProceduresReady)
			{
				return;
			}
			int count = Items.Count;
			try
			{
				Items.RaiseListChangedEvents = false;
				Dictionary<DBStoredProcedure, bool> dictionary = new Dictionary<DBStoredProcedure, bool>();
				HashSet<SqlStoredProcInfo> hashSet = new HashSet<SqlStoredProcInfo>(from q in GeneratedQueries.Values.OfType<StoredProcQuery>()
					select new SqlStoredProcInfo(q.StoredProcName, q.Parameters));
				foreach (DBStoredProcedure item3 in DBSchema.StoredProcedures.OrderBy((DBStoredProcedure x) => x.Name))
				{
					SqlStoredProcInfo item = new SqlStoredProcInfo(item3.Name, item3.Arguments.Select((DBStoredProcedureArgument a) => new DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter(((DBNameTypePair)a).Name, DBColumn.GetType(((DBNameTypePair)a).Type), null)).ToList());
					dictionary.Add(item3, hashSet.Contains(item));
				}
				foreach (KeyValuePair<DBStoredProcedure, bool> item4 in dictionary)
				{
					MultiQueryItem item2 = new MultiQueryStoredProcedureItem(item4.Key, item4.Value, count++, NodeIdStoredProcedures, MultiQueryItemActions.None);
					Items.Add(item2);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				Items.RaiseListChangedEvents = true;
				Items.ResetBindings();
			}
		}

		private void BuildQueryItems()
		{
			foreach (SqlQuery query in CustomQueries.Values)
			{
				bool value = base.Model.Queries.First((CheckItem<SqlQuery> x) => x.Value.Name == query.Name && x.CustomQuery).Checked;
				MultiQueryItem item = new MultiQueryItem(query.Name, value, Items.Count, NodeIdQueries, MultiQueryItemActions.EditRemove);
				Items.Add(item);
			}
		}

		protected virtual IEnumerable<CheckItem<SqlQuery>> YieldCustomQueries()
		{
			return from item in Items
				where item.ParentId == NodeIdQueries
				select new CheckItem<SqlQuery>(CustomQueries[item.Name], item.Selected == true, customQuery: true, item.Name);
		}

		private void View_ExpandNode(object sender, ItemUpdatedEventArgs args)
		{
			if (Items.Any((MultiQueryItem x) => x.ParentId == args.Item.Id))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (args.Item.ParentId == -1)
			{
				if (args.Item.Id == NodeIdTables)
				{
					LoadTables(createNodes: true, includeColumns: false);
				}
				else if (args.Item.Id == NodeIdViews)
				{
					LoadViews(createNodes: true, includeColumns: false);
				}
				else if (args.Item.Id == NodeIdStoredProcedures)
				{
					LoadStoredProcedures(createNodes: true);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				LoadAndInsertColumns(args.Item, args.Item.Selected);
			}
		}

		private DBSchema LoadStoredProcedures(DBSchema dbSchema, IWaitFormActivator waitFormActivator, IExceptionHandler exceptionHandler, IDBSchemaProviderEx provider, SqlDataConnection connection)
		{
			return ConnectionHelper.LoadStoredProcedures(dbSchema, waitFormActivator, exceptionHandler, provider, connection);
		}

		protected void LoadStoredProcedures(bool createNodes)
		{
			if (ConnectionHelper.CheckStoredProcedures(DBSchema))
			{
				return;
			}
			DBSchema = LoadStoredProcedures(DBSchema, WaitFormActivator, ExceptionHandler, dbSchemaProviderEx, base.Model.DataConnection);
			if (!IsProceduresReady || !createNodes)
			{
				return;
			}
			MultiQueryItem multiQueryItem = Items.First((MultiQueryItem x) => x.Id == NodeIdStoredProcedures);
			if (DBSchema.StoredProcedures.Length == 0)
			{
				multiQueryItem.Actions = MultiQueryItemActions.None;
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				Items.RaiseListChangedEvents = false;
				foreach (DBStoredProcedure item in DBSchema.StoredProcedures.OrderBy((DBStoredProcedure x) => x.Name))
				{
					Items.Add(new MultiQueryStoredProcedureItem(item, multiQueryItem.Selected == true, Items.Count, NodeIdStoredProcedures, MultiQueryItemActions.None));
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				Items.RaiseListChangedEvents = true;
				Items.ResetBindings();
			}
		}

		protected void LoadTablesAndViews(bool createNodes)
		{
			LoadTables(createNodes: true, includeColumns: true);
			LoadViews(createNodes: true, includeColumns: true);
		}

		protected void LoadTables(bool createNodes, bool includeColumns)
		{
			if (ConnectionHelper.CheckTables(DBSchema))
			{
				return;
			}
			DBSchema = ConnectionHelper.LoadTables(DBSchema, WaitFormActivator, ExceptionHandler, dbSchemaProviderEx, base.Model.DataConnection, includeColumns, new string[0]);
			if (IsTablesReady && createNodes)
			{
				MultiQueryItem parentItem = Items.First((MultiQueryItem x) => x.Id == NodeIdTables);
				AddExpandableNodes(parentItem, DBSchema.Tables);
			}
		}

		protected void LoadViews(bool createNodes, bool includeColumns)
		{
			if (ConnectionHelper.CheckViews(DBSchema))
			{
				return;
			}
			DBSchema = ConnectionHelper.LoadViews(DBSchema, WaitFormActivator, ExceptionHandler, dbSchemaProviderEx, base.Model.DataConnection, includeColumns, new string[0]);
			if (IsViewsReady && createNodes)
			{
				MultiQueryItem parentItem = Items.First((MultiQueryItem x) => x.Id == NodeIdViews);
				AddExpandableNodes(parentItem, DBSchema.Views);
			}
		}

		protected virtual SqlQuery RunQueryBuilder(SqlQuery query)
		{
			QueryBuilderRunnerBase queryBuilderRunnerBase = base.View.CreateQueryBuilderRunner(dbSchemaProviderEx, DBSchema, base.Model.DataConnection, parameterService);
			return queryBuilderRunnerBase.Edit(query);
		}

		private void AddExpandableNodes(MultiQueryItem parentItem, DBTable[] itemsForAdding)
		{
			if (itemsForAdding.Length == 0)
			{
				parentItem.Actions = MultiQueryItemActions.None;
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				Items.RaiseListChangedEvents = false;
				foreach (DBTable item in itemsForAdding.OrderBy((DBTable x) => x.Name))
				{
					Items.Add(new MultiQueryItem(item.Name, parentItem.Selected == true, Items.Count, parentItem.Id, MultiQueryItemActions.Expand));
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				Items.RaiseListChangedEvents = true;
				Items.ResetBindings();
			}
		}

		private void View_AddQuery(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			EditQuery(null);
		}

		private void View_ListStateUpdated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateEditRelationsButtonEnabled();
			base.RaiseChanged();
		}

		private void EditQuery(SqlQuery query)
		{
			LoadTablesAndViews(createNodes: true);
			if ((DBSchema.Tables == null || DBSchema.Tables.Length == 0) && (DBSchema.Views == null || DBSchema.Views.Length == 0) && !base.Model.DataConnection.IsSqlDataStore)
			{
				ShowMessage(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.QueryBuilderNoTablesAndViews));
				return;
			}
			SqlQuery sqlQuery = RunQueryBuilder(query);
			if (sqlQuery != null)
			{
				if (query == null)
				{
					sqlQuery.Name = SqlQueryCollection.GenerateUniqueName(sqlQuery, GetReservedNames());
					CustomQueries.Add(sqlQuery.Name, sqlQuery);
					MultiQueryItem item = new MultiQueryItem(sqlQuery.Name, true, Items.Count, NodeIdQueries, MultiQueryItemActions.EditRemove);
					Items.Add(item);
				}
				else
				{
					CustomQueries.Remove(query.Name);
					CustomQueries.Add(sqlQuery.Name, sqlQuery);
				}
			}
			UpdateEditRelationsButtonEnabled();
			base.RaiseChanged();
		}

		private HashSet<string> GetReservedNames()
		{
			return GetReservedNames(Enumerable.Empty<SqlQuery>());
		}

		private HashSet<string> GetReservedNames(IEnumerable<SqlQuery> queries)
		{
			IEnumerable<string> first = DBSchema.Tables?.Select((DBTable x) => x.Name) ?? Enumerable.Empty<string>();
			IEnumerable<string> first2 = DBSchema.Views?.Select((DBTable x) => x.Name) ?? Enumerable.Empty<string>();
			IEnumerable<string> first3 = CustomQueries.Values.Select((SqlQuery x) => x.Name);
			return new HashSet<string>(first.Union(first2.Union(first3.Union(queries.Select((SqlQuery q) => q.Name)))).Select(SqlQueryCollection.CleanQueryName));
		}

		private void LoadAndInsertColumns(MultiQueryItem item, bool? shouldBeSelected)
		{
			DBTable val;
			if (item.ParentId == NodeIdTables)
			{
				val = DBSchema.Tables.First((DBTable x) => x.Name == item.Name);
			}
			else
			{
				if (item.ParentId != NodeIdViews)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("The item should be either a table or a view.");
				}
				val = DBSchema.Views.First((DBTable x) => x.Name == item.Name);
			}
			IEnumerable<MultiQueryItem> source = Items.Where((MultiQueryItem x) => x.ParentId == item.Id);
			if (val.Columns.Count == 0)
			{
				LoadColumnsSchema(val);
			}
			if (source.Any())
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = Items.Count;
			int num2 = 0;
			while (num2 < val.Columns.Count)
			{
				DBColumn val2 = val.Columns[num2];
				if (val2 == null)
				{
					num--;
				}
				else
				{
					Items.Add(new MultiQueryItem(val2.Name, shouldBeSelected, num, item.Id, MultiQueryItemActions.None));
				}
				num2++;
				num++;
			}
		}

		private void View_ItemCheck(object sender, ItemUpdatedEventArgs args)
		{
			OnQueryItemClick(args.Item);
		}

		protected void OnQueryItemClick(MultiQueryItem item)
		{
			if (item.ParentId == -1)
			{
				OnRootItemChanged(item);
			}
			else if (item.ParentId == NodeIdTables)
			{
				OnTableItemChanged(item);
			}
			else if (item.ParentId == NodeIdViews)
			{
				OnViewItemChanged(item);
			}
			else if (item.ParentId == NodeIdStoredProcedures)
			{
				OnStoredProcedureItemChanged(item);
			}
			else if (item.ParentId > NodeIdLastRoot)
			{
				OnColumnItemChanged(item);
			}
		}

		private void OnRootItemChanged(MultiQueryItem item)
		{
			MultiQueryItem[] array = Items.Where((MultiQueryItem x) => x.ParentId == item.Id).ToArray();
			if (item.Selected == true)
			{
				if (!array.Any())
				{
					if (item.Id == NodeIdTables || item.Id == NodeIdViews)
					{
						LoadTablesAndViews(createNodes: true);
					}
					else if (item.Id == NodeIdStoredProcedures)
					{
						LoadStoredProcedures(createNodes: true);
					}
				}
				array = Items.Where((MultiQueryItem x) => x.ParentId == item.Id).ToArray();
				MultiQueryItem[] array2 = array;
				foreach (MultiQueryItem item2 in array2)
				{
					OnQueryItemClick(item2);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				MultiQueryItem[] array3 = array;
				foreach (MultiQueryItem multiQueryItem in array3)
				{
					GeneratedQueries.Remove(multiQueryItem.DisplayName);
					multiQueryItem.Selected = false;
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnTableItemChanged(MultiQueryItem item)
		{
			OnTableItemChangedCore(item, DBSchema.Tables);
		}

		private void OnViewItemChanged(MultiQueryItem item)
		{
			OnTableItemChangedCore(item, DBSchema.Views);
		}

		private void OnTableItemChangedCore(MultiQueryItem item, DBTable[] tables)
		{
			if (item.Selected == true)
			{
				DBTable val = tables.First((DBTable x) => x.Name == item.Name);
				if (!val.Columns.Any())
				{
					LoadColumnsSchema(val);
				}
				string queryName = SqlQueryCollection.CleanQueryName(item.Name);
				SelectQuery selectQuery = SelectQueryFluentBuilder.AddTable(val.Name).SelectColumns((from x in val.Columns
					where x != null
					select x.Name).ToArray()).Build(queryName);
				if (GeneratedQueries.TryGetValue(item.Name, out var value) && value.Meta != null)
				{
					selectQuery.Meta = value.Meta.Clone();
				}
				GeneratedQueries[item.Name] = selectQuery;
			}
			else
			{
				GeneratedQueries.Remove(item.Name);
			}
		}

		private void OnStoredProcedureItemChanged(MultiQueryItem item)
		{
			if (item.Selected == true)
			{
				if (item is MultiQueryStoredProcedureItem multiQueryStoredProcedureItem)
				{
					IEnumerable<DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter> parameters = from p in multiQueryStoredProcedureItem.StoredProcedure.Arguments
						where (int)p.Direction != 1
						select new DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter(((DBNameTypePair)p).Name, DBColumn.GetType(((DBNameTypePair)p).Type), null);
					SqlQuery sqlQuery = new StoredProcQuery(item.Name, item.Name, parameters);
					sqlQuery.Name = SqlQueryCollection.GenerateUniqueName(sqlQuery, GetReservedNames(GeneratedQueries.Values));
					GeneratedQueries[item.DisplayName] = sqlQuery;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				GeneratedQueries.Remove(item.DisplayName);
			}
		}

		private void OnColumnItemChanged(MultiQueryItem item)
		{
			MultiQueryItem multiQueryItem = Items.First((MultiQueryItem x) => x.Id == item.ParentId);
			if (item.Selected == true)
			{
				if (GeneratedQueries.ContainsKey(multiQueryItem.Name))
				{
					SelectQuery selectQuery = (SelectQuery)GeneratedQueries[multiQueryItem.Name];
					selectQuery.SelectColumn(selectQuery.Tables[0], item.Name);
				}
				else
				{
					string queryName = SqlQueryCollection.CleanQueryName(multiQueryItem.Name);
					SelectQuery value = SelectQueryFluentBuilder.AddTable(multiQueryItem.Name).SelectColumn(item.Name).Build(queryName);
					GeneratedQueries.Add(multiQueryItem.Name, value);
				}
				return;
			}
			SelectQuery selectQuery2 = (SelectQuery)GeneratedQueries[multiQueryItem.Name];
			ColumnBase item2 = selectQuery2.Columns.OfType<Column>().First((Column x) => x.ActualName == item.Name);
			selectQuery2.Columns.Remove(item2);
			if (!selectQuery2.Columns.Any())
			{
				GeneratedQueries.Remove(multiQueryItem.Name);
			}
		}

		private void View_DeleteQuery(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			MultiQueryItem focusedItem = base.View.GetFocusedItem();
			CustomQueries.Remove(focusedItem.Name);
		}

		private void View_EditRelations(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			MasterDetailRunnerBase masterDetailRunnerBase = base.View.CreateMasterDetailRunner();
			MasterDetailModel masterDetailModel = new MasterDetailModel(Relations);
			MasterDetailRunnerContext masterDetailRunnerContext;
			try
			{
				masterDetailRunnerContext = PrepareEditorContext();
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				ExceptionHandler.HandleException(ex);
				return;
			}
			if (masterDetailRunnerBase.Run(masterDetailModel, masterDetailRunnerContext))
			{
				Relations.Clear();
				Relations.AddRange(masterDetailModel);
			}
		}

		protected virtual MasterDetailRunnerContext PrepareEditorContext()
		{
			SqlQuery[] queries = GeneratedQueries.Values.Union(from q in YieldCustomQueries()
				where q.Checked
				select q.Value).ToArray();
			DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.ResultSet resultSchema = GetResultSchema(queries);
			return new MasterDetailRunnerContext
			{
				Queries = queries,
				DBSchema = DBSchema,
				DataSchema = FieldListDescriptor.ConvertFromResultSet(resultSchema)
			};
		}

		protected virtual DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.ResultSet GetResultSchema(IEnumerable<SqlQuery> queries)
		{
			List<DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryExecutionException> list = new List<DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryExecutionException>();
			CancellationToken none = CancellationToken.None;
			if (!ConnectionHelper.OpenConnection(base.Model.DataConnection, ExceptionHandler, WaitFormActivator, null))
			{
				return null;
			}
			LoadTablesAndViews(createNodes: false);
			DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.QueryExecutor queryExecutor = null;
			IParameter[] sourceParameters = parameterService?.Parameters.ToArray();
			Dictionary<SqlQuery, ResultTable> dictionary = new Dictionary<SqlQuery, ResultTable>();
			DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.ResultSet resultSet = new DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.ResultSet();
			try
			{
				ConnectionOptions connectionOptions = new ConnectionOptions(base.Model.DataConnection.ConnectionOptions)
				{
					CloseConnection = false
				};
				foreach (SqlQuery query in queries)
				{
					try
					{
						query.Validate(DBSchema);
						if (query is SelectQuery selectQuery)
						{
							ResultTable resultTable = SqlQueryHelper.GetResultTable(query.Name, resultSchemaProvider.GetSelectQuerySchema(selectQuery, DBSchema, base.Model.DataConnection, connectionOptions, sourceParameters));
							dictionary.Add(query, resultTable);
							continue;
						}
						if (!(query is StoredProcQuery storedProcedureQuery))
						{
							goto IL_017b;
						}
						object storedProcedureSchema = resultSchemaProvider.GetStoredProcedureSchema(storedProcedureQuery, base.Model.DataConnection, connectionOptions, sourceParameters);
						if (storedProcedureSchema is SubResultSet subResultSet)
						{
							resultSet.ComplexResults.Add(subResultSet.Name, subResultSet);
							continue;
						}
						ResultTable resultTable2 = SqlQueryHelper.GetResultTable(query.Name, storedProcedureSchema);
						if (resultTable2 == null || resultTable2.Columns.Count <= 0)
						{
							goto IL_017b;
						}
						dictionary.Add(query, resultTable2);
						goto end_IL_009a;
						IL_017b:
						dictionary.Add(query, null);
						end_IL_009a:;
					}
					catch (Exception innerException)
					{
						list.Add(new DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryExecutionException(query.Name, innerException));
						dictionary.Add(query, null);
					}
				}
				bool flag = dictionary.All((KeyValuePair<SqlQuery, ResultTable> r) => r.Value != null) || base.View.ConfirmQueryExecution(from r in dictionary
					where r.Value == null
					select r.Key);
				foreach (KeyValuePair<SqlQuery, ResultTable> queryResult in dictionary)
				{
					if (queryResult.Value != null)
					{
						resultSet.Add(queryResult.Value);
					}
					else
					{
						if (!flag)
						{
							continue;
						}
						queryExecutor = queryExecutor ?? new DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.QueryExecutor(base.Model.DataConnection, DBSchema, null, sourceParameters);
						ColumnarData columnarData = queryExecutor.Execute(queryResult.Key, none);
						object obj = columnarData.ToResult(queryResult.Key.Name);
						if (obj is SubResultSet value)
						{
							resultSet.ComplexResults.Add(queryResult.Key.Name, value);
							continue;
						}
						ResultTable resultTable3 = SqlQueryHelper.GetResultTable(queryResult.Key.Name, obj);
						if (resultTable3 != null && resultTable3.Columns.Count > 0)
						{
							resultSet.Add(new ResultTable(queryResult.Key.Name, columnarData));
							continue;
						}
						resultSet.Add(resultTable3);
						list.RemoveAll((DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryExecutionException e) => e.QueryName == queryResult.Key.Name);
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				base.Model.DataConnection.CloseDbConnection();
			}
			resultSet.ApplyRelations(Relations);
			if (list.Count > 0)
			{
				Exception ex = ((list.Count == 1) ? ((Exception)list[0]) : ((Exception)new AggregateException(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.QueriesFailedToExecute_ExceptionMessage), list)));
				throw ex;
			}
			return resultSet;
		}

		private void View_ConfigureQuery(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			SqlQuery query = CustomQueries[base.View.GetFocusedItem().Name];
			EditQuery(query);
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateEditRelationsButtonEnabled()
		{
			base.View.SetEditRelationEnabled(AnySelected());
		}
	}
