	public class ConfigureQueryPage<TModel> : WizardPageBase<IConfigureQueryPageView, TModel> where TModel : class, ISqlDataSourceModel
	{
		private const int maxLineLength = 70;

		private readonly IWizardRunnerContext context;

		private readonly SqlWizardOptions options;

		private readonly IDBSchemaProviderEx dbSchemaProviderEx;

		private readonly IResultSchemaProvider resultSchemaProvider;

		private readonly IParameterService parameterService;

		private QueryType queryType;

		private SelectQuery selectQuery;

		private CustomSqlQuery customSqlQuery;

		private DBStoredProcedureViewInfo[] storedProcedures;

		private readonly ICustomQueryValidator customQueryValidator;

		public override bool FinishEnabled => IsSchemaReady;

		public override bool MoveNextEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (GetResult() != null)
				{
					return !IsSchemaReady;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected bool IsSchemaReady
		{
			get
			{
				if (DataSchema == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				SqlQuery result = GetResult();
				if (result != null)
				{
					return result.Parameters.Count == 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected bool SqlTextModified => customSqlQuery != null;

		protected string SqlText
		{
			get
			{
				if (customSqlQuery == null)
				{
					return GetSql(selectQuery);
				}
				return customSqlQuery.Sql;
			}
			set
			{
				if (customSqlQuery == null)
				{
					customSqlQuery = new CustomSqlQuery();
				}
				if (!(value == customSqlQuery.Sql))
				{
					customSqlQuery.Sql = value;
					UpdateSqlEditor();
				}
			}
		}

		protected StoredProcQuery StoredProcedureQuery { get; private set; }

		protected object DataSchema { get; private set; }

		protected virtual IWaitFormActivator WaitFormActivator => context.WaitFormActivator;

		protected virtual IExceptionHandler ExceptionHandler => ((IUIRunnerContext)context).CreateExceptionHandler((ExceptionHandlerKind)0);

		public DBSchema DBSchema { get; set; }

		public ConfigureQueryPage(IConfigureQueryPageView view, IWizardRunnerContext context, SqlWizardOptions options, IDBSchemaProviderEx dbSchemaProviderEx, IParameterService parameterService, ICustomQueryValidator customQueryValidator)
			: this(view, context, options, dbSchemaProviderEx, (IResultSchemaProvider)null, parameterService, customQueryValidator)
		{
		}

		public ConfigureQueryPage(IConfigureQueryPageView view, IWizardRunnerContext context, SqlWizardOptions options, IDBSchemaProviderEx dbSchemaProviderEx, IResultSchemaProvider resultSchemaProvider, IParameterService parameterService, ICustomQueryValidator customQueryValidator)
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IConfigureQueryPageView, IConfigureQueryPageView>)(object)this)..ctor(view);
			this.context = context;
			this.options = options;
			this.parameterService = parameterService;
			this.customQueryValidator = customQueryValidator;
			this.dbSchemaProviderEx = dbSchemaProviderEx;
			this.resultSchemaProvider = resultSchemaProvider ?? new ResultSchemaProvider();
		}

		public override void Begin()
		{
			DBSchema = null;
			bool storedProceduresSupported = ((WizardPageBase<IConfigureQueryPageView, IConfigureQueryPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection.IsStoredProceduresSupported();
			((WizardPageBase<IConfigureQueryPageView, IConfigureQueryPageView>)(object)this).View.Initialize(options.HasFlag(SqlWizardOptions.EnableCustomSql) && ((WizardPageBase<IConfigureQueryPageView, IConfigureQueryPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection.IsSqlDataStore, storedProceduresSupported, ((WizardPageBase<IConfigureQueryPageView, IConfigureQueryPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection.DataStore as IAliasFormatter);
			if (((WizardPageBase<IConfigureQueryPageView, IConfigureQueryPageView>)(object)this).Model.Query is StoredProcQuery storedProcQuery)
			{
				queryType = QueryType.StoredProcedure;
				InitializeStoredProcedures();
				SetStoredProcQuery(storedProcQuery);
			}
			else
			{
				queryType = QueryType.TableOrCustomSql;
				SetTableOrCustomSqlQuery(((WizardPageBase<IConfigureQueryPageView, IConfigureQueryPageView>)(object)this).Model.Query);
			}
			((WizardPageBase<IConfigureQueryPageView, IConfigureQueryPageView>)(object)this).View.QueryType = queryType;
			((WizardPageBase<IConfigureQueryPageView, IConfigureQueryPageView>)(object)this).View.QueryTypeChanged += View_Changed;
			((WizardPageBase<IConfigureQueryPageView, IConfigureQueryPageView>)(object)this).View.RunQueryBuilder += View_RunQueryBuilder;
			((WizardPageBase<IConfigureQueryPageView, IConfigureQueryPageView>)(object)this).View.SqlStringChanged += SelectQueryControl_Changed;
			((WizardPageBase<IConfigureQueryPageView, IConfigureQueryPageView>)(object)this).View.StoredProcedureChanged += SpQueryControl_Changed;
		}

		public override bool Validate(out string errorMessage)
		{
			errorMessage = null;
			SqlQuery result = GetResult();
			IExceptionHandler exceptionHandler = ((IUIRunnerContext)context).CreateExceptionHandler((ExceptionHandlerKind)0, "Validation");
			return SqlQueryHelper.Validate(result, ((WizardPageBase<IConfigureQueryPageView, IConfigureQueryPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection.ConnectionParameters, customQueryValidator, exceptionHandler, DBSchema);
		}

		public override void Commit()
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IConfigureQueryPageView, IConfigureQueryPageView>)(object)this).Model.Query = GetResult();
			((WizardPageBase<IConfigureQueryPageView, IConfigureQueryPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataSchema = DataSchema;
			((WizardPageBase<IConfigureQueryPageView, IConfigureQueryPageView>)(object)this).Model.SqlQueryText = SqlText;
			((WizardPageBase<IConfigureQueryPageView, IConfigureQueryPageView>)(object)this).View.QueryTypeChanged -= View_Changed;
			((WizardPageBase<IConfigureQueryPageView, IConfigureQueryPageView>)(object)this).View.RunQueryBuilder -= View_RunQueryBuilder;
			((WizardPageBase<IConfigureQueryPageView, IConfigureQueryPageView>)(object)this).View.SqlStringChanged -= SelectQueryControl_Changed;
			((WizardPageBase<IConfigureQueryPageView, IConfigureQueryPageView>)(object)this).View.StoredProcedureChanged -= SpQueryControl_Changed;
		}

		public override Type GetNextPageType()
		{
			return typeof(ConfigureSqlParametersPage<TModel>);
		}

		protected virtual SqlQuery GetResult()
		{
			return queryType switch
			{
				QueryType.TableOrCustomSql => (SqlQuery)(((object)customSqlQuery) ?? ((object)selectQuery)), 
				QueryType.StoredProcedure => StoredProcedureQuery, 
				_ => throw new InvalidOperationException(), 
			};
		}

		protected virtual void SetTableOrCustomSqlQuery(SqlQuery value)
		{
			if (value == selectQuery)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (value is CustomSqlQuery customSqlQuery)
			{
				selectQuery = new SelectQuery();
				selectQuery.Parameters.AddRange(customSqlQuery.Parameters);
				this.customSqlQuery = customSqlQuery;
			}
			else
			{
				if (value is TableQuery tableQuery)
				{
					selectQuery = QueryConversionHelper.TableQueryToSelectQuery(tableQuery);
				}
				else
				{
					selectQuery = ((SelectQuery)value) ?? new SelectQuery();
				}
				CustomSqlQuery customSqlQuery2 = null;
				DataSchema = ((WizardPageBase<IConfigureQueryPageView, IConfigureQueryPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataSchema;
			}
			UpdateSqlEditor();
		}

		protected virtual void SetStoredProcQuery(StoredProcQuery value)
		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				if (!storedProcedures.Any((DBStoredProcedureViewInfo info) => StoredProcQueryHelper.CompareStoredProcQueryAndDBStoredProcedure(value, info.Value)))
				{
					DBStoredProcedureViewInfo dBStoredProcedureViewInfo = new DBStoredProcedureViewInfo(value);
					dBStoredProcedureViewInfo.IsValid = false;
					DBStoredProcedureViewInfo dBStoredProcedureViewInfo2 = dBStoredProcedureViewInfo;
					storedProcedures = storedProcedures.Union(new DBStoredProcedureViewInfo[1] { dBStoredProcedureViewInfo2 }).ToArray();
					((WizardPageBase<IConfigureQueryPageView, IConfigureQueryPageView>)(object)this).View.InitializeStoredProcedures(storedProcedures);
					((WizardPageBase<IConfigureQueryPageView, IConfigureQueryPageView>)(object)this).View.SelectedStoredProcedureIndex = storedProcedures.Length - 1;
				}
				else
				{
					StoredProcedureQuery = value;
				}
				UpdateSelectedIndex();
			}
			else
			{
				StoredProcedureQuery = null;
				((WizardPageBase<IConfigureQueryPageView, IConfigureQueryPageView>)(object)this).View.SelectedStoredProcedureIndex = -1;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateSelectedIndex()
		{
			if (StoredProcedureQuery != null)
			{
				((WizardPageBase<IConfigureQueryPageView, IConfigureQueryPageView>)(object)this).View.SelectedStoredProcedureIndex = Array.FindIndex(storedProcedures, (DBStoredProcedureViewInfo info) => StoredProcQueryHelper.CompareStoredProcQueryAndDBStoredProcedure(StoredProcedureQuery, info.Value));
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateSqlEditor()
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IConfigureQueryPageView, IConfigureQueryPageView>)(object)this).View.SqlString = ((customSqlQuery != null) ? customSqlQuery.Sql : AutoSqlWrapHelper.AutoSqlTextWrap(GetSql(selectQuery), 70));
		}

		protected virtual void RunQueryBuilder()
		{
			SqlQuery sqlQuery = GetResult();
			if (sqlQuery is CustomSqlQuery && !options.HasFlag(SqlWizardOptions.EnableCustomSql))
			{
				if (!context.Confirm(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.ConfigureQueryPage_CustomSqlWillBeLost)))
				{
					return;
				}
				sqlQuery = null;
			}
			LoadTablesAndViews();
			if (DBSchema == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (DBSchema.Tables.Length == 0 && DBSchema.Views.Length == 0 && !((WizardPageBase<IConfigureQueryPageView, IConfigureQueryPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection.IsSqlDataStore)
			{
				ShowMessage(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.QueryBuilderNoTablesAndViews));
				return;
			}
			QueryBuilderRunnerBase queryBuilderRunnerBase = ((WizardPageBase<IConfigureQueryPageView, IConfigureQueryPageView>)(object)this).View.CreateQueryBuilderRunner(dbSchemaProviderEx, DBSchema, ((WizardPageBase<IConfigureQueryPageView, IConfigureQueryPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection, parameterService);
			SqlQuery sqlQuery2 = queryBuilderRunnerBase.Edit(sqlQuery);
			if (sqlQuery2 != null && sqlQuery2 != sqlQuery)
			{
				if (sqlQuery2 is SelectQuery selectQuery)
				{
					this.selectQuery = selectQuery;
					customSqlQuery = null;
					DataSchema = resultSchemaProvider.GetSelectQuerySchema(this.selectQuery, DBSchema, ((WizardPageBase<IConfigureQueryPageView, IConfigureQueryPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection, ((WizardPageBase<IConfigureQueryPageView, IConfigureQueryPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection.ConnectionOptions, parameterService?.Parameters);
				}
				else
				{
					customSqlQuery = (CustomSqlQuery)sqlQuery2;
					DataSchema = null;
				}
				UpdateSqlEditor();
				((WizardPageBase<IConfigureQueryPageView, IConfigureQueryPageView>)(object)this).RaiseChanged();
			}
		}

		protected virtual string GetSql(SelectQuery selectQuery)
		{
			if (selectQuery == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			LoadTablesAndViews();
			ISqlGeneratorFormatter sqlGeneratorFormatter = ((WizardPageBase<IConfigureQueryPageView, IConfigureQueryPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection.SqlGeneratorFormatter;
			if (sqlGeneratorFormatter == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return SqlQueryHelper.BuildSql(selectQuery, DBSchema, sqlGeneratorFormatter);
		}

		protected virtual void InitializeStoredProcedures()
		{
			LoadStoredProcedures();
			if (DBSchema == null)
			{
				DBSchema = new DBSchema();
			}
			List<DBStoredProcedureViewInfo> list = ((DBSchema.StoredProcedures == null) ? new List<DBStoredProcedureViewInfo>() : (from sp in DBSchema.StoredProcedures
				orderby sp.Name
				select new DBStoredProcedureViewInfo(sp, sp.GetDisplayName())).ToList());
			if (StoredProcedureQuery != null && !storedProcedures.Any((DBStoredProcedureViewInfo info) => StoredProcQueryHelper.CompareStoredProcQueryAndDBStoredProcedure(StoredProcedureQuery, info.Value)))
			{
				DBStoredProcedureViewInfo item = new DBStoredProcedureViewInfo(StoredProcedureQuery);
				list.Add(item);
			}
			storedProcedures = list.ToArray();
			((WizardPageBase<IConfigureQueryPageView, IConfigureQueryPageView>)(object)this).View.InitializeStoredProcedures(storedProcedures);
			UpdateSelectedIndex();
		}

		protected virtual void ShowMessage(string message)
		{
			context.ShowMessage(message);
		}

		protected void LoadTablesAndViews()
		{
			if (!ConnectionHelper.CheckTablesAndViews(DBSchema))
			{
				DBSchema = ConnectionHelper.LoadTablesAndViews(DBSchema, CreateLoader(), dbSchemaProviderEx, ((WizardPageBase<IConfigureQueryPageView, IConfigureQueryPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection, new string[0]);
			}
		}

		protected void LoadStoredProcedures()
		{
			if (!ConnectionHelper.CheckStoredProcedures(DBSchema))
			{
				DBSchema = ConnectionHelper.LoadStoredProcedures(DBSchema, CreateLoader(), dbSchemaProviderEx, ((WizardPageBase<IConfigureQueryPageView, IConfigureQueryPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection);
			}
		}

		private UIDataLoader CreateLoader()
		{
			return new UIDataLoader(WaitFormActivator, ExceptionHandler);
		}

		private void View_Changed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			queryType = ((WizardPageBase<IConfigureQueryPageView, IConfigureQueryPageView>)(object)this).View.QueryType;
			if (queryType == QueryType.StoredProcedure)
			{
				InitializeStoredProcedures();
			}
			((WizardPageBase<IConfigureQueryPageView, IConfigureQueryPageView>)(object)this).RaiseChanged();
		}

		private void View_RunQueryBuilder(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (queryType == QueryType.TableOrCustomSql)
			{
				RunQueryBuilder();
			}
		}

		private void SpQueryControl_Changed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (((WizardPageBase<IConfigureQueryPageView, IConfigureQueryPageView>)(object)this).View.SelectedStoredProcedureIndex >= 0)
			{
				DBStoredProcedureViewInfo dBStoredProcedureViewInfo = storedProcedures[((WizardPageBase<IConfigureQueryPageView, IConfigureQueryPageView>)(object)this).View.SelectedStoredProcedureIndex];
				if (dBStoredProcedureViewInfo.IsValid)
				{
					DBStoredProcedure value = dBStoredProcedureViewInfo.Value;
					StoredProcQuery storedProcQuery = ((WizardPageBase<IConfigureQueryPageView, IConfigureQueryPageView>)(object)this).Model.Query as StoredProcQuery;
					if (StoredProcQueryHelper.CompareStoredProcQueryAndDBStoredProcedure(storedProcQuery, value))
					{
						StoredProcedureQuery = storedProcQuery;
					}
					else
					{
						DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter[] array = value.Arguments.Select((DBStoredProcedureArgument a) => new DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter(((DBNameTypePair)a).Name, DBColumn.GetType(((DBNameTypePair)a).Type), null)).ToArray();
						if (storedProcQuery != null && value.Name == storedProcQuery.StoredProcName)
						{
							DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter[] array2 = array;
							foreach (DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter parameter in array2)
							{
								DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter queryParameter = storedProcQuery.Parameters.FirstOrDefault((DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter p) => p.Name == parameter.Name);
								if (ApplyParameterValueFromModel(parameter, queryParameter))
								{
									parameter.Value = queryParameter?.Value;
								}
							}
						}
						StoredProcedureQuery = new StoredProcQuery(value.Name, value.Name, array);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					StoredProcedureQuery = null;
				}
				DataSchema = null;
			}
			((WizardPageBase<IConfigureQueryPageView, IConfigureQueryPageView>)(object)this).RaiseChanged();
		}

		private bool ApplyParameterValueFromModel(DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter parameter, DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter modelParameter)
		{
			if (modelParameter == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (modelParameter.Type == parameter.Type)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (modelParameter.Type == typeof(Expression) && (modelParameter.Value as Expression)?.ResultType == parameter.Type)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void SelectQueryControl_Changed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			SqlText = ((WizardPageBase<IConfigureQueryPageView, IConfigureQueryPageView>)(object)this).View.SqlString;
			DataSchema = null;
			((WizardPageBase<IConfigureQueryPageView, IConfigureQueryPageView>)(object)this).RaiseChanged();
		}
	}
	public struct DBStoredProcedureViewInfo
	{
		public DBStoredProcedure Value { get; }

		public string DisplayName { get; }

		public bool IsValid { get; set; }

		private static DBStoredProcedureArgument ConvertQueryParameterToProcedureArgument(DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter p)
		{
			//IL_001d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0055: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0056: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0049: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			DBColumnType val = ((p.Type == typeof(Expression)) ? DBColumn.GetColumnType((p.Value as Expression)?.ResultType ?? typeof(object)) : DBColumn.GetColumnType(p.Type));
			return new DBStoredProcedureArgument(p.Name, val);
		}

		public DBStoredProcedureViewInfo(StoredProcQuery query)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0005: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Expected O, but got Unknown
			DBStoredProcedure val = new DBStoredProcedure
			{
				Name = query.StoredProcName
			};
			val.Arguments.AddRange(query.Parameters.Select(ConvertQueryParameterToProcedureArgument));
			Value = val;
			DisplayName = val.GetDisplayName();
			IsValid = true;
		}

		public DBStoredProcedureViewInfo(DBStoredProcedure value, string displayName)
		{
			Value = value;
			DisplayName = displayName;
			IsValid = true;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return DisplayName;
		}
	}
	public enum QueryType
	{
		TableOrCustomSql,
		StoredProcedure
	}
	public class ConfigureSqlParametersPage<TModel> : WizardPageBase<IConfigureParametersPageView, TModel> where TModel : class, ISqlDataSourceModel
	{
		public override bool FinishEnabled => true;

		public override bool MoveNextEnabled => false;

		protected virtual IWaitFormActivator WaitFormActivator => Context.WaitFormActivator;

		protected virtual IExceptionHandler ExceptionHandler => ((IUIRunnerContext)Context).CreateExceptionHandler((ExceptionHandlerKind)2);

		private IParameterService ParameterService { get; }

		private IDBSchemaProviderEx DBSchemaProviderEx { get; }

		private IWizardRunnerContext Context { get; }

		private IResultSchemaProvider SchemaProvider { get; }

		private ICustomQueryValidator QueryValidator { get; }

		private bool LegacyExpressionEditor { get; }

		public ConfigureSqlParametersPage(IConfigureParametersPageView view, IWizardRunnerContext context, IParameterService parameterService, IDBSchemaProviderEx dbSchemaProviderEx, ICustomQueryValidator validator, SqlWizardOptions options)
			: this(view, context, parameterService, dbSchemaProviderEx, (IResultSchemaProvider)null, validator, options)
		{
		}

		public ConfigureSqlParametersPage(IConfigureParametersPageView view, IWizardRunnerContext context, IParameterService parameterService, IDBSchemaProviderEx dbSchemaProviderEx, IResultSchemaProvider resultSchemaProvider, ICustomQueryValidator validator, SqlWizardOptions options)
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IConfigureParametersPageView, IConfigureParametersPageView>)(object)this)..ctor(view);
			QueryValidator = validator;
			Context = context;
			SchemaProvider = resultSchemaProvider ?? new ResultSchemaProvider();
			LegacyExpressionEditor = options.HasFlag(SqlWizardOptions.LegacyExpressionEditor);
			ParameterService = parameterService;
			DBSchemaProviderEx = dbSchemaProviderEx;
		}

		public override void Begin()
		{
			bool fixedParameters = ((WizardPageBase<IConfigureParametersPageView, IConfigureParametersPageView>)(object)this).Model.Query is StoredProcQuery;
			((WizardPageBase<IConfigureParametersPageView, IConfigureParametersPageView>)(object)this).View.Initialize((IEnumerable<IParameter>)((WizardPageBase<IConfigureParametersPageView, IConfigureParametersPageView>)(object)this).Model.Query.Parameters.Select((DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter p) => new DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter(p.Name, p.Type, p.Value)).ToList(), GetPreviewData, fixedParameters, LegacyExpressionEditor);
			((WizardPageBase<IConfigureParametersPageView, IConfigureParametersPageView>)(object)this).View.ParameterRenamed += delegate(object sender, ParameterRenamedEventArgs args)
			{
				(((WizardPageBase<IConfigureParametersPageView, IConfigureParametersPageView>)(object)this).Model.Query as SelectQuery)?.RenameParameter(args.OldName, args.NewName);
			};
		}

		private PreviewData GetPreviewData()
		{
			PreviewContext context = new PreviewContext(GetQuery(), ((WizardPageBase<IConfigureParametersPageView, IConfigureParametersPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection, ParameterServiceHelper.GetSourceParameters(ParameterService), null, DBSchemaProviderEx, QueryValidator, WaitFormActivator, ((IUIRunnerContext)Context).CreateExceptionHandler((ExceptionHandlerKind)0, "Validation"), ((IUIRunnerContext)Context).CreateExceptionHandler((ExceptionHandlerKind)1), ExceptionHandler);
			return new PreviewData(SqlQueryHelper.LoadPreviewData(context), ((WizardPageBase<IConfigureParametersPageView, IConfigureParametersPageView>)(object)this).Model.Query is SelectQuery);
		}

		public override bool Validate(out string errorMessage)
		{
			errorMessage = null;
			if (((WizardPageBase<IConfigureParametersPageView, IConfigureParametersPageView>)(object)this).Model.Query == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (((WizardPageBase<IConfigureParametersPageView, IConfigureParametersPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataSchema != null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!SqlQueryUIHelper.GetResultSchema(GetQuery(), ((WizardPageBase<IConfigureParametersPageView, IConfigureParametersPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection, null, SchemaProvider, WaitFormActivator, ExceptionHandler, ParameterService, ((WizardPageBase<IConfigureParametersPageView, IConfigureParametersPageView>)(object)this).View.ConfirmQueryExecution, ((WizardPageBase<IConfigureParametersPageView, IConfigureParametersPageView>)(object)this).View.ShowDuplicatingColumnNameError, out var resultSchema))
			{
				return false;
			}
			((WizardPageBase<IConfigureParametersPageView, IConfigureParametersPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataSchema = resultSchema;
			return true;
		}

		private SqlQuery GetQuery()
		{
			IEnumerable<DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter> collection = ((WizardPageBase<IConfigureParametersPageView, IConfigureParametersPageView>)(object)this).View.GetParameters().Select(DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter.FromIParameter);
			SqlQuery sqlQuery = ((WizardPageBase<IConfigureParametersPageView, IConfigureParametersPageView>)(object)this).Model.Query.Clone();
			sqlQuery.Parameters.Clear();
			sqlQuery.Parameters.AddRange(collection);
			return sqlQuery;
		}

		public override void Commit()
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IConfigureParametersPageView, IConfigureParametersPageView>)(object)this).Model.Query.Parameters.Clear();
			((WizardPageBase<IConfigureParametersPageView, IConfigureParametersPageView>)(object)this).Model.Query.Parameters.AddRange(((WizardPageBase<IConfigureParametersPageView, IConfigureParametersPageView>)(object)this).View.GetParameters().Select(DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter.FromIParameter));
		}
	}
	public abstract class ConnectionPropertiesPageBase<TModel> : WizardPageBase<IConnectionPropertiesPageView, TModel> where TModel : class, ISqlDataConnectionModel
	{
		private readonly IWizardRunnerContext context;

		private SqlDataConnection dataConnection;

		private readonly HashSet<string> allowedProviderKeys;

		protected SqlWizardOptions Options { get; }

		protected SensitiveInfoSavingBehavior DatabaseCredentialsSavingBehavior { get; }

		protected DataConnectionParametersBase ModelDataConnectionParameters
		{
			get
			{
				if (((WizardPageBase<IConnectionPropertiesPageView, IConnectionPropertiesPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(((WizardPageBase<IConnectionPropertiesPageView, IConnectionPropertiesPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection.Name))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return ((WizardPageBase<IConnectionPropertiesPageView, IConnectionPropertiesPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection?.CreateDataConnectionParameters();
			}
		}

		protected virtual IWaitFormActivator WaitFormActivator => context.WaitFormActivator;

		protected virtual IExceptionHandler ExceptionHandler => ((IUIRunnerContext)context).CreateExceptionHandler((ExceptionHandlerKind)1);

		private IEnumerable<SqlDataConnection> DataConnections { get; set; }

		protected DataConnectionParametersBase DataConnectionParameters
		{
			get
			{
				if (dataConnection == null && string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataConnection.Name))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return dataConnection.CreateDataConnectionParameters();
			}
		}

		protected IConnectionStorageService ConnectionStorageService { get; set; }

		protected bool AlwaysSaveCredentials => DatabaseCredentialsSavingBehavior == SensitiveInfoSavingBehavior.Always;

		protected abstract Type SaveConnectionPageType { get; }

		public override bool FinishEnabled => ((WizardPageBase<IConnectionPropertiesPageView, IConnectionPropertiesPageView>)(object)this).GetNextPageType() == null;

		public override bool MoveNextEnabled => ((WizardPageBase<IConnectionPropertiesPageView, IConnectionPropertiesPageView>)(object)this).GetNextPageType() != null;

		public ConnectionPropertiesPageBase(IConnectionPropertiesPageView view, IWizardRunnerContext context, IConnectionStorageService connectionStorageService, SqlWizardOptions options, SensitiveInfoSavingBehavior databaseCredentialsSavingBehavior, List<ProviderLookupItem> dataProviders)
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IConnectionPropertiesPageView, IConnectionPropertiesPageView>)(object)this)..ctor(view);
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)connectionStorageService, "connectionStorageService");
			this.context = context;
			Options = options;
			DatabaseCredentialsSavingBehavior = databaseCredentialsSavingBehavior;
			allowedProviderKeys = new HashSet<string>(dataProviders.Select((ProviderLookupItem pli) => pli.ProviderKey));
			ConnectionStorageService = connectionStorageService;
			DataConnections = ConnectionStorageService.GetConnections();
		}

		public override void Begin()
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IConnectionPropertiesPageView, IConnectionPropertiesPageView>)(object)this).View.InitControls();
			((WizardPageBase<IConnectionPropertiesPageView, IConnectionPropertiesPageView>)(object)this).View.ConnectionName = ((WizardPageBase<IConnectionPropertiesPageView, IConnectionPropertiesPageView>)(object)this).Model.ConnectionName;
			((WizardPageBase<IConnectionPropertiesPageView, IConnectionPropertiesPageView>)(object)this).View.SetConnections(DataConnections.Select((SqlDataConnection c) => ((INamedItem)c).Name));
			((WizardPageBase<IConnectionPropertiesPageView, IConnectionPropertiesPageView>)(object)this).View.Changed += ViewOnChanged;
			if (((WizardPageBase<IConnectionPropertiesPageView, IConnectionPropertiesPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(((WizardPageBase<IConnectionPropertiesPageView, IConnectionPropertiesPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection.Name))
			{
				DataConnectionParametersBase dataConnectionParametersBase = ((WizardPageBase<IConnectionPropertiesPageView, IConnectionPropertiesPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection.CreateDataConnectionParameters();
				string text = ((dataConnectionParametersBase is CustomStringConnectionParameters) ? "<Custom connection string>" : dataConnectionParametersBase.Factory.ProviderKey);
				if (allowedProviderKeys.Contains(text))
				{
					dataConnection = ((WizardPageBase<IConnectionPropertiesPageView, IConnectionPropertiesPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection;
					((WizardPageBase<IConnectionPropertiesPageView, IConnectionPropertiesPageView>)(object)this).View.DataConnectionParameters = dataConnectionParametersBase;
				}
				else
				{
					context.ShowMessage(string.Format(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.ConnectionPropertiesPage_ProviderNotSupported), text));
				}
			}
			else if (((WizardPageBase<IConnectionPropertiesPageView, IConnectionPropertiesPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection != null)
			{
				dataConnection = ((WizardPageBase<IConnectionPropertiesPageView, IConnectionPropertiesPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection;
				((WizardPageBase<IConnectionPropertiesPageView, IConnectionPropertiesPageView>)(object)this).View.SelectProvider((dataConnection.Factory != null) ? ((WizardPageBase<IConnectionPropertiesPageView, IConnectionPropertiesPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection.ProviderKey : "<Custom connection string>");
			}
		}

		private void ViewOnChanged(object sender, EventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IConnectionPropertiesPageView, IConnectionPropertiesPageView>)(object)this).RaiseChanged();
		}

		public override bool Validate(out string errorMessage)
		{
			errorMessage = string.Empty;
			DataConnectionParametersBase dataConnectionParameters = ((WizardPageBase<IConnectionPropertiesPageView, IConnectionPropertiesPageView>)(object)this).View.DataConnectionParameters;
			if (DataConnectionParametersComparer.Equals(ModelDataConnectionParameters, dataConnectionParameters))
			{
				return OpenConnection(dataConnection);
			}
			SqlDataConnection sqlDataConnection = CreateSqlDataConnection(((WizardPageBase<IConnectionPropertiesPageView, IConnectionPropertiesPageView>)(object)this).View.ConnectionName, dataConnectionParameters);
			if (OpenConnection(sqlDataConnection))
			{
				dataConnection?.Close();
				dataConnection = sqlDataConnection;
				return true;
			}
			sqlDataConnection.Dispose();
			return false;
		}

		public override void Commit()
		{
			((WizardPageBase<IConnectionPropertiesPageView, IConnectionPropertiesPageView>)(object)this).Model.ConnectionName = ((WizardPageBase<IConnectionPropertiesPageView, IConnectionPropertiesPageView>)(object)this).View.ConnectionName;
			((WizardPageBase<IConnectionPropertiesPageView, IConnectionPropertiesPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection = dataConnection;
			((WizardPageBase<IConnectionPropertiesPageView, IConnectionPropertiesPageView>)(object)this).Model.ShouldSaveConnection = (ConnectionStorageService.CanSaveConnection ? SaveConnectionMethod.SaveToAppConfig : SaveConnectionMethod.Hardcode);
			if (AlwaysSaveCredentials)
			{
				TModel model = ((WizardPageBase<IConnectionPropertiesPageView, IConnectionPropertiesPageView>)(object)this).Model;
				SaveConnectionMethod shouldSaveConnection = model.ShouldSaveConnection | SaveConnectionMethod.KeepCredentials;
				model.ShouldSaveConnection = shouldSaveConnection;
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool OpenConnection(SqlDataConnection connection)
		{
			return ConnectionHelper.ValidateConnection(connection, ExceptionHandler, WaitFormActivator);
		}

		protected virtual SqlDataConnection CreateSqlDataConnection(string connectionName, DataConnectionParametersBase dataConnectionParametersBase)
		{
			return new SqlDataConnection(connectionName, dataConnectionParametersBase);
		}

		public override Type GetNextPageType()
		{
			DataConnectionParametersBase dataConnectionParameters = ((WizardPageBase<IConnectionPropertiesPageView, IConnectionPropertiesPageView>)(object)this).View.DataConnectionParameters;
			if (!ConnectionStorageService.CanSaveConnection)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return SaveConnectionPageType;
		}
	}

	public abstract class SaveConnectionPageBase<TModel> : WizardPageBase<ISaveConnectionPageView, TModel> where TModel : class, ISqlDataConnectionModel
	{
		private readonly IWizardRunnerContext context;

		protected readonly SqlWizardOptions options;

		private readonly SensitiveInfoSavingBehavior databaseCredentialsSavingBehavior;

		private IConnectionStorageService ConnectionStorageService { get; set; }

		public override bool FinishEnabled => true;

		public override bool MoveNextEnabled => false;

		public SaveConnectionPageBase(ISaveConnectionPageView view, IWizardRunnerContext context, IConnectionStorageService connectionStorageService, SqlWizardOptions options, SensitiveInfoSavingBehavior databaseCredentialsSavingBehavior)
		{
			((WizardPageBase<ISaveConnectionPageView, ISaveConnectionPageView>)(object)this)..ctor(view);
			this.context = context;
			this.options = options;
			this.databaseCredentialsSavingBehavior = databaseCredentialsSavingBehavior;
			ConnectionStorageService = connectionStorageService;
		}

		public override void Begin()
		{
			if (((WizardPageBase<ISaveConnectionPageView, ISaveConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.ConnectionName == null)
			{
				((WizardPageBase<ISaveConnectionPageView, ISaveConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.ConnectionName = ((WizardPageBase<ISaveConnectionPageView, ISaveConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection.Name;
			}
			((WizardPageBase<ISaveConnectionPageView, ISaveConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.ConnectionName = ((WizardPageBase<ISaveConnectionPageView, ISaveConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.ConnectionName;
			SqlDataConnection dataConnection = ((WizardPageBase<ISaveConnectionPageView, ISaveConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.DataConnection;
			((WizardPageBase<ISaveConnectionPageView, ISaveConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.SetCanSaveToStorage(ConnectionStorageService.CanSaveConnection);
			((WizardPageBase<ISaveConnectionPageView, ISaveConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.SetConnectionUsesServerAuth(dataConnection != null && dataConnection.HasSensitiveInfo && databaseCredentialsSavingBehavior == SensitiveInfoSavingBehavior.Prompt);
			((WizardPageBase<ISaveConnectionPageView, ISaveConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.ShouldSaveConnectionString = ((WizardPageBase<ISaveConnectionPageView, ISaveConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.ShouldSaveConnection.HasFlag(SaveConnectionMethod.SaveToAppConfig);
		}

		public override bool Validate(out string errorMessage)
		{
			errorMessage = null;
			if (!((WizardPageBase<ISaveConnectionPageView, ISaveConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.ShouldSaveConnectionString)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(((WizardPageBase<ISaveConnectionPageView, ISaveConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.ConnectionName))
			{
				ShowMessage(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.WizardEmptyConnectionNameMessage));
				return false;
			}
			if (ConnectionStorageService.Contains(((WizardPageBase<ISaveConnectionPageView, ISaveConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.ConnectionName))
			{
				ShowMessage(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.WizardDataConnectionNameExistsMessage));
				return false;
			}
			return ((WizardPageBase<ISaveConnectionPageView, ISaveConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Validate(ref errorMessage);
		}

		public override void Commit()
		{
			if (((WizardPageBase<ISaveConnectionPageView, ISaveConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.ShouldSaveConnectionString)
			{
				((WizardPageBase<ISaveConnectionPageView, ISaveConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.ConnectionName = ((WizardPageBase<ISaveConnectionPageView, ISaveConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.ConnectionName;
				((WizardPageBase<ISaveConnectionPageView, ISaveConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.ShouldSaveConnection = SaveConnectionMethod.SaveToAppConfig;
			}
			else
			{
				((WizardPageBase<ISaveConnectionPageView, ISaveConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model.ShouldSaveConnection = SaveConnectionMethod.Hardcode;
			}
			if (((WizardPageBase<ISaveConnectionPageView, ISaveConnectionPageView>)(object)this).View.ShouldSaveCredentials || databaseCredentialsSavingBehavior == SensitiveInfoSavingBehavior.Always)
			{
				TModel model = ((WizardPageBase<ISaveConnectionPageView, ISaveConnectionPageView>)(object)this).Model;
				SaveConnectionMethod shouldSaveConnection = model.ShouldSaveConnection | SaveConnectionMethod.KeepCredentials;
				model.ShouldSaveConnection = shouldSaveConnection;
			}
		}

		public override Type GetNextPageType()
		{
			return null;
		}

		public virtual void ShowMessage(string message)
		{
			context.ShowMessage(message);
		}
	}

	internal class DXTypeInfoAnalyzer
	{
		public TypeViewInfoNodeType GetClassType(IDXTypeInfo info)
		{
			if (info is IDXTypeInfoEx info2)
			{
				return GetClassType(info2);
			}
			Type type = info.ResolveType();
			if (type.IsInterface)
			{
				return TypeViewInfoNodeType.Interface;
			}
			if (type.IsAbstract)
			{
				if (!type.IsSealed)
				{
					return TypeViewInfoNodeType.AbstractClass;
				}
				return TypeViewInfoNodeType.StaticClass;
			}
			return TypeViewInfoNodeType.Class;
		}

		private TypeViewInfoNodeType GetClassType(IDXTypeInfoEx info)
		{
			if (info.IsInterface)
			{
				return TypeViewInfoNodeType.Interface;
			}
			if (info.IsAbstract)
			{
				if (!info.IsSealed)
				{
					return TypeViewInfoNodeType.AbstractClass;
				}
				return TypeViewInfoNodeType.StaticClass;
			}
			return TypeViewInfoNodeType.Class;
		}

		public bool IsHighlighted(IDXTypeInfo info)
		{
			return (info as IDXTypeInfoEx)?.IsHighlighted ?? Highlighted(info.ResolveType());
		}

		private static bool Highlighted(Type type)
		{
			if (!type.IsInterface)
			{
				return Highlighted<HighlightedClassAttribute>(type);
			}
			return Highlighted<HighlightedInterfaceAttribute>(type);
		}

		private static bool Highlighted<TAttibuteType>(Type type)
		{
			try
			{
				return type.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(TAttibuteType), inherit: false).Length != 0;
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool TypeIsVisible(IDXTypeInfo info, bool projectAssembly)
		{
			if (info is IDXTypeInfoEx iDXTypeInfoEx)
			{
				return iDXTypeInfoEx.IsVisible;
			}
			return TypeIsVisible(info.ResolveType(), projectAssembly);
		}

		private static bool TypeIsVisible(Type type, bool projectAssembly)
		{
			if (type.IsPublic)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (type.IsNestedPublic)
			{
				return TypeIsVisible(type.DeclaringType, projectAssembly);
			}
			if (!projectAssembly)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (IsCompilerGenerated(type))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!type.IsNested)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (type.IsNestedAssembly || type.IsNestedFamORAssem)
			{
				return TypeIsVisible(type.DeclaringType, projectAssembly: true);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool IsCompilerGenerated(Type type)
		{
			try
			{
				return type.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(CompilerGeneratedAttribute), inherit: false).Length != 0;
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool IsEnum(IDXTypeInfo info)
		{
			return (info as IDXTypeInfoEx)?.IsEnum ?? info.ResolveType().IsEnum;
		}

		public bool IsGenericTypeDefinition(IDXTypeInfo info)
		{
			return (info as IDXTypeInfoEx)?.IsGenericTypeDefinition ?? info.ResolveType().IsGenericTypeDefinition;
		}

		public bool IsNested(IDXTypeInfo info)
		{
			return (info as IDXTypeInfoEx)?.IsNested ?? info.ResolveType().IsNested;
		}

		public bool IsDeclaringTypeEquals(IDXTypeInfo typeInfo, IDXTypeInfo nestedTypeInfo)
		{
			IDXTypeInfoEx iDXTypeInfoEx = typeInfo as IDXTypeInfoEx;
			IDXTypeInfoEx iDXTypeInfoEx2 = nestedTypeInfo as IDXTypeInfoEx;
			if (iDXTypeInfoEx != null && iDXTypeInfoEx2 != null)
			{
				return string.Equals(((IDXTypeInfo)iDXTypeInfoEx).FullName, iDXTypeInfoEx2.DeclaringTypeFullName);
			}
			return typeInfo.ResolveType() == nestedTypeInfo.ResolveType().DeclaringType;
		}
	}

	{
		internal static IEnumerable<IParameter> GetSourceParameters(IParameterService parameterService)
		{
			DateTime epoch = new DateTime(1970, 1, 1);
			return parameterService?.Parameters.Select((IParameter p) => (IParameter)(object)((!(p.Value is DateTime) || !((DateTime)p.Value == default(DateTime))) ? ((DataSourceParameterBase)(object)p) : new DataSourceParameterBase(((IFilterParameter)p).Name, typeof(DateTime), epoch))) ?? Enumerable.Empty<IParameter>();
		}
	}

	internal static class SelectQueryExtensions
	{
		private class RenameParameterCriteriaVisitor : ClientCriteriaVisitorBase, IQueryCriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>, ICriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>
		{
			private readonly string renameFrom;

			private readonly string renameTo;

			private readonly IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters;

			private bool renamed;

			public RenameParameterCriteriaVisitor(string renameFrom, string renameTo, IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters)
			{
				this.renameFrom = renameFrom;
				this.renameTo = renameTo;
				this.parameters = parameters;
			}

			public string ProcessExpression(string input, out bool processed)
			{
				renamed = false;
				if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(input))
				{
					processed = false;
					return null;
				}
				CriteriaOperator filter = FilterHelper.GetFilter(input, parameters);
				string result = ((object)((ClientCriteriaVisitorBase)this).Process(filter)).ToString();
				processed = renamed;
				return result;
			}

			public CriteriaOperator Visit(QueryOperand theOperand)
			{
				//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0030: Expected O, but got Unknown
				//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0014: Expected O, but got Unknown
				if (theOperand.NodeAlias != null)
				{
					return (CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty(theOperand.NodeAlias + "." + theOperand.ColumnName);
				}
				return (CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty(theOperand.ColumnName);
			}

			public CriteriaOperator Visit(QuerySubQueryContainer theOperand)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}

			protected override CriteriaOperator Visit(OperandValue theOperand)
			{
				//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0030: Expected O, but got Unknown
				OperandParameter val = (OperandParameter)(object)((theOperand is OperandParameter) ? theOperand : null);
				if (val != null && val.ParameterName == renameFrom)
				{
					renamed = true;
					return (CriteriaOperator)new OperandParameter(renameTo);
				}
				return (CriteriaOperator)(object)theOperand;
			}
		}

		public static void RenameParameter(this SelectQuery query, string oldName, string newName)
		{
			RenameParameterCriteriaVisitor visitor = new RenameParameterCriteriaVisitor(oldName, newName, (IEnumerable<IParameter>)query.Parameters);
			PatchExpression(visitor, query.FilterString, delegate(string value)
			{
				query.FilterString = value;
			});
			PatchExpression(visitor, query.GroupFilterString, delegate(string value)
			{
				query.GroupFilterString = value;
			});
			foreach (CustomExpression expression in (from c in query.Columns.OfType<Column>()
				select c.Expression).OfType<CustomExpression>())
			{
				PatchExpression(visitor, expression.Expression, delegate(string value)
				{
					expression.Expression = value;
				});
			}
			foreach (CustomExpression expression2 in query.Groups.Select((DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.Group c) => c.Expression).OfType<CustomExpression>())
			{
				PatchExpression(visitor, expression2.Expression, delegate(string value)
				{
					expression2.Expression = value;
				});
			}
			foreach (CustomExpression expression3 in query.Sorting.Select((Sorting c) => c.Expression).OfType<CustomExpression>())
			{
				PatchExpression(visitor, expression3.Expression, delegate(string value)
				{
					expression3.Expression = value;
				});
			}
		}

		private static void PatchExpression(RenameParameterCriteriaVisitor visitor, string expression, Action<string> apply)
		{
			bool processed;
			string obj = visitor.ProcessExpression(expression, out processed);
			if (processed)
			{
				apply(obj);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class SqlQueryUIHelper
	{
		internal static bool GetResultSchema(SqlQuery query, SqlDataConnection dataConnection, DBSchema dbSchema, IResultSchemaProvider schemaProvider, IWaitFormActivator waitFormActivator, IExceptionHandler exceptionHandler, IParameterService parameterService, Func<bool> confirmQueryExecution, Action<string> showDuplicatingColumnNameError, out object resultSchema)
		{
			resultSchema = null;
			if (query is SelectQuery selectQuery)
			{
				resultSchema = schemaProvider.GetSelectQuerySchema(selectQuery, dbSchema, dataConnection, dataConnection.ConnectionOptions, parameterService?.Parameters);
				return true;
			}
			if (query is StoredProcQuery storedProcedureQuery)
			{
				object storedProcedureSchema;
				try
				{
					storedProcedureSchema = schemaProvider.GetStoredProcedureSchema(storedProcedureQuery, dataConnection, dataConnection.ConnectionOptions, parameterService?.Parameters);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					exceptionHandler.HandleException(ex);
					return false;
				}
				if (storedProcedureSchema != null)
				{
					resultSchema = storedProcedureSchema;
					return true;
				}
			}
			CustomSqlQuery customSqlQuery = query as CustomSqlQuery;
			IParameter[] sourceParameters = ParameterServiceHelper.GetSourceParameters(parameterService).ToArray();
			if (customSqlQuery != null)
			{
				try
				{
					resultSchema = schemaProvider.GetCustomSqlSchema(customSqlQuery, dataConnection, dataConnection.ConnectionOptions, sourceParameters);
					return true;
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			if (!confirmQueryExecution())
			{
				return false;
			}
			UIDataLoader uIDataLoader = new UIDataLoader(waitFormActivator, exceptionHandler);
			ColumnarData columnarData = uIDataLoader.LoadData(dataConnection, null, sourceParameters, query, topThousand: false);
			if (columnarData == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			HashSet<string> hashSet = new HashSet<string>();
			ColumnDescription[] schema = columnarData.Schema;
			foreach (ColumnDescription columnDescription in schema)
			{
				string name = columnDescription.Name;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(name) && !hashSet.Add(name))
				{
					showDuplicatingColumnNameError(name);
					return false;
				}
			}
			resultSchema = columnarData.ToResult(string.Empty);
			return true;
		}
	}
	public static class XPObjectFilterHelper
	{
		private static string[] assemblyFilters = new string[1] { "DevExpress" };

		public static bool TypeFilter(IDXTypeInfo typeInfo)
		{
			if (typeInfo == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string[] array = assemblyFilters;
			foreach (string value in array)
			{
				if (typeInfo.Assembly.AssemblyFullName.StartsWith(value))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			Type type = typeInfo.ResolveType();
			if (type == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (typeInfo.Assembly.IsProjectAssembly)
			{
				return IsValidXPClassInfo(type);
			}
			if (type.IsPublic)
			{
				return IsValidXPClassInfo(type);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsValidXPClassInfo(Type type)
		{
			if (!type.IsAbstract && (type.IsClass || type.IsValueType) && typeof(IXPSimpleObject).IsAssignableFrom(type))
			{
				return type.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(PersistentAttribute), inherit: true) != null;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

		}
	}
	public class ConnectionHelper
	{
		public static bool OpenConnection(DataConnectionBase dataConnection, IExceptionHandler exceptionHandler, IWaitFormActivator waitFormActivator, IDataConnectionParametersService dataConnectionParametersService)
		{
			CancellationTokenSource cancellationTokenSource = new CancellationTokenSource();
			Task<bool> task = new ConnectionHelperAsync(dataConnection).OpenAsync(waitFormActivator, dataConnectionParametersService, cancellationTokenSource);
			try
			{
				task.WithBackgroundService(cancellationTokenSource.Token);
				task.Wait(cancellationTokenSource.Token);
				return task.Result;
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				exceptionHandler.HandleException(ExceptionHelper.Adjust(ex));
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool ValidateConnection(SqlDataConnection connection, IExceptionHandler exceptionHandler, IWaitFormActivator waitFormActivator)
		{
			try
			{
				return OpenConnection(connection, exceptionHandler, waitFormActivator, null);
			}
			finally
			{
				connection.CloseDbConnection();
			}
		}

		public static bool ValidateJsonDataConnection(JsonDataConnection connection, int? schemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount, IParameterService parameterService, IExceptionHandler exceptionHandler, IWaitFormActivator waitFormActivator, UrlResolver UrlResolver, Action<JsonDataSource> onSuccess = null)
		{
			JsonDataSource dataSource = new JsonDataSource
			{
				SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount = (schemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount ?? 100)
			};
			try
			{
				dataSource.JsonSource = connection.GetJsonSource();
				IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters = ParameterServiceHelper.GetSourceParameters(parameterService);
				return AsyncHelper.DoWithWaitForm(delegate(CancellationToken token)
				{
					token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
					ServiceContainerExtensions.ReplaceService<UrlResolver>((IServiceContainer)dataSource, UrlResolver, false);
					dataSource.Fill(sourceParameters);
					onSuccess?.Invoke(dataSource);
				}, waitFormActivator, exceptionHandler);
			}
			finally
			{
				if (dataSource != null)
				{
					((IDisposable)dataSource).Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		public static bool ValidateMongoDBDataConnection(MongoDBDataConnection connection, IWaitFormActivator waitFormActivator, IExceptionHandler exceptionHandler, out string errorMessage)
		{
			errorMessage = string.Empty;
			try
			{
				return AsyncHelper.DoWithWaitForm(delegate(CancellationToken token)
				{
					connection.Open(CancellationToken.None);
					token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
				}, waitFormActivator, exceptionHandler);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				errorMessage = ex.Message;
				return false;
			}
			finally
			{
				connection.Close();
			}
		}

		public static bool OpenConnection(EFDataConnection dataConnection, IExceptionHandler exceptionHandler, IWaitFormActivator waitFormActivator)
		{
			waitFormActivator.ShowWaitForm(true, false, true);
			Exception ex2;
			try
			{
				dataConnection.Open();
				return dataConnection.IsConnected;
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				ex2 = ex;
			}
			finally
			{
				waitFormActivator.CloseWaitForm();
			}
			exceptionHandler.HandleException(ex2);
			return false;
		}

			DBTable[] views = dBSchema.Views;
			return new DBSchema(tables, views, dbSchema?.StoredProcedures);
		}

		public static DBSchema LoadTables(DBSchema dbSchema, UIDataLoader loader, IDBSchemaProviderEx provider, SqlDataConnection connection, bool includeColumns, string[] dbItemsList)
		{
			DBSchema dBSchema = loader.LoadTables(provider, connection, includeColumns, dbItemsList);
			if (dBSchema == null)
			{
				return dbSchema;
			}
			DBTable[] tables = dBSchema.Tables;
			DBTable[] views = dBSchema.Views;
			return new DBSchema(tables ?? dbSchema?.Tables, views ?? dbSchema?.Views, dbSchema?.StoredProcedures);
		}

		public static DBSchema LoadViews(DBSchema dbSchema, UIDataLoader loader, IDBSchemaProviderEx provider, SqlDataConnection connection, bool includeColumns, string[] dbItemsList)
		{
			DBSchema dBSchema = loader.LoadViews(provider, connection, includeColumns, dbItemsList);
			if (dBSchema == null)

				return dbSchema;
			}
			DBTable[] tables = dBSchema.Tables;
			DBTable[] views = dBSchema.Views;
			return new DBSchema(tables ?? dbSchema?.Tables, views ?? dbSchema?.Views, dbSchema?.StoredProcedures);
		}

		}

		public static DBSchema LoadStoredProcedures(DBSchema dbSchema, UIDataLoader loader, IDBSchemaProviderEx provider, SqlDataConnection connection)
		{
			DBTable[] tables = null;
			DBTable[] views = null;
			if (dbSchema != null)
			{
				tables = dbSchema.Tables;
				views = dbSchema.Views;
			}
			DBSchema dBSchema = loader.LoadStoredProcedures(provider, connection);
			if (dBSchema == null)
			{
				return dbSchema;
			}
			return new DBSchema(tables, views, dBSchema.StoredProcedures);
		}

		}

		}

		public static Type GetNextPageType<T>(DataSourceType dataSourceType, SqlWizardOptions options, MongoDBWizardOptions mongoOptions, IEnumerable<SqlDataConnection> dataConnections, IJsonConnectionStorageService jsonConnectionStorageService, IMongoDBConnectionStorageService mongoDBConnectionStorageService) where T : class, IDataSourceModel
		{
			bool flag = NewConnectionsDisabled(options);
			bool flag2 = NewMongoDBConnectionsDisabled(mongoOptions);
			return GetNextPageType<T>(dataSourceType, flag || dataConnections.Any(), flag || HasJsonConnections(jsonConnectionStorageService), flag2 || HasMongoDBConnections(mongoDBConnectionStorageService));
		}

		public static Type GetNextPageType<T>(DataSourceType dataSourceType, bool hasConnections, bool hasJsonConnections, bool hasMongoDBConnections) where T : class, IDataSourceModel
		{
			if (dataSourceType == DataSourceType.Xpo)
			{
				if (!hasConnections)
				{
					return typeof(ConnectionPropertiesPage<T>);
				}
				return typeof(ChooseConnectionPage<T>);
			}
			if (dataSourceType == DataSourceType.Entity)
			{
				return typeof(ChooseEFContextPage<T>);
			}
			if (dataSourceType == DataSourceType.Object)
			{
				return typeof(ChooseObjectAssemblyPage<T>);
			}
			if (dataSourceType == DataSourceType.Excel)
			{
				return typeof(ChooseFilePage<T>);
			}
			if (dataSourceType == DataSourceType.Json)
			{
				return GetNextJsonPageType<T>(hasJsonConnections);
			}
			if (dataSourceType == DataSourceType.MongoDB)
			{
				return GetNextMongoDBPageType<T>(hasMongoDBConnections);
			}
			if (dataSourceType == DataSourceType.XPObject)
			{
				return typeof(ChooseXPObjectSourceEntityTypePage<T>);
			}
			if (dataSourceType == DataSourceType.Federation)
			{
				return typeof(MultiFederatedQueryConfigurePage<T>);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static Type GetNextJsonPageType<T>(IJsonConnectionStorageService jsonConnectionStorageService, JsonWizardOptions options = JsonWizardOptions.None) where T : class, IJsonDataSourceModel
		{
			return GetNextJsonPageType<T>(NewConnectionsDisabled(options) || HasJsonConnections(jsonConnectionStorageService));
		}

		private static Type GetNextMongoDBPageType<T>(bool hasMongoDBConnection) where T : class, IMongoDBDataSourceModel
		{

			return typeof(ChooseMongoDBConnectionPage<T>);

		public static void CleanDataSourceTypes(DataSourceTypes dataSourceTypes)
		{
			if (dataSourceTypes.Contains(DataSourceType.Json) && !JsonLoaderHelper.TryLoadDependency(throwOnFalse: false))
			{
				dataSourceTypes.Remove(DataSourceType.Json);
			}
			if (dataSourceTypes.Contains(DataSourceType.MongoDB) && !MongoDBUrlBuilder.TryLoadDependency(throwOnFalse: false))
			{
				dataSourceTypes.Remove(DataSourceType.MongoDB);
			}
		}

		public static bool ValidateDataSourceType<TModel>(DataSourceType dataSourceType, TModel model, IWizardRunnerContext context, ISolutionTypesProvider solutionTypesProvider, IExceptionHandler exceptionHandler, IWaitFormActivator waitFormActivator, IFederatedDataSourceProvider federatedDataSourceProvider) where TModel : class, IDataSourceModel
		{
			if (dataSourceType == DataSourceType.Entity)
			{
				if (model.ModelHelper == null)
				{
					IEntityFrameworkModelHelper entityFrameworkModelHelper = EntityFrameworkModelHelper.Create(solutionTypesProvider, exceptionHandler, waitFormActivator);
					if (entityFrameworkModelHelper == null)
					{
						return false;
					}
					model.ModelHelper = entityFrameworkModelHelper;
				}
			}
			if (dataSourceType == DataSourceType.MongoDB)
			{
				try
				{
					MongoDBUrlBuilder.TryLoadDependency();
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					exceptionHandler.HandleException(ex);
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (dataSourceType == DataSourceType.Json)
			{
				try
				{
					JsonLoaderHelper.TryLoadDependency();
				}
				catch (Exception ex2)
				{
					exceptionHandler.HandleException(ex2);
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (dataSourceType == DataSourceType.Federation && federatedDataSourceProvider != null && federatedDataSourceProvider.GetDataSources().Count() == 0)
			{
				context.ShowMessage(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.Wizard_NoDataSourcesForDataFederationMessage));
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class EntityFrameworkModelHelper : IEntityFrameworkModelHelper
	{
		private IEnumerable<IContainerInfo> containers;

		private DataAccessEntityFrameworkModel entityFrameworkModel;

		protected ISolutionTypesProvider SolutionTypesProvider { get; set; }

		public virtual IEnumerable<IContainerInfo> Containers => containers;

		public DataAccessEntityFrameworkModel EntityFrameworkModel => entityFrameworkModel;

		public bool IsCustomAssembly { get; private set; }

		public string CustomAssemblyPath { get; private set; }

		public string[] ReferencedAssemblies { get; private set; }

		public static EntityFrameworkModelHelper Create(ISolutionTypesProvider solutionTypesProvider, IExceptionHandler exceptionHandler, IWaitFormActivator waitFormActivator)
		{
			Exception ex = null;
			EntityFrameworkModelHelper entityFrameworkModelHelper = new EntityFrameworkModelHelper(solutionTypesProvider);
			try
			{
				DoWithWaitForm(entityFrameworkModelHelper.RefreshEntityModel, waitFormActivator);
			}
			catch (Exception ex2)
			{
				ex = ex2;
			}
			if (ex == null)
			{
				return entityFrameworkModelHelper;
			}
			exceptionHandler.HandleException(ex);
			return null;
		}

		public EntityFrameworkModelHelper(ISolutionTypesProvider solutionTypesProvider)
		{
			SolutionTypesProvider = solutionTypesProvider;
		}

		public virtual void RefreshEntityModel()
		{
			entityFrameworkModel = new DataAccessEntityFrameworkModel(SolutionTypesProvider);
			containers = ((EntityFrameworkModelBase)EntityFrameworkModel).GetContainersInfo() ?? Enumerable.Empty<IContainerInfo>();
		}

		public virtual bool OpenAssembly(string filePath, IExceptionHandler exceptionHandler)
		{
			//IL_00ae: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b5: Expected O, but got Unknown
			Assembly orLoadAssemblyFile = SafeTypeResolver.GetOrLoadAssemblyFile(filePath, false);
			try
			{
				AppDomain currentDomain = AppDomain.CurrentDomain;
				ResolveEventHandler value = delegate(object s, ResolveEventArgs args)
				{
					if (args.Name.StartsWith("EntityFramework"))
					{
						string directoryName = Path.GetDirectoryName(filePath);
						if (directoryName == null)
						{
							return (Assembly)null;
						}
						string text = Path.Combine(directoryName, new AssemblyName(args.Name).Name + ".dll");
						if (!File.Exists(text))
						{
							return (Assembly)null;
						}
						return SafeTypeResolver.GetOrLoadAssemblyFrom(text, false);
					}
					return (Assembly)null;
				};
				currentDomain.AssemblyResolve += value;
				try
				{
					CustomAssemblyPath = filePath;
					IsCustomAssembly = true;
					Type[] types = orLoadAssemblyFile.GetTypes();
					ReferencedAssemblies = (from an in orLoadAssemblyFile.GetReferencedAssemblies()
						where an.FullName.StartsWith("EntityFramework")
						select an.Name).ToArray();
					SolutionTypesProviderConsole val = new SolutionTypesProviderConsole(orLoadAssemblyFile.FullName);
					val.AddRange((IEnumerable<Type>)types);
					SolutionTypesProvider = (ISolutionTypesProvider)(object)val;
					RefreshEntityModel();
				}
				finally
				{
					currentDomain.AssemblyResolve -= value;
				}
			}
			catch (ReflectionTypeLoadException ex)
			{
				exceptionHandler.HandleException((ex.LoaderExceptions.Length == 1) ? ex.LoaderExceptions[0] : new AggregateException(ex.LoaderExceptions));
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected static void DoWithWaitForm(Action action, IWaitFormActivator waitFormActivator)
		{
			waitFormActivator.ShowWaitForm(false, true, true);
			waitFormActivator.SetWaitFormCaption(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.LoadingDataPanelText));
			waitFormActivator.SetWaitFormDescription(string.Empty);
			waitFormActivator.EnableCancelButton(false);
			try
			{
				action();
			}
			finally
			{
				waitFormActivator.CloseWaitForm();
			}
		}
	}

				Condition = condition;
			}
		}

		{

			new PageInfo(typeof(ChooseObjectBindingModePage<>), AllowedAndSchemaIsAvailable),
			new PageInfo(typeof(ChooseObjectConstructorPage<>), AllowedAndHasCtors),

		};

		}

		public static Type AfterObjectMemberParametersPage<TModel>(Type objType, ObjectMember member, ConstructorInfo ctor, OperationMode mode) where TModel : IObjectDataSourceModel
		{
			return GetNextPage<TModel>(typeof(ObjectMemberParametersPage<>), objType, member, ctor, mode);
		}

		public static Type AfterChooseObjectBindingModePage<TModel>(Type objType, ConstructorInfo ctor, OperationMode mode) where TModel : IObjectDataSourceModel
		{
			return GetNextPage<TModel>(typeof(ChooseObjectBindingModePage<>), objType, null, ctor, mode);
		}

		public static Type AfterChooseObjectConstructorPage<TModel>(ConstructorInfo ctor, OperationMode mode) where TModel : IObjectDataSourceModel
		{
			return GetNextPage<TModel>(typeof(ChooseObjectConstructorPage<>), null, null, ctor, mode);
		}

		private static Type GetNextPage<TModel>(Type pageType, Type objType, ObjectMember member, ConstructorInfo ctor, OperationMode mode) where TModel : IObjectDataSourceModel
		{
			Type pageType2 = pages.SkipWhile((PageInfo info) => info.PageType != pageType).Skip(1).FirstOrDefault((PageInfo info) => info.Condition(objType, member, ctor, mode))
				.PageType;
			if (!(pageType2 == null))
			{
				return pageType2.MakeGenericType(typeof(TModel));
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static bool Always(Type objType, ObjectMember member, ConstructorInfo ctor, OperationMode mode)
		{
			return true;
		}

		private static bool TypeHasBindableMembers(Type objType, ObjectMember member, ConstructorInfo ctor, OperationMode mode)
		{
			return TypeHasBindableMembers(objType);
		}

		private static bool MemberHasParams(Type objType, ObjectMember member, ConstructorInfo ctor, OperationMode mode)
		{
			return MemberHasParams(member);
		}

		private static bool AllowedAndSchemaIsAvailable(Type objType, ObjectMember member, ConstructorInfo ctor, OperationMode mode)
		{
			if (ChooseObjectBindingModeAllowed(mode))
			{
				return SchemaIsAvailable(objType, member, mode);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool AllowedAndHasCtors(Type objType, ObjectMember member, ConstructorInfo ctor, OperationMode mode)
		{
			if (ChooseObjectConstructorAllowed(mode) && NeedConstructorSetUp(objType, member, mode, ctor))
			{
				return TypeHasNonDefaultCtors(objType);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool AllowedAndCtorHasParams(Type objType, ObjectMember member, ConstructorInfo ctor, OperationMode mode)
		{
			if (ChooseObjectConstructorAllowed(mode))
			{
				return CtorHasParams(ctor);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool TypeHasBindableMembers(Type objType)
		{
			try
			{
				object data = ObjectDataSourceFillHelper.CreateInstanceForSchema(objType);
				return ObjectDataSourceFillHelper.GetItemMembers(data).Any();
			}
			catch
			{
				return false;
			}
		}

		public static bool MemberHasParams(ObjectMember member)
		{
			return member?.HasParams ?? false;
		}

		public static bool ChooseObjectBindingModeAllowed(OperationMode mode)
		{
			return (mode & OperationMode.Both) == OperationMode.Both;
		}

		public static bool SchemaIsAvailable(Type objType, ObjectMember member, OperationMode mode)
		{
			if (!typeof(ITypedList).IsAssignableFrom(objType))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if ((objType.IsAbstract && objType.IsSealed) || (member != null && member.IsStatic))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return objType.GetConstructor(Type.EmptyTypes) != null;
		}

		public static bool ChooseObjectConstructorAllowed(OperationMode mode)
		{
			return mode.HasFlag(OperationMode.DataOnly);
		}

		public static bool NeedConstructorSetUp(Type objType, ObjectMember member, OperationMode mode, ConstructorInfo ctor)
		{
			if (SchemaIsAvailable(objType, member, mode))
			{
				return ctor != null;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool TypeHasNonDefaultCtors(Type objType)
		{
			bool flag = objType.GetConstructor(Type.EmptyTypes) != null;
			int num = objType.GetConstructors().Length;
			return num > (flag ? 1 : 0);
		}

		public static bool CtorHasParams(ConstructorInfo ctor)
		{
			if (ctor != null)
			{
				return ctor.GetParameters().Length != 0;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	public static class FieldInfoHelper
	{
		public static void CopySelection(DevExpress.DataAccess.Excel.FieldInfo[] source, DevExpress.DataAccess.Excel.FieldInfo[] destination)
		{
			foreach (DevExpress.DataAccess.Excel.FieldInfo field in destination)
			{
				DevExpress.DataAccess.Excel.FieldInfo fieldInfo = source.FirstOrDefault((DevExpress.DataAccess.Excel.FieldInfo fi) => fi.Name == field.Name);
				if (fieldInfo != null)
				{
					field.Selected = fieldInfo.Selected;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void CopyFieldNames(DevExpress.DataAccess.Excel.FieldInfo[] source, DevExpress.DataAccess.Excel.FieldInfo[] destination)
		{
			if (source.Length == destination.Length)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < source.Length; i++)
				{
					destination[i].Name = source[i].Name;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void CopyFieldTypesByIndex(DevExpress.DataAccess.Excel.FieldInfo[] source, DevExpress.DataAccess.Excel.FieldInfo[] destination)
		{
			if (source.Length == destination.Length)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < source.Length; i++)
				{
					destination[i].Type = source[i].Type;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void CopyFieldTypesByName(DevExpress.DataAccess.Excel.FieldInfo[] source, DevExpress.DataAccess.Excel.FieldInfo[] destination)
		{
			foreach (DevExpress.DataAccess.Excel.FieldInfo field in destination)
			{
				DevExpress.DataAccess.Excel.FieldInfo fieldInfo = source.FirstOrDefault((DevExpress.DataAccess.Excel.FieldInfo fi) => fi.Name == field.Name);
				if (fieldInfo != null)
				{
					field.Type = fieldInfo.Type;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void CopyFieldInfoByOriginalName(DevExpress.DataAccess.Excel.FieldInfo[] source, DevExpress.DataAccess.Excel.FieldInfo[] destination)
		{
			foreach (DevExpress.DataAccess.Excel.FieldInfo field in destination)
			{
				DevExpress.DataAccess.Excel.FieldInfo fieldInfo = source.FirstOrDefault((DevExpress.DataAccess.Excel.FieldInfo fi) => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(fi.OriginalName) && fi.OriginalName == field.OriginalName);
				if (fieldInfo != null)
				{
					field.Name = fieldInfo.Name;
					field.Type = fieldInfo.Type;
					field.Selected = fieldInfo.Selected;
				}
			}
		}

		internal static bool GetSchemaFromFile(string fullPath, ExcelSourceOptionsBase options, IExcelSchemaProvider schemaProvider, IWaitFormActivator waitFormActivator, IExceptionHandler exceptionHandler, out DevExpress.DataAccess.Excel.FieldInfo[] schema)
		{
			schema = null;
			try
			{
				DevExpress.DataAccess.Excel.FieldInfo[] array = AsyncHelper.LoadAsync((CancellationToken token) => schemaProvider.GetSchema(fullPath, null, ExcelDocumentFormat.Csv, options, token), waitFormActivator, exceptionHandler);
				if (array == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				schema = array;
				return true;
			}
			catch (Exception innerException)
			{
				exceptionHandler.HandleException((Exception)new CantLoadExcelFileSchemaException(innerException));
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal static void MergeSchema(DevExpress.DataAccess.Excel.FieldInfo[] modelSchema, DevExpress.DataAccess.Excel.FieldInfo[] newSchema)
		{
			if (modelSchema == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (modelSchema.Any((DevExpress.DataAccess.Excel.FieldInfo s) => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(s.OriginalName)))
			{
				CopyFieldInfoByOriginalName(modelSchema, newSchema);
				return;
			}
			CopyFieldNames(modelSchema, newSchema);
			CopySelection(modelSchema, newSchema);
			if (modelSchema.Length == newSchema.Length)
			{
				CopyFieldTypesByIndex(modelSchema, newSchema);
			}
			else
			{
				CopyFieldTypesByName(modelSchema, newSchema);
			}
		}
	}
	public static class DBStoredProcedureExtensions
	{
		public static string GetDisplayName(this DBStoredProcedure sp)
		{
			return string.Format("{0}({1})", sp.Name.Trim('"').Replace("\".\"", "."), string.Join(", ", sp.Arguments.Select((DBStoredProcedureArgument arg) => ((DBNameTypePair)arg).Name)));
		}
	}
	public abstract class StoredProcInfo<T> where T : IParameter
	{
		private readonly string name;

		public string Name => name;

		public List<T> Parameters { get; private set; }

		protected StoredProcInfo(string name, List<T> parameters)
		{
			this.name = name;
			Parameters = parameters;
		}

		public abstract T CreateParameter(string name, Type type, object value);

		protected bool Equals(StoredProcInfo<T> other)
		{
			if (!string.Equals(Name, other.Name))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!object.Equals(Parameters.Count, other.Parameters.Count))
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Parameters.Count; i++)
			{
				if (((IFilterParameter)Parameters[i]).Name != ((IFilterParameter)other.Parameters[i]).Name)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (((IFilterParameter)Parameters[i]).Type != ((IFilterParameter)other.Parameters[i]).Type)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (this == obj)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (obj.GetType() != GetType())
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Equals((StoredProcInfo<T>)obj);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			if (name == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return name.GetHashCode();
		}
	}

	public static class StoredProcParametersHelper
	{
		public static void SyncParams<T>(StoredProcInfo<T> storedProcInfo, DBSchema schema) where T : IParameter
		{
			DBStoredProcedure val = schema.StoredProcedures.FirstOrDefault((DBStoredProcedure s) => s.Name == storedProcInfo.Name);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<T> list = (from p in val.Arguments
				where (int)p.Direction != 1
				select storedProcInfo.CreateParameter(((DBNameTypePair)p).Name, DBColumn.GetType(((DBNameTypePair)p).Type), null)).ToList();
			for (int num = 0; num < storedProcInfo.Parameters.Count; num++)
			{
				string paramName = ((IFilterParameter)storedProcInfo.Parameters[num]).Name;
				if (!list.Any((T p) => string.Equals(((IFilterParameter)p).Name, paramName)))
				{
					storedProcInfo.Parameters.RemoveAt(num--);
				}
			}
			foreach (T item in list)
			{
				string paramName2 = ((IFilterParameter)item).Name;
				if (!storedProcInfo.Parameters.Any((T p) => string.Equals(((IFilterParameter)p).Name, paramName2)))
				{
					storedProcInfo.Parameters.Add(item);
				}
			}
		}

		public static List<StoredProcedureViewInfo> SyncProcedures(DBSchema schema, IEnumerable<EFStoredProcedureInfo> existingProcedures)
		{
			List<StoredProcedureViewInfo> procedures = new List<StoredProcedureViewInfo>();
			if (existingProcedures != null)
			{
				procedures.AddRange(from p in existingProcedures
					where schema.StoredProcedures.Any((DBStoredProcedure n) => n.Name == p.Name)
					select new StoredProcedureViewInfo(p, isChecked: true));
			}
			procedures.AddRange(from p in schema.StoredProcedures
				where procedures.All((StoredProcedureViewInfo i) => i.StoredProcedure.Name != p.Name)
				select new StoredProcedureViewInfo(p.Name));
			foreach (StoredProcedureViewInfo item in procedures)
			{
				EFStoredProcedureInfo eFStoredProcedureInfo = item;
				SyncParams(new EFStoredProcInfo(eFStoredProcedureInfo.Name, eFStoredProcedureInfo.Parameters), schema);
			}
			return procedures;
		}
	}

	public class FederationDataSourceModel : DataSourceModelBase, IFederationDataSourceModel, IDataComponentModel, IWizardModel, ICloneable
	{
		public List<CheckItem<QueryNode>> Queries { get; }

		public QueryNode Query { get; set; }

		public List<FederationMasterDetailInfo> Relations { get; }

		public FederationDataSourceModel()
		{
			Queries = new List<CheckItem<QueryNode>>();
			Relations = new List<FederationMasterDetailInfo>();
		}

		public FederationDataSourceModel(FederationDataSourceModel other)
		{
			Queries = other.Queries.Select((CheckItem<QueryNode> x) => new CheckItem<QueryNode>((QueryNode)JoinNodeCloneAssistant.Clone(x.Value), x.Checked, x.CustomQuery)).ToList();
			Query = JoinNodeCloneAssistant.Clone(other.Query) as QueryNode;
			Relations = other.Relations.Select((FederationMasterDetailInfo x) => new FederationMasterDetailInfo(x)).ToList();
		}

		public override object Clone()
		{
			return new FederationDataSourceModel(this);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!base.Equals(obj))
			{
				return false;
			}
			FederationDataSourceModel other = obj as FederationDataSourceModel;
			if (other == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Queries.Count != other.Queries.Count || Relations.Count != other.Relations.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Relations.Where((FederationMasterDetailInfo r, int i) => !FederationMasterDetailInfo.EqualityComparer.Equals(r, other.Relations[i])).Any())
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int num = 0; num < Queries.Count; num++)
			{
				if (!new JoinNodeEqualityAssistant(Queries[num].Value).Process(other.Queries[num].Value))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return 0;
		}
	}

	public class JsonDataSourceModel : DataSourceModelWithConnectionBase, IJsonDataSourceModel, IDataComponentModelWithConnection, IDataComponentModel, IWizardModel, ICloneable
	{
		private string rootElement;

		public JsonSchemaNode JsonSchema { get; set; }

		public JsonDataConnection DataConnection { get; set; }

		public string RootElement
		{
			get
			{
				string text = rootElement;
				if (text == null)
				{
					JsonSourceBase jsonSource = JsonSource;
					if (jsonSource == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					text = jsonSource.RootElement;
				}
				return text;
			}
			set
			{
				if (JsonSource != null)
				{
					JsonSource.RootElement = value;
				}
				rootElement = value;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public JsonSourceBase JsonSource
		{
			get
			{
				return DataConnection?.GetJsonSource();
			}
			set
			{
				DataConnection = new JsonDataConnection(value);
			}
		}

		public int SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount { get; set; }

		IDataConnection IDataComponentModelWithConnection.DataConnection
		{
			get
			{
				return DataConnection;
			}
			set
			{
				DataConnection = (JsonDataConnection)value;
			}
		}

		public JsonDataSourceModel()
		{
			SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount = 100;
		}

		public JsonDataSourceModel(JsonDataSourceModel other)
			: base(other)
		{
			DataConnection = other.DataConnection;
			RootElement = other.RootElement;
			JsonSchema = other.JsonSchema?.Clone();
			SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount = other.SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount;
		}

		public override object Clone()
		{
			return new JsonDataSourceModel(this);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is JsonDataSourceModel jsonDataSourceModel && base.Equals((object)jsonDataSourceModel) && object.Equals(DataConnection, jsonDataSourceModel.DataConnection) && object.Equals(JsonSchema, jsonDataSourceModel.JsonSchema) && object.Equals(RootElement, jsonDataSourceModel.RootElement))
			{
				return object.Equals(SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount, jsonDataSourceModel.SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return 0;
		}
	}
