	public class MongoDBDataSourceModel : DataSourceModelWithConnectionBase, IMongoDBDataSourceModel, IMongoDBDataConnectionModel, IDataComponentModelWithConnection, IDataComponentModel, IWizardModel, ICloneable
	{
		public MongoDBDataConnection DataConnection { get; set; }

		public List<MongoDBQuery> Queries { get; set; } = new List<MongoDBQuery>();

		public int SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount { get; set; }

		public IEnumerable<ResultCollection> ResultSchema { get; set; }

		IDataConnection IDataComponentModelWithConnection.DataConnection
		{
			get
			{
				return DataConnection;
			}
			set
			{
				DataConnection = (MongoDBDataConnection)value;
			}
		}

		public MongoDBDataSourceModel()
		{
			SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount = 100;
		}

		public MongoDBDataSourceModel(MongoDBDataSourceModel other)
			: base(other)
		{
			if (other.DataConnection != null)
			{
				if (other.DataConnection.ConnectionParameters is MongoDBCustomConnectionParameters connectionParameters && other.DataConnection.StoreConnectionNameOnly)
				{
					DataConnection = new MongoDBDataConnection(connectionParameters)
					{
						Name = other.DataConnection.Name,
						StoreConnectionNameOnly = true
					};
				}
				else
				{
					DataConnection = new MongoDBDataConnection(other.DataConnection);
				}
			}
			if (other.Queries != null)
			{
				Queries.AddRange(other.Queries.Select((MongoDBQuery q) => q.Clone()));
			}
			SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount = other.SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount;
			ResultSchema = other.ResultSchema;
		}

		public override object Clone()
		{
			return new MongoDBDataSourceModel(this);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is MongoDBDataSourceModel mongoDBDataSourceModel))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!base.Equals((object)mongoDBDataSourceModel))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!object.Equals(DataConnection, mongoDBDataSourceModel.DataConnection))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Queries.Count != mongoDBDataSourceModel.Queries.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount != mongoDBDataSourceModel.SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Queries.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!object.Equals(Queries[i], mongoDBDataSourceModel.Queries[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return 0;
		}
	}

		public object DataSchema
		{
			get
			{
				if (DataSourceType != DataSourceType.Xpo)
				{
					if (DataSourceType != DataSourceType.Entity)
					{
						if (DataSourceType != DataSourceType.Object)
						{
							if (DataSourceType != DataSourceType.Excel)
							{
								if (DataSourceType != DataSourceType.Json)
								{
									if (DataSourceType != DataSourceType.Federation)
									{
										if (DataSourceType != DataSourceType.XPObject)
										{
											return null;
										}
										return xpObjectSourceModel.DataSchema;
									}
									return federationDataSourceModel.DataSchema;
								}
								return jsonDataSourceModel.DataSchema;
							}
							return excelDataSourceModel.DataSchema;
						}
						return objectDataSourceModel.DataSchema;
					}
					return efDataSourceModel.DataSchema;
				}
				return sqlDataSourceModel.DataSchema;
			}

		protected DataSourceModel(DataSourceModel other)
		{
			sqlDataSourceModel = new SqlDataSourceModel(other.sqlDataSourceModel);
			efDataSourceModel = new EFDataSourceModel(other.efDataSourceModel);
			objectDataSourceModel = new ObjectDataSourceModel(other.objectDataSourceModel);
			excelDataSourceModel = new ExcelDataSourceModel(other.excelDataSourceModel);
			jsonDataSourceModel = new JsonDataSourceModel(other.jsonDataSourceModel);
			mongoDBDataSourceModel = new MongoDBDataSourceModel(other.mongoDBDataSourceModel);
			xpObjectSourceModel = new XPObjectSourceModel(other.xpObjectSourceModel);
			federationDataSourceModel = new FederationDataSourceModel(other.federationDataSourceModel);

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is DataSourceModel dataSourceModel))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!string.Equals(DataSourceName, dataSourceModel.DataSourceName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (DataSourceType != dataSourceModel.DataSourceType)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (DataSourceType == DataSourceType.Xpo)
			{
				return sqlDataSourceModel.Equals(dataSourceModel.sqlDataSourceModel);
			}
			if (DataSourceType == DataSourceType.Entity)
			{
				return efDataSourceModel.Equals(dataSourceModel.efDataSourceModel);
			}
			if (DataSourceType == DataSourceType.Object)
			{
				return objectDataSourceModel.Equals(dataSourceModel.objectDataSourceModel);
			}
			if (DataSourceType == DataSourceType.Excel)
			{
				return excelDataSourceModel.Equals(dataSourceModel.excelDataSourceModel);
			}
			if (DataSourceType == DataSourceType.Json)
			{
				return jsonDataSourceModel.Equals(dataSourceModel.jsonDataSourceModel);
			}
			if (DataSourceType == DataSourceType.MongoDB)
			{
				return mongoDBDataSourceModel.Equals(dataSourceModel.mongoDBDataSourceModel);
			}
			if (DataSourceType == DataSourceType.XPObject)
			{
				return xpObjectSourceModel.Equals(dataSourceModel.xpObjectSourceModel);
			}
			return federationDataSourceModel.Equals(dataSourceModel.federationDataSourceModel);
		}

	public abstract class DataSourceModelBase
	{
		public object DataSchema { get; set; }

		private static int CompareColumnInfo(ColumnInfo columnInfo1, ColumnInfo columnInfo2)
		{
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0035: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			int num = string.CompareOrdinal(((EntityInfo<string>)(object)columnInfo1).Name, ((EntityInfo<string>)(object)columnInfo2).Name);
			if (num != 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			num = string.CompareOrdinal(((EntityInfo<string>)(object)columnInfo1).DisplayName, ((EntityInfo<string>)(object)columnInfo2).DisplayName);
			if (num != 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			if (columnInfo1.TypeSpecifics != columnInfo2.TypeSpecifics)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		private static List<ColumnInfo> GetColumnInfos(PropertyDescriptorCollection properties)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0033: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0033: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_003f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0042: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0051: Expected O, but got Unknown
			List<ColumnInfo> list = new List<ColumnInfo>();
			TypeSpecificsService val = new TypeSpecificsService();
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor property in properties)
			{
				ColumnInfo val2 = new ColumnInfo();
				((EntityInfo<string>)val2).Name = property.Name;
				((EntityInfo<string>)val2).DisplayName = property.DisplayName;
				val2.TypeSpecifics = val.GetPropertyTypeSpecifics(property);
				list.Add(val2);
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected DataSourceModelBase()
		{
		}

		protected DataSourceModelBase(DataSourceModelBase other)
		{
			DataSchema = other.CloneDataSchema();
		}

		public abstract object Clone();

		protected virtual object CloneDataSchema()
		{
			if (DataSchema is ICloneable cloneable)
			{
				return cloneable.Clone();
			}
			return DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Data.DataView.ConvertToDataView(DataSchema);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			//IL_004a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0050: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (this == obj)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!(obj is DataSourceModelBase dataSourceModelBase))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if ((DataSchema == null && dataSourceModelBase.DataSchema != null) || (DataSchema != null && dataSourceModelBase.DataSchema == null))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (DataSchema != null && dataSourceModelBase.DataSchema != null)
			{
				DataContextBase val = new DataContextBase();
				PropertyDescriptorCollection itemProperties = val[DataSchema].GetItemProperties();
				List<ColumnInfo> columnInfos = GetColumnInfos(itemProperties);
				PropertyDescriptorCollection itemProperties2 = val[dataSourceModelBase.DataSchema].GetItemProperties();
				List<ColumnInfo> columnInfos2 = GetColumnInfos(itemProperties2);
				if (columnInfos.Count != columnInfos2.Count)
				{
					return false;
				}
				columnInfos.Sort(CompareColumnInfo);
				columnInfos2.Sort(CompareColumnInfo);
				for (int i = 0; i < columnInfos.Count; i++)
				{
					if (!((object)columnInfos[i]).Equals((object)columnInfos2[i]))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return 0;
		}

		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is DataSourceModelWithConnectionBase dataSourceModelWithConnectionBase))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ConnectionName != dataSourceModelWithConnectionBase.ConnectionName)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ShouldSaveConnection != dataSourceModelWithConnectionBase.ShouldSaveConnection)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return base.Equals(obj);
		}

	public class EFDataSourceModel : DataSourceModelWithConnectionBase, IEFDataSourceModel, IDataComponentModelWithConnection, IDataComponentModel, IWizardModel, ICloneable
	{
		public string DataMember { get; set; }

		public EFDataConnection DataConnection { get; set; }

		public IEntityFrameworkModelHelper ModelHelper { get; set; }

		public EFConnectionParameters ConnectionParameters { get; set; }

		public DataConnectionLocation ConnectionStringLocation { get; set; }

		public EFStoredProcedureInfo[] StoredProceduresInfo { get; set; }

		public DBSetFilter[] Filters { get; set; }

		IDataConnection IDataComponentModelWithConnection.DataConnection
		{
			get
			{
				return DataConnection;
			}
			set
			{
				DataConnection = (EFDataConnection)value;
			}
		}

		public EFDataSourceModel()
		{
			ConnectionParameters = new EFConnectionParameters();
			ConnectionStringLocation = (DataConnectionLocation)0;
			Filters = new DBSetFilter[0];
		}

		public EFDataSourceModel(EFDataConnection connection)
		{
			InitializeModel(this, connection);
			Filters = new DBSetFilter[0];
		}

		public EFDataSourceModel(EFDataSourceModel other)
			: base(other)
		{
			//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			DataConnection = other.DataConnection;
			ConnectionParameters = other.ConnectionParameters;
			ConnectionStringLocation = other.ConnectionStringLocation;
			StoredProceduresInfo = ((other.StoredProceduresInfo != null) ? other.StoredProceduresInfo.Select((EFStoredProcedureInfo p) => new EFStoredProcedureInfo(p)).ToArray() : null);
			Filters = ((other.Filters != null && other.Filters.Length != 0) ? other.Filters.Select((DBSetFilter filter) => filter.Clone()).ToArray() : new DBSetFilter[0]);
			DataMember = other.DataMember;
			ModelHelper = other.ModelHelper;
		}

		public override object Clone()
		{
			return new EFDataSourceModel(this);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is EFDataSourceModel eFDataSourceModel))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!EFConnectionParameters.EqualityComparer.Equals(ConnectionParameters, eFDataSourceModel.ConnectionParameters))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (DataConnection != null)
			{
				if (eFDataSourceModel.DataConnection == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!EFConnectionParameters.EqualityComparer.Equals(DataConnection.ConnectionParameters, eFDataSourceModel.DataConnection.ConnectionParameters))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			else if (eFDataSourceModel.DataConnection != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!EFStoredProcedureInfo.EqualityComparer.Equals(StoredProceduresInfo, eFDataSourceModel.StoredProceduresInfo))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Filters.Length != eFDataSourceModel.Filters.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Filters.Length != 0)
			{
				DBSetFilter[] filters = Filters;
				foreach (DBSetFilter setFilter in filters)
				{
					if (!eFDataSourceModel.Filters.Any((DBSetFilter otherFilter) => DBSetFilter.EqualityComparer.Equals(setFilter, otherFilter)))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			return base.Equals(obj);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return 0;
		}

		internal static void InitializeModel(IEFDataSourceModel model, EFDataConnection connection)
		{
			model.DataConnection = connection;
			model.ConnectionName = connection.Name;
			model.ConnectionParameters = connection.CreateDataConnectionParameters();
			model.ConnectionStringLocation = (DataConnectionLocation)((model.ConnectionParameters != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(model.ConnectionParameters.ConnectionStringName)) ? 2 : 0);
		}
	}

		private bool SchemaEquals(DevExpress.DataAccess.Excel.FieldInfo[] x, DevExpress.DataAccess.Excel.FieldInfo[] y)
		{
			if (x == y)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (x == null || y == null || x.GetType() != y.GetType())
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (x.Length != y.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DevExpress.DataAccess.Excel.FieldInfo[] array = new DevExpress.DataAccess.Excel.FieldInfo[x.Length];
			Array.Copy(x, array, x.Length);
			DevExpress.DataAccess.Excel.FieldInfo[] array2 = new DevExpress.DataAccess.Excel.FieldInfo[y.Length];
			Array.Copy(y, array2, y.Length);
			FieldInfoComparer comparer = new FieldInfoComparer();
			Array.Sort(array, comparer);
			Array.Sort(array2, comparer);
			for (int i = 0; i < x.Length; i++)
			{
				if (!array[i].Equals(array2[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

	{

		internal static string GetDataSourceTypeName(DataSourceType dsType)
		{
			if (dsType == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (Object == dsType)
			{
				return "Object";
			}
			if (Entity == dsType)
			{
				return "Entity";
			}
			if (Excel == dsType)
			{
				return "Excel";
			}
			if (Xpo == dsType)
			{
				return "Xpo";
			}
			if (Json == dsType)
			{
				return "Json";
			}
			if (MongoDB == dsType)
			{
				return "MongoDB";
			}
			if (Federation == dsType)
			{
				return "Federation";
			}
			if (XPObject == dsType)
			{
				return "XPObject";
			}
			return "Unknown";
		}
	}

			: this(value, selected, customQuery, (string)null)

		{
			Value = value;

	public class ObjectDataSourceModel : DataSourceModelBase, IObjectDataSourceModel, IDataComponentModel, IWizardModel, ICloneable
	{
		public IDXAssemblyInfo Assembly { get; set; }

		public IDXTypeInfo ObjectType { get; set; }

		public ObjectMember ObjectMember { get; set; }

		public Parameter[] MemberParameters { get; set; }

		public ConstructorInfo ObjectConstructor { get; set; }

		public Parameter[] CtorParameters { get; set; }

		public ShowAllState ShowAllState { get; set; }

		internal static bool ParametersEquals(Parameter[] x, Parameter[] y)
		{
			if (x == null)
			{
				return y == null;
			}
			if (y == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = x.Length;
			if (y.Length != num)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				if (!Parameter.EqualityComparer.Equals(x[i], y[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public ObjectDataSourceModel()
		{
		}

		public ObjectDataSourceModel(ObjectDataSourceModel other)
			: base(other)
		{
			Assembly = other.Assembly;
			ObjectType = other.ObjectType;
			ObjectMember = other.ObjectMember;
			MemberParameters = ((other.MemberParameters == null) ? null : other.MemberParameters.Select((Parameter p) => new Parameter((IParameter)(object)p)).ToArray());
			ObjectConstructor = other.ObjectConstructor;
			CtorParameters = ((other.CtorParameters == null) ? null : other.CtorParameters.Select((Parameter p) => new Parameter((IParameter)(object)p)).ToArray());
			ShowAllState = other.ShowAllState;
		}

		public override object Clone()
		{
			return new ObjectDataSourceModel(this);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is ObjectDataSourceModel objectDataSourceModel))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (base.Equals(obj) && Assembly == objectDataSourceModel.Assembly && ObjectType == objectDataSourceModel.ObjectType && ObjectMember == objectDataSourceModel.ObjectMember && ParametersEquals(MemberParameters, objectDataSourceModel.MemberParameters) && (object)ObjectConstructor == objectDataSourceModel.ObjectConstructor)
			{
				return ParametersEquals(CtorParameters, objectDataSourceModel.CtorParameters);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return 0;
		}
	}

	public class SqlDataSourceModel : DataSourceModelWithConnectionBase, ISqlDataSourceModel, ISqlDataConnectionModel, IDataComponentModelWithConnection, IDataComponentModel, IWizardModel, ICloneable
	{
		private readonly List<CheckItem<SqlQuery>> queries;

		private readonly List<MasterDetailInfo> relations;

		public SqlDataConnection DataConnection { get; set; }

		public List<CheckItem<SqlQuery>> Queries => queries;

		public List<MasterDetailInfo> Relations => relations;

		public SqlQuery Query { get; set; }

		public string SqlQueryText { get; set; }

		IDataConnection IDataComponentModelWithConnection.DataConnection
		{
			get
			{
				return DataConnection;
			}
			set
			{
				DataConnection = (SqlDataConnection)value;
			}
		}

		public SqlDataSourceModel()
		{
			queries = new List<CheckItem<SqlQuery>>();
			relations = new List<MasterDetailInfo>();
		}

		public SqlDataSourceModel(SqlDataSourceModel other)
			: base(other)
		{
			queries = new List<CheckItem<SqlQuery>>(other.Queries.Select((CheckItem<SqlQuery> q) => new CheckItem<SqlQuery>(q.Value.Clone(), q.Checked, q.CustomQuery, q.Key)));
			relations = new List<MasterDetailInfo>(other.Relations.Select((MasterDetailInfo r) => new MasterDetailInfo(r)));
			DataConnection = other.DataConnection;
			Query = ((other.Query == null) ? null : other.Query.Clone());
			SqlQueryText = other.SqlQueryText;
		}

		public override object Clone()
		{
			return new SqlDataSourceModel(this);
		}

		protected override object CloneDataSchema()
		{
			if (!(base.DataSchema is DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.ResultSet resultSet))
			{
				return base.CloneDataSchema();
			}
			return resultSet.Clone();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!base.Equals(obj))
			{
				return false;
			}
			SqlDataSourceModel other = obj as SqlDataSourceModel;
			if (other == null || Queries.Count != other.Queries.Count || Relations.Count != other.Relations.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (DataConnection != other.DataConnection)
			{
				if (DataConnection != null && other.DataConnection != null && DataConnection.StoreConnectionNameOnly == other.DataConnection.StoreConnectionNameOnly && DataConnection.Factory == null && other.DataConnection.Factory == null)
				{
					ProviderFactory factory = DataConnection.Factory;
					string obj2 = ((factory != null) ? factory.ProviderKey : null);
					ProviderFactory factory2 = other.DataConnection.Factory;
					if (!(obj2 != ((factory2 != null) ? factory2.ProviderKey : null)))
					{
						goto IL_0107;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
			goto IL_0107;
			IL_0107:
			for (int i = 0; i < Queries.Count; i++)
			{
				CheckItem<SqlQuery> checkItem = Queries[i];
				CheckItem<SqlQuery> checkItem2 = other.Queries[i];
				if (checkItem.Checked != checkItem2.Checked || checkItem.CustomQuery != checkItem2.CustomQuery || !SqlQuery.EqualityComparer.Equals(checkItem.Value, checkItem2.Value))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (Relations.Where((MasterDetailInfo t, int index) => !MasterDetailInfo.EqualityComparer.Equals(t, other.Relations[index])).Any())
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (SqlQuery.EqualityComparer.Equals(Query, other.Query) && string.Equals(SqlQueryText, other.SqlQueryText))
			{
				return DataConnectionParametersComparer.Equals(DataConnection, other.DataConnection);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return 0;
		}
	}

	[TypeConverter(typeof(EnumTypeConverter))]
	[ResourceFinder(typeof(ResFinder))]
	public enum CsvNewlineType
	{
		CRLF,
		LF,
		CR,
		LFCR,
		VT,
		FF
	}
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.Excel.ExcelDataSource.CsvSourceOptions")]
	public class CsvSourceOptions : ExcelSourceOptionsBase
	{
		public class EncodingConverter : TypeConverter
		{
			private static readonly StandardValuesCollection standardValuesCollection;

			static EncodingConverter()
			{
				EncodingInfo[] array = (from e in DXEncoding.GetEncodings()
					orderby e.DisplayName
					select e).ToArray();
				List<Encoding> list = new List<Encoding>(array.Length);
				list.AddRange(array.Select((EncodingInfo t) => t.GetEncoding()));
				standardValuesCollection = new StandardValuesCollection(list);
			}

			public override StandardValuesCollection GetStandardValues(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
			{
				return standardValuesCollection;
			}

			public override bool GetStandardValuesSupported(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
			{
				return true;
			}

			public override bool GetStandardValuesExclusive(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
			{
				return true;
			}

			public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
			{
				if (sourceType == typeof(string))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
			}

			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(string) && value != null)
				{
					return ((Encoding)value).EncodingName;
				}
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}

			public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
			{
				if (value == null || value.GetType() != typeof(string))
				{
					return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
				}
				EncodingInfo[] encodings = DXEncoding.GetEncodings();
				int num = encodings.Length;
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					Encoding encoding = encodings[i].GetEncoding();
					if (string.Compare(encoding.EncodingName, (string)value, ignoreCase: true) == 0)
					{
						return encoding;
					}
				}
				return DXEncoding.Default;
			}
		}

		private const string xml_CellRange = "CellRange";

		private const string xml_ValueSeparator = "ValueSeparator";

		public CsvSourceOptions()
		{
			ValueSeparator = ',';
			NewlineType = CsvNewlineType.CRLF;
			DetectEncoding = true;
			TextQualifier = '"';
			TrimBlanks = true;
			Culture = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;
		}

		private CsvSourceOptions(CsvSourceOptions other)
			: base(other)
		{
			CellRange = other.CellRange;
			Culture = other.Culture;
			DetectEncoding = other.DetectEncoding;
			DetectNewlineType = other.DetectNewlineType;
			DetectValueSeparator = other.DetectValueSeparator;
			Encoding = other.Encoding;
			NewlineType = other.NewlineType;
			TextQualifier = other.TextQualifier;
			TrimBlanks = other.TrimBlanks;
			ValueSeparator = other.ValueSeparator;
		}

		protected internal override ExcelSourceOptionsBase Clone()
		{
			return new CsvSourceOptions(this);
		}

		protected internal override SpreadsheetSourceOptions GetSpreadsheetSourceOptions()
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0005: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0035: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0041: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0059: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0065: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0072: Expected O, but got Unknown
			return (SpreadsheetSourceOptions)new CsvSpreadsheetSourceOptions
			{
				Culture = Culture,
				DetectEncoding = DetectEncoding,
				DetectNewlineType = DetectNewlineType,
				DetectValueSeparator = DetectValueSeparator,
				Encoding = Encoding,
				NewlineType = (CsvNewlineType)NewlineType,
				TextQualifier = TextQualifier,
				TrimBlanks = TrimBlanks,
				ValueSeparator = ValueSeparator
			};
		}

		protected internal override ISpreadsheetDataReader CreateReader(ISpreadsheetSource source)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(CellRange))
			{
				return source.GetDataReader(source.Worksheets[0], XlCellRange.Parse(CellRange));
			}
			return source.GetDataReader(source.Worksheets[0]);
		}

		private bool Equals(CsvSourceOptions other)
		{
			if (CellRange == other.CellRange && object.Equals(Culture, other.Culture) && DetectEncoding == other.DetectEncoding && DetectNewlineType == other.DetectNewlineType && DetectValueSeparator == other.DetectValueSeparator && object.Equals(Encoding, other.Encoding) && NewlineType == other.NewlineType && TextQualifier == other.TextQualifier && TrimBlanks == other.TrimBlanks)
			{
				return ValueSeparator == other.ValueSeparator;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override void SaveToXml(XElement options)
		{
			base.SaveToXml(options);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(CellRange))
			{
				options.Add(new XAttribute("CellRange", CellRange));
			}
			options.Add(new XAttribute("DetectEncoding", DetectEncoding));
			options.Add(new XAttribute("DetectNewlineType", DetectNewlineType));
			options.Add(new XAttribute("DetectValueSeparator", DetectValueSeparator));
			options.Add(new XAttribute("NewlineType", NewlineType));
			options.Add(new XAttribute("TrimBlanks", TrimBlanks));
			options.Add(new XAttribute("TextQualifier", TextQualifier));
			options.Add(new XAttribute("ValueSeparator", ValueSeparator));
			if (Encoding != null)
			{
				options.Add(new XAttribute("EncodingName", Encoding.WebName));
			}
			if (Culture != null)
			{
				options.Add(new XAttribute("CultureName", Culture.Name));
			}
		}

		protected internal override void LoadFromXml(XElement options)
		{
			base.LoadFromXml(options);
			CellRange = options.GetAttributeValue("CellRange");
			DetectEncoding = Convert.ToBoolean(options.GetAttributeValue("DetectEncoding"));
			DetectNewlineType = Convert.ToBoolean(options.GetAttributeValue("DetectNewlineType"));
			DetectValueSeparator = Convert.ToBoolean(options.GetAttributeValue("DetectValueSeparator"));
			NewlineType = (CsvNewlineType)Enum.Parse(typeof(CsvNewlineType), options.GetAttributeValue("NewlineType"));
			TrimBlanks = Convert.ToBoolean(options.GetAttributeValue("TrimBlanks"));
			TextQualifier = Convert.ToChar(options.GetAttributeValue("TextQualifier"));
			ValueSeparator = Convert.ToChar(options.GetAttributeValue("ValueSeparator"));
			string attributeValue = options.GetAttributeValue("EncodingName");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(attributeValue))
			{
				Encoding = Encoding.GetEncoding(attributeValue);
			}
			string attributeValue2 = options.GetAttributeValue("CultureName");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(attributeValue2))
			{
				Culture = new CultureInfo(attributeValue2);
			}
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!base.Equals(obj))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (obj is CsvSourceOptions other)
			{
				return Equals(other);
			}
			return false;

	public class ExcelSchemaProvider : IExcelSchemaProvider
	{
		private const int testRowCount = 10;

		private const string columnBaseName = "Column";

		public virtual int TestRowCount => 10;

		public virtual string ColumnBaseName => "Column";

		public FieldInfo[] GetSchema(string fileName, Stream stream, ExcelDocumentFormat format, ExcelSourceOptionsBase optionsBase, CancellationToken token)
		{
			//IL_0083: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_019a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ISpreadsheetSource val = ExcelDataLoaderHelper.CreateSource(stream, format, fileName, optionsBase);
			try
			{
				int num = TestRowCount;
				int num2 = (optionsBase.UseFirstRowAsHeader ? (num + 1) : num);
				int columnCount = ExcelDataLoaderHelper.GetColumnCount(val, num2, optionsBase);
				ISpreadsheetDataReader val2 = val.CreateReader(optionsBase);
				List<FieldInfo> schema = new List<FieldInfo>(columnCount);
				Predicate<string> exist = (string s) => schema.Any((FieldInfo fi) => string.Equals(fi.Name, s, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase));
				if (optionsBase.UseFirstRowAsHeader)
				{
					val2.Read();
					for (int num3 = 0; num3 < val2.FieldsCount; num3++)
					{
						token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
						string text = (((int)val2.GetFieldType(num3) != 0) ? val2.GetDisplayText(num3, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) : null);
						schema.Add(new FieldInfo
						{
							Name = ((!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text)) ? NameGenerator.GenerateUniqueName(text, (string s) => exist(s)) : ExcelDataLoaderHelper.GetFieldName(exist, ColumnBaseName + (num3 + 1))),
							Type = null
						});
					}
				}
				for (int num4 = schema.Count; num4 < columnCount; num4++)
				{
					schema.Add(new FieldInfo
					{
						Name = ExcelDataLoaderHelper.GetFieldName(exist, ColumnBaseName + (num4 + 1)),
						Type = null
					});
				}
				int num5 = num;
				while (val2.Read() && num5 > 0)
				{
					for (int num6 = 0; num6 < val2.FieldsCount; num6++)
					{
						token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
						Type type = ExcelDataLoaderHelper.GetType(val2.GetFieldType(num6));
						schema[num6].Type = ((type == null) ? schema[num6].Type : ((schema[num6].Type == null) ? type : ((type == schema[num6].Type) ? type : typeof(string))));
					}
					num5--;
				}
				foreach (FieldInfo item in schema.Where((FieldInfo field) => field.Type == null))
				{
					item.Type = typeof(string);
				}
				token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
				foreach (FieldInfo item2 in schema)
				{
					item2.OriginalName = item2.Name;
				}
				return schema.ToArray();
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
		}
	}
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.Excel.ExcelSourceOptions.ExcelWorksheetSettings")]
	public sealed class ExcelWorksheetSettings : ExcelSettingsBase
	{
		private const string xml_WorksheetName = "WorksheetName";

		private const string xml_WorksheetIndex = "WorksheetIndex";

		private const string xml_CellRange = "CellRange";

		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.Excel.ExcelWorksheetSettings.WorksheetName")]
		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.Excel.ExcelWorksheetSettings.WorksheetName")]
		public string WorksheetName { get; set; }

		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.Excel.ExcelWorksheetSettings.WorksheetIndex")]
		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.Excel.ExcelWorksheetSettings.WorksheetIndex")]

		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.Excel.ExcelWorksheetSettings.CellRange")]
		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.Excel.ExcelWorksheetSettings.CellRange")]
		public string CellRange { get; set; }

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public ExcelWorksheetSettings()
		{
		}

		public ExcelWorksheetSettings(int worksheetIndex)
			: this(worksheetIndex, null)
		{
		}

		public ExcelWorksheetSettings(int worksheetIndex, string cellRange)
		{
			WorksheetIndex = worksheetIndex;
			CellRange = cellRange;
		}

		public ExcelWorksheetSettings(string worksheetName)
			: this(worksheetName, null)
		{
		}

		public ExcelWorksheetSettings(string worksheetName, string cellRange)
		{
			WorksheetName = worksheetName;
			CellRange = cellRange;
		}

		private bool Equals(ExcelWorksheetSettings other)
		{
			if (string.Equals(WorksheetName, other.WorksheetName))
			{
				return string.Equals(CellRange, other.CellRange);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is ExcelWorksheetSettings other)
			{
				return Equals(other);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return 0;
		}

		protected internal override ISpreadsheetDataReader CreateReader(ISpreadsheetSource source)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(WorksheetName) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(CellRange))
			{
				return source.GetDataReader(GetSourceWorksheet(source, WorksheetName), XlCellRange.Parse(CellRange));
			}
			if (WorksheetIndex.HasValue && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(CellRange))
			{
				return source.GetDataReader(GetSourceWorksheet(source, WorksheetIndex.Value), XlCellRange.Parse(CellRange));
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(CellRange))
			{
				return source.GetDataReader(XlCellRange.Parse(CellRange));
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(WorksheetName) && WorksheetIndex.HasValue)
			{
				return source.GetDataReader(GetSourceWorksheet(source, WorksheetIndex.Value));
			}
			return source.GetDataReader(GetSourceWorksheet(source, WorksheetName));
		}

		private static IWorksheet GetSourceWorksheet(ISpreadsheetSource source, string worksheetName)
		{
			IWorksheet val = ((IEnumerable<IWorksheet>)source.Worksheets).FirstOrDefault((IWorksheet s) => s.Name == worksheetName);
			if (val == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidWorksheetNameValidationException(worksheetName);
			}
			return val;
		}

		private static IWorksheet GetSourceWorksheet(ISpreadsheetSource source, int worksheetIndex)
		{
			if (worksheetIndex < 0 || worksheetIndex >= ((ICollection)source.Worksheets).Count)
			{
				throw new InvalidWorksheetIndexValidationException(worksheetIndex);
			}
			return source.Worksheets[worksheetIndex];
		}

		protected internal override void SaveToXml(XElement worksheetSettings)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)worksheetSettings, "worksheetSettings");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(WorksheetName))
			{
				worksheetSettings.Add(new XAttribute("WorksheetName", WorksheetName));
			}
			if (WorksheetIndex.HasValue)
			{
				worksheetSettings.Add(new XAttribute("WorksheetIndex", WorksheetIndex));
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(CellRange))
			{
				worksheetSettings.Add(new XAttribute("CellRange", CellRange));
			}
		}

		protected internal override void LoadFromXml(XElement worksheetSettings)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)worksheetSettings, "cellRangeSettings");
			WorksheetName = worksheetSettings.GetAttributeValue("WorksheetName");
			if (int.TryParse(worksheetSettings.GetAttributeValue("WorksheetIndex"), out var result))
			{
				WorksheetIndex = result;
			}
			CellRange = worksheetSettings.GetAttributeValue("CellRange");
		}

		protected internal override ExcelSettingsBase Clone()
		{
			return new ExcelWorksheetSettings(WorksheetName, CellRange)
			{
				WorksheetIndex = WorksheetIndex
			};
		}
	}

	public class FieldInfoList : List<FieldInfo>
	{
		private const string xml_FieldInfo = "FieldInfo";

		public FieldInfoList()
		{
		}

		public FieldInfoList(IEnumerable<FieldInfo> collection)
			: base(collection)
		{
		}

		public void AddRange(FieldInfo[] collection)
		{
			AddRange((IEnumerable<FieldInfo>)collection);
		}

		internal void SaveToXml(XElement fieldInfoList)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)fieldInfoList, "fieldInfoList");
			using Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				FieldInfo current = enumerator.Current;
				XElement xElement = new XElement("FieldInfo");
				current.SaveToXml(xElement);
				fieldInfoList.Add(xElement);
			}
		}

		internal void LoadFromXml(XElement fieldInfoList)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)fieldInfoList, "fieldInfoList");
			foreach (XElement item in fieldInfoList.Elements("FieldInfo"))
			{
				FieldInfo fieldInfo = new FieldInfo();
				fieldInfo.LoadFromXml(item);
				Add(fieldInfo);
			}
		}
	}

				{
					ExcelSourceOptions excelSourceOptions = (ExcelSourceOptions)component;
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(excelSourceOptions.Password))

						return string.Empty;

					return base.GetValue(component);
				}
			}

			protected override PropertyDescriptor ProcessProperty(PropertyDescriptor property)
			{
				if (property.Name == "Password")
				{
					return new PasswordPropertyDescriptor(property);

				return property;
			}
		}

		public ExcelDataSource()
		{
			Schema = new FieldInfoList();
			result = new DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Excel.DataView(this, ColumnarData.Empty);
			((IServiceContainer)this).AddService(typeof(IExcelSchemaProvider), (object)new ExcelSchemaProvider());
			((IServiceContainer)this).AddService(typeof(IDataDirectoryPatchingService), (object)new RuntimeDataDirectoryPatchingService());
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeSourceOptions()
		{
			return !SourceOptions.IsDefault;
		}

		public void RebuildResultSchema()
		{
			RebuildResultSchemaCore(CancellationToken.None);
		}

		internal Task RebuildResultSchemaAsync()
		{
			return RebuildResultSchemaAsync(CancellationToken.None);
		}

		internal Task RebuildResultSchemaAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			return Task.Factory.StartNew(delegate
			{
				RebuildResultSchemaCore(cancellationToken);
			}, cancellationToken);
		}

		private void RebuildResultSchemaCore(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			FieldInfoList fieldInfoList = new FieldInfoList();
			if (Schema.Count == 0)
			{
				BeforeFillEventArgs actualArgs = GetActualArgs(cancellationToken);
				if (!CanFill(actualArgs))
				{
					return;
				}
				FieldInfo[] collection = LoadSchema(actualArgs, cancellationToken);
				fieldInfoList.AddRange(collection);
			}
			else
			{
				fieldInfoList.AddRange(Schema);
			}
			cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
			result.SetColumns(new ColumnarData(new IList[fieldInfoList.Count((FieldInfo s) => s.Selected)], (from s in fieldInfoList
				where s.Selected
				select new ColumnDescription
				{
					Name = s.Name,
					Type = s.Type
				}).ToArray()));
		}

		public void Fill()
		{
			Fill(null);
		}

		public override void Fill(IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters)
		{
			((IListAdapter)this).FillList((IServiceProvider)null);
		}

		public Task FillAsync()
		{
			return FillAsync(CancellationToken.None);
		}

		public Task FillAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			return Task<ColumnarData>.Factory.StartNew(() => FillCoreInternal(cancellationToken), cancellationToken, TaskCreationOptions.None, TaskScheduler.Default).ContinueWith(delegate(Task<ColumnarData> data)
			{
				result.SetColumns(data.Result);
			}, cancellationToken, TaskContinuationOptions.None, (SynchronizationContext.Current != null) ? TaskScheduler.FromCurrentSynchronizationContext() : TaskScheduler.Default);
		}

		Task ISupportFillAsync.FillAsync(IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			return FillAsync(CancellationToken.None);
		}

		protected virtual void FillCore(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			ColumnarData columns = FillCoreInternal(cancellationToken);
			result.SetColumns(columns);
		}

		internal Task<ColumnarData> FillCoreAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			return Task.Factory.StartNew(() => FillCoreInternal(cancellationToken), cancellationToken);
		}

		protected ColumnarData FillCoreInternal(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			BeforeFillEventArgs actualArgs = GetActualArgs(cancellationToken);
			if (!CanFill(actualArgs))
			{
				return ColumnarData.Empty;
			}
			cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
			FieldInfo[] actualSchema = GetActualSchema(actualArgs, cancellationToken);
			string text = SafePathHelper.Instance.FixAndValidatePath(actualArgs.FileName, UrlResolver, ServiceProviderExtensions.GetService<IDataDirectoryPatchingService>((IServiceProvider)this), AccessSettings.DataResources);
			ISpreadsheetSource val = ExcelDataLoaderHelper.CreateSource(actualArgs.Stream, actualArgs.StreamDocumentFormat, text, actualArgs.SourceOptions);
			try
			{
				ExcelDataLoaderHelper.PrepareSource(val, actualSchema);
				return ExcelDataLoaderHelper.LoadData(val, actualSchema, actualArgs.SourceOptions, topThousand: false, cancellationToken) ?? ColumnarData.Empty;
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		protected void ExecuteReader(Action<ISpreadsheetDataReader, ExcelSourceOptionsBase, FieldInfo[], CancellationToken> action, CancellationToken cancellationToken, Action onEmpty = null)
		{
			BeforeFillEventArgs actualArgs = GetActualArgs(cancellationToken);
			if (!CanFill(actualArgs))
			{
				onEmpty?.Invoke();
				return;
			}
			cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
			FieldInfo[] actualSchema = GetActualSchema(actualArgs, cancellationToken);
			string text = SafePathHelper.Instance.FixAndValidatePath(actualArgs.FileName, UrlResolver, ServiceProviderExtensions.GetService<IDataDirectoryPatchingService>((IServiceProvider)this), AccessSettings.DataResources);
			ISpreadsheetSource val = ExcelDataLoaderHelper.CreateSource(actualArgs.Stream, actualArgs.StreamDocumentFormat, text, actualArgs.SourceOptions);
			try
			{
				ExcelDataLoaderHelper.PrepareSource(val, actualSchema);
				ISpreadsheetDataReader arg = val.CreateReader(actualArgs.SourceOptions);
				action(arg, actualArgs.SourceOptions, actualSchema, cancellationToken);
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private BeforeFillEventArgs GetActualArgs(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
			BeforeFillEventArgs e = this.CreateBeforeFillArgs();
			RaiseBeforeFill(e);
			IExcelOptionsCustomizationService excelOptionsCustomizationService = (IExcelOptionsCustomizationService)GetService(typeof(IExcelOptionsCustomizationService));
			if (excelOptionsCustomizationService != null)
			{
				excelOptionsCustomizationService.Customize(e);
				FileNameInternal = e.FileName;
				if (SourceOptions is ExcelSourceOptions excelSourceOptions && e.SourceOptions is ExcelSourceOptions excelSourceOptions2)
				{
					excelSourceOptions.PasswordInternal.Password = excelSourceOptions2.Password;
				}
			}
			cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
			return e;
		}

		private void ValidateSchema(FieldInfo[] schema)
		{
			foreach (FieldInfo fieldInfo in schema)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(fieldInfo.Name))
				{
					throw new NameIsNullOrEmptyValidationException();
				}
				if (fieldInfo.Type == null)
				{
					throw new TypeIsNullValidationException();
				}
				if (Schema.Any((FieldInfo fi) => fi != fieldInfo && fi.Name == fieldInfo.Name))
				{
					throw new DuplicateNameValidationException(fieldInfo.Name);
				}
			}
		}

		private FieldInfo[] GetActualSchema(BeforeFillEventArgs beforeFillEventArgs, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (Schema.Count > 0)
			{
				FieldInfo[] schema = Schema.ToArray();
				ValidateSchema(schema);
				return schema;
			}
			return LoadSchema(beforeFillEventArgs, cancellationToken);
		}

		private FieldInfo[] LoadSchema(BeforeFillEventArgs beforeFillEventArgs, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			IExcelSchemaProvider excelSchemaProvider = (IExcelSchemaProvider)GetService(typeof(IExcelSchemaProvider));
			if (excelSchemaProvider == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("No IExcelSchemaProvider found");
			}
			Stream stream = beforeFillEventArgs.Stream;
			long offset = 0L;
			bool flag = stream != null;
			if (flag && !beforeFillEventArgs.Stream.CanSeek)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("We cannot use non-seakable stream. Provide ExcelDataSource.Schema or seakable stream.");
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				offset = stream.Position;
			}
			string text = SafePathHelper.Instance.FixAndValidatePath(beforeFillEventArgs.FileName, UrlResolver, ServiceProviderExtensions.GetService<IDataDirectoryPatchingService>((IServiceProvider)this), AccessSettings.DataResources);
			FieldInfo[] array = excelSchemaProvider.GetSchema(text, beforeFillEventArgs.Stream, beforeFillEventArgs.StreamDocumentFormat, beforeFillEventArgs.SourceOptions, cancellationToken).ToArray();
			if (flag)
			{
				stream.Seek(offset, SeekOrigin.Begin);
			}
			return array;
		}

		private void RaiseBeforeFill(BeforeFillEventArgs args)
		{
			if (this.BeforeFill != null)
			{
				this.BeforeFill(this, args);
			}
		}

		private bool CanFill(BeforeFillEventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			if (eventArgs.Stream != null || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(eventArgs.FileName))
			{
				return eventArgs.SourceOptions != null;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void SetResultSchemaXml(XElement xml)
		{
			if (xml != null)
			{
				XElement element = xml.Element("View") ?? xml;
				ViewDescriptor viewDescriptor = ViewDescriptor.LoadFromXml(element);
				viewDescriptor.FillDataView(result);
			}
		}

		internal void SetResultSchema(DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Data.DataView schema)
		{
			IEnumerable<PropertyDescriptor> source = schema.ColumnDescriptors.Cast<PropertyDescriptor>();
			SetResultSchema(new DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Excel.DataView(this, new ColumnarData(new IList[schema.ColumnDescriptors.Count], source.Select((PropertyDescriptor p) => new ColumnDescription
			{
				Name = p.Name,
				Type = p.PropertyType
			}).ToArray())));
		}

		internal void SetResultSchema(DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Excel.DataView schema)
		{
			result.SetColumns(new ColumnarData(new IList[schema.Columns.Count], schema.Columns.Select((ViewColumn column) => new ColumnDescription
			{
				Name = column.Name,
				Type = column.PropertyType
			}).ToArray()));
		}

		public override XElement SaveToXml()
		{
			return ExcelDataSourceSerializer.SaveToXml(this);
		}

		public override void LoadFromXml(XElement xElement)
		{
			Reset();
			ExcelDataSourceSerializer.LoadFromXml(this, xElement);
		}

		internal XElement GetResultSchemaXml()
		{
			return ResultSchema.SaveToXml();
		}

		protected override string GetDataMember()
		{
			return string.Empty;
		}

		private void Reset()
		{
			Name = null;
			FileName = null;
			SourceOptions = null;
			Schema.Clear();
		}

		IList IListSource.GetList()
		{
			return result;
		}

		void IListAdapter.FillList(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
		{
			ReplaceServiceFromProvider(typeof(IExcelSchemaProvider), serviceProvider);
			ReplaceServiceFromProvider(typeof(IDataDirectoryPatchingService), serviceProvider);
			ReplaceServiceFromProvider(typeof(UrlResolver), serviceProvider);
			FillCore(CancellationToken.None);
		}

		async Task IListAdapterAsync.FillAsync(IServiceProvider serviceProvider, CancellationToken token)
		{
			if (!fillListSemaphore.WaitOne(300))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Data source is busy");
			}
			try
			{
				ColumnarData columns = await FillCoreAsync(serviceProvider, token).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				result.SetColumns(columns);
			}
			catch (OperationCanceledException)
			{
			}
			finally
			{
				fillListSemaphore.Release();
			}
		}

		private Task<ColumnarData> FillCoreAsync(IServiceProvider serviceProvider, CancellationToken token)
		{
			ReplaceServiceFromProvider(typeof(IExcelSchemaProvider), serviceProvider);
			ReplaceServiceFromProvider(typeof(IDataDirectoryPatchingService), serviceProvider);
			return FillCoreAsync(token);
		}

		IAsyncResult IListAdapterAsync.BeginFillList(IServiceProvider serviceProvider, CancellationToken token)
		{
			if (!fillListSemaphore.WaitOne(300))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Data source is busy");
			}
			return FillCoreAsync(serviceProvider, token);
		}

		void IListAdapterAsync.EndFillList(IAsyncResult result, CancellationToken token)
		{
			Task<ColumnarData> task = (Task<ColumnarData>)result;
			try
			{
				task.Wait(token);
				this.result.SetColumns(task.Result);
			}
			catch (OperationCanceledException)
			{
			}
			catch (AggregateException ex2)
			{
				if (task.IsFaulted)
				{
					throw ExceptionHelper.Unwrap(ex2);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				fillListSemaphore.Release();
			}
		}
	}
	public sealed class FieldInfo
	{
		private const string xml_Name = "Name";

		private const string xml_OriginalName = "OriginalName";

		private const string xml_Type = "Type";

		private const string xml_Selected = "Selected";

		public string Name { get; set; }

		public string OriginalName { get; set; }

		public Type Type { get; set; }

		[DefaultValue(true)]
		public bool Selected { get; set; }

		public FieldInfo()
		{
			Selected = true;
			Type = typeof(string);
		}

		public FieldInfo(FieldInfo other)
		{
			Name = other.Name;
			OriginalName = other.OriginalName;
			Type = other.Type;
			Selected = other.Selected;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object other)
		{
			if (!(other is FieldInfo fieldInfo))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (string.Equals(Name, fieldInfo.Name) && Type == fieldInfo.Type)
			{
				return Selected == fieldInfo.Selected;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return 0;
		}

		internal void SaveToXml(XElement fieldInfo)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)fieldInfo, "fieldInfo");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Name))
			{
				fieldInfo.Add(new XAttribute("Name", Name));
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(OriginalName))
			{
				fieldInfo.Add(new XAttribute("OriginalName", OriginalName));
			}
			if (Type != null)
			{
				fieldInfo.Add(new XAttribute("Type", Type.FullName));
			}
			fieldInfo.Add(new XAttribute("Selected", Selected));
		}

		internal void LoadFromXml(XElement fieldInfo)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)fieldInfo, "fieldInfo");
			Name = fieldInfo.GetAttributeValue("Name");
			OriginalName = fieldInfo.GetAttributeValue("OriginalName");
			Type = SafeTypeResolver.GetPrimitiveOrTrustedType(fieldInfo.GetAttributeValue("Type"), (IDictionary<string, Type>)null, (bool?)null);
			Selected = bool.Parse(fieldInfo.GetAttributeValue("Selected"));
		}
	}
	public interface IExcelSchemaProvider
	{
		FieldInfo[] GetSchema(string fileName, Stream stream, ExcelDocumentFormat streamDocumentFormat, ExcelSourceOptionsBase optionsBase, CancellationToken token);
	}
	public abstract class SchemaValidationException : Exception
	{
		protected SchemaValidationException(string message)
			: base(message)
		{
		}
	}
	public class NameIsNullOrEmptyValidationException : SchemaValidationException
	{
		public NameIsNullOrEmptyValidationException()
			: base("FieldInfo's Name should not be null or empty")
		{
		}
	}
	public class DuplicateNameValidationException : SchemaValidationException
	{
		public string Name { get; private set; }

		public DuplicateNameValidationException(string name)
			: base("There should not be two fieldInfo with the same Name")
		{
			Name = name;
		}
	}
	public class TypeIsNullValidationException : SchemaValidationException
	{
		public TypeIsNullValidationException()
			: base("FieldInfo's Type should not be null")
		{
		}
	}
}
namespace DevExpress.DataAccess.EntityFramework

	public class DBSetFilter : ICloneable
	{
		internal class EqualityComparer : IEqualityComparer<DBSetFilter>
		{
			public static bool Equals(DBSetFilter x, DBSetFilter y)
			{
				if (x == null && y == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (x == null || y == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!string.Equals(x.DBSetName, y.DBSetName))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!string.Equals(x.FilterString, y.FilterString))
				{
					return false;
				}
				int count = x.parameters.Count;
				if (y.parameters.Count != count)
				{
					return false;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					EFParameter x2 = x.parameters[i];
					EFParameter y2 = y.parameters[i];
					if (!DataSourceParameterBase.BaseEqualityComparer.Equals((IParameter)(object)x2, (IParameter)(object)y2))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}

			bool IEqualityComparer<DBSetFilter>.Equals(DBSetFilter x, DBSetFilter y)
			{
				return Equals(x, y);
			}

			int IEqualityComparer<DBSetFilter>.GetHashCode(DBSetFilter obj)
			{
				return 0;
			}
		}

		internal const string XML_DBSetFilter = "DBSetFilter";

		internal const string XML_DBSetName = "DBSetName";

		internal const string XML_FilterString = "FilterString";

		internal const string XML_Parameters = "Parameters";

		private readonly EFParameterCollection parameters = new EFParameterCollection();

		[Browsable(false)]
		public CriteriaOperator CriteriaOperator { get; set; }

		[Browsable(false)]
		public string DBSetName { get; set; }

		[Browsable(false)]
		public string FilterString { get; set; }

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(EFParameterCollectionTypeConverter))]
		[Editor("DevExpress.DataAccess.UI.Native.EntityFramework.EFFilterParametersEditor, DevExpress.DataAccess.v23.2.UI, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.EntityFramework.DBSetFilter.Parameters")]
		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.EntityFramework.DBSetFilter.Parameters")]
		public EFParameterCollection Parameters => parameters;

		internal EFFiltersCollection Owner { get; set; }

		public DBSetFilter()
		{
		}

		public DBSetFilter(string dbSetName, string filterString)
			: this(dbSetName, filterString, null)
		{
		}

		public DBSetFilter(string dbSetName, string filterString, IEnumerable<EFParameter> parameters)
		{
			DBSetName = dbSetName;
			FilterString = filterString;
			if (parameters != null)
			{
				Parameters.AddRange(parameters);
			}
		}

		public XElement SaveToXml()
		{
			return SaveToXml(null, null);
		}

		internal XElement SaveToXml(ISerializableTypesCollector collector, IExtensionsProvider extensionsProvider)
		{
			XElement xElement = new XElement("DBSetFilter");
			xElement.Add(new XAttribute("DBSetName", DBSetName));
			xElement.Add(new XAttribute("FilterString", FilterString));
			if (Parameters.Count > 0)
			{
				XElement xElement2 = new XElement("Parameters");
				foreach (EFParameter parameter in Parameters)
				{
					xElement2.Add(ParameterSerializer.SerializeParameter(extensionsProvider, parameter, collector));
				}
				xElement.Add(xElement2);
			}
			return xElement;
		}

		public void LoadFromXml(XElement filter)
		{
			LoadFromXml(filter, null);
		}

		public void LoadFromXml(XElement filter, IExtensionsProvider extensionsProvider)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)filter, "filter");
			DBSetName = filter.GetAttributeValue("DBSetName");
			FilterString = filter.GetAttributeValue("FilterString");
			XElement xElement = filter.Element("Parameters");
			if (xElement == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (XElement item in xElement.Elements())
			{
				EFParameter eFParameter = new EFParameter();
				eFParameter.LoadFromXMl(item, extensionsProvider);
				Parameters.Add(eFParameter);
			}
		}

		internal DBSetFilter Clone()
		{
			DBSetFilter dBSetFilter = new DBSetFilter(DBSetName, FilterString);
			dBSetFilter.Parameters.AddRange(Parameters.Select((EFParameter p) => new EFParameter((IParameter)(object)p)));
			return dBSetFilter;
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}
	}

		internal class EqualityComparer : IEqualityComparer<EFConnectionParameters>
		{
			public static bool Equals(EFConnectionParameters x, EFConnectionParameters y)
			{
				if (x == y)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (x == null || y == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!string.Equals(x.ConnectionString, y.ConnectionString))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!string.Equals(x.ConnectionStringName, y.ConnectionStringName))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!string.Equals(x.CustomContextName, y.CustomContextName))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!string.Equals(x.CustomAssemblyPath, y.CustomAssemblyPath))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (x.source == y.source)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (x.source == null)
				{
					return CompareSource(y.source, x.CustomContextName);
				}
				if (y.source == null)
				{
					return CompareSource(x.source, y.CustomContextName);
				}
				return false;
			}

			private static bool CompareSource(Type source, string context)
			{
				return string.Equals(source.FullName, context);
			}

			bool IEqualityComparer<EFConnectionParameters>.Equals(EFConnectionParameters x, EFConnectionParameters y)
			{
				return Equals(x, y);
			}

			int IEqualityComparer<EFConnectionParameters>.GetHashCode(EFConnectionParameters obj)
			{
				return 0;
			}
		}

		internal MethodInfo[] SourceMethods
		{
			get
			{
				if (ConnectionParameters == null || ConnectionParameters.Source == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				MethodInfo[] methods = ConnectionParameters.Source.GetMethods(BindingFlags.DeclaredOnly | BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public);
				return methods.Where((MethodInfo m) => !m.IsSpecialName && m.ReturnType.GetInterfaces().Any((Type i) => i == typeof(IEnumerable))).ToArray();
			}
		}

		private static DBTable CreateDbTable(string name, Type enumerableType, bool isView)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			DBTable val = new DBTable(name)
			{
				IsView = isView
			};
			Type itemType = ObjectDataSourceFillHelper.GetItemType(enumerableType);
			val.Columns.AddRange(((IEnumerable<PropertyInfo>)itemType.GetProperties(BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public)).Select((Func<PropertyInfo, DBColumn>)((PropertyInfo a) => new DBColumn
			{
				Name = a.Name,
				ColumnType = DBColumn.GetColumnType(TypeHelper.ExpandNullable(a.PropertyType), true)
			})));
			return val;
		}

		private static DBTable CreateDbTable(IEntitySetInfo es)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			DBTable val = new DBTable(es.Name);
			val.Columns.AddRange(((IEntityProperties)es.ElementType).AllProperties.Select((Func<IEdmPropertyInfo, DBColumn>)((IEdmPropertyInfo a) => new DBColumn
			{
				Name = a.DisplayName,
				DBTypeName = "string",
				ColumnType = DBColumn.GetColumnType(TypeHelper.ExpandNullable(a.PropertyType), true)
			})));
			return val;
		}

		private static DBStoredProcedure CreateDbStoredProcedure(IEntityFunctionInfo ef)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0005: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0084: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			DBStoredProcedure val = new DBStoredProcedure
			{
				Name = ef.Name
			};
			val.Arguments.AddRange(((IEnumerable<IFunctionParameterInfo>)ef.Parameters).Select((Func<IFunctionParameterInfo, DBStoredProcedureArgument>)((IFunctionParameterInfo p) => new DBStoredProcedureArgument
			{
				Name = p.Name,
				Type = DBColumn.GetColumnType(p.ClrType, true)
			})));
			if (ef.ResultTypeProperties != null)
			{
				val.ResultSets.Add(new DBStoredProcedureResultSet((ICollection<DBNameTypePair>)((IEnumerable<IEdmComplexTypePropertyInfo>)ef.ResultTypeProperties).Select((Func<IEdmComplexTypePropertyInfo, DBNameTypePair>)((IEdmComplexTypePropertyInfo p) => new DBNameTypePair(p.Name, DBColumn.GetColumnType(p.ClrType, true)))).ToList()));
			}
			return val;
		}

		private static void ProcessException(Exception exception)
		{
			UnableToOpenDatabaseException ex = (UnableToOpenDatabaseException)(object)((exception is UnableToOpenDatabaseException) ? exception : null);
			Exception ex2 = exception;
			string message = exception.Message;
			if (ex != null && ((Exception)(object)ex).InnerException != null)
			{
				ex2 = ((Exception)(object)ex).InnerException;
				message = ex2.Message;
			}
			if (exception is TargetInvocationException { InnerException: not null } ex3)
			{
				ex2 = ex3.InnerException;
				message = ex3.Message;
			}
			throw new EFConnectionException(string.Format(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.DatabaseConnectionExceptionStringId), message), ex2);
		}

		public DBSchema GetDBSchema()
		{
			IDbContainerInfo val = ContainerInfo;
			if (val == null)
			{
				return new DBSchema();
			}
			List<DBTable> list = new List<DBTable>();
			List<DBTable> list2 = new List<DBTable>();
			GetDBTablesAndViews(val, list, list2);
			DBStoredProcedure[] storedProcedures = val.EntityFunctions.Where((IEntityFunctionInfo f) => f.ResultTypeProperties != null).Select(CreateDbStoredProcedure).ToArray();
			return new DBSchema(list.ToArray(), list2.ToArray(), storedProcedures);
		}

		public DBSchema GetDBSchema(string[] tableList)
		{
			IDbContainerInfo val = ContainerInfo;
			if (val == null)
			{
				return new DBSchema();
			}
			List<DBTable> list = new List<DBTable>();
			List<DBTable> list2 = new List<DBTable>();
			GetDBTablesAndViews(val, list, list2);
			return new DBSchema(list.Where((DBTable es) => tableList.Contains(es.Name)).ToArray(), list2.Where((DBTable es) => tableList.Contains(es.Name)).ToArray());
		}

		private static void GetDBTablesAndViews(IDbContainerInfo dbContainerInfo, List<DBTable> tables, List<DBTable> views)
		{
			tables.AddRange(dbContainerInfo.EntitySets.Where((IEntitySetInfo es) => !es.IsView).Select(CreateDbTable));
			views.AddRange(dbContainerInfo.EntitySets.Where((IEntitySetInfo es) => es.IsView).Select(CreateDbTable));
			if (!(dbContainerInfo.DbContextType == null))
			{
				string[] dbSetNames = tables.Select((DBTable t) => t.Name).Union(views.Select((DBTable v) => v.Name)).ToArray();
				List<DBTable> source = (from p in dbContainerInfo.DbContextType.GetProperties(BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public)
					where EFDataSourceServerModeFilterHelper.HasInterface(p.PropertyType, typeof(IEnumerable<>)) && !dbSetNames.Contains(p.Name)
					select CreateDbTable(p.Name, p.PropertyType, !p.CanWrite)).ToList();
				tables.AddRange(source.Where((DBTable t) => !t.IsView));
				views.AddRange(source.Where((DBTable t) => t.IsView));
			}
		}

		internal void CreateDataStore()
		{
			if (!IsConnected)
			{
				Exception ex = null;
				try
				{
					CreateDataStoreCore();
				}
				catch (Exception ex2)
				{
					ex = ex2;
				}
				if (!IsConnected && ex != null)
				{
					ProcessException(ex);
				}
			}
		}

		private void ApplyParameters(IDataConnectionParametersService dataConnectionParametersProvider)
		{
			if (dataConnectionParametersProvider != null)
			{
				DataConnectionParametersBase parameters = CreateDataConnectionParameters();
				parameters = dataConnectionParametersProvider.RaiseConfigureDataConnection(Name, parameters);
				connectionParameters = parameters as EFConnectionParameters;
			}
		}

		private void CreateDataStoreCore()
		{
			ApplyParameters(DataConnectionParametersProvider);
			if (model == null)
			{
				model = new DataAccessEntityFrameworkModel(SolutionTypesProvider, ConnectionStringsProvider, EFContextProvider);
			}
			else
			{
				model.Exceptions.Clear();
			}
			string connectionString;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(ConnectionParameters.ConnectionString) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(ConnectionParameters.ConnectionStringName))
			{
				connectionString = ConnectionStringsProvider.GetConnectionString(ConnectionParameters.ConnectionStringName);
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(connectionString))
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException($"The application config file does not contain the specified connection: \"{ConnectionParameters.ConnectionStringName}\".");
				}
			}
			else
			{
				connectionString = ConnectionParameters.ConnectionString;
			}
			model.ConnectionString = connectionString;
			model.ConnectionName = Name;
			string text = ((ConnectionParameters.Source != null) ? ConnectionParameters.Source.FullName : ConnectionParameters.CustomContextName);
			IDbContainerInfo container = ((EntityFrameworkModelBase)model).GetContainer(text, false);
			if (model.Exceptions.Any())
			{
				if (model.Exceptions.Count == 1)
				{
					throw model.Exceptions.First();
				}
				throw new AggregateException(model.Exceptions);
			}
			containerInfo = container;
			connected = containerInfo != null;
		}
	}

		public class EFFilterVisitor : ClientCriteriaVisitorBase
		{
			private readonly IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters;

			public EFFilterVisitor(IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters)
			{
				this.parameters = parameters;
			}

			protected override CriteriaOperator Visit(OperandProperty theOperand)
			{
				//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_002a: Expected O, but got Unknown
				int num = theOperand.PropertyName.IndexOf('.') + 1;
				if (num == -1)
				{
					return (CriteriaOperator)(object)theOperand;
				}
				string text = theOperand.PropertyName.Substring(num);
				return (CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty(text);
			}

			protected override CriteriaOperator Visit(OperandValue theOperand)
			{
				if (parameters == null)
				{
					return (CriteriaOperator)(object)theOperand;
				}
				if (theOperand.Value == null || theOperand.Value is Expression)
				{
					OperandParameter parameter = (OperandParameter)(object)((theOperand is OperandParameter) ? theOperand : null);
					if (parameter != null)
					{
						IParameter val = parameters.FirstOrDefault((IParameter p) => string.Equals(((IFilterParameter)p).Name, parameter.ParameterName));
						if (val != null)
						{
							((OperandValue)parameter).Value = val.Value;
						}
					}
				}
				return ((ClientCriteriaVisitorBase)this).Visit(theOperand);
			}
		}

		private void FillList(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
		{
			ReplaceServiceFromProvider(typeof(ISolutionTypesProvider), serviceProvider);
			ReplaceServiceFromProvider(typeof(IConnectionStringsProvider), serviceProvider);
			ReplaceServiceFromProvider(typeof(IEFContextProvider), serviceProvider);
			IParameterSupplierBase val = ((serviceProvider != null) ? ServiceProviderExtensions.GetService<IParameterSupplierBase>(serviceProvider) : null);
			List<IParameter> list = ((val != null) ? val.GetIParameters().ToList() : null);
			if (Connection != null)
			{
				AddServicesToConnection(this);
				EvaluateStoredProcedureParameters(ContextWrapper, StoredProcedures, list);
				EvaluateDbSetParameters(ContextWrapper, Filters, list);
				Connection.CreateDataStore();
				if (!Connection.IsConnected)
				{
					return;
				}
				ContextWrapper.FillData();
				filled = true;
			}
			OnAfterFill(list);
		}

		bool IListAdapter2.ShouldRefillQuery(string query)
		{
			if (!filled)
			{
				return true;
			}
			DBSetFilter dBSetFilter = filters.FirstOrDefault((DBSetFilter f) => f.DBSetName == query);
			if (dBSetFilter == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return dBSetFilter.Parameters.Count > 0;
		}

		private static void EvaluateStoredProcedureParameters(EFContextWrapper contextWrapper, IEnumerable<EFStoredProcedureInfo> storedProcedures, List<IParameter> parentParameters)
		{
			contextWrapper.StoredProcedures.Clear();
			foreach (EFStoredProcedureInfo storedProcedure in storedProcedures)
			{
				IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters = ParametersEvaluator.EvaluateParameters(parentParameters ?? Enumerable.Empty<IParameter>(), storedProcedure.Parameters);
				contextWrapper.StoredProcedures.Add(new EFStoredProcedureInfo(storedProcedure.Name, parameters));
			}
		}

		private static void EvaluateDbSetParameters(EFContextWrapper contextWrapper, IEnumerable<DBSetFilter> filters, List<IParameter> parentParameters)
		{
			contextWrapper.Filters.Clear();
			foreach (DBSetFilter filter in filters)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(filter?.DBSetName))
				{
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(filter.FilterString))
					{
						contextWrapper.Filters.Add(filter);
						continue;
					}
					IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters = ParametersEvaluator.EvaluateParameters(parentParameters ?? Enumerable.Empty<IParameter>(), filter.Parameters);
					DBSetFilter dBSetFilter = new DBSetFilter(filter.DBSetName, filter.FilterString);
					dBSetFilter.CriteriaOperator = CriteriaOperator.Parse(filter.FilterString, new object[0]).Accept<CriteriaOperator>((ICriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>)(object)new EFFilterVisitor(parameters));
					contextWrapper.Filters.Add(dBSetFilter);
				}
			}
		}

		DataConnectionParametersBase IDataConnectionParametersService.RaiseConfigureDataConnection(string connectionName, DataConnectionParametersBase parameters)
		{
			if (this.ConfigureDataConnection == null)

				return parameters;

			DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.ConfigureDataConnectionEventArgs e = new DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.ConfigureDataConnectionEventArgs(connectionName, parameters);
			this.ConfigureDataConnection(this, e);
			return e.ConnectionParameters;
		}

		DataConnectionParametersBase IDataConnectionParametersService.RaiseHandleConnectionError(DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.ConnectionErrorEventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			this.ConnectionError?.Invoke(this, eventArgs);
			if (eventArgs.Handled && eventArgs.Cancel)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return eventArgs.ConnectionParameters;
		}

				obj2 = ((obj3 != null) ? ServiceProviderExtensions.GetService<T>(obj3) : null) ?? ServiceProviderExtensions.GetService<T>((IServiceProvider)this);
			}
			return (T)obj2;
		}

		private void AddServicesToConnection(IServiceProvider provider)
		{
			ISolutionTypesProvider service = ServiceProviderExtensions.GetService<ISolutionTypesProvider>(provider);
			if (service != null)
			{
				Connection.SolutionTypesProvider = service;
			}
			IConnectionStringsProvider service2 = ServiceProviderExtensions.GetService<IConnectionStringsProvider>(provider);
			if (service2 != null)
			{
				Connection.ConnectionStringsProvider = service2;
			}
			Connection.DataConnectionParametersProvider = DataConnectionParametersService;
			IEFContextProvider service3 = ServiceProviderExtensions.GetService<IEFContextProvider>(provider);
			if (service3 != null)

			}
		}

		private void CreateDataConnection()
		{
			if (!loading)
			{
				connection = new EFDataConnection(connectionName, ConnectionParameters);
				try
				{
					LoadDbContext();
				}
				catch
				{
					connection = null;
					throw;
				}
				RefreshTypesProviderService();
				AddServicesToConnection(this);
			}
		}

		protected virtual EFContextWrapper CreateContextWrapperCore()
		{
			return new EFContextWrapper(Connection, StoredProcedures, Filters);
		}

		protected virtual void LoadDbContext()
		{
			EFConnectionParameters eFConnectionParameters = connection.ConnectionParameters;
			if (eFConnectionParameters == null || eFConnectionParameters.Source != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			BeforeLoadCustomAssemblyEventArgs e = new BeforeLoadCustomAssemblyEventArgs(eFConnectionParameters.CustomAssemblyPath, eFConnectionParameters.CustomContextName);
			EFDataSource.BeforeLoadCustomAssemblyGlobal?.Invoke(this, e);
			this.BeforeLoadCustomAssembly?.Invoke(this, e);
			if (!e.AllowLoading || string.IsNullOrEmpty(e.AssemblyPath) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(e.ContextName))
			{
				throw new CustomAssemblyLoadingProhibitedException(eFConnectionParameters.CustomAssemblyPath, eFConnectionParameters.CustomContextName);
			}
			eFConnectionParameters.CustomAssemblyPath = e.AssemblyPath;
			eFConnectionParameters.CustomContextName = e.ContextName;
			try
			{
				Assembly orLoadAssemblyFile = SafeTypeResolver.GetOrLoadAssemblyFile(eFConnectionParameters.CustomAssemblyPath, false);
				Type knownType = SafeTypeResolver.GetKnownType(orLoadAssemblyFile, eFConnectionParameters.CustomContextName, false, (bool?)null);
				eFConnectionParameters.Source = knownType;
			}
			catch (FileNotFoundException innerException)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Unable to load the " + eFConnectionParameters.CustomAssemblyPath + " assembly for the " + eFConnectionParameters.CustomContextName + " context.", innerException);
			}
		}

		private void RefreshTypesProviderService()
		{
			Type type;
			try
			{
				type = ((Connection == null) ? null : ((Connection.ConnectionParameters != null) ? Connection.ConnectionParameters.Source : null));
			}
			catch
			{
				type = null;
			}
			Assembly assembly = ((type != null) ? type.Assembly : ((Assembly.GetEntryAssembly() == null) ? DXTypeExtensions.GetAssembly(GetType()) : Assembly.GetEntryAssembly()));
			if (!(assembly == null))
			{
				object service = ((IServiceProvider)this).GetService(typeof(ISolutionTypesProvider));
				ISolutionTypesProvider val = (ISolutionTypesProvider)((service is ISolutionTypesProvider) ? service : null);
				if (val is RuntimeSolutionTypesProvider)
				{
					((IServiceContainer)this).RemoveService(typeof(ISolutionTypesProvider));
					val = null;
				}
				if (val == null)
				{
					RuntimeSolutionTypesProvider serviceInstance = new RuntimeSolutionTypesProvider(assembly.GetTypes);
					((IServiceContainer)this).AddService(typeof(ISolutionTypesProvider), (object)serviceInstance);
				}
			}
		}

		private Type GetDBContextType(string typeName)
		{
			if (((base.ExtensionsProvider is IServiceProvider serviceProvider) ? serviceProvider.GetService(typeof(ITypeResolutionService)) : null) is ITypeResolutionService typeResolutionService)
			{
				return typeResolutionService?.GetType(typeName);
			}
			Type result = default(Type);
			if (!SafeTypeResolver.IsTypeAvailable(typeName, ref result, (Predicate<Type>)IsDBContext, false))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private static bool IsDBContext(Type type)
		{
			Type type2 = type;
			while (type2 != typeof(object))
			{
				string text = type2.Assembly.GetName().Name;
				if (type2.FullName == "System.Data.Entity.DbContext" && text == "EntityFramework")
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (type2.FullName == "Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.DbContext" && text == "Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore")
				{
					return true;
				}
				type2 = DXTypeExtensions.GetBaseType(type2);
			}
			return false;
		}
