		DynamicLookupResult IDynamicLookupSettingsDataProvider.GetResult(string dataMember, IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters, string filterString, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			//IL_0124: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0129: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0131: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0138: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0140: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00e2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ec: Expected O, but got Unknown
			EFContextWrapper eFContextWrapper = new EFContextWrapper(Connection, new EFStoredProcedureInfo[0], new DBSetFilter[0]);
			List<IParameter> list = parameters.ToList();
			bool filterApplied = false;
			EFStoredProcedureInfo eFStoredProcedureInfo = StoredProcedures.Find((EFStoredProcedureInfo p) => p.Name == dataMember);
			if (eFStoredProcedureInfo != null)
			{
				EvaluateStoredProcedureParameters(eFContextWrapper, new EFStoredProcedureInfo[1] { eFStoredProcedureInfo }, list);
				eFContextWrapper.FillData();
			}
			else
			{
				DBSetFilter dBSetFilter = Filters.FirstOrDefault((DBSetFilter f) => f.DBSetName == dataMember);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(filterString))
				{
					CriteriaOperator criteriaOperator = FilterHelper.GetCriteriaOperator(filterString, list);
					criteriaOperator = criteriaOperator.Accept<CriteriaOperator>((ICriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>)new DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.MongoDB.QueryExecutor.ParametersToValuesReplacer());
					if (dBSetFilter == null)
					{
						dBSetFilter = new DBSetFilter(dataMember, ((object)criteriaOperator).ToString());
					}
					else
					{
						CriteriaOperator criteriaOperator2 = FilterHelper.GetCriteriaOperator(dBSetFilter.FilterString, (IEnumerable<IParameter>)(object)dBSetFilter.Parameters);
						dBSetFilter.FilterString = ((object)new GroupOperator((GroupOperatorType)0, (CriteriaOperator[])(object)new CriteriaOperator[2] { criteriaOperator2, criteriaOperator })).ToString();
					}
				}
				EvaluateDbSetParameters(eFContextWrapper, new DBSetFilter[1] { dBSetFilter }, list);
				filterApplied = true;
			}
			PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = ((ITypedList)eFContextWrapper).GetItemProperties((PropertyDescriptor[])null).Find(dataMember, ignoreCase: false);
			object value = propertyDescriptor.GetValue(eFContextWrapper);
			return new DynamicLookupResult
			{
				Result = value,
				ActualDataMember = null,
				FilterApplied = filterApplied
			};
		}

		Task<DynamicLookupResult> IDynamicLookupSettingsDataProvider.GetResultAsync(string dataMember, IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters, string filterString, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			return Task.FromResult<DynamicLookupResult>(((IDynamicLookupSettingsDataProvider)this).GetResult(dataMember, parameters, filterString, cancellationToken));
		}

			: base(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.WizardAssemblyLoadingDisallowed))

			this.assemblyPath = assemblyPath;
			this.contextName = contextName;
		}
	}

			set

				SetOwner(value);
				((IList)innerList)[index] = value;
			}
		}

		public object SyncRoot => ((ICollection)innerList).SyncRoot;

		public bool IsSynchronized => ((ICollection)innerList).IsSynchronized;

		public int Count => innerList.Count;

		bool ICollection<DBSetFilter>.IsReadOnly => ((ICollection<DBSetFilter>)innerList).IsReadOnly;

		public EFDataSource Owner => owner;

		public DBSetFilter this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return innerList[index];
			}
			set
			{
				SetOwner(value);
				innerList[index] = value;
			}
		}

		public string this[string name]
		{
			get
			{
				return innerList.Find((DBSetFilter filter) => string.Equals(filter.DBSetName, name)).FilterString;
			}
			set
			{
				DBSetFilter dBSetFilter = innerList.Find((DBSetFilter filter) => string.Equals(filter.DBSetName, name));
				if (dBSetFilter != null)
				{
					dBSetFilter.FilterString = value;
					return;
				}
				innerList.Add(new DBSetFilter(name, value)
				{
					Owner = this
				});
			}
		}

		internal EFFiltersCollection(EFDataSource owner)
		{
			this.owner = owner;
		}

	{

			: this(null, typeof(string), null)
		{
		}

		public EFParameter(string name, Type type, object value)
			: base(name, type, value)
		{
		}

		internal EFParameter(IParameter other)
			: this(((IFilterParameter)other).Name, ((IFilterParameter)other).Type, other.Value)
		{
		}

		internal new static EFParameter FromIParameter(IParameter value)
		{
			object obj;
			if (value != null)
			{
				obj = value as EFParameter;
				if (obj == null)
				{
					return new EFParameter(value);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				obj = null;
			}
			return (EFParameter)obj;
		}
	}

	public sealed class EFStoredProcedureInfo
	{
		internal class EqualityComparer : IEqualityComparer<EFStoredProcedureInfo[]>
		{
			public static bool Equals(EFStoredProcedureInfo[] x, EFStoredProcedureInfo[] y)
			{
				if (x == null && y == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (x == null || y == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (x.Length != y.Length)
				{
					return false;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < x.Length; i++)
				{
					if (!Equals(x[i], y[i]))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}

			public static bool Equals(EFStoredProcedureInfo x, EFStoredProcedureInfo y)
			{
				if (x == null && y == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (x == null || y == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!string.Equals(x.Name, y.Name))
				{
					return false;
				}
				int count = x.parameters.Count;
				if (y.parameters.Count != count)
				{
					return false;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					EFParameter x2 = x.parameters[i];
					EFParameter y2 = y.parameters[i];
					if (!DataSourceParameterBase.BaseEqualityComparer.Equals((IParameter)(object)x2, (IParameter)(object)y2))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}

			bool IEqualityComparer<EFStoredProcedureInfo[]>.Equals(EFStoredProcedureInfo[] x, EFStoredProcedureInfo[] y)
			{
				return Equals(x, y);
			}

			int IEqualityComparer<EFStoredProcedureInfo[]>.GetHashCode(EFStoredProcedureInfo[] obj)
			{
				return 0;
			}
		}

		internal const string storedProcInfoXml = "StoredProcInfo";

		internal const string storedProcInfoNameXml = "StoredProcInfoName";

		private readonly EFParameterCollection parameters;

		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.EntityFramework.EFStoredProcedureInfo.Name")]
		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.EntityFramework.EFStoredProcedureInfo.Name")]
		public string Name { get; set; }

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[Editor("DevExpress.DataAccess.UI.Native.EntityFramework.EFStoredProcedureParametersEditor, DevExpress.DataAccess.v23.2.UI, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.EntityFramework.EFStoredProcedureInfo.Parameters")]
		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.EntityFramework.EFStoredProcedureInfo.Parameters")]
		public EFParameterCollection Parameters => parameters;

		internal EFStoredProcedureInfoCollection ParentCollection { get; set; }

		public EFStoredProcedureInfo()
		{
			parameters = new EFParameterCollection();
		}

		public EFStoredProcedureInfo(string name)
			: this()
		{
			Name = name;
		}

		public EFStoredProcedureInfo(string name, IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters)
			: this(name)
		{
			if (parameters != null)
			{
				this.parameters.AddRange(parameters.Select(EFParameter.FromIParameter));
			}
		}

		public EFStoredProcedureInfo(EFStoredProcedureInfo other)
			: this(other.Name, (IEnumerable<IParameter>)(object)other.Parameters)
		{
		}

		internal XElement SaveToXml(IExtensionsProvider extensionsProvider, ISerializableTypesCollector collector)
		{
			XElement xElement = new XElement("StoredProcInfo", new XAttribute("StoredProcInfoName", Name));
			foreach (EFParameter parameter in parameters)
			{
				collector?.SerializableTypes.Add(parameter.Type);
				xElement.Add(parameter.SaveToXml(extensionsProvider, collector));
			}
			return xElement;
		}

		internal void LoadFromXMl(XElement element, IExtensionsProvider extensionsProvider)
		{
			Name = element.GetAttributeValue("StoredProcInfoName");
			foreach (XElement item in element.Elements("Parameter"))
			{
				EFParameter eFParameter = new EFParameter();
				eFParameter.LoadFromXMl(item, extensionsProvider);
				parameters.Add(eFParameter);
			}
		}
	}

	public struct FilterViewColumnInfo
	{
		public string ColumnName { get; }

		public Type ColumnType { get; }

		public FilterViewColumnInfo(string columnName, Type columnType)
		{
			ColumnName = (columnName.Contains(".") ? ("[" + columnName.Replace("]", "\\]") + "]") : columnName);
			ColumnType = columnType;
		}
	}
	public struct FilterViewTableInfo
	{
		public string TableName { get; }

		public IEnumerable<FilterViewColumnInfo> Columns { get; }

		public FilterViewTableInfo(string tableName, IEnumerable<FilterViewColumnInfo> columns)
		{
			TableName = ((tableName.Split('.').Length > 2) ? ("[" + tableName.Replace("]", "\\]") + "]") : tableName);
			Columns = columns?.ToArray();
		}
	}

	public class DBSetFilterViewModel : INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		private readonly ParametersGridViewModel parametersGridViewModel;

		private string dbSetName;

		private string filterString;

		public IParametersGridViewModel ParametersViewModel => parametersGridViewModel;

		public DBSetFilter Filter
		{
			get
			{
				DBSetFilter dBSetFilter = new DBSetFilter(DBSetName, FilterString);
				dBSetFilter.Parameters.AddRange(Parameters.Select(EFParameter.FromIParameter));
				return dBSetFilter;
			}
		}

		public string DBSetName
		{
			get
			{
				return dbSetName;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(dbSetName == value))
				{
					dbSetName = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("DBSetName");
				}
			}
		}

		public string FilterString
		{
			get
			{
				return filterString;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(filterString == value))
				{
					filterString = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("FilterString");
				}
			}
		}

		public BindingList<IParameterViewModel> Parameters => ParametersViewModel.Records;

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public DBSetFilterViewModel()
			: this(null, null, null)
		{
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public DBSetFilterViewModel(DBSetFilter filter, IParameterService parameterService, IServiceProvider propertyGridServices, IParameterEditorService parameterEditorService)
			: this(filter, parameterService, parameterEditorService)
		{
		}

		public DBSetFilterViewModel(DBSetFilter filter, IParameterService parameterService, IParameterEditorService parameterEditorService)
		{
			IEnumerable<IParameter> enumerable = null;
			if (filter != null)
			{
				dbSetName = filter.DBSetName;
				filterString = filter.FilterString;
				enumerable = (IEnumerable<IParameter>)(object)filter.Parameters;
			}
			ParametersGridModel model = new ParametersGridModel(enumerable ?? Enumerable.Empty<IParameter>());
			parametersGridViewModel = new ParametersGridViewModel(model, parameterService, parameterEditorService, () => (PreviewData)null, isFixedParameters: false);
		}

		public void RefreshParameters()
		{
			OnPropertyChanged("Parameters");
		}

		public void OnRenameParameter(string name, string newName)
		{
			FilterString = EFFilterHelper.RenameParameter(FilterString, name, newName);
		}

		protected virtual void OnPropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}
	}
	public class EFFiltersViewModel : INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		private readonly DBSetFiltersViewModelsList filters;

		private readonly IDictionary<string, DBTable> dbTables;

		private readonly IParameterService parameterService;

		private readonly IParameterEditorService parameterEditorService;

		public IList<DBSetFilterViewModel> Filters => filters;

		public string[] DBSets => dbTables.Keys.ToArray();

		public string[] AvailableDBSets => DBSets.Except(Filters.Select((DBSetFilterViewModel f) => f.DBSetName)).ToArray();

		public object[] ExternalParameterExpressions => ((parameterService != null) ? parameterService.Parameters.Select((IParameter p) => new Expression("[Parameters." + ((IFilterParameter)p).Name + "]", ((IFilterParameter)p).Type)).Cast<object>().ToList() : new List<object>()).ToArray();

		public object[] Types => parameterEditorService.GetParameterTypes("").Values.Cast<object>().ToArray();

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		public EFFiltersViewModel(DBSetFilter[] filters, IDictionary<string, DBTable> dbTables, IParameterService parameterService, IServiceProvider propertyGridServices, IParameterEditorService parameterEditorService)
		{
			this.parameterEditorService = parameterEditorService;
			this.parameterService = parameterService;
			this.filters = new DBSetFiltersViewModelsList(filters.Select((DBSetFilter filter) => new DBSetFilterViewModel(filter.Clone(), parameterService, propertyGridServices, parameterEditorService)).ToList(), parameterService, propertyGridServices, parameterEditorService);
			this.dbTables = dbTables;
		}

		public void EditFilter(Func<IFilterView> createView, DBSetFilterViewModel filter)
		{
			if (LaunchFilterEditor(createView, filter, out var model))
			{
				filter.FilterString = model.FilterString;
				filter.Parameters.Clear();
				foreach (DataSourceParameterBase parameter in model.Parameters)
				{
					filter.Parameters.Add(ParameterViewModel.FromIParameter((IParameter)(object)parameter, parameterService));
				}
				filter.RefreshParameters();
			}
			else if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(filter.FilterString))
			{
				Filters.Remove(filter);
			}
			OnPropertyChanged("AvailableDBSets");
		}

		public void DeleteFilter(int index)
		{
			filters.RemoveAt(index);
		}

		private bool LaunchFilterEditor(Func<IFilterView> createView, DBSetFilterViewModel filter, out FilterModel model)
		{
			string filterString = EFFilterHelper.PrependTableNames(new DBSetFilter(filter.DBSetName, filter.FilterString));
			model = new FilterModel(filterString, filter.Parameters.Select(EFParameter.FromIParameter));
			IFilterView view = createView();
			EFFilterPresenter eFFilterPresenter = new EFFilterPresenter(model, view, dbTables, filter.DBSetName);
			((PresenterBase<FilterModel, IFilterView, EFFilterPresenter>)eFFilterPresenter).InitView();
			return ((PresenterBase<FilterModel, IFilterView, EFFilterPresenter>)eFFilterPresenter).Run();
		}

		protected virtual void OnPropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			this.PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
		}
	}
}

	public class DataAccessUILocalizer : XtraLocalizer<DataAccessUIStringId>
	{
		public static XtraLocalizer<DataAccessUIStringId> Active
		{
			get
			{
				return XtraLocalizer<DataAccessUIStringId>.Active;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(XtraLocalizer<DataAccessUIStringId>.GetActiveLocalizerProvider() is DefaultActiveLocalizerProvider<DataAccessUIStringId>))
				{
					XtraLocalizer<DataAccessUIStringId>.SetActiveLocalizerProvider((ActiveLocalizerProvider<DataAccessUIStringId>)(object)new DefaultActiveLocalizerProvider<DataAccessUIStringId>(value));
					XtraLocalizer<DataAccessUIStringId>.RaiseActiveChanged();
				}
				else
				{
					XtraLocalizer<DataAccessUIStringId>.Active = value;
				}
			}
		}

		static DataAccessUILocalizer()
		{
			if (XtraLocalizer<DataAccessUIStringId>.GetActiveLocalizerProvider() == null)
			{
				XtraLocalizer<DataAccessUIStringId>.SetActiveLocalizerProvider((ActiveLocalizerProvider<DataAccessUIStringId>)(object)new DefaultActiveLocalizerProvider<DataAccessUIStringId>(CreateDefaultLocalizer()));
			}
		}

		public static XtraLocalizer<DataAccessUIStringId> CreateDefaultLocalizer()
		{
			return (XtraLocalizer<DataAccessUIStringId>)(object)new DataAccessUIResLocalizer();
		}

		public static string GetString(DataAccessUIStringId id)
		{
			return Active.GetLocalizedString(id);
		}

		protected override void PopulateStringTable()
		{
			AddStrings();
		}

		public override XtraLocalizer<DataAccessUIStringId> CreateResXLocalizer()
		{
			return (XtraLocalizer<DataAccessUIStringId>)(object)new DataAccessUIResLocalizer();
		}
	}
	public class DataAccessUIResLocalizer : XtraResXLocalizer<DataAccessUIStringId>
	{
		public DataAccessUIResLocalizer()
			: base((XtraLocalizer<DataAccessUIStringId>)new DataAccessUILocalizer())
		{
		}

		protected override ResourceManager CreateResourceManagerCore()
		{
			return XtraLocalizer.CreateResourceManager<DataAccessUIStringId>((XtraResXLocalizer<DataAccessUIStringId>)this, "DevExpress.DataAccess.UI.LocalizationRes", typeof(DataAccessUIResLocalizer));
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.DataAccess.UI.Native

	public static class DataAccessUIStringIdExtensions
	{
		public static string GetString(this DataAccessUIStringId id)
		{
			return DataAccessUILocalizer.GetString(id);
		}

		public static string GetString(this DataAccessStringId id)
		{
			return DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(id);
		}
	}
	public class WaitFormProvider : IWaitFormProvider
	{
		private readonly IWaitFormActivator waitFormActivator;

		private CancellationTokenHook hook;

		private string caption;

		private bool closedCompletely;

		public WaitFormProvider(IWaitFormActivator waitFormActivator, CancellationTokenHook hook, string caption)
		{
			this.waitFormActivator = waitFormActivator;
			this.hook = hook;
			this.caption = caption;
		}

		public void CloseWaitForm(bool closeCompletely)
		{
			if (!closedCompletely)
			{
				if (closeCompletely)
				{
					closedCompletely = true;
				}
				waitFormActivator.CloseWaitForm();
			}
		}

		public void ShowWaitForm()
		{
			if (!closedCompletely)
			{
				waitFormActivator.ShowWaitForm(true, false, true);
				waitFormActivator.SetWaitFormObject((ISupportCancel)(object)hook);
				waitFormActivator.EnableCancelButton(true);
				waitFormActivator.SetWaitFormCaption(caption);
			}
		}
	}
	public class SqlDataSourceUIProvider
	{
		private SqlDataSource dataSource;

		private string Caption => DataAccessUIStringId.MessageBoxErrorTitle.GetString();

		private IDataConnectionParametersService ParametersService => ServiceProviderExtensions.GetService<IDataConnectionParametersService>((IServiceProvider)dataSource);

		public SqlDataSourceUIProvider(SqlDataSource dataSource)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)dataSource, "dataSource");
			this.dataSource = dataSource;
		}

		public Task<bool> OpenConnectionAsync(IWaitFormActivator waitActivator, CancellationTokenSource cts)
		{
			return new ConnectionHelperAsync(dataSource.Connection).OpenAsync(waitActivator, ParametersService, cts);
		}

		public SqlDataConnection ValidateConnection(Action<string, string> handleMessage, IConnectionProviderService connectionProviderService)
		{
			IConnectionProviderService connectionProviderService2 = null;
			if (connectionProviderService != null)
			{
				connectionProviderService2 = ServiceProviderExtensions.GetService<IConnectionProviderService>((IServiceProvider)dataSource);
				((IServiceContainer)dataSource).RemoveService(typeof(IConnectionProviderService));
				((IServiceContainer)dataSource).AddService(typeof(IConnectionProviderService), (object)connectionProviderService);
			}
			try
			{
				return ValidateConnection(handleMessage);
			}
			finally
			{
				if (connectionProviderService != null)
				{
					((IServiceContainer)dataSource).RemoveService(typeof(IConnectionProviderService));
				}
				if (connectionProviderService2 != null)
				{
					((IServiceContainer)dataSource).AddService(typeof(IConnectionProviderService), (object)connectionProviderService2);
				}
			}
		}

		public SqlDataConnection ValidateConnection(Action<string, string> handleMessage)
		{
			try
			{
				SqlDataConnection connection = dataSource.Connection;
				if (connection == null)
				{
					handleMessage?.Invoke(DataAccessUIStringId.MessageMissingConnection.GetString(), Caption);
				}
				return connection;
			}
			catch (InvalidOperationException ex)
			{
				handleMessage?.Invoke(ex.Message, Caption);
				return null;
			}
			catch (ArgumentException ex2)
			{
				handleMessage?.Invoke(ex2.Message, Caption);
				return null;
			}
		}

		public async Task RequestDatabaseSchemaAsync(IWaitFormActivator activator, CancellationTokenSource cts)
		{
			CancellationTokenHook hook = new CancellationTokenHook(cts);
			WaitFormProvider waitFormProvider = new WaitFormProvider(activator, hook, DataAccessStringId.LoadingDataPanelText.GetString());
			try
			{
				waitFormProvider.ShowWaitForm();
				dataSource.Connection.DropDBSchemaCache();
				await dataSource.LoadDBSchemaAsync(cts.Token);
			}
			finally
			{
				waitFormProvider.CloseWaitForm(closeCompletely: true);
			}
		}

		public async Task<bool> RebuildResultSchemaAsync(Func<string, string, bool> confirmExecution, IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters, IResultSchemaProvider resultSchemaProvider, IWaitFormActivator activator, CancellationTokenSource cts)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)dataSource, "dataSource");
			WaitFormProvider waitFormProvider = new WaitFormProvider(activator, new CancellationTokenHook(cts), DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.RebuildResultSchemaWaitFormText));
			try
			{
				waitFormProvider.ShowWaitForm();
				await dataSource.EnsureIsReadyToBuildAsync(cts.Token);
				DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.ResultSet resultSet = dataSource.RebuildResultSchema(delegate(IEnumerable<SqlQuery> queries)
				{
					waitFormProvider.CloseWaitForm(closeCompletely: false);
					bool result = confirmExecution(GetdResultSchemaConfirmationText(queries.Select((SqlQuery q) => q.Name)), DataAccessUIStringId.MessageBoxConfirmationTitle.GetString());
					waitFormProvider.ShowWaitForm();
					return result;
				}, parameters, dataSource.Queries, resultSchemaProvider, cts.Token);
				if (resultSet != null)
				{
					dataSource.ResultSet.SetTables(resultSet.Tables, resultSet.ComplexResults.Values);
					dataSource.ResultSet.ApplyRelations(dataSource.Relations);
					return true;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				waitFormProvider.CloseWaitForm(closeCompletely: true);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static string GetdResultSchemaConfirmationText(IEnumerable<string> names)
		{
			return string.Join("\r\n\t• ", new string[1] { DataAccessUIStringId.RebuildResultSchemaConfirmationText.GetString() }.Union(names));
		}
	}
	public class ConnectionHelperAsync
	{
		private DataConnectionBase dataConnection;

		public ConnectionHelperAsync(DataConnectionBase dataConnection)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)dataConnection, "dataConnection");
			this.dataConnection = dataConnection;
		}

		public Task<bool> OpenAsync(IDataConnectionParametersService parametersService, CancellationTokenSource cts)
		{
			if (dataConnection.IsConnected)
			{
				return Task.FromResult(result: true);
			}
			return dataConnection.CreateDataStoreAsync(parametersService, cts.Token);
		}

		public async Task<bool> OpenAsync(IWaitFormActivator waitActivator, IDataConnectionParametersService parametersService, CancellationTokenSource cts)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)waitActivator, "waitActivator");
			if (dataConnection.IsConnected)
			{
				return true;
			}
			CancellationTokenHook cancellationTokenHook = new CancellationTokenHook(cts);
			WaitFormProvider waitFormProvider = new WaitFormProvider(waitActivator, cancellationTokenHook, DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.ConnectingToDatabaseMessage));
			try
			{
				waitFormProvider.ShowWaitForm();
				return await dataConnection.CreateDataStoreAsync(parametersService, cancellationTokenHook.Token).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			finally
			{
				waitFormProvider.CloseWaitForm(closeCompletely: true);
			}
		}
	}
}

	public class EFFiltersTypeConverter : CollectionTypeConverter
	{
		private class EFFilterPropertyDescriptor : TypeConverter.SimplePropertyDescriptor
		{
			private string dbSetName;

			public EFFilterPropertyDescriptor(string dbSetName, System.Attribute[] attributes)
				: base(typeof(EFFiltersCollection), dbSetName, typeof(DBSetFilter), attributes)
			{
				this.dbSetName = dbSetName;
			}

			public override object GetValue(object component)
			{
				return ((EFFiltersCollection)component).First((DBSetFilter filter) => string.Equals(dbSetName, filter.DBSetName));
			}

			public override void SetValue(object component, object value)
			{
			}
		}

		private class EFFilterTypeConverter : TypeConverter
		{
			private class EFParametersCollectionPropertyDescriptor : SimplePropertyDescriptor
			{
				public EFParametersCollectionPropertyDescriptor(Type componentType, string name, Type propertyType)
					: base(componentType, name, propertyType, GetAttributes(name))
				{
				}

				private static System.Attribute[] GetAttributes(string propertyName)
				{
					return Enumerable.Cast<System.Attribute>(typeof(DBSetFilter).GetProperty(propertyName).GetCustomAttributes(inherit: true)).ToArray();
				}

				public override object GetValue(object component)
				{
					return ((DBSetFilter)component).Parameters;
				}

				public override void SetValue(object component, object value)
				{
				}
			}

			public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(string))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}

			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(string) && value is DBSetFilter dBSetFilter)
				{
					return dBSetFilter.FilterString;
				}
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}

			public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value, System.Attribute[] attributes)
			{
				return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(new PropertyDescriptor[1]
				{
					new EFParametersCollectionPropertyDescriptor(typeof(DBSetFilter), "Parameters", typeof(EFParameterCollection))
				});
			}

			public override bool GetPropertiesSupported(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
			{
				return true;
			}
		}

		public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value, System.Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			PropertyDescriptorCollection propertyDescriptorCollection = new PropertyDescriptorCollection(new PropertyDescriptor[0]);
			if (value is EFFiltersCollection eFFiltersCollection)
			{
				List<PropertyDescriptor> list = new List<PropertyDescriptor>();
				foreach (DBSetFilter item in eFFiltersCollection)
				{
					list.Add(new EFFilterPropertyDescriptor(item.DBSetName, new System.Attribute[1]
					{
						new TypeConverterAttribute(typeof(EFFilterTypeConverter))
					}));
				}
				foreach (PropertyDescriptor item2 in list)
				{
					propertyDescriptorCollection.Add(item2);
				}
			}
			return propertyDescriptorCollection;
		}

		public override bool GetPropertiesSupported(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return true;
		}
	}

	public class JsonWizardSettings
	{
		private readonly DataSourceWizardSettings internalSettings;

		private bool disableNewConnections;

		private JsonSensitiveInfoSavingBehavior databaseCredentialsSavingBehavior = JsonSensitiveInfoSavingBehavior.Never;

		private int schemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount = 100;

		[DefaultValue(JsonSensitiveInfoSavingBehavior.Never)]
		[Description("")]
		public JsonSensitiveInfoSavingBehavior JsonCredentialsSavingBehavior
		{
			get
			{
				return GetPropertySafe((JsonWizardSettings s) => s.databaseCredentialsSavingBehavior);
			}
			set
			{
				SetPropertySafe(delegate(JsonWizardSettings s)
				{
					s.databaseCredentialsSavingBehavior = value;
				});
			}
		}

		[DefaultValue(false)]
		[Description("")]
		public bool DisableNewConnections
		{
			get
			{
				return GetPropertySafe((JsonWizardSettings s) => s.disableNewConnections);
			}
			set
			{
				SetPropertySafe(delegate(JsonWizardSettings s)
				{
					s.disableNewConnections = value;
				});
			}
		}

		[DefaultValue(100)]
		[Description("")]
		public int SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount
		{
			get
			{
				return GetPropertySafe((JsonWizardSettings s) => s.schemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount);
			}
			set
			{
				SetPropertySafe(delegate(JsonWizardSettings s)
				{
					s.schemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount = value;
				});
			}
		}

		public JsonWizardSettings()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		protected internal JsonWizardSettings(DataSourceWizardSettings internalSettings)
		{
			this.internalSettings = internalSettings;
			ResetCore();
		}

		private void ResetCore()
		{
			DisableNewConnections = false;
			JsonCredentialsSavingBehavior = JsonSensitiveInfoSavingBehavior.Never;
		}

		public virtual void Reset()
		{
			ResetCore();
		}

		public JsonWizardOptions ToJsonWizardOptions()
		{
			JsonWizardOptions jsonWizardOptions = JsonWizardOptions.None;
			if (JsonCredentialsSavingBehavior == JsonSensitiveInfoSavingBehavior.Always)
			{
				jsonWizardOptions |= JsonWizardOptions.AlwaysSaveCredentials;
			}
			if (DisableNewConnections)
			{
				jsonWizardOptions |= JsonWizardOptions.DisableNewConnections;
			}
			return jsonWizardOptions;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (this == obj)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!(obj is JsonWizardSettings jsonWizardSettings))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (DisableNewConnections == jsonWizardSettings.DisableNewConnections && JsonCredentialsSavingBehavior == jsonWizardSettings.JsonCredentialsSavingBehavior)
			{
				return SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount == jsonWizardSettings.SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return 0;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>(8);
			if (DisableNewConnections)
			{
				list.Add("DisableNewConnections = True");
			}
			if (JsonCredentialsSavingBehavior != JsonSensitiveInfoSavingBehavior.Never)
			{
				list.Add(string.Format("{0} = {1}", "JsonCredentialsSavingBehavior", JsonCredentialsSavingBehavior));
			}
			if (SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount != 100)
			{
				list.Add(string.Format("{0} = {1}", "SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount", SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount));
			}
			if (!list.Any())
			{
				return "None";
			}
			return string.Join(", ", list);
		}

		private void SetPropertySafe(Action<JsonWizardSettings> setter)
		{
			setter((internalSettings != null) ? internalSettings.JsonWizardSettings : this);
		}

		private TOut GetPropertySafe<TOut>(Func<JsonWizardSettings, TOut> getter)
		{
			return getter((internalSettings != null) ? internalSettings.JsonWizardSettings : this);
		}
	}

	public static class WizardDataSourceTypeExtensions
	{
		public static IEnumerable<DataSourceType> ToDataSourceTypes(this WizardDataSourceType dataSourceType)
		{
			if (dataSourceType.HasFlag(WizardDataSourceType.Sql))
			{
				yield return DataSourceType.Xpo;
			}
			if (dataSourceType.HasFlag(WizardDataSourceType.EF))
			{
				yield return DataSourceType.Entity;
			}
			if (dataSourceType.HasFlag(WizardDataSourceType.Object))
			{
				yield return DataSourceType.Object;
			}
			if (dataSourceType.HasFlag(WizardDataSourceType.Excel))
			{
				yield return DataSourceType.Excel;
			}
			if (dataSourceType.HasFlag(WizardDataSourceType.Federation))
			{
				yield return DataSourceType.Federation;
			}
			if (dataSourceType.HasFlag(WizardDataSourceType.Json))
			{
				yield return DataSourceType.Json;
			}
			if (dataSourceType.HasFlag(WizardDataSourceType.MongoDB))
			{
				yield return DataSourceType.MongoDB;
			}
			if (dataSourceType.HasFlag(WizardDataSourceType.XPO))
			{
				yield return DataSourceType.XPObject;
			}
		}

	public abstract class FederatedQueryBuilderRunnerBase
	{
		protected readonly IFederatedDataSourceProvider dataSourcesProvider;

		public ExpressionEditorContext ExpressionEditorContext { get; set; }

		protected FederatedQueryBuilderRunnerBase(IFederatedDataSourceProvider dataSourcesProvider)
		{
			this.dataSourcesProvider = dataSourcesProvider;
		}

		public QueryNode Edit(QueryNode node, IEnumerable<Source> existingSources)
		{
			QueryNode clone = ((node != null) ? (JoinNodeCloneAssistant.Clone(node) as QueryNode) : new SelectNode());
			DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.DataFederation.QueryBuilder.QueryBuilderViewModel model = CreateQueryBuilderViewModel(existingSources, clone);
			return EditCore(model, node?.Owner?.Parent?.Name) ?? node;
		}

		protected virtual DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.DataFederation.QueryBuilder.QueryBuilderViewModel CreateQueryBuilderViewModel(IEnumerable<Source> existingSources, QueryNode clone)
		{
			return new DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.DataFederation.QueryBuilder.QueryBuilderViewModel(dataSourcesProvider, clone, existingSources.ToList(), ExpressionEditorContext);
		}

		private QueryNode EditCore(IQueryBuilderUIViewModel model, string dataSourceName)
		{
			IQueryBuilderView view = CreateView(model);
			try
			{
				QueryNode result = null;
				view.Ok += delegate
				{
					string text = Validate(model, dataSourceName);
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
					{
						result = model.QueryNodeViewModel.Query;
						view.Stop();
					}
					else
					{
						result = null;
						view.ShowError(text);
					}
				};
				view.Start();
				return result;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (view != null)
				{
					view.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		internal static string Validate(IQueryBuilderUIViewModel queryBuilderModel, string dataSourceName)
		{
			IMissingItem missingItem = queryBuilderModel.QueryNodeViewModel.GetMissingItems().FirstOrDefault();
			if (missingItem != null)
			{
				return GetRemovedItemMessage(queryBuilderModel, missingItem);
			}
			ValidationError validationError = new QueryNode.Validator(new IndeterminateSourceColumnsProvider(), dataSourceName).Process(queryBuilderModel.QueryNodeViewModel.Query);
			if (validationError is RootNullValidationError || validationError is UnionWithNoElementsValidationError)
			{
				return DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.QueryBuilderNoTablesSelected);
			}
			if (validationError is NoColumnsValidationError)
			{
				return DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.QueryBuilderNothingSelected);
			}
			if (validationError is NoRulesValidationError)
			{
				return DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.QueryBuilderNoRules);
			}
			if (queryBuilderModel.QueryNodeViewModel is TransformationNodeViewModel transformationNodeViewModel)
			{
				HashSet<string> hashSet = new HashSet<string>();
				foreach (TransformationResultItemData result in transformationNodeViewModel.Results)
				{
					if (!hashSet.Add(result.ColumnName))
					{
						return string.Format(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.Federation_TransformationDuplicatedColumnNamesValidationErrorMessage), transformationNodeViewModel.Query.ActualName, result);
					}
				}
			}
			return validationError?.Message;
		}

		private static string GetRemovedItemMessage(IQueryBuilderUIViewModel model, IMissingItem missingItem)
		{
			if (missingItem == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.DataFederation.QueryBuilder.AvailableItemData availableItemData = model.Available.SingleOrDefault((DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.DataFederation.QueryBuilder.AvailableItemData x) => x.Source.DataSource == missingItem.Source.DataSource && string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.Source.DataMember));
			object obj = availableItemData?.Source.DataSource ?? missingItem.Source.DataSource;
			object obj2 = ((obj is IDataComponent) ? obj : null);
			string text = ((obj2 != null) ? ((IDataComponent)obj2).Name : null) ?? obj?.GetType().Name;
			if (missingItem.IsTable)
			{
				if (availableItemData == null)
				{
					return string.Format(DataAccessUILocalizer.GetString(DataAccessUIStringId.FederationDataSourceQueryBuilder_RemovedDataSourceMessage), text, missingItem.Name);
				}
				return string.Format(DataAccessUILocalizer.GetString(DataAccessUIStringId.FederationDataSourceQueryBuilder_RemovedTableMessage), missingItem.Name, text);
			}
			DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.DataFederation.QueryBuilder.SelectionItemData selectionItemData = ((SelectNodeViewModel)model.QueryNodeViewModel).Selection.Single((DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.DataFederation.QueryBuilder.SelectionItemData x) => x.Id == ((DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.DataFederation.QueryBuilder.SelectionItemData)missingItem).Parent);
			return string.Format(DataAccessUILocalizer.GetString(DataAccessUIStringId.FederationDataSourceQueryBuilder_RemovedColumnMessage), selectionItemData.Name, missingItem.Name, text);
		}

		protected abstract IQueryBuilderView CreateView(IQueryBuilderUIViewModel model);
	}
	internal class ParametersSeeker : IClientCriteriaVisitor<bool>, ICriteriaVisitor<bool>
	{
		public static bool CheckForParameters(CriteriaOperator theOperator)
		{
			return theOperator.Accept<bool>((ICriteriaVisitor<bool>)new ParametersSeeker());
		}

		private ParametersSeeker()
		{
		}

		bool ICriteriaVisitor<bool>.Visit(BetweenOperator theOperator)
		{
			if (!Process(theOperator.BeginExpression) && !Process(theOperator.EndExpression))
			{
				return Process(theOperator.TestExpression);
			}
			return true;
		}

		bool ICriteriaVisitor<bool>.Visit(BinaryOperator theOperator)
		{
			if (!Process(theOperator.RightOperand))
			{
				return Process(theOperator.LeftOperand);
			}
			return true;
		}

		bool ICriteriaVisitor<bool>.Visit(UnaryOperator theOperator)
		{
			return Process(theOperator.Operand);
		}

		bool ICriteriaVisitor<bool>.Visit(InOperator theOperator)
		{
			return ProcessCollection(theOperator.Operands);
		}

		bool ICriteriaVisitor<bool>.Visit(GroupOperator theOperator)
		{
			return ProcessCollection(theOperator.Operands);
		}

		bool ICriteriaVisitor<bool>.Visit(OperandValue theOperand)
		{
			return theOperand is OperandParameter;
		}

		bool ICriteriaVisitor<bool>.Visit(FunctionOperator theOperator)
		{
			return ProcessCollection(theOperator.Operands);
		}

		bool IClientCriteriaVisitor<bool>.Visit(AggregateOperand theOperand)
		{
			if (!Process(theOperand.AggregatedExpression))
			{
				return Process(theOperand.Condition);
			}
			return true;
		}

		bool IClientCriteriaVisitor<bool>.Visit(OperandProperty theOperand)
		{
			return false;
		}

		bool IClientCriteriaVisitor<bool>.Visit(JoinOperand theOperand)
		{
			if (!Process(theOperand.AggregatedExpression) && !Process(theOperand.Condition))
			{
				return ProcessCollection(theOperand.CustomAggregateOperands);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool Process(CriteriaOperator criteriaOperator)
		{
			if (criteriaOperator != null)
			{
				return criteriaOperator.Accept<bool>((ICriteriaVisitor<bool>)this);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ProcessCollection(CriteriaOperatorCollection collecttion)
		{
			foreach (CriteriaOperator item in (List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)collecttion)
			{
				if (item.Accept<bool>((ICriteriaVisitor<bool>)this))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class ProviderLookupItem
	{
		public string ProviderKey { get; private set; }

		public string ProviderName { get; private set; }

		public IConnectionParametersStrategy Strategy { get; private set; }

		public ProviderLookupItem(string providerKey, string providerName, IConnectionParametersStrategy strategy)
		{
			ProviderKey = providerKey;
			ProviderName = providerName;
			Strategy = strategy;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return ProviderName;
		}

	public abstract class QueryBuilderRunnerBase
	{
		private readonly IDBSchemaProviderEx schemaProvider;

		private readonly SqlDataConnection connection;

		private readonly ICustomQueryValidator customQueryValidator;

		private readonly DBSchema dbSchema;

		private readonly ExpressionEditorContext expressionEditorContext;

		protected IParameterService ParameterService { get; }

		protected IEnumerable<IParameter> SourceParameters => ParameterService?.Parameters;

		protected bool EnableCustomSql { get; set; }

		internal SqlDataConnection Connection => connection;

		protected QueryBuilderRunnerBase(IDBSchemaProviderEx schemaProvider, DBSchema dbSchema, SqlDataConnection connection)
			: this(schemaProvider, dbSchema, connection, null, null, null)
		{
		}

		protected QueryBuilderRunnerBase(IDBSchemaProviderEx schemaProvider, DBSchema dbSchema, SqlDataConnection connection, IParameterService parameterService, ICustomQueryValidator customQueryValidator, ExpressionEditorContext context)
		{
			expressionEditorContext = context;
			this.dbSchema = dbSchema;
			ParameterService = parameterService;
			this.schemaProvider = schemaProvider;
			this.connection = connection;
			this.customQueryValidator = customQueryValidator;
		}

		public SqlQuery Edit(SqlQuery query)
		{
			if (query == null)
			{
				return Create();
			}
			QueryBuilderModel model = new QueryBuilderModel(query);
			return EditCore(model) ?? query;
		}

		public SqlQuery Create()
		{
			QueryBuilderModel model = new QueryBuilderModel(new SelectQuery());
			return EditCore(model);
		}

		protected abstract IQueryBuilderView CreateView(DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.QueryBuilder.QueryBuilderViewModel vm);

		private SqlQuery EditCore(QueryBuilderModel model)
		{
			DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.QueryBuilder.QueryBuilderViewModel vm = new DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.QueryBuilder.QueryBuilderViewModel(model);
			IQueryBuilderView view = CreateView(vm);
			try
			{
				vm.Initialize(schemaProvider, dbSchema, connection, SourceParameters, customQueryValidator, expressionEditorContext, EnableCustomSql);
				SqlQuery result = null;
				view.Ok += delegate
				{
					result = (model.SqlEditing ? ((SqlQuery)model.CustomSqlQuery) : ((SqlQuery)model.SelectQuery));
					string text = SqlQueryHelper.Validate(result, dbSchema, vm.SqlProviderLimitations, customQueryValidator, connection.ConnectionParameters, connection.IsSqlDataStore);
					if (text == null)
					{
						view.Stop();
					}
					else
					{
						result = null;
						view.ShowError(text);
					}
				};
				view.Start();
				return result;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (view != null)
				{
					view.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}
	}

		protected internal SqlWizardSettings(DataSourceWizardSettings internalSettings)
		{
			this.internalSettings = internalSettings;
			ResetCore();

		{
			ResetCore();
		}

		public SqlWizardOptions ToSqlWizardOptions()
		{
			SqlWizardOptions sqlWizardOptions = SqlWizardOptions.None;
			if (AlwaysSaveCredentials)
			{
				sqlWizardOptions |= SqlWizardOptions.AlwaysSaveCredentials;
			}
			if (DisableNewConnections)
			{
				sqlWizardOptions |= SqlWizardOptions.DisableNewConnections;
			}
			if (EnableCustomSql)
			{
				sqlWizardOptions |= SqlWizardOptions.EnableCustomSql;
			}
			if (QueryBuilderLight)
			{
				sqlWizardOptions |= SqlWizardOptions.QueryBuilderLight;
			}
			if (!QueryBuilderDiagramView)
			{
				sqlWizardOptions |= SqlWizardOptions.QueryBuilderTreeListView;
			}
			if (LegacyMasterDetailEditor)
			{
				sqlWizardOptions |= SqlWizardOptions.LegacyMasterDetailEditor;
			}
			if (MultiQueryWizard)
			{
				sqlWizardOptions |= SqlWizardOptions.MultiQueryWizard;
			}
			if (LegacyExpressionEditor)
			{
				sqlWizardOptions |= SqlWizardOptions.LegacyExpressionEditor;
			}
			return sqlWizardOptions;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (this == obj)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!(obj is SqlWizardSettings sqlWizardSettings))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (AlwaysSaveCredentials == sqlWizardSettings.AlwaysSaveCredentials && DisableNewConnections == sqlWizardSettings.DisableNewConnections && EnableCustomSql == sqlWizardSettings.EnableCustomSql && QueryBuilderLight == sqlWizardSettings.QueryBuilderLight && QueryBuilderDiagramView == sqlWizardSettings.QueryBuilderDiagramView && LegacyMasterDetailEditor == sqlWizardSettings.LegacyMasterDetailEditor && AvailableDataProviders == sqlWizardSettings.AvailableDataProviders)
			{
				return DatabaseCredentialsSavingBehavior == sqlWizardSettings.DatabaseCredentialsSavingBehavior;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return 0;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>(8);
			if (EnableCustomSql)
			{
				list.Add("EnableCustomSql = True");
			}
			if (DisableNewConnections)
			{
				list.Add("DisableNewConnections = True");
			}
			if (QueryBuilderLight)
			{
				list.Add("QueryBuilderLight = True");
			}
			if (!QueryBuilderDiagramView)
			{
				list.Add("QueryBuilderDiagramView = False");
			}
			if (LegacyMasterDetailEditor)
			{
				list.Add("LegacyMasterDetailEditor = True");
			}
			if (AvailableDataProviders != SqlDataProviders.All)
			{
				list.Add($"AvailableDataProviders = {AvailableDataProviders}");
			}
			if (DatabaseCredentialsSavingBehavior != SensitiveInfoSavingBehavior.Never)
			{
				list.Add($"DatabaseCredentialsSavingOptions = {DatabaseCredentialsSavingBehavior}");
			}
			if (!list.Any())
			{
				return "None";
			}
			return string.Join(", ", list);
		}

		internal List<ProviderLookupItem> GetProvidersList()
		{
			return (from pli in ProviderLookupItemHelper.GetPredefinedItems()
				where (pli.ProviderKey == "MSSqlServer" && availableDataProviders.HasFlag(SqlDataProviders.MSSqlServer)) || (pli.ProviderKey == "Access97" && availableDataProviders.HasFlag(SqlDataProviders.Access)) || (pli.ProviderKey == "Access2007" && availableDataProviders.HasFlag(SqlDataProviders.Access)) || (pli.ProviderKey == "MSSqlServerCE" && availableDataProviders.HasFlag(SqlDataProviders.MSSqlServerCE)) || (pli.ProviderKey == "Oracle" && availableDataProviders.HasFlag(SqlDataProviders.Oracle)) || (pli.ProviderKey == "Amazon Redshift" && availableDataProviders.HasFlag(SqlDataProviders.Redshift)) || (pli.ProviderKey == "BigQuery" && availableDataProviders.HasFlag(SqlDataProviders.BigQuery)) || (pli.ProviderKey == "Teradata" && availableDataProviders.HasFlag(SqlDataProviders.Teradata)) || (pli.ProviderKey == "Hana" && availableDataProviders.HasFlag(SqlDataProviders.Hana)) || (pli.ProviderKey == "Firebird" && availableDataProviders.HasFlag(SqlDataProviders.Firebird)) || (pli.ProviderKey == "DB2" && availableDataProviders.HasFlag(SqlDataProviders.DB2)) || (pli.ProviderKey == "MySql" && availableDataProviders.HasFlag(SqlDataProviders.MySql)) || (pli.ProviderKey == "Pervasive" && availableDataProviders.HasFlag(SqlDataProviders.Pervasive)) || (pli.ProviderKey == "Postgres" && availableDataProviders.HasFlag(SqlDataProviders.Postgres)) || (pli.ProviderKey == "Advantage" && availableDataProviders.HasFlag(SqlDataProviders.Advantage)) || (pli.ProviderKey == "Ase" && availableDataProviders.HasFlag(SqlDataProviders.Ase)) || (pli.ProviderKey == "Asa" && availableDataProviders.HasFlag(SqlDataProviders.Asa)) || (pli.ProviderKey == "SQLite" && availableDataProviders.HasFlag(SqlDataProviders.SQLite)) || (pli.ProviderKey == "VistaDB" && availableDataProviders.HasFlag(SqlDataProviders.VistaDB)) || (pli.ProviderKey == "VistaDB5" && availableDataProviders.HasFlag(SqlDataProviders.VistaDB)) || (pli.ProviderKey == "VistaDB6" && availableDataProviders.HasFlag(SqlDataProviders.VistaDB)) || (pli.ProviderKey == "InMemorySetFull" && availableDataProviders.HasFlag(SqlDataProviders.XmlFile)) || (pli.ProviderKey == "<Custom connection string>" && availableDataProviders.HasFlag(SqlDataProviders.CustomConnectionString))
				select pli).ToList();
		}

		private void ResetCore()
		{
			EnableCustomSql = false;
			AlwaysSaveCredentials = false;
			DisableNewConnections = false;
			QueryBuilderLight = false;
			QueryBuilderDiagramView = true;
			AvailableDataProviders = SqlDataProviders.All;
			LegacyMasterDetailEditor = false;
			DatabaseCredentialsSavingBehavior = SensitiveInfoSavingBehavior.Never;
		}

		private void SetPropertySafe(Action<SqlWizardSettings> setter)
		{
			setter((internalSettings != null) ? internalSettings.SqlWizardSettings : this);
		}

		private TOut GetPropertySafe<TOut>(Func<SqlWizardSettings, TOut> getter)
		{
			return getter((internalSettings != null) ? internalSettings.SqlWizardSettings : this);
		}
	}

		private MongoDBDataConnection Connection { get; }

		private IParameterEditorService ParameterEditorService { get; }

		public object[] Types => ParameterEditorService.GetParameterTypes("").Values.Cast<object>().ToArray();

		public object[] ExternalParameterExpressions => ParameterService?.Parameters.Select((IParameter p) => new Expression("?" + ((IFilterParameter)p).Name, ((IFilterParameter)p).Type)).Cast<object>().ToArray() ?? new object[0];

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		public MongoDBQueriesViewModel(MongoDBDataConnection connection, IList<MongoDBQuery> queries, IParameterService parameterService, IParameterEditorService parameterEditorService, Dictionary<string, string[]> serverSchema)
		{
			Connection = connection;
			ParameterEditorService = parameterEditorService;
			ParameterService = parameterService;
			Queries = new MongoDBQueryViewModelsList(queries?.Select((MongoDBQuery query) => new MongoDBQueryViewModel(MongoDBQuery.CopyWithoutSchema(query), parameterService, parameterEditorService, serverSchema)).ToList(), parameterService, parameterEditorService, serverSchema);
			DatabaseNames = serverSchema.Keys.ToList();
		}

		public void EditFilter(Func<IFilterView> createView, MongoDBQueryViewModel query)
		{
			if (!LaunchFilterEditor(createView, query, out var model))
			{
				return;
			}
			query.FilterString = model.FilterString;
			query.Parameters.Clear();
			foreach (DataSourceParameterBase parameter in model.Parameters)
			{
				query.Parameters.Add(ParameterViewModel.FromIParameter((IParameter)(object)parameter, ParameterService));
			}
			query.RaiseParametersChanged();
		}

		private bool LaunchFilterEditor(Func<IFilterView> createView, MongoDBQueryViewModel query, out FilterModel model)
		{
			string filterString = EFFilterHelper.PrependTableNames(new DBSetFilter(query.CollectionName, query.FilterString));
			model = new FilterModel(filterString, query.Parameters.Select(DevExpress.DataAccess.MongoDB.QueryParameter.FromIParameter));
			IFilterView view = createView();
			Type type;
			try
			{
				Connection.Open(CancellationToken.None);
				IMongoDBDatabase database = Connection.Client.GetDatabase(query.DatabaseName);
				type = database.GetCollectionElementType(query.CollectionName, CancellationToken.None).Type;
			}
			finally
			{
				Connection.Close();
			}
			MongoDBFilterPresenter mongoDBFilterPresenter = new MongoDBFilterPresenter(model, view, query.GetQuery(), type);
			((PresenterBase<FilterModel, IFilterView, MongoDBFilterPresenter>)mongoDBFilterPresenter).InitView();
			return ((PresenterBase<FilterModel, IFilterView, MongoDBFilterPresenter>)mongoDBFilterPresenter).Run();
		}

		protected virtual void OnPropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			this.PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
		}
	}
	public class MongoDBQueryViewModel : INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		private readonly ParametersGridViewModel parametersGridViewModel;

		private readonly Dictionary<string, string[]> serverSchema;

		public MongoDBQuery Query { get; }

		public BindingList<IParameterViewModel> Parameters => ParametersViewModel.Records;

		public IParametersGridViewModel ParametersViewModel => parametersGridViewModel;

		public string DatabaseName
		{
			get
			{
				return Query.DatabaseName;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(Query.DatabaseName == value))
				{
					Query.DatabaseName = value;
					CollectionName = Collections.FirstOrDefault();
					OnPropertyChanged("DatabaseName");
					OnPropertyChanged("Collections");
				}
			}
		}

		public string CollectionName
		{
			get
			{
				return Query.CollectionName;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(Query.CollectionName == value))
				{
					Query.CollectionName = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("CollectionName");
				}
			}
		}

		public string Alias
		{
			get
			{
				return Query.Alias;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(Query.Alias == value))
				{
					Query.Alias = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("Alias");
				}
			}
		}

		public string FilterString
		{
			get
			{
				return Query.FilterString;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(Query.FilterString == value))
				{
					Query.FilterString = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("FilterString");
				}
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable<string> Collections
		{
			get
			{
				if (DatabaseName == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				serverSchema.TryGetValue(DatabaseName, out var value);
				return value;
			}
		}

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		public MongoDBQueryViewModel(MongoDBQuery query, IParameterService parameterService, IParameterEditorService parameterEditorService, Dictionary<string, string[]> serverSchema)
		{
			Query = query ?? new MongoDBQuery();
			this.serverSchema = serverSchema;
			IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters = (IEnumerable<IParameter>)Query.Parameters;
			ParametersGridModel model = new ParametersGridModel(parameters ?? Enumerable.Empty<IParameter>());
			parametersGridViewModel = new ParametersGridViewModel(model, parameterService, parameterEditorService, () => (PreviewData)null, isFixedParameters: false);
		}

		public MongoDBQuery GetQuery()
		{
			MongoDBQuery mongoDBQuery = Query.Clone();
			mongoDBQuery.Parameters.Clear();
			IEnumerable<DevExpress.DataAccess.MongoDB.QueryParameter> collection = parametersGridViewModel.Records.Select((IParameterViewModel p) => new DevExpress.DataAccess.MongoDB.QueryParameter(((IFilterParameter)p).Name, ((IFilterParameter)p).Type, ((IParameter)p).Value));
			mongoDBQuery.Parameters.AddRange(collection);
			return mongoDBQuery;
		}

		public void OnRenameParameter(string name, string newName)
		{
			FilterString = EFFilterHelper.RenameParameter(FilterString, name, newName);
		}

		protected virtual void OnPropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			this.PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
		}

		public void RaiseParametersChanged()
		{
			this.PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs("Parameters"));
		}
	}
	public class MongoDBQueryViewModelsList : BindingList<MongoDBQueryViewModel>
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<string, string[]> serverSchema;

		private IParameterService ParameterService { get; }

		private IParameterEditorService ParameterEditorService { get; }

		public MongoDBQueryViewModelsList(IList<MongoDBQueryViewModel> list, IParameterService parameterService, IParameterEditorService parameterEditorService, Dictionary<string, string[]> serverSchema)
			: base(list)
		{
			ParameterEditorService = parameterEditorService;
			this.serverSchema = serverSchema;
			ParameterService = parameterService;
			base.AllowRemove = true;
			base.AllowNew = true;
		}

		protected override object AddNewCore()
		{
			MongoDBQueryViewModel mongoDBQueryViewModel = new MongoDBQueryViewModel(new MongoDBQuery(), ParameterService, ParameterEditorService, serverSchema);
			Add(mongoDBQueryViewModel);
			return mongoDBQueryViewModel;
		}
	}

	public class SqlQueryParameterCollection : List<QueryParameter>
	{
		public QueryParameter this[string name]
		{
			get
			{
				int num = FindIndex((QueryParameter q) => q.Name == name);
				if (num < 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("There is no parameters with name \"" + name + "\"");
				}
				return base[num];
			}
			set
			{
				Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)value, "parameter");
				int num = FindIndex((QueryParameter q) => q.Name == name);
				if (num < 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("There is no parameters with name \"" + name + "\"");
				}
				base[num] = value;
			}
		}

		public void AddRange(params QueryParameter[] values)
		{
			AddRange((IEnumerable<QueryParameter>)values);
		}
	}

	public abstract class AliasedBase : ColumnBase
	{
		[DefaultValue(null)]
		public string Alias { get; set; }

		public bool HasAlias => Alias != null;

		public virtual string ActualName => Alias;

		protected override bool EqualsCore(ColumnBase obj)
		{
			AliasedBase aliasedBase = (AliasedBase)obj;
			return Alias == aliasedBase.Alias;
		}
	}
	public sealed class AllColumns : ColumnBase
	{
		public Table Table { get; set; }

		protected override bool EqualsCore(ColumnBase obj)
		{
			AllColumns allColumns = (AllColumns)obj;
			return Table.EqualityComparer.Equals(Table, allColumns.Table);
		}
	}
	public sealed class Column : AliasedBase
	{
		public ExpressionBase Expression { get; set; }

		public override string ActualName
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(Expression is ColumnExpression columnExpression))
				{
					return base.ActualName;
				}
				return base.Alias ?? columnExpression.ColumnName;
			}
		}

		protected override bool EqualsCore(ColumnBase obj)
		{
			if (!base.EqualsCore(obj))
			{
				return false;
			}
			Column column = (Column)obj;
			return ExpressionBase.EqualityComparer.Equals(Expression, column.Expression);
		}
	}
	public abstract class ColumnBase
	{
		internal class EqualityComparer : IEqualityComparer<ColumnBase>
		{
			public static bool Equals(ColumnBase x, ColumnBase y)
			{
				if (x == y)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (x == null || y == null || x.GetType() != y.GetType())
				{
					return false;
				}
				return x.EqualsCore(y);
			}

			bool IEqualityComparer<ColumnBase>.Equals(ColumnBase x, ColumnBase y)
			{
				return Equals(x, y);
			}

			int IEqualityComparer<ColumnBase>.GetHashCode(ColumnBase obj)
			{
				return 0;
			}
		}

		protected abstract bool EqualsCore(ColumnBase obj);
	}
	public sealed class ColumnExpression : ExpressionBase
	{
		public Table Table { get; set; }

		public string ColumnName { get; set; }

		protected override bool EqualsCore(ExpressionBase obj)
		{
			if (!base.EqualsCore(obj))
			{
				return false;
			}
			ColumnExpression columnExpression = (ColumnExpression)obj;
			if (ColumnName == columnExpression.ColumnName)
			{
				return Table.EqualityComparer.Equals(Table, columnExpression.Table);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	[Obsolete("This class has become obsolete. Use the corresponding functionality of the SelectQuery class instead.")]
	public sealed class ColumnInfo
	{
		internal class EqualityComparer : IEqualityComparer<ColumnInfo>
		{
			public static bool Equals(ColumnInfo x, ColumnInfo y)
			{
				if (x == y)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (x == null || y == null || x.GetType() != y.GetType())
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (x.Aggregation == y.Aggregation && string.Equals(x.Name, y.Name, StringComparison.Ordinal))
				{
					return string.Equals(x.alias, y.alias, StringComparison.Ordinal);
				}
				return false;
			}

			bool IEqualityComparer<ColumnInfo>.Equals(ColumnInfo x, ColumnInfo y)
			{
				return Equals(x, y);
			}

			int IEqualityComparer<ColumnInfo>.GetHashCode(ColumnInfo obj)
			{
				return 0;
			}
		}

		private string alias;

		public string Name { get; set; }

		[DefaultValue(null)]
		public string Alias
		{
			get
			{
				return alias;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != null && value.Length == 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException();
				}
				alias = value;
			}
		}

		[DefaultValue(AggregationType.None)]
		public AggregationType Aggregation { get; set; }

		public bool HasAlias => alias != null;

		public string ActualName => alias ?? Name;

		public ColumnInfo(string name, AggregationType aggregation, string alias)
		{
			Name = name;
			this.alias = alias;
			Aggregation = aggregation;
		}

		public ColumnInfo(string name, string alias)
			: this(name, AggregationType.None, alias)
		{
		}

		public ColumnInfo(string name, AggregationType aggregation)
			: this(name, aggregation, null)
		{
		}

		public ColumnInfo(string name)
			: this(name, AggregationType.None, null)
		{
		}

		public ColumnInfo()
			: this(null, AggregationType.None, null)
		{
		}

		internal ColumnInfo(ColumnInfo other)
			: this(other.Name, other.Aggregation, other.alias)
		{
		}
	}

	[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.SqlDataSource.ConnectionOptions")]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter))]
	public sealed class ConnectionOptions : IConnectionOptions
	{
		private const string XML_CloseConnection = "CloseConnection";

		private const string XML_CommandTimeout = "CommandTimeout";

		private const string XML_DbCommandTimeout = "DbCommandTimeout";

		private const string XML_IsolationLevel = "IsolationLevel";

		[DefaultValue(true)]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.ConnectionOptions.CloseConnection")]
		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.ConnectionOptions.CloseConnection")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(BooleanTypeConverter))]
		public bool CloseConnection { get; set; }

		[DefaultValue(0)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DXHelpExclude(true)]
		public int CommandTimeout
		{
			get
			{
				return DbCommandTimeout.GetValueOrDefault();
			}
			set
			{
				DbCommandTimeout = ((value > 0) ? new int?(value) : ((int?)null));
			}
		}

		[DefaultValue(null)]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.ConnectionOptions.DbCommandTimeout")]
		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.ConnectionOptions.DbCommandTimeout")]
		public int? DbCommandTimeout { get; set; }

		[DefaultValue(SqlIsolationLevel.None)]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.ConnectionOptions.IsolationLevel")]
		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.ConnectionOptions.IsolationLevel")]
		public SqlIsolationLevel IsolationLevel { get; set; }

		bool IConnectionOptions.CloseConnection => CloseConnection;

		public ConnectionOptions()
		{
			CloseConnection = true;
			IsolationLevel = SqlIsolationLevel.None;
		}

		public ConnectionOptions(ConnectionOptions other)
		{
			Assign(other);
		}

		internal void SaveToXml(XElement options)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)options, "options");
			options.Add(new XAttribute("CloseConnection", CloseConnection));
			if (DbCommandTimeout.HasValue)
			{
				options.Add(new XAttribute("DbCommandTimeout", DbCommandTimeout.Value));
			}
			if (IsolationLevel != SqlIsolationLevel.None)
			{
				options.Add(new XAttribute("IsolationLevel", IsolationLevel));
			}
		}

		internal void LoadFromXml(XElement options)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)options, "options");
			CloseConnection = Convert.ToBoolean(options.GetAttributeValue("CloseConnection"));
			object attributeValue = options.GetAttributeValue("CommandTimeout");
			if (attributeValue != null)
			{
				int num = Convert.ToInt32(attributeValue);
				if (num > 0)
				{
					DbCommandTimeout = num;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				attributeValue = options.GetAttributeValue("DbCommandTimeout");
				if (attributeValue != null)
				{
					DbCommandTimeout = Convert.ToInt32(attributeValue);
				}
			}
			Enum.TryParse<SqlIsolationLevel>(options.GetAttributeValue("IsolationLevel")?.ToString(), out var result);
			IsolationLevel = result;
		}

		internal void Assign(ConnectionOptions other)
		{
			CloseConnection = other.CloseConnection;
			DbCommandTimeout = other.DbCommandTimeout;
			IsolationLevel = other.IsolationLevel;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeCommandTimeout()
		{
			return false;
		}
	}
	public sealed class CustomSqlQuery : SqlQuery
	{
		private class CustomSqlTypeConverter : TypeConverter
		{
			public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
			{
				if (sourceType == typeof(string))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
			}
		}

		private string sql;

		private static readonly int[] blackList = new int[4] { 76, 112, 192, 69 };

		[TypeConverter(typeof(CustomSqlTypeConverter))]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.CustomSqlQuery.Sql")]
		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.CustomSqlQuery.Sql")]
		[LocalizableCategory(DataAccessStringId.QueryPropertyGridCustomSqlCategoryName)]
		public string Sql
		{
			get
			{
				return sql;
			}
			set
			{
				sql = value;
			}
		}

		public CustomSqlQuery(string name, string sql)
			: base(name)
		{
			this.sql = sql;
		}

		public CustomSqlQuery()
			: this(string.Empty, string.Empty)
		{
		}

		internal CustomSqlQuery(CustomSqlQuery other)
			: base(other)
		{
			sql = other.sql;
		}

		public override void Validate()
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(sql))
			{
				throw new SqlStringEmptyValidationException();
			}
			bool flag = IsSqlValid(sql);
			ValidateCustomSqlQueryEventArgs e = new ValidateCustomSqlQueryEventArgs(this, flag);
			if (!flag)
			{
				e.ExceptionMessage = DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.CustomSqlQueryValidationException);
			}
			if (base.Owner?.DataSource != null)
			{
				SqlDataSource.RaiseValidateCustomSqlQueryGlobal(base.Owner.DataSource, e);
				base.Owner.DataSource.RaiseValidateCustomSqlQuery(e);
			}
			if (!e.Valid)
			{
				throw new CustomSqlQueryValidationException(e.ExceptionMessage);
			}
		}

		internal static bool IsSqlValid(string sql)
		{
			if (SqlDataSource.DisableCustomQueryValidation)
			{
				return true;
			}
			string text = sql.ToLowerInvariant();
			if (CheckSelectStatement(text) && CheckSeveralStatements(text))
			{
				return CheckBlackList(text);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool CheckSelectStatement(string sql)
		{
			using (SourceStringReader s = new SourceStringReader(sql))
			{
				using CommonSqlScanner commonSqlScanner = new CommonSqlScanner(s);
				Token token = commonSqlScanner.Scan();
				while (token.Type != 0)
				{
					if (token.Type == 8)
					{
						token = commonSqlScanner.Scan();
						continue;
					}
					return token.Type == 170;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool CheckSeveralStatements(string sql)
		{
			bool flag = true;
			using SourceStringReader s = new SourceStringReader(sql);
			using (CommonSqlScanner commonSqlScanner = new CommonSqlScanner(s))
			{
				Token token = commonSqlScanner.Scan();
				while (token.Type != 0)
				{
					if (!flag && token.Type != 8)
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (token.Type == 24)
					{
						flag = false;
					}
					token = commonSqlScanner.Scan();
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool CheckBlackList(string sql)
		{
			using (SourceStringReader s = new SourceStringReader(sql))
			{
				using CommonSqlScanner commonSqlScanner = new CommonSqlScanner(s);
				Token token = commonSqlScanner.Scan();
				while (token.Type != 0)
				{
					if (blackList.Contains(token.Type))
					{
						return false;
					}
					token = commonSqlScanner.Scan();
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override void Validate(DBSchema schema)
		{
			Validate();
		}

		internal override bool EqualsCore(SqlQuery obj)
		{
			CustomSqlQuery customSqlQuery = (CustomSqlQuery)obj;
			return string.Equals(sql, customSqlQuery.sql, StringComparison.Ordinal);
		}

		internal override SqlQuery Clone()
		{
			return new CustomSqlQuery(this);
		}
	}

	public class DBSchema
	{
		private const string xmlDBSchema = "DBSchema";

		private const string xmlTables = "Tables";

		private const string xmlViews = "Views";

		private const string xmlProcedures = "Procedures";

		internal const string xmlProcedure = "DBStoredProcedure";

		private DBTable[] tables;

		private DBTable[] views;

		private DBStoredProcedure[] storedProcedures;

		internal bool FullListOfViewsLoaded { get; set; }

		internal bool FullListOfTablesLoaded { get; set; }

		internal bool FullListOfProceduresLoaded { get; set; }

		public DBTable[] Tables => tables;

		public DBTable[] Views => views;

		public DBStoredProcedure[] StoredProcedures => storedProcedures;

		public DBSchema(DBTable[] tables, DBTable[] views, DBStoredProcedure[] storedProcedures)
		{
			this.storedProcedures = storedProcedures;
			this.tables = tables;
			this.views = views;
		}

		public DBSchema(DBStoredProcedure[] storedProcedures)
			: this(null, null, storedProcedures)
		{
		}

		public DBSchema(DBTable[] tables, DBTable[] views)
			: this(tables, views, null)
		{
		}

		public DBSchema()
		{
		}

		public void SaveToXml(Stream stream)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)stream, "stream");
			XElement xElement = new XElement("DBSchema");
			if (tables != null)
			{
				XElement xElement2 = new XElement("Tables");
				SaveToXml(xElement2, tables);
				xElement.Add(xElement2);
			}
			if (views != null)
			{
				XElement xElement3 = new XElement("Views");
				SaveToXml(xElement3, views);
				xElement.Add(xElement3);
			}
			if (storedProcedures != null)
			{
				XElement xElement4 = new XElement("Procedures");
				SaveToXml(xElement4, storedProcedures);
				xElement.Add(xElement4);
			}
			using XmlWriter writer = XmlWriter.Create(stream, new XmlWriterSettings
			{
				Encoding = Encoding.UTF8,
				Indent = true,
				CloseOutput = false
			});
			new XDocument(xElement).WriteTo(writer);
		}

		public void LoadFromXml(Stream stream)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)stream, "stream");
			XDocument xDocument;
			using (XmlTextReader xmlTextReader = SafeXml.CreateTextReader(stream))
			{
				xDocument = SafeXml.CreateXDocument((XmlReader)xmlTextReader, (Action<XmlReaderSettings>)null);
			}
			if (xDocument?.Root == null || xDocument.Root.Name != "DBSchema")
			{
				throw new XmlException();
			}
			XElement root = xDocument.Root;
			XElement xElement = root.Element("Tables");
			tables = (DBTable[])((xElement != null) ? ((Array)GetTables(xElement)) : ((Array)new DBTable[0]));
			XElement xElement2 = root.Element("Views");
			views = (DBTable[])((xElement2 != null) ? ((Array)GetTables(xElement2)) : ((Array)new DBTable[0]));
			XElement xElement3 = root.Element("Procedures");
			storedProcedures = (DBStoredProcedure[])((xElement3 != null) ? ((Array)GetProcedures(xElement3)) : ((Array)new DBStoredProcedure[0]));
		}

		private static DBTable[] GetTables(XElement element)
		{
			List<DBTable> list = new List<DBTable>();
			foreach (XElement item in element.Elements())
			{
				if (item.Name == "DBTable" || item.Name == "DBTableWithAlias")
				{
					list.Add(RestoreTableFromXml(item));
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private static DBStoredProcedure[] GetProcedures(XElement element)
		{
			List<DBStoredProcedure> list = new List<DBStoredProcedure>();
			foreach (XElement item in element.Elements())
			{
				if (item.Name == "DBStoredProcedure")
				{
					list.Add(RestoreProcedureFromXml(item));
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private static void SaveToXml(XElement element, IEnumerable<DBTable> tables)
		{
			foreach (DBTable table in tables)
			{
				SaveTableToXml(element, table);
			}
		}

		private static void SaveToXml(XElement element, IEnumerable<DBStoredProcedure> procedures)
		{
			foreach (DBStoredProcedure procedure in procedures)
			{
				SaveProcedureToXml(element, procedure);
			}
		}

		private static DBTable RestoreTableFromXml(XElement tableElement)
		{
			object obj = SafeXml.Deserialize(tableElement.CreateReader(), typeof(DBTable), (Type[])null);
			return (DBTable)((obj is DBTable) ? obj : null);
		}

		private static DBStoredProcedure RestoreProcedureFromXml(XElement storedProcElement)
		{
			object obj = SafeXml.Deserialize(storedProcElement.CreateReader(), typeof(DBStoredProcedure), (Type[])null);
			return (DBStoredProcedure)((obj is DBStoredProcedure) ? obj : null);
		}

		private static void SaveTableToXml(XElement element, DBTable table)
		{
			using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			SafeXml.Serialize((Stream)memoryStream, (object)table, ((object)table).GetType(), (Type[])null);
			memoryStream.Position = 0L;
			using XmlReader xmlReader = SafeXml.CreateReader((Stream)memoryStream);
			XElement content = SafeXml.CreateXElement(xmlReader, (Action<XmlReaderSettings>)null);
			element.Add(content);
		}

		private static void SaveProcedureToXml(XElement element, DBStoredProcedure procedure)
		{
			using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			SafeXml.Serialize((Stream)memoryStream, (object)procedure, ((object)procedure).GetType(), (Type[])null);
			memoryStream.Position = 0L;
			using XmlReader xmlReader = SafeXml.CreateReader((Stream)memoryStream);
			XElement content = SafeXml.CreateXElement(xmlReader, (Action<XmlReaderSettings>)null);
			element.Add(content);
		}
	}

	{
		internal class EqualityComparer
		{
			public static bool Equals(Join x, Join y)
			{
				if (x == y)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (x == null || y == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (x.SqlJoinType != y.SqlJoinType || x.KeyColumns.Count != y.KeyColumns.Count || !Table.EqualityComparer.Equals(x.Parent, y.Parent) || !Table.EqualityComparer.Equals(x.Nested, y.Nested))
				{
					return false;
				}
				using (IEnumerator<RelationColumnInfo> enumerator = y.KeyColumns.GetEnumerator())
				{
					foreach (RelationColumnInfo keyColumn in x.KeyColumns)
					{
						enumerator.MoveNext();
						if (!RelationColumnInfoBase.EqualityComparer.Equals(keyColumn, enumerator.Current))
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		}

		{
		}

		public MasterDetailInfo(string masterQueryName, string detailQueryName, IEnumerable<RelationColumnInfo> keyColumns)
			: this(masterQueryName, detailQueryName)
		{
			KeyColumns.AddRange(keyColumns);
		}

		public MasterDetailInfo(string masterQueryName, string detailQueryName, RelationColumnInfo keyColumn)
			: this(masterQueryName, detailQueryName)
		{
			KeyColumns.Add(keyColumn);
		}

		public MasterDetailInfo(string masterQueryName, string detailQueryName, string masterKeyColumn, string detailKeyColumn)
			: this(masterQueryName, detailQueryName, new RelationColumnInfo(masterKeyColumn, detailKeyColumn))
		{
		}

		internal MasterDetailInfo(IMasterDetailInfo other)
			: this(other.MasterQueryName, other.DetailQueryName)
		{
			if (other.HasCustomName)
			{
				customName = other.Name;
			}
			foreach (RelationColumnInfoBase keyColumn in other.KeyColumns)
			{
				KeyColumns.Add(new RelationColumnInfo(keyColumn));
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeName()
		{
			return HasCustomName;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return Name;
		}

		public string GetDetailedDescription()
		{
			int count = KeyColumns.Count;
			string text = DetailQueryName ?? "<null>";
			string text2 = MasterQueryName ?? "<null>";
			string[] array = new string[count];
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				RelationColumnInfo relationColumnInfo = KeyColumns[i];
				array[i] = text + "." + (relationColumnInfo.NestedKeyColumn ?? "<null>") + " = " + text2 + "." + (relationColumnInfo.ParentKeyColumn ?? "<null>");
			}
			return text2 + " master-detailed " + text + " on " + string.Join(" and ", array);
		}

		public string GenerateName()
		{
			return master + detail;
		}
	}

		[Description("Indicates the SQL data source to which the collection of master-detail relations belongs.")]

	public sealed class QueryParameter : DataSourceParameterBase
	{
		internal class EqualityComparer : IEqualityComparer<QueryParameter>
		{
			public static bool Equals(QueryParameter x, QueryParameter y)
			{
				if (x == y)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (x == null || y == null || x.GetType() != y.GetType())
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (string.Equals(x.Name, y.Name, StringComparison.Ordinal) && x.Type == y.Type)
				{
					return object.Equals(x.Value, y.Value);
				}
				return false;
			}

			bool IEqualityComparer<QueryParameter>.Equals(QueryParameter x, QueryParameter y)
			{
				return Equals(x, y);
			}

			int IEqualityComparer<QueryParameter>.GetHashCode(QueryParameter obj)
			{
				return 0;
			}
		}

		public QueryParameter()
			: this(null, typeof(string), null)
		{
		}

		public QueryParameter(string name, Type type, object value)
			: base(name, type, value)
		{
		}

		internal QueryParameter(IParameter other)
			: this(((IFilterParameter)other).Name, ((IFilterParameter)other).Type, other.Value)
		{
		}

		internal new static QueryParameter FromIParameter(IParameter value)
		{
			object obj;
			if (value != null)
			{
				obj = value as QueryParameter;
				if (obj == null)
				{
					return new QueryParameter(value);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				obj = null;
			}
			return (QueryParameter)obj;
		}
	}
