	public sealed class SelectQuery : SqlQuery
	{
		internal class Validator
		{
			private readonly SelectQuery query;

			private readonly bool hasSchema;

			private readonly Dictionary<string, DBTable> dbTables;

			private bool? aggregated;

			private Table[] tablesInOrder;

			public IEnumerable<Table> TablesInOrder => tablesInOrder;

			public Dictionary<string, CriteriaOperator> ColumnsParsed { get; }

			public List<CriteriaOperator> SortingParsed { get; }

			public List<CriteriaOperator> GroupingParsed { get; }

			public CriteriaOperator Filter { get; private set; }

			public CriteriaOperator GroupFilter { get; private set; }

			public Validator(SelectQuery query, bool hasSchema, DBSchema schema)
			{
				this.query = query;
				this.hasSchema = hasSchema;
				dbTables = (hasSchema ? schema.Tables.Union(schema.Views).ToDictionary((DBTable t) => t.Name) : null);
				ColumnsParsed = new Dictionary<string, CriteriaOperator>();
				SortingParsed = new List<CriteriaOperator>();
				GroupingParsed = new List<CriteriaOperator>();
			}

			public void Do()
			{
				tablesInOrder = null;
				ColumnsParsed.Clear();
				SortingParsed.Clear();
				GroupingParsed.Clear();
				Filter = null;
				GroupFilter = null;
				ValidateTables();
				ValidateRelations();
				ValidateColumns();
				ValidateSorting();
				ValidateGrouping();
				ValidateFilterString();
				ValidateGroupFilterString();
				ValidateTop();
				ValidateSkip();
			}

			public void BuildCache()
			{
				tablesInOrder = ResolveDependencies();
				ColumnsParsed.Clear();
				foreach (Column item in query.Columns.OfType<Column>())
				{
					if (item.Expression is CustomExpression expr)
					{
						CriteriaOperator value = TryParseExpr(expr);
						ColumnsParsed.Add(item.ActualName, value);
					}
				}
				SortingParsed.Clear();
				SortingParsed.AddRange(query.Sorting.Select((Sorting s) => s.Expression).OfType<CustomExpression>().Select(TryParseExpr));
				GroupingParsed.Clear();
				GroupingParsed.AddRange(query.Groups.Select((Group g) => g.Expression).OfType<CustomExpression>().Select(TryParseExpr));
				Filter = TryParseExpr(query.FilterString);
				GroupFilter = TryParseExpr(query.GroupFilterString);
				if (GroupFilter != null)
				{
					GroupFilter = GroupFilter.Accept<CriteriaOperator>((ICriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>)new HavingCriteriaPatcher(query.Columns, ColumnsParsed));
				}
			}

			internal Table[] ResolveDependencies()
			{
				if (SqlQueryHelper.ResolveDependencies(query.tables, query.relations, out var dependencies))
				{
					return dependencies.ToArray();
				}
				throw new CircularRelationsValidationException();
			}

			private CriteriaOperator TryParseExpr(CustomExpression expr)
			{
				CriteriaOperator innerOperator = TryParseExpr(expr.Expression);
				return SqlQueryHelper.CreateSubQueryContainer(innerOperator, expr.Aggregate);
			}

			private CriteriaOperator TryParseExpr(string expr)
			{
				try
				{
					return FilterHelper.GetFilter(expr, (IEnumerable<IParameter>)query.Parameters);
				}
				catch
				{
					return CriteriaOperator.op_Implicit(expr);
				}
			}

			private void ValidateTables()
			{
				HashSet<string> hashSet = new HashSet<string>();
				if (query.Tables.Count == 0)
				{
					throw new NoTablesValidationException();
				}
				foreach (Table table in query.Tables)
				{
					if (table == null)
					{
						throw new TableNullValidationException();
					}
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(table.Name))
					{
						throw new UnnamedTableValidationException();
					}
					if (!hashSet.Add(table.ActualName))
					{
						throw new DuplicatingTableNamesValidationException(table.ActualName);
					}
					if (hasSchema)
					{
						IDataStore val = query.Owner?.DataSource?.Connection?.DataStore;
						string text = (val as ISupportDefaultSchema)?.RemoveDefaultSchema(table.Name) ?? table.Name;
						if (!dbTables.ContainsKey(text))
						{
							throw new TableNotInSchemaValidationException(text);
						}
					}
				}
			}

			private void ValidateRelations()
			{
				HashSet<string> hashSet = new HashSet<string>(query.Tables.Select((Table t) => t.ActualName));
				foreach (Join relation in query.Relations)
				{
					if (relation == null)
					{
						throw new RelationNullValidationException();
					}
					if (relation.Parent == null || relation.Nested == null)
					{
						throw new IncompleteRelationValidationException(relation);
					}
					if (!query.Tables.Contains(relation.Parent))
					{
						throw new RelationTableNotSelectedValidationException(relation.Parent.ActualName);
					}
					if (!query.Tables.Contains(relation.Nested))
					{
						throw new RelationTableNotSelectedValidationException(relation.Nested.ActualName);
					}
					if (relation.KeyColumns.Count == 0)
					{
						throw new NoRelationColumnsValidationException(relation);
					}
					if (relation.KeyColumns.Contains(null))
					{
						throw new RelationColumnNullValidationException();
					}
					hashSet.Remove(relation.Nested.ActualName);
					if (!hasSchema)
					{
						continue;
					}
					DBTable table = dbTables[relation.Parent.Name];
					DBTable table2 = dbTables[relation.Nested.Name];
					foreach (RelationColumnInfo keyColumn in relation.KeyColumns)
					{
						DBColumn columnSafe = table.GetColumnSafe(keyColumn.ParentKeyColumn);
						if (columnSafe == null)
						{
							throw new RelationColumnNotInSchemaValidationException(relation.Parent.Name, keyColumn.ParentKeyColumn);
						}
						DBColumn columnSafe2 = table2.GetColumnSafe(keyColumn.NestedKeyColumn);
						if (columnSafe2 == null)
						{
							throw new RelationColumnNotInSchemaValidationException(relation.Nested.Name, keyColumn.NestedKeyColumn);
						}
					}
				}
				if (hashSet.Count > 1)
				{
					throw new TablesNotRelatedValidationException(hashSet.ToArray());
				}
				tablesInOrder = ResolveDependencies();
			}

			private void ValidateColumns()
			{
				if (query.Columns.Count == 0)
				{
					throw new NoColumnsValidationException();
				}
				HashSet<string> hashSet = new HashSet<string>();
				aggregated = null;
				foreach (ColumnBase column2 in query.Columns)
				{
					if (column2 == null)
					{
						throw new ColumnNullValidationException();
					}
					if (column2 is AliasedBase aliasedBase)
					{
						if (aliasedBase.ActualName == null)
						{
							throw new UnnamedColumnValidationException();
						}
						if (!hashSet.Add(aliasedBase.ActualName))
						{
							throw new DuplicatingColumnNamesValidationException(string.Empty, aliasedBase.ActualName);
						}
						Column column = aliasedBase as Column;
						if (column != null)
						{
							ValidateExpression(column.Expression, out var columnExpression, out var customExpressionOperator);
							if (column.Expression.Aggregate != AggregationType.None && !column.HasAlias)
							{
								throw new AggregationWithoutAliasValidationException();
							}
							if (columnExpression != null)
							{
								if (columnExpression.Aggregate == AggregationType.None && !query.Groups.Any((Group g) => g != null && ExpressionBase.EqualityComparer.Equals(g.Expression, column.Expression)))
								{
									if (aggregated == true)
									{
										throw new PartialAggregationValidationException();
									}
									aggregated = false;
								}
								else
								{
									if (aggregated == false)
									{
										throw new PartialAggregationValidationException();
									}
									aggregated = true;
								}
								if (hasSchema && dbTables[columnExpression.Table.Name].GetColumnSafe(columnExpression.ColumnName) == null)
								{
									throw new ColumnNotInSchemaValidationException(columnExpression.Table.Name, columnExpression.ColumnName);
								}
							}
							if (customExpressionOperator == null)
							{
								continue;
							}
							if (column.Expression.Aggregate != AggregationType.None)
							{
								if (aggregated == false)
								{
									throw new PartialAggregationValidationException();
								}
								aggregated = true;
							}
							Dictionary<string, string> tableActualNames = tablesInOrder.ToDictionary((Table tk) => tk.ActualName, (Table tn) => tn.Name);
							customExpressionOperator.Accept((ICriteriaVisitor)(object)new CustomExpressionValidatorVisitor(tableActualNames, dbTables, (IEnumerable<IParameter>)query.Parameters));
							ColumnsParsed.Add(aliasedBase.ActualName, customExpressionOperator);
						}
						else
						{
							if (!(aliasedBase is RecordsCount))
							{
								throw new InvalidOperationException($"Unknown column type: {column2.GetType()}");
							}
							if (aggregated == false)
							{
								throw new PartialAggregationValidationException();
							}
							aggregated = true;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						if (!(column2 is AllColumns allColumns))
						{
							throw new InvalidOperationException($"Unknown column type: {column2.GetType()}");
						}
						if (aggregated == true)
						{
							throw new PartialAggregationValidationException();
						}
						aggregated = false;
						if (allColumns.Table != null && !query.Tables.Contains(allColumns.Table))
						{
							throw new TableNotSelectedValidationException(allColumns.Table);
						}
					}
				}
			}

			private void ValidateSorting()
			{
				HashSet<ColumnExpression> hashSet = new HashSet<ColumnExpression>(new ExpressionBase.EqualityComparer());
				foreach (Sorting item in query.Sorting)
				{
					if (item == null)
					{
						throw new SortingNullValidationException();
					}
					ValidateExpression(item.Expression, out var columnExpression, out var customExpressionOperator);
					if (columnExpression != null)
					{
						bool? flag = aggregated;
						if (flag.HasValue)
						{
							if (flag == true)
							{
								if (columnExpression.Aggregate == AggregationType.None && !query.Groups.Any((Group g) => ExpressionBase.EqualityComparer.Equals(g.Expression, columnExpression)))
								{
									throw new AggregateQueryInvalidSortingValidationException(columnExpression.Table.ActualName, columnExpression.ColumnName);
								}
							}
							else if (columnExpression.Aggregate != AggregationType.None)
							{
								throw new SortByAggregateColumnValidationException(columnExpression);
							}
						}
						else
						{
							aggregated = columnExpression.Aggregate != AggregationType.None;
						}
						if (!hashSet.Add(columnExpression))
						{
							throw new SortingBySameColumnTwiceValidationException(columnExpression.Table.ActualName, columnExpression.ColumnName);
						}
					}
					if (customExpressionOperator == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (item.Expression.Aggregate != AggregationType.None)
					{
						if (aggregated == false)
						{
							throw new SortByAggregateColumnValidationException((CustomExpression)item.Expression);
						}
						aggregated = true;
					}
					SortingParsed.Add(customExpressionOperator);
				}
			}

			private void ValidateGrouping()
			{
				if (aggregated == false && query.Groups.Any())
				{
					throw new GroupByWithoutAggregateValidationException();
				}
				foreach (Group group in query.Groups)
				{
					if (group == null)
					{
						throw new GroupNullValidationException();
					}
					ValidateExpression(group.Expression, out var columnExpression, out var customExpressionOperator);
					if (columnExpression != null && columnExpression.Aggregate != AggregationType.None)
					{
						throw new GroupByAggregateColumnValidationException(columnExpression.Table.ActualName, columnExpression.ColumnName);
					}
					if (customExpressionOperator != null)
					{
						GroupingParsed.Add(customExpressionOperator);
					}
				}
			}

			private void ValidateFilterString()
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(query.FilterString))
				{
					return;
				}
				Exception innerException = null;
				try
				{
					Dictionary<string, string> tableActualNames = tablesInOrder.ToDictionary((Table tk) => tk.ActualName, (Table tn) => tn.Name);
					Filter = FilterHelper.GetFilter(query.FilterString, (IEnumerable<IParameter>)query.Parameters);
					Filter.Accept((ICriteriaVisitor)(object)new DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.FilterCriteriaValidatorVisitor(tableActualNames, dbTables, (IEnumerable<IParameter>)query.Parameters));
				}
				catch (ValidationException)
				{
					throw;
				}
				catch (Exception ex2)
				{
					Filter = null;
					innerException = ex2;
				}
				if (Filter != null)
				{
					return;
				}
				throw new InvalidExpressionStringValidationException(query.FilterString, innerException);
			}

			private void ValidateGroupFilterString()
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(query.GroupFilterString))
				{
					return;
				}
				if (query.Groups.Count == 0)
				{
					throw new HavingWithoutGroupByValidationException();
				}
				Exception innerException = null;
				try
				{
					Dictionary<string, string> tableActualNames = tablesInOrder.ToDictionary((Table tk) => tk.ActualName, (Table tn) => tn.Name);
					GroupFilter = FilterHelper.GetFilter(query.GroupFilterString, (IEnumerable<IParameter>)query.Parameters).Accept<CriteriaOperator>((ICriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>)new HavingCriteriaPatcher(query.Columns, ColumnsParsed));
					GroupFilter.Accept((ICriteriaVisitor)(object)new DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.FilterCriteriaValidatorVisitor(tableActualNames, dbTables, (IEnumerable<IParameter>)query.Parameters));
				}
				catch (ValidationException)
				{
					throw;
				}
				catch (Exception ex2)
				{
					GroupFilter = null;
					innerException = ex2;
				}
				if (GroupFilter != null)
				{
					return;
				}
				throw new InvalidExpressionStringValidationException(query.GroupFilterString, innerException);
			}

			private void ValidateTop()
			{
				if (query.Top < 0)
				{
					throw new NegativeTopSkipValidationException();
				}
			}

			private void ValidateSkip()
			{
				if (query.Skip < 0)
				{
					throw new NegativeTopSkipValidationException();
				}
				if (query.Skip != 0 && query.Sorting.Count == 0)
				{
					throw new SkipWithoutSortingValidationException();
				}
			}

			private void ValidateExpression(ExpressionBase expression, out ColumnExpression columnExpression, out CriteriaOperator customExpressionOperator)
			{
				if (expression == null)
				{
					throw new ExpressionNullValidationException();
				}
				ColumnExpression columnExpression2 = expression as ColumnExpression;
				if (columnExpression2 != null)
				{
					customExpressionOperator = null;
					if (columnExpression2.Table == null)
					{
						throw new TableNullValidationException();
					}
					if (!query.Tables.Contains(columnExpression2.Table))
					{
						throw new TableNotSelectedValidationException(columnExpression2.Table);
					}
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(columnExpression2.ColumnName))
					{
						throw new UnnamedColumnValidationException();
					}
					if (hasSchema && dbTables[columnExpression2.Table.Name].GetColumnSafe(columnExpression2.ColumnName) == null)
					{
						throw new ColumnNotInSchemaValidationException(columnExpression2.Table.Name, columnExpression2.ColumnName);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (!(expression is CustomExpression expression2))
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException($"Unknown column expression type: {expression.GetType()}");
					}
					customExpressionOperator = ValidateExpressionString(expression2);
				}
				columnExpression = columnExpression2;
			}

			private CriteriaOperator ValidateExpressionString(CustomExpression expression)
			{
				if (expression.Expression == null)
				{
					throw new ExpressionStringNullValidationException();
				}
				Exception innerException = null;
				CriteriaOperator val;
				try
				{
					val = FilterHelper.GetFilter(expression.Expression, (IEnumerable<IParameter>)query.Parameters);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					val = null;
					innerException = ex;
				}
				if (val == null)
				{
					throw new InvalidExpressionStringValidationException(expression.Expression, innerException);
				}
				if (expression.Aggregate != AggregationType.None)
				{
					val = SqlQueryHelper.CreateSubQueryContainer(val, expression.Aggregate);
				}
				return val;
			}
		}

		private readonly List<Table> tables;

		private readonly List<Join> relations;

		private readonly List<ColumnBase> columns;

		private readonly List<Sorting> sorting;

		private readonly List<Group> groups;

		private string filterString;

		private string groupFilterString;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		public IList<Table> Tables => tables;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		public IList<Join> Relations => relations;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		public IList<ColumnBase> Columns => columns;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		public IList<Sorting> Sorting => sorting;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		public IList<Group> Groups => groups;

		[DefaultValue(null)]
		[Editor("DevExpress.DataAccess.UI.Native.Sql.FilterStringEditor,DevExpress.DataAccess.v23.2.UI, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.SelectQuery.FilterString")]
		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.SelectQuery.FilterString")]
		[LocalizableCategory(DataAccessStringId.QueryPropertyGridTableSelectionCategoryName)]
		public string FilterString
		{
			get
			{
				return filterString;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(value == filterString))
				{
					filterString = value;
					ValidatorCache = null;
				}
			}
		}

		[DefaultValue(null)]

		public string GetSql(DBSchema schema)
		{
			if (!base.DataSource.Connection.IsConnected)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("The connection is not open.");
			}
			return SqlQueryHelper.BuildSql(this, schema, base.DataSource.Connection.SqlGeneratorFormatter);
		}

		public override void Validate()
		{
			ValidateCore(hasSchema: false, null);
		}

		public override void Validate(DBSchema schema)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)schema, "schema");
			ValidateCore(hasSchema: true, schema);
		}

		private void ValidateCore(bool hasSchema, DBSchema schema)
		{
			ValidatorCache = null;
			Validator validator = new Validator(this, hasSchema, schema);
			validator.Do();
			ValidatorCache = validator;
		}

		internal override bool EqualsCore(SqlQuery obj)
		{
			SelectQuery selectQuery = (SelectQuery)obj;
			if (Top != selectQuery.Top || Skip != selectQuery.Skip)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Tables.Count != selectQuery.Tables.Count || Relations.Count != selectQuery.Relations.Count || Columns.Count != selectQuery.Columns.Count || Sorting.Count != selectQuery.Sorting.Count || Groups.Count != selectQuery.Groups.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (FilterString != selectQuery.FilterString || GroupFilterString != selectQuery.GroupFilterString)
			{
				return false;
			}
			using (IEnumerator<Table> enumerator = selectQuery.Tables.GetEnumerator())
			{
				foreach (Table table in Tables)
				{
					enumerator.MoveNext();
					if (!Table.EqualityComparer.Equals(table, enumerator.Current))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			using (IEnumerator<Join> enumerator3 = selectQuery.Relations.GetEnumerator())
			{
				foreach (Join relation in Relations)
				{
					enumerator3.MoveNext();
					if (!Join.EqualityComparer.Equals(relation, enumerator3.Current))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			using (IEnumerator<ColumnBase> enumerator5 = selectQuery.Columns.GetEnumerator())
			{
				foreach (ColumnBase column in Columns)
				{
					enumerator5.MoveNext();
					if (!ColumnBase.EqualityComparer.Equals(column, enumerator5.Current))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			using (IEnumerator<Sorting> enumerator7 = selectQuery.Sorting.GetEnumerator())
			{
				foreach (Sorting item in Sorting)
				{
					enumerator7.MoveNext();
					if (!DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.Sorting.EqualityComparer.Equals(item, enumerator7.Current))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			using (IEnumerator<Group> enumerator9 = selectQuery.Groups.GetEnumerator())
			{
				foreach (Group group in Groups)
				{
					enumerator9.MoveNext();
					if (!Group.EqualityComparer.Equals(group, enumerator9.Current))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal override SqlQuery Clone()
		{
			return DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.QuerySerializer.LoadFromXml(DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.QuerySerializer.SaveToXml(this, null), null);
		}

	[TypeConverter(typeof(SqlJoinTypeTypeConverter))]
	public enum SqlJoinType
	{
		Inner,
		LeftOuter,
		RightOuter,
		FullOuter
	}
	public static class SqlJoinTypeExtensions
	{
		public static JoinType ToXpoJoinType(this SqlJoinType joinType)
		{
			if (joinType != SqlJoinType.LeftOuter)
			{
				return (JoinType)0;
			}
			return (JoinType)1;
		}
	}

			: base(table, alias, type.ToXpoJoinType())
		{
			//IL_0004: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			SqlJoinType = type;
		}
	}
	public sealed class Sorting
	{
		internal class EqualityComparer : IEqualityComparer<Sorting>
		{
			public static bool Equals(Sorting x, Sorting y)
			{
				if (x == y)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (x == null || y == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (x.Direction == y.Direction)
				{
					return ExpressionBase.EqualityComparer.Equals(x.Expression, y.Expression);
				}
				return false;
			}

			bool IEqualityComparer<Sorting>.Equals(Sorting x, Sorting y)
			{
				return Equals(x, y);
			}

			int IEqualityComparer<Sorting>.GetHashCode(Sorting obj)
			{
				return 0;
			}
		}

		public ExpressionBase Expression { get; set; }

		[DefaultValue(ListSortDirection.Ascending)]
		public ListSortDirection Direction { get; set; }
	}

	public sealed class SortingInfoList : List<SortingInfo>
	{
		internal class EqualityComparer : IEqualityComparer<SortingInfoList>
		{
			public static bool Equals(SortingInfoList x, SortingInfoList y)
			{
				if (x == y)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (x == null || y == null || x.GetType() != y.GetType())
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (x.Count != y.Count)
				{
					return false;
				}
				using (Enumerator enumerator = x.GetEnumerator())
				{
					using Enumerator enumerator2 = y.GetEnumerator();
					while (enumerator.MoveNext() && enumerator2.MoveNext())
					{
						if (!SortingInfo.EqualityComparer.Equals(enumerator.Current, enumerator2.Current))
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
				}
				return true;
			}

			bool IEqualityComparer<SortingInfoList>.Equals(SortingInfoList x, SortingInfoList y)
			{
				return Equals(x, y);
			}

			int IEqualityComparer<SortingInfoList>.GetHashCode(SortingInfoList obj)
			{
				return 0;
			}
		}

		}

	[Editor("DevExpress.DataAccess.UI.Native.Sql.QueryEditor, DevExpress.DataAccess.v23.2.UI, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	public abstract class SqlQuery : IQuery
	{
		internal abstract class EqualityComparer : IEqualityComparer<SqlQuery>
		{
			public static bool Equals(SqlQuery x, SqlQuery y)
			{
				return Equals(x, y, checkName: true);
			}

			public static bool Equals(SqlQuery x, SqlQuery y, bool checkName)
			{
				if (x == y)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (x == null || y == null || x.GetType() != y.GetType())
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (checkName && !string.Equals(x.name, y.name, StringComparison.Ordinal))
				{
					return false;
				}
				int count = x.Parameters.Count;
				if (y.Parameters.Count != count)
				{
					return false;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					if (!QueryParameter.EqualityComparer.Equals(x.Parameters[i], y.Parameters[i]))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return x.EqualsCore(y);
			}

			bool IEqualityComparer<SqlQuery>.Equals(SqlQuery x, SqlQuery y)
			{
				return Equals(x, y);
			}

			int IEqualityComparer<SqlQuery>.GetHashCode(SqlQuery obj)
			{
				return 0;
			}
		}

		{

			}
		}

		{
			get

				return sqlQueryCollection;
			}

				sqlQueryCollection = value;
			}
		}

			set

			}
		}

		protected SqlQuery(string name)
		{
			Parameters = new SqlQueryParameterCollection();
			this.name = name;
		}

		protected SqlQuery(SqlQuery other)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)other, "other");
			name = other.name;
			Parameters = new SqlQueryParameterCollection();
			foreach (QueryParameter parameter in other.Parameters)
			{
				Parameters.Add(new QueryParameter((IParameter)(object)parameter));
			}
			if (other.Meta != null)
			{
				Meta = other.Meta.Clone();
			}
			IsolationLevel = other.IsolationLevel;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeParameters()
		{
			return Parameters.Count > 0;
		}

		public abstract void Validate();

		public abstract void Validate(DBSchema schema);

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Name))
			{
				return Name;
			}
			return base.ToString();
		}

		internal abstract bool EqualsCore(SqlQuery obj);

		internal abstract SqlQuery Clone();

		private bool ShouldSerializeMetaSerializable()
		{
			if (Meta != null)
			{
				return !Meta.IsEmpty;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	public class SqlDataConnection : DataConnectionBase, INamedItem, IDisposable, IDataConnection
	{

		protected DBSchema dbSchema;

		private readonly ConnectionOptions connectionOptions = new ConnectionOptions();

		private IDBConnectionInterceptor dbConnectionInterceptor;

		[Description("Specifies the connection string of the SqlDataConnection.")]
		public override string ConnectionString { get; set; }

		public override string ConnectionStringSerializable
		{

					return connectionStringSerializable;

		[Browsable(false)]

			set

				if (xElement != null)

					LoadParametersFromXml(xElement);
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Provides access to the data connection parameters of the SqlDataConnection.")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(ExpandableObjectConverter))]
		public DataConnectionParametersBase ConnectionParameters

				return connectionParameters;

			}

		internal IDataStoreSchemaExplorer SchemaExplorer => (IDataStoreSchemaExplorer)DataStore;

		internal Dictionary<string, string> Parameters { get; } = new Dictionary<string, string>();

		internal ISqlGeneratorFormatter SqlGeneratorFormatter
		{

		internal bool IsSqlDataStore => DataStore is ISqlDataStore;

		[Description("Indicates whether or not the data connection is currently active.")]

		private Dictionary<string, string> ActualParameters
		{
			get
			{
				Dictionary<string, string> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, string>(Parameters);
				if (!dictionary.ContainsKey("userid"))
				{
					dictionary.Add("userid", userId ?? string.Empty);
				}
				if (!dictionary.ContainsKey("password"))
				{
					dictionary.Add("password", password ?? string.Empty);
				}
				return dictionary;
			}
		}

		internal SqlDataSource SqlDataSource { get; set; }

		internal ConnectionOptions ConnectionOptions
		{

				if (SqlDataSource == null)

		internal IDBConnectionInterceptor DBConnectionInterceptor => SqlDataSource?.DBConnectionInterceptor ?? dbConnectionInterceptor;

		internal bool HasSensitiveInfo
		{

		protected internal override void SaveToXml(XElement element)
		{
			if (base.StoreConnectionNameOnly)
			{
				element.Add(new XAttribute("Name", base.Name));
				element.Add(new XAttribute("FromAppConfig", base.StoreConnectionNameOnly));
				return;
			}
			base.SaveToXml(element);
			if (ShouldSerializeProviderKey())
			{
				element.Add(new XAttribute("ProviderKey", ProviderKey));
			}
			XElement xElement = SaveParametersToXml();
			if (xElement != null)
			{
				element.Add(xElement);
			}
		}

		private XElement SaveParametersToXml()
		{
			if (ShouldSerializeParameters())
			{
				XElement xElement = new XElement("Parameters");
				{
					foreach (KeyValuePair<string, string> parameter in Parameters)
					{
						XElement xElement2 = new XElement("Parameter");
						xElement2.Add(new XAttribute("Name", parameter.Key));
						xElement2.Add(new XAttribute("Value", parameter.Value));
						xElement.Add(xElement2);
					}
					return xElement;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override DBSchema GetDBSchema()
		{
			return GetDBSchema(loadColumns: true);
		}

		public override DBSchema GetDBSchema(string[] tableList)
		{
			GetTables(loadColumns: true, tableList);
			GetViews(loadColumns: true, tableList);
			return dbSchema;
		}

		internal DBStoredProcedure[] GetProcedures(params string[] storedProcedures)
		{
			dbSchema = dbSchema ?? new DBSchema();
			List<DBStoredProcedure> procedures = new List<DBStoredProcedure>((IEnumerable<DBStoredProcedure>)(((object)dbSchema.StoredProcedures) ?? ((object)new DBStoredProcedure[0])));
			List<DBStoredProcedure> list = procedures.Where((DBStoredProcedure t) => storedProcedures.Length == 0 || storedProcedures.Contains(t.Name)).ToList();
			if (!dbSchema.FullListOfProceduresLoaded && (storedProcedures.Length == 0 || !storedProcedures.All((string p) => procedures.Select((DBStoredProcedure t) => t.Name).Contains(p))))
			{
				string[] storedProcedures2 = storedProcedures.Except(procedures.Select((DBStoredProcedure p) => p.Name)).ToArray();
				IEnumerable<DBStoredProcedure> proceduresCore = GetProceduresCore(storedProcedures2);
				procedures.AddRange(proceduresCore);
				list.AddRange(proceduresCore);
				dbSchema = new DBSchema(dbSchema.Tables, dbSchema.Views, procedures.ToArray())
				{
					FullListOfTablesLoaded = dbSchema.FullListOfTablesLoaded,
					FullListOfViewsLoaded = dbSchema.FullListOfViewsLoaded,
					FullListOfProceduresLoaded = (storedProcedures.Length == 0)
				};
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private DBStoredProcedure[] GetProceduresCore(string[] storedProcedures)
		{
			if (!(CheckSchemaExplorer() is ISupportStoredProc supportStoredProc))
			{
				return (DBStoredProcedure[])(object)new DBStoredProcedure[0];
			}
			return supportStoredProc.GetStoredProcedures(ConnectionOptions, storedProcedures);
		}

		internal DBTable[] GetTables(bool loadColumns, params string[] tableList)
		{
			dbSchema = dbSchema ?? new DBSchema();
			DBTable[] tables = (DBTable[])(((object)dbSchema.Tables) ?? ((object)new DBTable[0]));
			if (!dbSchema.FullListOfTablesLoaded && (tableList.Length == 0 || !tableList.All((string p) => tables.Select((DBTable t) => t.Name).Contains(p))))
			{
				string[] tableList2 = tableList.Except(tables.Select((DBTable p) => p.Name)).ToArray();
				tables = tables.Union(GetTablesCore(tableList2, loadColumns)).ToArray();
				dbSchema = new DBSchema(tables, dbSchema.Views, dbSchema.StoredProcedures)
				{
					FullListOfTablesLoaded = (tableList.Length == 0),
					FullListOfViewsLoaded = dbSchema.FullListOfViewsLoaded,
					FullListOfProceduresLoaded = dbSchema.FullListOfProceduresLoaded
				};
			}
			ISupportDefaultSchema supportDefaultSchema = DataStore as ISupportDefaultSchema;
			return tables.Where((DBTable t) => tableList.Length == 0 || tableList.Select((string n) => (supportDefaultSchema == null) ? n : supportDefaultSchema.RemoveDefaultSchema(n)).Contains(t.Name)).ToArray();
		}

		private DBTable[] GetTablesCore(string[] tableList, bool loadColumns)
		{
			IDataStoreSchemaExplorer val = CheckSchemaExplorer();
			ISqlSchemaExplorer sqlSchemaExplorer = val as ISqlSchemaExplorer;
			tableList = tableList ?? new string[0];
			if (sqlSchemaExplorer != null)
			{
				return sqlSchemaExplorer.GetStorageTables(loadColumns, ConnectionOptions, tableList);
			}
			string[] array = ((tableList.Length == 0) ? val.GetStorageTablesList(false) : tableList);
			return val.GetStorageTables(array);
		}

		internal DBTable[] GetViews(bool loadColumns, params string[] viewList)
		{
			dbSchema = dbSchema ?? new DBSchema();
			DBTable[] views = (DBTable[])(((object)dbSchema.Views) ?? ((object)new DBTable[0]));
			if (!dbSchema.FullListOfViewsLoaded && (viewList.Length == 0 || !viewList.All((string p) => views.Select((DBTable t) => t.Name).Contains(p))))
			{
				string[] viewList2 = viewList.Except(views.Select((DBTable p) => p.Name)).ToArray();
				views = views.Union(GetViewsCore(viewList2, loadColumns)).ToArray();
				dbSchema = new DBSchema(dbSchema.Tables, views, dbSchema.StoredProcedures)
				{
					FullListOfTablesLoaded = dbSchema.FullListOfTablesLoaded,
					FullListOfViewsLoaded = (viewList.Length == 0),
					FullListOfProceduresLoaded = dbSchema.FullListOfProceduresLoaded
				};
			}
			return views.Where((DBTable t) => viewList.Length == 0 || viewList.Contains(t.Name)).ToArray();
		}

		private DBTable[] GetViewsCore(string[] viewList, bool loadColumns)
		{
			IDataStoreSchemaExplorer val = CheckSchemaExplorer();
			ISqlSchemaExplorer sqlSchemaExplorer = val as ISqlSchemaExplorer;
			viewList = viewList ?? new string[0];
			if (sqlSchemaExplorer != null)
			{
				return sqlSchemaExplorer.GetStorageViews(loadColumns, ConnectionOptions, viewList);
			}
			string[] array = ((viewList.Length == 0) ? val.GetStorageTablesList(true) : viewList);
			DBTable[] storageTables = val.GetStorageTables(array);
			return storageTables.Where((DBTable o) => o.IsView).ToArray();
		}

		public DBSchema GetDBSchema(bool loadColumns)
		{
			return GetDBSchema(loadColumns, SchemaLoadingMode.TablesAndViews);
		}

		public DBSchema GetDBSchema(bool loadColumns, SchemaLoadingMode schemaLoadingMode)
		{
			if (schemaLoadingMode.HasFlag(SchemaLoadingMode.TablesAndViews))
			{
				GetTables(loadColumns);
				GetViews(loadColumns);
			}
			if (schemaLoadingMode.HasFlag(SchemaLoadingMode.StoredProcedures))
			{
				GetProcedures();
			}
			return dbSchema;
		}

		public void LoadDBColumns(params DBTable[] tables)
		{
			IDataStoreSchemaExplorer val = CheckSchemaExplorer();
			if (val is ISqlSchemaExplorer sqlSchemaExplorer)
			{
				sqlSchemaExplorer.GetColumns(ConnectionOptions, tables);
			}
		}

		internal void DropDBSchemaCache()
		{
			dbSchema = null;
		}

		private IDataStoreSchemaExplorer CheckSchemaExplorer()
		{
			IDataStoreSchemaExplorer schemaExplorer = SchemaExplorer;
			if (schemaExplorer == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("The connection is not open.");
			}
			return schemaExplorer;
		}

		protected internal override void LoadFromXml(XElement element)
		{
			base.LoadFromXml(element);
			string attributeValue = element.GetAttributeValue("FromAppConfig");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(attributeValue) && StringExtensions.CompareInvariantCultureIgnoreCase(attributeValue, bool.TrueString) == 0)
			{
				base.StoreConnectionNameOnly = true;
				return;
			}
			string attributeValue2 = element.GetAttributeValue("ProviderKey");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(attributeValue2))
			{
				ProviderKey = attributeValue2;
			}
			XElement xElement = element.Element("Parameters");
			if (xElement != null)
			{
				LoadParametersFromXml(xElement);
			}
		}

		private void LoadParametersFromXml(XElement parametersElement)
		{
			ConnectionString = null;
			Parameters.Clear();
			foreach (XElement item in parametersElement.Elements("Parameter"))
			{
				string attributeValue = item.GetAttributeValue("Name");
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(attributeValue))
				{
					throw new XmlException();
				}
				string attributeValue2 = item.GetAttributeValue("Value");
				if (attributeValue2 == null)
				{
					throw new XmlException();
				}
				Parameters.Add(attributeValue, attributeValue2);
			}
		}

		protected override void ApplyParameters(DataConnectionParametersBase dataConnectionParameters, bool serializeCustomConnStrCredentials)
		{
			CustomStringConnectionParameters customStringConnectionParameters = dataConnectionParameters as CustomStringConnectionParameters;
			if (customStringConnectionParameters == null)
			{
				string keyByItem = DataConnectionParametersRepository.Instance.GetKeyByItem(dataConnectionParameters);
				dataConnectionParameters.Factory = DataConnectionHelper.GetProviderFactory(keyByItem);
				Parameters.Clear();
				Dictionary<string, string> paramsDict = DataAccessConnectionParameter.GetParamsDict(dataConnectionParameters);
				foreach (KeyValuePair<string, string> item in paramsDict)
				{
					if (item.Key == "password")
					{
						password = item.Value;
					}
					else if (item.Key == "userid")
					{
						userId = item.Value;
					}
					else
					{
						Parameters.Add(item.Key, item.Value ?? string.Empty);
					}
				}
				Factory = dataConnectionParameters.Factory;
				ConnectionString = string.Empty;
			}
			base.ApplyParameters(dataConnectionParameters, serializeCustomConnStrCredentials);
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				Close();
				if (objectsToDispose != null)
				{
					foreach (IDisposable item in objectsToDispose.Where((IDisposable obj) => obj != null))
					{
						item.Dispose();
					}
					objectsToDispose = null;
				}
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		protected override void CreateDataStoreInternal()
		{
			//IL_0033: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0045: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			dataStore = GetNewDataStore(out objectsToDispose);
			if (dataStore is ISqlDataStore)
			{
				IDataStore obj = dataStore;
				ISqlDataStore val = (ISqlDataStore)(object)((obj is ISqlDataStore) ? obj : null);
				val.ConnectionOpening += (ConnectionOpeningEventHandler)delegate(object o, ConnectionOpeningEventArgs e)
				{
					DBConnectionInterceptor?.ConnectionOpening(base.Name, e.Connection);
				};
				val.ConnectionOpened += (ConnectionOpenedEventHandler)delegate(object o, ConnectionOpenedEventArgs e)
				{
					DBConnectionInterceptor?.ConnectionOpened(base.Name, e.Connection);
				};
			}
		}

		internal IDataStore GetNewDataStore(out IDisposable[] toDispose)
		{
			if (base.HasConnectionString)
			{
				DataConnectionHelper.RegisterProviders();
				return DataConnectionHelper.GetConnectionProvider(ConnectionString, (AutoCreateOption)3, out toDispose);
			}
			if (Factory == null)
			{
				throw new CannotFindAppropriateConnectionProviderException(ConnectionString);
			}
			return Factory.CreateProvider(ActualParameters, (AutoCreateOption)3, ref toDispose);
		}

		public override void Close()
		{
			if (IsConnected)
			{
				CloseDbConnection();
				if (DataStore is IDisposable disposable)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
				dataStore = null;
			}
		}

		internal void CloseDbConnection()
		{
			IDataStore obj = DataStore;
			IDataStore obj2 = ((obj is ISqlDataStore) ? obj : null);
			if (obj2 != null)
			{
				((ISqlDataStore)obj2).Connection?.Close();
			}
		}

		public override DataConnectionParametersBase CreateDataConnectionParameters()
		{
			return base.HasConnectionString ? new CustomStringConnectionParameters(ConnectionString) : DataConnectionHelper.CreateDataConnectionParameters(Factory, ActualParameters);
		}

		public override string CreateConnectionString()
		{
			return CreateConnectionString(blackoutCredentials: false);
		}

		public string CreateConnectionString(bool blackoutCredentials)
		{
			if (base.HasConnectionString)
			{
				if (!blackoutCredentials)
				{
					return ConnectionString;
				}
				return DataConnectionHelper.ClearConnectionString(ConnectionString);
			}
			if (Factory == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			DataConnectionParametersBase dataConnectionParametersBase = DataConnectionHelper.CreateDataConnectionParameters(Factory, ActualParameters);
			if (blackoutCredentials)
			{
				DataConnectionHelper.ObscureCredentials(dataConnectionParametersBase, keepUserName: false);
			}
			Dictionary<string, string> paramsDict = DataAccessConnectionParameter.GetParamsDict(dataConnectionParametersBase);
			return Factory.GetConnectionString(paramsDict);
		}

		public void BlackoutCredentials()
		{
			DataConnectionHelper.ObscureCredentials(ConnectionParameters, keepUserName: false);
			ApplyParameters(ConnectionParameters, serializeCustomConnStrCredentials: true);
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeProviderKey()
		{
			if (!base.HasConnectionString)
			{
				return Factory != null;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeParameters()
		{
			return !base.HasConnectionString;
		}

		internal bool IsStoredProceduresSupported()
		{
			if (!IsConnected)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("The connection is not open.");
			}
			return DataStore is ISupportStoredProc;
		}

		internal void ClearCredentials(bool keepUserName)
		{
			if (base.HasConnectionString)
			{
				ConnectionStringSerializable = DataConnectionHelper.ClearConnectionString(ConnectionString);
			}
			ConnectionParameters?.ClearCredentials(keepUserName);
		}

		internal void AssignCredentials(SqlDataConnection targetConnection)
		{
			password = targetConnection.password;
			userId = targetConnection.userId;
			ConnectionString = targetConnection.ConnectionString;
			ConnectionStringSerializable = targetConnection.ConnectionStringSerializable;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}
	}

	[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "PropertyNamesRes", "DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.SqlDataSource", "SqlDataSource")]
	[Description("A component for quick binding to SQL data sources.")]
	[ToolboxTabName("DX.23.2: Data & Analytics")]
	[DXToolboxItem(true)]
	public class SqlDataSource : DataComponentBase, IListSource, IDataConnectionParametersService, IListAdapterAsync2, IListAdapterAsync, IListAdapter, IListAdapter2, ISupportFillAsync, IDynamicLookupSettingsDataProvider
	{
		private class ConnectionParametersTypeConverter : ObscuredTypeConverter
		{
			private class CustomConnectionStringPropertyDescriptor : DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.ReadOnlyPropertyDescriptor
			{
				public CustomConnectionStringPropertyDescriptor(PropertyDescriptor parent)
					: base(parent)
				{
				}

				public override object GetValue(object component)
				{
					string connectionString = (string)base.GetValue(component);
					return DataConnectionHelper.ObscureConnectionString(connectionString);
				}
			}

			private class PasswordPropertyDescriptor : ObscuredPropertyDescriptor
			{
				public PasswordPropertyDescriptor(PropertyDescriptor original)
					: base(original)
				{
				}

				public override object GetValue(object component)
				{
					IConnectionPage connectionPage = (IConnectionPage)component;
					if (connectionPage.AuthType)
					{
						return string.Empty;
					}
					return base.GetValue(component);
				}
			}

			protected override PropertyDescriptor ProcessProperty(PropertyDescriptor property)
			{
				if (property.Name == "ConnectionString")
				{
					return new CustomConnectionStringPropertyDescriptor(property);
				}
				if (property.Name == "Password")
				{
					return new PasswordPropertyDescriptor(property);
				}
				return new DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.ReadOnlyPropertyDescriptor(base.ProcessProperty(property));
			}

			public override bool GetPropertiesSupported(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
			{
				return ((SqlDataSource)(context?.Instance))?.ConnectionParameters != null;
			}
		}

		private class ExpressionReplacingCriteriaOperatorPatcher : ClientCriteriaVisitorBase, IQueryCriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>, ICriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>
		{
			private readonly SelectQuery query;

			private readonly ColumnDescription[] columns;

			public ExpressionReplacingCriteriaOperatorPatcher(SelectQuery query, ColumnDescription[] columns)
			{
				this.query = query;
				this.columns = columns;
			}

			protected override CriteriaOperator Visit(OperandProperty theOperand)
			{
				//IL_0086: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_008c: Expected O, but got Unknown
				//IL_00ec: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_00f2: Expected O, but got Unknown
				Column column = query.Columns.OfType<Column>().FirstOrDefault((Column c) => c.ActualName == theOperand.PropertyName);
				if (column != null)
				{
					if (column.Expression is CustomExpression customExpression)
					{
						return FilterHelper.GetCriteriaOperator(customExpression.Expression, (IEnumerable<IParameter>)query.Parameters);
					}
					ColumnExpression columnExpression = (ColumnExpression)column.Expression;
					return (CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty(columnExpression.Table.ActualName + "." + columnExpression.ColumnName);
				}
				ColumnDescription? columnDescription = columns?.FirstOrDefault((ColumnDescription c) => c.Name == theOperand.PropertyName);
				if (columnDescription.HasValue)
				{
					return (CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty(columnDescription.Value.ActualTableName + "." + columnDescription.Value.Name);
				}
				return (CriteriaOperator)(object)theOperand;
			}

			CriteriaOperator IQueryCriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>.Visit(QueryOperand theOperand)
			{
				return (CriteriaOperator)(object)theOperand;
			}

			CriteriaOperator IQueryCriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>.Visit(QuerySubQueryContainer theOperand)
			{
				return (CriteriaOperator)(object)theOperand;
			}

			public CriteriaOperator Process(CriteriaOperator criteriaOperator)
			{
				return ((ClientCriteriaVisitorBase)this).Process(criteriaOperator);
			}
		}

		private static object ResolveQueryFromSqlDataSource(SqlDataSource dataSource, string dataMember)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMember))
			{
				return dataSource.Result;
			}
			return dataSource.Result[dataMember];
		}

		private static void ThrowAggregateExceptionIfNeeded(Exception[] exceptions, string message)
		{
			if (exceptions.Length != 0)
			{
				throw new AggregateException(message, exceptions);
			}
		}

		private void AddServices()
		{
			((IServiceContainer)this).AddService(typeof(IDataConnectionParametersService), (object)this);
			((IServiceContainer)this).AddService(typeof(IDBSchemaProviderEx), (object)GetDefaultDBSchemaProvider);
			((IServiceContainer)this).AddService(typeof(IResultSchemaProvider), (object)new ResultSchemaProvider());
			((IServiceContainer)this).AddService(typeof(IConnectionProviderService), (object)new ConnectionProviderService(this, RuntimeConnectionStringsProvider.CreateDefault()));
			((IServiceContainer)this).AddService(typeof(IDBCommandInterceptor), (object)new NullDBCommandInterceptor());
			((IServiceContainer)this).AddService(typeof(IDBConnectionInterceptor), (object)new NullDBConnectionInterceptor());
		}

		internal IResultSchemaProvider GetResultSchemaProvider()
		{
			if (!(GetService(typeof(IResultSchemaProvider)) is IResultSchemaProvider result))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("No IResultSchemaProvider found");
			}
			return result;
		}

		private DBSchemaProviderHelper GetDBSchemaProviderHelper()
		{
			IDataConnectionParametersService dataConnectionParameterService = GetService(typeof(IDataConnectionParametersService)) as IDataConnectionParametersService;
			ISite obj = Site;
			IDBSchemaProviderEx dbSchemaProviderEx = ((obj != null) ? ServiceProviderExtensions.GetService<IDBSchemaProviderEx>((IServiceProvider)obj) : null) ?? (GetService(typeof(IDBSchemaProviderEx)) as IDBSchemaProviderEx);
			return new DBSchemaProviderHelper(dataConnectionParameterService, dbSchemaProviderEx);
		}

		internal async Task LoadDBSchemaAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			DBSchemaProviderHelper dBSchemaProviderHelper = GetDBSchemaProviderHelper();
			DBSchema = await dBSchemaProviderHelper.GetSchemaAsync(Connection, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
		}

		private Task LoadDBSchemaAsync(string[] tableList, string[] proceduresList, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			DBSchemaProviderHelper dbSchemaProviderAsyncHelper = GetDBSchemaProviderHelper();
			Action action = delegate
			{
				dbSchemaProviderAsyncHelper.GetSchemaAsync(Connection, tableList, proceduresList, cancellationToken).ContinueWith(delegate(Task<DBSchema> task)
				{
					if (task.IsFaulted && task.Exception != null)
					{
						throw task.Exception;
					}
					DBSchema = task.Result;
				}, cancellationToken, TaskContinuationOptions.None, TaskScheduler.Default).Wait(cancellationToken);
			};
			action = ImpersonateHelper.Impersonate(action);
			return Task.Factory.StartNew(action, cancellationToken, TaskCreationOptions.None, TaskScheduler.Default);
		}

		private DBSchema LoadDBSchema(string[] tableList, string[] proceduresList, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			//IL_0005: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			DashboardTelemetry val = new DashboardTelemetry("SqlDataSource.LoadDBSchema");
			try
			{
				DBSchemaProviderHelper dBSchemaProviderHelper = GetDBSchemaProviderHelper();
				DBSchema schema = dBSchemaProviderHelper.GetSchema(Connection, tableList, proceduresList, cancellationToken);
				DashboardTelemetry.TraceInformation((object)$"Number of tables: {(DBSchema?.Tables?.Length).GetValueOrDefault()}");
				DashboardTelemetry.TraceInformation((object)$"Total number of columns: {DBSchema?.Tables?.Select((DBTable table) => table.Columns.Count()).Sum()}");
				DashboardTelemetry.TraceInformation((object)$"Number of views: {(DBSchema?.Views?.Length).GetValueOrDefault()}");
				DashboardTelemetry.TraceInformation((object)$"Number of stored procedures: {(DBSchema?.StoredProcedures?.Length).GetValueOrDefault()}");
				return schema;
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		internal void AssignConnection(SqlDataConnection sourceConnection)
		{
			SetConnectionInfo(sourceConnection);
			connection = sourceConnection;
			if (connection != null)
			{
				connection.SqlDataSource = this;
			}
		}

		internal void SetConnectionInfo(SqlDataConnection sourceConnection)
		{
			if (sourceConnection != null)
			{
				ConnectionName = sourceConnection.Name;
				if (sourceConnection.StoreConnectionNameOnly)
				{
					connectionParameters = null;
				}
				else
				{
					ConnectionParameters = sourceConnection.ConnectionParameters ?? sourceConnection.CreateDataConnectionParameters();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				connectionName = null;
				connectionParameters = null;
			}
		}

		private void CreateConnection(string name)
		{
			IConnectionProviderService connectionProviderService = (IConnectionProviderService)GetService(typeof(IConnectionProviderService));
			if (connectionProviderService == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot find the IConnectionProviderService.");
			}
			connection = connectionProviderService.LoadConnection(name);
			connection.SqlDataSource = this;
		}

		private void DropConnection()
		{
			DBSchema = null;
			if (connection != null)
			{
				if (connection.IsConnected)
				{
					connection.Close();
				}
				connection.Dispose();
				connection = null;
			}
		}

		DataConnectionParametersBase IDataConnectionParametersService.RaiseConfigureDataConnection(string connectionName, DataConnectionParametersBase parameters)
		{
			if (this.ConfigureDataConnection == null)
			{
				return parameters;
			}
			ConfigureDataConnectionEventArgs e = new ConfigureDataConnectionEventArgs(connectionName, parameters);
			this.ConfigureDataConnection(this, e);
			return e.ConnectionParameters;
		}

		DataConnectionParametersBase IDataConnectionParametersService.RaiseHandleConnectionError(ConnectionErrorEventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			this.ConnectionError?.Invoke(this, eventArgs);
			if (eventArgs.Handled && eventArgs.Cancel)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return eventArgs.ConnectionParameters;
		}

		protected CriteriaOperator RaiseCustomFilterExpression(CustomizeFilterExpressionEventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			if (this.CustomizeFilterExpression != null)
			{
				this.CustomizeFilterExpression(this, eventArgs);
				return eventArgs.FilterExpression;
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected bool ReadyToBuild(string[] queriesToFill)
		{
			if (Connection == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			SqlQuery[] array = Queries.Where((SqlQuery q) => queriesToFill.Contains(q.Name)).ToArray();
			if (array.Length == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (DBSchema == null && array.Any((SqlQuery q) => q is TableQuery || q is SelectQuery))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!Connection.IsSqlDataStore)
			{
				return array.All((SqlQuery q) => q is TableQuery || q is SelectQuery);
			}
			return true;
		}

		}

		internal bool ContainsResult(string queryName)
		{
			if (!ResultSet.Tables.Any((ResultTable t) => t.TableName == queryName))
			{
				return ResultSet.ComplexResults.Any((KeyValuePair<string, SubResultSet> t) => t.Key == queryName);
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void SetResultSchemaPart(string queryName, object dataSchema)
		{
			SetResultSchemaPart(ResultSet, queryName, dataSchema);
		}

		private static void SetResultSchemaPart(DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.ResultSet resultSet, string queryName, object dataSchema)
		{
			//IL_0126: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_012d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			Guard.ArgumentIsNotNullOrEmpty(queryName, "queryName");
			List<ResultTable> list = new List<ResultTable>(resultSet.Tables);
			List<SubResultSet> list2 = new List<SubResultSet>(resultSet.ComplexResults.Values);
			if (dataSchema is SubResultSet subResultSet)
			{
				RemoveComplexResultByName(list2, queryName);
				ResultTable resultTable = list.FirstOrDefault((ResultTable table) => table.TableName == queryName);
				if (resultTable != null)
				{
					list.Remove(resultTable);
				}
				subResultSet.SetName(queryName);
				list2.Add(subResultSet);
			}
			else
			{
				RemoveComplexResultByName(list2, queryName);
				ResultTable resultTable2 = list.FirstOrDefault((ResultTable table) => table.TableName == queryName);
				if (resultTable2 == null)
				{
					resultTable2 = new ResultTable(queryName);
					list.Add(resultTable2);
				}
				else
				{
					resultTable2.Columns.Clear();
					resultTable2.ClearRows();
				}
				if (dataSchema is ColumnDescription[] array)
				{
					for (int num = 0; num < array.Length; num++)
					{
						resultTable2.AddColumn(ResultTable.CleanColumnName(array[num].Name, num), array[num].Type);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					DataContextBase val = new DataContextBase();
					PropertyDescriptorCollection itemProperties = val[dataSchema].GetItemProperties();
					if (itemProperties != null)
					{
						foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in itemProperties)
						{
							FieldDescriptor fieldDescriptor = new FieldDescriptor
							{
								Name = item.Name,
								FieldType = item.PropertyType
							};
							if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.DisplayName) && item.DisplayName != item.Name)
							{
								fieldDescriptor.DisplayName = item.DisplayName;
							}
							resultTable2.AddColumn(item.Name, item.PropertyType);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			resultSet.SetTables(list, list2);
		}

		private static void RemoveComplexResultByName(List<SubResultSet> subSets, string queryName)
		{
			SubResultSet subResultSet = subSets.FirstOrDefault((SubResultSet set) => set.Name == queryName);
			if (subResultSet != null)
			{
				subSets.Remove(subResultSet);
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateResultSet(IEnumerable<ResultTable> tables)
		{
			UpdateResultSet(tables, Enumerable.Empty<SubResultSet>());
		}

		internal void UpdateResultSet(IEnumerable<ResultTable> tables, IEnumerable<SubResultSet> subSets)
		{
			ResultSet.SetTables(tables, subSets);
		}

		internal void RenameResultSchemaPart(string oldQueryName, string newQueryName)
		{
			if (ResultSet.Tables.SingleOrDefault((ResultTable t) => t.TableName == newQueryName) != null)
			{
				throw new InvalidNameException(string.Format(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.MessageDuplicateItemName), newQueryName));
			}
			ResultTable resultTable = ResultSet.Tables.SingleOrDefault((ResultTable t) => t.TableName == oldQueryName);
			if (resultTable != null)
			{
				resultTable.TableName = newQueryName;
				ResultSet.SetTablesCore(ResultSet.Tables, ResultSet.ComplexResults.Values);
			}
			UpdateResultSchemaRelations();
		}

		internal void RemoveResultSchemaPart(string queryName)
		{
			if (ResultSet.Tables.Any((ResultTable t) => t.TableName == queryName) || ResultSet.ComplexResults.ContainsKey(queryName))
			{
				IEnumerable<ResultTable> resultTables = ResultSet.Tables.Where((ResultTable r) => r.TableName != queryName).ToArray();
				IEnumerable<SubResultSet> subSets = ResultSet.ComplexResults.Values.Where((SubResultSet r) => r.Name != queryName).ToArray();
				ResultSet.SetTables(resultTables, subSets);
				UpdateResultSchemaRelations();
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateResultSchemaRelations(DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.ResultSet resultSet)
		{
			resultSet.ApplyRelations(Relations);
		}

		internal void UpdateResultSchemaRelations()
		{
			UpdateResultSchemaRelations(ResultSet);
		}

		}

			RebuildResultSchema((IEnumerable<SqlQuery> queriesToExecute) => true, parameters);
		}

		public void RebuildResultSchema(Predicate<IEnumerable<SqlQuery>> confirmExecution)
		{
			RebuildResultSchema(confirmExecution, null);
		}

		public void RebuildResultSchema(Predicate<IEnumerable<SqlQuery>> confirmExecution, IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters, IEnumerable<SqlQuery> queries)
		{
			SqlQuery[] array = (queries as SqlQuery[]) ?? queries.ToArray();
			string[] array2 = array.Select((SqlQuery q) => q.Name).ToArray();
			EnsureIsReadyToBuild(CancellationToken.None, array2);
			DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.ResultSet resultSet = RebuildResultSchemaCore(confirmExecution, parameters, array, null, CancellationToken.None);
			ResultTable[] tablesForResultSet = GetTablesForResultSet(resultSet.Tables, array2);
			SubResultSet[] complexResultsForResultSet = GetComplexResultsForResultSet(resultSet.ComplexResults.Values, array2);
			ResultSet.SetTables(tablesForResultSet, complexResultsForResultSet);
			ResultSet.ApplyRelations(Relations);
		}

		private ResultTable[] GetTablesForResultSet(IEnumerable<ResultTable> tables, string[] queryNames)
		{
			List<ResultTable> list = new List<ResultTable>(tables);
			foreach (ResultTable table in ResultSet.Tables)
			{
				if (!queryNames.Contains(table.TableName) && Queries.Any((SqlQuery q) => q.Name == table.TableName))
				{
					list.Add(table);
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private SubResultSet[] GetComplexResultsForResultSet(IEnumerable<SubResultSet> tables, string[] queryNames)
		{
			List<SubResultSet> list = new List<SubResultSet>(tables);
			foreach (SubResultSet table in ResultSet.ComplexResults.Values)
			{
				if (!queryNames.Contains(table.Name) && Queries.Any((SqlQuery q) => q.Name == table.Name))
				{
					list.Add(table);
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		internal DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.ResultSet RebuildResultSchema(Predicate<IEnumerable<SqlQuery>> confirmExecution, IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters, IEnumerable<SqlQuery> queries, IResultSchemaProvider resultSchemaProvider, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			return RebuildResultSchemaCore(confirmExecution, parameters, queries, resultSchemaProvider, cancellationToken);

		private DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.ResultSet RebuildResultSchemaCore(Predicate<IEnumerable<SqlQuery>> confirmExecution, IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters, IEnumerable<SqlQuery> queries, IResultSchemaProvider resultSchemaProvider, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			List<SqlQuery> list = new List<SqlQuery>();
			List<SelectQuery> list2 = new List<SelectQuery>();
			Dictionary<string, object> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, object>();
			object obj;
			if (parameters == null)
			{
				IList<IParameter> list3 = new List<IParameter>();
				obj = list3;
			}
			else
			{
				obj = (parameters as IList<IParameter>) ?? parameters.ToList();
			}
			IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters = (IEnumerable<IParameter>)obj;
			resultSchemaProvider = resultSchemaProvider ?? GetResultSchemaProvider();
			try
			{
				foreach (SqlQuery query in queries)
				{
					cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
					if (query is TableQuery tableQuery)
					{
						list2.Add(QueryConversionHelper.TableQueryToSelectQuery(tableQuery));
					}
					if (query is SelectQuery item)
					{
						list2.Add(item);
					}
					if (query is StoredProcQuery storedProcQuery)
					{
						object storedProcedureSchema = resultSchemaProvider.GetStoredProcedureSchema(storedProcQuery, connection, ConnectionOptions, sourceParameters);
						if (storedProcedureSchema != null)
						{
							ResultTable obj2 = storedProcedureSchema as ResultTable;
							if (obj2 == null || obj2.Columns.Count != 0)
							{
								SubResultSet obj3 = storedProcedureSchema as SubResultSet;
								if (obj3 == null || obj3.Tables.Any())
								{
									dictionary.Add(storedProcQuery.Name, storedProcedureSchema);
									continue;
								}
							}
						}
						list.Add(storedProcQuery);
					}
					else if (query is CustomSqlQuery customSqlQuery && AllowCustomSqlQueries)
					{
						try
						{
							object customSqlSchema = resultSchemaProvider.GetCustomSqlSchema(customSqlQuery, connection, ConnectionOptions, sourceParameters);
							dictionary.Add(customSqlQuery.Name, customSqlSchema);
						}
						catch
						{
							list.Add(customSqlQuery);
						}
					}
				}
				cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
				if (list.Count > 0 && !confirmExecution(list))
				{
					return null;
				}
				cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
				DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.ResultSet resultSet = new DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.ResultSet(this);
				foreach (KeyValuePair<string, object> item3 in dictionary)
				{
					SetResultSchemaPart(resultSet, item3.Key, item3.Value);
				}
				foreach (SelectQuery item4 in list2)
				{
					object selectQuerySchema = resultSchemaProvider.GetSelectQuerySchema(item4, DBSchema, Connection, ConnectionOptions, sourceParameters);
					SetResultSchemaPart(resultSet, item4.Name, selectQuerySchema);
				}
				List<QueryExecutionException> list4 = new List<QueryExecutionException>();
				Dictionary<string, object> dictionary2 = new Dictionary<string, object>();
				foreach (SqlQuery item5 in list)
				{
					try
					{
						object value = ExecuteQuery(item5, new DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.QueryExecutor(Connection, DBSchema, null, sourceParameters, DBCommandInterceptor), cancellationToken);
						dictionary2.Add(item5.Name, value);
					}
					catch (QueryExecutionException item2)
					{
						list4.Add(item2);
					}
				}
				Exception[] exceptions = list4.ToArray();
				ThrowAggregateExceptionIfNeeded(exceptions, DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.QueriesFailedToExecute_ExceptionMessage));
				foreach (KeyValuePair<string, object> item6 in dictionary2)
				{
					SetResultSchemaPart(resultSet, item6.Key, item6.Value);
				}
				return resultSet;
			}
			finally
			{
				CloseConnection();
			}
		}

		protected internal Task EnsureIsReadyToBuildAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			Action action = delegate
			{
				EnsureIsReadyToBuildCore(cancellationToken, AllQueryNames, delegate(string[] tableList, string[] proceduresList)
				{
					LoadDBSchemaAsync(tableList, proceduresList, cancellationToken).Wait(cancellationToken);
				});
			};
			action = ImpersonateHelper.Impersonate(action);
			return Task.Factory.StartNew(action, cancellationToken, TaskCreationOptions.None, TaskScheduler.Default);
		}

		}

		private DBSchema EnsureIsReadyToBuildCore(CancellationToken cancellationToken, string[] queriesToFill)
		{
			DBSchema result = null;
			Action<string[], string[]> loadSchema = delegate(string[] tableList, string[] proceduresList)
			{
				result = LoadDBSchema(tableList, proceduresList, cancellationToken);
			};
			EnsureIsReadyToBuildCore(cancellationToken, queriesToFill, loadSchema);
			return result;
		}

		private void EnsureIsReadyToBuildCore(CancellationToken cancellationToken, string[] queriesToFill, Action<string[], string[]> loadSchema)
		{
			if (Connection == null)
			{
				throw new DatabaseConnectionException(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.ConnectionNotSpecified_ExceptionMessage));
			}
			if (!Connection.IsConnected)
			{
				Connection.CreateDataStore(DataConnectionParametersService, cancellationToken);
			}
			if (!Connection.IsConnected)
			{
				throw new DatabaseConnectionException(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.ConnectionAborted_ExceptionMessage));
			}
			DBSchemaProviderHelper.GetRequiredDBObjects(Queries.Where((SqlQuery q) => queriesToFill.Contains(q.Name)).ToArray(), out var tables, out var proceduresList);
			loadSchema(tables, proceduresList);
		}

		protected virtual void ValidateQuery(SqlQuery query, DBSchema schema)
		{
			try
			{
				if (!(Connection.DataStore is ISupportStoredProc) && query is StoredProcQuery)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException("The specified data provider does not support stored procedures.");
				}
				query.Validate(schema);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (ex is ValidationException || ex is NotSupportedException)
				{
					throw new QueryExecutionException(query.Name, ex);
				}
				throw;
			}
		}

		bool IListAdapter2.ShouldRefillQuery(string name)
		{
			SqlQuery sqlQuery = Queries.FirstOrDefault((SqlQuery x) => x.Name == name);
			if (sqlQuery != null)
			{
				return ShouldRefillQuery(sqlQuery);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ShouldRefillQuery(SqlQuery query)
		{
			ITable table = ResultSet?.FirstOrDefault((ITable x) => x.Name == query.Name);
			SubResultSet subResultSet = ResultSet?.ComplexResults?.FirstOrDefault((KeyValuePair<string, SubResultSet> x) => x.Key == query.Name).Value;
			if (table == null && subResultSet == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (table != null && !table.Any())
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (subResultSet != null && subResultSet.All((ITable t) => !t.Any()))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return query.Parameters.Any((QueryParameter x) => DataSourceParameterHelper.IsBoundToExternalParameter(x));
		}

		internal void CustomizeQueryFilterCallback(SelectQuery query, ref CriteriaOperator filter)
		{
			CustomizeFilterExpressionEventHandler customizeFilterExpressionEventHandler = this.CustomizeFilterExpression;
			if (customizeFilterExpressionEventHandler != null)
			{
				CustomizeFilterExpressionEventArgs e = new CustomizeFilterExpressionEventArgs(query.Name, filter);
				customizeFilterExpressionEventHandler(this, e);
				filter = e.FilterExpression;
			}
			ISelectQueryFilterService selectQueryFilterService = (ISelectQueryFilterService)GetService(typeof(ISelectQueryFilterService));
			if (selectQueryFilterService != null)
			{
				filter = selectQueryFilterService.CustomizeFilterExpression(query, filter);
			}
		}

		DynamicLookupResult IDynamicLookupSettingsDataProvider.GetResult(string dataMember, IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters, string filterString, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			//IL_01c7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01cc: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01dd: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01e4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01ec: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0156: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0160: Expected O, but got Unknown
			SqlQuery sqlQuery = Queries.First((SqlQuery q) => q.Name == dataMember).Clone();
			DBSchema dBSchema = EnsureIsReadyToBuildCore(cancellationToken, new string[1] { sqlQuery.Name });
			bool flag = false;
			IParameter[] array = (parameters as IParameter[]) ?? parameters.ToArray();
			if (sqlQuery is SelectQuery selectQuery)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(filterString))
				{
					CriteriaOperator criteriaOperator = FilterHelper.GetCriteriaOperator(filterString, array);
					IAggregationResultTypeProvider aggregationResultTypeProvider = connection.DataStore as IAggregationResultTypeProvider;

					ColumnDescription[] columns = new SelectQueryActualColumnInfosHelper(aggregationResultTypeProvider, supportDefaultSchema, selectQuery, dbTables, suppressException: false).GetActualQueryColumns().ToArray();
					criteriaOperator = new ExpressionReplacingCriteriaOperatorPatcher(selectQuery, columns).Process(criteriaOperator);
					criteriaOperator = criteriaOperator.Accept<CriteriaOperator>((ICriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>)new DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.MongoDB.QueryExecutor.ParametersToValuesReplacer());
					string text = null;
					string filterString2 = selectQuery.FilterString;
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(filterString2))
					{
						text = ((object)criteriaOperator).ToString();
					}
					else

						text = ((object)new GroupOperator((GroupOperatorType)0, (CriteriaOperator[])(object)new CriteriaOperator[2] { criteriaOperator2, criteriaOperator })).ToString();
					}

					{
						selectQuery.FilterString = text;
						ValidateQuery(selectQuery, dBSchema);
						flag = true;
					}
					catch (QueryExecutionException)
					{
						selectQuery.FilterString = filterString2;
						flag = false;
					}
					if (!flag)
					{
						ValidateQuery(selectQuery, dBSchema);
					}

		protected virtual DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.ResultSet FillInternal(IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters, CancellationToken cancellationToken, string[] queriesToFill)
		{
			filled = false;
			if (!ReadyToBuild(queriesToFill))
			{
				return new DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.ResultSet();
			}
			ValidateQueries(queriesToFill, DBSchema);
			try
			{
				DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.ResultSet resultSet = new DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.ResultSet(this);
				cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
				DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.QueryExecutor executor = new DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.QueryExecutor(Connection, DBSchema, CustomizeQueryFilterCallback, parameters, DBCommandInterceptor);
				List<QueryExecutionException> list = new List<QueryExecutionException>();
				foreach (SqlQuery query in Queries)
				{
					cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
					if ((query is CustomSqlQuery && !AllowCustomSqlQueries) || !queriesToFill.Contains(query.Name))
					{
						continue;
					}
					try
					{
						object obj = ExecuteQuery(query, executor, cancellationToken);
						if (obj is SubResultSet subResultSet)
						{
							resultSet.ComplexResults.Add(subResultSet.Name, subResultSet);
							continue;
						}
						ResultTable item = obj as ResultTable;
						if (obj != null)
						{
							resultSet.Add(item);
						}
					}
					catch (QueryExecutionException item2)
					{
						list.Add(item2);
					}
				}
				Exception[] exceptions = list.ToArray();
				ThrowAggregateExceptionIfNeeded(exceptions, DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.QueriesFailedToExecute_ExceptionMessage));
				filled = true;
				return resultSet;
			}
			finally
			{
				CloseConnection();
			}
		}

		private void ValidateQueries(string[] queriesToFill, DBSchema schema)
		{
			List<QueryExecutionException> list = new List<QueryExecutionException>();
			foreach (SqlQuery query in Queries)
			{
				if (queriesToFill.Contains(query.Name))
				{
					try
					{
						ValidateQuery(query, schema);
					}
					catch (QueryExecutionException item)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
				}
			}
			Exception[] exceptions = list.ToArray();
			ThrowAggregateExceptionIfNeeded(exceptions, DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.QueriesFailedToValidate_ExceptionMessage));
		}

		internal void CloseConnection()
		{
			if (ConnectionOptions.CloseConnection)
			{
				IDataStore dataStore = Connection.DataStore;
				ISqlDataStore val = (ISqlDataStore)(object)((dataStore is ISqlDataStore) ? dataStore : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					val.Connection?.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		protected void ExecuteReader(SqlQuery query, DBSchema dbSchema, IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters, CancellationToken token, Action<IDataReader, string, CancellationToken> action)
		{
			ExecuteReader(query, dbSchema, sourceParameters, token, delegate(IDataReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
