				action(reader, query.Name, cancellationToken);
			});
		}

		protected void ExecuteReader(SqlQuery query, DBSchema dbSchema, IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters, CancellationToken token, Action<IDataReader, CancellationToken> action)
		{
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0134: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_013b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0172: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0179: Expected O, but got Unknown
			DashboardTelemetry val = new DashboardTelemetry("SqlDataSource.ExecuteReader");
			try
			{
				IEnumerable<IParameter> enumerable = ParametersEvaluator.EvaluateParameters(sourceParameters, query.Parameters);
				IList<IParameter> list = (enumerable as IList<IParameter>) ?? enumerable.ToList();
				IColumnarDataLoader columnarDataLoader = ColumnarDataLoaderFactory.GetColumnarDataLoader(connection.DataStore);
				columnarDataLoader.AfterCommandCreated = delegate(IDbCommand command)
				{
					DBCommandInterceptor?.CommandCreated(query.Name, command);
				};
				try
				{
					SelectQuery selectQuery = ((query is TableQuery tableQuery) ? QueryConversionHelper.TableQueryToSelectQuery(tableQuery) : (query as SelectQuery));
					if (selectQuery != null)
					{
						if (columnarDataLoader != null)
						{
							SelectStatement val2 = SqlQueryHelper.BuildSelectStatement(selectQuery, dbSchema, connection.SqlGeneratorFormatter, list);
							DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.QueryExecutor.ApplyCustomFilter(selectQuery, list, val2, CustomizeQueryFilterCallback);
							Query query2 = ((BaseSqlGeneratorWithParameters)new SelectSqlGeneratorWithAlias(connection.SqlGeneratorFormatter, selectQuery, list)).GenerateSql((BaseStatement)(object)val2);
							columnarDataLoader.ProcessQuery(token, query2, action, ConnectionOptions);
						}
					}
					else if (query is CustomSqlQuery customSqlQuery)
					{
						QueryParameterCollection val3 = new QueryParameterCollection(((IEnumerable<IParameter>)list).Select((Func<IParameter, OperandValue>)((IParameter p) => new OperandValue(p.Value))).ToArray());
						if (columnarDataLoader != null)
						{
							Query query3 = new Query(customSqlQuery.Sql, val3, (IList)list.Select((IParameter p) => ((IFilterParameter)p).Name).ToArray());
							columnarDataLoader.ProcessQuery(token, query3, action, ConnectionOptions);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						if (!(query is StoredProcQuery storedProcQuery))
						{
							throw new NotSupportedException($"Unknown query type: {query.GetType()}");
						}
						columnarDataLoader?.ProcessStoredProc(token, storedProcQuery.StoredProcName, action, ConnectionOptions, ((IEnumerable<IParameter>)list).Select((Func<IParameter, OperandParameter>)((IParameter p) => new OperandParameter(((IFilterParameter)p).Name, p.Value))).ToArray());
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					CloseConnection();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		protected virtual object ExecuteQuery(SqlQuery query, DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.QueryExecutor executor, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			try
			{
				ColumnarData columnarData = executor.Execute(query, cancellationToken);
				return columnarData.ToResult(query.Name);
			}
			catch (SqlExecutionException innerException)
			{
				throw new QueryExecutionException(query.Name, innerException);
			}
		}

		private void ClearResult()
		{
			filled = false;
			ResultSet.SetTables(new ResultTable[0]);
		}

		internal XElement GetResultSchemaXml()
		{
			return ResultSchema.SaveToXml();
		}

		internal void SetResultSchemaXml(XElement xml)
		{
			FieldListDescriptor fieldListDescriptor = FieldListDescriptor.LoadFromXml(xml);
			fieldListDescriptor.FillResultSet(ResultSet);
		}

		IList IListSource.GetList()
		{
			return ResultSet;
		}

		protected override string GetDataMember()
		{
			string dataMember = DataMember;
			if (dataMember == null)
			{
				if (Queries.Count <= 0)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				dataMember = Queries[0].Name;
			}
			return dataMember;
		}

		internal void UpdateRelations(string oldQueryName, string newQueryName)
		{
			foreach (MasterDetailInfo relation in Relations)
			{
				if (relation.MasterQueryName == oldQueryName)
				{
					relation.MasterQueryName = newQueryName;
				}
				if (relation.DetailQueryName == oldQueryName)
				{
					relation.DetailQueryName = newQueryName;
				}
			}
		}

		private void ReplaceServicesFromProvider(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
		{
			ReplaceServiceFromProvider(typeof(IConnectionProviderService), serviceProvider);
			ReplaceServiceFromProvider(typeof(IDBSchemaProviderEx), serviceProvider);
			ReplaceServiceFromProvider(typeof(IResultSchemaProvider), serviceProvider);
			ReplaceServiceFromProvider(typeof(ISelectQueryFilterService), serviceProvider);
			ReplaceServiceFromProvider(typeof(IDBCommandInterceptor), serviceProvider);
			ReplaceServiceFromProvider(typeof(IDBConnectionInterceptor), serviceProvider);
		}

		internal static string GenerateUniqueName(SqlQuery query, IEnumerable<SqlQuery> queries)
		{
			return GenerateUniqueName(query, new HashSet<string>(queries.Select((SqlQuery x) => x.Name)));
		}

		internal static string GenerateUniqueName(SqlQuery query, HashSet<string> reservedNames)
		{
			string text = query.Name;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				Table table = ((query is SelectQuery selectQuery) ? selectQuery.Tables.FirstOrDefault() : null);
				if (table != null)
				{
					text = table.ActualName;
				}
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				text = ((!(query is TableQuery tableQuery) || !tableQuery.Tables.Any()) ? "Query" : (tableQuery.Tables[0].Alias ?? tableQuery.Tables[0].Name));
			}
			text = CleanQueryName(text);
			return NameGenerator.GenerateUniqueName(text, reservedNames);
		}

		internal static string CleanQueryName(string name)
		{
			return name?.Trim('"').Replace("\".\"", ".").Replace('.', '_');
		}

		public void CheckQueryName(SqlQuery query)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)query, "query");
			string name = query.Name;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
			{
				throw new InvalidNameException(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.MessageEmptyQueryName));
			}
			using IEnumerator<SqlQuery> enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SqlQuery current = enumerator.Current;
				if (current != query && current.Name == name)
				{
					throw new InvalidNameException(string.Format(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.MessageDuplicateQueryName), name));
				}
			}
		}

		internal void CheckQueryName(string queryName)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(queryName))
			{
				throw new InvalidNameException(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.MessageEmptyQueryName));
			}
			if (ContainsName(queryName))
			{
				throw new InvalidNameException(string.Format(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.MessageDuplicateQueryName), queryName));
			}
		}

		public string GenerateUniqueName(SqlQuery query)
		{
			return GenerateUniqueName(query, this);
		}

	public sealed class StoredProcQuery : SqlQuery
	{
		private class StoredProcNameTypeConverter : TypeConverter
		{
			public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
			{
				if (sourceType == typeof(string))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DXHelpExclude(true)]
		public static bool IgnoreParameterValidation { get; set; }

		[TypeConverter(typeof(StoredProcNameTypeConverter))]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.StoredProcQuery.StoredProcName")]
		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.StoredProcQuery.StoredProcName")]
		[LocalizableCategory(DataAccessStringId.QueryPropertyGridStoredProcCategoryName)]
		public string StoredProcName { get; set; }

		internal string DisplayName => StoredProcName + "(" + string.Join(", ", base.Parameters.Select((QueryParameter arg) => arg.Name)) + ")";

		public StoredProcQuery(string queryName, string storedProcName)
			: base(queryName)
		{
			StoredProcName = storedProcName;
		}

		public StoredProcQuery()
			: this(string.Empty, null)
		{
		}

		public StoredProcQuery(string queryName, string storedProcName, IEnumerable<QueryParameter> parameters)
			: this(queryName, storedProcName)
		{
			base.Parameters.AddRange(parameters);
		}

		internal StoredProcQuery(StoredProcQuery other)
			: base(other)
		{
			StoredProcName = other.StoredProcName;
		}

		public override void Validate()
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(StoredProcName))
			{
				throw new StoredProcNameNullValidationException();
			}
		}

		public override void Validate(DBSchema schema)
		{
			Validate();
			if (schema?.StoredProcedures == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			IDataStore val = base.Owner?.DataSource?.Connection?.DataStore;
			string name = (val as ISupportDefaultSchema)?.RemoveDefaultSchema(StoredProcName) ?? StoredProcName;
			DBStoredProcedure[] array = schema.StoredProcedures.Where((DBStoredProcedure p) => string.Equals(p.Name, name)).ToArray();
			if (array.Length == 1 && IgnoreParameterValidation)
			{
				return;
			}
			DBStoredProcedure[] array2 = array;
			foreach (DBStoredProcedure val2 in array2)
			{
				if (val2.Arguments.Count((DBStoredProcedureArgument a) => (int)a.Direction != 1) == base.Parameters.Count && StoredProcQueryHelper.CompareParameters(this, val2, throwOnError: false))
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			throw new StoredProcNotInSchemaValidationException(this);
		}

		internal override bool EqualsCore(SqlQuery obj)
		{
			StoredProcQuery storedProcQuery = (StoredProcQuery)obj;
			return string.Equals(StoredProcName, storedProcQuery.StoredProcName);
		}

		internal override SqlQuery Clone()
		{
			return new StoredProcQuery(this);
		}
	}
	public sealed class Table
	{
		internal class EqualityComparer : IEqualityComparer<Table>
		{
			public static bool Equals(Table x, Table y)
			{
				if (x == y)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (x == null || y == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (x.Name == y.Name)
				{
					return x.Alias == y.Alias;
				}
				return false;
			}

			bool IEqualityComparer<Table>.Equals(Table x, Table y)
			{
				return Equals(x, y);
			}

			int IEqualityComparer<Table>.GetHashCode(Table obj)
			{
				return 0;
			}
		}

		[DefaultValue(null)]
		public string Name { get; set; }

		[DefaultValue(null)]
		public string Alias { get; set; }

		public string ActualName => Alias ?? Name;

		public bool HasAlias => Alias != null;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DXHelpExclude(true)]
		public string MetaSerializable
		{
			get
			{
				if (Meta == null || Meta.IsEmpty)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return Meta.Save().ToString();
			}
			set
			{
				Meta = TableMetaInfo.Load(value);
			}
		}

		internal TableMetaInfo Meta { get; set; }

		private bool ShouldSerializeMetaSerializable()
		{
			if (Meta != null)
			{
				return !Meta.IsEmpty;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

			public static bool Equals(TableInfo x, TableInfo y)
			{
				if (x == y)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (x == null || y == null || x.GetType() != y.GetType())
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!string.Equals(x.Name, y.Name, StringComparison.Ordinal) || !string.Equals(x.Alias, y.Alias, StringComparison.Ordinal))
				{
					return false;
				}
				int count = x.Columns.Count;
				if (y.Columns.Count != count)
				{
					return false;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					if (!ColumnInfo.EqualityComparer.Equals(x.Columns[i], y.Columns[i]))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}

			bool IEqualityComparer<TableInfo>.Equals(TableInfo x, TableInfo y)
			{
				return Equals(x, y);
			}

		}

		public void Save(XElement element)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0035: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			PointFloat pos = Pos;
			if (!((PointFloat)(ref pos)).IsEmpty)
			{
				pos = Pos;
				SetAttributeValue(element, "X", ((PointFloat)(ref pos)).X);
				pos = Pos;
				SetAttributeValue(element, "Y", ((PointFloat)(ref pos)).Y);
			}
			if (!Size.Equals(DefaultSize))
			{
				SetAttributeValue(element, "Width", Size.Width);
				SetAttributeValue(element, "Height", Size.Height);
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(UserData))
			{
				SetAttributeValue(element, "UserData", UserData);
			}
		}

		internal override bool EqualsCore(SqlQuery obj)
		{
			TableQuery tableQuery = (TableQuery)obj;
			if (Top != tableQuery.Top || Skip != tableQuery.Skip)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!string.Equals(FilterString, tableQuery.FilterString, StringComparison.Ordinal) || !string.Equals(GroupFilterString, tableQuery.GroupFilterString, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				return false;
			}
			int count = Tables.Count;
			int count2 = Relations.Count;
			if (tableQuery.Tables.Count != count || tableQuery.Relations.Count != count2)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (!TableInfo.EqualityComparer.Equals(Tables[i], tableQuery.Tables[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < count2; j++)
			{
				if (!RelationInfo.EqualityComparer.Equals(Relations[j], tableQuery.Relations[j]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (!GroupingInfoList.EqualityComparer.Equals(Grouping, tableQuery.Grouping))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal override SqlQuery Clone()
		{
			return new TableQuery(this);
		}

	public interface IColumn
	{
		string Name { get; }

		Type Type { get; }

		object this[int rowIndex] { get; }

		T GetValue<T>(IRow row);

		T GetValue<T>(int rowIndex);
	}
	public interface IRelation
	{
		string Name { get; }

		ITable Master { get; }

		ITable Detail { get; }

		IEnumerable<IColumn> MasterKeyColumns { get; }

		IEnumerable<IColumn> DetailKeyColumns { get; }

		IEnumerable<IRow> GetDetailRows(IRow masterRow);

		IEnumerable<IRow> GetDetailRows(int masterRowIndex);
	}
	public interface IRow : IEnumerable<object>, IEnumerable
	{
		object this[int columnIndex] { get; }

		object this[string columnName] { get; }

		T GetValue<T>(IColumn column);

		T GetValue<T>(int columnIndex);

		T GetValue<T>(string columnName);

		IEnumerable<IRow> GetDetailRows(IRelation relation);

		IEnumerable<IRow> GetDetailRows(string relationName);
	}
	public interface ITable : IEnumerable<IRow>, IEnumerable
	{
		string Name { get; }

		IEnumerable<IColumn> Columns { get; }

		IRow this[int rowIndex] { get; }

		IEnumerable<IRelation> DetailRelations { get; }

		IColumn GetColumn(int index);

		IColumn GetColumn(string name);

		bool TryGetColumn(string name, out IColumn column);

		IRelation GetDetailRelation(string name);

		bool TryGetDetailRelation(string name, out IRelation relation);
	}
	public interface IResultSet : IEnumerable<ITable>, IEnumerable
	{
		ITable this[string name] { get; }

		ITable this[int index] { get; }

		bool TryGetTable(string name, out ITable table);
	}

	public class ObjectConstructorInfo
	{
		internal class EqualityComparer : IEqualityComparer<ObjectConstructorInfo>
		{
			public static bool Equals(ObjectConstructorInfo x, ObjectConstructorInfo y)
			{
				if (x == y)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (x == null || y == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (x.Parameters.Count != y.Parameters.Count)
				{
					return false;
				}
				IEnumerator<Parameter> enumerator = x.Parameters.GetEnumerator();
				IEnumerator<Parameter> enumerator2 = y.Parameters.GetEnumerator();
				while (enumerator.MoveNext() && enumerator2.MoveNext())
				{
					if (!Parameter.EqualityComparer.Equals(enumerator.Current, enumerator2.Current))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}

			bool IEqualityComparer<ObjectConstructorInfo>.Equals(ObjectConstructorInfo x, ObjectConstructorInfo y)
			{
				return Equals(x, y);
			}

			int IEqualityComparer<ObjectConstructorInfo>.GetHashCode(ObjectConstructorInfo obj)
			{
				return 0;
			}
		}

		private static readonly ObjectConstructorInfo @default = new ObjectConstructorInfo();

		public static ObjectConstructorInfo Default => @default;

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		public ParameterList Parameters { get; private set; }

		public ObjectConstructorInfo()
		{
			Parameters = new ParameterList();
		}

		public ObjectConstructorInfo(IEnumerable<Parameter> parameters)
		{
			Parameters = new ParameterList(parameters);
		}

		public ObjectConstructorInfo(params Parameter[] parameters)
			: this(parameters.AsEnumerable())
		{
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (!Parameters.Any())
			{
				return DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.ParameterlessConstructor);
			}
			return string.Format("({0})", string.Join(", ", Parameters.Select((Parameter parameter) => (parameter.Value != null) ? $"{TypeNamesHelper.ShortName(TargetType(parameter.Type, parameter.Value as Expression))} {parameter.Name} = {parameter.Value}" : $"{TypeNamesHelper.ShortName(parameter.Type)} {parameter.Name}")));
		}

		private static Type TargetType(Type type, Expression expr)
		{
			if (type != typeof(Expression) || expr == null)
			{
				return type;
			}
			return expr.ResultType ?? type;
		}
	}

		public object DataSource
		{
			get
			{
				return dataSource;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != dataSource)
				{
					dataSource = value;
					OnDataSourceChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		{
			get
			{
				if (DataSource == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return DataSource.GetType();
			}
			set
			{
				DataSource = value;
			}
		}

		private static string GetPublicKeyToken(Type type)
		{
			Match match = Regex.Match(type.AssemblyQualifiedName, "^.+, Version=\\d{1}[.]\\d{1}[.]\\d{1}[.]\\d{1}, Culture=\\w+, PublicKeyToken=(?<key>.+)$");
			if (match.Success)
			{
				return match.Groups["key"].Value;
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		protected virtual BeforeFillEventArgs CreateBeforeFillEventArgs(object dataSource, string dataMember, ParameterList parameters, ObjectConstructorInfo constructor)
		{
			return new BeforeFillEventArgs(dataSource, dataMember, constructor, parameters)
			{
				IsValid = (GetBeforeFillEventIsValidDefaultValue(dataSource, dataMember) && BeforeFillEventIsValidDefaultValue)
			};
		}

		private bool GetBeforeFillEventIsValidDefaultValue(object dataSource, string dataMember)
		{
			Type type = dataSource as Type;
			if (type != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMember))
			{
				string publicKeyToken = GetPublicKeyToken(type);
				if (publicKeyToken.SequenceEqual("b77a5c561934e089") || publicKeyToken.SequenceEqual("7cec85d7bea7798e"))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal virtual ObjectDataSourceInfo GetDataSourceFillInfo(IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters, bool schemaOnly)

			};
		}

		internal void Fill(IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters, bool schemaOnly)
		{
			ObjectDataSourceInfo dataSourceFillInfo = GetDataSourceFillInfo(sourceParameters, schemaOnly);
			if (!schemaOnly)
			{
				RaiseBeforeFill(dataSourceFillInfo.DataSource, dataSourceFillInfo.DataMember);
			}
			result = GetFillResult(sourceParameters, schemaOnly, dataSourceFillInfo.DataSource, dataSourceFillInfo.DataMember, Parameters, Constructor);
			this.schemaOnly = schemaOnly;
			OnAfterFill(sourceParameters);
		}

		protected void RaiseBeforeFill(object dataSource, string dataMember)
		{
			BeforeFillEventArgs e = CreateBeforeFillEventArgs(dataSource, dataMember, Parameters, Constructor);
			RaiseBeforeFillGlobal(this, e);
			RaiseBeforeFill(e);
			if (!e.IsValid)
			{
				throw new ValidationFailedException("Validation failed");
			}
		}

		protected ResultTypedList GetFillResult(IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters, bool schemaOnly, object dataSource, string dataMember, ParameterList parameters, ObjectConstructorInfo constructor)
		{
			object obj;
			if (sourceParameters != null)
			{
				obj = (sourceParameters as IList<IParameter>) ?? sourceParameters.ToList();
			}
			else
			{
				IList<IParameter> list = (IList<IParameter>)(object)new IParameter[0];
				obj = list;
			}
			IList<IParameter> envParameters = (IList<IParameter>)obj;
			ResultTypedList resultTypedList;
			if (dataSource == null)
			{
				resultTypedList = new ResultTypedList(Name, PropertyDescriptorCollection.Empty);
			}
			else
			{
				ParameterList dataMemberParameters = (schemaOnly ? ObjectDataSourceFillHelper.EvaluateParametersForSchema(parameters) : ObjectDataSourceFillHelper.EvaluateParametersForResult(parameters, envParameters));
				ParameterList ctorParameters = ((constructor == null) ? null : (schemaOnly ? ObjectDataSourceFillHelper.EvaluateParametersForSchema(constructor.Parameters) : ObjectDataSourceFillHelper.EvaluateParametersForResult(constructor.Parameters, envParameters)));
				if (schemaOnly)
				{
					resultTypedList = GetProvider<IResultTypedListProvider>()?.GetResult(dataSource, dataMember, dataMemberParameters, constructor == null, ctorParameters);
					if (resultTypedList != null)
					{
						return resultTypedList;
					}
				}
				ObjectDataSourceFillHelper.FindPropertiesHelper findPropertiesHelper = new ObjectDataSourceFillHelper.FindPropertiesHelper(dataSource, dataMember, dataMemberParameters, constructor == null, ctorParameters);
				PropertyDescriptorCollection pDC = findPropertiesHelper.PDC;
				object instance = findPropertiesHelper.Instance;
				object data = findPropertiesHelper.Data;
				if (schemaOnly)
				{
					resultTypedList = (((string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMember) ? instance : data) is ITypedList typedList) ? new ResultTypedList(Name, typedList, new object[0]) : new ResultTypedList(Name, pDC));
				}
				else
				{
					instance = instance ?? CreateInstance(dataSource, sourceParameters, ctorParameters);
					data = data ?? (string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMember) ? instance : ObjectDataSourceFillHelper.BrowseForResult(instance, dataMember, dataMemberParameters));
					resultTypedList = ObjectDataSourceFillHelper.CreateTypedList(data, Name, pDC);
					RaiseListChanged(new ListChangedEventArgs(ListChangedType.Reset, -1));
				}
			}
			return resultTypedList;
		}

		private T GetProvider<T>() where T : class
		{
			ISite obj = Site;
			object obj2 = ((obj != null) ? ServiceProviderExtensions.GetService<T>((IServiceProvider)obj) : null);
			if (obj2 == null)
			{
				IServiceProvider obj3 = base.ExtensionsProvider as IServiceProvider;
				obj2 = ((obj3 != null) ? ServiceProviderExtensions.GetService<T>(obj3) : null) ?? ServiceProviderExtensions.GetService<T>((IServiceProvider)this);
			}
			return (T)obj2;
		}

		}

		internal Type ResolveType()
		{
			object obj = DataSource as Type;
			if (obj == null)
			{
				object obj2 = DataSource;
				if (obj2 == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				obj = obj2.GetType();
			}
			return (Type)obj;
		}

		private void UpdateSchema(IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters)
		{
			IObjectDataSourceExceptionCollector objectDataSourceExceptionCollector = (IObjectDataSourceExceptionCollector)GetService(typeof(IObjectDataSourceExceptionCollector));
			objectDataSourceExceptionCollector?.Clear();
			try
			{
				Fill(sourceParameters, schemaOnly: true);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				objectDataSourceExceptionCollector?.Collect(ex);
				result = new ResultTypedList(Name, PropertyDescriptorCollection.Empty);
				schemaOnly = true;
				if (ex is NoDefaultConstructorException)
				{
					throw;
				}
			}
		}

			IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters = ((val != null) ? val.GetIParameters() : null);
			Fill(sourceParameters);
		}

		{

			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("The object data source is already being updated.");
			}
			BeginUpdate();
		}

		public virtual void EndInit()
		{
			if (updateCnt > 1)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("The object data source is still being updated.");
			}
			EndUpdate();
		}

		DynamicLookupResult IDynamicLookupSettingsDataProvider.GetResult(string dataMember, IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters, string filterString, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0032: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			IParameter[] sourceParameters = (parameters as IParameter[]) ?? parameters.ToArray();
			ObjectDataSourceInfo dataSourceFillInfo = GetDataSourceFillInfo(sourceParameters, schemaOnly);
			return new DynamicLookupResult
			{
				FilterApplied = false,
				ActualDataMember = dataMember,
				Result = GetFillResult(sourceParameters, schemaOnly: false, dataSourceFillInfo.DataSource, dataSourceFillInfo.DataMember, Parameters, Constructor)
			};
		}

		}

	internal struct ObjectDataSourceInfo
	{

	public sealed class ObjectMember
	{
		internal class EqualityComparer : IEqualityComparer<ObjectMember>
		{
			public static EqualityComparer Instance = new EqualityComparer();

			public static bool Equals(ObjectMember x, ObjectMember y)
			{
				if (x == y)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (x == null || y == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (Equals(x.Pd, y.Pd))
				{
					return Equals(x.MemberInfo, y.MemberInfo);
				}
				return false;
			}

			public static bool Equals(PropertyDescriptor x, PropertyDescriptor y)
			{
				if (x == y)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (x == null || y == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return string.Equals(x.Name, y.Name, StringComparison.Ordinal);
			}

			public static bool Equals(MemberInfo x, MemberInfo y)
			{
				if ((object)x == y)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (x == null || y == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				PropertyInfo propertyInfo = x as PropertyInfo;
				if (propertyInfo != null)
				{
					PropertyInfo propertyInfo2 = y as PropertyInfo;
					if (propertyInfo2 == null)
					{
						return false;
					}
					return string.Equals(propertyInfo.Name, propertyInfo2.Name, StringComparison.Ordinal);
				}
				MethodInfo methodInfo = y as MethodInfo;
				if (methodInfo == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				MethodInfo methodInfo2 = (MethodInfo)x;
				if (!string.Equals(methodInfo2.Name, methodInfo.Name))
				{
					return false;
				}
				ParameterInfo[] parameters = methodInfo2.GetParameters();
				ParameterInfo[] parameters2 = methodInfo.GetParameters();
				if (parameters2.Length != parameters.Length)
				{
					return false;
				}
				IEnumerator<ParameterInfo> enumerator = ((IEnumerable<ParameterInfo>)parameters).GetEnumerator();
				IEnumerator<ParameterInfo> enumerator2 = ((IEnumerable<ParameterInfo>)parameters2).GetEnumerator();
				while (enumerator.MoveNext() && enumerator2.MoveNext())
				{
					ParameterInfo current = enumerator.Current;
					ParameterInfo current2 = enumerator2.Current;
					if (current.ParameterType != current2.ParameterType || !string.Equals(current.Name, current2.Name, StringComparison.Ordinal))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}

			bool IEqualityComparer<ObjectMember>.Equals(ObjectMember x, ObjectMember y)
			{
				return Equals(x, y);
			}

			int IEqualityComparer<ObjectMember>.GetHashCode(ObjectMember obj)
			{
				return ((obj.Pd != null) ? obj.Pd.GetHashCode() : 0) ^ ((!(obj.MemberInfo == null)) ? obj.MemberInfo.GetHashCode() : 0);
			}
		}

		private readonly MemberInfo memberInfo;

		private readonly PropertyDescriptor pd;

		private readonly bool hasParams;

		private readonly bool isStatic;

		private readonly MemberTypes memberType;

		private readonly bool highlighted;

		private readonly Type returnType;

		private readonly string name;

		private readonly string parameters;

		private readonly System.Attribute[] attributes;

		private readonly IEnumerable<Parameter> rawParameters;

		public string Name => name;

		public MemberInfo MemberInfo => memberInfo;

		public PropertyDescriptor Pd => pd;

		public bool HasParams => hasParams;

		public bool IsStatic => isStatic;

		public MemberTypes MemberType => memberType;

		public bool Highlighted => highlighted;

		public Type ReturnType => returnType;

		public string Parameters => parameters;

		public bool IsProperty => MemberType == MemberTypes.Property;

		public bool IsMethod => MemberType == MemberTypes.Method;

		public IEnumerable<System.Attribute> Attributes => attributes;

		public ObjectMember(MemberInfo memberInfo)
		{
			this.memberInfo = memberInfo;
			MethodInfo methodInfo = memberInfo as MethodInfo;
			if (methodInfo == null)
			{
				hasParams = false;
				memberType = MemberTypes.Property;
				PropertyInfo propertyInfo = (PropertyInfo)memberInfo;
				attributes = Enumerable.Cast<System.Attribute>(propertyInfo.GetCustomAttributes(inherit: false)).ToArray();
				MethodInfo getMethod = propertyInfo.GetGetMethod();
				isStatic = getMethod.IsStatic;
				returnType = getMethod.ReturnType;
				parameters = null;
			}
			else
			{
				ParameterInfo[] array = methodInfo.GetParameters();
				hasParams = array.Length != 0;
				memberType = MemberTypes.Method;
				isStatic = methodInfo.IsStatic;
				returnType = methodInfo.ReturnType;
				parameters = string.Format("({0})", string.Join(", ", array.Select((ParameterInfo info) => $"{TypeNamesHelper.ShortName(info.ParameterType)} {info.Name}")));
				attributes = Enumerable.Cast<System.Attribute>(methodInfo.GetCustomAttributes(inherit: false)).ToArray();
			}
			highlighted = memberInfo.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(HighlightedMemberAttribute), inherit: false).Any();
			name = memberInfo.Name;
		}

		public ObjectMember(PropertyDescriptor pd)
		{
			this.pd = pd;
			hasParams = false;
			isStatic = false;
			memberType = MemberTypes.Property;
			highlighted = pd.Attributes.Cast<System.Attribute>().Any((System.Attribute attr) => attr is HighlightedMemberAttribute);
			returnType = pd.PropertyType;
			name = pd.Name;
			parameters = null;
			attributes = pd.Attributes.Cast<System.Attribute>().ToArray();
		}

		internal ObjectMember(string name, MemberTypes memberType, Type returnType, bool isStatic, bool highlighted, IEnumerable<Parameter> parameters)
		{
			this.name = name;
			this.memberType = memberType;
			this.returnType = returnType;
			this.isStatic = isStatic;
			this.highlighted = highlighted;
			hasParams = parameters?.Any() ?? false;
			this.parameters = string.Format("({0})", string.Join(", ", parameters.Select((Parameter info) => $"{TypeNamesHelper.ShortName(info.Type)} {info.Name}")));
			rawParameters = parameters;
		}

		public IEnumerable<Parameter> GetParameters(IEnumerable<Parameter> defaultValues)
		{
			if (!hasParams)
			{
				return new Parameter[0];
			}
			if (rawParameters != null)
			{
				return rawParameters.Select((Parameter p) => GetParameter(p, defaultValues));
			}
			MethodInfo methodInfo = MemberInfo as MethodInfo;
			if (methodInfo == null)
			{
				return new Parameter[0];
			}
			return from p in methodInfo.GetParameters()
				select GetParameter(p, defaultValues);
		}

		internal static Parameter GetParameter(ParameterInfo p, IEnumerable<Parameter> defaultValues)
		{
			return GetParameterCore(p.Name, p.ParameterType, p.HasDefaultValue ? p.DefaultValue : null, defaultValues);
		}

		private static Parameter GetParameter(Parameter p, IEnumerable<Parameter> defaultValues)
		{
			return GetParameterCore(p.Name, p.Type, p.Value, defaultValues);
		}

		private static Parameter GetParameterCore(string parameterName, Type parameterType, object parameterValue, IEnumerable<Parameter> defaultValues)
		{
			object value = parameterValue;
			Type type = parameterType;
			if (defaultValues != null)
			{
				foreach (Parameter defaultValue in defaultValues)
				{
					if (string.Equals(defaultValue.Name, parameterName, StringComparison.Ordinal) && (defaultValue.Type == parameterType || defaultValue.Type == typeof(Expression)))
					{
						value = defaultValue.Value;
						type = defaultValue.Type;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return new Parameter(parameterName, type, value);
		}

		public object Invoke(object instance, object[] parameters)
		{
			if (Pd != null)
			{
				return Pd.GetValue(instance);
			}
			MethodInfo methodInfo = (MemberInfo as MethodInfo) ?? ((PropertyInfo)MemberInfo).GetGetMethod();
			return methodInfo.Invoke(instance, parameters);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Format(IsProperty ? "{0} : {1}" : "{0}{2} : {1}", Name, TypeNamesHelper.ShortName(ReturnType), Parameters);
		}
	}
	public sealed class Parameter : DataSourceParameterBase
	{
		internal class EqualityComparer : IEqualityComparer<Parameter>
		{
			public static bool Equals(Parameter x, Parameter y)
			{
				if (x == y)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (x == null || y == null || x.GetType() != y.GetType())
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (string.Equals(x.Name, y.Name, StringComparison.Ordinal) && x.Type == y.Type)
				{
					return object.Equals(x.Value, y.Value);
				}
				return false;
			}

			bool IEqualityComparer<Parameter>.Equals(Parameter x, Parameter y)
			{
				return Equals(x, y);
			}

			int IEqualityComparer<Parameter>.GetHashCode(Parameter obj)
			{
				return 0;
			}
		}

		public Parameter()
		{
		}

		public Parameter(string name, Type type, object value)
			: base(name, type, value)
		{
		}

		internal Parameter(IParameter other)
			: this(((IFilterParameter)other).Name, ((IFilterParameter)other).Type, other.Value)
		{
		}

		internal new static Parameter FromIParameter(IParameter value)
		{
			object obj;
			if (value != null)
			{
				obj = value as Parameter;
				if (obj == null)
				{
					return new Parameter(value);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				obj = null;
			}
			return (Parameter)obj;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (base.Value != null)
			{
				return $"{base.Type} {base.Name} = {base.Value}";
			}
			return $"{base.Type} {base.Name}";
		}
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(ParameterListTypeConverter))]
	public class ParameterList : List<Parameter>
	{
		private class ParameterListTypeConverter : TypeConverter
		{
			public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(string))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}

			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(string))
				{
					if (!(value is ParameterList parameterList))
					{
						return DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.ParameterListNull);
					}
					if (parameterList.Count == 0)
					{
						return DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.ParameterListEmpty);
					}
					return string.Join(", ", parameterList.Select((Parameter p) => $"{p.Name} = {p.Value}"));
				}
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}
		}

		public ParameterList()
		{
		}

		public ParameterList(int capacity)
			: base(capacity)
		{
		}

		public ParameterList(IEnumerable<Parameter> collection)
			: base(collection)
		{
		}

		public void AddRange(Parameter[] items)
		{
			AddRange(items.AsEnumerable());
		}
	}

	public class ConfigFileConnectionStringsProvider : IDataSourceWizardConnectionStringsProvider
	{
		protected virtual IConnectionStringInfo[] GetConnectionStrings()
		{
			return AppConfigHelper.ConnectionStrings();
		}

		public Dictionary<string, string> GetConnectionDescriptions()
		{
			DataConnectionParametersBase connectionParameters;
			JsonDataConnection jsonConnection;
			return (from connectionString in GetConnectionStrings()
				where AppConfigHelper.TryCreateSqlConnectionParameters(connectionString, out connectionParameters) || JsonSourceConfigurationHelper.TryCreateJsonDataConnection(connectionString, out jsonConnection)
				select connectionString.Name).ToDictionary((string x) => x, (string x) => x);
		}

		public DataConnectionParametersBase GetDataConnectionParameters(string name)
		{
			IConnectionStringInfo val = GetConnectionStrings().FirstOrDefault((IConnectionStringInfo info) => info.Name == name);
			if (val != null)
			{
				if (AppConfigHelper.TryCreateSqlConnectionParameters(val, out var connectionParameters))
				{
					return connectionParameters;
				}
				if (JsonSourceConfigurationHelper.TryCreateJsonDataConnection(val, out var jsonConnection))
				{
					return new CustomStringConnectionParameters(jsonConnection.CreateConnectionString());
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.DataAccess.Web.QueryBuilder.Native.Services
{
	public class QueryBuilderInputSerializer : IQueryBuilderInputSerializer
	{
		public const bool DefaultValidateQueryByExecution = true;

		private bool validateQueryByExecution = true;

		private readonly ISqlDataSourceWizardService wizardService;

		private readonly IDataSourceSerializationService dataSourceSerializationService;

		private readonly SqlDataSourceWizardServiceContext context;

		public QueryBuilderInputSerializer(ISqlDataSourceWizardService sqlDataSourceWizardService, IDataSourceSerializationService dataSourceSerializationService, SqlDataSourceWizardServiceContext context)
		{
			wizardService = sqlDataSourceWizardService;
			this.dataSourceSerializationService = dataSourceSerializationService;
			this.context = context;
		}

		public QueryBuilderInput DeserializeSaveQueryRequest(SaveQueryRequest saveQueryRequest)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)saveQueryRequest, "saveQueryRequest");
			SelectStatementRequest request = new SelectStatementRequest
			{
				ConnectionJSON = saveQueryRequest.Connection,
				SqlQueryJSON = saveQueryRequest.QueryLayout
			};
			string sqlSelectStatement = wizardService.GetSelectStatement(request).SqlSelectStatement;
			if (validateQueryByExecution)
			{
				SelectQuery selectQuery = (SelectQuery)dataSourceSerializationService.RestoreQuery(saveQueryRequest.QueryLayout);
				selectQuery.Top = 1;
				wizardService.GetDataPreview(new SelectStatementRequest
				{
					ConnectionJSON = saveQueryRequest.Connection,
					SqlQueryJSON = "{\"Query\":" + dataSourceSerializationService.PackQuery(selectQuery) + "}"
				});
			}
			return new QueryBuilderInput(sqlSelectStatement, (SelectQuery)dataSourceSerializationService.RestoreQuery(saveQueryRequest.QueryLayout));
		}

		public SqlDataConnection DeserializeSqlDataConnection(string connectionJson)
		{
			return context.DataSourceSerializer.RestoreConnection(connectionJson);
		}
	}

	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.DataAccess.UI.Design.JsonSchemaNodeCodeDomSerializer, DevExpress.DataAccess.v23.2.UI, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(MongoDBSchemaNodeTypeConverter))]
	public class MongoDBSchemaNode : INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		internal class Counter
		{
			public int I { get; private set; }

			public Counter(int i)
			{
				I = i;
			}

			public void Increment()
			{
				I++;
			}
		}

		private class MongoDBSchemaNodeTypeConverter : TypeConverter
		{
			public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (!(destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor)))
				{
					return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
				}
				return true;
			}

			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (value is MongoDBSchemaNode mongoDBSchemaNode && destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					List<Type> list = new List<Type>();
					list.Add(typeof(string));
					list.Add(typeof(bool?));
					List<Type> list2 = list;
					List<object> list3 = new List<object> { mongoDBSchemaNode.Name, mongoDBSchemaNode.Selected };
					if (mongoDBSchemaNode.NodeType != MongoDBNodeType.Object)
					{
						list2.Add(typeof(MongoDBNodeType));
						list3.Add(mongoDBSchemaNode.NodeType);
						if (ShouldSerializeType(mongoDBSchemaNode))
						{
							list2.Add(typeof(Type));
							list3.Add(mongoDBSchemaNode.Type);
						}
					}
					ConstructorInfo constructor = typeof(MongoDBSchemaNode).GetConstructor(BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public, null, list2.ToArray(), null);
					return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, list3.ToArray(), isComplete: false);
				}
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}
		}

		public const string XML_Name = "Name";

		public const string XML_DisplayName = "DisplayName";

		public const string XML_Type = "Type";

		public const string XML_Selected = "Selected";

		public const string XML_NodeType = "NodeType";

		public const string XML_DiscoveryLimitApplied = "DiscoveryLimitApplied";

		private string displayName;

		private bool? selected;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DXHelpExclude(true)]
		public int Id { get; private set; }

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DXHelpExclude(true)]
		public int ParentId { get; private set; }

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DXHelpExclude(true)]
		public string ActualName => DisplayName ?? Name;

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public string Name { get; set; }

		[DefaultValue(null)]
		public string DisplayName
		{
			get
			{
				return displayName;
			}
			set
			{
				displayName = value;
				OnPropertyChanged("DisplayName");
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public Type Type { get; set; }

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public MongoDBNodeType NodeType { get; set; }

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public bool? Selected
		{
			get
			{
				return selected;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != selected)
				{
					selected = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("Selected");
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool DiscoveryLimitApplied { get; set; }

		internal bool AnySelected
		{
			get
			{
				if (Selected.HasValue && Selected.Value)
				{
					return true;
				}
				foreach (MongoDBSchemaNode children in ChildrenList)
				{
					if (children.AnySelected)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public MongoDBSchemaNode Parent { get; internal set; }

		public IEnumerable<MongoDBSchemaNode> Children => ChildrenList;

		private List<MongoDBSchemaNode> ChildrenList { get; } = new List<MongoDBSchemaNode>();

		internal bool HasSelectedChildren => Children.Any((MongoDBSchemaNode child) => child.Selected.HasValue && child.Selected.Value);

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		public List<MongoDBSchemaNode> Nodes => ChildrenList;

		internal MongoDBSchemaNode this[int index] => ChildrenList[index];

		internal IEnumerable<string> RootNames
		{
			get
			{
				if (NodeType == MongoDBNodeType.Property)
				{
					yield break;
				}
				yield return GetFullName();
				if (NodeType == MongoDBNodeType.Array)
				{
					yield break;
				}
				foreach (MongoDBSchemaNode child in Children)
				{
					foreach (string rootName in child.RootNames)
					{
						yield return rootName;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		internal static void ApplySelectedState(MongoDBSchemaNode source, MongoDBSchemaNode target)
		{
			foreach (MongoDBSchemaNode node in target.Children)
			{
				MongoDBSchemaNode mongoDBSchemaNode = source.Children.FirstOrDefault((MongoDBSchemaNode n) => n.Name == node.Name);
				if (mongoDBSchemaNode == null)
				{
					if (node.NodeType == MongoDBNodeType.Property)
					{
						node.Selected = false;
					}
					else if (node.NodeType == MongoDBNodeType.Array && node.ChildrenList.Count == 0)
					{
						node.Selected = false;
					}
					continue;
				}
				if (node.NodeType != mongoDBSchemaNode.NodeType)
				{
					node.Selected = false;
					continue;
				}
				if (node.NodeType == MongoDBNodeType.Property || node.NodeType == MongoDBNodeType.ObjectID)
				{
					node.Selected = mongoDBSchemaNode.Selected;
				}
				else if (node.NodeType == MongoDBNodeType.Array && node.ChildrenList.Count == 0)
				{
					node.Selected = mongoDBSchemaNode.Selected;
				}
				else
				{
					ApplySelectedState(mongoDBSchemaNode, node);
					if (node.Children.All((MongoDBSchemaNode n) => n.Selected == true))
					{
						node.selected = true;
					}
					else if (node.Children.All((MongoDBSchemaNode n) => n.Selected == false))
					{
						node.selected = false;
					}
					else
					{
						node.selected = null;
					}
				}
				node.DisplayName = mongoDBSchemaNode.DisplayName;
			}
		}

		public MongoDBSchemaNode()
			: this("root", true)
		{
			ParentId = -1;
			Id = 0;
		}

		public MongoDBSchemaNode(string name, bool? selected)
		{
			Name = name;
			Selected = selected;
			NodeType = MongoDBNodeType.Object;
		}

		public MongoDBSchemaNode(string name, bool? selected, MongoDBNodeType nodeType)
		{
			Name = name;
			Selected = selected;
			NodeType = nodeType;
			if (nodeType == MongoDBNodeType.ObjectID)
			{
				Type = MongoDBDatabase.TypeObjectId;
			}
		}

		public MongoDBSchemaNode(string name, bool? selected, MongoDBNodeType nodeType, Type type)
		{
			Name = name;
			Selected = selected;
			NodeType = nodeType;
			Type = type;
		}

		internal MongoDBSchemaNode(MongoDBSchemaNode other)
		{
			Id = other.Id;
			ParentId = other.ParentId;
			DisplayName = other.DisplayName;
			Name = other.Name;
			Selected = other.Selected;
			NodeType = other.NodeType;
			Type = other.Type;
			if (other.Children.Any())
			{
				AddChildren(other.Children.Select((MongoDBSchemaNode child) => child.Clone()).ToArray());
			}
			DiscoveryLimitApplied = other.DiscoveryLimitApplied;
		}

		internal MongoDBSchemaNode(string name, Type type)
			: this(name, type, limitApplied: false)
		{
		}

		internal MongoDBSchemaNode(string name, Type type, bool limitApplied)
			: this(name, true)
		{
			DiscoveryLimitApplied = limitApplied;
			NodeType = MongoDBNodeType.Property;
			Type = type;
			if (!DataContext.IsStandardType(type))
			{
				NodeType = MongoDBNodeType.Object;
				if (TypeHelper.CanUnfold(type, out var columnItemType))
				{
					NodeType = MongoDBNodeType.Array;
					type = columnItemType;
				}
				if (type == MongoDBDatabase.TypeObjectId)
				{
					NodeType = MongoDBNodeType.ObjectID;
				}
				else if (!DataContext.IsStandardType(type))
				{
					PropertyInfo[] properties = type.GetProperties(BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public);
					foreach (PropertyInfo propertyInfo in properties)
					{
						MongoDBSchemaNode mongoDBSchemaNode = new MongoDBSchemaNode(propertyInfo.Name, propertyInfo.PropertyType);
						if (propertyInfo.CustomAttributes.FirstOrDefault((CustomAttributeData c) => c.AttributeType == typeof(System.ComponentModel.DisplayNameAttribute))?.ConstructorArguments.FirstOrDefault().Value is string text)
						{
							mongoDBSchemaNode.displayName = text;
						}
						AddChildren(mongoDBSchemaNode);
					}
				}
			}
			Numerate(new Counter(Id));
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DXHelpExclude(true)]
		public MongoDBSchemaNode[] GetFlatModel()
		{
			if (Parent == null)
			{
				ParentId = -1;
				Id = 0;
				Counter counter = new Counter(Id);
				Numerate(counter);
			}
			List<MongoDBSchemaNode> list = new List<MongoDBSchemaNode>();
			ForEach(delegate(MongoDBSchemaNode node)
			{
				list.Add(node);
			});
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		public IEnumerable<MongoDBSchemaNode> GetParents()
		{
			for (MongoDBSchemaNode node = this; node != null; node = node.Parent)
			{
				yield return node;
			}
		}

		public void AddChildren(params MongoDBSchemaNode[] nodes)
		{
			foreach (MongoDBSchemaNode mongoDBSchemaNode in nodes)
			{
				mongoDBSchemaNode.Parent = this;
			}
			ChildrenList.AddRange(nodes);
		}

		public void ForEach(Action<MongoDBSchemaNode> action)
		{
			action(this);
			ForEachCore(action, Children);
		}

		public void AbandonChildren()
		{
			ChildrenList.Clear();
		}

		private void ForEachCore(Action<MongoDBSchemaNode> action, IEnumerable<MongoDBSchemaNode> nodes)
		{
			foreach (MongoDBSchemaNode node in nodes)
			{
				action(node);
				ForEachCore(action, node.Children);
			}
		}

		private bool ChildrenEquals(MongoDBSchemaNode other)
		{
			if (ChildrenList.Count != other.ChildrenList.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < ChildrenList.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!object.Equals(ChildrenList[i], other.ChildrenList[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void Numerate(Counter counter)
		{
			foreach (MongoDBSchemaNode child in Children)
			{
				counter.Increment();
				child.Id = counter.I;
				child.ParentId = Id;
				child.Numerate(counter);
			}
		}

		internal string GetFullName()
		{
			return string.Join(".", GetParents().Select(GetSafeName).Reverse());
		}

		private static string GetSafeName(MongoDBSchemaNode node)
		{
			return GetSafeName(node.Name);
		}

		internal static string GetSafeName(string name)
		{
			if (name.All((char x) => x == '_' || char.IsLetter(x) || (char.IsDigit(x) && name.IndexOf(x) != 0)))
			{
				return name;
			}
			return "['" + name + "']";
		}

		protected internal virtual MongoDBSchemaNode Clone()
		{
			return new MongoDBSchemaNode(this);
		}

		protected virtual void OnPropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			this.PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
		}

		protected internal virtual XElement SaveToXml()
		{
			XElement xElement = new XElement("Schema");
			XElement xElement2 = new XElement("Node");
			SaveToXml(xElement2);
			foreach (MongoDBSchemaNode child in Children)
			{
				xElement2.Add(SaveNodes(child));
			}
			xElement.Add(xElement2);
			return xElement;
		}

		private void SaveToXml(XElement root)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Name))
			{
				root.Add(new XAttribute("Name", Name));
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(DisplayName))
			{
				root.Add(new XAttribute("DisplayName", DisplayName));
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeType(this))
			{
				root.Add(new XAttribute("Type", Type.ToString()));
			}
			if (Selected.HasValue)
			{
				root.Add(new XAttribute("Selected", Selected));
			}
			root.AddAttribute(NodeType.ToString(), "NodeType");
			if (DiscoveryLimitApplied)
			{
				root.Add(new XAttribute("DiscoveryLimitApplied", true));
			}
		}

		internal static XElement SaveNodes(MongoDBSchemaNode current)
		{
			XElement xElement = new XElement("Node");
			current.SaveToXml(xElement);
			foreach (MongoDBSchemaNode child in current.Children)
			{
				xElement.Add(SaveNodes(child));
			}
			return xElement;
		}

		protected internal virtual void LoadFromXml(XElement schema)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)schema, "schema");
			XElement root = schema.Element("Node");
			LoadNodeData(this, root);
		}

		private void LoadNodeData(MongoDBSchemaNode node, XElement root)
		{
			node.Name = root.GetAttributeValue("Name");
			node.DisplayName = root.GetAttributeValue("DisplayName");
			string attributeValue = root.GetAttributeValue("Selected");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(attributeValue))
			{
				node.Selected = bool.Parse(attributeValue);
			}
			node.NodeType = (MongoDBNodeType)Enum.Parse(typeof(MongoDBNodeType), root.GetAttributeValue("NodeType"));
			if (node.NodeType != MongoDBNodeType.Object)
			{
				string attributeValue2 = root.GetAttributeValue("Type");
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(attributeValue2) && attributeValue2 != typeof(object).FullName)
				{
					node.Type = SafeTypeResolver.GetPrimitiveOrTrustedType(attributeValue2, (IDictionary<string, Type>)null, (bool?)null);
				}
			}
			if (bool.TryParse(root.GetAttributeValue("DiscoveryLimitApplied"), out var result) && result)
			{
				node.DiscoveryLimitApplied = true;
			}
			node.AbandonChildren();
			node.LoadNodes(root, new Counter(Id));
		}

		private void LoadNodes(XElement parentNode, Counter counter)
		{
			IEnumerable<XElement> enumerable = parentNode.Elements("Node");
			foreach (XElement item in enumerable)
			{
				MongoDBSchemaNode mongoDBSchemaNode = new MongoDBSchemaNode();
				LoadNodeData(mongoDBSchemaNode, item);
				counter.Increment();
				MongoDBSchemaNode mongoDBSchemaNode2 = new MongoDBSchemaNode(mongoDBSchemaNode)
				{
					Id = counter.I,
					ParentId = Id
				};
				AddChildren(mongoDBSchemaNode2);
			}
		}

		internal static bool ShouldSerializeType(MongoDBSchemaNode node)
		{
			Type type = node.Type;
			if (node.NodeType == MongoDBNodeType.Array && type != null)
			{
				type = type.GetElementType();
			}
			if (type != null && type != typeof(object))
			{
				return DataContext.IsStandardType(type);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	{
		ObjectID,
		Object,
		Array,
		Property
	}

		public string Name
		{

					name = "MongoDBConnection" + nameCounter++;
				}
				return name;
			}
			set

				name = value;
			}
		}

			}
		}

		public bool StoreConnectionNameOnly { get; set; }

		public string ProviderName { get; set; }

		internal IMongoDBClient Client { get; private set; }

		internal event ConfigureDataConnectionEventHandler ConfigureDataConnection;

		internal static DatabaseConnectionException ProcessException(string connectionName, Exception exception)
		{
			if (exception is DatabaseConnectionException result)
			{
				return result;
			}
			Exception ex = exception;
			string text = exception.Message;
			if (exception is TargetInvocationException { InnerException: not null } ex2)
			{
				ex = ex2.InnerException;
				text = ex.Message;
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(connectionName))
			{
				text = string.Format(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.DatabaseConnectionExceptionMessage), connectionName, text);
			}
			return new DatabaseConnectionException(string.Format(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.DatabaseConnectionExceptionStringId), text), ex);
		}

		public string CreateConnectionString()
		{
			return GetConnectionString(ConnectionParameters);
		}

		public string CreateConnectionString(bool blackoutCredentials)
		{
			if (ConnectionParameters == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (blackoutCredentials)
			{
				MongoDBConnectionParametersBase mongoDBConnectionParametersBase = ConnectionParameters;
				if (mongoDBConnectionParametersBase == null || mongoDBConnectionParametersBase.HasSensitiveInfo)
				{
					return CreateConnectionStringWithBlackoutCredentials(ConnectionParameters);
				}
			}
			return GetConnectionString(ConnectionParameters);
		}

		public void BlackoutCredentials()
		{
			MongoDBConnectionParametersBase mongoDBConnectionParametersBase = ConnectionParameters;
			if (mongoDBConnectionParametersBase != null && mongoDBConnectionParametersBase.HasSensitiveInfo)
			{
				ConnectionParameters.ClearCredentials(keepUserName: false);
			}
		}

		public void Open()
		{
			Open(CancellationToken.None);
		}

		public void Open(CancellationToken token)
		{
			if (TestClient != null)
			{
				Client = TestClient;
			}
			else
			{
				if (Client != null)
				{
					return;
				}
				MongoDBConnectionParametersBase parameters = ConnectionParametersInternal;
				try
				{
					if (this.ConfigureDataConnection != null)
					{
						ConfigureDataConnectionEventArgs e = new ConfigureDataConnectionEventArgs(Name, ConnectionParametersInternal);
						this.ConfigureDataConnection(this, e);
						MongoDBConnectionParametersBase mongoDBConnectionParametersBase = e.ConnectionParameters;
						if (mongoDBConnectionParametersBase != null)
						{
							parameters = mongoDBConnectionParametersBase;
						}
					}
				}
				catch (Exception exception)
				{
					throw ProcessException(Name, exception);
				}
				while (true)
				{
					try
					{
						string connectionString = GetConnectionString(parameters) ?? "";
						IMongoDBClient mongoDBClient = GetMongoDBClient(connectionString);
						mongoDBClient.CheckConnection(token);
						Client = mongoDBClient;
						break;
					}
					catch (NoMongoDBDriverException exception2)
					{
						throw ProcessException(name, exception2);
					}
					catch (Exception exception3)
					{
						token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
						ConnectionErrorEventArgs e2 = new ConnectionErrorEventArgs(name, parameters, exception3);
						this.ConnectionError?.Invoke(this, e2);
						if (!e2.Handled)
						{
							throw ProcessException(name, exception3);
						}
						parameters = e2.ConnectionParameters;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private string CreateConnectionStringWithBlackoutCredentials(MongoDBConnectionParametersBase parameters)
		{
			return MongoDBClientHelper.Factory.CreateConnectionStringWithBlackoutCredentials(parameters);
		}

		private string GetConnectionString(MongoDBConnectionParametersBase parameters)
		{
			return MongoDBClientHelper.Factory.GetConnectionString(parameters);
		}

		private IMongoDBClient GetMongoDBClient(string connectionString)
		{
			return MongoDBClientHelper.Factory.GetClient(connectionString);
		}

		public void Close()
		{
			Client = null;
		}

		private void ApplyParameters(MongoDBConnectionParametersBase connectionParameters)
		{
			ConnectionParameters = connectionParameters;
		}

		internal void SaveToXml(XElement element)
		{
			element.Add(new XAttribute("Name", Name));
			if (StoreConnectionNameOnly)
			{
				element.Add(new XAttribute("FromAppConfig", StoreConnectionNameOnly));
			}
			else if (ConnectionParameters != null)
			{
				XElement xElement = ConnectionParameters.SaveToXml();
				if (xElement != null)
				{
					element.Add(xElement);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void LoadFromXml(XElement element)
		{
			Name = element.GetAttributeValue("Name");
			string attributeValue = element.GetAttributeValue("FromAppConfig");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(attributeValue) && StringExtensions.CompareInvariantCultureIgnoreCase(attributeValue, bool.TrueString) == 0)
			{
				StoreConnectionNameOnly = true;
			}
			ConnectionParameters = MongoDBConnectionParametersBase.CreateFromXml(element);
		}
	}

		protected override void FillInternal(IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters, string[] queriesToFill, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0011: Expected O, but got Unknown
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)queriesToFill, "queriesToFill");
			ServiceManager val = new ServiceManager();
			IParameter[] parameters = (IParameter[])(((object)sourceParameters?.ToArray()) ?? ((object)new IParameter[0]));
			val.AddService(typeof(IParameterSupplierBase), (object)new ParameterSupplier(parameters));
			val.AddService(typeof(QueryHelper), (object)new QueryHelper(queriesToFill));
			((IListAdapter)this).FillList((IServiceProvider)val);
		}

		}

			FillInternal(serviceProvider, queriesToFill);

		async Task IListAdapterAsync2.FillAsync(IServiceProvider serviceProvider, CancellationToken token, string[] queriesToFill)
		{
			if (!fillListSemaphore.WaitOne(300))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Data source is busy");
			}
			try
			{
				ResultCollection[] resultSet = await FillCoreAsync(serviceProvider, token, queriesToFill);
				isFilled = true;
				ApplyResult(queriesToFill, resultSet);
			}
			catch (OperationCanceledException)
			{
			}
			finally
			{
				fillListSemaphore.Release();
			}
		}

		IAsyncResult IListAdapterAsync.BeginFillList(IServiceProvider serviceProvider, CancellationToken token)

		}

		IAsyncResult IListAdapterAsync2.BeginFillList(IServiceProvider serviceProvider, CancellationToken token, string[] queriesToFill)
		{
			ReplaceServicesFromProvider(serviceProvider);
			if (!fillListSemaphore.WaitOne(300))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Data source is busy");
			}
			return FillCoreAsync(serviceProvider, token, queriesToFill);
		}

		private Task<ResultCollection[]> FillCoreAsync(IServiceProvider serviceProvider, CancellationToken token, string[] queriesToFill)
		{
			ReplaceServicesFromProvider(serviceProvider);
			IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters = ParameterSupplierHelper.GetSourceParameters(serviceProvider);
			return FillCoreAsync(sourceParameters, token, queriesToFill);
		}

		private async Task<ResultCollection[]> FillCoreAsync(IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters, CancellationToken token, string[] queriesToFill)
		{
			return (await DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.MongoDB.QueryExecutor.ExecuteQueriesAsync(base.Connection, base.Queries.Where((MongoDBQuery q) => queriesToFill.Contains(q.ActualName)), sourceParameters, base.SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount, includeData: true, token)).ToArray();
		}

		void IListAdapterAsync.EndFillList(IAsyncResult result, CancellationToken token)
		{
			Task<ResultCollection[]> task = (Task<ResultCollection[]>)result;
			try
			{
				task.Wait(token);
				isFilled = true;
				ResultCollection[] result2 = task.Result;
				ApplyResult(result2.Select((ResultCollection c) => c.Name).ToArray(), result2);
			}
			catch (OperationCanceledException)
			{
			}
			catch (AggregateException ex2)
			{
				if (task.IsFaulted)
				{
					throw ExceptionHelper.Unwrap(ex2);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				fillListSemaphore.Release();
			}
		}

		private void FillInternal(IServiceProvider serviceProvider, string[] queriesToFill)
		{
			ReplaceServicesFromProvider(serviceProvider);
			IList<IParameter> sourceParameters = ParameterSupplierHelper.GetSourceParameters(serviceProvider).ToList();
			ResultCollection[] resultSet = FillCore(queriesToFill, sourceParameters, includeData: true, CancellationToken.None);
			ApplyResult(queriesToFill, resultSet);
			isFilled = true;
		}

		private void ReplaceServicesFromProvider(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
		{
			ReplaceServiceFromProvider(typeof(IConnectionStringsProvider), serviceProvider);
			ReplaceServiceFromProvider(typeof(IMongoDBConnectionProviderService), serviceProvider);
			ReplaceServiceFromProvider(typeof(UrlResolver), serviceProvider);
		}

		private bool ShouldRefillQuery(MongoDBQuery query)
		{
			ResultCollection resultCollection = Result?.OfType<ResultCollection>().SingleOrDefault((ResultCollection x) => x.Name == query.ActualName);
			if (resultCollection != null)
			{
				if (!resultCollection.IsEmpty)
				{
					return query.Parameters.Any(DataSourceParameterHelper.IsBoundToExternalParameter);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal override void RenameResultSchemaPart(string oldQueryName, string newQueryName)
		{
			if (Result.Collections.SingleOrDefault((ResultCollection t) => t.Name == newQueryName) != null)
			{
				throw new InvalidNameException(string.Format(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.MessageDuplicateItemName), newQueryName));
			}
			ResultCollection resultCollection = Result.Collections.SingleOrDefault((ResultCollection t) => t.Name == oldQueryName);
			if (resultCollection != null)
			{
				ApplyResult(new string[1] { newQueryName }, new ResultCollection(newQueryName, resultCollection.InnerList, resultCollection.ElementType));
			}
		}

		private ResultCollection[] FillCore(string[] queriesToFill, IList<IParameter> sourceParameters, bool includeData, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			return DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.MongoDB.QueryExecutor.ExecuteQueries(base.Connection, base.Queries.Where((MongoDBQuery q) => queriesToFill.Contains(q.ActualName)), sourceParameters, base.SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount, includeData, cancellationToken).ToArray();
		}

		internal void ApplyResult(string[] queriesToFill, params ResultCollection[] resultSet)
		{
			Result.ApplyResult(resultSet.ToArray());
		}

		internal XElement GetResultSchemaXml()
		{
			XElement xElement = new XElement("DataSet");
			foreach (ResultCollection collection in Result.Collections)
			{
				MongoDBSchemaNode current2 = new MongoDBSchemaNode(collection.Name, collection.ElementType);
				XElement content = MongoDBSchemaNode.SaveNodes(current2);
				xElement.Add(content);
			}
			return xElement;
		}

		internal void SetResultSchemaXml(XElement resultSetElement)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)resultSetElement, "resultSetElement");
			foreach (XElement item in resultSetElement.Elements())
			{
				MongoDBSchemaNode mongoDBSchemaNode = new MongoDBSchemaNode();
				XElement xElement = new XElement("schema");
				xElement.Add(item);
				mongoDBSchemaNode.LoadFromXml(xElement);
				Type elementType = MongoDBSchemaHelper.CreateMongoDBType(mongoDBSchemaNode);
				Result.AddSilent(new ResultCollection(mongoDBSchemaNode.Name, null, elementType));
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeResultSchemaSerializable()
		{
			return base.Queries.All((MongoDBQuery q) => q.Schema == null);
		}

		bool IDynamicLookupSettingsDataProvider.CanGetResult(string dataMember)
		{
			return base.Queries.Any((MongoDBQuery q) => q.ActualName == dataMember);
		}

		void IDynamicLookupSettingsDataProvider.Initialize(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
		{
			ReplaceServicesFromProvider(serviceProvider);
		}

		private async Task<DynamicLookupResult> GetResultAsyncInternal(string dataMember, IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters, string filterString, CancellationToken cancellationToken, bool useAsync)
		{
			MongoDBQuery mongoDBQuery = base.Queries.First((MongoDBQuery q) => q.ActualName == dataMember).Clone();
			IParameter[] array = (parameters as IParameter[]) ?? parameters.ToArray();
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(filterString))
			{
				CriteriaOperator criteriaOperator = FilterHelper.GetCriteriaOperator(filterString, array);
				criteriaOperator = criteriaOperator.Accept<CriteriaOperator>((ICriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>)new DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.MongoDB.QueryExecutor.ParametersToValuesReplacer());
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(mongoDBQuery.FilterString))
				{
					mongoDBQuery.FilterString = ((object)criteriaOperator).ToString();
				}
				else
				{
					CriteriaOperator criteriaOperator2 = FilterHelper.GetCriteriaOperator(mongoDBQuery.FilterString, (IEnumerable<IParameter>)mongoDBQuery.Parameters);
					mongoDBQuery.FilterString = ((object)new GroupOperator((GroupOperatorType)0, (CriteriaOperator[])(object)new CriteriaOperator[2] { criteriaOperator2, criteriaOperator })).ToString();
				}
			}
			ResultCollection[] array2 = ((!useAsync) ? DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.MongoDB.QueryExecutor.ExecuteQueries(base.Connection, new MongoDBQuery[1] { mongoDBQuery }, array, base.SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount, includeData: true, cancellationToken).ToArray() : (await DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.MongoDB.QueryExecutor.ExecuteQueriesAsync(base.Connection, new MongoDBQuery[1] { mongoDBQuery }, array, base.SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount, includeData: true, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false)).ToArray());
			ResultCollection[] array3 = array2;
			return new DynamicLookupResult
			{
				Result = array3[0],
				FilterApplied = true,
				ActualDataMember = null
			};
		}

		DynamicLookupResult IDynamicLookupSettingsDataProvider.GetResult(string dataMember, IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters, string filterString, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			return TaskExtensions.Await<DynamicLookupResult>(GetResultAsyncInternal(dataMember, parameters, filterString, cancellationToken, useAsync: false));
		}

		Task<DynamicLookupResult> IDynamicLookupSettingsDataProvider.GetResultAsync(string dataMember, IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters, string filterString, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			return GetResultAsyncInternal(dataMember, parameters, filterString, cancellationToken, useAsync: true);
		}
	}

		{

				FilterString = FilterString

			if (Schema != null)

		public void CheckQueryName(MongoDBQuery query)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)query, "query");
			string actualName = query.ActualName;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(actualName))
			{
				throw new InvalidNameException(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.MessageEmptyQueryName));
			}
			using IEnumerator<MongoDBQuery> enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				MongoDBQuery current = enumerator.Current;
				if (current != query && current.ActualName == actualName)
				{
					throw new InvalidNameException(string.Format(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.MessageDuplicateQueryName), actualName));
				}
			}
		}

		internal void CheckQueryName(string queryName)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(queryName))
			{
				throw new InvalidNameException(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.MessageEmptyQueryName));
			}
			if (ContainsName(queryName))
			{
				throw new InvalidNameException(string.Format(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.MessageDuplicateQueryName), queryName));
			}
		}

		public string GenerateUniqueName(MongoDBQuery query)
		{
			return GenerateUniqueName(query, this);
		}

		internal class EqualityComparer : IEqualityComparer<DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter>
		{
			public static bool Equals(DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter x, DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter y)
			{
				if (x == y)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (x == null || y == null || x.GetType() != y.GetType())
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (string.Equals(x.Name, y.Name, StringComparison.Ordinal) && x.Type == y.Type)
				{
					return object.Equals(x.Value, y.Value);
				}
				return false;
			}

			bool IEqualityComparer<DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter>.Equals(DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter x, DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter y)
			{
				return Equals(x, y);
			}

			int IEqualityComparer<DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter>.GetHashCode(DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter obj)
			{
				return 0;
			}
		}

		internal new static QueryParameter FromIParameter(IParameter value)
		{
			object obj;
			if (value != null)
			{
				obj = value as QueryParameter;
				if (obj == null)
				{
					return new QueryParameter(value);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				obj = null;
			}
			return (QueryParameter)obj;
		}

			{
				public CustomConnectionStringPropertyDescriptor(PropertyDescriptor parent)
					: base(parent)
				{
				}

				public override object GetValue(object component)
				{
					string connectionString = (string)base.GetValue(component);
					return DataConnectionHelper.ObscureMongoDBConnectionString(connectionString);
				}
			}

			protected override PropertyDescriptor ProcessProperty(PropertyDescriptor property)
			{
				if (property.Name == "ConnectionString")
				{
					return new CustomConnectionStringPropertyDescriptor(property);
				}
				return new DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.ReadOnlyPropertyDescriptor(base.ProcessProperty(property));
			}

			{
				return ((MongoDBDataSourceBase)(context?.Instance))?.ConnectionParameters != null;
			}
		}

			}
		}

		[Description("Allows you to configure connection settings for a MongoDB instance.")]
		public event ConfigureDataConnectionEventHandler ConfigureDataConnection;

		public event ConnectionErrorEventHandler ConnectionError;

		protected MongoDBDataSourceBase()
		{
			SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount = 100;
			Queries = new MongoDBQueryCollection(this);
		}

		protected MongoDBDataSourceBase(MongoDBConnectionParametersBase connectionParameters)
			: this()
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)connectionParameters, "connectionParameters");
			ConnectionParameters = connectionParameters;
		}

		protected MongoDBDataSourceBase(string connectionName)
			: this()
		{
			Guard.ArgumentIsNotNullOrEmpty(connectionName, "connectionName");
			this.connectionName = connectionName;
		}

		public override XElement SaveToXml()
		{
			return MongoDBDataSourceSerializer.SaveToXml(this, base.ExtensionsProvider);
		}

		public override void LoadFromXml(XElement element)
		{
			MongoDBDataSourceSerializer.LoadFromXml(this, element, base.ExtensionsProvider);
		}

		protected override string GetDataMember()
		{
			string text = DataMember;
			if (text == null)
			{
				if (Queries.Count <= 0)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				text = Queries[0].ActualName;
			}
			return text;
		}

		public void Fill()
		{
			Fill(null, null);
		}

		public override void Fill(IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters)
		{
			Fill(sourceParameters, null);
		}

		public void Fill(string[] queriesToFill)
		{
			Fill(null, queriesToFill);
		}

		public void Fill(IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters, string[] queriesToFill)
		{
			FillInternal(sourceParameters ?? Enumerable.Empty<IParameter>(), queriesToFill ?? Queries.Select((MongoDBQuery q) => q.ActualName).ToArray(), CancellationToken.None);
		}

		protected abstract void FillInternal(IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters, string[] queriesToFill, CancellationToken cancellationToken);

		protected internal void AssignConnection(MongoDBDataConnection sourceConnection)
		{
			if (sourceConnection != null)
			{
				ConnectionName = sourceConnection.Name;
				if (!sourceConnection.StoreConnectionNameOnly)
				{
					ConnectionParameters = sourceConnection.ConnectionParameters?.Clone();
					ConnectionParametersInternal = sourceConnection.ConnectionParametersInternal?.Clone();
					connection = null;
				}
			}
		}

		internal IMongoDBConnectionProviderService GetMongoDBConnectionProviderService()
		{
			IMongoDBConnectionProviderService mongoDBConnectionProviderService = ServiceProviderExtensions.GetService<IMongoDBConnectionProviderService>((IServiceProvider)this);
			if (mongoDBConnectionProviderService == null)
			{
				mongoDBConnectionProviderService = new MongoDBConnectionProviderService(ServiceProviderExtensions.GetService<IConnectionStringsProvider>((IServiceProvider)this) ?? RuntimeConnectionStringsProvider.CreateDefault());
				((IServiceContainer)this).AddService(typeof(IMongoDBConnectionProviderService), (object)mongoDBConnectionProviderService);
			}
			return mongoDBConnectionProviderService;
		}

		internal void SetConnectionInfo(MongoDBDataConnection sourceConnection)
		{
			if (sourceConnection != null)
			{
				ConnectionName = sourceConnection.Name;
				ConnectionParameters = (sourceConnection.StoreConnectionNameOnly ? null : sourceConnection.ConnectionParameters);
			}
			else
			{
				connectionName = null;
				ConnectionParameters = null;
			}
		}

		internal void ApplyConnection(MongoDBDataConnection dataConnection)
		{
			ConnectionName = dataConnection.Name;
			if (!dataConnection.StoreConnectionNameOnly)
			{
				ConnectionParameters = dataConnection.ConnectionParameters;
				ConnectionParametersInternal = dataConnection.ConnectionParametersInternal;
			}
		}

		internal abstract void RebuildResultSchemaInternal();

		internal abstract void ApplyResultSchemaInternal(IEnumerable<ResultCollection> schema);

		internal abstract void ApplyResultSchemaInternal(string name, Type documentType);

		internal abstract bool TryGetResultSchemaInternal(string queryName, out Type schema);

		internal abstract void RenameResultSchemaPart(string oldQueryName, string newQueryName);

		private void CreateConnection()
		{
			if (connection != null)
			{
				connection.ConfigureDataConnection -= Connection_ConfigureDataConnection;
				connection.ConnectionError -= Connection_ConnectionError;
			}
			if (connectionParameters == null && connectionName == null)
			{
				connection = null;
				return;
			}
			if (ConnectionParametersInternal != null)
			{
				connection = new MongoDBDataConnection(ConnectionParameters)
				{
					ConnectionParametersInternal = ConnectionParametersInternal,
					Name = (ConnectionName ?? "Connection")
				};
			}
			else
			{
				IMongoDBConnectionProviderService mongoDBConnectionProviderService = GetMongoDBConnectionProviderService();
				if (mongoDBConnectionProviderService == null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot find the IMongoDBConnectionProviderService.");
				}
				connection = mongoDBConnectionProviderService.LoadConnection(connectionName);
			}
			connection.ConfigureDataConnection += Connection_ConfigureDataConnection;
			connection.ConnectionError += Connection_ConnectionError;
		}

		private void Connection_ConfigureDataConnection(object sender, ConfigureDataConnectionEventArgs e)
		{
			this.ConfigureDataConnection?.Invoke(this, e);
		}

		private void Connection_ConnectionError(object sender, ConnectionErrorEventArgs e)
		{
			this.ConnectionError?.Invoke(this, e);
		}

		private void DropConnection()
		{
			connection = null;
		}
	}
