	internal class JsonDataSourceParameterTypeConverter<T> : TypeConverter where T : DataSourceParameterBase
	{
		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (!(destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor)))
			{
				return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (value is T val && destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
			{
				bool flag = val.Type == typeof(string);
				Type[] types = ((!flag) ? new Type[3]
				{
					typeof(string),
					typeof(Type),
					typeof(object)
				} : new Type[2]
				{
					typeof(string),
					typeof(object)
				});
				object[] arguments = ((!flag) ? new object[3] { val.Name, val.Type, val.Value } : new object[2] { val.Name, val.Value });
				ConstructorInfo constructor = typeof(T).GetConstructor(BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public, null, types, null);
				return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, arguments);
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}
	}

	public class JsonDataConnection : IDataConnection, INamedItem, IDataConnectionProvider
	{
		private JsonSourceBase jsonSource;

		public string Name { get; set; }

		public bool StoreConnectionNameOnly { get; set; }

		public string ProviderName { get; set; } = "JsonSourceProvider";

		public bool HasSensitiveInfo => (jsonSource as UriJsonSource)?.HasSensitiveInfo() ?? false;

		public JsonDataConnection(JsonSourceBase jsonSource)
		{
			this.jsonSource = jsonSource;
		}

		public JsonDataConnection(string connectionString)
		{
			jsonSource = JsonSourceConfigurationHelper.ParseJsonConnectionString(connectionString);
		}

		public void BlackoutCredentials()
		{
			(jsonSource as UriJsonSource)?.ClearCredentials();
		}

		public string CreateConnectionString()
		{
			return JsonSourceConfigurationHelper.CreateJsonConnectionString(jsonSource);
		}

		public string CreateConnectionString(bool blackoutCredentials)
		{
			JsonDataConnection jsonDataConnection = this;
			if (blackoutCredentials)
			{
				jsonDataConnection = new JsonDataConnection(jsonSource.Clone());
				jsonDataConnection.BlackoutCredentials();
			}
			return JsonSourceConfigurationHelper.CreateJsonConnectionString(jsonDataConnection.GetJsonSource());
		}

		public JsonSourceBase GetJsonSource()
		{
			return jsonSource;
		}

		public JsonDataConnection Clone()
		{
			return new JsonDataConnection(jsonSource?.Clone())
			{
				Name = Name,
				ProviderName = ProviderName,
				StoreConnectionNameOnly = StoreConnectionNameOnly
			};
		}
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(JsonNodeTypeConverter))]
	public class JsonNode
	{
		public class JsonNodeTypeConverter : TypeConverter
		{
			public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}

			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (value is JsonNode jsonNode && destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					List<Type> list = new List<Type>(new Type[2]
					{
						typeof(string),
						typeof(bool?)
					});
					List<object> list2 = new List<object>(new object[2] { jsonNode.Name, jsonNode.Selected });
					if (jsonNode.NodeType != JsonNodeType.Object)
					{
						list.Add(typeof(JsonNodeType));
						list2.Add(jsonNode.NodeType);
						if (JsonSchemaNode.ShouldSerializeType(jsonNode))
						{
							list.Add(typeof(Type));
							list2.Add(jsonNode.Type);
						}
					}
					ConstructorInfo constructor = typeof(JsonNode).GetConstructor(BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public, null, list.ToArray(), null);
					return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, list2.ToArray());
				}
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}
		}

		public const string XML_Name = "Name";

		public const string XML_DisplayName = "DisplayName";

		public const string XML_Type = "Type";

		public const string XML_Selected = "Selected";

		public const string XML_NodeType = "NodeType";

		public string Name { get; set; }

		public Type Type { get; set; }

		public JsonNodeType NodeType { get; set; }

		public string DisplayName { get; set; }

		public bool? Selected { get; set; }

		public JsonNode()
			: this(string.Empty, true)
		{
		}

		public JsonNode(string name, bool? selected)
			: this(name, selected, JsonNodeType.Object)
		{
		}

		public JsonNode(string name, bool? selected, JsonNodeType nodeType)
			: this(name, selected, nodeType, typeof(object))
		{
		}

		public JsonNode(string name, bool? selected, JsonNodeType nodeType, Type type)
		{
			Name = name;
			NodeType = nodeType;
			Selected = selected;
			Type = type;
		}

		internal void SaveToXml(XElement jsonNode)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)jsonNode, "jsonNode");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Name))
			{
				jsonNode.Add(new XAttribute("Name", Name));
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(DisplayName))
			{
				jsonNode.Add(new XAttribute("DisplayName", DisplayName));
			}
			if (JsonSchemaNode.ShouldSerializeType(this))
			{
				jsonNode.Add(new XAttribute("Type", Type.ToString()));
			}
			if (Selected.HasValue)
			{
				jsonNode.Add(new XAttribute("Selected", Selected));
			}
			jsonNode.AddAttribute(NodeType.ToString(), "NodeType");
		}

		internal void LoadFromXml(XElement jsonNode)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)jsonNode, "jsonNode");
			Name = jsonNode.GetAttributeValue("Name");
			DisplayName = jsonNode.GetAttributeValue("DisplayName");
			NodeType = (JsonNodeType)Enum.Parse(typeof(JsonNodeType), jsonNode.GetAttributeValue("NodeType"));
			if (NodeType != JsonNodeType.Object)
			{
				string attributeValue = jsonNode.GetAttributeValue("Type");
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(attributeValue) && attributeValue != typeof(object).FullName)
				{
					Type = SafeTypeResolver.GetPrimitiveOrTrustedType(attributeValue, (IDictionary<string, Type>)null, (bool?)null);
				}
			}
			string attributeValue2 = jsonNode.GetAttributeValue("Selected");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(attributeValue2))
			{
				Selected = bool.Parse(attributeValue2);
			}
		}

		protected bool Equals(JsonNode other)
		{
			if (string.Equals(Name, other.Name) && TypeEquals(other) && NodeType == other.NodeType && string.Equals(DisplayName, other.DisplayName))
			{
				return Selected == other.Selected;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool TypeEquals(JsonNode other)
		{
			if (Type == null && other.Type == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (Type == null || other.Type == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!string.Equals(Type.Name, other.Type.Name))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (this == obj)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (obj.GetType() != GetType())
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Equals((JsonNode)obj);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return 0;
		}
	}
	internal static class NodeExtensions
	{
		public static IEnumerable<Node<JsonNode>> GetByPath(this IEnumerable<Node<JsonNode>> nodes, IEnumerable<string> path)
		{
			foreach (string pathPart in path)
			{
				Node<JsonNode> node = nodes.FirstOrDefault((Node<JsonNode> x) => x.Value.Name == pathPart);
				if (node == null)
				{
					return Enumerable.Empty<Node<JsonNode>>();
				}
				nodes = node.Children;
			}
			return nodes;
		}
	}

		internal IEnumerable<string> RootNames
		{
			get
			{
				if (NodeType == JsonNodeType.Property)
				{
					yield break;
				}
				yield return GetFullName();
				if (NodeType == JsonNodeType.Array)
				{
					yield break;
				}
				foreach (JsonSchemaNode child in Children)
				{
					foreach (string rootName in child.RootNames)
					{
						yield return rootName;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		internal static void ApplySelectedState(JsonSchemaNode source, JsonSchemaNode target)
		{
			foreach (JsonSchemaNode node in target.Children)
			{
				JsonSchemaNode jsonSchemaNode = source.Children.FirstOrDefault((JsonSchemaNode n) => n.Name == node.Name);
				if (jsonSchemaNode == null)
				{
					if (node.NodeType == JsonNodeType.Property)
					{
						node.Selected = false;
					}
					else if (node.NodeType == JsonNodeType.Array && node.ChildrenList.Count == 0)
					{
						node.Selected = false;
					}
					continue;
				}
				if (node.NodeType != jsonSchemaNode.NodeType)
				{
					node.Selected = false;
					continue;
				}
				if (node.NodeType == JsonNodeType.Property)
				{
					node.Selected = jsonSchemaNode.Selected;
				}
				else if (node.NodeType == JsonNodeType.Array && node.ChildrenList.Count == 0)
				{
					node.Selected = jsonSchemaNode.Selected;
				}
				else
				{
					ApplySelectedState(jsonSchemaNode, node);
					if (node.Children.All((JsonSchemaNode n) => n.Selected == true))
					{
						node.Selected = true;
					}
					else if (node.Children.All((JsonSchemaNode n) => n.Selected == false))
					{
						node.Selected = false;
					}
					else
					{
						node.Selected = null;
					}
				}
				node.DisplayName = jsonSchemaNode.DisplayName;
			}
		}

		public JsonSchemaNode(JsonNode value)
			: base(value)
		{
			ParentId = -1;
			Id = 0;
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public JsonSchemaNode()
			: this(new JsonNode("root", true))
		{
		}

		public JsonSchemaNode(string name, bool? selected)
			: this(new JsonNode(name, selected))
		{
		}

		public JsonSchemaNode(string name, bool? selected, JsonNodeType nodeType)
			: this(new JsonNode(name, selected, nodeType))
		{
		}

		public JsonSchemaNode(string name, bool? selected, JsonNodeType nodeType, Type type)
			: this(new JsonNode(name, selected, nodeType, type))
		{
		}

		internal JsonSchemaNode(JsonSchemaNode other)
			: this(new JsonNode(other.Name, other.Selected, other.NodeType, other.Type))
		{
			Id = other.Id;
			ParentId = other.ParentId;
			DisplayName = other.DisplayName;
			if (other.Children.Any())
			{
				Node<JsonNode>[] nodes = other.Children.Select((JsonSchemaNode child) => child.Clone()).ToArray();
				AddChildren(nodes);
			}
			DiscoveryLimitApplied = other.DiscoveryLimitApplied;
		}

		internal JsonSchemaNode(string name, Type type, bool limitApplied)
			: this(name, type)
		{
			DiscoveryLimitApplied = limitApplied;
		}

		internal JsonSchemaNode(string name, Type type)
			: this(new JsonNode(name, true)
			{
				Type = type
			})
		{
			base.Value.NodeType = JsonNodeType.Property;
			if (!DataContext.IsStandardType(type))
			{
				base.Value.NodeType = JsonNodeType.Object;
				if (type.HasElementType)
				{
					base.Value.NodeType = JsonNodeType.Array;
					type = type.GetElementType();
				}
				if (!DataContext.IsStandardType(type))
				{
					PropertyInfo[] properties = type.GetProperties(BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public);
					foreach (PropertyInfo propertyInfo in properties)
					{
						AddChildren(new JsonSchemaNode(propertyInfo.Name, propertyInfo.PropertyType));
					}
				}
			}
			Numerate(new Counter(Id));
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DXHelpExclude(true)]
		public JsonSchemaNode[] GetFlatModel()
		{
			if (base.Parent == null)
			{
				ParentId = -1;
				Id = 0;
				Counter counter = new Counter(Id);
				Numerate(counter);
			}
			List<JsonSchemaNode> list = new List<JsonSchemaNode>();
			ForEach(delegate(Node<JsonNode> node)
			{
				list.Add((JsonSchemaNode)node);
			});
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private void Numerate(Counter counter)
		{
			foreach (JsonSchemaNode child in Children)
			{
				counter.Increment();
				child.Id = counter.I;
				child.ParentId = Id;
				child.Numerate(counter);
			}
		}

		internal string GetFullName()
		{
			return string.Join(".", GetParents().Select(GetSafeName).Reverse());
		}

		private static string GetSafeName(Node<JsonNode> node)
		{
			return GetSafeName(node.Value.Name);
		}

		internal static string GetSafeName(string name)
		{
			if (name.All((char x) => x == '_' || char.IsLetter(x) || (char.IsDigit(x) && name.IndexOf(x) != 0)))
			{
				return name;
			}
			return "['" + name + "']";
		}

		protected internal virtual JsonSchemaNode Clone()
		{
			return new JsonSchemaNode(this);
		}

		protected virtual void OnPropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			this.PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
		}

		protected internal virtual XElement SaveToXml()
		{
			XElement xElement = new XElement("Schema");
			XElement xElement2 = new XElement("Node");
			base.Value.SaveToXml(xElement2);
			if (DiscoveryLimitApplied)
			{
				xElement2.Add(new XAttribute("DiscoveryLimitApplied", true));
			}
			foreach (JsonSchemaNode child in Children)
			{
				xElement2.Add(SaveNodes(child));
			}
			xElement.Add(xElement2);
			return xElement;
		}

		internal static XElement SaveNodes(JsonSchemaNode current)
		{
			XElement xElement = new XElement("Node");
			current.Value.SaveToXml(xElement);
			foreach (JsonSchemaNode child in current.Children)
			{
				xElement.Add(SaveNodes(child));
			}
			return xElement;
		}

		protected internal virtual void LoadFromXml(XElement schema)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)schema, "schema");
			XElement xElement = schema.Element("Node");
			base.Value.LoadFromXml(xElement);
			AbandonChildren();
			LoadNodes(xElement, new Counter(Id));
			if (bool.TryParse(xElement.GetAttributeValue("DiscoveryLimitApplied"), out var result) && result)
			{
				DiscoveryLimitApplied = true;
			}
		}

		private void LoadNodes(XElement parentNode, Counter counter)
		{
			IEnumerable<XElement> enumerable = parentNode.Elements("Node");
			foreach (XElement item in enumerable)
			{
				JsonNode jsonNode = new JsonNode();
				jsonNode.LoadFromXml(item);
				counter.Increment();
				JsonSchemaNode jsonSchemaNode = new JsonSchemaNode(jsonNode)
				{
					Id = counter.I,
					ParentId = Id
				};
				AddChildren(jsonSchemaNode);
				jsonSchemaNode.LoadNodes(item, counter);
			}
		}

		internal static bool ShouldSerializeType(JsonNode node)
		{
			Type type = node.Type;
			if (node.NodeType == JsonNodeType.Array && type != null)
			{
				type = type.GetElementType();
			}
			if (type != null && type != typeof(object))
			{
				return DataContext.IsStandardType(type);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class JsonDataSourceSerializer
	{
		public const string XML_JsonDataSource = "JsonDataSource";

		public const string XML_Name = "Name";

		public const string XML_Source = "Source";

		public const string XML_SourceType = "SourceType";

		public const string XML_Schema = "Schema";

		public const string XML_ConnectionName = "ConnectionName";

		public const string XML_RootElement = "RootElement";

		public const string XML_SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCountElement = "SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount";

		private static readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string, Type> predefinedTypes = new ConcurrentDictionary<string, Type>(new KeyValuePair<string, Type>[2]
		{
			new KeyValuePair<string, Type>(typeof(UriJsonSource).FullName, typeof(UriJsonSource)),
			new KeyValuePair<string, Type>(typeof(CustomJsonSource).FullName, typeof(CustomJsonSource))
		});

		protected JsonDataSource DataSource { get; private set; }

		public static XElement SaveToXml(JsonDataSource jsonDataSource)
		{
			JsonDataSourceSerializer jsonDataSourceSerializer = new JsonDataSourceSerializer(jsonDataSource);
			return jsonDataSourceSerializer.SaveToXml();
		}

		public static void LoadFromXml(JsonDataSource jsonDataSource, XElement root)
		{
			JsonDataSourceSerializer jsonDataSourceSerializer = new JsonDataSourceSerializer(jsonDataSource);
			jsonDataSourceSerializer.LoadFromXml(root);
		}

		public JsonDataSourceSerializer(JsonDataSource dataSource)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)dataSource, "dataSource");
			DataSource = dataSource;
		}

		public virtual XElement SaveToXml()
		{
			XElement xElement = new XElement("JsonDataSource");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(DataSource.Name))
			{
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("Name", DataSource.Name));
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(DataSource.ConnectionName))
			{
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("ConnectionName", DataSource.ConnectionName));
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(DataSource.RootElement))
			{
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("RootElement", DataSource.RootElement));
			}
			if (DataSource.SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount != 100)
			{
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount", DataSource.SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount));
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(DataSource.ConnectionName))
			{
				SaveDataConnection(xElement);
			}
			if (DataSource.Schema != null)
			{
				xElement.Add(DataSource.Schema.SaveToXml());
			}
			return xElement;
		}

		protected virtual void SaveDataConnection(XElement root)
		{
			if (DataSource.JsonSource != null)
			{
				XElement xElement = new XElement("Source");
				Type type = DataSource.JsonSource.GetType();
				string value = (type.Assembly.FullName.Contains("DevExpress.DataAccess.v23.2") ? type.FullName : type.AssemblyQualifiedName);
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("SourceType", value));
				DataSource.JsonSource.SaveToXml(xElement);
				root.Add(xElement);
			}
		}

		public virtual void LoadFromXml(XElement root)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)root, "root");
			if (!string.Equals(root.Name.LocalName, "JsonDataSource", StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Incorrect XML root element: <" + root.Name.LocalName + ">, <JsonDataSource> is expected.");
			}
			DataSource.Name = root.GetAttributeValue("Name");
			DataSource.ConnectionName = root.GetAttributeValue("ConnectionName") ?? "";
			DataSource.RootElement = root.GetAttributeValue("RootElement") ?? "";
			string attributeValue = root.GetAttributeValue("SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(attributeValue))
			{
				DataSource.SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount = Convert.ToInt32(attributeValue);
			}
			LoadConnection(root);
			XElement xElement = root.Element("Schema");
			if (xElement != null)
			{
				JsonSchemaNode jsonSchemaNode = new JsonSchemaNode();
				jsonSchemaNode.LoadFromXml(xElement);
				DataSource.Schema = jsonSchemaNode;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void LoadConnection(XElement root)
		{
			XElement xElement = root.Element("Source");
			if (xElement != null)
			{
				string attributeValue = xElement.GetAttributeValue("SourceType");
				Type primitiveOrTrustedType = SafeTypeResolver.GetPrimitiveOrTrustedType(attributeValue, (IDictionary<string, Type>)predefinedTypes, (bool?)false);
				if (primitiveOrTrustedType == null && !SafeTypeResolver.IsTypeAvailable(attributeValue, ref primitiveOrTrustedType, (Predicate<Type>)((Type t) => t.IsSubclassOf(typeof(JsonSourceBase))), false))
				{
					throw new TypeLoadException("Could not load type '" + attributeValue + "'.");
				}
				JsonSourceBase jsonSourceBase = (JsonSourceBase)Activator.CreateInstance(primitiveOrTrustedType, nonPublic: true);
				jsonSourceBase.LoadFromXml(xElement);
				DataSource.JsonSource = jsonSourceBase;
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class JsonSourceBase : ICloneable
	{
		public const string XML_RootElement = "RootElement";

		private string rootElement = "";

		private bool assignedRootElementWithoutOwner;

		private JsonDataSource owner;

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[Obsolete("This property is now obsolete. Use the JsonDataSource.RootElement property instead.", false)]
		public string RootElement
		{
			get
			{
				string text = owner?.RootElement;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					return text;
				}
				return rootElement;
			}
			set
			{
				if (owner != null)
				{
					owner.RootElement = value;
				}
				else if (value != rootElement)
				{
					assignedRootElementWithoutOwner = true;
				}
				rootElement = value;
			}
		}

		internal JsonDataSource Owner
		{
			get
			{
				return owner;
			}
			set
			{
				owner = value;
				if (owner != null && assignedRootElementWithoutOwner)
				{
					owner.RootElement = rootElement;
				}
			}
		}

		public abstract string GetJsonString();

		public virtual string GetJsonString(IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters)
		{
			return GetJsonString();
		}

		public virtual async Task<string> GetJsonStringAsync(IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			Func<string> function = () => GetJsonString(sourceParameters);
			return await Task<string>.Factory.StartNew(function, cancellationToken, TaskCreationOptions.None, TaskScheduler.Default).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
		}

		protected internal virtual void SaveToXml(XElement connection)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)connection, "options");
		}

		protected internal virtual void LoadFromXml(XElement connection)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)connection, "options");
			RootElement = connection.GetAttributeValue("RootElement") ?? "";
		}

		private bool Equals(JsonSourceBase other)
		{
			return string.Equals(RootElement, other.RootElement);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is JsonSourceBase other)
			{
				return Equals(other);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return 0;
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		protected internal abstract JsonSourceBase Clone();

		protected T GetActualJsonSource<T>() where T : JsonSourceBase
		{
			return (Owner?.Connection?.GetJsonSource() as T) ?? (this as T);
		}
	}

	[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.Json.UriJsonSource")]
	public class UriJsonSource : JsonSourceBase
	{
		public const string XML_Uri = "Uri";

		internal const string XML_Auth_Username = "user";

		internal const string XML_Auth_Password = "password";

		internal const string XML_AuthenticationInfo = "AuthenticationInfo";

		internal const string XML_Headers = "Headers";

		internal const string XML_Header = "Header";

		internal const string XML_Query = "QueryParameters";

		internal const string XML_QueryParam = "QueryParameter";

		internal const string XML_Path = "PathParameters";

		internal const string XML_PathParam = "PathParameter";

		internal const string XML_Expression_Prefix = "expression:";

		[DefaultValue(null)]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.Json.UriJsonSource.Uri")]
		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.Json.UriJsonSource.Uri")]
		[TypeConverter("DevExpress.DataAccess.UI.Native.NoConvertableFromStringConverter,DevExpress.DataAccess.v23.2.UI, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a")]
		[Editor("DevExpress.DataAccess.UI.Native.Json.JsonSourceUriEditor, DevExpress.DataAccess.v23.2.UI, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
		public Uri Uri { get; set; }

		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.Json.UriJsonSource.AuthenticationInfo")]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[Description("Specifies the Basic authentication parameters that the associated web service endpoint requests.")]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		public HttpBasicAuthenticationInfo AuthenticationInfo { get; } = new HttpBasicAuthenticationInfo();

		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.Json.UriJsonSource.QueryParameters")]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[Description("Provides access to a collection of parameters that the UriJsonSource passes to a JSON endpoint as HTTP request parameters.")]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		public QueryParameterCollection QueryParameters { get; } = new QueryParameterCollection();

		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.Json.UriJsonSource.HeaderParameters")]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[Description("Provides access to a collection of parameters that the UriJsonSource includes in requests to a JSON endpoint as custom HTTP headers.")]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		public HeaderParameterCollection HeaderParameters { get; } = new HeaderParameterCollection();

		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.Json.UriJsonSource.PathParameters")]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[Description("Provides access to a collection of parameters that the UriJsonSource adds to a JSON endpoint’s URI as path elements.")]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		public PathParameterCollection PathParameters { get; } = new PathParameterCollection();

		private bool AllowSerializeConnectionInfo
		{
			get
			{
				JsonDataSource jsonDataSource = base.Owner;
				bool? obj;
				if (jsonDataSource == null)
				{
					obj = null;
				}
				else
				{
					JsonDataConnection connection = jsonDataSource.Connection;
					obj = ((connection != null) ? new bool?(!connection.StoreConnectionNameOnly) : ((bool?)null));
				}
				bool? flag = obj;
				return flag == true;
			}
		}

		public UriJsonSource()
		{
		}

		public UriJsonSource(Uri uri)
		{
			Uri = uri;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeQueryParameters()
		{
			return QueryParameters.Any();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeHeaderParameters()
		{
			return HeaderParameters.Any();
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializePathParameters()
		{
			return PathParameters.Any();
		}

		public override string GetJsonString()
		{
			return GetJsonStringCore(null);
		}

		public override string GetJsonString(IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters)
		{
			return GetJsonStringCore(sourceParameters);
		}

		private string GetJsonStringCore(IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters)
		{
			UriJsonSource actualJsonSource = GetActualJsonSource<UriJsonSource>();
			IList<IParameter> evaluatedHeaderParameters = GetEvaluatedHeaderParameters(sourceParameters, actualJsonSource);
			Uri uriWithParams = GetUriWithParams(sourceParameters);
			JsonDataSource jsonDataSource = base.Owner;
			return JsonLoaderHelper.LoadJson(uriWithParams, (jsonDataSource != null) ? ServiceProviderExtensions.GetService<UrlResolver>((IServiceProvider)jsonDataSource) : null, actualJsonSource?.AuthenticationInfo, evaluatedHeaderParameters);
		}

		public override async Task<string> GetJsonStringAsync(IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			UriJsonSource actualJsonSource = GetActualJsonSource<UriJsonSource>();
			IList<IParameter> evaluatedHeaderParameters = GetEvaluatedHeaderParameters(sourceParameters, actualJsonSource);
			Uri uriWithParams = GetUriWithParams(sourceParameters);
			JsonDataSource jsonDataSource = base.Owner;
			return await JsonLoaderHelper.LoadJsonAsync(uriWithParams, cancellationToken, (jsonDataSource != null) ? ServiceProviderExtensions.GetService<UrlResolver>((IServiceProvider)jsonDataSource) : null, actualJsonSource?.AuthenticationInfo, evaluatedHeaderParameters).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
		}

		private IList<IParameter> GetEvaluatedHeaderParameters(IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters, UriJsonSource jsonSource)
		{
			if (jsonSource != null)
			{
				return ParametersEvaluator.EvaluateParameters(sourceParameters, jsonSource.HeaderParameters).ToList();
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal Uri GetUriWithParams(IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters)
		{
			UriJsonSource actualJsonSource = GetActualJsonSource<UriJsonSource>();
			Uri uri = actualJsonSource.Uri;
			if (actualJsonSource == null || uri == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!uri.IsAbsoluteUri || uri.IsFile)
			{
				return uri;
			}
			string query = uri.Query;
			PathParameterCollection pathParameters = actualJsonSource.PathParameters;
			if (pathParameters.Count > 0)
			{
				IList<IParameter> source = ParametersEvaluator.EvaluateParameters(sourceParameters, pathParameters).ToList();
				string[] pathSegments = (from x in source
					where x.Value != null
					select x.Value.ToString()).ToArray();
				uri = AppendPathSegment(uri, pathSegments);
			}
			QueryParameterCollection queryParameters = actualJsonSource.QueryParameters;
			if (queryParameters.Count == 0)
			{
				return uri;
			}
			IList<IParameter> queryParameters2 = ParametersEvaluator.EvaluateParameters(sourceParameters, queryParameters).ToList();
			return AppendQuerySegment(uri, query, queryParameters2);
		}

		internal static Uri AppendPathSegment(Uri uri, string[] pathSegments)
		{
			string text = uri.GetLeftPart(UriPartial.Path);
			foreach (string text2 in pathSegments)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
				{
					text = text.TrimEnd('/') + "/" + text2.TrimStart('/');
				}
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(uri.Query))
			{
				text += uri.Query;
			}
			return new Uri(text, UriKind.RelativeOrAbsolute);
		}

		private static string GetQueryParameterValueString(string parameterName, object value, bool escapeValues = true)
		{
			string text = value?.ToString() ?? string.Empty;
			if (escapeValues)
			{
				text = Uri.EscapeDataString(text);
			}
			return parameterName + "=" + text;
		}

		internal static Uri AppendQuerySegment(Uri uri, string originalQuery, IEnumerable<IParameter> queryParameters, bool escapeValues = true)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			foreach (IParameter queryParameter in queryParameters)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(((IFilterParameter)queryParameter).Name))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (stringBuilder.Length > 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append('&');
				}
				string parameterName = Uri.EscapeDataString(((IFilterParameter)queryParameter).Name);
				string value;
				if (queryParameter.Value is IEnumerable && !(queryParameter.Value is string))
				{
					IEnumerable enumerable = (IEnumerable)queryParameter.Value;
					List<string> list = new List<string>();
					foreach (object item in enumerable)
					{
						list.Add(GetQueryParameterValueString(parameterName, item, escapeValues));
					}
					value = string.Join("&", list.ToArray());
				}
				else
				{
					value = GetQueryParameterValueString(parameterName, queryParameter.Value, escapeValues);
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(value);
			}
			string text = "";
			if (stringBuilder.Length > 0)
			{
				text = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(originalQuery) ? "?" : "&");
			}
			return new Uri(uri?.OriginalString + text + stringBuilder.ToString(), UriKind.RelativeOrAbsolute);
		}

		protected internal override void SaveToXml(XElement connection)
		{
			base.SaveToXml(connection);
			if (Uri != null)
			{
				connection.Add(new XAttribute("Uri", Uri));
			}
			if (AllowSerializeConnectionInfo)
			{
				SaveAuthInto(connection);
				SaveRequestParameterCollection(connection, "Headers", "Header", HeaderParameters);
				SaveRequestParameterCollection(connection, "QueryParameters", "QueryParameter", QueryParameters);
				SaveRequestParameterCollection(connection, "PathParameters", "PathParameter", PathParameters);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void LoadFromXml(XElement connection)
		{
			base.LoadFromXml(connection);
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(connection.GetAttributeValue("Uri")))
			{
				Uri = new Uri(connection.GetAttributeValue("Uri"), UriKind.RelativeOrAbsolute);
			}
			FillHeaders(connection);
			FillQuery(connection);
			FillPath(connection);
			LoadAuthInfo(connection);
		}

		private void SaveRequestParameterCollection(XElement connection, string nodeName, string itemNodeName, IEnumerable<DataSourceParameterBase> collection)
		{
			if (!collection.Any())
			{
				return;
			}
			XElement xElement = new XElement(nodeName);
			foreach (DataSourceParameterBase item in collection.Distinct())
			{
				XElement xElement2 = new XElement(itemNodeName);
				xElement2.Add(new XAttribute("Name", item.Name));
				object parameterValue = GetParameterValue(item);
				if (parameterValue != null)
				{
					xElement2.Add(new XAttribute("Value", parameterValue));
				}
				xElement.Add(xElement2);
			}
			connection.Add(xElement);
		}

		internal static object GetParameterValue(DataSourceParameterBase parameter)
		{
			if (parameter.Type == typeof(Expression))
			{
				if (parameter.Value is Expression)
				{
					return string.Format("{0}{1}", "expression:", ((Expression)parameter.Value).ExpressionString);
				}
				return null;
			}
			return parameter.Value;
		}

		private void FillHeaders(XElement connection)
		{
			FillDataSourceParameterCollection(connection, HeaderParameters, "Headers", "Header");
		}

		private void FillQuery(XElement connection)
		{
			FillDataSourceParameterCollection(connection, QueryParameters, "QueryParameters", "QueryParameter");
		}

		private void FillPath(XElement connection)
		{
			FillDataSourceParameterCollection(connection, PathParameters, "PathParameters", "PathParameter");
		}

		private void FillDataSourceParameterCollection<T>(XElement connection, Collection<T> collection, string colletionNode, string collectionItem) where T : DataSourceParameterBase, new()
		{
			if (connection == null || !connection.Elements().Any((XElement x) => x.Name == colletionNode))
			{
				return;
			}
			XElement xElement = connection.Elements().FirstOrDefault((XElement x) => x.Name == colletionNode);
			if (xElement == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (XElement item in from x in xElement.Elements()
				where x.Name == collectionItem
				select x)
			{
				T val = new T
				{
					Name = item.GetAttributeValue("Name")
				};
				SetParameterValue(val, item);
				collection.Add(val);
			}
		}

		private static void SetParameterValue<T>(T parameter, XElement element) where T : DataSourceParameterBase
		{
			SetParameterValue(parameter, element.GetAttributeValue("Value"));
		}

		internal static void SetParameterValue<T>(T parameter, string rawValue) where T : DataSourceParameterBase
		{
			if (rawValue != null && rawValue.StartsWith("expression:"))
			{
				parameter.Type = typeof(Expression);
				string expressionString = rawValue.Substring("expression:".Length);
				parameter.Value = new Expression(expressionString);
			}
			else
			{
				parameter.Value = rawValue;
			}
		}

		private void SaveAuthInto(XElement connection)
		{
			if (!AuthenticationInfo.IsEmpty)
			{
				XElement xElement = new XElement("AuthenticationInfo");
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("user", AuthenticationInfo.Username));
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("password", AuthenticationInfo.Password));
				connection.Add(xElement);
			}
		}

		private void LoadAuthInfo(XElement connection)
		{
			if (connection != null && connection.Elements().Any((XElement x) => x.Name == "AuthenticationInfo"))
			{
				XElement xElement = connection.Elements().FirstOrDefault((XElement x) => x.Name == "AuthenticationInfo");
				if (xElement != null)
				{
					AuthenticationInfo.Username = xElement.GetAttributeValue("user");
					AuthenticationInfo.Password = xElement.GetAttributeValue("password");
				}
			}
		}

		private bool Equals(UriJsonSource other)
		{
			if (object.Equals(Uri, other.Uri))
			{
				return string.Equals(base.RootElement, other.RootElement);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!base.Equals(obj))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (obj is UriJsonSource other)
			{
				return Equals(other);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return 0;
		}

		protected internal override JsonSourceBase Clone()
		{
			UriJsonSource uriJsonSource = new UriJsonSource
			{
				Uri = Uri,
				RootElement = base.RootElement
			};
			uriJsonSource.AuthenticationInfo.Password = AuthenticationInfo.Password;
			uriJsonSource.AuthenticationInfo.Username = AuthenticationInfo.Username;
			foreach (HeaderParameter headerParameter in HeaderParameters)
			{
				uriJsonSource.HeaderParameters.Add(headerParameter.Clone());
			}
			foreach (QueryParameter queryParameter in QueryParameters)
			{
				uriJsonSource.QueryParameters.Add(queryParameter.Clone());
			}
			foreach (PathParameter pathParameter in PathParameters)
			{
				uriJsonSource.PathParameters.Add(pathParameter.Clone());
			}
			return uriJsonSource;
		}

		internal void ClearCredentials()
		{
			AuthenticationInfo.Clear();
			HeaderParameters.Clear();
			QueryParameters.Clear();
			PathParameters.Clear();
		}

		internal bool HasSensitiveInfo()
		{
			if (AuthenticationInfo.IsEmpty && !HeaderParameters.Any() && !QueryParameters.Any())
			{
				return PathParameters.Any();
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

		internal JsonSourceBase GetActualJsonSource()
		{
			return Connection?.GetJsonSource();
		}

		internal void AssignConnection(JsonDataConnection sourceConnection)
		{
			if (sourceConnection != null)
			{
				if (!sourceConnection.StoreConnectionNameOnly || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ConnectionName))
				{
					JsonSource = sourceConnection.GetJsonSource();
				}
				else
				{
					JsonSource = null;
				}
				Connection = sourceConnection;
			}
		}

		internal IJsonDataConnectionProviderService GetJsonDataConnectionProviderService()
		{
			IJsonDataConnectionProviderService jsonDataConnectionProviderService = ServiceProviderExtensions.GetService<IJsonDataConnectionProviderService>((IServiceProvider)this);
			if (jsonDataConnectionProviderService == null)
			{
				jsonDataConnectionProviderService = new JsonDataConnectionProviderService(ServiceProviderExtensions.GetService<IConnectionStringsProvider>((IServiceProvider)this) ?? RuntimeConnectionStringsProvider.CreateDefault());
			}
			return jsonDataConnectionProviderService;
		}

		internal void SafeInitializeConnection()
		{
			try
			{
				InitializeConnection();
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		internal void InitializeConnection()
		{
			if (connection == null && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ConnectionName))
			{
				JsonDataConnection jsonDataConnection = GetJsonDataConnectionProviderService()?.GetJsonDataConnection(ConnectionName);
				if (jsonDataConnection != null && string.IsNullOrEmpty(jsonDataConnection.GetJsonSource()?.RootElement) && jsonSource != null)
				{
					jsonDataConnection.GetJsonSource().RootElement = jsonSource.RootElement;
				}
				AssignConnection(jsonDataConnection);
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<DataSourceParameterBase> GetJsonSourceParameters()
		{
			if (!(GetActualJsonSource() is UriJsonSource uriJsonSource))
			{
				return Enumerable.Empty<DataSourceParameterBase>();
			}
			return uriJsonSource.HeaderParameters.Cast<DataSourceParameterBase>().Union(uriJsonSource.QueryParameters.Cast<DataSourceParameterBase>()).Union(uriJsonSource.PathParameters.Cast<DataSourceParameterBase>());
		}

		public override void Fill(IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Expected O, but got Unknown
			IServiceContainer serviceContainer = (IServiceContainer)new ServiceManager();
			IParameter[] parameters = (IParameter[])(((object)sourceParameters?.ToArray()) ?? ((object)new IParameter[0]));
			serviceContainer.AddService(typeof(IParameterSupplierBase), new ParameterSupplier(parameters));
			((IListAdapter)this).FillList((IServiceProvider)serviceContainer);
		}

		private void FillCore(IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters)
		{
			FillResult fillResult = FillInternal(sourceParameters, null);
			ApplyResult(fillResult);
		}

		protected FillResult FillInternal(IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters, string dataMember)
		{
			return TaskExtensions.Await<FillResult>(FillInternalAsync(sourceParameters, dataMember, default(CancellationToken), useAsync: false));
		}

		protected async Task<FillResult> FillInternalAsync(IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters, string dataMember, CancellationToken token, bool useAsync)
		{
			JsonSourceBase source = PrepareJsonSource();
			if (source == null)
			{
				return new FillResult();
			}
			string jsonString = await GetJsonStringAsync(source, sourceParameters, token, useAsync).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			string text = GetRootElement(source);
			return GetFillResult(jsonString, text, dataMember);
		}

		private string GetJsonString(JsonSourceBase source, IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters)
		{
			return TaskExtensions.Await<string>(GetJsonStringAsync(source, sourceParameters, default(CancellationToken), useAsync: false));
		}

		private async Task<string> GetJsonStringAsync(JsonSourceBase source, IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters, CancellationToken token, bool useAsync)
		{
			string jsonString = null;
			Exception exception = null;
			try
			{
				jsonString = ((!useAsync) ? source.GetJsonString(sourceParameters) : (await source.GetJsonStringAsync(sourceParameters, token).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false)));
			}
			catch (WebException ex)
			{
				exception = ex;
			}
			catch (IOException ex2)
			{
				exception = ex2;
			}
			catch (HttpRequestException ex3)
			{
				exception = ex3;
			}
			if (exception != null)
			{
				RaiseFillError(exception);
			}
			return jsonString;
		}

		private void RaiseFillError(Exception exception)
		{
			DataSourceFillErrorEventArgs e = new DataSourceFillErrorEventArgs(ConnectionName, exception);
			if (base.Events[fillError] is DataSourceFillErrorEventHandler dataSourceFillErrorEventHandler)
			{
				dataSourceFillErrorEventHandler(this, e);
			}
			if (!e.Handled)
			{
				throw new JsonDataSourceException(string.Format(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.DataSourceFillExceptionMessage), exception.Message), exception);
			}
		}

		public async Task FillAsync()
		{
			await FillAsync(Enumerable.Empty<IParameter>(), CancellationToken.None);
		}

		public async Task FillAsync(IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters)
		{
			await FillAsync(sourceParameters, CancellationToken.None);
		}

		public async Task FillAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			await FillAsync(Enumerable.Empty<IParameter>(), cancellationToken);
		}

		public async Task FillAsync(IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			JsonSourceBase source = PrepareJsonSource();
			if (source != null)
			{
				string jsonString = await GetJsonStringAsync(source, sourceParameters, cancellationToken, useAsync: true).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				string text = GetRootElement(source);
				FillResult fillResult = GetFillResult(jsonString, text, null);
				ApplyResult(fillResult);
			}
		}

		private void ApplyResult(FillResult fillResult)
		{
			ListChangedEventHandler listChangedEventHandler = base.Events[listChanged] as ListChangedEventHandler;
			if (fillResult.NewSchema != null)
			{
				Schema = fillResult.NewSchema;
			}
			if (fillResult.NewInnerList != null)
			{
				innerList = fillResult.NewInnerList;
			}
			if (fillResult.NewJsonTypeCreated)
			{
				jsonType = fillResult.NewJsonType;
				if (propertiesRequested)
				{
					listChangedEventHandler?.Invoke(this, new ListChangedEventArgs(ListChangedType.PropertyDescriptorChanged, -1));
					propertiesRequested = false;
				}
			}
			listChangedEventHandler?.Invoke(this, new ListChangedEventArgs(ListChangedType.Reset, -1));
		}

		private JsonSourceBase PrepareJsonSource()
		{
			IJsonSourceCustomizationService service = ServiceProviderExtensions.GetService<IJsonSourceCustomizationService>((IServiceProvider)this);
			if (service != null)
			{
				JsonSourceBase jsonSourceBase = service.CustomizeJsonSource(this);
				AssignConnection(new JsonDataConnection(jsonSourceBase)
				{
					Name = ConnectionName
				});
			}
			JsonDataConnection jsonDataConnection = null;
			JsonSourceBase source = null;
			try
			{
				jsonDataConnection = Connection;
				source = jsonDataConnection?.GetJsonSource();
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				PrepareWithIConfigureJsonSourceService(jsonDataConnection, ref source);
				if (source == null)
				{
					throw;
				}
				return source;
			}
			PrepareWithIConfigureJsonSourceService(jsonDataConnection, ref source);
			return source;
		}

		private void PrepareWithIConfigureJsonSourceService(JsonDataConnection conn, ref JsonSourceBase source)
		{
			IConfigureJsonSourceService service = ServiceProviderExtensions.GetService<IConfigureJsonSourceService>((IServiceProvider)this);
			if (service != null)
			{
				source = service.Configure(Name, (conn != null) ? conn.Name : ConnectionName, source);
				if (source != null)
				{
					source.Owner = null;
				}
			}
			else if (source != null && source.Owner == null)
			{
				source.Owner = this;
			}
		}

		private string GetRootElement(JsonSourceBase source)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(RootElement))
			{
				if (source == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(source.RootElement))
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return source.RootElement;
			}
			return RootElement;
		}

		private FillResult GetFillResult(string jsonString, string rootElement, string dataMember)
		{
			FillResult result = new FillResult();
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(jsonString))
			{
				return result;
			}
			JsonSchemaNode jsonSchemaNode = Schema;
			string rootElementWithDataMember = GetRootElementWithDataMember(rootElement, dataMember);
			JsonLoaderHelper jsonLoaderHelper = null;
			object obj = null;
			object obj2 = null;
			try
			{
				if (Schema == null || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(rootElementWithDataMember))
				{
					if (Schema == null)
					{
						jsonSchemaNode = new JsonLoaderHelper().DetectJsonSchema(jsonString, null, SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount);
					}
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(rootElementWithDataMember))
					{
						object obj3 = JsonLoaderHelper.DeserializeAndWrapObject(jsonString);
						JObject jObject = obj3 as JObject;
						obj = jObject.SelectToken(rootElementWithDataMember);
						if (obj == null)
						{
							return result;
						}
					}
				}
				jsonLoaderHelper = new JsonLoaderHelper(rootElementWithDataMember, jsonSchemaNode);
				string json = ((obj != null) ? obj.ToString() : jsonString);
				obj2 = jsonLoaderHelper.CreateObject(json, DataObjectType ?? jsonLoaderHelper.CreateJsonType(), schemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount);
			}
			catch (Exception ex) when (IsNewtonsoftException(ex))
			{
				RaiseFillError(ex.InnerException);
				return result;
			}
			return CreateFillResult(obj2, jsonSchemaNode, DataObjectType ?? jsonLoaderHelper.JsonType);
		}

		{
			return FillAsync(sourceParameters, cancellationToken);
		}

		public JsonSchemaNode LoadSchema(Type type)
		{
			return new JsonSchemaNode("root", type);

		private bool IsNewtonsoftException(Exception e)
		{
			return e.InnerException?.GetType().FullName.Contains("Newtonsoft.Json") ?? false;
		}

		private FillResult CreateFillResult(object createdObject, JsonSchemaNode schema, Type jsonType)
		{
			FillResult fillResult = new FillResult();
			if (Schema == null)
			{
				fillResult.NewSchema = schema;
			}
			IList list = createdObject as IList;
			IEnumerable<object> enumerable = createdObject as IEnumerable<object>;
			if (list != null)
			{
				fillResult.NewInnerList = list;
			}
			else if (enumerable != null)
			{
				fillResult.NewInnerList = enumerable.ToList();
			}
			else
			{
				fillResult.NewInnerList = new object[1] { createdObject };
			}
			fillResult.NewJsonType = jsonType;
			fillResult.NewJsonTypeCreated = true;
			return fillResult;
		}

		private string GetRootElementWithDataMember(string rootElement, string dataMember)
		{
			string text = null;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMember))
			{
				return rootElement ?? string.Empty;
			}
			string text2 = string.Join(".", from p in dataMember.Split('.')
				select JsonSchemaNode.GetSafeName(p));
			return string.IsNullOrEmpty(rootElement) ? text2 : (rootElement + "." + text2);
		}

		internal JsonSchemaNode GetSchema(IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters)
		{
			if (Schema != null)
			{
				return Schema;
			}
			JsonSchemaNode result = null;
			string jsonString = GetJsonString(jsonSource, sourceParameters);
			try
			{
				result = new JsonLoaderHelper().DetectJsonSchema(jsonString, GetRootElement(jsonSource), SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount);
			}
			catch (Exception ex) when (IsNewtonsoftException(ex))
			{
				RaiseFillError(ex);
			}
			return result;
		}

		void IListAdapter.FillList(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
		{
			ReplaceServicesFromProvider(serviceProvider);
			IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters = ParameterSupplierHelper.GetSourceParameters(serviceProvider);
			FillCore(sourceParameters);
			OnAfterFill(sourceParameters);
		}

		async Task IListAdapterAsync.FillAsync(IServiceProvider serviceProvider, CancellationToken token)
		{
			if (!fillListSemaphore.WaitOne(300))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Data source is busy");
			}
			try
			{
				await FillCoreAsync(serviceProvider, token).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			catch (OperationCanceledException)
			{
			}
			finally
			{
				fillListSemaphore.Release();
			}
		}

		private Task FillCoreAsync(IServiceProvider serviceProvider, CancellationToken token)
		{
			ReplaceServicesFromProvider(serviceProvider);
			IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters = ParameterSupplierHelper.GetSourceParameters(serviceProvider);
			return FillAsync(sourceParameters, token);
		}

		IAsyncResult IListAdapterAsync.BeginFillList(IServiceProvider serviceProvider, CancellationToken token)
		{
			if (!fillListSemaphore.WaitOne(300))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Data source is busy");
			}
			return FillCoreAsync(serviceProvider, token);
		}

		void IListAdapterAsync.EndFillList(IAsyncResult result, CancellationToken token)
		{
			Task task = (Task)result;
			try
			{
				task.Wait(token);
			}
			catch (OperationCanceledException)
			{
			}
			catch (AggregateException ex2)
			{
				if (task.IsFaulted)
				{
					throw ExceptionHelper.Unwrap(ex2);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				fillListSemaphore.Release();
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<string> SplitRootElement(string root)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			while (true)
			{
				string[] array;
				if (!root.StartsWith("['", StringComparison.Ordinal))
				{
					array = root.Split(new char[1] { '.' }, 2);
				}
				else
				{
					array = root.Split(new string[1] { "']." }, 2, StringSplitOptions.None);
					array[0] = array[0].Substring("['".Length);
					if (array[0].EndsWith("']", StringComparison.Ordinal))
					{
						array[0] = array[0].Substring(0, array[0].Length - "']".Length);
					}
				}
				string item = array[0];
				list.Add(item);
				if (array.Length < 2)
				{
					break;
				}
				root = array[1];
			}
			return list;
		}

		{
			FillResult fillResult = await FillInternalAsync(parameters, null, cancellationToken, useAsync).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			JsonDataSource jsonDataSource = new JsonDataSource();
			jsonDataSource.schema = schema?.Clone();
			jsonDataSource.ApplyResult(fillResult);
			return new DynamicLookupResult
			{
				FilterApplied = false,
				ActualDataMember = dataMember,
				Result = jsonDataSource
			};
		}

	internal static class AsyncExtensions
	{
		internal static IBackgroundService BackgroundService { get; set; }

		public static async Task<T> WithCancellation<T>(this Task<T> task, CancellationToken cancellationToken, Action action, bool useSynchronizationContext = true)
		{
			using (cancellationToken.Register(action, useSynchronizationContext))
			{
				try
				{
					return await task;
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
					{
						throw new OperationCanceledException(ex.Message, ex, cancellationToken);
					}
					throw;
				}
			}
		}

		public static async Task WithCancellation(this Task task, CancellationToken cancellationToken, Action action, bool useSynchronizationContext = true)
		{
			using (cancellationToken.Register(action, useSynchronizationContext))
			{
				try
				{
					await task;
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
					{
						throw new OperationCanceledException(ex.Message, ex, cancellationToken);
					}
					throw;
				}
			}
		}

		public static Task WithBackgroundService(this Task task, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (BackgroundService != null)
			{
				while (!task.IsCompleted && !cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
				{
					Thread.Sleep(1);
					BackgroundService.PerformAction();
				}
			}
			return task;
		}

		public static Task<T> WithBackgroundService<T>(this Task<T> task, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (BackgroundService != null)
			{
				while (!task.IsCompleted && !cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
				{
					Thread.Sleep(1);
					BackgroundService.PerformAction();
				}
			}
			return task;
		}
	}
	internal static class DynamicTypesHelper
	{
		private static readonly object jsonTypesLock;

		internal static Dictionary<GeneratedTypeKey, Type> GeneratedTypes { get; }

		public static ModuleBuilder ModuleBuilder { get; }

		public static T GetPropertyValue<T>(object theObject, string name)
		{
			return (T)TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(theObject)[name].GetValue(theObject);
		}

		public static void SetPropertyValue<T>(object theObject, string name, T value)
		{
			TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(theObject)[name].SetValue(theObject, value);
		}

		private static string GetPostfix()
		{
			return Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
		}

		private static string GetAssemblyName()
		{
			return GetPostfix();
		}

		static DynamicTypesHelper()
		{
			GeneratedTypes = new Dictionary<GeneratedTypeKey, Type>(GeneratedTypeKey.Comparer);
			jsonTypesLock = new object();
			AssemblyName name = new AssemblyName(GetAssemblyName());
			AssemblyBuilder assemblyBuilder = AssemblyBuilder.DefineDynamicAssembly(name, AssemblyBuilderAccess.RunAndCollect);
			ModuleBuilder = assemblyBuilder.DefineDynamicModule("MainModule");
		}

		internal static Type CreateType(ModuleBuilder moduleBuilder, IEnumerable<Property> properties, string typeName, params CustomAttributeBuilder[] customAttributes)
		{
			return CreateType(moduleBuilder, properties, typeName, readOnly: false, customAttributes);
		}

		internal static Type CreateType(ModuleBuilder moduleBuilder, IEnumerable<Property> properties, string typeName, bool readOnly, params CustomAttributeBuilder[] customAttributes)
		{
			lock (jsonTypesLock)
			{
				Property[] array = (properties as Property[]) ?? properties.ToArray();
				GeneratedTypeKey key = new GeneratedTypeKey(array);
				if (GeneratedTypes.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
				{
					return value;
				}
				TypeBuilder typeBuilder = moduleBuilder.DefineType(typeName + GetPostfix(), TypeAttributes.Public | TypeAttributes.AutoClass | TypeAttributes.BeforeFieldInit, null);
				typeBuilder.DefineDefaultConstructor(MethodAttributes.Public | MethodAttributes.SpecialName | MethodAttributes.RTSpecialName);
				HashSet<string> hashSet = new HashSet<string>(array.Select((Property p) => p.Name));
				Property[] array2 = array;
				foreach (Property property in array2)
				{
					Type type = ((property.Type != null && property.Type.IsValueType && Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(property.Type) == null && property.CanBeNull) ? typeof(Nullable<>).MakeGenericType(property.Type) : (property.Type ?? typeof(object)));
					bool flag = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(property.DisplayName);
					string text = (flag ? property.DisplayName : property.Name);
					string name = property.Name;
					string text2 = NameGenerator.GenerateUniqueName("_" + name, hashSet);
					hashSet.Add(text2);
					FieldBuilder field = typeBuilder.DefineField(text2, type, FieldAttributes.Private);
					PropertyBuilder propertyBuilder = typeBuilder.DefineProperty(name, System.Reflection.PropertyAttributes.HasDefault, type, null);
					MethodAttributes attributes = MethodAttributes.Public | MethodAttributes.HideBySig | MethodAttributes.SpecialName;
					MethodBuilder methodBuilder = typeBuilder.DefineMethod("get_" + name, attributes, type, Type.EmptyTypes);
					ILGenerator iLGenerator = methodBuilder.GetILGenerator();
					iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldarg_0);
					iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldfld, field);
					iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ret);
					MethodAttributes attributes2 = (readOnly ? MethodAttributes.Private : (MethodAttributes.Public | MethodAttributes.HideBySig | MethodAttributes.SpecialName));
					MethodBuilder methodBuilder2 = typeBuilder.DefineMethod("set_" + name, attributes2, null, new Type[1] { type });
					ILGenerator iLGenerator2 = methodBuilder2.GetILGenerator();
					System.Reflection.Emit.Label loc = iLGenerator2.DefineLabel();
					System.Reflection.Emit.Label loc2 = iLGenerator2.DefineLabel();
					iLGenerator2.MarkLabel(loc);
					iLGenerator2.Emit(OpCodes.Ldarg_0);
					iLGenerator2.Emit(OpCodes.Ldarg_1);
					iLGenerator2.Emit(OpCodes.Stfld, field);
					iLGenerator2.Emit(OpCodes.Nop);
					iLGenerator2.MarkLabel(loc2);
					iLGenerator2.Emit(OpCodes.Ret);
					if (flag)
					{
						ConstructorInfo constructor = typeof(System.ComponentModel.DisplayNameAttribute).GetConstructor(new Type[1] { typeof(string) });
						CustomAttributeBuilder customAttribute = new CustomAttributeBuilder(constructor, new object[1] { text });
						propertyBuilder.SetCustomAttribute(customAttribute);
					}
					foreach (CustomAttributeBuilder attribute in property.Attributes)
					{
						propertyBuilder.SetCustomAttribute(attribute);
					}
					propertyBuilder.SetSetMethod(methodBuilder2);
					propertyBuilder.SetGetMethod(methodBuilder);
				}
				foreach (CustomAttributeBuilder customAttributeBuilder in customAttributes)
				{
					if (customAttributeBuilder != null)
					{
						typeBuilder.SetCustomAttribute(customAttributeBuilder);
					}
				}
				Type type2 = typeBuilder.CreateType();
				if (!GeneratedTypes.ContainsKey(key))
				{
					GeneratedTypes.Add(key, type2);
				}
				return type2;
			}
		}
	}
	internal struct GeneratedTypeKey : IEquatable<GeneratedTypeKey>
	{
		private class JsonTypeKeyEqualityComparer : IEqualityComparer<GeneratedTypeKey>
		{
			public bool Equals(GeneratedTypeKey x, GeneratedTypeKey y)
			{
				if (x.Properties.Length == y.Properties.Length)
				{
					return x.Properties.All((Property keyProperty) => y.Properties.Any((Property p) => p.Equals(keyProperty)));
				}
				return false;
			}

			public int GetHashCode(GeneratedTypeKey key)
			{
				return key.Hash;
			}
		}

		public static IEqualityComparer<GeneratedTypeKey> Comparer { get; }

		public int Hash { get; }

		public Property[] Properties { get; }

		static GeneratedTypeKey()
		{
			Comparer = new JsonTypeKeyEqualityComparer();
		}

		public GeneratedTypeKey(IEnumerable<Property> properties)
		{
			Properties = properties.ToArray();
			Hash = HashCodeHelper.CalculateGenericList<Property>((IList<Property>)Properties);
		}

		public bool Equals(GeneratedTypeKey other)
		{
			return Comparer.Equals(this, other);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return Hash;
		}
	}
	internal class Property
	{
		public Type Type { get; }

		public string Name { get; }

		public string DisplayName { get; }

		public virtual bool CanBeNull => true;

		public List<CustomAttributeBuilder> Attributes { get; } = new List<CustomAttributeBuilder>();

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<string, string, string>(Type?.FullName ?? "null", Name, DisplayName);
		}

		public Property(Property other)
		{
			Name = other.Name;
			Type = other.Type;
			Attributes.AddRange(other.Attributes);
		}

		public Property(string name, Type type)
		{
			Name = name;
			Type = type;
		}

		public Property(string name, string displayName, Type type)
			: this(name, type)
		{
			DisplayName = displayName;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is Property property && property.Type?.FullName == Type?.FullName && property.Name == Name)
			{
				return property.DisplayName == DisplayName;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsEnumerable(Type enumerableType)
		{
			if (enumerableType == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Type itemType;
			return IsEnumerable(enumerableType, out itemType);
		}

		public static bool IsEnumerable(Type enumerableType, out Type itemType)
		{
			itemType = null;
			if (IsPrimitive(enumerableType) || enumerableType == typeof(byte[]))
			{
				return false;
			}
			IEnumerable<Type> enumerable = enumerableType.GetInterfaces();
			if (enumerableType.IsInterface)
			{
				enumerable = enumerable.Union(new Type[1] { enumerableType });
			}
			Type type = enumerable.FirstOrDefault((Type i) => i.IsGenericType && i.GetGenericTypeDefinition() == typeof(IQueryable<>)) ?? enumerable.FirstOrDefault((Type i) => i.IsGenericType && i.GetGenericTypeDefinition() == typeof(IEnumerable<>));
			if (type != null)
			{
				itemType = type.GetGenericArguments()[0];
				return true;
			}
			Type[] array = (from info in enumerableType.GetProperties()
				where info.GetIndexParameters().Length != 0
				select info.PropertyType).Distinct().ToArray();
			if (array.Length == 1)
			{
				itemType = array[0];
				return true;
			}
			itemType = typeof(object);
			return false;
		}

		public static IEnumerable<PropertyDescriptor> GetDetailsFromSQLResultTable(Type fieldType, string name, ResultTable sqlTable)
		{
			if (fieldType == typeof(FilteredResultList))
			{
				return sqlTable?.GetDetailList(name)?.Columns.Cast<PropertyDescriptor>();
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static bool CanFlatten(Type columnType, out List<PropertyDescriptor> properties)
		{
			properties = new List<PropertyDescriptor>();
			if (columnType == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (IsEnumerable(columnType, out var _))
			{
				return false;
			}
			columnType = ExpandNullable(columnType);
			if (IsPrimitive(columnType))
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor property in TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(columnType))
			{
				Type componentType = property.ComponentType;
				if ((object)componentType == null || !componentType.Assembly.FullName.StartsWith("DevExpress.Xpo.v23.2"))
				{
					properties.Add(property);
				}
			}
			return properties.Any();
		}

		public static bool CanFlatten(Type columnType, Type columnTypeBeforeUnfold, string name, ResultTable sqlTable, out List<PropertyDescriptor> properties)
		{
			IEnumerable<PropertyDescriptor> source = GetDetailsFromSQLResultTable(columnTypeBeforeUnfold, name, sqlTable) ?? Enumerable.Empty<PropertyDescriptor>();
			if (source.Any())
			{
				properties = source.ToList();
				return true;
			}
			return CanFlatten(columnType, out properties);
		}

		public static bool CanUnfold(Type columnType, out Type columnItemType)
		{
			columnItemType = null;
			if (columnType != typeof(string))
			{
				return IsEnumerable(columnType, out columnItemType);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static Type ExpandNullable(Type type)
		{
			if (type != null && type.IsGenericType && type.GetGenericTypeDefinition() == typeof(Nullable<>))
			{
				return type.GetGenericArguments()[0];
			}
			return type;
		}

	public class ChangeCache<T>
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<T, int> items = new Dictionary<T, int>();

		public void AddItem(T item)
		{
			if (!items.ContainsKey(item))
			{
				items.Add(item, 1);
			}
			else
			{
				items[item]++;
			}
		}

		public void RemoveItem(T item)
		{
			if (!items.ContainsKey(item))
			{
				items.Add(item, -1);
			}
			else
			{
				items[item]--;
			}
		}

		public void GetAddedRemovedItems(out List<T> addedItems, out List<T> removedItems)
		{
			addedItems = new List<T>();
			removedItems = new List<T>();
			foreach (KeyValuePair<T, int> item in items)
			{
				if (item.Value > 0)
				{
					addedItems.Add(item.Key);
				}
				else if (item.Value < 0)
				{
					removedItems.Add(item.Key);
				}
			}
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			items.Clear();
		}
	}

	internal abstract class BaseClientCriteriaVisitor : IClientCriteriaVisitor, ICriteriaVisitor
	{
		protected void Process(CriteriaOperator theOperator)
		{
			if (theOperator != null)
			{
				theOperator.Accept((ICriteriaVisitor)(object)this);
			}
		}

		public virtual void Visit(BetweenOperator theOperator)
		{
			Process(theOperator.TestExpression);
			Process(theOperator.BeginExpression);
			Process(theOperator.EndExpression);
		}

		public virtual void Visit(BinaryOperator theOperator)
		{
			Process(theOperator.LeftOperand);
			Process(theOperator.RightOperand);
		}

		public virtual void Visit(UnaryOperator theOperator)
		{
			Process(theOperator.Operand);
		}

		public virtual void Visit(InOperator theOperator)
		{
			Process(theOperator.LeftOperand);
			foreach (CriteriaOperator item in (List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)theOperator.Operands)
			{
				Process(item);
			}
		}

		public virtual void Visit(GroupOperator theOperator)
		{
			foreach (CriteriaOperator item in (List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)theOperator.Operands)
			{
				Process(item);
			}
		}

		public virtual void Visit(OperandValue theOperand)
		{
		}

		public virtual void Visit(FunctionOperator theOperator)
		{
			foreach (CriteriaOperator item in (List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)theOperator.Operands)
			{
				Process(item);
			}
		}

		public virtual void Visit(AggregateOperand theOperand)
		{
			Process((CriteriaOperator)(object)theOperand.CollectionProperty);
			Process(theOperand.AggregatedExpression);
			Process(theOperand.Condition);
		}

		public virtual void Visit(OperandProperty theOperand)
		{
		}

		public virtual void Visit(JoinOperand theOperand)
		{
			Process(theOperand.Condition);
			Process(theOperand.AggregatedExpression);
		}
	}
	internal class CriteriaOperatorEx
	{
		private struct ParseResult
		{
			private class ParseResultComparer : IEqualityComparer<ParseResult>
			{
				bool IEqualityComparer<ParseResult>.Equals(ParseResult x, ParseResult y)
				{
					if (x.Exception != null || x.Exception != null)
					{
						return false;
					}
					return CriteriaOperator.CriterionEquals(x.Criteria, y.Criteria);
				}

				int IEqualityComparer<ParseResult>.GetHashCode(ParseResult obj)
				{
					if (obj.Exception != null)
					{
						return 0;
					}
					return CriteriaProcessingExtensions.GetHashCodeNullSafe(obj.Criteria);
				}
			}

			private static IEqualityComparer<ParseResult> comparer;

			public static IEqualityComparer<ParseResult> Comparer
			{
				get
				{
					if (comparer == null)
					{
						comparer = new ParseResultComparer();
					}
					return comparer;
				}
			}

			public CriteriaOperator Criteria { get; private set; }

			public Exception Exception { get; private set; }

			public ParseResult(CriteriaOperator result, Exception exception)
			{
				Criteria = result;
				Exception = exception;
			}

			public void ThrowIfInvalid()
			{
				if (Exception != null)
				{
					throw Exception;
				}
			}
		}

		private static object parseLockObject = new object();

		private static ConcurrentDictionary<string, ParseResult> ParsedCache = new ConcurrentDictionary<string, ParseResult>();

		public static CriteriaOperator GetOrParse(string expressionString)
		{
			ParseResult orParseInternal = GetOrParseInternal(expressionString);
			orParseInternal.ThrowIfInvalid();
			return orParseInternal.Criteria;
		}

		public static CriteriaOperator GetOrTryParse(string expressionString)
		{
			return GetOrParseInternal(expressionString).Criteria;
		}

		public static bool Compare(string firstExpression, string secondExpression)
		{
			return ParseResult.Comparer.Equals(GetOrParseInternal(firstExpression), GetOrParseInternal(secondExpression));
		}

		private static ParseResult GetOrParseInternal(string expressionString)
		{
			ParseResult value = default(ParseResult);
			if (expressionString == null)
			{
				return value;
			}
			if (ParsedCache.TryGetValue(expressionString, out value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			lock (parseLockObject)
			{
				CriteriaOperator result = null;
				Exception exception = null;
				try
				{
					result = CriteriaOperator.Parse(expressionString, new object[0]);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					exception = ex;
				}
				value = new ParseResult(result, exception);
			}
			ParsedCache.TryAdd(expressionString, value);
			return value;
		}
	}
	internal static class EnumerableHelper
	{
		public static bool Unique<T>(this IEnumerable<T> collection)
		{
			HashSet<T> hashSet = new HashSet<T>(EqualityComparer<T>.Default);
			foreach (T item in collection)
			{
				if (!hashSet.Add(item))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static void AddRange<T>(this HashSet<T> hashSet, IEnumerable<T> values)
		{
			foreach (T value in values)
			{
				hashSet.Add(value);
			}
		}

		public static void AddValues<TKey, TValue>(this Dictionary<TKey, HashSet<TValue>> dict, Dictionary<TKey, HashSet<TValue>> other)
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<TKey, HashSet<TValue>> item in other)
			{
				HashSet<TValue> value = null;
				if (dict.TryGetValue(item.Key, out value))
				{
					value.AddRange(item.Value);
				}
				else
				{
					dict[item.Key] = item.Value;
				}
			}
		}

		public static bool SetEqualsWithElementsCount<T>(this IEnumerable<T> first, IEnumerable<T> second)
		{
			return first.SetEqualsWithElementsCount(second, EqualityComparer<T>.Default);
		}

		public static bool SetEqualsWithElementsCount<T>(this IEnumerable<T> first, IEnumerable<T> second, IEqualityComparer<T> eqComparer)
		{
			int num = first.Count((T item) => item == null);
			int num2 = second.Count((T item) => item == null);
			if (num != num2)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Dictionary<T, int> dictionary = first.Where((T item) => item != null).GroupBy((T item) => item, eqComparer).ToDictionary((IGrouping<T, T> g) => g.Key, (IGrouping<T, T> g) => g.Count(), eqComparer);
			Dictionary<T, int> dictionary2 = second.Where((T item) => item != null).GroupBy((T item) => item, eqComparer).ToDictionary((IGrouping<T, T> g) => g.Key, (IGrouping<T, T> g) => g.Count(), eqComparer);
			if (dictionary.Count != dictionary2.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			while (dictionary.Count > 0)
			{
				KeyValuePair<T, int> keyValuePair = dictionary.First();
				if (!dictionary2.TryGetValue(keyValuePair.Key, out var value))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (keyValuePair.Value != value)
				{
					return false;
				}
				dictionary.Remove(keyValuePair.Key);
				dictionary2.Remove(keyValuePair.Key);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static IEnumerable<T> Cast<T>(this IList list)
		{
			foreach (object item in list)
			{
				yield return (T)item;
			}
		}

		{

			try
			{
				return (IList)Activator.CreateInstance(type2);
			}
			catch (TargetInvocationException ex)
			{
				throw ex.InnerException;
			}
		}

	internal static class EqualsHelper
	{
		internal static bool ObjectsEquals<T>(T x, T y, Func<T, T, bool> equalsCore)
		{
			if ((object)x == (object)y)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (x == null || y == null || x.GetType() != y.GetType())
			{
				return false;
			}
			return equalsCore(x, y);
		}

		internal static bool ListsEquals<T>(IList<T> x, IList<T> y, Func<T, T, bool> elementsEquals)
		{
			int count = x.Count;
			if (y.Count != count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (!elementsEquals(x[i], y[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

		public static ColumnarData GetData(SelectedData selectedData, ColumnDescription[] schema)
		{
			List<IList> list = CreateChunkedLists(schema);
			for (int i = 0; i < selectedData.ResultSet[0].Rows.Length; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < selectedData.ResultSet[0].Rows[i].Values.Length; j++)
				{
					list[j].Add(selectedData.ResultSet[0].Rows[i].Values[j]);
				}
			}
			return new ColumnarData(list.ToArray(), schema);
		}
