		{
			return GetSchema(connectionProvider, command, null);
		}

		public static ColumnDescription[] GetSchema(object connectionProvider, IDbCommand command, string[] columns)
		{
			using IDataReader reader = InternalExecuteReader(connectionProvider, command, CommandBehavior.SchemaOnly, CancellationToken.None);
			return GetSchema(reader, columns);
		}

		public static ColumnDescription[] GetSchemaForComplexCustomSql(object connectionProvider, IDbCommand command, string[] columns)
		{
			command.CommandText = "select top 1 * from (" + command.CommandText + ") comm where 0=1";
			using IDataReader reader = InternalExecuteReader(connectionProvider, command);
			return GetSchema(reader, columns);
		}

		public static ColumnDescription[] GetSchema(IDataReader reader, string[] columns)
		{
			HashSet<string> hashSet = new HashSet<string>();
			ColumnDescription[] array;
			if (columns == null)
			{
				array = new ColumnDescription[reader.FieldCount];
				for (int i = 0; i < reader.FieldCount; i++)
				{
					string text = NameGenerator.GenerateUniqueName(reader.GetName(i), hashSet);
					array[i].Name = text;
					hashSet.Add(text);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				array = new ColumnDescription[columns.Length];
				for (int j = 0; j < columns.Length; j++)
				{
					array[j].Name = columns[j];
				}
			}
			for (int k = 0; k < array.Length; k++)
			{
				array[k].Type = reader.GetFieldType(k);
			}
			return array;
		}

		public static List<IList> CreateChunkedLists(ColumnDescription[] schema)
		{
			return CreateChunkedLists(schema, ReadersHelper.Readers);
		}

		public static List<IList> CreateChunkedLists(ColumnDescription[] schema, Dictionary<Type, Action<int, IDataReader, IList>> readers)
		{
			List<IList> list = new List<IList>();
			for (int i = 0; i < schema.Length; i++)
			{
				ColumnDescription columnDescription = schema[i];
				if (!columnDescription.Skip)
				{
					Type type = ((readers != null && !readers.ContainsKey(columnDescription.Type)) ? typeof(ChunkedList<>).MakeGenericType(typeof(object)) : ((!columnDescription.Type.IsValueType) ? typeof(ChunkedList<>).MakeGenericType(columnDescription.Type) : typeof(ChunkedList<>).MakeGenericType(typeof(Nullable<>).MakeGenericType(columnDescription.Type))));
					IList item = (IList)Activator.CreateInstance(type);
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}
	}
	public static class FileNameFilterStrings
	{
		private static string fileNameFilterFormat = "{0} {1}";

		private static string extensionsFormat = "({0})|{0}";

		private static string xmlExtensions = "*.xml;*.xsd";

		private static string excelExtensions = "*.xls;*.xlsx;*.xlsm;";

		private static string csvExtensions = "*.csv";

		private static string jsonExtensions = "*.json;*.txt";

		private static readonly string allExcelExtensions = excelExtensions + ";" + csvExtensions;

		private static readonly string xmlFormattedExtensions = FormatExtensions(xmlExtensions);

		private static readonly string excelFormattedExtensions = FormatExtensions(excelExtensions);

		private static readonly string csvFormattedExtensions = FormatExtensions(csvExtensions);

		private static readonly string jsonFormattedExtensions = FormatExtensions(jsonExtensions);

		private static readonly string allExcelFormattedExtensions = FormatExtensions(allExcelExtensions);

		public static string Xml => FormatFilter(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.XmlFileStrategy_FileNameFilter), xmlFormattedExtensions);

		public static string ExcelCsv => string.Join("|", AllSupportedExcel, Excel, Csv);

		public static string Json => FormatFilter("Json", jsonFormattedExtensions);

		private static string AllSupportedExcel => FormatFilter(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.FileNameFilter_AllFormats), allExcelFormattedExtensions);

		private static string Excel => FormatFilter(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.FileNameFilter_Excel), excelFormattedExtensions);

		private static string Csv => FormatFilter(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.FileNameFilter_CSV), csvFormattedExtensions);

		private static string FormatExtensions(string extensions)
		{
			return string.Format(extensionsFormat, extensions);
		}

		private static string FormatFilter(string filterName, string filterExtensions)
		{
			return string.Format(fileNameFilterFormat, filterName, filterExtensions);
		}
	}
	public class ChunkedList<T> : IList, ICollection, IEnumerable, IList<T>, ICollection<T>, IEnumerable<T>
	{
		private class Enumerator : IEnumerator<T>, IDisposable, IEnumerator
		{
			private readonly ChunkedList<T> owner;

			private int chunkIndex;

			private IEnumerator<T> chunkEnumerator;

			private bool disposed;

			object IEnumerator.Current => Current;

			public T Current
			{
				get
				{
					if (disposed)
					{
						throw new ObjectDisposedException(null);
					}
					return chunkEnumerator.Current;
				}
			}

			public Enumerator(ChunkedList<T> owner)
			{
				this.owner = owner;
				Reset();
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				if (disposed)
				{
					throw new ObjectDisposedException(null);
				}
				chunkIndex = 0;
				CreateChunkEnumerator();
			}

			public bool MoveNext()
			{
				if (disposed)
				{
					throw new ObjectDisposedException(null);
				}
				if (chunkEnumerator == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (chunkEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					return true;
				}
				chunkIndex++;
				CreateChunkEnumerator();
				if (chunkEnumerator == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return chunkEnumerator.MoveNext();
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
				if (!disposed)
				{
					if (chunkEnumerator != null)
					{
						chunkEnumerator.Dispose();
					}
					chunkEnumerator = null;
					disposed = true;
				}
			}

			private void CreateChunkEnumerator()
			{
				if (chunkEnumerator != null)
				{
					chunkEnumerator.Dispose();
				}
				chunkEnumerator = ((chunkIndex < owner.arrayList.Count) ? owner.arrayList[chunkIndex].Cast<T>().GetEnumerator() : null);
			}
		}

		private readonly List<T[]> arrayList = new List<T[]>();

		private int position;

		private int chunkSize;

		private const int shift = 12;

		private int lastChunkIndex;

		private int count;

		public T this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return arrayList[index >> 12][index & lastChunkIndex];
			}
			set
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
		}

		public int ChunkSize => chunkSize;

		public int Count => count;

		public bool IsReadOnly
		{
			get
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
		}

		object IList.this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return this[index];
			}
			set
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
		}

		bool IList.IsFixedSize
		{
			get
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
		}

		bool IList.IsReadOnly => true;

		bool ICollection.IsSynchronized
		{
			get
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
		}

		object ICollection.SyncRoot
		{
			get
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
		}

		public ChunkedList()
		{
			chunkSize = 4096;
			position = chunkSize;
			lastChunkIndex = chunkSize - 1;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public void CopyToArray(int startIndex, int count, T[] array)
		{
			if (count != 0)
			{
				T[] sourceArray = arrayList[startIndex >> 12];
				if ((startIndex & lastChunkIndex) != 0)
				{
					throw new Exception("incorrectStartIndex");
				}
				Array.Copy(sourceArray, array, count);
			}
		}

		bool IList.Contains(object value)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public int IndexOf(T item)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public void Insert(int index, T item)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public void Add(T item)
		{
			if (position == chunkSize)
			{
				T[] item2 = new T[chunkSize];
				arrayList.Add(item2);
				position = 0;
			}
			arrayList[arrayList.Count - 1][position] = item;
			position++;
			count++;
		}

		public void CopyTo(T[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public bool Remove(T item)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		IEnumerator<T> IEnumerable<T>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new Enumerator(this);
		}

		int IList.Add(object value)
		{
			Add((T)value);
			return Count - 1;
		}

		void IList.Clear()
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		int IList.IndexOf(object value)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		void IList.Insert(int index, object value)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		void IList.Remove(object value)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		void IList.RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		void ICollection.CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new Enumerator(this);
		}

		void IList<T>.RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public bool Contains(T item)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

	public class DataConnectionParametersComparer : IEqualityComparer<DataConnectionParametersBase>
	{
		bool IEqualityComparer<DataConnectionParametersBase>.Equals(DataConnectionParametersBase x, DataConnectionParametersBase y)
		{
			return Equals(x, y);
		}

		public static bool Equals(DataConnectionParametersBase x, DataConnectionParametersBase y)
		{
			if (x == y)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (y == null || x == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (y.GetType() != x.GetType())
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!object.Equals(((IConnectionPage)x).FileName, ((IConnectionPage)y).FileName))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!object.Equals(((IConnectionPage)x).Password, ((IConnectionPage)y).Password))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!object.Equals(((IConnectionPage)x).UserName, ((IConnectionPage)y).UserName))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!object.Equals(((IConnectionPage)x).ServerName, ((IConnectionPage)y).ServerName))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!object.Equals(((IConnectionPage)x).DatabaseName, ((IConnectionPage)y).DatabaseName))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!object.Equals(((IConnectionPage)x).CustomConStr, ((IConnectionPage)y).CustomConStr))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (((IConnectionPage)x).AuthType != ((IConnectionPage)y).AuthType)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!Equals(x as IConnectionPagePort, y as IConnectionPagePort, (IConnectionPagePort cx, IConnectionPagePort cy) => cx.PortNumber == cy.PortNumber))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!Equals(x as IConnectionPageSslMode, y as IConnectionPageSslMode, (IConnectionPageSslMode cx, IConnectionPageSslMode cy) => cx.SslMode == cy.SslMode))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!Equals(x as IConnectionPageClientLibrary, y as IConnectionPageClientLibrary, (IConnectionPageClientLibrary cx, IConnectionPageClientLibrary cy) => cx.ClientLibrary == cy.ClientLibrary))
			{
				return false;
			}
			IConnectionPageBigQuery connectionPageBigQuery = x as IConnectionPageBigQuery;
			IConnectionPageBigQuery connectionPageBigQuery2 = y as IConnectionPageBigQuery;
			if (connectionPageBigQuery != null || connectionPageBigQuery2 != null)
			{
				return Equals(connectionPageBigQuery, connectionPageBigQuery2);
			}
			if (!Equals(x as IConnectionPageHostname, y as IConnectionPageHostname, (IConnectionPageHostname cx, IConnectionPageHostname cy) => cx.Hostname == cy.Hostname))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!Equals(x as IConnectionPageAdvantage, y as IConnectionPageAdvantage, (IConnectionPageAdvantage cx, IConnectionPageAdvantage cy) => cx.ServerType == cy.ServerType))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!Equals(x as IConnectionPageMongoDB, y as IConnectionPageMongoDB, (IConnectionPageMongoDB cx, IConnectionPageMongoDB cy) => cx.Port == cy.Port && cx.IsSRVRecord == cy.IsSRVRecord && new MongoDBAuthenticationInfo.MongoDBAuthInfoEqualityComparer().Equals(cx.AuthenticationInfo, cy.AuthenticationInfo)))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool Equals<T>(T x, T y, Func<T, T, bool> compare)
		{
			if ((object)x == (object)y)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (x == null || y == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return compare(x, y);
		}

		private static bool Equals(IConnectionPageBigQuery x, IConnectionPageBigQuery y)
		{
			if (x == y)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (x == null || y == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!object.Equals(x.AuthorizationType, y.AuthorizationType))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (x.AuthorizationType == BigQueryAuthorizationType.PrivateKeyFile)
			{
				if (!object.Equals(x.PrivateKeyFileName, y.PrivateKeyFileName))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!object.Equals(x.ServiceAccountEmail, y.ServiceAccountEmail))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (x.AuthorizationType == BigQueryAuthorizationType.OAuth)
			{
				if (!object.Equals(x.OAuthClientID, y.OAuthClientID))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!object.Equals(x.OAuthClientSecret, y.OAuthClientSecret))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!object.Equals(x.OAuthRefreshToken, y.OAuthRefreshToken))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool Equals(SqlDataConnection x, SqlDataConnection y)
		{
			if (x == y)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (x == null || y == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Equals(x.ConnectionParameters, y.ConnectionParameters);
		}

		public int GetHashCode(DataConnectionParametersBase obj)
		{
			return 0;
		}
	}
	public class AppConfigHelper
	{
		public static SqlDataConnection CreateSqlConnectionFromConnectionString(SqlDataSource sqlDataSource, IConnectionStringsProvider connectionStringsProvider, string name)
		{
			IConnectionStringInfo connectionStringInfo = connectionStringsProvider.GetConnectionStringInfo(name);
			if (connectionStringInfo != null)
			{
				return CreateSqlConnection(sqlDataSource, connectionStringInfo, useAppConfig: true);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static Dictionary<string, SqlDataConnection> GetConnections()
		{
			return GetConnections(ConnectionStrings());
		}

		protected static Dictionary<string, SqlDataConnection> GetConnections(IConnectionStringInfo[] collection)
		{
			Dictionary<string, SqlDataConnection> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, SqlDataConnection>(collection.Length);
			foreach (IConnectionStringInfo val in collection)
			{
				SqlDataConnection sqlDataConnection = CreateSqlConnection(null, val, useAppConfig: true);
				if (sqlDataConnection != null)
				{
					dictionary.Add(val.Name, sqlDataConnection);
				}
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		public static IConnectionStringInfo[] ConnectionStrings()
		{
			return RuntimeConnectionStringsProvider.GetConnectionStringInfos();
		}

		public static string GetConnectionString(string connectionName)
		{
			return ConfigurationManager.ConnectionStrings[connectionName]?.ConnectionString;
		}

		public static DataConnectionParametersBase LoadConnectionParameters(string name)
		{
			string connectionString = GetConnectionString(name);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(connectionString))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return ConnectionStringParser.Parse(connectionString);
		}

		public static SqlDataConnection CreateSqlConnection(SqlDataSource sqlDataSource, IConnectionStringInfo connectionStringInfo, bool useAppConfig)
		{
			if (TryCreateSqlConnectionParameters(connectionStringInfo, out var connectionParameters))
			{
				return new SqlDataConnection(sqlDataSource, connectionStringInfo.Name, connectionParameters)
				{
					StoreConnectionNameOnly = useAppConfig
				};
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static bool TryCreateSqlConnectionParameters(IConnectionStringInfo connectionStringInfo, out DataConnectionParametersBase connectionParameters)
		{
			connectionParameters = null;
			string connectionString = connectionStringInfo.RunTimeConnectionString;
			DbConnectionStringBuilder dbConnectionStringBuilder = null;
			try
			{
				dbConnectionStringBuilder = new DbConnectionStringBuilder
				{
					ConnectionString = connectionString
				};
			}
			catch (ArgumentException)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string providerName = connectionStringInfo.ProviderName;
			if (!dbConnectionStringBuilder.ContainsKey("XpoProvider".ToLowerInvariant()))
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(providerName) || StringExtensions.CompareInvariantCultureIgnoreCase(providerName, "System.Data.SqlClient") == 0)
				{
					connectionString = AddXpoProviderToConnectionString(connectionString, "MSSqlServer");
				}
				else if (providerName.StartsWith("Microsoft.SqlServerCe.Client.", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
				{
					connectionString = AddXpoProviderToConnectionString(connectionString, "MSSqlServerCE");
				}
				else if (providerName.Equals("Oracle.DataAccess.Client", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
				{
					connectionString = AddXpoProviderToConnectionString(connectionString, "Oracle");
				}
				else
				{
					if (!providerName.Equals("System.Data.OleDb", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
					{
						return false;
					}
					string text = (string)dbConnectionStringBuilder["Provider"];
					if (!text.Equals("Microsoft.Jet.OLEDB.4.0", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase) && !text.Equals("Microsoft.ACE.OLEDB.12.0", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
					{
						return false;
					}
					connectionString = AddXpoProviderToConnectionString(connectionString, "MSAccess");
				}
			}
			connectionParameters = ConnectionStringParser.Parse(connectionString);
			return true;
		}

		private static string AddXpoProviderToConnectionString(string connectionString, string providerName)
		{
			return string.Format("{0}={1};{2}", "XpoProvider", providerName, connectionString);
		}
	}

	public static class DXDataDirectoryHelper
	{
		public const string DataDirectoryTag = "|DataDirectory|";

		public const string DataDirectoryKey = "DataDirectory";

		public const string DXDataDirectoryKey = "DXDataDirectory";

		public static string ExpandDataDirectory(string fileName)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(fileName))
			{
				return fileName;
			}
			if (fileName.StartsWith("|DataDirectory|", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				string text = GetValue("DataDirectory") ?? GetValue("DXDataDirectory") ?? AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory;
				if (text != null)
				{
					int length = "|DataDirectory|".Length;
					if (fileName.Length > length && (fileName[length] == Path.DirectorySeparatorChar || fileName[length] == Path.AltDirectorySeparatorChar))
					{
						fileName = fileName.Remove(length, 1);
					}
					return Path.Combine(text, fileName.Substring(length));
				}
			}
			return fileName;
		}

		public static void SetDXDataDirectory(string dxDataDirectory)
		{
			AppDomain.CurrentDomain.SetData("DXDataDirectory", dxDataDirectory);
		}

		private static string GetValue(string variable)
		{
			return AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetData(variable) as string;
		}
	}

	public static class AsyncHelper
	{
		public static T LoadAsync<T>(Func<CancellationToken, T> getSchema, IWaitFormActivator waitFormActivator, IExceptionHandler exceptionHandler)
		{
			CancellationTokenSource cancellationTokenSource = new CancellationTokenSource();
			CancellationTokenHook hook = new CancellationTokenHook(cancellationTokenSource);
			CancellationToken token = cancellationTokenSource.Token;
			WaitFormProvider waitFormProvider = new WaitFormProvider(waitFormActivator, hook, DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.LoadingPanelText));
			T result = default(T);
			Exception ex = null;
			waitFormProvider.ShowWaitForm();
			try
			{
				Task<T> task = Task.Factory.StartNew(() => getSchema(token), token);
				task.WithBackgroundService(token);
				task.Wait(token);
				result = task.Result;
			}
			catch (Exception ex2)
			{
				ex = ((!(ex2 is AggregateException ex3)) ? ex2 : ExceptionHelper.Unwrap(ex3));
			}
			finally
			{
				waitFormProvider.CloseWaitForm(closeCompletely: true);
			}
			if (ex != null)
			{
				if (!(ex is OperationCanceledException))
				{
					exceptionHandler.HandleException(ex);
				}
				return default(T);
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static bool DoWithWaitForm(Action<CancellationToken> action, IWaitFormActivator waitFormActivator, IExceptionHandler exceptionHandler)
		{
			CancellationTokenSource cancellationTokenSource = new CancellationTokenSource();
			CancellationTokenHook hook = new CancellationTokenHook(cancellationTokenSource);
			CancellationToken token = cancellationTokenSource.Token;
			WaitFormProvider waitFormProvider = new WaitFormProvider(waitFormActivator, hook, DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.LoadingPanelText));
			Exception ex = null;
			waitFormProvider.ShowWaitForm();
			try
			{
				Task task = Task.Factory.StartNew(delegate
				{
					action(token);
				}, token);
				task.WithBackgroundService(token);
				task.Wait(token);
			}
			catch (TargetInvocationException ex2)
			{
				ex = ex2.InnerException;
			}
			catch (Exception ex3)
			{
				ex = ((!(ex3 is AggregateException ex4)) ? ex3 : ExceptionHelper.Unwrap(ex4));
			}
			finally
			{
				waitFormProvider.CloseWaitForm(closeCompletely: true);
			}
			if (ex != null)
			{
				if (ex is TargetInvocationException ex5)
				{
					ex = ex5.InnerException;
				}
				if (!(ex is OperationCanceledException))
				{
					exceptionHandler.HandleException(ex);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class CustomPropertiesTypeConverter : LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter
	{
		protected abstract PropertyDescriptor ProcessProperty(PropertyDescriptor property);

		public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value, System.Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = ((ExpandableObjectConverter)this).GetProperties(context, value, attributes);
			PropertyDescriptor[] array = new PropertyDescriptor[properties.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < properties.Count; i++)
			{
				array[i] = ProcessProperty(properties[i]);
			}
			return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(array);
		}
	}
	internal class ObscuredTypeConverter : CustomPropertiesTypeConverter
	{
		protected override PropertyDescriptor ProcessProperty(PropertyDescriptor property)
		{
			if (DataConnectionHelper.KeysToObscure.Contains(property.Name, StringComparer.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
			{
				return new ObscuredPropertyDescriptor(property);
			}
			return property;
		}
	}

	public static class ParameterSerializer
	{
		public const string XML_Parameter = "Parameter";

		private const string XML_ParameterName = "Name";

		private const string XML_ParameterType = "Type";

		private const string XML_StringNull = "IsNull";

		private static readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string, Type> predefinedTypes = new ConcurrentDictionary<string, Type>(new KeyValuePair<string, Type>[1]
		{
			new KeyValuePair<string, Type>(typeof(Expression).FullName, typeof(Expression))
		});

		public static XElement SerializeParameter(IExtensionsProvider extensionProvider, DataSourceParameterBase parameter)
		{
			return SerializeParameter(extensionProvider, parameter, null);
		}

		internal static XElement SerializeParameter(IExtensionsProvider extensionProvider, DataSourceParameterBase parameter, ISerializableTypesCollector collector)
		{
			object value = parameter.Value;
			XElement xElement = new XElement("Parameter");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(parameter.Name))
			{
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("Name", parameter.Name));
			}
			if (parameter.Type == null)
			{
				return xElement;
			}
			xElement.Add(new XAttribute("Type", IsPrimitive(parameter.Type) ? parameter.Type.FullName : parameter.Type.AssemblyQualifiedName));
			if (parameter.Value == null)
			{
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("IsNull", true));
				return xElement;
			}
			Type boxedType = NullableHelpers.GetBoxedType(parameter.Type);
			string content = default(string);
			try
			{
				if (ObjectConverter.Instance.CanConvertToString(boxedType))
				{
					content = ObjectConverter.Instance.ConvertToString(value);
				}
				else if (boxedType == typeof(string))
				{
					content = (string)value;
				}
				else if (boxedType == typeof(bool))
				{
					content = ((bool)value).ToString();
				}
				else if (boxedType == typeof(char))
				{
					content = $"{Convert.ToUInt16((char)value):X4}";
				}
				else if (boxedType == typeof(int))
				{
					content = ((int)value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				}
				else if (boxedType == typeof(uint))
				{
					content = ((uint)value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				}
				else if (boxedType == typeof(short))
				{
					content = ((short)value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				}
				else if (boxedType == typeof(ushort))
				{
					content = ((ushort)value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				}
				else if (boxedType == typeof(long))
				{
					content = ((long)value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				}
				else if (boxedType == typeof(ulong))
				{
					content = ((ulong)value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				}
				else if (boxedType == typeof(byte))
				{
					content = $"{(byte)value:X2}";
				}
				else if (boxedType == typeof(sbyte))
				{
					content = $"{(sbyte)value:X2}";
				}
				else if (boxedType == typeof(double))
				{
					content = Convert.ToBase64String(BitConverter.GetBytes((double)value));
				}
				else if (boxedType == typeof(float))
				{
					content = Convert.ToBase64String(BitConverter.GetBytes((float)value));
				}
				else if (boxedType == typeof(decimal))
				{
					byte[] array = new byte[16];
					int[] bits = decimal.GetBits((decimal)value);
					for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
					{
						BitConverter.GetBytes(bits[i]).CopyTo(array, 4 * i);
					}
					content = Convert.ToBase64String(array);
				}
				else if (boxedType == typeof(DateTime))
				{
					content = ((DateTime)value).ToBinary().ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				}
				else if (boxedType == typeof(Expression))
				{
					content = Expression.ConvertToString(value as Expression);
				}
				else if (boxedType == typeof(Guid))
				{
					content = ((Guid)value/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).ToString();
				}
				else if (!SerializationService.SerializeObject(value, ref content, extensionProvider))
				{
					if (!boxedType.IsEnum)
					{
						throw new NotSupportedException("Binary serialization is no longer supported. Refer to the following BC for details: https://supportcenter.devexpress.com/ticket/details/t1159158/dataaccess-library-binary-serialization-of-multiple-properties-replaced-by-a-custom");
					}
					content = value.ToString();
				}
			}
			catch (InvalidCastException innerException)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot serialize the parameter " + parameter.Name + " because of the type mismatch: " + parameter.Type.FullName + " expected, " + parameter.Value.GetType().FullName + " found.", innerException);
			}
			xElement.Add(content);
			return xElement;
		}

		public static void DeserializeParameter(DataSourceParameterBase paramInfo, XElement paramEl, IExtensionsProvider extensionProvider)
		{
			paramInfo.Name = paramEl.GetAttributeValue("Name");
			string attributeValue = paramEl.GetAttributeValue("Type");
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(attributeValue))
			{
				return;
			}
			Type type = (((extensionProvider as IServiceProvider)?.GetService(typeof(ITypeResolutionService)) is ITypeResolutionService typeResolutionService) ? typeResolutionService.GetType(attributeValue) : SafeTypeResolver.GetPrimitiveOrTrustedType(attributeValue, (IDictionary<string, Type>)predefinedTypes, (bool?)null));
			if (!(type == null))
			{
				paramInfo.Type = type;
				if (bool.TryParse(paramEl.GetAttributeValue("IsNull"), out var result) && result)
				{
					paramInfo.Value = null;
					return;
				}
				string value = paramEl.Value;
				FillParamInfoFromString(paramInfo, attributeValue, value, extensionProvider);
			}
		}

		public static void FillParamInfoFromString(DataSourceParameterBase paramInfo, string paramTypeStr, string paramValueStr, IExtensionsProvider extensionProvider)
		{
			Type primitiveOrTrustedType = SafeTypeResolver.GetPrimitiveOrTrustedType(paramTypeStr, (IDictionary<string, Type>)predefinedTypes, (bool?)null);
			if (primitiveOrTrustedType == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			paramInfo.Type = primitiveOrTrustedType;
			object obj = default(object);
			Guid result;
			if (ObjectConverter.Instance.CanConvertFromString(primitiveOrTrustedType, paramValueStr))
			{
				obj = ObjectConverter.Instance.ConvertFromString(primitiveOrTrustedType, paramValueStr);
			}
			else if (primitiveOrTrustedType == typeof(string))
			{
				obj = paramValueStr;
			}
			else if (primitiveOrTrustedType == typeof(Expression))
			{
				obj = Expression.ConvertFromString(paramValueStr, extensionProvider);
			}
			else if (primitiveOrTrustedType == typeof(bool))
			{
				obj = bool.Parse(paramValueStr);
			}
			else if (primitiveOrTrustedType == typeof(char))
			{
				obj = Convert.ToChar(ushort.Parse(paramValueStr, NumberStyles.HexNumber));
			}
			else if (primitiveOrTrustedType == typeof(int))
			{
				obj = int.Parse(paramValueStr);
			}
			else if (primitiveOrTrustedType == typeof(uint))
			{
				obj = uint.Parse(paramValueStr);
			}
			else if (primitiveOrTrustedType == typeof(short))
			{
				obj = short.Parse(paramValueStr);
			}
			else if (primitiveOrTrustedType == typeof(ushort))
			{
				obj = ushort.Parse(paramValueStr);
			}
			else if (primitiveOrTrustedType == typeof(long))
			{
				obj = long.Parse(paramValueStr);
			}
			else if (primitiveOrTrustedType == typeof(ulong))
			{
				obj = ulong.Parse(paramValueStr);
			}
			else if (primitiveOrTrustedType == typeof(byte))
			{
				obj = byte.Parse(paramValueStr, NumberStyles.HexNumber);
			}
			else if (primitiveOrTrustedType == typeof(sbyte))
			{
				obj = sbyte.Parse(paramValueStr, NumberStyles.HexNumber);
			}
			else if (primitiveOrTrustedType == typeof(double))
			{
				obj = BitConverter.ToDouble(Convert.FromBase64String(paramValueStr.Trim()), 0);
			}
			else if (primitiveOrTrustedType == typeof(float))
			{
				obj = BitConverter.ToSingle(Convert.FromBase64String(paramValueStr.Trim()), 0);
			}
			else if (primitiveOrTrustedType == typeof(decimal))
			{
				byte[] value = Convert.FromBase64String(paramValueStr.Trim());
				obj = new decimal(new int[4]
				{
					BitConverter.ToInt32(value, 0),
					BitConverter.ToInt32(value, 4),
					BitConverter.ToInt32(value, 8),
					BitConverter.ToInt32(value, 12)
				});
			}
			else if (primitiveOrTrustedType == typeof(DateTime))
			{
				obj = DateTime.FromBinary(long.Parse(paramValueStr.Trim()));
			}
			else if (primitiveOrTrustedType == typeof(Guid) && Guid.TryParse(paramValueStr.Trim(), out result))
			{
				obj = result;
			}
			else if (SerializationService.DeserializeObject(paramValueStr, paramTypeStr, ref obj, extensionProvider))
			{
				if (obj != null)
				{
					paramInfo.Type = obj.GetType();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (!primitiveOrTrustedType.IsEnum)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException("Binary serialization is no longer supported. Refer to the following BC for details: https://supportcenter.devexpress.com/ticket/details/t1159158/dataaccess-library-binary-serialization-of-multiple-properties-replaced-by-a-custom");
				}
				obj = Enum.Parse(primitiveOrTrustedType, paramValueStr);
			}
			paramInfo.Value = obj;
		}

		private static bool IsPrimitive(Type type)
		{
			if (!XtraPropertyInfo.IsPrimitiveType(type) && !(type == typeof(object)))
			{
				return type == typeof(Expression);
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	[DXHelpExclude(true)]
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public static class DataAccessXmlSerializerSettings
	{
		public const string CustomSerializerName = "DataAccessParameterSerializer";
	}
	public class ParametersRenamingHelper : IClientCriteriaVisitor, ICriteriaVisitor
	{
		private readonly IDictionary<string, string> renamingMap;

		public void Process(IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters)
		{
			foreach (IParameter parameter in parameters)
			{
				if (!(((IFilterParameter)parameter).Type != typeof(Expression)) && parameter.Value is Expression expression)
				{
					CriteriaOperator val;
					try
					{
						val = CriteriaOperator.Parse(expression.ExpressionString, new object[0]);
					}
					catch
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (val != null)
					{
						Process(val);
						expression.ExpressionString = ((object)val).ToString();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public void Process(CriteriaOperator op)
		{
			if (op != null)
			{
				op.Accept((ICriteriaVisitor)(object)this);
			}
		}

		public ParametersRenamingHelper(IDictionary<string, string> renamingMap)
		{
			this.renamingMap = renamingMap;
		}

		public void Visit(FunctionOperator theOperator)
		{
			foreach (CriteriaOperator item in (List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)theOperator.Operands)
			{
				Process(item);
			}
		}

		public void Visit(BinaryOperator theOperator)
		{
			Process(theOperator.LeftOperand);
			Process(theOperator.RightOperand);
		}

		public void Visit(UnaryOperator theOperator)
		{
			Process(theOperator.Operand);
		}

		public void Visit(BetweenOperator theOperator)
		{
			Process(theOperator.TestExpression);
			Process(theOperator.BeginExpression);
			Process(theOperator.EndExpression);
		}

		public void Visit(InOperator theOperator)
		{
			Process(theOperator.LeftOperand);
			foreach (CriteriaOperator item in (List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)theOperator.Operands)
			{
				Process(item);
			}
		}

		public void Visit(GroupOperator theOperator)
		{
			foreach (CriteriaOperator item in (List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)theOperator.Operands)
			{
				Process(item);
			}
		}

		public void Visit(AggregateOperand theOperand)
		{
		}

		public void Visit(JoinOperand theOperand)
		{
		}

		public void Visit(OperandValue theOperand)
		{
			OperandParameter val = (OperandParameter)(object)((theOperand is OperandParameter) ? theOperand : null);
			if (val != null && renamingMap.ContainsKey(val.ParameterName))
			{
				val.ParameterName = renamingMap[val.ParameterName];
			}
		}

		public void Visit(OperandProperty theOperand)
		{
			string propertyName = theOperand.PropertyName;
			Regex regex = new Regex("\\AParameters\\.(?<name>.+)\\z", RegexOptions.None);
			Match match = regex.Match(propertyName);
			if (match.Success)
			{
				string value = match.Groups["name"].Value;
				if (renamingMap.TryGetValue(value, out var value2))
				{
					theOperand.PropertyName = $"Parameters.{value2}";
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public static class ReadersHelper
	{
		public static readonly Dictionary<Type, Action<int, IDataReader, IList>> Readers = new Dictionary<Type, Action<int, IDataReader, IList>>
		{
			{
				typeof(decimal),
				delegate(int i, IDataReader reader, IList list)
				{
					ReadStruct(reader, (ChunkedList<decimal?>)list, i, (IDataReader r, int index) => r.GetDecimal(index));
				}
			},
			{
				typeof(float),
				delegate(int i, IDataReader reader, IList list)
				{
					ReadStruct(reader, (ChunkedList<float?>)list, i, (IDataReader r, int index) => r.GetFloat(index));
				}
			},
			{
				typeof(bool),
				delegate(int i, IDataReader reader, IList list)
				{
					ReadStruct(reader, (ChunkedList<bool?>)list, i, (IDataReader r, int index) => r.GetBoolean(index));
				}
			},
			{
				typeof(string),
				delegate(int i, IDataReader reader, IList list)
				{
					ReadClass(reader, (ChunkedList<string>)list, i, (IDataReader r, int index) => r.GetString(index));
				}
			},
			{
				typeof(double),
				delegate(int i, IDataReader reader, IList list)
				{
					ReadStruct(reader, (ChunkedList<double?>)list, i, (IDataReader r, int index) => r.GetDouble(index));
				}
			},
			{
				typeof(byte),
				delegate(int i, IDataReader reader, IList list)
				{
					ReadStruct(reader, (ChunkedList<byte?>)list, i, GetByte);
				}
			},
			{
				typeof(sbyte),
				delegate(int i, IDataReader reader, IList list)
				{
					ReadStruct(reader, (ChunkedList<sbyte?>)list, i, (IDataReader r, int index) => (sbyte)r.GetValue(index));
				}
			},
			{
				typeof(short),
				delegate(int i, IDataReader reader, IList list)
				{
					ReadStruct(reader, (ChunkedList<short?>)list, i, (IDataReader r, int index) => r.GetInt16(index));
				}
			},
			{
				typeof(ushort),
				delegate(int i, IDataReader reader, IList list)
				{
					ReadStruct(reader, (ChunkedList<ushort?>)list, i, (IDataReader r, int index) => (ushort)r.GetValue(index));
				}
			},
			{
				typeof(ulong),
				delegate(int i, IDataReader reader, IList list)
				{
					ReadStruct(reader, (ChunkedList<ulong?>)list, i, (IDataReader r, int index) => (ulong)r.GetValue(index));
				}
			},
			{
				typeof(uint),
				delegate(int i, IDataReader reader, IList list)
				{
					ReadStruct(reader, (ChunkedList<uint?>)list, i, (IDataReader r, int index) => (uint)r.GetValue(index));
				}
			},
			{
				typeof(int),
				delegate(int i, IDataReader reader, IList list)
				{
					ReadStruct(reader, (ChunkedList<int?>)list, i, (IDataReader r, int index) => r.GetInt32(index));
				}
			},
			{
				typeof(long),
				delegate(int i, IDataReader reader, IList list)
				{
					ReadStruct(reader, (ChunkedList<long?>)list, i, (IDataReader r, int index) => r.GetInt64(index));
				}
			},
			{
				typeof(DateTime),
				delegate(int i, IDataReader reader, IList list)
				{
					ReadStruct(reader, (ChunkedList<DateTime?>)list, i, (IDataReader r, int index) => r.GetDateTime(index));
				}
			},
			{
				typeof(byte[]),
				delegate(int i, IDataReader reader, IList list)
				{
					ReadClass(reader, (ChunkedList<byte[]>)list, i, (IDataReader r, int index) => (byte[])r.GetValue(index));
				}
			},
			{
				typeof(object),
				delegate(int i, IDataReader reader, IList list)
				{
					ReadClass(reader, (ChunkedList<object>)list, i, (IDataReader r, int index) => r.GetValue(index));
				}
			},
			{
				typeof(Guid),
				delegate(int i, IDataReader reader, IList list)
				{
					ReadStruct(reader, (ChunkedList<Guid?>)list, i, GetGuid);
				}
			},
			{
				typeof(TimeSpan),
				delegate(int i, IDataReader reader, IList list)
				{
					ReadStruct(reader, (ChunkedList<TimeSpan?>)list, i, GetTimeSpan);
				}
			},
			{
				typeof(char),
				delegate(int i, IDataReader reader, IList list)
				{
					ReadStruct(reader, (ChunkedList<char?>)list, i, GetChar);
				}
			}
		};

		private static byte GetByte(IDataReader r, int index)
		{
			try
			{
				return r.GetByte(index);
			}
			catch (InvalidCastException)
			{
			}
			int @int = r.GetInt32(index);
			return Convert.ToByte(@int);
		}

		private static char GetChar(IDataReader dataReader, int index)
		{
			try
			{
				return dataReader.GetChar(index);
			}
			catch (NotSupportedException)
			{
			}
			catch (IndexOutOfRangeException)
			{
			}
			string text = (string)dataReader.GetValue(index);
			if (text.Length != 0)
			{
				return Convert.ToChar(text);
			}
			return ' ';
		}

		private static TimeSpan GetTimeSpan(IDataReader dataReader, int index)
		{
			object value = dataReader.GetValue(index);
			if (value is TimeSpan)
			{
				return (TimeSpan)value;
			}
			double num = Convert.ToDouble(value);
			if (num > TimeSpan.MaxValue.TotalSeconds - 0.0005 && num < TimeSpan.MaxValue.TotalSeconds + 0.0005)
			{
				return TimeSpan.MaxValue;
			}
			if (num < TimeSpan.MinValue.TotalSeconds + 0.0005 && num > TimeSpan.MinValue.TotalSeconds - 0.0005)
			{
				return TimeSpan.MinValue;
			}
			return TimeSpan.FromSeconds(num);
		}

		private static Guid GetGuid(IDataReader dataReader, int index)
		{
			object value = dataReader.GetValue(index);
			if (!(value is byte[]))
			{
				return new Guid(value.ToString());
			}
			return new Guid((byte[])value);
		}

		public static void ReadStruct<T>(IDataReader dataReader, ChunkedList<T?> list, int index, Func<IDataReader, int, T> getValue) where T : struct
		{
			if (dataReader.IsDBNull(index))
			{
				list.Add(null);
			}
			else
			{
				list.Add(getValue(dataReader, index));
			}
		}

		private static void ReadClass<T>(IDataReader dataReader, ChunkedList<T> list, int index, Func<IDataReader, int, T> getValue) where T : class
		{
			if (dataReader.IsDBNull(index))
			{
				list.Add(null);
			}
			else
			{
				list.Add(getValue(dataReader, index));
			}
		}
	}
	public class DataComponentHelper
	{
		private const string typeNameAttribute = "TypeName";

		private readonly string rootElementName;

		private static readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string, Type> predefinedTypes = new ConcurrentDictionary<string, Type>(new KeyValuePair<string, Type>[8]
		{
			new KeyValuePair<string, Type>(typeof(SqlDataSource).FullName, typeof(SqlDataSource)),
			new KeyValuePair<string, Type>(typeof(EFDataSource).FullName, typeof(EFDataSource)),
			new KeyValuePair<string, Type>(typeof(ObjectDataSource).FullName, typeof(ObjectDataSource)),
			new KeyValuePair<string, Type>(typeof(ExcelDataSource).FullName, typeof(ExcelDataSource)),
			new KeyValuePair<string, Type>(typeof(JsonDataSource).FullName, typeof(JsonDataSource)),
			new KeyValuePair<string, Type>(typeof(FederationDataSource).FullName, typeof(FederationDataSource)),
			new KeyValuePair<string, Type>(typeof(MongoDBDataSource).FullName, typeof(MongoDBDataSource)),
			new KeyValuePair<string, Type>(typeof(XPObjectSource).FullName, typeof(XPObjectSource))
		});

		public DataComponentHelper(string rootElementName)
		{
			this.rootElementName = rootElementName;
		}

		public DataComponentHelper()
			: this("DataSource")
		{
		}

		public IDataComponent LoadFromXml(XElement e)
		{
			string attributeValue = e.GetAttributeValue("TypeName");
			Type primitiveOrTrustedType = SafeTypeResolver.GetPrimitiveOrTrustedType(attributeValue, (IDictionary<string, Type>)predefinedTypes, (bool?)true);
			object obj = Activator.CreateInstance(primitiveOrTrustedType);
			IDataComponent val = (IDataComponent)((obj is IDataComponent) ? obj : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			val.LoadFromXml(e.Elements().First());
			return val;
		}

		public XElement SaveToXml(IDataComponent dataComponent)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)dataComponent, "dataComponent");
			XElement xElement = new XElement(rootElementName);
			xElement.Add(new XAttribute("TypeName", ((object)dataComponent).GetType().FullName));
			xElement.Add(dataComponent.SaveToXml());
			return xElement;
		}
	}
	public class EmptyExceptionHandler : IExceptionHandler
	{
		public Exception Exception { get; set; }

	public static class Base64XmlSerializer
	{
		public static string GetBase64String(XElement element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				return Convert.ToBase64String(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(element.ToString()));
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static XElement GetXElement(string base64String)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(base64String))
			{
				using (MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream(Convert.FromBase64String(base64String)))
				{
					return SafeXml.CreateXElement((Stream)memoryStream, (Action<XmlReaderSettings>)null);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class CriteriaPatcher : IClientCriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>, ICriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>
	{
		protected CriteriaOperator Process(CriteriaOperator op)
		{
			if (op != null)
			{
				return op.Accept<CriteriaOperator>((ICriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>)this);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator> ProcessAny(IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator> operands)
		{
			List<CriteriaOperator> list = new List<CriteriaOperator>();
			foreach (CriteriaOperator operand in operands)
			{
				CriteriaOperator val = Process(operand);
				if (val != null)
				{
					list.Add(val);
				}
			}
			if (list.Count <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return list;
		}

		private IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator> ProcessEvery(IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator> operands)
		{
			List<CriteriaOperator> list = new List<CriteriaOperator>();
			foreach (CriteriaOperator operand in operands)
			{
				CriteriaOperator val = Process(operand);
				if (val == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				list.Add(val);
			}
			if (list.Count <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return list;
		}

		CriteriaOperator ICriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>.Visit(BetweenOperator theOperator)
		{
			//IL_0039: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			CriteriaOperator val = Process(theOperator.TestExpression);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			CriteriaOperator val2 = Process(theOperator.BeginExpression);
			if (val2 == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			CriteriaOperator val3 = Process(theOperator.EndExpression);
			if (val3 == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return (CriteriaOperator)new BetweenOperator(val, val2, val3);
		}

		CriteriaOperator ICriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>.Visit(BinaryOperator theOperator)
		{
			//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0032: Expected O, but got Unknown
			CriteriaOperator val = Process(theOperator.LeftOperand);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			CriteriaOperator val2 = Process(theOperator.RightOperand);
			if (val2 == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return (CriteriaOperator)new BinaryOperator(val, val2, theOperator.OperatorType);
		}

		CriteriaOperator ICriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>.Visit(FunctionOperator theOperator)
		{
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator> enumerable = ProcessEvery((IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator>)theOperator.Operands);
			if (enumerable == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return (CriteriaOperator)new FunctionOperator(theOperator.OperatorType, enumerable);
		}

		CriteriaOperator ICriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>.Visit(GroupOperator theOperator)
		{
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator> enumerable = ProcessAny((IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator>)theOperator.Operands);
			if (enumerable == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return (CriteriaOperator)new GroupOperator(theOperator.OperatorType, enumerable);
		}

		CriteriaOperator ICriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>.Visit(InOperator theOperator)
		{
			//IL_0026: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			CriteriaOperator val = Process(theOperator.LeftOperand);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator> enumerable = ProcessAny((IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator>)theOperator.Operands);
			if (enumerable == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return (CriteriaOperator)new InOperator(val, enumerable);
		}

		public virtual CriteriaOperator Visit(OperandValue theOperand)
		{
			return (CriteriaOperator)(object)theOperand;
		}

		CriteriaOperator ICriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>.Visit(UnaryOperator theOperator)
		{
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			CriteriaOperator val = Process(theOperator.Operand);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return (CriteriaOperator)new UnaryOperator(theOperator.OperatorType, val);
		}

		CriteriaOperator IClientCriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>.Visit(AggregateOperand theOperand)
		{
			return (CriteriaOperator)(object)theOperand;
		}

		CriteriaOperator IClientCriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>.Visit(JoinOperand theOperand)
		{
			return (CriteriaOperator)(object)theOperand;
		}

		public virtual CriteriaOperator Visit(OperandProperty theOperand)
		{
			return (CriteriaOperator)(object)theOperand;
		}

	public static class DataSourceParameterHelper
	{
		public static bool IsBoundToExternalParameter(DataSourceParameterBase parameter)
		{
			string externalParameterName;
			return IsBoundToExternalParameter(parameter, out externalParameterName);
		}

		public static bool IsBoundToExternalParameter(DataSourceParameterBase parameter, out string externalParameterName)
		{
			externalParameterName = string.Empty;
			if (parameter.Type == typeof(Expression))
			{
				if (!(parameter.Value is Expression expression))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return GetParameterNames(expression.ExpressionString).Length != 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static string[] GetParameterNames(string expressionString)
		{
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			CriteriaOperator val = CriteriaOperator.TryParse(expressionString, new object[0]);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return new string[0];
			}
			return new CriteriaNameExtractor(val).GetParameterNames();
		}

		public static bool ExtractParameterName(string expressionString, out string parameterName)
		{
			string[] parameterNames = GetParameterNames(expressionString);
			if (parameterNames.Length != 0)
			{
				parameterName = parameterNames[0];
				return true;
			}
			parameterName = string.Empty;
			return false;
		}
	}

	public static class ExceptionHelper
	{
		public static Exception Adjust(Exception ex)
		{
			if (!(ex is AggregateException ex2))
			{
				return ex;
			}
			return Unwrap(ex2);
		}

		public static Exception Unwrap(AggregateException ex)
		{
			Exception[] array = ex.Flatten().InnerExceptions.Select((Exception e) => (!(e is SqlExecutionErrorException) && !(e is TargetInvocationException)) ? e : e.InnerException).ToArray();
			if (array.Length == 1)
			{
				return array[0];
			}
			Exception ex2 = array.FirstOrDefault((Exception e) => e is OutOfMemoryException);
			if (ex2 != null)
			{
				return ex2;
			}
			return new AggregateException(array);
		}
	}

	public class InMemoryConnectionStringProvider : IConnectionStringsProvider
	{
		private readonly Func<IDictionary<string, string>> connectionStringsProvider;

		public InMemoryConnectionStringProvider(Func<IDictionary<string, string>> connectionStringsProvider)
		{
			this.connectionStringsProvider = connectionStringsProvider;
		}

		public IConnectionStringInfo[] GetConfigFileConnections()
		{
			return (IConnectionStringInfo[])(object)(from x in connectionStringsProvider()
				where !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.Key) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.Value)
				select x).Select((Func<KeyValuePair<string, string>, ConnectionStringInfo>)((KeyValuePair<string, string> x) => new ConnectionStringInfo
			{
				Name = x.Key,
				RunTimeConnectionString = x.Value
			})).ToArray();
		}

		public IConnectionStringInfo[] GetConnections()
		{
			return (IConnectionStringInfo[])(object)new ConnectionStringInfo[0];
		}

		public IConnectionStringInfo GetConnectionStringInfo(string connectionStringName)
		{
			//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			string value = null;
			connectionStringsProvider().TryGetValue(connectionStringName, out value);
			return (IConnectionStringInfo)new ConnectionStringInfo
			{
				Name = connectionStringName,
				RunTimeConnectionString = value
			};
		}

		public string GetConnectionString(string connectionStringName)
		{
			IConnectionStringInfo connectionStringInfo = GetConnectionStringInfo(connectionStringName);
			if (connectionStringInfo == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return connectionStringInfo.RunTimeConnectionString;
		}

	public class Locker
	{
		private int lockCounter;

		public bool IsLocked => lockCounter > 0;

		public void Lock()
		{
			lockCounter++;
		}

		public void Unlock()
		{
			lockCounter--;
			if (lockCounter < 0)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Unpaired unlock");
			}
		}
	}
	public class ActionTypeData
	{
		private readonly ActionType actionType;

		private readonly string text;

		public ActionType ActionType => actionType;

		public ActionTypeData(ActionType actionType)
		{
			this.actionType = actionType;
			switch (actionType)
			{
			case ActionType.InnerJoin:
				text = DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.RelationEditorRelationTypeInnerJoin);
				break;
			case ActionType.LeftOuterJoin:
				text = DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.RelationEditorRelationTypeLeftOuterJoin);
				break;
			case ActionType.RightOuterJoin:
				text = DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.RelationEditorRelationTypeRightOuterJoin);
				break;
			case ActionType.FullOuterJoin:
				text = DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.RelationEditorRelationTypeFullOuterJoin);
				break;
			case ActionType.MasterDetailRelation:
				text = DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.RelationEditorRelationTypeMasterDetail);
				break;
			default:
			{
				Type type = actionType.GetType();
				throw new NotSupportedException($"'{type.Name}.{Enum.GetName(type, actionType)}' value isn't supported");
			}
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return text;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is ActionTypeData actionTypeData)
			{
				return actionTypeData.actionType == actionType;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return actionType.GetHashCode();
		}
	}
	public class ItemsRepository<T>
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<string, Type> types = new Dictionary<string, Type>();

		public void RegisterItemType(string key, Type type)
		{
			if (types.ContainsKey(key))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException($"Repository already contains the '{key}' key");
			}
			types.Add(key, type);
		}

		public T CreateItemByKey(string key)
		{
			if (types.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
			{
				return (T)Activator.CreateInstance(value);
			}
			throw new ArgumentException($"Unsupported  key '{key}'");
		}

		public T CreateItemByKey(string key, params object[] args)
		{
			if (types.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
			{
				return (T)Activator.CreateInstance(value, args);
			}
			throw new ArgumentException($"Unsupported  key '{key}'");
		}

		public string GetKeyByItem(T parameters)
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, Type> type in types)
			{
				if (type.Value == parameters.GetType())
				{
					return type.Key;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void ReplaceItemType(string key, Type type)
		{
			if (types.TryGetValue(key, out var _))
			{
				types.Remove(key);
			}
			RegisterItemType(key, type);
		}
	}
	public abstract class NameGenerator
	{
		private readonly string separator;

		internal static string GenerateUniqueName(string columnName, HashSet<string> existing)
		{
			return GenerateUniqueName(columnName, existing.Contains);
		}

		internal static string GenerateUniqueName(string columnName, Func<string, bool> contains)
		{
			if (!contains(columnName))
			{
				return columnName;
			}
			int num = 1;
			string text;
			while (true)
			{
				text = $"{columnName}_{num}";
				if (!contains(text))
				{
					break;
				}
				num++;
			}
			return text;
		}

		protected NameGenerator(string separator)
		{
			this.separator = separator;
		}

		protected string GetNextName(string prefix, ref int index, Predicate<string> contains)
		{
			string text;
			do
			{
				text = $"{prefix}{separator}{index++}";
			}
			while (contains != null && contains(text));
			return text;
		}

		protected bool IsMatchToDefaultNamePattern(string name, string prefix)
		{
			string pattern = prefix + separator + "\\d+";
			Regex regex = new Regex(pattern);
			return regex.IsMatch(name);
		}
	}
	public class PrefixNameGenerator : NameGenerator
	{
		private const string DefaultSeparator = "";

		private readonly string prefix;

		public PrefixNameGenerator(string prefix)
			: this(prefix, "", 0)

			: base(separator)
		{
			this.prefix = prefix;
			this.startIndex = startIndex;
			index = startIndex;
		}

		public string GenerateNameFromStart(Predicate<string> contains)
		{
			index = startIndex;
			return GenerateName(contains);
		}

		public string GenerateName()
		{
			return GenerateName(null);
		}

		public string GenerateName(Predicate<string> contains)
		{
			return GetNextName(prefix, ref index, contains);
		}
	}

	public class ColumnarData
	{
		private static ColumnarData columnarData;

		public static ColumnarData Empty => columnarData ?? (columnarData = new ColumnarData(new IList[0], new ColumnDescription[0]));

		public ColumnDescription[] Schema { get; private set; }

		public IList[] Lists { get; private set; }

		public Dictionary<string, ColumnarData> NestedLists { get; } = new Dictionary<string, ColumnarData>();

		public ColumnarData(IList[] lists, ColumnDescription[] schema)
		{
			Lists = lists;
			Schema = schema;
		}

		public ColumnarData(ColumnDescription[] schema)
		{
			Lists = new IList[schema.Length];
			Schema = schema;
		}

		internal object ToResult(string queryName)
		{
			if (NestedLists.Count != 0)
			{
				return new SubResultSet(queryName, NestedLists.Select((KeyValuePair<string, ColumnarData> d) => new ResultTable(d.Key, d.Value)).ToArray());
			}
			return new ResultTable(queryName, this);
		}
	}
	public sealed class FieldDescriptor
	{
		internal const string XML_Field = "Field";

		internal const string XML_Name = "Name";

		internal const string XML_FieldType = "Type";

		internal const string XML_DisplayName = "DisplayName";

		public string Name { get; set; }

		public string DisplayName { get; set; }

		public Type FieldType { get; set; }

		public XElement SaveToXml()
		{
			//IL_0046: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			XElement xElement = new XElement("Field");
			xElement.Add(new XAttribute("Name", Name ?? string.Empty));
			xElement.Add(new XAttribute("Type", ((object)DBColumn.GetColumnType(FieldType, true)/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).ToString()));
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(DisplayName) && !string.Equals(Name, DisplayName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("DisplayName", DisplayName));
			}
			return xElement;
		}

		public static FieldDescriptor LoadFromXml(XElement element)
		{
			//IL_0032: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			FieldDescriptor fieldDescriptor = new FieldDescriptor();
			fieldDescriptor.Name = element.GetAttributeValue("Name");
			fieldDescriptor.FieldType = DBColumn.GetType((DBColumnType)Enum.Parse(typeof(DBColumnType), element.GetAttributeValue("Type")));
			fieldDescriptor.DisplayName = element.GetAttributeValue("DisplayName");
			return fieldDescriptor;
		}
	}
	public sealed class ViewDescriptor : List<FieldDescriptor>
	{
		internal const string XML_View = "View";

		internal const string XML_Name = "Name";

		internal const string XML_DisplayName = "DisplayName";

		internal const string XML_SubDescriptors = "SubDescriptors";

		public string Name { get; set; }

		public string DisplayName { get; set; }

		public ViewDescriptor()
		{
		}

		public ViewDescriptor(int capacity)
			: base(capacity)
		{
		}

		public ViewDescriptor(IEnumerable<FieldDescriptor> collection)
			: base(collection)
		{
		}

		public XElement SaveToXml()
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(Name) && base.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			XElement xElement = new XElement("View");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Name))
			{
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("Name", Name));
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(DisplayName) && !string.Equals(Name, DisplayName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("DisplayName", DisplayName));
			}
			using Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				FieldDescriptor current = enumerator.Current;
				xElement.Add(current.SaveToXml());
			}
			return xElement;
		}

		public static ViewDescriptor LoadFromXml(XElement element)
		{
			ViewDescriptor viewDescriptor = new ViewDescriptor
			{
				Name = element.GetAttributeValue("Name"),
				DisplayName = element.GetAttributeValue("DisplayName")
			};
			foreach (XElement item in element.Elements("Field"))
			{
				viewDescriptor.Add(FieldDescriptor.LoadFromXml(item));
			}
			return viewDescriptor;
		}

		public void FillDataView(DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Excel.DataView dataView)
		{
			dataView.SetColumns(new ColumnarData(new IList[base.Count], this.Select((FieldDescriptor fd) => new ColumnDescription
			{
				Name = fd.Name,
				Type = fd.FieldType
			}).ToArray()));
		}

			{

	internal static class Base64Helper
	{
		public static string Encode(XElement element)
		{
			string text = element.ToString(SaveOptions.DisableFormatting);
			return Encode(text);
		}

		public static string Encode(string text)
		{
			byte[] bytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(text);
			return Convert.ToBase64String(bytes);
		}

		public static XElement Decode(string base64)
		{
			string s = base64.Trim();
			byte[] bytes = Convert.FromBase64String(s);
			string text = Encoding.UTF8.GetString(bytes);
			return SafeXml.CreateXElement(text, (Action<XmlReaderSettings>)null);
		}
	}
	internal class ColumnNameHelper
	{
		internal static string GetColumnName(string propertyName, out string tableAlias, bool enclose, bool mergeTableName)
		{
			string[] array = (from p in ExtractParts(propertyName, "[", "]", enclose: false)
				select p.Replace("\\]", "]") into n
				select (!enclose || !n.Contains(".")) ? n : ("[" + n + "]")).ToArray();
			if (array.Length == 0)
			{
				tableAlias = null;
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (array.Length == 1)
			{
				tableAlias = null;
				return array[0];
			}
			if (array.Length == 2)
			{
				tableAlias = array[0];
				return array[1];
			}
			if (mergeTableName)
			{
				tableAlias = string.Join(".", array, 0, 2);
				return string.Join(".", array, 2, array.Length - 2);
			}
			tableAlias = array[0];
			return string.Join(".", array, 1, array.Length - 1);
		}

		internal static IEnumerable<string> ExtractParts(string name, string quoteStart, string quoteEnd, bool enclose)
		{
			string escapedQuote = "\\" + quoteEnd;
			while (true)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				if (name.StartsWith(quoteStart))
				{
					if (name.Length == 1)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					else if (name.EndsWith(quoteEnd))
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					else if (name.Contains(quoteEnd + "."))
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				int dotIndex;
				if (flag)
				{
					int startIndex = 1;
					int endQuoteIndex;
					while (true)
					{
						endQuoteIndex = name.IndexOf(quoteEnd, startIndex, StringComparison.Ordinal);
						int num = name.IndexOf(escapedQuote, startIndex, StringComparison.Ordinal);
						if (endQuoteIndex == -1)
						{
							yield break;
						}
						if (num < 0 || num >= endQuoteIndex)
						{
							break;
						}
						startIndex = num + escapedQuote.Length;
					}
					yield return enclose ? name.Substring(0, endQuoteIndex + 1) : name.Substring(1, endQuoteIndex - 1);
					dotIndex = name.IndexOf('.', endQuoteIndex);
					if (dotIndex == -1)
					{
						yield break;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					dotIndex = name.IndexOf('.', 0);
					if (dotIndex == -1)
					{
						break;
					}
					for (; dotIndex < name.Length - 1 && name[dotIndex + 1] == '.'; dotIndex++)
					{
					}
					string text = name.Substring(0, dotIndex);
					yield return enclose ? Enclose(text, quoteStart, quoteEnd) : text;
				}
				name = name.Substring(dotIndex + 1, name.Length - dotIndex - 1);
			}
			yield return enclose ? Enclose(name, quoteStart, quoteEnd) : name;
		}

		internal static string Enclose(string name, string quoteStart, string quoteEnd)
		{
			return quoteStart + name.ToUpper() + quoteEnd;
		}
	}
	public static class ValueHelper
	{
		public static bool ConvertValue(object oldValue, Type newType, out object result)
		{
			try
			{
				result = TypeDescriptor.GetConverter(newType).ConvertFromString(oldValue.ToString());
				return true;
			}
			catch
			{
				result = GetDefaultValue(newType);
				return false;
			}
		}

		public static object GetDefaultValue(Type type)
		{
			if (type == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (type == typeof(DateTime))
			{
				return (DateTime)SqlDateTime.MinValue;
			}
			if (!type.IsValueType)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return Activator.CreateInstance(type);
		}

		public static string ConvertValueToString(object value, Type valueType)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (valueType == typeof(DateTime))
			{
				return "'" + value?.ToString() + "'";
			}
			return value.ToString();
		}
	}
	internal static class XmlHelperBase
	{
		public static string GetAttributeValue(this XElement element, string attributeName)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)element, "element");
			Guard.ArgumentIsNotNullOrEmpty(attributeName, "attributeName");
			return element.Attribute(attributeName)?.Value;
		}

		public static object FromString(Type type, string str)
		{
			TypeConverter converter = TypeDescriptor.GetConverter(type);
			if (converter == null)
			{
				throw new XmlException();
			}
			try
			{
				if (type == typeof(TimeSpan))
				{
					return XmlConvert.ToTimeSpan(str);
				}
				return converter.ConvertFrom(null, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, str);
			}
			catch
			{
				try
				{
					return converter.ConvertTo(null, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, str, type);
				}
				catch
				{
					throw new XmlException();
				}
			}
		}

		public static TEnum EnumFromString<TEnum>(string str)
		{
			return (TEnum)Enum.Parse(typeof(TEnum), str);
		}

		public static string GetAttributeOrElementValue(this XElement root, string name)
		{
			string attributeValue = root.GetAttributeValue(name);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(attributeValue))
			{
				return attributeValue;
			}
			return root.Element(name)?.Value;
		}

		public static void AddAttribute(this XElement rootEl, string value, string attributeName)
		{
			rootEl.Add(new XAttribute(attributeName, value));
		}
	}
	public static class StoredProcQueryHelper
	{
		internal static bool CompareStoredProcQueryAndDBStoredProcedure(StoredProcQuery query, DBStoredProcedure procedure)
		{
			if (query == null && procedure == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (query == null || procedure == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (query.StoredProcName != procedure.Name)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (query.Parameters.Count != procedure.Arguments.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return CompareParameters(query, procedure, throwOnError: false);
		}

		internal static bool CompareParameters(StoredProcQuery query, DBStoredProcedure dbProcedure, bool throwOnError)
		{
			//IL_00ac: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			using (IEnumerator<DBStoredProcedureArgument> enumerator = dbProcedure.Arguments.Where((DBStoredProcedureArgument a) => (int)a.Direction != 1).GetEnumerator())
			{
				using List<DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter>.Enumerator enumerator2 = query.Parameters.GetEnumerator();
				while (enumerator.MoveNext() && enumerator2.MoveNext())
				{
					DBStoredProcedureArgument current = enumerator.Current;
					DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter current2 = enumerator2.Current;
					if (current2 == null)
					{
						if (throwOnError)
						{
							throw new StoredProcParamNullValidationException();
						}
						return false;
					}
					if (current2.Name != ((DBNameTypePair)current).Name)
					{
						if (throwOnError)
						{
							throw new StoredProcParamNameValidationException(current2.Name, ((DBNameTypePair)current).Name);
						}
						return false;
					}
					if (current2.Type != typeof(Expression) && !DBColumn.GetType(((DBNameTypePair)current).Type).IsAssignableFrom(current2.Type))
					{
						if (throwOnError)
						{
							throw new StoredProcParamTypeValidationException(current2.Type.Name, ((object)System.Runtime.CompilerServices.Unsafe.As<DBColumnType, DBColumnType>(ref ((DBNameTypePair)current).Type)/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).ToString(), current2.Name);
						}
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

	public class ParametersGridViewModel : IParametersGridViewModel, INotifyPropertyChanged

		private static string UnknownTypeString = DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.UnknownType);

		private readonly IParameterService parameterService;

		private readonly bool isFixedParameters;

		private readonly Func<PreviewData> previewFunc;

		private readonly string defaultQueryName;

		private readonly string defaultPrefixName;

		private readonly IParameterEditorService parameterEditorService;

		public BindingList<IParameterViewModel> Records { get; }

		public IParameterService ParameterService => parameterService;

		public object[] ExternalParameterExpressions => ((parameterService != null) ? parameterService.Parameters.Select((IParameter p) => new Expression("?" + ((IFilterParameter)p).Name, ((IFilterParameter)p).Type)).Cast<object>().ToList() : new List<object>()).ToArray();

		public object[] Types => parameterEditorService.GetParameterTypes("").Values.Cast<object>().ToArray();

		public bool IsFixedParameters => isFixedParameters;

		public bool CanRemoveParameters
		{
			get
			{
				if (!isFixedParameters)
				{
					return Records.Count > 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public event EventHandler CanRemoveParametersChanged;

		public event EventHandler ExternalParameterAdded;

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		public ParametersGridViewModel(ParametersGridModel model, IParameterService parameterService, IParameterEditorService parameterEditorService, Func<PreviewData> previewFunc, bool isFixedParameters, string defaultQueryName = null, string defaultPrefixName = null)
		{
			this.previewFunc = previewFunc;
			this.isFixedParameters = isFixedParameters;
			this.parameterService = parameterService;
			this.parameterEditorService = parameterEditorService;
			this.defaultQueryName = defaultQueryName;
			this.defaultPrefixName = defaultPrefixName;
			List<IParameterViewModel> list = model.Parameters.Select((Func<IParameter, IParameterViewModel>)((IParameter p) => ParameterViewModel.FromIParameter(p, parameterService))).ToList();
			Records = new ParametersBindingList(list)
			{
				AllowNew = true
			};
			Records.ListChanged += Records_ListChanged;
		}

		public PreviewData LoadPreviewData()
		{
			return previewFunc();
		}

		public string GetDisplayName(IParameterViewModel record)
		{
			if (!record.IsExpression)
			{
				if (!(((IFilterParameter)record).Type == null))
				{
					if (!((IFilterParameter)record).Type.IsGenericType)
					{
						return parameterEditorService.GetDisplayNameByParameterType(string.Empty, ((IFilterParameter)record).Type);
					}
					return TypeNamesHelper.ShortName(((IFilterParameter)record).Type);
				}
				return UnknownTypeString;
			}
			if (record.Expression != null)
			{
				if (!(record.Expression.ResultType == null))
				{
					if (!record.Expression.ResultType.IsGenericType)
					{
						return parameterEditorService.GetDisplayNameByParameterType(string.Empty, record.Expression.ResultType);
					}
					return TypeNamesHelper.ShortName(record.Expression.ResultType);
				}
				return UnknownTypeString;
			}
			return UnknownTypeString;
		}

		public void OnCreateParameter()
		{
			OnCreateParameter(null);
		}

		public void OnCreateParameter(string queryName)
		{
			Predicate<string> containsName = delegate(string s)
			{
				IEnumerable<IParameterViewModel> source;
				if (queryName != null)
				{
					source = Records.Where((IParameterViewModel r) => r.QueryName == queryName);
				}
				else
				{
					IEnumerable<IParameterViewModel> records = Records;
					source = records;
				}
				return source.Any((IParameterViewModel p) => s == ((IFilterParameter)p).Name);
			};
			string generatedName = ExternalParameterHelper.GenerateParameterName(containsName, defaultPrefixName);
			Records.Add(CreateNewParameterViewModel(generatedName, queryName));
		}

		protected virtual ParameterViewModel CreateNewParameterViewModel(string generatedName, string queryName)
		{
			return new ParameterViewModel(generatedName, parameterService)
			{
				QueryName = (queryName ?? defaultQueryName)
			};
		}

		public void OnRemoveParameter(IParameterViewModel parameter)
		{
			if (CanRemoveParameters)
			{
				Records.Remove(parameter);
			}
		}

		public void OnCreateExternalParameter(Func<IPropertyGridView> createViewFunc, IParameterViewModel record)
		{
			if (parameterService != null && parameterService.CanCreateParameters)
			{
				IParameter parameter = parameterService.CreateParameter(record.Expression.ResultType);
				if (LaunchPropertyGridParameterEdit(createViewFunc, parameter, out var pgModel))
				{
					BindToExternalParameterCore(record, pgModel.Parameter);
					OnExternalParameterAdded();
					OnPropertyChanged("ExternalParameterExpressions");
				}
			}
		}

		public void OnBindToExternalParameter(IParameterViewModel record, string externalParameterName)
		{
			IParameter val = parameterService.Parameters.FirstOrDefault((IParameter p) => ((IFilterParameter)p).Name == externalParameterName);
			if (val != null)
			{
				BindToExternalParameterCore(record, val);
			}
		}

		public void OnExpressionEdit(Func<string, IExpressionEditorView> createViewFunc, Func<ExpressionEditorContext> createContextFunc, IParameterViewModel record)
		{
			Expression expression = record.Expression;
			if (expression != null && LaunchExpressionEdit(createViewFunc, createContextFunc, expression.ExpressionString, out var eModel))
			{
				((IParameter)record).Value = new Expression(eModel.ExpressionString, expression.ResultType);
			}
		}

		private void BindToExternalParameterCore(IParameterViewModel record, IParameter externalParameter)
		{
			record.IsExpression = true;
			Type resultType = record.Expression.ResultType;
			DataSourceParameterBase parameter = externalParameter.ToExternalQueryParameter((string s) => false, resultType);
			record.ApplyParameter((IParameter)(object)parameter, !isFixedParameters);
		}

		private bool LaunchExpressionEdit(Func<string, IExpressionEditorView> createViewFunc, Func<ExpressionEditorContext> createContextFunc, string expression, out ExpressionEditorModel eModel)
		{
			//IL_0003: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0009: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0088: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			eModel = new ExpressionEditorModel(expression);
			IExpressionEditorView val = createViewFunc(expression);
			ExpressionEditorContext val2 = createContextFunc();
			val2.Functions.Add(new FunctionInfo((ICustomFunctionOperator)(object)new FormatStringCustomFunction()));
			val2.Parameters.AddRange(parameterService?.Parameters.Select((Func<IParameter, ParameterInfo>)((IParameter p) => new ParameterInfo
			{
				Name = ((IFilterParameter)p).Name,
				Type = ((IFilterParameter)p).Type
			})) ?? Enumerable.Empty<ParameterInfo>());
			ExpressionEditorPresenter val3 = new ExpressionEditorPresenter(eModel, val, val2, (Func<string, string>)Validate);
			((PresenterBase<ExpressionEditorModel, IExpressionEditorView, ExpressionEditorPresenter>)(object)val3).InitView();
			return ((PresenterBase<ExpressionEditorModel, IExpressionEditorView, ExpressionEditorPresenter>)(object)val3).Run();
		}

		private string Validate(string expression)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(expression))
			{
				return DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.ExpressionEditor_EmptyExpression);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private bool LaunchPropertyGridParameterEdit(Func<IPropertyGridView> createViewFunc, IParameter parameter, out PropertyGridModel pgModel)
		{
			pgModel = new PropertyGridModel(parameter);
			IPropertyGridView propertyGridView = createViewFunc();
			PropertyGridPresenter propertyGridPresenter = new PropertyGridPresenter(pgModel, propertyGridView, parameterService);
			((PresenterBase<PropertyGridModel, IPropertyGridView, PropertyGridPresenter>)propertyGridPresenter).InitView();
			bool result = ((PresenterBase<PropertyGridModel, IPropertyGridView, PropertyGridPresenter>)propertyGridPresenter).Run();
			if (propertyGridView is IDisposable disposable)
			{
				disposable.Dispose();
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected virtual void OnCanRemoveParametersChanged()

		}

				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}
