	public class ParameterViewModel : IParameterViewModel, IParameter, IFilterParameter, INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		private readonly IParameterService parameterService;

		private string name;

		private Type type;

		private object value;

		private bool isExpression;

		private string queryName;

		public string QueryName
		{
			get
			{
				return queryName;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(queryName == value))
				{
					queryName = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("QueryName");
				}
			}
		}

		public string Name
		{
			get
			{
				return name;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(value == name))
				{
					name = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("Name");
				}
			}
		}

		[TypeConverter("DevExpress.DataAccess.UI.Native.Sql.QueryParameterTypeConverter,DevExpress.DataAccess.v23.2.UI")]
		public Type Type
		{
			get
			{
				return type;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(value == type) && !(value == typeof(Expression)))
				{
					if (IsExpression)
					{
						Expression.ResultType = value;
					}
					else
					{
						type = value;
						ValueHelper.ConvertValue(Value, type, out var result);
						Value = result;
					}
					OnPropertyChanged("Type");
				}
			}
		}

		public object Value
		{
			get
			{
				return value;
			}
			set
			{
				if (object.Equals(value, this.value))
				{
					return;
				}
				object result;
				if (IsExpression)
				{
					if (value is Expression expression)
					{
						this.value = new Expression(expression.ExpressionString, Expression.ResultType);
					}
					else
					{
						Expression.ExpressionString = value.ToString();
					}
				}
				else if (ValueHelper.ConvertValue(value, Type, out result))
				{
					this.value = result;
				}
				OnPropertyChanged("Value");
				OnPropertyChanged("Expression");
			}
		}

		public bool IsExpression
		{
			get
			{
				return isExpression;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == isExpression)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (value)
				{
					this.value = new Expression(ValueHelper.ConvertValueToString(Value, Type), Type);
					type = typeof(Expression);
				}
				else
				{
					type = Expression.ResultType;
					object result = null;
					try
					{
						object obj = Expression.EvaluateExpression(SourceParameters);
						if (obj != null)
						{
							ValueHelper.ConvertValue(obj, type, out result);
						}
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
					}
					this.value = result ?? ValueHelper.GetDefaultValue(Expression.ResultType);
				}
				isExpression = value;
				OnPropertyChanged("IsExpression");
				OnPropertyChanged("Expression");
			}
		}

		public Expression Expression
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsExpression)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return Value as Expression;
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<IParameter> SourceParameters
		{
			get
			{
				if (parameterService == null)
				{
					return Enumerable.Empty<IParameter>();
				}
				return parameterService.Parameters;
			}
		}

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		internal static ParameterViewModel FromIParameter(IParameter parameter)
		{
			return FromIParameter(parameter, null);
		}

		internal static ParameterViewModel FromIParameter(IParameter parameter, IParameterService parameterService)
		{
			if (parameter != null)
			{
				return new ParameterViewModel(parameter, parameterService);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public ParameterViewModel(string name, IParameterService parameterService)
		{
			this.name = name;
			type = typeof(int);
			value = ValueHelper.GetDefaultValue(type);
			this.parameterService = parameterService;
		}

		public ParameterViewModel(IParameter parameter, IParameterService parameterService)
		{
			ApplyParameterCore(parameter, applyName: true, applyType: true);
			this.parameterService = parameterService;
		}

		public void ApplyParameter(IParameter parameter, bool applyType)
		{
			ApplyParameterCore(parameter, applyName: false, applyType);
		}

		protected virtual void OnPropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			this.PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
		}

		private void ApplyParameterCore(IParameter parameter, bool applyName, bool applyType)
		{
			if (applyName)
			{
				name = ((IFilterParameter)parameter).Name;
			}
			if (applyType)
			{
				type = ((IFilterParameter)parameter).Type ?? typeof(int);
			}
			if (parameter is IQueryParameter queryParameter)
			{
				queryName = queryParameter.QueryName;
			}
			value = ((parameter.Value == null || parameter.Value == DBNull.Value) ? ValueHelper.GetDefaultValue(((IFilterParameter)parameter).Type) : parameter.Value);
			isExpression = parameter.Value is Expression;
		}
	}

	public class PropertyGridPresenter : PresenterBase<PropertyGridModel, IPropertyGridView, PropertyGridPresenter>, IPropertyGridPresenter
	{
		private readonly IParameterService service;

		public PropertyGridPresenter(PropertyGridModel model, IPropertyGridView view, IParameterService service)
			: base(model, view)
		{
			this.service = service;
		}

		protected override void InitViewCore()
		{
			base.View.Parameter = base.Model.Parameter;
		}

		protected override string Validate()
		{
			try
			{
				service.AddParameter(base.Model.Parameter);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				return ex.Message;
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override void Commit()
		{
			IParameter parameter = base.View.Parameter;
			IRangeRootParameter val = (IRangeRootParameter)(object)((parameter is IRangeRootParameter) ? parameter : null);
			if (val != null && val.IsRange)
			{
				base.Model.Parameter = (IParameter)(object)val.StartParameter;
			}
			else
			{
				base.Model.Parameter = base.View.Parameter;
			}
		}
	}

	public enum FilterVisitorCommand
	{
		PrependTableNames,
		CutOffTableNames,
		RenameColumn,
		RenameParameter
	}
	public interface IFilterVisitorLogic
	{
		CriteriaOperator PrependTableNames(QueryOperand theOperand);

		CriteriaOperator CutOffTableNames(QueryOperand theOperand);

		CriteriaOperator Rename(QueryOperand theOperand, string renameFrom, string renameTo);

		CriteriaOperator Rename(OperandValue theOperand, string renameFrom, string renameTo);
	}
	public class FilterVisitor : ClientCriteriaVisitorBase, IQueryCriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>, ICriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>
	{
		private readonly FilterVisitorCommand command;

		private readonly IFilterVisitorLogic logic;

		private readonly string renameFrom;

		private readonly string renameTo;

		public static string Process(FilterVisitor visitor, string filterString, IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters)
		{
			if (filterString == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return CriteriaOperator.ToString(visitor.Process(FilterHelper.GetFilter(filterString, parameters)));
		}

		public FilterVisitor(FilterVisitorCommand command, IFilterVisitorLogic logic)
		{
			this.logic = logic;
			this.command = command;
		}

		public FilterVisitor(string renameFrom, string renameTo, IFilterVisitorLogic logic)
			: this(FilterVisitorCommand.PrependTableNames, renameFrom, renameTo, logic)
		{
		}

		public FilterVisitor(FilterVisitorCommand command, string renameFrom, string renameTo, IFilterVisitorLogic logic)
			: this(command, logic)
		{
			this.renameFrom = renameFrom;
			this.renameTo = renameTo;
		}

		public CriteriaOperator Process(CriteriaOperator input)
		{
			return ((ClientCriteriaVisitorBase)this).Process(input);
		}

		public CriteriaOperator Visit(QueryOperand theOperand)
		{
			//IL_0078: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_005c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0062: Expected O, but got Unknown
			switch (command)
			{
			case FilterVisitorCommand.CutOffTableNames:
				return logic.CutOffTableNames(theOperand);
			case FilterVisitorCommand.PrependTableNames:
				return logic.PrependTableNames(theOperand);
			case FilterVisitorCommand.RenameColumn:
				return logic.Rename(theOperand, renameFrom, renameTo);
			default:
				if (theOperand.NodeAlias != null)
				{
					return (CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty($"{theOperand.NodeAlias}.{theOperand.ColumnName}");
				}
				return (CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty(theOperand.ColumnName);
			}
		}

		public CriteriaOperator Visit(QuerySubQueryContainer theOperand)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		protected override CriteriaOperator Visit(OperandValue theOperand)
		{
			if (command == FilterVisitorCommand.RenameParameter)
			{
				return logic.Rename(theOperand, renameFrom, renameTo);
			}
			return (CriteriaOperator)(object)theOperand;
		}
	}
	public static class ExternalParameterHelper
	{
		public static DataSourceParameterBase ToExternalQueryParameter(this IParameter parameter, Predicate<string> containsName)
		{
			return parameter.ToExternalQueryParameter(containsName, ((IFilterParameter)parameter).Type);
		}

		public static DataSourceParameterBase ToExternalQueryParameter(this IParameter parameter, Predicate<string> containsName, Type resultType)
		{
			string validName = GetValidName(((IFilterParameter)parameter).Name, containsName);
			Expression value = new Expression("?" + ((IFilterParameter)parameter).Name, resultType);
			return new DataSourceParameterBase(validName, typeof(Expression), value);
		}

		public static string GenerateParameterName(Predicate<string> containsName, string prefix = null)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(prefix))
			{
				prefix = DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.DefaultNameParameter);
			}
			PrefixNameGenerator prefixNameGenerator = new PrefixNameGenerator(prefix, 1);
			return prefixNameGenerator.GenerateName(containsName);
		}

		private static string GetValidName(string name, Predicate<string> containsName)
		{
			if (containsName(name))
			{
				return GenerateParameterName(containsName);
			}
			return name;
		}
	}

	public class AliasesCriteriaPatcher : CriteriaPatcher
	{
		private readonly string oldAlias;

		private readonly string newAlias;

		private bool success;

		public static CriteriaOperator Process(CriteriaOperator criteria, string oldAlias, string newAlias)
		{
			AliasesCriteriaPatcher aliasesCriteriaPatcher = new AliasesCriteriaPatcher(oldAlias, newAlias);
			CriteriaOperator result = aliasesCriteriaPatcher.Process(criteria);
			if (!aliasesCriteriaPatcher.success)
			{
				return criteria;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private AliasesCriteriaPatcher(string oldAlias, string newAlias)
		{
			this.oldAlias = oldAlias;
			this.newAlias = newAlias;
		}

		public override CriteriaOperator Visit(OperandProperty theOperand)
		{
			//IL_0049: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (theOperand.PropertyName.IndexOf(oldAlias, StringComparison.Ordinal) != 0)
			{
				return (CriteriaOperator)(object)theOperand;
			}
			success = true;
			if (newAlias == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return (CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty(newAlias + theOperand.PropertyName.Remove(0, oldAlias.Length));
		}
	}
	public class DataColumn
	{

		internal const string XmlName = "Name";

		internal const string XmlAlias = "Alias";

		private readonly DataTable dataTable;

		private readonly DBTable foreignKeyTable;

		private string alias;

		private DBColumn column;

		private string columnName;

		private bool selected;

		private bool HasAlias => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(alias);

		public bool IsForeignKey => foreignKeyTable != null;

		public DBTable ForeignKeyTable => foreignKeyTable;

		public DBColumn Column
		{
			get
			{
				if (column == null)
				{
					column = selection.DataProvider.FindColumn(dataTable.TableName, columnName);
				}
				return column;
			}
			private set
			{
				column = value;
				columnName = value.Name;
			}
		}

		public string ColumnName
		{
			get
			{
				if (column == null)
				{
					return columnName;
				}
				return column.Name;
			}
		}

		public DataSelection DataSelection => selection;

		public bool Selected
		{
			get
			{
				return selected;
			}
			set
			{
				SetSelected(value, raiseChanged: true);
			}
		}

		public string Alias
		{
			get
			{
				return alias;
			}
			set
			{
				SetAlias(value, raiseChanged: true);
			}
		}

		public string ActualName
		{
			get
			{
				if (!HasAlias)
				{
					return columnName;
				}
				return alias;
			}
		}

		public DataColumn(DataSelection selection, DataTable dataTable, DBColumn column, string alias, DBTable foreignKeyTable)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)selection, "selection");
			this.selection = selection;
			Column = column;
			this.alias = alias;
			this.dataTable = dataTable;
			this.foreignKeyTable = foreignKeyTable;
		}

		public DataColumn(DataSelection selection, DataTable dataTable, string columnName, string alias, DBTable foreignKeyTable)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)selection, "selection");
			this.selection = selection;
			this.dataTable = dataTable;
			this.columnName = columnName;
			this.alias = alias;
			this.foreignKeyTable = foreignKeyTable;
		}

		public DataColumn(DataSelection selection, DataTable dataTable, XElement columnElement)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)selection, "selection");
			this.selection = selection;
			this.dataTable = dataTable;
			string attributeValue = columnElement.GetAttributeValue("Name");
			string text = columnElement.GetAttributeValue("Alias") ?? string.Empty;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(attributeValue))
			{
				throw new XmlException();
			}
			columnName = attributeValue;
			SetAlias(text, raiseChanged: false);
			SetSelected(selected: true, raiseChanged: false);
		}

		public SchemaLoadingExceptionInfo LoadDataObjects()
		{
			if (Column == null)
			{
				return new SchemaLoadingExceptionInfo(dataTable.TableName, columnName);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public DataObjectCompareResult CompareWith(DataColumn dataColumn)
		{
			if (Column != dataColumn.Column || selected != dataColumn.Selected)
			{
				return DataObjectCompareResult.NotEqual;
			}
			if (alias != dataColumn.Alias)
			{
				return DataObjectCompareResult.EqualExceptForAliases;
			}
			return DataObjectCompareResult.Equal;
		}

		public void SetAlias(string alias, bool raiseChanged)
		{
			if (this.alias != alias)
			{
				this.alias = alias;
				if (raiseChanged)
				{
					selection.OnColumnAliasChanged(this);
				}
			}
		}

		public void SetSelected(bool selected, bool raiseChanged)
		{
			if (this.selected != selected)
			{
				this.selected = selected;
				if (selected)
				{
					selection.OnColumnSelected(this);
				}
				else
				{
					selection.OnColumnDeselected(this);
				}
				if (raiseChanged)
				{
					selection.OnTableChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public XElement SaveToXml()
		{
			XElement xElement = new XElement("Column");
			xElement.Add(new XAttribute("Name", columnName));
			if (HasAlias)
			{
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("Alias", alias));
			}
			return xElement;
		}
	}

	public class DataReferences : List<DataReference>

		public void PrepareSelect(SelectStatement selectStatement)
		{
			//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0032: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_008c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0091: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_009b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (base.Count <= 0 || ActionType == ActionType.MasterDetailRelation)
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = alias;
			JoinNode val = new JoinNode(KeyDBTable, text, JoinType);
			List<CriteriaOperator> list = new List<CriteriaOperator>();
			using (Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					DataReference current = enumerator.Current;
					QueryOperand val2 = CreateQueryOperand(KeyDBTable, current.KeyColumn, text);
					QueryOperand val3 = CreateQueryOperand(current.ParentDataTable.Table, current.ParentKeyColumn, current.ParentDataTable.Alias);
					list.Add((CriteriaOperator)new BinaryOperator((CriteriaOperator)(object)val2, (CriteriaOperator)(object)val3, current.OperatorType));
				}
			}
			val.Condition = CriteriaOperator.And((IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator>)list);
			((List<JoinNode>)(object)((JoinNode)selectStatement).SubNodes).Add(val);
		}

		public XElement SaveToXml()
		{
			XElement xElement = new XElement("References");
			if (actionType != ActionType.InnerJoin)
			{
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("ActionType", actionType));
			}
			using Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				DataReference current = enumerator.Current;
				xElement.Add(current.SaveToXml());
			}
			return xElement;
		}

		public void LoadDataObjects()
		{
			if (keyDBTable == null)
			{
				keyDBTable = dataSelection.DataProvider.FindTable(keyDBTableName);
			}
			using Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				DataReference current = enumerator.Current;
				current.LoadDataObjects();
			}
		}

		public DataReferences Clone()
		{
			DataReferences dataReferences = new DataReferences(dataSelection, KeyDBTable, Alias);
			dataReferences.Capacity = base.Count;
			dataReferences.AddRange(this.Select((DataReference reference) => reference.Clone()));
			dataReferences.SetActionType(ActionType, raiseChanged: false);
			return dataReferences;
		}

		public void SetActionType(ActionType actionType, bool raiseChanged)
		{
			if (this.actionType != actionType)
			{
				this.actionType = actionType;
				if (raiseChanged)
				{
					dataSelection.OnTableChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (base.Count > 0)
			{
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
				stringBuilder.Append(base[0].ToString());
				for (int i = 1; i < base.Count; i++)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.QueryDesignerJoinExpressionElementSeparator));
					stringBuilder.Append(base[i].ToString());
				}
				return string.Format(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.QueryDesignerJoinExpressionPattern), new ActionTypeData(ActionType).ToString(), stringBuilder.ToString());
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}
	}
	public class DataSchemaChangedEventArgs : EventArgs
	{
		private readonly IEnumerable<AliasChangeInfo> changes;

		public IEnumerable<AliasChangeInfo> Changes => changes;

		public DataSchemaChangedEventArgs(IEnumerable<AliasChangeInfo> changes)
		{
			this.changes = changes;
		}
	}
	public enum DataObjectCompareResult
	{
		Equal,
		EqualExceptForAliases,
		NotEqual
	}
	public class AliasChangeInfo
	{
		public string OldDataMember { get; set; }

		public string NewDataMember { get; set; }

		public AliasChangeInfo(string oldDataMember, string newDataMember)
		{
			OldDataMember = oldDataMember;
			NewDataMember = newDataMember;
		}
	}
	public class SchemaLoadingExceptionInfo
	{
		public string TableName { get; set; }

		public string ColumnName { get; set; }

		public SchemaLoadingExceptionInfo(string tableName, string columnName)
		{
			TableName = tableName;
			ColumnName = columnName;
		}
	}
	public class SchemaLoadingExceptionsInfo : List<SchemaLoadingExceptionInfo>
	{
		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			foreach (SchemaLoadingExceptionInfo item in this.Distinct())
			{
				stringBuilder.Append($", {item.TableName}.{item.ColumnName}");
			}
			stringBuilder.Remove(0, 1);
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}
	public class DataSelection : List<DataTable>
	{
		internal const string XmlSelection = "Selection";

		internal const string XmlFilters = "Filters";

		private readonly FilterInfoCollection filters;

		private readonly DataProviderBase dataProvider;

		private readonly Dictionary<QueryOperand, DataColumn> operands = new Dictionary<QueryOperand, DataColumn>();

		private readonly List<DataColumn> selectedColumns = new List<DataColumn>();

		public bool IsEmpty => base.Count == 0;

		public DataProviderBase DataProvider => dataProvider;

		public Dictionary<QueryOperand, DataColumn> Operands => operands;

		public List<DataColumn> SelectedColumns => selectedColumns;

		public FilterInfoCollection Filters => filters;

		private IAliasFormatter AliasFormatter
		{
			get
			{
				if (DataProvider == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (DataProvider.DataConnection == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return DataProvider.DataConnection.SqlGeneratorFormatter as IAliasFormatter;
			}
		}

		private int MaxTableAliasLength
		{
			get
			{
				if (AliasFormatter == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return AliasFormatter.MaxTableAliasLength;
			}
		}

		private int MaxColumnAliasLength
		{
			get
			{
				if (AliasFormatter == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return AliasFormatter.MaxColumnAliasLength;
			}
		}

		private static void CollectReferencedTables(DataTable table, List<DataTable> referencedTables)
		{
			referencedTables.Add(table);
			if (table.References.ActionType != ActionType.MasterDetailRelation)
			{
				table.References.ForEach(delegate(DataReference r)
				{
					CollectReferencedTables(r.ParentDataTable, referencedTables);
				});
			}
		}

		public DataSelection(DataProviderBase dataProvider)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)dataProvider, "dataProvider");
			this.dataProvider = dataProvider;
			filters = new FilterInfoCollection(this.dataProvider);
		}

		public DataSelection(DataProviderBase dataProvider, XElement element)
			: this(dataProvider)
		{
			foreach (XElement item in element.Elements("Table"))
			{
				Add(new DataTable(this, item));
			}
			foreach (XElement item2 in element.Elements("Filters"))
			{
				foreach (XElement item3 in item2.Elements("Filter"))
				{
					string text = item3.GetAttributeValue("TableName");
					string attributeValue = item3.GetAttributeValue("FilterString");
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
					{
						Dictionary<string, IEnumerable<DataTable>> tableGroups = GetTableGroups();
						if (tableGroups.Count > 0)
						{
							text = tableGroups.Keys.First();
						}
					}
					filters.Add(text, attributeValue);
				}
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable<DataTable> GetTablesForRelation(string currentTable)
		{
			return DataProvider.GetTablesForRelation(currentTable);
		}

		public DataObjectCompareResult CompareWith(DataSelection dataSelection)
		{
			if (base.Count != dataSelection.Count)
			{
				return DataObjectCompareResult.NotEqual;
			}
			DataObjectCompareResult result = DataObjectCompareResult.Equal;
			for (int i = 0; i < dataSelection.Count; i++)
			{
				DataTable dataTable = base[i];
				DataTable dataTable2 = dataSelection[i];
				switch (dataTable.CompareWith(dataTable2))
				{
				case DataObjectCompareResult.NotEqual:
					return DataObjectCompareResult.NotEqual;
				case DataObjectCompareResult.EqualExceptForAliases:
					result = DataObjectCompareResult.EqualExceptForAliases;
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public List<AliasChangeInfo> GetChangeList(DataSelection dataSelection)
		{
			List<AliasChangeInfo> list = new List<AliasChangeInfo>();
			if (base.Count == dataSelection.Count)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < dataSelection.Count; i++)
				{
					DataTable dataTable = base[i];
					DataTable dataTable2 = dataSelection[i];
					dataTable.FillChangeList(dataTable2, list);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public IEnumerable<DataReference> GetReferences(DBTable table)
		{
			List<DataReference> list = new List<DataReference>();
			list.AddRange(GetMasterDetailReferences(table));
			list.AddRange(GetJoinReferences(table));
			return list;
		}

		public IEnumerable<DataReference> GetMasterDetailReferences(DBTable table)
		{
			List<DataReference> list = new List<DataReference>();
			using Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				DataTable current = enumerator.Current;
				foreach (DBForeignKey foreignKey in table.ForeignKeys)
				{
					if (foreignKey.PrimaryKeyTable == current.Table.Name)
					{
						list.AddRange(CreateReferences(((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)foreignKey).Columns, table, foreignKey.PrimaryKeyTableKeyColumns, current));
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public IEnumerable<DataReference> GetJoinReferences(DBTable table)
		{
			List<DataReference> list = new List<DataReference>();
			using Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				DataTable current = enumerator.Current;
				foreach (DBForeignKey foreignKey in current.Table.ForeignKeys)
				{
					if (foreignKey.PrimaryKeyTable == table.Name)
					{
						list.AddRange(CreateReferences(foreignKey.PrimaryKeyTableKeyColumns, table, ((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)foreignKey).Columns, current));
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public Type GetActionType(DBTable table)
		{
			if (GetMasterDetailReferences(table).Any())
			{
				return DataProvider.ActionType;
			}
			return typeof(JoinType);
		}

		public string GetUniqueName(DBTable table)
		{
			int num = 0;
			string text = table.Name;
			string uniqueName;
			while (true)
			{
				uniqueName = ((num != 0) ? $"{text}_{num}" : text);
				if (MaxTableAliasLength > 0 && uniqueName.Length > MaxTableAliasLength)
				{
					text = text.Substring(0, MaxTableAliasLength - 1 - num.ToString().Length);
					num = 1;
					continue;
				}
				if (!Exists((DataTable t) => t.UniqueName == uniqueName))
				{
					break;
				}
				num++;
			}
			return uniqueName;
		}

		public bool CanSelectTable(DBTable table)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)table, "table");
			if (!IsEmpty)
			{
				return GetReferences(table).Any();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public DataTable AddTableByReference(DataColumn dataColumn)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)dataColumn, "dataColumn");
			IEnumerable<DataReference> references = GetReferences(dataColumn);
			DataTable dataTable = new DataTable(this, dataColumn.ForeignKeyTable, GetUniqueName(dataColumn.ForeignKeyTable), references);
			Add(dataTable);
			return dataTable;
		}

		public DataTable AddTable(DBTable table, DataReferences references)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)table, "table");
			DataTable dataTable = (IsEmpty ? new DataTable(this, table, GetUniqueName(table)) : new DataTable(this, table, GetUniqueName(table), references));
			Add(dataTable);
			return dataTable;
		}

		public DataTable AddTable(DBTable table)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)table, "table");
			DataTable dataTable;
			if (IsEmpty)
			{
				dataTable = new DataTable(this, table, GetUniqueName(table));
			}
			else
			{
				IEnumerable<DataReference> references = GetReferences(table);
				if (!references.Any())
				{
					throw new ArgumentException($"'{table.Name}' table can't be selected, because no references have been found");
				}
				dataTable = new DataTable(this, table, GetUniqueName(table), references);
			}
			Add(dataTable);
			return dataTable;
		}

		public List<DataTable> GetDataTablesToRemove(DataTable dataTableToRemove)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)dataTableToRemove, "dataTable");
			if (base.Count == 1)
			{
				return new List<DataTable> { dataTableToRemove };
			}
			SortedDictionary<int, List<DataTable>> sortedDictionary = new SortedDictionary<int, List<DataTable>>();
			if (dataTableToRemove.References != null)
			{
				foreach (DataReference reference in dataTableToRemove.References)
				{
					CalculateReachableTablesFrom(reference.ParentDataTable, dataTableToRemove, sortedDictionary);
				}
			}
			using (Enumerator enumerator2 = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator2.MoveNext())
				{
					DataTable current2 = enumerator2.Current;
					foreach (DataReference reference2 in current2.References)
					{
						if (reference2.ParentDataTable == dataTableToRemove)
						{
							CalculateReachableTablesFrom(current2, dataTableToRemove, sortedDictionary);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			using (SortedDictionary<int, List<DataTable>>.ValueCollection.Enumerator enumerator4 = sortedDictionary.Values.GetEnumerator())
			{
				if (enumerator4.MoveNext())
				{
					List<DataTable> current4 = enumerator4.Current;
					List<DataTable> list = new List<DataTable>();
					using (Enumerator enumerator5 = GetEnumerator())
					{
						while (enumerator5.MoveNext())
						{
							DataTable current5 = enumerator5.Current;
							if (!current4.Contains(current5))
							{
								list.Add(current5);
							}
						}
					}
					return list;
				}
			}
			return new List<DataTable> { dataTableToRemove };
		}

		public void RemoveDataTables(IList<DataTable> dataTables)
		{
			foreach (DataTable dataTable in dataTables)
			{
				Remove(dataTable);
				foreach (DataColumn selectedColumn in dataTable.SelectedColumns)
				{
					OnColumnDeselected(selectedColumn);
				}
			}
			using Enumerator enumerator3 = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator3.MoveNext())
			{
				DataTable current3 = enumerator3.Current;
				int num = 0;
				while (num < current3.References.Count)
				{
					DataReference dataReference = current3.References[num];
					if (dataTables.Contains(dataReference.ParentDataTable))
					{
						current3.References.Remove(dataReference);
					}
					else
					{
						num++;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public SelectStatement CreateSelectStatement()
		{
			if (!IsEmpty)
			{
				string filterTableName = GetFilterTableName(base[0].Alias);
				return GetTableGroupSelectStatement(filterTableName);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public IEnumerable<DataColumn> GetTableGroupsDataColumns(string tableGroupName)
		{
			Dictionary<string, IEnumerable<DataTable>> tableGroups = GetTableGroups();
			IEnumerable<DataTable> enumerable = tableGroups[tableGroupName];
			List<DataColumn> dataColumns = new List<DataColumn>();
			foreach (DataTable table in enumerable)
			{
				SelectedColumns.ForEach(delegate(DataColumn c)
				{
					if (c.DataTable == table)
					{
						dataColumns.Add(c);
					}
				});
			}
			return dataColumns;
		}

		public SelectStatement GetTableGroupSelectStatement(string tableGroupName)
		{
			Dictionary<string, IEnumerable<DataTable>> tableGroups = GetTableGroups();
			if (tableGroups != null && tableGroups.Keys.Count > 0 && tableGroupName != null && tableGroups.ContainsKey(tableGroupName))
			{
				operands.Clear();
				IEnumerable<DataTable> enumerable = tableGroups[tableGroupName];
				IEnumerable<DataColumn> tableGroupsDataColumns = GetTableGroupsDataColumns(tableGroupName);
				SelectStatement val = ((enumerable.Count() > 1) ? CreateAndPrepareSelectStatement(enumerable, tableGroupsDataColumns) : CreateSelectStatementCore(enumerable.First(), tableGroupsDataColumns));
				FilterInfo filterInfo = filters[tableGroupName];
				if (filterInfo != null)
				{
					((JoinNode)val).Condition = FilterHelper.GetFilter(filterInfo.FilterString, DataProvider.Parameters);
				}
				return val;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public Dictionary<string, IEnumerable<DataTable>> GetTableGroups()
		{
			Dictionary<string, IEnumerable<DataTable>> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, IEnumerable<DataTable>>();
			using (Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					DataTable current = enumerator.Current;
					if (current.References.ActionType == ActionType.MasterDetailRelation)
					{
						dictionary.Add(current.Alias, new List<DataTable> { current });
						continue;
					}
					List<DataTable> list = new List<DataTable>();
					CollectReferencedTables(current, list);
					List<DataTable> result = null;
					foreach (List<DataTable> value in dictionary.Values)
					{
						if (value.Intersect(list).Any())
						{
							result = value;
							break;
						}
					}
					if (result != null)
					{
						list.ForEach(delegate(DataTable dataTable)
						{
							if (!result.Contains(dataTable))
							{
								result.Add(dataTable);
							}
						});
					}
					else
					{
						dictionary.Add(list[0].Alias, list);
					}
				}
			}
			Dictionary<string, IEnumerable<DataTable>> dictionary2 = new Dictionary<string, IEnumerable<DataTable>>();
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, IEnumerable<DataTable>> item in dictionary)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				foreach (DataTable item2 in item.Value)
				{
					if (item2.HasSelectedColumns)
					{
						flag = false;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					dictionary2.Add(item.Key, item.Value);
				}
			}
			return dictionary2;
		}

		public string GetSqlQuery(string tableName)
		{
			string filterTableName = GetFilterTableName(tableName);
			SelectStatement tableGroupSelectStatement = GetTableGroupSelectStatement(filterTableName);
			return DataProvider.CreateAutoSql(tableGroupSelectStatement);
		}

		public string GetFilterTableName(string tableName)
		{
			return (string)GetResult(tableName, (KeyValuePair<string, IEnumerable<DataTable>> i) => i.Key);
		}

		public IEnumerable<DataTable> GetTables(string tableName)
		{
			if (GetResult(tableName, (KeyValuePair<string, IEnumerable<DataTable>> i) => i.Value) is IEnumerable<DataTable> result)
			{
				return result;
			}
			return this;
		}

		public void OnColumnSelected(DataColumn dataColumn)
		{
			if (selectedColumns.Contains(dataColumn))
			{
				throw new DataSourceWizardException("The specified column has already been selected");
			}
			Dictionary<string, IEnumerable<DataTable>> tableGroups = GetTableGroups();
			if (tableGroups.Count != 0)
			{
				string key = tableGroups.FirstOrDefault((KeyValuePair<string, IEnumerable<DataTable>> g) => g.Value.Any((DataTable t) => t == dataColumn.DataTable)).Key;
				if (key != null)
				{
					IEnumerable<DataColumn> tableGroupsDataColumns = GetTableGroupsDataColumns(key);
					if (tableGroupsDataColumns.Any((DataColumn _dataColumn) => _dataColumn.ActualName == dataColumn.ActualName))
					{
						string text = $"{dataColumn.DataTable.Alias}_{dataColumn.ActualName}";
						int num = 0;
						string uniqueName;
						while (true)
						{
							uniqueName = ((num != 0) ? $"{text}_{num}" : text);
							num++;
							if (MaxColumnAliasLength > 0 && uniqueName.Length > MaxColumnAliasLength)
							{
								text = text.Substring(0, text.Length - 1);
								num = 1;
							}
							else if (!selectedColumns.Any((DataColumn _dataColumn) => _dataColumn.ActualName == uniqueName))
							{
								break;
							}
						}
						dataColumn.SetAlias(uniqueName, raiseChanged: false);
					}
				}
			}
			IEnumerable<DataColumn> collection = selectedColumns.Where((DataColumn col) => !Contains(col.DataTable)).ToList();
			selectedColumns.Clear();
			foreach (DataColumn item in this.SelectMany((DataTable table) => table.Columns.Where((DataColumn column) => column.Selected)))
			{
				selectedColumns.Add(item);
			}
			selectedColumns.AddRange(collection);
			if (!Contains(dataColumn.DataTable))
			{
				selectedColumns.Add(dataColumn);
			}
		}

		public void OnColumnDeselected(DataColumn dataColumn)
		{
			if (!selectedColumns.Contains(dataColumn))
			{
				throw new DataSourceWizardException("The specified column is not selected");
			}
			selectedColumns.Remove(dataColumn);
		}

		public XElement SaveToXml()
		{
			XElement xElement = new XElement("Selection");
			using (Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					DataTable current = enumerator.Current;
					xElement.Add(current.SaveToXml());
				}
			}
			if (Filters.Count > 0)
			{
				XElement xElement2 = new XElement("Filters");
				xElement.Add(xElement2);
				foreach (FilterInfo filter in Filters)
				{
					xElement2.Add(filter.SaveToXml());
				}
			}
			return xElement;
		}

		public void OnTableChanged()
		{
			DataProvider.OnDataSelectionChanged();
		}

		public void OnColumnAliasChanged(DataColumn dataColumn)
		{
			dataProvider.OnColumnOrTableAliasChanged();
		}

		public void OnTableAliasChanged(DataTable dataTable)
		{
			dataProvider.OnColumnOrTableAliasChanged();
		}

		public DataSelection Clone()
		{
			//IL_0050: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			DataSelection dataSelection = new DataSelection(dataProvider);
			using (Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					DataTable current = enumerator.Current;
					List<DataReference> list = new List<DataReference>();
					foreach (DataReference reference in current.References)
					{
						list.Add(new DataReference(dataSelection, reference.KeyColumn, reference.KeyDBTable, reference.OperatorType, reference.ParentKeyColumn, reference.ParentDataTable.Alias));
					}
					DataTable dataTable = new DataTable(dataSelection, current.Table, current.UniqueName, list);
					dataTable.References.SetActionType(current.References.ActionType, raiseChanged: false);
					dataTable.SetAlias(current.Alias, raiseChanged: false);
					foreach (DataColumn column in current.Columns)
					{
						if (column.Column != null)
						{
							dataTable[column.Column.Name].SetSelected(column.Selected, raiseChanged: false);
							dataTable[column.Column.Name].SetAlias(column.Alias, raiseChanged: false);
						}
					}
					dataSelection.Add(dataTable);
				}
			}
			dataSelection.filters.AddRange(filters.Select((FilterInfo fi) => fi.Clone()).ToArray());
			return dataSelection;
		}

		public bool HasJoinOnColumn(DataColumn dataColumn, DBTable table)
		{
			using (Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					DataTable current = enumerator.Current;
					if (!((object)current.Table).Equals((object)table))
					{
						continue;
					}
					foreach (DataReference reference in current.References)
					{
						if (reference.ParentKeyColumn == dataColumn.Column.Name && reference.ParentDataTable == dataColumn.DataTable)
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (DataReference reference2 in dataColumn.DataTable.References)
			{
				if (reference2.KeyColumn == dataColumn.Column.Name && ((object)reference2.ParentDataTable.Table).Equals((object)table))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool IsTableAliasExists(string alias)
		{
			return this.Any((DataTable t) => t.Alias == alias);
		}

		internal void LoadDataObjects()
		{
			SchemaLoadingExceptionsInfo schemaLoadingExceptionsInfo = new SchemaLoadingExceptionsInfo();
			using (Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					DataTable current = enumerator.Current;
					schemaLoadingExceptionsInfo.AddRange(current.LoadDataObjects());
				}
			}
			if (schemaLoadingExceptionsInfo.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			string message = string.Join("\n", from e in schemaLoadingExceptionsInfo
				group e by e.TableName into p
				select string.Format("The \"{0}\" table does not contain the specified columns: \"{1}\".", p.Key, string.Join("\", \"", p.Select((SchemaLoadingExceptionInfo c) => c.ColumnName))));
			throw new InvalidOperationException(message);
		}

		private void CalculateReachableTablesFrom(DataTable dataTable, DataTable dataTableToRemove, SortedDictionary<int, List<DataTable>> reachableTables)
		{
			List<DataTable> list = new List<DataTable>();
			list.Add(dataTable);
			AddReferencedTablesToList(dataTable, dataTableToRemove, list);
			int num = int.MaxValue;
			foreach (DataTable item in list)
			{
				int num2 = IndexOf(item);
				if (num2 < num)
				{
					num = num2;
				}
			}
			if (!reachableTables.ContainsKey(num))
			{
				reachableTables.Add(num, list);
			}
			else
			{
				reachableTables[num].AddRange(list);
			}
		}

		private void AddReferencedTablesToList(DataTable dataTable, DataTable dataTableToRemove, List<DataTable> list)
		{
			foreach (DataReference reference in dataTable.References)
			{
				if (!list.Contains(reference.ParentDataTable) && reference.ParentDataTable != dataTableToRemove)
				{
					list.Add(reference.ParentDataTable);
					AddReferencedTablesToList(reference.ParentDataTable, dataTableToRemove, list);
				}
			}
			using Enumerator enumerator2 = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator2.MoveNext())
			{
				DataTable current2 = enumerator2.Current;
				if (list.Contains(current2) || current2 == dataTableToRemove || current2.References == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (DataReference reference2 in current2.References)
				{
					if (reference2.ParentDataTable == dataTable)
					{
						list.Add(current2);
						AddReferencedTablesToList(current2, dataTableToRemove, list);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private object GetResult(string tableName, Function<object, KeyValuePair<string, IEnumerable<DataTable>>> func)
		{
			Dictionary<string, IEnumerable<DataTable>> tableGroups = GetTableGroups();
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, IEnumerable<DataTable>> item in tableGroups)
			{
				foreach (DataTable item2 in item.Value)
				{
					if (item2.Alias == tableName)
					{
						return func.Invoke(item);
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private IEnumerable<DataReference> CreateReferences(StringCollection keys, DBTable dbTable, StringCollection parentKeys, DataTable parentDataTable)
		{
			if (keys.Count != parentKeys.Count)
			{
				throw new DataSourceWizardException("The keys.Count and parentKeys.Count properties have different values.");
			}
			List<DataReference> list = new List<DataReference>();
			for (int i = 0; i < keys.Count; i++)
			{
				list.Add(new DataReference(this, keys[i], dbTable, parentKeys[i], parentDataTable));
			}
			return list;
		}

		private IEnumerable<DataReference> GetReferences(DataColumn dataColumn)
		{
			foreach (DBForeignKey foreignKey in dataColumn.DataTable.Table.ForeignKeys)
			{
				if (((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)foreignKey).Columns.Contains(dataColumn.Column.Name))
				{
					DBTable dbTable = DataProvider.FindTable((DBTable table) => table.Name == foreignKey.PrimaryKeyTable);
					return CreateReferences(foreignKey.PrimaryKeyTableKeyColumns, dbTable, ((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)foreignKey).Columns, dataColumn.DataTable);
				}
			}
			throw new DataSourceWizardException("The column contains an inconsistent foreign key.");
		}

		private SelectStatement CreateAndPrepareSelectStatement(IEnumerable<DataTable> tables, IEnumerable<DataColumn> dataColumns)
		{
			DataTable table = tables.First();
			SelectStatement val = CreateSelectStatementCore(table, dataColumns);
			foreach (DataTable table2 in tables)
			{
				table2.PrepareSelectStatement(val);
			}
			return val;
		}

		private SelectStatement CreateSelectStatementCore(DataTable table, IEnumerable<DataColumn> dataColumns)
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0044: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0049: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0050: Expected O, but got Unknown
			SelectStatement val = new SelectStatement(table.Table, table.Alias);
			foreach (DataColumn dataColumn in dataColumns)
			{
				string alias = dataColumn.DataTable.Alias;
				DBColumn column = dataColumn.Column;
				if (column != null)
				{
					QueryOperand val2 = new QueryOperand(column.Name, alias, column.ColumnType);
					Operands.Add(val2, dataColumn);
					((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)((BaseStatement)val).Operands).Add((CriteriaOperator)(object)val2);
				}
			}
			return val;
		}
	}

	public class DataTable : Dictionary<string, DataColumn>
	{
		internal const string XmlTable = "Table";

		internal const string XmlName = "Name";

		internal const string XmlUniqueName = "UniqueName";

		internal const string XmlAlias = "Alias";

		internal const string XmlColumns = "Columns";

		private readonly DataSelection selection;

		private readonly string uniqueName;

		private string alias;

		private DBTable table;

		private string tableName;

		private DataReferences references;

		public DataSelection Selection => selection;

		public bool HasSelectedColumns
		{
			get
			{
				foreach (DataColumn column in Columns)
				{
					if (column.Selected)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable<DataColumn> SelectedColumns
		{
			get
			{
				foreach (DataColumn column in Columns)
				{
					if (column.Selected)
					{
						yield return column;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable<DataColumn> Columns => this.Select((KeyValuePair<string, DataColumn> p) => p.Value);

		public DBTable Table
		{
			get
			{
				if (table == null)
				{
					table = selection.DataProvider.FindTable(tableName);
				}
				return table;
			}
			private set
			{
				table = value;
				tableName = value.Name;
			}
		}

		public string TableName
		{
			get
			{
				if (table == null)
				{
					return tableName;
				}
				return table.Name;
			}
		}

		public DataReferences References
		{
			get
			{
				return references;
			}
			set

				references = value;
				selection.OnTableChanged();
			}
		}

		public string UniqueName => uniqueName;

		public string Alias
		{
			get

				return alias;
			}
			set

			}

		public static Type GetColumnType(DBColumn column)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return DBColumn.GetType(column.ColumnType);
		}

		public DataTable(DataSelection selection, DBTable table, string uniqueName, DataReferences references)
			: this(selection, table, uniqueName, (IEnumerable<DataReference>)references)
		{
			if (references != null)
			{
				this.references.ActionType = references.ActionType;
			}
		}

		public DataTable(DataSelection selection, DBTable table, string uniqueName, IEnumerable<DataReference> references)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)selection, "selection");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)table, "table");
			this.selection = selection;
			Table = table;
			this.uniqueName = uniqueName;
			alias = uniqueName;
			FillColumns(selection, table);
			this.references = new DataReferences(selection, table, uniqueName);
			if (references != null)
			{
				this.references.AddRange(references);
			}
		}

		public DataTable(DataSelection selection, DBTable table, string uniqueName)
			: this(selection, table, uniqueName, null)
		{
		}

		public DataTable(DataSelection selection, XElement element)
		{
			this.selection = selection;
			tableName = element.GetAttributeValue("Name");
			uniqueName = element.GetAttributeValue("UniqueName") ?? tableName;
			alias = element.GetAttributeValue("Alias") ?? uniqueName;
			XElement xElement = element.Element("References");
			if (xElement != null)
			{
				references = new DataReferences(selection, tableName, alias, xElement);
			}
			else
			{
				references = new DataReferences(selection, tableName, alias);
			}
			XElement xElement2 = element.Element("Columns");
			if (xElement2 == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (XElement item in xElement2.Elements("Column"))
			{
				string attributeValue = item.GetAttributeValue("Name");
				Add(attributeValue, new DataColumn(selection, this, item));
			}
		}

		private void FillColumns(DataSelection selection, DBTable table)
		{
			foreach (DBColumn column in table.Columns)
			{
				string text = "";
				foreach (DBForeignKey foreignKey in table.ForeignKeys)
				{
					if (((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)foreignKey).Columns.Contains(column.Name))
					{
						text = foreignKey.PrimaryKeyTable;
						break;
					}
				}
				DBTable foreignKeyTable = null;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					foreignKeyTable = selection.DataProvider.FindTable(text);
				}
				Add(column.Name, new DataColumn(selection, this, column, string.Empty, foreignKeyTable));
			}
		}

		public DataObjectCompareResult CompareWith(DataTable dataTable)
		{
			if (!((object)Table).Equals((object)dataTable.Table))
			{
				return DataObjectCompareResult.NotEqual;
			}
			DataObjectCompareResult result = ((Alias != dataTable.Alias) ? DataObjectCompareResult.EqualExceptForAliases : DataObjectCompareResult.Equal);
			IEnumerator<DataColumn> enumerator = SelectedColumns.GetEnumerator();
			IEnumerator<DataColumn> enumerator2 = dataTable.SelectedColumns.GetEnumerator();
			bool flag;
			do
			{
				flag = enumerator.MoveNext();
				bool flag2 = enumerator2.MoveNext();
				if (flag != flag2)
				{
					return DataObjectCompareResult.NotEqual;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					switch (enumerator.Current.CompareWith(enumerator2.Current))
					{
					case DataObjectCompareResult.NotEqual:
						return DataObjectCompareResult.NotEqual;
					case DataObjectCompareResult.EqualExceptForAliases:
						result = DataObjectCompareResult.EqualExceptForAliases;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			while (flag);
			if (references.ActionType != dataTable.references.ActionType)
			{
				return DataObjectCompareResult.NotEqual;
			}
			IEnumerator<DataReference> enumerator3 = References.GetEnumerator();
			IEnumerator<DataReference> enumerator4 = dataTable.References.GetEnumerator();
			do
			{
				flag = enumerator3.MoveNext();
				bool flag2 = enumerator4.MoveNext();
				if (flag != flag2)
				{
					return DataObjectCompareResult.NotEqual;
				}
				if (flag && !enumerator3.Current.CompareWith(enumerator4.Current))
				{
					return DataObjectCompareResult.NotEqual;
				}
			}
			while (flag);
			return result;
		}

		public void FillChangeList(DataTable dataTable, IList<AliasChangeInfo> changeList)
		{
			if (!((object)Table).Equals((object)dataTable.Table))
			{
				return;
			}
			IEnumerator<DataColumn> enumerator = SelectedColumns.GetEnumerator();
			IEnumerator<DataColumn> enumerator2 = dataTable.SelectedColumns.GetEnumerator();
			bool flag;
			do
			{
				flag = enumerator.MoveNext();
				bool flag2 = enumerator2.MoveNext();
				if (flag && flag2 && flag == flag2)
				{
					DataObjectCompareResult dataObjectCompareResult = enumerator.Current.CompareWith(enumerator2.Current);
					if (dataObjectCompareResult == DataObjectCompareResult.EqualExceptForAliases)
					{
						changeList.Add(new AliasChangeInfo(enumerator.Current.ActualName, enumerator2.Current.ActualName));
					}
				}
			}
			while (flag);
		}

		public void PrepareSelectStatement(SelectStatement selectStatement)
		{
			references.PrepareSelect(selectStatement);
		}

		public void OnChanged()
		{
			selection.OnTableChanged();
		}

		public XElement SaveToXml()
		{
			XElement xElement = new XElement("Table");
			xElement.Add(new XAttribute("Name", tableName));
			if (uniqueName != tableName)
			{
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("UniqueName", uniqueName));
			}
			if (alias != uniqueName)
			{
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("Alias", alias));
			}
			if (references.Count > 0)
			{
				xElement.Add(references.SaveToXml());
			}
			List<DataColumn> list = new List<DataColumn>(SelectedColumns);
			if (list.Count > 0)
			{
				XElement xElement2 = new XElement("Columns");
				foreach (DataColumn item in list)
				{
					xElement2.Add(item.SaveToXml());
				}
				xElement.Add(xElement2);
			}
			return xElement;
		}

		public SchemaLoadingExceptionsInfo LoadDataObjects()
		{
			SchemaLoadingExceptionsInfo schemaLoadingExceptionsInfo = new SchemaLoadingExceptionsInfo();
			table = selection.DataProvider.FindTable(tableName);
			foreach (DataColumn column in Columns)
			{
				SchemaLoadingExceptionInfo schemaLoadingExceptionInfo = column.LoadDataObjects();
				if (schemaLoadingExceptionInfo != null)
				{
					schemaLoadingExceptionsInfo.Add(schemaLoadingExceptionInfo);
				}
			}
			references.LoadDataObjects();
			return schemaLoadingExceptionsInfo;
		}

		public void SetAllColumnsSelection(bool selected)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			foreach (DataColumn column in Columns)
			{
				if (column.Selected != selected)
				{
					column.SetSelected(selected, raiseChanged: false);
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				OnChanged();
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return alias;
		}

		public void SetAlias(string newAlias, bool raiseChanged)
		{
			if (alias != newAlias)
			{
				if (selection.IsTableAliasExists(newAlias))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException();
				}
				FilterInfo filterInfo = selection.Filters[alias];
				if (filterInfo != null)
				{
					filterInfo.TableName = newAlias;
					filterInfo.FilterString = CriteriaOperator.ToString(AliasesCriteriaPatcher.Process(CriteriaOperator.Parse(filterInfo.FilterString, new object[0]), Alias, newAlias));
				}
				alias = newAlias;
				references.Alias = alias;
				if (raiseChanged)
				{
					selection.OnTableAliasChanged(this);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public class FilterInfo
	{
		private string tableName;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public FilterInfoCollection Owner { get; set; }

		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[Editor("DevExpress.DataAccess.UI.Native.Data.FilterInfoTableNameEditor,DevExpress.DataAccess.v23.2.UI, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
		public string TableName
		{
			get
			{
				return tableName;
			}
			set
			{
				if (string.CompareOrdinal(tableName, value) != 0)
				{
					if (!ValidateName(value))
					{
						throw new ArgumentException();
					}
					tableName = value;
				}
			}
		}

		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[Editor("DevExpress.DataAccess.UI.Native.Sql.FilterStringEditor,DevExpress.DataAccess.v23.2.UI, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
		public string FilterString { get; set; }

		private bool ValidateName(string name)
		{
			if (Owner != null)
			{
				foreach (FilterInfo item in Owner)
				{
					if (string.CompareOrdinal(name, item.TableName) == 0)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public FilterInfo()
		{
		}

		public FilterInfo(string tableName, string filterString)
		{
			TableName = tableName;
			FilterString = filterString;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is FilterInfo filterInfo && TableName == filterInfo.TableName)
			{
				return FilterString == filterInfo.FilterString;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		public XElement SaveToXml()
		{
			XElement xElement = new XElement("Filter");
			xElement.Add(new XAttribute("TableName", TableName ?? string.Empty));
			xElement.Add(new XAttribute("FilterString", FilterString ?? string.Empty));
			return xElement;
		}

		public FilterInfo Clone()
		{
			return new FilterInfo(TableName, FilterString);
		}
	}

	public class FilterInfoCollection : ObservableCollection<FilterInfo>
	{
		public FilterInfo this[string tableName]
		{
			get
			{
				using (IEnumerator<FilterInfo> enumerator = GetEnumerator())
				{
					while (enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						FilterInfo current = enumerator.Current;
						if (current.TableName == tableName)
						{
							return current;
						}
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public IParametersOwner ParametersOwner { get; set; }

		public FilterInfoCollection(IParametersOwner parametersOwner)
		{
			ParametersOwner = parametersOwner;
		}

		public void AddRange(FilterInfo[] filterInfos)
		{
			foreach (FilterInfo item in filterInfos)
			{
				Add(item);
			}
		}

		public void Add(string tableName, string filterString)
		{
			FilterInfo filterInfo = new FilterInfo();
			filterInfo.TableName = tableName;
			filterInfo.FilterString = filterString;
			filterInfo.Owner = this;
			Add(filterInfo);
		}

		public bool Contains(string tableName)
		{
			using (IEnumerator<FilterInfo> enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					FilterInfo current = enumerator.Current;
					if (current.TableName == tableName)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void InsertItem(int index, FilterInfo item)
		{
			item.Owner = this;
			base.InsertItem(index, item);
		}

		protected override void RemoveItem(int index)
		{
			base[index].Owner = null;
			base.RemoveItem(index);
		}
	}
	public static class FilterHelper
	{
		public static CriteriaOperator GetFilter(string filterString, IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters)
		{
			return GetFilter(filterString, parameters, mergeTableName: true);
		}

		public static CriteriaOperator GetFilter(string filterString, IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters, bool mergeTableName)
		{
			IList<IParameter> parameters2 = (parameters as IList<IParameter>) ?? parameters.ToList();
			CriteriaOperator criteriaOperator = GetCriteriaOperator(filterString, parameters2);
			return GetFilter(criteriaOperator, parameters2, mergeTableName);
		}

		public static CriteriaOperator GetFilter(CriteriaOperator criteriaOperator, IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters)
		{
			return GetFilter(criteriaOperator, parameters, mergeTableName: true);
		}

		public static CriteriaOperator GetFilter(CriteriaOperator criteriaOperator, IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters, bool mergeTableName)
		{
			OperandPropertyReplacingCriteriaOperatorPatcher operandPropertyReplacingCriteriaOperatorPatcher = new OperandPropertyReplacingCriteriaOperatorPatcher(parameters, mergeTableName);
			return operandPropertyReplacingCriteriaOperatorPatcher.Process(criteriaOperator);
		}

		public static CriteriaOperator GetCriteriaOperator(string filterString, IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters)
		{
			OperandValue[] array = default(OperandValue[]);
			CriteriaOperator result = CriteriaOperator.Parse(filterString, ref array);
			if (array != null)
			{
				IList<IParameter> list = (parameters as IList<IParameter>) ?? parameters?.ToList() ?? new List<IParameter>(0);
				OperandValue[] array2 = array;
				foreach (OperandValue val in array2)
				{
					string text = string.Empty;
					OperandParameter val2 = (OperandParameter)(object)((val is OperandParameter) ? val : null);
					if (val2 != null)
					{
						text = val2.ParameterName;
					}
					foreach (IParameter item in list)
					{
						if (text == ((IFilterParameter)item).Name)
						{
							val.Value = item.Value;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

	public class ExcelDataSourceSerializer
	{
		public const string XML_ExcelDataSource = "ExcelDataSource";

		public const string XML_Name = "Name";

		public const string XML_FileName = "FileName";

		public const string XML_Options = "Options";

		public const string XML_Schema = "Schema";

		public const string XML_SourceOptionsType = "Type";

		public const string XML_ResultSchema = "ResultSchema";

		private static readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string, Type> predefinedTypes = new ConcurrentDictionary<string, Type>(new KeyValuePair<string, Type>[2]
		{
			new KeyValuePair<string, Type>(typeof(ExcelSourceOptions).FullName, typeof(ExcelSourceOptions)),
			new KeyValuePair<string, Type>(typeof(CsvSourceOptions).FullName, typeof(CsvSourceOptions))
		});

		public static XElement SaveToXml(ExcelDataSource dataSource)
		{
			XElement xElement = new XElement("ExcelDataSource");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataSource.Name))
			{
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("Name", dataSource.Name));
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataSource.FileName))
			{
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("FileName", dataSource.FileName));
			}
			if (dataSource.SourceOptions != null)
			{
				XElement xElement2 = new XElement("Options");
				xElement2.Add(new XAttribute("Type", dataSource.SourceOptions.GetType().FullName));
				dataSource.SourceOptions.SaveToXml(xElement2);
				xElement.Add(xElement2);
			}
			XElement xElement3 = new XElement("Schema");
			dataSource.Schema.SaveToXml(xElement3);
			xElement.Add(xElement3);
			XElement xElement4 = new XElement("ResultSchema");
			XElement resultSchemaXml = dataSource.GetResultSchemaXml();
			xElement4.Add(resultSchemaXml);
			xElement.Add(xElement4);
			return xElement;
		}

		public static void LoadFromXml(ExcelDataSource dataSource, XElement xElement)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)xElement, "xElement");
			if (!string.Equals(xElement.Name.LocalName, "ExcelDataSource", StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Incorrect XML root element: <" + xElement.Name.LocalName + ">, <ExcelDataSource> is expected.");
			}
			dataSource.Name = xElement.GetAttributeValue("Name");
			dataSource.FileName = xElement.GetAttributeValue("FileName");
			XElement xElement2 = xElement.Element("Options");
			if (xElement2 != null)
			{
				string attributeValue = xElement2.GetAttributeValue("Type");
				Type primitiveOrTrustedType = SafeTypeResolver.GetPrimitiveOrTrustedType(attributeValue, (IDictionary<string, Type>)predefinedTypes, (bool?)true);
				ExcelSourceOptionsBase excelSourceOptionsBase = (ExcelSourceOptionsBase)Activator.CreateInstance(primitiveOrTrustedType);
				excelSourceOptionsBase.LoadFromXml(xElement2);
				dataSource.SourceOptions = excelSourceOptionsBase;
			}
			XElement xElement3 = xElement.Element("Schema");
			if (xElement3 != null)
			{
				dataSource.Schema.LoadFromXml(xElement3);
			}
			XElement xElement4 = xElement.Element("ResultSchema");
			if (xElement4 != null)
			{
				dataSource.SetResultSchemaXml(xElement4);
			}
		}
	}
	public static class ExcelExceptionHelper
	{
		public static ExcelEncryptedFileException Wrap(this EncryptedFileException spreadsheetException)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0019: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			EncryptedFileError error = spreadsheetException.Error;
			return (int)error switch
			{
				0 => new ExcelEncryptedFileException(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.ExcelEncryptedFileException_PasswordRequired), spreadsheetException), 
				1 => new ExcelEncryptedFileException(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.ExcelEncryptedFileException_WrongPassword), spreadsheetException), 
				2 => new ExcelEncryptedFileException(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.ExcelEncryptedFileException_EncryptionTypeNotSupported), spreadsheetException), 
				_ => new ExcelEncryptedFileException(((Exception)(object)spreadsheetException).Message, spreadsheetException), 
			};
		}

		public static ExcelInvalidFileException Wrap(this InvalidFileException spreadsheetException)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0019: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			InvalidFileError error = spreadsheetException.Error;
			return (int)error switch
			{
				0 => new ExcelInvalidFileException(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.ExcelInvalidFileException_WrongFormat), spreadsheetException), 
				1 => new ExcelInvalidFileException(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.ExcelInvalidFileException_BIFF5Format), spreadsheetException), 
				2 => new ExcelInvalidFileException(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.ExcelInvalidFileException_CorruptedFile), spreadsheetException), 
				_ => new ExcelInvalidFileException(((Exception)(object)spreadsheetException).Message, spreadsheetException), 
			};
		}
	}

	public static class ExcelDataLoaderHelper

		public static readonly DateTime BaseDateTime = new DateTime(1900, 1, 1);

		private static readonly Dictionary<Type, Action<int, ISpreadsheetDataReader, IList, CultureInfo>> readers = new Dictionary<Type, Action<int, ISpreadsheetDataReader, IList, CultureInfo>>
		{
			{

					ReadStruct(reader, (ChunkedList<TimeSpan?>)list, i, cultureInfo, delegate(ISpreadsheetDataReader r, int index, CultureInfo culture)
					{
						DateTime dateTime = r.GetDateTime(index);
						return (dateTime.Year < 1900) ? dateTime.TimeOfDay : (BaseDateTime - dateTime);
					});
				}
			}
		};

		public static ColumnarData LoadData(ISpreadsheetSource source, DevExpress.DataAccess.Excel.FieldInfo[] schema, ExcelSourceOptionsBase sourceOptions, bool topThousand, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
			List<IList> list = ColumnarDataLoaderHelper.CreateChunkedLists(schema.Select((DevExpress.DataAccess.Excel.FieldInfo s) => new ColumnDescription
			{
				Name = s.Name,
				Type = s.Type
			}).ToArray());
			ISpreadsheetDataReader val = source.CreateReader(sourceOptions);
			CultureInfo arg = GetCulture(sourceOptions) ?? CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture;
			if (sourceOptions.UseFirstRowAsHeader)
			{
				val.Read();
			}
			int num = 1000;
			while (val.Read() && (!topThousand || num-- > 0))
			{
				cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
				for (int num2 = 0; num2 < schema.Length; num2++)
				{
					if (schema[num2].Selected)
					{
						if (num2 < val.FieldsCount)
						{
							readers[schema[num2].Type](num2, val, list[num2], arg);
						}
						else
						{
							list[num2].Add(null);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			List<IList> list2 = new List<IList>(schema.Count((DevExpress.DataAccess.Excel.FieldInfo f) => f.Selected));
			for (int num3 = 0; num3 < schema.Length; num3++)
			{
				if (schema[num3].Selected)
				{
					list2.Add(list[num3]);
				}
			}
			cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
			return new ColumnarData(list2.ToArray(), (from s in schema
				where s.Selected
				select new ColumnDescription
				{
					Name = s.Name,
					Type = s.Type
				}).ToArray());
		}

		public static void PrepareSource(ISpreadsheetSource source, DevExpress.DataAccess.Excel.FieldInfo[] schema)
		{

		public static Type GetType(XlVariantValueType value)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0002: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0011: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0020: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)value == 4)
			{
				return typeof(DateTime);
			}
			if ((int)value == 1)
			{
				return typeof(bool);
			}
			if ((int)value == 3)
			{
				return typeof(double);
			}
			if ((int)value == 2)
			{
				return typeof(string);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static XlVariantValueType GetType(Type type)
		{
			switch (DXTypeExtensions.GetTypeCode(type))
			{
			case TypeCode.String:
				return (XlVariantValueType)2;
			case TypeCode.Boolean:
				return (XlVariantValueType)1;
			case TypeCode.DateTime:
				return (XlVariantValueType)4;
			case TypeCode.SByte:
			case TypeCode.Byte:
			case TypeCode.Int16:
			case TypeCode.UInt16:
			case TypeCode.UInt32:
			case TypeCode.Int64:
			case TypeCode.UInt64:
			case TypeCode.Single:
			case TypeCode.Double:
			case TypeCode.Decimal:
				return (XlVariantValueType)3;
			default:
				return (XlVariantValueType)0;
			}
		}

			if (!exist(testedName))

				generateFromHere += 1;
			}
			return generateFromHere;
		}

		}

	public class JsonSourceConfigurationHelper
	{
		private const string headerPrefix = "header";

		private const string queryPrefix = "query";

		private const string pathPrefix = "path";

		private const string jsonKey = "Json";

		private const string uriKey = "Uri";

		private const string userNameKey = "Username";

		private const string passwordKey = "Password";

		private static readonly string headersPattern = "^header\\:(?<value>.+)$";

		private static readonly string queriesPattern = "^query\\:(?<value>.+)$";

		private static readonly string pathPattern = "^path\\:(?<value>.+)$";

		private static readonly Regex headerRegex = new Regex(headersPattern, RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Compiled);

		private static readonly Regex queryRegex = new Regex(queriesPattern, RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Compiled);

		private static readonly Regex pathRegex = new Regex(pathPattern, RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Compiled);

		public const string JsonProviderName = "JsonSourceProvider";

		public static bool TryParseJsonConnectionString(string connectionString, out JsonSourceBase jsonSource)
		{
			jsonSource = null;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(connectionString))
			{
				return false;
			}
			try
			{
				JsonSourceBase jsonSourceBase = ParseJsonConnectionString(connectionString);
				if (jsonSourceBase != null && ((jsonSourceBase is CustomJsonSource && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace((jsonSourceBase as CustomJsonSource).Json)) || (jsonSourceBase is UriJsonSource && (jsonSourceBase as UriJsonSource).Uri != null)))
				{
					jsonSource = jsonSourceBase;
					return true;
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static JsonSourceBase ParseJsonConnectionString(string connectionString)
		{
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			Guard.ArgumentIsNotNullOrEmpty(connectionString, "connectionString");
			ConnectionStringParser val;
			try
			{
				DbConnectionStringBuilder dbConnectionStringBuilder = new DbConnectionStringBuilder
				{
					ConnectionString = connectionString
				};
				val = new ConnectionStringParser(connectionString);
			}
			catch (ArgumentException innerException)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("ConnectionString has invalid format", "connectionString", innerException);
			}
			UriJsonSource uriJsonSource = new UriJsonSource();
			HttpBasicAuthenticationInfo httpBasicAuthenticationInfo = new HttpBasicAuthenticationInfo();
			foreach (string key in val.Keys)
			{
				string partByName = val.GetPartByName(key);
				if (headerRegex.IsMatch(key))
				{
					HeaderParameter headerParameter = new HeaderParameter(headerRegex.Match(key).Groups["value"].Value, string.Empty);
					UriJsonSource.SetParameterValue(headerParameter, partByName);
					uriJsonSource.HeaderParameters.Add(headerParameter);
					continue;
				}
				if (queryRegex.IsMatch(key))
				{
					DevExpress.DataAccess.Json.QueryParameter queryParameter = new DevExpress.DataAccess.Json.QueryParameter(queryRegex.Match(key).Groups["value"].Value, string.Empty);
					UriJsonSource.SetParameterValue(queryParameter, partByName);
					uriJsonSource.QueryParameters.Add(queryParameter);
					continue;
				}
				if (pathRegex.IsMatch(key))
				{
					PathParameter pathParameter = new PathParameter(pathRegex.Match(key).Groups["value"].Value, string.Empty);
					UriJsonSource.SetParameterValue(pathParameter, partByName);
					uriJsonSource.PathParameters.Add(pathParameter);
					continue;
				}
				if (key.Equals("Json", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
				{
					return new CustomJsonSource
					{
						Json = partByName
					};
				}
				if (key.Equals("Uri", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
				{
					uriJsonSource.Uri = new Uri(partByName, UriKind.RelativeOrAbsolute);
				}
				else if (key.Equals("Username", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
				{
					uriJsonSource.AuthenticationInfo.Username = partByName;
				}
				else if (key.Equals("Password", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
				{
					uriJsonSource.AuthenticationInfo.Password = partByName;
				}
			}
			return uriJsonSource;
		}

		public static string CreateJsonConnectionString(JsonSourceBase jsonSource)
		{
			DbConnectionStringBuilder dbConnectionStringBuilder = new DbConnectionStringBuilder();
			if (jsonSource is CustomJsonSource)
			{
				string json = ((CustomJsonSource)jsonSource).Json;
				dbConnectionStringBuilder.Add("Json", json);
			}
			else if (jsonSource is UriJsonSource)
			{
				UriJsonSource uriJsonSource = (UriJsonSource)jsonSource;
				if (uriJsonSource.Uri != null)
				{
					dbConnectionStringBuilder.Add("Uri", uriJsonSource.Uri.OriginalString);
				}
				if (!uriJsonSource.AuthenticationInfo.IsEmpty)
				{
					dbConnectionStringBuilder.Add("Username", uriJsonSource.AuthenticationInfo.Username);
					dbConnectionStringBuilder.Add("Password", uriJsonSource.AuthenticationInfo.Password);
				}
				foreach (HeaderParameter headerParameter in uriJsonSource.HeaderParameters)
				{
					dbConnectionStringBuilder.Add("header:" + headerParameter.Name, UriJsonSource.GetParameterValue(headerParameter));
				}
				foreach (DevExpress.DataAccess.Json.QueryParameter queryParameter in uriJsonSource.QueryParameters)
				{
					dbConnectionStringBuilder.Add("query:" + queryParameter.Name, UriJsonSource.GetParameterValue(queryParameter));
				}
				foreach (PathParameter pathParameter in uriJsonSource.PathParameters)
				{
					dbConnectionStringBuilder.Add("path:" + pathParameter.Name, UriJsonSource.GetParameterValue(pathParameter));
				}
			}
			return dbConnectionStringBuilder.ConnectionString;
		}

		public static bool TryCreateJsonDataConnection(IConnectionStringInfo connectionsInfo, out JsonDataConnection jsonConnection)
		{
			jsonConnection = null;
			if ((string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(connectionsInfo.ProviderName) || connectionsInfo.ProviderName == "JsonSourceProvider") && TryParseJsonConnectionString(connectionsInfo.RunTimeConnectionString, out var jsonSource))
			{
				JsonDataConnection jsonDataConnection = new JsonDataConnection(jsonSource)
				{
					Name = connectionsInfo.Name,
					StoreConnectionNameOnly = true
				};
				jsonConnection = jsonDataConnection;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static List<JsonDataConnection> GetConnections(IConnectionStringInfo[] connectionsInfo)
		{
			List<JsonDataConnection> list = new List<JsonDataConnection>();
			foreach (IConnectionStringInfo connectionsInfo2 in connectionsInfo)
			{
				JsonDataConnection jsonConnection = null;
				if (TryCreateJsonDataConnection(connectionsInfo2, out jsonConnection))
				{
					list.Add(jsonConnection);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}
