		public static string LoadJson(Uri uri, UrlResolver urlResolver = null, HttpBasicAuthenticationInfo authorizationInfo = null, IList<IParameter> headers = null)
		{
			if (uri == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			urlResolver = urlResolver ?? UrlResolver.Instance;
			Uri uri2 = UriCreator.ValidateUriSecurity(UrlResolverExtensions.MapPath(urlResolver, uri.OriginalString, ""), AccessSettings.DataResources);
			if (uri2 != null && uri2.IsAbsoluteUri && uri2.IsFile)
			{
				return File.ReadAllText(uri2.LocalPath);
			}
			Task<string> task = LoadResultAsync(authorizationInfo, headers, uri2, CancellationToken.None);
			return TaskExtensions.Await<string>(task);
		}

		public static async Task<string> LoadJsonAsync(Uri uri, CancellationToken cancellationToken, UrlResolver urlResolver = null, HttpBasicAuthenticationInfo authorizationInfo = null, IList<IParameter> headers = null)
		{
			if (uri == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			urlResolver = urlResolver ?? UrlResolver.Instance;
			Uri uri2 = UriCreator.ValidateUriSecurity(UrlResolverExtensions.MapPath(urlResolver, uri.OriginalString, ""), AccessSettings.DataResources);
			if (uri2 != null && uri2.IsAbsoluteUri && uri2.IsFile)
			{
				using (Stream fileStream = File.OpenRead(uri2.LocalPath))
				{
					return await new StreamReader(fileStream, Encoding.UTF8).ReadToEndAsync().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
			}
			return await LoadResultAsync(authorizationInfo, headers, uri2, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
		}

		private static async Task<string> LoadAsync(HttpBasicAuthenticationInfo authorizationInfo, IList<IParameter> headers, Uri secureUri, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			LifeTime<JsonWebResult> val = AsyncDownloader<JsonWebResult>.CreateLocalLifeTime((Action<HttpClientHandler>)delegate(HttpClientHandler client)
			{
				ConfigureHttpClient(client, authorizationInfo);
			});
			SendMethodOptions<JsonWebResult> val2 = new SendMethodOptions<JsonWebResult>(HttpMethod.Get, (Action<HttpRequestMessage>)delegate(HttpRequestMessage m)
			{
				IList<IParameter> list = headers;
				if (list != null && list.Count > 0)
				{
					foreach (IParameter header in headers)
					{
						ApplyHeader(m, header);
					}
				}
				ConfigureHttpRequestMessage?.Invoke(m, authorizationInfo);
			}, (Predicate<HttpResponseMessage>)null, val, (AccessSettings)null);
			Task<JsonWebResult> task = AsyncDownloader<JsonWebResult>.LoadAsync(secureUri?.ToString(), (Func<ExceptionDispatchInfo, Stream, JsonWebResult>)((ExceptionDispatchInfo info, Stream stream) => new JsonWebResult(info?.SourceException, stream)), cancellationToken, val2);
			return (await task.ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false)).Result;
		}

		private static void ConfigureHttpClientAuthentication(HttpClientHandler client, HttpBasicAuthenticationInfo authorizationInfo)
		{
			bool flag = authorizationInfo != null && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(authorizationInfo.Username);
			client.UseDefaultCredentials = !flag;
			if (flag)
			{
				client.Credentials = new NetworkCredential(authorizationInfo.Username, authorizationInfo.Password ?? "");
			}
		}

		private static void ApplyHeader(HttpRequestMessage message, IParameter header)
		{
			string value = header.Value?.ToString() ?? string.Empty;
			message.Headers.Add(((IFilterParameter)header).Name, value);
		}

		public Type CreateJsonType()
		{
			JsonSchemaNode jsonSchemaNode = schema;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(rootElement))
			{
				jsonSchemaNode = schema.GetFlatModel().First((JsonSchemaNode node) => node.GetFullName() == schema.Name + "." + rootElement);
			}
			Type type = jsonSchemaNode.Type?.GetElementType();
			if (jsonSchemaNode.NodeType == JsonNodeType.Array && type != null && DataContext.IsStandardType(jsonSchemaNode.Type.GetElementType()))
			{
				return jsonSchemaNode.Type;
			}
			Type type2 = CreateJsonTypeCore(jsonSchemaNode);
			if (jsonSchemaNode.NodeType == JsonNodeType.Array)
			{
				return type2.MakeArrayType();
			}
			return type2;
		}

		internal static string GetPostfix()
		{
			return Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
		}

		private static string GetAssemblyName()
		{
			return GetPostfix();
		}

		internal Type CreateJsonTypeCore(JsonSchemaNode schema)
		{
			List<Property> list = new List<Property>();
			foreach (JsonSchemaNode child in schema.Children)
			{
				string name = child.Name;
				if (!child.Selected.HasValue || child.Selected.Value)
				{
					switch (child.NodeType)
					{
					case JsonNodeType.Object:
						list.Add(new Property(name, child.DisplayName, CreateJsonTypeCore(child)));
						break;
					case JsonNodeType.Array:
						list.Add(new Property(name, child.DisplayName, child.Children.Any() ? typeof(List<>).MakeGenericType(CreateJsonTypeCore(child)) : child.Type));
						break;
					case JsonNodeType.Property:
						list.Add(new Property(name, child.DisplayName, child.Type));
						break;
					default:
						throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
					}
				}
			}
			return DynamicTypesHelper.CreateType(ModuleBuilder, list, schema.Name);
		}

		public Type GetJsonType(string json, string rootElement, int schemaDiscoveryDepthLimit)
		{
			if (schema == null)
			{
				return DetectJsonType(json, rootElement, schemaDiscoveryDepthLimit);
			}
			return CreateJsonType();
		}

		}

			{
				throw new Exception("An attempt to load the \"Newtonsoft.Json.dll\" assembly failed.\r\nThe \"Newtonsoft.Json.dll\" package should to be installed in your application project to provide JSON data at runtime.");

		}

	internal class JsonSchemaHelper
	{
		private const string typeHandlingTypeProperty = "$type";

		private const string typeHandlingValuesProperty = "$values";

		public bool DiscoveryLimitApplied { get; private set; }

		private ModuleBuilder ModuleBuilder { get; }

		internal IEnumerable<Property> DetectObjectProperties(ModuleBuilder moduleBuilder, JObject jObject, int schemaDiscoveryDepthLimit)
		{
			List<Property> list = new List<Property>();
			foreach (IJProperty item in jObject.Properties())
			{
				if (item.Name == "$type")
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (item.Value is JValue jValue)
				{
					list.Add(new Property(item.Name, (jValue.Value != null) ? jValue.Value.GetType() : typeof(object)));
				}
				if (item.Value is JObject jObject2)
				{
					if (ProcessTypeHandling(moduleBuilder, item.Name, schemaDiscoveryDepthLimit, jObject2, out var firstItemType))
					{
						list.Add(new Property(item.Name, firstItemType.MakeArrayType()));
					}
					else
					{
						list.Add(CreateObjectProperty(moduleBuilder, jObject2, item.Name, schemaDiscoveryDepthLimit));
					}
				}
				if (item.Value is JArray jArray)
				{
					Type type = CreateArrayItemType(moduleBuilder, jArray, item.Name, schemaDiscoveryDepthLimit);
					list.Add(new Property(item.Name, type.MakeArrayType()));
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static string MoveToRootElement(object element, string rootElement)
		{
			if (element is JObject jObject)
			{
				object obj = jObject.SelectToken(rootElement);
				if (obj != null)
				{
					return obj.ToString();
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static Property GetActualProperty(ModuleBuilder moduleBuilder, Property firstProp, Property secondProp)
		{
			if (firstProp.Type == secondProp.Type)
			{
				return firstProp;
			}
			bool isArray = firstProp.Type.IsArray;
			bool isArray2 = secondProp.Type.IsArray;
			if (isArray != isArray2)
			{
				return firstProp;
			}
			Type type = (isArray ? firstProp.Type.GetElementType() : firstProp.Type);
			Type type2 = (isArray2 ? secondProp.Type.GetElementType() : secondProp.Type);
			if (type != typeof(object) && type2 == typeof(object))
			{
				return firstProp;
			}
			if (type == typeof(object) && type2 != typeof(object))
			{
				return secondProp;
			}
			string name = firstProp.Name;
			bool flag = DataContext.IsStandardType(type);
			bool flag2 = DataContext.IsStandardType(type2);
			if (flag && flag2)
			{
				Type type3 = ((TypeHelper.IsNumericType(type) && TypeHelper.IsNumericType(type2)) ? typeof(double) : typeof(string));
				return new Property(name, isArray ? type3.MakeArrayType() : type3);
			}
			if (flag != flag2)
			{
				return firstProp;
			}
			return CreateMergedProperty(moduleBuilder, type, type2, isArray, name);
		}

		private static void MergeProperties(ModuleBuilder moduleBuilder, List<Property> existentProperties, Property newProperty)
		{
			if (newProperty.Name == "$type")
			{
				return;
			}
			Property property = existentProperties.Find((Property element) => element.Name == newProperty.Name);
			if (property != null)
			{
				Property actualProperty = GetActualProperty(moduleBuilder, property, newProperty);
				if (!object.Equals(property, actualProperty))
				{
					existentProperties.Remove(property);
					existentProperties.Add(actualProperty);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				existentProperties.Add(newProperty);
			}
		}

		private static Property CreateMergedProperty(ModuleBuilder moduleBuilder, Type firstType, Type secondType, bool isArrayType, string propertyName)
		{
			List<Property> list = new List<Property>();
			PropertyInfo[] properties = firstType.GetProperties();
			PropertyInfo[] properties2 = secondType.GetProperties();
			PropertyInfo[] array = properties;
			foreach (PropertyInfo propertyInfo in array)
			{
				list.Add(new Property(propertyInfo.Name, propertyInfo.PropertyType));
			}
			PropertyInfo[] array2 = properties2;
			foreach (PropertyInfo propertyInfo2 in array2)
			{
				Property newProperty = new Property(propertyInfo2.Name, propertyInfo2.PropertyType);
				MergeProperties(moduleBuilder, list, newProperty);
			}
			Type type = DynamicTypesHelper.CreateType(moduleBuilder, list, propertyName);
			return new Property(propertyName, isArrayType ? type.MakeArrayType() : type);
		}

		private Property CreateObjectProperty(ModuleBuilder moduleBuilder, JObject nestedJObject, string jPropertyName, int schemaDiscoveryDepthLimit)
		{
			IEnumerable<Property> properties = DetectObjectProperties(moduleBuilder, nestedJObject, schemaDiscoveryDepthLimit);
			Type type = DynamicTypesHelper.CreateType(moduleBuilder, properties, jPropertyName);
			return new Property(jPropertyName, type);
		}

		public JsonSchemaHelper(ModuleBuilder moduleBuilder)
		{
			ModuleBuilder = moduleBuilder;
		}

		public Type DetectJsonSchema(string json, string rootElement, int schemaDiscoveryDepthLimit)
		{
			object deserializeObject = JsonLoaderHelper.DeserializeObject(json);
			deserializeObject = JTokenBase.Wrap(deserializeObject);
			return DetectJsonSchema(deserializeObject, rootElement, schemaDiscoveryDepthLimit);
		}

		public Type DetectJsonSchema(object deserializeObject, string rootElement, int schemaDiscoveryDepthLimit)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(rootElement))
			{
				string text = MoveToRootElement(deserializeObject, rootElement);
				if (text != null)
				{
					return DetectJsonSchema(text, rootElement, schemaDiscoveryDepthLimit);
				}
			}
			if (deserializeObject is JArray jArray)
			{
				Type type = CreateArrayItemType(ModuleBuilder, jArray, string.IsNullOrEmpty(rootElement) ? JsonLoaderHelper.GetPostfix() : rootElement, schemaDiscoveryDepthLimit);
				return type.MakeArrayType();
			}
			if (deserializeObject is JObject jObject)
			{
				if (ProcessTypeHandling(ModuleBuilder, string.IsNullOrEmpty(rootElement) ? JsonLoaderHelper.GetPostfix() : rootElement, schemaDiscoveryDepthLimit, jObject, out var firstItemType))
				{
					return firstItemType;
				}
				List<Property> list = new List<Property>();
				list.AddRange(DetectObjectProperties(ModuleBuilder, jObject, schemaDiscoveryDepthLimit));
				return DynamicTypesHelper.CreateType(ModuleBuilder, list, string.IsNullOrEmpty(rootElement) ? "root" : rootElement);
			}
			return typeof(object);
		}

		private bool ProcessTypeHandling(ModuleBuilder moduleBuilder, string propertyName, int schemaDiscoveryDepthLimit, JObject jObject, out Type firstItemType)
		{
			firstItemType = null;
			IJProperty[] array = jObject.Properties().ToArray();
			if (array.Length == 2 && array[0].Name == "$type" && array[1].Name == "$values" && array[1].Value is JArray jArray)
			{
				firstItemType = CreateArrayItemType(moduleBuilder, jArray, propertyName, schemaDiscoveryDepthLimit);
			}
			return firstItemType != null;
		}

		private Type CreateArrayItemType(ModuleBuilder moduleBuilder, JArray jArray, string itemTypeName, int schemaDiscoveryDepthLimit)
		{
			if (!jArray.HasValues)
			{
				return typeof(object);
			}
			int count;
			if (schemaDiscoveryDepthLimit > 0)
			{
				DiscoveryLimitApplied |= schemaDiscoveryDepthLimit < jArray.Children().Count();
				count = schemaDiscoveryDepthLimit;
			}
			else
			{
				count = jArray.Children().Count();
			}
			IJToken[] array = jArray.Children().Take(count).ToArray();
			if ((array[0] as JValue)?.Value != null)
			{
				if (array.Any((IJToken n) => n is JObject))
				{
					return typeof(object);
				}
				Type[] array2 = (from v in array.OfType<JValue>()
					select v?.Value?.GetType() into t
					where t != null
					select t).Distinct().ToArray();
				switch (array2.Length)
				{
				case 0:
					return typeof(object);
				case 1:
					return array2[0];
				default:
					if (!array2.All(TypeHelper.IsNumericType))
					{
						return typeof(string);
					}
					return typeof(double);
				}
			}
			List<Property> list = new List<Property>();
			foreach (JObject item in array.OfType<JObject>())
			{
				List<Property> list2 = new List<Property>(DetectObjectProperties(moduleBuilder, item, schemaDiscoveryDepthLimit));
				foreach (Property item2 in list2)
				{
					MergeProperties(moduleBuilder, list, item2);
				}
			}
			if (list.Count != 0)
			{
				return DynamicTypesHelper.CreateType(moduleBuilder, list, itemTypeName + "Item");
			}
			return typeof(object);
		}
	}
	public abstract class JTokenBase : IJToken
	{
		private readonly object innerObject;

		public string Path => GetPropertyValue<string>("Path");

		public static IJToken Wrap(object deserializeObject)
		{
			if (deserializeObject == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (deserializeObject is IJToken result)
			{
				return result;
			}
			Type type = deserializeObject.GetType();
			if (type.Name.Contains("JArray"))
			{
				return new JArray(deserializeObject);
			}
			if (type.Name.Contains("JProperty"))
			{
				return new JProperty(deserializeObject);
			}
			if (type.Name.Contains("JValue"))
			{
				return new JValue(deserializeObject);
			}
			if (type.Name.Contains("JObject"))
			{
				return new JObject(deserializeObject);
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected static IEnumerable<IJToken> WrapCollection(IEnumerable<object> objects)
		{
			return objects.Select(Wrap);
		}

		protected static IEnumerable<JProperty> ConvertToJProperties(IEnumerable<object> properties)
		{
			foreach (object property in properties)
			{
				yield return new JProperty(property);
			}
		}

		protected JTokenBase(object innerObject)
		{
			this.innerObject = innerObject;
		}

		protected IJToken GetPropertyValue(string name)
		{
			object propertyValue = GetPropertyValue<object>(name);
			return Wrap(propertyValue);
		}

		protected IEnumerable<IJToken> GetMethodValues(string name)
		{
			IEnumerable<object> objects = InvokeMethod<IEnumerable<object>>(name);
			return WrapCollection(objects);
		}

		protected IEnumerable<JProperty> GetMethodValuesAsJProperties(string name)
		{
			IEnumerable<object> properties = InvokeMethod<IEnumerable<object>>(name);
			return ConvertToJProperties(properties);
		}

		protected T GetPropertyValue<T>(string name)
		{
			return (T)TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(innerObject)[name].GetValue(innerObject);
		}

		protected T InvokeMethod<T>(string methodName)
		{
			MethodInfo method = innerObject.GetType().GetMethod(methodName, BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public);
			return (T)method.Invoke(innerObject, new object[0]);
		}

		protected T InvokeMethod<T>(string methodName, Type[] types, params object[] args)
		{
			return (T)innerObject.GetType().GetMethod(methodName, types).Invoke(innerObject, args);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return innerObject.ToString();
		}
	}

	internal class FederationJoinNodeExpandAssistant : JoinNodeCloneAssistant
	{
		private class JoinNodeSourceReplacer : JoinNodeVisitor<IJoinNode>
		{
			private readonly Dictionary<string, Source> sources;

			public JoinNodeSourceReplacer(Dictionary<string, Source> sources)
			{
				this.sources = sources;
			}

			protected override IJoinNode Visit(SelectNode selectNode)
			{
				Process(selectNode.Root);
				foreach (JoinElement subNode in selectNode.SubNodes)
				{
					Process(subNode.Node);
				}
				return selectNode;
			}

			protected override IJoinNode Visit(UnionNode unionNode)
			{
				foreach (QueryNode element in unionNode.Elements)
				{
					Process(element);
				}
				return unionNode;
			}

			protected override IJoinNode Visit(TransformationNode transformationNode)
			{
				Process(transformationNode.Root);
				return transformationNode;
			}

			protected override IJoinNode Visit(SourceNode sourceNode)
			{
				Source value = null;
				Source source = sourceNode.Source;
				if (sources.TryGetValue(source.Name, out value) && SimpleSourceEqualityComparer.Equals(value, source))
				{
					sourceNode.Source = value;
					return sourceNode;
				}
				string key = (source.Name = NameGenerator.GenerateUniqueName(source.Name, sources.ContainsKey));
				sources.Add(key, source);
				return sourceNode;
			}
		}

		private readonly Dictionary<string, Source> sources;

		internal FederationJoinNodeExpandAssistant(FederationDataSourceBase dataSource)
		{
			sources = dataSource.Sources.ToDictionary((Source s) => s.Name);
		}

		public QueryNode Expand(IQueryNode node)
		{
			return (QueryNode)Process(node);
		}

		protected override IJoinNode Visit(SourceNode sourceNode)
		{
			if (sourceNode.Source.DataSource is FederationDataSourceBase federationDataSourceBase && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(sourceNode.Source.DataMember))
			{
				QueryNode query = federationDataSourceBase.Queries.FirstOrDefault((QueryNode q) => q.ActualName == sourceNode.Source.DataMember);
				if (query != null)
				{
					base.OriginalCloneNodePairs.GetOrAdd(sourceNode, delegate
					{
						IJoinNode joinNode = Process(query);
						joinNode.Alias = sourceNode.ActualName;
						new JoinNodeSourceReplacer(sources).Process(joinNode);
						return joinNode;
					});
				}
			}
			return base.Visit(sourceNode);
		}
	}
	internal static class ITypedColumnarDataFilterHelper
	{
		public static ITypedColumnarData Filter(this ITypedColumnarData data, CriteriaOperator filter, CancellationToken token)
		{
			if (CriteriaProcessingExtensions.ReferenceEqualsNull(filter))
			{
				return data;
			}
			TypedColumnarDataDescriptor typedColumnarDataDescriptor = new TypedColumnarDataDescriptor(data);
			Func<int, bool> func = CriteriaCompiler.ToPredicate<int>(filter, (CriteriaCompilerDescriptor)(object)typedColumnarDataDescriptor);
			ITypedColumnarDataReader typedColumnarDataReader = new TypedColumnarDataReader(data);
			TypedColumn[] array = data.Select((ITypedColumn c) => TypedColumn.NewList(c.Type, c)).ToArray();
			for (int num = 0; num < data.RowCount; num++)
			{
				if (token.IsCancellationRequested)
				{
					break;
				}
				typedColumnarDataReader.Read();
				if (func(num))
				{
					for (int num2 = 0; num2 < array.Length; num2++)
					{
						array[num2].Read(typedColumnarDataReader, num2);
					}
				}
			}
			token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
			return new TypedColumnarData(array);
		}
	}

	internal class JoinNodeCloneAssistant : JoinNodeVisitor<IJoinNode>
	{
		protected ConcurrentDictionary<SourceNode, IJoinNode> OriginalCloneNodePairs { get; } = new ConcurrentDictionary<SourceNode, IJoinNode>();

		protected JoinNodeCloneAssistant()
		{
		}

		public static IJoinNode Clone(IJoinNode node)
		{
			return new JoinNodeCloneAssistant().Process(node);
		}

		protected override IJoinNode Visit(SelectNode selectNode)
		{
			SelectNode selectNode2 = new SelectNode
			{
				Alias = selectNode.Alias,
				Root = Process(selectNode.Root),
				FilterString = selectNode.FilterString
			};
			selectNode2.SubNodes.AddRange(selectNode.SubNodes.Select(Clone));
			IEnumerable<DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression> collection = selectNode.Expressions.Select(Clone);
			selectNode2.Expressions.AddRange(collection);
			return selectNode2;
		}

		protected override IJoinNode Visit(UnionNode unionNode)
		{
			UnionNode unionNode2 = new UnionNode
			{
				Alias = unionNode.Alias,
				Type = unionNode.Type
			};
			IEnumerable<QueryNode> items = unionNode.Elements.Select(base.Process).Cast<QueryNode>();
			unionNode2.Elements.AddRange(items);
			return unionNode2;
		}

		protected override IJoinNode Visit(SourceNode sourceNode)
		{
			return OriginalCloneNodePairs.GetOrAdd(sourceNode, (SourceNode x) => new SourceNode
			{
				Source = sourceNode.Source,
				Alias = sourceNode.Alias,
				Meta = sourceNode.Meta?.Clone()
			});
		}

		protected override IJoinNode Visit(TransformationNode transformationNode)
		{
			TransformationNode transformationNode2 = new TransformationNode
			{
				Alias = transformationNode.Alias,
				Root = Process(transformationNode.Root)
			};
			transformationNode2.Rules.AddRange(transformationNode.Rules.Select((TransformationRule c) => new TransformationRule(c)));
			return transformationNode2;
		}

		private JoinElement Clone(JoinElement source)
		{
			return new JoinElement
			{
				Type = source.Type,
				Condition = source.Condition,
				Node = Process(source.Node)
			};
		}

		private DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression Clone(DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression source)
		{
			if (source is SelectColumnExpression source2)
			{
				return Clone(source2);
			}
			if (source is DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.SelectExpression source3)
			{
				return Clone(source3);
			}
			if (source is SelectAllNodeColumnsExpression source4)
			{
				return Clone(source4);
			}
			if (source is SelectRowCountExpression selectRowCountExpression)
			{
				return new SelectRowCountExpression(selectRowCountExpression.Alias);
			}
			return new SelectAllColumnsExpression();
		}

		private SelectColumnExpression Clone(SelectColumnExpression source)
		{
			return new SelectColumnExpression(Process(source.Node), source.Name, source.Alias);
		}

		private DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.SelectExpression Clone(DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.SelectExpression source)
		{
			return new DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.SelectExpression(source.Expression, source.Alias);
		}

		private SelectAllNodeColumnsExpression Clone(SelectAllNodeColumnsExpression source)
		{
			return new SelectAllNodeColumnsExpression(Process(source.Node));
		}
	}
	internal class JoinNodeEqualityAssistant : JoinNodeVisitor<bool>
	{
		private readonly IJoinNode expectedNode;

		public JoinNodeEqualityAssistant(IJoinNode expectedNode)
		{
			this.expectedNode = expectedNode;
		}

		protected override bool Visit(SourceNode sourceNode)
		{
			SourceNode x = expectedNode as SourceNode;
			return SourceNode.EqualityComparer.Equals(x, sourceNode);
		}

		protected override bool Visit(SelectNode selectNode)
		{
			SelectNode x = expectedNode as SelectNode;
			return SelectNode.EqualityComparer.Equals(x, selectNode);
		}

		protected override bool Visit(UnionNode unionNode)
		{
			UnionNode x = expectedNode as UnionNode;
			return UnionNode.EqualityComparer.Equals(x, unionNode);
		}

		protected override bool Visit(TransformationNode transformationNode)
		{
			return TransformationNode.EqualityComparer.Equals(expectedNode as TransformationNode, transformationNode);
		}
	}

	internal class SourceColumnsProvider : ISourceColumnsProvider
	{
		IValidationColumn[] ISourceColumnsProvider.GetColumns(Source source)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			DataBrowser val = new DataContextBase()[source.DataSource, source.DataMember];
			PropertyDescriptorCollection itemProperties = val.GetItemProperties();
			return GetColumns(itemProperties.OfType<PropertyDescriptor>().ToList(), string.Empty).ToArray();
		}

		private static IEnumerable<IValidationColumn> GetColumns(List<PropertyDescriptor> properties, string prefix, int level = 0)
		{
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor property in properties)
			{
				string text = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(prefix) ? property.Name : (prefix + "." + property.Name));
				ValidationColumn column = new ValidationColumn(text, TypeHelper.ExpandNullable(property.PropertyType));
				if (level < 2 && TypeHelper.CanFlatten(property.PropertyType, out var properties2))
				{
					foreach (IValidationColumn column2 in GetColumns(properties2, text, level + 1))
					{
						yield return column2;
					}
				}
				yield return column;
			}
		}
	}

	internal class SourceDataProvider : SourceDataProviderBase
	{
		public SourceDataProvider(IEnumerable<QueryNode> queries)
			: base(queries)
		{
		}

		protected override ITypedColumnarData RetrieveSourceData(Source source, SourceColumnsInfo columns, bool includeData, CancellationToken token)
		{
			return RetrieveData(source.DataSource, source.DataMember, columns, includeData);
		}

		protected ITypedColumnarData RetrieveData(object dataSource, string dataMember, SourceColumnsInfo columns, bool includeData)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			DataBrowser val = new DataContextBase()[dataSource, dataMember];
			string[] columnsList = GetColumnsList(columns, val);
			ITypedColumnarDataReader typedColumnarDataReader = new DataBrowserReader(val, columnsList);
			ITypedColumn[] array = new ITypedColumn[columnsList.Length];
			ResultTable sqlTable = val.DataSource as ResultTable;
			for (int i = 0; i < typedColumnarDataReader.FieldCount; i++)
			{
				array[i] = CreateTypedColumn(typedColumnarDataReader.GetFieldType(i), columnsList[i], sqlTable);
			}
			if (includeData)
			{
				while (typedColumnarDataReader.Read())
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
					{
						array[j].Read(typedColumnarDataReader, j);
					}
				}
			}
			return new TypedColumnarData(array);
		}

		private ITypedColumn CreateTypedColumn(Type fieldType, string name, ResultTable sqlTable)
		{
			IEnumerable<PropertyDescriptor> detailsFromSQLResultTable = TypeHelper.GetDetailsFromSQLResultTable(fieldType, name, sqlTable);
			if (detailsFromSQLResultTable != null && detailsFromSQLResultTable.Any())
			{
				return TypedColumn.NewChunkedListWithDetails(fieldType, name, detailsFromSQLResultTable.ToArray());
			}
			return TypedColumn.NewChunkedList(fieldType, name);
		}

		private static string[] GetColumnsList(SourceColumnsInfo columnsInfo, DataBrowser browser)
		{
			if (columnsInfo == null)
			{
				columnsInfo = new SourceColumnsInfo
				{
					NeedAllColumns = true
				};
			}
			HashSet<string> hashSet = new HashSet<string>(columnsInfo.Columns);
			if (columnsInfo.NeedAllColumns)
			{
				foreach (PropertyDescriptor itemProperty in browser.GetItemProperties())
				{
					hashSet.Add(itemProperty.Name);
				}
			}
			return hashSet.ToArray();
		}
	}

		public LookupSourceDataProvider(QueryNode query, IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters, IServiceProvider serviceProvider)

			IDynamicLookupSettingsDataProvider val = (IDynamicLookupSettingsDataProvider)((dataSource is IDynamicLookupSettingsDataProvider) ? dataSource : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return base.RetrieveSourceData(source, columns, includeData, token);
			}
			val.Initialize(serviceProvider);
			DynamicLookupResult result = val.GetResult(source.DataMember, parameters, (string)null, CancellationToken.None);
			return RetrieveData(result.Result, result.ActualDataMember, columns, includeData);
		}

	internal class DataBrowserReader : ITypedColumnarDataReader
	{
		private readonly PropertyDescriptor[] descriptors;

		private readonly DataBrowser browser;

		private int current = -1;

		int ITypedColumnarDataReader.FieldCount => descriptors.Length;

		public DataBrowserReader(DataBrowser browser, string[] columnsList)
		{
			this.browser = browser;
			PropertyDescriptorCollection itemProperties = browser.GetItemProperties();
			descriptors = new PropertyDescriptor[columnsList.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < columnsList.Length; i++)
			{
				descriptors[i] = itemProperties[columnsList[i]];
			}
		}

		string ITypedColumnarDataReader.GetFieldName(int i)
		{
			return descriptors[i].Name;
		}

		Type ITypedColumnarDataReader.GetFieldType(int i)
		{
			if (descriptors[i] == null)
			{
				return typeof(object);
			}
			return NullableHelpers.GetUnBoxedType(descriptors[i].PropertyType);
		}

		public Type GetResultColumnType(int i)
		{
			if (descriptors[i] == null)
			{
				return typeof(object);
			}
			return descriptors[i].PropertyType;
		}

		T ITypedColumnarDataReader.GetValue<T>(int i)
		{
			object obj = descriptors[i]?.GetValue(browser.Current);
			return (T)((obj == DBNull.Value) ? null : obj);
		}

		bool ITypedColumnarDataReader.Read()
		{
			current++;
			return ReadToCurrent();
		}

		bool ITypedColumnarDataReader.Seek(int index)
		{
			current = index;
			return ReadToCurrent();
		}

		private bool ReadToCurrent()
		{
			if (current >= 0 && current < browser.Count)
			{
				browser.Position = current;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class SourceDataProviderBase
	{
		protected IEnumerable<QueryNode> Queries { get; }

		protected SourceDataProviderBase(IEnumerable<QueryNode> queries)
		{
			Queries = queries;
		}

		public Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, ITypedColumnarData>> RetrieveSourceDataByQuery(string[] queriesToFill, bool includeData, CancellationToken token)
		{
			Dictionary<string, Dictionary<Source, SourceColumnsInfo>> sourceColumnsByQuery = GetSourceColumnsByQuery(queriesToFill);
			Dictionary<string, ITypedColumnarData> sourceDatas = GetSourceDatas(includeData, sourceColumnsByQuery, token);
			return SplitSourceDataByQueries(sourceColumnsByQuery, sourceDatas);
		}

		public Dictionary<string, Dictionary<Source, SourceColumnsInfo>> GetSourceColumnsByQuery(string[] queriesToFill)
		{
			return (from queryName in queriesToFill.Distinct()
				select Queries.FirstOrDefault((QueryNode q) => q.ActualName == queryName) into q
				where q != null
				select q).ToDictionary((QueryNode query) => query.ActualName, SourceColumnsExtractor.Extract);
		}

		public Dictionary<string, ITypedColumnarData> GetSourceDatas(bool includeData, Dictionary<string, Dictionary<Source, SourceColumnsInfo>> sourceColumnsByQuery, CancellationToken token)
		{
			Dictionary<Source, SourceColumnsInfo> source = (from g in sourceColumnsByQuery.SelectMany((KeyValuePair<string, Dictionary<Source, SourceColumnsInfo>> q) => q.Value)
				group g by g.Key).ToDictionary((IGrouping<Source, KeyValuePair<Source, SourceColumnsInfo>> g) => g.Key, (IGrouping<Source, KeyValuePair<Source, SourceColumnsInfo>> g) => MergeSourceColumnsInfos(g.Select((KeyValuePair<Source, SourceColumnsInfo> gr) => gr.Value).ToArray()));
			return source.ToDictionary((KeyValuePair<Source, SourceColumnsInfo> s) => s.Key.Name, (KeyValuePair<Source, SourceColumnsInfo> s) => RetrieveSourceData(s.Key, s.Value, includeData, token));
		}

		internal static SourceColumnsInfo MergeSourceColumnsInfos(params SourceColumnsInfo[] infos)
		{
			SourceColumnsInfo sourceColumnsInfo = new SourceColumnsInfo();
			foreach (SourceColumnsInfo sourceColumnsInfo2 in infos)
			{
				sourceColumnsInfo.Columns.AddRange(sourceColumnsInfo2.Columns);
				sourceColumnsInfo.NeedAllColumns |= sourceColumnsInfo2.NeedAllColumns;
			}
			return sourceColumnsInfo;
		}

		public static Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, ITypedColumnarData>> SplitSourceDataByQueries(Dictionary<string, Dictionary<Source, SourceColumnsInfo>> sourceColumnsByQuery, Dictionary<string, ITypedColumnarData> sourceDatas)
		{
			Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, ITypedColumnarData>> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, ITypedColumnarData>>();
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, Dictionary<Source, SourceColumnsInfo>> item in sourceColumnsByQuery)
			{
				Dictionary<string, ITypedColumnarData> dictionary2 = new Dictionary<string, ITypedColumnarData>();
				foreach (KeyValuePair<Source, SourceColumnsInfo> sourceQueryColumns in item.Value)
				{
					ITypedColumnarData source = sourceDatas[sourceQueryColumns.Key.Name];
					List<ITypedColumn> columns = source.Where((ITypedColumn c) => sourceQueryColumns.Value == null || sourceQueryColumns.Value.NeedAllColumns || sourceQueryColumns.Value.Columns.Contains(c.Name)).ToList();
					dictionary2.Add(sourceQueryColumns.Key.Name, new TypedColumnarData(columns));
				}
				dictionary.Add(item.Key, dictionary2);
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		protected abstract ITypedColumnarData RetrieveSourceData(Source source, SourceColumnsInfo columns, bool includeData, CancellationToken token);
	}

	internal class ValidationTablesExtractor : JoinNodeVisitor<IValidationTable>
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<IJoinNode, IValidationTable> nodeValidationTables = new Dictionary<IJoinNode, IValidationTable>();

		private readonly ISourceColumnsProvider columnsProvider;

		public ValidationTablesExtractor(ISourceColumnsProvider columnsProvider)
		{
			this.columnsProvider = columnsProvider;
		}

		protected override IValidationTable Visit(SelectNode selectNode)
		{
			if (nodeValidationTables.TryGetValue(selectNode, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			List<IValidationColumn> list = new List<IValidationColumn>(selectNode.Expressions.Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < selectNode.Expressions.Count; i++)
			{
				SelectColumnExpression columnExpression = selectNode.Expressions[i] as SelectColumnExpression;
				if (columnExpression != null)
				{
					Type type = null;
					if (nodeValidationTables.TryGetValue(columnExpression.Node, out var value2))
					{
						IValidationColumn validationColumn = value2.Columns?.FirstOrDefault((IValidationColumn c) => c.Name == columnExpression.Name);
						if (validationColumn != null)
						{
							type = validationColumn.Type;
						}
					}
					list.Add(new ValidationColumn(columnExpression.ActualName, type));
				}
				else if (selectNode.Expressions[i] is DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.SelectExpression selectExpression)
				{
					list.Add(new ValidationColumn(selectExpression.ActualName, typeof(object)));
				}
				else if (selectNode.Expressions[i] is SelectAllNodeColumnsExpression selectAllNodeColumnsExpression)
				{
					IValidationTable validationTable = new ValidationTablesExtractor(columnsProvider).Process(selectAllNodeColumnsExpression.Node);
					list.AddRange(validationTable.Columns);
					list.AddRange(validationTable.Columns);
				}
				else if (selectNode.Expressions[i] is SelectAllColumnsExpression)
				{
					IValidationTable validationTable2 = new ValidationTablesExtractor(columnsProvider).Process(selectNode.Root);
					if (validationTable2.Columns != null)
					{
						list.AddRange(validationTable2.Columns);
					}
					foreach (JoinElement subNode in selectNode.SubNodes)
					{
						IValidationTable validationTable3 = new ValidationTablesExtractor(columnsProvider).Process(subNode.Node);
						if (validationTable3.Columns != null)
						{
							list.AddRange(validationTable3.Columns);
						}
					}
				}
				else if (selectNode.Expressions[i] is SelectRowCountExpression selectRowCountExpression)
				{
					list.Add(new ValidationColumn(selectRowCountExpression.ActualName, typeof(int)));
				}
			}
			value = new ValidationTable(selectNode.ActualName, list.ToArray());
			nodeValidationTables.Add(selectNode, value);
			return value;
		}

		protected override IValidationTable Visit(UnionNode unionNode)
		{
			if (nodeValidationTables.TryGetValue(unionNode, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			if (unionNode.Elements.Count <= 0)
			{
				return new ValidationTable(unionNode.ActualName, null);
			}
			value = Process(unionNode.Elements[0]);
			value.Name = unionNode.ActualName;
			nodeValidationTables.Add(unionNode, value);
			return value;
		}

		protected override IValidationTable Visit(SourceNode sourceNode)
		{
			if (nodeValidationTables.TryGetValue(sourceNode, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			Source source = sourceNode.Source;
			if (source == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IValidationColumn[] columns = columnsProvider.GetColumns(sourceNode.Source);
			value = new ValidationTable(sourceNode.ActualName, columns);
			nodeValidationTables.Add(sourceNode, value);
			return value;
		}

		protected override IValidationTable Visit(TransformationNode transformationNode)
		{
			IValidationTable validationTable = Process(transformationNode.Root);
			Dictionary<string, TransformationRule> dictionary = transformationNode.Rules.Where((TransformationRule c) => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(c.Alias) || c.Flatten).ToDictionary((TransformationRule c) => c.ColumnName, (TransformationRule c) => c);
			List<IValidationColumn> list = null;
			if (validationTable.Columns != null)
			{
				list = new List<IValidationColumn>();
				IValidationColumn[] columns = validationTable.Columns;
				foreach (IValidationColumn validationColumn in columns)
				{
					if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(validationColumn.Name, out var transformationRule))
					{
						list.Add(validationColumn);
						continue;
					}
					Type type = validationColumn.Type;
					if (transformationRule.Unfold && TypeHelper.IsEnumerable(validationColumn.Type, out var itemType))
					{
						type = itemType;
					}
					if (transformationRule.Flatten && TypeHelper.CanFlatten(type, out var properties))
					{
						list.AddRange(properties.Select((PropertyDescriptor p) => new ValidationColumn(transformationRule.ActualName + "_" + p.Name, p.PropertyType)));
					}
					else
					{
						list.Add(new ValidationColumn(transformationRule.ActualName, type));
					}
				}
			}
			return new ValidationTable(transformationNode.ActualName, list?.ToArray());
		}
	}
	public class FederationResultTable : ResultTable
	{
		private readonly QueryNode query;

		public FederationResultTable(QueryNode query, ColumnarData columnarData)
			: base(query.ActualName, columnarData)
		{
			this.query = query;
		}

		protected override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(PropertyDescriptor[] listAccessors)
		{
			ResultTableBase resultTableBase = this;
			if (listAccessors == null)
			{
				return GetPropertiesFromResultTable(resultTableBase);
			}
			PropertyDescriptor[] array = listAccessors.ToArray();
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = array[i];
				ResultTable detailList = resultTableBase.GetDetailList(propertyDescriptor.Name);
				if (detailList == null)
				{
					if (TypeDetector.DetectColumnType(query, propertyDescriptor.Name, listAccessors.Skip(i + 1).ToArray(), out var result))
					{
						return result;
					}
					return GetPropertiesFromType(propertyDescriptor.PropertyType, listAccessors.Skip(i + 1).ToArray());
				}
				resultTableBase = detailList;
			}
			return GetPropertiesFromResultTable(resultTableBase);
		}

		protected override ResultColumn CreateResultColumn(ResultTableView resultTableView, string name)
		{
			return new FederationResultColumn(name, resultTableView);
		}

		protected override ResultColumn CreateResultColumn(ResultTableView resultTableView, ColumnDescription description)
		{
			return new FederationResultColumn(description.Name, resultTableView, description.DisplayName);
		}

		private PropertyDescriptorCollection GetPropertiesFromResultTable(ResultTableBase list)
		{
			return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(((IEnumerable<ResultRelation>)list.Details).Select((Func<ResultRelation, PropertyDescriptor>)((ResultRelation d) => d)).Union(list.Columns).ToArray());
		}

		private PropertyDescriptorCollection GetPropertiesFromType(Type type, PropertyDescriptor[] listAccessors)
		{
			type = TypeHelper.ExpandNullable(type);
			PropertyDescriptorCollection itemProperties = ObjectDataSourceFillHelper.GetItemProperties(type);
			if (listAccessors == null || listAccessors.Length == 0)
			{
				return itemProperties;
			}
			PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = itemProperties.Find(listAccessors[0].Name, ignoreCase: false);
			if (propertyDescriptor != null)
			{
				return GetPropertiesFromType(propertyDescriptor.PropertyType, listAccessors.Skip(1).ToArray());
			}
			return ResultTableBase.EmptyPropertyDescriptorCollection;
		}
	}
	internal class TypeDetector : JoinNodeVisitor<bool>
	{
		private readonly PropertyDescriptor[] descriptors;

		private PropertyDescriptorCollection itemProperties;

		private string actualColumnName;

		private readonly List<string> subNames = new List<string>();

		public static bool DetectColumnType(QueryNode query, string columnName, PropertyDescriptor[] descriptors, out PropertyDescriptorCollection result)
		{
			TypeDetector typeDetector = new TypeDetector(columnName, descriptors);
			bool result2 = typeDetector.Process(query);
			result = typeDetector.itemProperties;
			return result2;
		}

		private TypeDetector(string columnName, PropertyDescriptor[] descriptors)
		{
			actualColumnName = columnName;
			this.descriptors = descriptors;
		}

		protected override bool Visit(SelectNode selectNode)
		{
			SelectColumnExpression selectColumnExpression = selectNode.Expressions.OfType<SelectColumnExpression>().FirstOrDefault((SelectColumnExpression c) => c.ActualName == actualColumnName);
			if (selectColumnExpression == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			actualColumnName = selectColumnExpression.Name;
			return Process(selectColumnExpression.Node);
		}

		protected override bool Visit(UnionNode unionNode)
		{
			return Process(unionNode.Elements.FirstOrDefault());
		}

		protected override bool Visit(SourceNode sourceNode)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(sourceNode.Source.DataMember))
			{
				list.Add(sourceNode.Source.DataMember);
			}
			list.Add(actualColumnName);
			list.AddRange(subNames);
			list.AddRange(descriptors.Select((PropertyDescriptor d) => d.Name));
			ITypedList typedList = (sourceNode.Source.DataSource as ITypedList) ?? ((sourceNode.Source.DataSource as IListSource)?.GetList() as ITypedList);
			if (typedList == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			List<PropertyDescriptor> list2 = new List<PropertyDescriptor>();
			foreach (string item in list)
			{
				PropertyDescriptorCollection propertyDescriptorCollection = typedList.GetItemProperties(list2.ToArray());
				PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = propertyDescriptorCollection.Find(item, ignoreCase: false);
				if (propertyDescriptor == null)
				{
					itemProperties = ResultTableBase.EmptyPropertyDescriptorCollection;
					return itemProperties.Count > 0;
				}
				list2.Add(propertyDescriptor);
			}
			itemProperties = typedList.GetItemProperties(list2.ToArray());
			return itemProperties.Count > 0;
		}

		protected override bool Visit(TransformationNode transformationNode)
		{
			if (transformationNode.Rules.Any((TransformationRule r) => r.Unfold))
			{
				return false;
			}
			string text = null;
			TransformationRule transformationRule = transformationNode.Rules.FirstOrDefault((TransformationRule c) => c.ActualName == actualColumnName && !c.Flatten);
			if (transformationRule == null)
			{
				transformationRule = transformationNode.Rules.FirstOrDefault((TransformationRule c) => actualColumnName.StartsWith(c.ActualName + "_") && c.Flatten);
				if (transformationRule != null)
				{
					text = actualColumnName.Substring(transformationRule.ActualName.Length + 1);
				}
			}
			if (transformationRule != null)
			{
				actualColumnName = transformationRule.ColumnName;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					subNames.Insert(0, text);
				}
				return Process(transformationNode.Root);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class FederationResultColumn : ResultColumn
	{
		public FederationResultColumn(string name, ResultTableView view)
			: this(name, view, null)
		{
		}

		public FederationResultColumn(string name, ResultTableView view, string displayName)
			: base(name, view, displayName)
		{
		}
	}
	internal abstract class QueryNodeCriteriaValidatorVisitor : IQueryCriteriaVisitor<ValidationError>, ICriteriaVisitor<ValidationError>
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<string, string> tableActualNames;

		private readonly Dictionary<string, IValidationTable> validationTables;

		private readonly IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters;

		private readonly IEnumerable<IValidationTable> validationTablesWithActualNames;

		protected QueryNodeCriteriaValidatorVisitor(Dictionary<string, string> tableActualNames, Dictionary<string, IValidationTable> validationTables, IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters)
		{
			this.tableActualNames = tableActualNames;
			this.validationTables = validationTables;
			this.parameters = parameters;
			validationTablesWithActualNames = this.validationTables.Values.Where((IValidationTable table) => this.tableActualNames.ContainsValue(table.Name)).ToList();
		}

		public ValidationError Process(CriteriaOperator theOperator)
		{
			if (theOperator != null)
			{
				return theOperator.Accept<ValidationError>((ICriteriaVisitor<ValidationError>)this);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public ValidationError Visit(BetweenOperator theOperator)
		{
			return Process(theOperator.TestExpression) ?? Process(theOperator.BeginExpression) ?? Process(theOperator.EndExpression);
		}

		public ValidationError Visit(BinaryOperator theOperator)
		{
			return Process(theOperator.LeftOperand) ?? Process(theOperator.RightOperand);
		}

		public ValidationError Visit(UnaryOperator theOperator)
		{
			return Process(theOperator.Operand);
		}

		public ValidationError Visit(InOperator theOperator)
		{
			ValidationError validationError = Process(theOperator.LeftOperand);
			if (validationError != null)
			{
				return validationError;
			}
			foreach (CriteriaOperator item in (List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)theOperator.Operands)
			{
				validationError = Process(item);
				if (validationError != null)
				{
					return validationError;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public ValidationError Visit(GroupOperator theOperator)
		{
			foreach (CriteriaOperator item in (List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)theOperator.Operands)
			{
				ValidationError validationError = Process(item);
				if (validationError != null)
				{
					return validationError;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public ValidationError Visit(OperandValue theOperand)
		{
			OperandValue obj = ((theOperand is OperandParameter) ? theOperand : null);
			string parameterName = ((obj != null) ? ((OperandParameter)obj).ParameterName : null);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(parameterName) && parameters.All((IParameter p) => ((IFilterParameter)p).Name != parameterName))
			{
				return CreateMissingParameterValidationError(parameterName);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public ValidationError Visit(FunctionOperator theOperator)
		{
			foreach (CriteriaOperator item in (List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)theOperator.Operands)
			{
				ValidationError validationError = Process(item);
				if (validationError != null)
				{
					return validationError;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public ValidationError Visit(QuerySubQueryContainer theOperand)
		{
			return Process(theOperand.AggregateProperty);
		}

		public ValidationError Visit(QueryOperand theOperand)
		{
			if (validationTables == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (theOperand.NodeAlias == null)
			{
				return CheckOrphanColumn(theOperand.ColumnName);
			}
			string value = null;
			if (!tableActualNames.TryGetValue(theOperand.NodeAlias, out value))
			{
				return CreateMissingTableValidationError(theOperand.NodeAlias, theOperand.ColumnName);
			}
			IValidationTable validationTable = validationTables[value];
			if (validationTable.Columns == null || !validationTable.Columns.All((IValidationColumn c) => c.Name != theOperand.ColumnName))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return CreateMissingInSchemaColumnValidationError(value, theOperand.ColumnName);
		}

		protected abstract ValidationError CreateMissingTableValidationError(string tableName, string columnName);

		protected abstract ValidationError CreateMissingTableValidationError(string columnName);

		protected abstract ValidationError CreateMissingParameterValidationError(string parameterName);

		protected abstract ValidationError CreateMissingInSchemaColumnValidationError(string tableName, string columnName);

		protected abstract ValidationError CreateAmbiguousColumnValidationError(string columnName, string[] tables);

		private ValidationError CheckOrphanColumn(string columnName)
		{
			string[] array = (from t in validationTablesWithActualNames
				where t.Columns != null && t.Columns.Any((IValidationColumn c) => c.Name == columnName)
				select t.Name).ToArray();
			bool flag = validationTablesWithActualNames.Any((IValidationTable t) => t.Columns == null);
			if (array.Length == 0 && !flag)
			{
				return CreateMissingTableValidationError(columnName);
			}
			if (array.Length > 1)
			{
				return CreateAmbiguousColumnValidationError(columnName, array);
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	internal class ExpressionCriteriaValidatorVisitor : QueryNodeCriteriaValidatorVisitor
	{
		private readonly SelectNode node;

		private readonly string expression;

		public ExpressionCriteriaValidatorVisitor(SelectNode node, string expression, Dictionary<string, string> tableActualNames, Dictionary<string, IValidationTable> validationTables)
			: base(tableActualNames, validationTables, Enumerable.Empty<IParameter>())
		{
			this.node = node;
			this.expression = expression;
		}

		protected override ValidationError CreateMissingTableValidationError(string tableName, string columnName)
		{
			return new ExpressionWithColumnOfMissingTableValidationError(node, expression, tableName + "." + columnName);
		}

		protected override ValidationError CreateMissingTableValidationError(string columnName)
		{
			return new ExpressionWithColumnOfMissingTableValidationError(node, expression, columnName ?? "");
		}

		protected override ValidationError CreateMissingParameterValidationError(string parameterName)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override ValidationError CreateMissingInSchemaColumnValidationError(string tableName, string columnName)
		{
			return new ExpressionWithMissingInSchemaColumnValidationError(node, expression, tableName, columnName);
		}

		protected override ValidationError CreateAmbiguousColumnValidationError(string columnName, string[] tables)
		{
			return new ExpressionWithAmbiguousColumnValidationError(node, expression, columnName, tables);
		}
	}
	internal class ConditionCriteriaValidatorVisitor : QueryNodeCriteriaValidatorVisitor
	{
		private readonly SelectNode node;

		private readonly IJoinNode subNode;

		private readonly string condition;

		public ConditionCriteriaValidatorVisitor(SelectNode node, IJoinNode subNode, string condition, Dictionary<string, string> tableActualNames, Dictionary<string, IValidationTable> validationTables)
			: base(tableActualNames, validationTables, Enumerable.Empty<IParameter>())
		{
			this.node = node;
			this.subNode = subNode;
			this.condition = condition;
		}

		protected override ValidationError CreateMissingTableValidationError(string tableName, string columnName)
		{
			return new ConditionColumnNotExistValidationError(node, subNode, condition, tableName + "." + columnName);
		}

		protected override ValidationError CreateMissingTableValidationError(string columnName)
		{
			return new ConditionColumnNotExistValidationError(node, subNode, condition, columnName ?? "");
		}

		protected override ValidationError CreateMissingParameterValidationError(string parameterName)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override ValidationError CreateMissingInSchemaColumnValidationError(string tableName, string columnName)
		{
			return new ConditionWithMissingInSchemaColumnValidationError(node, subNode, condition, tableName, columnName);
		}

		protected override ValidationError CreateAmbiguousColumnValidationError(string columnName, string[] tables)
		{
			return new ConditionWithAmbiguousColumnValidationError(node, subNode, condition, columnName, tables);
		}
	}

	{

		public string Name { get; set; }

	public static class SourceMapExtensions
	{
		public static bool TryGetDataSource(this Collection<SourceMapItem> sourceMap, string sourceName, out object dataSource)
		{
			SourceMapItem sourceMapItem = sourceMap.FirstOrDefault((SourceMapItem x) => x.Name == sourceName);
			if (sourceMapItem == null)
			{
				dataSource = null;
				return false;
			}
			dataSource = sourceMapItem.DataSource;
			return true;
		}
	}
	internal class TableInfo
	{
		public string Name { get; set; }

		public List<ColumnInfo> Columns { get; } = new List<ColumnInfo>();

		public TableInfo(string name)
		{
			Name = name;
		}

		public DBColumn GetColumnSafe(string name)
		{
			int count = Columns.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				DBColumn val = (DBColumn)(object)Columns[i];
				if (val != null && val.Name == name)
				{
					return val;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

	internal class OneTimeReadColumnarData : IEnumerable<ITypedColumn>, IEnumerable, ITypedColumnarData
	{
		private class RemoveFromSourceColumnEnumerator : IEnumerator<ITypedColumn>, IDisposable, IEnumerator
		{
			private List<ITypedColumn> typedColumns;

			private ITypedColumn current;

			private int position = -1;

			public ITypedColumn Current => current;

			object IEnumerator.Current => Current;

			public RemoveFromSourceColumnEnumerator(ITypedColumnarData typedColumnarData)
			{
				typedColumns = typedColumnarData.ToList();
				if (typedColumns.Count == 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("typedColumnarData has no columns");
				}
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
				typedColumns.Clear();
			}

			public bool MoveNext()
			{
				if (current != null)
				{
					typedColumns[position] = null;
				}
				position++;
				if (position < typedColumns.Count)
				{
					current = typedColumns[position];
					return true;
				}
				current = null;
				return false;
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
		}

		private readonly RemoveFromSourceColumnEnumerator enumerator;

		private bool enumeratorTaken;

		public int RowCount { get; }

		public bool HasColumns { get; }

		public ITypedColumn this[string name]
		{
			get
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("This data is for only one time enumeration");
			}
		}

		public OneTimeReadColumnarData(ITypedColumnarData columnarData)
		{
			RowCount = columnarData.RowCount;
			enumerator = new RemoveFromSourceColumnEnumerator(columnarData);
			HasColumns = columnarData.HasColumns;
		}

		public IEnumerator<ITypedColumn> GetEnumerator()
		{
			if (enumeratorTaken)
			{
				throw new Exception("Don`t take enumerator more than once");
			}
			enumeratorTaken = true;
			return enumerator;
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}
	}
	internal class TypedColumnarData : ITypedColumnarData, IEnumerable<ITypedColumn>, IEnumerable
	{
		private readonly int rowCount;

		private readonly IEnumerable<ITypedColumn> columns;

		ITypedColumn ITypedColumnarData.this[string name] => columns.FirstOrDefault((ITypedColumn c) => c.Name == name);

		int ITypedColumnarData.RowCount => rowCount;

		bool ITypedColumnarData.HasColumns => columns.Any();

		public TypedColumnarData(IEnumerable<ITypedColumn> columns)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)columns, "columns");
			this.columns = columns.ToList();
			if (!this.columns.Any())
			{
				rowCount = 0;
				return;
			}
			rowCount = this.columns.First().RowCount;
			Guard.ArgumentMatch<IEnumerable<ITypedColumn>>(this.columns, "columns", (Func<IEnumerable<ITypedColumn>, bool>)((IEnumerable<ITypedColumn> cols) => cols.All((ITypedColumn c) => c.RowCount == rowCount)));
		}

		IEnumerator<ITypedColumn> IEnumerable<ITypedColumn>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return columns.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return columns.GetEnumerator();
		}
	}
	internal abstract class TypedColumn : ITypedColumn
	{
		protected string displayName;

		public string Name { get; set; }

		public string DisplayName
		{
			get
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(displayName))
				{
					return displayName;
				}
				return Name;
			}
			set
			{
				displayName = value;
			}
		}

		public abstract Type Type { get; }

		public IResultColumnInfo ResultColumnInfo { get; private set; }

		public abstract int RowCount { get; }

		public static TypedColumn NewArray(Type colType, string name, int rowCount)
		{
			return ActivatorEx.New<TypedColumn>(typeof(ArrayTypedColumn<>), colType, new object[2] { name, rowCount });
		}

		public static TypedColumn NewList(Type colType, string name)
		{
			return ActivatorEx.New<TypedColumn>(typeof(ListTypedColumn<>), colType, new object[1] { name });
		}

		public static TypedColumn NewList(Type type, ITypedColumn info)
		{
			TypedColumn typedColumn = NewList(type, info.Name);
			typedColumn.displayName = (info as TypedColumn)?.displayName;
			return typedColumn;
		}

		public static TypedColumn NewChunkedList(Type colType, string name)
		{
			return ActivatorEx.New<TypedColumn>(typeof(ChunkedListTypedColumn<>), colType, new object[1] { name });
		}

		public static TypedColumn NewChunkedListWithDetails(Type colType, string name, PropertyDescriptor[] details)
		{
			return ActivatorEx.New<TypedColumn>(typeof(ChunkedListTypedColumnWithDetails<>), colType, new object[2] { name, details });
		}

		public static TypedColumn NewChunkedList(Type colType, ITypedColumn info)
		{
			TypedColumn typedColumn = NewChunkedList(colType, info.Name);
			typedColumn.displayName = (info as TypedColumn)?.displayName;
			return typedColumn;
		}

		public static TypedColumn NewUnionAll(Type colType, ITypedColumn col1, ITypedColumn col2)
		{
			return ActivatorEx.New<TypedColumn>(typeof(UnionAllTypedColumn<>), colType, new object[2] { col1, col2 });
		}

		public TypedColumn(string name)
		{
			Name = name;
		}

		public abstract System.Linq.Expressions.Expression GetValue(System.Linq.Expressions.Expression index);

		public abstract IList GetList();

		public abstract ITypedColumn LightClone(string cloneName);

		public abstract void Read(ITypedColumnarDataReader reader, int i);
	}

	internal class ArrayTypedColumn<T> : TypedColumn<T>
	{
		private int index = -1;

		private readonly T[] data;

		public override int RowCount => data.Length;

		public ArrayTypedColumn(string name, int rowCount)
			: this(name, new T[rowCount])
		{
		}

		public ArrayTypedColumn(string name, T[] data)
			: base(name)
		{
			this.data = data;
		}

		public override System.Linq.Expressions.Expression GetValue(System.Linq.Expressions.Expression index)
		{
			return System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.ArrayAccess(System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Constant(data, typeof(T[])), index);
		}

		public override T GetValue(int index)
		{
			return data[index];
		}

		public override void Read(ITypedColumnarDataReader reader, int i)
		{
			index++;
			data[index] = reader.GetValue<T>(i);
		}

		public override ITypedColumn LightClone(string cloneName)
		{
			return new ArrayTypedColumn<T>(cloneName, data);
		}

		public override IList GetList()
		{
			return data;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class IListTypedColumn<L, T> : TypedColumn<T>, ISupportBufferedRead<T> where L : IList, IList<T>, new()
	{
		private static MethodInfo GetValueMethod = typeof(IListTypedColumn<L, T>).GetMethod("GetValue", new Type[1] { typeof(int) });

		private const int DefaultBufferSize = 4096;

		protected L Data { get; private set; }

		private IList<T> IListTData { get; set; }

		public override int RowCount => IListTData.Count;

		public IListTypedColumn(string name)
			: this(name, new L())
		{
		}

		public IListTypedColumn(string name, L data)
			: base(name)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)data, "data");
			Data = data;
			IListTData = data;
		}

		public override System.Linq.Expressions.Expression GetValue(System.Linq.Expressions.Expression index)
		{
			return System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Call(System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Constant(this), GetValueMethod, index);
		}

		public override T GetValue(int index)
		{
			return IListTData[index];
		}

		public override void Read(ITypedColumnarDataReader reader, int i)
		{
			Data.Add(reader.GetValue<T>(i));
		}

		public override IList GetList()
		{
			return Data;
		}

		public abstract void CopyToBuffer(int startIndex, int count, T[] array);

		public virtual int GetBufferSize()
		{
			return 4096;
		}
	}
