	internal static class TypedColumnExtensions
	{
		public static Delegate GetGetValue(this ITypedColumn col)
		{
			ParameterExpression parameterExpression = System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Parameter(typeof(int));
			System.Linq.Expressions.Expression value = col.GetValue(parameterExpression);
			return System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Lambda(value, parameterExpression).Compile();
		}

		public static Func<int, T> GetGetOrConvertValue<T>(this ITypedColumn col)
		{
			return (Func<int, T>)col.GetGetOrConvertValue(typeof(T));
		}

		public static Delegate GetGetOrConvertValue(this ITypedColumn col, Type type)
		{
			ParameterExpression parameterExpression = System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Parameter(typeof(int));
			System.Linq.Expressions.Expression value = col.GetValue(parameterExpression);
			return System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Lambda(value.Convert(type), parameterExpression).Compile();
		}
	}
	public interface ITypedColumnarDataReader
	{
		int FieldCount { get; }

		string GetFieldName(int i);

		Type GetFieldType(int i);

		T GetValue<T>(int i);

		bool Read();

		bool Seek(int index);
	}
	internal class TypedColumnarDataReader : ITypedColumnarDataReader
	{
		private readonly Delegate[] getters;

		private readonly int rowCount;

		private readonly string[] fields;

		protected int Current { get; set; } = -1;

		int ITypedColumnarDataReader.FieldCount => getters.Length;

		public TypedColumnarDataReader(ITypedColumnarData source)
		{
			rowCount = source.RowCount;
			getters = source.Select((ITypedColumn c) => CreateGetter(c)).ToArray();
			fields = source.Select((ITypedColumn c) => c.Name).ToArray();
		}

		protected virtual Delegate CreateGetter(ITypedColumn source)
		{
			return source.GetGetValue();
		}

		string ITypedColumnarDataReader.GetFieldName(int i)
		{
			return fields[i];
		}

		Type ITypedColumnarDataReader.GetFieldType(int i)
		{
			return getters[i].Method.ReturnType;
		}

		T ITypedColumnarDataReader.GetValue<T>(int col)
		{
			Func<int, T> func = (Func<int, T>)getters[col];
			return func(Current);
		}

		public virtual bool Read()
		{
			Current++;
			if (Current >= 0)
			{
				return Current < rowCount;
			}
			return false;
		}

		bool ITypedColumnarDataReader.Seek(int index)
		{
			Current = index;
			if (Current >= 0)
			{
				return Current < rowCount;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal class MakeNullableTypedColumnarDataReader : TypedColumnarDataReader
	{
		public MakeNullableTypedColumnarDataReader(ITypedColumnarData source)
			: base(source)
		{
		}

		protected override Delegate CreateGetter(ITypedColumn source)
		{
			ParameterExpression parameterExpression = System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Parameter(typeof(int));
			System.Linq.Expressions.Expression expression = source.GetValue(parameterExpression);
			Type unBoxedType = NullableHelpers.GetUnBoxedType(expression.Type);
			if (unBoxedType != expression.Type)
			{
				ConstructorInfo constructor = NullableHelpers.MakeNullableType(expression.Type).GetConstructor(new Type[1] { expression.Type });
				expression = System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.New(constructor, expression);
			}
			return System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Lambda(expression, parameterExpression).Compile();
		}
	}
	internal class UnlimitedNullReader : ITypedColumnarDataReader
	{
		private readonly Type[] nullTypes;

		private readonly string[] fieldNames;

		int ITypedColumnarDataReader.FieldCount => nullTypes.Length;

		public UnlimitedNullReader(ITypedColumnarData source)
		{
			nullTypes = source.Select((ITypedColumn c) => NullableHelpers.GetUnBoxedType(c.Type)).ToArray();
			fieldNames = source.Select((ITypedColumn c) => c.Name).ToArray();
		}

		string ITypedColumnarDataReader.GetFieldName(int i)
		{
			return fieldNames[i];
		}

		Type ITypedColumnarDataReader.GetFieldType(int i)
		{
			return nullTypes[i];
		}

		T ITypedColumnarDataReader.GetValue<T>(int i)
		{
			return default(T);
		}

		bool ITypedColumnarDataReader.Read()
		{
			return true;
		}

		bool ITypedColumnarDataReader.Seek(int index)
		{
			return true;
		}
	}
	public interface IFederationDataSourceSerializer
	{
		XElement SaveToXml();

		void LoadFromXml(XElement dataSourceEl);
	}
	public static class FederationDataSourceSerializerConstants
	{
		public const string XML_FederationDataSource = "FederationDataSource";

		public const string XML_Sources = "Sources";

		public const string XML_Queries = "Queries";

		public const string XML_Relations = "Relations";

		public const string XML_KeyColumns = "KeyColumns";

		public const string XML_Views = "Views";

		public const string XML_Fields = "Fields";

		public const string XML_SubNodes = "SubNodes";

		public const string XML_Expressions = "Expressions";

		public const string XML_UnionElements = "UnionElements";

		public const string XML_TransformationRules = "TransformationRules";
	}
	public abstract class FederationDataSourceSerializerBase<TDataSource> : IFederationDataSourceSerializer where TDataSource : FederationDataSourceBase
	{
		private class JoinNodeSerializer : JoinNodeVisitor<XElement>
		{
			private const string XML_QueryType = "QueryType";

			private const string XML_SelectNode = "SelectNode";

			private const string XML_UnionNode = "UnionNode";

			private const string XML_SourceNode = "SourceNode";

			private const string XML_QueryNodeAlias = "Alias";

			private const string XML_Root = "Root";

			private const string XML_SubNodes = "SubNodes";

			private const string XML_JoinElement = "JoinElement";

			private const string XML_JoinType = "JoinType";

			private const string XML_Expressions = "Expressions";

			private const string XML_Expression = "Expression";

			private const string XML_ExpressionType = "ExpressionType";

			private const string XML_FilterString = "FilterString";

			private const string XML_SelectColumnExpression = "SelectColumnExpression";

			private const string XML_SelectAllColumnsExpression = "SelectAllColumnsExpression";

			private const string XML_SelectAllNodeColumnsExpression = "SelectAllNodeColumnsExpression";

			private const string XML_SelectExpression = "SelectExpression";

			private const string XML_ColumnExpression = "ColumnExpression";

			private const string XML_SelectRowCountExpression = "SelectRowCountExpression";

			private const string XML_ColumnAlias = "Alias";

			private const string XML_ColumnName = "Name";

			private const string XML_JoinCondition = "Condition";

			private const string XML_ColumnNodeAlias = "NodeAlias";

			private const string XML_UnionType = "UnionType";

			private const string XML_UnionElements = "UnionElements";

			private const string XML_SourceName = "SourceName";

			private const string XML_TransformationNode = "TransformationNode";

			private const string XML_TransformationRules = "TransformationRules";

			private const string XML_TransformationRule = "TransformationRule";

			private const string XML_Unfold = "Unfold";

			private const string XML_Flatten = "Flatten";

			private readonly List<Source> sources;

			private static XElement SaveSelectExpression(DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression column)
			{
				XElement xElement = new XElement("Expression");
				if (column is SelectColumnExpression selectColumnExpression)
				{
					xElement.Add(new XAttribute("ExpressionType", "SelectColumnExpression"));
					if (selectColumnExpression.Name != null)
					{
						xElement.Add(new XAttribute("Name", selectColumnExpression.Name));
					}
				}
				else if (column is DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.SelectExpression selectExpression)
				{
					xElement.Add(new XAttribute("ExpressionType", "SelectExpression"));
					xElement.Add(new XAttribute("ColumnExpression", selectExpression.Expression));
				}
				else if (column is SelectAllColumnsExpression)
				{
					xElement.Add(new XAttribute("ExpressionType", "SelectAllColumnsExpression"));
				}
				else if (column is SelectAllNodeColumnsExpression)
				{
					xElement.Add(new XAttribute("ExpressionType", "SelectAllNodeColumnsExpression"));
				}
				else if (column is SelectRowCountExpression)
				{
					xElement.Add(new XAttribute("ExpressionType", "SelectRowCountExpression"));
				}
				IAliasedSelectExpression aliasedSelectExpression = column as IAliasedSelectExpression;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(aliasedSelectExpression?.Alias))
				{
					xElement.Add(new XAttribute("Alias", aliasedSelectExpression.Alias));
				}
				INodeSelectExpression nodeSelectExpression = column as INodeSelectExpression;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(nodeSelectExpression?.Node?.ActualName))
				{
					xElement.Add(new XAttribute("NodeAlias", nodeSelectExpression.Node.ActualName));
				}
				return xElement;
			}

			private static XElement SaveTransformationRule(TransformationRule rule)
			{
				XElement xElement = new XElement("TransformationRule");
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(rule.ColumnName))
				{
					xElement.Add(new XAttribute("Name", rule.ColumnName));
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(rule.Alias))
				{
					xElement.Add(new XAttribute("Alias", rule.Alias));
				}
				if (rule.Flatten)
				{
					xElement.Add(new XAttribute("Flatten", rule.Flatten));
				}
				if (rule.Unfold)
				{
					xElement.Add(new XAttribute("Unfold", rule.Unfold));
				}
				return xElement;
			}

			public JoinNodeSerializer(List<Source> sources)
			{
				this.sources = sources;
			}

			private void SaveJoinElement(XElement subNodesEl, JoinElement element)
			{
				XElement xElement = new XElement("JoinElement");
				FederationDataSourceSerializerBase<TDataSource>.SerializeEnumValue(xElement, "JoinType", typeof(JoinType), (Enum)element.Type, (Enum)JoinType.Inner);
				if (element.Node != null)
				{
					xElement.Add(Process(element.Node));
				}
				if (element.Condition != null)
				{
					xElement.Add(new XAttribute("Condition", element.Condition));
				}
				subNodesEl.Add(xElement);
			}

			private static void SaveAlias(XElement nodeEl, IJoinNode node)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(node.Alias))
				{
					nodeEl.Add(new XAttribute("Alias", node.Alias));
				}
			}

			protected override XElement Visit(SelectNode selectNode)
			{
				XElement xElement = new XElement("Query");
				SaveAlias(xElement, selectNode);
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("QueryType", "SelectNode"));
				if (selectNode.Root != null)
				{
					XElement xElement2 = Process(selectNode.Root);
					xElement2.Name = "Root";
					xElement.Add(xElement2);
				}
				if (selectNode.SubNodes.Count > 0)
				{
					XElement xElement3 = new XElement("SubNodes");
					foreach (JoinElement subNode in selectNode.SubNodes)
					{
						SaveJoinElement(xElement3, subNode);
					}
					xElement.Add(xElement3);
				}
				if (selectNode.Expressions.Count > 0)
				{
					XElement xElement4 = new XElement("Expressions");
					foreach (DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression expression in selectNode.Expressions)
					{
						XElement content = SaveSelectExpression(expression);
						xElement4.Add(content);
					}
					xElement.Add(xElement4);
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(selectNode.FilterString))
				{
					xElement.Add(new XAttribute("FilterString", selectNode.FilterString));
				}
				if (selectNode.Meta != null && !selectNode.Meta.IsEmpty)
				{
					xElement.Add(selectNode.Meta.Save());
				}
				return xElement;
			}

			protected override XElement Visit(UnionNode unionNode)
			{
				XElement xElement = new XElement("Query");
				SaveAlias(xElement, unionNode);
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("QueryType", "UnionNode"));
				FederationDataSourceSerializerBase<TDataSource>.SerializeEnumValue(xElement, "UnionType", typeof(UnionType), (Enum)unionNode.Type, (Enum)UnionType.Union);
				if (unionNode.Elements.Count > 0)
				{
					XElement xElement2 = new XElement("UnionElements");
					foreach (QueryNode element in unionNode.Elements)
					{
						xElement2.Add(Process(element));
					}
					xElement.Add(xElement2);
				}
				if (unionNode.Meta != null && !unionNode.Meta.IsEmpty)
				{
					xElement.Add(unionNode.Meta.Save());
				}
				return xElement;
			}

			protected override XElement Visit(SourceNode sourceNode)
			{
				XElement xElement = new XElement("Query");
				SaveAlias(xElement, sourceNode);
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("QueryType", "SourceNode"));
				if (sourceNode.Source != null)
				{
					xElement.Add(new XAttribute("SourceName", sourceNode.Source.Name));
				}
				if (sourceNode.Meta != null && !sourceNode.Meta.IsEmpty)
				{
					xElement.Add(sourceNode.Meta.Save());
				}
				return xElement;
			}

			protected override XElement Visit(TransformationNode transformationNode)
			{
				XElement xElement = new XElement("Query");
				SaveAlias(xElement, transformationNode);
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("QueryType", "TransformationNode"));
				if (transformationNode.Root != null)
				{
					XElement xElement2 = Process(transformationNode.Root);
					xElement2.Name = "Root";
					xElement.Add(xElement2);
				}
				if (transformationNode.Rules.Count > 0)
				{
					XElement xElement3 = new XElement("TransformationRules");
					foreach (TransformationRule rule in transformationNode.Rules)
					{
						XElement content = SaveTransformationRule(rule);
						xElement3.Add(content);
					}
					xElement.Add(xElement3);
				}
				if (transformationNode.Meta != null && !transformationNode.Meta.IsEmpty)
				{
					xElement.Add(transformationNode.Meta.Save());
				}
				return xElement;
			}

			public QueryNode LoadQueryNode(XElement queryEl)
			{
				return queryEl.GetAttributeValue("QueryType") switch
				{
					"SelectNode" => LoadSelectNode(queryEl), 
					"UnionNode" => LoadUnionNode(queryEl), 
					"TransformationNode" => LoadTransformationNode(queryEl), 
					_ => throw new InvalidOperationException(), 
				};
			}

			private IJoinNode LoadJoinNode(XElement queryEl)
			{
				return queryEl.GetAttributeValue("QueryType") switch
				{
					"SelectNode" => LoadSelectNode(queryEl), 
					"UnionNode" => LoadUnionNode(queryEl), 
					"SourceNode" => LoadSourceNode(queryEl), 
					"TransformationNode" => LoadTransformationNode(queryEl), 
					_ => throw new InvalidOperationException(), 
				};
			}

			private QueryNode LoadTransformationNode(XElement queryEl)
			{
				TransformationNode transformationNode = new TransformationNode();
				LoadQueryAlias(transformationNode, queryEl);
				XElement xElement = queryEl.Element("Root");
				if (xElement != null)
				{
					IJoinNode root = LoadJoinNode(xElement);
					transformationNode.Root = root;
				}
				XElement xElement2 = queryEl.Element("TransformationRules");
				if (xElement2 != null)
				{
					foreach (XElement item2 in xElement2.Elements("TransformationRule"))
					{
						TransformationRule item = new TransformationRule
						{
							ColumnName = item2.GetAttributeValue("Name"),
							Alias = item2.GetAttributeValue("Alias"),
							Unfold = (item2.GetAttributeValue("Unfold") == "true"),
							Flatten = (item2.GetAttributeValue("Flatten") == "true")
						};
						transformationNode.Rules.Add(item);
					}
				}
				transformationNode.Meta = TableMetaInfo.Load(queryEl);
				return transformationNode;
			}

			private SelectNode LoadSelectNode(XElement queryEl)
			{
				SelectNode selectNode = new SelectNode();
				LoadQueryAlias(selectNode, queryEl);
				Dictionary<string, IJoinNode> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, IJoinNode>();
				XElement xElement = queryEl.Element("Root");
				if (xElement != null)
				{
					IJoinNode joinNode = (selectNode.Root = LoadJoinNode(xElement));
					dictionary.Add(joinNode.ActualName, joinNode);
				}
				XElement xElement2 = queryEl.Element("SubNodes");
				if (xElement2 != null)
				{
					foreach (XElement item in xElement2.Elements("JoinElement"))
					{
						IJoinNode joinNode3 = LoadJoinElement(selectNode, item);
						dictionary.Add(joinNode3.ActualName, joinNode3);
					}
				}
				XElement xElement3 = queryEl.Element("Expressions");
				if (xElement3 != null)
				{
					foreach (XElement item2 in xElement3.Elements("Expression"))
					{
						selectNode.Expressions.Add(LoadISelectExpression(item2, dictionary));
					}
				}
				selectNode.FilterString = queryEl.GetAttributeValue("FilterString");
				selectNode.Meta = TableMetaInfo.Load(queryEl);
				return selectNode;
			}

			private static DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression LoadISelectExpression(XElement columnEl, Dictionary<string, IJoinNode> nodes)
			{
				switch (columnEl.GetAttributeValue("ExpressionType"))
				{
				case "SelectColumnExpression":
				{
					SelectColumnExpression selectColumnExpression = new SelectColumnExpression
					{
						Name = columnEl.GetAttributeValue("Name")
					};
					LoadAlias(columnEl, selectColumnExpression);
					LoadColumnNode(columnEl, selectColumnExpression, nodes);
					return selectColumnExpression;
				}
				case "SelectExpression":
				{
					DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.SelectExpression selectExpression = new DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.SelectExpression();
					LoadAlias(columnEl, selectExpression);
					selectExpression.Expression = columnEl.GetAttributeValue("ColumnExpression");
					return selectExpression;
				}
				case "SelectAllColumnsExpression":
					return new SelectAllColumnsExpression();
				case "SelectAllNodeColumnsExpression":
				{
					SelectAllNodeColumnsExpression selectAllNodeColumnsExpression = new SelectAllNodeColumnsExpression();
					LoadColumnNode(columnEl, selectAllNodeColumnsExpression, nodes);
					return selectAllNodeColumnsExpression;
				}
				case "SelectRowCountExpression":
				{
					SelectRowCountExpression selectRowCountExpression = new SelectRowCountExpression();
					LoadAlias(columnEl, selectRowCountExpression);
					return selectRowCountExpression;
				}
				default:
					throw new InvalidOperationException();
				}
			}

			private static void LoadAlias(XElement columnEl, IAliasedSelectExpression selectColumn)
			{
				selectColumn.Alias = columnEl.GetAttributeValue("Alias");
			}

			private static void LoadColumnNode(XElement columnEl, INodeSelectExpression selectColumn, Dictionary<string, IJoinNode> nodes)
			{
				string attributeValue = columnEl.GetAttributeValue("NodeAlias");
				selectColumn.Node = nodes[attributeValue];
			}

			private IJoinNode LoadJoinElement(SelectNode node, XElement subNodeEl)
			{
				JoinElement joinElement = new JoinElement();
				string attributeValue = subNodeEl.GetAttributeValue("JoinType");
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(attributeValue))
				{
					joinElement.Type = (JoinType)Enum.Parse(typeof(JoinType), attributeValue);
				}
				string attributeValue2 = subNodeEl.GetAttributeValue("Condition");
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(attributeValue2))
				{
					joinElement.Condition = attributeValue2;
				}
				XElement xElement = subNodeEl.Elements("Query").SingleOrDefault();
				if (xElement != null)
				{
					joinElement.Node = LoadJoinNode(xElement);
				}
				node.SubNodes.Add(joinElement);
				return joinElement.Node;
			}

			private UnionNode LoadUnionNode(XElement queryEl)
			{
				UnionNode unionNode = new UnionNode();
				LoadQueryAlias(unionNode, queryEl);
				XElement xElement = queryEl.Element("UnionElements");
				if (xElement != null)
				{
					foreach (XElement item in xElement.Elements("Query"))
					{
						unionNode.Elements.Add(LoadQueryNode(item));
					}
				}
				string attributeValue = queryEl.GetAttributeValue("UnionType");
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(attributeValue))
				{
					unionNode.Type = (UnionType)Enum.Parse(typeof(UnionType), attributeValue);
				}
				unionNode.Meta = TableMetaInfo.Load(queryEl);
				return unionNode;
			}

			private SourceNode LoadSourceNode(XElement queryEl)
			{
				SourceNode sourceNode = new SourceNode();
				LoadQueryAlias(sourceNode, queryEl);
				string sourceName = queryEl.GetAttributeValue("SourceName");
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(sourceName))
				{
					sourceNode.Source = sources.FirstOrDefault((Source s) => s.Name == sourceName);
				}
				sourceNode.Meta = TableMetaInfo.Load(queryEl);
				return sourceNode;
			}

			private static void LoadQueryAlias(IJoinNode node, XElement queryEl)
			{
				node.Alias = queryEl.GetAttributeValue("Alias");
			}
		}

		private const string XML_FederationDataSource = "FederationDataSource";

		private const string XML_Name = "Name";

		private const string XML_Sources = "Sources";

		private const string XML_Source = "Source";

		private const string XML_Queries = "Queries";

		private const string XML_Query = "Query";

		private readonly JoinNodeSerializer joinNodeSerializer;

		private readonly List<Source> sources = new List<Source>();

		protected TDataSource DataSource { get; }

		protected static void SerializeEnumValue(XElement rootEl, string elementName, Type enumType, Enum value, Enum defaultValue)
		{
			if (!object.Equals(value, defaultValue))
			{
				string name = Enum.GetName(enumType, value);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
				{
					rootEl.Add(new XAttribute(elementName, name));
				}
			}
		}

		protected FederationDataSourceSerializerBase(TDataSource dataSource)
		{
			DataSource = dataSource;
			joinNodeSerializer = new JoinNodeSerializer(sources);
		}

		public virtual XElement SaveToXml()
		{
			XElement xElement = new XElement("FederationDataSource");
			SaveName(xElement);
			SaveSources(xElement);
			SaveQueries(xElement);
			return xElement;
		}

		private void SaveName(XElement rootEl)
		{
			if (DataSource.Name != null)
			{
				rootEl.Add(new XAttribute("Name", DataSource.Name));
			}
		}

		private void SaveSources(XElement rootEl)
		{
			if (!DataSource.Sources.Any())
			{
				return;
			}
			XElement xElement = new XElement("Sources");
			foreach (Source source in DataSource.Sources)
			{
				SaveSource(xElement, source);
			}
			rootEl.Add(xElement);
		}

		private void SaveQueries(XElement rootEl)
		{
			if (DataSource.Queries.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			XElement xElement = new XElement("Queries");
			foreach (QueryNode query in DataSource.Queries)
			{
				xElement.Add(joinNodeSerializer.Process(query));
			}
			rootEl.Add(xElement);
		}

		internal void SaveSource(XElement rootEl, Source source)
		{
			XElement xElement = new XElement("Source");
			SaveSourceContents(xElement, source);
			rootEl.Add(xElement);
		}

		protected abstract void SaveSourceContents(XElement sourceEl, Source source);

		public virtual void LoadFromXml(XElement dataSourceEl)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)dataSourceEl, "xElement");
			if (!string.Equals(dataSourceEl.Name.LocalName, "FederationDataSource", StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Incorrect XML root element: <" + dataSourceEl.Name.LocalName + ">, <FederationDataSource> is expected.");
			}
			DataSource.Queries.Clear();
			LoadName(dataSourceEl);
			LoadSources(dataSourceEl);
			LoadQueries(dataSourceEl);
		}

		private void LoadName(XElement dataSourceEl)
		{
			DataSource.Name = dataSourceEl.GetAttributeValue("Name");
		}

		private void LoadSources(XElement dataSourceEl)
		{
			XElement xElement = dataSourceEl.Element("Sources");
			if (xElement == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (XElement item in xElement.Elements("Source"))
			{
				Source source = LoadSource(item);
				if (source != null)
				{
					sources.Add(source);
				}
			}
		}

		protected abstract Source LoadSource(XElement sourceEl);

		private void LoadQueries(XElement dataSourceEl)
		{
			XElement xElement = dataSourceEl.Element("Queries");
			if (xElement == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (XElement item in xElement.Elements("Query"))
			{
				DataSource.Queries.Add(joinNodeSerializer.LoadQueryNode(item));
			}
		}
	}
	public sealed class JoinNodeEqualityComparer : IEqualityComparer<IJoinNode>
	{
		public static bool Equals(IJoinNode x, IJoinNode y)
		{
			return EqualsHelper.ObjectsEquals(x, y, EqualsCore);
		}

		private static bool EqualsCore(IJoinNode x, IJoinNode y)
		{
			return new JoinNodeEqualityAssistant(x).Process(y);
		}

		bool IEqualityComparer<IJoinNode>.Equals(IJoinNode x, IJoinNode y)
		{
			return Equals(x, y);
		}

		int IEqualityComparer<IJoinNode>.GetHashCode(IJoinNode obj)
		{
			return 0;
		}
	}
	internal class QueryNodeSelectSqlSerializer : QueryNodeVisitor
	{
		private class SelectExpressionSqlSerializer : SelectExpressionVisitor<string>
		{
			public static string Serialize(DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression expr)
			{
				return new SelectExpressionSqlSerializer().Process(expr);
			}

			protected override string Visit(SelectColumnExpression col)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(col.Node.Alias) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(col.Alias))
				{
					return Escape(col.Node.Alias) + "." + Escape(col.Name) + " " + Escape(col.Alias);
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(col.Node.Alias))
				{
					return Escape(col.Node.Alias) + "." + Escape(col.Name);
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(col.Alias))
				{
					return Escape(col.Name) + " " + Escape(col.Alias);
				}
				return Escape(col.Name) ?? "";
			}

			protected override string Visit(DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.SelectExpression col)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(col.Alias))
				{
					return col.Expression ?? "";
				}
				return col.Expression + " " + Escape(col.Alias);
			}

			protected override string Visit(SelectAllColumnsExpression col)
			{
				return "*";
			}

			protected override string Visit(SelectAllNodeColumnsExpression col)
			{
				return Escape(col.Node.ActualName) + ".*";
			}

			protected override string Visit(SelectRowCountExpression col)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(col.Alias))
				{
					return "count(*)";
				}
				return "count(*) " + Escape(col.Alias);
			}
		}

		private StringBuilder Current { get; } = new StringBuilder();

		private QueryNodeSelectSqlSerializerMode Mode { get; }

		public static string Serialize(QueryNode query)
		{
			return Serialize(query, QueryNodeSelectSqlSerializerMode.AddSelect | QueryNodeSelectSqlSerializerMode.AddTransform);
		}

		public static string SerializeShort(QueryNode query)
		{
			return Serialize(query, QueryNodeSelectSqlSerializerMode.None);
		}

		private static string Serialize(QueryNode query, QueryNodeSelectSqlSerializerMode mode)
		{
			QueryNodeSelectSqlSerializer queryNodeSelectSqlSerializer = new QueryNodeSelectSqlSerializer(mode);
			queryNodeSelectSqlSerializer.Process(query);
			string query2 = queryNodeSelectSqlSerializer.Current.ToString();
			return AutoSqlWrapHelper.AutoSqlTextWrap(query2, 170);
		}

		private static string GetJoinString(JoinType joinType)
		{
			return joinType switch
			{
				JoinType.Inner => "join ", 
				JoinType.LeftOuter => "left join ", 
				JoinType.RightOuter => "right join ", 
				JoinType.FullOuter => "full join ", 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid joinType: {joinType}."), 
			};
		}

		private static string GetUnionString(UnionType unionType)
		{
			return unionType switch
			{
				UnionType.Union => "union", 
				UnionType.UnionAll => "union all", 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid unionType: {unionType}."), 
			};
		}

		private static string Escape(string s)
		{
			if (!s.Contains(' '))
			{
				return s;
			}
			return "[" + s + "]";
		}

		private QueryNodeSelectSqlSerializer(QueryNodeSelectSqlSerializerMode mode)
		{
			Mode = mode;
		}

		protected override VVoid Visit(SelectNode selectNode)
		{
			if (Mode.HasFlag(QueryNodeSelectSqlSerializerMode.AddSelect))
			{
				Current.Append("select ");
				bool flag = true;
				foreach (DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression expression in selectNode.Expressions)
				{
					if (!flag)
					{
						Current.Append(", ");
					}
					Current.Append(SelectExpressionSqlSerializer.Serialize(expression));
					flag = false;
				}
				Current.AppendLine();
				Current.Append("from ");
			}
			ProcessJoinNode(selectNode.Root);
			foreach (JoinElement subNode in selectNode.SubNodes)
			{
				Current.AppendLine();
				Current.Append(GetJoinString(subNode.Type));
				ProcessJoinNode(subNode.Node);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(subNode.Condition))
				{
					Current.Append(" on " + subNode.Condition);
				}
			}
			return VVoid.V;
		}

		private void ProcessJoinNode(IJoinNode node)
		{
			if (node is SourceNode sourceNode)
			{
				string value = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(sourceNode.Alias) ? Escape(sourceNode.Source.Name) : (Escape(sourceNode.Source.Name) + " " + Escape(sourceNode.Alias)));
				Current.Append(value);
				return;
			}
			QueryNode query = (QueryNode)node;
			Current.AppendLine("(");
			Process(query);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(node.Alias))
			{
				Current.AppendLine(")");
			}
			else
			{
				Current.AppendLine(") " + node.Alias);
			}
		}

		protected override VVoid Visit(UnionNode unionNode)
		{
			bool flag = true;
			foreach (QueryNode element in unionNode.Elements)
			{
				if (!flag)
				{
					Current.AppendLine();
					Current.AppendLine(GetUnionString(unionNode.Type));
				}
				else
				{
					flag = false;
				}
				Process(element);
			}
			return VVoid.V;
		}

		protected override VVoid Visit(TransformationNode transformationNode)
		{
			Current.Append("transform ");
			if (transformationNode == null)
			{
				return VVoid.V;
			}
			ProcessJoinNode(transformationNode.Root);
			if (!Mode.HasFlag(QueryNodeSelectSqlSerializerMode.AddTransform))
			{
				return VVoid.V;
			}
			bool flag = true;
			Current.Append(" ");
			foreach (TransformationRule rule in transformationNode.Rules)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					flag = false;
				}
				else
				{
					Current.AppendLine(",");
				}
				if (rule.Unfold)
				{
					Current.Append("unfold");
					if (rule.Flatten)
					{
						Current.Append(" and flatten");
					}
				}
				else if (rule.Flatten)
				{
					Current.Append(" flatten");
				}
				Current.Append(" " + rule.ColumnName);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(rule.Alias))
				{
					Current.Append(" as " + rule.Alias);
				}
				Current.AppendLine();
			}
			return VVoid.V;
		}
	}
	[Flags]
	internal enum QueryNodeSelectSqlSerializerMode
	{
		None = 0,
		AddSelect = 2,
		AddTransform = 4
	}
	internal abstract class QueryNodeVisitor<T>
	{
		protected T Process(IQueryNode query)
		{
			if (query == null)
			{
				return default(T);
			}
			if (query is SelectNode selectNode)
			{
				return Visit(selectNode);
			}
			if (query is UnionNode unionNode)
			{
				return Visit(unionNode);
			}
			if (query is TransformationNode transformationNode)
			{
				return Visit(transformationNode);
			}
			throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid query type: {query.GetType()}.");
		}

		protected abstract T Visit(SelectNode selectNode);

		protected abstract T Visit(UnionNode unionNode);

		protected abstract T Visit(TransformationNode transformationNode);
	}
	[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential, Size = 1)]
	internal struct VVoid
	{
		public static VVoid V { get; }
	}
	internal abstract class QueryNodeVisitor : QueryNodeVisitor<VVoid>
	{
	}
	internal abstract class JoinNodeVisitor<T> : QueryNodeVisitor<T>
	{
		public T Process(IJoinNode query)
		{
			if (query is SourceNode sourceNode)
			{
				return Visit(sourceNode);
			}
			return Process(query as IQueryNode);
		}

		protected abstract T Visit(SourceNode sourceNode);
	}
	internal abstract class JoinNodeVisitor : JoinNodeVisitor<VVoid>
	{
	}
	public sealed class SelectColumnEqualityComparer : IEqualityComparer<DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression>
	{
		public static bool Equals(DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression x, DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression y)
		{
			return EqualsHelper.ObjectsEquals(x, y, EqualsCore);
		}

		private static bool EqualsCore(DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression x, DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression y)
		{
			if (x is IAliasedSelectExpression x2 && !Equals(x2, y as IAliasedSelectExpression))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (x is INodeSelectExpression x3 && !Equals(x3, y as INodeSelectExpression))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (x is SelectColumnExpression x4 && !Equals(x4, y as SelectColumnExpression))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (x is DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.SelectExpression x5 && !Equals(x5, y as DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.SelectExpression))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool Equals(IAliasedSelectExpression x, IAliasedSelectExpression y)
		{
			return EqualsHelper.ObjectsEquals(x, y, (IAliasedSelectExpression _, IAliasedSelectExpression __) => string.Equals(x.Alias, y.Alias, StringComparison.Ordinal));
		}

		private static bool Equals(INodeSelectExpression x, INodeSelectExpression y)
		{
			return EqualsHelper.ObjectsEquals(x, y, (INodeSelectExpression _, INodeSelectExpression __) => new JoinNodeEqualityAssistant(x.Node).Process(y.Node));
		}

		private static bool Equals(SelectColumnExpression x, SelectColumnExpression y)
		{
			return EqualsHelper.ObjectsEquals(x, y, (SelectColumnExpression _, SelectColumnExpression __) => string.Equals(x.Name, y.Name, StringComparison.Ordinal));
		}

		private static bool Equals(DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.SelectExpression x, DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.SelectExpression y)
		{
			return EqualsHelper.ObjectsEquals(x, y, (DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.SelectExpression _, DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.SelectExpression __) => string.Equals(x.Expression, y.Expression, StringComparison.Ordinal));
		}

		bool IEqualityComparer<DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression>.Equals(DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression x, DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression y)
		{
			return Equals(x, y);
		}

		int IEqualityComparer<DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression>.GetHashCode(DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression obj)
		{
			return 0;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class SelectExpressionVisitor<T>
	{
		protected T Process(DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression expr)
		{
			if (expr == null)
			{
				return default(T);
			}
			if (expr is SelectColumnExpression selectColumnExpression)
			{
				return Visit(selectColumnExpression);
			}
			if (expr is DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.SelectExpression selectExpression)
			{
				return Visit(selectExpression);
			}
			if (expr is SelectAllColumnsExpression selectAllColumnsExpression)
			{
				return Visit(selectAllColumnsExpression);
			}
			if (expr is SelectAllNodeColumnsExpression selectAllNodeColumnsExpression)
			{
				return Visit(selectAllNodeColumnsExpression);
			}
			if (expr is SelectRowCountExpression selectRowCountExpression)
			{
				return Visit(selectRowCountExpression);
			}
			throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid select expression type: {expr.GetType()}.");
		}

		protected abstract T Visit(SelectColumnExpression selectColumnExpression);

		protected abstract T Visit(DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.SelectExpression selectExpression);

		protected abstract T Visit(SelectAllColumnsExpression selectAllColumnsExpression);

		protected abstract T Visit(SelectAllNodeColumnsExpression selectAllNodeColumnsExpression);

		protected abstract T Visit(SelectRowCountExpression selectRowCountExpression);
	}
	internal abstract class SelectExpressionVisitor : SelectExpressionVisitor<VVoid>
	{
	}
	internal class SourceColumnsExtractor : QueryNodeVisitor
	{
		private class CriteriaSourceColumnsExtractor : BaseClientCriteriaVisitor
		{
			private readonly Dictionary<Source, SourceColumnsInfo> to;

			private readonly Dictionary<string, Source> sourceByNodeActualName;

			public static void AddNames(Dictionary<Source, SourceColumnsInfo> to, Dictionary<string, Source> sourceByNodeActualName, string criteriaString)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(criteriaString))
				{
					CriteriaOperator orParse = CriteriaOperatorEx.GetOrParse(criteriaString);
					CriteriaSourceColumnsExtractor criteriaSourceColumnsExtractor = new CriteriaSourceColumnsExtractor(to, sourceByNodeActualName);
					orParse.Accept((ICriteriaVisitor)(object)criteriaSourceColumnsExtractor);
				}
			}

			private CriteriaSourceColumnsExtractor(Dictionary<Source, SourceColumnsInfo> to, Dictionary<string, Source> sourceByNodeActualName)
			{
				this.to = to;
				this.sourceByNodeActualName = sourceByNodeActualName;
			}

			public override void Visit(OperandProperty theOperand)
			{
				string tableAlias;
				string columnName = ColumnNameHelper.GetColumnName(theOperand.PropertyName, out tableAlias, enclose: false, mergeTableName: true);
				if (sourceByNodeActualName.TryGetValue(tableAlias, out var value))
				{
					if (!to.TryGetValue(value, out var value2))
					{
						value2 = (to[value] = new SourceColumnsInfo());
					}
					value2?.Columns.Add(columnName);
				}
			}
		}

		private readonly Dictionary<Source, SourceColumnsInfo> sourceColumnsBySource = new Dictionary<Source, SourceColumnsInfo>(new SourceByNameComparer());

		public static Dictionary<Source, SourceColumnsInfo> Extract(IQueryNode node)
		{
			SourceColumnsExtractor sourceColumnsExtractor = new SourceColumnsExtractor();
			sourceColumnsExtractor.Process(node);
			return sourceColumnsExtractor.sourceColumnsBySource;
		}

		private SourceColumnsExtractor()
		{
		}

		protected override VVoid Visit(SelectNode selectNode)
		{
			Dictionary<string, Source> sourceByNodeActualName = new Dictionary<string, Source>();
			GetColumnsFromNode(selectNode.Root, selectNode.Expressions, sourceByNodeActualName);
			foreach (JoinElement subNode in selectNode.SubNodes)
			{
				GetColumnsFromNode(subNode.Node, selectNode.Expressions, sourceByNodeActualName);
				CriteriaSourceColumnsExtractor.AddNames(sourceColumnsBySource, sourceByNodeActualName, subNode.Condition);
			}
			foreach (DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.SelectExpression item in selectNode.Expressions.OfType<DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.SelectExpression>())
			{
				CriteriaSourceColumnsExtractor.AddNames(sourceColumnsBySource, sourceByNodeActualName, item.Expression);
			}
			CriteriaSourceColumnsExtractor.AddNames(sourceColumnsBySource, sourceByNodeActualName, selectNode.FilterString);
			return VVoid.V;
		}

		private void GetColumnsFromNode(IJoinNode node, List<DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression> selectColumns, Dictionary<string, Source> sourceByNodeActualName)
		{
			if (node is IQueryNode query)
			{
				Process(query);
			}
			if (node is SourceNode sourceNode)
			{
				GetColumnsFromSourceNode(sourceNode, selectColumns, sourceByNodeActualName);
			}
		}

		private void GetColumnsFromSourceNode(SourceNode sourceNode, List<DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression> selectColumns, Dictionary<string, Source> sourceByNodeActualName)
		{
			sourceByNodeActualName[sourceNode.ActualName] = sourceNode.Source;
			SourceColumnsInfo columnsFromSourceNode = GetColumnsFromSourceNode(sourceNode, selectColumns);
			if (sourceColumnsBySource.TryGetValue(sourceNode.Source, out var value))
			{
				if (columnsFromSourceNode != null)
				{
					sourceColumnsBySource[sourceNode.Source] = SourceDataProviderBase.MergeSourceColumnsInfos(value, columnsFromSourceNode);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				sourceColumnsBySource[sourceNode.Source] = columnsFromSourceNode;
			}
		}

		private static SourceColumnsInfo GetColumnsFromSourceNode(SourceNode sourceNode, List<DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression> selectExpressions)
		{
			if (selectExpressions == null)
			{
				return new SourceColumnsInfo
				{
					NeedAllColumns = true
				};
			}
			SourceColumnsInfo sourceColumnsInfo = new SourceColumnsInfo();
			if (selectExpressions.Any((DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression c) => c is SelectAllColumnsExpression))
			{
				sourceColumnsInfo.NeedAllColumns = true;
			}
			if (selectExpressions.OfType<SelectAllNodeColumnsExpression>().Any((SelectAllNodeColumnsExpression c) => c.Node == sourceNode))
			{
				sourceColumnsInfo.NeedAllColumns = true;
			}
			foreach (DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression selectExpression in selectExpressions)
			{
				if (!(selectExpression is SelectAllNodeColumnsExpression) && !(selectExpression is DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.SelectExpression) && selectExpression is SelectColumnExpression selectColumnExpression && selectColumnExpression.Node == sourceNode)
				{
					sourceColumnsInfo.Columns.Add(selectColumnExpression.Name);
				}
			}
			return sourceColumnsInfo;
		}

		protected override VVoid Visit(UnionNode node)
		{
			foreach (QueryNode element in node.Elements)
			{
				Process(element);
			}
			return VVoid.V;
		}

		protected override VVoid Visit(TransformationNode transformationNode)
		{
			Dictionary<string, Source> sourceByNodeActualName = new Dictionary<string, Source>();
			GetColumnsFromNode(transformationNode.Root, null, sourceByNodeActualName);
			return VVoid.V;
		}
	}
	public class SourceColumnsInfo
	{
		public HashSet<string> Columns { get; } = new HashSet<string>();

		public bool NeedAllColumns { get; set; }

		public SourceColumnsInfo()
		{
		}

		public SourceColumnsInfo(IEnumerable<string> columns)
		{
			if (columns != null)
			{
				Columns.AddRange(columns);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class SourceByNameComparer : IEqualityComparer<Source>
	{
		bool IEqualityComparer<Source>.Equals(Source x, Source y)
		{
			return x.Name == y.Name;
		}

		int IEqualityComparer<Source>.GetHashCode(Source obj)
		{
			return obj.Name.GetHashCode();
		}
	}
	internal class FederationDataSourceXmlSerializer : FederationDataSourceSerializerBase<FederationDataSource>
	{
		private const string XML_Relations = "Relations";

		private const string XML_MasterDetailInfo = "Relation";

		private const string XML_MasterDetailInfoName = "RelationName";

		private const string XML_MasterQueryName = "MasterQueryName";

		private const string XML_DetailQueryName = "DetailQueryName";

		private const string XML_MasterDetailKeyColumns = "KeyColumns";

		private const string XML_RelationKeyColumn = "KeyColumn";

		private const string XML_ParentKeyColumn = "Parent";

		private const string XML_NestedKeyColumn = "Nested";

		private const string XML_ConditionOperator = "Operator";

		private const string XML_SourceName = "SourceName";

		private const string XML_DataMember = "DataMember";

		private static void SaveRelation(XElement relationsEl, FederationMasterDetailInfo info)
		{
			XElement xElement = new XElement("Relation");
			if (info.HasCustomName)
			{
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("RelationName", info.Name));
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(info.MasterQueryName))
			{
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("MasterQueryName", info.MasterQueryName));
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(info.DetailQueryName))
			{
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("DetailQueryName", info.DetailQueryName));
			}
			if (info.KeyColumns.Count > 0)
			{
				XElement xElement2 = new XElement("KeyColumns");
				foreach (FederationRelationColumnInfo keyColumn in info.KeyColumns)
				{
					xElement2.Add(SerializeRelationKeyColumn(keyColumn));
				}
				xElement.Add(xElement2);
			}
			relationsEl.Add(xElement);
		}

		private static XElement SerializeRelationKeyColumn(FederationRelationColumnInfo keyColumnInfo)
		{
			XElement xElement = new XElement("KeyColumn");
			xElement.Add(new XAttribute("Parent", keyColumnInfo.ParentKeyColumn));
			xElement.Add(new XAttribute("Nested", keyColumnInfo.NestedKeyColumn));
			FederationDataSourceSerializerBase<FederationDataSource>.SerializeEnumValue(xElement, "Operator", typeof(FederationConditionType), keyColumnInfo.ConditionOperator, FederationConditionType.Equal);
			return xElement;
		}

		public FederationDataSourceXmlSerializer(FederationDataSource dataSource)
			: base(dataSource)
		{
		}

		protected override Source LoadSource(XElement sourceEl)
		{
			Source source = new Source
			{
				Name = sourceEl.GetAttributeValue("SourceName"),
				DataMember = sourceEl.GetAttributeValue("DataMember")
			};
			if (base.DataSource.SerializableSourceMap.TryGetDataSource(source.Name, out var dataSource))
			{
				source.DataSource = dataSource;
			}
			return source;
		}

		protected override void SaveSourceContents(XElement sourceEl, Source source)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(source.Name))
			{
				sourceEl.Add(new XAttribute("SourceName", source.Name));
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(source.DataMember))
			{
				sourceEl.Add(new XAttribute("DataMember", source.DataMember));
			}
		}

		public override XElement SaveToXml()
		{
			XElement xElement = base.SaveToXml();
			SaveRelations(xElement);
			return xElement;
		}

		protected void SaveRelations(XElement rootEl)
		{
			if (base.DataSource.Relations.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			XElement xElement = new XElement("Relations");
			foreach (FederationMasterDetailInfo relation in base.DataSource.Relations)
			{
				SaveRelation(xElement, relation);
			}
			rootEl.Add(xElement);
		}

		public override void LoadFromXml(XElement dataSourceEl)
		{
			base.DataSource.Relations.Clear();
			base.LoadFromXml(dataSourceEl);
			LoadRelations(dataSourceEl);
		}

		private void LoadRelations(XElement dataSourceEl)
		{
			XElement xElement = dataSourceEl.Element("Relations");
			if (xElement == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (XElement item in xElement.Elements("Relation"))
			{
				FederationMasterDetailInfo federationMasterDetailInfo = new FederationMasterDetailInfo
				{
					MasterQueryName = item.GetAttributeValue("MasterQueryName"),
					DetailQueryName = item.GetAttributeValue("DetailQueryName")
				};
				string attributeValue = item.GetAttributeValue("RelationName");
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(attributeValue))
				{
					federationMasterDetailInfo.Name = attributeValue;
				}
				XElement xElement2 = item.Element("KeyColumns");
				if (xElement2 != null)
				{
					foreach (XElement item2 in xElement2.Elements("KeyColumn"))
					{
						federationMasterDetailInfo.KeyColumns.Add(DeserializeRelationKeyColumn(item2));
					}
				}
				base.DataSource.Relations.Add(federationMasterDetailInfo);
			}
		}

		private static FederationRelationColumnInfo DeserializeRelationKeyColumn(XElement keyColEl)
		{
			FederationRelationColumnInfo federationRelationColumnInfo = new FederationRelationColumnInfo
			{
				ParentKeyColumn = keyColEl.GetAttributeValue("Parent"),
				NestedKeyColumn = keyColEl.GetAttributeValue("Nested")
			};
			string attributeValue = keyColEl.GetAttributeValue("Operator");
			if (attributeValue != null)
			{
				federationRelationColumnInfo.ConditionOperator = (FederationConditionType)Enum.Parse(typeof(FederationConditionType), attributeValue);
			}
			return federationRelationColumnInfo;
		}
	}
	internal class FederationResultBuilder : JoinNodeVisitor<ITypedColumnarData>
	{
		private class ExpressionDescriptor : CriteriaCompilerDescriptor
		{
			private readonly ITypedColumnarData data;

			public override Type ObjectType => typeof(Row);

			public ExpressionDescriptor(ITypedColumnarData data)
			{
				this.data = data;
			}

			public override System.Linq.Expressions.Expression MakePropertyAccess(System.Linq.Expressions.Expression baseExpression, string propertyPath)
			{
				ITypedColumn typedColumn = data[propertyPath];
				MemberExpression index = System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Property(baseExpression, "Index");
				return typedColumn.GetValue(index);
			}
		}

		private class ExpressionReader : ITypedColumnarDataReader
		{
			private readonly Delegate[] getters;

			private readonly int rowCount;

			public string[] Fields { get; }

			public Type[] Types { get; }

			private int Current { get; set; } = -1;

			int ITypedColumnarDataReader.FieldCount => getters.Length;

			public ExpressionReader(ITypedColumnarData source, DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.SelectExpression[] customExpressions, IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters, Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>>> renamingMaps)
			{
				rowCount = source.RowCount;
				getters = new Delegate[customExpressions.Length];
				Fields = new string[customExpressions.Length];
				Types = new Type[customExpressions.Length];
				ExpressionDescriptor expressionDescriptor = new ExpressionDescriptor(source);
				for (int i = 0; i < customExpressions.Length; i++)
				{
					DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.SelectExpression selectExpression = customExpressions[i];
					CriteriaOperator criteriaOperator = FilterHelper.GetCriteriaOperator(selectExpression.Expression, sourceParameters);
					CriteriaOperator val = SelectNodeCriteriaRenamer.CreateRenamed(criteriaOperator, renamingMaps);
					Delegate obj = CriteriaCompiler.ToLambda(val, (CriteriaCompilerDescriptor)(object)expressionDescriptor).Compile();
					getters[i] = obj;
					Types[i] = obj.Method.ReturnType;
					Fields[i] = selectExpression.ActualName;
				}
			}

			public ITypedColumn[] CreateColumns()
			{
				return Enumerable.Range(0, getters.Length).Select((int f, int i) => TypedColumn.NewList(Types[i], Fields[i])).ToArray();
			}

			string ITypedColumnarDataReader.GetFieldName(int i)
			{
				return Fields[i];
			}

			Type ITypedColumnarDataReader.GetFieldType(int i)
			{
				return Types[i];
			}

			T ITypedColumnarDataReader.GetValue<T>(int col)
			{
				object obj = getters[col].DynamicInvoke(new Row(Current));
				return (T)obj;
			}

			public bool Read()
			{
				Current++;
				if (Current >= 0)
				{
					return Current < rowCount;
				}
				return false;
			}

			bool ITypedColumnarDataReader.Seek(int index)
			{
				Current = index;
				if (Current >= 0)
				{
					return Current < rowCount;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private class Row
		{
			public int Index { get; }

			public Row(int index)
			{
				Index = index;
			}
		}

		private class ComplexColumnDataReader<TColumn> : ITypedColumnarDataReader
		{
			private readonly ITypedColumn source;

			private readonly int rowCount;

			private readonly IList<PropertyDescriptor> properties;

			private readonly Delegate getter;

			private TColumn currentValue;

			public int FieldCount => properties.Count;

			private int Current { get; set; } = -1;

			public ComplexColumnDataReader(ITypedColumn source, IList<PropertyDescriptor> properties)
			{
				this.source = source;
				rowCount = source.RowCount;
				this.properties = properties;
				getter = source.GetGetValue();
			}

			public string GetFieldName(int i)
			{
				return properties[i].Name;
			}

			public Type GetFieldType(int i)
			{
				return properties[i].PropertyType;
			}

			public T GetValue<T>(int i)
			{
				return (T)properties[i].GetValue(currentValue);
			}

			public bool Read()
			{
				Current++;
				Func<int, TColumn> func = (Func<int, TColumn>)getter;
				bool flag = Current >= 0 && Current < rowCount;
				if (flag)
				{
					currentValue = func(Current);
				}
				return flag;
			}

			public bool Seek(int index)
			{
				Current = index;
				Func<int, TColumn> func = (Func<int, TColumn>)getter;
				bool flag = Current >= 0 && Current < rowCount;
				if (flag)
				{
					currentValue = func(Current);
				}
				return flag;
			}
		}

		private class NestedEnumerableDataReader : ITypedColumnarDataReader
		{
			private readonly string name;

			private readonly Type elementType;

			private readonly IEnumerator enumerator;

			public int FieldCount => 1;

			public NestedEnumerableDataReader(string name, IEnumerable value, Type elementType)
			{
				this.name = name;
				this.elementType = elementType;
				enumerator = value.GetEnumerator();
			}

			public string GetFieldName(int i)
			{
				return name;
			}

			public Type GetFieldType(int i)
			{
				return elementType;
			}

			public T GetValue<T>(int i)
			{
				return (T)enumerator.Current;
			}

			public bool Read()
			{
				return enumerator.MoveNext();
			}

			public bool Seek(int index)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
		}

		private readonly Dictionary<string, ITypedColumnarData> sourceDatas;

		private readonly IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters;

		private CancellationToken token;

		public static ITypedColumnarData Process(IQueryNode node, Dictionary<string, ITypedColumnarData> sourceDatas, IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters, CancellationToken token)
		{
			return new FederationResultBuilder(sourceDatas, sourceParameters).Process(node, token);
		}

		private FederationResultBuilder(Dictionary<string, ITypedColumnarData> sourceDatas, IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters)
		{
			this.sourceDatas = sourceDatas;
			this.sourceParameters = sourceParameters;
		}

		private ITypedColumnarData Process(IQueryNode node, CancellationToken token)
		{
			this.token = token;
			return Process(node);
		}

		protected override ITypedColumnarData Visit(SourceNode node)
		{
			if (!sourceDatas.TryGetValue(node.Source.Name, out var value))
			{
				throw new Exception("Data for the " + node.Source.Name + " source cannot be found.");
			}
			return value;
		}

		protected override ITypedColumnarData Visit(SelectNode node)
		{
			IUniqueNameProvider names = new UniqueNameProvider();
			Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>>> dictionary = RegisterSelectedNames(node, names);
			ITypedColumnarData data = Process(node.Root);
			ITypedColumnarData typedColumnarData = Rename(data, dictionary[node.Root.ActualName], names);
			foreach (JoinElement subNode in node.SubNodes)
			{
				ITypedColumnarData data2 = Process(subNode.Node);
				ITypedColumnarData detail = Rename(data2, dictionary[subNode.Node.ActualName], names);
				CriteriaOperator criteriaOperator = FilterHelper.GetCriteriaOperator(subNode.Condition, sourceParameters);
				CriteriaOperator condition = SelectNodeCriteriaRenamer.CreateRenamed(criteriaOperator, dictionary);
				typedColumnarData = ((IJoiner)Joiner.Instance).Join(typedColumnarData, detail, subNode.Type, condition, token);
			}
			CriteriaOperator criteriaOperator2 = FilterHelper.GetCriteriaOperator(node.FilterString, sourceParameters);
			if (!CriteriaProcessingExtensions.ReferenceEqualsNull(criteriaOperator2))
			{
				CriteriaOperator filter = SelectNodeCriteriaRenamer.CreateRenamed(criteriaOperator2, dictionary);
				typedColumnarData = typedColumnarData.Filter(filter, token);
			}
			Dictionary<string, ITypedColumn> expressionColumns = CalculateExpressions(typedColumnarData, node.Expressions, dictionary).ToDictionary((ITypedColumn c) => c.Name);
			return SelectExpressions(typedColumnarData, node.Expressions, dictionary, expressionColumns);
		}

		private ITypedColumn[] CalculateExpressions(ITypedColumnarData result, IEnumerable<DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression> expressions, Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>>> renamingMaps)
		{
			DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.SelectExpression[] array = expressions.OfType<DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.SelectExpression>().ToArray();
			if (array.Length == 0)
			{
				return new ITypedColumn[0];
			}
			ExpressionReader expressionReader = new ExpressionReader(result, array, sourceParameters, renamingMaps);
			ITypedColumn[] array2 = expressionReader.CreateColumns();
			for (int i = 0; i < result.RowCount; i++)
			{
				if (token.IsCancellationRequested)
				{
					break;
				}
				expressionReader.Read();
				for (int j = 0; j < array2.Length; j++)
				{
					array2[j].Read(expressionReader, j);
				}
			}
			return array2;
		}

		private static ITypedColumnarData SelectExpressions(ITypedColumnarData data, IList<DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression> expressions, Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>>> renamingMaps, Dictionary<string, ITypedColumn> expressionColumns)
		{
			List<ITypedColumn> list = new List<ITypedColumn>();
			HashSet<string> hashSet = new HashSet<string>(from expr in expressions.OfType<IAliasedSelectExpression>()
				select expr.ActualName);
			foreach (DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression expression in expressions)
			{
				if (expression is SelectColumnExpression selectColumnExpression)
				{
					Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>> dictionary = renamingMaps[selectColumnExpression.Node.ActualName];
					HashSet<string> value = null;
					string text;
					if (dictionary.TryGetValue(selectColumnExpression.Name, out value))
					{
						text = value.First();
						value.Remove(text);
					}
					else
					{
						text = selectColumnExpression.ActualName;
					}
					ITypedColumn typedColumn = data[text];
					if (typedColumn != null)
					{
						list.Add(typedColumn);
					}
				}
				else if (expression is SelectAllColumnsExpression)
				{
					foreach (ITypedColumn datum in data)
					{
						if (!datum.Name.Contains("."))
						{
							string text2 = NameGenerator.GenerateUniqueName(datum.Name, hashSet);
							hashSet.Add(text2);
							list.Add(datum.LightClone(text2));
						}
					}
				}
				else if (expression is SelectAllNodeColumnsExpression selectAllNodeColumnsExpression)
				{
					Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>> dictionary2 = renamingMaps[selectAllNodeColumnsExpression.Node.ActualName];
					foreach (KeyValuePair<string, HashSet<string>> item in dictionary2)
					{
						ITypedColumn typedColumn2 = data[item.Value.FirstOrDefault() ?? item.Key];
						if (!typedColumn2.Name.Contains("."))
						{
							string text3 = NameGenerator.GenerateUniqueName(item.Key, hashSet);
							hashSet.Add(text3);
							list.Add(typedColumn2.LightClone(text3));
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (!(expression is DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.SelectExpression selectExpression))
					{
						throw new NotSupportedException();
					}
					if (expressionColumns.TryGetValue(selectExpression.ActualName, out var value2))
					{
						list.Add(value2);
					}
				}
			}
			return new TypedColumnarData(list);
		}

		protected override ITypedColumnarData Visit(TransformationNode node)
		{
			ITypedColumnarData typedColumnarData = Process(node.Root);
			Dictionary<string, string> dictionary = node.Rules.Where((TransformationRule c) => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(c.Alias)).ToDictionary((TransformationRule c) => c.ColumnName, (TransformationRule c) => c.Alias);
			foreach (ITypedColumn item in typedColumnarData)
			{
				if (dictionary.TryGetValue(item.Name, out var value))
				{
					item.Name = value;
				}
			}
			Dictionary<string, ITypedColumnWithDetails> namedDetails = typedColumnarData.OfType<ITypedColumnWithDetails>().ToDictionary((ITypedColumnWithDetails c) => c.Name, (ITypedColumnWithDetails c) => c);
			Dictionary<string, PropertyDescriptor[]> typedLists = new Dictionary<string, PropertyDescriptor[]>();
			ITypedColumnarData data = Unfold(node, typedColumnarData, typedLists);
			return Flatten(node, data, namedDetails, typedLists);
		}

		private static ITypedColumnarData Unfold(TransformationNode node, ITypedColumnarData result, Dictionary<string, PropertyDescriptor[]> typedLists)
		{
			HashSet<string> hashSet = new HashSet<string>(from c in node.Rules
				where c.Unfold
				select c.ActualName);
			if (hashSet.Count <= 0)
			{
				return result;
			}
			ITypedColumn[] array = result.ToArray();
			for (int num = 0; num < array.Length; num++)
			{
				if (hashSet.Contains(array[num].Name))
				{
					array = UnfoldColumn(array, num, typedLists);
				}
			}
			result = new TypedColumnarData(array);
			return result;
		}

		private static ITypedColumn[] UnfoldColumn(ITypedColumn[] existing, int index, Dictionary<string, PropertyDescriptor[]> typedLists)
		{
			ITypedColumn typedColumn = existing[index];
			if (!TypeHelper.CanUnfold(typedColumn.Type, out var columnItemType))
			{
				return existing;
			}
			ITypedColumnarData source = new TypedColumnarData(existing);
			ITypedColumnarDataReader reader = new TypedColumnarDataReader(source);
			ITypedColumn[] array = existing.Select((ITypedColumn c, int i) => (i != index) ? TypedColumn.NewChunkedList(reader.GetFieldType(i), c) : TypedColumn.NewChunkedList(columnItemType, c.Name)).ToArray();
			ITypedColumn[] array2 = array;
			while (reader.Read())
			{
				string name = array2[index].Name;
				IEnumerable value = reader.GetValue<IEnumerable>(index);
				if (value == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (!typedLists.ContainsKey(name) && typeof(ITypedList).IsAssignableFrom(existing[index].Type))
				{
					ITypedList typedList = value as ITypedList;
					Type type = typedList?.GetType();
					if (type != null && (!type.IsGenericType || !(type.GetGenericTypeDefinition() == typeof(XPCollection<>))))
					{
						typedLists.Add(name, typedList.GetItemProperties(null).OfType<PropertyDescriptor>().ToArray());
					}
				}
				NestedEnumerableDataReader nestedEnumerableDataReader = new NestedEnumerableDataReader(existing[index].Name, value, columnItemType);
				while (nestedEnumerableDataReader.Read())
				{
					for (int num = 0; num < existing.Length; num++)
					{
						if (num == index)
						{
							array2[num].Read(nestedEnumerableDataReader, 0);
						}
						else
						{
							array2[num].Read(reader, num);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return array2.ToArray();
		}

		private static ITypedColumnarData Flatten(TransformationNode node, ITypedColumnarData data, Dictionary<string, ITypedColumnWithDetails> namedDetails, Dictionary<string, PropertyDescriptor[]> typedLists)
		{
			return Flatten(node, data, "_", namedDetails, typedLists);
		}

		internal static ITypedColumnarData FlattenComplexColumn(string columnName, ITypedColumnarData data)
		{
			TransformationNode node = new TransformationNode
			{
				Rules = 
				{
					new TransformationRule
					{
						ColumnName = columnName,
						Flatten = true
					}
				}
			};
			return Flatten(node, data, ".", new Dictionary<string, ITypedColumnWithDetails>(), new Dictionary<string, PropertyDescriptor[]>());
		}

		private static ITypedColumnarData Flatten(TransformationNode node, ITypedColumnarData data, string separator, Dictionary<string, ITypedColumnWithDetails> namedDetails, Dictionary<string, PropertyDescriptor[]> typedLists)
		{
			HashSet<string> hashSet = new HashSet<string>(from c in node.Rules
				where c.Flatten
				select c.ActualName);
			if (hashSet.Count <= 0)
			{
				return data;
			}
			HashSet<string> existingNames = new HashSet<string>(data.Select((ITypedColumn c) => c.Name));
			List<ITypedColumn> list = new List<ITypedColumn>();
			List<ITypedColumn> list2 = new List<ITypedColumn>();
			List<ITypedColumn> list3 = new List<ITypedColumn>();
			foreach (ITypedColumn column in data)
			{
				if (hashSet.Contains(column.Name))
				{
					List<PropertyDescriptor> list4 = null;
					List<PropertyDescriptor> properties;
					ITypedColumnWithDetails value2;
					if (typedLists.TryGetValue(column.Name, out var value))
					{
						list4 = value.ToList();
					}
					else if (TypeHelper.CanFlatten(column.Type, out properties))
					{
						list4 = properties;
					}
					else if (namedDetails.TryGetValue(column.Name, out value2))
					{
						list4 = value2.Details.ToList();
					}
					if (list4 != null)
					{
						ITypedColumnarDataReader typedColumnarDataReader = ActivatorEx.New<ITypedColumnarDataReader>(typeof(ComplexColumnDataReader<>), new Type[1] { column.Type }, new object[2] { column, list4 });
						TypedColumn[] array = list4.Select((PropertyDescriptor p) => TypedColumn.NewChunkedList(p.PropertyType, NameGenerator.GenerateUniqueName(column.Name + separator + p.Name, existingNames))).ToArray();
						while (typedColumnarDataReader.Read())
						{
							for (int num = 0; num < array.Length; num++)
							{
								array[num].Read(typedColumnarDataReader, num);
							}
						}
						list3.AddRange(array);
						continue;
					}
				}
				list.Add(column);
				list2.Add(TypedColumn.NewList(column.Type, column));
			}
			TypedColumnarDataReader typedColumnarDataReader2 = new TypedColumnarDataReader(new TypedColumnarData(list));
			while (typedColumnarDataReader2.Read())
			{
				for (int num2 = 0; num2 < list.Count; num2++)
				{
					list2[num2].Read(typedColumnarDataReader2, num2);
				}
			}
			return new TypedColumnarData(list2.Union(list3));
		}

		protected override ITypedColumnarData Visit(UnionNode node)
		{
			ITypedColumnarData typedColumnarData = Process(node.Elements.First());
			switch (node.Type)
			{
			case UnionType.Union:
				foreach (QueryNode item in node.Elements.Skip(1))
				{
					typedColumnarData = Uniter.Unite(typedColumnarData, Process(item));
				}
				break;
			case UnionType.UnionAll:
				foreach (QueryNode item2 in node.Elements.Skip(1))
				{
					typedColumnarData = UnionAllUniter.Unite(typedColumnarData, Process(item2));
				}
				break;
			default:
				throw new ArgumentException();
			}
			return typedColumnarData;
		}

		private static Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>>> RegisterSelectedNames(SelectNode node, IUniqueNameProvider names)
		{
			Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>>> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>>>();
			dictionary[node.Root.ActualName] = RegisterSelectedNames(node.Expressions, node.Root, names);
			foreach (JoinElement subNode in node.SubNodes)
			{
				dictionary[subNode.Node.ActualName] = RegisterSelectedNames(node.Expressions, subNode.Node, names);
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		private static Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>> RegisterSelectedNames(List<DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression> selectedExpressions, IJoinNode node, IUniqueNameProvider names)
		{
			Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>>();
			foreach (INodeSelectExpression item2 in from c in selectedExpressions.OfType<INodeSelectExpression>()
				where c.Node == node
				select c)
			{
				if (!(item2 is SelectAllNodeColumnsExpression))
				{
					if (!(item2 is SelectColumnExpression selectColumnExpression))
					{
						throw new NotSupportedException();
					}
					string item = names.NextName(selectColumnExpression.ActualName);
					HashSet<string> value = null;
					if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(selectColumnExpression.Name, out value))
					{
						value = (dictionary[selectColumnExpression.Name] = new HashSet<string>());
					}
					value.Add(item);
				}
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		private static ITypedColumnarData Rename(ITypedColumnarData data, Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>> renamingMap, IUniqueNameProvider names)
		{
			List<ITypedColumn> list = new List<ITypedColumn>();
			foreach (ITypedColumn datum in data)
			{
				string name = datum.Name;
				HashSet<string> value = null;
				if (!renamingMap.TryGetValue(name, out value))
				{
					value = (renamingMap[name] = new HashSet<string>());
					value.Add(names.NextName(name));
				}
				foreach (string item in value)
				{
					if (item == name)
					{
						list.Add(datum);
					}
					else
					{
						list.Add(datum.LightClone(item));
					}
				}
			}
			return new TypedColumnarData(list);
		}
	}
	internal class SelectNodeCriteriaRenamer : BaseClientCriteriaPatcher
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>>> renamingMaps;

		public static CriteriaOperator CreateRenamed(CriteriaOperator criteria, Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>>> renamingMaps)
		{
			if (renamingMaps.Count == 0 || renamingMaps.All((KeyValuePair<string, Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>>> p) => p.Value.Count == 0))
			{
				return CriteriaOperator.Clone(criteria);
			}
			return new SelectNodeCriteriaRenamer(renamingMaps).Process(criteria);
		}

		private SelectNodeCriteriaRenamer(Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>>> renamingMaps)
		{
			this.renamingMaps = renamingMaps;
		}

		public override CriteriaOperator Visit(OperandProperty theOperand)
		{
			//IL_0043: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0049: Expected O, but got Unknown
			string tableAlias;
			string columnName = ColumnNameHelper.GetColumnName(theOperand.PropertyName, out tableAlias, enclose: false, mergeTableName: true);
			Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>> value = null;
			if (!renamingMaps.TryGetValue(tableAlias, out value))
			{
				return (CriteriaOperator)(object)theOperand;
			}
			HashSet<string> value2 = null;
			string text = null;
			text = ((!value.TryGetValue(columnName, out value2)) ? columnName : value2.First());
			return (CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty(text);
		}
	}
	internal class SourceExtractor : JoinNodeVisitor<IEnumerable<Source>>
	{
		public static IEnumerable<Source> Extract(IJoinNode node)
		{
			return new SourceExtractor().Process(node);
		}

		private SourceExtractor()
		{
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<Source> Visit(SelectNode selectNode)
		{
			List<Source> list = new List<Source>();
			if (selectNode.Root != null)
			{
				list.AddRange(Process(selectNode.Root));
			}
			foreach (JoinElement subNode in selectNode.SubNodes)
			{
				list.AddRange(Process(subNode.Node));
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<Source> Visit(UnionNode unionNode)
		{
			return unionNode.Elements.SelectMany(base.Process).Distinct();
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<Source> Visit(SourceNode sourceNode)
		{
			yield return sourceNode.Source;
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<Source> Visit(TransformationNode transformationNode)
		{
			if (transformationNode.Root != null)
			{
				return Process(transformationNode.Root);
			}
			return Enumerable.Empty<Source>();
		}
	}
	internal class TopLevelSelectExpressionExtractor : QueryNodeVisitor<IEnumerable<DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression>>
	{
		public static IEnumerable<DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression> Extract(IQueryNode node)
		{
			return new TopLevelSelectExpressionExtractor().Process(node);

		{
			return selectNode.Expressions;
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression> Visit(UnionNode unionNode)
		{
			return Process(unionNode.Elements[0]);
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression> Visit(TransformationNode transformationNode)
		{
			return Enumerable.Empty<DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression>();
		}
	}
	internal interface IUniqueNameProvider
	{
		string NextName(string baseName);
	}
	internal class UniqueNameProvider : IUniqueNameProvider
	{
		private readonly HashSet<string> existing;

		public UniqueNameProvider()
		{
			existing = new HashSet<string>();
		}

		string IUniqueNameProvider.NextName(string baseName)
		{
			if (existing.Add(baseName))
			{
				return baseName;
			}
			int num = 0;
			string text2;
			while (true)
			{
				num++;
				if (num >= int.MaxValue)
				{
					string text = baseName.Substring(0, baseName.Length - 1);
					if (text == baseName)
					{
						throw new Exception("Cannot create a new name.");
					}
					baseName = text;
					num = 0;
				}
				else
				{
					text2 = baseName + "_" + num;
					if (existing.Add(text2))
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return text2;
		}
	}
	public class FederationResultSet : ResultSetBase
	{
		private readonly FederationDataSource dataSource;

		public override string Name => dataSource?.Name;

		public FederationResultSet()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		public FederationResultSet(FederationDataSource dataSource)
		{
			this.dataSource = dataSource;
		}

		public FederationResultSet(FederationDataSource dataSource, IEnumerable<FederationResultTable> collection)
		{
			this.dataSource = dataSource;
			tablesList = new List<ResultTable>(collection);
			glossary = null;
		}

		public override object Clone()
		{
			IEnumerable<FederationResultTable> collection = base.Tables.Select((ResultTable resultTable) => (FederationResultTable)resultTable.Clone()).ToArray();
			return new FederationResultSet(dataSource, collection);
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.DataFederation.Union
{
	internal class UnionAllTypedColumn<T> : TypedColumn<T>
	{
		private readonly ITypedColumn col1;

		private readonly ITypedColumn col2;

		private readonly Func<int, T> getCol1Value;

		private readonly Func<int, T> getCol2Value;

		private readonly IList list;

		public override int RowCount => col1.RowCount + col2.RowCount;

		public UnionAllTypedColumn(ITypedColumn col1, ITypedColumn col2)
			: this(col1.Name, col1, col2)
		{
		}

		public UnionAllTypedColumn(string columnName, ITypedColumn col1, ITypedColumn col2)
			: base(columnName)
		{
			this.col1 = col1;
			this.col2 = col2;
			getCol1Value = col1.GetGetOrConvertValue<T>();
			getCol2Value = col2.GetGetOrConvertValue<T>();
			list = new TypedColumnList<T>(this);
		}

		public override IList GetList()
		{
			return list;
		}

		public override T GetValue(int index)
		{
			if (index < col1.RowCount)
			{
				return getCol1Value(index);
			}
			return getCol2Value(index - col1.RowCount);
		}

		public override System.Linq.Expressions.Expression GetValue(System.Linq.Expressions.Expression index)

			return System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Condition(System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.LessThan(index, System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Constant(col1.RowCount)), value.Convert<T>(), value2.Convert<T>());
		}

		}

	internal static class UnionAllUniter
	{
		public static ITypedColumnarData Unite(ITypedColumnarData first, ITypedColumnarData second)
		{
			if (first.Count() != second.Count())
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Number of columns in united data sets should be equal.");
			}
			TypedColumn[] columns = first.Zip(second, delegate(ITypedColumn cFirst, ITypedColumn cSecond)
			{
				if (!UnionHelper.TryGetUnionType(cFirst.Type, cSecond.Type, out var type))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException();
				}
				return TypedColumn.NewUnionAll(type, cFirst, cSecond);
			}).ToArray();
			return new TypedColumnarData(columns);
		}
	}

	{
