		public static bool TryGetUnionType(Type first, Type second, out Type type)
		{
			type = null;
			if (first == second)
			{
				type = first;
				return true;
			}
			if (first.IsClass ^ second.IsClass)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (first.IsClass)
			{
				if (first.IsAssignableFrom(second))
				{
					type = first;
					return true;
				}
				if (second.IsAssignableFrom(first))
				{
					type = second;
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			Type boxedType = NullableHelpers.GetBoxedType(first);
			Type boxedType2 = NullableHelpers.GetBoxedType(second);
			bool flag = boxedType != first;
			bool flag2 = boxedType2 != second;
			if (boxedType == boxedType2)
			{
				type = (flag ? first : (flag2 ? second : null));
				return true;
			}
			HashSet<Type> value;
			bool flag3 = ImplicitConversions.TryGetValue(boxedType, out value);
			HashSet<Type> value2;
			bool flag4 = ImplicitConversions.TryGetValue(boxedType2, out value2);
			if (!flag3 && !flag4)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool makeNullable = flag || flag2;
			if (flag3 && value.Contains(boxedType2))
			{
				type = MakeResultType(second, flag2, makeNullable);
				return true;
			}
			if (flag4 && value2.Contains(boxedType))
			{
				type = MakeResultType(first, flag, makeNullable);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static Type MakeResultType(Type type, bool typeNullable, bool makeNullable)
		{
			if (!makeNullable)
			{
				return type;
			}
			if (!typeNullable)
			{
				return NullableHelpers.MakeNullableType(type);
			}
			return type;
		}
	}
	internal static class Uniter
	{
		private abstract class UnionColumnBase
		{
			public static UnionColumnBase New(Type type, ITypedColumn first, ITypedColumn second)
			{
				return ActivatorEx.New<UnionColumnBase>(typeof(UnionColumn<>), type, new object[2] { first, second });
			}

			public abstract bool Equals(int index1, int index2);

			public abstract int GetHashCode(int index);
		}

		private class UnionColumn<T> : UnionColumnBase
		{
			private readonly IEqualityComparer<T> comparer;

			private readonly Func<int, T> getValue;

			public UnionColumn(ITypedColumn first, ITypedColumn second)
			{
				comparer = EqualityComparer<T>.Default;
				ParameterExpression parameterExpression = System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Parameter(typeof(int));
				System.Linq.Expressions.Expression value = first.GetValue(parameterExpression);
				System.Linq.Expressions.Expression value2 = second.GetValue(System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Subtract(parameterExpression, System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Constant(first.RowCount)));
				System.Linq.Expressions.ConditionalExpression body = System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Condition(System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.LessThan(parameterExpression, System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Constant(first.RowCount)), value.Convert<T>(), value2.Convert<T>());
				getValue = (Func<int, T>)System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Lambda(body, parameterExpression).Compile();
			}

			public override bool Equals(int index1, int index2)
			{
				return comparer.Equals(getValue(index1), getValue(index2));
			}

			public override int GetHashCode(int index)
			{
				return comparer.GetHashCode(getValue(index));
			}
		}

		private class UnionTupleEqualityComparer : IEqualityComparer<int>
		{
			private readonly UnionColumnBase[] columns;

			public UnionTupleEqualityComparer(UnionColumnBase[] columns)
			{
				this.columns = columns;
			}

			public bool Equals(int x, int y)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < columns.Length; i++)
				{
					if (!columns[i].Equals(x, y))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}

			public int GetHashCode(int index)
			{
				int num = HashCodeHelper.Start();
				for (int i = 0; i < columns.Length; i++)
				{
					int hashCode = columns[i].GetHashCode(index);
					num = HashCodeHelper.Combine(num, hashCode);
				}
				return HashCodeHelper.Finish(num);
			}
		}

		private class SelectingReader : ITypedColumnarDataReader
		{
			private readonly Type[] types;

			private readonly string[] names;

			private readonly Delegate[] getFirstValue;

			private readonly Delegate[] getSecondValue;

			private readonly int[] rows;

			private readonly int firstCount;

			private int current = -1;

			int ITypedColumnarDataReader.FieldCount => names.Length;

			public SelectingReader(Type[] types, ITypedColumnarData first, ITypedColumnarData second, HashSet<int> rows)
			{
				this.types = types;
				names = first.Select((ITypedColumn c) => c.Name).ToArray();
				this.rows = rows.ToArray();
				firstCount = first.RowCount;
				getFirstValue = first.Select((ITypedColumn c, int i) => c.GetGetOrConvertValue(types[i])).ToArray();
				getSecondValue = second.Select((ITypedColumn c, int i) => c.GetGetOrConvertValue(types[i])).ToArray();
			}

			string ITypedColumnarDataReader.GetFieldName(int i)
			{
				return names[i];
			}

			Type ITypedColumnarDataReader.GetFieldType(int i)
			{
				return types[i];
			}

			T ITypedColumnarDataReader.GetValue<T>(int i)
			{
				int num = rows[current];
				if (num < firstCount)
				{
					return ((Func<int, T>)getFirstValue[i])(num);
				}
				return ((Func<int, T>)getSecondValue[i])(num - firstCount);
			}

			bool ITypedColumnarDataReader.Read()
			{
				return ++current < rows.Length;
			}

			bool ITypedColumnarDataReader.Seek(int index)
			{
				if (index < 0 || index >= rows.Length)
				{
					return false;
				}
				current = index;
				return true;
			}
		}

		public static ITypedColumnarData Unite(ITypedColumnarData first, ITypedColumnarData second)
		{
			if (first.Count() != second.Count())
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Number of columns in united data sets should be equal.");
			}
			var source = first.Zip(second, delegate(ITypedColumn cFirst, ITypedColumn cSecond)
			{
				if (!UnionHelper.TryGetUnionType(cFirst.Type, cSecond.Type, out var type))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException();
				}
				return new
				{
					Type = type,
					First = cFirst,
					Second = cSecond
				};
			});
			UnionColumnBase[] columns = source.Select(cnv => UnionColumnBase.New(cnv.Type, cnv.First, cnv.Second)).ToArray();
			UnionTupleEqualityComparer comparer = new UnionTupleEqualityComparer(columns);
			HashSet<int> finalRows = new HashSet<int>(comparer);
			for (int num = 0; num < first.RowCount + second.RowCount; num++)
			{
				finalRows.Add(num);
			}
			TypedColumn[] array = source.Select(cnv => TypedColumn.NewArray(cnv.Type, cnv.First.Name, finalRows.Count)).ToArray();
			ITypedColumnarDataReader typedColumnarDataReader = new SelectingReader(source.Select(cnv => cnv.Type).ToArray(), first, second, finalRows);
			while (typedColumnarDataReader.Read())
			{
				for (int num2 = 0; num2 < array.Length; num2++)
				{
					array[num2].Read(typedColumnarDataReader, num2);
				}
			}
			return new TypedColumnarData(array);
		}
	}

	internal class EquiExtractor : BaseClientCriteriaVisitor
	{
		private readonly HashSet<Tuple<CriteriaOperator, CriteriaOperator>> extracted = new HashSet<Tuple<CriteriaOperator, CriteriaOperator>>(CriteriaTuplesComparer.Instance);

		private bool match = true;

		public static bool TryExtract(CriteriaOperator criteria, IEnumerable<ITypedColumn> firstCols, IEnumerable<ITypedColumn> secondCols, out IEnumerable<ColumnsTuple> extracted)
		{
			extracted = null;
			if (!TryExtract(criteria, new HashSet<string>(firstCols.Select((ITypedColumn c) => c.Name)), new HashSet<string>(secondCols.Select((ITypedColumn c) => c.Name)), out extracted))
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (ColumnsTuple tuple in extracted)
			{
				Type type = firstCols.First((ITypedColumn c) => c.Name == tuple.First).Type;
				Type type2 = secondCols.First((ITypedColumn c) => c.Name == tuple.Second).Type;
				if (type != type2)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool TryExtract(CriteriaOperator criteria, HashSet<string> firstCols, HashSet<string> secondCols, out IEnumerable<ColumnsTuple> extracted)
		{
			extracted = null;
			if (!TryExtract(criteria, out var enumerable))
			{
				return false;
			}
			List<ColumnsTuple> list = (List<ColumnsTuple>)(extracted = new List<ColumnsTuple>());
			foreach (Tuple<CriteriaOperator, CriteriaOperator> item3 in enumerable)
			{
				CriteriaOperator item = item3.Item1;
				OperandProperty val = (OperandProperty)(object)((item is OperandProperty) ? item : null);
				if (CriteriaProcessingExtensions.ReferenceEqualsNull((CriteriaOperator)(object)val))
				{
					return false;
				}
				CriteriaOperator item2 = item3.Item2;
				OperandProperty val2 = (OperandProperty)(object)((item2 is OperandProperty) ? item2 : null);
				if (CriteriaProcessingExtensions.ReferenceEqualsNull((CriteriaOperator)(object)val2))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (firstCols.Contains(val.PropertyName))
				{
					if (!secondCols.Contains(val2.PropertyName))
					{
						return false;
					}
					list.Add(new ColumnsTuple(val.PropertyName, val2.PropertyName));
					continue;
				}
				if (secondCols.Contains(val.PropertyName))
				{
					if (!firstCols.Contains(val2.PropertyName))
					{
						return false;
					}
					list.Add(new ColumnsTuple(val2.PropertyName, val.PropertyName));
					continue;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool TryExtract(CriteriaOperator criteria, out IEnumerable<Tuple<CriteriaOperator, CriteriaOperator>> extracted)
		{
			EquiExtractor equiExtractor = new EquiExtractor();
			equiExtractor.Process(criteria);
			extracted = equiExtractor.extracted;
			return equiExtractor.match;
		}

	internal class CriteriaTuplesComparer : IEqualityComparer<Tuple<CriteriaOperator, CriteriaOperator>>
	{
		public static CriteriaTuplesComparer Instance { get; } = new CriteriaTuplesComparer();

		bool IEqualityComparer<Tuple<CriteriaOperator, CriteriaOperator>>.Equals(Tuple<CriteriaOperator, CriteriaOperator> x, Tuple<CriteriaOperator, CriteriaOperator> y)
		{
			if (!CriteriaOperator.CriterionEquals(x.Item1, y.Item1) || !CriteriaOperator.CriterionEquals(x.Item2, y.Item2))
			{
				if (CriteriaOperator.CriterionEquals(x.Item1, y.Item2))
				{
					return CriteriaOperator.CriterionEquals(x.Item2, y.Item1);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		int IEqualityComparer<Tuple<CriteriaOperator, CriteriaOperator>>.GetHashCode(Tuple<CriteriaOperator, CriteriaOperator> obj)
		{
			return ((object)obj.Item1).GetHashCode() ^ ((object)obj.Item2).GetHashCode();
		}

	internal class HashJoiner : IJoiner
	{
		private struct JoinTuple : IEquatable<JoinTuple>
		{
			public int Index { get; }

			public bool IsProbe { get; }

			public JoinTuple(int index, bool isProbe)
			{
				Index = index;
				IsProbe = isProbe;
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return (Index * 397) ^ IsProbe.GetHashCode();
			}

			public override bool Equals(object obj)
			{
				if (obj == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (obj is JoinTuple)
				{
					return Equals((JoinTuple)obj);
				}
				return false;
			}

			public bool Equals(JoinTuple other)
			{
				if (Index == other.Index)
				{
					return IsProbe == other.IsProbe;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private abstract class JoinColumnBase
		{
			public static JoinColumnBase New(Type type, ITypedColumn probe, ITypedColumn build)
			{
				return ActivatorEx.New<JoinColumnBase>(typeof(JoinColumn<>), type, new object[2] { probe, build });
			}

			public abstract int BuildHashCode(int index);

			public abstract int ProbeHashCode(int index);

			public abstract bool BuildEquals(int index1, int index2);

			public abstract bool ProbeEquals(int index1, int index2);
		}

		private class JoinColumn<T> : JoinColumnBase
		{
			private readonly IEqualityComparer<T> comparer;

			private readonly Func<int, T> getProbeValue;

			private readonly Func<int, T> getBuildValue;

			public JoinColumn(ITypedColumn probe, ITypedColumn build)
			{
				comparer = EqualityComparer<T>.Default;
				ParameterExpression parameterExpression = System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Parameter(typeof(int));
				getProbeValue = (Func<int, T>)System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Lambda(probe.GetValue(parameterExpression), parameterExpression).Compile();
				getBuildValue = (Func<int, T>)System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Lambda(build.GetValue(parameterExpression), parameterExpression).Compile();
			}

			public override int BuildHashCode(int index)
			{
				return comparer.GetHashCode(getBuildValue(index));
			}

			public override int ProbeHashCode(int index)
			{
				return comparer.GetHashCode(getProbeValue(index));
			}

			public override bool BuildEquals(int index1, int index2)
			{
				return comparer.Equals(getBuildValue(index1), getBuildValue(index2));
			}

			public override bool ProbeEquals(int probeIndex, int buildIndex)
			{
				return comparer.Equals(getProbeValue(probeIndex), getBuildValue(buildIndex));
			}
		}

		private class JoinTupleEqualityComparer : IEqualityComparer<JoinTuple>
		{
			private readonly JoinColumnBase[] columns;

			public JoinTupleEqualityComparer(JoinColumnBase[] columns)
			{
				this.columns = columns;
			}

			public bool Equals(JoinTuple x, JoinTuple y)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < columns.Length; i++)
				{
					if (!(y.IsProbe ? columns[i].ProbeEquals(y.Index, x.Index) : columns[i].BuildEquals(y.Index, x.Index)))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}

			public int GetHashCode(JoinTuple tuple)
			{
				int num = HashCodeHelper.Start();
				for (int i = 0; i < columns.Length; i++)
				{
					int num2 = (tuple.IsProbe ? columns[i].ProbeHashCode(tuple.Index) : columns[i].BuildHashCode(tuple.Index));
					num = HashCodeHelper.Combine(num, num2);
				}
				return HashCodeHelper.Finish(num);
			}
		}

		ITypedColumnarData IJoiner.Join(ITypedColumnarData master, ITypedColumnarData detail, JoinType joinType, CriteriaOperator condition, CancellationToken token)
		{
			if (!EquiExtractor.TryExtract(condition, master, detail, out var extracted))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Cannot extract columns equality conditions from the condition argument.");
			}
			return Join(master, detail, joinType, extracted, token);
		}

		internal ITypedColumnarData Join(ITypedColumnarData left, ITypedColumnarData right, JoinType joinType, IEnumerable<ColumnsTuple> conditions, CancellationToken token)
		{
			switch (joinType)
			{
			case JoinType.Inner:
			case JoinType.LeftOuter:
			case JoinType.FullOuter:
				return JoinData(left, right, joinType == JoinType.LeftOuter || joinType == JoinType.FullOuter, conditions, right: false, joinType == JoinType.FullOuter, token);
			case JoinType.RightOuter:
				return JoinData(right, left, outer: true, conditions.Select((ColumnsTuple c) => new ColumnsTuple(c.Second, c.First)), right: true, full: false, token);
			default:
				throw new ArgumentException($"The HashJoiner is not designed for {joinType} join type.");
			}
		}

		private ITypedColumnarData JoinData(ITypedColumnarData master, ITypedColumnarData detail, bool outer, IEnumerable<ColumnsTuple> conditions, bool right, bool full, CancellationToken token)
		{
			bool detailBuild = master.RowCount > detail.RowCount;
			ITypedColumnarData typedColumnarData = (detailBuild ? detail : master);
			ITypedColumnarData typedColumnarData2 = (detailBuild ? master : detail);
			JoinColumnBase[] columns = conditions.Select(delegate(ColumnsTuple rel)
			{
				ITypedColumn typedColumn = master[rel.First];
				ITypedColumn typedColumn2 = detail[rel.Second];
				return (!detailBuild) ? JoinColumnBase.New(typedColumn2.Type, typedColumn2, typedColumn) : JoinColumnBase.New(typedColumn.Type, typedColumn, typedColumn2);
			}).ToArray();
			JoinTupleEqualityComparer comparer = new JoinTupleEqualityComparer(columns);
			Dictionary<JoinTuple, List<int>> dictionary = new Dictionary<JoinTuple, List<int>>(comparer);
			for (int num = 0; num < typedColumnarData.RowCount; num++)
			{
				if (token.IsCancellationRequested)
				{
					break;
				}
				JoinTuple key = new JoinTuple(num, isProbe: false);
				List<int> value = null;
				if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(key, out value))
				{
					value = (dictionary[key] = new List<int>());
				}
				value.Add(num);
			}
			token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
			ITypedColumnarDataReader probeReader = null;
			ITypedColumnarDataReader buildReader = null;
			ITypedColumnarDataReader reader = null;
			ITypedColumnarDataReader reader2 = null;
			if (full)
			{
				reader = new UnlimitedNullReader(typedColumnarData2);
				reader2 = new UnlimitedNullReader(typedColumnarData);
				probeReader = new MakeNullableTypedColumnarDataReader(typedColumnarData2);
				buildReader = new MakeNullableTypedColumnarDataReader(typedColumnarData);
			}
			else if (outer)
			{
				if (detailBuild)
				{
					probeReader = new TypedColumnarDataReader(typedColumnarData2);
					buildReader = new MakeNullableTypedColumnarDataReader(typedColumnarData);
					reader2 = new UnlimitedNullReader(typedColumnarData);
				}
				else
				{
					buildReader = new TypedColumnarDataReader(typedColumnarData);
					probeReader = new MakeNullableTypedColumnarDataReader(typedColumnarData2);
					reader = new UnlimitedNullReader(typedColumnarData2);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				probeReader = new TypedColumnarDataReader(typedColumnarData2);
				buildReader = new TypedColumnarDataReader(typedColumnarData);
			}
			ITypedColumn[] array = typedColumnarData2.Select((ITypedColumn c, int i) => TypedColumn.NewChunkedList(probeReader.GetFieldType(i), c)).ToArray();
			ITypedColumn[] array2 = array;
			array = typedColumnarData.Select((ITypedColumn c, int i) => TypedColumn.NewChunkedList(buildReader.GetFieldType(i), c)).ToArray();
			ITypedColumn[] array3 = array;
			HashSet<int> hashSet = new HashSet<int>();
			for (int num2 = 0; num2 < typedColumnarData2.RowCount; num2++)
			{
				if (token.IsCancellationRequested)
				{
					break;
				}
				probeReader.Read();
				JoinTuple key2 = new JoinTuple(num2, isProbe: true);
				List<int> value2 = null;
				if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(key2, out value2))
				{
					if ((detailBuild && outer) || full)
					{
						for (int num3 = 0; num3 < array2.Length; num3++)
						{
							array2[num3].Read(probeReader, num3);
						}
						for (int num4 = 0; num4 < array3.Length; num4++)
						{
							array3[num4].Read(reader2, num4);
						}
					}
					continue;
				}
				for (int num5 = 0; num5 < value2.Count; num5++)
				{
					for (int num6 = 0; num6 < array2.Length; num6++)
					{
						array2[num6].Read(probeReader, num6);
					}
					for (int num7 = 0; num7 < array3.Length; num7++)
					{
						buildReader.Seek(value2[num5]);
						array3[num7].Read(buildReader, num7);
					}
				}
				if ((outer && !detailBuild) || full)
				{
					hashSet.AddRange(value2);
				}
			}
			token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
			if ((outer && !detailBuild) || full)
			{
				for (int num8 = 0; num8 < typedColumnarData.RowCount; num8++)
				{
					if (token.IsCancellationRequested)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (!hashSet.Contains(num8))
					{
						for (int num9 = 0; num9 < array2.Length; num9++)
						{
							array2[num9].Read(reader, num9);
						}
						buildReader.Seek(num8);
						for (int num10 = 0; num10 < array3.Length; num10++)
						{
							array3[num10].Read(buildReader, num10);
						}
					}
				}
				token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
			}
			return new TypedColumnarData((detailBuild ^ right) ? array2.Concat(array3).ToArray() : array3.Concat(array2).ToArray());
		}
	}
	public interface IJoiner
	{
		ITypedColumnarData Join(ITypedColumnarData master, ITypedColumnarData detail, JoinType joinType, CriteriaOperator condition, CancellationToken token);
	}
	internal class Joiner : IJoiner
	{
		private readonly NestedLoopsJoiner nestedLoops = new NestedLoopsJoiner();

		private readonly HashJoiner hash = new HashJoiner();

		public static Joiner Instance { get; } = new Joiner();

		public static void CheckNamesUniqueness(ITypedColumnarData master, ITypedColumnarData detail)
		{
			if (!master.Select((ITypedColumn c) => c.Name).Concat(detail.Select((ITypedColumn c) => c.Name)).Unique())
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Column names in the master and detail datas should be unique.");
			}
		}

		ITypedColumnarData IJoiner.Join(ITypedColumnarData master, ITypedColumnarData detail, JoinType joinType, CriteriaOperator condition, CancellationToken token)
		{
			CheckNamesUniqueness(master, detail);
			if ((uint)joinType <= 3u)
			{
				if (EquiExtractor.TryExtract(condition, master, detail, out var extracted))
				{
					return hash.Join(master, detail, joinType, extracted, token);
				}
				return ((IJoiner)nestedLoops).Join(master, detail, joinType, condition, token);
			}
			throw new ArgumentException();
		}
	}
	internal class NestedLoopsJoiner : IJoiner
	{
		private struct Pair
		{
			public int First { get; set; }

			public int Second { get; set; }

			public Pair(int first, int second)
			{
				First = first;
				Second = second;
			}
		}

		private class CompareDescriptor : CriteriaCompilerDescriptor
		{
			private readonly ITypedColumnarData firstData;

			private readonly ITypedColumnarData secondData;

			public override Type ObjectType => typeof(Pair);

			public CompareDescriptor(ITypedColumnarData first, ITypedColumnarData second)
			{
				firstData = first;
				secondData = second;
			}

			public override System.Linq.Expressions.Expression MakePropertyAccess(System.Linq.Expressions.Expression baseExpression, string propertyPath)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				ITypedColumn typedColumn = firstData[propertyPath];
				if (typedColumn == null)
				{
					flag = false;
					typedColumn = secondData[propertyPath];
				}
				string propertyName = (flag ? "First" : "Second");
				MemberExpression index = System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Property(baseExpression, propertyName);
				return typedColumn.GetValue(index);
			}
		}

		ITypedColumnarData IJoiner.Join(ITypedColumnarData left, ITypedColumnarData right, JoinType joinType, CriteriaOperator condition, CancellationToken token)
		{
			Joiner.CheckNamesUniqueness(left, right);
			if (joinType != JoinType.Inner && joinType != JoinType.LeftOuter && joinType != JoinType.RightOuter && joinType != JoinType.FullOuter)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException($"The NestedLoops Joiner is not designed for {joinType} join type.");
			}
			ITypedColumnarDataReader rightReader = null;
			ITypedColumnarDataReader typedColumnarDataReader = null;
			ITypedColumnarDataReader leftReader;
			switch (joinType)
			{
			case JoinType.Inner:
				leftReader = new TypedColumnarDataReader(left);
				rightReader = new TypedColumnarDataReader(right);
				break;
			case JoinType.RightOuter:
				leftReader = new MakeNullableTypedColumnarDataReader(left);
				rightReader = new TypedColumnarDataReader(right);
				typedColumnarDataReader = new UnlimitedNullReader(right);
				break;
			case JoinType.LeftOuter:
				leftReader = new TypedColumnarDataReader(left);
				rightReader = new MakeNullableTypedColumnarDataReader(right);
				typedColumnarDataReader = new UnlimitedNullReader(right);
				break;
			case JoinType.FullOuter:
				leftReader = new MakeNullableTypedColumnarDataReader(left);
				rightReader = new MakeNullableTypedColumnarDataReader(right);
				typedColumnarDataReader = new UnlimitedNullReader(right);
				break;
			default:
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
			ITypedColumn[] array = left.Select((ITypedColumn c, int i) => TypedColumn.NewChunkedList(leftReader.GetFieldType(i), c)).ToArray();
			ITypedColumn[] array2 = array;
			array = right.Select((ITypedColumn c, int i) => TypedColumn.NewChunkedList(rightReader.GetFieldType(i), c)).ToArray();
			ITypedColumn[] array3 = array;
			bool outer = joinType == JoinType.LeftOuter || joinType == JoinType.RightOuter || joinType == JoinType.FullOuter;
			switch (joinType)
			{
			case JoinType.Inner:
			case JoinType.LeftOuter:
			case JoinType.FullOuter:
				JoinData(left, right, token, leftReader, rightReader, typedColumnarDataReader, condition, array2, array3, outer);
				break;
			case JoinType.RightOuter:
				JoinData(right, left, token, rightReader, leftReader, typedColumnarDataReader, condition, array3, array2, outer);
				break;
			default:
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
			if (joinType == JoinType.FullOuter)
			{
				CriteriaCompilerDescriptor val = (CriteriaCompilerDescriptor)(object)new CompareDescriptor(left, right);
				Func<Pair, bool> func = CriteriaCompiler.ToPredicate<Pair>(condition, val);
				for (int num = 0; num < right.RowCount; num++)
				{
					if (token.IsCancellationRequested)
					{
						break;
					}
					rightReader.Seek(num);
					bool flag = false;
					for (int num2 = 0; num2 < left.RowCount; num2++)
					{
						if (token.IsCancellationRequested)
						{
							break;
						}
						if (func(new Pair(num2, num)))
						{
							flag = true;
							break;
						}
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						continue;
					}
					for (int num3 = 0; num3 < array2.Length; num3++)
					{
						if (token.IsCancellationRequested)
						{
							break;
						}
						array2[num3].Read(typedColumnarDataReader, num3);
					}
					for (int num4 = 0; num4 < array3.Length; num4++)
					{
						if (token.IsCancellationRequested)
						{
							break;
						}
						array3[num4].Read(rightReader, num4);
					}
				}
			}
			token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
			return new TypedColumnarData(array2.Concat(array3));
		}

		private static void JoinData(ITypedColumnarData master, ITypedColumnarData detail, CancellationToken token, ITypedColumnarDataReader masterReader, ITypedColumnarDataReader detailReader, ITypedColumnarDataReader nullReader, CriteriaOperator condition, ITypedColumn[] masterResultColumns, ITypedColumn[] detailResultColumns, bool outer)
		{
			CriteriaCompilerDescriptor val = (CriteriaCompilerDescriptor)(object)new CompareDescriptor(master, detail);
			Func<Pair, bool> func = CriteriaCompiler.ToPredicate<Pair>(condition, val);
			for (int i = 0; i < master.RowCount; i++)
			{
				if (token.IsCancellationRequested)
				{
					break;
				}
				masterReader.Read();
				bool flag = false;
				for (int j = 0; j < detail.RowCount; j++)
				{
					if (token.IsCancellationRequested)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (!func(new Pair(i, j)))
					{
						continue;
					}
					flag = true;
					detailReader.Seek(j);
					for (int k = 0; k < masterResultColumns.Length; k++)
					{
						if (token.IsCancellationRequested)
						{
							break;
						}
						masterResultColumns[k].Read(masterReader, k);
					}
					for (int l = 0; l < detailResultColumns.Length; l++)
					{
						if (token.IsCancellationRequested)
						{
							break;
						}
						detailResultColumns[l].Read(detailReader, l);
					}
				}
				if (!(!flag && outer))
				{
					continue;
				}
				for (int m = 0; m < masterResultColumns.Length; m++)
				{
					if (token.IsCancellationRequested)
					{
						break;
					}
					masterResultColumns[m].Read(masterReader, m);
				}
				for (int n = 0; n < detailResultColumns.Length; n++)
				{
					if (token.IsCancellationRequested)
					{
						break;
					}
					detailResultColumns[n].Read(nullReader, n);
				}
			}
			token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
		}
	}
}

	public abstract class QueryNodeViewModel : IQueryNodeViewModel, INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		private readonly Locker locker = new Locker();

		protected INativeQueryBuilderModel Owner { get; }

		public QueryNode Query { get; }

		protected bool CanChangeAlias { get; }

		public abstract bool CanRemoveTable { get; }

		QueryNodeType IQueryNodeViewModel.QueryNodeType => QueryNodeType;

		bool IQueryNodeViewModel.CanChangeAlias => CanChangeAlias;

		protected abstract QueryNodeType QueryNodeType { get; }

		public event EventHandler BeforeUpdate;

		public event EventHandler AfterUpdate;

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		protected QueryNodeViewModel(QueryNode queryNode, INativeQueryBuilderModel owner)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)queryNode, "queryNode");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)owner, "owner");
			Query = queryNode;
			Owner = owner;
			CanChangeAlias = string.IsNullOrEmpty(Query.Alias);
		}

		protected SourceNode FindSourceNode(string actualName)
		{
			return SourceNodeExtractor.Extract(Query).SingleOrDefault((SourceNode x) => x.ActualName == actualName);
		}

		protected string CreateAliasCore(string nameBase, Predicate<string> isOk)
		{
			if (isOk(nameBase))
			{
				return nameBase;
			}
			int num = 0;
			string text;
			do
			{
				text = ((num != 0) ? $"{nameBase}_{num}" : nameBase);
				num++;
			}
			while (!isOk(text));
			return text;
		}

		public abstract void AddTable(Source source, string tableName);

		public abstract void RemoveTable(Source source, string tableName);

		public abstract IEnumerable<IMissingItem> GetMissingItems();

		protected void BeginUpdate()
		{
			if (!locker.IsLocked)
			{
				RaiseBeforeUpdate();
			}
			locker.Lock();
		}

		protected void EndUpdate()
		{
			locker.Unlock();
			if (!locker.IsLocked)
			{
				RaiseAfterUpdate();
			}
		}

		private void RaiseBeforeUpdate()
		{
			this.BeforeUpdate?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		private void RaiseAfterUpdate()
		{
			this.AfterUpdate?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		protected void RaisePropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			this.PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
		}
	}
	public class TransformationNodeViewModel : QueryNodeViewModel<TransformationNode>
	{
		public TransformationRulesGridItemData.List Rules { get; }

		public TransformationResultItemData.List Results { get; }

		public new TransformationNode Query { get; }

		public Source Source
		{
			get
			{
				return QuerySourceNode.Source;
			}
			set
			{
				QuerySourceNode.Source = value;
			}
		}

		private SourceNode QuerySourceNode { get; }

		private TypeSpecificsService TypeSpecificsService { get; } = new TypeSpecificsService();

		public override bool CanRemoveTable => false;

		protected override QueryNodeType QueryNodeType => QueryNodeType.Transform;

		public TransformationNodeViewModel(TransformationNode queryNode, INativeQueryBuilderModel owner)
			: base(queryNode, owner)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			Query = queryNode;
			QuerySourceNode = (SourceNode)Query.Root;
			Rules = new TransformationRulesGridItemData.List(owner, this);
			Results = new TransformationResultItemData.List();
			Rules.Initialize(Query, Source);
		}

		public override void AddTable(Source source, string tableName)
		{
			Source = GetOrAddExistingSource(source);
			Query.Alias = tableName;
			Rules.RefreshGridData(source);
			RaisePropertyChanged("Source");
		}

		public override void RemoveTable(Source source, string tableName)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public void RefreshResults()
		{
			//IL_00fe: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Results.Clear();
			HashSet<string> existing = new HashSet<string>(Rules.Select((TransformationRulesGridItemData c) => c.ActualName));
			foreach (TransformationRulesGridItemData rule in Rules)
			{
				if (rule.CanFlatten && rule.Transform == true)
				{
					foreach (KeyValuePair<string, Type> property in rule.Properties)
					{
						string columnName = NameGenerator.GenerateUniqueName(rule.ActualName + "_" + property.Key, existing);
						Results.Add(new TransformationResultItemData(columnName, TypeSpecificsService.GetTypeSpecifics(property.Value)));
					}
				}
				else
				{
					Results.Add(new TransformationResultItemData(rule.ActualName, rule.TypeSpecifics));
				}
			}
		}

		public override IEnumerable<IMissingItem> GetMissingItems()
		{
			return Enumerable.Empty<IMissingItem>();
		}
	}
	public abstract class QueryNodeViewModel<T> : QueryNodeViewModel where T : QueryNode
	{
		public new T Query => (T)base.Query;

		public override bool CanRemoveTable => true;

		protected QueryNodeViewModel(T queryNode, INativeQueryBuilderModel owner)
			: base(queryNode, owner)
		{
		}

		internal string CreateSourceAlias(string nameBase)
		{
			return CreateAliasCore(nameBase, (string name) => !base.Owner.ExistingSources.Any((Source source) => string.Equals(source?.Name, name, StringComparison.Ordinal)));
		}

		internal Source GetOrAddExistingSource(Source source)
		{
			Source source2 = base.Owner.ExistingSources.SingleOrDefault((Source x) => SimpleSourceEqualityComparer.Equals(x, source));
			if (source2 == null)
			{
				string name = CreateSourceAlias(source.Name);
				source2 = new Source(source)
				{
					Name = name
				};
				base.Owner.ExistingSources.Add(source2);
			}
			return source2;
		}
	}
	public class SelectNodeViewModel : QueryNodeViewModel<SelectNode>, ISelectQueryViewModel
	{
		public SelectionItemData.List Selection { get; }

		public QueryGridItemData.List QueryGrid { get; }

		internal List<Join> QueryJoins { get; } = new List<Join>();

		protected override QueryNodeType QueryNodeType => QueryNodeType.Select;

		public event EventHandler<RequestJoinEditorEventArgs> RequestJoinEditor;

		public event EventHandler<RelationUpdatingConfirmationEventArgs> RelationUpdatingConfirmation;

		public event EventHandler<TablesRemovingConfirmationEventArgs> TablesRemovingConfirmation;

		public event EventHandler<CircularRelationWarningEventArgs> CircularRelationWarning;

		internal SelectNodeViewModel(SelectNode node, INativeQueryBuilderModel owner)
			: base(node, owner)
		{
			Selection = new SelectionItemData.List(this);
			QueryGrid = new QueryGridItemData.List(this);
			InitSelectedTables();
			IEnumerable<DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression> source = SelectExpressionExtractor.Extract(base.Query);
			IEnumerable<Tuple<DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression, string>> columns = source.Select(delegate(DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression exp)
			{
				SelectColumnExpression selectColumnExpression = exp as SelectColumnExpression;
				string item = null;
				if (selectColumnExpression != null)
				{
					item = ((IDisplayNameProvider)owner).GetFieldDisplayName(new string[2]
					{
						selectColumnExpression.Node.ActualName,
						selectColumnExpression.Name
					});
				}
				return Tuple.Create(exp, item);
			});
			QueryGrid.Initialize(columns);
		}

		private string[] GetRelationColumns(string tableName)
		{
			string[] first = (from k in QueryJoins.Where((Join j) => j.Parent.ActualName == tableName).SelectMany((Join x) => x.KeyColumns)
				select k.ParentKeyColumn).ToArray();
			string[] second = (from k in QueryJoins.Where((Join j) => j.Nested.ActualName == tableName).SelectMany((Join x) => x.KeyColumns)
				select k.NestedKeyColumn).ToArray();
			return first.Concat(second).ToArray();
		}

		private void InitSelectedTables()
		{
			//IL_00de: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0383: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			IEnumerable<SourceNode> enumerable = SourceNodeExtractor.Extract(base.Query);
			QueryJoins.AddRange(CriteriaOperatorToJoinConverter.ToJoin(base.Query));
			foreach (SourceNode node in enumerable)
			{
				AvailableItemData availableItemData = base.Owner.FindAvailableItem(node.Source);
				bool tableIsMissing = availableItemData == null;
				TableMetaInfo meta = node.Meta;
				SelectionItemData selectionItemData = ((meta != null) ? Selection.AddNew(node.Source, node.ActualName, false, tableIsMissing, meta.Pos, meta.Size) : Selection.AddNew(node.Source, node.ActualName, false, tableIsMissing, PointFloat.Empty, SizeF.Empty));
				int id = selectionItemData.Id;
				SelectColumnExpression[] queryColumns = (from c in base.Query.Expressions.OfType<SelectColumnExpression>()
					where c.Node == node
					select c).ToArray();
				string[] relationColumns = GetRelationColumns(selectionItemData.Name);
				string[] availableColumnNames = ((availableItemData != null) ? availableItemData.Columns.Select((AvailableItemData.ColumnData c) => c.Name).ToArray() : new string[0]);
				var array = availableColumnNames.Concat(queryColumns.Select((SelectColumnExpression c) => c.Name)).Concat(relationColumns).Distinct()
					.Select(delegate(string c)
					{
						bool isMissing = tableIsMissing || !availableColumnNames.Contains(c);
						bool isSelected = queryColumns.Any((SelectColumnExpression qc) => qc.Name == c);
						return new
						{
							Name = c,
							IsMissing = isMissing,
							IsSelected = isSelected
						};
					})
					.ToArray();
				Selection.AddNew(id, node.Source, null, base.Query.Expressions.OfType<SelectAllNodeColumnsExpression>().Any(), isMissing: false);
				var array2 = array;
				foreach (var anon in array2)
				{
					Selection.AddNew(id, node.Source, anon.Name, anon.IsSelected, anon.IsMissing);
				}
				bool? value = (array.All(c => c.IsSelected) ? new bool?(true) : (array.Any(c => c.IsSelected) ? ((bool?)null) : new bool?(false)));
				Selection.SetSelected(selectionItemData, value, update: false);
			}
			foreach (Join queryJoin in QueryJoins)
			{
				foreach (RelationColumnInfo keyColumn in queryJoin.KeyColumns)
				{
					SelectionItemData selectionItemData2 = Selection.FindColumnItem(queryJoin.Parent.ActualName, keyColumn.ParentKeyColumn);
					Join obj = null;
					RelationColumnInfo relationColumnInfo = new RelationColumnInfo(keyColumn.ParentKeyColumn, keyColumn.NestedKeyColumn, keyColumn.ConditionOperator);
					if (obj != null)
					{
						obj.KeyColumns.Add(relationColumnInfo);
						continue;
					}
					obj = new Join(queryJoin.Parent, queryJoin.Nested, queryJoin.Type, new RelationColumnInfo[1] { relationColumnInfo });
					selectionItemData2.JoinedTo.Add(obj);
				}
			}
		}

		public override IEnumerable<IMissingItem> GetMissingItems()
		{
			return from x in Selection
				where x.IsMissing && x.Selected == true
				orderby x.Parent
				select x;
		}

		public override void AddTable(Source source, string tableName)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)source, "source");
			Guard.ArgumentIsNotNullOrEmpty(tableName, "tableName");
			AvailableItemData availableItemData = base.Owner.FindAvailableItem(source, tableName);
			if (availableItemData != null)
			{
				AddTableCore(availableItemData, (SourceNode sourceNode) => (!LaunchJoinEditor(sourceNode, newTable: true, out var jeModel)) ? null : jeModel);
			}
		}

		private void AddTableCore(AvailableItemData table, Func<SourceNode, IEnumerable<Join>> getRelationFunc)
		{
			//IL_020b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01e9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_015f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				string text = ((FindSourceNode(table.Name) != null) ? CreateTableAlias(table.Name) : null);
				string text2 = text ?? table.Name;
				Source orAddExistingSource = GetOrAddExistingSource(table.Source);
				SourceNode sourceNode = new SourceNode(orAddExistingSource)
				{
					Alias = text2
				};
				IEnumerable<SourceNode> source = SourceNodeExtractor.Extract(base.Query);
				if (source.Any())
				{
					IEnumerable<Join> enumerable = getRelationFunc(sourceNode);
					if (enumerable == null)
					{
						return;
					}
					Join[] array = (enumerable as Join[]) ?? enumerable.ToArray();
					QueryJoins.AddRange(array);
					CriteriaOperator criteria = GetCriteria(array);
					JoinElement item = new JoinElement(sourceNode, (JoinType)array.First().SqlJoinType, ((object)criteria).ToString());
					base.Query.SubNodes.Add(item);
					Join[] array2 = array;
					foreach (Join obj in array2)
					{
						foreach (RelationColumnInfo keyColumn in obj.KeyColumns)
						{
							SelectionItemData selectionItemData = Selection.FindColumnItem(obj.Parent.ActualName, keyColumn.ParentKeyColumn);
							Join obj2 = null;
							RelationColumnInfo relationColumnInfo = new RelationColumnInfo(keyColumn.ParentKeyColumn, keyColumn.NestedKeyColumn, keyColumn.ConditionOperator);
							if (obj2 != null)
							{
								obj2.KeyColumns.Add(relationColumnInfo);
								continue;
							}
							obj2 = new Join(obj.Parent, obj.Nested, obj.Type, new RelationColumnInfo[1] { relationColumnInfo });
							selectionItemData.JoinedTo.Add(obj2);
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					base.Query.Root = sourceNode;
					base.Query.Alias = sourceNode.Alias;
				}
				TableMetaInfo meta = sourceNode.Meta;
				SelectionItemData selectionItemData2 = ((meta != null) ? Selection.AddNew(orAddExistingSource, text2, false, isMissing: false, meta.Pos, meta.Size) : Selection.AddNew(orAddExistingSource, text2, false, isMissing: false, PointFloat.Empty, SizeF.Empty));
				int id = selectionItemData2.Id;
				Selection.AddNew(id, table.Source, null, false, isMissing: false);
				foreach (AvailableItemData.ColumnData column in table.Columns)
				{
					Selection.AddNew(id, orAddExistingSource, column.Name, false, isMissing: false);
				}
				UpdateJoinConditions();
			}
			finally
			{
				EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		public override void RemoveTable(Source source, string tableName)
		{
			SelectionItemData selectionItemData = Selection.SingleOrDefault((SelectionItemData x) => x.Parent == -1 && Source.EqualityComparer.Equals(x.Source, source) && x.Name == tableName);
			if (selectionItemData != null)
			{
				RemoveTableCore(selectionItemData, confirmSingleTableRemoving: false);
			}
		}

		private void RemoveTableCore(SelectionItemData selectionData, bool confirmSingleTableRemoving)
		{
			BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				SourceNode sourceNode = FindSourceNode(selectionData.Name);
				Join[] array = GetRelationsHierarchy(sourceNode).ToArray();
				List<SourceNode> toRemove = array.Select((Join obj) => FindSourceNode(obj.Nested.ActualName)).Distinct().ToList();
				toRemove.Insert(0, sourceNode);
				if (toRemove.Count > 1 || confirmSingleTableRemoving)
				{
					TablesRemovingConfirmationEventArgs e = new TablesRemovingConfirmationEventArgs(toRemove.Select((SourceNode t) => t.ActualName));
					this.TablesRemovingConfirmation?.Invoke(this, e);
					if (!e.Confirmed)
					{
						return;
					}
				}
				Join[] array2 = array;
				foreach (Join item in array2)
				{
					QueryJoins.Remove(item);
				}
				for (int num2 = QueryJoins.Count - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
				{
					Join r = QueryJoins[num2];
					if (toRemove.Any((SourceNode x) => x.ActualName == r.Nested.ActualName))
					{
						QueryJoins.RemoveAt(num2);
					}
				}
				QueryGrid.RemoveAll((QueryGridItemData data) => toRemove.Any((SourceNode x) => x.ActualName == data.Table));
				foreach (SourceNode removingNode in toRemove)
				{
					if (base.Query.Root == removingNode)
					{
						base.Query.Root = null;
					}
					else
					{
						JoinElement item2 = base.Query.SubNodes.Single((JoinElement x) => x.Node == removingNode);
						base.Query.SubNodes.Remove(item2);
					}
					(from x in base.Query.Expressions.OfType<INodeSelectExpression>()
						where x.Node == removingNode
						select x).ToList().ForEach(delegate(INodeSelectExpression x)
					{
						base.Query.Expressions.Remove(x);
					});
					string actualName = removingNode.ActualName;
					SelectionItemData selectionItemData = Selection.SingleOrDefault((SelectionItemData x) => x.Name == removingNode.ActualName && x.Parent == -1);
					int tableId = selectionItemData.Id;
					Selection.RemoveAll((SelectionItemData d) => d.Parent == tableId);
					Selection.Remove(selectionItemData);
				}
				UpdateJoinConditions();
			}
			finally
			{
				EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		public void SetTableSelected(string tableName, bool selected)
		{
			BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				SourceNode sourceNode = FindSourceNode(tableName);
				SelectionItemData item = Selection.Single((SelectionItemData x) => x.Name == tableName && x.Parent == -1);
				Selection.SetSelected(item, selected, update: true);
			}
			finally
			{
				EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		public void SetAllColumnsSelected(string tableName, bool selected)
		{
			SourceNode node = FindSourceNode(tableName);
			BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				if (selected)
				{
					base.Query.Expressions.Add(new SelectAllNodeColumnsExpression(node));
					QueryGrid.Add(new QueryGridItemData(QueryGrid, tableName));
				}
				else
				{
					QueryGridItemData[] array = QueryGrid.Where((QueryGridItemData x) => x.Table == node.ActualName && x.Column == null).ToArray();
					QueryGridItemData[] array2 = array;
					foreach (QueryGridItemData item in array2)
					{
						QueryGrid.Remove(item);
					}
				}
				SelectionItemData item2 = Selection.FindColumnItem(tableName, null);
				Selection.SetSelected(item2, selected, update: false);
			}
			finally
			{
				EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		public void SetColumnSelected(string tableName, string columnName, bool selected)
		{
			SourceNode node = FindSourceNode(tableName);
			BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				SelectColumnCore(node, columnName, selected);
			}
			finally
			{
				EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		private void SelectColumnCore(SourceNode node, string columnName, bool selected)
		{
			if (selected)
			{
				string alias = null;
				if (FindSelectedColumn(columnName) != null)
				{
					alias = CreateColumnAlias(node.ActualName + "_" + columnName);
				}
				SelectColumnExpression item = new SelectColumnExpression(node, columnName, alias);
				QueryGrid.Add(new QueryGridItemData(QueryGrid, columnName, ((IDisplayNameProvider)base.Owner).GetFieldDisplayName(new string[2]
				{
					node.Source.Name,
					columnName
				}), node.ActualName, alias));
				base.Query.Expressions.Add(item);
				SelectionItemData item2 = Selection.FindColumnItem(node.ActualName, columnName);
				Selection.SetSelected(item2, true, update: false);
			}
			else
			{
				SelectionItemData item3 = Selection.FindColumnItem(node.ActualName, columnName);
				Selection.SetSelected(item3, false, update: false);
				QueryGridItemData item4 = QueryGrid.Single((QueryGridItemData x) => x.Table == node.ActualName && x.Column == columnName);
				QueryGrid.Remove(item4);
				SelectColumnExpression item5 = FindSelectedColumn(node, columnName);
				base.Query.Expressions.Remove(item5);
			}
		}

		bool? ISelectQueryViewModel.IsColumnSelected(SelectionItemData table, string column)
		{
			return base.Query.Expressions.OfType<SelectColumnExpression>().Any((SelectColumnExpression x) => x.Node.ActualName == table.Name && x.Name == column);
		}

		void ISelectQueryViewModel.SelectColumn(int index, ColumnDataItem columnData, string alias)
		{
			SourceNode node = FindSourceNode(columnData.Table);
			DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression item = columnData.ColumnKind switch
			{
				ColumnDataItem.Kind.Column => new SelectColumnExpression(node, columnData.Column, alias), 
				ColumnDataItem.Kind.Expression => new DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.SelectExpression(columnData.Column, alias), 
				ColumnDataItem.Kind.Asterisk => (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(columnData.Table)) ? ((DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression)new SelectAllNodeColumnsExpression(node)) : ((DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression)new SelectAllColumnsExpression()), 
				ColumnDataItem.Kind.Count => new SelectRowCountExpression(alias), 
				_ => throw new InvalidOperationException(), 
			};
			base.Query.Expressions.Insert(index, item);
		}

		void ISelectQueryViewModel.RemoveColumn(int index)
		{
			base.Query.Expressions.RemoveAt(index);
		}

		IAliasedSelectExpression ISelectQueryViewModel.FindColumn(string name)
		{
			return base.Query.Expressions.OfType<IAliasedSelectExpression>().FirstOrDefault((IAliasedSelectExpression x) => x.ActualName == name);
		}

		private SelectColumnExpression FindSelectedColumn(string columnName)
		{
			return base.Query.Expressions.OfType<SelectColumnExpression>().FirstOrDefault((SelectColumnExpression x) => x.ActualName == columnName);
		}

		private SelectColumnExpression FindSelectedColumn(SourceNode node, string columnName)
		{
			return base.Query.Expressions.OfType<SelectColumnExpression>().FirstOrDefault((SelectColumnExpression x) => x.Node == node && x.Name == columnName);
		}

		public void AddRelation(string parentTableName, string parentColumnName, string nestedTableName, string nestedColumnName)
		{
			BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				SelectionItemData selectionItemData = Selection.FindTableItem(parentTableName);
				if (selectionItemData == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				SelectionItemData selectionItemData2 = Selection.FindTableItem(nestedTableName);
				if (selectionItemData2 == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				SourceNode sourceNode = FindSourceNode(parentTableName);
				SourceNode table = FindSourceNode(nestedTableName);
				Join obj = QueryJoins.FirstOrDefault((Join r) => r.Parent.ActualName == parentTableName && r.Nested.ActualName == nestedTableName);
				RelationColumnInfo relationColumnInfo = new RelationColumnInfo(parentColumnName, nestedColumnName);
				if (obj != null)
				{
					obj.KeyColumns.Add(relationColumnInfo);
					UpdateRelationNestedTable(nestedTableName);
				}
				else
				{
					if (ContainsCircularRelations(parentTableName, nestedTableName))
					{
						this.CircularRelationWarning?.Invoke(this, new CircularRelationWarningEventArgs(parentTableName, parentColumnName, nestedTableName, nestedColumnName));
						return;
					}
					obj = new Join(new Table
					{
						Name = parentTableName
					}, new Table
					{
						Name = nestedTableName
					}, (JoinType)0, new RelationColumnInfo[1] { relationColumnInfo });
					UpdateRelationsCore(table, new Join[0], new Join[1] { obj });
				}
				UpdateJoinConditions();
			}
			finally
			{
				EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		public void RemoveRelation(string parentTableName, string parentColumnName, string nestedTableName, string nestedColumnName)
		{
			BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				Join rel = QueryJoins.FirstOrDefault((Join r) => r.Parent.ActualName == parentTableName && r.Nested.ActualName == nestedTableName && r.KeyColumns.Any((RelationColumnInfo c) => c.ParentKeyColumn == parentColumnName && c.NestedKeyColumn == nestedColumnName));
				if (rel == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (rel.KeyColumns.Count == 1)
				{
					if (!QueryJoins.Where((Join r) => r.Nested == rel.Nested).Except(new Join[1] { rel }).Any())
					{
						SelectionItemData selectionData = Selection.Single((SelectionItemData x) => x.Name == rel.Nested.ActualName);
						RemoveTableCore(selectionData, confirmSingleTableRemoving: true);
						return;
					}
					QueryJoins.Remove(rel);
					UpdateRelationNestedTable(rel.Nested.ActualName);
				}
				else
				{
					RelationColumnInfo relationColumnInfo = rel.KeyColumns.FirstOrDefault((RelationColumnInfo k) => k.ParentKeyColumn == parentColumnName && k.NestedKeyColumn == nestedColumnName);
					if (relationColumnInfo == null)
					{
						return;
					}
					rel.KeyColumns.Remove(relationColumnInfo);
					UpdateRelationNestedTable(rel.Nested.ActualName);
				}
				UpdateJoinConditions();
			}
			finally
			{
				EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		public void EditRelation(string parentTableName, string parentColumnName, string nestedTableName, string nestedColumnName)
		{
			//IL_017c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0181: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0185: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_018a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01cc: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				IEnumerable<SourceNode> source = SourceNodeExtractor.Extract(base.Query);
				SourceNode sourceNode = source.Single((SourceNode x) => x.ActualName == parentTableName);
				if (sourceNode == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				SourceNode nestedTable = source.Single((SourceNode x) => x.ActualName == nestedTableName);
				if (nestedTable == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				Join obj = QueryJoins.FirstOrDefault((Join r) => r.Parent.ActualName == parentTableName && r.Nested.ActualName == nestedTableName);
				RelationColumnInfo relationColumnInfo = obj?.KeyColumns.FirstOrDefault((RelationColumnInfo r) => r.ParentKeyColumn == parentColumnName && r.NestedKeyColumn == nestedColumnName);
				if (relationColumnInfo == null || !LaunchJoinEditor(new Join(obj.Parent, obj.Nested, obj.SqlJoinType, new RelationColumnInfo[1] { relationColumnInfo }), out var jeModel))
				{
					return;
				}
				if (obj.KeyColumns.Count == 1)
				{
					Join[] removingRelations = QueryJoins.Where((Join r) => r.Nested.ActualName == nestedTable.ActualName).ToArray();
					Join[] newRelations = jeModel.ToArray();
					UpdateRelationsCore(nestedTable, removingRelations, newRelations);
				}
				else
				{
					int index = obj.KeyColumns.IndexOf(relationColumnInfo);
					obj.KeyColumns.RemoveAt(index);
					jeModel.ForEach(delegate(Join newJoin)
					{
						Join obj2 = QueryJoins.FirstOrDefault((Join j) => j.Parent.ActualName == newJoin.Parent.ActualName && j.Nested.ActualName == newJoin.Nested.ActualName);
						if (obj2 != null)
						{
							foreach (RelationColumnInfo keyColumn in newJoin.KeyColumns)
							{
								if (!obj2.KeyColumns.Contains(keyColumn))
								{
									obj2.KeyColumns.Add(keyColumn);
								}
							}
						}
						else
						{
							QueryJoins.Add(newJoin);
						}
						UpdateRelationNestedTable(newJoin.Nested.ActualName);
					});
					JoinType type = jeModel.First().Type;
					if (obj.Type != type)
					{
						RelationUpdatingConfirmationEventArgs e = new RelationUpdatingConfirmationEventArgs(obj.Parent.ActualName, obj.Nested.ActualName);
						this.RelationUpdatingConfirmation?.Invoke(this, e);
						if (e.Confirmed)
						{
							obj.Type = type;
						}
					}
				}
				UpdateJoinConditions();
			}
			finally
			{
				EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		void ISelectQueryViewModel.UpdateRelations(string oldTableName, string newTableName)
		{
			foreach (Join queryJoin in QueryJoins)
			{
				if (queryJoin.Parent.ActualName == oldTableName)
				{
					queryJoin.Parent.Alias = newTableName;
					UpdateRelationParentTable(newTableName);
				}
				else if (queryJoin.Nested.ActualName == oldTableName)
				{
					queryJoin.Nested.Alias = newTableName;
					UpdateRelationNestedTable(newTableName);
				}
			}
			UpdateJoinConditions();
		}

		private void UpdateRelationsCore(SourceNode table, Join[] removingRelations, Join[] newRelations)
		{
			SourceNode[] array = new SourceNode[1] { table };
			foreach (Join obj in removingRelations)
			{
				foreach (RelationColumnInfo keyColumn in obj.KeyColumns)
				{
					string actualName = obj.Parent.ActualName;
					string parentKeyColumn = keyColumn.ParentKeyColumn;
					SelectionItemData selectionItemData = Selection.FindColumnItem(actualName, parentKeyColumn);
					selectionItemData.JoinedTo.Clear();
				}
				QueryJoins.Remove(obj);
			}
			for (int num = QueryJoins.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (QueryJoins[num].Nested.ActualName == table.ActualName)
				{
					QueryJoins.RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
			foreach (Join item in newRelations)
			{
				QueryJoins.Add(item);
			}
			UpdateRelationNestedTable(table.ActualName);
		}

		private void UpdateJoinConditions()
		{
			//IL_0119: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			foreach (SelectionItemData column in Selection)
			{
				bool flag = column.Parent == -1;
				SelectionItemData selectionItemData = (flag ? column : Selection.First((SelectionItemData data) => data.Id == column.Parent));
				if (flag)
				{
					continue;
				}
				SelectionItemData columnData = column;
				columnData.JoinedTo.Clear();
				foreach (Join queryJoin in QueryJoins)
				{
					if (!(queryJoin.Parent.ActualName != selectionItemData.Name))
					{
						IEnumerable<RelationColumnInfo> columns = from c in queryJoin.KeyColumns
							where c.ParentKeyColumn == columnData.Name
							select new RelationColumnInfo(c.ParentKeyColumn, c.NestedKeyColumn, c.ConditionOperator);
						Join obj = new Join(queryJoin.Parent, queryJoin.Nested, queryJoin.Type, columns);
						if (obj.KeyColumns.Count > 0)
						{
							column.JoinedTo.Add(obj);
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateRelationParentTable(string parentTableName)
		{
			Join[] array = QueryJoins.Where((Join x) => x.Parent.ActualName == parentTableName).ToArray();
			Join[] array2 = array;
			foreach (Join obj in array2)
			{
				UpdateRelationNestedTable(obj.Nested.ActualName);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateRelationNestedTable(string nestedTableName)
		{
			IEnumerable<Join> enumerable = QueryJoins.Where((Join x) => x.Nested.ActualName == nestedTableName);
			SqlJoinType sqlJoinType = enumerable.First().SqlJoinType;
			CriteriaOperator criteria = GetCriteria(enumerable);
			SourceNode node = FindSourceNode(nestedTableName);
			JoinElement joinElement = base.Query.SubNodes.Single((JoinElement x) => x.Node == node);
			joinElement.Type = (JoinType)sqlJoinType;
			joinElement.Condition = ((object)criteria).ToString();
		}

		private IEnumerable<Join> GetRelationsHierarchy(SourceNode table)
		{
			foreach (Join curve in QueryJoins.Where((Join r) => r.Parent.ActualName == table.ActualName))
			{
				yield return curve;
				SourceNode table2 = FindSourceNode(curve.Nested.ActualName);
				foreach (Join item in GetRelationsHierarchy(table2))
				{
					yield return item;
				}
			}
		}

		private bool ContainsCircularRelations(string parentTableName, string nestedTableName)
		{
			SelectionItemData nestedTableItem = Selection.FindTableItem(nestedTableName);
			if (nestedTableItem == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (SelectionItemData item in Selection.Where((SelectionItemData n) => n.Parent == nestedTableItem.Id))
			{
				foreach (Join item2 in item.JoinedTo)
				{
					if (item2.Nested.ActualName == parentTableName)
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (ContainsCircularRelations(parentTableName, item2.Nested.ActualName))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool LaunchJoinEditor(Join relation, out JoinList jeModel)
		{
			jeModel = new JoinList(new Join[1] { relation });
			IEnumerable<SourceNode> enumerable = SourceNodeExtractor.Extract(base.Query);
			return LaunchJoinEditorCore(jeModel, enumerable, enumerable.Single((SourceNode x) => x.ActualName == relation.Nested.ActualName), relation.Nested.ActualName);
		}

		private bool LaunchJoinEditor(SourceNode table, bool newTable, out JoinList jeModel)
		{
			jeModel = new JoinList();
			IEnumerable<SourceNode> enumerable = SourceNodeExtractor.Extract(base.Query);
			if (newTable)
			{
				enumerable = enumerable.Union(new SourceNode[1] { table });
			}
			return LaunchJoinEditorCore(jeModel, enumerable, table, table.ActualName);
		}

		private bool LaunchJoinEditorCore(JoinList jeModel, IEnumerable<SourceNode> tables, SourceNode table, string tableActualName)
		{
			RequestJoinEditorEventArgs e = new RequestJoinEditorEventArgs();
			this.RequestJoinEditor?.Invoke(this, e);
			if (e.JoinEditor == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			IEnumerable<SourceNode> source = tables.Where((SourceNode x) => !ContainsCircularRelations(x.ActualName, table.ActualName));
			Dictionary<string, Table> dictionary = source.ToDictionary((SourceNode t) => t.ActualName, (SourceNode t) => new Table
			{
				Name = (t.Source.Name ?? t.ActualName),
				Alias = t.ActualName
			});
			JoinEditorPresenter joinEditorPresenter = new JoinEditorPresenter(jeModel, e.JoinEditor, base.Owner.GetDBSchema(tables), dictionary, dictionary[tableActualName]);
			((PresenterBase<JoinList, IJoinEditorView, JoinEditorPresenter>)joinEditorPresenter).InitView();
			return ((PresenterBase<JoinList, IJoinEditorView, JoinEditorPresenter>)joinEditorPresenter).Run();
		}

		private string CreateTableAlias(string nameBase)
		{
			return CreateAliasCore(nameBase, (string name) => !SourceNodeExtractor.Extract(base.Query).Any((SourceNode table) => string.Equals(table.ActualName, name, StringComparison.Ordinal)));
		}

		private string CreateColumnAlias(string columnName)
		{
			return CreateAliasCore(columnName, (string name) => base.Query.Expressions.OfType<IAliasedSelectExpression>().All((IAliasedSelectExpression c) => c.ActualName != name));
		}

		string ISelectQueryViewModel.CreateColumnAlias(string columnName)
		{
			return CreateColumnAlias(columnName);
		}

		void ISelectQueryViewModel.BeginUpdate()
		{
			BeginUpdate();
		}

		void ISelectQueryViewModel.EndUpdate()
		{
			EndUpdate();
		}

		SourceNode ISelectQueryViewModel.FindSourceNode(string actualName)
		{
			return FindSourceNode(actualName);
		}

		private static CriteriaOperator GetCriteria(IEnumerable<Join> joins)
		{
			var source = joins.SelectMany((Join x) => x.KeyColumns, (Join j, RelationColumnInfo c) => new
			{
				Parent = j.Parent.ActualName,
				Nested = j.Nested.ActualName,
				ParentColumn = c.ParentKeyColumn,
				NestedColumn = c.NestedKeyColumn,
				Operator = c.ConditionOperator
			});
			return CriteriaOperator.And((IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator>)source.Select(x => new BinaryOperator((CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty("[" + x.Nested + "].[" + x.NestedColumn + "]"), (CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty("[" + x.Parent + "].[" + x.ParentColumn + "]"), (BinaryOperatorType)x.Operator)));
		}
	}
	public class UnionNodeViewModel : QueryNodeViewModel<UnionNode>
	{
		public UnionNodeElementData.List Tables { get; }

		public UnionNodeColumnData.List Columns { get; } = new UnionNodeColumnData.List();

		protected override QueryNodeType QueryNodeType
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Query.Type != UnionType.Union)
				{
					return QueryNodeType.UnionAll;
				}
				return QueryNodeType.Union;
			}
		}

		public UnionNodeViewModel(UnionNode node, INativeQueryBuilderModel owner)
			: base(node, owner)
		{
			Tables = new UnionNodeElementData.List(this);
			if (IsSupportedQuery())
			{
				List<SelectNode> list = node.Elements.OfType<SelectNode>().ToList();
				foreach (SelectNode item in list)
				{
					Source source = SourceExtractor.Extract(item.Root).FirstOrDefault();
					if (source == null)
					{
						return;
					}
					AvailableItemData availableItemData = owner.FindAvailableItem(source);
					Tables.Add(new UnionNodeElementData(source, item.ActualName, availableItemData == null));
				}
				if (!list.Any())
				{
					return;
				}
				SelectNode selectNode = list.First();
				Source source2 = SourceExtractor.Extract(selectNode.Root).FirstOrDefault();
				{
					foreach (SelectColumnExpression item2 in selectNode.Expressions.Cast<SelectColumnExpression>())
					{
						Columns.Add(new UnionNodeColumnData(item2.Name, GetColumns, ValidateAlias, item2.Alias)
						{
							DisplayName = ((IDisplayNameProvider)base.Owner).GetFieldDisplayName(new string[2]
							{
								source2?.Name,
								item2.Name
							})
						});
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			node.Elements.Clear();
		}

		public override IEnumerable<IMissingItem> GetMissingItems()
		{
			return Tables.Where((UnionNodeElementData x) => x.IsMissing);
		}

		public override void AddTable(Source source, string tableName)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)source, "source");
			Guard.ArgumentIsNotNullOrEmpty(tableName, "tableName");
			AvailableItemData availableItemData = base.Owner.FindAvailableItem(source, tableName);
			if (availableItemData == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Source[] sources = SourceExtractor.Extract(base.Query).Concat(new Source[1] { source }).ToArray();
			IEnumerable<AvailableItemData.ColumnData> subsetColumns = GetSubsetColumns(sources);
			SourceNode root = new SourceNode(source);
			string alias = CreateTableAlias(tableName);
			SelectNode selectNode = new SelectNode(root)
			{
				Alias = alias
			};
			SelectNode[] nodes = base.Query.Elements.OfType<SelectNode>().Concat(new SelectNode[1] { selectNode }).ToArray();
			FillUnionNode(nodes, subsetColumns);
			var source2 = Columns.Select((UnionNodeColumnData unionNodeColumnData) => new { unionNodeColumnData.ColumnName, unionNodeColumnData.Alias }).ToArray();
			Tables.Add(new UnionNodeElementData(source, selectNode.ActualName, isMissing: false));
			Columns.Clear();
			foreach (AvailableItemData.ColumnData x in subsetColumns)
			{
				string alias2 = source2.FirstOrDefault(c => c.ColumnName == x.Name)?.Alias;
				Columns.Add(new UnionNodeColumnData(x.Name, GetColumns, ValidateAlias, alias2)
				{
					DisplayName = x.DisplayName
				});
			}
		}

		public override void RemoveTable(Source source, string actualName)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)source, "source");
			Guard.ArgumentIsNotNullOrEmpty(actualName, "actualName");
			if (!(base.Query.Elements.SingleOrDefault((QueryNode queryNode) => queryNode.ActualName == actualName) is SelectNode selectNode))
			{
				return;
			}
			SelectNode[] array = base.Query.Elements.OfType<SelectNode>().Except(new SelectNode[1] { selectNode }).ToArray();
			IEnumerable<Source> sources = array.SelectMany(SourceExtractor.Extract).Distinct();
			IEnumerable<AvailableItemData.ColumnData> subsetColumns = GetSubsetColumns(sources);
			FillUnionNode(array, subsetColumns);
			var source2 = Columns.Select((UnionNodeColumnData unionNodeColumnData) => new { unionNodeColumnData.ColumnName, unionNodeColumnData.Alias }).ToArray();
			UnionNodeElementData item = Tables.Single((UnionNodeElementData unionNodeElementData) => unionNodeElementData.Source == source && unionNodeElementData.Name == actualName);
			Tables.Remove(item);
			Columns.Clear();
			foreach (AvailableItemData.ColumnData x in subsetColumns)
			{
				string alias = source2.FirstOrDefault(c => c.ColumnName == x.Name)?.Alias;
				Columns.Add(new UnionNodeColumnData(x.Name, GetColumns, ValidateAlias, alias)
				{
					DisplayName = x.DisplayName
				});
			}
		}

		private void ValidateAlias(string alias)
		{
			if (Columns.Any((UnionNodeColumnData c) => c.ActualName == alias))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.QueryBuilderAliasAlreadyExists));
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<IAliasedSelectExpression> GetColumns(string columnName)
		{
			return (from x in base.Query.Elements.Cast<SelectNode>().SelectMany((SelectNode x) => x.Expressions.OfType<SelectColumnExpression>())
				where x.Name == columnName
				select x).ToArray();
		}

		private IEnumerable<AvailableItemData.ColumnData> GetSubsetColumns(IEnumerable<Source> sources)
		{
			if (!sources.Any())
			{
				return Enumerable.Empty<AvailableItemData.ColumnData>();
			}
			AvailableItemData[] source = sources.Select((Source x) => base.Owner.FindAvailableItem(x)).ToArray();
			IEnumerable<IEnumerable<AvailableItemData.ColumnData>> enumerable = source.Select((AvailableItemData x) => x.Columns);
			IEnumerable<AvailableItemData.ColumnData> enumerable2 = enumerable.First();
			foreach (IEnumerable<AvailableItemData.ColumnData> item in enumerable)
			{
				enumerable2 = enumerable2.Intersect(item);
			}
			return enumerable2.ToArray();
		}

		private bool IsSupportedQuery()
		{
			if (!base.Query.Elements.Any())
			{
				return true;
			}
			IEnumerable<SelectNode> source = base.Query.Elements.Cast<SelectNode>();
			if (source.Any((SelectNode x) => x.SubNodes.Any()))
			{
				return false;
			}
			var source2 = source.Select(delegate(SelectNode x)
			{
				IEnumerable<SelectColumnExpression> source3 = x.Expressions.Cast<SelectColumnExpression>();
				return source3.Select((SelectColumnExpression e) => new { e.Name, e.Alias });
			});
			var firstNodeColumns = source2.First();
			return source2.All(x => x.SequenceEqual(firstNodeColumns));
		}

		private void FillUnionNode(IEnumerable<SelectNode> nodes, IEnumerable<AvailableItemData.ColumnData> columnsInfo)
		{
			base.Query.Elements.Clear();
			base.Query.Alias = nodes.FirstOrDefault()?.ActualName;
			foreach (SelectNode node in nodes)
			{
				node.Expressions.Clear();
				node.Expressions.AddRange(columnsInfo.Select((AvailableItemData.ColumnData x) => new SelectColumnExpression(node.Root, x.Name)));
				base.Query.Elements.Add(node);
			}
		}

		private string CreateTableAlias(string baseName)
		{
			return CreateAliasCore(baseName, (string name) => !base.Query.Elements.Any((QueryNode element) => string.Equals(element.ActualName, name, StringComparison.Ordinal)));
		}
	}
	public class TransformationRulesGridItemData : ImmutableObject
	{
		public class List : ItemDataListBase<TransformationRulesGridItemData>
		{
			private TransformationNode Query { get; set; }

			private INativeQueryBuilderModel Owner { get; }

			private AvailableItemData Available { get; set; }

			private TransformationNodeViewModel NodeViewModel { get; }

			public List(INativeQueryBuilderModel owner, TransformationNodeViewModel nodeViewModel)
			{
				Owner = owner;
				NodeViewModel = nodeViewModel;
				base.AllowNew = false;
			}

			public void Initialize(TransformationNode query, Source initialSource)
			{
				Query = query;
				RefreshGridData(initialSource);
			}

			public void RefreshGridData(Source source)
			{
				//IL_0132: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (source == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				Available = Owner.FindAvailableItem(source);
				if (Available?.Columns == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				TransformationRule[] source2 = Query.Rules.ToArray();
				Query.Rules.Clear();
				Clear();
				foreach (AvailableItemData.ColumnData availableItemColumn in Available.Columns)
				{
					TransformationRule transformationRule = source2.FirstOrDefault((TransformationRule r) => r.ColumnName == availableItemColumn.Name);
					TransformationRulesGridItemData transformationRulesGridItemData;
					if (transformationRule != null)
					{
						transformationRulesGridItemData = new TransformationRulesGridItemData(this, transformationRule.ColumnName, transformationRule.Alias)
						{
							transform = (transformationRule.Unfold || transformationRule.Flatten)
						};
						Query.Rules.Add(transformationRule);
					}
					else
					{
						transformationRulesGridItemData = new TransformationRulesGridItemData(this, availableItemColumn.Name, null);
					}
					ITable table = null;
					(source.DataSource as SqlDataSource)?.Result?.TryGetTable(Available.Name, out table);
					DetectCanUnfoldAndFlatten(availableItemColumn, transformationRulesGridItemData, table as ResultTable);
					transformationRulesGridItemData.TypeSpecifics = availableItemColumn.TypeSpecifics;
					Add(transformationRulesGridItemData);
				}
				NodeViewModel.RefreshResults();
			}

			private void DetectCanUnfoldAndFlatten(AvailableItemData.ColumnData availableItemColumn, TransformationRulesGridItemData data, ResultTable sqlTable)
			{
				Type type = availableItemColumn.Type;
				if (type == typeof(object))
				{
					data.CanUnfold = availableItemColumn.IsList;
					if (availableItemColumn.IsComplex)
					{
						Dictionary<string, Type> complexTypeProperties = availableItemColumn.ComplexTypeProperties;
						if (complexTypeProperties != null && complexTypeProperties.Count > 0)
						{
							data.CanFlatten = true;
							data.Properties = availableItemColumn.ComplexTypeProperties;
						}
					}
					data.ColumnType = typeof(object);
					return;
				}
				Type columnTypeBeforeUnfold = type;
				if (TypeHelper.CanUnfold(type, out var columnItemType))
				{
					data.CanUnfold = true;
					type = columnItemType;
				}
				if (TypeHelper.CanFlatten(type, columnTypeBeforeUnfold, availableItemColumn.Name, sqlTable, out var properties))
				{
					data.CanFlatten = true;
					data.Properties = properties.ToDictionary((PropertyDescriptor p) => p.Name, (PropertyDescriptor p) => p.PropertyType);
				}
				data.ColumnType = type;
			}

			protected override void OnAddingNew(AddingNewEventArgs e)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}

			internal void SetAlias(TransformationRulesGridItemData item, string value)
			{
				TransformationRule transformationRule = Query.Rules.FirstOrDefault((TransformationRule r) => r.ColumnName == item.Column);
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
				{
					if (transformationRule != null)
					{
						if (transformationRule.Flatten || transformationRule.Unfold)
						{
							transformationRule.Alias = null;
						}
						else
						{
							Query.Rules.Remove(transformationRule);
						}
					}
					item.alias = null;
				}
				else
				{
					if (transformationRule == null)
					{
						TransformationRuleCollection rules = Query.Rules;
						TransformationRule obj = new TransformationRule
						{
							ColumnName = item.Column,
							Alias = value
						};
						transformationRule = obj;
						rules.Add(obj);
					}
					item.alias = value;
					transformationRule.Alias = value;
				}
				NodeViewModel.RefreshResults();
			}

			internal void SetDenormalize(TransformationRulesGridItemData item, bool value)
			{
				TransformationRule transformationRule = Query.Rules.FirstOrDefault((TransformationRule r) => r.ColumnName == item.Column);
				if (transformationRule == null)
				{
					transformationRule = new TransformationRule
					{
						ColumnName = item.Column
					};
					Query.Rules.Add(transformationRule);
				}
				item.transform = value;
				transformationRule.Unfold = value && item.CanUnfold;
				transformationRule.Flatten = value && item.CanFlatten;
				NodeViewModel.RefreshResults();
			}
		}

		private string displayName;

		private string alias;

		private bool transform;

		private List Owner { get; }

		public string DisplayName
		{
			get
			{
				return displayName ?? Column;
			}
			set
			{
				displayName = value;
			}
		}

		public string Column { get; }

		public Type ColumnType { get; private set; }

		public string Alias
		{
			get
			{
				return alias;
			}
			set
			{
				Owner.SetAlias(this, string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) ? null : value);
			}
		}

		internal string ActualName => alias ?? Column;

		public bool? Transform
		{
			get
			{
				if (!CanFlatten && !CanUnfold)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return transform;
			}
			set
			{
				if ((CanFlatten || CanUnfold) && value.HasValue)
				{
					Owner.SetDenormalize(this, value.Value);
				}
			}
		}

		public bool CanUnfold { get; private set; }

		public bool CanFlatten { get; private set; }

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool CanTransform
		{
			get
			{
				if (!CanUnfold)
				{
					return CanFlatten;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public TypeSpecifics TypeSpecifics { get; private set; }

		public Dictionary<string, Type> Properties { get; set; }

		public TransformationRulesGridItemData(List owner)
			: this(owner, null, null)
		{
		}

		public TransformationRulesGridItemData(List owner, string column, string alias)
		{
			Owner = owner;
			Column = column;
			this.alias = alias;
		}
	}
