	public struct ColumnDataItem : IEquatable<ColumnDataItem>
	{
		public enum Kind
		{
			Column,
			Expression,
			Asterisk,
			Count
		}

		public string Table { get; }

		public string Column { get; }

		public string DisplayName { get; }

		public Kind ColumnKind { get; }

		public ColumnDataItem(string table, string column)
			: this(Kind.Column, table, column, null)
		{
		}

		public ColumnDataItem(Kind kind, string table, string column)
			: this(kind, table, column, null)
		{
		}

		public ColumnDataItem(Kind kind, string table, string column, string columnDisplayName)
		{
			Table = table;
			Column = column;
			DisplayName = columnDisplayName ?? column;
			ColumnKind = kind;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is ColumnDataItem)
			{
				return Equals((ColumnDataItem)obj);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			if (Column == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return Column.GetHashCode();
		}

		public bool Equals(ColumnDataItem other)
		{
			if (ColumnKind == other.ColumnKind && Table == other.Table)
			{
				return Column == other.Column;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (ColumnKind == Kind.Asterisk)
			{
				return DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.QueryBuilder_AllColumns);
			}
			if (ColumnKind == Kind.Count)
			{
				return DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.QueryBuilder_RowCount);
			}
			return DisplayName ?? Column;
		}
	}
	public class ColumnDataItemComparer : IEqualityComparer<ColumnDataItem>
	{
		public bool Equals(ColumnDataItem x, ColumnDataItem y)
		{
			return x.Equals(y);
		}

		public int GetHashCode(ColumnDataItem obj)
		{
			return obj.GetHashCode();
		}
	}
	public class QueryGridItemData : INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		public class List : ItemDataList<QueryGridItemData>
		{
			private static readonly PropertyDescriptor aliasPropertyDescriptor;

			private static readonly PropertyDescriptor columnPropertyDescriptor;

			private static readonly PropertyDescriptor outputPropertyDescriptor;

			private const string expressionAliasBase = "Expr";

			static List()
			{
				PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(typeof(QueryGridItemData));
				aliasPropertyDescriptor = properties["Alias"];
				columnPropertyDescriptor = properties["Column"];
				outputPropertyDescriptor = properties["Output"];
			}

			public List(ISelectQueryViewModel owner)
				: base(owner)
			{
				base.AllowNew = true;
			}

			public void Initialize(IEnumerable<Tuple<DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression, string>> columns)
			{
				foreach (Tuple<DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression, string> column in columns)
				{
					DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression item = column.Item1;
					if (item is SelectColumnExpression selectColumnExpression)
					{
						Add(new QueryGridItemData(this, selectColumnExpression.Name, column.Item2, selectColumnExpression.Node.ActualName, selectColumnExpression.Alias));
					}
					else if (item is SelectAllNodeColumnsExpression selectAllNodeColumnsExpression)
					{
						string actualName = selectAllNodeColumnsExpression.Node.ActualName;
						Add(new QueryGridItemData(this, ColumnDataItem.Kind.Asterisk, null, actualName, null, output: true));
					}
					else if (item is SelectAllColumnsExpression)
					{
						Add(new QueryGridItemData(this, ColumnDataItem.Kind.Asterisk, null, null, null, output: true));
					}
					else if (item is DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.SelectExpression selectExpression)
					{
						Add(new QueryGridItemData(this, selectExpression.Expression, selectExpression.Alias));
					}
					else if (item is SelectRowCountExpression)
					{
						Add(new QueryGridItemData(this, ColumnDataItem.Kind.Count, null, null, null, output: true));
					}
				}
			}

			protected override void RemoveItem(int index)
			{
				QueryGridItemData queryGridItemData = base[index];
				base.Owner.BeginUpdate();
				try
				{
					if (queryGridItemData.Output)
					{
						SetOutputFull(queryGridItemData, value: false);
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					base.Owner.EndUpdate();
				}
				base.RemoveItem(index);
			}

			protected override void OnAddingNew(AddingNewEventArgs e)
			{
				e.NewObject = new QueryGridItemData(this);
			}

			internal void SetColumnData(QueryGridItemData item, ColumnDataItem value, bool update)
			{
				bool flag = item.ColumnData.ColumnKind == ColumnDataItem.Kind.Column && item.ColumnData.Column == null;
				SetItemProperty(item, value, new ColumnDataItemComparer(), columnPropertyDescriptor, (QueryGridItemData data) => data.ColumnData, update ? new Action<QueryGridItemData, ColumnDataItem>(SetColumnDataFull) : ((Action<QueryGridItemData, ColumnDataItem>)delegate(QueryGridItemData data, ColumnDataItem s)
				{
					data.columnData = s;
				}));
				if (flag)
				{
					SetOutput(item, value: true, update: true);
				}
			}

			internal void SetAlias(QueryGridItemData item, string value, bool update)
			{
				SetItemProperty(item, value, aliasPropertyDescriptor, (QueryGridItemData data) => data.Alias, update ? new Action<QueryGridItemData, string>(SetAliasFull) : ((Action<QueryGridItemData, string>)delegate(QueryGridItemData data, string s)
				{
					data.alias = s;
				}));
			}

			internal void MoveTo(QueryGridItemData item, int pos)
			{
				base.Owner.BeginUpdate();
				try
				{
					int num = IndexOf(item);
					if (pos != num)
					{
						int num2 = IndexInOutput(item);
						base.RemoveItem(num);
						if (pos > num)
						{
							pos--;
						}
						InsertItem(pos, item);
						int num3 = IndexInOutput(item);
						if (item.Output && num3 != num2)
						{
							SelectNode query = base.Owner.Query;
							IList<DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression> expressions = query.Expressions;
							DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression item2 = expressions[num2];
							expressions.RemoveAt(num2);
							expressions.Insert(num3, item2);
						}
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					base.Owner.EndUpdate();
				}
			}

			private void SetAliasFull(QueryGridItemData item, string value)
			{
				if (base.Owner.FindColumn(value ?? item.Column) != null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.QueryBuilderAliasAlreadyExists));
				}
				IAliasedSelectExpression aliasedSelectExpression = base.Owner.FindColumn(item.ActualName);
				if (aliasedSelectExpression == null)
				{
					base.Owner.SelectColumn(IndexInOutput(item), item.ColumnData, value);
					SetOutput(item, value: true, update: false);
					SelectionItemData selectionItemData = base.Owner.Selection.FindColumnItem(item.Table, item.Column);
					if (selectionItemData != null)
					{
						base.Owner.Selection.SetSelected(selectionItemData, true, update: false);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (value == null)
					{
						SelectColumnExpression selectColumnExpression = aliasedSelectExpression as SelectColumnExpression;
						if (selectColumnExpression == null)
						{
							throw new ArgumentException(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.UnnamedColumnValidationException));
						}
					}
					aliasedSelectExpression.Alias = value;
				}
				item.alias = value;
			}

			private int IndexInOutput(QueryGridItemData item)
			{
				return this.TakeWhile((QueryGridItemData x) => x != item).Count((QueryGridItemData x) => x.Output);
			}

			private bool IsAutoExpressionAlias(string alias)
			{
				return string.Equals(alias, base.Owner.CreateColumnAlias("Expr"), StringComparison.Ordinal);
			}

			private void SetColumnDataFull(QueryGridItemData item, ColumnDataItem value)
			{
				bool output = item.Output;
				string alias = item.alias;
				SetOutput(item, value: false, update: true);
				item.columnData = value;
				SetOutput(item, output, update: true);
				ColumnDataItem.Kind columnKind = value.ColumnKind;
				if ((uint)columnKind <= 1u)
				{
					SetAggregateAndAlias(item, alias);
				}
			}

			internal void SetOutput(QueryGridItemData item, bool value, bool update)
			{
				SetItemProperty(item, value, outputPropertyDescriptor, (QueryGridItemData data) => data.Output, update ? new Action<QueryGridItemData, bool>(SetOutputFull) : ((Action<QueryGridItemData, bool>)delegate(QueryGridItemData data, bool b)
				{
					data.output = b;
				}));
			}

			private void SetOutputFull(QueryGridItemData item, bool value)
			{
				item.output = value;
				int index = IndexInOutput(item);
				if (value)
				{
					string text = null;
					switch (item.ColumnData.ColumnKind)
					{
					case ColumnDataItem.Kind.Column:
					{
						text = ((base.Owner.FindColumn(item.Column) != null) ? base.Owner.CreateColumnAlias(item.Table + "_" + item.Column) : null);
						SelectionItemData selectionItemData2 = base.Owner.Selection.FindColumnItem(item.Table, item.Column);
						if (selectionItemData2 != null)
						{
							base.Owner.Selection.SetSelected(selectionItemData2, true, update: false);
						}
						break;
					}
					case ColumnDataItem.Kind.Expression:
						text = base.Owner.CreateColumnAlias("Expr");
						break;
					case ColumnDataItem.Kind.Asterisk:
					{
						SelectionItemData selectionItemData = base.Owner.Selection.FindColumnItem(item.Table, null);
						if (selectionItemData != null)
						{
							base.Owner.Selection.SetSelected(selectionItemData, true, update: false);
						}
						break;
					}
					}
					SetAlias(item, text, update: false);
					base.Owner.SelectColumn(index, item.ColumnData, text);
					return;
				}
				base.Owner.RemoveColumn(index);
				SetAlias(item, null, update: false);
				if (item.ColumnData.ColumnKind == ColumnDataItem.Kind.Column)
				{
					SelectionItemData selectionItemData3 = base.Owner.Selection.FindColumnItem(item.Table, item.Column);
					if (selectionItemData3 != null)
					{
						SelectionItemData table = base.Owner.Selection.FindTableItem(item.Table);
						base.Owner.Selection.SetSelected(selectionItemData3, base.Owner.IsColumnSelected(table, item.Column), update: false);
					}
				}
				if (item.ColumnData.ColumnKind != ColumnDataItem.Kind.Asterisk)
				{
					return;
				}
				SelectionItemData selectionItemData4 = base.Owner.Selection.FindColumnItem(item.Table, item.Column);
				if (selectionItemData4 != null)
				{
					SelectionItemData table2 = base.Owner.Selection.Single((SelectionItemData x) => string.Equals(x.Name, item.Table, StringComparison.Ordinal));
					base.Owner.Selection.SetSelected(selectionItemData4, base.Owner.IsColumnSelected(table2, item.Column), update: false);
				}
			}

			private void SetAggregateAndAlias(QueryGridItemData item, string alias)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(alias) && ShouldKeepAlias(alias, item))
				{
					SetAlias(item, alias, update: true);
				}
			}

			private bool ShouldKeepAlias(string alias, QueryGridItemData item)
			{
				if (item.ColumnData.ColumnKind == ColumnDataItem.Kind.Column && IsAutoExpressionAlias(alias))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private readonly List owner;

		private string alias;

		private bool output;

		private ColumnDataItem columnData;

		public ColumnDataItem ColumnData
		{
			get
			{
				return columnData;
			}
			set
			{
				owner.SetColumnData(this, value, update: true);
				RaisePropertyChanged("ColumnData");
			}
		}

		public string Column => columnData.Column;

		public string DisplayName => columnData.DisplayName;

		public string Table
		{
			get
			{
				return columnData.Table;
			}
			set
			{
				switch (ColumnData.ColumnKind)
				{
				case ColumnDataItem.Kind.Column:
					owner.SetColumnData(this, new ColumnDataItem(value, columnData.Column), update: false);
					break;
				case ColumnDataItem.Kind.Asterisk:
					owner.SetColumnData(this, new ColumnDataItem(ColumnDataItem.Kind.Asterisk, value, null), update: false);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public string Alias
		{
			get
			{
				return alias;
			}
			set
			{
				owner.SetAlias(this, string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) ? null : value, update: true);
			}
		}

		internal string ActualName => alias ?? Column;

		public bool Output
		{
			get
			{
				return output;
			}
			set
			{
				owner.SetOutput(this, value, update: true);
			}
		}

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		public QueryGridItemData(List owner)
			: this(owner, ColumnDataItem.Kind.Column, null, null, null, output: false)
		{

			: this(owner, ColumnDataItem.Kind.Column, column, columnDisplayName, table, alias, output: true)
		{
		}

		private QueryGridItemData(List owner, ColumnDataItem.Kind kind, string column, string table, string alias, bool output)
			: this(owner, kind, column, null, table, alias, output)
		{
		}

		private QueryGridItemData(List owner, ColumnDataItem.Kind kind, string column, string columnDisplayName, string table, string alias, bool output)
		{

			columnData = new ColumnDataItem(kind, table, column, columnDisplayName);
			this.alias = alias;
			this.output = output;
		}

	public class ItemDataListBase<T> : BindingList<T>
	{
		public void RemoveAll(Predicate<T> predicate)
		{
			for (int num = base.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (predicate(base[num]))
				{
					RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
		}

		public void AddRange(IEnumerable<T> items)
		{
			foreach (T item in items)
			{
				Add(item);
			}
		}
	}
	public class ItemDataList<T> : ItemDataListBase<T>
	{
		protected ISelectQueryViewModel Owner { get; }

		protected ItemDataList(ISelectQueryViewModel owner)
		{
			Owner = owner;
		}

		private void RaiseItemChanged(T item, PropertyDescriptor pd)
		{
			OnListChanged(new ListChangedEventArgs(ListChangedType.ItemChanged, IndexOf(item), pd));
		}

		protected void SetItemProperty(T item, bool value, PropertyDescriptor pd, Func<T, bool> getValue, Action<T, bool> setValue)
		{
			SetItemProperty(item, value, EqualityComparer<bool>.Default, pd, getValue, setValue);
		}

		protected void SetItemProperty(T item, string value, PropertyDescriptor pd, Func<T, string> getValue, Action<T, string> setValue)
		{
			SetItemProperty(item, value, StringComparer.Ordinal, pd, getValue, setValue);
		}

		protected void SetItemProperty<TVal>(T item, TVal value, IEqualityComparer<TVal> eqComparer, PropertyDescriptor pd, Func<T, TVal> getValue, Action<T, TVal> setValue)
		{
			if (eqComparer.Equals(getValue(item), value))
			{
				return;
			}
			Owner.BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				setValue(item, value);
				RaiseItemChanged(item, pd);
			}
			finally
			{
				Owner.EndUpdate();
			}
		}
	}
	public sealed class SelectionItemData : SelectionItemDataBase, IMissingItem
	{
		public class List : ItemDataList<SelectionItemData>

			private static readonly PropertyDescriptor namePropertyDescriptor;

			private const float offset = 30f;

			private int selectionItemsCnt;

			public List(ISelectQueryViewModel owner)
				: base(owner)
			{
			}

			public SelectionItemData AddNew(Source source, string name, bool? selected, bool isMissing, PointFloat position, SizeF size)
			{
				//IL_009e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (((PointFloat)(ref position)).IsEmpty)
				{
					((PointFloat)(ref position))..ctor(30f + (this.Any() ? this.Select(delegate(SelectionItemData q)
					{
						//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
						//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
						PointFloat position2 = q.Position;
						return ((PointFloat)(ref position2)).X + q.Size.Width;
					}).Max() : 0f), 30f);
				}
				if (size.IsEmpty || size.Equals(TableMetaInfo.DefaultSize))
				{
					size = new SizeF(125f, 0f);
				}
				SelectionItemData selectionItemData = new SelectionItemData(this, selectionItemsCnt++, source, name, selected, isMissing, position, size);
				Add(selectionItemData);
				return selectionItemData;
			}

			public SelectionItemData AddNew(int parent, Source source, string name, bool? selected, bool isMissing)
			{
				SelectionItemData selectionItemData = new SelectionItemData(this, selectionItemsCnt++, parent, source, name, selected, isMissing);
				Add(selectionItemData);
				return selectionItemData;
			}

			internal void SetPosition(SelectionItemData item, PointFloat value)
			{
				//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0063: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (item.Parent < 0)
				{
					item.position = value;
					SourceNode sourceNode = SourceNodeExtractor.Extract(base.Owner.Query).FirstOrDefault((SourceNode n) => n.ActualName == item.Name);
					if (sourceNode.Meta == null)
					{
						sourceNode.Meta = new TableMetaInfo();
					}
					sourceNode.Meta.Pos = value;
				}
			}

			internal void SetSize(SelectionItemData item, SizeF value)
			{
				if (item.Parent < 0)
				{
					item.size = value;
					SourceNode sourceNode = SourceNodeExtractor.Extract(base.Owner.Query).FirstOrDefault((SourceNode n) => n.ActualName == item.Name);
					if (sourceNode.Meta == null)
					{
						sourceNode.Meta = new TableMetaInfo();
					}
					sourceNode.Meta.Size = value;
				}
			}

			internal void SetName(SelectionItemData item, string value, bool update)
			{
				if (item.Parent < 0)
				{
					SetItemProperty(item, value, namePropertyDescriptor, (SelectionItemData data) => data.Name, update ? new Action<SelectionItemData, string>(SetTableNameFull) : ((Action<SelectionItemData, string>)delegate(SelectionItemData data, string s)
					{
						data.SetNameCore(s);
					}));
				}
			}

			private void SetTableNameFull(SelectionItemData item, string value)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
				{
					throw new InvalidNameException(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.MessageInvalidItemName));
				}
				if (this.Any((SelectionItemData data) => data.Parent == -1 && string.Equals(data.Name, value)))
				{
					throw new InvalidNameException(string.Format(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.MessageDuplicateItemName), value));
				}
				string oldValue = item.Name;
				if (item.IsMissing)
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (QueryGridItemData item2 in base.Owner.QueryGrid.Where((QueryGridItemData gridItemData) => string.Equals(gridItemData.Table, oldValue, StringComparison.Ordinal)))
				{
					item2.Table = value;
				}
				SourceNode sourceNode = base.Owner.FindSourceNode(oldValue);
				sourceNode.Alias = value;
				if (base.Owner.Query.Root == sourceNode && ((IQueryNodeViewModel)base.Owner).CanChangeAlias)
				{
					base.Owner.Query.Alias = value;
				}
				item.SetNameCore(value);
				base.Owner.UpdateRelations(oldValue, value);
			}

			internal void SetSelected(SelectionItemData item, bool? value, bool update)
			{
				SetItemProperty(item, value, EqualityComparer<bool?>.Default, selectedPropertyDescriptor, (SelectionItemData data) => data.Selected, update ? new Action<SelectionItemData, bool?>(SetSelectedFull) : new Action<SelectionItemData, bool?>(SetSelectedLight));
			}

			private void SetSelectedFull(SelectionItemData item, bool? value)
			{
				int itemParentId = item.Parent;
				SelectionItemData selectionItemData = this.FirstOrDefault((SelectionItemData child) => child.Id == itemParentId);
				if (selectionItemData == null)
				{
					string name = item.Name;
					bool? value2 = value;
					foreach (SelectionItemData item2 in this.Where((SelectionItemData child) => child.Parent == item.Id))
					{
						if (item2.Name == null)
						{
							if (value2.HasValue && !value2.Value && item2.Selected.HasValue && item2.Selected.Value)
							{
								value2 = null;
							}
						}
						else if (item2.Selected != value)
						{
							SetSelectedValue(item2, value);
							SetColumnSelected(item2, value, name);
						}
					}
					SetSelectedValue(item, value2);
				}
				else
				{
					SetColumnSelected(item, value, selectionItemData.Name);
					SetSelectedCore(item, value);
				}
			}

			private void SetSelectedLight(SelectionItemData item, bool? value)
			{
				SetSelectedCore(item, value);
			}

			private void SetSelectedValue(SelectionItemData item, bool? value)
			{
				item.SetSelectedCore(value);
				item.RaisePropertyChanged("Selected");
			}

			private void SetColumnSelected(SelectionItemData item, bool? value, string tableName)
			{
				string name = item.Name;
				if (name != null)
				{
					base.Owner.SetColumnSelected(tableName, name, value.Value);
				}
				else
				{
					base.Owner.SetAllColumnsSelected(tableName, value.Value);
				}
			}

			private void SetSelectedCore(SelectionItemData item, bool? value)
			{
				SetSelectedValue(item, value);
				SelectionItemData selectionItemData = this.FirstOrDefault((SelectionItemData child) => child.Id == item.Parent);
				if (selectionItemData != null)
				{
					SelectionItemData[] source = this.Where((SelectionItemData child) => child.Parent == item.Parent).ToArray();
					bool? flag = (source.All((SelectionItemData b) => b.Selected == false) ? new bool?(false) : ((!source.All((SelectionItemData b) => b.Selected == true || b.Name == null)) ? ((bool?)null) : new bool?(true)));
					bool? value2 = flag;
					SetSelected(selectionItemData, value2, update: false);
				}
			}

			internal SelectionItemData FindColumnItem(string table, string column)
			{
				SelectionItemData selectionItemData = FindNode(-1, table);
				if (selectionItemData != null)
				{
					return FindNode(selectionItemData.Id, column);
				}
				return null;
			}

			internal SelectionItemData FindTableItem(string table)
			{
				return FindNode(-1, table);
			}

			private SelectionItemData FindNode(int parentId, string name)
			{
				return this.FirstOrDefault((SelectionItemData item) => item.Parent == parentId && string.Equals(item.Name, name, StringComparison.Ordinal));
			}
		}

	public class UnionNodeElementData : ImmutableObject, IMissingItem
	{
		public class List : ItemDataListBase<UnionNodeElementData>
		{
			private readonly IQueryNodeViewModel owner;

			private readonly Locker removeLocker = new Locker();

			public List(IQueryNodeViewModel owner)
			{
				this.owner = owner;
			}

			protected override void RemoveItem(int index)
			{
				if (!removeLocker.IsLocked)
				{
					removeLocker.Lock();
					UnionNodeElementData unionNodeElementData = base[index];
					owner.RemoveTable(unionNodeElementData.Source, unionNodeElementData.Name);
					base.RemoveItem(index);
					removeLocker.Unlock();
				}

		void IQueryBuilderUIViewModel.SwitchQueryType(QueryNodeType queryType)
		{
			QueryNode node = null;
			switch (queryType)
			{
			case QueryNodeType.Select:
				if (!(QueryNodeViewModel is SelectNodeViewModel))
				{
					node = new SelectNode();
				}
				break;
			case QueryNodeType.Union:
			case QueryNodeType.UnionAll:
				if (QueryNodeViewModel is UnionNodeViewModel unionNodeViewModel)
				{
					unionNodeViewModel.Query.Type = ((queryType != QueryNodeType.Union) ? UnionType.UnionAll : UnionType.Union);
				}
				else
				{
					node = new UnionNode((queryType != QueryNodeType.Union) ? UnionType.UnionAll : UnionType.Union);
				}
				break;
			case QueryNodeType.Transform:
			{
				TransformationNode transformationNode = new TransformationNode
				{
					Root = new SourceNode()
				};
				node = transformationNode;
				break;
			}
			}
			QueryNodeViewModel = CreateQueryNodeViewModel(node);
			this.PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs("QueryNodeViewModel"));
		}

		private static bool CompareSources(Source source, Source other)
		{
			if (source.DataSource != other.DataSource)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(source.DataMember) && string.IsNullOrEmpty(other.DataMember))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return string.Equals(source.DataMember, other.DataMember, StringComparison.Ordinal);
		}

		}

		}

	internal class CriteriaOperatorToJoinConverter
	{
		private readonly List<Join> joins = new List<Join>();

		private IEnumerable<SourceNode> sourceNodes;

		private JoinElement currentJoin;

		public static IEnumerable<Join> ToJoin(SelectNode node)
		{
			CriteriaOperatorToJoinConverter criteriaOperatorToJoinConverter = new CriteriaOperatorToJoinConverter();
			if (!criteriaOperatorToJoinConverter.Process(node))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return criteriaOperatorToJoinConverter.joins;
		}

		private CriteriaOperatorToJoinConverter()
		{
		}

		private bool Process(SelectNode node)
		{
			bool result = true;
			sourceNodes = SourceNodeExtractor.Extract(node);
			node.SubNodes.ForEach(delegate(JoinElement x)
			{
				currentJoin = x;
				if (!result || !Process(CriteriaOperator.Parse(x.Condition, new object[0]), (SourceNode)x.Node))
				{
					result = false;
				}
			});
			return result;
		}

		private bool Process(CriteriaOperator criteria, SourceNode node)
		{
			GroupOperator val = (GroupOperator)(object)((criteria is GroupOperator) ? criteria : null);
			BinaryOperator binary = (BinaryOperator)(object)((criteria is BinaryOperator) ? criteria : null);
			if (!Process(binary, node))
			{
				return Process(val, node);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool Process(GroupOperator group, SourceNode node)
		{
			//IL_0004: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (group == null || (int)group.OperatorType != 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (CriteriaOperator item in (List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)group.Operands)
			{
				BinaryOperator binary = (BinaryOperator)(object)((item is BinaryOperator) ? item : null);
				if (!Process(binary, node))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool Process(BinaryOperator binary, SourceNode node)
		{
			if (binary == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			CriteriaOperator leftOperand = binary.LeftOperand;
			OperandProperty val = (OperandProperty)(object)((leftOperand is OperandProperty) ? leftOperand : null);
			CriteriaOperator rightOperand = binary.RightOperand;
			OperandProperty val2 = (OperandProperty)(object)((rightOperand is OperandProperty) ? rightOperand : null);
			if (!Validate(val) || !Validate(val2))
			{
				return false;
			}
			string nestedNodeActualName;
			string columnName = ColumnNameHelper.GetColumnName(val.PropertyName, out nestedNodeActualName, enclose: false, mergeTableName: false);
			string masterNodeActualName;
			string columnName2 = ColumnNameHelper.GetColumnName(val2.PropertyName, out masterNodeActualName, enclose: false, mergeTableName: false);
			SourceNode sourceNode = sourceNodes.Single((SourceNode x) => x.ActualName == masterNodeActualName);
			Join obj = joins.SingleOrDefault((Join x) => x.Parent.ActualName == masterNodeActualName && x.Nested.ActualName == nestedNodeActualName);
			if (obj == null)
			{
				obj = new Join
				{
					Parent = new Table
					{
						Name = (sourceNode.Source.Name ?? sourceNode.ActualName),
						Alias = masterNodeActualName
					},
					Nested = new Table
					{
						Name = (node.Source.Name ?? node.ActualName),
						Alias = nestedNodeActualName
					},
					SqlJoinType = (SqlJoinType)currentJoin.Type
				};
				joins.Add(obj);
			}
			obj.KeyColumns.Add(new RelationColumnInfo(columnName2, columnName));
			return true;
		}

		private bool Validate(OperandProperty operand)
		{
			if (operand == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string tableAlias;
			string columnName = ColumnNameHelper.GetColumnName(operand.PropertyName, out tableAlias, enclose: false, mergeTableName: false);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(columnName))
			{
				return tableAlias != null;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal class SimpleSourceEqualityComparer : IEqualityComparer<Source>
	{
		public static SimpleSourceEqualityComparer Instance { get; } = new SimpleSourceEqualityComparer();

		private SimpleSourceEqualityComparer()
		{
		}

		public static bool Equals(Source x, Source y)
		{
			return EqualsHelper.ObjectsEquals(x, y, EqualsCore);
		}

		private static bool EqualsCore(Source x, Source y)
		{
			if (x.DataSource != y.DataSource)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!string.Equals(x.DataMember, y.DataMember, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		bool IEqualityComparer<Source>.Equals(Source x, Source y)
		{
			return Equals(x, y);
		}

		int IEqualityComparer<Source>.GetHashCode(Source obj)
		{
			return 0;
		}
	}

	public class SchemeLoader : IFederatedDataSourceSchemeProvider
	{
		protected IEnumerable<Source> existingSources;

		protected List<QueryItemInfo> result = new List<QueryItemInfo>();

		private readonly IEnumerable<DataComponentBase> components;

		private readonly Locker locker = new Locker();

		private int id;

		private readonly bool isQueryBuilderRequest;

		public SchemeLoader(IEnumerable<DataComponentBase> components, IEnumerable<Source> existingSources, bool isQueryBuilderRequest = false)
		{
			this.components = components.ToList();
			this.existingSources = existingSources ?? Enumerable.Empty<Source>();
			this.isQueryBuilderRequest = isQueryBuilderRequest;
		}

		public IEnumerable<QueryItemInfo> GetScheme()
		{
			if (locker.IsLocked)
			{
				throw new Exception("Operation already in progress");
			}
			locker.Lock();
			result = new List<QueryItemInfo>();
			foreach (DataComponentBase component in components)
			{
				if (component != null)
				{
					GetScheme(component);
				}
			}
			locker.Unlock();
			return result;
		}

		public Dictionary<string, Type> GetComplexFieldProperties(Source source, string fieldName)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		protected virtual bool GetScheme(DataComponentBase component)
		{
			if (!GetScheme(component as SqlDataSource) && !GetScheme(component as EFDataSource) && !GetScheme(component as ObjectDataSource) && !GetScheme(component as ExcelDataSource) && !GetScheme(component as JsonDataSource) && !GetScheme(component as XPObjectSource) && !GetScheme(component as FederationDataSourceBase))
			{
				return GetScheme(component as MongoDBDataSource);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool GetScheme(SqlDataSource source)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return new CommonFieldsFiller(source, existingSources, result, IncreaseId).GetSchemaFromObject(isQuery: false);
		}

		private bool GetScheme(MongoDBDataSource source)
		{

			{
				return false;
			}

		{

			}
			return new CommonFieldsFiller(source, existingSources, result, IncreaseId).GetSchemaFromObject(isQuery: false);
		}

		{

			}

			DataContext val = new DataContext();
			DataContext val2 = val;
			dataContext = val;
			DataContext val3 = val2;
			try
			{
				dataContextUtils = new DataContextUtils(dataContext);
				string dataSourceDisplayName = dataContext.GetDataSourceDisplayName(DataSource, string.Empty);
				string name = (DataSource as DataComponentBase)?.Name ?? string.Empty;
				Depth = 0;
				QueryItemType itemType = ((!isQuery) ? QueryItemType.Source : (QueryItemType.Source | QueryItemType.Query));
				Source source = new Source(name, DataSource, string.Empty);
				Source source2 = existingSources.FirstOrDefault((Source x) => SimpleSourceEqualityComparer.Equals(x, source));
				QueryItemInfo item = CreateItem(source2 ?? source, string.Empty, name, (TypeSpecifics)1, dataSourceDisplayName, -1, null, itemType);
				if (queryItems.Any((QueryItemInfo x) => x.ParentId == item.Id) || item.Children.Any())
				{
					queryItems.Add(item);
				}
				return true;
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val3)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		protected virtual QueryItemInfo CreateItem(Source source, string dataMember, string name, TypeSpecifics typeSpecifics, string displayName, int parentId, Type type, QueryItemType itemType)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			QueryItemInfo queryItemInfo = new QueryItemInfo(source, name, typeSpecifics, isComplex: false, isList: false, displayName, Id, parentId, type, itemType);
			if (itemType != QueryItemType.Field)
			{
				FillFields(source, dataMember, queryItemInfo.Id, queryItemInfo.Children);
			}
			return queryItemInfo;
		}

		protected void FillFields(Source source, string dataMember, int parentID, List<QueryItemInfo> children)
		{
			//IL_006a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0072: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_010e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Depth++;
			try
			{
				IEnumerable<PropertyDescriptor> properties = GetProperties(source.DataSource, dataMember);
				if (properties == null || !properties.Any())
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in properties)
				{
					if (item.Attributes.Contains(BrowsableAttribute.No))
					{
						continue;
					}
					TypeSpecifics typeSpecifics = typeScpecificsService.GetTypeSpecifics(item.PropertyType);
					QueryItemType queryItemType = GetQueryItemType(typeSpecifics);
					Source newSource = source;
					Source source2 = null;
					if (queryItemType.HasFlag(QueryItemType.Query))
					{
						newSource = new Source(newSource.Name + "_" + item.Name, newSource.DataSource, item.Name);
						source2 = existingSources.FirstOrDefault((Source x) => SimpleSourceEqualityComparer.Equals(x, newSource));
					}
					QueryItemInfo queryItemInfo = CreateItem(source2 ?? newSource, GetDataMember(dataMember, item.Name), item.Name, typeSpecifics, item.DisplayName, parentID, ((queryItemType & QueryItemType.Field) == QueryItemType.Field) ? item.PropertyType : null, queryItemType);
					if (queryItemInfo.ItemType != QueryItemType.Field && queryItemInfo.Children.Any())
					{
						queryItems.Add(queryItemInfo);
					}
					if (queryItemInfo.ItemType.HasFlag(QueryItemType.Field))
					{
						children.Add(queryItemInfo);
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				Depth--;
			}
		}

		protected virtual QueryItemType GetQueryItemType(TypeSpecifics typeSpecifics)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0002: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0004: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)typeSpecifics == 1 || (int)typeSpecifics == 2)
			{
				if (Depth <= MaxDepth)
				{
					return QueryItemType.Query;
				}
				return QueryItemType.Field;
			}
			return QueryItemType.Field;
		}

		protected virtual IEnumerable<PropertyDescriptor> GetProperties(object dataSource, string dataMember)
		{
			return dataContextUtils.GetDisplayedProperties(dataSource, dataMember, (Func<PropertyDescriptor, bool>)null);
		}

		private static string GetDataMember(string prefix, string field)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(prefix))
			{
				return prefix + "." + field;
			}
			return field;
		}
	}

		public FederationFieldsFiller(FederationDataSourceBase dataSource, IEnumerable<Source> existingSources, IList<QueryItemInfo> queryItems, Func<int> getNextId)

		public override bool GetSchemaFromObject(bool isQuery = true)
		{
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0024: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0199: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_019e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01a9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!(dataSource is IFederationDataSchemaProvider federationDataSchemaProvider))
			{
				return base.GetSchemaFromObject(isQuery);
			}
			DataContext val = new DataContext();
			DataContext val2 = val;
			dataContext = val;
			DataContext val3 = val2;
			try
			{
				CreateFederationDataContext context = new CreateFederationDataContext();
				string dataSourceDisplayName = dataContext.GetDataSourceDisplayName(base.DataSource, string.Empty);
				Source source = new Source(dataSource.Name, base.DataSource, string.Empty);
				Source source2 = existingSources.FirstOrDefault((Source x) => SimpleSourceEqualityComparer.Equals(x, source));
				QueryItemInfo item = new QueryItemInfo(source2 ?? source, dataSource.Name, (TypeSpecifics)1, isComplex: false, isList: false, dataSourceDisplayName, base.Id, -1, null, QueryItemType.Source);
				foreach (QueryNode query in dataSource.Queries)
				{
					ITypedColumnarData typedColumnarData = federationDataSchemaProvider.CreateFederationDataSchema(query.ActualName, context);
					Source newSource = new Source(dataSource.Name + "_" + query.ActualName, dataSource, query.ActualName);
					source2 = existingSources.FirstOrDefault((Source x) => SimpleSourceEqualityComparer.Equals(x, newSource));
					Source source3 = source2 ?? newSource;
					QueryItemInfo queryItemInfo = new QueryItemInfo(source3, query.ActualName, (TypeSpecifics)1, isComplex: false, isList: false, query.ActualName, base.Id, item.Id, null, QueryItemType.Query);
					foreach (ITypedColumn item3 in typedColumnarData)
					{
						TypeSpecifics typeSpecifics = typeScpecificsService.GetTypeSpecifics(item3.Type);
						QueryItemInfo item2 = new QueryItemInfo(source3, item3.Name, typeSpecifics, isComplex: false, isList: false, item3.Name, base.Id, queryItemInfo.Id, item3.Type, QueryItemType.Field);
						queryItemInfo.Children.Add(item2);
					}
					if (queryItemInfo.Children.Any())
					{
						item.Children.Add(queryItemInfo);
						queryItems.Add(queryItemInfo);
					}
				}
				if (queryItems.Any((QueryItemInfo x) => x.ParentId == item.Id) || item.Children.Any())
				{
					queryItems.Add(item);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val3)?.Dispose();
			}
			return true;
		}

	internal class ObjectDataSourceFieldsFiller : CommonFieldsFiller
	{
		private new ObjectDataSource DataSource => (ObjectDataSource)base.DataSource;

		private bool isQueryBuilderRequest { get; }

		protected override int MaxDepth { get; }

		public ObjectDataSourceFieldsFiller(object dataSource, IEnumerable<Source> existingSources, IList<QueryItemInfo> queryItems, Func<int> getNextId, bool isQueryBuilderRequest)
			: base(dataSource, existingSources, queryItems, getNextId)
		{
			Type type = ((DataSource.DataSource is Type) ? ((Type)DataSource.DataSource) : DataSource.DataSourceType);
			if (type == null)
			{
				MaxDepth = 0;
			}
			else
			{
				MaxDepth = ((!typeof(IEnumerable).IsAssignableFrom(type) && string.IsNullOrEmpty(DataSource.DataMember)) ? 1 : 0);
			}
			this.isQueryBuilderRequest = isQueryBuilderRequest;
		}

		protected override QueryItemInfo CreateItem(Source source, string dataMember, string name, TypeSpecifics typeSpecifics, string displayName, int parentId, Type type, QueryItemType itemType)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			QueryItemInfo queryItemInfo = new QueryItemInfo(source, name, typeSpecifics, isComplex: false, isList: false, displayName, base.Id, parentId, type, itemType);
			if (itemType != QueryItemType.Field && base.Depth <= MaxDepth)
			{
				FillFields(source, dataMember, queryItemInfo.Id, queryItemInfo.Children);
			}
			return queryItemInfo;
		}

		protected override QueryItemType GetQueryItemType(TypeSpecifics typeSpecifics)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0002: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0004: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)typeSpecifics == 1 || (int)typeSpecifics == 2)
			{
				if (isQueryBuilderRequest)
				{
					if (base.Depth <= MaxDepth)
					{
						return QueryItemType.Query | QueryItemType.Field;
					}
					return QueryItemType.Field;
				}
				return QueryItemType.Field;
			}
			return QueryItemType.Field;
		}
	}

	internal class SelectExpressionExtractor : JoinNodeVisitor<IEnumerable<DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression>>
	{
		public static IEnumerable<DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression> Extract(IJoinNode node)
		{
			return new SelectExpressionExtractor().Process(node);
		}

		private SelectExpressionExtractor()
		{
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression> Visit(SourceNode sourceNode)
		{
			return Enumerable.Empty<DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression>();
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression> Visit(SelectNode selectNode)
		{
			List<DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression> list = new List<DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression>();
			list.AddRange(selectNode.Expressions);
			foreach (INodeSelectExpression item in selectNode.Expressions.OfType<INodeSelectExpression>())
			{
				list.AddRange(Process(item.Node));
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression> Visit(UnionNode unionNode)
		{
			return unionNode.Elements.SelectMany(base.Process).Distinct();
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.ISelectExpression> Visit(TransformationNode transformationNode)
		{
			return Process(transformationNode.Root);
		}
	}
	internal class SourceNodeExtractor : JoinNodeVisitor
	{
		private readonly List<SourceNode> list = new List<SourceNode>();

		private SourceNodeExtractor()
		{
		}

		public static IEnumerable<SourceNode> Extract(IJoinNode node)
		{
			SourceNodeExtractor sourceNodeExtractor = new SourceNodeExtractor();
			sourceNodeExtractor.Process(node);
			return sourceNodeExtractor.list;
		}

		protected override VVoid Visit(SourceNode sourceNode)
		{
			list.Add(sourceNode);
			return VVoid.V;
		}

		protected override VVoid Visit(SelectNode selectNode)
		{
			Process(selectNode.Root);
			selectNode.SubNodes.ForEach(delegate(JoinElement x)
			{
				Process(x.Node);
			});
			return VVoid.V;
		}

		protected override VVoid Visit(UnionNode unionNode)
		{
			foreach (QueryNode element in unionNode.Elements)
			{
				Process(element);
			}
			return VVoid.V;
		}

		protected override VVoid Visit(TransformationNode transformationNode)
		{
			Process(transformationNode.Root);
			return VVoid.V;
		}
	}

	{

	}
	public class ObjectDataSourceExceptionCollector : IObjectDataSourceExceptionCollector
	{
		private readonly List<Exception> exceptions = new List<Exception>();

		public void Clear()
		{
			exceptions.Clear();
		}

		public void Collect(Exception e)
		{
			exceptions.Add(e);
		}

	public class ObjectDataSourceProcessor
	{
		private static bool IsPotentiallyDangerousDataSource(ObjectDataSource objectDataSource)
		{
			return objectDataSource.DataSource is Type;
		}

		public virtual void ProcessDataSources(IEnumerable<ObjectDataSource> dataSources, DocumentLoadingBehavior objectDataSourceLoadingBehavior, Func<bool> shouldSterializePotentiallyDangerousDataSource)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)dataSources, "dataSources");
			if (ShouldClearDataSources(dataSources, objectDataSourceLoadingBehavior, shouldSterializePotentiallyDangerousDataSource))
			{
				ClearDataSources(dataSources);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void ClearDataSources(IEnumerable<ObjectDataSource> dataSources)
		{
			foreach (ObjectDataSource dataSource in dataSources)
			{
				if (IsPotentiallyDangerousDataSource(dataSource))
				{
					dataSource.DataSource = null;
					dataSource.DataMember = null;
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool ShouldClearDataSources(IEnumerable<ObjectDataSource> dataSources, DocumentLoadingBehavior objectDataSourceLoadingBehavior, Func<bool> shouldSterializePotentiallyDangerousDataSource)
		{
			if (!dataSources.Any(IsPotentiallyDangerousDataSource))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return objectDataSourceLoadingBehavior switch
			{
				DocumentLoadingBehavior.Prompt => shouldSterializePotentiallyDangerousDataSource(), 
				DocumentLoadingBehavior.LoadSafely => true, 
				_ => false, 
			};
		}
	}
