	public static class ObjectDataSourceFillHelper
	{
		public class FindPropertiesHelper
		{
			private object instance;

			private object data;

			private PropertyDescriptorCollection pdc;

			public object Instance => instance;

			public object Data => data;

			public PropertyDescriptorCollection PDC => pdc;

			public FindPropertiesHelper(object dataSource, string dataMember, ParameterList dataMemberParameters, bool ctorIsNull, ParameterList ctorParameters)
			{
				Type type = dataSource as Type;
				instance = null;
				data = null;
				if (type != null)
				{
					if (typeof(IListSource).IsAssignableFrom(type) || typeof(ITypedList).IsAssignableFrom(type) || (typeof(IEnumerable).IsAssignableFrom(type) && GetItemType(type) == typeof(object)))
					{
						instance = CreateInstance(type, ctorIsNull, ctorParameters);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					type = dataSource.GetType();
					instance = dataSource;
				}
				if (!IsSpecialType(ref type, dataMember, dataMemberParameters))
				{
					pdc = GetPropertiesFromDataMember(type, dataMember, dataMemberParameters, ctorIsNull, ctorParameters);
				}
			}

			private bool IsSpecialType(ref Type type, string dataMember, ParameterList parameters)
			{
				if (typeof(IListSource).IsAssignableFrom(type))
				{
					instance = ((IListSource)instance).GetList();
					type = instance.GetType();
				}
				if (typeof(ExpandoObject).IsAssignableFrom(type))
				{
					pdc = InvokeDataMemberOfExpandoObject((ExpandoObject)instance, dataMember, parameters);
					return true;
				}
				if (IsEnumerable(type, out var enumerableType))
				{
					if (typeof(ExpandoObject).IsAssignableFrom(enumerableType))
					{
						ExpandoObject expandoObject = ((IEnumerable)instance).Cast<ExpandoObject>().FirstOrDefault();
						pdc = InvokeDataMemberOfExpandoObject(expandoObject, dataMember, parameters);
						return true;
					}
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMember))
					{
						pdc = GetItemProperties(enumerableType);
					}
					else
					{
						pdc = GetItemProperties(FindMethod(type, dataMember, parameters).ReturnType);
					}
					return true;
				}
				if (typeof(ITypedList).IsAssignableFrom(type))
				{
					pdc = ((ITypedList)instance).GetItemProperties(null);
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMember))
					{
						pdc = ((ITypedList)instance).GetItemProperties(new PropertyDescriptor[1] { pdc[dataMember] });
					}
					return true;
				}
				if (typeof(IEnumerable).IsAssignableFrom(type) && instance != null)
				{
					object obj = ((IEnumerable)instance).Cast<object>().FirstOrDefault();
					if (obj != null)
					{
						pdc = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMember) ? obj.GetType() : FindMethod(obj, dataMember, parameters).ReturnType);
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}

			private PropertyDescriptorCollection GetPropertiesFromDataMember(Type type, string dataMember, ParameterList parameters, bool ctorIsNull, ParameterList ctorParameters)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMember))
				{
					return TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(type);
				}
				MethodInfo methodInfo = FindMethod(type, dataMember, parameters);
				Type type2 = methodInfo.ReturnType;
				if (typeof(IListSource).IsAssignableFrom(type2) && !BindingHelper.IsEFDbSet(type2))
				{
					GetData(type, methodInfo, parameters, ctorIsNull, ctorParameters);
					data = ((IListSource)data).GetList();
					type2 = data.GetType();
				}
				if (typeof(ExpandoObject).IsAssignableFrom(type2))
				{
					GetData(type, methodInfo, parameters, ctorIsNull, ctorParameters);
					return GetExpandoObjectProperties((ExpandoObject)data);
				}
				if (IsEnumerable(type2, out var enumerableType))
				{
					if (typeof(ExpandoObject).IsAssignableFrom(enumerableType))
					{
						GetData(type, methodInfo, parameters, ctorIsNull, ctorParameters);
						return GetExpandoObjectProperties(((IEnumerable)data).Cast<ExpandoObject>().FirstOrDefault());
					}
					return GetItemProperties(enumerableType);
				}
				if (typeof(ITypedList).IsAssignableFrom(type2))
				{
					GetData(type, methodInfo, parameters, ctorIsNull, ctorParameters);
					return ((ITypedList)data).GetItemProperties(null);
				}
				return TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(type2);
			}

			private void GetData(Type type, MethodInfo method, ParameterList parameters, bool ctorIsNull, ParameterList ctorParameters)
			{
				if (data == null && !(method.ReturnType == typeof(void)))
				{
					if (instance == null && !method.IsStatic)
					{
						instance = CreateInstance(type, ctorIsNull, ctorParameters);
					}
					else if (method.IsStatic)
					{
						instance = type;
					}
					data = method.Invoke(instance, GetValues(method, parameters));
				}
			}

			private PropertyDescriptorCollection GetExpandoObjectProperties(ExpandoObject instance)
			{
				if (instance == null)
				{
					return PropertyDescriptorCollection.Empty;
				}
				PropertyDescriptor[] properties = (PropertyDescriptor[])(object)GetItemExpandoObjectProperties(instance).ToArray();
				return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(properties, readOnly: true);
			}

			private IEnumerable<ExpandoPropertyDescriptor> GetItemExpandoObjectProperties(ExpandoObject instance)
			{
				foreach (KeyValuePair<string, object> item in (IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<string, object>>)instance)
				{
					string key = item.Key;
					object value = item.Value;
					if (!(value is Delegate))
					{
						yield return new ExpandoPropertyDescriptor((DataControllerBase)null, key, (value == null) ? typeof(object) : value.GetType());
					}
				}
			}

			private PropertyDescriptorCollection InvokeDataMemberOfExpandoObject(ExpandoObject instance, string dataMember, ParameterList parameters)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMember))
				{
					return GetExpandoObjectProperties(instance);
				}
				data = ((IDictionary<string, object>)instance)[dataMember];
				Type type = data.GetType();
				if (data is Delegate)
				{
					Delegate[] allMembers = GetExpandoObjectMethods(instance, dataMember).ToArray();
					Delegate obj2 = FindMemberCore(allMembers, dataMember, parameters);
					data = obj2.DynamicInvoke(GetValues(obj2.GetMethodInfo(), parameters));
					type = data.GetType();
				}
				if (typeof(ExpandoObject).IsAssignableFrom(type))
				{
					return GetExpandoObjectProperties((ExpandoObject)data);
				}
				if (IsEnumerable(type, out var enumerableType))
				{
					if (typeof(ExpandoObject).IsAssignableFrom(enumerableType))
					{
						return GetExpandoObjectProperties(((IEnumerable)data).Cast<ExpandoObject>().FirstOrDefault());
					}
					return TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(enumerableType);
				}
				if (typeof(ITypedList).IsAssignableFrom(type))
				{
					return ((ITypedList)data).GetItemProperties(null);
				}
				return TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(data);
			}

			private IEnumerable<Delegate> GetExpandoObjectMethods(ExpandoObject expando, string methodName)
			{
				return (from pair in expando
					where pair.Key == methodName
					select pair.Value).OfType<Delegate>();
			}

			private object CreateInstance(Type type, bool ctorIsNull, ParameterList ctorParameters)
			{
				if (ctorIsNull)
				{
					ConstructorInfo constructorInfo = FindConstructor(type, new ParameterList(0));
					return constructorInfo.Invoke(null);
				}
				ConstructorInfo constructorInfo2 = FindConstructor(type, ctorParameters);
				return constructorInfo2.Invoke(GetValues(constructorInfo2, ctorParameters));
			}
		}

		internal static bool IsEnumerable(Type type, out Type enumerableType)
		{
			if (typeof(IEnumerable).IsAssignableFrom(type))
			{
				enumerableType = GetItemType(type);
				return enumerableType != typeof(object);
			}
			enumerableType = null;
			return false;
		}

		public static object CreateInstanceForSchema(object dataSource)
		{
			Type type = dataSource as Type;
			object obj = null;
			if (type == null)
			{
				type = dataSource.GetType();
				obj = dataSource;
			}
			if (typeof(IListSource).IsAssignableFrom(type))
			{
				obj = obj ?? CreateInstance(type);
				return ((IListSource)obj).GetList();
			}
			if (typeof(ITypedList).IsAssignableFrom(type))
			{
				return obj ?? CreateInstance(type);
			}
			return type;
		}

		public static object CreateInstanceForResult(object dataSource)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull(dataSource, "dataSource");
			Type type = dataSource as Type;
			if (type == null)
			{
				type = dataSource.GetType();
				if (!typeof(IListSource).IsAssignableFrom(type))
				{
					return dataSource;
				}
				return ((IListSource)dataSource).GetList();
			}
			return type;
		}

		public static object CreateInstanceForResult(object dataSource, ParameterList ctorParameters)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull(dataSource, "dataSource");
			Type type = dataSource as Type;
			object obj;
			if (type == null)
			{
				type = dataSource.GetType();
				obj = dataSource;
			}
			else
			{
				obj = CreateInstance(type, ctorParameters);
			}
			if (typeof(IListSource).IsAssignableFrom(type))
			{
				return ((IListSource)obj).GetList();
			}
			return obj;
		}

		public static object CreateInstance(Type dsType)
		{
			ConstructorInfo constructor = dsType.GetConstructor(new Type[0]);
			if (constructor == null)
			{
				throw new NoDefaultConstructorException(dsType);
			}
			return constructor.Invoke(new object[0]);
		}

		private static object CreateInstance(Type dsType, ParameterList ctorParameters)
		{
			ConstructorInfo constructorInfo = FindConstructor(dsType, ctorParameters);
			return constructorInfo.Invoke(GetValues(constructorInfo, ctorParameters));
		}

		public static ConstructorInfo FindConstructor(Type dsType, ParameterList ctorParameters)
		{
			ConstructorInfo[] constructors = dsType.GetConstructors();
			return FindMemberCore(constructors, dsType, ctorParameters);
		}

		private static object[] GetValues(ConstructorInfo ctor, IEnumerable<Parameter> parameterList)
		{
			return GetValues(ctor.GetParameters(), parameterList);
		}

		public static object BrowseForResult(object instance, string dataMember, ParameterList parameters)
		{
			if (instance is ITypedList typedList)
			{
				return BrowseTypedList(dataMember, typedList);
			}
			MethodInfo methodInfo = FindMethod(instance, dataMember, parameters);
			if (!methodInfo.IsStatic && instance is Type && methodInfo.DeclaringType != typeof(Type))
			{
				return methodInfo.ReturnType;
			}
			object[] values = GetValues(methodInfo, parameters);
			if (instance is IEnumerable source)
			{
				IEnumerable<object> enumerable = source.Cast<object>();
				int length = enumerable.Count();
				Array array = Array.CreateInstance(methodInfo.ReturnType, length);
				int num = 0;
				{
					foreach (object item in enumerable)
					{
						array.SetValue(methodInfo.Invoke(item, values), num++);
					}
					return array;
				}
			}
			try
			{
				return methodInfo.Invoke(instance, values) ?? methodInfo.ReturnType;
			}
			catch (TargetInvocationException ex)
			{
				throw ex.InnerException;
			}
		}

		public static object BrowseTypedList(string dataMember, ITypedList typedList)
		{
			IEnumerable enumerable = typedList as IEnumerable;
			PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = typedList.GetItemProperties(null)[dataMember];
			if (propertyDescriptor == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(string.Format(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.ODSErrorMissingMember), dataMember));
			}
			if (enumerable != null)
			{
				ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
				{
					foreach (object item in enumerable)
					{
						if (propertyDescriptor.GetValue(item) is IEnumerable enumerable2)
						{
							foreach (object item2 in enumerable2)
							{
								arrayList.Add(item2);
							}
						}
						else
						{
							arrayList.Add(propertyDescriptor.GetValue(item));
						}
					}
					return arrayList;
				}
			}
			return propertyDescriptor.GetValue(typedList);
		}

		public static MethodInfo FindMethod(object instance, string dataMember, ParameterList parameters)
		{
			MemberInfo memberInfo = FindMemberCore(instance, dataMember, parameters);
			PropertyInfo propertyInfo = memberInfo as PropertyInfo;
			if (propertyInfo != null)
			{
				return propertyInfo.GetGetMethod();
			}
			MethodInfo methodInfo = memberInfo as MethodInfo;
			if (methodInfo != null)
			{
				return methodInfo;
			}
			throw new InvalidOperationException(string.Format(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.ODSErrorMissingMember), dataMember));
		}

		private static object[] GetValues(MethodInfo method, IEnumerable<Parameter> parameterList)
		{
			return GetValues(method.GetParameters(), parameterList);
		}

		public static ResultTypedList CreateTypedList(object data, string name)
		{
			PropertyDescriptorCollection itemProperties = GetItemProperties(data);
			Type type = data as Type;
			if (type != null)
			{
				return new ResultTypedList(name, itemProperties);
			}
			IEnumerable data2 = (data as IEnumerable) ?? new object[1] { data };
			if (data is ITypedList)
			{
				return new ResultTypedList(name, (ITypedList)data, data2);
			}
			return new ResultTypedList(name, itemProperties, data2);
		}

		public static ResultTypedList CreateTypedList(object data, string name, PropertyDescriptorCollection pdc)
		{
			Type type = data as Type;
			if (type != null)
			{
				return new ResultTypedList(name, pdc);
			}
			type = data.GetType();
			if (typeof(ExpandoObject).IsAssignableFrom(type))
			{
				return new ResultTypedList(name, pdc, new object[1] { data });
			}
			IEnumerable data2 = (data as IEnumerable) ?? new object[1] { data };
			if (data is ITypedList)
			{
				return new ResultTypedList(name, (ITypedList)data, data2);
			}
			return new ResultTypedList(name, pdc, data2);
		}

		public static PropertyDescriptorCollection GetItemProperties(object data)
		{
			Type type = (data as Type) ?? data.GetType();
			if (typeof(IEnumerable).IsAssignableFrom(type))
			{
				type = GetItemType(type);
			}
			return GetItemProperties(type);
		}

		private static PropertyDescriptorCollection GetItemProperties(Type type)
		{
			if (!type.IsInterface)
			{
				return GetTypeProperties(type);
			}
			List<Type> list = new List<Type>(new Type[1] { type });
			list.AddRange(type.GetInterfaces());
			List<PropertyDescriptor> list2 = new List<PropertyDescriptor>();
			foreach (Type item in list)
			{
				PropertyDescriptorCollection typeProperties = GetTypeProperties(item);
				list2.AddRange(typeProperties.Cast<PropertyDescriptor>());
			}
			return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(list2.ToArray());
		}

		private static PropertyDescriptorCollection GetTypeProperties(Type type)
		{
			try
			{
				type = Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(type) ?? type;
				return TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(type);
			}
			catch (FileNotFoundException)
			{
				return PropertyDescriptorCollection.Empty;
			}
		}

		public static object BrowseForSchema(object instance, ObjectMember dataMember)
		{
			if (dataMember == null)
			{
				return instance;
			}
			if (instance is ITypedList typedList && dataMember.Pd != null)
			{
				if (typedList is IEnumerable source)
				{
					object obj = source.Cast<object>().FirstOrDefault();
					if (obj != null)
					{
						return dataMember.Pd.GetValue(obj);
					}
					return dataMember.Pd.PropertyType;
				}
				return dataMember.Pd.GetValue(typedList);
			}
			if (instance is IEnumerable)
			{
				return typeof(IEnumerable<>).MakeGenericType(dataMember.ReturnType);
			}
			return dataMember.ReturnType;
		}

		public static ObjectMember FindMember(object instance, string dataMember, ParameterList parameters)
		{
			if (!(instance is ITypedList typedList))
			{
				return new ObjectMember(FindMemberCore(instance, dataMember, parameters));
			}
			PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = typedList.GetItemProperties(null)[dataMember];
			if (propertyDescriptor == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new ObjectMember(propertyDescriptor);
		}

		public static IEnumerable<ObjectMember> GetItemMembers(object data)
		{
			IEnumerable<ObjectMember> source = ((data is ITypedList typedList) ? GetItemMembersCore(typedList) : GetItemMembersCore((data as Type) ?? data.GetType()));
			return source.Where((ObjectMember member) => IsBrowsable(member) && member.ReturnType.FullName != null && !DataContext.IsStandardType(member.ReturnType));
		}

		public static ParameterList EvaluateParametersForSchema(IEnumerable<Parameter> odsParameters)
		{
			return new ParameterList(odsParameters.Select((Parameter parameter) => (!(parameter.Type == typeof(Expression))) ? parameter : new Parameter(parameter.Name, ((Expression)parameter.Value).ResultType, null)));
		}

		public static ParameterList EvaluateParametersForResult(ParameterList odsParameters, IEnumerable<IParameter> envParameters)
		{
			return new ParameterList(odsParameters.Select(delegate(Parameter parameter)
			{
				if (parameter.Type == typeof(Expression))
				{
					Expression expression = (Expression)parameter.Value;
					return new Parameter(parameter.Name, expression.ResultType, expression.EvaluateExpression(envParameters));
				}
				return parameter;
			}));
		}

		private static bool IsBrowsable(ObjectMember member)
		{
			foreach (System.Attribute attribute in member.Attributes)
			{
				if (attribute is BrowsableAttribute browsableAttribute)
				{
					return browsableAttribute.Browsable;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static IEnumerable<ObjectMember> GetItemMembersCore(Type type)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (typeof(IEnumerable).IsAssignableFrom(type))
			{
				type = GetItemType(type);
				flag = true;
			}
			IEnumerable<PropertyInfo> enumerable = GetProperties(type);
			IEnumerable<MethodInfo> enumerable2 = GetMethods(type);
			if (flag)
			{
				enumerable = enumerable.Where((PropertyInfo info) => !info.GetGetMethod().IsStatic);
				enumerable2 = enumerable2.Where((MethodInfo info) => !info.IsStatic);
			}
			enumerable = RemoveShadowed(enumerable);
			enumerable2 = RemoveShadowed(enumerable2);
			IEnumerable<ObjectMember> enumerable3 = from info in ((IEnumerable<MemberInfo>)enumerable.Where((PropertyInfo p) => p.GetGetMethod() != null)).Union((IEnumerable<MemberInfo>)enumerable2)
				select new ObjectMember(info);
			if (type.IsAbstract && type.IsSealed)
			{
				enumerable3 = enumerable3.Where((ObjectMember member) => member.IsStatic);
			}
			return enumerable3;
		}

		private static IEnumerable<PropertyInfo> GetProperties(Type type)
		{
			Func<PropertyInfo, bool> predicate = delegate(PropertyInfo info)
			{
				try
				{
					return info.GetIndexParameters().Length == 0;
				}
				catch
				{
					return false;
				}
			};
			return type.GetProperties().Where(predicate).ToList();
		}

		private static IEnumerable<MethodInfo> GetMethods(Type type)
		{
			Func<MethodInfo, bool> predicate = delegate(MethodInfo info)
			{
				try
				{
					return info.ReturnType != typeof(void) && !IsPropertyGetter(info, type) && info.DeclaringType != typeof(object);
				}
				catch
				{
					return false;
				}
			};
			return type.GetMethods().Where(predicate).ToList();
		}

		private static IEnumerable<PropertyInfo> RemoveShadowed(IEnumerable<PropertyInfo> properties)
		{
			List<PropertyInfo> list = properties.OrderBy((PropertyInfo info) => info.Name).ToList();
			for (int num = 0; num < list.Count - 1; num++)
			{
				PropertyInfo propertyInfo = list[num];
				PropertyInfo propertyInfo2 = list[num + 1];
				if (string.Equals(propertyInfo.Name, propertyInfo2.Name, StringComparison.Ordinal))
				{
					list.RemoveAt(propertyInfo2.DeclaringType.IsAssignableFrom(propertyInfo.DeclaringType) ? (num + 1) : num);
					num--;
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static IEnumerable<MethodInfo> RemoveShadowed(IEnumerable<MethodInfo> methods)
		{
			List<MethodInfo> list = methods.OrderBy((MethodInfo info) => string.Format("{0}({1})", info.Name, string.Join(",", from parameterInfo in info.GetParameters()
				select parameterInfo.ParameterType.FullName))).ToList();
			for (int num = 0; num < list.Count - 1; num++)
			{
				MethodInfo methodInfo = list[num];
				MethodInfo methodInfo2 = list[num + 1];
				if (string.Equals(methodInfo.Name, methodInfo2.Name, StringComparison.Ordinal) && HasSameParameters(methodInfo, methodInfo2))
				{
					list.RemoveAt(methodInfo2.DeclaringType.IsAssignableFrom(methodInfo.DeclaringType) ? (num + 1) : num);
					num--;
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static bool HasSameParameters(MethodInfo x, MethodInfo y)
		{
			ParameterInfo[] parameters = x.GetParameters();
			ParameterInfo[] parameters2 = y.GetParameters();
			int num = parameters.Length;
			if (parameters2.Length != num)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				if (parameters[i].ParameterType != parameters2[i].ParameterType)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static IEnumerable<ObjectMember> GetItemMembersCore(ITypedList typedList)
		{
			try
			{
				return from PropertyDescriptor descriptor in typedList.GetItemProperties(null)
					select (!descriptor.GetType().ToString().Contains("DataTablePropertyDescriptor")) ? new ObjectMember(descriptor) : new ObjectMember(new DTPropertyDescriptor(descriptor));
			}
			catch
			{
				return new ObjectMember[0];
			}
		}

		private static bool IsPropertyGetter(MethodInfo method, Type objectType)
		{
			if (!method.Name.StartsWith("get_"))
			{
				return false;
			}
			string text = method.Name.Substring(4);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return false;
			}
			PropertyInfo property = objectType.GetProperty(text, method.ReturnType, (from pi in method.GetParameters()
				select pi.ParameterType).ToArray());
			if (property == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return property.GetGetMethod() == method;
		}

		private static object[] GetValues(IEnumerable<ParameterInfo> signature, IEnumerable<Parameter> parameterList)
		{
			return signature.Select((ParameterInfo info) => parameterList.First((Parameter parameter) => string.Equals(parameter.Name, info.Name, StringComparison.Ordinal)).Value).ToArray();
		}

		public static Type GetItemType(Type enumerableType)
		{
			if (TypeHelper.IsEnumerable(enumerableType, out var itemType))
			{
				return itemType;
			}
			return typeof(object);
		}

		private static MemberInfo FindMemberCore(object instance, string dataMember, ParameterList parameters)
		{
			Type type = (instance as Type) ?? instance.GetType();
			if (typeof(IEnumerable).IsAssignableFrom(type))
			{
				type = GetItemType(type);
			}
			MemberInfo[] member = type.GetMember(dataMember);
			return FindMemberCore(member, dataMember, parameters);
		}

		private static TMember FindMemberCore<TMember>(TMember[] allMembers, string memberName, ParameterList parameters) where TMember : MemberInfo
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)parameters, "parameters");
			List<TMember> list = new List<TMember>(allMembers.Length);
			foreach (TMember val in allMembers)
			{
				PropertyInfo propertyInfo = val as PropertyInfo;
				if (propertyInfo != null)
				{
					if (parameters.Count == 0)
					{
						list.Add((TMember)(MemberInfo)propertyInfo);
					}
				}
				else if (CheckSignature((MethodBase)(object)val, parameters))
				{
					list.Add(val);
				}
			}
			return Unique(list, memberName, parameters);
		}

		private static ConstructorInfo FindMemberCore(ConstructorInfo[] allMembers, Type type, ParameterList parameters)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)parameters, "parameters");
			List<ConstructorInfo> list = allMembers.Where((ConstructorInfo ctor) => CheckSignature(ctor, parameters)).ToList();
			if (list.Count == 1)
			{
				return list[0];
			}
			if (list.Count > 1)
			{
				throw new AmbiguousConstructorException(type, parameters);
			}
			if (parameters.Count == 0)
			{
				throw new NoDefaultConstructorException(type);
			}
			throw new ConstructorNotFoundException(type, parameters);
		}

		private static Delegate FindMemberCore(Delegate[] allMembers, string memberName, ParameterList parameters)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)parameters, "parameters");
			List<Delegate> matches = allMembers.Where((Delegate member) => CheckSignature(member.GetMethodInfo(), parameters)).ToList();
			return Unique(matches, memberName, parameters);
		}

		private static bool CheckSignature(MethodBase method, ParameterList parameters)
		{
			ParameterInfo[] parameters2 = method.GetParameters();
			if (parameters2.Length != parameters.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ParameterInfo[] array = parameters2;
			foreach (ParameterInfo expected in array)
			{
				Parameter parameter = parameters.FirstOrDefault((Parameter p) => string.Equals(p.Name, expected.Name, StringComparison.Ordinal));
				if (parameter == null || !expected.ParameterType.IsAssignableFrom(parameter.Type))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static T Unique<T>(List<T> matches, string memberName, ParameterList parameters)
		{
			if (matches.Count == 0)
			{
				throw new DataMemberResolveException(string.Format("Cannot find the following DataMember: {0}({1}).", memberName, string.Join(", ", parameters)));
			}
			if (matches.Count > 1)
			{
				throw new DataMemberResolveException(string.Format("DataMember ambiguous match: {0}({1}).", memberName, string.Join(", ", parameters)));
			}
			return matches[0];
		}
	}
	public class DTPropertyDescriptor : PropertyDescriptor
	{
		private readonly PropertyDescriptor innerDescriptor;

		private readonly Type dataTableType;

		public override Type ComponentType => innerDescriptor.ComponentType;

		public override bool IsReadOnly => innerDescriptor.IsReadOnly;

		public override Type PropertyType => dataTableType;

		public DTPropertyDescriptor(PropertyDescriptor innerDescriptor)
			: base(innerDescriptor.Name, null)
		{
			this.innerDescriptor = innerDescriptor;
			PropertyInfo property = innerDescriptor.GetType().GetProperty("Table");
			object value = property.GetValue(innerDescriptor, null);
			dataTableType = value.GetType();
		}

		public override bool CanResetValue(object component)
		{
			return innerDescriptor.CanResetValue(component);
		}

		public override object GetValue(object component)
		{
			return innerDescriptor.GetValue(component);
		}

		public override void ResetValue(object component)
		{
			innerDescriptor.ResetValue(component);
		}

		public override void SetValue(object component, object value)
		{
			innerDescriptor.SetValue(component, value);
		}

		public override bool ShouldSerializeValue(object component)
		{
			return innerDescriptor.ShouldSerializeValue(component);
		}
	}
	public class ObjectDataSourceSerializer : IDataSerializer
	{
		public const string XML_ObjectDataSource = "ObjectDataSource";

		public const string XML_Name = "Name";

		public const string XML_DataSource = "DataSource";

		public const string XML_DataSourceType = "Type";

		public const string XML_DataMember = "DataMember";

		public const string XML_Parameters = "Parameters";

		public const string XML_Constructor = "Constructor";

		private static ObjectDataSourceSerializerBase instance;

		private static ObjectDataSourceSerializerBase Instance
		{
			get
			{
				if (instance == null)
				{
					instance = new ObjectDataSourceSerializerBase();
				}
				return instance;
			}
		}

		public static XElement SaveToXml(ObjectDataSource data)
		{
			return SaveToXml(data, null, null);
		}

		public static XElement SaveToXml(ObjectDataSource data, IExtensionsProvider extensionProvider, ISerializableTypesCollector collector)
		{
			return Instance.SaveToXml(data, extensionProvider, collector);
		}

		public static ObjectDataSource LoadFromXml(XElement element)
		{
			return LoadFromXml(element, null);
		}

		public static ObjectDataSource LoadFromXml(XElement element, IExtensionsProvider extensionsProvider)
		{
			ObjectDataSource objectDataSource = new ObjectDataSource();
			LoadFromXml(objectDataSource, element, extensionsProvider);
			return objectDataSource;
		}

		public static void LoadFromXml(ObjectDataSource target, XElement element)
		{
			LoadFromXml(target, element, null);
		}

		public static void LoadFromXml(ObjectDataSource target, XElement element, IExtensionsProvider extensionsProvider)
		{
			Instance.LoadFromXml(target, element, extensionsProvider);
		}

		bool IDataSerializer.CanSerialize(object data, object extensionProvider)
		{
			return ((IDataSerializer)Instance).CanSerialize(data, extensionProvider);
		}

		string IDataSerializer.Serialize(object data, object extensionProvider)
		{
			return ((IDataSerializer)Instance).Serialize(data, extensionProvider);
		}

		bool IDataSerializer.CanDeserialize(string value, string typeName, object extensionProvider)
		{
			return ((IDataSerializer)Instance).CanDeserialize(value, typeName, extensionProvider);
		}

		object IDataSerializer.Deserialize(string value, string typeName, object extensionProvider)
		{
			return ((IDataSerializer)Instance).Deserialize(value, typeName, extensionProvider);
		}
	}
	internal class ObjectDataSourceSerializerBase : IDataSerializer
	{
		public XName ObjectDataSourceSerializerXML_DataSourceType { get; private set; }

		private ISerializableTypesCollector Collector { get; set; }

		public virtual XElement SaveToXml(ObjectDataSource data)
		{
			Collector = null;
			return SaveToXml(data, null, null);
		}

		public virtual XElement SaveToXml(ObjectDataSource data, IExtensionsProvider extensionProvider, ISerializableTypesCollector collector)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)data, "data");
			Collector = collector;
			XElement xElement = new XElement("ObjectDataSource");
			SaveName(data, xElement);
			SaveDataSource(data, xElement, extensionProvider);
			SaveDataMember(data, xElement);
			SaveParameters(data, xElement, extensionProvider);
			SaveCtorParameters(data, xElement, extensionProvider);
			return xElement;
		}

		protected virtual void SaveName(ObjectDataSource objectDataSource, XElement rootEl)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(objectDataSource.Name))
			{
				rootEl.AddAttribute(objectDataSource.Name, "Name");
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SaveDataSource(ObjectDataSource data, XElement rootEl, IExtensionsProvider extensionsProvider)
		{
			if (data.DataSource == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			XElement xElement = new XElement("DataSource");
			Type type = data.ResolveType();
			Collector?.SerializableTypes.Add(type);
			XAttribute content = new XAttribute("Type", type.AssemblyQualifiedName);
			xElement.Add(content);
			if (!(data.DataSource is Type))
			{
				string value = default(string);
				if (ObjectConverter.Instance.CanConvertToString(data.DataSource.GetType()))
				{
					xElement.Value = ObjectConverter.Instance.ConvertToString(data.DataSource);
				}
				else if (SerializationService.SerializeObject(data.DataSource, ref value, extensionsProvider))
				{
					xElement.Value = value;
				}
			}
			rootEl.Add(xElement);
		}

		protected virtual void SaveDataMember(ObjectDataSource data, XElement rootEl)
		{
			if (data.DataMember != null)
			{
				XElement xElement = new XElement("DataMember");
				xElement.Value = data.DataMember;
				rootEl.Add(xElement);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SaveParameters(ObjectDataSource data, XElement rootEl, IExtensionsProvider extensionsProvider)
		{
			if (data.Parameters == null || data.Parameters.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			XElement xElement = new XElement("Parameters");
			foreach (Parameter parameter in data.Parameters)
			{
				xElement.Add(DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.QuerySerializer.SerializeParameter(extensionsProvider, parameter));
			}
			rootEl.Add(xElement);
		}

		protected virtual void SaveCtorParameters(ObjectDataSource data, XElement rootEl, IExtensionsProvider extensionsProvider)
		{
			if (data.Constructor == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			XElement xElement = new XElement("Constructor");
			foreach (Parameter parameter in data.Constructor.Parameters)
			{
				xElement.Add(DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.QuerySerializer.SerializeParameter(extensionsProvider, parameter));
			}
			rootEl.Add(xElement);
		}

		public virtual ObjectDataSource LoadFromXml(XElement element)
		{
			return LoadFromXml(element, null);
		}

		public virtual ObjectDataSource LoadFromXml(XElement element, IExtensionsProvider extensionsProvider)
		{
			ObjectDataSource objectDataSource = new ObjectDataSource();
			LoadFromXml(objectDataSource, element, extensionsProvider);
			return objectDataSource;
		}

		public virtual void LoadFromXml(ObjectDataSource target, XElement element)
		{
			LoadFromXml(target, element, null);
		}

		public virtual void LoadFromXml(ObjectDataSource target, XElement element, IExtensionsProvider extensionsProvider)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)target, "target");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)element, "element");
			if (!string.Equals(element.Name.LocalName, "ObjectDataSource", StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Incorrect XML root element: <" + element.Name.LocalName + ">, <ObjectDataSource> is expected.");
			}
			bool flag = false;
			target.BeginUpdate();
			Clear(target);
			LoadName(target, element);
			LoadDataSource(target, element, extensionsProvider);
			LoadDataMember(target, element);
			LoadParameters(target, element, extensionsProvider);
			LoadCtorParameters(target, element, extensionsProvider);
			try
			{
				target.EndUpdate();
			}
			catch (NoDefaultConstructorException)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				target.DataSource = null;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void Clear(ObjectDataSource target)
		{
			target.DataSource = null;
			target.DataMember = null;
			target.Parameters.Clear();
			target.Constructor = null;
		}

		protected virtual void LoadName(ObjectDataSource target, XElement element)
		{
			string attributeOrElementValue = element.GetAttributeOrElementValue("Name");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(attributeOrElementValue))
			{
				target.Name = attributeOrElementValue;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void LoadDataSource(ObjectDataSource target, XElement element, IExtensionsProvider extensionsProvider)
		{
			XElement xElement = element.Element("DataSource");
			if (xElement == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string attributeValue = xElement.GetAttributeValue("Type");
			Type type = TryGetType(extensionsProvider, attributeValue);
			if (type == null)
			{
				if (!SafeTypeResolver.IsTypeAvailable(attributeValue, ref type, (Predicate<Type>)null, false))
				{
					throw new TypeLoadException("Could not load type '" + attributeValue + "'.");
				}
				SafeTypeResolver.Validate(type, (bool?)null, (bool?)null);
			}
			string value = xElement.Value;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				target.DataSource = type;
				return;
			}
			if (ObjectConverter.Instance.CanConvertFromString(type, value))
			{
				target.DataSource = ObjectConverter.Instance.ConvertFromString(type, value);
				return;
			}
			object dataSource = default(object);
			if (SerializationService.DeserializeObject(value, type, ref dataSource, extensionsProvider))
			{
				target.DataSource = dataSource;
				return;
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException("Binary serialization is no longer supported. Refer to the following BC for details: https://supportcenter.devexpress.com/ticket/details/t1159158/dataaccess-library-binary-serialization-of-multiple-properties-replaced-by-a-custom");
		}

		protected virtual Type TryGetType(IExtensionsProvider extensionsProvider, string typeName)
		{
			if (!(((extensionsProvider is IServiceProvider serviceProvider) ? serviceProvider.GetService(typeof(ITypeResolutionService)) : null) is ITypeResolutionService typeResolutionService))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return typeResolutionService.GetType(typeName);
		}

		protected virtual void LoadDataMember(ObjectDataSource target, XElement element)
		{
			XElement xElement = element.Element("DataMember");
			if (xElement != null)
			{
				target.DataMember = xElement.Value.Trim();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void LoadParameters(ObjectDataSource target, XElement element, IExtensionsProvider extensionsProvider)
		{
			XElement paramsEl = element.Element("Parameters");
			LoadParametersCore(target.Parameters, paramsEl, extensionsProvider);
		}

		protected virtual void LoadCtorParameters(ObjectDataSource target, XElement element, IExtensionsProvider extensionsProvider)
		{
			XElement xElement = element.Element("Constructor");
			if (xElement != null)
			{
				target.Constructor = new ObjectConstructorInfo();
				LoadParametersCore(target.Constructor.Parameters, xElement, extensionsProvider);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void LoadParametersCore(ParameterList target, XElement paramsEl, IExtensionsProvider extensionsProvider)
		{
			if (paramsEl == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (XElement item in paramsEl.Elements("Parameter"))
			{
				Parameter parameter = new Parameter();
				DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.QuerySerializer.DeserializeParameter(parameter, item, extensionsProvider);
				target.Add(parameter);
			}
		}

		bool IDataSerializer.CanSerialize(object data, object extensionProvider)
		{
			if (data == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return data.GetType() == typeof(ObjectDataSource);
		}

		string IDataSerializer.Serialize(object data, object extensionProvider)
		{
			return SaveToXml((ObjectDataSource)data, (IExtensionsProvider)((extensionProvider is IExtensionsProvider) ? extensionProvider : null), null).ToString(SaveOptions.DisableFormatting);
		}

		bool IDataSerializer.CanDeserialize(string value, string typeName, object extensionProvider)
		{
			if (!string.Equals(typeName, typeof(ObjectDataSource).FullName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				return false;
			}
			try
			{
				return string.Equals(SafeXml.CreateXElement(value, (Action<XmlReaderSettings>)null).Name.LocalName, "ObjectDataSource", StringComparison.Ordinal);
			}
			catch (XmlException)
			{
				return false;
			}
		}

		object IDataSerializer.Deserialize(string value, string typeName, object extensionProvider)
		{
			return LoadFromXml(SafeXml.CreateXElement(value, (Action<XmlReaderSettings>)null), (IExtensionsProvider)((extensionProvider is IExtensionsProvider) ? extensionProvider : null));
		}
	}
	public class ResultTypedList : ITypedList, IList, ICollection, IEnumerable, ICloneable
	{
		private readonly string name;

		private readonly PropertyDescriptorCollection pdc;

		private readonly ITypedList typedList;

		private readonly IList innerList;

		public bool IsFixedSize => true;

		public bool IsReadOnly => true;

		public object this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return innerList[index];
			}
			set
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
		}

		public int Count => innerList.Count;

		public bool IsSynchronized => false;

		public object SyncRoot => null;

		public ResultTypedList(string name, ITypedList typedList, IEnumerable data)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)data, "data");
			this.typedList = typedList;
			this.name = name;
			innerList = (data as IList) ?? data.Cast<object>().ToList();
		}

		public ResultTypedList(string name, PropertyDescriptorCollection pdc)
		{
			this.pdc = pdc;
			this.name = name;
			innerList = new ArrayList(0);
		}

		public ResultTypedList(string name, PropertyDescriptorCollection pdc, IEnumerable data)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)data, "data");
			this.pdc = pdc;
			this.name = name;
			innerList = (data as IList) ?? data.Cast<object>().ToList();
		}

		public object Clone()
		{
			if (pdc == null)
			{
				return new ResultTypedList(name, typedList, innerList);
			}
			return new ResultTypedList(name, pdc, innerList);
		}

		public string GetListName(PropertyDescriptor[] listAccessors)
		{
			if (listAccessors == null || listAccessors.Length == 0)
			{
				return name;
			}
			return GetList(listAccessors[0])?.GetListName(listAccessors.Skip(1).ToArray());
		}

		public PropertyDescriptorCollection GetItemProperties(PropertyDescriptor[] listAccessors)
		{
			if (typedList != null)
			{
				return typedList.GetItemProperties(listAccessors);
			}
			if (listAccessors == null || listAccessors.Length == 0)
			{
				return pdc;
			}
			ITypedList list = GetList(listAccessors[0]);
			if (list == null)
			{
				return PropertyDescriptorCollection.Empty;
			}
			return list.GetItemProperties(listAccessors.Skip(1).ToArray());
		}

		private ITypedList GetList(PropertyDescriptor pd)
		{
			if (typeof(IEnumerable).IsAssignableFrom(pd.PropertyType))
			{
				Type itemType = ObjectDataSourceFillHelper.GetItemType(pd.PropertyType);
				if (itemType != typeof(object))
				{
					return new ResultTypedList(name, ObjectDataSourceFillHelper.GetItemProperties(itemType));
				}
			}
			if (typeof(ITypedList).IsAssignableFrom(pd.PropertyType))
			{
				return GetNestedList(pd);
			}
			return ObjectDataSourceFillHelper.CreateTypedList(pd.PropertyType, pd.Name);
		}

		private ITypedList GetNestedList(PropertyDescriptor pd)
		{
			object component;
			if (Count > 0)
			{
				component = this[0];
			}
			else
			{
				Type componentType = pd.ComponentType;
				if (componentType.IsAbstract)
				{
					return null;
				}
				ConstructorInfo constructor = componentType.GetConstructor(new Type[0]);
				if (constructor == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				component = constructor.Invoke(new object[0]);
			}
			object value = pd.GetValue(component);
			if (!(value is ITypedList result))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public int Add(object value)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public bool Contains(object value)
		{
			return innerList.Contains(value);
		}

		public int IndexOf(object value)
		{
			return innerList.IndexOf(value);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, object value)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public void Remove(object value)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public void CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{
			innerList.CopyTo(array, index);
		}

		public IEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			return innerList.GetEnumerator();
		}
	}
	public static class TypeNamesHelper
	{
		private static readonly Dictionary<Type, string> aliases = new Dictionary<Type, string>
		{
			{
				typeof(byte),
				"byte"
			},
			{
				typeof(sbyte),
				"sbyte"
			},
			{
				typeof(short),
				"short"
			},
			{
				typeof(ushort),
				"ushort"
			},
			{
				typeof(int),
				"int"
			},
			{
				typeof(uint),
				"uint"
			},
			{
				typeof(long),
				"long"
			},
			{
				typeof(ulong),
				"ulong"
			},
			{
				typeof(float),
				"float"
			},
			{
				typeof(double),
				"double"
			},
			{
				typeof(decimal),
				"decimal"
			},
			{
				typeof(object),
				"object"
			},
			{
				typeof(bool),
				"bool"
			},
			{
				typeof(char),
				"char"
			},
			{
				typeof(string),
				"string"
			},
			{
				typeof(void),
				"void"
			}
		};

		public static string ShortName(Type type)
		{
			return NameCore(type, (Type t) => GetAliasForType(t) ?? t.Name);
		}

		public static string LongName(Type type)
		{
			return NameCore(type, (Type t) => GetAliasForType(t) ?? t.FullName);
		}

		private static string GetAliasForType(Type type)
		{
			if (!aliases.TryGetValue(type, out var value))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return value;
		}

		private static string NameCore(Type type, Func<Type, string> nameFunc)
		{
			if (!type.IsGenericType)
			{
				return nameFunc(type);
			}
			Type genericTypeDefinition = type.GetGenericTypeDefinition();
			Type[] genericArguments = type.GetGenericArguments();
			if (genericTypeDefinition == typeof(Nullable<>))
			{
				return NameCore(genericArguments[0], nameFunc) + "?";
			}
			return string.Format("{0}<{1}>", nameFunc(genericTypeDefinition).Split('`')[0], string.Join(", ", genericArguments.Select((Type typeArg) => NameCore(typeArg, nameFunc))));
		}
	}

		{
			if (obj is ConstructorInfo)
			{
				return ObjectDataSourceElementWrapper<ObjectDataSourceConstructorInfo, ConstructorInfo>.Wrap(obj as ConstructorInfo).Key == base.Key;
			}
			if (obj is MemberInfo)
			{
				return ObjectDataSourceElementWrapper<ObjectDataSourceMemberInfo, MemberInfo>.Wrap(obj as MemberInfo).Key == base.Key;
			}
			return base.Equals(obj);
		}

		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}
	}

	public class DefaultExceptionHandlerProxy : IExceptionHandlerProxy
	{
		public string GetExceptionMessage(Exception ex)
		{
			if (ex is DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.ValidationException validationException)
			{
				return GetMessageFromValidationException(validationException);
			}
			return ex.Message;
		}

		public static string GetMessageFromValidationException(DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.ValidationException validationException)
		{
			if (validationException is NoTablesValidationException || validationException is NoColumnsValidationException)
			{
				return DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.QueryBuilderNothingSelected);
			}
			if (validationException is SkipWithoutSortingValidationException)
			{
				return DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.SkipWithoutSortingWebValidationException);
			}
			return validationException.Message;
		}
	}
	public interface IExceptionHandlerProxy
	{
		string GetExceptionMessage(Exception ex);
	}

	public abstract class ObjectDataSourceElementWrapper<TContract, TElement> where TContract : ObjectDataSourceElement, new() where TElement : class
	{
		protected TContract Contract { get; set; }

		protected TElement Element { get; set; }

		public ObjectDataSourceElementWrapper(TElement element)
		{
			Element = element;
		}

		public static TContract Wrap(TElement element)
		{
			if (typeof(TContract) == typeof(ObjectDataSourceParameterInfo))
			{
				return new ObjectDataSourceParameterWrapper(element as ParameterInfo).Wrap() as TContract;
			}
			if (typeof(TContract) == typeof(ObjectDataSourceMemberInfo))
			{
				return new ObjectDataSourceMemberWrapper(element as MemberInfo).Wrap() as TContract;
			}
			if (typeof(TContract) == typeof(ObjectDataSourceConstructorInfo))
			{
				return new ObjectDataSourceCtorWrapper(element as ConstructorInfo).Wrap() as TContract;
			}
			if (typeof(TContract) == typeof(ObjectDataSourceTypeInfo))
			{
				return new ObjectDataSourceTypeWrapper(element as Type).Wrap() as TContract;
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected abstract void AssignToContract();

		public TContract Wrap()
		{
			Contract = new TContract();
			AssignToContract();
			return Contract;
		}

		protected string GetDisplayNameAttributeValue(MemberInfo member, Func<string> onFail)
		{
			System.ComponentModel.DisplayNameAttribute customAttribute = member.GetCustomAttribute<System.ComponentModel.DisplayNameAttribute>(inherit: false);
			if (customAttribute != null)
			{
				return customAttribute.DisplayName;
			}
			return onFail();
		}
	}
	public abstract class ObjectDataSourceBaseElementWrapper<TContract, TElement> : ObjectDataSourceElementWrapper<TContract, TElement> where TContract : ObjectDataSourceElement, new() where TElement : class
	{
		public ObjectDataSourceBaseElementWrapper(TElement element)
			: base(element)
		{
			Init();
		}

		protected override void AssignToContract()
		{
			base.Contract.DataMember = GetDataMember();
			base.Contract.DisplayName = GetDisplayName();
			base.Contract.Key = GetKey();
		}

		protected abstract string GetDisplayName();

		protected abstract string GetKey();

		protected abstract string GetDataMember();

		protected abstract void Init();
	}
	public class ObjectDataSourceParameterWrapper : ObjectDataSourceBaseElementWrapper<ObjectDataSourceParameterInfo, ParameterInfo>
	{
		public ObjectDataSourceParameterWrapper(ParameterInfo element)
			: base(element)
		{
		}

		protected override string GetDataMember()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override string GetDisplayName()
		{
			return base.Element.Name;
		}

		protected override string GetKey()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<string, string>(base.Element.Name, base.Element.ParameterType.FullName).ToString();
		}

		protected override void Init()
		{
		}

		protected override void AssignToContract()
		{
			base.AssignToContract();
			base.Contract.Type = base.Element.ParameterType.FullName;
			base.Contract.ResultType = base.Element.ParameterType.FullName;
			base.Contract.Value = ((base.Element.DefaultValue is DBNull) ? null : base.Element.DefaultValue?.ToString());
		}
	}
	public abstract class ObjectDataSourceMethodWrapper<TContractMethod, TElement> : ObjectDataSourceBaseElementWrapper<TContractMethod, TElement> where TContractMethod : ObjectDataSourceMethodInfoBase, new() where TElement : MemberInfo
	{
		public ObjectDataSourceMethodWrapper(TElement element)
			: base(element)
		{
		}

		protected override void AssignToContract()
		{
			base.AssignToContract();
			base.Contract.ParametersInfo = GetParameters();
		}

		protected abstract ObjectDataSourceParameterInfo[] GetParameters();

		protected override string GetDataMember()
		{
			return base.Element.Name;
		}
	}
	public class ObjectDataSourceCtorWrapper : ObjectDataSourceMethodWrapper<ObjectDataSourceConstructorInfo, ConstructorInfo>
	{
		private ParametersViewInfo viewInfo;

		public ObjectDataSourceCtorWrapper(ConstructorInfo element)
			: base(element)
		{
		}

		protected override string GetDisplayName()
		{
			string text = (viewInfo.Data.Any() ? viewInfo.ToString() : ("(" + string.Empty + ")"));
			return "ctor" + text;
		}

		protected override string GetKey()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<bool, string, string>(base.Element.IsConstructor, base.Element.Name, GetDisplayName()).ToString();
		}

		protected override ObjectDataSourceParameterInfo[] GetParameters()
		{
			return viewInfo.Data.Select((ParameterInfo a) => ObjectDataSourceElementWrapper<ObjectDataSourceParameterInfo, ParameterInfo>.Wrap(a)).ToArray();
		}

		protected override void Init()
		{
			viewInfo = new ParametersViewInfo(base.Element.GetParameters());
		}
	}
	public class ObjectDataSourceMemberWrapper : ObjectDataSourceMethodWrapper<ObjectDataSourceMemberInfo, MemberInfo>
	{
		private ObjectMember objectMember;

		public ObjectDataSourceMemberWrapper(MemberInfo element)
			: base(element)
		{
		}

		protected override string GetDisplayName()
		{
			return string.Format(objectMember.IsProperty ? "{0} : {1}" : "{0}{2} : {1}", GetDisplayNameAttributeValue(objectMember.MemberInfo, () => objectMember.Name), TypeNamesHelper.ShortName(objectMember.ReturnType), objectMember.Parameters);
		}

		protected override string GetKey()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<MemberTypes, string, string, string, bool, bool, bool>(objectMember.MemberType, objectMember.Parameters, objectMember.ReturnType.FullName, objectMember.Name, objectMember.IsMethod, objectMember.IsProperty, objectMember.IsStatic).ToString();
		}

		protected override ObjectDataSourceParameterInfo[] GetParameters()
		{
			MethodInfo methodInfo = objectMember.MemberInfo as MethodInfo;
			if (methodInfo != null)
			{
				return (from a in methodInfo.GetParameters()
					select ObjectDataSourceElementWrapper<ObjectDataSourceParameterInfo, ParameterInfo>.Wrap(a)).ToArray();
			}
			return Enumerable.Empty<ObjectDataSourceParameterInfo>().ToArray();
		}

		protected override void Init()
		{
			objectMember = new ObjectMember(base.Element);
		}

		protected override void AssignToContract()
		{
			base.AssignToContract();
			base.Contract.MemberType = objectMember.MemberType.ToString();
			base.Contract.IsStatic = objectMember.IsStatic;
		}
	}
	internal class ObjectDataSourceTypeWrapper : ObjectDataSourceBaseElementWrapper<ObjectDataSourceTypeInfo, Type>
	{
		public ObjectDataSourceConstructorInfo[] ConstructorInfo
		{
			get
			{
				return base.Contract.ConstructorInfo;
			}
			set
			{
				base.Contract.ConstructorInfo = value;
			}
		}

		public ObjectDataSourceMemberInfo[] MemberInfo
		{
			get
			{
				return base.Contract.MemberInfo;
			}
			set
			{
				base.Contract.MemberInfo = value;
			}
		}

		public ObjectDataSourceTypeWrapper(Type element)
			: base(element)
		{
		}

		protected override string GetDataMember()
		{
			return base.Element.Name;
		}

		protected override string GetDisplayName()
		{
			return GetDisplayNameAttributeValue(base.Element, () => base.Element.FullName);
		}

		protected override string GetKey()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<string>(base.Element.FullName).ToString();
		}

		protected override void Init()
		{
		}
	}

	public class ObjectDataSourceWizardService : IObjectDataSourceWizardService
	{
		protected readonly IObjectDataSourceWizardTypeProvider typeProvider;

		protected readonly IObjectDataSourceWizardValidationService validationService;

		protected readonly IObjectDataSourceMemberFilterService filterMemberService;

		protected readonly IObjectDataSourceConstructorFilterService ctorFilterService;

		public ObjectDataSourceWizardService(IObjectDataSourceWizardTypeProvider typeProvider, IObjectDataSourceWizardValidationService validationService, IObjectDataSourceMemberFilterService filterMemberService, IObjectDataSourceConstructorFilterService ctorFilterService)
		{
			this.typeProvider = typeProvider;
			this.validationService = validationService;
			this.filterMemberService = filterMemberService;
			this.ctorFilterService = ctorFilterService;
		}

		public ObjectDataSource DeserializeObjectDataSource(ObjectDataSourceModel model, ObjectDataSource objectDataSource = null)
		{
			ObjectDataSource objectDataSource2 = new ObjectDataSource();
			objectDataSource2.BeginUpdate();
			Type type = (Type)(objectDataSource2.DataSource = ((objectDataSource != null) ? ((Type)objectDataSource.DataSource) : typeProvider.GetAvailableTypes(model.Context).FirstOrDefault((Type a) => ObjectDataSourceElementWrapper<ObjectDataSourceTypeInfo, Type>.Wrap(a).Key == model.SelectedType)));
			if (model.DataMemberInfo != null)
			{
				MemberInfo memberInfo = (from x in ObjectDataSourceFillHelper.GetItemMembers(ObjectDataSourceFillHelper.CreateInstanceForSchema(type))
					select x.MemberInfo).FirstOrDefault((MemberInfo x) => model.DataMemberInfo.Equals(x));
				objectDataSource2.DataMember = ((objectDataSource != null) ? objectDataSource.DataMember : memberInfo.Name);
				if (model.DataMemberInfo.ParametersInfo.Any())
				{
					objectDataSource2.Parameters.AddRange(GetParams(memberInfo as MethodBase, model.DataMemberInfo.ParametersInfo));
				}
			}
			if (model.ConstructorInfo != null)
			{
				ConstructorInfo methodInfo = type.GetConstructors().FirstOrDefault((ConstructorInfo a) => model.ConstructorInfo.Equals(a));
				if (!model.ConstructorInfo.ParametersInfo.Any())
				{
					objectDataSource2.Constructor = ObjectConstructorInfo.Default;
				}
				else
				{
					objectDataSource2.Constructor = new ObjectConstructorInfo(GetParams(methodInfo, model.ConstructorInfo.ParametersInfo));
				}
			}
			if (!validationService.Validate(objectDataSource2))
			{
				throw CreateFaultException("An invalid data source model");
			}
			objectDataSource2.EndUpdate();
			return objectDataSource2;
		}

		public ObjectDataSourceDescriptionsResponse GetAvailableObjectDescriptions(string context)
		{
			ObjectDataSourceDescriptionsResponse objectDataSourceDescriptionsResponse = new ObjectDataSourceDescriptionsResponse();
			List<ObjectDataSourceTypeInfo> list = new List<ObjectDataSourceTypeInfo>();
			IEnumerable<Type> availableTypes = typeProvider.GetAvailableTypes(context);
			foreach (Type item in availableTypes)
			{
				ObjectDataSourceTypeInfo objectDataSourceTypeInfo = ObjectDataSourceElementWrapper<ObjectDataSourceTypeInfo, Type>.Wrap(item);
				objectDataSourceTypeInfo.MemberInfo = GetMemberInfo(item, filterMemberService);
				objectDataSourceTypeInfo.ConstructorInfo = GetConstructorInfo(item, ctorFilterService);
				list.Add(objectDataSourceTypeInfo);
			}
			objectDataSourceDescriptionsResponse.ObjectDataSourceInfo = list.ToArray();
			return objectDataSourceDescriptionsResponse;
		}

		private static ObjectDataSourceMemberInfo[] GetMemberInfo(Type type, IObjectDataSourceMemberFilterService filterMemberService)
		{
			object data = ObjectDataSourceFillHelper.CreateInstanceForSchema(type);
			List<ObjectMember> source = ObjectDataSourceFillHelper.GetItemMembers(data).ToList();
			return (from a in filterMemberService.Filter(type, source.Select((ObjectMember a) => a.MemberInfo))
				select ObjectDataSourceElementWrapper<ObjectDataSourceMemberInfo, MemberInfo>.Wrap(a)).ToArray();
		}

		private static ObjectDataSourceConstructorInfo[] GetConstructorInfo(Type type, IObjectDataSourceConstructorFilterService ctorFilterService)
		{
			return (from a in ctorFilterService.Filter(type, type.GetConstructors()).ToList()
				select ObjectDataSourceElementWrapper<ObjectDataSourceConstructorInfo, ConstructorInfo>.Wrap(a)).ToArray();
		}

		private static List<Parameter> GetParams(MethodBase methodInfo, ObjectDataSourceParameterInfo[] infos)
		{
			List<Parameter> list = new List<Parameter>();
			List<ParameterInfo> list2 = methodInfo.GetParameters().ToList();
			for (int i = 0; i < list2.Count(); i++)
			{
				list.Add(ConvertToParameter(list2[i], infos[i]));
			}
			return list;
		}

		public static Parameter ConvertToParameter(ParameterInfo memberParameter, ObjectDataSourceParameterInfo methodInfoBase)
		{
			if (methodInfoBase.Type == "DevExpress.DataAccess.Expression")
			{
				return new Parameter(memberParameter.Name, typeof(Expression), new Expression(methodInfoBase.Value as string, memberParameter.ParameterType));
			}
			return new Parameter(memberParameter.Name, memberParameter.ParameterType, ConvertValue(memberParameter.ParameterType, methodInfoBase.Value));
		}

		private static object ConvertValue(Type targetType, object value)
		{
			if (targetType != null && value != null && (PSNativeMethods.IsNumericalType(targetType) || targetType == typeof(DateTime)))
			{
				try
				{
					return Convert.ChangeType(value, targetType, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				}
				catch (InvalidCastException)
				{
				}
			}
			return value;
		}

		protected virtual Exception CreateFaultException(string errorMessage)
		{
			return new FaultException(errorMessage);
		}
	}

	public class ActionHelper
	{
		public static T DeserializeContract<T>(string json)
		{
			byte[] bytes = JsonGenerator.Encoding.GetBytes(json);
			DataContractJsonSerializer dataContractJsonSerializer = new DataContractJsonSerializer(typeof(T));
			using XmlDictionaryReader reader = JsonReaderWriterFactory.CreateJsonReader(bytes, 0, bytes.Length, JsonGenerator.Encoding, XmlDictionaryReaderQuotas.Max, null);
			return (T)dataContractJsonSerializer.ReadObject(reader, verifyObjectName: false);
		}

		public static string SerializeContract<T>(T data)
		{
			using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			using (XmlDictionaryWriter writer = JsonReaderWriterFactory.CreateJsonWriter(memoryStream, JsonGenerator.Encoding))
			{
				DataContractJsonSerializer dataContractJsonSerializer = new DataContractJsonSerializer(typeof(T));
				dataContractJsonSerializer.WriteObject(writer, data);
			}
			return JsonGenerator.Encoding.GetString(memoryStream.ToArray());
		}
	}

	public class JsonDataSourceJsonToXmlAdapter : XmlToJsonAdapter
	{
		private string[] biHierarchicalElements;

		private const string firstSchemaNode = "Schema/Node";

		public JsonDataSourceJsonToXmlAdapter(string[] collectionNames, IEnumerable<ArrayElementInfo> arrayElementNames, string[] biHierarchicalElements)
			: base(collectionNames, arrayElementNames)
		{
			this.biHierarchicalElements = biHierarchicalElements;
		}

		public override void Patch(XElement element)
		{
			PatchCollections(element);
		}

		public override void UnPatch(XElement element)
		{
			UnpatchCollections(element);
			UnPatchBiHierarchicalElements(element);
		}

		public static void UnPatchBiHierarchicalElements(XElement element)
		{
			XElement nodeElement = element.XPathSelectElement("Schema/Node");
			List<Action> list = new List<Action>();
			UnpatchNodeElements(nodeElement, list);
			foreach (Action item in list)
			{
				item();
			}
			(from x in element.Descendants()
				where !x.HasElements && !x.HasAttributes && x.Name.LocalName == "Node"
				select x).Remove();
		}

		private static void UnpatchNodeElements(XElement nodeElement, List<Action> lazySortingSteps)
		{
			if (nodeElement == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (XElement item in nodeElement.XPathSelectElements("Node"))
			{
				UnpatchNodeElements(item, lazySortingSteps);
			}
			foreach (XElement item2 in nodeElement.XPathSelectElements("item"))
			{
				UnpatchNodeElements(item2, lazySortingSteps);
			}
			if (nodeElement.Name.LocalName == "item")
			{
				nodeElement.Name = "Node";
				XElement grandParent = nodeElement.Parent.Parent;
				lazySortingSteps.Add(delegate
				{
					nodeElement.Remove();
					grandParent.Add(nodeElement);
				});
			}
		}
	}
	public class JsonDataSourceJsonXmlSerializer
	{
		public static string[] CollectionTokens = new string[0];

		public static string[] BiHierarchicalElements = new string[1] { "Node" };

		public static List<ArrayElementInfo> ArrayElementNames = new List<ArrayElementInfo>
		{
			new ArrayElementInfo("QueryParameter", "QueryParameters", "Source"),
			new ArrayElementInfo("Header", "Headers", "Source")
		};

		internal static JsonDataSourceJsonToXmlAdapter XmlToJsonAdapter { get; } = new JsonDataSourceJsonToXmlAdapter(CollectionTokens, ArrayElementNames, BiHierarchicalElements);

		public static JsonDataSource CreateJsonDataSourceFromJson(string json, Func<string, string> restore, bool firstChildAsRoot = true)
		{
			XElement root = JsonConverter.JsonToXDocument(json, firstChildAsRoot).Root;
			XmlToJsonAdapter.UnPatch(root);
			JsonDataSource jsonDataSource = new JsonDataSource();
			jsonDataSource.Base64 = restore(Base64Helper.Encode(root));
			return jsonDataSource;
		}

		public static string GenerateJsonDataSourceJson(string dataSourceBase64)
		{
			XElement xElement = Base64Helper.Decode(dataSourceBase64);
			XmlToJsonAdapter.Patch(xElement);
			return JsonConverter.XmlToJson(xElement);
		}

		internal static string GenerateJsonSchemaJson(JsonDataSource dataSource)
		{
			if (dataSource.Schema == null)
			{
				dataSource.Fill();
			}
			XElement xElement = dataSource.Schema.SaveToXml();
			if (xElement == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			XmlToJsonAdapter.Patch(xElement);
			return JsonConverter.XmlToJson(xElement);
		}

		public static UriJsonSource CreateUriJsonSourceFromJsonString(string json)
		{
			XElement root = JsonConverter.JsonToXDocument(json, true).Root;
			XmlToJsonAdapter.UnPatch(root);
			UriJsonSource uriJsonSource = new UriJsonSource();
			uriJsonSource.LoadFromXml(root);
			return uriJsonSource;
		}
	}
	public class JsonDataSourceWizardService : IJsonDataSourceWizardService
	{
		private readonly UrlResolver urlResolver;

		private readonly IDataSourceWizardJsonConnectionStorage jsonConnectionStorageService;

		private readonly IConfigureJsonSourceService configureJsonSourceService;

		private readonly IWizardJsonDataSourceSchemaDiscoveryInterceptor jsonSourceSchemaDiscoveryInterceptor;

		public JsonDataSourceWizardService(UrlResolver urlResolver, IDataSourceWizardJsonConnectionStorage jsonConnectionStorageService, IConfigureJsonSourceService configureJsonSourceService, IWizardJsonDataSourceSchemaDiscoveryInterceptor jsonSourceSchemaDiscoveryInterceptor)
		{
			this.jsonConnectionStorageService = jsonConnectionStorageService;
			this.jsonSourceSchemaDiscoveryInterceptor = jsonSourceSchemaDiscoveryInterceptor;
			this.urlResolver = urlResolver;
			this.configureJsonSourceService = configureJsonSourceService;
		}

		public JsonUriSourceValidationResponse ValidateUriJsonSource(JsonUriSourceValidationRequest request)
		{
			UriJsonSource uriJsonSource = LoadUriJsonSourceFromJson(request.UriJsonSourceJSON);
			try
			{
				UriCreator.ValidateUriSecurity(UrlResolverExtensions.MapPath(urlResolver, uriJsonSource.Uri.OriginalString, ""), AccessSettings.DataResources);
				if (uriJsonSource.Uri.Scheme == Uri.UriSchemeFile)
				{
					return new JsonUriSourceValidationResponse
					{
						IsUriValid = false,
						FaultMessage = "File system requests are not allowed."
					};
				}
			}
			catch (UriFormatException)
			{
				return new JsonUriSourceValidationResponse
				{
					IsUriValid = false
				};
			}
			catch (UriSecurityAccessException)
			{
				string faultMessage = string.Format(CommonLocalizer.GetString((CommonStringId)1), uriJsonSource?.Uri?.OriginalString);
				return new JsonUriSourceValidationResponse
				{
					IsUriValid = false,
					FaultMessage = faultMessage
				};
			}
			return new JsonUriSourceValidationResponse
			{
				IsUriValid = true
			};
		}

		private async Task<JsonSchemaResponse> GetJsonSchemaCore(JsonSchemaRequest request, bool isAsync)
		{
			JsonDataSource dataSource = new JsonDataSource();
			ServiceContainerExtensions.ReplaceService<UrlResolver>((IServiceContainer)dataSource, urlResolver, false);
			IJsonDataConnectionProviderService jsonDataConnectionProviderService = jsonConnectionStorageService;
			if (jsonDataConnectionProviderService != null)
			{
				ServiceContainerExtensions.ReplaceService<IJsonDataConnectionProviderService>((IServiceContainer)dataSource, jsonDataConnectionProviderService, false);
			}
			if (configureJsonSourceService != null)
			{
				ServiceContainerExtensions.ReplaceService<IConfigureJsonSourceService>((IServiceContainer)dataSource, configureJsonSourceService, false);
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(request.ConnectionName))
			{
				dataSource.ConnectionName = request.ConnectionName;
			}
			else
			{
				if (!jsonConnectionStorageService.CanSaveConnection)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("It is not possible to store JSON data connections.");
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(request.CustomJson))
				{
					dataSource.JsonSource = new CustomJsonSource(request.CustomJson);
				}
				else
				{
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(request.UriJsonSourceJSON))
					{
						throw new ArgumentException("JsonSource is invalid");
					}
					UriJsonSource jsonSource = LoadUriJsonSourceFromJson(request.UriJsonSourceJSON);
					JsonUriSourceValidationResponse jsonUriSourceValidationResponse = ValidateUriJsonSource(request);
					if (!jsonUriSourceValidationResponse.IsUriValid)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException("Schema loading failed. Url is invalid. " + jsonUriSourceValidationResponse.FaultMessage);
					}
					dataSource.JsonSource = jsonSource;
				}
			}
			jsonSourceSchemaDiscoveryInterceptor.Customize(dataSource);
			if (isAsync)
			{
				await dataSource.FillAsync((IEnumerable<IParameter>)(object)request.Parameters).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			}
			else
			{
				dataSource.Fill((IEnumerable<IParameter>)(object)request.Parameters);
			}
			string jsonSchemaJSON = JsonDataSourceJsonXmlSerializer.GenerateJsonSchemaJson(dataSource);
			return new JsonSchemaResponse
			{
				JsonSchemaJSON = jsonSchemaJSON
			};
		}

		public async Task<JsonSchemaResponse> GetJsonSchemaAsync(JsonSchemaRequest request)
		{
			return await GetJsonSchemaCore(request, isAsync: true).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
		}

		public JsonSchemaResponse GetJsonSchema(JsonSchemaRequest request)
		{
			return TaskExtensions.Await<JsonSchemaResponse>(GetJsonSchemaCore(request, isAsync: false));
		}

		public void SaveJsonSource(JsonSchemaRequest request)
		{
			if (!jsonConnectionStorageService.CanSaveConnection)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("It is not possible to store JSON data connections.");
			}
			JsonDataConnection jsonDataConnection = null;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(request.CustomJson))
			{
				jsonDataConnection = new JsonDataConnection(new CustomJsonSource(request.CustomJson));
			}
			else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(request.UriJsonSourceJSON))
			{
				jsonDataConnection = new JsonDataConnection(LoadUriJsonSourceFromJson(request.UriJsonSourceJSON));
			}
			jsonDataConnection.Name = request.ConnectionName;
			jsonDataConnection.StoreConnectionNameOnly = true;
			jsonConnectionStorageService.SaveConnection(request.ConnectionName, jsonDataConnection, saveCredentials: true);
		}

		internal static UriJsonSource LoadUriJsonSourceFromJson(string uriJsonSource)
		{
			return JsonDataSourceJsonXmlSerializer.CreateUriJsonSourceFromJsonString(uriJsonSource);
		}
	}

	public static class ImpersonateHelper
	{
		public static bool Enabled { get; set; }

		public static Action Impersonate(Action action)
		{
			if (!Enabled)
			{
				return action;
			}
			WindowsIdentity currentWindowsIdentity = WindowsIdentity.GetCurrent();
			return delegate
			{
				WindowsImpersonationContext windowsImpersonationContext = null;
				try
				{
					windowsImpersonationContext = currentWindowsIdentity.Impersonate();
					action();
				}
				finally
				{
					windowsImpersonationContext?.Undo();
				}
			};
		}

		public static Action<Action> ImpersonateDeferred()
		{
			if (!Enabled)
			{
				return delegate(Action action)
				{
					action();
				};
			}
			WindowsIdentity currentWindowsIdentity = WindowsIdentity.GetCurrent();
			return delegate(Action action)
			{
				WindowsImpersonationContext windowsImpersonationContext = null;
				try
				{
					windowsImpersonationContext = currentWindowsIdentity.Impersonate();
					action();
				}
				finally
				{
					windowsImpersonationContext?.Undo();
				}
			};
		}

		public static Func<Task, T> Impersonate<T>(Func<Task, T> action)
		{
			if (!Enabled)
			{
				return action;
			}
			WindowsIdentity currentWindowsIdentity = WindowsIdentity.GetCurrent();
			return delegate(Task task)
			{
				WindowsImpersonationContext windowsImpersonationContext = null;
				try
				{
					windowsImpersonationContext = currentWindowsIdentity.Impersonate();
					return action(task);
				}
				finally
				{
					windowsImpersonationContext?.Undo();
				}
			};
		}
	}

	public class DataSourceSerializationService : IDataSourceSerializationService
	{
		private readonly ISecureDataConverter secureDataConverter;

		private readonly IDataSourceWizardConnectionStringsProvider connectionStringsProvider;

		private long maxImageSize = 102400L;

		public long MaxImageSize
		{
			get
			{
				return maxImageSize;
			}
			set
			{
				maxImageSize = value;
			}
		}

		public DataSourceSerializationService(IDataSourceWizardConnectionStringsProvider connectionStringsProvider, ISecureDataConverter secureDataConverter)
		{
			this.connectionStringsProvider = connectionStringsProvider;
			this.secureDataConverter = secureDataConverter;
		}

		public virtual SqlDataSource RestoreDataSource(string json)
		{
			XElement root = JsonConverter.JsonToXDocument(json, true).Root;
			SqlDataSourceJsonSerializer.XmlToJsonAdapter.UnPatch(root);
			XElement xElement = root.Element("Connection");
			if (xElement != null)
			{
				UnpatchConnection(xElement);
			}
			SqlDataSource sqlDataSource = new SqlDataSource();
			sqlDataSource.LoadFromXml(root);
			if (sqlDataSource.ConnectionParameters == null)
			{
				DataConnectionParametersBase dataConnectionParametersBase = TryToGetDataConnectionParameters(connectionStringsProvider, sqlDataSource.ConnectionName);
				if (dataConnectionParametersBase != null)
				{
					sqlDataSource.ConnectionParameters = dataConnectionParametersBase;
					sqlDataSource.Connection.StoreConnectionNameOnly = false;
				}
			}
			return sqlDataSource;
		}

		public SqlDataConnection RestoreConnection(string json)
		{
			XElement root = JsonConverter.JsonToXDocument(json, false).Root;
			XElement xElement = root.Element("DataConnection");
			SqlDataSourceJsonSerializer.XmlToJsonAdapter.UnPatch(xElement);
			UnpatchConnection(xElement);
			SqlDataConnection sqlDataConnection = new SqlDataConnection();
			sqlDataConnection.LoadFromXml(xElement);
			if (sqlDataConnection.ConnectionParameters == null && connectionStringsProvider != null)
			{
				DataConnectionParametersBase dataConnectionParametersBase = TryToGetDataConnectionParameters(connectionStringsProvider, sqlDataConnection.Name);
				if (dataConnectionParametersBase != null)
				{
					sqlDataConnection = new SqlDataConnection(sqlDataConnection.Name, dataConnectionParametersBase)
					{
						StoreConnectionNameOnly = false
					};
				}
			}
			XElement xElement2 = root.Element("ConnectionOptions");
			if (xElement2 != null)
			{
				sqlDataConnection.ConnectionOptions.LoadFromXml(xElement2);
			}
			return sqlDataConnection;
		}

		public void RestoreConnection(string json, SqlDataSource destination)
		{
			destination.AssignConnection(RestoreConnection(json));
		}

		public virtual SqlQuery RestoreQuery(string json)
		{
			return SqlDataSourceJsonSerializer.CreateSqlQueryFromJson(json);
		}

		public virtual DBSchema RestoreDBSchema(string json)
		{

		protected virtual void UnpatchConnection(XElement connectionXml)
		{
			if (connectionXml.Attribute("ConnectionString") != null)
			{
				throw new SecurityException("The ConnectionString attribute is not allowed.");
			}
			XElement xElement = connectionXml.Element("Parameters");
			if (xElement != null)
			{
				string value = xElement.Value;
				xElement.Value = string.Empty;
				xElement.Add(SafeXml.CreateXDocument(secureDataConverter.Unprotect(value), (Action<XmlReaderSettings>)null).Root.Elements());
				UnpatchConnectionPrameter(connectionXml, xElement, "ProviderKey");
				UnpatchConnectionPrameter(connectionXml, xElement, "ConnectionString");
				if (xElement.IsEmpty)
				{
					xElement.Remove();
				}
			}
		}

		private static void UnpatchConnectionPrameter(XElement connectionXml, XElement parametersXml, string attrName)
		{
			XElement xElement = parametersXml.Element(attrName);
			if (xElement != null)
			{
				XAttribute content = new XAttribute(attrName, xElement.GetAttributeValue("Value"));
				connectionXml.Add(content);
				xElement.Remove();
			}
		}

		public virtual string PackDataSource(SqlDataSource instance)
		{
			XElement xElement = instance.SaveToXml();
			XElement xElement2 = xElement.Element("Connection");
			if (xElement2 != null)
			{
				PatchConnection(xElement2);
			}
			SqlDataSourceJsonSerializer.XmlToJsonAdapter.Patch(xElement);
			return JsonConverter.XmlToJson(xElement);
		}

		public virtual string PackConnection(SqlDataConnection instance)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)instance, "instance");
			XElement xElement = instance.SaveToXml();
			SqlDataSourceSerializer.SaveCredentials(xElement, instance);
			PatchConnection(xElement);
			SqlDataSourceJsonSerializer.XmlToJsonAdapter.Patch(xElement);
			string value = JsonConverter.XmlToJson(xElement);
			XElement xElement2 = new XElement("ConnectionOptions");
			instance.ConnectionOptions.SaveToXml(xElement2);
			string value2 = JsonConverter.XmlToJson(xElement2);
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder("{");
			JsonGenerator.AppendQuotedValue(stringBuilder, "DataConnection", true);
			stringBuilder.Append(value);
			stringBuilder.Append(",");
			JsonGenerator.AppendQuotedValue(stringBuilder, "ConnectionOptions", true);
			stringBuilder.Append(value2);
			stringBuilder.Append("}");
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		protected virtual void PatchConnection(XElement connectionXml)
		{
			PatchConnectionParameter(connectionXml, "ProviderKey");
			PatchConnectionParameter(connectionXml, "ConnectionString");
			XElement xElement = connectionXml.Element("Parameters");
			if (xElement != null)
			{
				xElement.Value = secureDataConverter.Protect(xElement.ToString(SaveOptions.DisableFormatting));
			}
		}

		private static void PatchConnectionParameter(XElement connectionXml, string attrName)
		{
			XAttribute xAttribute = connectionXml.Attribute(attrName);
			if (xAttribute != null)
			{
				XElement xElement = connectionXml.Element("Parameters");
				if (xElement == null)
				{
					xElement = new XElement("Parameters");
					connectionXml.Add(xElement);
				}
				XElement xElement2 = new XElement(attrName);
				xElement2.Add(new XAttribute("Value", xAttribute.Value));
				xElement.Add(xElement2);
				xAttribute.Remove();
			}
		}
