		public virtual string PackDataPreview(ColumnarData instance)
		{
			if (instance == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("instance");
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder("{");
			JsonGenerator.AppendQuotedValue(stringBuilder, "schema", true);
			stringBuilder.Append('[');
			ColumnDescription[] schema = instance.Schema;
			for (int i = 0; i < schema.Length; i++)
			{
				ColumnDescription columnDescription = schema[i];
				stringBuilder.Append('{');
				JsonGenerator.AppendQuotedValue(stringBuilder, "name", true);
				JsonGenerator.AppendQuotedValue(stringBuilder, columnDescription.Name, false);
				stringBuilder.Append(',');
				JsonGenerator.AppendQuotedValue(stringBuilder, "type", true);
				JsonGenerator.AppendQuotedValue(stringBuilder, columnDescription.Type.ToString(), false);
				stringBuilder.Append('}');
				stringBuilder.Append(',');
			}
			stringBuilder.Remove(stringBuilder.Length - 1, 1);
			stringBuilder.Append("],");
			JsonGenerator.AppendQuotedValue(stringBuilder, "values", true);
			if (instance.Lists[0].Count == 0)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append("null");
			}
			else
			{
				stringBuilder.Append('[');
				for (int j = 0; j < instance.Lists[0].Count && j < 100; j++)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append('[');
					IList[] lists = instance.Lists;
					foreach (IList list in lists)
					{
						JsonGenerator.AppendQuotedValue(stringBuilder, ValueToString(list[j]), false);
						stringBuilder.Append(',');
					}
					stringBuilder.Remove(stringBuilder.Length - 1, 1);
					stringBuilder.Append(']');
					stringBuilder.Append(',');
				}
				stringBuilder.Remove(stringBuilder.Length - 1, 1);
				stringBuilder.Append("]");
			}
			stringBuilder.Append('}');
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public virtual string PackConnectionParameters(DataConnectionParametersBase instance)
		{
			string text = PackConnection(new SqlDataConnection("_", instance));
			XElement root = JsonConverter.JsonToXDocument(text, true).Root;
			XElement xElement = root.Element("Parameters");
			if (xElement == null)
			{
				xElement = new XElement("Parameters");
				xElement.Add(root.Elements());
			}
			return JsonConverter.XmlToJson(new XElement("Parameters", xElement));
		}

		protected virtual string ValueToString(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return "null";
			}
			if (value is byte[] array)
			{
				if (array.LongLength > MaxImageSize)
				{
					return $"!{array.LongLength}";
				}
				return Convert.ToBase64String(array);
			}
			return value.ToString();
		}

		public static DataConnectionParametersBase TryToGetDataConnectionParameters(IDataSourceWizardConnectionStringsProvider connectionStringsProvider, string connectionName)
		{
			if (!connectionStringsProvider.GetConnectionDescriptions().ContainsKey(connectionName))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return connectionStringsProvider.GetDataConnectionParameters(connectionName);
		}

		private string SerializeDBSchema(DBSchema schema)
		{
			using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			DataContractJsonSerializer dataContractJsonSerializer = new DataContractJsonSerializer(typeof(DBSchema));
			dataContractJsonSerializer.WriteObject(memoryStream, schema);
			memoryStream.Position = 0L;
			using StreamReader streamReader = new StreamReader(memoryStream, Encoding.UTF8);
			return streamReader.ReadToEnd();
		}

		private DBSchema DeserializeDBSchema(string json)
		{
			using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			using (StreamWriter streamWriter = new StreamWriter(memoryStream, Encoding.UTF8))
			{
				streamWriter.Write(json);
			}
			memoryStream.Position = 0L;
			DataContractJsonSerializer dataContractJsonSerializer = new DataContractJsonSerializer(typeof(DBSchema));
			return dataContractJsonSerializer.ReadObject(memoryStream) as DBSchema;
		}
	}

	public class SqlDataSourceWizardService : ISqlDataSourceWizardService
	{
		protected SqlDataSourceWizardServiceContext Context { get; }

		private void ValidateCustomQueries(IEnumerable<SqlQuery> queries, DataConnectionParametersBase connectionParameters)
		{
			foreach (SqlQuery query in queries)
			{
				if (query is CustomSqlQuery customSqlQuery)
				{
					string message = DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.CustomSqlQueryValidationException);
					if (!Context.DataSourceWizardCustomizationService.CustomQueryValidator.Validate(connectionParameters, customSqlQuery.Sql, ref message))
					{
						throw new FaultException(message);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private bool TryValidateSelectQuery(SelectQuery selectQuery, out string errorMessage, DBSchema schema = null)
		{
			Exception ex;
			try
			{
				ex = ValidateSelectQueryCore(selectQuery, schema, noThrow: true);
				errorMessage = ex?.Message;
			}
			catch (Exception ex2)
			{
				ex = ex2;
				errorMessage = Context.ExceptionHandlerProxy.GetExceptionMessage(ex2);
			}
			return ex == null;
		}

		public SqlDataSourceWizardService(SqlDataSourceWizardServiceContext context)
		{
			Context = context;
		}

		public string Execute(NameValueCollection request)
		{
			string text = request["actionKey"];
			string arg = Uri.UnescapeDataString(request["arg"]);
			try
			{
				return text switch
				{
					"getDBSchema" => Invoke<DBSchemaRequest, DBSchemaModel>(GetDBSchema, arg), 
					"getDBStoredProcedures" => Invoke<DBSchemaRequest, DBSchemaModel>(GetDBStoredProcedures, arg), 
					"getSelectStatement" => Invoke<SelectStatementRequest, SelectStatementModel>(GetSelectStatement, arg), 
					"getDataPreview" => Invoke<SelectStatementRequest, DataPreviewModel>(GetDataPreview, arg), 
					"rebuildResultSchema" => Invoke<DataSourceModel, ResultSchemaModel>(RebuildResultSchema, arg), 
					_ => throw new ArgumentException($"Action '{text}' not found"), 
				};
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				string errorMessage = ((ex is FaultException) ? ex.Message : "Internal Server Error");
				return ActionHelper.SerializeContract(new Response<object>(null)
				{
					Success = false,
					ErrorMessage = errorMessage
				});
			}
		}

		private static string Invoke<TIn, TOut>(Func<TIn, TOut> action, string arg)
		{
			TIn arg2 = ActionHelper.DeserializeContract<TIn>(arg);
			TOut result = action(arg2);
			Response<TOut> data = new Response<TOut>(result);
			return ActionHelper.SerializeContract(data);
		}

		public virtual DBSchemaModel GetDBSchema(DBSchemaRequest request)
		{
			DBSchema instance;
			using (SqlDataConnection connection = Context.DataSourceSerializer.RestoreConnection(request.ConnectionJSON))
			{
				OpenConnection(connection);
				IDBSchemaProviderEx iDBSchemaProviderEx = Context.DBSchemaProviderFactory.Create();
				string[] tables = request.Tables;
				if (tables != null && tables.Length != 0)
				{
					goto IL_0055;
				}
				string[] views = request.Views;
				if (views != null && views.Length != 0)
				{
					goto IL_0055;
				}
				bool flag = !request.GetTables && !request.GetViews;
				instance = new DBSchema((flag || request.GetTables) ? iDBSchemaProviderEx.GetTables(connection) : null, (flag || request.GetViews) ? iDBSchemaProviderEx.GetViews(connection) : null);
				goto end_IL_0017;
				IL_0055:
				DBTable[] array = MapToDbTable(request.Tables, isViews: false);
				DBTable[] array2 = MapToDbTable(request.Views, isViews: true);
				iDBSchemaProviderEx.LoadColumns(connection, array.Union(array2).ToArray());
				instance = new DBSchema(array, array2);
				end_IL_0017:;
			}
			return new DBSchemaModel
			{
				DBSchemaJSON = Context.DataSourceSerializer.PackDBSchema(instance)
			};
		}

		private DBTable[] MapToDbTable(string[] names, bool isViews)
		{
			return ((IEnumerable<string>)(names ?? new string[0])).Select((Func<string, DBTable>)((string x) => new DBTable(x)
			{
				IsView = isViews
			})).ToArray();
		}

		public DBSchemaModel GetDBStoredProcedures(DBSchemaRequest request)
		{
			DBStoredProcedure[] procedures;
			using (SqlDataConnection connection = Context.DataSourceSerializer.RestoreConnection(request.ConnectionJSON))
			{
				OpenConnection(connection);
				IDBSchemaProviderEx iDBSchemaProviderEx = Context.DBSchemaProviderFactory.Create();
				procedures = iDBSchemaProviderEx.GetProcedures(connection);
			}
			return new DBSchemaModel
			{
				DBSchemaJSON = Context.DataSourceSerializer.PackDBSchema(new DBSchema(procedures))
			};
		}

		public virtual DataPreviewModel GetDataPreview(SelectStatementRequest request)
		{
			if (!(Context.DataSourceSerializer.RestoreQuery(request.SqlQueryJSON) is SelectQuery selectQuery))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (selectQuery.Top == 0 || selectQuery.Top > 100)
			{
				selectQuery.Top = 100;
			}
			ValidateSelectQuery(selectQuery);
			using SqlDataConnection connection = Context.DataSourceSerializer.RestoreConnection(request.ConnectionJSON);
			OpenConnection(connection);
			DBSchema dBSchema = GetDBSchema(connection, selectQuery);
			ValidateSelectQuery(selectQuery, dBSchema);
			ColumnarData instance;
			try
			{
				DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.QueryExecutor queryExecutor = new DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.QueryExecutor(connection, dBSchema, CustomizeQueryFilterCallback, null, Context.DBCommandInterceptor);
				instance = queryExecutor.Execute(selectQuery, topThousand: true, CancellationToken.None);
			}
			catch (Exception baseException)
			{
				if (baseException is AggregateException ex)
				{
					baseException = ex.GetBaseException();
				}
				ProcessException(baseException, baseException.Message, false);
				return null;
			}
			return new DataPreviewModel
			{
				DataPreviewJSON = Context.DataSourceSerializer.PackDataPreview(instance)
			};
		}

		private void CustomizeQueryFilterCallback(SelectQuery query, ref CriteriaOperator filter)
		{
			filter = Context.QueryFilterService.CustomizeFilterExpression(query, filter);
		}

		public virtual SelectStatementModel GetSelectStatement(SelectStatementRequest request)
		{
			if (!(Context.DataSourceSerializer.RestoreQuery(request.SqlQueryJSON) is SelectQuery selectQuery))
			{
				return null;
			}
			SelectStatementModel selectStatementModel = new SelectStatementModel
			{
				SqlSelectStatement = " "
			};
			if (!TryValidateSelectQuery(selectQuery, out var errorMessage))
			{
				selectStatementModel.ErrorMessage = errorMessage;
			}
			using SqlDataConnection sqlDataConnection = Context.DataSourceSerializer.RestoreConnection(request.ConnectionJSON);
			OpenConnection(sqlDataConnection);
			if (!sqlDataConnection.IsSqlDataStore)
			{
				try
				{
					DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.QueryExecutor.EnsureXmlSupported(selectQuery);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					ProcessException(ex, ex.Message, false);
					throw;
				}
				return selectStatementModel;
			}
			DBSchema dBSchema = GetDBSchema(sqlDataConnection, selectQuery);
			if (!TryValidateSelectQuery(selectQuery, out errorMessage, dBSchema))
			{
				selectStatementModel.ErrorMessage = errorMessage;
			}
			try
			{
				selectStatementModel.SqlSelectStatement = SqlQueryHelper.BuildSql(selectQuery, dBSchema, sqlDataConnection.SqlGeneratorFormatter);
				return selectStatementModel;
			}
			catch (Exception originalException)
			{
				ProcessException(originalException, DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.MessageCannotCreateSelectStatement), false);
				throw;
			}
		}

		public virtual ResultSchemaModel RebuildResultSchema(DataSourceModel dataSourceModel)
		{
			using SqlDataSource sqlDataSource = Context.DataSourceSerializer.RestoreDataSource(dataSourceModel.SqlDataSourceJSON);
			try
			{
				if (!dataSourceModel.IsRelationsEditing && string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataSourceModel.QueryName))
				{
					ValidateCustomQueries(sqlDataSource.Queries, sqlDataSource.ConnectionParameters);
					sqlDataSource.RebuildResultSchema();
				}
				else
				{
					SqlQuery sqlQuery = (sqlDataSource.Queries.ContainsName(dataSourceModel.QueryName) ? sqlDataSource.Queries[dataSourceModel.QueryName] : null);
					IEnumerable<SqlQuery> enumerable;
					if (sqlQuery == null)
					{
						enumerable = Enumerable.Empty<SqlQuery>();
					}
					else
					{
						IEnumerable<SqlQuery> enumerable2 = new SqlQuery[1] { sqlQuery };
						enumerable = enumerable2;
					}
					IEnumerable<SqlQuery> queries = enumerable;
					ValidateCustomQueries(queries, sqlDataSource.Connection.ConnectionParameters);
					sqlDataSource.RebuildResultSchema((IEnumerable<SqlQuery> _) => true, (IEnumerable<IParameter>)(object)dataSourceModel.Parameters, queries);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception originalException)
			{
				ProcessException(originalException, DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.MessageCannotRebuildSchema), false, typeof(RelationException), typeof(DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.ValidationException));
				throw;
			}
			ResultSchemaModel resultSchemaModel = new ResultSchemaModel
			{
				ResultSchemaJSON = Context.DataSourceSerializer.PackResultSchema(sqlDataSource)
			};
			DataConnectionParametersBase connectionParameters = sqlDataSource.ConnectionParameters;
			if (connectionParameters != null && !sqlDataSource.Connection.StoreConnectionNameOnly)
			{
				resultSchemaModel.ConnectionParametersJSON = Context.DataSourceSerializer.PackConnectionParameters(connectionParameters);
			}
			return resultSchemaModel;
		}

		protected virtual SqlDataConnection LoadConnection(string name)
		{
			DataConnectionParametersBase connectionParameters = DataSourceSerializationService.TryToGetDataConnectionParameters(Context.ConnectionStringsProvider, name) ?? AppConfigHelper.LoadConnectionParameters(name);
			return new SqlDataConnection(name, connectionParameters);
		}

		protected void OpenConnection(SqlDataConnection connection)
		{
			try
			{
				if (connection.ConnectionParameters == null && connection.StoreConnectionNameOnly && Context.ConnectionStringsProvider != null)
				{
					SqlDataConnection sqlDataConnection = LoadConnection(connection.Name);
					XElement xElement = sqlDataConnection.SaveToXml();
					SqlDataSourceSerializer.SaveCredentials(xElement, sqlDataConnection);
					connection.LoadFromXml(xElement);
					connection.StoreConnectionNameOnly = true;
				}
				if (Context.DBConnectionInterceptor != null)
				{
					connection.TrySetDBConnectionInterceptor(Context.DBConnectionInterceptor);
				}
				connection.CreateDataStore(Context.DataConnectionService);
			}
			catch (Exception originalException)
			{
				ProcessException(originalException, DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.MessageCannotOpenDatabase), false);
				throw;
			}
		}

		private DBSchema GetDBSchema(SqlDataConnection connection, SelectQuery query)
		{
			IDBSchemaProviderEx iDBSchemaProviderEx = Context.DBSchemaProviderFactory.Create();
			DBTable[] tables = iDBSchemaProviderEx.GetTables(connection);
			DBTable[] views = iDBSchemaProviderEx.GetViews(connection);
			HashSet<string> set = new HashSet<string>(query.Tables.Select((Table t) => t.Name));
			iDBSchemaProviderEx.LoadColumns(connection, (from t in tables.Union(views)
				where set.Contains(t.Name)
				select t).ToArray());
			return new DBSchema(tables, views);
		}

		private void ValidateSelectQuery(SelectQuery query, DBSchema schema = null)
		{
			ValidateSelectQueryCore(query, schema, noThrow: false);
		}

		private Exception ValidateSelectQueryCore(SelectQuery query, DBSchema schema, bool noThrow)
		{
			try
			{
				if (schema == null)
				{
					query.Validate();
				}
				else
				{
					query.Validate(schema);
				}
				return null;
			}
			catch (DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.ValidationException ex)
			{
				string exceptionMessage = Context.ExceptionHandlerProxy.GetExceptionMessage(ex);
				return ProcessException(ex, exceptionMessage, noThrow);
			}
		}

		protected Exception ProcessException(Exception originalException, string customMessage, bool noThrow = false, params Type[] authorizedExceptionTypes)
		{
			if (originalException is FaultException)
			{
				return originalException;
			}
			Context.Logger.LogException(originalException);
			FaultException ex = null;
			if (Array.IndexOf(authorizedExceptionTypes, originalException.GetType()) >= 0)
			{
				ex = CreateFaultException(originalException.Message, originalException);
			}
			else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(customMessage))
			{
				ex = CreateFaultException(customMessage, originalException);
			}
			if (noThrow)
			{
				return ex;
			}
			throw ex;
		}

		private FaultException CreateFaultException(string message, Exception innerException)
		{
			BindingFlags bindingAttr = BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic;
			object[] args = new object[4]
			{
				message,
				new FaultCode("Sender"),
				string.Empty,
				innerException
			};
			try
			{
				Type typeFromHandle = typeof(FaultException);
				object obj = typeFromHandle.Assembly.CreateInstance(typeFromHandle.FullName, ignoreCase: false, bindingAttr, null, args, null, null);
				return (FaultException)obj;
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				Context.Logger.LogException(exception);
				return new FaultException(message);
			}
		}
	}
	public class XmlToJsonAdapter
	{
		public const string ItemTypeAttribute = "ItemType";

		public const string ItemTypeNew = "Item";

		public const string ExpressionResultTypeAttribute = "ResultType";

		private string[] xmlCollectionNames;

		private IEnumerable<ArrayElementInfo> xmlArrayElementNames;

		private static readonly Type[] parameterTypesToPatch = new Type[8]
		{
			typeof(char),
			typeof(byte),
			typeof(sbyte),
			typeof(double),
			typeof(float),
			typeof(decimal),
			typeof(DateTime),
			typeof(Guid)
		};

		private static string xpathQueryParameters = "//Query/Parameter";

		private static string xpathParameters = "//Parameter";

		private static readonly Dictionary<string, Type> predefinedParameterTypes = new Dictionary<string, Type> { [typeof(Expression).FullName] = typeof(Expression) };

		protected virtual bool SkipElement(XElement element)
		{
			return false;
		}

		private void PatchQueriesParametersValues(XElement element)
		{
			string expression = ((element.Name.LocalName == "Query") ? xpathParameters : xpathQueryParameters);
			IEnumerable<XElement> enumerable = element.XPathSelectElements(expression);
			foreach (XElement item in enumerable)
			{
				DataSourceParameterBase dataSourceParameterBase = new DataSourceParameterBase();
				DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.QuerySerializer.DeserializeParameter(dataSourceParameterBase, item, null);
				if (dataSourceParameterBase.Type == typeof(Expression))
				{
					Expression expression2 = (Expression)dataSourceParameterBase.Value;
					item.Value = expression2.ExpressionString;
					if (expression2.ResultType != null)
					{
						item.Add(new XAttribute("ResultType", expression2.ResultType.FullName));
					}
				}
				else if (Array.IndexOf(parameterTypesToPatch, dataSourceParameterBase.Type) > -1)
				{
					item.Value = ParameterHelper.ConvertValueToString(dataSourceParameterBase.Value);
				}
			}
		}

		private void PatchToArrays(XElement itemsElement)
		{
			if (SkipElement(itemsElement))
			{
				return;
			}
			Dictionary<string, IList<XElement>> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, IList<XElement>>();
			foreach (XElement element in itemsElement.Elements())
			{
				ArrayElementInfo arrayElementInfo = xmlArrayElementNames.FirstOrDefault((ArrayElementInfo info) => info.NeedPatching(element));
				if (arrayElementInfo != null)
				{
					if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(arrayElementInfo.ArrayName, out var value))
					{
						value = new List<XElement>();
						dictionary.Add(arrayElementInfo.ArrayName, value);
					}
					value.Add(element);
				}
				PatchToArrays(element);
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, IList<XElement>> item in dictionary)
			{
				foreach (XElement item2 in item.Value)
				{
					XElement parent = item2.Parent;
					XElement xElement = parent.Element(item.Key);
					if (xElement == null)
					{
						xElement = new XElement(item.Key, item2);
						item2.ReplaceWith(xElement);
					}
					else
					{
						item2.Remove();
						xElement.Add(item2);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void UnpatchFromArrays(XElement itemsElement)
		{
			List<XElement> list = new List<XElement>();
			CollectArrays(itemsElement, list);
			foreach (XElement item in list)
			{
				item.ReplaceWith(item.Elements());
			}
		}

		private void CollectArrays(XElement itemsElement, List<XElement> arrays)
		{
			foreach (XElement element in itemsElement.Elements())
			{
				if (!SkipElement(element))
				{
					CollectArrays(element, arrays);
					if (xmlArrayElementNames.FirstOrDefault((ArrayElementInfo item) => item.NeedToUnPatch(element)) != null)
					{
						arrays.Add(element);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void PatchCollections(XElement itemsElement)
		{
			if (SkipElement(itemsElement))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (XElement item in itemsElement.Elements())
			{
				PatchCollections(item);
			}
			if (Array.IndexOf(xmlCollectionNames, itemsElement.Name.LocalName) < 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = 1;
			foreach (XElement item2 in itemsElement.Elements())
			{
				string localName = item2.Name.LocalName;
				item2.Name = XName.Get(string.Format("{0}{1}", "Item", num++));
				item2.Add(new XAttribute("ItemType", localName));
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UnpatchCollections(XElement itemsElement)
		{
			if (SkipElement(itemsElement))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (XElement item in itemsElement.Elements())
			{
				UnpatchCollections(item);
			}
			XAttribute xAttribute = itemsElement.Attribute("ItemType");
			if (xAttribute != null)
			{
				itemsElement.Name = XName.Get(xAttribute.Value);
				xAttribute.Remove();
			}
		}

		private void UnPatchQueriesParametersValues(XElement element)
		{
			IEnumerable<XElement> enumerable = element.XPathSelectElements(xpathQueryParameters);
			foreach (XElement item in enumerable)
			{
				DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter queryParameter = new DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter();
				string attributeValue = item.GetAttributeValue("Type");
				Type type = SafeTypeResolver.GetPrimitiveOrTrustedType(attributeValue, (IDictionary<string, Type>)predefinedParameterTypes, (bool?)null) ?? SafeTypeResolver.GetKnownType(typeof(Expression).Assembly, attributeValue, false, (bool?)null);
				if (type == null)
				{
					DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.QuerySerializer.DeserializeParameter(queryParameter, item, null);
				}
				else
				{
					string value = item.Value;
					object obj = null;
					if (type == typeof(Expression))
					{
						string attributeValue2 = item.GetAttributeValue("ResultType");
						if (attributeValue2 != null)
						{
							Type type2 = SafeTypeResolver.GetType(attributeValue2, (bool?)null, (bool?)null);
							if (type2 != null)
							{
								obj = new Expression(value, type2);
							}
						}
					}
					if (obj == null)
					{
						obj = ParameterHelper.ConvertFrom((object)value, type, (object)null);
					}
					if (obj == null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.Value))
					{
						DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.QuerySerializer.DeserializeParameter(queryParameter, item, null);
					}
					else
					{
						queryParameter.Name = item.GetAttributeValue("Name");
						queryParameter.Type = type;
						queryParameter.Value = obj;
					}
				}
				XElement xElement = DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.QuerySerializer.SerializeParameter(null, queryParameter);
				item.ReplaceAttributes(xElement.Attributes());
				item.Value = xElement.Value;
			}
		}

		public XmlToJsonAdapter(string[] collectionNames, IEnumerable<ArrayElementInfo> arrayElementNames)
		{
			xmlCollectionNames = collectionNames;
			xmlArrayElementNames = arrayElementNames;
		}

		public virtual void Patch(XElement element)
		{
			PatchQueriesParametersValues(element);
			PatchToArrays(element);
			PatchCollections(element);
		}

		public virtual void UnPatch(XElement element)
		{
			UnpatchCollections(element);
			UnpatchFromArrays(element);
			UnPatchQueriesParametersValues(element);
		}
	}
	public class ArrayElementInfo
	{
		private string elementName;

		private string arrayName;

		private string elementParentName;

		public string ArrayName => arrayName;

		public ArrayElementInfo(string elementName, string arrayName)
			: this(elementName, arrayName, null)
		{
		}

		public ArrayElementInfo(string elementName, string arrayName, string elementParentName)
		{
			this.elementName = elementName;
			this.arrayName = arrayName;
			this.elementParentName = elementParentName;
		}

		public bool NeedPatching(XElement element)
		{
			if (element.Name.LocalName == elementName)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(elementParentName) && element.Parent.Name.LocalName != elementParentName)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool NeedToUnPatch(XElement element)
		{
			if (element.Name == arrayName)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(elementParentName) && element.Parent.Name.LocalName != elementParentName)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

			}

			{

	public static class ParametersEvaluator
	{
		public static IEnumerable<IParameter> EvaluateParameters(IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters, IEnumerable<DataSourceParameterBase> parametersToEvaluate)
		{
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Expected O, but got Unknown

			//IL_0018: Expected O, but got Unknown
			List<IParameter> list = new List<IParameter>();
			XREvaluatorContextDescriptor context = new XREvaluatorContextDescriptor(sourceParameters, new DataContext(), (object)null, string.Empty);
			foreach (DataSourceParameterBase item in parametersToEvaluate)
			{
				if (item.Type != typeof(Expression) || item.Value == null)
				{
					list.Add((IParameter)(object)new DataSourceParameterBase(item.Name, item.Type, item.Value));
					continue;
				}
				if (!(item.Value is Expression expression))

					throw new InvalidOperationException("If the Type property is set to Expression, the Value property must return an Expression instance.");

			}
			return list;
		}

		}

		public static object EvaluateExpression(this Expression expression, XREvaluatorContextDescriptor context)
		{

		}

	public class AliasedCriteriaOperand : CriteriaOperator
	{
		private readonly CriteriaOperator innerOperator;

		private string alias;

		public string Alias
		{
			get
			{
				return alias;
			}
			set
			{
				alias = value;
			}
		}

		public CriteriaOperator InnerOperator => innerOperator;

		public AliasedCriteriaOperand(CriteriaOperator innerOperator, string alias)
		{
			this.innerOperator = innerOperator;
			this.alias = alias;
		}

		public override void Accept(ICriteriaVisitor visitor)
		{
			if (visitor is ISelectQueryCriteriaVisitor selectQueryCriteriaVisitor)
			{
				selectQueryCriteriaVisitor.Visit(this);
			}
			innerOperator.Accept(visitor);
		}

		public override T Accept<T>(ICriteriaVisitor<T> visitor)
		{
			if (visitor is ISelectQueryCriteriaVisitor<T> selectQueryCriteriaVisitor)
			{
				return selectQueryCriteriaVisitor.Visit(this);
			}
			return innerOperator.Accept<T>(visitor);
		}

		protected override CriteriaOperator CloneCommon()
		{
			return (CriteriaOperator)(object)new AliasedCriteriaOperand(InnerOperator, alias);
		}
	}
	public static class AliasGeneratorHelper
	{
		internal const int MaxAliasLength = 20;

		public static string CreateColumnAlias(string columnName, string tableName, SelectQuery selectQuery)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(tableName) || selectQuery == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(columnName))
			{
				return null;
			}
			HashSet<string> columnsSet = new HashSet<string>(from column in selectQuery.Columns.OfType<AliasedBase>()
				select column.ActualName);
			return CreateAliasCore(columnName, (string name) => !columnsSet.Contains(name), tableName);
		}

		public static string CreateTableAlias(string tableName, SelectQuery selectQuery)
		{
			if (selectQuery == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(tableName))
			{
				return null;
			}
			HashSet<string> tablesSet = new HashSet<string>(from table in selectQuery.Tables
				where table != null
				select table.ActualName);
			return CreateAliasCore(tableName, (string name) => !tablesSet.Contains(name));
		}

		private static string CreateAliasCore(string baseName, Predicate<string> isOk)
		{
			return CreateAliasCore(baseName, isOk, null);
		}

		private static string CreateAliasCore(string columnName, Predicate<string> isOk, string tableName)
		{
			string text = GeneratedAdjustedAlias(tableName, columnName, 20);
			int num = 1;
			while (!isOk(text))
			{
				string text2 = num.ToString();
				text = GeneratedAdjustedAlias(tableName, columnName, 20 - text2.Length);
				text += text2;
				num++;
			}
			return text;
		}

		private static string GeneratedAdjustedAlias(string tableName, string columnName, int maxLength)
		{
			string text = GenerateAliasName(tableName, columnName);
			int num = text.Length - maxLength;
			if (num <= 0)
			{
				return text;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(tableName))
			{
				return columnName.Truncate(num);
			}
			if (tableName.Length < num)
			{
				int amount = num - tableName.Length - 1;
				return GenerateAliasName(string.Empty, columnName.Truncate(amount));
			}
			return GenerateAliasName(tableName.Truncate(num), columnName);
		}

		private static string GenerateAliasName(string tableName, string columnName)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(tableName))
			{
				return string.Join("_", tableName, columnName);
			}
			return columnName;
		}

		private static string Truncate(this string str, int amount)
		{
			return str.Substring(0, str.Length - amount);
		}
	}
	public class AllColumnsOperand : CriteriaOperator
	{

		}

		public AllColumnsOperand(string tableName)

		}

		public override void Accept(ICriteriaVisitor visitor)
		{
			ISelectQueryCriteriaVisitor selectQueryCriteriaVisitor = (ISelectQueryCriteriaVisitor)visitor;
			selectQueryCriteriaVisitor.Visit(this);

	public class AutoSqlWrapHelper
	{
		private class TokensGroup : List<Token>
		{
			public bool NewLine => NeedNewLine(base[0]);

			public bool NewLineAfter => NeedNewLineAfter(this.Last());

			public int AdditionalSpacesCount => GetAdditionalSpaceCount(base[0]);

			public override string ToString()
			{
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
				Token token = null;
				using (Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator())
				{
					while (enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						Token current = enumerator.Current;
						if (token != null && NeedSpacesBetween(token, current))
						{
							stringBuilder.Append(' ');
						}
						stringBuilder.Append(current.Value);
						token = current;
					}
				}
				return stringBuilder.ToString();
			}
		}

		private static bool CanSplit(Token previous, Token current)
		{
			switch (previous.Type)
			{
			case 15:
			case 16:
			case 22:
			case 28:
			case 30:
			case 39:
			case 95:
			case 114:
			case 131:
			case 138:
			case 170:
				return false;
			case 109:
			case 140:
				if (current.Type == 114)
				{
					return false;
				}
				break;
			case 96:
			case 117:
			case 162:
				if (current.Type == 140 || current.Type == 114)
				{
					return false;
				}
				break;
			case 100:
				if (current.Type == 39)
				{
					return false;
				}
				break;
			case 1:
				if (current.Type == 4)
				{
					return false;
				}
				break;
			case 189:
				if (current.Type == 26)
				{
					return false;
				}
				break;
			}
			int type = current.Type;
			if ((uint)(type - 15) <= 1u || type == 22 || type == 30)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return NeedSpacesBetween(previous, current);
		}

		private static bool NeedSpacesBetween(Token previous, Token current)
		{
			if ((previous.Type == 16 || previous.Type == 15 || previous.Type == 22) && (current.Type == 16 || current.Type == 15 || current.Type == 22))
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (previous.Type)
			{
			case 9:
			case 11:
			case 13:
			case 14:
				return false;
			case 17:
			case 18:
			case 19:
			case 20:
			case 21:
				if (current.Type == 9)
				{
					return false;
				}
				break;
			case 1:
				if (current.Type == 4)
				{
					return false;
				}
				break;
			}
			int type = current.Type;
			if (type == 10 || (uint)(type - 12) <= 2u || type == 23)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool NeedNewLine(Token token)
		{
			switch (token.Type)
			{
			case 95:
			case 96:
			case 100:
			case 101:
			case 109:
			case 114:
			case 117:
			case 139:
			case 140:
			case 162:
			case 170:
			case 189:
			case 201:
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		private static bool NeedNewLineAfter(Token token)
		{
			int type = token.Type;
			if (type == 26 || type == 189)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static int GetAdditionalSpaceCount(Token token)
		{
			switch (token.Type)
			{
			case 100:
			case 101:
			case 139:
			case 170:
				return 0;
			case 201:
				return 1;
			default:
				if (!NeedNewLine(token))
				{
					return 7;
				}
				return 2;
			}
		}

		public static string AutoSqlTextWrap(string query, int maxLineLength)
		{
			if (query == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Token token = null;
			TokensGroup tokensGroup = new TokensGroup();
			List<TokensGroup> list = new List<TokensGroup> { tokensGroup };
			using (SourceStringReader s = new SourceStringReader(query))
			{
				CommonSqlScanner commonSqlScanner = new CommonSqlScanner(s);
				while (true)
				{
					Token token2 = commonSqlScanner.Scan();
					if (token2.Type == 0)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (token != null && CanSplit(token, token2))
					{
						tokensGroup = new TokensGroup();
						list.Add(tokensGroup);
					}
					tokensGroup.Add(token2);
					token = token2;
				}
			}
			int num = 0;
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			foreach (TokensGroup item in list)
			{
				string text = item.ToString();
				if (stringBuilder.Length > 0)
				{
					if (item.NewLine || num + 1 + text.Length > maxLineLength)
					{
						if (num > 0)
						{
							stringBuilder.AppendLine();
						}
						stringBuilder.Append(new string(' ', item.AdditionalSpacesCount));
						num = item.AdditionalSpacesCount;
					}
					else
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(' ');
						num++;
					}
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(text);
				if (item.NewLineAfter)
				{
					stringBuilder.AppendLine();
					num = 0;
				}
				else
				{
					num += text.Length;
				}
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}
	public static class ColumnarDataLoaderFactory
	{
		private static Dictionary<Type, Func<ISupportColumnarDataLoader, IColumnarDataLoader>> customColumnarDataLoaders = new Dictionary<Type, Func<ISupportColumnarDataLoader, IColumnarDataLoader>>
		{
			{
				typeof(DataAccessMSSqlCEConnectionProvider),
				(ISupportColumnarDataLoader provider) => new MsSqlCeColumnarDataLoader(provider)
			},
			{
				typeof(DataAccessODPConnectionProvider),
				(ISupportColumnarDataLoader provider) => new OracleColumnarDataLoader(provider)
			},
			{
				typeof(DataAccessOracleConnectionProvider),
				(ISupportColumnarDataLoader provider) => new OracleColumnarDataLoader(provider)
			},
			{
				typeof(DataAccessODPManagedConnectionProvider),
				(ISupportColumnarDataLoader provider) => new OracleColumnarDataLoader(provider)
			},
			{
				typeof(DataAccessMSSqlConnectionProvider),
				(ISupportColumnarDataLoader provider) => new MsSqlColumnarDataLoader(provider)
			},
			{
				typeof(DataAccessSQLiteConnectionProvider),
				(ISupportColumnarDataLoader provider) => new SqliteColumnarDataLoader(provider)
			},
			{
				typeof(DataAccessPostgreSqlConnectionProvider),
				(ISupportColumnarDataLoader provider) => new PostgreSqlColumnarDataLoader(provider)
			},
			{
				typeof(DataAccessPervasiveSqlConnectionProvider),
				(ISupportColumnarDataLoader provider) => new PervasiveSqlColumnarDataLoader(provider)
			}
		};

		public static IColumnarDataLoader GetColumnarDataLoader(IDataStore dataStore)
		{
			if (dataStore is IColumnarDataLoader result)
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (!(dataStore is ISupportColumnarDataLoader supportColumnarDataLoader))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!customColumnarDataLoaders.TryGetValue(((object)dataStore).GetType(), out var value))
			{
				return new ColumnarDataLoader(supportColumnarDataLoader);
			}
			return value(supportColumnarDataLoader);
		}

		public static void RegisterCustomColumnarDataLoader<TProvider>(Func<ISupportColumnarDataLoader, IColumnarDataLoader> func) where TProvider : IDataStore
		{
			customColumnarDataLoaders.Add(typeof(TProvider), func);
		}
	}
	public static class DBTableExtensions
	{
		public static DBColumn GetColumnSafe(this DBTable table, string name)
		{
			int count = table.Columns.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				DBColumn val = table.Columns[i];
				if (val != null && val.Name == name)
				{
					return val;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class ResultTableView
	{
		private class ColumnInfo
		{
			public IList List { get; }

			public int SchemaIndex { get; }

			public ColumnInfo(IList list, int schemaIndex)
			{
				List = list;
				SchemaIndex = schemaIndex;
			}
		}

		private const string duplicatedColumnMessage = "The query scheme is not valid because it contains duplicated columns with the following name: '{0}'. Modify your query to avoid duplicates.";

		private Dictionary<string, ColumnInfo> Map { get; } = new Dictionary<string, ColumnInfo>();

		private ColumnarData Data { get; set; }

		public ResultTableView()
			: this(null)
		{
			ClearData();
		}

		public ResultTableView(ColumnarData data)
		{
			SetData(data);
		}

		public IList GetList(string name)
		{
			Map.TryGetValue(name, out var value);
			return value?.List;
		}

		public Type GetColumnType(string name)
		{
			if (Data == null || !Map.ContainsKey(name))
			{
				return typeof(object);
			}
			return Data.Schema[Map[name].SchemaIndex].Type ?? typeof(object);
		}

		public void ClearData()
		{
			SetData(new ColumnarData(new IList[0], Data?.Schema ?? new ColumnDescription[0]));
		}

		public void SetData(ColumnarData data)
		{
			Map.Clear();
			Data = data;
			if (Data != null)
			{
				BuildMap(data);
			}
		}

		private void BuildMap(ColumnarData data)
		{
			int num = -1;
			int num2 = 0;
			ColumnDescription[] schema = data.Schema;
			for (int i = 0; i < schema.Length; i++)
			{
				ColumnDescription columnDescription = schema[i];
				if (!columnDescription.Skip)
				{
					num++;
					Map.Add(columnDescription.Name, new ColumnInfo((num < data.Lists.Length) ? data.Lists[num] : null, num2));
				}
				num2++;
			}
		}

		public void AddColumn(string name, Type type)
		{
			IList[] lists = Data.Lists;
			ColumnDescription[] schema = Data.Schema;
			if (Map.ContainsKey(name))
			{
				Trace.WriteLine($"The query scheme is not valid because it contains duplicated columns with the following name: '{name}'. Modify your query to avoid duplicates.");
				return;
			}
			IList list = new ArrayList();
			Data = new ColumnarData(lists.Union(new IList[1] { list }).ToArray(), schema.Union(new ColumnDescription[1]
			{
				new ColumnDescription(name)
				{
					Type = type
				}
			}).ToArray());
			Map.Add(name, new ColumnInfo(list, Data.Schema.Length - 1));
		}

		public void Copy(ResultTableView other)
		{
			SetData(other.Data);
		}
	}
	internal static class ConnectionStringParser
	{
		private class ConnectionStringModel
		{
			private readonly DbConnectionStringBuilder builder;

			private readonly HashSet<string> unparsedKeys;

			private bool HasUnparsedKeys => unparsedKeys.Count != 0;

			public ConnectionStringModel(string connectionString)
			{
				builder = new DbConnectionStringBuilder
				{
					ConnectionString = connectionString
				};
				unparsedKeys = new HashSet<string>();
				foreach (object key in builder.Keys)
				{
					unparsedKeys.Add((string)key);
				}
			}

			public BigQueryConnectionParameters ParseBigQueryTypeString()
			{
				string parameter = GetParameter("dsn");
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(parameter))
				{
					return new BigQueryConnectionParameters(parameter);
				}
				string projectId = GetParameter("ProjectID") ?? GetParameter("Catalog");
				string datasetId = GetParameter("DataSetID") ?? GetParameter("DefaultDataset");
				string text = GetParameter("PrivateKeyFileName") ?? GetParameter("KeyFilePath");
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					string serviceAccountEmail = GetParameter("ServiceAccountEmail") ?? GetParameter("Email");
					return new BigQueryConnectionParameters(projectId, datasetId, serviceAccountEmail, text);
				}
				string parameter2 = GetParameter("OAuthClientID");
				string parameter3 = GetParameter("OAuthClientSecret");
				string parameter4 = GetParameter("OAuthRefreshToken");
				return new BigQueryConnectionParameters(projectId, datasetId, parameter2, parameter3, parameter4);
			}

			public Access97ConnectionParameters ParseAccess97ConnectionString()
			{
				if (!CheckFixedParameter("Mode", "Share Deny None"))
				{
					return null;
				}
				string parameter = GetParameter("data source");
				string parameter2 = GetParameter("user id");
				string parameter3 = GetParameter("Jet OLEDB:Database password");
				if (HasUnparsedKeys)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return new Access97ConnectionParameters(parameter, parameter2, parameter3);
			}

				if (!CheckFixedParameter("TrimTrailingSpaces", "true"))
				{
					return null;
				}
				string parameter = GetParameter("Data source");
				string parameter2 = GetParameter("user id");
				string parameter3 = GetParameter("Password");
				string parameter4 = GetParameter("servertype");
				if (HasUnparsedKeys)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(parameter4))
				{
					return new AdvantageConnectionParameters(parameter, parameter2, parameter3);
				}
				return parameter4.ToLowerInvariant() switch
				{
					"local" => new AdvantageConnectionParameters(parameter, parameter2, parameter3, AdvantageServerType.Local), 
					"remote" => new AdvantageConnectionParameters(parameter, parameter2, parameter3, AdvantageServerType.Remote), 
					"internet" => new AdvantageConnectionParameters(parameter, parameter2, parameter3, AdvantageServerType.Internet), 
					_ => null, 
				};

				{
					return null;
				}
				string parameter = GetParameter("eng");
				string parameter2 = GetParameter("uid");
				string parameter3 = GetParameter("pwd");
				string parameter4 = GetParameter("dbn");

				if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(parameter6))
				{
					Regex regex = new Regex("\\Atcpip\\{host=(?<name>.+)\\}\\z", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
					Match match = regex.Match(parameter6);

						return null;
					}

			public MsSqlConnectionParameters ParseMSSqlServerConnectionString()
			{
				string parameter = GetParameter("data source");
				string parameter2 = GetParameter("initial catalog");
				if (parameter == null || parameter2 == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				switch (GetParameter("integrated security"))
				{
				case "SSPI":
				case "True":
					if (HasUnparsedKeys)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return new MsSqlConnectionParameters(parameter, parameter2, null, null, MsSqlAuthorizationType.Windows);
				case null:
				{
					CheckFixedParameter("Persist Security Info", "true");
					string parameter3 = GetParameter("user id");
					string parameter4 = GetParameter("password");
					if (HasUnparsedKeys)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return new MsSqlConnectionParameters(parameter, parameter2, parameter3, parameter4, MsSqlAuthorizationType.SqlServer);
				}
				default:
					return null;
				}
			}

			public SQLiteConnectionParameters ParseSQLiteConnectionString()
			{
				string parameter = GetParameter("Data Source");
				string parameter2 = GetParameter("Password");
				if (HasUnparsedKeys)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return new SQLiteConnectionParameters(parameter, parameter2);
			}

			public bool CheckFixedParameter(string key, string value)
			{
				key = key.ToLowerInvariant();
				if (unparsedKeys.Contains(key))
				{
					unparsedKeys.Remove(key);
					return (string)builder[key] == value;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public string GetParameter(string key)
			{
				key = key.ToLowerInvariant();
				if (unparsedKeys.Contains(key))
				{
					unparsedKeys.Remove(key);
					return (string)builder[key];
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public const string StrOledbProvider = "Provider";

		public const string StrJetOledb4 = "Microsoft.Jet.OLEDB.4.0";

		public const string StrAceOledb12 = "Microsoft.ACE.OLEDB.12.0";

		public static DataConnectionParametersBase Parse(string connectionString)
		{
			ConnectionStringModel connectionStringModel = new ConnectionStringModel(connectionString);
			DataConnectionParametersBase dataConnectionParametersBase;
			switch (connectionStringModel.GetParameter("XpoProvider"))
			{
			case "MSAccess":
			{
				string parameter = connectionStringModel.GetParameter("Provider");
				dataConnectionParametersBase = ((parameter == "Microsoft.Jet.OLEDB.4.0") ? ((FileConnectionParametersBase)connectionStringModel.ParseAccess97ConnectionString()) : ((FileConnectionParametersBase)((!(parameter == "Microsoft.ACE.OLEDB.12.0")) ? null : connectionStringModel.ParseAccess2007ConnectionString())));
				break;
			}
			case "Oracle":
				dataConnectionParametersBase = connectionStringModel.ParseOracleConnectionString(OracleProviderType.ODP);
				break;
			case "ODPManaged":
				dataConnectionParametersBase = connectionStringModel.ParseOracleConnectionString(OracleProviderType.ODPManaged);
				break;
			case "Advantage":
				dataConnectionParametersBase = connectionStringModel.ParseAdvantageConnectionString();
				break;
			case "Ase":
				dataConnectionParametersBase = connectionStringModel.ParseAseConnectionString();
				break;
			case "Asa":
				dataConnectionParametersBase = connectionStringModel.ParseAsaConnectionString();
				break;
			case "Pervasive":
				dataConnectionParametersBase = connectionStringModel.ParsePervasiveConnectionString();
				break;
			case "VistaDB":
				dataConnectionParametersBase = connectionStringModel.ParseVistaDBConnectionString();
				break;
			case "VistaDB5":
				dataConnectionParametersBase = connectionStringModel.ParseVistaDB5ConnectionString();
				break;
			case "MSSqlServerCE":
				dataConnectionParametersBase = connectionStringModel.ParseMSSqlServerCEConnectionString();
				break;
			case "VistaDB6":
				dataConnectionParametersBase = connectionStringModel.ParseVistaDB6ConnectionString();
				break;
			case "Firebird":
				dataConnectionParametersBase = connectionStringModel.ParseFirebirdConnectionString();
				break;
			case "DB2":
				dataConnectionParametersBase = connectionStringModel.ParseDB2ConnectionString();
				break;
			case "Teradata":
				dataConnectionParametersBase = connectionStringModel.ParseTeradataConnectionString();
				break;
			case "Hana":
				dataConnectionParametersBase = connectionStringModel.ParseHanaConnectionString();
				break;
			case "BigQuery":
				dataConnectionParametersBase = connectionStringModel.ParseBigQueryTypeString();
				break;
			case "MSSqlServer":
				dataConnectionParametersBase = connectionStringModel.ParseMSSqlServerConnectionString();
				break;
			case "SQLite":
				dataConnectionParametersBase = connectionStringModel.ParseSQLiteConnectionString();
				break;
			case "Postgres":
				dataConnectionParametersBase = connectionStringModel.ParsePostgresConnectionString();
				break;
			case "MySql":
				dataConnectionParametersBase = connectionStringModel.ParseMySqlConnectionString();
				break;
			default:
				dataConnectionParametersBase = null;
				break;
			}
			return dataConnectionParametersBase ?? new CustomStringConnectionParameters(connectionString);
		}
	}
	public static class DataAccessConnectionParameter
	{
		public const string PortParamID = "Port";

		public const string DsnParamID = "Dsn";

		public const string HostnameParamID = "hostname";

		public const string ClientLibraryParamID = "ClientLibrary";

		public const string AdvantageServerTypeParamID = "servertype";

		public const string PrivateKeyFileNameParamID = "PrivateKeyFileName";

		public const string ServiceAccountEmailParamID = "ServiceAccountEmail";

		public const string OAuthClientIDParamID = "OAuthClientID";

		public const string OAuthClientSecretParamID = "OAuthClientSecret";

		public const string OAuthRefreshTokenParamID = "OAuthRefreshToken";

		public const string OracleProviderTypeParamID = "OracleProviderType";

		public static Dictionary<string, string> GetParamsDict(IConnectionPage connPage)
		{
			Dictionary<string, string> paramsDict = ConnectionParameter.GetParamsDict(connPage);
			if (connPage is IConnectionPagePort connectionPagePort)
			{
				AddKey(paramsDict, "Port", connectionPagePort.PortNumber.ToString(), skipEmptyValues: true);
			}
			if (connPage is IConnectionPageSslMode { SslMode: MySqlSslMode.None })
			{
				AddKey(paramsDict, "sslmode", "none", skipEmptyValues: false);
			}
			if (connPage is IConnectionPageClientLibrary connectionPageClientLibrary)
			{
				AddKey(paramsDict, "ClientLibrary", connectionPageClientLibrary.ClientLibrary, skipEmptyValues: true);
			}
			if (connPage is IConnectionPageHostname connectionPageHostname)
			{
				AddKey(paramsDict, "hostname", connectionPageHostname.Hostname, skipEmptyValues: true);
			}
			if (connPage is IConnectionPageAdvantage connectionPageAdvantage)
			{
				AddKey(paramsDict, "servertype", connectionPageAdvantage.ServerType.ToString(), skipEmptyValues: true);
			}
			if (connPage is IConnectionPageBigQuery connectionPageBigQuery)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(connectionPageBigQuery.Dsn))
				{
					AddKey(paramsDict, "Dsn", connectionPageBigQuery.Dsn, skipEmptyValues: false);
				}
				else if (connectionPageBigQuery.AuthorizationType == BigQueryAuthorizationType.PrivateKeyFile)
				{
					AddKey(paramsDict, "PrivateKeyFileName", connectionPageBigQuery.PrivateKeyFileName, skipEmptyValues: false);
					AddKey(paramsDict, "ServiceAccountEmail", connectionPageBigQuery.ServiceAccountEmail, skipEmptyValues: false);
				}
				if (connectionPageBigQuery.AuthorizationType == BigQueryAuthorizationType.OAuth)
				{
					AddKey(paramsDict, "OAuthClientID", connectionPageBigQuery.OAuthClientID, skipEmptyValues: false);
					AddKey(paramsDict, "OAuthClientSecret", connectionPageBigQuery.OAuthClientSecret, skipEmptyValues: false);
					AddKey(paramsDict, "OAuthRefreshToken", connectionPageBigQuery.OAuthRefreshToken, skipEmptyValues: false);
				}
			}
			if (connPage is IConnectionPageOracleProvider connectionPageOracleProvider)
			{
				AddKey(paramsDict, "OracleProviderType", connectionPageOracleProvider.ProviderType.ToString(), skipEmptyValues: true);
			}
			return paramsDict;
		}

		public static void SetParamsDict(string providerKey, Dictionary<string, string> paramDict, IConnectionPage connPage)
		{
			ConnectionParameter.SetParamsDict(providerKey, paramDict, connPage);
			IConnectionPagePort connectionPagePort = connPage as IConnectionPagePort;
			if (connectionPagePort != null)
			{
				ReadKey(paramDict, "Port", delegate(string s)
				{
					if (s != null)
					{
						connectionPagePort.PortNumber = ushort.Parse(s);
					}
				});
			}
			IConnectionPageSslMode connectionPageNoSsl = connPage as IConnectionPageSslMode;
			if (connectionPageNoSsl != null)
			{
				ReadKey(paramDict, "sslmode", delegate(string s)
				{
					connectionPageNoSsl.SslMode = ((s == "none") ? MySqlSslMode.None : MySqlSslMode.Default);
				});
			}
			IConnectionPageBigQuery pageBigQuery = connPage as IConnectionPageBigQuery;
			if (pageBigQuery != null)
			{
				ReadKey(paramDict, "Dsn", delegate(string s)
				{
					pageBigQuery.Dsn = s;
				});
				ReadKey(paramDict, "PrivateKeyFileName", delegate(string s)
				{
					pageBigQuery.PrivateKeyFileName = s;
				});
				ReadKey(paramDict, "ServiceAccountEmail", delegate(string s)
				{
					pageBigQuery.ServiceAccountEmail = s;
				});
				ReadKey(paramDict, "OAuthClientID", delegate(string s)
				{
					pageBigQuery.OAuthClientID = s;
				});
				ReadKey(paramDict, "OAuthClientSecret", delegate(string s)
				{
					pageBigQuery.OAuthClientSecret = s;
				});
				ReadKey(paramDict, "OAuthRefreshToken", delegate(string s)
				{
					pageBigQuery.OAuthRefreshToken = s;
				});
			}
			IConnectionPageHostname connectionPageHost = connPage as IConnectionPageHostname;
			if (connectionPageHost != null)
			{
				ReadKey(paramDict, "hostname", delegate(string s)
				{
					connectionPageHost.Hostname = s;
				});
			}
			IConnectionPageAdvantage pageAdvantage = connPage as IConnectionPageAdvantage;
			if (pageAdvantage != null)
			{
				ReadKey(paramDict, "servertype", delegate(string s)
				{
					string text = s.ToLowerInvariant();
					if (!(text == "remote"))
					{
						if (text == "internet")
						{
							pageAdvantage.ServerType = AdvantageServerType.Internet;
						}
						else
						{
							pageAdvantage.ServerType = AdvantageServerType.Local;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						pageAdvantage.ServerType = AdvantageServerType.Remote;
					}
				});
			}
			IConnectionPageOracleProvider pageOracleProvider = connPage as IConnectionPageOracleProvider;
			if (pageOracleProvider != null)
			{
				ReadKey(paramDict, "OracleProviderType", delegate(string s)
				{
					pageOracleProvider.ProviderType = (Enum.Parse(typeof(OracleProviderType), s) as OracleProviderType?) ?? OracleProviderType.ODPManaged;
				});
			}
		}

		private static void AddKey(IDictionary<string, string> destination, string id, string value, bool skipEmptyValues)
		{
			if (skipEmptyValues ? (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value)) : (value != null))
			{
				destination.Add(id, value);
			}
		}

		private static void ReadKey(IDictionary<string, string> source, string key, Action<string> apply)
		{
			if (source.ContainsKey(key))
			{
				apply(source[key]);
			}
		}
	}

		static DataConnectionHelper()

		public static ProviderFactory GetProviderFactory(string providerKey)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentIsNotNullOrEmpty(providerKey, "providerKey");
			if (!factories.ContainsKey(providerKey))

				return null;
			}
			return factories[providerKey];
		}

		public static IDataStore GetConnectionProvider(string connectionString, AutoCreateOption defaultAutoCreateOption, out IDisposable[] objectsToDisposeOnDisconnect)
		{
			//IL_00d0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(connectionString))
			{
				connectionString = XpoDefault.ActiveConnectionString;
			}
			DbConnectionStringBuilder dbConnectionStringBuilder = DbConnectionStringBuilderHelper.CreateBuilder(connectionString);
			string text = dbConnectionStringBuilder.GetByKeyword("XpoProvider");
			if (text != null && text.Length == 0)
			{
				text = null;
			}
			string text2 = string.Empty;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
			{
				text2 = connectionString;
			}
			if (text != null)
			{
				dbConnectionStringBuilder.Remove("XpoProvider");
				text2 = dbConnectionStringBuilder.ConnectionString;
			}
			else if (dbConnectionStringBuilder.GetByKeyword("Initial Catalog").Length != 0 && dbConnectionStringBuilder.GetByKeyword("Provider").Length == 0)
			{
				text = "MSSqlServer";
			}
			else
			{
				string text3 = dbConnectionStringBuilder.GetByKeyword("Provider").ToLower(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				if (text3.IndexOf("microsoft.ace.oledb", StringComparison.Ordinal) < 0 && text3.IndexOf("microsoft.jet.oledb", StringComparison.Ordinal) < 0)
				{
					throw new CannotFindAppropriateConnectionProviderException(ObscureConnectionString(text2));
				}
				text = "MSAccess";
			}
			IDataStore val = QueryDataStore(text, text2, defaultAutoCreateOption, out objectsToDisposeOnDisconnect);
			if (val == null)
			{
				throw new CannotFindAppropriateConnectionProviderException(ObscureConnectionString(text2));
			}
			return val;
		}

		public static IDataStore QueryDataStore(string providerType, string connectionString, AutoCreateOption defaultAutoCreateOption, out IDisposable[] objectsToDisposeOnDisconnect)
		{
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0011: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			DataStoreCreationFromStringDelegate val = (DataStoreCreationFromStringDelegate)Providers[providerType];
			if (val != null)
			{
				return val.Invoke(connectionString, defaultAutoCreateOption, ref objectsToDisposeOnDisconnect);
			}
			objectsToDisposeOnDisconnect = null;
			return null;
		}

		public static DataConnectionParametersBase CreateDataConnectionParameters(ProviderFactory factory, Dictionary<string, string> parameters)
		{
			if (factory == null)
			{
				return new CustomStringConnectionParameters();
			}
			DataConnectionParametersBase dataConnectionParametersBase = DataConnectionParametersRepository.Instance.CreateItemByKey(factory.ProviderKey);
			dataConnectionParametersBase.Factory = factory;
			if (factory.ProviderKey == "Firebird" && (!parameters.ContainsKey("server") || string.IsNullOrEmpty(parameters["server"])))
			{
				((FireBirdConnectionParameters)dataConnectionParametersBase).ConnectionType = FireBirdConnectionType.Embedded;
			}
			if (factory.ProviderKey == "Asa" && (!parameters.ContainsKey("server") || string.IsNullOrEmpty(parameters["server"])))
			{
				((AsaConnectionParameters)dataConnectionParametersBase).ConnectionType = AsaConnectionType.File;
			}
			DataAccessConnectionParameter.SetParamsDict(factory.ProviderKey, parameters, dataConnectionParametersBase);
			return dataConnectionParametersBase;
		}

		public static void ObscureCredentials(DataConnectionParametersBase parameters, bool keepUserName)
		{
			if (parameters is CustomStringConnectionParameters customStringConnectionParameters)
			{
				customStringConnectionParameters.ConnectionString = ObscureConnectionString(customStringConnectionParameters.ConnectionString);
			}
			else
			{
				parameters.ClearCredentials(keepUserName);
			}
		}

		public static string ObscureMongoDBConnectionString(string connectionString)
		{
			return connectionString;
		}

		public static string ObscureConnectionString(string connectionString)
		{
			DbConnectionStringBuilder dbConnectionStringBuilder = new DbConnectionStringBuilder
			{
				ConnectionString = connectionString
			};
			string[] keysToObscure = KeysToObscure;
			foreach (string keyword in keysToObscure)
			{
				if (dbConnectionStringBuilder.ContainsKey(keyword))
				{
					dbConnectionStringBuilder[keyword] = "***********";
				}
			}
			if (dbConnectionStringBuilder.ContainsKey("provider connection string"))
			{
				dbConnectionStringBuilder["provider connection string"] = ObscureConnectionString((string)dbConnectionStringBuilder["provider connection string"]);
			}
			return dbConnectionStringBuilder.ConnectionString;
		}

		public static string ClearConnectionString(string connectionString)
		{
			try
			{
				DbConnectionStringBuilder dbConnectionStringBuilder = new DbConnectionStringBuilder
				{
					ConnectionString = connectionString
				};
				string[] keysToRemove = KeysToRemove;
				foreach (string keyword in keysToRemove)
				{
					dbConnectionStringBuilder.Remove(keyword);
				}
				return dbConnectionStringBuilder.ConnectionString;
			}
			catch (ArgumentException)
			{
				return connectionString;
			}
		}

		public static bool HasSensitiveInfo(string customConnectionString)
		{
			try
			{
				DbConnectionStringBuilder connectionStringBuilder = new DbConnectionStringBuilder
				{
					ConnectionString = customConnectionString
				};
				return KeysToRemove.Any((string sensitiveKey) => connectionStringBuilder.ContainsKey(sensitiveKey));
			}
			catch (ArgumentException)
			{
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal static SqlDataSource CreateSqlDataSourceFromXmlStream(Stream stream)
		{
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0023: Expected O, but got Unknown
			RegisterProvider("XmlStream", (DataStoreCreationFromStringDelegate)delegate(string connectionString, AutoCreateOption option, out IDisposable[] disposable)
			{
				InMemoryDataStore inMemoryDataStore = (InMemoryDataStore)(object)InMemoryDataStore.CreateProviderFromString(connectionString, (AutoCreateOption)3, out disposable);
				inMemoryDataStore.ReadXml(SafeXml.CreateReader(stream));
				return (IDataStore)(object)inMemoryDataStore;
			});
			SqlDataSource sqlDataSource = new SqlDataSource(new CustomStringConnectionParameters("XpoProvider=XmlStream;data source=;"));
			sqlDataSource.ConnectionOptions.CloseConnection = false;
			return sqlDataSource;
		}

		public static bool IsAcceptableSqlConnectionString(string connectionString)
		{
			try
			{
				DbConnectionStringBuilder dbConnectionStringBuilder = new DbConnectionStringBuilder
				{
					ConnectionString = connectionString
				};
				return !dbConnectionStringBuilder.ContainsKey("cube name");
			}
			catch (ArgumentException)
			{
				return false;
			}
		}

		public static IEnumerable<SqlDataConnection> FilterByProviderKey(this IEnumerable<SqlDataConnection> dataConnections, string providerKey)
		{
			return dataConnections.Where(delegate(SqlDataConnection x)
			{
				DbConnectionStringBuilder builder = new DbConnectionStringBuilder
				{
					ConnectionString = x.ConnectionString
				};
				if (!(builder.GetByKeyword("XpoProvider") == providerKey))
				{
					ProviderFactory factory = x.Factory;
					return ((factory != null) ? factory.ProviderKey : null) == providerKey;
				}
				return true;
			});
		}

		internal static string AddDataDirectoryToLocalPathInConnectionString(string connectionString)
		{
			DbConnectionStringBuilder dbConnectionStringBuilder = DbConnectionStringBuilderHelper.CreateBuilder(connectionString);
			switch (dbConnectionStringBuilder.GetByKeyword("XpoProvider"))
			{
			default:
				return connectionString;
			case "MSAccess":
			case "SQLite":
			case "MSSqlServerCE":
			case "VistaDB5":
			case "VistaDB6":
			{
				string byKeyword = dbConnectionStringBuilder.GetByKeyword("data source");
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(byKeyword))
				{
					if (byKeyword.StartsWith("|DataDirectory|", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
					{
						return connectionString;
					}
					if (VSUrlResolver.CheckAbsolutePath(byKeyword))
					{
						return connectionString;
					}
					byKeyword = "|DataDirectory|" + byKeyword;
					dbConnectionStringBuilder["data source"] = byKeyword;
					return dbConnectionStringBuilder.ToString();
				}
				return dbConnectionStringBuilder.ToString();
			}
			}
		}
	}
	public class DataConnectionParametersRepository : ItemsRepository<DataConnectionParametersBase>
	{
		public const string OlapProviderKey = "Microsoft SQL Server Analysis Services";

		public const string XmlFileProviderKey = "InMemorySetFull";

		public const string CustomConStrTag = "<Custom connection string>";

		private static DataConnectionParametersRepository parametersRepository;

		private static readonly object repositoryLock = new object();

		public static DataConnectionParametersRepository Instance
		{
			get
			{
				lock (repositoryLock)
				{
					if (parametersRepository == null)
					{
						CreateParametersRepository();
					}
					return parametersRepository;
				}
			}
		}

		private static void CreateParametersRepository()
		{
			parametersRepository = new DataConnectionParametersRepository();
			parametersRepository.RegisterItemType("InMemorySetFull", typeof(XmlFileConnectionParameters));
			parametersRepository.RegisterItemType("Access97", typeof(Access97ConnectionParameters));
			parametersRepository.RegisterItemType("Access2007", typeof(Access2007ConnectionParameters));
			parametersRepository.RegisterItemType("Oracle", typeof(OracleConnectionParameters));
			parametersRepository.RegisterItemType("Advantage", typeof(AdvantageConnectionParameters));
			parametersRepository.RegisterItemType("Ase", typeof(AseConnectionParameters));
			parametersRepository.RegisterItemType("Asa", typeof(AsaConnectionParameters));
			parametersRepository.RegisterItemType("Pervasive", typeof(PervasiveSqlConnectionParameters));
			parametersRepository.RegisterItemType("VistaDB", typeof(VistaDBConnectionParameters));
			parametersRepository.RegisterItemType("VistaDB5", typeof(VistaDB5ConnectionParameters));
			parametersRepository.RegisterItemType("MSSqlServerCE", typeof(MsSqlCEConnectionParameters));

			parametersRepository.RegisterItemType("MySql", typeof(MySqlConnectionParameters));

			parametersRepository.RegisterItemType("Amazon Redshift", typeof(AmazonRedshiftConnectionParameters));
			parametersRepository.RegisterItemType("MSSqlServer", typeof(MsSqlConnectionParameters));

		}

	public delegate string[] GetItemsListDelegate();
	public abstract class DbDataConnectionControlsHelperBase<TException> where TException : Exception, new()
	{
		protected abstract IExceptionHandler ExceptionHandler { get; }

		protected abstract IList Databases { get; }

		protected abstract WaitFormProvider CreateWaitFormProvider(CancellationTokenHook hook);

		protected void FillItemsListCore(GetItemsListDelegate getItems)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)getItems, "getItems");
			Databases.Clear();
			CancellationTokenSource cancellationTokenSource = new CancellationTokenSource();
			CancellationTokenHook hook = new CancellationTokenHook(cancellationTokenSource);
			CancellationToken token = cancellationTokenSource.Token;
			WaitFormProvider waitFormProvider = CreateWaitFormProvider(hook);
			Exception ex = null;
			waitFormProvider.ShowWaitForm();
			string[] array = null;
			try
			{
				Task<string[]> task = Task.Factory.StartNew(() => getItems(), token, TaskCreationOptions.None, TaskScheduler.Default);
				task.WithBackgroundService(token);
				task.Wait(token);
				array = task.Result;
			}
			catch (Exception ex2)
			{
				ex = ((!(ex2 is AggregateException ex3)) ? ex2 : ExceptionHelper.Unwrap(ex3));
			}
			finally
			{
				waitFormProvider.CloseWaitForm(closeCompletely: false);
			}
			if (ex != null)
			{
				if (!(ex is OperationCanceledException))
				{
					ExceptionHandler.HandleException(ex);
				}
				return;
			}
			if (array == null || array.Length == 0)
			{
				ExceptionHandler.HandleException((Exception)new TException());
				return;
			}
			string[] array2 = array;
			foreach (string value in array2)
			{
				Databases.Add(value);
			}
		}
	}

	public class DBSchemaProviderExWrapper : IDBSchemaProviderEx

		public DBTable[] GetTables(SqlDataConnection connection, params string[] tableList)
		{
			DBTable[] tables = dbSchemaProvider.GetSchema(connection, SchemaLoadingMode.TablesAndViews).Tables;
			if (tables == null)

			return tables.Where((DBTable t) => tableList.Length == 0 || tableList.Contains(t.Name)).ToArray();
		}

		public DBTable[] GetViews(SqlDataConnection connection, params string[] viewList)
		{
			DBTable[] views = dbSchemaProvider.GetSchema(connection, SchemaLoadingMode.TablesAndViews).Views;

			}
			return views.Where((DBTable t) => viewList.Length == 0 || viewList.Contains(t.Name)).ToArray();
		}

		public DBStoredProcedure[] GetProcedures(SqlDataConnection connection, params string[] procedureList)
		{
			DBStoredProcedure[] storedProcedures = dbSchemaProvider.GetSchema(connection, SchemaLoadingMode.StoredProcedures).StoredProcedures;
			if (storedProcedures == null)
			{
				return (DBStoredProcedure[])(object)new DBStoredProcedure[0];
			}
			return storedProcedures.Where((DBStoredProcedure t) => procedureList.Length == 0 || procedureList.Contains(t.Name)).ToArray();
		}
