	public class DBSchemaProviderHelper
	{
		private readonly IDataConnectionParametersService dataConnectionParameterService;

		private readonly IDBSchemaProviderEx dbSchemaProviderEx;

		public static void GetRequiredDBObjects(SqlQuery[] queries, out string[] tables, out string[] proceduresList)
		{
			tables = (from name in queries.SelectMany(delegate(SqlQuery query)
				{
					if (query is TableQuery tableQuery)
					{
						return tableQuery.Tables.Select((DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.TableInfo table) => table.Name);
					}
					return (query is SelectQuery selectQuery) ? selectQuery.Tables.Select((Table table) => table.Name) : new string[0];
				})
				orderby name
				select name).ToArray();
			proceduresList = (from p in queries.OfType<StoredProcQuery>()
				select p.StoredProcName).ToArray();
		}

		public DBSchemaProviderHelper(IDataConnectionParametersService dataConnectionParameterService, IDBSchemaProviderEx dbSchemaProviderEx)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)dbSchemaProviderEx, "dbSchemaProviderEx");
			this.dataConnectionParameterService = dataConnectionParameterService;
			this.dbSchemaProviderEx = dbSchemaProviderEx;
		}

		public Task<DBSchema> GetSchemaAsync(SqlDataConnection connection, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			Func<Task, DBSchema> action = delegate(Task task)
			{
				if (task.IsFaulted && task.Exception != null)
				{
					throw task.Exception;
				}
				return GetSchema(connection);
			};
			return OpenConnectionAsync(connection, cancellationToken).ContinueWith(ImpersonateHelper.Impersonate(action), cancellationToken, TaskContinuationOptions.None, TaskScheduler.Default);
		}

		public DBSchema GetSchema(SqlDataConnection connection)
		{
			return connection.GetDBSchema();
		}

		public DBSchema GetSchema(SqlDataConnection connection, string[] tableList)
		{
			DBTable[] tables = dbSchemaProviderEx.GetTables(connection, tableList);
			DBTable[] views = dbSchemaProviderEx.GetViews(connection, tableList);
			dbSchemaProviderEx.LoadColumns(connection, (from t in tables.Union(views)
				where t.Columns.Count == 0
				select t).ToArray());
			return new DBSchema(tables, views);
		}

		public Task<DBSchema> GetSchemaAsync(SqlDataConnection connection, string[] tableList, string[] proceduresList, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			Func<Task, DBSchema> action = delegate(Task task)
			{
				if (task.IsFaulted && task.Exception != null)
				{
					throw task.Exception;
				}
				return GetSchema(connection, tableList, proceduresList, cancellationToken);
			};
			return OpenConnectionAsync(connection, cancellationToken).ContinueWith(ImpersonateHelper.Impersonate(action), cancellationToken, TaskContinuationOptions.None, TaskScheduler.Default);
		}

		public DBSchema GetSchema(SqlDataConnection connection, string[] tableList, string[] proceduresList, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			DBSchema dBSchema = null;
			if (tableList.Length != 0)
			{
				dBSchema = GetSchema(connection, tableList);
			}
			cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
			if (proceduresList.Length != 0)
			{
				dBSchema = new DBSchema((DBTable[])((dBSchema != null) ? ((Array)dBSchema.Tables) : ((Array)new DBTable[0])), (DBTable[])((dBSchema != null) ? ((Array)dBSchema.Views) : ((Array)new DBTable[0])), GetStoredProcedures(connection, proceduresList));
			}
			return dBSchema;
		}

		public DBStoredProcedure[] GetStoredProcedures(SqlDataConnection connection, string[] proceduresList)
		{
			return dbSchemaProviderEx.GetProcedures(connection, proceduresList);
		}

		private Task OpenConnectionAsync(SqlDataConnection connection, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			Action action = delegate
			{
				Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)connection, "connection");
				OpenConnection(connection, cancellationToken);
			};
			action = ImpersonateHelper.Impersonate(action);
			return Task.Factory.StartNew(action, cancellationToken, TaskCreationOptions.None, TaskScheduler.Default);
		}

		private void OpenConnection(SqlDataConnection connection, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			connection.CreateDataStore(dataConnectionParameterService, cancellationToken);
		}
	}
	public class DistinctCriteriaOperand : CriteriaOperator
	{
		private readonly CriteriaOperator innerOperator;

		public CriteriaOperator InnerOperator => innerOperator;

		public DistinctCriteriaOperand(CriteriaOperator innerOperator)
		{
			this.innerOperator = innerOperator;
		}

		public override void Accept(ICriteriaVisitor visitor)
		{
			if (visitor is ISelectQueryCriteriaVisitor selectQueryCriteriaVisitor)
			{
				selectQueryCriteriaVisitor.Visit(this);
			}
			innerOperator.Accept(visitor);
		}

		public override T Accept<T>(ICriteriaVisitor<T> visitor)
		{
			if (visitor is ISelectQueryCriteriaVisitor<T> selectQueryCriteriaVisitor)
			{
				return selectQueryCriteriaVisitor.Visit(this);
			}
			return innerOperator.Accept<T>(visitor);
		}

		protected override CriteriaOperator CloneCommon()
		{
			return (CriteriaOperator)(object)new DistinctCriteriaOperand(InnerOperator);
		}
	}
	public class FilteredResultList : ResultTableBase
	{
		private readonly ResultTable originalTable;

		private readonly List<ResultRow> records;

		private int addNewPos = -1;

		public override string TableName
		{
			get
			{
				return originalTable.TableName;
			}
			set
			{
			}
		}

		public override List<ResultColumn> Columns => originalTable.Columns;

		public override List<ResultRelation> Details => originalTable.Details;

		public override int Count => records.Count;

		public FilteredResultList(ResultTable originalTable, Func<ResultRow, bool> filter)
		{
			this.originalTable = originalTable;
			records = originalTable.AsParallel<ResultRow>().AsOrdered().Where(filter)
				.ToList();
		}

		public FilteredResultList(ResultTable originalTable, List<ResultRow> records)
		{
			this.originalTable = originalTable;
			this.records = records;
		}

		public override IEnumerator<ResultRow> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return records.GetEnumerator();
		}

		public override bool Contains(ResultRow item)
		{
			return records.Contains(item);
		}

		public override void CopyTo(ResultRow[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			records.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		public override int IndexOf(ResultRow item)
		{
			return records.IndexOf(item);
		}

		protected override ResultRow ElementAt(int index)
		{
			return records[index];
		}

		public override object AddNew()
		{
			if (Columns.Count > 0)
			{
				ResultRow item = new ResultRow(originalTable, 0);
				records.Add(item);
				addNewPos = records.IndexOf(item);
				OnListChanged(ListChangedType.ItemAdded, Count);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override void CancelNew(int itemIndex)
		{
			if (addNewPos >= 0 && addNewPos == itemIndex)
			{
				records.RemoveAt(addNewPos);
				addNewPos = -1;
			}
		}

		public override void EndNew(int itemIndex)
		{
			if (addNewPos >= 0 && addNewPos == itemIndex)
			{
				addNewPos = -1;
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class QueryCriteriaValidatorVisitor : IQueryCriteriaVisitor, ICriteriaVisitor
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<string, string> tableActualNames;

		private readonly Dictionary<string, DBTable> dbTables;

		private readonly IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters;

		protected QueryCriteriaValidatorVisitor(Dictionary<string, string> tableActualNames, Dictionary<string, DBTable> dbTables, IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters)
		{
			this.tableActualNames = tableActualNames;
			this.dbTables = dbTables;
			this.parameters = parameters;
		}

		public void Process(CriteriaOperator theOperator)
		{
			if (theOperator != null)
			{
				theOperator.Accept((ICriteriaVisitor)(object)this);
			}
		}

		public void Visit(BetweenOperator theOperator)
		{
			Process(theOperator.TestExpression);
			Process(theOperator.BeginExpression);
			Process(theOperator.EndExpression);
		}

		public void Visit(BinaryOperator theOperator)
		{
			Process(theOperator.LeftOperand);
			Process(theOperator.RightOperand);
		}

		public void Visit(UnaryOperator theOperator)
		{
			Process(theOperator.Operand);
		}

		public void Visit(InOperator theOperator)
		{
			Process(theOperator.LeftOperand);
			foreach (CriteriaOperator item in (List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)theOperator.Operands)
			{
				Process(item);
			}
		}

		public void Visit(GroupOperator theOperator)
		{
			foreach (CriteriaOperator item in (List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)theOperator.Operands)
			{
				Process(item);
			}
		}

		public void Visit(OperandValue theOperand)
		{
			OperandValue obj = ((theOperand is OperandParameter) ? theOperand : null);
			string parameterName = ((obj != null) ? ((OperandParameter)obj).ParameterName : null);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(parameterName) && parameters.All((IParameter p) => ((IFilterParameter)p).Name != parameterName))
			{
				ThrowMissingParameterValidationException(parameterName);
			}
		}

		public void Visit(FunctionOperator theOperator)
		{
			foreach (CriteriaOperator item in (List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)theOperator.Operands)
			{
				Process(item);
			}
		}

		public void Visit(QuerySubQueryContainer theOperand)
		{
			Process(theOperand.AggregateProperty);
		}

		public void Visit(QueryOperand theOperand)
		{
			if (dbTables == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (theOperand.NodeAlias != null)
			{
				if (!tableActualNames.ContainsKey(theOperand.NodeAlias))
				{
					ThrowMissingTableValidationException(theOperand.NodeAlias, theOperand.ColumnName);
				}
				string text = tableActualNames[theOperand.NodeAlias];
				DBTable table = dbTables[text];
				DBColumn columnSafe = table.GetColumnSafe(theOperand.ColumnName);
				if (columnSafe == null)
				{
					ThrowMissingInSchemaColumnValidationException(text, theOperand.ColumnName);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				CheckOrphanColumn(theOperand.ColumnName);
			}
		}

		protected abstract void ThrowMissingTableValidationException(string tableName, string columnName);

		protected abstract void ThrowMissingTableValidationException(string columnName);

		protected abstract void ThrowMissingParameterValidationException(string parameterName);

		protected abstract void ThrowMissingInSchemaColumnValidationException(string tableName, string columnName);

		protected abstract void ThrowAmbiguousColumnValidationException(string columnName, string[] tables);

		private void CheckOrphanColumn(string columnName)
		{
			string[] array = (from table in dbTables.Values
				where tableActualNames.ContainsValue(table.Name) && table.GetColumnSafe(columnName) != null
				select table.Name).ToArray();
			if (array.Length == 0)
			{
				ThrowMissingTableValidationException(columnName);
			}
			if (array.Length > 1)
			{
				ThrowAmbiguousColumnValidationException(columnName, array);
			}
		}
	}
	public class FilterCriteriaValidatorVisitor : QueryCriteriaValidatorVisitor
	{
		public FilterCriteriaValidatorVisitor(Dictionary<string, string> tableActualNames, Dictionary<string, DBTable> dbTables, IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters)
			: base(tableActualNames, dbTables, parameters)
		{
		}

		protected override void ThrowMissingTableValidationException(string tableName, string columnName)
		{
			throw new FilterByColumnOfMissingTableValidationException(tableName + "." + columnName);
		}

		protected override void ThrowMissingTableValidationException(string columnName)
		{
			throw new FilterByColumnOfMissingTableValidationException(columnName);
		}

		protected override void ThrowMissingParameterValidationException(string parameterName)
		{
			throw new FilterByMissingParameterValidationException(parameterName);
		}

		protected override void ThrowMissingInSchemaColumnValidationException(string tableName, string columnName)
		{
			throw new FilterByMissingInSchemaColumnValidationException(tableName, columnName);
		}

		protected override void ThrowAmbiguousColumnValidationException(string columnName, string[] tables)
		{
			throw new FilterByAmbiguousColumnValidationException(columnName, tables);
		}
	}
	public class CustomExpressionValidatorVisitor : QueryCriteriaValidatorVisitor
	{
		public CustomExpressionValidatorVisitor(Dictionary<string, string> tableActualNames, Dictionary<string, DBTable> dbTables, IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters)
			: base(tableActualNames, dbTables, parameters)
		{
		}

		protected override void ThrowMissingTableValidationException(string tableName, string columnName)
		{
			throw new CustomExpressionWithColumnOfMissingTableValidationException(tableName + "." + columnName);
		}

		protected override void ThrowMissingTableValidationException(string columnName)
		{
			throw new CustomExpressionWithColumnOfMissingTableValidationException(columnName);
		}

		protected override void ThrowMissingParameterValidationException(string parameterName)
		{
			throw new CustomExpressionWithMissingParameterValidationException(parameterName);
		}

		protected override void ThrowMissingInSchemaColumnValidationException(string tableName, string columnName)
		{
			throw new CustomExpressionWithMissingInSchemaColumnValidationException(tableName, columnName);
		}

		protected override void ThrowAmbiguousColumnValidationException(string columnName, string[] tables)
		{
			throw new CustomExpressionWithAmbiguousColumnValidationException(columnName, tables);
		}
	}
	public class HavingCriteriaPatcher : IQueryCriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>, ICriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>
	{
		private struct ColumnDescription
		{
			private readonly string table;

			private readonly string column;

			private readonly AggregationType aggregation;

			public string TableName => table;

			public string ColumnName => column;

			public AggregationType Aggregation => aggregation;

			public ColumnDescription(string table, string column, AggregationType aggregation)
			{
				this.table = table;
				this.column = column;
				this.aggregation = aggregation;
			}
		}

		private readonly Dictionary<string, ColumnDescription> columnAliases = new Dictionary<string, ColumnDescription>();

		private readonly Dictionary<string, CriteriaOperator> expressionAliases;

		public HavingCriteriaPatcher(IList<ColumnBase> columns, Dictionary<string, CriteriaOperator> columnsParsed)
		{
			foreach (ColumnBase column2 in columns)
			{
				if (column2 is Column { Expression: ColumnExpression expression } column)
				{
					columnAliases.Add(column.ActualName, new ColumnDescription(expression.Table.ActualName, expression.ColumnName, expression.Aggregate));
				}
			}
			expressionAliases = columnsParsed;
		}

		public CriteriaOperator Visit(BetweenOperator theOperator)
		{
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			return (CriteriaOperator)new BetweenOperator(theOperator.TestExpression.Accept<CriteriaOperator>((ICriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>)this), theOperator.BeginExpression.Accept<CriteriaOperator>((ICriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>)this), theOperator.EndExpression.Accept<CriteriaOperator>((ICriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>)this));
		}

		public CriteriaOperator Visit(BinaryOperator theOperator)
		{
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0024: Expected O, but got Unknown
			return (CriteriaOperator)new BinaryOperator(theOperator.LeftOperand.Accept<CriteriaOperator>((ICriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>)this), theOperator.RightOperand.Accept<CriteriaOperator>((ICriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>)this), theOperator.OperatorType);
		}

		public CriteriaOperator Visit(UnaryOperator theOperator)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Expected O, but got Unknown
			return (CriteriaOperator)new UnaryOperator(theOperator.OperatorType, theOperator.Operand.Accept<CriteriaOperator>((ICriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>)this));
		}

		public CriteriaOperator Visit(InOperator theOperator)
		{
			//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0029: Expected O, but got Unknown
			return (CriteriaOperator)new InOperator(theOperator.LeftOperand.Accept<CriteriaOperator>((ICriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>)this), ((IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator>)theOperator.Operands).Select((CriteriaOperator op) => op.Accept<CriteriaOperator>((ICriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>)this)));
		}

		public CriteriaOperator Visit(GroupOperator theOperator)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0023: Expected O, but got Unknown
			return (CriteriaOperator)new GroupOperator(theOperator.OperatorType, ((IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator>)theOperator.Operands).Select((CriteriaOperator op) => op.Accept<CriteriaOperator>((ICriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>)this)));
		}

		public CriteriaOperator Visit(OperandValue theOperand)
		{
			return (CriteriaOperator)(object)theOperand;
		}

		public CriteriaOperator Visit(FunctionOperator theOperator)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0023: Expected O, but got Unknown
			return (CriteriaOperator)new FunctionOperator(theOperator.OperatorType, ((IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator>)theOperator.Operands).Select((CriteriaOperator op) => op.Accept<CriteriaOperator>((ICriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>)this)));
		}

		public CriteriaOperator Visit(QueryOperand theOperand)
		{
			//IL_0086: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0091: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_004e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0054: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0035: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0040: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (theOperand.NodeAlias == null)
			{
				if (columnAliases.TryGetValue(theOperand.ColumnName, out var value))
				{
					if (value.Aggregation == AggregationType.None)
					{
						return (CriteriaOperator)new QueryOperand(value.ColumnName, value.TableName, theOperand.ColumnType);
					}
					QueryOperand innerOperator = new QueryOperand(value.ColumnName, value.TableName);
					return SqlQueryHelper.CreateSubQueryContainer((CriteriaOperator)(object)innerOperator, value.Aggregation);
				}
				if (expressionAliases.TryGetValue(theOperand.ColumnName, out var value2))
				{
					return value2;
				}
			}
			return (CriteriaOperator)new QueryOperand(theOperand.ColumnName, theOperand.NodeAlias, theOperand.ColumnType);
		}

		public CriteriaOperator Visit(QuerySubQueryContainer theOperand)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}
	}

	public class PositiveIntegerTypeConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			if (!(sourceType == typeof(string)))
			{
				return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			if (!(value is string s))
			{
				return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
			}
			if (!int.TryParse(s, out var result) || result < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.PositiveIntegerError));
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

	public static class QueryConversionHelper
	{
		public static SelectQuery TableQueryToSelectQuery(TableQuery tableQuery)
		{
			Dictionary<string, Table> tables = new Dictionary<string, Table>();
			SelectQuery selectQuery = new SelectQuery(tableQuery.Name);
			ConvertTables(tableQuery, selectQuery, tables);
			foreach (SortingInfo item in tableQuery.Sorting)
			{
				selectQuery.Sorting.Add(ConvertSorting(item, tables));
			}
			foreach (GroupingInfo item2 in tableQuery.Grouping)
			{
				selectQuery.Groups.Add(ConvertGrouping(item2, tables));
			}
			foreach (RelationInfo relation in tableQuery.Relations)
			{
				selectQuery.Relations.Add(ConvertRelation(relation, tables));
			}
			if (tableQuery.Parameters != null)
			{
				selectQuery.Parameters.AddRange(tableQuery.Parameters.Select((DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter p) => new DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter((IParameter)(object)p)));
			}
			selectQuery.Top = tableQuery.Top;
			selectQuery.Skip = tableQuery.Skip;
			selectQuery.FilterString = tableQuery.FilterString;
			selectQuery.GroupFilterString = tableQuery.GroupFilterString;
			return selectQuery;
		}

		private static void ConvertTables(TableQuery tableQuery, SelectQuery selectQuery, Dictionary<string, Table> tables)
		{
			foreach (DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.TableInfo table2 in tableQuery.Tables)
			{
				if (table2 == null)
				{
					selectQuery.Tables.Add(null);
					continue;
				}
				Table table = new Table
				{
					Name = table2.Name,
					Alias = table2.Alias
				};
				if (tables.ContainsKey(table.ActualName))
				{
					throw new DuplicatingTableNamesValidationException(table.ActualName);
				}
				tables.Add(table.ActualName, table);
				selectQuery.Tables.Add(table);
				foreach (DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.ColumnInfo column in table2.SelectedColumns)
				{
					AliasedBase aliasedBase = selectQuery.Columns.OfType<AliasedBase>().FirstOrDefault((AliasedBase c) => c.ActualName == column.ActualName);
					if (aliasedBase == null)
					{
						selectQuery.Columns.Add(ConvertColumn(column, table));
					}
					else if (!column.HasAlias)
					{
						DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.ColumnInfo columnInfo = new DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.ColumnInfo(column);
						columnInfo.Alias = AliasGeneratorHelper.CreateColumnAlias(columnInfo.Name, table2.ActualName, selectQuery);
						selectQuery.Columns.Add(ConvertColumn(columnInfo, table));
					}
					else if (!aliasedBase.HasAlias)
					{
						aliasedBase.Alias = AliasGeneratorHelper.CreateColumnAlias(aliasedBase.ActualName, table2.ActualName, selectQuery);
						selectQuery.Columns.Add(ConvertColumn(column, table));
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private static Column ConvertColumn(DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.ColumnInfo column, Table table)
		{
			if (column != null)
			{
				return new Column
				{
					Alias = column.Alias,
					Expression = new ColumnExpression
					{
						Aggregate = column.Aggregation,
						ColumnName = column.Name,
						Table = table
					}
				};
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.Group ConvertGrouping(GroupingInfo grouping, Dictionary<string, Table> tables)
		{
			if (grouping != null)
			{
				return new DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.Group
				{
					Expression = new ColumnExpression
					{
						ColumnName = grouping.Column,
						Table = GetTableFromDictionary(grouping.Table, tables),
						Aggregate = AggregationType.None
					}
				};
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static Sorting ConvertSorting(SortingInfo sortingInfo, Dictionary<string, Table> tables)
		{
			if (sortingInfo != null)
			{
				return new Sorting
				{
					Direction = ((sortingInfo.Direction != SortingInfo.SortingDirection.Ascending) ? ListSortDirection.Descending : ListSortDirection.Ascending),
					Expression = new ColumnExpression
					{
						ColumnName = sortingInfo.Column,
						Table = GetTableFromDictionary(sortingInfo.Table, tables),
						Aggregate = AggregationType.None
					}
				};
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static Join ConvertRelation(RelationInfo relation, Dictionary<string, Table> tables)
		{
			//IL_0030: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003a: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			if (relation == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Join obj = new Join
			{
				Nested = GetTableFromDictionary(relation.NestedTable, tables),
				Parent = GetTableFromDictionary(relation.ParentTable, tables),
				SqlJoinType = (SqlJoinType)relation.JoinType
			};
			foreach (RelationColumnInfo keyColumn in relation.KeyColumns)
			{
				obj.KeyColumns.Add(new RelationColumnInfo(keyColumn));
			}
			return obj;
		}

		private static Table GetTableFromDictionary(string tableName, Dictionary<string, Table> tables)
		{
			if (!tables.ContainsKey(tableName))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return tables[tableName];
		}
	}
	public sealed class QueryExecutor
	{
		private readonly SqlDataConnection connection;

		private readonly CustomizeQueryFilterCalback customizeQueryFilterCallback;

		private ConnectionOptions ConnectionOptions => connection.ConnectionOptions;

		public static void ApplyCustomFilter(SelectQuery query, IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters, SelectStatement selectStatement, CustomizeQueryFilterCalback customizeQueryFilterCallback)
		{
			if (customizeQueryFilterCallback != null)
			{
				IList<IParameter> parameters2 = (parameters as IList<IParameter>) ?? parameters.ToList();
				CriteriaOperator filter = FilterHelper.GetCriteriaOperator(query.FilterString, parameters2);
				customizeQueryFilterCallback(query, ref filter);
				filter = new IsNullMultiValueParameterCriteriaOperatorPatcher(parameters2).Process(filter);
				filter = new OperandPropertyReplacingCriteriaOperatorPatcher(parameters2).Process(filter);
				((JoinNode)selectStatement).Condition = filter;
			}
		}

		public QueryExecutor(SqlDataConnection connection, DBSchema dbSchema)
			: this(connection, dbSchema, null)
		{
		}

			: this(connection, dbSchema, customizeQueryFilterCallback, sourceParameters, null)
		{
		}

		public QueryExecutor(SqlDataConnection connection, DBSchema dbSchema, CustomizeQueryFilterCalback customizeQueryFilterCallback, IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters, IDBCommandInterceptor dbCommandInterceptor)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)connection, "connection");
			this.dbSchema = dbSchema;
			this.connection = connection;
			this.customizeQueryFilterCallback = customizeQueryFilterCallback;
			SourceParameters = sourceParameters;
			dbTables = dbSchema?.Tables.Union(dbSchema.Views).ToDictionary((DBTable t) => t.Name);
			this.dbCommandInterceptor = dbCommandInterceptor;
		}

		public ColumnarData Execute(SqlQuery query, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			return Execute(query, topThousand: false, cancellationToken);
		}

		public ColumnarData Execute(SqlQuery query, bool topThousand, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)query, "query");
			IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters = ParametersEvaluator.EvaluateParameters(SourceParameters, query.Parameters);
			IColumnarDataLoader columnarDataLoader = CreateColumnarDataLoader(query.Name);
			SelectQuery selectQuery = ((query is TableQuery tableQuery) ? QueryConversionHelper.TableQueryToSelectQuery(tableQuery) : (query as SelectQuery));
			if (selectQuery != null)
			{
				return Execute(selectQuery, parameters, columnarDataLoader, cancellationToken, topThousand);
			}
			if (query is CustomSqlQuery query2)
			{
				return Execute(query2, parameters, columnarDataLoader, cancellationToken);
			}
			if (query is StoredProcQuery query3)
			{
				return Execute(query3, parameters, columnarDataLoader, cancellationToken);
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException($"Unknown query type: {query.GetType()}");
		}

		private IColumnarDataLoader CreateColumnarDataLoader(string queryName)
		{
			IColumnarDataLoader columnarDataLoader = ColumnarDataLoaderFactory.GetColumnarDataLoader(connection.DataStore);
			if (columnarDataLoader == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			columnarDataLoader.AfterCommandCreated = delegate(IDbCommand command)
			{
				dbCommandInterceptor?.CommandCreated(queryName, command);
			};
			return columnarDataLoader;
		}

		private ColumnarData Execute(CustomSqlQuery query, IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters, IColumnarDataLoader columnarDataLoader, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			//IL_004f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0083: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_007e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0084: Expected O, but got Unknown

			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("This provider does not implement no ISupportColumnarDataLoader or IColumnarDataLoader.");
			}
			IList<IParameter> source = (parameters as IList<IParameter>) ?? parameters.ToList();
			Query query2 = new Query(query.Sql, new QueryParameterCollection(((IEnumerable<IParameter>)source).Select((Func<IParameter, OperandValue>)((IParameter p) => new OperandValue(p.Value))).ToArray()), (IList)source.Select((IParameter p) => ((IFilterParameter)p).Name).ToArray());
			return columnarDataLoader.SelectData(cancellationToken, query2, null, ConnectionOptions.Override(query));
		}

		private ColumnarData Execute(StoredProcQuery query, IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters, IColumnarDataLoader columnarDataLoader, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (columnarDataLoader == null)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("This provider does not implement no ISupportColumnarDataLoader or IColumnarDataLoader.");
			}
			return columnarDataLoader.ExecuteStoredProcedure(cancellationToken, query.StoredProcName, ConnectionOptions.Override(query), parameters.Select((Func<IParameter, OperandParameter>)((IParameter p) => new OperandParameter(((IFilterParameter)p).Name, p.Value))).ToArray());
		}

		private ColumnarData Execute(SelectQuery query, IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters, IColumnarDataLoader columnarDataLoader, CancellationToken cancellationToken, bool topThousand)
		{
			//IL_01b2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_019b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			IList<IParameter> list = (parameters as IList<IParameter>) ?? parameters.ToList();
			SelectStatement val = SqlQueryHelper.BuildSelectStatement(query, dbSchema, connection.SqlGeneratorFormatter, list);
			if (topThousand && (val.TopSelectedRecords == 0 || val.TopSelectedRecords > 1000))
			{
				val.TopSelectedRecords = 1000;
			}
			ApplyCustomFilter(query, list, val, customizeQueryFilterCallback);
			cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
			if (columnarDataLoader != null)
			{
				IAggregationResultTypeProvider aggregationResultTypeProvider = connection.DataStore as IAggregationResultTypeProvider;
				ISupportDefaultSchema supportDefaultSchema = connection?.DataStore as ISupportDefaultSchema;
				ColumnDescription[] columns = new SelectQueryActualColumnInfosHelper(aggregationResultTypeProvider, supportDefaultSchema, query, dbTables, suppressException: false).GetActualQueryColumns().ToArray();
				Query query2 = ((BaseSqlGeneratorWithParameters)new SelectSqlGeneratorWithAlias(connection.SqlGeneratorFormatter, query, list)).GenerateSql((BaseStatement)(object)val);
				return columnarDataLoader.SelectData(cancellationToken, query2, columns, ConnectionOptions.Override(query));
			}
			EnsureXmlSupported(query);

			{

				{
					ColumnExpression columnExpression = (ColumnExpression)item.Expression;
					if (!dbTables.TryGetValue(columnExpression.Table.Name, out var value))
					{
						throw new TableNotInSchemaValidationException(columnExpression.Table.Name);
					}
					DBColumn columnSafe = value.GetColumnSafe(columnExpression.ColumnName);
					if (columnSafe == null)
					{
						throw new ColumnNotInSchemaValidationException(columnExpression.Table.Name, columnExpression.ColumnName);
					}
					Type type = ((connection.DataStore is IAggregationResultTypeProvider aggregationResultTypeProvider2) ? aggregationResultTypeProvider2.GetAggregateFunctionResultType(columnExpression.Aggregate, columnSafe.ColumnType) : ConnectionProviderHelper.GetAggregateFunctionResultType(columnExpression.Aggregate, columnSafe.ColumnType));

						Type = type
					});
				}
			}
			SelectedData selectedData = connection.DataStore.SelectData((SelectStatement[])(object)new SelectStatement[1] { val });
			return ColumnarDataLoaderHelper.GetData(selectedData, list2.ToArray());
		}

		public static void EnsureXmlSupported(SelectQuery query)
		{
			if (query.Distinct)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.XmlProviderNotSupportedFeatureException));
			}
			foreach (ColumnBase column2 in query.Columns)
			{
				if (column2 != null && (!(column2 is Column column) || !(column.Expression is ColumnExpression)))
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.XmlProviderNotSupportedFeatureException));
				}
			}
		}

	internal abstract class SelectQueryActualColumnsHelper<T>
	{
		protected ISupportDefaultSchema SupportDefaultSchema { get; }

		protected IAggregationResultTypeProvider AggregationResultTypeProvider { get; }

		protected HashSet<string> Existing { get; }

		protected Dictionary<string, DBTable> DBTables { get; }

		protected SelectQuery Query { get; }

		protected virtual bool SuppressTableNotInSchemaValidationException => false;

		protected static string GetUniqueName(string tableActualName, DBColumn table, HashSet<string> existing)
		{
			return GetUniqueName(tableActualName, table.Name, existing);
		}

		protected static string GetUniqueName(string tableActualName, string name, HashSet<string> existing)
		{
			if (existing.Contains(name))
			{
				name = tableActualName + "_" + name;
				if (existing.Contains(name))
				{
					name = new PrefixNameGenerator(name).GenerateName(existing.Contains);
				}
			}
			existing.Add(name);
			return name;
		}

		protected SelectQueryActualColumnsHelper(IAggregationResultTypeProvider aggregationResultTypeProvider, ISupportDefaultSchema supportDefaultSchema, SelectQuery query, Dictionary<string, DBTable> dbTables)
		{
			AggregationResultTypeProvider = aggregationResultTypeProvider;
			SupportDefaultSchema = supportDefaultSchema;
			Query = query;
			DBTables = dbTables;
			Existing = new HashSet<string>(from c in Query.Columns.OfType<AliasedBase>()
				select c.ActualName);
		}

		public IEnumerable<T> GetActualQueryColumns()
		{
			List<Table> orderedTables = new List<Table>();
			foreach (ColumnBase columnBase in Query.Columns)
			{
				if (columnBase is AliasedBase aliased)
				{
					yield return GetResult(aliased);
				}
				if (!(columnBase is AllColumns allColumns))
				{
					continue;
				}
				orderedTables.Clear();
				if (allColumns.Table != null)
				{
					orderedTables.Add(allColumns.Table);
				}
				else if (Query.Relations.Count == 0)
				{
					orderedTables.AddRange(Query.Tables);
				}
				else
				{
					foreach (Join relation in Query.Relations)
					{
						if (!orderedTables.Contains(relation.Parent))
						{
							orderedTables.Add(relation.Parent);
						}
						if (!orderedTables.Contains(relation.Nested))
						{
							orderedTables.Add(relation.Nested);
						}
					}
				}
				foreach (Table item in orderedTables)
				{
					foreach (T column in GetColumns(item))
					{
						yield return column;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<T> GetColumns(Table table)
		{
			string text = ((SupportDefaultSchema != null) ? SupportDefaultSchema.RemoveDefaultSchema(table.Name) : table.Name);
			if (!DBTables.TryGetValue(text, out var value))
			{
				if (!SuppressTableNotInSchemaValidationException)
				{
					throw new TableNotInSchemaValidationException(text);
				}
				yield break;
			}
			foreach (DBColumn column in value.Columns)
			{
				yield return GetResult(table, column);
			}
		}

		protected abstract T GetResult(Table table, DBColumn dbColumn);

		protected abstract T GetResult(AliasedBase aliased);
	}
	internal class SelectQueryActualColumnNamesHelper : SelectQueryActualColumnsHelper<string>
	{
		protected override bool SuppressTableNotInSchemaValidationException { get; }

		public SelectQueryActualColumnNamesHelper(SelectQuery query, Dictionary<string, DBTable> dbTables, bool suppressException)
			: base((IAggregationResultTypeProvider)null, (ISupportDefaultSchema)null, query, dbTables)
		{
			SuppressTableNotInSchemaValidationException = suppressException;
		}

		protected override string GetResult(Table table, DBColumn dbColumn)
		{
			if (dbColumn == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return SelectQueryActualColumnsHelper<string>.GetUniqueName(table.ActualName, dbColumn.Name, base.Existing);
		}

		protected override string GetResult(AliasedBase aliased)
		{
			return aliased.ActualName;
		}
	}
	internal class SelectQueryActualColumnInfosHelper : SelectQueryActualColumnsHelper<ColumnDescription>
	{
		protected override bool SuppressTableNotInSchemaValidationException { get; }

		public SelectQueryActualColumnInfosHelper(IAggregationResultTypeProvider aggregationResultTypeProvider, ISupportDefaultSchema supportDefaultSchema, SelectQuery query, Dictionary<string, DBTable> dbTables, bool suppressException)
			: base(aggregationResultTypeProvider, supportDefaultSchema, query, dbTables)
		{
			SuppressTableNotInSchemaValidationException = suppressException;
		}

		protected override ColumnDescription GetResult(Table table, DBColumn dbColumn)
		{
			//IL_003e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (dbColumn == null)
			{
				return new ColumnDescription
				{
					Skip = true
				};
			}
			return new ColumnDescription
			{
				Name = SelectQueryActualColumnsHelper<ColumnDescription>.GetUniqueName(table.ActualName, dbColumn.Name, base.Existing),
				Type = DBColumn.GetType(dbColumn.ColumnType),
				ActualTableName = table.ActualName
			};
		}

		protected override ColumnDescription GetResult(AliasedBase aliased)
		{
			//IL_0067: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0091: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!(((aliased is Column column) ? column.Expression : null) is ColumnExpression columnExpression))
			{
				return new ColumnDescription
				{
					Name = aliased.ActualName
				};
			}
			base.DBTables.TryGetValue(columnExpression.Table.Name, out var value);
			DBColumn val = value?.GetColumnSafe(columnExpression.ColumnName);
			DBColumnType columnType = (DBColumnType)((val != null) ? ((int)val.ColumnType) : 0);
			Type type = ((base.AggregationResultTypeProvider != null) ? base.AggregationResultTypeProvider.GetAggregateFunctionResultType(columnExpression.Aggregate, columnType) : ConnectionProviderHelper.GetAggregateFunctionResultType(columnExpression.Aggregate, columnType));
			return new ColumnDescription
			{
				Name = (aliased.ActualName ?? SelectQueryActualColumnsHelper<ColumnDescription>.GetUniqueName(columnExpression.Table.ActualName, columnExpression.ColumnName, base.Existing)),
				Type = type,
				ActualTableName = value?.Name
			};
		}
	}

	public class QueryParameterExpressionEditorLogic : ExpressionEditorLogic
	{
		private readonly IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters;

		public QueryParameterExpressionEditorLogic(IExpressionEditor editor, object expression, IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters)
			: base(editor, expression)
		{
			this.parameters = parameters;
		}

		protected override object[] GetListOfInputTypesObjects()
		{
			return new object[4]
			{
				base.editor.GetResourceString("Functions.Text"),
				base.editor.GetResourceString("Operators.Text"),
				base.editor.GetResourceString("Constants.Text"),
				base.editor.GetResourceString("Parameters.Text")
			};
		}

		protected internal override void FillFieldsTable(Dictionary<string, string> itemsTable)
		{
		}

		protected internal override void FillParametersTable(Dictionary<string, string> itemsTable)
		{
			if (parameters == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (IParameter parameter in parameters)
			{
				itemsTable[$"[Parameters.{((IFilterParameter)parameter).Name}]"] = "";
			}
		}

		protected override string GetExpressionMemoEditText()
		{
			return base.contextInstance.ToString();
		}
	}

		public const string XML_Parameter = "Parameter";

		private static readonly Dictionary<Type, QueryType> MAP_QueryTypes;

		private static readonly Dictionary<Type, ColumnType> MAP_ColumnTypes;

		public static string XmlRootTag => "Query";

		static QuerySerializer()
		{
			MAP_QueryTypes = new Dictionary<Type, QueryType>(4)
			{
				{
					typeof(TableQuery),
					QueryType.TableQuery
				},
				{
					typeof(CustomSqlQuery),
					QueryType.CustomSqlQuery
				},
				{
					typeof(StoredProcQuery),
					QueryType.StoredProcQuery
				},
				{
					typeof(SelectQuery),
					QueryType.SelectQuery
				}
			};
			MAP_ColumnTypes = new Dictionary<Type, ColumnType>(3)
			{
				{
					typeof(Column),
					ColumnType.Column
				},
				{
					typeof(AllColumns),
					ColumnType.AllColumns
				},
				{
					typeof(RecordsCount),
					ColumnType.RecordsCount
				}
			};
		}

		public static XElement SaveToXml(object data, IExtensionsProvider extensionProvider)
		{
			return SaveToXml(data, extensionProvider, null);
		}

		internal static XElement SaveToXml(object data, IExtensionsProvider extensionProvider, ISerializableTypesCollector collector)
		{
			if (data == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("data");
			}
			if (!MAP_QueryTypes.TryGetValue(data.GetType(), out var value))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException();
			}
			SqlQuery sqlQuery = (SqlQuery)data;
			XElement xElement = new XElement("Query");
			xElement.Add(new XAttribute("Type", value.ToString()));
			if (sqlQuery.Name != null)
			{
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("Name", sqlQuery.Name));
			}
			CultureInfo currentCulture = CultureInfo.CurrentCulture;
			CultureInfoExtensions.SetCurrentCulture(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			try
			{
				foreach (DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter parameter in sqlQuery.Parameters)
				{
					xElement.Add(SerializeParameter(extensionProvider, parameter, collector));
				}
				switch (value)
				{
				case QueryType.TableQuery:
				{
					TableQuery tableQuery = (TableQuery)sqlQuery;
					SerializeTableQueryCore(xElement, tableQuery);
					break;
				}
				case QueryType.CustomSqlQuery:
				{
					CustomSqlQuery customSqlQuery = (CustomSqlQuery)sqlQuery;
					SerializeCustomSqlQuery(xElement, customSqlQuery);
					break;
				}
				case QueryType.StoredProcQuery:
				{
					StoredProcQuery storedProcQuery = (StoredProcQuery)sqlQuery;
					SerializeStoredProcQuery(xElement, storedProcQuery);
					break;
				}
				case QueryType.SelectQuery:
				{
					SelectQuery selectQuery = (SelectQuery)sqlQuery;
					SerializeSelectQuery(xElement, selectQuery);
					break;
				}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				CultureInfoExtensions.SetCurrentCulture(currentCulture);
			}
			if (sqlQuery.Meta != null && !sqlQuery.Meta.IsEmpty)
			{
				xElement.Add(sqlQuery.Meta.Save());
			}
			return xElement;
		}

		public static SqlQuery LoadFromXml(XElement element, IExtensionsProvider extensionProvider)
		{
			if (!string.Equals(element.Name.LocalName, "Query", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(string.Format("Incorrect XML root element: <{0}>, <{1}> is expected.", element.Name.LocalName, "Query"));
			}
			QueryType queryType = XmlHelperBase.EnumFromString<QueryType>(element.GetAttributeValue("Type"));
			SqlQuery sqlQuery = null;
			CultureInfo currentCulture = CultureInfo.CurrentCulture;
			CultureInfoExtensions.SetCurrentCulture(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			try
			{
				switch (queryType)
				{
				case QueryType.TableQuery:
					sqlQuery = DeserializeTableQuery(element);
					break;
				case QueryType.CustomSqlQuery:
					sqlQuery = DeserializeCustomSqlQuery(element);
					break;
				case QueryType.StoredProcQuery:
					sqlQuery = DeserializeStoredProcQuery(element);
					break;
				case QueryType.SelectQuery:
					sqlQuery = DeserializeSelectQuery(element);
					break;
				}
				sqlQuery.Meta = TableMetaInfo.Load(element);
				foreach (XElement item in element.Elements("Parameter"))
				{
					DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter queryParameter = new DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter();
					DeserializeParameter(queryParameter, item, extensionProvider);
					sqlQuery.Parameters.Add(queryParameter);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				CultureInfoExtensions.SetCurrentCulture(currentCulture);
			}
			sqlQuery.Name = element.GetAttributeValue("Name");
			return sqlQuery;
		}

		private static void SerializeTableQueryCore(XElement rootEl, TableQuery tableQuery)
		{
			//IL_027f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(tableQuery.FilterString))
			{
				XElement xElement = new XElement("Filter");
				xElement.Add(tableQuery.FilterString);
				rootEl.Add(xElement);
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(tableQuery.GroupFilterString))
			{
				XElement xElement2 = new XElement("GroupFilter");
				xElement2.Add(tableQuery.GroupFilterString);
				rootEl.Add(xElement2);
			}
			if (tableQuery.Top > 0)
			{
				XElement xElement3 = new XElement("Top");
				xElement3.Add(tableQuery.Top);
				rootEl.Add(xElement3);
			}
			if (tableQuery.Skip > 0)
			{
				XElement xElement4 = new XElement("Skip");
				xElement4.Add(tableQuery.Skip);
				rootEl.Add(xElement4);
			}
			foreach (DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.TableInfo table in tableQuery.Tables)
			{
				XElement xElement5 = new XElement("Table");
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(table.Name))
				{
					xElement5.Add(new XAttribute("Name", table.Name));
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(table.Alias))
				{
					xElement5.Add(new XAttribute("Alias", table.Alias));
				}
				foreach (DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.ColumnInfo selectedColumn in table.SelectedColumns)
				{
					XElement xElement6 = new XElement("Column");
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(selectedColumn.Name))
					{
						xElement6.Add(new XAttribute("Name", selectedColumn.Name));
					}
					if (selectedColumn.Aggregation != AggregationType.None)
					{
						xElement6.Add(new XAttribute("Aggregate", selectedColumn.Aggregation.ToString()));
					}
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(selectedColumn.Alias))
					{
						xElement6.Add(new XAttribute("Alias", selectedColumn.Alias));
					}
					xElement5.Add(xElement6);
				}
				rootEl.Add(xElement5);
			}
			foreach (RelationInfo relation in tableQuery.Relations)
			{
				XElement xElement7 = new XElement("Relation");
				xElement7.Add(new XAttribute("Type", relation.JoinType));
				xElement7.Add(new XAttribute("Parent", relation.ParentTable ?? string.Empty));
				xElement7.Add(new XAttribute("Nested", relation.NestedTable ?? string.Empty));
				foreach (RelationColumnInfo keyColumn in relation.KeyColumns)
				{
					xElement7.Add(SerializeRelationKeyColumn(keyColumn));
				}
				rootEl.Add(xElement7);
			}
			foreach (SortingInfo item in tableQuery.Sorting)
			{
				XElement xElement8 = new XElement("OrderBy");
				xElement8.Add(new XAttribute("Table", item.Table ?? string.Empty));
				xElement8.Add(new XAttribute("Column", item.Column ?? string.Empty));
				if (item.Direction == SortingInfo.SortingDirection.Descending)
				{
					xElement8.Add(new XAttribute("Descending", true));
				}
				rootEl.Add(xElement8);
			}
			foreach (GroupingInfo item2 in tableQuery.Grouping)
			{
				XElement xElement9 = new XElement("GroupBy");
				xElement9.Add(new XAttribute("Table", item2.Table ?? string.Empty));
				xElement9.Add(new XAttribute("Column", item2.Column ?? string.Empty));
				rootEl.Add(xElement9);
			}
		}

		private static XElement SerializeRelationKeyColumn(RelationColumnInfo keyColumnInfo)
		{
			XElement xElement = new XElement("KeyColumn");
			xElement.Add(new XAttribute("Parent", keyColumnInfo.ParentKeyColumn));
			xElement.Add(new XAttribute("Nested", keyColumnInfo.NestedKeyColumn));
			if (keyColumnInfo.ConditionOperator != ConditionType.Equal)
			{
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("Operator", Enum.GetName(typeof(ConditionType), keyColumnInfo.ConditionOperator)));
			}
			return xElement;
		}

		private static void SerializeCustomSqlQuery(XElement rootEl, CustomSqlQuery customSqlQuery)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(customSqlQuery.Sql))
			{
				XElement xElement = new XElement("Sql");
				xElement.Add(customSqlQuery.Sql);
				rootEl.Add(xElement);
			}
		}

		private static void SerializeStoredProcQuery(XElement rootEl, StoredProcQuery storedProcQuery)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(storedProcQuery.StoredProcName))
			{
				XElement xElement = new XElement("ProcName");
				xElement.Add(storedProcQuery.StoredProcName);
				rootEl.Add(xElement);
			}
		}

		private static void SerializeSelectQuery(XElement rootEl, SelectQuery selectQuery)
		{
			XElement xElement = new XElement("Tables");
			bool flag = false;
			foreach (Table table in selectQuery.Tables)
			{
				XElement xElement2 = new XElement("Table");
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(table.Name))
				{
					xElement2.Add(new XAttribute("Name", table.Name));
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(table.Alias))
				{
					xElement2.Add(new XAttribute("Alias", table.Alias));
				}
				if (table.Meta != null && !table.Meta.IsEmpty)
				{
					table.Meta.Save(xElement2);
				}
				xElement.Add(xElement2);
				flag = true;
			}
			foreach (Join relation in selectQuery.Relations)
			{
				XElement xElement3 = new XElement("Relation");
				xElement3.Add(new XAttribute("Type", relation.SqlJoinType));
				if (relation.Parent != null)
				{
					xElement3.Add(new XAttribute("Parent", relation.Parent.ActualName));
				}
				if (relation.Nested != null)
				{
					xElement3.Add(new XAttribute("Nested", relation.Nested.ActualName));
				}
				foreach (RelationColumnInfo keyColumn in relation.KeyColumns)
				{
					xElement3.Add(SerializeRelationKeyColumn(keyColumn));
				}
				xElement.Add(xElement3);
				flag = true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				rootEl.Add(xElement);
			}
			xElement = new XElement("Columns");
			flag = false;
			foreach (ColumnBase column in selectQuery.Columns)
			{
				string text = ((!(column is AliasedBase aliasedBase)) ? null : aliasedBase.Alias);
				if (!MAP_ColumnTypes.TryGetValue(column.GetType(), out var value))
				{
					continue;
				}
				XElement xElement4;
				switch (value)
				{
				case ColumnType.Column:
					xElement4 = SerializeExpression(((Column)column).Expression);
					break;
				case ColumnType.AllColumns:
				{
					xElement4 = new XElement("AllColumns");
					AllColumns allColumns = (AllColumns)column;
					if (allColumns.Table != null)
					{
						xElement4.Add(new XAttribute("Table", allColumns.Table.ActualName));
					}
					break;
				}
				case ColumnType.RecordsCount:
					xElement4 = new XElement("RecordsCount");
					break;
				default:
					continue;
				}
				if (text != null)
				{
					xElement4.Add(new XAttribute("Alias", text));
				}
				xElement.Add(xElement4);
				flag = true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				rootEl.Add(xElement);
			}
			xElement = new XElement("Sorting");
			flag = false;
			foreach (Sorting item in selectQuery.Sorting)
			{
				XElement xElement5 = SerializeExpression(item.Expression);
				if (item.Direction == ListSortDirection.Descending)
				{
					xElement5.Add(new XAttribute("Descending", true));
				}
				xElement.Add(xElement5);
				flag = true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				rootEl.Add(xElement);
			}
			xElement = new XElement("Grouping");
			flag = false;
			foreach (DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.Group group in selectQuery.Groups)
			{
				xElement.Add(SerializeExpression(group.Expression));
				flag = true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				rootEl.Add(xElement);
			}
			if (selectQuery.FilterString != null)
			{
				XElement xElement6 = new XElement("Filter");
				xElement6.Add(selectQuery.FilterString);
				rootEl.Add(xElement6);
			}
			if (selectQuery.GroupFilterString != null)
			{
				XElement xElement7 = new XElement("GroupFilter");
				xElement7.Add(selectQuery.GroupFilterString);
				rootEl.Add(xElement7);
			}
			if (selectQuery.Top != 0)
			{
				rootEl.Add(new XAttribute("Top", selectQuery.Top));
			}
			if (selectQuery.Skip != 0)
			{
				rootEl.Add(new XAttribute("Skip", selectQuery.Skip));
			}
			if (selectQuery.Distinct)
			{
				rootEl.Add(new XAttribute("Distinct", true));
			}
		}

		private static XElement SerializeExpression(ExpressionBase expr)
		{
			XElement xElement;
			if (expr is ColumnExpression columnExpression)
			{
				xElement = new XElement("Column");
				if (columnExpression.Table != null)
				{
					xElement.Add(new XAttribute("Table", columnExpression.Table.ActualName));
				}
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("Name", columnExpression.ColumnName));
			}
			else
			{
				CustomExpression customExpression = (CustomExpression)expr;
				xElement = new XElement("Expression");
				if (customExpression != null)
				{
					xElement.Add(customExpression.Expression);
				}
			}
			if (expr != null && expr.Aggregate != AggregationType.None)
			{
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("Aggregate", expr.Aggregate));
			}
			return xElement;
		}

		private static TableQuery DeserializeTableQuery(XElement rootEl)
		{
			TableQuery tableQuery = new TableQuery();
			XElement xElement = rootEl.Element("Filter");
			if (xElement != null)
			{
				tableQuery.FilterString = xElement.Value;
			}
			XElement xElement2 = rootEl.Element("GroupFilter");
			if (xElement2 != null)
			{
				tableQuery.GroupFilterString = xElement2.Value;
			}
			XElement xElement3 = rootEl.Element("Top");
			if (xElement3 != null && int.TryParse(xElement3.Value, out var result) && result > 0)
			{
				tableQuery.Top = result;
			}
			XElement xElement4 = rootEl.Element("Skip");
			if (xElement4 != null && int.TryParse(xElement4.Value, out var result2) && result2 > 0)
			{
				tableQuery.Skip = result2;
			}
			foreach (XElement item in rootEl.Elements("Table"))
			{
				DeserializeTableQueryTable(item, tableQuery);
			}
			foreach (XElement item2 in rootEl.Elements("Relation"))
			{
				DeserializeTableQueryRelation(item2, tableQuery);
			}
			foreach (XElement item3 in rootEl.Elements("OrderBy"))
			{
				DeserializeTableQuerySortingInfo(item3, tableQuery);
			}
			foreach (XElement item4 in rootEl.Elements("GroupBy"))
			{
				DeserializeTableQueryGroupInfo(item4, tableQuery);
			}
			return tableQuery;
		}

		private static void DeserializeTableQueryGroupInfo(XElement groupEl, TableQuery tableQuery)
		{
			string attributeValue = groupEl.GetAttributeValue("Table");
			string attributeValue2 = groupEl.GetAttributeValue("Column");
			GroupingInfo item = new GroupingInfo(attributeValue, attributeValue2);
			tableQuery.Grouping.Add(item);
		}

		private static void DeserializeTableQuerySortingInfo(XElement sortEl, TableQuery tableQuery)
		{
			string attributeValue = sortEl.GetAttributeValue("Table");
			string attributeValue2 = sortEl.GetAttributeValue("Column");
			SortingInfo sortingInfo = new SortingInfo(attributeValue, attributeValue2);
			if (bool.TryParse(sortEl.GetAttributeValue("Descending"), out var result) && result)
			{
				sortingInfo.Direction = SortingInfo.SortingDirection.Descending;
			}
			tableQuery.Sorting.Add(sortingInfo);
		}

		private static void DeserializeTableQueryRelation(XElement relEl, TableQuery tableQuery)
		{
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			RelationInfo relationInfo = new RelationInfo();
			string attributeValue = relEl.GetAttributeValue("Type");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(attributeValue))
			{
				relationInfo.JoinType = XmlHelperBase.EnumFromString<JoinType>(attributeValue);
			}
			relationInfo.ParentTable = relEl.GetAttributeValue("Parent");
			relationInfo.NestedTable = relEl.GetAttributeValue("Nested");
			foreach (XElement item2 in relEl.Elements("KeyColumn"))
			{
				RelationColumnInfo item = DeserializeRelationKeyColumn(item2);
				relationInfo.KeyColumns.Add(item);
			}
			tableQuery.Relations.Add(relationInfo);
		}

		private static RelationColumnInfo DeserializeRelationKeyColumn(XElement keyColEl)
		{
			RelationColumnInfo relationColumnInfo = new RelationColumnInfo();
			relationColumnInfo.ParentKeyColumn = keyColEl.GetAttributeValue("Parent");
			relationColumnInfo.NestedKeyColumn = keyColEl.GetAttributeValue("Nested");
			string attributeValue = keyColEl.GetAttributeValue("Operator");
			if (attributeValue != null)
			{
				relationColumnInfo.ConditionOperator = (ConditionType)Enum.Parse(typeof(ConditionType), attributeValue);
			}
			return relationColumnInfo;
		}

		private static void DeserializeTableQueryTable(XElement tableEl, TableQuery tableQuery)
		{
			DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.TableInfo tableInfo = new DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.TableInfo();
			string attributeValue = tableEl.GetAttributeValue("Name");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(attributeValue))
			{
				tableInfo.Name = attributeValue;
			}
			string attributeValue2 = tableEl.GetAttributeValue("Alias");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(attributeValue2))
			{
				tableInfo.Alias = attributeValue2;
			}
			foreach (XElement item in tableEl.Elements("Column"))
			{
				DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.ColumnInfo columnInfo = new DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.ColumnInfo();
				string attributeValue3 = item.GetAttributeValue("Name");
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(attributeValue3))
				{
					columnInfo.Name = attributeValue3;
				}
				string attributeValue4 = item.GetAttributeValue("Aggregate");
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(attributeValue4))
				{
					columnInfo.Aggregation = (AggregationType)Enum.Parse(typeof(AggregationType), attributeValue4);
				}
				string attributeValue5 = item.GetAttributeValue("Alias");
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(attributeValue5))
				{
					columnInfo.Alias = attributeValue5;
				}
				tableInfo.SelectedColumns.Add(columnInfo);
			}
			tableQuery.Tables.Add(tableInfo);
		}

		private static CustomSqlQuery DeserializeCustomSqlQuery(XElement element)
		{
			XElement xElement = element.Element("Sql");
			if (xElement == null)

				return new CustomSqlQuery();

			return new CustomSqlQuery
			{
				Sql = xElement.Value
			};
		}

		private static StoredProcQuery DeserializeStoredProcQuery(XElement element)

			XElement xElement = element.Element("ProcName");

		private static SelectQuery DeserializeSelectQuery(XElement element)
		{
			SelectQuery selectQuery = new SelectQuery();
			DeserializeSelectQueryTables(element, selectQuery);
			DeserializeSelectQueryColumns(element, selectQuery);
			DeserializeSelectQuerySorting(element, selectQuery);
			DeserializeSelectQueryGrouping(element, selectQuery);
			XElement xElement = element.Element("Filter");
			if (xElement != null)
			{
				selectQuery.FilterString = xElement.Value;
			}
			XElement xElement2 = element.Element("GroupFilter");
			if (xElement2 != null)
			{
				selectQuery.GroupFilterString = xElement2.Value;
			}
			if (int.TryParse(element.GetAttributeValue("Top"), out var result))
			{
				selectQuery.Top = result;
			}
			if (int.TryParse(element.GetAttributeValue("Skip"), out var result2))
			{
				selectQuery.Skip = result2;
			}
			if (bool.TryParse(element.GetAttributeValue("Distinct"), out var result3) && result3)
			{
				selectQuery.Distinct = true;
			}
			return selectQuery;
		}

		private static void DeserializeSelectQueryGrouping(XElement element, SelectQuery query)
		{
			XElement xElement = element.Element("Grouping");
			if (xElement == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (XElement item in xElement.Elements())
			{
				ExpressionBase expressionBase = DeserializeExpression(item, query);
				if (expressionBase != null)
				{
					query.Groups.Add(new DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.Group
					{
						Expression = expressionBase
					});
				}
			}
		}

		private static void DeserializeSelectQuerySorting(XElement element, SelectQuery query)
		{
			XElement xElement = element.Element("Sorting");
			if (xElement == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (XElement item in xElement.Elements())
			{
				ExpressionBase expressionBase = DeserializeExpression(item, query);
				if (expressionBase != null)
				{
					query.Sorting.Add(new Sorting
					{
						Expression = expressionBase,
						Direction = ((bool.TryParse(item.GetAttributeValue("Descending"), out var result) && result) ? ListSortDirection.Descending : ListSortDirection.Ascending)
					});
				}
			}
		}

		private static void DeserializeSelectQueryColumns(XElement element, SelectQuery query)
		{
			XElement xElement = element.Element("Columns");
			if (xElement == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (XElement item2 in xElement.Elements())
			{
				ColumnBase item;
				if (string.Equals(item2.Name.LocalName, "RecordsCount", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
				{
					item = new RecordsCount
					{
						Alias = item2.GetAttributeValue("Alias")
					};
				}
				else if (string.Equals(item2.Name.LocalName, "AllColumns", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
				{
					item = new AllColumns
					{
						Table = FindTable(item2, query)
					};
				}
				else
				{
					ExpressionBase expressionBase = DeserializeExpression(item2, query);
					if (expressionBase == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					item = new Column
					{
						Alias = item2.GetAttributeValue("Alias"),
						Expression = expressionBase
					};
				}
				query.Columns.Add(item);
			}
		}

		private static void DeserializeSelectQueryTables(XElement element, SelectQuery query)
		{
			XElement xElement = element.Element("Tables");
			if (xElement == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (XElement item in xElement.Elements("Table"))
			{
				Table table = new Table
				{
					Name = item.GetAttributeValue("Name"),
					Alias = item.GetAttributeValue("Alias")
				};
				table.Meta = TableMetaInfo.Load(item);
				query.Tables.Add(table);
			}
			foreach (XElement item2 in xElement.Elements("Relation"))
			{
				Table table2 = FindTable(item2, query, "Parent");
				if (table2 == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				Table table3 = FindTable(item2, query, "Nested");
				if (table3 == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (!Enum.TryParse<SqlJoinType>(item2.GetAttributeValue("Type"), out var result))
				{
					result = SqlJoinType.Inner;
				}
				Join obj = new Join
				{
					Parent = table2,
					Nested = table3,
					SqlJoinType = result
				};
				foreach (XElement item3 in item2.Elements("KeyColumn"))
				{
					obj.KeyColumns.Add(DeserializeRelationKeyColumn(item3));
				}
				query.Relations.Add(obj);
			}
		}

		private static ExpressionBase DeserializeExpression(XElement element, SelectQuery query)
		{
			ExpressionBase expressionBase = null;
			if (string.Equals(element.Name.LocalName, "Column", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				Table table = FindTable(element, query);
				if (table == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				expressionBase = new ColumnExpression
				{
					Table = table,
					ColumnName = element.GetAttributeValue("Name")
				};
			}
			else if (string.Equals(element.Name.LocalName, "Expression", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				expressionBase = new CustomExpression
				{
					Expression = element.Value
				};
			}
			if (expressionBase == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!Enum.TryParse<AggregationType>(element.GetAttributeValue("Aggregate"), out var result))
			{
				result = AggregationType.None;
			}
			expressionBase.Aggregate = result;
			return expressionBase;
		}

		private static Table FindTable(XElement element, SelectQuery query)
		{
			return FindTable(element, query, "Table");
		}

		private static Table FindTable(XElement element, SelectQuery query, string attribute)
		{
			string tableName = element.GetAttributeValue(attribute);
			if (tableName != null)
			{
				return query.Tables.FirstOrDefault((Table t) => t.ActualName == tableName);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static XElement SerializeParameter(IExtensionsProvider extensionProvider, DataSourceParameterBase parameter)
		{
			return SerializeParameter(extensionProvider, parameter, null);
		}

		internal static XElement SerializeParameter(IExtensionsProvider extensionProvider, DataSourceParameterBase parameter, ISerializableTypesCollector collector)
		{
			return ParameterSerializer.SerializeParameter(extensionProvider, parameter, collector);
		}

		public static void DeserializeParameter(DataSourceParameterBase paramInfo, XElement paramEl, IExtensionsProvider extensionProvider)
		{
			ParameterSerializer.DeserializeParameter(paramInfo, paramEl, extensionProvider);
		}

		bool IDataSerializer.CanDeserialize(string value, string typeName, object extensionProvider)
		{
			if (typeof(SqlQuery).FullName == typeName)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return MAP_QueryTypes.Keys.Any((Type t) => t.FullName == typeName);
		}

		bool IDataSerializer.CanSerialize(object data, object extensionProvider)
		{
			if (data == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return MAP_QueryTypes.ContainsKey(data.GetType());
		}

		object IDataSerializer.Deserialize(string value, string typeName, object extensionProvider)
		{
			return LoadFromXml(SafeXml.CreateXElement(value, (Action<XmlReaderSettings>)null), (IExtensionsProvider)((extensionProvider is IExtensionsProvider) ? extensionProvider : null));
		}

		string IDataSerializer.Serialize(object data, object extensionProvider)
		{
			return SaveToXml(data, (IExtensionsProvider)((extensionProvider is IExtensionsProvider) ? extensionProvider : null), null).ToString(SaveOptions.DisableFormatting);
		}
	}
