	public class ResultRelation : PropertyDescriptor, IRelation, ICloneable
	{
		private struct IndexPair
		{
			public int MasterColumnIndex;

			public int DetailColumnIndex;
		}

		private readonly ResultTable master;

		private readonly ResultTable detail;

		private IndexPair[] indexPairsKeyColumns;

		private readonly IEnumerable<RelationColumnInfoBase> keyColumns;

		private readonly Dictionary<ResultRow, FilteredResultList> resultSets = new Dictionary<ResultRow, FilteredResultList>();

		private IDictionary index;

		private Type detailsKeyType;

		private IndexPair[] IndexPairsKeyColumns
		{
			get
			{
				if (indexPairsKeyColumns == null)
				{
					indexPairsKeyColumns = keyColumns.Select(delegate(RelationColumnInfoBase colInfo, int i)
					{
						int num = master.Columns.FindIndex((ResultColumn col) => col.Name == colInfo.ParentKeyColumn);
						if (num == -1)
						{
							throw new InvalidOperationException(string.Format(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.ResultRelation_ColumnNotFoundError), master.TableName, colInfo.ParentKeyColumn));
						}
						int num2 = detail.Columns.FindIndex((ResultColumn col) => col.Name == colInfo.NestedKeyColumn);
						if (num2 == -1)
						{
							throw new InvalidOperationException(string.Format(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.ResultRelation_ColumnNotFoundError), detail.TableName, colInfo.NestedKeyColumn));
						}
						return new IndexPair
						{
							MasterColumnIndex = num,
							DetailColumnIndex = num2
						};
					}).ToArray();
				}
				return indexPairsKeyColumns;
			}
		}

		public override Type ComponentType => typeof(ResultRow);

		public override bool IsReadOnly => true;

		public override Type PropertyType => typeof(FilteredResultList);

		ITable IRelation.Master => Master;

		ITable IRelation.Detail => Detail;

		IEnumerable<IColumn> IRelation.MasterKeyColumns => KeyColumns.Select((RelationColumnInfoBase info) => ((ITable)Master).GetColumn(info.ParentKeyColumn));

		IEnumerable<IColumn> IRelation.DetailKeyColumns => KeyColumns.Select((RelationColumnInfoBase info) => ((ITable)Detail).GetColumn(info.NestedKeyColumn));

		public ResultTable Master => master;

		public ResultTable Detail => detail;

		public IEnumerable<RelationColumnInfoBase> KeyColumns => keyColumns;

		private static object TryConvertValue(object value, Type type)
		{
			Type underlyingType = Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(type);
			if (value == null && underlyingType != null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Type type2 = underlyingType ?? type;
			if (value?.GetType() == type2)
			{
				return value;
			}
			try
			{
				return Convert.ChangeType(value, type2, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		public ResultRelation(ResultTable master, ResultTable detail, IEnumerable<RelationColumnInfoBase> keyColumns)
			: this(master, detail, keyColumns, master.TableName + detail.TableName)
		{
		}

		public ResultRelation(ResultTable master, ResultTable detail, IEnumerable<RelationColumnInfoBase> keyColumns, string name)
			: base(name, new System.Attribute[0])
		{
			this.master = master;
			this.detail = detail;
			this.keyColumns = keyColumns;
		}

		public override bool CanResetValue(object component)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public override object GetValue(object component)
		{
			ResultRow resultRow = (ResultRow)component;
			if (resultSets.ContainsKey(resultRow))
			{
				return resultSets[resultRow];
			}
			int num = IndexPairsKeyColumns.Length;
			object[] array = new object[num];
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				object value = master.Columns[IndexPairsKeyColumns[i].MasterColumnIndex].GetValue(resultRow);
				if (value == null)
				{
					return new FilteredResultList(Detail, new List<ResultRow>(0));
				}
				array[i] = value;
			}
			List<ResultRow> list = new List<ResultRow>();
			if (index == null)
			{
				CreateIndex();
			}
			object value2 = array[0];
			IDictionary dictionary = index;
			if (dictionary == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			value2 = TryConvertValue(value2, detailsKeyType);
			if (value2 != null && dictionary.Contains(value2))
			{
				list = (List<ResultRow>)dictionary[value2];
			}
			for (int j = 1; j < num; j++)
			{
				List<ResultRow> list2 = new List<ResultRow>();
				foreach (ResultRow item in list)
				{
					IndexPair indexPair = IndexPairsKeyColumns[j];
					object value3 = detail.Columns[indexPair.DetailColumnIndex].GetValue(item);
					if (value3 != null)
					{
						value3 = TryConvertValue(value3, array[j].GetType());
						if (value3 != null && array[j].GetHashCode() == value3.GetHashCode() && array[j].Equals(value3))
						{
							list2.Add(item);
						}
					}
				}
				list = list2;
				if (list2.Count == 0)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			FilteredResultList filteredResultList = new FilteredResultList(Detail, list);
			resultSets.Add(resultRow, filteredResultList);
			return filteredResultList;
		}

		private void CreateIndex()
		{
			int detailColumnIndex = IndexPairsKeyColumns[0].DetailColumnIndex;
			ResultColumn resultColumn = Detail.Columns[detailColumnIndex];
			detailsKeyType = Detail.Columns[detailColumnIndex].PropertyType;
			GetType().GetMethod("CreateIndex", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic, null, new Type[1] { typeof(ResultColumn) }, null).MakeGenericMethod(detailsKeyType).Invoke(this, new object[1] { resultColumn });
		}

		private void CreateIndex<T>(ResultColumn detailsKeyColumn)
		{
			Dictionary<T, List<ResultRow>> dictionary = (Dictionary<T, List<ResultRow>>)(index = new Dictionary<T, List<ResultRow>>());
			IList values = detailsKeyColumn.Values;
			if (values == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ResultColumn resultColumn = new ResultColumn(detailsKeyColumn.Name, detailsKeyColumn.PropertyType, values);
			foreach (ResultRow item in Detail)
			{
				object value = resultColumn.GetValue(item);
				if (value != null && !(value is DBNull))
				{
					T key = (T)value;
					if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(key, out var value2))
					{
						value2 = new List<ResultRow>();
						dictionary.Add(key, value2);
					}
					value2.Add(item);
				}
			}
		}

		public override void ResetValue(object component)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public override void SetValue(object component, object value)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public override bool ShouldSerializeValue(object component)
		{
			return false;
		}

		IEnumerable<IRow> IRelation.GetDetailRows(IRow masterRow)
		{
			return (ITable)GetValue(masterRow);
		}

		IEnumerable<IRow> IRelation.GetDetailRows(int masterRowIndex)
		{
			return ((IRelation)this).GetDetailRows(((ITable)Master)[masterRowIndex]);
		}

		public object Clone()
		{
			return new ResultRelation(Master, Detail, KeyColumns, Name);
		}
	}
	public class ResultRow : IRow, IEnumerable<object>, IEnumerable
	{
		private class Enumerator : IEnumerator<object>, IDisposable, IEnumerator
		{
			private readonly IEnumerator<IColumn> columnsEnumerator;

			private readonly int rowIndex;

			public object Current => columnsEnumerator.Current.GetValue<object>(rowIndex);

			public Enumerator(ResultRow owner)
			{
				columnsEnumerator = owner.owner.Columns.GetEnumerator();
				rowIndex = owner.Index;
			}

			public bool MoveNext()
			{
				return columnsEnumerator.MoveNext();
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				columnsEnumerator.Reset();
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
				columnsEnumerator.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private readonly ITable owner;

		internal int Index { get; }

		object IRow.this[int columnIndex] => ((IRow)this).GetValue<object>(columnIndex);

		object IRow.this[string columnName] => ((IRow)this).GetValue<object>(columnName);

		public ResultRow(ITable owner)
			: this(owner, 0)
		{
		}

		internal ResultRow(ITable owner, int index)
		{
			this.owner = owner;
			Index = index;
		}

		T IRow.GetValue<T>(IColumn column)
		{
			return column.GetValue<T>(Index);
		}

		T IRow.GetValue<T>(int columnIndex)
		{
			return owner.GetColumn(columnIndex).GetValue<T>(Index);
		}

		T IRow.GetValue<T>(string columnName)
		{
			return owner.GetColumn(columnName).GetValue<T>(Index);
		}

		IEnumerable<IRow> IRow.GetDetailRows(IRelation relation)
		{
			return relation.GetDetailRows(this);
		}

		IEnumerable<IRow> IRow.GetDetailRows(string relationName)
		{
			return owner.GetDetailRelation(relationName).GetDetailRows(this);
		}

		public IEnumerator<object> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new Enumerator(this);
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is ResultRow resultRow && Index == resultRow.Index)
			{
				return owner == resultRow.owner;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return Index;
		}
	}
	public class ResultSet : ResultSetBase
	{
		internal class ComplexResultSetPropertyDescriptor : PropertyDescriptor
		{
			private readonly string displayName;

			public override Type ComponentType { get; }

			public override bool IsReadOnly => true;

			public override Type PropertyType => typeof(SubResultSet);

			public override string DisplayName => displayName ?? base.DisplayName;

			public ComplexResultSetPropertyDescriptor(Type resultSetType, string name, string displayName)
				: base(name, new System.Attribute[0])
			{
				ComponentType = resultSetType;
				this.displayName = displayName;
			}

			public override bool CanResetValue(object component)
			{
				return false;
			}

			public override object GetValue(object component)
			{
				return ((ResultSet)component).ComplexResults[Name];
			}

			public override void ResetValue(object component)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}

			public override void SetValue(object component, object value)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}

			public override bool ShouldSerializeValue(object component)
			{
				return false;
			}
		}

		private readonly SqlDataSource dataSource;

		public Dictionary<string, SubResultSet> ComplexResults { get; } = new Dictionary<string, SubResultSet>();

		public override string Name => dataSource?.Name;

		public ResultSet()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		public ResultSet(SqlDataSource dataSource)
		{
			this.dataSource = dataSource;
		}

		public ResultSet(SqlDataSource dataSource, IEnumerable<ResultTable> collection)
		{
			this.dataSource = dataSource;
			tablesList = new List<ResultTable>(collection);
			glossary = null;
		}

		public override object Clone()
		{
			IEnumerable<ResultTable> collection = base.Tables.Select((ResultTable resultTable) => (ResultTable)resultTable.Clone()).ToArray();
			ResultSet resultSet = new ResultSet(dataSource, collection);
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, SubResultSet> complexResult in ComplexResults)
			{
				resultSet.ComplexResults.Add(complexResult.Key, (SubResultSet)complexResult.Value.Clone());
			}
			return resultSet;
		}

		public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetItemProperties(PropertyDescriptor[] listAccessors)
		{
			if (listAccessors == null || listAccessors.Length == 0)
			{
				PropertyDescriptor[] second = ((IEnumerable<SubResultSet>)ComplexResults.Values).Select((Func<SubResultSet, PropertyDescriptor>)((SubResultSet t) => new ComplexResultSetPropertyDescriptor(GetType(), t.Name, t.Name))).ToArray();
				PropertyDescriptor[] properties = ((IEnumerable<ResultTable>)tablesList).Select((Func<ResultTable, PropertyDescriptor>)((ResultTable t) => new TypedListPropertyDescriptor(GetType(), t.TableName, t.DisplayName))).Union(second).ToArray();
				return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(properties);
			}
			if (ComplexResults.TryGetValue(listAccessors.First().Name, out var value))
			{
				return value.GetItemProperties(listAccessors.Skip(1).ToArray());
			}
			return base.GetItemProperties(listAccessors);
		}

		internal void SetTables(IEnumerable<ResultTable> resultTables, IEnumerable<SubResultSet> subSets, bool shouldMergeTables = false)
		{
			SetTablesCore(resultTables, subSets, shouldMergeTables);
			ComplexResults.Clear();
			foreach (SubResultSet subSet in subSets)
			{
				ComplexResults.Add(subSet.Name, subSet);
			}
			RaiseChanged();
		}

		protected override ResultTable FindTable(string name)
		{
			string[] array = name.Split(new char[1] { '.' }, 2);
			string queryName = array[0];
			string resultName = ((array.Length > 1) ? array[1] : null);
			if (!Contains(queryName) && ComplexResults.All((KeyValuePair<string, SubResultSet> r) => r.Key != queryName))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (resultName == null)
			{
				return base[queryName];
			}
			SubResultSet value = null;
			if (ComplexResults.TryGetValue(queryName, out value))
			{
				return value.Tables.FirstOrDefault((ResultTable t) => t.TableName == resultName);
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class SubResultSet : ResultSetBase
	{
		private string name;

		}

		public override object Clone()
		{
			IEnumerable<ResultTable> collection = base.Tables.Select((ResultTable resultTable) => (ResultTable)resultTable.Clone()).ToArray();
			return new SubResultSet(Name, collection);
		}

		public void SetName(string name)
		{
			this.name = name;
		}
	}
	public class ResultTable : ResultTableBase, ICloneable
	{
		private class ResultTableEnumerator : IEnumerator<ResultRow>, IDisposable, IEnumerator
		{
			private int position = -1;

			private readonly ResultTable owner;

			private readonly int count;

			object IEnumerator.Current => Current;

			public ResultRow Current => new ResultRow(owner, position);

			public ResultTableEnumerator(ResultTable owner, int count)
			{
				this.count = count;
				this.owner = owner;
			}

			public bool MoveNext()
			{
				return ++position < count;
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				position = -1;
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
			}
		}

		private class TypedListPropertyDescriptor : PropertyDescriptor
		{
			private readonly string displayName;

			private readonly ResultTable table;

			public override Type ComponentType { get; }

			public override bool IsReadOnly => true;

			public override Type PropertyType => typeof(ResultTable);

			public override string DisplayName => displayName ?? base.DisplayName;

			public TypedListPropertyDescriptor(Type resultSetType, string name, string displayName, ResultTable table)
				: base(name, new System.Attribute[0])
			{
				ComponentType = resultSetType;
				this.displayName = displayName;
				this.table = table;
			}

			public override bool CanResetValue(object component)
			{
				return false;
			}

			public override object GetValue(object component)
			{
				return table;
			}

			public override void ResetValue(object component)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}

			public override void SetValue(object component, object value)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}

			public override bool ShouldSerializeValue(object component)
			{
				return false;
			}
		}

		private string tableName;

		protected readonly ResultTableView view = new ResultTableView();

		private bool addNew;

		private readonly object copyLock = new object();

		public string DisplayName { get; set; }

		public override string TableName
		{
			get
			{
				return tableName;
			}
			set
			{
				tableName = value;
			}
		}

		public override List<ResultColumn> Columns { get; } = new List<ResultColumn>();

		public override List<ResultRelation> Details { get; } = new List<ResultRelation>();

		public override int Count
		{
			get
			{
				if (Columns.Count > 0)
				{
					return Columns[0].Count;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		public ResultTable(string tableName)
		{
			this.tableName = tableName;
		}

		public ResultTable(string tableName, ColumnarData columnarData)
			: this(tableName)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)columnarData, "selectedData");
			SetResultTableColumns(columnarData);
		}

		public override IEnumerator<ResultRow> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new ResultTableEnumerator(this, Count);
		}

		public override bool Contains(ResultRow item)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public override void CopyTo(ResultRow[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public override int IndexOf(ResultRow item)
		{
			return item?.Index ?? (-1);
		}

		protected override ResultRow ElementAt(int index)
		{
			return new ResultRow(this, index);
		}

		public ResultRelation AddDetail(ResultTable detail, IEnumerable<RelationColumnInfoBase> columns)
		{
			ResultRelation resultRelation = new ResultRelation(this, detail, columns);
			Details.Add(resultRelation);
			return resultRelation;
		}

		public ResultRelation AddDetail(ResultTable detail, IEnumerable<RelationColumnInfoBase> columns, string name)
		{
			ResultRelation resultRelation = new ResultRelation(this, detail, columns, name);
			Details.Add(resultRelation);
			return resultRelation;
		}

		private void SetResultTableColumns(ColumnarData columnarData)
		{
			Columns.Clear();
			for (int i = 0; i < columnarData.Schema.Length; i++)
			{
				if (!columnarData.Schema[i].Skip)
				{
					string name = columnarData.Schema[i].Name;
					columnarData.Schema[i].Name = CleanColumnName(name, i);
					ResultColumn item = CreateResultColumn(view, columnarData.Schema[i]);
					Columns.Add(item);
				}
			}
			view.SetData(columnarData);
		}

		protected virtual ResultColumn CreateResultColumn(ResultTableView resultTableView, string name)
		{
			return new ResultColumn(name, resultTableView);
		}

		protected virtual ResultColumn CreateResultColumn(ResultTableView resultTableView, ColumnDescription description)
		{
			return new ResultColumn(description.Name, resultTableView);
		}

		internal static string CleanColumnName(string name, int i)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
			{
				return name;
			}
			return $"Column{i + 1}";
		}

		internal void ClearRows()
		{
			view.ClearData();
			OnListChanged(ListChangedType.Reset, -1);
		}

		public void Copy(ResultTable source)
		{
			lock (copyLock)
			{
				CopyData(source);
			}
			OnListChanged(ListChangedType.Reset, -1);
		}

		protected virtual void CopyData(ResultTable source)
		{
			IEnumerable<ResultColumn> enumerable = Columns.Select((ResultColumn t) => t).ToArray();
			foreach (ResultColumn item in enumerable)
			{
				Columns.Remove(item);
			}
			foreach (ResultColumn sourceColumn in source.Columns)
			{
				ResultColumn resultColumn = enumerable.FirstOrDefault((ResultColumn c) => string.Equals(c.Name, sourceColumn.Name, StringComparison.Ordinal));
				if (resultColumn == null)
				{
					sourceColumn.View = view;
					resultColumn = sourceColumn;
				}
				Columns.Add(resultColumn);
			}
			foreach (ResultColumn column in Columns)
			{
				OnListChanged(ListChangedType.PropertyDescriptorAdded, column);
			}
			Details.Clear();
			Details.AddRange(source.Details);
			view.Copy(source.view);
		}

		public ResultColumn AddColumn(string name, Type fieldType)
		{
			view.AddColumn(name, fieldType);
			ResultColumn resultColumn = CreateResultColumn(view, name);
			Columns.Add(resultColumn);
			return resultColumn;
		}

		public object Clone()
		{
			ResultTable resultTable = new ResultTable(TableName);
			resultTable.Columns.AddRange(Columns.Select((ResultColumn c) => (ResultColumn)c.Clone()));
			resultTable.Details.AddRange(Details.Select((ResultRelation d) => (ResultRelation)d.Clone()));
			resultTable.view.Copy(view);
			return resultTable;
		}

		public override object AddNew()
		{
			if (Columns.Count > 0 && Columns[0].Values != null && Columns[0].Values.GetType() == typeof(ArrayList))
			{
				addNew = true;
				Columns[0].Values.Add(1);
				OnListChanged(ListChangedType.ItemAdded, Count);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override void CancelNew(int itemIndex)
		{
			if (Columns.Count > 0 && addNew)
			{
				Columns[0].Values.Clear();
				addNew = false;
			}
		}

		public override void EndNew(int itemIndex)
		{
			addNew = false;
		}
	}

			ResultTableBase resultTableBase = this;
			if (listAccessors == null)
			{
				return resultTableBase;

			foreach (PropertyDescriptor listAccessor in listAccessors)

				}

			return resultTableBase;

	public class SelectSqlGeneratorWithAlias : SelectSqlGenerator, ISelectQueryCriteriaVisitor<string>, IQueryCriteriaVisitor<string>, ICriteriaVisitor<string>
	{
		private static class DistinctSqlGeneratorFormatterFactory
		{
			public static ISqlGeneratorFormatter GetFormatter(ISqlGeneratorFormatter formatter, SelectQuery query)
			{
				if (query.Distinct)
				{
					return (ISqlGeneratorFormatter)(object)new DistinctSqlGeneratorFormatter(formatter);
				}
				return formatter;
			}
		}

		private class DistinctSqlGeneratorFormatter : ISqlGeneratorFormatterSupportSkipTake, ISqlGeneratorFormatter, ISqlGeneratorFormatterEx
		{
			private readonly ISqlGeneratorFormatter formatter;

			public bool BraceJoin => formatter.BraceJoin;

			public bool SupportNamedParameters => formatter.SupportNamedParameters;

			public bool NativeSkipTakeSupported
			{
				get
				{
					ISqlGeneratorFormatterSupportSkipTake skipTakeImpl = SelectSqlGenerator.GetSkipTakeImpl(formatter);
					if (skipTakeImpl != null)
					{
						return skipTakeImpl.NativeSkipTakeSupported;
					}
					return false;
				}
			}

			private ISqlGeneratorFormatter Formatter => formatter;

			private ISqlGeneratorFormatterSupportSkipTake SkipTakeFormatter => SelectSqlGenerator.GetSkipTakeImpl(formatter);

			public DistinctSqlGeneratorFormatter(ISqlGeneratorFormatter formatter)
			{
				this.formatter = formatter;
			}

			public string FormatFunction(ProcessParameter processParameter, FunctionOperatorType operatorType, params object[] operands)
			{
				//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				return ((ISqlGeneratorFormatterEx)formatter).FormatFunction(processParameter, operatorType, operands);
			}

			public string FormatTable(string schema, string tableName)
			{
				return formatter.FormatTable(schema, tableName);
			}

			public string FormatTable(string schema, string tableName, string tableAlias)
			{
				return formatter.FormatTable(schema, tableName, tableAlias);
			}

			public string FormatColumn(string columnName)
			{
				return formatter.FormatColumn(columnName);
			}

			public string FormatColumn(string columnName, string tableAlias)
			{
				return formatter.FormatColumn(columnName, tableAlias);
			}

			public string FormatSelect(string selectedPropertiesSql, string fromSql, string whereSql, string orderBySql, string groupBySql, string havingSql, int topSelectedRecords)
			{
				return FormatSelectDistinctTop(selectedPropertiesSql, fromSql, whereSql, orderBySql, groupBySql, havingSql, topSelectedRecords);
			}

			public string FormatSelect(string selectedPropertiesSql, string fromSql, string whereSql, string orderBySql, string groupBySql, string havingSql, int skipSelectedRecords, int topSelectedRecords)
			{
				if (skipSelectedRecords == 0)
				{
					return FormatSelect(selectedPropertiesSql, fromSql, whereSql, orderBySql, groupBySql, havingSql, topSelectedRecords);
				}
				return FormatSelectDistinctTopSkip(selectedPropertiesSql, fromSql, whereSql, orderBySql, groupBySql, havingSql, skipSelectedRecords, topSelectedRecords);
			}

			public string FormatInsertDefaultValues(string tableName)
			{
				return formatter.FormatInsertDefaultValues(tableName);
			}

			public string FormatInsert(string tableName, string fields, string values)
			{
				return formatter.FormatInsert(tableName, fields, values);
			}

			public string FormatUpdate(string tableName, string sets, string whereClause)
			{
				return formatter.FormatUpdate(tableName, sets, whereClause);
			}

			public string FormatDelete(string tableName, string whereClause)
			{
				return formatter.FormatDelete(tableName, whereClause);
			}

			public string FormatUnary(UnaryOperatorType operatorType, string operand)
			{
				//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				return formatter.FormatUnary(operatorType, operand);
			}

			public string FormatBinary(BinaryOperatorType operatorType, string leftOperand, string rightOperand)
			{
				//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				return formatter.FormatBinary(operatorType, leftOperand, rightOperand);
			}

			public string FormatFunction(FunctionOperatorType operatorType, params string[] operands)
			{
				//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				return formatter.FormatFunction(operatorType, operands);
			}

			public string FormatOrder(string sortProperty, SortingDirection direction)
			{
				//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				return formatter.FormatOrder(sortProperty, direction);
			}

			public string GetParameterName(OperandValue parameter, int index, ref bool createParameter)
			{
				return formatter.GetParameterName(parameter, index, ref createParameter);
			}

			public string ComposeSafeTableName(string tableName)
			{
				return formatter.ComposeSafeTableName(tableName);
			}

			public string ComposeSafeSchemaName(string tableName)
			{
				return formatter.ComposeSafeSchemaName(tableName);
			}

			public string ComposeSafeColumnName(string columnName)
			{
				return formatter.ComposeSafeColumnName(columnName);
			}

			private string FormatSelectDistinctTop(string selectedPropertiesSql, string fromSql, string whereSql, string orderBySql, string groupBySql, string havingSql, int topSelectedRecords)
			{
				if (formatter is ISqlGeneratorFormatterSupportDistinctTop sqlGeneratorFormatterSupportDistinctTop)
				{
					return sqlGeneratorFormatterSupportDistinctTop.FormatSelectDistinct(selectedPropertiesSql, fromSql, whereSql, orderBySql, groupBySql, havingSql, topSelectedRecords);
				}
				string sql = Formatter.FormatSelect(selectedPropertiesSql, fromSql, whereSql, orderBySql, groupBySql, havingSql, topSelectedRecords);
				return ConnectionProviderHelper.ApplyDistinct(sql);
			}

			private string FormatSelectDistinctTopSkip(string selectedPropertiesSql, string fromSql, string whereSql, string orderBySql, string groupBySql, string havingSql, int skipSelectedRecords, int topSelectedRecords)
			{
				if (formatter is ISqlGeneratorFormatterSupportDistinctTopSkip sqlGeneratorFormatterSupportDistinctTopSkip)
				{
					return sqlGeneratorFormatterSupportDistinctTopSkip.FormatSelectDistinct(selectedPropertiesSql, fromSql, whereSql, orderBySql, groupBySql, havingSql, skipSelectedRecords, topSelectedRecords);
				}
				string sql = SkipTakeFormatter.FormatSelect(selectedPropertiesSql, fromSql, whereSql, orderBySql, groupBySql, havingSql, skipSelectedRecords, topSelectedRecords);
				return ConnectionProviderHelper.ApplyDistinct(sql);
			}
		}

		private readonly IList<IParameter> parameters;

		public SelectSqlGeneratorWithAlias(ISqlGeneratorFormatter formatter, SelectQuery query)
			: base(DistinctSqlGeneratorFormatterFactory.GetFormatter(formatter, query))
		{
			parameters = ((IEnumerable<IParameter>)query.Parameters).ToList();
		}

		public SelectSqlGeneratorWithAlias(ISqlGeneratorFormatter formatter, SelectQuery query, IList<IParameter> evaluatedParameters)
			: base(DistinctSqlGeneratorFormatterFactory.GetFormatter(formatter, query))
		{
			parameters = evaluatedParameters;
		}

		public override string GetNextParameterName(OperandValue parameter)
		{
			//IL_007f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0089: Expected O, but got Unknown
			OperandParameter operandParameter = (OperandParameter)(object)((parameter is OperandParameter) ? parameter : null);
			if (operandParameter != null && (parameter.Value == null || parameter.Value is Expression))
			{
				IParameter val = parameters.FirstOrDefault((IParameter p) => ((IFilterParameter)p).Name == operandParameter.ParameterName);
				object obj = ((val == null) ? new object() : ((parameter.Value is Expression) ? val.Value : ValueHelper.GetDefaultValue(((IFilterParameter)val).Type)));
				return ((SelectSqlGenerator)this).GetNextParameterName((OperandValue)new OperandParameter(operandParameter.ParameterName, obj));
			}
			return ((SelectSqlGenerator)this).GetNextParameterName(parameter);
		}

		protected override string InternalGenerateSql()
		{
			PatchDBProjection((JoinNode)(object)((SelectSqlGenerator)this).Root);
			foreach (JoinNode item in (List<JoinNode>)(object)((JoinNode)((SelectSqlGenerator)this).Root).SubNodes)
			{
				PatchDBProjection(item);
			}
			return ((SelectSqlGenerator)this).InternalGenerateSql();
		}

		private void PatchDBProjection(JoinNode node)
		{
			if (node.Table is DBProjection)
			{
				node.Alias = ((BaseSqlGenerator)this).formatter.FormatColumn(node.Alias);
			}
		}

		protected override void AppendJoinType(JoinNode node, StringBuilder joins)
		{
			if (!(node is SqlJoinNode { SqlJoinType: var sqlJoinType }))
			{
				((BaseSqlGenerator)this).AppendJoinType(node, joins);
				return;
			}
			switch (sqlJoinType)
			{
			case SqlJoinType.RightOuter:
				joins.Append("right outer");
				break;
			case SqlJoinType.FullOuter:
				joins.Append("full outer");
				break;
			default:
				((BaseSqlGenerator)this).AppendJoinType(node, joins);
				break;
			}
		}

		public string Visit(AliasedCriteriaOperand theOperand)
		{
			string text = theOperand.InnerOperator.Accept<string>((ICriteriaVisitor<string>)this);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(theOperand.Alias))
			{
				return text;
			}
			return text + " as " + ((BaseSqlGenerator)this).formatter.FormatColumn(theOperand.Alias);
		}

		public string Visit(AllColumnsOperand theOperand)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(theOperand.TableName))
			{
				return "*";
			}
			return ((BaseSqlGenerator)this).formatter.FormatColumn(theOperand.TableName) + ".*";
		}

		public string Visit(RecordsCountOperand theOperand)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(theOperand.Alias))
			{
				return "count(*)";
			}
			return "count(*) as " + ((BaseSqlGenerator)this).formatter.FormatColumn(theOperand.Alias);
		}

		public string Visit(DistinctCriteriaOperand theOperand)
		{
			string text = theOperand.InnerOperator.Accept<string>((ICriteriaVisitor<string>)this);
			return "distinct " + text;
		}
	}
	public sealed class KeyColumnDescriptor
	{
		internal const string XML_KeyColumn = "KeyColumn";

		internal const string XML_MasterTableColumn = "Master";

		internal const string XML_DetailTableColumn = "Detail";

		public string MasterTableColumn { get; set; }

		public string DetailTableColumn { get; set; }

		public XElement SaveToXml()
		{
			XElement xElement = new XElement("KeyColumn");
			xElement.Add(new XAttribute("Master", MasterTableColumn));
			xElement.Add(new XAttribute("Detail", DetailTableColumn));
			return xElement;
		}

		public static KeyColumnDescriptor LoadFromXml(XElement element)
		{
			return new KeyColumnDescriptor
			{
				MasterTableColumn = element.GetAttributeValue("Master"),
				DetailTableColumn = element.GetAttributeValue("Detail")
			};
		}
	}
	public sealed class RelationDescriptor : List<KeyColumnDescriptor>
	{
		internal const string XML_Relation = "Relation";

		internal const string XML_Name = "Name";

		internal const string XML_Master = "Master";

		internal const string XML_Detail = "Detail";

		public string MasterTable { get; set; }

		public string DetailTable { get; set; }

		public string CustomName { get; set; }

		public XElement SaveToXml()
		{
			XElement xElement = new XElement("Relation");
			if (CustomName != null)
			{
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("Name", CustomName));
			}
			xElement.Add(new XAttribute("Master", MasterTable));
			xElement.Add(new XAttribute("Detail", DetailTable));
			using Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				KeyColumnDescriptor current = enumerator.Current;
				xElement.Add(current.SaveToXml());
			}
			return xElement;
		}

		public static RelationDescriptor LoadFromXml(XElement element)
		{
			RelationDescriptor relationDescriptor = new RelationDescriptor
			{
				MasterTable = element.GetAttributeValue("Master"),
				DetailTable = element.GetAttributeValue("Detail"),
				CustomName = element.GetAttributeValue("Name")
			};
			foreach (XElement item in element.Elements("KeyColumn"))
			{
				relationDescriptor.Add(KeyColumnDescriptor.LoadFromXml(item));
			}
			return relationDescriptor;
		}
	}
	public sealed class FieldListDescriptor : List<ViewDescriptor>
	{
		internal const string XML_DataSet = "DataSet";

		internal const string XML_Name = "Name";

		internal const string XML_DisplayName = "DisplayName";

		public string Name { get; set; }

		public string DisplayName { get; set; }

		public List<RelationDescriptor> Relations { get; } = new List<RelationDescriptor>();

		public List<FieldListDescriptor> ComplexResults { get; } = new List<FieldListDescriptor>();

		public FieldListDescriptor()
		{
		}

		public FieldListDescriptor(int capacity)
			: base(capacity)
		{
		}

		public FieldListDescriptor(IEnumerable<ViewDescriptor> collection)
			: base(collection)
		{
		}

		public XElement SaveToXml()
		{
			if (base.Count == 0 && ComplexResults.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			XElement xElement = new XElement("DataSet");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Name))
			{
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("Name", Name));
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(DisplayName) && !string.Equals(Name, DisplayName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("DisplayName", DisplayName));
			}
			using (Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					ViewDescriptor current = enumerator.Current;
					xElement.Add(current.SaveToXml());
				}
			}
			foreach (RelationDescriptor relation in Relations)
			{
				xElement.Add(relation.SaveToXml());
			}
			foreach (FieldListDescriptor complexResult in ComplexResults)
			{
				xElement.Add(complexResult.SaveToXml());
			}
			return xElement;
		}

		public static FieldListDescriptor LoadFromXml(XElement element)
		{
			FieldListDescriptor fieldListDescriptor = new FieldListDescriptor
			{
				Name = element.GetAttributeValue("Name"),
				DisplayName = element.GetAttributeValue("DisplayName")
			};
			foreach (XElement item in element.Elements("View"))
			{
				fieldListDescriptor.Add(ViewDescriptor.LoadFromXml(item));
			}
			foreach (XElement item2 in element.Elements("Relation"))
			{
				fieldListDescriptor.Relations.Add(RelationDescriptor.LoadFromXml(item2));
			}
			foreach (XElement item3 in element.Elements("DataSet"))
			{
				fieldListDescriptor.ComplexResults.Add(LoadFromXml(item3));
			}
			return fieldListDescriptor;
		}

		public void FillResultSet(ResultSet resultSet)
		{
			FillResultSet((ResultSetBase)resultSet);
			foreach (FieldListDescriptor complexResult in ComplexResults)
			{
				SubResultSet subResultSet = new SubResultSet(complexResult.Name, new ResultTable[0]);
				complexResult.FillResultSet(subResultSet);
				resultSet.ComplexResults.Add(subResultSet.Name, subResultSet);
			}
		}

		public void FillResultSet(ResultSetBase resultSet)
		{
			List<ResultTable> list = new List<ResultTable>();
			using (Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					ViewDescriptor current = enumerator.Current;
					ResultTable resultTable = new ResultTable(current.Name)
					{
						DisplayName = current.DisplayName
					};
					foreach (FieldDescriptor item in current)
					{
						ResultColumn resultColumn = resultTable.AddColumn(item.Name, item.FieldType);
						if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.DisplayName))
						{
							resultColumn.SetDisplayName(item.DisplayName);
						}
					}
					list.Add(resultTable);
				}
			}
			if (resultSet is ResultSet resultSet2)
			{
				resultSet2.SetTables(list, Enumerable.Empty<SubResultSet>());
			}
			else
			{
				resultSet.SetTables(list);
			}
			foreach (RelationDescriptor relation in Relations)
			{
				if (resultSet.Contains(relation.MasterTable) && resultSet.Contains(relation.DetailTable))
				{
					ResultTable resultTable2 = resultSet[relation.MasterTable];
					ResultTable detail = resultSet[relation.DetailTable];
					IEnumerable<RelationColumnInfo> columns = relation.Select((KeyColumnDescriptor descriptor) => new RelationColumnInfo(descriptor.MasterTableColumn, descriptor.DetailTableColumn));
					if (relation.CustomName != null)
					{
						resultTable2.AddDetail(detail, columns, relation.CustomName);
					}
					else
					{
						resultTable2.AddDetail(detail, columns);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public static FieldListDescriptor ConvertFromResultSet(ResultSet resultSet)
		{
			FieldListDescriptor fieldListDescriptor = ConvertFromResultSet((ResultSetBase)resultSet);
			foreach (SubResultSet value in resultSet.ComplexResults.Values)
			{
				fieldListDescriptor.ComplexResults.Add(ConvertFromResultSet(value));
			}
			return fieldListDescriptor;
		}

		public static FieldListDescriptor ConvertFromResultSet(ResultSetBase resultSet)
		{
			if (resultSet == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			FieldListDescriptor fieldListDescriptor = new FieldListDescriptor
			{
				Name = (resultSet.Name ?? "ResultSet")
			};
			foreach (ResultTable table in resultSet.Tables)
			{
				ViewDescriptor item = CreateViewDescriptor(table);
				fieldListDescriptor.Add(item);
				foreach (ResultRelation detail in table.Details)
				{
					RelationDescriptor relationDescriptor = new RelationDescriptor
					{
						MasterTable = detail.Master.TableName,
						DetailTable = detail.Detail.TableName
					};
					if (detail.Name != relationDescriptor.MasterTable + relationDescriptor.DetailTable)
					{
						relationDescriptor.CustomName = detail.Name;
					}
					foreach (RelationColumnInfoBase keyColumn in detail.KeyColumns)
					{
						KeyColumnDescriptor item2 = new KeyColumnDescriptor
						{
							MasterTableColumn = keyColumn.ParentKeyColumn,
							DetailTableColumn = keyColumn.NestedKeyColumn
						};
						relationDescriptor.Add(item2);
					}
					fieldListDescriptor.Relations.Add(relationDescriptor);
				}
			}
			return fieldListDescriptor;
		}

		private static ViewDescriptor CreateViewDescriptor(ResultTable table)
		{
			ViewDescriptor viewDescriptor = new ViewDescriptor
			{
				Name = table.TableName,
				DisplayName = table.DisplayName
			};
			foreach (ResultColumn column in table.Columns)
			{
				FieldDescriptor item = new FieldDescriptor
				{
					Name = column.Name,
					FieldType = column.PropertyType,
					DisplayName = column.DisplayName
				};
				viewDescriptor.Add(item);
			}
			return viewDescriptor;
		}
	}
	public class SkipTypeConverter : PositiveIntegerTypeConverter
	{
		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			SelectQuery selectQuery = (SelectQuery)context.Instance;
			if (selectQuery.Sorting.Count == 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.SkipWithoutSortingPropertyGridError));
			}
			return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
		}
	}
	public static class SqlDataConnectionExtensions
	{
		public static bool IsSupportStoredProcedure(this SqlDataConnection dataConnection)
		{
			if (!dataConnection.IsConnected)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("The connection is not open.");
			}
			return dataConnection.DataStore is ISupportStoredProc;
		}
	}
	public class SqlDataSourceSerializer : IDataSerializer
	{
		public const string XML_SqlDataSource = "SqlDataSource";

		public const string XML_Name = "Name";

		public const string XML_Connection = "Connection";

		public const string XML_Relation = "Relation";

		public const string XML_RelationName = "Name";

		public const string XML_MasterTable = "Master";

		public const string XML_DetailTable = "Detail";

		public const string XML_KeyColumn = "KeyColumn";

		public const string XML_MasterKeyColumn = "Master";

		public const string XML_DetailKeyColumn = "Detail";

		public const string XML_ResultSchema = "ResultSchema";

		public const string XML_ConnectionOptions = "ConnectionOptions";

		protected SqlDataSource SqlDataSource { get; private set; }

		public string XmlRootTag => "SqlDataSource";

		public SqlDataSourceSerializer()
		{
		}

		public SqlDataSourceSerializer(SqlDataSource sqlDataSource)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)sqlDataSource, "sqlDataSource");
			SqlDataSource = sqlDataSource;
		}

		public XElement SaveToXml()
		{
			return SaveToXml(null);
		}

		public virtual XElement SaveToXml(IExtensionsProvider extensionProvider)
		{
			XElement xElement = new XElement("SqlDataSource");
			SaveName(xElement);
			SaveConnection(xElement);
			SaveQueries(extensionProvider, xElement);
			SaveRelations(xElement);
			SaveResultSchema(xElement);
			SaveConnectionOptions(xElement);
			return xElement;
		}

		protected virtual void SaveName(XElement rootEl)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(SqlDataSource.Name))
			{
				rootEl.AddAttribute(SqlDataSource.Name, "Name");
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SaveConnection(XElement rootEl)
		{
			if (SqlDataSource.ConnectionParameters == null && string.IsNullOrEmpty(SqlDataSource.ConnectionName))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (SqlDataSource.ConnectionParameters == null)
			{
				SqlDataConnection sqlDataConnection = new SqlDataConnection
				{
					Name = SqlDataSource.ConnectionName,
					StoreConnectionNameOnly = true
				};
				XElement xElement = new XElement("Connection");
				sqlDataConnection.SaveToXml(xElement);
				rootEl.Add(xElement);
				return;
			}
			SqlDataConnection connection = SqlDataSource.Connection;
			if (connection != null)
			{
				XElement xElement2 = new XElement("Connection");
				connection.SaveToXml(xElement2);
				if (ShouldStoreCredentials(connection) && connection.ConnectionParameters.Factory != null)
				{
					SaveCredentials(xElement2, connection);
				}
				rootEl.Add(xElement2);
			}
		}

		internal static void SaveCredentials(XElement connectEl, SqlDataConnection connection)
		{
			XElement xElement = connectEl.Element("Parameters");
			if (xElement != null)
			{
				Dictionary<string, string> paramsDict = ConnectionParameter.GetParamsDict(connection.ConnectionParameters);
				if (paramsDict.TryGetValue("userid", out var value) && value != null)
				{
					XElement xElement2 = new XElement("Parameter");
					xElement2.Add(new XAttribute("Name", "userid"));
					xElement2.Add(new XAttribute("Value", value));
					xElement.Add(xElement2);
				}
				if (paramsDict.TryGetValue("password", out var value2) && value2 != null)
				{
					XElement xElement3 = new XElement("Parameter");
					xElement3.Add(new XAttribute("Name", "password"));
					xElement3.Add(new XAttribute("Value", value2));
					xElement.Add(xElement3);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool ShouldStoreCredentials(SqlDataConnection connection)
		{
			if (!connection.StoreConnectionNameOnly && !connection.HasConnectionString)
			{
				return connection.ConnectionParameters != null;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual void SaveQueries(IExtensionsProvider extensionProvider, XElement rootEl)
		{
			ISerializableTypesCollector collector = SqlDataSource.GetService(typeof(ISerializableTypesCollector)) as ISerializableTypesCollector;
			foreach (SqlQuery query in SqlDataSource.Queries)
			{
				rootEl.Add(QuerySerializer.SaveToXml(query, extensionProvider, collector));
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SaveRelations(XElement rootEl)
		{
			foreach (MasterDetailInfo relation in SqlDataSource.Relations)
			{
				XElement xElement = new XElement("Relation");
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("Master", relation.MasterQueryName ?? string.Empty));
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("Detail", relation.DetailQueryName ?? string.Empty));
				if (relation.HasCustomName)
				{
					xElement.Add(new XAttribute("Name", relation.Name));
				}
				foreach (RelationColumnInfo keyColumn in relation.KeyColumns)
				{
					XElement xElement2 = new XElement("KeyColumn");
					xElement2.Add(new XAttribute("Master", keyColumn.ParentKeyColumn ?? string.Empty));
					xElement2.Add(new XAttribute("Detail", keyColumn.NestedKeyColumn ?? string.Empty));
					xElement.Add(xElement2);
				}
				rootEl.Add(xElement);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SaveResultSchema(XElement rootEl)
		{
			XElement resultSchemaXml = SqlDataSource.GetResultSchemaXml();
			if (resultSchemaXml != null && !resultSchemaXml.IsEmpty)
			{
				XElement xElement = new XElement("ResultSchema");
				xElement.Add(resultSchemaXml);
				rootEl.Add(xElement);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SaveConnectionOptions(XElement rootEl)
		{
			XElement xElement = new XElement("ConnectionOptions");
			SqlDataSource.ConnectionOptions.SaveToXml(xElement);
			rootEl.Add(xElement);
		}

		public void LoadFromXml(XElement element)
		{
			LoadFromXml(element, null);
		}

		public virtual void LoadFromXml(XElement element, IExtensionsProvider extensionProvider)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)element, "element");
			if (!string.Equals(element.Name.LocalName, "SqlDataSource", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(string.Format("Incorrect XML root element: <{0}>, <{1}> is expected.", element.Name.LocalName, "SqlDataSource"));
			}
			SqlDataSource.Queries.Clear();
			SqlDataSource.Relations.Clear();
			SqlDataSource.ResultSet.SetTablesCore(new ResultTable[0], new SubResultSet[0]);
			LoadName(element);
			LoadConnection(element);
			LoadQueries(element, extensionProvider);
			LoadRelations(element);
			LoadResultSchema(element);
			LoadConnectionOptions(element);
		}

		protected virtual void LoadName(XElement element)
		{
			string attributeOrElementValue = element.GetAttributeOrElementValue("Name");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(attributeOrElementValue))
			{
				SqlDataSource.Name = attributeOrElementValue;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void LoadConnection(XElement element)
		{
			XElement xElement = element.Element("Connection");
			if (xElement != null)
			{
				SqlDataConnection sqlDataConnection = new SqlDataConnection();
				sqlDataConnection.LoadFromXml(xElement);
				SqlDataSource.SetConnectionInfo(sqlDataConnection);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void LoadQueries(XElement element, IExtensionsProvider extensionProvider)
		{
			foreach (XElement item in element.Elements(QuerySerializer.XmlRootTag))
			{
				SqlDataSource.Queries.Add(QuerySerializer.LoadFromXml(item, extensionProvider));
			}
		}

		protected virtual void LoadRelations(XElement element)
		{
			foreach (XElement item in element.Elements("Relation"))
			{
				MasterDetailInfo masterDetailInfo = new MasterDetailInfo
				{
					MasterQueryName = item.GetAttributeValue("Master"),
					DetailQueryName = item.GetAttributeValue("Detail"),
					Name = item.GetAttributeValue("Name")
				};
				foreach (XElement item2 in item.Elements("KeyColumn"))
				{
					RelationColumnInfo relationColumnInfo = new RelationColumnInfo();
					relationColumnInfo.ParentKeyColumn = item2.GetAttributeValue("Master");
					relationColumnInfo.NestedKeyColumn = item2.GetAttributeValue("Detail");
					masterDetailInfo.KeyColumns.Add(relationColumnInfo);
				}
				SqlDataSource.Relations.Add(masterDetailInfo);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void LoadResultSchema(XElement element)
		{
			XElement xElement = element.Element("ResultSchema");
			if (xElement != null && xElement.HasElements)
			{
				SqlDataSource.SetResultSchemaXml(xElement.Elements().First());
			}
		}

		protected virtual void LoadConnectionOptions(XElement element)
		{
			XElement xElement = element.Element("ConnectionOptions");
			if (xElement != null)
			{
				SqlDataSource.ConnectionOptions.LoadFromXml(xElement);
			}
		}

		bool IDataSerializer.CanDeserialize(string value, string typeName, object extensionProvider)
		{
			return typeof(SqlDataSource).FullName == typeName;
		}

		bool IDataSerializer.CanSerialize(object data, object extensionProvider)
		{
			if (data == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return data.GetType() == typeof(SqlDataSource);
		}

		object IDataSerializer.Deserialize(string value, string typeName, object extensionProvider)
		{
			SqlDataSource sqlDataSource = new SqlDataSource();
			SqlDataSourceSerializer sqlDataSourceSerializer = new SqlDataSourceSerializer(sqlDataSource);
			sqlDataSourceSerializer.LoadFromXml(SafeXml.CreateXElement(value, (Action<XmlReaderSettings>)null), (IExtensionsProvider)((extensionProvider is IExtensionsProvider) ? extensionProvider : null));
			return sqlDataSource;
		}

		string IDataSerializer.Serialize(object data, object extensionProvider)
		{
			SqlDataSourceSerializer sqlDataSourceSerializer = new SqlDataSourceSerializer((SqlDataSource)data);
			return sqlDataSourceSerializer.SaveToXml((IExtensionsProvider)((extensionProvider is IExtensionsProvider) ? extensionProvider : null)).ToString(SaveOptions.DisableFormatting);
		}
	}
	public class SqlExecutionException : Exception
	{
		public string Sql { get; private set; }

		public string Parameters { get; private set; }

		internal static string ConvertIDataParametersCollectionToString(IDataParameterCollection parameters)
		{
			if (parameters == null || parameters.Count == 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return string.Join(Environment.NewLine, parameters.Cast<IDataParameter>().Select(ConvertIDataParameterToString));
		}

		private static string ConvertIDataParameterToString(IDataParameter parameter)
		{
			return $"{parameter.ParameterName}({parameter.DbType}) = {parameter.Value}";
		}

		private static string BuildErrorString(string sql, string error, string parameters)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(parameters))
			{
				parameters = string.Format(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.SqlExecutionException_WithParameters), Environment.NewLine, parameters);
			}
			string format = DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.SqlExecutionException);
			return string.Format(format, BuildSqlString(sql), parameters, Environment.NewLine, error);
		}

		private static string BuildSqlString(string sql)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(sql))
			{
				return $" '{sql}'";
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		public SqlExecutionException(Exception innerException)
			: base(BuildErrorString(string.Empty, innerException.Message, string.Empty))
		{
		}

		public SqlExecutionException(IDbCommand command, string parameters, Exception innerException)
			: base(BuildErrorString(command.CommandText, innerException.Message, parameters), innerException)
		{
			Sql = command.CommandText;
			Parameters = parameters;
		}
	}
	public class SqlQueryCollectionTypeConverter : CollectionTypeConverter
	{
		private class QueryPropertyDescriptor : TypeConverter.SimplePropertyDescriptor
		{
			public class QueryExpandableObjectConverter : ExpandableObjectConverter
			{
				private class QueryNamePropertyDescriptor : SimplePropertyDescriptor
				{
					private readonly PropertyDescriptor parent;

					private readonly IServiceProvider serviceProvider;

					public QueryNamePropertyDescriptor(PropertyDescriptor parent, IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
						: base(parent.ComponentType, parent.Name, parent.PropertyType, (System.Attribute[])new ArrayList(parent.Attributes).ToArray(typeof(System.Attribute)))
					{
						this.parent = parent;
						this.serviceProvider = serviceProvider;
					}

					public override object GetValue(object component)
					{
						return parent.GetValue(component);
					}

					public override void SetValue(object component, object value)
					{
						IDesignerHost designerHost = ((serviceProvider != null) ? ((IDesignerHost)serviceProvider.GetService(typeof(IDesignerHost))) : null);
						IComponentChangeService componentChangeService = ((serviceProvider != null) ? ((IComponentChangeService)serviceProvider.GetService(typeof(IComponentChangeService))) : null);
						DesignerTransaction designerTransaction = designerHost?.CreateTransaction();
						SqlQuery sqlQuery = (SqlQuery)component;
						string newQueryName = (string)value;
						string oldQueryName = sqlQuery.Name;
						componentChangeService?.OnComponentChanging(sqlQuery.DataSource, null);
						try
						{
							parent.SetValue(component, value);
							sqlQuery.DataSource.UpdateRelations(oldQueryName, newQueryName);
							sqlQuery.DataSource.RenameResultSchemaPart(oldQueryName, newQueryName);
							componentChangeService?.OnComponentChanged(sqlQuery.DataSource, null, null, null);
							designerTransaction?.Commit();
						}
						catch (Exception)
						{
							designerTransaction?.Cancel();
							throw;
						}
					}
				}

				private class QueryGroupFilterStringPropertyDescriptor : SimplePropertyDescriptor
				{
					private readonly PropertyDescriptor parent;

					public QueryGroupFilterStringPropertyDescriptor(PropertyDescriptor parent)
						: base(parent.ComponentType, parent.Name, parent.PropertyType, (System.Attribute[])new ArrayList(parent.Attributes).ToArray(typeof(System.Attribute)))
					{
						this.parent = parent;
					}

					public override object GetValue(object component)
					{
						return parent.GetValue(component);
					}

					public override void SetValue(object component, object value)
					{
						SelectQuery selectQuery = (SelectQuery)component;
						if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value as string) && selectQuery.Groups.Count == 0)
						{
							throw new ArgumentException(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.GroupFilterStringEditorNoGroups));
						}
						parent.SetValue(component, value);
					}

					public override bool CanResetValue(object component)
					{
						return parent.CanResetValue(component);
					}
				}

				public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value, System.Attribute[] attributes)
				{
					PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = base.GetProperties(context, value, attributes);
					List<PropertyDescriptor> list = new List<PropertyDescriptor>(properties.Count);
					foreach (PropertyDescriptor item2 in properties)
					{
						string name = item2.Name;
						PropertyDescriptor item = ((name == "Name") ? new QueryNamePropertyDescriptor(item2, context) : ((!(name == "GroupFilterString")) ? item2 : new QueryGroupFilterStringPropertyDescriptor(item2)));
						list.Add(item);
					}
					return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(list.ToArray(), readOnly: true);
				}
			}

			private readonly int index;

			public QueryPropertyDescriptor(int index, System.Attribute[] attributes)
				: base(typeof(SqlQueryCollection), $"[{index}]", typeof(SqlQuery), attributes)
			{
				this.index = index;

			}
		}

		public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value, System.Attribute[] attributes)
		{

	public static class SqlQueryHelper
	{
		private class SelectStatementBuilderHelper
		{
			private readonly Dictionary<string, DBTable> dbTables;

			private readonly ISqlGeneratorFormatter sqlFormatter;

			public SelectStatementBuilderHelper(ISqlGeneratorFormatter sqlFormatter, DBSchema dbSchema)
			{
				Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)dbSchema, "dbSchema");
				this.sqlFormatter = sqlFormatter;
				dbTables = dbSchema.Tables.Union(dbSchema.Views).ToDictionary((DBTable t) => t.Name);
			}

			public string BuildSql(SelectQuery query)
			{
				if (sqlFormatter == null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException();
				}
				if (query.Tables.Count == 0)
				{
					return "select 1";
				}
				SelectStatement val = BuildSelectStatement(query, (IEnumerable<IParameter>)query.Parameters);
				return ((BaseSqlGeneratorWithParameters)new SelectSqlGeneratorWithAlias(sqlFormatter, query)).GenerateSql((BaseStatement)(object)val).Sql;
			}

			public SelectStatement BuildSelectStatement(SelectQuery query, IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters)
			{
				if (query.ValidatorCache == null)
				{
					query.BuildValidatorCache();
				}
				SelectStatement val = BuildSelectStatementCore(query);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(query.FilterString))
				{
					IsNullMultiValueParameterCriteriaOperatorPatcher isNullMultiValueParameterCriteriaOperatorPatcher = new IsNullMultiValueParameterCriteriaOperatorPatcher(parameters);
					((JoinNode)val).Condition = isNullMultiValueParameterCriteriaOperatorPatcher.Process(query.ValidatorCache.Filter);
				}
				if (query.Top > 0)
				{
					val.TopSelectedRecords = query.Top;
				}
				if (query.Skip > 0 && query.Sorting.Count != 0)
				{
					val.SkipSelectedRecords = query.Skip;
				}
				BuildSorting(query, val);
				BuildGrouping(query, val);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(query.GroupFilterString))
				{
					IsNullMultiValueParameterCriteriaOperatorPatcher isNullMultiValueParameterCriteriaOperatorPatcher2 = new IsNullMultiValueParameterCriteriaOperatorPatcher(parameters);
					val.GroupCondition = isNullMultiValueParameterCriteriaOperatorPatcher2.Process(query.ValidatorCache.GroupFilter);
				}
				return val;
			}

			private SelectStatement BuildSelectStatementCore(SelectQuery selectQuery)
			{
				if (!selectQuery.Tables.Any())
				{
					throw new NoTablesValidationException();
				}
				if (!selectQuery.Relations.Any())
				{
					if (selectQuery.Tables.Count == 1)
					{
						SelectStatement result = BuildSelectStatement(selectQuery, selectQuery.Tables[0], selectQuery.Columns, selectQuery.ValidatorCache.ColumnsParsed);
						PatchAllColumns(selectQuery, result, selectQuery.Tables[0]);
						return result;
					}
					throw new TablesNotRelatedValidationException(selectQuery.Tables.Select((Table t) => t.ActualName).ToArray());
				}
				if (selectQuery.ValidatorCache == null)
				{
					selectQuery.BuildValidatorCache();
				}
				SelectStatement val;
				using (IEnumerator<Table> enumerator = selectQuery.ValidatorCache.TablesInOrder.GetEnumerator())
				{
					enumerator.MoveNext();
					val = BuildSelectStatement(selectQuery, enumerator.Current, selectQuery.Columns, selectQuery.ValidatorCache.ColumnsParsed);
					while (enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						Table current = enumerator.Current;
						((List<JoinNode>)(object)((JoinNode)val).SubNodes).Add(BuildJoinNode(current, selectQuery.Relations.Where((Join r) => r.Nested == current)));
					}
				}
				PatchAllColumns(selectQuery, val, selectQuery.ValidatorCache.TablesInOrder.ToArray());
				return val;
			}

			private void PatchAllColumns(SelectQuery selectQuery, SelectStatement result, params Table[] tablesInOrder)
			{
				if (!selectQuery.Distinct || (selectQuery.Top == 0 && selectQuery.Skip == 0) || !NeedToPatchAllColumns())
				{
					return;
				}
				CriteriaOperator[] array = ((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)((BaseStatement)result).Operands).ToArray();
				((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)((BaseStatement)result).Operands).Clear();
				CriteriaOperator[] array2 = array;
				foreach (CriteriaOperator val in array2)
				{
					if (val is AllColumnsOperand allColumnsOperand && string.IsNullOrEmpty(allColumnsOperand.TableName))
					{
						foreach (Table table in tablesInOrder)
						{
							((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)((BaseStatement)result).Operands).Add((CriteriaOperator)(object)new AllColumnsOperand(table.ActualName));
						}
					}
					else
					{
						((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)((BaseStatement)result).Operands).Add(val);
					}
				}
			}

			private bool NeedToPatchAllColumns()
			{
				if (sqlFormatter is DataAccessTeradataConnectionProvider)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (sqlFormatter is DataAccessDB2ConnectionProvider)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}

						{

			}

		public static object GetDataSchema(StoredProcQuery query, SqlDataConnection connection, ConnectionOptions connectionOptions, IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)connection, "connection");
			if (!connection.IsConnected)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("The connection is not open.");
			}
			ISupportStoredProc supportStoredProc = connection.DataStore as ISupportStoredProc;
			IEnumerable<DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter> parameters = from a in ParametersEvaluator.EvaluateParameters(sourceParameters, query.Parameters)
				select new DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter(a);
			DBStoredProcedureResultSet val = supportStoredProc?.GetStoredProcedureTableSchema(query.StoredProcName, (IEnumerable<IParameter>)parameters, connectionOptions);
			if (val is StoredProcedureResultSet storedProcedureResultSet)
			{
				DBStoredProcedureResultSet[] resultSets = storedProcedureResultSet.ResultSets;
				if (resultSets != null && resultSets.Length != 0)
				{
					List<ResultTable> list = new List<ResultTable>();
					int num = 1;
					DBStoredProcedureResultSet[] resultSets2 = storedProcedureResultSet.ResultSets;
					foreach (DBStoredProcedureResultSet resultSet in resultSets2)
					{
						ResultTable resultTableFromResultSet = GetResultTableFromResultSet(query, resultSet);
						resultTableFromResultSet.TableName = $"Result{num++}";
						list.Add(resultTableFromResultSet);
					}
					return new SubResultSet(query.Name, list.ToArray());
				}
			}
			if (val == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GetResultTableFromResultSet(query, val);
		}

		private static ResultTable GetResultTableFromResultSet(StoredProcQuery query, DBStoredProcedureResultSet resultSet)
		{
			//IL_0055: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Dictionary<string, Type> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, Type>(resultSet.Columns.Count);
			int num = 0;
			foreach (DBNameTypePair column in resultSet.Columns)
			{
				string columnName = ResultTable.CleanColumnName(column.Name, num++);
				columnName = NameGenerator.GenerateUniqueName(columnName, dictionary.ContainsKey);
				dictionary.Add(columnName, DBColumn.GetType(column.Type));
			}
			return BuildResultTable(query.Name, dictionary);
		}

		public static object GetDataSchema(IEnumerable<SqlQuery> queries, DBSchema dbSchema, SqlDataConnection connection, ConnectionOptions connectionOptions, IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters, List<MasterDetailInfo> relations)
		{
			return GetDataSchema(queries, new ResultSchemaProvider(), dbSchema, connection, connectionOptions, sourceParameters, relations);
		}

		public static object GetDataSchema(IEnumerable<SqlQuery> queries, IResultSchemaProvider resultSchemaProvider, DBSchema dbSchema, SqlDataConnection connection, ConnectionOptions connectionOptions, IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters, List<MasterDetailInfo> relations)
		{
			ResultSet resultSet = new ResultSet();
			IParameter[] sourceParameters2 = (IParameter[])((sourceParameters != null) ? ((Array)((sourceParameters as IParameter[]) ?? sourceParameters.ToArray())) : ((Array)new IParameter[0]));
			foreach (SqlQuery query in queries)
			{
				if (query is SelectQuery selectQuery)
				{
					resultSet.Add(GetResultTable(query.Name, resultSchemaProvider.GetSelectQuerySchema(selectQuery, dbSchema, connection, connectionOptions, sourceParameters2)));
					continue;
				}
				if (query is StoredProcQuery storedProcedureQuery)
				{
					resultSet.Add(GetResultTable(query.Name, resultSchemaProvider.GetStoredProcedureSchema(storedProcedureQuery, connection, connectionOptions, sourceParameters2)));
					continue;
				}
				if (query is CustomSqlQuery customSqlQuery)
				{
					resultSet.Add(GetResultTable(query.Name, resultSchemaProvider.GetCustomSqlSchema(customSqlQuery, connection, connectionOptions, sourceParameters2)));
					continue;
				}
				throw new ArgumentException($"Unknown type of query {query.Name}", "queries");
			}
			resultSet.ApplyRelations(relations);
			return resultSet;
		}

		internal static ResultTable GetResultTable(string name, object schema)
		{
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (schema == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (schema is ResultTable result)
			{
				return result;
			}
			DataContextBase val = new DataContextBase();
			PropertyDescriptorCollection itemProperties = val[schema].GetItemProperties();
			ResultTable resultTable = new ResultTable(name);
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in itemProperties)
			{
				resultTable.AddColumn(item.Name, item.PropertyType);
			}
			return resultTable;
		}

		private static Dictionary<string, Type> GetSelectQueryColumns(SelectQuery selectQuery, DBSchema dbSchema, SqlDataConnection connection, ConnectionOptions connectionOptions, IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters)
		{
			Dictionary<string, DBTable> dbTables = dbSchema.Tables.Union(dbSchema.Views).ToDictionary((DBTable t) => t.Name);
			IAggregationResultTypeProvider aggregationResultTypeProvider = connection?.DataStore as IAggregationResultTypeProvider;
			ISupportDefaultSchema supportDefaultSchema = connection?.DataStore as ISupportDefaultSchema;
			List<ColumnDescription> list = new SelectQueryActualColumnInfosHelper(aggregationResultTypeProvider, supportDefaultSchema, selectQuery, dbTables, suppressException: true).GetActualQueryColumns().ToList();
			if (list.Any((ColumnDescription c) => c.Type == null) && connection != null)
			{
				IColumnarDataLoader columnarDataLoader = ColumnarDataLoaderFactory.GetColumnarDataLoader(connection.DataStore);
				if (columnarDataLoader != null)
				{
					try
					{
						IList<IParameter> list2 = ParametersEvaluator.EvaluateParameters(sourceParameters, selectQuery.Parameters).ToList();
						SelectStatement val = BuildSelectStatement(selectQuery, dbSchema, connection.SqlGeneratorFormatter, list2);
						string[] columns = new SelectQueryActualColumnNamesHelper(selectQuery, dbTables, suppressException: true).GetActualQueryColumns().ToArray();
						Query query = ((BaseSqlGeneratorWithParameters)new SelectSqlGeneratorWithAlias(connection.SqlGeneratorFormatter, selectQuery, list2)).GenerateSql((BaseStatement)(object)val);
						return (from c in columnarDataLoader.SelectSchema(query, columns, connectionOptions)
							where !string.IsNullOrEmpty(c.Name)
							select c).ToDictionary((ColumnDescription c) => c.Name, (ColumnDescription c) => c.Type);
					}
					catch (SqlExecutionException)
					{
					}
				}
			}
			for (int num = 0; num < list.Count; num++)
			{
				ColumnDescription columnDescription = list[num];
				if (columnDescription.Type == null)
				{
					columnDescription.Type = typeof(object);
				}
			}
			return list.ToDictionary((ColumnDescription c) => c.Name, (ColumnDescription c) => c.Type);
		}

		private static ResultTable BuildResultTable(string queryName, Dictionary<string, Type> columns)
		{
			ResultTable resultTable = new ResultTable(queryName);
			int num = 0;
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, Type> column in columns)
			{
				string name = ResultTable.CleanColumnName(column.Key, num++);
				resultTable.AddColumn(name, column.Value);
			}
			return resultTable;
		}

		public static object LoadPreviewData(PreviewContext context)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)context, "context");
			SqlQuery query = context.Query;
			if (query == null || !Validate(query, context.Connection.ConnectionParameters, context.Validator, context.ValidationExceptionHandler, null))
			{
				return null;
			}
			SqlDataConnection connection = context.Connection;
			if (!ConnectionHelper.OpenConnection(connection, context.ConnectionExceptionHandler, context.WaitFormActivator, context.ConnectionParametersService))
			{
				return null;
			}
			UIDataLoader uIDataLoader = new UIDataLoader(context.WaitFormActivator, context.LoaderExceptionHandler);
			SelectQuery selectQuery = ((query is TableQuery tableQuery) ? QueryConversionHelper.TableQueryToSelectQuery(tableQuery) : (query as SelectQuery));
			DBSchema dbSchema = null;
			if (selectQuery != null)
			{
				string[] dbItemsList = selectQuery.Tables.Select((Table t) => t.Name).ToArray();
				dbSchema = uIDataLoader.LoadSchema(context.DBSchemaProviderEx, connection, dbItemsList);
			}
			return uIDataLoader.LoadData(connection, dbSchema, context.SourceParameters, query, topThousand: true)?.ToResult(string.Empty);
		}

		public static bool Validate(SqlQuery query, DataConnectionParametersBase connectionParameter, ICustomQueryValidator queryValidator, IExceptionHandler exceptionHandler, DBSchema schema)
		{
			if (query is CustomSqlQuery || schema != null)
			{
				try
				{
					query.Validate(queryValidator, connectionParameter, schema);
					return true;
				}
				catch (DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.ValidationException ex)
				{
					exceptionHandler.HandleException((Exception)ex);
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static string Validate(SqlQuery query, DBSchema schema, SqlProviderLimitations limitations, ICustomQueryValidator customQueryValidator, DataConnectionParametersBase dataConnectionParametersBase, bool isSqlDataStore)
		{
			return Validate(query, schema, limitations, customQueryValidator, dataConnectionParametersBase, isSqlDataStore, (string m) => m);
		}

		internal static string Validate(SqlQuery query, DBSchema schema, SqlProviderLimitations limitations, ICustomQueryValidator customQueryValidator, DataConnectionParametersBase dataConnectionParametersBase, bool isSqlDataStore, Func<string, string> processExceptionMessage)
		{
			try
			{
				query.Validate(customQueryValidator, dataConnectionParametersBase, schema);
			}
			catch (DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.ValidationException ex)
			{
				if (ex is NoTablesValidationException)
				{
					return DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.QueryBuilderNoTablesSelected);
				}
				if (ex is NoColumnsValidationException)
				{
					return DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.QueryBuilderNothingSelected);
				}
				if (ex is FilterByColumnOfMissingTableValidationException || ex is FilterByMissingInSchemaColumnValidationException)
				{
					return ex.Message + Environment.NewLine + DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.QueryBuilderInvalidFilter);
				}
				return processExceptionMessage(ex.Message);
			}
			if (!(query is SelectQuery selectQuery))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (limitations.HasFlag(SqlProviderLimitations.NoParametersInSelect) && (from expression in (from c in selectQuery.Columns.OfType<Column>()
					select c.Expression).OfType<CustomExpression>()
				select FilterHelper.GetCriteriaOperator(expression.Expression, (IEnumerable<IParameter>)(object)new IParameter[0])).Any(ParametersSeeker.CheckForParameters))
			{
				return DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.QueryBuilder.QueryBuilderViewModel.GetErrorMessage(SqlProviderLimitations.NoParametersInSelect);
			}
			if (isSqlDataStore)
			{
				return null;
			}
			try
			{
				QueryExecutor.EnsureXmlSupported(selectQuery);
			}
			catch (NotSupportedException ex2)
			{
				return ex2.Message;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static CriteriaOperator CreateSubQueryContainer(CriteriaOperator innerOperator, AggregationType aggregate)
		{
			switch (aggregate)
			{
			case AggregationType.Count:
			case AggregationType.Max:
			case AggregationType.Min:
			case AggregationType.Avg:
			case AggregationType.Sum:
				return CreateSubQueryContainer(innerOperator, (Aggregate)aggregate, distinct: false);
			case AggregationType.CountDistinct:
				return CreateSubQueryContainer(innerOperator, (Aggregate)1, distinct: true);
			case AggregationType.AvgDistinct:
				return CreateSubQueryContainer(innerOperator, (Aggregate)4, distinct: true);
			case AggregationType.SumDistinct:
				return CreateSubQueryContainer(innerOperator, (Aggregate)5, distinct: true);
			case AggregationType.None:
				return innerOperator;
			default:
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("aggregate", aggregate, null);
			}
		}

		internal static Aggregate ConvertToAggregate(AggregationType aggregate)
		{
			switch (aggregate)
			{
			case AggregationType.Count:
			case AggregationType.Max:
			case AggregationType.Min:
			case AggregationType.Avg:
			case AggregationType.Sum:
				return (Aggregate)aggregate;
			case AggregationType.CountDistinct:
				return (Aggregate)1;
			case AggregationType.AvgDistinct:
				return (Aggregate)4;
			case AggregationType.SumDistinct:
				return (Aggregate)5;
			default:
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("aggregate", aggregate, null);
			}
		}

		internal static bool ResolveDependencies(IEnumerable<Table> nodes, IEnumerable<Join> joins, out IEnumerable<Table> dependencies)
		{
			Dictionary<Table, List<Table>> dictionary = nodes.ToDictionary((Table t) => t, (Table t) => (from r in joins
				where r.Nested == t
				select r.Parent).ToList());
			List<Table> list = (List<Table>)(dependencies = new List<Table>());
			while (dictionary.Count > 0)
			{
				Table key = dictionary.FirstOrDefault((KeyValuePair<Table, List<Table>> pair) => pair.Value.Count == 0).Key;
				if (key == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				dictionary.Remove(key);
				foreach (List<Table> value in dictionary.Values)
				{
					while (value.Remove(key))
					{
					}
				}
				list.Add(key);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static CriteriaOperator CreateSubQueryContainer(CriteriaOperator innerOperator, Aggregate aggregate, bool distinct)
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0015: Expected O, but got Unknown
			CriteriaOperator val = innerOperator;
			if (distinct)
			{
				val = (CriteriaOperator)(object)new DistinctCriteriaOperand(val);
			}
			return (CriteriaOperator)new QuerySubQueryContainer((BaseStatement)null, val, aggregate);
		}
	}

	{
		public DBStoredProcedureResultSet[] ResultSets { get; set; }

		public override string ToString()
		{
			int? num = ResultSets?.Length;
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				if (num.Value != 1)
				{
					return $"{num.Value} result sets";
				}
				return "1 result set";
			}
			return ((DBStoredProcedureResultSet)this).ToString();
		}
	}

		protected override void NextTokenComments()
		{
		}

		protected override void NextTokenScan(int state)
		{
			AddCh();
			switch (state)
			{
			case -1:
				t.Type = 0;
				break;
			case 0:
				t.Type = 205;
				break;
			case 1:
				if ((ch >= 'A' && ch <= 'Z') || ch == '_' || (ch >= 'a' && ch <= 'z') || ch == 'ª' || ch == 'µ' || ch == 'º' || (ch >= 'À' && ch <= 'Ö') || (ch >= 'Ø' && ch <= 'ö') || (ch >= 'ø' && ch <= 'ÿ') || ch == 'Ă' || IsUnicodeLetter(ch))
				{
					AddCh();
					goto case 2;
				}
				if (ch != '\\')
				{
					goto case 0;
				}
				AddCh();
				goto case 16;
			case 2:
				while ((ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') || (ch >= 'A' && ch <= 'Z') || ch == '_' || (ch >= 'a' && ch <= 'z') || ch == 'ª' || ch == 'µ' || ch == 'º' || (ch >= 'À' && ch <= 'Ö') || (ch >= 'Ø' && ch <= 'ö') || (ch >= 'ø' && ch <= 'ÿ') || ch == 'Ă' || IsUnicodeLetter(ch))
				{
					AddCh();
				}
				if (ch == '\\')
				{
					AddCh();
					goto case 3;
				}
				t.Type = 1;
				t.Value = new string(tval, 0, tlen);
				CheckLiteral();
				break;
			case 3:
				if (ch == 'u')
				{
					AddCh();
					goto case 4;
				}
				if (ch != 'U')
				{
					goto case 0;
				}
				AddCh();
				goto case 8;
			case 4:
				if ((ch < '0' || ch > '9') && (ch < 'A' || ch > 'F') && (ch < 'a' || ch > 'f'))
				{
					goto case 0;
				}
				AddCh();
				goto case 5;
			case 5:
				if ((ch < '0' || ch > '9') && (ch < 'A' || ch > 'F') && (ch < 'a' || ch > 'f'))
				{
					goto case 0;
				}
				AddCh();
				goto case 6;
			case 6:
				if ((ch < '0' || ch > '9') && (ch < 'A' || ch > 'F') && (ch < 'a' || ch > 'f'))
				{
					goto case 0;
				}
				AddCh();
				goto case 7;
			case 7:
				if ((ch < '0' || ch > '9') && (ch < 'A' || ch > 'F') && (ch < 'a' || ch > 'f'))
				{
					goto case 0;
				}
				AddCh();
				goto case 2;
			case 8:
				if ((ch < '0' || ch > '9') && (ch < 'A' || ch > 'F') && (ch < 'a' || ch > 'f'))
				{
					goto case 0;
				}
				AddCh();
