namespace DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.MasterDetail
{
	public static class MasterDetailEditorHelper
	{
		private struct ColumnNameDescription
		{
			public string DBTableName { get; set; }

			public string DBColumnName { get; set; }

			public string ActualColumnName { get; set; }

			public string ActualTableName { get; set; }
		}

		private class SelectQueryColumnActualNamesHelper : SelectQueryActualColumnsHelper<ColumnNameDescription>
		{
			protected override bool SuppressTableNotInSchemaValidationException => true;

			public SelectQueryColumnActualNamesHelper(IAggregationResultTypeProvider aggregationResultTypeProvider, ISupportDefaultSchema supportDefaultSchema, SelectQuery query, Dictionary<string, DBTable> dbTables)
				: base(aggregationResultTypeProvider, supportDefaultSchema, query, dbTables)
			{
			}

			protected override ColumnNameDescription GetResult(Table table, DBColumn dbColumn)
			{
				return new ColumnNameDescription
				{
					DBTableName = table.Name,
					DBColumnName = dbColumn.Name,
					ActualTableName = table.Name,
					ActualColumnName = dbColumn.Name
				};
			}

			protected override ColumnNameDescription GetResult(AliasedBase aliased)
			{
				if (!(((aliased is Column column) ? column.Expression : null) is ColumnExpression { Table: not null } columnExpression) || !base.DBTables.ContainsKey(columnExpression.Table.Name))
				{
					return default(ColumnNameDescription);
				}
				DBTable val = base.DBTables[columnExpression.Table.Name];
				DBColumn columnSafe = val.GetColumnSafe(columnExpression.ColumnName);
				return new ColumnNameDescription
				{
					DBTableName = val.Name,
					DBColumnName = columnSafe.Name,
					ActualColumnName = (aliased.ActualName ?? SelectQueryActualColumnsHelper<ColumnNameDescription>.GetUniqueName(columnExpression.Table.ActualName, columnSafe.Name, base.Existing)),
					ActualTableName = columnExpression.Table.ActualName
				};
			}
		}

		public static IEnumerable<MasterDetailInfo> GetRelationsBetweenQueries(SqlDataSource dataSource, string masterQueryName, string detailQueryName)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)dataSource, "dataSource");
			Dictionary<string, DBTable> dbTables = dataSource.DBSchema.Tables.Union(dataSource.DBSchema.Views).ToDictionary((DBTable t) => t.Name);
			if (dataSource.DBSchema != null)
			{
				SelectQuery query = GetQuery(dataSource.Queries, masterQueryName);
				SelectQuery query2 = GetQuery(dataSource.Queries, detailQueryName);
				if (query != null && query2 != null)
				{
					return GetRelationsBetweenQueries(dbTables, query, query2);
				}
			}
			return Enumerable.Empty<MasterDetailInfo>();
		}

		public static IEnumerable<MasterDetailInfo> GetRelationsBetweenAllQueries(IEnumerable<SqlQuery> queries, DBSchema dbSchema)
		{
			if (dbSchema == null)
			{
				return Enumerable.Empty<MasterDetailInfo>();
			}
			List<MasterDetailInfo> list = new List<MasterDetailInfo>();
			IEnumerable<DBTable> tables = dbSchema.Tables;
			IEnumerable<DBTable> first = tables ?? Enumerable.Empty<DBTable>();
			tables = dbSchema.Views;
			Dictionary<string, DBTable> dbTables = first.Union(tables ?? Enumerable.Empty<DBTable>()).ToDictionary((DBTable t) => t.Name);
			SelectQuery[] array = queries.OfType<SelectQuery>().ToArray();
			SelectQuery[] array2 = array;
			foreach (SelectQuery selectQuery in array2)
			{
				SelectQuery[] array3 = array;
				foreach (SelectQuery selectQuery2 in array3)
				{
					if (selectQuery != selectQuery2 && selectQuery != null && selectQuery2 != null)
					{
						list.AddRange(GetRelationsBetweenQueries(dbTables, selectQuery, selectQuery2));
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public static void ValidateRelations(FieldListDescriptor dataSchema, IEnumerable<MasterDetailInfo> relations)
		{
			ValidateRelations(dataSchema, relations, checkTypes: true);
		}

		public static void ValidateRelations(FieldListDescriptor dataSchema, IEnumerable<MasterDetailInfo> relations, bool checkTypes)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)dataSchema, "dataSchema");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)relations, "relations");
			foreach (MasterDetailInfo relation in relations)
			{
				ViewDescriptor viewDescriptor = dataSchema.FirstOrDefault((ViewDescriptor t) => t.Name == relation.MasterQueryName);
				if (viewDescriptor == null)
				{
					throw new InvalidConditionException(relation.MasterQueryName);
				}
				ViewDescriptor viewDescriptor2 = dataSchema.FirstOrDefault((ViewDescriptor t) => t.Name == relation.DetailQueryName);
				if (viewDescriptor2 == null)
				{
					throw new InvalidConditionException(relation.DetailQueryName);
				}
				foreach (RelationColumnInfo relationColumn in relation.KeyColumns)
				{
					FieldDescriptor fieldDescriptor = viewDescriptor.FirstOrDefault((FieldDescriptor c) => c.Name == relationColumn.ParentKeyColumn);
					if (fieldDescriptor == null)
					{
						throw new InvalidConditionException(relation.MasterQueryName, relationColumn.ParentKeyColumn);
					}
					FieldDescriptor fieldDescriptor2 = viewDescriptor2.FirstOrDefault((FieldDescriptor c) => c.Name == relationColumn.NestedKeyColumn);
					if (fieldDescriptor2 == null)
					{
						throw new InvalidConditionException(relation.DetailQueryName, relationColumn.NestedKeyColumn);
					}
					if (checkTypes && fieldDescriptor.FieldType != fieldDescriptor2.FieldType)
					{
						throw new RelationException(relation.MasterQueryName, relationColumn.ParentKeyColumn, fieldDescriptor.FieldType, relation.DetailQueryName, relationColumn.NestedKeyColumn, fieldDescriptor2.FieldType);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private static IEnumerable<MasterDetailInfo> GetRelationsBetweenQueries(Dictionary<string, DBTable> dbTables, SelectQuery masterQuery, SelectQuery detailQuery)
		{
			List<MasterDetailInfo> list = new List<MasterDetailInfo>();
			List<ColumnNameDescription> actualColumns = new SelectQueryColumnActualNamesHelper(null, null, masterQuery, dbTables).GetActualQueryColumns().ToList();
			List<ColumnNameDescription> actualColumns2 = new SelectQueryColumnActualNamesHelper(null, null, detailQuery, dbTables).GetActualQueryColumns().ToList();
			foreach (Table table2 in detailQuery.Tables)
			{
				dbTables.TryGetValue(table2.Name, out var value);
				if (value == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (DBForeignKey foreignKey in value.ForeignKeys)
				{
					string[] array = GetKeyColumns(actualColumns2, ((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)foreignKey).Columns, table2).ToArray();
					if (array.Length != ((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)foreignKey).Columns.Count)
					{
						break;
					}
					Table table = masterQuery.Tables.FirstOrDefault((Table t) => t.Name == foreignKey.PrimaryKeyTable);
					if (table != null)
					{
						string[] array2 = GetKeyColumns(actualColumns, foreignKey.PrimaryKeyTableKeyColumns, table).ToArray();
						if (array2.Length != foreignKey.PrimaryKeyTableKeyColumns.Count)
						{
							break;
						}
						MasterDetailInfo masterDetailInfo = new MasterDetailInfo(masterQuery.Name, detailQuery.Name);
						for (int num = 0; num < ((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)foreignKey).Columns.Count; num++)
						{
							RelationColumnInfo item = new RelationColumnInfo
							{
								ParentKeyColumn = array2[num],
								NestedKeyColumn = array[num]
							};
							masterDetailInfo.KeyColumns.Add(item);
						}
						masterDetailInfo.Name = ((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)foreignKey).Name;
						list.Add(masterDetailInfo);
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static IEnumerable<string> GetKeyColumns(IList<ColumnNameDescription> actualColumns, StringCollection columns, Table table)
		{
			StringEnumerator enumerator = columns.GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					string column = enumerator.Current;
					ColumnNameDescription columnNameDescription = actualColumns.FirstOrDefault((ColumnNameDescription c) => c.DBTableName == table.Name && c.ActualTableName == table.ActualName && c.DBColumnName == column);
					if (columnNameDescription.ActualColumnName != null)
					{
						yield return columnNameDescription.ActualColumnName;
						continue;
					}
					yield break;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (enumerator is IDisposable disposable)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		private static SelectQuery GetQuery(IEnumerable<SqlQuery> collection, string name)
		{
			SqlQuery sqlQuery = collection.Single((SqlQuery q) => q.Name == name);
			if (sqlQuery is SelectQuery result)
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (sqlQuery is TableQuery tableQuery)
			{
				return QueryConversionHelper.TableQueryToSelectQuery(tableQuery);
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class InvalidConditionException : Exception
	{
		public string ColumnName { get; private set; }

		public string QueryName { get; private set; }

		public InvalidConditionException(string queryName)
			: base(string.Format(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.MessageNonexistentQuery), queryName))
		{
			QueryName = queryName;
		}

		public InvalidConditionException(string queryName, string columnName)
			: base(string.Format(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.MessageNonexistentColumn), queryName, columnName))
		{
			QueryName = queryName;
			ColumnName = columnName;
		}
	}
	public interface IMasterDetailView
	{
		event EventHandler Ok;

		void Initialize(MasterDetailPresenter presenter);

		void RefreshData();

		void ShowError(IEnumerable<Error> errors);

		bool ShowWarning(Warning error);
	}
	public class EditEventArgs : EventArgs
	{
		public string Name { get; set; }

		public EditEventArgs(string name)
		{
			Name = name;
		}
	}
	public interface IMasterDetailRunner
	{
		bool Run(MasterDetailModel model, MasterDetailRunnerContext context);
	}
	public class MasterDetailRunnerContext
	{
		public IEnumerable<SqlQuery> Queries { get; set; }

		public DBSchema DBSchema { get; set; }

		public FieldListDescriptor DataSchema { get; set; }

		public MasterDetailRunnerContext()
		{
		}

		public MasterDetailRunnerContext(SqlDataSource dataSource)
		{
			Queries = dataSource.Queries;
			DBSchema = dataSource.DBSchema;
			DataSchema = dataSource.ResultSchema;
		}

		public MasterDetailRunnerContext(FederationDataSource dataSource)
		{
			DataSchema = dataSource.ResultSchema;
			DBSchema = new DBSchema();
			Queries = dataSource.Queries.Select((QueryNode q) => new SelectQuery(q.ActualName)
			{
				Meta = q.Meta?.Clone()
			}).ToList();
		}
	}
	public sealed class MasterDetailModel : List<MasterDetailInfo>, ICloneable
	{
		public MasterDetailModel()
		{
		}

		public MasterDetailModel(MasterDetailModel other)
			: base(other.Select((MasterDetailInfo m) => new MasterDetailInfo(m)))
		{
		}

		public MasterDetailModel(IEnumerable<MasterDetailInfo> relations)
		{
			AddRange(relations.Select((MasterDetailInfo m) => new MasterDetailInfo(m)).ToArray());
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			return new MasterDetailModel(this);
		}
	}
	public class MasterDetailPresenter
	{
		private readonly MasterDetailModel model;

		private readonly FieldListDescriptor resultSchema;

		private readonly IEnumerable<MasterDetailInfo> foreignKeys;

		private readonly Dictionary<string, List<string>> objectNames;

		private readonly Dictionary<string, SqlQuery> queries;

		private readonly DBSchema dbSchema;

		private readonly Func<LegacyEditorSettings, IMasterDetailRunner> createSubRunnerFunc;

		public IEnumerable<MasterDetailInfo> Relations => model;

		public IEnumerable<MasterDetailInfo> ValidRelations => model.Where((MasterDetailInfo r) => ValidateRelation(r).Code == ErrorCode.None);

		public IEnumerable<MasterDetailInfo> InvalidRelations => model.Where((MasterDetailInfo r) => ValidateRelation(r).Code != ErrorCode.None);

		public Dictionary<string, List<string>> ObjectNames => objectNames;

		public Dictionary<string, SqlQuery> Queries => queries;

		public event EventHandler DataChanged;

		public MasterDetailPresenter(MasterDetailModel model, MasterDetailRunnerContext context, Func<LegacyEditorSettings, IMasterDetailRunner> createSubRunnerFunc)
		{
			this.model = model;
			resultSchema = context.DataSchema;
			objectNames = resultSchema.ToDictionary((ViewDescriptor vd) => vd.Name, (ViewDescriptor vd) => vd.Select((FieldDescriptor fd) => fd.Name).ToList());
			foreach (FieldListDescriptor complexResult in resultSchema.ComplexResults)
			{
				foreach (ViewDescriptor item in complexResult)
				{
					objectNames.Add(complexResult.Name + "." + item.Name, item.Select((FieldDescriptor fd) => fd.Name).ToList());
				}
			}
			queries = context.Queries.Select((SqlQuery q) => q.Clone()).ToDictionary((SqlQuery q) => q.Name);
			dbSchema = context.DBSchema;
			this.createSubRunnerFunc = createSubRunnerFunc;
			foreignKeys = MasterDetailEditorHelper.GetRelationsBetweenAllQueries(context.Queries, dbSchema);
		}

		public void AddCondition(string masterQuery, string masterColumn, string detailQuery, string detailColumn, Func<Warning, bool> showWarning)
		{
			Warning arg = CheckForWarningsRelation(new MasterDetailInfo(masterQuery, detailQuery, masterColumn, detailColumn));
			if (arg.Code == WarningCode.None || showWarning(arg))
			{
				AddCondition(null, masterQuery, masterColumn, detailQuery, detailColumn);
			}
		}

		public void AddCondition(string relationName, string masterQuery, string masterColumn, string detailQuery, string detailColumn)
		{
			MasterDetailInfo masterDetailInfo = model.FirstOrDefault((MasterDetailInfo r) => (r.Name == relationName || relationName == null) && r.MasterQueryName == masterQuery && r.DetailQueryName == detailQuery);
			if (masterDetailInfo == null)
			{
				masterDetailInfo = new MasterDetailInfo(masterQuery, detailQuery);
				model.Add(masterDetailInfo);
			}
			masterDetailInfo.KeyColumns.Add(new RelationColumnInfo(masterColumn, detailColumn));
			RaiseDataChanged();
		}

		public void RemoveCondition(string relationName, string masterQuery, string masterColumn, string detailQuery, string detailColumn)
		{
			RemoveCondition(relationName, masterQuery, masterColumn, detailQuery, detailColumn, removeEmptyRelation: true);
		}

		public void RemoveCondition(string relationName, string masterQuery, string masterColumn, string detailQuery, string detailColumn, bool removeEmptyRelation)
		{
			MasterDetailInfo masterDetailInfo = model.FirstOrDefault((MasterDetailInfo r) => r.Name == relationName && r.MasterQueryName == masterQuery && r.DetailQueryName == detailQuery);
			if (masterDetailInfo != null)
			{
				RelationColumnInfo item = masterDetailInfo.KeyColumns.FirstOrDefault((RelationColumnInfo r) => r.ParentKeyColumn == masterColumn && r.NestedKeyColumn == detailColumn);
				masterDetailInfo.KeyColumns.Remove(item);
				if (removeEmptyRelation && masterDetailInfo.KeyColumns.Count == 0)
				{
					model.Remove(masterDetailInfo);
				}
				RaiseDataChanged();
			}
		}

		public void UpdateCondition(string relationName, MasterDetailInfo relation, RelationColumnInfo condition, string newMasterQuery, string newMasterColumn, string newDetailQuery, string newDetailColumn)
		{
			UpdateCondition(relationName, relation, condition, newMasterQuery, newMasterColumn, newDetailQuery, newDetailColumn, removeEmptyRelation: false);
		}

		public void UpdateCondition(string relationName, MasterDetailInfo relation, RelationColumnInfo condition, string newMasterQuery, string newMasterColumn, string newDetailQuery, string newDetailColumn, bool removeEmptyRelation)
		{
			int index = relation.KeyColumns.IndexOf(condition);
			relation.KeyColumns.Remove(condition);
			MasterDetailInfo masterDetailInfo = model.FirstOrDefault((MasterDetailInfo r) => (r.Name == relationName || relationName == null) && r.MasterQueryName == newMasterQuery && r.DetailQueryName == newDetailQuery);
			if (masterDetailInfo == null)
			{
				masterDetailInfo = new MasterDetailInfo(newMasterQuery, newDetailQuery);
				model.Add(masterDetailInfo);
			}
			if (relation == masterDetailInfo)
			{
				masterDetailInfo.KeyColumns.Insert(index, new RelationColumnInfo(newMasterColumn, newDetailColumn));
			}
			else
			{
				masterDetailInfo.KeyColumns.Add(new RelationColumnInfo(newMasterColumn, newDetailColumn));
			}
			if (removeEmptyRelation && relation.KeyColumns.Count == 0)
			{
				model.Remove(relation);
			}
			RaiseDataChanged();
		}

		public void RemoveRelation(string relationName)
		{
			MasterDetailInfo relation = model.FirstOrDefault((MasterDetailInfo r) => r.Name == relationName);
			RemoveRelation(relation);
		}

		public void RemoveRelation(MasterDetailInfo relation)
		{
			if (relation != null)
			{
				model.Remove(relation);
				RaiseDataChanged();
			}
		}

		public bool RenameRelation(string oldName, string newName)
		{
			if (oldName == newName)
			{
				return true;
			}
			MasterDetailInfo masterDetailInfo = model.FirstOrDefault((MasterDetailInfo r) => r.Name == oldName);
			if (masterDetailInfo == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (model.Any((MasterDetailInfo r) => r.Name == newName))
			{
				return false;
			}
			masterDetailInfo.Name = newName;
			RaiseDataChanged();
			return true;
		}

		public bool CheckRelationsBetweenQueries(string masterQueryName, string detailQueryName)
		{
			return foreignKeys.Any((MasterDetailInfo f) => f.MasterQueryName == masterQueryName && f.DetailQueryName == detailQueryName);
		}

		public void AddRelationsBetweenQueries(string masterQueryName, string detailQueryName)
		{
			List<MasterDetailInfo> list = (from r in foreignKeys
				where r.MasterQueryName == masterQueryName && r.DetailQueryName == detailQueryName
				select new MasterDetailInfo(r)).ToList();
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				list.Add(new MasterDetailInfo(masterQueryName, detailQueryName, new RelationColumnInfo()));
			}
			foreach (MasterDetailInfo item in list)
			{
				string name = item.Name;
				if (model.Any((MasterDetailInfo r) => r.Name == name))
				{
					PrefixNameGenerator prefixNameGenerator = new PrefixNameGenerator(name, "_", 1);
					name = prefixNameGenerator.GenerateName((string n) => model.Any((MasterDetailInfo r) => r.Name == n));
				}
				item.Name = name;
				model.Add(item);
			}
			RaiseDataChanged();
		}

		public IEnumerable<Error> Validate()
		{
			return from relation in Relations
				select ValidateRelation(relation) into relationError
				where relationError.Code != ErrorCode.None
				select relationError;
		}

		public IEnumerable<Warning> CheckForWarnings()
		{
			return from relation in Relations
				select CheckForWarningsRelation(relation) into relationWarning
				where relationWarning.Code != WarningCode.None
				select relationWarning;
		}

		public void EditRelation(string name)
		{
			Edit(new LegacyEditorSettings
			{
				Mode = LegacyEditorMode.Relation,
				Name = name
			}, (MasterDetailInfo r) => r.Name == name);
		}

		public void EditQuery(string name)
		{
			Edit(new LegacyEditorSettings
			{
				Mode = LegacyEditorMode.Query,
				Name = name
			}, (MasterDetailInfo r) => r.MasterQueryName == name || r.DetailQueryName == name);
		}

		public void EditInvalidRelations()
		{
			Edit(new LegacyEditorSettings
			{
				Mode = LegacyEditorMode.InvalidRelations
			}, (MasterDetailInfo r) => ValidateRelation(r).Code != ErrorCode.None);
		}

		private void Edit(LegacyEditorSettings settings, Func<MasterDetailInfo, bool> predicate)
		{
			IMasterDetailRunner masterDetailRunner = createSubRunnerFunc(settings);
			List<MasterDetailInfo> source = model.Where(predicate).ToList();
			MasterDetailModel source2 = new MasterDetailModel(source.Select((MasterDetailInfo r) => new MasterDetailInfo(r)));
			MasterDetailRunnerContext context = new MasterDetailRunnerContext
			{
				Queries = Queries.Values,
				DBSchema = dbSchema,
				DataSchema = resultSchema
			};
			if (masterDetailRunner.Run(source2, context))
			{
				model.RemoveAll(predicate.Invoke);
				model.AddRange(source2.Where((MasterDetailInfo r) => r.KeyColumns.Count > 0));
				RaiseDataChanged();
			}
		}

		public Error ValidateRelation(MasterDetailInfo relation)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(relation.MasterQueryName) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(relation.DetailQueryName))
			{
				return new Error
				{
					Code = ErrorCode.IncompleteCondition
				};
			}
			foreach (RelationColumnInfo keyColumn in relation.KeyColumns)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(keyColumn.ParentKeyColumn) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(keyColumn.NestedKeyColumn))
				{
					return new Error
					{
						Code = ErrorCode.IncompleteCondition
					};
				}
			}
			ViewDescriptor viewDescriptor = FindViewDescriptor(relation.MasterQueryName);
			if (viewDescriptor == null)
			{
				return new Error
				{
					Code = ErrorCode.InvalidRelation,
					QueryName = relation.MasterQueryName
				};
			}
			ViewDescriptor viewDescriptor2 = FindViewDescriptor(relation.DetailQueryName);
			if (viewDescriptor2 == null)
			{
				return new Error
				{
					Code = ErrorCode.InvalidRelation,
					QueryName = relation.DetailQueryName
				};
			}
			foreach (RelationColumnInfo relationColumn in relation.KeyColumns)
			{
				if (viewDescriptor.All((FieldDescriptor fd) => fd.Name != relationColumn.ParentKeyColumn))
				{
					return new Error
					{
						Code = ErrorCode.InvalidRelation,
						QueryName = relation.MasterQueryName,
						ColumnName = relationColumn.ParentKeyColumn
					};
				}
				if (viewDescriptor2.All((FieldDescriptor fd) => fd.Name != relationColumn.NestedKeyColumn))
				{
					return new Error
					{
						Code = ErrorCode.InvalidRelation,
						QueryName = relation.DetailQueryName,
						ColumnName = relationColumn.NestedKeyColumn
					};
				}
			}
			return Error.None;
		}

		public Warning CheckForWarningsRelation(MasterDetailInfo relation)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(relation.MasterQueryName) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(relation.DetailQueryName))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			foreach (RelationColumnInfo keyColumn in relation.KeyColumns)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(keyColumn.ParentKeyColumn) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(keyColumn.NestedKeyColumn))
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException();
				}
			}
			ViewDescriptor viewDescriptor = FindViewDescriptor(relation.MasterQueryName);
			if (viewDescriptor == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			ViewDescriptor viewDescriptor2 = FindViewDescriptor(relation.DetailQueryName);
			if (viewDescriptor2 == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			foreach (RelationColumnInfo relationColumn in relation.KeyColumns)
			{
				FieldDescriptor fieldDescriptor = viewDescriptor.FirstOrDefault((FieldDescriptor fd) => fd.Name == relationColumn.ParentKeyColumn);
				if (fieldDescriptor == null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException();
				}
				FieldDescriptor fieldDescriptor2 = viewDescriptor2.FirstOrDefault((FieldDescriptor fd) => fd.Name == relationColumn.NestedKeyColumn);
				if (fieldDescriptor2 == null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException();
				}
				if (fieldDescriptor.FieldType != fieldDescriptor2.FieldType)
				{
					return new Warning
					{
						Code = WarningCode.DifferentTypes,
						MasterQueryName = relation.MasterQueryName,
						MasterColumnName = relationColumn.ParentKeyColumn,
						MasterColumnType = fieldDescriptor.FieldType,
						DetailQueryName = relation.DetailQueryName,
						DetailColumnName = relationColumn.NestedKeyColumn,
						DetailColumnType = fieldDescriptor2.FieldType
					};
				}
			}
			return Warning.None;
		}

		private ViewDescriptor FindViewDescriptor(string name)
		{
			return resultSchema.FirstOrDefault((ViewDescriptor vd) => vd.Name == name) ?? resultSchema.ComplexResults.SelectMany((FieldListDescriptor c) => c, (FieldListDescriptor fd, ViewDescriptor vd) => new KeyValuePair<string, ViewDescriptor>(fd.Name + "." + vd.Name, vd)).FirstOrDefault((KeyValuePair<string, ViewDescriptor> vd) => vd.Key == name).Value;
		}

		private void RaiseDataChanged()
		{
			if (this.DataChanged != null)
			{
				this.DataChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}
	}
	public enum ErrorCode
	{
		None,
		IncompleteCondition,
		InvalidRelation
	}
	public struct Error
	{
		public static readonly Error None = new Error
		{
			Code = ErrorCode.None
		};

		public ErrorCode Code { get; set; }

		public string QueryName { get; set; }

		public string ColumnName { get; set; }
	}
	public enum WarningCode
	{
		None,
		DifferentTypes
	}
	public struct Warning
	{
		public static readonly Warning None = new Warning
		{
			Code = WarningCode.None
		};

		public WarningCode Code { get; set; }

		public string MasterQueryName { get; set; }

		public string DetailQueryName { get; set; }

		public string MasterColumnName { get; set; }

		public string DetailColumnName { get; set; }

		public Type MasterColumnType { get; set; }

		public Type DetailColumnType { get; set; }
	}
	public sealed class WarningEventArgs : EventArgs

			Approved = false;
		}
	}

	public enum LegacyEditorMode
	{
		Full,
		Query,
		Relation,
		InvalidRelations
	}
	public struct LegacyEditorSettings
	{
		public static readonly LegacyEditorSettings Default = new LegacyEditorSettings
		{
			Mode = LegacyEditorMode.Full
		};

		public LegacyEditorMode Mode { get; set; }

		public string Name { get; set; }
	}
	public abstract class MasterDetailRunnerBase : IMasterDetailRunner
	{
		public bool Run(MasterDetailModel model, MasterDetailRunnerContext context)
		{
			MasterDetailPresenter presenter = new MasterDetailPresenter(model, context, CreateSub);
			IMasterDetailView view = CreateView();
			bool ok = false;
			EventHandler value = delegate
			{
				Error[] array = presenter.Validate().ToArray();
				if (array.Length != 0)
				{
					view.ShowError(array);
				}
				else
				{
					Warning[] array2 = presenter.CheckForWarnings().ToArray();
					Warning[] array3 = array2;
					foreach (Warning error in array3)
					{
						if (!view.ShowWarning(error))
						{
							return;
						}
					}
					model.RemoveAll((MasterDetailInfo r) => r.KeyColumns.Count == 0);
					ok = true;
					Close(view);
				}
			};
			try
			{
				view.Initialize(presenter);
				view.Ok += value;
				Show(view);
				if (ok)
				{
					SaveMetaData(presenter, context.Queries);
				}
				return ok;
			}
			finally
			{
				view.Ok -= value;
				if (view is IDisposable disposable)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		protected abstract IMasterDetailView CreateView();

		protected abstract IMasterDetailRunner CreateSub(LegacyEditorSettings settings);

		protected abstract void Show(IMasterDetailView view);

		protected abstract void Close(IMasterDetailView view);

		protected virtual void SaveMetaData(MasterDetailPresenter presenter, IEnumerable<SqlQuery> dest)
		{
			foreach (SqlQuery item in dest)
			{
				SqlQuery sqlQuery = presenter.Queries[item.Name];
				if (sqlQuery.Meta != null)
				{
					item.Meta = sqlQuery.Meta;
				}
			}
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.QueryBuilder
{
	internal static class DBSchemaExtensions
	{
		public static DBSchema AddMissingTables(this DBSchema dbSchema, SelectQuery query)
		{
			Dictionary<string, DBTable> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, DBTable>();
			CopyDBObjectsToDictionary(dictionary, dbSchema.Tables);
			CopyDBObjectsToDictionary(dictionary, dbSchema.Views);
			foreach (string item in query.Tables.Select((Table t) => t.Name))
			{
				CheckTableName(dictionary, item);
			}
			foreach (ExpressionBase item2 in from c in query.Columns.OfType<Column>()
				select c.Expression)
			{
				CheckExpression(dictionary, item2);
			}
			foreach (Join relation in query.Relations)
			{
				CheckTableName(dictionary, relation.Parent.Name);
				CheckTableName(dictionary, relation.Nested.Name);
				foreach (RelationColumnInfo keyColumn in relation.KeyColumns)
				{
					CheckColumnName(dictionary, relation.Parent.Name, keyColumn.ParentKeyColumn);
					CheckColumnName(dictionary, relation.Nested.Name, keyColumn.NestedKeyColumn);
				}
			}
			foreach (ExpressionBase item3 in query.Groups.Select((DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.Group s) => s.Expression))
			{
				CheckExpression(dictionary, item3);
			}
			foreach (ExpressionBase item4 in query.Sorting.Select((Sorting s) => s.Expression))
			{
				CheckExpression(dictionary, item4);
			}
			return new DBSchema(dictionary.Values.ToArray(), (DBTable[])(object)new DBTable[0], (DBStoredProcedure[])(object)new DBStoredProcedure[0]);
		}

		private static void CopyDBObjectsToDictionary(Dictionary<string, DBTable> tables, DBTable[] objects)
		{
			//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0016: Expected O, but got Unknown
			foreach (DBTable val in objects)
			{
				DBTable val2 = new DBTable(val.Name);
				val2.Columns.AddRange(((IEnumerable<DBColumn>)val.Columns).Select((Func<DBColumn, DBColumn>)((DBColumn c) => (c != null) ? new DBColumn
				{
					Name = c.Name,
					ColumnType = c.ColumnType
				} : ((DBColumn)null))));
				val2.ForeignKeys.AddRange(val.ForeignKeys.Select(CopyFoerignKey));
				tables.Add(val.Name, val2);
			}
		}

		private static DBForeignKey CopyFoerignKey(DBForeignKey foreignKey)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0005: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			DBForeignKey val = new DBForeignKey
			{
				Name = ((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)foreignKey).Name,
				PrimaryKeyTable = foreignKey.PrimaryKeyTable
			};
			StringEnumerator enumerator = ((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)foreignKey).Columns.GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					string current = enumerator.Current;
					((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)val).Columns.Add(current);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (enumerator is IDisposable disposable)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			StringEnumerator enumerator2 = foreignKey.PrimaryKeyTableKeyColumns.GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator2.MoveNext())
				{
					string current2 = enumerator2.Current;
					val.PrimaryKeyTableKeyColumns.Add(current2);
				}
				return val;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (enumerator2 is IDisposable disposable2)
				{
					disposable2.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		private static void CheckExpression(Dictionary<string, DBTable> tables, ExpressionBase expression)
		{
			if (expression is ColumnExpression columnExpression)
			{
				CheckColumnName(tables, columnExpression.Table.Name, columnExpression.ColumnName);
			}
		}

		private static void CheckColumnName(Dictionary<string, DBTable> tables, string tableName, string columnName)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(tableName) && tables.ContainsKey(tableName) && tables[tableName].Columns.All((DBColumn c) => c.Name != columnName))
			{
				DBTable obj = tables[tableName];
				if (obj != null)
				{
					obj.Columns.Add((DBColumn)(object)new MissingDBColumn(columnName));
				}
			}
		}

		private static void CheckTableName(Dictionary<string, DBTable> tables, string tableName)
		{
			if (!tables.ContainsKey(tableName))
			{
				tables.Add(tableName, (DBTable)(object)new MissingDBTable(tableName));
			}
		}
	}

	{

		{
			base.Name = name;
		}
	}
	internal class MissingDBColumn : DBColumn
	{
		public MissingDBColumn(string name)
		{
			base.Name = name;
		}
	}
	public class AvailableItemData : INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		public enum NodeType
		{
			None,
			Table,
			View,
			Column
		}

		public class ColumnData
		{
			public string Name { get; }

			public string Type { get; }

			public ColumnData()
			{
			}

			public ColumnData(string name, string type)
			{
				Name = name;
				Type = type;
			}
		}

		public class List : ItemDataList<AvailableItemData>
		{
			private static readonly PropertyDescriptor shadowedPropertyDescriptor = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(typeof(AvailableItemData))["Shadowed"];

			private readonly Dictionary<string, AvailableItemData> glossary;

			public AvailableItemData this[string tableName] => glossary[tableName];

			public List(QueryBuilderViewModel owner)
				: base(owner)
			{
				glossary = new Dictionary<string, AvailableItemData>();
			}

			public void Initialize(IEnumerable<string> tables, IEnumerable<string> views)
			{
				foreach (string table in tables)
				{
					Add(CreateTableNode(NodeType.Table, table, base.Owner.GetShadowed(table)));
				}
				foreach (string view in views)
				{
					Add(CreateTableNode(NodeType.View, view, base.Owner.GetShadowed(view)));
				}
			}

			internal void SetShadowed(AvailableItemData item, bool value)
			{
				SetItemProperty(item, value, shadowedPropertyDescriptor, (AvailableItemData data) => data.Shadowed, delegate(AvailableItemData data, bool b)
				{
					data.Shadowed = b;
				});
			}

			private AvailableItemData CreateTableNode(NodeType type, string name, bool shadowed)
			{
				AvailableItemData availableItemData = new AvailableItemData(type, name, shadowed);
				availableItemData.Children.Add(new ColumnData());
				glossary.Add(name, availableItemData);
				return availableItemData;
			}
		}

		private bool shadowed;

		public BindingList<ColumnData> Children { get; } = new BindingList<ColumnData>();

		public NodeType Type { get; }

		public string Name { get; }

		public bool Shadowed
		{
			get
			{
				return shadowed;
			}
			set
			{
				shadowed = value;
				RaisePropertyChanged("Shadowed");
			}
		}

		public bool IsExpanded
		{
			get
			{
				BindingList<ColumnData> children = Children;
				if (children != null && children.Count == 1)
				{
					return Children[0].Name != null;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		private AvailableItemData(NodeType type, string name, bool shadowed)
		{
			Type = type;
			Name = name;
			Shadowed = shadowed;
		}

		private void RaisePropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			this.PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
		}
	}

	public class ConditionStringInfo
	{
		public struct ColumnInfo : IEquatable<ColumnInfo>
		{
			public string Table { get; }

			public string Column { get; }

			public ColumnInfo(string table, string column)
			{
				Table = table;
				Column = column;
			}

			public override bool Equals(object obj)
			{
				if (obj == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (obj is ColumnInfo)
				{
					return Equals((ColumnInfo)obj);
				}
				return false;
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return (((Table != null) ? Table.GetHashCode() : 0) * 397) ^ ((Column != null) ? Column.GetHashCode() : 0);
			}

			public override string ToString()
			{
				return "[" + Table + "].[" + Column + "]";
			}

			public bool Equals(ColumnInfo other)
			{
				if (Table == other.Table)
				{
					return Column == other.Column;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private readonly ColumnInfo[] columns;

		public DataAccessStringId Format { get; }

		public string JoinType { get; }

		public IEnumerable<ColumnInfo> Columns => columns;

		public ConditionStringInfo(DataAccessStringId format, params ColumnInfo[] columns)
			: this(format, null, columns)
		{
		}

		public ConditionStringInfo(DataAccessStringId format, string joinType, params ColumnInfo[] columns)
			: this(format, joinType, columns.AsEnumerable())
		{
		}

		public ConditionStringInfo(DataAccessStringId format, IEnumerable<ColumnInfo> columns)
			: this(format, null, columns)
		{
		}

		public ConditionStringInfo(DataAccessStringId format, string joinType, IEnumerable<ColumnInfo> columns)
		{
			Format = format;
			JoinType = joinType;
			this.columns = columns.ToArray();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (this == obj)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (obj.GetType() != GetType())
			{
				return false;
			}
			ConditionStringInfo conditionStringInfo = (ConditionStringInfo)obj;
			if (Format != conditionStringInfo.Format)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (JoinType != conditionStringInfo.JoinType)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = columns.Length;
			if (conditionStringInfo.columns.Length != num)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				if (!columns[i].Equals(conditionStringInfo.columns[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			if (columns.Length != 0)
			{
				return columns[0].GetHashCode();
			}
			return 0;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			string format = DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(Format);
			string text = string.Join(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.QueryDesignerJoinExpressionElementSeparator), columns);
			if (JoinType == null)
			{
				return string.Format(format, text);
			}
			return string.Format(format, JoinType, text);
		}
	}
	public class ConditionStringInfoComparer : IEqualityComparer<ConditionStringInfo>
	{
		public bool Equals(ConditionStringInfo x, ConditionStringInfo y)
		{
			return x?.Equals(y) ?? (y == null);
		}

		public int GetHashCode(ConditionStringInfo obj)
		{
			return obj?.GetHashCode() ?? 0;
		}
	}

	public class SqlFilterPresenter<TModel, TView> : FilterPresenterBase<TModel, TView, SqlFilterPresenter<TModel, TView>> where TModel : FilterModel where TView : class, IFilterView
	{
		protected readonly SelectQuery query;

		private readonly IDictionary<string, DBTable> dbTables;

		public SqlFilterPresenter(TModel model, TView view, SelectQuery query, IDictionary<string, DBTable> dbTables)
			: base(model, view)
		{
			this.query = query;
			this.dbTables = dbTables;
		}

		protected static IEnumerable<FilterViewTableInfo> GetColumnsInfo(SelectQuery query, IDictionary<string, DBTable> dbTables)
		{
			foreach (Table table in query.Tables)
			{
				if (dbTables.TryGetValue(table.ActualName, out var value))
				{
					yield return new FilterViewTableInfo(table.ActualName, from c in value.Columns
						where c != null
						select new FilterViewColumnInfo(c.Name, DBColumn.GetType(c.ColumnType)));
				}
			}
			if (dbTables.ContainsKey("Expressions"))
			{
				yield return new FilterViewTableInfo("Expressions", from c in dbTables["Expressions"].Columns
					where c != null
					select new FilterViewColumnInfo(c.Name, DBColumn.GetType(c.ColumnType)));
			}
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<FilterViewTableInfo> GetColumnsInfo()
		{
			return GetColumnsInfo(query, dbTables);
		}
	}

	public class SqlFiltersPresenter : SqlFilterPresenter<FiltersModel, IFiltersView>
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<string, DBTable> groupDbTables;

		private const int suggestedTopRecordsCount = 100;

		public SqlFiltersPresenter(FiltersModel model, IFiltersView view, SelectQuery query, IDictionary<string, DBTable> dbTables, Dictionary<string, DBTable> groupDbTables)
			: base(model, view, query, dbTables)
		{
			this.groupDbTables = groupDbTables;
			((PresenterBase<FiltersModel, IFiltersView, SqlFilterPresenter<FiltersModel, IFiltersView>>)this).View.ChangeRecordsLimitationState += ChangeIsRecordLimitationStateHandler;
		}

		protected override void InitViewCore()
		{
			base.InitViewCore();
			((PresenterBase<FiltersModel, IFiltersView, SqlFilterPresenter<FiltersModel, IFiltersView>>)this).View.TopRecords = ((PresenterBase<FiltersModel, IFiltersView, SqlFilterPresenter<FiltersModel, IFiltersView>>)this).Model.TopRecords;
			((PresenterBase<FiltersModel, IFiltersView, SqlFilterPresenter<FiltersModel, IFiltersView>>)this).View.SkipRecords = ((PresenterBase<FiltersModel, IFiltersView, SqlFilterPresenter<FiltersModel, IFiltersView>>)this).Model.SkipRecords;
			((PresenterBase<FiltersModel, IFiltersView, SqlFilterPresenter<FiltersModel, IFiltersView>>)this).View.Distinct = ((PresenterBase<FiltersModel, IFiltersView, SqlFilterPresenter<FiltersModel, IFiltersView>>)this).Model.Distinct;
			((PresenterBase<FiltersModel, IFiltersView, SqlFilterPresenter<FiltersModel, IFiltersView>>)this).View.RecordsLimitationEnabled = ((PresenterBase<FiltersModel, IFiltersView, SqlFilterPresenter<FiltersModel, IFiltersView>>)this).Model.TopRecords != 0 || ((PresenterBase<FiltersModel, IFiltersView, SqlFilterPresenter<FiltersModel, IFiltersView>>)this).Model.SkipRecords != 0;
			((PresenterBase<FiltersModel, IFiltersView, SqlFilterPresenter<FiltersModel, IFiltersView>>)this).View.GroupFilterEnabled = (query.Groups.Count != 0 && query.Columns.OfType<Column>().Any((Column c) => c.Expression.Aggregate != AggregationType.None)) || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(query.GroupFilterString);
			if (((PresenterBase<FiltersModel, IFiltersView, SqlFilterPresenter<FiltersModel, IFiltersView>>)this).View.GroupFilterEnabled)
			{
				((PresenterBase<FiltersModel, IFiltersView, SqlFilterPresenter<FiltersModel, IFiltersView>>)this).View.SetGroupColumnsInfo(SqlFilterPresenter<FiltersModel, IFiltersView>.GetColumnsInfo(query, groupDbTables));
				((PresenterBase<FiltersModel, IFiltersView, SqlFilterPresenter<FiltersModel, IFiltersView>>)this).View.GroupFilterString = ((PresenterBase<FiltersModel, IFiltersView, SqlFilterPresenter<FiltersModel, IFiltersView>>)this).Model.GroupFilterString;
			}
		}

		protected override void Commit()
		{
			base.Commit();
			((PresenterBase<FiltersModel, IFiltersView, SqlFilterPresenter<FiltersModel, IFiltersView>>)this).Model.GroupFilterString = GroupFilterPatcher.CutOffTableNames(((PresenterBase<FiltersModel, IFiltersView, SqlFilterPresenter<FiltersModel, IFiltersView>>)this).View.GroupFilterString, query);
			if (((PresenterBase<FiltersModel, IFiltersView, SqlFilterPresenter<FiltersModel, IFiltersView>>)this).View.RecordsLimitationEnabled)
			{
				((PresenterBase<FiltersModel, IFiltersView, SqlFilterPresenter<FiltersModel, IFiltersView>>)this).Model.SkipRecords = ((PresenterBase<FiltersModel, IFiltersView, SqlFilterPresenter<FiltersModel, IFiltersView>>)this).View.SkipRecords;
				((PresenterBase<FiltersModel, IFiltersView, SqlFilterPresenter<FiltersModel, IFiltersView>>)this).Model.TopRecords = ((PresenterBase<FiltersModel, IFiltersView, SqlFilterPresenter<FiltersModel, IFiltersView>>)this).View.TopRecords;
			}
			else
			{
				((PresenterBase<FiltersModel, IFiltersView, SqlFilterPresenter<FiltersModel, IFiltersView>>)this).Model.SkipRecords = 0;
				((PresenterBase<FiltersModel, IFiltersView, SqlFilterPresenter<FiltersModel, IFiltersView>>)this).Model.TopRecords = 0;
			}
			((PresenterBase<FiltersModel, IFiltersView, SqlFilterPresenter<FiltersModel, IFiltersView>>)this).Model.Distinct = ((PresenterBase<FiltersModel, IFiltersView, SqlFilterPresenter<FiltersModel, IFiltersView>>)this).View.Distinct;
			((PresenterBase<FiltersModel, IFiltersView, SqlFilterPresenter<FiltersModel, IFiltersView>>)this).View.ChangeRecordsLimitationState -= ChangeIsRecordLimitationStateHandler;
		}

		private void ChangeIsRecordLimitationStateHandler(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			((PresenterBase<FiltersModel, IFiltersView, SqlFilterPresenter<FiltersModel, IFiltersView>>)this).View.TopEditEnabled = ((PresenterBase<FiltersModel, IFiltersView, SqlFilterPresenter<FiltersModel, IFiltersView>>)this).View.RecordsLimitationEnabled;
			if (((PresenterBase<FiltersModel, IFiltersView, SqlFilterPresenter<FiltersModel, IFiltersView>>)this).View.TopEditEnabled && ((PresenterBase<FiltersModel, IFiltersView, SqlFilterPresenter<FiltersModel, IFiltersView>>)this).View.TopRecords == 0)
			{
				((PresenterBase<FiltersModel, IFiltersView, SqlFilterPresenter<FiltersModel, IFiltersView>>)this).View.TopRecords = 100;
			}
			((PresenterBase<FiltersModel, IFiltersView, SqlFilterPresenter<FiltersModel, IFiltersView>>)this).View.SkipEditEnabled = (query.Sorting.Count != 0 && ((PresenterBase<FiltersModel, IFiltersView, SqlFilterPresenter<FiltersModel, IFiltersView>>)this).View.RecordsLimitationEnabled) || ((PresenterBase<FiltersModel, IFiltersView, SqlFilterPresenter<FiltersModel, IFiltersView>>)this).View.SkipRecords > 0;
		}

	public class GroupFilterPatcher
	{
		private class SelectQueryFilterVisitorLogic : IFilterVisitorLogic
		{
			private readonly SelectQuery query;

			public SelectQueryFilterVisitorLogic(SelectQuery query)
			{
				this.query = query;
			}

			public CriteriaOperator PrependTableNames(QueryOperand theOperand)
			{
				//IL_0098: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_009e: Expected O, but got Unknown
				string text = "???";
				Column column = query.Columns.OfType<Column>().SingleOrDefault((Column c) => c.ActualName == theOperand.ColumnName);
				if (column != null)
				{
					if (column.Expression is ColumnExpression { Table: { } table } && query.Tables.Contains(table))
					{
						text = table.ActualName;
					}
					if (column.Expression is CustomExpression)
					{
						text = "Expressions";
					}
				}
				return (CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty(text + "." + theOperand.ColumnName);
			}

			public CriteriaOperator CutOffTableNames(QueryOperand theOperand)
			{
				//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_000c: Expected O, but got Unknown
				return (CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty(theOperand.ColumnName);
			}

			public CriteriaOperator Rename(QueryOperand theOperand, string renameFrom, string renameTo)
			{
				//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0027: Expected O, but got Unknown
				if (theOperand.NodeAlias != null)
				{
					return (CriteriaOperator)(object)theOperand;
				}
				return (CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty((theOperand.ColumnName == renameFrom) ? renameTo : theOperand.ColumnName);
			}

			public CriteriaOperator Rename(OperandValue theOperand, string renameFrom, string renameTo)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
		}

		public const string ExpressionsTableAlias = "Expressions";

		private Dictionary<string, DBTable> tablesDictionary;

		private SelectQuery Query { get; }

		private DBSchema Schema { get; }

		private IEnumerable<IParameter> Parameters { get; }

		private Dictionary<string, DBTable> VirtualSchema { get; }

		private Dictionary<string, DBTable> TablesDictionary => tablesDictionary ?? (tablesDictionary = Schema.Tables.Union(Schema.Views).ToDictionary((DBTable t) => t.Name));

		public static string CutOffTableNames(string filterString, SelectQuery query)
		{
			return FilterVisitor.Process(new FilterVisitor(FilterVisitorCommand.CutOffTableNames, new SelectQueryFilterVisitorLogic(query)), filterString, (IEnumerable<IParameter>)query.Parameters);
		}

		public static string PrependTableNames(string filterString, SelectQuery query)
		{
			return FilterVisitor.Process(new FilterVisitor(FilterVisitorCommand.PrependTableNames, new SelectQueryFilterVisitorLogic(query)), filterString, (IEnumerable<IParameter>)query.Parameters);
		}

		public static string RenameColumn(string filterString, SelectQuery query, string oldName, string newName)
		{
			return FilterVisitor.Process(new FilterVisitor(oldName, newName, new SelectQueryFilterVisitorLogic(query)), filterString, (IEnumerable<IParameter>)query.Parameters);
		}

		public static IEnumerable<DBTable> GetVirtualSchema(SelectQuery query, DBSchema schema)
		{
			return GetVirtualSchema(query, schema, null);
		}

		public static IEnumerable<DBTable> GetVirtualSchema(SelectQuery query, DBSchema schema, IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters)
		{
			return new GroupFilterPatcher(query, schema, sourceParameters).GetVirtualSchema();
		}

		private GroupFilterPatcher(SelectQuery query, DBSchema schema, IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters)
		{
			Query = query;
			Schema = schema;
			object obj;
			if (sourceParameters == null)
			{
				IList<IParameter> list = new List<IParameter>();
				obj = list;
			}
			else
			{
				obj = (sourceParameters as IList<IParameter>) ?? sourceParameters.ToList();
			}
			Parameters = (IEnumerable<IParameter>)obj;
			VirtualSchema = query.Tables.Select((Table t) => t.ActualName).ToDictionary((Func<string, string>)((string name) => name), (Func<string, DBTable>)((string name) => new DBTable(name)));
		}

		private IEnumerable<DBTable> GetVirtualSchema()
		{
			foreach (Column item in Query.Columns.OfType<Column>())
			{
				if (item.Expression is CustomExpression customExpression)
				{
					ProcessCustomExpression(item, customExpression);
				}
				else if (item.Expression is ColumnExpression columnExpression)
				{
					ProcessColumnExpression(item, columnExpression);
				}
			}
			return VirtualSchema.Values.Where((DBTable t) => t.Columns.Count > 0);
		}

		private void ProcessColumnExpression(Column column, ColumnExpression columnExpression)
		{
			//IL_0093: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ca: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0097: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0088: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00f4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00f5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ff: Expected O, but got Unknown
			DBColumnType val;
			switch (columnExpression.Aggregate)
			{
			case AggregationType.None:
				if (Query.Groups.Any((DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.Group g) => g.Expression is ColumnExpression columnExpression2 && columnExpression2.ColumnName == columnExpression.ColumnName && columnExpression2.Table.Name == columnExpression.Table.Name))
				{
					val = TablesDictionary[columnExpression.Table.Name].GetColumnSafe(columnExpression.ColumnName).ColumnType;
					break;
				}
				return;
			case AggregationType.Count:
			case AggregationType.CountDistinct:
				val = (DBColumnType)12;
				break;
			case AggregationType.Avg:
				val = (DBColumnType)6;
				break;
			default:
				val = TablesDictionary[columnExpression.Table.Name].GetColumnSafe(columnExpression.ColumnName).ColumnType;
				break;
			}
			VirtualSchema[columnExpression.Table.ActualName].Columns.Add(new DBColumn(column.ActualName, false, (string)null, 0, val));
		}

		private void ProcessCustomExpression(Column column, CustomExpression customExpression)
		{
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0085: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0052: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			object obj;
			try
			{
				obj = new Expression(customExpression.Expression).EvaluateExpression(Parameters);
			}
			catch
			{
				obj = null;
			}
			DBColumnType val = (DBColumnType)((obj != null) ? ((int)DBColumn.GetColumnType(obj.GetType())) : 0);
			if (!VirtualSchema.ContainsKey("Expressions"))
			{
				VirtualSchema.Add("Expressions", new DBTable("Expressions"));
			}
			VirtualSchema["Expressions"].Columns.Add(new DBColumn(column.ActualName, false, (string)null, 0, val));
		}
	}

	public class ItemDataList<T> : BindingList<T>
	{
		protected QueryBuilderViewModel Owner { get; }

		protected ItemDataList(QueryBuilderViewModel owner)
		{
			Owner = owner;
		}

		public void RemoveAll(Predicate<T> predicate)
		{
			for (int num = base.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (predicate(base[num]))
				{
					RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
		}

		private void RaiseItemChanged(T item, PropertyDescriptor pd)
		{
			OnListChanged(new ListChangedEventArgs(ListChangedType.ItemChanged, IndexOf(item), pd));
		}

		protected void SetItemProperty(T item, bool value, PropertyDescriptor pd, Func<T, bool> getValue, Action<T, bool> setValue)
		{
			SetItemProperty(item, value, EqualityComparer<bool>.Default, pd, getValue, setValue);
		}

		protected void SetItemProperty(T item, string value, PropertyDescriptor pd, Func<T, string> getValue, Action<T, string> setValue)
		{
			SetItemProperty(item, value, StringComparer.Ordinal, pd, getValue, setValue);
		}

		protected void SetItemProperty<TVal>(T item, TVal value, IEqualityComparer<TVal> eqComparer, PropertyDescriptor pd, Func<T, TVal> getValue, Action<T, TVal> setValue)
		{
			if (eqComparer.Equals(getValue(item), value))
			{
				return;
			}
			Owner.BeginUpdate(waitForm: false);
			try
			{
				setValue(item, value);
				RaiseItemChanged(item, pd);
			}
			finally
			{
				Owner.EndUpdate(waitForm: false);
			}
		}
	}
	public class JoinEditorPresenter : PresenterBase<JoinList, IJoinEditorView, JoinEditorPresenter>, IJoinEditorPresenter
	{
		private readonly DBSchema dbSchema;

		private readonly IDictionary<string, Table> tableAliases;

		private readonly Table joiningTable;

		private SqlJoinType ModelJoinType => base.Model.FirstOrDefault((Join x) => Table.EqualityComparer.Equals(x.Nested, joiningTable))?.SqlJoinType ?? SqlJoinType.Inner;

		public JoinEditorPresenter(JoinList model, IJoinEditorView view, DBSchema dbSchema, IDictionary<string, Table> tableAliases, Table joiningTable)
			: base(model, view)
		{
			this.dbSchema = dbSchema;
			this.tableAliases = tableAliases;
			this.joiningTable = joiningTable;
		}

		protected override void InitViewCore()
		{
			base.View.JoinType = ModelJoinType;
			base.View.InitLookups(joiningTable.ActualName, FindTableColumns(joiningTable.ActualName), tableAliases.Keys.Where((string t) => !string.Equals(t, joiningTable.ActualName, StringComparison.Ordinal)).ToDictionary((string t) => t, FindTableColumns));
			Dictionary<string, RelationColumnInfoList> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, RelationColumnInfoList>();
			foreach (Join item in base.Model.Where((Join rel) => Table.EqualityComparer.Equals(rel.Nested, joiningTable)))
			{
				if (dictionary.TryGetValue(item.Parent.ActualName, out var value))
				{
					dictionary[item.Parent.ActualName] = new RelationColumnInfoList(value.Union(item.KeyColumns));
				}
				else
				{
					dictionary.Add(item.Parent.ActualName, new RelationColumnInfoList(item.KeyColumns));
				}
			}
			base.View.SetColumns(dictionary);
		}

		private IEnumerable<string> FindTableColumns(string tableAlias)
		{
			return from c in dbSchema.Tables.Union(dbSchema.Views).First((DBTable t) => string.Equals(t.Name, tableAliases[tableAlias].Name, StringComparison.Ordinal)).Columns
				where c != null
				select c.Name;
		}

		protected override string Validate()
		{
			IDictionary<string, RelationColumnInfoList> columns = base.View.GetColumns();
			if (columns == null || columns.Count == 0 || columns.Values.Any((RelationColumnInfoList list) => list.Any((RelationColumnInfo rel) => string.IsNullOrEmpty(rel.ParentKeyColumn) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(rel.NestedKeyColumn))))
			{
				return DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.QueryBuilderJoinEditorMissingData);
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override void Commit()
		{
			base.Model.RemoveAll((Join rel) => Table.EqualityComparer.Equals(rel.Nested, joiningTable));
			base.Model.AddRange(from keyValuePair in base.View.GetColumns()
				select new Join(tableAliases[keyValuePair.Key], joiningTable, base.View.JoinType, keyValuePair.Value));
		}
	}

	public class QueryParametersPresenter : PresenterBase<ParametersModel, IQueryParametersView, QueryParametersPresenter>, IParametersPresenter
	{
		private readonly Func<SqlQuery, ColumnarData> execute;

		private readonly SqlQuery query;

		public QueryParametersPresenter(ParametersModel model, IQueryParametersView view, SqlQuery query, Func<SqlQuery, ColumnarData> execute)
			: base(model, view)
		{
			this.execute = execute;
			this.query = query.Clone();
		}

		public PreviewData GetPreviewData()
		{
			query.Parameters.Clear();
			query.Parameters.AddRange(base.View.GetResult());
			ColumnarData columnarData = execute(query);
			return new PreviewData(columnarData.ToResult(string.Empty), !(query is CustomSqlQuery));
		}

		protected override void InitViewCore()
		{
			base.View.Initialize(base.Model.Parameters);
		}

		protected override void Commit()
		{
			base.Model.Parameters.Clear();
			base.Model.Parameters.AddRange(base.View.GetResult());
		}
	}
	public class QueryBuilderModel
	{
		public SelectQuery SelectQuery { get; set; }

		public CustomSqlQuery CustomSqlQuery { get; set; }

		public bool SqlEditing { get; set; }

		public SqlQuery Query
		{
			get
			{
				if (!SqlEditing)
				{
					return SelectQuery;
				}
				return CustomSqlQuery;
			}
		}

		public QueryBuilderModel(SqlQuery query)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)query, "query");
			if (query is StoredProcQuery)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Either SelectQuery or CustomSqlQuery required.");
			}
			SqlQuery sqlQuery = query.Clone();
			if (sqlQuery is SelectQuery selectQuery)
			{
				SelectQuery = selectQuery;
				CustomSqlQuery = new CustomSqlQuery
				{
					Name = selectQuery.Name
				};
			}
			else if (sqlQuery is TableQuery tableQuery)
			{
				SelectQuery = QueryConversionHelper.TableQueryToSelectQuery(tableQuery);
				CustomSqlQuery = new CustomSqlQuery();
			}
			else
			{
				SelectQuery = new SelectQuery();
				CustomSqlQuery = (CustomSqlQuery)sqlQuery;
				SqlEditing = true;
			}
		}
	}

	{
