		internal static string GetErrorMessage(SqlProviderLimitations sqlProviderLimitations)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			if (sqlProviderLimitations.HasFlag(SqlProviderLimitations.NoParametersInSelect))
			{
				list.Add("\r\n\t• " + DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.ProviderNotSupportedFeatureParametersInSelect));
			}
			string text = DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.ProviderNotSupportedFeatureExceptionHeader);
			return text + string.Join(";", list) + ".";
		}

		public QueryBuilderViewModel(QueryBuilderModel model)
		{
			Model = model;
			QueryGrid = new QueryGridItemData.List(this);
			Selection = new SelectionItemData.List(this);
			Available = new AvailableItemData.List(this);
		}

		public void Initialize(IDBSchemaProviderEx schemaProvider, DBSchema dbSchema, SqlDataConnection connection, IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters, ICustomQueryValidator customQueryValidator, ExpressionEditorContext context, bool enableCustomSql)
		{
			expressionEditorContext = context;
			this.connection = connection;
			this.schemaProvider = schemaProvider;
			this.sourceParameters = sourceParameters;
			this.customQueryValidator = customQueryValidator;
			dbCommandInterceptor = connection?.SqlDataSource?.DBCommandInterceptor ?? new NullDBCommandInterceptor();
			Schema = dbSchema;
			sourceDbTablesAndViews = Schema.Tables.Union(Schema.Views).ToDictionary((DBTable table) => table.Name, StringComparer.Ordinal);
			FullSchema = dbSchema.AddMissingTables(ModelQuery);
			dbTablesAndViews = FullSchema.Tables.Union(Schema.Views).ToDictionary((DBTable table) => table.Name, StringComparer.Ordinal);
			AliasFormatter = connection.DataStore as IAliasFormatter;
			EnableCustomSql = enableCustomSql;
			ColumnsWithFKs = dbTablesAndViews.Keys.ToDictionary((string s) => s, (string _) => new HashSet<ForeignKeyInfo>());
			DBTable[] tables = Schema.Tables;
			foreach (DBTable val in tables)
			{
				foreach (DBForeignKey item in val.ForeignKeys.Where((DBForeignKey key) => ((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)key).Columns.Count == 1))
				{
					if (dbTablesAndViews.ContainsKey(item.PrimaryKeyTable))
					{
						ColumnsWithFKs[val.Name].Add(new ForeignKeyInfo
						{
							ColumnName = ((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)item).Columns[0],
							ParentColumnName = item.PrimaryKeyTableKeyColumns[0],
							PrimaryKeyTable = item.PrimaryKeyTable
						});
					}
				}
			}
			BeginUpdate(waitForm: true);
			try
			{
				RaiseIsSqlSupportedChanged();
				Selection.Initialize(ModelQuery.Tables, ModelQuery.Columns, ModelQuery.Sorting, ModelQuery.Relations, ModelQuery.Groups);
				QueryGrid.Initialize(ModelQuery.Columns, ModelQuery.Sorting, ModelQuery.Groups);
				Available.Initialize(GetTables(), GetViews());
				if (connection != null && connection.IsSqlDataStore)
				{
					SetSqlText(Model.SqlEditing ? Model.CustomSqlQuery.Sql : SqlQueryHelper.BuildSql(Model.SelectQuery, dbSchema, Connection.SqlGeneratorFormatter), update: false);
				}
				else if (Model.SqlEditing)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException();
				}
				SetAllowEditSql(Model.SqlEditing, update: false);
				UpdateConditions();
			}
			finally
			{
				EndUpdate(waitForm: true);
			}
		}

		private void CustomizeQueryFilterCallback(SelectQuery query, ref CriteriaOperator filter)
		{
			CustomizeFilterExpressionEventHandler customizeFilterExpressionEventHandler = this.CustomFilterExpression;
			if (customizeFilterExpressionEventHandler != null)
			{
				CustomizeFilterExpressionEventArgs e = new CustomizeFilterExpressionEventArgs(query.Name, filter);
				customizeFilterExpressionEventHandler(null, e);
				filter = e.FilterExpression;
			}
		}

		public string GetTableName(string actualName)
		{
			return ModelQuery.Tables.Single((Table t) => t.ActualName == actualName).Name;
		}

		public void OnAvailableExpand(string table)
		{
			//IL_0068: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			BeginUpdate(waitForm: true);
			Exception ex = null;
			try
			{
				AvailableItemData availableItemData = Available[table];
				if (availableItemData == null || availableItemData.IsExpanded)
				{
					return;
				}
				AvailableItemData.ColumnData item = availableItemData.Children[0];
				foreach (DBColumn column in GetColumns(table))
				{
					availableItemData.Children.Add(new AvailableItemData.ColumnData(column.Name, (column.Size <= 0) ? ((object)System.Runtime.CompilerServices.Unsafe.As<DBColumnType, DBColumnType>(ref column.ColumnType)/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).ToString() : $"{column.ColumnType}({column.Size})"));
				}
				availableItemData.Children.Remove(item);
			}
			catch (Exception ex2)
			{
				ex = ex2;
			}
			finally
			{
				EndUpdate(waitForm: true);
			}
			if (ex != null)
			{
				RaiseError(ex);
			}
		}

		public void OnTableAddToSelection(string tableName, Func<IJoinEditorView> createViewFunc)
		{
			TableAddCore(tableName, delegate(Table table)
			{
				DBTable dbTable = GetDbTable(tableName);
				IEnumerable<Join> relationsFromFKs = GetRelationsFromFKs(table, dbTable);
				IEnumerable<Join> enumerable = (relationsFromFKs as Join[]) ?? relationsFromFKs.ToArray();
				if (enumerable.Count() != 1)
				{
					if (!LaunchJoinEditor(createViewFunc, table, newTable: true, out var jeModel, enumerable))
					{
						return (IEnumerable<Join>)null;
					}
					enumerable = jeModel;
				}
				return enumerable;
			});
		}

		public void OnTableRemoveFromSelection(string tableName, Predicate<IEnumerable<string>> confirmMultipleRemovePredicate)
		{
			OnTableRemoveFromSelection(tableName, confirmSingleTableRemoving: false, confirmMultipleRemovePredicate);
		}

		public void OnTableRemoveFromSelection(string tableName, bool confirmSingleTableRemoving, Predicate<IEnumerable<string>> confirmMultipleRemovePredicate)
		{
			if (allowEditSql)
			{
				return;
			}
			BeginUpdate(waitForm: false);
			try
			{
				Table table = Model.SelectQuery.Tables.FirstOrDefault((Table t) => t.ActualName == tableName);
				Join[] array = GetRelationsHierarchy(table).ToArray();
				List<Table> toRemove = array.Select((Join r) => r.Nested).Distinct().ToList();
				toRemove.Insert(0, table);
				if ((toRemove.Count > 1 || confirmSingleTableRemoving) && !confirmMultipleRemovePredicate(toRemove.Select((Table t) => t.ActualName)))
				{
					return;
				}
				Join[] array2 = array;
				foreach (Join item in array2)
				{
					Model.SelectQuery.Relations.Remove(item);
				}
				for (int num2 = ModelQuery.Relations.Count - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
				{
					Join obj = ModelQuery.Relations[num2];
					if (toRemove.Contains(obj.Nested))
					{
						if (obj.KeyColumns.Count == 1)
						{
							SelectionItemData selectionItemData = Selection.FindNode(obj.Parent.ActualName, obj.KeyColumns[0].ParentKeyColumn);
							if (selectionItemData.ForeignKey == SelectionItemData.FKState.AlreadyJoined && AllRelationsRemoving(obj.Parent, obj.KeyColumns[0].ParentKeyColumn, toRemove))
							{
								Selection.SetForeignKey(selectionItemData, SelectionItemData.FKState.CanBeJoined);
							}
						}
						ModelQuery.Relations.RemoveAt(num2);
					}
				}
				QueryGrid.RemoveAll((QueryGridItemData data) => toRemove.Any((Table t) => t.ActualName == data.Table));
				foreach (Table item2 in toRemove)
				{
					ModelQuery.Tables.Remove(item2);
					string actualName = item2.ActualName;
					SelectionItemData selectionItemData2 = Selection.FindTableNode(actualName);
					int tableId = selectionItemData2.Id;
					Selection.RemoveAll((SelectionItemData data) => data.Parent == tableId);
					Selection.Remove(selectionItemData2);
				}
				UpdateShadowed();
				UpdateConditions();
			}
			finally
			{
				EndUpdate(waitForm: false);
			}
		}

		public void OnEditFilter(Func<IFiltersView> createViewFunc)
		{
			if (allowEditSql)
			{
				return;
			}
			BeginUpdate(waitForm: false);
			try
			{
				if (LaunchFilterEditor(createViewFunc, out var feModel))
				{
					ModelQuery.FilterString = feModel.FilterString;
					ModelQuery.Top = feModel.TopRecords;
					ModelQuery.Skip = feModel.SkipRecords;
					ModelQuery.GroupFilterString = feModel.GroupFilterString;
					ModelQuery.Distinct = feModel.Distinct;
					ModelQuery.Parameters.Clear();
					ModelQuery.Parameters.AddRange(feModel.Parameters.Select(DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter.FromIParameter));
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				EndUpdate(waitForm: false);
			}
		}

		public void OnEditParameters(Func<IQueryParametersView> createViewFunc)
		{
			BeginUpdate(waitForm: false);
			try
			{
				if (LaunchParametersEditor(createViewFunc, out var peModel))
				{
					Model.Query.Parameters.Clear();
					Model.Query.Parameters.AddRange(peModel.Parameters);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				EndUpdate(waitForm: false);
			}
		}

		public void OnJoinWithForeignKey(string tableName, string column)
		{
			Table table = GetTableInfo(tableName);
			if (table == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			DBTable dbTable = GetDbTable(table.Name);
			DBForeignKey foreignKey = ((dbTable != null) ? dbTable.ForeignKeys.FirstOrDefault((DBForeignKey fk) => ((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)fk).Columns.Count == 1 && string.Equals(((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)fk).Columns[0], column, StringComparison.Ordinal)) : null);
			if (foreignKey != null)
			{
				TableAddCore(foreignKey.PrimaryKeyTable, (Table tableInfo) => new Join[1]
				{
					new Join
					{
						Parent = table,
						Nested = tableInfo,
						KeyColumns = 
						{
							new RelationColumnInfo(column, foreignKey.PrimaryKeyTableKeyColumns[0])
						}
					}
				});
			}
		}

		public Task<ColumnarData> GetPreviewDataAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			return Task.Factory.StartNew(() => GetPreviewDataCore(Model.Query, cancellationToken), cancellationToken);
		}

		private ColumnarData GetPreviewDataCore(SqlQuery query, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			query.Validate(customQueryValidator, connection.ConnectionParameters, Schema);
			return Executor.Execute(query, topThousand: true, cancellationToken);
		}

		public bool IsTopThousandApplicable()
		{
			return SqlQueryHelper.IsTopThousandApplicable(Model.Query);
		}

		public void OnEditJoin(string tableName, Func<IJoinEditorView> createViewFunc)
		{
			if (allowEditSql)
			{
				return;
			}
			BeginUpdate(waitForm: false);
			try
			{
				Table table = GetTableInfo(tableName);
				if (LaunchJoinEditor(createViewFunc, table, newTable: false, out var jeModel))
				{
					Join[] removingRelations = ModelQuery.Relations.Where((Join r) => r.Nested == table).ToArray();
					Join[] newRelations = jeModel.ToArray();
					UpdateRelations(table, removingRelations, newRelations);
					UpdateConditions();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				EndUpdate(waitForm: false);
			}
		}

		public void OnRemoveRelation(string parentTableName, string parentColumnName, string nestedTableName, string nestedColumnName, Predicate<IEnumerable<string>> confirmMultipleRemovePredicate)
		{
			if (allowEditSql)
			{
				return;
			}
			BeginUpdate(waitForm: false);
			try
			{
				Join rel = ModelQuery.Relations.FirstOrDefault((Join r) => r.Parent.ActualName == parentTableName && r.Nested.ActualName == nestedTableName && r.KeyColumns.Any((RelationColumnInfo c) => c.ParentKeyColumn == parentColumnName && c.NestedKeyColumn == nestedColumnName));
				if (rel == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (rel.KeyColumns.Count == 1)
				{
					if (!ModelQuery.Relations.Where((Join r) => r.Nested == rel.Nested).Except(new Join[1] { rel }).Any())
					{
						OnTableRemoveFromSelection(rel.Nested.ActualName, confirmSingleTableRemoving: true, confirmMultipleRemovePredicate);
						return;
					}
					ModelQuery.Relations.Remove(rel);
				}
				else
				{
					RelationColumnInfo relationColumnInfo = rel.KeyColumns.FirstOrDefault((RelationColumnInfo k) => k.ParentKeyColumn == parentColumnName && k.NestedKeyColumn == nestedColumnName);
					if (relationColumnInfo == null)
					{
						return;
					}
					rel.KeyColumns.Remove(relationColumnInfo);
					if (rel.KeyColumns.Count == 1)
					{
						SelectionItemData selectionItemData = Selection.FindNode(rel.Parent.ActualName, rel.KeyColumns[0].ParentKeyColumn);
						if (selectionItemData.Condition != null && selectionItemData.Condition.Columns.Count() == 1)
						{
							ConditionStringInfo.ColumnInfo columnInfo = selectionItemData.Condition.Columns.First();
							if (selectionItemData.ForeignKey == SelectionItemData.FKState.CanBeJoined && columnInfo.Table == rel.Nested.Name && columnInfo.Column == rel.KeyColumns[0].NestedKeyColumn)
							{
								Selection.SetForeignKey(selectionItemData, SelectionItemData.FKState.AlreadyJoined);
							}
						}
					}
				}
				UpdateConditions();
			}
			finally
			{
				EndUpdate(waitForm: false);
			}
		}

		public void OnAddRelation(string parentTableName, string parentColumnName, string nestedTableName, string nestedColumnName, ShowCircularRelationWarningDelegate showCircularRelationWarningDelegate)
		{
			if (allowEditSql)
			{
				return;
			}
			BeginUpdate(waitForm: false);
			try
			{
				Table tableInfo = GetTableInfo(parentTableName);
				if (tableInfo == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				Table tableInfo2 = GetTableInfo(nestedTableName);
				if (tableInfo2 == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				Join obj = ModelQuery.Relations.FirstOrDefault((Join r) => r.Parent.ActualName == parentTableName && r.Nested.ActualName == nestedTableName);
				RelationColumnInfo relationColumnInfo = new RelationColumnInfo(parentColumnName, nestedColumnName);
				if (obj != null)
				{
					if (obj.KeyColumns.Count == 1)
					{
						SelectionItemData selectionItemData = Selection.FindNode(obj.Parent.ActualName, obj.KeyColumns[0].ParentKeyColumn);
						if (selectionItemData.ForeignKey == SelectionItemData.FKState.AlreadyJoined)
						{
							Selection.SetForeignKey(selectionItemData, SelectionItemData.FKState.CanBeJoined);
						}
					}
					obj.KeyColumns.Add(relationColumnInfo);
				}
				else
				{
					if (FindCircularLinks(parentTableName, nestedTableName))
					{
						showCircularRelationWarningDelegate(parentTableName, parentColumnName, nestedTableName, nestedColumnName);
						return;
					}
					obj = new Join(tableInfo, tableInfo2, SqlJoinType.Inner, new RelationColumnInfo[1] { relationColumnInfo });
					ModelQuery.Relations.Add(obj);
				}
				UpdateConditions();
			}
			finally
			{
				EndUpdate(waitForm: false);
			}
		}

		public void OnReverseRelation(string parentTableName, string parentColumnName, string nestedTableName, string nestedColumnName, ShowRelationUpdatingConfirmationDelegate showRelationUpdatingConfirmationDelegate)
		{
			if (allowEditSql)
			{
				return;
			}
			BeginUpdate(waitForm: false);
			try
			{
				Table tableInfo = GetTableInfo(parentTableName);
				if (tableInfo == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				Table tableInfo2 = GetTableInfo(nestedTableName);
				if (tableInfo2 == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				Join obj = ModelQuery.Relations.FirstOrDefault((Join r) => r.Parent.ActualName == parentTableName && r.Nested.ActualName == nestedTableName);
				if (obj != null)
				{
					Join obj2 = new Join(obj.Nested, obj.Parent, obj.SqlJoinType, obj.KeyColumns.Select((RelationColumnInfo kc) => new RelationColumnInfo(kc.NestedKeyColumn, kc.ParentKeyColumn, kc.ConditionOperator)));
					if (showRelationUpdatingConfirmationDelegate(obj.Parent.ActualName, obj.Nested.ActualName))
					{
						UpdateRelations(tableInfo2, new Join[1] { obj }, new Join[1] { obj2 });
					}
					UpdateConditions();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				EndUpdate(waitForm: false);
			}
		}

		public void OnEditRelation(string parentTableName, string parentColumnName, string nestedTableName, string nestedColumnName, Func<IJoinEditorView> createViewFunc, ShowRelationUpdatingConfirmationDelegate showRelationUpdatingConfirmationDelegate)
		{
			if (allowEditSql)
			{
				return;
			}
			BeginUpdate(waitForm: false);
			try
			{
				Table tableInfo = GetTableInfo(parentTableName);
				if (tableInfo == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				Table nestedTable = GetTableInfo(nestedTableName);
				if (nestedTable == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				Join obj = ModelQuery.Relations.FirstOrDefault((Join r) => r.Parent.ActualName == parentTableName && r.Nested.ActualName == nestedTableName);
				RelationColumnInfo relationColumnInfo = obj?.KeyColumns.FirstOrDefault((RelationColumnInfo r) => r.ParentKeyColumn == parentColumnName && r.NestedKeyColumn == nestedColumnName);
				if (relationColumnInfo == null || !LaunchJoinEditor(createViewFunc, new Join(obj.Parent, obj.Nested, obj.SqlJoinType, new RelationColumnInfo[1] { relationColumnInfo }), out var jeModel))
				{
					return;
				}
				if (obj.KeyColumns.Count == 1)
				{
					Join[] removingRelations = ModelQuery.Relations.Where((Join r) => r.Nested == nestedTable).ToArray();
					Join[] newRelations = jeModel.ToArray();
					UpdateRelations(nestedTable, removingRelations, newRelations);
				}
				else
				{
					int index = obj.KeyColumns.IndexOf(relationColumnInfo);
					obj.KeyColumns.RemoveAt(index);
					Join obj2 = jeModel.Single();
					obj.KeyColumns.Insert(index, obj2.KeyColumns.Single());
					if (obj.SqlJoinType != obj2.SqlJoinType && showRelationUpdatingConfirmationDelegate(obj.Parent.ActualName, obj.Nested.ActualName))
					{
						obj.SqlJoinType = obj2.SqlJoinType;
					}
				}
				UpdateConditions();
			}
			finally
			{
				EndUpdate(waitForm: false);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateRelations(Table table, Join[] removingRelations, Join[] newRelations)
		{
			Table[] removingTables = new Table[1] { table };
			foreach (Join obj in removingRelations)
			{
				foreach (RelationColumnInfo keyColumn in obj.KeyColumns)
				{
					string actualName = obj.Parent.ActualName;
					string parentKeyColumn = keyColumn.ParentKeyColumn;
					SelectionItemData selectionItemData = Selection.FindNode(actualName, parentKeyColumn);
					if (obj.KeyColumns.Count == 1 && selectionItemData.ForeignKey == SelectionItemData.FKState.AlreadyJoined && AllRelationsRemoving(obj.Parent, parentKeyColumn, removingTables))
					{
						Selection.SetForeignKey(selectionItemData, SelectionItemData.FKState.CanBeJoined);
					}
					selectionItemData.JoinedTo.Clear();
				}
				ModelQuery.Relations.Remove(obj);
			}
			for (int num = ModelQuery.Relations.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (ModelQuery.Relations[num].Nested == table)
				{
					ModelQuery.Relations.RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
			foreach (Join item in newRelations)
			{
				ModelQuery.Relations.Add(item);
			}
			foreach (Join item2 in newRelations.Where((Join info) => info.KeyColumns.Count == 1))
			{
				SelectionItemData selectionItemData2 = Selection.FindNode(item2.Parent.ActualName, item2.KeyColumns[0].ParentKeyColumn);
				if (selectionItemData2.ForeignKey == SelectionItemData.FKState.CanBeJoined && IsJoinedWithFK(table.Name, item2))
				{
					Selection.SetForeignKey(selectionItemData2, SelectionItemData.FKState.AlreadyJoined);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool FindCircularLinks(string parentTableName, string nestedTableName)
		{
			SelectionItemData nestedTableItem = Selection.FindTableNode(nestedTableName);
			foreach (SelectionItemData item in Selection.Where((SelectionItemData n) => n.Parent == nestedTableItem.Id))
			{
				foreach (Join item2 in item.JoinedTo)
				{
					if (item2.Nested.ActualName == parentTableName)
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (FindCircularLinks(parentTableName, item2.Nested.ActualName))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void BeginUpdate(bool waitForm)
		{
			if (updateCnt == 0)
			{
				RaiseBeforeUpdate(waitForm);
			}
			updateCnt++;
		}

		internal void EndUpdate(bool waitForm)
		{
			if (updateCnt == 1)
			{
				UpdateSqlText();
			}
			updateCnt--;
			if (updateCnt == 0)
			{
				RaiseAfterUpdate(waitForm);
			}
			else if (updateCnt < 0)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
		}

		internal Table GetTableInfo(string name)
		{
			return ModelQuery.Tables.Single((Table table) => table.ActualName == name);
		}

		internal AliasedBase GetColumnInfo(string column)
		{
			return ModelQuery.Columns.OfType<AliasedBase>().SingleOrDefault((AliasedBase c) => c.ActualName == column);
		}

		public void OnColumnAddToQueryGrid(int pos, string table, string column, bool checkForExisting)
		{
			string text = null;
			if (GetColumnInfo(column) != null)
			{
				text = CreateColumnAlias(table + "_" + column);
			}
			QueryGridItemData queryGridItemData = null;
			if (checkForExisting)
			{
				queryGridItemData = QueryGrid.FirstOrDefault((QueryGridItemData data) => !data.Output && data.Aggregate == AggregationType.None && string.Equals(data.Table, table, StringComparison.Ordinal) && string.Equals(data.Column, column, StringComparison.Ordinal));
			}
			BeginUpdate(waitForm: false);
			try
			{
				if (queryGridItemData == null)
				{
					SelectColumn(-1, new ColumnDataItem(ColumnDataItem.Kind.Column, table, column), AggregationType.None, text);
					Selection.SetSelected(Selection.FindNode(table, column), true, update: false);
					QueryGridItemData item = new QueryGridItemData(QueryGrid, column, table, text, AggregationType.None);
					QueryGrid.Add(item);
					if (pos >= 0 && pos < QueryGrid.Count)
					{
						QueryGrid.MoveTo(item, pos);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					QueryGrid.SetOutput(queryGridItemData, value: true, update: true);
					QueryGrid.SetAlias(queryGridItemData, text, update: false);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				EndUpdate(waitForm: false);
			}
		}

		public void OnTableSetSelected(string table, bool selected)
		{
			BeginUpdate(waitForm: false);
			try
			{
				SelectionItemData item = Selection.FindTableNode(table);
				Selection.SetSelected(item, selected, update: true);
			}
			finally
			{
				EndUpdate(waitForm: false);
			}
		}

		public void OnColumnChangeSortedAsc(string table, string column)
		{
			OnColumnChangeSorted(table, column, ListSortDirection.Ascending);
		}

		public void OnColumnChangeSortedDesc(string table, string column)
		{
			OnColumnChangeSorted(table, column, ListSortDirection.Descending);
		}

		private void OnColumnChangeSorted(string table, string column, ListSortDirection direction)
		{
			string alias = null;
			if (GetColumnInfo(column) != null)
			{
				alias = CreateColumnAlias(table + "_" + column);
			}
			BeginUpdate(waitForm: false);
			try
			{
				QueryGridItemData queryGridItemData = QueryGrid.FirstOrDefault((QueryGridItemData data) => data.Aggregate == AggregationType.None && string.Equals(data.Table, table, StringComparison.Ordinal) && string.Equals(data.Column, column, StringComparison.Ordinal));
				if (queryGridItemData == null)
				{
					queryGridItemData = new QueryGridItemData(QueryGrid, column, table, alias, AggregationType.None);
					QueryGrid.Add(queryGridItemData);
					QueryGrid.SetOutput(queryGridItemData, value: false, update: false);
					QueryGrid.SetSortingType(queryGridItemData, direction, update: true);
				}
				else if (!queryGridItemData.SortingType.HasValue || queryGridItemData.SortingType.Value != direction)
				{
					QueryGrid.SetSortingType(queryGridItemData, direction, update: true);
				}
				else if (queryGridItemData.Output)
				{
					QueryGrid.SetSortingType(queryGridItemData, null, update: true);
				}
				else
				{
					QueryGrid.Remove(queryGridItemData);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				EndUpdate(waitForm: false);
			}
		}

		public void OnColumnChangeGroupBy(string table, string column)
		{
			string alias = null;
			if (GetColumnInfo(column) != null)
			{
				alias = CreateColumnAlias(table + "_" + column);
			}
			BeginUpdate(waitForm: false);
			try
			{
				QueryGridItemData queryGridItemData = QueryGrid.FirstOrDefault((QueryGridItemData data) => data.Aggregate == AggregationType.None && string.Equals(data.Table, table, StringComparison.Ordinal) && string.Equals(data.Column, column, StringComparison.Ordinal));
				if (queryGridItemData == null)
				{
					queryGridItemData = new QueryGridItemData(QueryGrid, column, table, alias, AggregationType.None);
					QueryGrid.Add(queryGridItemData);
					QueryGrid.SetOutput(queryGridItemData, value: false, update: false);
					QueryGrid.SetGroupBy(queryGridItemData, value: true, update: true);
				}
				else
				{
					QueryGrid.SetGroupBy(queryGridItemData, !queryGridItemData.GroupBy, update: true);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				EndUpdate(waitForm: false);
			}
		}

		public void OnAllColumnsAddToQueryGrid(int pos, string table, bool checkForExisting)
		{
			SelectColumn(-1, new ColumnDataItem(ColumnDataItem.Kind.Asterisk, table, null), AggregationType.None, null);
			QueryGridItemData queryGridItemData = null;
			if (checkForExisting)
			{
				queryGridItemData = QueryGrid.FirstOrDefault((QueryGridItemData data) => !data.Output && data.Aggregate == AggregationType.None && data.Table == table && data.Column == null);
			}
			BeginUpdate(waitForm: false);
			try
			{
				Selection.SetSelected(Selection.FindNode(table, null), true, update: false);
				if (queryGridItemData == null)
				{
					QueryGridItemData item = new QueryGridItemData(QueryGrid, table);
					QueryGrid.Add(item);
					if (pos >= 0 && pos < QueryGrid.Count)
					{
						QueryGrid.MoveTo(item, pos);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					QueryGrid.SetOutput(queryGridItemData, value: true, update: false);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				EndUpdate(waitForm: false);
			}
		}

		public void OnColumnsBatchAddToQueryGrid(int pos, IEnumerable<ColumnDataItem> columns)
		{
			BeginUpdate(waitForm: false);
			try
			{
				foreach (ColumnDataItem column in columns)
				{
					switch (column.ColumnKind)
					{
					case ColumnDataItem.Kind.Column:
						OnColumnAddToQueryGrid(pos++, column.Table, column.Column, checkForExisting: false);
						break;
					case ColumnDataItem.Kind.Asterisk:
						OnAllColumnsAddToQueryGrid(pos++, column.Table, checkForExisting: false);
						break;
					default:
						throw new NotSupportedException();
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				EndUpdate(waitForm: false);
			}
		}

		public void OnColumnDeselect(string table, string column)
		{
			List<QueryGridItemData> list = QueryGrid.Where((QueryGridItemData data) => data.Output && data.Aggregate == AggregationType.None && string.Equals(data.Table, table, StringComparison.Ordinal) && string.Equals(data.Column, column, StringComparison.Ordinal)).ToList();
			BeginUpdate(waitForm: false);
			try
			{
				foreach (QueryGridItemData item in list)
				{
					Selection.SetSelected(Selection.FindNode(table, column), false, update: false);
					QueryGrid.Remove(item);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				EndUpdate(waitForm: false);
			}
		}

		internal void SelectColumn(int pos, ColumnDataItem columnData, AggregationType aggregate, string alias)
		{
			ColumnBase item = columnData.ColumnKind switch
			{
				ColumnDataItem.Kind.Column => new Column
				{
					Expression = new ColumnExpression
					{
						Table = ModelQuery.Tables.Single((Table t) => t.ActualName == columnData.Table),
						ColumnName = columnData.Column,
						Aggregate = aggregate
					},
					Alias = alias
				}, 
				ColumnDataItem.Kind.Expression => new Column
				{
					Expression = new CustomExpression
					{
						Expression = columnData.Column,
						Aggregate = aggregate
					},
					Alias = alias
				}, 
				ColumnDataItem.Kind.Asterisk => aggregate switch
				{
					AggregationType.None => new AllColumns
					{
						Table = ((columnData.Table == null) ? null : ModelQuery.Tables.Single((Table t) => t.ActualName == columnData.Table))
					}, 
					AggregationType.Count => new RecordsCount
					{
						Alias = alias
					}, 
					_ => throw new InvalidOperationException(), 
				}, 
				_ => throw new InvalidOperationException(), 
			};
			if (pos < 0)
			{
				pos += ModelQuery.Columns.Count + 1;
			}
			ModelQuery.Columns.Insert(pos, item);
		}

		internal void RemoveAt(int pos)
		{
			ModelQuery.Columns.RemoveAt(pos);
		}

		internal bool IsColumnSelected(Table table, string columnName)
		{
			return IsColumnCore(table, columnName, (ColumnExpression x) => x.Aggregate == AggregationType.None);
		}

		internal bool IsColumnAggregated(Table table, string columnName)
		{
			return IsColumnCore(table, columnName, (ColumnExpression x) => x.Aggregate != AggregationType.None);
		}

		private bool IsColumnCore(Table table, string columnName, Predicate<ColumnExpression> condition)
		{
			return (from c in ModelQuery.Columns.OfType<Column>()
				select c.Expression).OfType<ColumnExpression>().Any((ColumnExpression x) => x.Table == table && x.ColumnName == columnName && condition(x));
		}

		internal Column GetColumnInfo(string table, string column)
		{
			return GetColumnCore((Table t) => t.ActualName == table, column);
		}

		private Column GetColumnCore(Predicate<Table> tableCondition, string column)
		{
			return ModelQuery.Columns.OfType<Column>().SingleOrDefault(delegate(Column c)
			{
				if (c.ActualName != column)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return c.Expression is ColumnExpression columnExpression && tableCondition(columnExpression.Table);
			});
		}

		internal bool GetShadowed(string table)
		{
			if (allowEditSql)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ModelQuery == null || ModelQuery.Tables.Count == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (TableSelected(table))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (GetDbTable(table).ForeignKeys.Any((DBForeignKey fk) => TableSelected(fk.PrimaryKeyTable)))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ModelQuery.Tables.Select((Table t) => t.Name).Distinct().Any((string selected) => GetDbTable(selected).ForeignKeys.Any((DBForeignKey fk) => string.Equals(fk.PrimaryKeyTable, table, StringComparison.Ordinal))))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal ConditionStringInfo GetConditionString(Table table)
		{
			Join[] source = Model.SelectQuery.Relations.Where((Join r) => r.Nested == table).ToArray();
			if (!source.Any())
			{
				return null;
			}
			IEnumerable<ConditionStringInfo.ColumnInfo> columns = source.SelectMany((Join rel) => rel.KeyColumns.Select((RelationColumnInfo kc) => new ConditionStringInfo.ColumnInfo(rel.Parent.ActualName, kc.ParentKeyColumn)));
			string joinType = new ActionTypeData((ActionType)source.First().SqlJoinType).ToString();
			return new ConditionStringInfo(DataAccessStringId.QueryDesignerJoinExpressionPattern, joinType, columns);
		}

		internal IEnumerable<DBColumn> GetColumns(string table)
		{
			//IL_00b1: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b6: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c0: Expected O, but got Unknown
			DBTable dbTable = GetDbTable(table);
			if (dbTable == null)
			{
				return Enumerable.Empty<DBColumn>();
			}
			if (dbTable.Columns.Count == 0 && sourceDbTablesAndViews.ContainsKey(table))
			{
				DBTable val = sourceDbTablesAndViews[table];
				schemaProvider.LoadColumns(connection, val);
				if (val != dbTable)
				{
					foreach (DBColumn item in val.Columns.Where((DBColumn c) => c != null))
					{
						dbTable.AddColumn(new DBColumn(item.Name, item.IsKey, item.DBTypeName, item.Size, item.ColumnType));
					}
				}
			}
			return dbTable.Columns.Where((DBColumn c) => c != null);
		}

		internal string CreateColumnAlias(string nameBase)
		{
			return CreateAliasCore(nameBase, MaxColumnAliasLength, (string name) => ModelQuery.Columns.OfType<AliasedBase>().All((AliasedBase c) => c.ActualName != name));
		}

		internal void UpdateConditions()
		{
			foreach (SelectionItemData column in Selection)
			{
				bool flag = column.Parent == -1;
				SelectionItemData selectionItemData = (flag ? column : Selection.First((SelectionItemData data) => data.Id == column.Parent));
				ConditionStringInfo condition = (flag ? GetConditionString(GetTableInfo(selectionItemData.Name)) : GetColumnConditionString(selectionItemData.Name, column.Name, column.ForeignKey));
				Selection.SetCondition(column, condition);
				if (flag)
				{
					continue;
				}
				SelectionItemData columnData = column;
				columnData.JoinedTo.Clear();
				foreach (Join relation in ModelQuery.Relations)
				{
					if (!(relation.Parent.ActualName != selectionItemData.Name))
					{
						IEnumerable<RelationColumnInfo> columns = from c in relation.KeyColumns
							where c.ParentKeyColumn == columnData.Name
							select new RelationColumnInfo(c.ParentKeyColumn, c.NestedKeyColumn, c.ConditionOperator);
						Join obj = new Join(relation.Parent, relation.Nested, relation.SqlJoinType, columns);
						if (obj.KeyColumns.Count > 0)
						{
							column.JoinedTo.Add(obj);
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool IsJoinedWithFK(Join join)
		{
			return IsJoinedWithFK(join.Nested.ActualName, join);
		}

		private ConditionStringInfo GetColumnConditionString(string table, string column, SelectionItemData.FKState state)
		{
			Table tInfo;
			switch (state)
			{
			case SelectionItemData.FKState.CanBeJoined:
			{
				tInfo = GetTableInfo(table);
				DBTable dbTable = GetDbTable(tInfo.Name);
				DBForeignKey val = dbTable.ForeignKeys.FirstOrDefault((DBForeignKey fk) => ((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)fk).Columns.Count == 1 && string.Equals(((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)fk).Columns[0], column, StringComparison.Ordinal));
				if (val == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return new ConditionStringInfo(DataAccessStringId.QueryBuilderCanJoin, new ConditionStringInfo.ColumnInfo(val.PrimaryKeyTable, val.PrimaryKeyTableKeyColumns[0]));
			}
			case SelectionItemData.FKState.AlreadyJoined:
				tInfo = GetTableInfo(table);
				return new ConditionStringInfo(DataAccessStringId.QueryBuilderJoinedOn, from info in ModelQuery.Relations
					where info.KeyColumns.Count == 1 && info.Parent == tInfo && info.KeyColumns[0].ParentKeyColumn == column
					select new ConditionStringInfo.ColumnInfo(info.Nested.ActualName, info.KeyColumns[0].NestedKeyColumn));
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		private void TableAddCore(string tableName, Func<Table, IEnumerable<Join>> getRelationsFunc)
		{
			//IL_026f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (allowEditSql)
			{
				return;
			}
			BeginUpdate(waitForm: false);
			try
			{
				string text = (ModelQuery.Tables.Any((Table t) => string.Equals(t.Name, tableName, StringComparison.Ordinal)) ? CreateTableAlias(tableName) : null);
				string name = text ?? tableName;
				Table table = new Table
				{
					Name = tableName,
					Alias = text
				};
				if (ModelQuery.Tables.Count > 0)
				{
					EnsureDBColumnsLoaded(tableName);
					IEnumerable<Join> enumerable = getRelationsFunc(table);
					if (enumerable == null)
					{
						return;
					}
					Join[] array = (enumerable as Join[]) ?? enumerable.ToArray();
					Join[] array2 = array;
					foreach (Join relation in array2)
					{
						ModelQuery.Relations.Add(relation);
						foreach (RelationColumnInfo keyColumn in relation.KeyColumns)
						{
							SelectionItemData selectionItemData = Selection.FindNode(relation.Parent.ActualName, keyColumn.ParentKeyColumn);
							if (relation.KeyColumns.Count == 1 && selectionItemData.ForeignKey == SelectionItemData.FKState.CanBeJoined && IsJoinedWithFK(tableName, relation))
							{
								Selection.SetForeignKey(selectionItemData, SelectionItemData.FKState.AlreadyJoined);
							}
							Join obj = selectionItemData.JoinedTo.FirstOrDefault((Join r) => r.Parent == relation.Parent && r.Nested == relation.Nested);
							RelationColumnInfo relationColumnInfo = new RelationColumnInfo(keyColumn.ParentKeyColumn, keyColumn.NestedKeyColumn, keyColumn.ConditionOperator);
							if (obj != null)
							{
								obj.KeyColumns.Add(relationColumnInfo);
								continue;
							}
							obj = new Join(relation.Parent, relation.Nested, relation.SqlJoinType, new RelationColumnInfo[1] { relationColumnInfo });
							selectionItemData.JoinedTo.Add(obj);
						}
					}
				}
				ModelQuery.Tables.Add(table);
				ConditionStringInfo conditionString = GetConditionString(table);
				int id = Selection.AddNew(name, conditionString, false, PointFloat.Empty, SizeF.Empty).Id;
				Selection.AddNew(id, null, null, false, aggregated: false, sortedAsc: false, sortedDesc: false, groupedBy: false, SelectionItemData.FKState.NoFK);
				foreach (DBColumn column in GetColumns(tableName))
				{
					if (column is MissingDBColumn)
					{
						continue;
					}
					SelectionItemData.FKState foreignKey = SelectionItemData.FKState.NoFK;
					ForeignKeyInfo info = ColumnsWithFKs[tableName].FirstOrDefault((ForeignKeyInfo c) => c.ColumnName == column.Name);
					if (info.PrimaryKeyTable != null)
					{
						EnsureDBColumnsLoaded(info.PrimaryKeyTable);
						if (dbTablesAndViews[info.PrimaryKeyTable].Columns.Any((DBColumn c) => c != null && c.Name == info.ParentColumnName))
						{
							foreignKey = SelectionItemData.FKState.CanBeJoined;
						}
					}
					Selection.AddNew(id, column.Name, null, false, aggregated: false, sortedAsc: false, sortedDesc: false, groupedBy: false, foreignKey);
				}
				UpdateShadowed();
				UpdateConditions();
			}
			finally
			{
				EndUpdate(waitForm: false);
			}
		}

		private void EnsureDBColumnsLoaded(string table)
		{
			RaiseShowWaitForm();
			try
			{
				GetColumns(table);
			}
			finally
			{
				RaiseHideWaitForm();
			}
		}

		private bool IsJoinedWithFK(string tableName, Join join)
		{
			DBTable dbTable = GetDbTable(join.Parent.Name);
			return dbTable.ForeignKeys.Any((DBForeignKey fk) => IsJoinedWithFK(tableName, join, fk));
		}

		private static bool IsJoinedWithFK(string tableName, Join join, DBForeignKey fk)
		{
			if (((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)fk).Columns.Count == 1 && ((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)fk).Columns[0] == join.KeyColumns[0].ParentKeyColumn && fk.PrimaryKeyTable == tableName)
			{
				return fk.PrimaryKeyTableKeyColumns[0] == join.KeyColumns[0].NestedKeyColumn;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private IEnumerable<Join> GetRelationsFromFKs(Table table, DBTable dbTable)
		{
			IEnumerable<DBForeignKey> enumerable = dbTable.ForeignKeys.Where((DBForeignKey fk) => ModelQuery.Tables.Any((Table t) => t.Name == fk.PrimaryKeyTable));
			foreach (DBForeignKey item in enumerable)
			{
				DBForeignKey foreignKey = item;
				foreach (Table item2 in ModelQuery.Tables.Where((Table t) => t.Name == foreignKey.PrimaryKeyTable))
				{
					yield return new Join(item2, table, SqlJoinType.Inner, ((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)foreignKey).Columns.Cast<string>().Select((string nestedCol, int i) => new RelationColumnInfo(foreignKey.PrimaryKeyTableKeyColumns[i], nestedCol)));
				}
			}
			HashSet<string> toSkip = new HashSet<string>(NotUnique(ModelQuery.Tables.Select((Table t) => t.Name)), StringComparer.Ordinal) { table.Name };
			foreach (Table ti in ModelQuery.Tables)
			{
				if (toSkip.Contains(ti.Name))
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (DBForeignKey foreignKey3 in GetDbTable(ti.Name).ForeignKeys)
				{
					if (!(foreignKey3.PrimaryKeyTable != table.Name))
					{
						DBForeignKey foreignKey2 = foreignKey3;
						yield return new Join(ti, table, SqlJoinType.Inner, ((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)foreignKey2).Columns.Cast<string>().Select((string col, int i) => new RelationColumnInfo(col, foreignKey2.PrimaryKeyTableKeyColumns[i])));
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private static IEnumerable<string> NotUnique(IEnumerable<string> source)
		{
			HashSet<string> set = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
			return source.Where((string item) => !set.Add(item));
		}

		private void UpdateSqlText()
		{
			string value;
			if (!IsSqlSupported)
			{
				value = string.Empty;
			}
			else if (Model.SqlEditing)
			{
				value = Model.CustomSqlQuery.Sql;
			}
			else
			{
				try
				{
					value = SqlQueryHelper.BuildSql(ModelQuery, Schema, connection.SqlGeneratorFormatter);
					value = AutoSqlWrapHelper.AutoSqlTextWrap(value, 50);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					RaiseError(ex);
					value = string.Empty;
				}
			}
			SetSqlText(value, update: false);
			RaiseSqlTextChanged();
		}

		private void SetSqlText(string value, bool update)
		{
			if (string.Equals(sqlText, value, StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				return;
			}
			BeginUpdate(waitForm: false);
			try
			{
				if (update)
				{
					if (!Model.SqlEditing)
					{
						return;
					}
					Model.CustomSqlQuery.Sql = value.Trim();
					CustomSqlModified = true;
				}
				sqlText = value;
			}
			finally
			{
				EndUpdate(waitForm: false);
				RaisePropertyChanged("SqlText");
				RaisePropertyChanged("CustomSqlModified");
			}
		}

		private void SetAllowEditSql(bool value, bool update)
		{
			if (allowEditSql == value)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (value && !IsSqlSupported)
			{
				RaiseAllowEditSqlChanged();
				return;
			}
			BeginUpdate(waitForm: false);
			try
			{
				allowEditSql = value;
				CustomSqlModified = !update;
				if (update)
				{
					if (value)
					{
						string query = SqlQueryHelper.BuildSql(ModelQuery, Schema, connection.SqlGeneratorFormatter);
						query = AutoSqlWrapHelper.AutoSqlTextWrap(query, 50);
						if (Model.CustomSqlQuery == null)
						{
							Model.CustomSqlQuery = new CustomSqlQuery(ModelQuery.Name, query);
						}
						else
						{
							Model.CustomSqlQuery.Sql = query;
						}
					}
					else if (ModelQuery == null)
					{
						Model.SelectQuery = new SelectQuery(Model.CustomSqlQuery.Name);
					}
					List<DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter> collection = Model.Query.Parameters.ToList();
					Model.SqlEditing = value;
					Model.Query.Parameters.Clear();
					Model.Query.Parameters.AddRange(collection);
					UpdateShadowed();
				}
				RaiseAllowEditSqlChanged();
			}
			finally
			{
				EndUpdate(waitForm: false);
				RaisePropertyChanged("AllowEditSql");
				RaisePropertyChanged("CustomSqlModified");
			}
		}

		private string CreateTableAlias(string nameBase)
		{
			return CreateAliasCore(nameBase, MaxTableAliasLength, (string name) => !ModelQuery.Tables.Any((Table table) => string.Equals(table.ActualName, name, StringComparison.Ordinal)));
		}

		private string CreateAliasCore(string nameBase, int maxLen, Predicate<string> isOk)
		{
			if (isOk(nameBase))
			{
				return nameBase;
			}
			int num = 0;
			string text;
			while (true)
			{
				text = ((num != 0) ? $"{nameBase}_{num}" : nameBase);
				num++;
				if (maxLen > 0 && text.Length > maxLen)
				{
					nameBase = nameBase.Substring(0, nameBase.Length - 1);
					num = 1;
				}
				else if (isOk(text))
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			return text;
		}

		private IEnumerable<string> GetTables()
		{
			return from table in Schema.Tables
				select table.Name into s
				orderby s
				select s;
		}

		private IEnumerable<string> GetViews()
		{
			return from view in Schema.Views
				select view.Name into s
				orderby s
				select s;
		}

		private DBTable GetDbTable(string tableName)
		{
			return dbTablesAndViews[tableName];
		}

		private bool TableSelected(string table)
		{
			return ModelQuery.Tables.Any((Table t) => t.Name == table);
		}

		private void UpdateShadowed()
		{
			foreach (AvailableItemData item in Available)
			{
				bool shadowed = GetShadowed(item.Name);
				if (item.Shadowed != shadowed)
				{
					Available.SetShadowed(item, shadowed);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool LaunchJoinEditor(Func<IJoinEditorView> createViewFunc, Table table, bool newTable, out JoinList jeModel)
		{
			return LaunchJoinEditor(createViewFunc, table, newTable, out jeModel, Enumerable.Empty<Join>());
		}

		private bool LaunchJoinEditor(Func<IJoinEditorView> createViewFunc, Table table, bool newTable, out JoinList jeModel, IEnumerable<Join> presets)
		{
			jeModel = new JoinList(Model.SelectQuery.Relations.Where((Join info) => string.Equals(info.Nested.ActualName, table.ActualName, StringComparison.Ordinal)).Union(presets).ToList());
			IEnumerable<Table> enumerable = Model.SelectQuery.Tables;
			if (newTable)
			{
				enumerable = enumerable.Union(new Table[1] { table });
			}
			return LaunchJoinEditorCore(createViewFunc, jeModel, enumerable, table.Name, table.ActualName);
		}

		private bool LaunchJoinEditor(Func<IJoinEditorView> createViewFunc, Join relation, out JoinList jeModel)
		{
			jeModel = new JoinList(new Join[1] { relation });
			IEnumerable<Table> tables = Model.SelectQuery.Tables;
			return LaunchJoinEditorCore(createViewFunc, jeModel, tables, relation.Nested.Name, relation.Nested.ActualName);
		}

		private bool LaunchJoinEditorCore(Func<IJoinEditorView> createViewFunc, JoinList jeModel, IEnumerable<Table> tables, string tableName, string tableActualName)
		{
			EnsureDBColumnsLoaded(tableName);
			IJoinEditorView view = createViewFunc();
			Dictionary<string, Table> dictionary = tables.ToDictionary((Table t) => t.ActualName, (Table t) => t);
			JoinEditorPresenter joinEditorPresenter = new JoinEditorPresenter(jeModel, view, FullSchema, dictionary, dictionary[tableActualName]);
			((PresenterBase<JoinList, IJoinEditorView, JoinEditorPresenter>)joinEditorPresenter).InitView();
			return ((PresenterBase<JoinList, IJoinEditorView, JoinEditorPresenter>)joinEditorPresenter).Run();
		}

		private bool LaunchFilterEditor(Func<IFiltersView> createViewFunc, out FiltersModel feModel)
		{
			IDictionary<string, DBTable> dbTables = ModelQuery.Tables.ToDictionary((Table table) => table.ActualName, (Table table) => GetDbTable(table.Name));
			Dictionary<string, DBTable> groupDbTables = GroupFilterPatcher.GetVirtualSchema(ModelQuery, Schema, sourceParameters).ToDictionary((DBTable t) => t.Name);
			string groupFilterString = GroupFilterPatcher.PrependTableNames(ModelQuery.GroupFilterString, ModelQuery);
			if (!LaunchFilterEditorCore(createViewFunc, dbTables, groupDbTables, ModelQuery.FilterString, groupFilterString, out feModel))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool LaunchFilterEditorCore(Func<IFiltersView> createViewFunc, IDictionary<string, DBTable> dbTables, Dictionary<string, DBTable> groupDbTables, string filterString, string groupFilterString, out FiltersModel feModel)
		{
			feModel = new FiltersModel(filterString, groupFilterString, ModelQuery.Top, ModelQuery.Skip, ModelQuery.Parameters)
			{
				Distinct = ModelQuery.Distinct
			};
			IFiltersView view = createViewFunc();
			SqlFiltersPresenter sqlFiltersPresenter = new SqlFiltersPresenter(feModel, view, ModelQuery, dbTables, groupDbTables);
			((PresenterBase<FiltersModel, IFiltersView, SqlFilterPresenter<FiltersModel, IFiltersView>>)sqlFiltersPresenter).InitView();
			return ((PresenterBase<FiltersModel, IFiltersView, SqlFilterPresenter<FiltersModel, IFiltersView>>)sqlFiltersPresenter).Run();
		}

		public bool LaunchExpressionEditor(Func<IExpressionEditorView> createViewFunc, string expressionString, out ExpressionEditorModel xeModel)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00c9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00cf: Expected O, but got Unknown
			xeModel = new ExpressionEditorModel(expressionString);
			IExpressionEditorView val = createViewFunc();
			IEnumerable<ColumnInfo> collection = ModelQuery.Tables.SelectMany(delegate(Table t)
			{
				//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_002e: Expected O, but got Unknown
				EnsureDBColumnsLoaded(t.Name);
				ColumnInfo tableInfo = new ColumnInfo
				{
					Name = Escape(t.ActualName)
				};
				tableInfo.Children.AddRange(dbTablesAndViews[t.Name].Columns.Where((DBColumn c) => c != null).Select((Func<DBColumn, ColumnInfo>)((DBColumn c) => new ColumnInfo
				{
					Name = (Escape(c.Name) ?? ""),
					Type = DBColumn.GetType(c.ColumnType),
					Parent = tableInfo
				})));
				return (IEnumerable<ColumnInfo>)(object)new ColumnInfo[1] { tableInfo };
			});
			expressionEditorContext.Columns.Clear();
			expressionEditorContext.Columns.AddRange(collection);
			expressionEditorContext.Parameters.Clear();
			if (!SqlProviderLimitations.HasFlag(SqlProviderLimitations.NoParametersInSelect))
			{
				expressionEditorContext.Parameters.AddRange(((IEnumerable<DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter>)ModelQuery.Parameters).Select((Func<DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter, ParameterInfo>)((DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.QueryParameter p) => new ParameterInfo((IParameter)(object)p))));
			}
			ExpressionEditorPresenter val2 = new ExpressionEditorPresenter(xeModel, val, (Func<string, string>)Validate, expressionEditorContext);
			((PresenterBase<ExpressionEditorModel, IExpressionEditorView, ExpressionEditorPresenter>)(object)val2).InitView();
			return ((PresenterBase<ExpressionEditorModel, IExpressionEditorView, ExpressionEditorPresenter>)(object)val2).Run();
		}

		internal static string Escape(string name)
		{
			if (!name.Contains("."))
			{
				return name;
			}
			return "[" + name.Replace("]", "\\]") + "]";
		}

		private string Validate(string expression)
		{
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0028: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0029: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(expression))
			{
				return DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.ExpressionEditor_EmptyExpression);
			}
			try
			{
				SelectStatement val = new SelectStatement(new DBTable("DummyTable"), "Dummy");
				((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)((BaseStatement)val).Operands).Add(FilterHelper.GetFilter(expression, Enumerable.Empty<IParameter>()));
				((BaseSqlGeneratorWithParameters)new SelectSqlGeneratorWithAlias(connection.SqlGeneratorFormatter, new SelectQuery("DummyQuery"))).GenerateSql((BaseStatement)(object)val);
				return null;
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				return ex.Message;
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<Join> GetRelationsHierarchy(Table table)
		{
			foreach (Join curve in Model.SelectQuery.Relations.Where((Join r) => r.Parent == table))
			{
				yield return curve;
				foreach (Join item in GetRelationsHierarchy(curve.Nested))
				{
					yield return item;
				}
			}
		}

		private bool AllRelationsRemoving(Table table, string column, ICollection<Table> removingTables)
		{
			return ModelQuery.Relations.Where((Join rel) => rel.KeyColumns.Count == 1 && rel.Parent == table && rel.KeyColumns[0].ParentKeyColumn == column).All((Join rel) => removingTables.Contains(rel.Nested));
		}

	public class QueryGridItemData
	{
		public class List : ItemDataList<QueryGridItemData>
		{
			private static readonly PropertyDescriptor outputPropertyDescriptor;

			private static readonly PropertyDescriptor aliasPropertyDescriptor;

			private static readonly PropertyDescriptor sortingTypePropertyDescriptor;

			private static readonly PropertyDescriptor sortOrderPropertyDescriptor;

			private static readonly PropertyDescriptor aggregatePropertyDescriptor;

			private static readonly PropertyDescriptor groupByPropertyDescriptor;

			private static readonly PropertyDescriptor columnPropertyDescriptor;

			private static readonly PropertyDescriptor columnDataPropertyDescriptor;

			private const string expressionAliasBase = "Expr";

			static List()
			{
				PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(typeof(QueryGridItemData));
				outputPropertyDescriptor = properties["Output"];
				aliasPropertyDescriptor = properties["Alias"];
				sortingTypePropertyDescriptor = properties["SortingType"];
				sortOrderPropertyDescriptor = properties["SortOrder"];
				aggregatePropertyDescriptor = properties["Aggregate"];
				groupByPropertyDescriptor = properties["GroupBy"];
				columnPropertyDescriptor = properties["Column"];
				columnDataPropertyDescriptor = properties["ColumnData"];
			}

			public List(QueryBuilderViewModel owner)
				: base(owner)
			{
				base.AllowNew = true;
			}

			public void Initialize(IEnumerable<ColumnBase> columns, IEnumerable<Sorting> sortingInfos, IEnumerable<DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.Group> groupingInfos)
			{
				foreach (ColumnBase column2 in columns)
				{
					if (column2 is Column column)
					{
						if (column.Expression is ColumnExpression columnExpression)
						{
							Add(new QueryGridItemData(this, columnExpression.ColumnName, columnExpression.Table.ActualName, column.Alias, columnExpression.Aggregate));
						}
						else if (column.Expression is CustomExpression customExpression)
						{
							Add(new QueryGridItemData(this, customExpression.Expression, column.Alias, customExpression.Aggregate));
						}
					}
					else if (column2 is AllColumns allColumns)
					{
						string table = allColumns.Table?.ActualName;
						Add(new QueryGridItemData(this, ColumnDataItem.Kind.Asterisk, null, table, null, output: true, null, null, groupBy: false, AggregationType.None));
					}
					else if (column2 is RecordsCount recordsCount)
					{
						Add(new QueryGridItemData(this, ColumnDataItem.Kind.Asterisk, null, null, recordsCount.Alias, output: true, null, null, groupBy: false, AggregationType.Count));
					}
				}
				InitSorting(sortingInfos);
				InitGrouping(groupingInfos);
			}

			private void InitSorting(IEnumerable<Sorting> sortingInfos)
			{
				int num = 1;
				foreach (Sorting sorting in sortingInfos)
				{
					ColumnDataItem.Kind kind;
					string columnName;
					string tableName;
					if (sorting.Expression is ColumnExpression columnExpression)
					{
						kind = ColumnDataItem.Kind.Column;
						columnName = columnExpression.ColumnName;
						tableName = columnExpression.Table.ActualName;
					}
					else
					{
						if (!(sorting.Expression is CustomExpression customExpression))
						{
							continue;
						}
						kind = ColumnDataItem.Kind.Expression;
						columnName = customExpression.Expression;
						tableName = null;
					}
					QueryGridItemData queryGridItemData = this.FirstOrDefault((QueryGridItemData item) => item.Column == columnName && item.Table == tableName && item.Aggregate == sorting.Expression.Aggregate);
					if (queryGridItemData != null)
					{
						SetSortingType(queryGridItemData, sorting.Direction, update: false);
						SetSortOrder(queryGridItemData, num, update: false);
					}
					else
					{
						Add(new QueryGridItemData(this, kind, columnName, tableName, null, output: false, sorting.Direction, num, groupBy: false, AggregationType.None));
					}
					num++;
				}
			}

			private void InitGrouping(IEnumerable<DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.Group> groupingInfos)
			{
				foreach (DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.Group groupingInfo in groupingInfos)
				{
					ColumnDataItem.Kind kind;
					string columnName;
					string tableName;
					if (groupingInfo.Expression is ColumnExpression columnExpression)
					{
						kind = ColumnDataItem.Kind.Column;
						columnName = columnExpression.ColumnName;
						tableName = columnExpression.Table.ActualName;
					}
					else
					{
						if (!(groupingInfo.Expression is CustomExpression customExpression))
						{
							continue;
						}
						kind = ColumnDataItem.Kind.Expression;
						columnName = customExpression.Expression;
						tableName = null;
					}
					QueryGridItemData queryGridItemData = this.FirstOrDefault((QueryGridItemData item) => item.Column == columnName && item.Table == tableName);
					if (queryGridItemData != null)
					{
						SetGroupBy(queryGridItemData, value: true, update: false);
					}
					else
					{
						Add(new QueryGridItemData(this, kind, columnName, tableName, null, output: false, null, null, groupBy: true, AggregationType.None));
					}
				}
			}

			protected override void RemoveItem(int index)
			{
				QueryGridItemData queryGridItemData = base[index];
				base.Owner.BeginUpdate(waitForm: false);
				try
				{
					if (queryGridItemData.Output)
					{
						SetOutputFull(queryGridItemData, value: false);
					}
					if (queryGridItemData.SortingType.HasValue)
					{
						SetSortingTypeFull(queryGridItemData, null);
					}
					if (queryGridItemData.GroupBy)
					{
						SetGroupByFull(queryGridItemData, value: false);
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					base.Owner.EndUpdate(waitForm: false);
				}
				base.RemoveItem(index);
			}

			protected override void OnAddingNew(AddingNewEventArgs e)
			{
				e.NewObject = new QueryGridItemData(this, null, null);
			}

			internal void SetColumnData(QueryGridItemData item, ColumnDataItem value, bool update)
			{
				bool flag = item.ColumnData.ColumnKind == ColumnDataItem.Kind.Column && item.ColumnData.Column == null;
				SetItemProperty(item, value, new ColumnDataItemComparer(), columnPropertyDescriptor, (QueryGridItemData data) => data.ColumnData, update ? new Action<QueryGridItemData, ColumnDataItem>(SetColumnDataFull) : ((Action<QueryGridItemData, ColumnDataItem>)delegate(QueryGridItemData data, ColumnDataItem s)
				{
					data.columnData = s;
				}));
				if (flag)
				{
					SetOutput(item, value: true, update: true);
				}
			}

			internal void SetOutput(QueryGridItemData item, bool value, bool update)
			{
				SetItemProperty(item, value, outputPropertyDescriptor, (QueryGridItemData data) => data.Output, update ? new Action<QueryGridItemData, bool>(SetOutputFull) : ((Action<QueryGridItemData, bool>)delegate(QueryGridItemData data, bool b)
				{
					data.output = b;
				}));
			}

			internal void SetAlias(QueryGridItemData item, string value, bool update)
			{
				SetItemProperty(item, value, aliasPropertyDescriptor, (QueryGridItemData data) => data.Alias, update ? new Action<QueryGridItemData, string>(SetAliasFull) : ((Action<QueryGridItemData, string>)delegate(QueryGridItemData data, string s)
				{
					PatchGroupFilterString(data, s);
					data.alias = s;
				}));
			}

			internal void SetSortingType(QueryGridItemData item, ListSortDirection? value, bool update)
			{
				SetItemProperty(item, value, EqualityComparer<ListSortDirection?>.Default, sortingTypePropertyDescriptor, (QueryGridItemData data) => data.SortingType, update ? new Action<QueryGridItemData, ListSortDirection?>(SetSortingTypeFull) : ((Action<QueryGridItemData, ListSortDirection?>)delegate(QueryGridItemData data, ListSortDirection? direction)
				{
					data.sortingType = direction;
				}));
			}

			internal void SetSortOrder(QueryGridItemData item, int? value, bool update)
			{
				SetItemProperty(item, value, EqualityComparer<int?>.Default, sortOrderPropertyDescriptor, (QueryGridItemData data) => data.SortOrder, update ? new Action<QueryGridItemData, int?>(SetSortOrderFull) : ((Action<QueryGridItemData, int?>)delegate(QueryGridItemData data, int? i)
				{
					data.sortOrder = i;
				}));
			}

			internal void SetAggregate(QueryGridItemData item, AggregationType value, bool update)
			{
				SetItemProperty(item, value, EqualityComparer<AggregationType>.Default, aggregatePropertyDescriptor, (QueryGridItemData data) => data.Aggregate, update ? new Action<QueryGridItemData, AggregationType>(SetAggregateFull) : ((Action<QueryGridItemData, AggregationType>)delegate(QueryGridItemData data, AggregationType type)
				{
					data.aggregate = type;
				}));
			}

			internal void SetGroupBy(QueryGridItemData item, bool value, bool update)
			{
				SetItemProperty(item, value, groupByPropertyDescriptor, (QueryGridItemData data) => data.GroupBy, update ? new Action<QueryGridItemData, bool>(SetGroupByFull) : ((Action<QueryGridItemData, bool>)delegate(QueryGridItemData data, bool b)
				{
					data.groupBy = b;
				}));
			}

			internal void MoveTo(QueryGridItemData item, int pos)
			{
				base.Owner.BeginUpdate(waitForm: false);
				try
				{
					int num = IndexOf(item);
					if (pos != num)
					{
						int num2 = IndexInOutput(item);
						base.RemoveItem(num);
						if (pos > num)
						{
							pos--;
						}
						InsertItem(pos, item);
						int num3 = IndexInOutput(item);
						if (item.Output && num3 != num2)
						{
							IList<ColumnBase> columns = base.Owner.ModelQuery.Columns;
							ColumnBase item2 = columns[num2];
							columns.RemoveAt(num2);
							columns.Insert(num3, item2);
						}
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					base.Owner.EndUpdate(waitForm: false);
				}
			}

			private void SetOutputFull(QueryGridItemData item, bool value)
			{
				item.output = value;
				int pos = IndexInOutput(item);
				if (value)
				{
					string text;
					switch (item.ColumnData.ColumnKind)
					{
					case ColumnDataItem.Kind.Column:
					{
						text = ((item.Aggregate != AggregationType.None) ? base.Owner.CreateColumnAlias($"{item.Aggregate}_{item.Column}") : ((base.Owner.GetColumnInfo(item.Column) != null) ? base.Owner.CreateColumnAlias(item.Table + "_" + item.Column) : null));
						SelectionItemData selectionItemData2 = base.Owner.Selection.FindNode(item.Table, item.Column);
						if (selectionItemData2 != null)
						{
							if (item.Aggregate == AggregationType.None)
							{
								base.Owner.Selection.SetSelected(selectionItemData2, true, update: false);
							}
							else
							{
								base.Owner.Selection.SetAggregated(selectionItemData2, value: true);
							}
						}
						break;
					}
					case ColumnDataItem.Kind.Expression:
						text = base.Owner.CreateColumnAlias("Expr");
						break;
					case ColumnDataItem.Kind.Asterisk:
					{
						SelectionItemData selectionItemData = base.Owner.Selection.FindNode(item.Table, null);
						if (selectionItemData != null)
						{
							base.Owner.Selection.SetSelected(selectionItemData, true, update: false);
						}
						text = ((item.Aggregate == AggregationType.Count) ? base.Owner.CreateColumnAlias("Count") : null);
						break;
					}
					default:
						throw new InvalidOperationException();
					}
					SetAlias(item, text, update: false);
					base.Owner.SelectColumn(pos, item.ColumnData, item.Aggregate, text);
					return;
				}
				base.Owner.RemoveAt(pos);
				SetAlias(item, null, update: false);
				if (item.ColumnData.ColumnKind == ColumnDataItem.Kind.Column)
				{
					SelectionItemData selectionItemData3 = base.Owner.Selection.FindNode(item.Table, item.Column);
					if (selectionItemData3 != null)
					{
						Table tableInfo = base.Owner.GetTableInfo(item.Table);
						if (item.Aggregate == AggregationType.None)
						{
							base.Owner.Selection.SetSelected(selectionItemData3, base.Owner.IsColumnSelected(tableInfo, item.Column), update: false);
						}
						else
						{
							base.Owner.Selection.SetAggregated(selectionItemData3, base.Owner.IsColumnAggregated(tableInfo, item.Column));
						}
					}
				}
				if (item.ColumnData.ColumnKind == ColumnDataItem.Kind.Asterisk)
				{
					SelectionItemData selectionItemData4 = base.Owner.Selection.FindNode(item.Table, item.Column);
					if (selectionItemData4 != null)
					{
						Table tableInfo2 = base.Owner.GetTableInfo(item.Table);
						base.Owner.Selection.SetSelected(selectionItemData4, base.Owner.IsColumnSelected(tableInfo2, item.Column), update: false);
					}
				}
			}

			private void SetAliasFull(QueryGridItemData item, string value)
			{
				if (base.Owner.GetColumnInfo(value ?? item.Column) != null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.QueryBuilderAliasAlreadyExists));
				}
				AliasedBase columnInfo = base.Owner.GetColumnInfo(item.ActualName);
				if (columnInfo == null)
				{
					base.Owner.SelectColumn(IndexInOutput(item), item.ColumnData, item.Aggregate, value);
					SetOutput(item, value: true, update: false);
					SelectionItemData selectionItemData = base.Owner.Selection.FindNode(item.Table, item.Column);
					if (selectionItemData != null)
					{
						if (item.Aggregate != AggregationType.None)
						{
							base.Owner.Selection.SetAggregated(selectionItemData, value: true);
						}
						else
						{
							base.Owner.Selection.SetSelected(selectionItemData, true, update: false);
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (value == null && !(((columnInfo is Column column) ? column.Expression : null) is ColumnExpression))
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.UnnamedColumnValidationException));
					}
					columnInfo.Alias = value;
				}
				PatchGroupFilterString(item, value);
				item.alias = value;
			}

			private int IndexInOutput(QueryGridItemData item)
			{
				return this.TakeWhile((QueryGridItemData x) => x != item).Count((QueryGridItemData x) => x.Output);
			}

			private void PatchGroupFilterString(QueryGridItemData item, string value)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
				{
					base.Owner.ModelQuery.GroupFilterString = GroupFilterPatcher.RenameColumn(base.Owner.ModelQuery.GroupFilterString, base.Owner.ModelQuery, item.ActualName, value);
				}
			}

			private void SetSortingTypeFull(QueryGridItemData item, ListSortDirection? value)
			{
				ListSortDirection? listSortDirection = value;
				IList<Sorting> sorting = base.Owner.ModelQuery.Sorting;
				ExpressionBase expr = BuildExpression(item);
				if (item.sortingType.HasValue && value.HasValue)
				{
					item.sortingType = value;
					sorting.First((Sorting info) => ExpressionBase.EqualityComparer.Equals(info.Expression, expr)).Direction = value.Value;
				}
				else
				{
					item.sortingType = value;
					if (value.HasValue)
					{
						sorting.Add(new Sorting
						{
							Direction = value.Value,
							Expression = expr
						});
						SetSortOrder(item, sorting.Count, update: false);
					}
					else
					{
						int num = IListExtensions.FindIndex<Sorting>(sorting, (Predicate<Sorting>)((Sorting info) => ExpressionBase.EqualityComparer.Equals(info.Expression, expr)));
						sorting.RemoveAt(num);
						SetSortOrder(item, null, update: false);
						int i;
						for (i = num; i < sorting.Count; i++)
						{
							SetSortOrder(this.First((QueryGridItemData data) => data.SortOrder == i + 2), i + 1, update: false);
						}
						listSortDirection = sorting.FirstOrDefault((Sorting info) => ExpressionBase.EqualityComparer.Equals(info.Expression, expr))?.Direction;
					}
				}
				if (item.ColumnData.ColumnKind == ColumnDataItem.Kind.Column)
				{
					SelectionItemData item2 = base.Owner.Selection.FindNode(item.Table, item.Column);
					base.Owner.Selection.SetSortedAsc(item2, listSortDirection == ListSortDirection.Ascending);
					base.Owner.Selection.SetSortedDesc(item2, listSortDirection == ListSortDirection.Descending);
				}
			}

			private void SetSortOrderFull(QueryGridItemData item, int? value)
			{
				if (!item.SortOrder.HasValue || !value.HasValue)
				{
					return;
				}
				List<QueryGridItemData> list = (from data in this
					where data.SortOrder.HasValue
					orderby data.SortOrder
					select data).ToList();
				int num = value.Value;
				if (num < 1)
				{
					num = 1;
				}
				if (num > list.Count)
				{
					num = list.Count;
				}
				int value2 = item.SortOrder.Value;
				if (num > value2)
				{
					for (int num2 = value2; num2 < num; num2++)
					{
						SetSortOrder(list[num2], num2, update: false);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					for (int num3 = num - 1; num3 < value2; num3++)
					{
						SetSortOrder(list[num3], num3 + 2, update: false);
					}
				}
				item.sortOrder = num;
				IList<Sorting> sorting = base.Owner.ModelQuery.Sorting;
				Sorting item2 = sorting[value2 - 1];
				sorting.RemoveAt(value2 - 1);
				sorting.Insert(num - 1, item2);
			}

			private void SetAggregateFull(QueryGridItemData item, AggregationType value)
			{
				item.aggregate = value;
				switch (item.ColumnData.ColumnKind)
				{
				case ColumnDataItem.Kind.Column:
				{
					if (item.SortingType.HasValue && item.SortOrder.HasValue)
					{
						base.Owner.ModelQuery.Sorting[item.SortOrder.Value - 1].Expression.Aggregate = value;
					}
					Column columnInfo = base.Owner.GetColumnInfo(item.Table, item.ActualName);
					if (columnInfo == null)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (item.Output)
					{
						if (value != AggregationType.None)
						{
							if (item.Alias == null || IsAutoAlias(item.Alias, columnInfo.Expression.Aggregate, item.Column))
							{
								SetAlias(value: columnInfo.Alias = base.Owner.CreateColumnAlias($"{item.Aggregate}_{item.Column}"), item: item, update: false);
							}
						}
						else if (item.Alias != null && IsAutoAlias(item.Alias, columnInfo.Expression.Aggregate, item.Column))
						{
							columnInfo.Alias = null;
							SetAlias(item, null, update: false);
						}
					}
					columnInfo.Expression.Aggregate = value;
					Table tableInfo = base.Owner.GetTableInfo(item.Table);
					SelectionItemData item2 = base.Owner.Selection.FindNode(item.Table, item.Column);
					base.Owner.Selection.SetAggregated(item2, base.Owner.IsColumnAggregated(tableInfo, item.Column));
					base.Owner.Selection.SetSelected(item2, base.Owner.IsColumnSelected(tableInfo, item.Column), update: false);
					break;
				}
				case ColumnDataItem.Kind.Expression:
				{
					Column columnInfo = base.Owner.ModelQuery.Columns.OfType<Column>().FirstOrDefault((Column c) => c.ActualName == item.Alias);
					if (columnInfo?.Expression is CustomExpression)
					{
						columnInfo.Expression.Aggregate = value;
					}
					break;
				}
				case ColumnDataItem.Kind.Asterisk:
					if (item.Output)
					{
						SetAggregate(item, value ^ AggregationType.Count, update: false);
						SetOutput(item, value: false, update: true);
						SetAggregate(item, value, update: false);
						SetOutput(item, value: true, update: true);
					}
					break;
				}
				if (value != AggregationType.None)
				{
					SetGroupBy(item, value: false, update: true);
				}
			}

			private bool IsAutoAlias(string alias, AggregationType aggregate, string column)
			{
				string text = $"{aggregate}_{column}";
				if (string.Equals(alias, text, StringComparison.Ordinal))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (new Regex("\\A" + text + "_\\d+\\z").IsMatch(alias))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (base.Owner.AliasFormatter == null || base.Owner.AliasFormatter.MaxColumnAliasLength == 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				Match match = new Regex("_\\d+\\z").Match(alias);
				if (!match.Success)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return text.StartsWith(alias.Substring(0, alias.Length - match.Length));
			}

			private bool IsAutoExpressionAlias(string alias)
			{
				return string.Equals(alias, base.Owner.CreateColumnAlias("Expr"), StringComparison.Ordinal);
			}

			private void SetGroupByFull(QueryGridItemData item, bool value)
			{
				item.groupBy = value;
				IList<DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.Group> groups = base.Owner.ModelQuery.Groups;
				DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.Group obj = new DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.Group
				{
					Expression = BuildExpression(item)
				};
				obj.Expression.Aggregate = AggregationType.None;
				if (value)
				{
					if (!groups.Contains(obj, new DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.Group.EqualityComparer()))
					{
						groups.Add(obj);
					}
					SetAggregate(item, AggregationType.None, update: true);
				}
				else
				{
					for (int num = groups.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
					{
						if (DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.Group.EqualityComparer.Equals(groups[num], obj))
						{
							groups.RemoveAt(num);
						}
					}
				}
				if (item.ColumnData.ColumnKind == ColumnDataItem.Kind.Column)
				{
					SelectionItemData item2 = base.Owner.Selection.FindNode(item.Table, item.Column);
					if (value)
					{
						base.Owner.Selection.SetGroupedBy(item2, value: true);
					}
					else if (!this.Any((QueryGridItemData data) => data.GroupBy && string.Equals(data.Table, item.Table, StringComparison.Ordinal) && string.Equals(data.Column, item.Column, StringComparison.Ordinal)))
					{
						base.Owner.Selection.SetGroupedBy(item2, value: false);
					}
				}
			}

			private void SetColumnDataFull(QueryGridItemData item, ColumnDataItem value)
			{
				bool output = item.Output;
				ListSortDirection? sortingType = item.SortingType;
				int? sortOrder = item.SortOrder;
				bool groupBy = item.GroupBy;
				AggregationType aggregate = item.Aggregate;
				string alias = item.alias;
				SetOutput(item, value: false, update: true);
				SetSortingType(item, null, update: true);
				SetGroupBy(item, value: false, update: true);
				SetAggregate(item, AggregationType.None, update: true);
				item.columnData = value;
				SetOutput(item, output, update: true);
				if (value.ColumnKind == ColumnDataItem.Kind.Asterisk)
				{
					if (value.Table == null && aggregate == AggregationType.Count)
					{
						SetAggregateAndAlias(item, aggregate, alias);
					}
					return;
				}
				if (sortingType.HasValue)
				{
					SetSortingType(item, sortingType, update: true);
					SetSortOrder(item, sortOrder, update: true);
				}
				if (groupBy)
				{
					SetGroupBy(item, value: true, update: true);
				}
				SetAggregateAndAlias(item, aggregate, alias);
			}

			private void SetAggregateAndAlias(QueryGridItemData item, AggregationType aggregate, string alias)
			{
				if (aggregate != AggregationType.None)
				{
					SetAggregate(item, aggregate, update: true);
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(alias) && ShouldKeepAlias(alias, item))
				{
					SetAlias(item, alias, update: true);
				}
			}

			private bool ShouldKeepAlias(string alias, QueryGridItemData item)
			{
				if (item.Aggregate != AggregationType.None)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (item.ColumnData.ColumnKind == ColumnDataItem.Kind.Column && IsAutoExpressionAlias(alias))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}

			private ExpressionBase BuildExpression(QueryGridItemData item)
			{
				return item.ColumnData.ColumnKind switch
				{
					ColumnDataItem.Kind.Column => new ColumnExpression
					{
						ColumnName = item.Column,
						Table = base.Owner.GetTableInfo(item.Table),
						Aggregate = item.Aggregate
					}, 
					ColumnDataItem.Kind.Expression => new CustomExpression
					{
						Expression = item.Column,
						Aggregate = item.Aggregate
					}, 
					_ => null, 
				};
			}
		}

		private readonly List owner;

		private string alias;

		private bool output;

		private ListSortDirection? sortingType;

		private int? sortOrder;

		private bool groupBy;

		private AggregationType aggregate;

		private ColumnDataItem columnData;

		public ColumnDataItem ColumnData
		{
			get
			{
				return columnData;
			}
			set
			{
				owner.SetColumnData(this, value, update: true);
			}
		}

		public string Column => columnData.Column;

		public string Table
		{
			get
			{
				return columnData.Table;
			}
			set
			{
				switch (ColumnData.ColumnKind)
				{
				case ColumnDataItem.Kind.Column:
					owner.SetColumnData(this, new ColumnDataItem(value, columnData.Column), update: false);
					break;
				case ColumnDataItem.Kind.Asterisk:
					owner.SetColumnData(this, new ColumnDataItem(ColumnDataItem.Kind.Asterisk, value, null), update: false);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public string Alias
		{
			get
			{
				return alias;
			}
			set
			{
				owner.SetAlias(this, string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) ? null : value, update: true);
			}
		}

		internal string ActualName => alias ?? Column;

		public bool Output
		{
			get
			{
				return output;
			}
			set
			{
				owner.SetOutput(this, value, update: true);
			}
		}

		public ListSortDirection? SortingType
		{
			get
			{
				return sortingType;
			}
			set
			{
				owner.SetSortingType(this, value, update: true);
			}
		}

		public int? SortOrder
		{
			get
			{
				return sortOrder;
			}
			set
			{
				owner.SetSortOrder(this, value, update: true);
			}
		}

		public bool GroupBy
		{
			get
			{
				return groupBy;
			}
			set
			{
				owner.SetGroupBy(this, value, update: true);
			}
		}

		public AggregationType Aggregate
		{
			get
			{
				return aggregate;
			}
			set
			{
				owner.SetAggregate(this, value, update: true);
			}
		}

		public QueryGridItemData(List owner, string table)

				Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>> dictionary3 = list.ToDictionary((Table t) => t.ActualName, (Table _) => new HashSet<string>());

					string actualName = table.ActualName;
					HashSet<string> selectedColumns = dictionary2[actualName];
					HashSet<string> aggregatedColumns = dictionary3[actualName];
					if (!allSortedAscColumns.TryGetValue(actualName, out var value))
					{
						value = new HashSet<string>(Enumerable.Empty<string>());
					}
					if (!allSortedDescColumns.TryGetValue(actualName, out var value2))
