			private static Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>> GetAllGroupedByColumns(IEnumerable<DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.Group> groupingInfos)
			{
				Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>>();
				foreach (DevExpress.DataAccess.Sql.Group groupingInfo in groupingInfos)
				{
					if (groupingInfo.Expression is ColumnExpression columnExpression)
					{
						string actualName = columnExpression.Table.ActualName;
						if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(actualName, out var value))
						{
							dictionary.Add(actualName, value = new HashSet<string>());
						}
						value.Add(columnExpression.ColumnName);
					}
				}
				return dictionary;
			}

			private static void GetAllSortedColumns(IEnumerable<Sorting> sortingInfos, out Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>> allSortedAscColumns, out Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>> allSortedDescColumns)
			{
				allSortedAscColumns = new Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>>();
				allSortedDescColumns = new Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>>();
				foreach (Sorting sortingInfo in sortingInfos)
				{
					if (!(sortingInfo.Expression is ColumnExpression columnExpression))
					{
						break;
					}
					string actualName = columnExpression.Table.ActualName;
					Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>> dictionary = ((sortingInfo.Direction == ListSortDirection.Ascending) ? allSortedAscColumns : allSortedDescColumns);
					if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(actualName, out var value))
					{
						dictionary.Add(actualName, value = new HashSet<string>());
					}
					value.Add(columnExpression.ColumnName);
				}
			}

			private void InitializeTable(Table table, bool allColumnsSelected, HashSet<string> selectedColumns, HashSet<string> aggregatedColumns, HashSet<string> sortedAscColumns, HashSet<string> sortedDescColumns, HashSet<string> groupedByColumns, Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>> columnsInRelations)

				DBTable val = base.Owner.FullSchema.Tables.FirstOrDefault((DBTable t) => t.Name == table.Name);

((!columnsInRelations[actualName].Contains(column)) ? FKState.CanBeJoined : ((!base.Owner.ModelQuery.Relations.Any((Join rel) => rel.KeyColumns.Count == 1 && rel.Parent == table && rel.KeyColumns[0].ParentKeyColumn == column && base.Owner.IsJoinedWithFK(rel))) ? FKState.CanBeJoined : FKState.AlreadyJoined)) : FKState.NoFK, parent: selectionItemData.Id, name: column, condition: null, selected: flag2, aggregated: aggregated, sortedAsc: sortedAsc, sortedDesc: sortedDesc, groupedBy: groupedBy);
					selectionItemData2.IsMissing = val is MissingDBTable || val.Columns.FirstOrDefault((DBColumn c) => c.Name == column) is MissingDBColumn;
					foreach (Join item2 in base.Owner.ModelQuery.Relations.Where((Join rel) => rel.Parent == table))

			public SelectionItemData AddNew(string name, ConditionStringInfo condition, bool? selected, PointFloat position, SizeF size)
			{
				//IL_009c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (((PointFloat)(ref position)).IsEmpty)

				}

				Add(selectionItemData);

			}

			internal void SetSelected(SelectionItemData item, bool? value, bool update)
			{
				SetItemProperty(item, value, EqualityComparer<bool?>.Default, selectedPropertyDescriptor, (SelectionItemData data) => data.Selected, update ? new Action<SelectionItemData, bool?>(SetSelectedFull) : new Action<SelectionItemData, bool?>(SetSelectedLight));
			}

			private void SetSelectedFull(SelectionItemData item, bool? value)
			{
				int itemParentId = item.Parent;
				SelectionItemData selectionItemData = this.FirstOrDefault((SelectionItemData child) => child.Id == itemParentId);
				if (selectionItemData == null)
				{
					string name = item.Name;
					bool? value2 = value;
					foreach (SelectionItemData item2 in this.Where((SelectionItemData child) => child.Parent == item.Id))
					{
						if (item2.Name == null)
						{
							if (value2.HasValue && !value2.Value && item2.Selected.HasValue && item2.Selected.Value)
							{
								value2 = null;
							}
						}
						else if (item2.Selected != value)
						{
							SetSelectedValue(item2, value);
							SetColumnSelected(item2, value, name);
						}
					}
					SetSelectedValue(item, value2);
				}
				else
				{
					SetColumnSelected(item, value, selectionItemData.Name);
					SetSelectedCore(item, value);
				}
			}

			private void SetColumnSelected(SelectionItemData item, bool? value, string tableName)
			{
				string columnName = item.Name;
				if (value.Value)
				{
					if (columnName != null)
					{
						base.Owner.OnColumnAddToQueryGrid(-1, tableName, columnName, checkForExisting: true);
					}
					else
					{
						base.Owner.OnAllColumnsAddToQueryGrid(-1, tableName, checkForExisting: true);
					}
					return;
				}
				HashSet<QueryGridItemData> hashSet = new HashSet<QueryGridItemData>();
				foreach (QueryGridItemData item2 in base.Owner.QueryGrid.Where((QueryGridItemData row) => row.Aggregate == AggregationType.None && string.Equals(row.Table, tableName, StringComparison.Ordinal) && string.Equals(row.Column, columnName, StringComparison.Ordinal)))
				{
					if (!item2.SortingType.HasValue && !item2.GroupBy)
					{
						hashSet.Add(item2);
					}
					else
					{
						base.Owner.QueryGrid.SetOutput(item2, value: false, update: true);
					}
				}
				base.Owner.QueryGrid.RemoveAll(hashSet.Contains);
			}

			private void SetSelectedLight(SelectionItemData item, bool? value)
			{
				SetSelectedCore(item, value);
			}

			private void SetSelectedCore(SelectionItemData item, bool? value)
			{
				SetSelectedValue(item, value);
				SelectionItemData selectionItemData = this.FirstOrDefault((SelectionItemData child) => child.Id == item.Parent);
				if (selectionItemData != null)
				{
					SelectionItemData[] source = this.Where((SelectionItemData child) => child.Parent == item.Parent).ToArray();
					bool? flag = (source.All((SelectionItemData b) => b.Selected == false) ? new bool?(false) : ((!source.All((SelectionItemData b) => b.Selected == true || b.Name == null)) ? ((bool?)null) : new bool?(true)));
					bool? value2 = flag;
					SetSelected(selectionItemData, value2, update: false);
				}
			}

			private void SetSelectedValue(SelectionItemData item, bool? value)

			internal void SetPosition(SelectionItemData item, PointFloat value)
			{
				//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0036: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0037: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0077: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (item.Parent < 0 && !TableMetaInfo.EqualityComparer.Equals(item.Position, value))
				{
					item.position = value;
					Table table = base.Owner.ModelQuery.Tables.Single((Table t) => t.ActualName == item.Name);
					if (table.Meta == null)
					{
						table.Meta = new TableMetaInfo();
					}
					table.Meta.Pos = value;
				}
			}

			internal void SetSize(SelectionItemData item, SizeF value)
			{
				if (item.Parent < 0 && !TableMetaInfo.EqualityComparer.Equals(item.Size, value))
				{
					item.size = value;
					Table table = base.Owner.ModelQuery.Tables.Single((Table t) => t.ActualName == item.Name);
					if (table.Meta == null)
					{

					}

				}

			private void SetTableNameFull(SelectionItemData item, string value)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
				{
					throw new InvalidNameException(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.MessageInvalidItemName));
				}
				if (this.Any((SelectionItemData data) => data.Parent == -1 && string.Equals(data.Name, value)))
				{
					throw new InvalidNameException(string.Format(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.MessageDuplicateItemName), value));
				}
				string oldValue = item.Name;
				if (item.IsMissing)
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (QueryGridItemData item2 in base.Owner.QueryGrid.Where((QueryGridItemData gridItemData) => string.Equals(gridItemData.Table, oldValue, StringComparison.Ordinal)))
				{
					item2.Table = value;
				}
				base.Owner.GetTableInfo(oldValue).Alias = value;
				item.SetNameCore(value);
				base.Owner.UpdateConditions();
			}

			internal SelectionItemData FindTableNode(string table)
			{
				return FindNode(-1, table);
			}

			internal SelectionItemData FindNode(string table, string column)
			{
				SelectionItemData selectionItemData = FindNode(-1, table);
				if (selectionItemData != null)
				{
					return FindNode(selectionItemData.Id, column);
				}
				return null;
			}

			private SelectionItemData FindNode(int parentId, string name)
			{
				return this.FirstOrDefault((SelectionItemData item) => item.Parent == parentId && string.Equals(item.Name, name, StringComparison.Ordinal));
			}
		}

		public enum FKState
		{
			NoFK,
			CanBeJoined,
			AlreadyJoined
		}

		private PointFloat position;

		private SizeF size;

		public ConditionStringInfo Condition { get; private set; }

		public bool Aggregated { get; private set; }

		public bool SortedAsc { get; private set; }

		public bool SortedDesc { get; private set; }

		public bool GroupedBy { get; private set; }

		public FKState ForeignKey { get; private set; }

		public BindingList<Join> JoinedTo { get; } = new BindingList<Join>();

		public PointFloat Position
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				return position;
			}
			set
			{
				//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				Owner.SetPosition(this, value);
			}
		}

		public SizeF Size
		{
			get
			{
				return size;
			}
			set
			{
				Owner.SetSize(this, value);
			}
		}

		private List Owner { get; }

		private SelectionItemData(List owner, int id, string name, ConditionStringInfo condition, bool? selected, PointFloat position, SizeF size)
			: this(owner, id, -1, name, condition, selected, aggregated: false, sortedAsc: false, sortedDesc: false, groupedBy: false, FKState.NoFK)
		{
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Position = position;
			Size = size;
		}

		private SelectionItemData(List owner, int id, int parent, string name, ConditionStringInfo condition, bool? selected, bool aggregated, bool sortedAsc, bool sortedDesc, bool groupedBy, FKState foreignKey)
			: base(id, parent, name, selected)
		{
			Owner = owner;
			Condition = condition;
			Aggregated = aggregated;
			SortedAsc = sortedAsc;
			SortedDesc = sortedDesc;
			GroupedBy = groupedBy;
			ForeignKey = foreignKey;
		}

		protected override void SetSelected(bool? value)
		{
			Owner.SetSelected(this, value, update: true);
		}

		protected override void SetName(string value)
		{
			Owner.SetName(this, value, update: true);
		}
	}

	public class AsaStrategy : DbStrategyBase
	{
		private DataAccessAsaProviderFactory factory;

		public override ConnectionParameterEdits Subscriptions => ConnectionParameterEdits.ServerType;

		protected override ProviderFactory Factory => (ProviderFactory)(object)(factory ?? (factory = new DataAccessAsaProviderFactory()));

		public override bool CanGetDatabases => false;

		public override ConnectionParameterEdits GetEditsSet(IConnectionParametersControl control)
		{
			return (ConnectionParameterEdits)(0x61 | (control.ServerBased ? 131204 : 2));
		}

		public override string GetDefaultText(ConnectionParameterEdits edit)
		{
			switch (edit)
			{
			case ConnectionParameterEdits.FileName:
			case ConnectionParameterEdits.ServerName:
			case ConnectionParameterEdits.UserName:
			case ConnectionParameterEdits.Password:
				return string.Empty;
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		public override DataConnectionParametersBase GetConnectionParameters(IConnectionParametersControl control)
		{
			if (!control.ServerBased)
			{
				return new AsaConnectionParameters(control.FileName, control.UserName, control.Password);
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(control.Hostname))
			{
				return new AsaConnectionParameters(control.ServerName, control.Hostname, control.Database, control.UserName, control.Password);
			}
			return new AsaConnectionParameters(control.ServerName, control.Database, control.UserName, control.Password);
		}

		public override string GetConnectionName(IConnectionParametersControl control)
		{
			if (!control.ServerBased)
			{
				return FileDbStrategyBase.GetConnectionName(control.FileName);
			}
			return ServerDbStrategyBase.GetConnectionName(control.ServerName, control.Database);
		}

		public override void InitializeControl(IConnectionParametersControl control, DataConnectionParametersBase value)
		{
			base.InitializeControl(control, value);
			AsaConnectionParameters asaConnectionParameters = (AsaConnectionParameters)value;
			switch (asaConnectionParameters.ConnectionType)
			{
			case AsaConnectionType.ServerBased:
				control.ServerBased = true;
				control.ServerName = asaConnectionParameters.ServerName;
				control.Database = asaConnectionParameters.DatabaseName;
				break;
			case AsaConnectionType.File:
				control.ServerBased = false;
				control.FileName = asaConnectionParameters.FileName;
				break;
			default:
				throw new ArgumentException();
			}
			control.UserName = asaConnectionParameters.UserName;
			control.Password = asaConnectionParameters.Password;
		}

		public override int GetDefaultIndex(ConnectionParameterEdits edit)
		{
			if (edit != ConnectionParameterEdits.ServerType)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return 0;
		}
	}

	public class BigQueryStrategy : ServerDbStrategyBase
	{
		private const ConnectionParameterEdits editsKeyFile = ConnectionParameterEdits.KeyFileName | ConnectionParameterEdits.ServiceEmail;

		private const ConnectionParameterEdits editsOAuth = ConnectionParameterEdits.OAuthClientID | ConnectionParameterEdits.OAuthClientSecret | ConnectionParameterEdits.OAuthRefreshToken;

		private DataAccessBigQueryProviderFactory factory;

		public override ConnectionParameterEdits Subscriptions => ConnectionParameterEdits.AuthTypeBigQuery;

		protected override ProviderFactory Factory => (ProviderFactory)(object)ProviderFactory;

		private DataAccessBigQueryProviderFactory ProviderFactory => factory ?? (factory = new DataAccessBigQueryProviderFactory());

		public override bool CanGetDatabases => ProviderFactory.Legacy;

		public override ConnectionParameterEdits GetEditsSet(IConnectionParametersControl control)
		{
			return (ConnectionParameterEdits)(0x20010600 | ((control.AuthTypeBigQuery == BigQueryAuthorizationType.PrivateKeyFile) ? 6144 : 57344));
		}

		public override int GetDefaultIndex(ConnectionParameterEdits edit)
		{
			return 1;
		}

		public override string GetDefaultText(ConnectionParameterEdits edit)
		{
			switch (edit)
			{
			case ConnectionParameterEdits.ProjectID:
			case ConnectionParameterEdits.DataSetID:
			case ConnectionParameterEdits.KeyFileName:
			case ConnectionParameterEdits.ServiceEmail:
			case ConnectionParameterEdits.OAuthClientSecret:
			case ConnectionParameterEdits.OAuthRefreshToken:
				return string.Empty;
			case ConnectionParameterEdits.OAuthClientID:
				return "***.apps.googleusercontent.com";
			default:
				return base.GetDefaultText(edit);
			}
		}

		public override DataConnectionParametersBase GetConnectionParameters(IConnectionParametersControl control)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(control.Dsn))
			{
				return new BigQueryConnectionParameters(control.Dsn);
			}
			return control.AuthTypeBigQuery switch
			{
				BigQueryAuthorizationType.OAuth => new BigQueryConnectionParameters(control.ProjectID, control.DataSetID, control.OAuthClientID, control.OAuthClientSecret, control.OAuthRefreshToken), 
				BigQueryAuthorizationType.PrivateKeyFile => new BigQueryConnectionParameters(control.ProjectID, control.DataSetID, control.ServiceEmail, control.KeyFileName), 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException(), 
			};
		}

		public override void InitializeControl(IConnectionParametersControl control, DataConnectionParametersBase value)
		{
			base.InitializeControl(control, value);
			if (value is BigQueryConnectionParameters bigQueryConnectionParameters)
			{
				control.ProjectID = bigQueryConnectionParameters.ProjectID;
				control.DataSetID = bigQueryConnectionParameters.DataSetID;
				control.AuthTypeBigQuery = bigQueryConnectionParameters.AuthorizationType;
				control.KeyFileName = ((bigQueryConnectionParameters.AuthorizationType == BigQueryAuthorizationType.PrivateKeyFile) ? bigQueryConnectionParameters.PrivateKeyFileName : string.Empty);
				control.ServiceEmail = ((bigQueryConnectionParameters.AuthorizationType == BigQueryAuthorizationType.PrivateKeyFile) ? bigQueryConnectionParameters.ServiceAccountEmail : string.Empty);
				control.OAuthClientID = ((bigQueryConnectionParameters.AuthorizationType == BigQueryAuthorizationType.OAuth) ? bigQueryConnectionParameters.OAuthClientID : string.Empty);
				control.OAuthClientSecret = ((bigQueryConnectionParameters.AuthorizationType == BigQueryAuthorizationType.OAuth) ? bigQueryConnectionParameters.OAuthClientSecret : string.Empty);
				control.OAuthRefreshToken = ((bigQueryConnectionParameters.AuthorizationType == BigQueryAuthorizationType.OAuth) ? bigQueryConnectionParameters.OAuthRefreshToken : string.Empty);
				control.Dsn = bigQueryConnectionParameters.Dsn;
			}
		}

		public override IEnumerable<string> GetDatabases(IConnectionParametersControl control)
		{
			return control.AuthTypeBigQuery switch
			{
				BigQueryAuthorizationType.OAuth => ProviderFactory.GetDatabases(control.ProjectID, control.OAuthClientID, control.OAuthClientSecret, control.OAuthRefreshToken), 
				BigQueryAuthorizationType.PrivateKeyFile => ((ProviderFactory)ProviderFactory).GetDatabases(control.ProjectID, control.KeyFileName, control.ServiceEmail), 
				_ => new string[0], 
			};
		}
	}

	public abstract class DbStrategyBase : IConnectionParametersStrategy
	{
		public virtual ConnectionParameterEdits Subscriptions => ConnectionParameterEdits.None;

		public virtual string FileNameFilter => Factory.FileFilter;

		public virtual bool CanGetDatabases => false;

		protected abstract ProviderFactory Factory { get; }

		public abstract ConnectionParameterEdits GetEditsSet(IConnectionParametersControl control);

		public virtual ConnectionParameterEdits GetDisabledEdits(IConnectionParametersControl control)
		{
			return ConnectionParameterEdits.None;
		}

		public abstract string GetDefaultText(ConnectionParameterEdits edit);

		public virtual int GetDefaultIndex(ConnectionParameterEdits edit)
		{
			return -1;
		}

		public abstract DataConnectionParametersBase GetConnectionParameters(IConnectionParametersControl control);

		public abstract string GetConnectionName(IConnectionParametersControl control);

		public virtual IEnumerable<string> GetDatabases(IConnectionParametersControl control)
		{
			yield break;
		}

		public virtual void InitializeControl(IConnectionParametersControl control, DataConnectionParametersBase value)
		{
			if (value is IConnectionPagePort connectionPagePort)
			{
				control.Port = connectionPagePort.PortNumber.ToString();
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class FileDbStrategyBase : DbStrategyBase
	{
		protected const string DefaultConnectionName = "Connection";

		public override ConnectionParameterEdits GetEditsSet(IConnectionParametersControl control)
		{
			return ConnectionParameterEdits.FileName | ConnectionParameterEdits.Password;
		}

		public override string GetDefaultText(ConnectionParameterEdits edit)
		{
			if (edit != ConnectionParameterEdits.FileName && edit != ConnectionParameterEdits.Password)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		public override string GetConnectionName(IConnectionParametersControl control)
		{
			return GetConnectionName(control.FileName);
		}

		public static string GetConnectionName(string filename)
		{
			string text;
			try
			{
				text = Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(filename);
			}
			catch
			{
				text = filename;
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return text;
			}
			return "Connection";
		}
	}
	public class FirebirdStrategy : DbStrategyBase
	{
		private FirebirdProviderFactory factory;

		public override ConnectionParameterEdits Subscriptions => ConnectionParameterEdits.ServerType;

		protected override ProviderFactory Factory => (ProviderFactory)(object)(factory ?? (factory = new FirebirdProviderFactory()));

		public override bool CanGetDatabases => false;

		public override ConnectionParameterEdits GetEditsSet(IConnectionParametersControl control)
		{
			return (ConnectionParameterEdits)(0x61 | (control.ServerBased ? 140 : 2097154));
		}

		public override string GetDefaultText(ConnectionParameterEdits edit)
		{
			switch (edit)
			{
			case ConnectionParameterEdits.FileName:
			case ConnectionParameterEdits.ServerName:
			case ConnectionParameterEdits.UserName:
			case ConnectionParameterEdits.Password:
				return string.Empty;
			case ConnectionParameterEdits.Port:
				return 3050.ToString();
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		public override DataConnectionParametersBase GetConnectionParameters(IConnectionParametersControl control)
		{
			if (!control.ServerBased)
			{
				FireBirdConnectionParameters fireBirdConnectionParameters = new FireBirdConnectionParameters(control.FileName, control.UserName, control.Password);
				if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(control.ClientLibrary))
				{
					fireBirdConnectionParameters.ClientLibrary = control.ClientLibrary;
				}
				return fireBirdConnectionParameters;
			}
			string text = control.Port.Trim();
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return new FireBirdConnectionParameters(control.ServerName, int.Parse(text), control.Database, control.UserName, control.Password);
			}
			return new FireBirdConnectionParameters(control.ServerName, control.Database, control.UserName, control.Password);
		}

		public override string GetConnectionName(IConnectionParametersControl control)
		{
			if (!control.ServerBased)
			{
				return FileDbStrategyBase.GetConnectionName(control.FileName);
			}
			return ServerDbStrategyBase.GetConnectionName(control.ServerName, control.Database);
		}

		public override void InitializeControl(IConnectionParametersControl control, DataConnectionParametersBase value)
		{
			base.InitializeControl(control, value);
			FireBirdConnectionParameters fireBirdConnectionParameters = (FireBirdConnectionParameters)value;
			switch (fireBirdConnectionParameters.ConnectionType)
			{
			case FireBirdConnectionType.ServerBased:
				control.ServerBased = true;
				control.ServerName = fireBirdConnectionParameters.ServerName;
				control.Database = fireBirdConnectionParameters.DatabaseName;
				break;
			case FireBirdConnectionType.Embedded:
				control.ServerBased = false;
				control.FileName = fireBirdConnectionParameters.FileName;
				control.ClientLibrary = fireBirdConnectionParameters.ClientLibrary;
				break;
			default:
				throw new ArgumentException();
			}
			control.UserName = fireBirdConnectionParameters.UserName;
			control.Password = fireBirdConnectionParameters.Password;
		}

		public override int GetDefaultIndex(ConnectionParameterEdits edit)
		{
			if (edit != ConnectionParameterEdits.ServerType)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return 0;
		}
	}

	public class MsSqlServerStrategy : ServerDbStrategyBase
	{
		private MSSqlProviderFactory factory;

		public override ConnectionParameterEdits Subscriptions => ConnectionParameterEdits.AuthTypeMsSql;

		protected override ProviderFactory Factory => (ProviderFactory)(object)(factory ?? (factory = new DataAccessMSSqlProviderFactory()));

		public override bool CanGetDatabases => true;

		public override IEnumerable<string> GetDatabases(IConnectionParametersControl control)
		{
			return control.AuthTypeMsSql switch
			{
				MsSqlAuthorizationType.SqlServer => Factory.GetDatabases(control.ServerNameLookup, control.UserName, control.Password), 
				MsSqlAuthorizationType.Windows => Factory.GetDatabases(control.ServerNameLookup, string.Empty, string.Empty), 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException(), 
			};
		}

		public override ConnectionParameterEdits GetEditsSet(IConnectionParametersControl control)
		{
			return ConnectionParameterEdits.AuthTypeMsSql | ConnectionParameterEdits.UserName | ConnectionParameterEdits.Password | ConnectionParameterEdits.Database | ConnectionParameterEdits.ServerNameLookup;
		}

		public override ConnectionParameterEdits GetDisabledEdits(IConnectionParametersControl control)
		{
			if (control.AuthTypeMsSql != MsSqlAuthorizationType.Windows)
			{
				return ConnectionParameterEdits.None;
			}
			return ConnectionParameterEdits.UserName | ConnectionParameterEdits.Password;
		}

		public override string GetDefaultText(ConnectionParameterEdits edit)
		{
			if (edit == ConnectionParameterEdits.ServerNameLookup)
			{
				return "localhost";
			}
			return base.GetDefaultText(edit);
		}

		public override int GetDefaultIndex(ConnectionParameterEdits edit)
		{
			if (edit != ConnectionParameterEdits.AuthTypeMsSql)
			{
				return base.GetDefaultIndex(edit);
			}
			return 0;
		}

		public override DataConnectionParametersBase GetConnectionParameters(IConnectionParametersControl control)
		{
			return control.AuthTypeMsSql switch
			{
				MsSqlAuthorizationType.SqlServer => new MsSqlConnectionParameters(control.ServerNameLookup, control.Database, control.UserName, control.Password, MsSqlAuthorizationType.SqlServer), 
				MsSqlAuthorizationType.Windows => new MsSqlConnectionParameters(control.ServerNameLookup, control.Database, string.Empty, string.Empty, MsSqlAuthorizationType.Windows), 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException(), 
			};
		}

		public override void InitializeControl(IConnectionParametersControl control, DataConnectionParametersBase value)
		{
			base.InitializeControl(control, value);
			MsSqlConnectionParameters msSqlConnectionParameters = (MsSqlConnectionParameters)value;
			control.ServerNameLookup = msSqlConnectionParameters.ServerName;
			control.Database = msSqlConnectionParameters.DatabaseName;
			control.UserName = msSqlConnectionParameters.UserName ?? string.Empty;
			control.Password = msSqlConnectionParameters.Password ?? string.Empty;
			control.AuthTypeMsSql = msSqlConnectionParameters.AuthorizationType;
		}
	}

	public abstract class ServerDbStrategyBase : DbStrategyBase
	{
		public override ConnectionParameterEdits GetEditsSet(IConnectionParametersControl control)
		{
			return ConnectionParameterEdits.ServerName | ConnectionParameterEdits.UserName | ConnectionParameterEdits.Password | ConnectionParameterEdits.Database;
		}

		public override string GetDefaultText(ConnectionParameterEdits edit)
		{
			switch (edit)
			{
			case ConnectionParameterEdits.ServerName:
				return "localhost";
			case ConnectionParameterEdits.UserName:
			case ConnectionParameterEdits.Password:
			case ConnectionParameterEdits.Database:
				return string.Empty;
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		public override string GetConnectionName(IConnectionParametersControl control)
		{
			string serverName = control.ServerName;
			string database = control.Database;
			return GetConnectionName(serverName, database);
		}

		public static string GetConnectionName(string server, string db)
		{
			return string.Join("_", new string[3] { server, db, "Connection" }.Where((string s) => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(s)).ToArray());
		}

		public override IEnumerable<string> GetDatabases(IConnectionParametersControl control)
		{
			return Factory.GetDatabases(control.ServerName, control.UserName, control.Password);
		}
	}

		{

				{
					dictionary.Add(storageTables, value: false);
				}
			}
			if (types.HasFlag(DataObjectTypes.Views))
			{
				foreach (string storageTables2 in GetStorageTablesList("SELECT VIEW_NAME, t.SCHEMA_NAME FROM SYS.VIEWS t join SYS.SCHEMAS s on s.SCHEMA_NAME = t.SCHEMA_NAME where not (t.SCHEMA_NAME = 'SYS' or t.SCHEMA_NAME like '_SYS_%' or s.SCHEMA_OWNER like '_SYS_%');", stripKnownSchema: true, connectionOptions))

		}

		void ISqlSchemaExplorer.GetColumns(IConnectionOptions connectionOptions, params DBTable[] tables)
		{

			{

			}
		}

		private DBTable[] GetStorageDataObjects(bool includeColumns, bool isView, IConnectionOptions connectionOptions, params string[] tablesList)
		{
			string[] storageDataObjectsNames = ((ISqlSchemaExplorer)this).GetStorageDataObjectsNames(connectionOptions, (!isView) ? DataObjectTypes.Tables : DataObjectTypes.Views);
			IEnumerable<string> enumerable;
			if (tablesList.Length != 0)
			{
				enumerable = storageDataObjectsNames.Where((string n) => tablesList.Select(((ISupportDefaultSchema)this).RemoveDefaultSchema).Any((string f) => f == n));
			}
			else
			{
				IEnumerable<string> enumerable2 = storageDataObjectsNames;
				enumerable = enumerable2;
			}
			IEnumerable<string> source = enumerable;
			List<DBTable> list = source.Select((string p) => ConnectionProviderHelper.CreateTable(p, isView)).ToList();
			if (list.Count > 0)
			{
				if (includeColumns)
				{
					GetStorageTablesColumns(list, tablesList.Length != 0, connectionOptions);
				}
				if (!isView)
				{
					GetStorageTablesForeignKeys(list, tablesList.Length != 0, connectionOptions);
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private void GetStorageTablesColumns(ICollection<DBTable> tables, bool useTablesFilter, IConnectionOptions connectionOptions)
		{
			foreach (DBTable table in tables)
			{
				GetColumns(table, connectionOptions);
			}
		}

		{
			ReadersHelper.ReadStruct(reader, (ChunkedList<T?>)list, i, delegate(IDataReader r, int index)
			{
				object value = r.GetValue(index);
				return (T)Convert.ChangeType(value, typeof(T));
			});
		}
	}

		private void GetStorageTablesForeignKeys(IEnumerable<DBTable> tables)
		{
			//IL_00e3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00e8: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00fa: Expected O, but got Unknown
			foreach (DBTable table in tables)
			{
				if (table.IsView)
				{
					continue;
				}
				table.ForeignKeys.Clear();
				try
				{
					XPVistaDBTableSchema xPVistaDBTableSchema = DataBase.TableSchema(((ConnectionProviderSql)this).ComposeSafeTableName(table.Name));
					List<XPVistaDBRelationshipInformation> foreignKeys = xPVistaDBTableSchema.GetForeignKeys();
					if (foreignKeys == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					foreach (XPVistaDBRelationshipInformation item in foreignKeys)
					{
						StringCollection stringCollection = SplitColumnsDefinition(item.ForeignKey);
						XPVistaDBTableSchema xPVistaDBTableSchema2 = DataBase.TableSchema(item.PrimaryTable);
						XPVistaDBIndexInformation xPVistaDBIndexInformation = xPVistaDBTableSchema2.GetIndices()?.FirstOrDefault((XPVistaDBIndexInformation i) => i.Primary);
						if (xPVistaDBIndexInformation != null)
						{
							StringCollection stringCollection2 = SplitColumnsDefinition(xPVistaDBIndexInformation.KeyExpression);
							table.ForeignKeys.Add(new DBForeignKey((ICollection)stringCollection, item.PrimaryTable, stringCollection2)
							{
								Name = item.Name
							});
						}
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
		}

		private static StringCollection SplitColumnsDefinition(string foreignKey)

			}

		}

		public static Type GetAggregateFunctionResultType(AggregationType aggregationType, DBColumnType columnType)
		{

		public static string EscapeAlias(string alias, string lead, string end)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(alias) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(lead) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(end))
			{
				return alias;
			}
			string text = alias.Replace(lead, Twice(lead));
			if (lead != end)
			{
				text = text.Replace(end, Twice(end));
			}
			return text;
		}

		public static string EncloseAlias(string alias, string lead, string end)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(alias) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(lead) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(end))
			{
				return alias;
			}
			return lead + EscapeAlias(alias, lead, end) + end;
		}

		private static string Twice(string value)
		{
			return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}{0}", new object[1] { value });
		}

		public static string ExpandProperty(string property, string prefix)
		{
			if (property != null)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}{1} {2}", new object[3]
				{
					Environment.NewLine,
					prefix,
					property
				});
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static string ApplyDistinct(string sql)
		{
			int num = sql.IndexOf("select ", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
			sql = sql.Insert(num + "select ".Length, "distinct ");
			return sql;
		}

		public static string GetDataObjectTypeCondition(DataObjectTypes types, string includeTablesCondition, string includeViewsCondition)
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			if ((types & DataObjectTypes.Tables) != 0)
			{
				text += includeTablesCondition;
			}
			if ((types & DataObjectTypes.Tables) != 0 && (types & DataObjectTypes.Views) != 0)
			{
				text += " or ";
			}
			if ((types & DataObjectTypes.Views) != 0)
			{
				text += includeViewsCondition;
			}
			return text;
		}

		internal static string FormatFloatingPointConstant(IConvertible value)
		{
			string text = value.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			if (!Regex.IsMatch(text, "[.eE]"))
			{
				text += ".0";
			}
			return text;
		}

		internal static string ExponentToFloatingPoint(string str)
		{
			Regex regex = new Regex("^(?<sign>[+\\-]?)0*(?<integral>(?:[1-9]\\d*)?)(?:\\.(?<fractional>\\d*))?e(?<exponent>[+\\-]?\\d+)$", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
			Match match = regex.Match(str);
			if (!match.Success)
			{
				return str;
			}
			bool flag = match.Groups["sign"].Value.Equals("-", StringComparison.Ordinal);
			string value = match.Groups["integral"].Value;
			string value2 = match.Groups["fractional"].Value;
			int num = int.Parse(match.Groups["exponent"].Value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			num += value.Length;
			string text = value + value2;
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			if (flag)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append('-');
			}
			if (num <= 0)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append("0.");
				stringBuilder.Append('0', -num);
				stringBuilder.Append(text);
			}
			else
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(text);
				if (num < text.Length)
				{
					stringBuilder.Insert(num + (flag ? 1 : 0), '.');
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.Append('0', num - text.Length);
					stringBuilder.Append(".0");
				}
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public static DBStoredProcedureResultSet GetResultSetFromCommand(ConnectionProviderSql provider, IDbCommand command, CommandBehavior commandBehavior = CommandBehavior.Default)
		{
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0020: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_009c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a1: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ba: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_003e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			List<DBStoredProcedureResultSet> list = new List<DBStoredProcedureResultSet>();
			using (IDataReader dataReader = ColumnarDataLoaderHelper.InternalExecuteReader(provider, command, commandBehavior, CancellationToken.None))
			{
				do
				{
					HashSet<string> names = new HashSet<string>();
					DBStoredProcedureResultSet val = new DBStoredProcedureResultSet();
					System.Data.DataTable schemaTable = dataReader.GetSchemaTable();
					if (schemaTable == null)
					{
						for (int i = 0; i < dataReader.FieldCount; i++)
						{
							DBColumnType columnType = DBColumn.GetColumnType(dataReader.GetFieldType(i));

						}

					{

				}
				while (dataReader.NextResult());
				dataReader.Close();
			}
			if (list.Count <= 1)
			{
				return list[0];
			}
			return (DBStoredProcedureResultSet)(object)new StoredProcedureResultSet
			{
				ResultSets = list.ToArray()
			};
		}

		}

		public static Dictionary<string, DBTable> CreateTablesDictionary(ICollection<DBTable> tables, bool clearColumns, bool clearForeignKeys, IEqualityComparer<string> comparer)
		{
			Dictionary<string, DBTable> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, DBTable>(comparer);
			foreach (DBTable table in tables)
			{
				if (clearColumns)
				{
					table.Columns.Clear();
				}
				if (clearForeignKeys)
				{
					table.ForeignKeys.Clear();
				}
				dictionary.Add(table.Name, table);
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		internal static XPVistaDBDatabase GetVistaDBDataBase(IDbConnection connection)
		{
			XPVistaDBDA vistaDBDA = XPVistaDBDA.GetVistaDBDA(connection.GetType());
			if (connection.State == ConnectionState.Open && vistaDBDA.GetConnectionOpenmode(connection) == "ExclusiveReadWrite")
			{
				connection.Close();

			string encryptionKeyString = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(vistaDBDA.GetConnectionPassword(connection)) ? null : vistaDBDA.GetConnectionPassword(connection));
			return vistaDBDA.OpenDatabase(vistaDBDA.GetConnectionSource(connection), "NonexclusiveReadWrite", encryptionKeyString);
		}

				return false;

			if (x.Name != y.Name)

	public class DBTableEqualityComparer : IEqualityComparer<DBTable>
	{
		public bool Equals(DBTable x, DBTable y)
		{
			if (x == null && y == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (x == null || y == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (x.Name != y.Name)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (x.IsView != y.IsView)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!new DBIndexEqualityComparer().Equals((DBIndex)(object)x.PrimaryKey, (DBIndex)(object)y.PrimaryKey))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (x.Columns.Count != y.Columns.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < x.Columns.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!new DBColumnEqualityComparer().Equals(x.Columns[i], y.Columns[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (x.Indexes.Count != y.Indexes.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < x.Indexes.Count; j++)
			{
				if (!new DBIndexEqualityComparer().Equals(x.Indexes[j], y.Indexes[j]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (x.ForeignKeys.Count != y.ForeignKeys.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int k = 0; k < x.ForeignKeys.Count; k++)
			{
				if (!new DBForeignKeyEqualityComparer().Equals(x.ForeignKeys[k], y.ForeignKeys[k]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public int GetHashCode(DBTable table)
		{
			return table.Name.GetHashCode();
		}
	}
	public class DBSchemaEqualityComparer : IEqualityComparer<DBSchema>
	{
		private readonly DBTableEqualityComparer tableComparer = new DBTableEqualityComparer();

		public bool Equals(DBSchema x, DBSchema y)
		{
			if (x == null && y == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (x == null || y == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (x.Tables.Length != y.Tables.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < x.Tables.Length; i++)
			{
				if (!tableComparer.Equals(x.Tables[i], y.Tables[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (x.Views.Length != y.Views.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < x.Views.Length; j++)
			{
				if (!tableComparer.Equals(x.Views[j], y.Views[j]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public int GetHashCode(DBSchema schema)
		{
			if (!schema.Tables.Any())
			{
				return base.GetHashCode();
			}
			return schema.Tables[0].Name.GetHashCode();
		}
	}
	internal class StringCollectionEqualityComparer : IEqualityComparer<StringCollection>
	{
		public bool Equals(StringCollection x, StringCollection y)
		{
			if (x == null && y == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (x == null || y == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (x.Count != y.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < x.Count; i++)
			{
				if (x[i] != y[i])
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public int GetHashCode(StringCollection collection)
		{
			return collection.OfType<string>().Aggregate((string result, string next) => result + next).GetHashCode();
		}

		public override string GetParameterName(OperandValue parameter, int index, ref bool createParameter)

				}

			{
				createParameter = false;
				switch (DXTypeExtensions.GetTypeCode(value.GetType()))
				{

					if (!(bool)value)
					{
						return "false";
					}
					return "true";

					return $"'{(char)value}'";

			{
				return "?";
			}
			return "@p" + index.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);

		private static string FormatArithmeticFunction(FunctionOperatorType operatorType, params string[] operands)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0003: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

					{

		public override string FormatFunction(ProcessParameter processParameter, FunctionOperatorType operatorType, params object[] operands)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0003: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0153: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_012f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0150: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0106: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_012d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_007f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0089: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if ((int)operatorType != 19)
			{
				if ((int)operatorType == 46 && legacy)
				{
					object obj = operands[1];
					OperandParameter val = (OperandParameter)((obj is OperandParameter) ? obj : null);
					if (val == null)
					{
						object obj2 = operands[1];
						OperandValue val2 = (OperandValue)((obj2 is OperandValue) ? obj2 : null);
						if (val2 != null)
						{
							string text = val2.Value.ToString();
							int num = text.IndexOfAny(achtungChars);
							if (num < 0)
							{
								return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "({0} LIKE {1})", new object[2]
								{
									processParameter.Invoke(operands[0]),
									processParameter.Invoke((object)new ConstantValue((object)(text + "%")))
								});
							}
							if (num > 0)
							{
								return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "(SUBSTR({0}, 0, LENGTH({1})) = {1})", new object[2]
								{
									processParameter.Invoke(operands[0]),
									processParameter.Invoke((object)val2)
								});
							}
						}
					}
					return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "(SUBSTR({0}, 0, LENGTH({1})) = ({1}))", new object[2]
					{
						processParameter.Invoke(operands[0]),
						processParameter.Invoke(operands[1])
					});
				}
			}
			else if (!legacy)
			{
				switch (operands.Length)
				{
				case 3:
					return string.Format((IFormatProvider)new ProcessParameterInvariantCulture(processParameter), "CONCAT(SUBSTR({0}, 0, {1} + 1), SUBSTR({0}, {1} + {2} + 1))", new object[3]
					{
						operands[0],
						operands[1],
						operands[2]
					});
				case 2:
					return string.Format((IFormatProvider)new ProcessParameterInvariantCulture(processParameter), "(SUBSTR({0}, 0, {1} + 1))", new object[2]
					{
						operands[0],
						operands[1]
					});
				}
			}
			return ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).FormatFunction(processParameter, operatorType, operands);
		}

		public override string FormatSelect(string selectedPropertiesSql, string fromSql, string whereSql, string orderBySql, string groupBySql, string havingSql, int topSelectedRecords)
		{
			string text = ((whereSql != null) ? string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}where {1}", new object[2]
			{
				Environment.NewLine,
				whereSql
			}) : string.Empty);
			string text2 = ((orderBySql != null) ? string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}order by {1}", new object[2]
			{
				Environment.NewLine,
				orderBySql
			}) : string.Empty);
			string text3 = ((havingSql != null) ? string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}having {1}", new object[2]
			{
				Environment.NewLine,
				havingSql
			}) : string.Empty);
			string text4 = ((groupBySql != null) ? string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}group by {1}", new object[2]
			{
				Environment.NewLine,
				groupBySql
			}) : string.Empty);
			string text5 = ((topSelectedRecords != 0) ? string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0}limit {1}", new object[2]
			{
				Environment.NewLine,
				topSelectedRecords
			}) : string.Empty);
			if (legacy && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(fromSql) && fromSql.StartsWith("(") && fromSql.EndsWith(")"))
			{
				fromSql = fromSql.Substring(1, fromSql.Length - 2);
			}
			return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "select {0} from {1}{2}{3}{4}{5}{6}", selectedPropertiesSql, fromSql, text, text4, text3, text2, text5);
		}

		string[] ISqlSchemaExplorer.GetStorageDataObjectsNames(IConnectionOptions connectionOptions, DataObjectTypes types)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			try
			{
				if (((ConnectionProviderSql)this).Connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
				{
					((ConnectionProviderSql)this).Connection.Open();
				}
				if (legacy)
				{
					Type type = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).Connection.GetType();
					GetObjectNames(type, list, (types & DataObjectTypes.Tables) != 0, "GetTableNames");
					GetObjectNames(type, list, (types & DataObjectTypes.Views) != 0, "GetViewNames");
				}
				else
				{
					if (types.HasFlag(DataObjectTypes.Tables))
					{
						GetObjectNames(connectionOptions, list, "SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE table_type = \"BASE TABLE\";");
					}
					if (types.HasFlag(DataObjectTypes.Views))
					{
						GetObjectNames(connectionOptions, list, "SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.VIEWS;");
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (connectionOptions.CloseConnection && ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).Connection.State == ConnectionState.Open)
				{
					((ConnectionProviderSql)this).Connection.Close();
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private void GetObjectNames(Type connectionType, List<string> result, bool condition, string methodName)
		{
			if (condition && connectionType.GetMethod(methodName)?.Invoke(((ConnectionProviderSql)this).Connection, new object[0]) is string[] collection)
			{
				result.AddRange(collection);
			}
		}

		private void GetObjectNames(IConnectionOptions connectionOptions, List<string> result, string query)
		{
			ColumnarDataLoaderFactory.GetColumnarDataLoader((IDataStore)(object)this).ExecuteDbCommand(connectionOptions, delegate(IDbCommand command)
			{
				command.CommandText = query;
				Type type = XPTypeActivator.GetType("System.Data", "System.Data.Odbc.OdbcDataAdapter", false) ?? XPTypeActivator.GetType("System.Data.Odbc", "System.Data.Odbc.OdbcDataAdapter", true);
				IDbDataAdapter dbDataAdapter = (IDbDataAdapter)Activator.CreateInstance(type);
				dbDataAdapter.SelectCommand = command;
				DataSet dataSet = new DataSet();
				dbDataAdapter.Fill(dataSet);
				System.Data.DataTable dataTable = dataSet.Tables[0];
				foreach (DataRow row in dataTable.Rows)
				{
					result.Add(row[2].ToString() ?? "");
				}
			});
		}

		void ISqlSchemaExplorer.GetColumns(IConnectionOptions connectionOptions, params DBTable[] tables)
		{
			if (legacy)
			{
				GetColumnsLegacy(connectionOptions, tables);
				return;
			}
			ColumnarDataLoaderFactory.GetColumnarDataLoader((IDataStore)(object)this).ExecuteDbCommand(connectionOptions, delegate(IDbCommand command)
			{
				DBTable[] array = tables;
				foreach (DBTable val in array)
				{
					command.CommandText = "SELECT * FROM " + val.Name + ";";

		public override string GetParameterName(OperandValue parameter, int index, ref bool createParameter)
		{
			//IL_00ec: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00f8: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00b3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00bf: Expected O, but got Unknown
			bool flag = createParameter;
			OperandParameter val = (OperandParameter)(object)((parameter is OperandParameter) ? parameter : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				createParameter = true;
				return "@" + val.ParameterName;
			}
			object value = parameter.Value;
			if (value != null && value != DBNull.Value)
			{
				createParameter = false;
				switch (DXTypeExtensions.GetTypeCode(value.GetType()))
				{
				case TypeCode.Char:
					return $"'{value}'";
				case TypeCode.DateTime:
					return "convert(datetime, '" + ((DateTime)value).ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH':'mm':'ss", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + "', 120)";
				case TypeCode.Boolean:
				case TypeCode.String:
					return base.GetParameterName((OperandValue)new ConstantValue(parameter.Value), index, ref createParameter);
				case TypeCode.Single:
				case TypeCode.Double:
				case TypeCode.Decimal:
					return ConnectionProviderHelper.FormatFloatingPointConstant((IConvertible)value);
				}
				if (value is IConvertible convertible)
				{
					return convertible.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				}
			}
			createParameter = flag;
			return base.GetParameterName((OperandValue)new ConstantValue(parameter.Value), index, ref createParameter);
		}

		public override string FormatFunction(FunctionOperatorType operatorType, params string[] operands)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0003: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0005: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_004c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if ((int)operatorType != 116)
			{
				if ((int)operatorType == 136)
				{
					return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "DATEADD(dd, {1}, {0})", new object[2]
					{
						operands[0],
						operands[1]
					});
				}
				return base.FormatFunction(operatorType, operands);
			}
			return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "DATEADD(dd, DATEDIFF(dd, 0, {0}), 0)", new object[1] { operands[0] });
		}

					processParameter.Invoke(operands[1])
				});
			}
			return base.FormatFunction(processParameter, operatorType, operands);
		}

		private DBTable[] GetStorageDataObjects(bool includeColumns, bool isView, IConnectionOptions connectionOptions, params string[] tablesList)
		{
			string[] storageDataObjectsNames = ((ISqlSchemaExplorer)this).GetStorageDataObjectsNames(connectionOptions, (!isView) ? DataObjectTypes.Tables : DataObjectTypes.Views);
			IEnumerable<string> enumerable;
			if (tablesList.Length != 0)
			{
				enumerable = storageDataObjectsNames.Where((string n) => tablesList.Select(((ISupportDefaultSchema)this).RemoveDefaultSchema).Any((string f) => f == n));
			}
			else
			{
				IEnumerable<string> enumerable2 = storageDataObjectsNames;
				enumerable = enumerable2;
			}
			IEnumerable<string> source = enumerable;
			List<DBTable> list = source.Select((string p) => ConnectionProviderHelper.CreateTable(p, isView)).ToList();
			if (list.Count > 0)
			{
				if (includeColumns)
				{
					GetStorageTablesColumns(list, tablesList.Length != 0, connectionOptions, (!isView) ? DataObjectTypes.Tables : DataObjectTypes.Views);
				}
				if (!isView)
				{
					GetStorageTablesForeignKeys(list, tablesList.Length != 0, connectionOptions);
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		DBStoredProcedureResultSet ISupportStoredProc.GetStoredProcedureTableSchema(string procedureName, IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters, IConnectionOptions connectionOptions)
		{
			try
			{
				IDbCommand command = ((ISpSupportColumnarDataLoader)this).CreateCommand();
				IParameter[] array = (parameters as IParameter[]) ?? parameters.ToArray();
				PrepareCommandForStoredProc(command, procedureName, ((IEnumerable<IParameter>)array).Select((Func<IParameter, OperandParameter>)((IParameter p) => new OperandParameter(((IFilterParameter)p).Name, p.Value))).ToArray());
				DBStoredProcedureResultSet resultSetFromCommand = ConnectionProviderHelper.GetResultSetFromCommand((ConnectionProviderSql)(object)this, command, CommandBehavior.SchemaOnly);
				if (resultSetFromCommand.Columns.Count != 0)
				{
					return resultSetFromCommand;
				}
				StoredProcedureResultSet obj = resultSetFromCommand as StoredProcedureResultSet;
				if (obj != null && obj.ResultSets.Length != 0)
				{
					return resultSetFromCommand;
				}
				if (!Is2012)
				{
					return resultSetFromCommand;
				}
				string schema = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).ComposeSafeSchemaName(procedureName);
				string procedure = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).ComposeSafeTableName(procedureName);
				resultSetFromCommand = DescribeResultSet(connectionOptions, schema, procedure, array);
				if (resultSetFromCommand.Columns.Count > 0)
				{
					return resultSetFromCommand;
				}
				return GetResultSetByFmtonly(connectionOptions, schema, procedure, array);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (ex.GetType().FullName == ConnectionHelper.ConnectionType.Namespace + ".SqlException")
				{
					return null;
				}
				throw;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (connectionOptions.CloseConnection && ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).Connection.State == ConnectionState.Open)
				{
					((ConnectionProviderSql)this).Connection.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		string ISupportDefaultSchema.RemoveDefaultSchema(string name)
		{
			string[] array = name.Split('.');
			if (array[0] == ObjectsOwner && array.Length == 2)
			{
				return array[1];
			}
			return name;
		}

		protected static DBColumnType GetColumnType(string typeName, string providerAssemblyName)
		{

				return (DBColumnType)0;
			}

			{

				{

				}

				{
				case "int":
				case "mediumint":
					return (DBColumnType)8;
				case "int unsigned":
				case "mediumint unsigned":
					return (DBColumnType)9;

				case "bigint":

				case "datetime":
				case "date":
				case "timestamp":
					return (DBColumnType)15;
				case "decimal":
					return (DBColumnType)5;
				default:
					if (!typeName.StartsWith("char("))
					{

						{
							if (!typeName.StartsWith("decimal("))
							{
								return (DBColumnType)0;
							}
							return (DBColumnType)5;
						}

					}

			}
			return (DBColumnType)4;
		}

		protected static int GetColumnSize(string typeName)
		{

			}

			}
			if (typeName.StartsWith("varchar("))

			}
			return 0;
		}

		public void PrepareCommandForStoredProc(IDbCommand command, string sprocName, OperandParameter[] parameters)
		{
			//IL_008a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0094: Expected O, but got Unknown
			PrepareCommandForGetStoredProcParameters(command, sprocName);
			List<IDataParameter> list = default(List<IDataParameter>);
			IDataParameter dataParameter = default(IDataParameter);
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).PrepareParametersForExecuteSproc((OperandValue[])(object)parameters, command, ref list, ref dataParameter);
			foreach (IDataParameter parameter in command.Parameters)
			{
				if (parameter.Value == DBNull.Value && (parameter.DbType == DbType.String || parameter.DbType == DbType.StringFixedLength))
				{
					parameter.Value = string.Empty;
				}
			}
			Trace.WriteLineIf(ConnectionProviderSql.xpoSwitch.TraceInfo, (object)new DbCommandTracer(command));
		}

		private void PrepareCommandForGetStoredProcParameters(IDbCommand command, string sprocName)
		{
			command.CommandType = CommandType.StoredProcedure;
			string text = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).ComposeSafeTableName(sprocName);
			string commandText = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).FormatTable(((ConnectionProviderSql)this).ComposeSafeSchemaName(sprocName), text);
			if (base.ProviderAssemblyName == "MySqlConnector")
			{
				command.CommandText = text;
			}
			else
			{
				command.CommandText = commandText;
			}
			((ConnectionProviderSql)this).CommandBuilderDeriveParameters(command);
			command.CommandText = commandText;
		}

		{

				return base.GetConnectionString(parameters);
			}

			{

			{
				return null;
			}
			string server = parameters["server"];
			string userid = parameters["userid"];
			string password = parameters["password"];
			string database = parameters["database"];
			string port = parameters["Port"];
			MySqlSslMode sslMode = ((parameters.ContainsKey("sslmode") && string.Equals(parameters["sslmode"], "none", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase)) ? MySqlSslMode.None : MySqlSslMode.Default);
			return DataAccessMySqlConnectionProvider.GetConnectionString(server, userid, password, database, port, sslMode);
		}

			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				DataConnectionBase.ProcessException(exception);
			}
			using (dbConnection)
			{
				using IDbCommand dbCommand = dbConnection.CreateCommand();
				dbCommand.CommandText = "show databases";
				using IDataReader dataReader = ColumnarDataLoaderHelper.InternalExecuteReader(this, dbCommand);
				List<string> list = new List<string>();

				}

			}
		}

	public class DataAccessOracleProviderFactory : OracleProviderFactory
	{
		private static OracleProviderType GetOracleProviderType(Dictionary<string, string> parameters)
		{
			parameters.TryGetValue("OracleProviderType", out var value);
			if (!Enum.TryParse<OracleProviderType>(value, out var result))
			{
				return OracleProviderType.ODP;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override IDataStore CreateProviderFromConnection(IDbConnection connection, AutoCreateOption autoCreateOption)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public override IDataStore CreateProviderFromString(string connectionString, AutoCreateOption autoCreateOption, out IDisposable[] objectsToDisposeOnDisconnect)
		{
			//IL_0049: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0052: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			DbConnectionStringBuilder dbConnectionStringBuilder = DbConnectionStringBuilderHelper.CreateBuilder(connectionString);
			string byKeyword = dbConnectionStringBuilder.GetByKeyword("XpoProvider");
			dbConnectionStringBuilder.Remove("XpoProvider");
			return (IDataStore)(byKeyword switch
			{
				"Oracle" => DataAccessOracleConnectionProvider.DataAccessCreateProviderFromString(connectionString, autoCreateOption, out objectsToDisposeOnDisconnect), 
				"ODP" => DataAccessODPConnectionProvider.DataAccessCreateProviderFromString(connectionString, autoCreateOption, out objectsToDisposeOnDisconnect), 
				_ => DataAccessODPManagedConnectionProvider.DataAccessCreateProviderFromString(connectionString, autoCreateOption, out objectsToDisposeOnDisconnect), 
			});
		}

		public override string GetConnectionString(Dictionary<string, string> parameters)
		{
			if (!parameters.ContainsKey("server") || !parameters.ContainsKey("userid") || !parameters.ContainsKey("password"))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (GetOracleProviderType(parameters) != OracleProviderType.ODP)
			{
				return ODPManagedConnectionProvider.GetConnectionString(parameters["server"], parameters["userid"], parameters["password"]);
			}
			return OracleConnectionProvider.GetConnectionString(parameters["server"], parameters["userid"], parameters["password"]);
		}

		public override IDataStore CreateProvider(Dictionary<string, string> parameters, AutoCreateOption autoCreateOption, out IDisposable[] objectsToDisposeOnDisconnect)
		{
			//IL_0043: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			string connectionString = ((ProviderFactory)this).GetConnectionString(parameters);
			if (connectionString == null)
			{
				objectsToDisposeOnDisconnect = new IDisposable[0];
				return null;
			}
			DbConnectionStringBuilder dbConnectionStringBuilder = DbConnectionStringBuilderHelper.CreateBuilder(connectionString);
			dbConnectionStringBuilder.Remove("XpoProvider");
			OracleProviderType oracleProviderType = GetOracleProviderType(parameters);
			string connectionString2 = dbConnectionStringBuilder.ConnectionString;
			if (oracleProviderType != OracleProviderType.ODP)
			{
				return DataAccessODPManagedConnectionProvider.DataAccessCreateProviderFromString(connectionString2, autoCreateOption, out objectsToDisposeOnDisconnect);
			}
			return DataAccessODPConnectionProvider.DataAccessCreateProviderFromString(connectionString2, autoCreateOption, out objectsToDisposeOnDisconnect);
		}
	}

		public static string CleanStoredProcedureName(string name, string objectsOwner, bool sysUser)
		{
			if (sysUser)
			{
				return name;
			}
			if (!name.StartsWith(objectsOwner + "."))

			}
			return name.Substring(objectsOwner.Length + 1);
		}

		public static string FormatSelect(string selectedPropertiesSql, string fromSql, string whereSql, string orderBySql, string groupBySql, string havingSql, int skipSelectedRecords, int topSelectedRecords)
		{
			string text = ConnectionProviderHelper.ExpandProperty(whereSql, "where");
			string text2 = ConnectionProviderHelper.ExpandProperty(orderBySql, "order by");
			string text3 = ConnectionProviderHelper.ExpandProperty(havingSql, "having");
			string text4 = ConnectionProviderHelper.ExpandProperty(groupBySql, "group by");
			string text5 = ((topSelectedRecords != 0) ? string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, " and RowNum <= {0}", new object[1] { topSelectedRecords }) : string.Empty);
			if (skipSelectedRecords > 0)
			{
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "select * from(select a.*, RowNum rNum from(select {0} from {1}{2}{3}{4}{5}) a) where rNum > {6} {7}", selectedPropertiesSql, fromSql, text, text4, text3, text2, skipSelectedRecords, text5);
			}
			if (topSelectedRecords <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "select * from (select {0} from {1}{2}{3}{4}{5}) where RowNum <= {6}", selectedPropertiesSql, fromSql, text, text4, text3, text2, topSelectedRecords);
		}

		public static string FormatSelectDistinctTop(ISqlGeneratorFormatter formatter, string selectedPropertiesSql, string fromSql, string whereSql, string orderBySql, string groupBySql, string havingSql, int topSelectedRecords)
		{
			if (topSelectedRecords > 0)
			{
				string text = ConnectionProviderHelper.ExpandProperty(whereSql, "where");
				string text2 = ConnectionProviderHelper.ExpandProperty(orderBySql, "order by");
				string text3 = ConnectionProviderHelper.ExpandProperty(havingSql, "having");
				string text4 = ConnectionProviderHelper.ExpandProperty(groupBySql, "group by");
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "select * from (select distinct {0} from {1}{2}{3}{4}{5}) where RowNum <= {6}", selectedPropertiesSql, fromSql, text, text4, text3, text2, topSelectedRecords);
			}
			string sql = formatter.FormatSelect(selectedPropertiesSql, fromSql, whereSql, orderBySql, groupBySql, havingSql, topSelectedRecords);
			return ConnectionProviderHelper.ApplyDistinct(sql);
		}

		public static string FormatSelectDistinctTopSkip(string selectedPropertiesSql, string fromSql, string whereSql, string orderBySql, string groupBySql, string havingSql, int skipSelectedRecords, int topSelectedRecords)

		public static string FormatFunction(ProcessParameter processParameter, FunctionOperatorType operatorType, params object[] operands)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0003: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)operatorType == 46 && operands[1] is OperandParameter)
			{

					processParameter.Invoke(operands[1])

		}

		public static string GetParameterName(OperandValue parameter, int index, ref bool createParameter)
		{
			bool flag = createParameter;
			OperandParameter val = (OperandParameter)(object)((parameter is OperandParameter) ? parameter : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				createParameter = true;
				return ":" + val.ParameterName;
			}
			object value = parameter.Value;
			if (value == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (value == DBNull.Value)
			{
				return null;
			}
			createParameter = false;
			switch (Type.GetTypeCode(value.GetType()))
			{
			case TypeCode.DateTime:
				return "to_date('" + ((DateTime)value).ToString("dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + "', 'dd.mm.yyyy hh24:mi:ss')";
			case TypeCode.Boolean:
			case TypeCode.String:
				return null;
			case TypeCode.Char:
				return "N'" + ((char)value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture).Replace("'", "''") + "'";
			case TypeCode.Single:
			case TypeCode.Double:
			case TypeCode.Decimal:
				return ConnectionProviderHelper.FormatFloatingPointConstant((IConvertible)value);
			default:
				if (value is IConvertible convertible)
				{
					return convertible.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				}
				createParameter = flag;
				return null;
			}
		}
