("select c.TABLE_NAME, fc.TABLE_NAME as PRIMARY_TABLE_NAME, tc.COLUMN_NAME, fc.COLUMN_NAME as PRIMARY_COLUMN_NAME, c.CONSTRAINT_NAME\r\n                                                            from USER_CONSTRAINTS c\r\n                                                             join USER_CONS_COLUMNS tc on tc.CONSTRAINT_NAME = c.CONSTRAINT_NAME \r\n                                                             join USER_CONS_COLUMNS fc on c.R_CONSTRAINT_NAME = fc.CONSTRAINT_NAME and tc.POSITION = fc.POSITION \r\n                                                            " + GetTablesFilter(tables, "LOWER(c.TABLE_NAME)", useTablesFilter) + "                                                            order by c.CONSTRAINT_NAME, tc.POSITION") : string.Format("with table_primary_keys as (\r\n                                                             select CASE WHEN c.OWNER IS NOT NULL AND c.OWNER <> '{0}' then c.OWNER || '.' ELSE '' END || c.TABLE_NAME as full_table_name,\r\n                                                                    CASE WHEN fc.OWNER IS NOT NULL AND fc.OWNER <> '{0}' then fc.OWNER || '.' ELSE '' END || fc.TABLE_NAME as primary_table_name,\r\n                                                                    tc.COLUMN_NAME, fc.COLUMN_NAME as PRIMARY_COLUMN_NAME, c.CONSTRAINT_NAME\r\n                                                             from ALL_CONSTRAINTS c\r\n                                                              join ALL_CONS_COLUMNS tc on c.CONSTRAINT_NAME = tc.CONSTRAINT_NAME and c.owner = tc.owner\r\n                                                              join ALL_CONS_COLUMNS fc on c.R_CONSTRAINT_NAME = fc.CONSTRAINT_NAME and c.owner = fc.owner and tc.POSITION = fc.POSITION \r\n                                                              join SYS.USER$ u on c.\"OWNER\" = u.\"NAME\"\r\n                                                             where u.\"NAME\" <> 'SYS' and u.\"NAME\" <> 'SYSTEM' and u.\"TYPE#\" = 1 and u.ASTATUS = 0\r\n                                                             order by c.CONSTRAINT_NAME, tc.POSITION)\r\n                                                            select * from table_primary_keys {1}", objectsOwner, GetTablesFilter(tables, "LOWER(full_table_name)", useTablesFilter))), cancellationToken: CancellationToken.None, action: delegate(IDataReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
			{
				//IL_008f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0094: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_00a0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_00a9: Expected O, but got Unknown
				DBTable val = null;
				while (reader.Read())
				{
					string foreignTableName = reader.GetString(0);
					string primaryKeyTable = reader.GetString(1);
					if (val == null || !string.Equals(val.Name, foreignTableName, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
					{
						val = tables.FirstOrDefault((DBTable t) => string.Equals(t.Name, foreignTableName, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase));
					}
					if (val != null)
					{
						string value = reader.GetString(2);
						string value2 = reader.GetString(3);
						string keyName = reader.GetString(4);
						DBForeignKey val2 = val.ForeignKeys.FirstOrDefault((DBForeignKey k) => string.Equals(((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)k).Name, keyName, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase));
						if (val2 == null)
						{
							val2 = new DBForeignKey
							{
								Name = keyName,
								PrimaryKeyTable = primaryKeyTable
							};
							val.ForeignKeys.Add(val2);
						}
						((DBTableMultiColumnGadget)val2).Columns.Add(value);
						val2.PrimaryKeyTableKeyColumns.Add(value2);
					}
				}
			}, connectionOptions: connectionOptions);
		}

		public static DBStoredProcedure[] GetStoredProcedures(IColumnarDataLoader dataLoader, ConnectionProviderSql provider, bool sysUsersAvailable, string objectsOwner, IConnectionOptions connectionOptions, params string[] procedureNames)
		{
			List<DBStoredProcedure> list = new List<DBStoredProcedure>();
			if (procedureNames.Length == 0)
			{
				IEnumerable<string> procedureNames2 = GetProcedureNames(dataLoader, sysUsersAvailable, objectsOwner, connectionOptions);
				list.AddRange(procedureNames2.Select(ConnectionProviderHelper.CreateDBStoredProcedure));
			}
			else
			{
				list.AddRange(procedureNames.Select((string name) => ConnectionProviderHelper.CreateDBStoredProcedure(((ISupportDefaultSchema)provider).RemoveDefaultSchema(name))));
			}
			List<ProcedureInfo> list2 = new List<ProcedureInfo>();
			List<DBStoredProcedure> list3 = new List<DBStoredProcedure>();
			foreach (DBStoredProcedure item in list)
			{
				string procedureName = item.Name;
				string packageName = null;
				string owner = null;
				if (SplitProcedureName(provider, item, list3, ref procedureName, ref owner, ref packageName))
				{
					list2.Add(new ProcedureInfo
					{
						Procedure = item,
						ProcedureName = procedureName,
						Package = packageName,
						Owner = owner
					});
				}
			}
			var enumerable = from p in list2
				group p by new { p.Owner, p.Package } into groups
				select new
				{
					Owner = groups.Key.Owner,
					Package = groups.Key.Package,
					Procedures = groups.ToList()
				};
			foreach (var item2 in enumerable)
			{
				string owner2 = item2.Owner;
				string package = item2.Package;
				if (item2.Procedures.Count > 100)
				{
					int num = item2.Procedures.Count % 100;
					IEnumerable<ProcedureInfo> source = item2.Procedures;
					if (num > 0)
					{
						LoadArguments(dataLoader, connectionOptions, source.Take(num), owner2, package, list3);
						source = item2.Procedures.Skip(num);
					}
					int num2 = source.Count() / 100;
					for (int num3 = 0; num3 < num2; num3++)
					{
						LoadArguments(dataLoader, connectionOptions, source.Skip(100 * num3).Take(100), owner2, package, list3);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					LoadArguments(dataLoader, connectionOptions, item2.Procedures, owner2, package, list3);
				}
			}
			foreach (DBStoredProcedure item3 in list3)
			{
				list.Remove(item3);
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private static bool SplitProcedureName(ConnectionProviderSql provider, DBStoredProcedure procedure, List<DBStoredProcedure> toRemove, ref string procedureName, ref string owner, ref string packageName)
		{
			if (provider is DataAccessOracleConnectionProvider)
			{
				string[] array = procedure.Name.Trim('"').Split('.');
				switch (array.Length)
				{
				case 1:
					procedureName = array[0];
					break;
				case 2:
					owner = array[0];
					procedureName = array[1];
					break;
				case 3:
					owner = array[0];
					packageName = array[1];
					procedureName = array[2];
					break;
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (!ResolveObjectName(provider, procedure.Name, out var part, out var part2, out var schema, out var part1Type))
			{
				toRemove.Add(procedure);
				return false;
			}
			switch (part1Type)
			{
			case ObjectType.TopLevelProcedure:
			case ObjectType.TopLevelFunction:
				owner = schema;
				procedureName = part2;
				break;
			case ObjectType.Package:
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(part2))
				{
					toRemove.Add(procedure);
					return false;
				}
				owner = schema;
				packageName = part;
				procedureName = part2;
				break;
			default:
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static void LoadArguments(IColumnarDataLoader dataLoader, IConnectionOptions connectionOptions, IEnumerable<ProcedureInfo> proceduresInfo, string owner, string packageName, List<DBStoredProcedure> toRemove)
		{
			//IL_00f2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0109: Expected O, but got Unknown
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder("SELECT owner, package_name, object_name, argument_name, data_type, data_length, data_precision, data_scale, in_out, position FROM all_arguments");
			ProcedureInfo[] infos = (proceduresInfo as ProcedureInfo[]) ?? proceduresInfo.ToArray();
			stringBuilder.Append(" where object_name in (" + string.Join(", ", infos.Select((ProcedureInfo c) => "'" + c.ProcedureName + "'")) + ")");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(owner))
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(" and owner = '" + owner + "'");
			}
			stringBuilder.Append(" and package_name ");
			stringBuilder.Append((!string.IsNullOrEmpty(packageName)) ? ("= '" + packageName + "'") : "is null");
			stringBuilder.Append(" ORDER BY Position");
			ProcedureInfo procedureInfo = null;
			DBStoredProcedure procedure = null;
			dataLoader.ProcessQuery(CancellationToken.None, new Query(stringBuilder.ToString()), delegate(IDataReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
			{
				//IL_00ec: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_00f2: Expected O, but got Unknown
				//IL_01d5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_01da: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0216: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_021f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0228: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				while (reader.Read())
				{
					string text = ((reader["owner"] == DBNull.Value) ? null : reader["owner"].ToString());
					string text2 = ((reader["package_name"] == DBNull.Value) ? null : reader["package_name"].ToString());
					string name = reader["object_name"].ToString();
					if (procedureInfo == null || procedureInfo.Owner != text || procedureInfo.Package != text2 || procedureInfo.ProcedureName != name)
					{
						procedureInfo = infos.FirstOrDefault((ProcedureInfo wp) => wp.ProcedureName == name);
						if (procedureInfo == null)
						{
							continue;
						}
						procedure = procedureInfo.Procedure;
					}
					DBStoredProcedureArgument val = new DBStoredProcedureArgument();
					int size = ((reader["data_length"] != DBNull.Value) ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["data_length"]) : 0);
					int precision = ((reader["data_precision"] != DBNull.Value) ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["data_precision"]) : 0);
					int scale = ((reader["data_scale"] != DBNull.Value) ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["data_scale"]) : 0);
					if (reader["data_type"] == DBNull.Value)
					{
						toRemove.Add(procedure);
					}
					else
					{
						((DBNameTypePair)val).Name = ((reader["argument_name"] == DBNull.Value) ? string.Empty : ((string)reader["argument_name"]));
						((DBNameTypePair)val).Type = GetColumnType((string)reader["data_type"], size, precision, scale);
						string text3 = ((string)reader["in_out"]).ToUpper();
						if (!(text3 == "IN"))
						{
							if (text3 == "OUT")
							{
								val.Direction = (DBStoredProcedureArgumentDirection)1;
								continue;
							}
							val.Direction = (DBStoredProcedureArgumentDirection)2;
						}
						else
						{
							val.Direction = (DBStoredProcedureArgumentDirection)0;
						}
						DBStoredProcedure obj = procedure;
						if (obj != null)
						{
							obj.Arguments?.Add(val);
						}
					}
				}
			}, connectionOptions);
		}

		public static DBStoredProcedureResultSet GetStoredProcedureTableSchema(ISpSupportColumnarDataLoader provider, Action<IDbCommand, string, OperandParameter[]> prepareParameters, string procedureName, IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters, IConnectionOptions connectionOptions)
		{
			//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			DBStoredProcedureResultSet result = new DBStoredProcedureResultSet();
			ISpSupportColumnarDataLoader spSupportColumnarDataLoader = provider;
			ColumnarDataLoaderFactory.GetColumnarDataLoader((IDataStore)((spSupportColumnarDataLoader is IDataStore) ? spSupportColumnarDataLoader : null)).ExecuteDbCommand(connectionOptions, delegate(IDbCommand command)
			{
				//IL_0082: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0087: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_00a4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_00a6: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_00b0: Expected O, but got Unknown
				prepareParameters(command, procedureName, parameters.Select((Func<IParameter, OperandParameter>)((IParameter p) => new OperandParameter(((IFilterParameter)p).Name, (object)DBNull.Value))).ToArray());
				using IDataReader dataReader = ColumnarDataLoaderHelper.InternalExecuteReader(provider, command);
				System.Data.DataTable schemaTable = dataReader.GetSchemaTable();
				if (schemaTable != null)
				{
					foreach (DataRow row in schemaTable.Rows)
					{
						DBColumnType columnType = DBColumn.GetColumnType(row["DataType"] as Type);
						result.Columns.Add(new DBNameTypePair(row["ColumnName"].ToString(), columnType));
					}
					return;
				}
			});
			return result;
		}

		public static DBColumnType GetColumnType(string typeName, int size, int precision, int scale)
		{
			switch (typeName.ToLower())
			{
			case "int":
				return (DBColumnType)8;
			case "blob":
			case "raw":
				return (DBColumnType)18;
			case "number":
				if (precision != 0 && scale == 0)
				{
					if (precision != 1)
					{
						if (precision >= 3)
						{
							if (precision >= 5)
							{
								if (precision >= 10)
								{
									if (precision >= 20)
									{
										return (DBColumnType)5;
									}
									return (DBColumnType)12;
								}
								return (DBColumnType)8;
							}
							return (DBColumnType)10;
						}
						return (DBColumnType)2;
					}
					return (DBColumnType)1;
				}
				return (DBColumnType)5;
			case "nchar":
			case "char":
				if (size <= 1)
				{
					return (DBColumnType)4;
				}
				return (DBColumnType)14;
			case "money":
			case "float":
				return (DBColumnType)5;
			case "nvarchar":
			case "varchar":
			case "varchar2":
			case "nvarchar2":
				return (DBColumnType)14;
			case "date":
			case "timestamp":
				return (DBColumnType)15;
			case "clob":
			case "nclob":
				return (DBColumnType)14;
			default:
				if (!typeName.ToLowerInvariant().StartsWith("timestamp"))
				{
					return (DBColumnType)0;
				}
				return (DBColumnType)15;
			}
		}

		private static string GetTablesFilter(ICollection<DBTable> tables, string prefix, bool useTablesFilter)
		{
			if (!useTablesFilter || tables.Count == 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			string[] names = tables.Select((DBTable n) => "'" + n.Name.ToLowerInvariant() + "'").ToArray();
			IEnumerable<string> values = from n in Enumerable.Range(0, (int)Math.Ceiling((double)names.Length / 1000.0))
				select prefix + " in (" + string.Join(", ", names.Skip(n * 1000).Take(1000)) + ")";
			return "where (" + string.Join(" or ", values) + ")";
		}

		private static IEnumerable<string> GetProcedureNames(IColumnarDataLoader provider, bool sysUsersAvailable, string objectsOwner, IConnectionOptions connectionOptions)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			string text = (sysUsersAvailable ? "SELECT concat('\"' || p.OWNER || '\"', concat('.', nvl2(p.procedure_name, concat('\"' || p.object_name || '\"', concat('.\"', p.procedure_name || '\"')), '\"' || p.object_name || '\"'))) as ProcedureName\r\n                    from SYS.all_procedures p inner join SYS.USER$ u on p.OWNER = u.NAME\r\n                    where p.owner not in ('SYS', 'SYSTEM') and u.type# = 1 and u.ASTATUS = 0" : string.Format("             select concat(case when owner = '{0}' then '' else '\"' || owner || '\".' end,\r\n                    concat('\"' || object_name || '\"' , case when procedure_name is not null then (concat('.\"', procedure_name || '\"')) else '' end)) as ProcedureName\r\n                    from all_procedures p\r\n                      left outer join all_tab_privs privs on privs.table_name = p.object_name and privs.privilege = 'EXECUTE'\r\n                    where p.owner not in ('SYS', 'SYSMAN', 'CTXSYS', 'XDB', 'CTXSYS', 'MDSYS', 'WMSYS', 'WKSYS', 'ORDSYS', 'ORDPLUGINS', \r\n                                          'OLAPSYS', 'LBACSYS', 'DBSNMP', 'MGMT_VIEW', 'OWBSYS', 'OUTLN', 'SI_INFORMTN_SCHEMA', 'TSMSYS',\r\n                                          'EXFSYS', 'ANONYMOUS', 'DIP', 'DMSYS', 'DSSYS', 'ORACLE_OCM', 'TRACESVR', 'PERFSTAT', 'ORDSYS')\r\n                          and p.owner not like 'APEX_%'\r\n                          and (p.owner = '{0}' or privs.grantee = '{0}')", objectsOwner));
			string text2 = " and p.object_type in ('PROCEDURE', 'FUNCTION', 'PACKAGE')";
			try
			{
				ReadProcedureNames(provider, connectionOptions, text + text2, list);
			}
			catch (SqlExecutionException)
			{
				ReadProcedureNames(provider, connectionOptions, text, list);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static void ReadProcedureNames(IColumnarDataLoader provider, IConnectionOptions connectionOptions, string queryText, List<string> procedureNames)
		{
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			provider.ProcessQuery(CancellationToken.None, new Query(queryText), delegate(IDataReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
			{
				while (reader.Read())
				{
					if (!reader.IsDBNull(0))
					{
						procedureNames.Add(reader.GetString(0));
					}
				}
			}, connectionOptions);
		}

		private static bool ResolveObjectName(ConnectionProviderSql provider, string name, out string part1, out string part2, out string schema, out ObjectType part1Type)
		{
			schema = null;
			part1 = null;
			part2 = null;
			part1Type = ObjectType.Table;
			if (!(provider is ISpSupportColumnarDataLoader spSupportColumnarDataLoader))
			{
				return false;
			}
			using IDbCommand dbCommand = spSupportColumnarDataLoader.CreateCommand();
			dbCommand.CommandType = CommandType.StoredProcedure;
			dbCommand.CommandText = "\"DBMS_UTILITY\".\"NAME_RESOLVE\"";
			AddParameterToCommand(dbCommand, name, "NAME", DbType.String, 32767, ParameterDirection.Input);
			AddParameterToCommand(dbCommand, 1, "CONTEXT", DbType.Decimal, 0, ParameterDirection.Input);
			AddParameterToCommand(dbCommand, null, "SCHEMA", DbType.String, 32767, ParameterDirection.Output);
			AddParameterToCommand(dbCommand, null, "PART1", DbType.String, 32767, ParameterDirection.Output);
			AddParameterToCommand(dbCommand, null, "PART2", DbType.String, 32767, ParameterDirection.Output);
			AddParameterToCommand(dbCommand, null, "DBLINK", DbType.String, 32767, ParameterDirection.Output);
			AddParameterToCommand(dbCommand, null, "PART1_TYPE", DbType.Decimal, 0, ParameterDirection.Output);
			AddParameterToCommand(dbCommand, null, "OBJECT_NUMBER", DbType.Decimal, 0, ParameterDirection.Output);
			try
			{
				ColumnarDataLoaderHelper.InternalExecuteNonQuery(provider, dbCommand);
			}
			catch (DbException)
			{
				return false;
			}
			schema = ((IDbDataParameter)dbCommand.Parameters["SCHEMA"]).Value.ToString();
			part1 = ((IDbDataParameter)dbCommand.Parameters["PART1"]).Value.ToString();
			part2 = ((IDbDataParameter)dbCommand.Parameters["PART2"]).Value.ToString();
			object value = ((IDbDataParameter)dbCommand.Parameters["PART1_TYPE"]).Value;
			part1Type = ToObjectType(Convert.ToInt32(value));
			return true;
		}

		private static void AddParameterToCommand(IDbCommand command, object value, string name, DbType type, int size, ParameterDirection direction)
		{
			IDbDataParameter dbDataParameter = command.CreateParameter();
			dbDataParameter.ParameterName = name;
			dbDataParameter.DbType = type;
			dbDataParameter.Direction = direction;
			dbDataParameter.Value = value;
			dbDataParameter.Size = size;
			command.Parameters.Add(dbDataParameter);
		}

		private static ObjectType ToObjectType(int typeIndex)
		{
			return typeIndex switch
			{
				2 => ObjectType.Table, 
				4 => ObjectType.View, 
				5 => ObjectType.Synonym, 
				7 => ObjectType.TopLevelProcedure, 
				8 => ObjectType.TopLevelFunction, 
				9 => ObjectType.Package, 
				_ => ObjectType.Unknown, 
			};
		}

		public static string CanonicalizeName(string name)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!name.Contains('.'))
			{
				if (name.StartsWith("\"") && name.EndsWith("\""))
				{
					return name;
				}
				if (!name.Contains("\""))
				{
					return Enclose(name);
				}
			}
			IEnumerable<string> values = (name.Contains("\"") ? ExtractParts(name) : name.Split('.').Select(Enclose));
			string text = string.Join(".", values);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return text;
			}
			return name;
		}

		internal static IEnumerable<string> ExtractParts(string name)
		{
			return ColumnNameHelper.ExtractParts(name, "\"", "\"", enclose: true);
		}

		private static string Enclose(string name)
		{
			return ColumnNameHelper.Enclose(name, "\"", "\"");
		}

		public static string FormatIn(string left, params string[] operands)
		{
			string text = "";
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			for (int i = 0; i < operands.Length; i++)
			{
				if (stringBuilder.Length > 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(',');
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(operands[i]);
				if ((i > 0 && (i + 1) % 1000 == 0) || i == operands.Length - 1)
				{
					if (text.Length > 0)
					{
						text += " or ";
					}
					text += string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0} in ({1})", new object[2]
					{
						left,
						stringBuilder.ToString()
					});
					stringBuilder.Clear();
				}
			}
			return "(" + text + ")";
		}
	}

	{
		private const string aliasLead = "\"";

		private const bool singleQuotedString = true;

		SqlProviderLimitations ISqlProviderWithLimitations.Limitations => SqlProviderLimitations.NoParametersInSelect;

		string IAliasFormatter.AliasLead => "\"";

		string IAliasFormatter.AliasEnd => "\"";

		int IAliasFormatter.MaxTableAliasLength => ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).GetSafeNameTableMaxLength();

		int IAliasFormatter.MaxColumnAliasLength => ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).GetSafeNameColumnMaxLength();

		bool ISupportOrderByExpressionAlias.ReplaceExpressionWithAlias => true;

		private static DBColumnType GetColumnType(byte dataType, uint size, uint dec, uint flags)
		{
			switch (dataType)
			{
			case 0:
				if ((flags & 0x1000) != 4096)
				{
					return (DBColumnType)(size switch
					{
						1u => 4, 
						36u => 16, 
						_ => 14, 
					});
				}
				break;
			case 1:
				switch (size)
				{
				case 1u:
					return (DBColumnType)2;
				case 2u:
					return (DBColumnType)10;
				case 4u:
					return (DBColumnType)8;
				case 8u:
					return (DBColumnType)12;
				}
				break;
			case 2:
				switch (size)
				{
				case 4u:
					return (DBColumnType)7;
				case 8u:
					return (DBColumnType)6;
				}
				break;
			case 3:
				return (DBColumnType)15;
			case 5:
			case 6:
				return (DBColumnType)5;
			case 7:
				switch (size)
				{
				case 1u:
					return (DBColumnType)1;
				case 2u:
					return (DBColumnType)10;
				}
				break;
			case 8:
				if (dec != 0)
				{
					return (DBColumnType)5;
				}
				return (DBColumnType)12;
			case 11:
				return (DBColumnType)14;
			case 14:
				switch (size)
				{
				case 1u:
					return (DBColumnType)2;
				case 2u:
					return (DBColumnType)11;
				case 4u:
					return (DBColumnType)9;
				case 8u:
					return (DBColumnType)13;
				}
				break;
			case 15:
				switch (size)
				{
				case 4u:
					return (DBColumnType)8;
				case 2u:
					return (DBColumnType)10;
				}
				break;
			case 16:
				return (DBColumnType)1;
			case 20:
				return (DBColumnType)15;
			case 21:
				if ((flags & 0x1000) != 4096)
				{
					return (DBColumnType)14;
				}
				return (DBColumnType)18;
			case 30:
				return (DBColumnType)15;
			}
			return (DBColumnType)0;
		}

		private DBTable[] GetStorageDataObjects(bool includeColumns, bool isView, IConnectionOptions connectionOptions, params string[] tablesList)
		{
			string[] storageDataObjectsNames = ((ISqlSchemaExplorer)this).GetStorageDataObjectsNames(connectionOptions, (!isView) ? DataObjectTypes.Tables : DataObjectTypes.Views);
			IEnumerable<string> source;
			if (tablesList.Length == 0)
			{
				source = storageDataObjectsNames;
			}
			else
			{
				ISupportDefaultSchema supportDefaultSchema = this as ISupportDefaultSchema;
				object obj;
				if (supportDefaultSchema == null)
				{
					obj = tablesList;
				}
				else
				{
					obj = tablesList.Select(supportDefaultSchema.RemoveDefaultSchema);
				}
				IEnumerable<string> selected = (IEnumerable<string>)obj;
				source = storageDataObjectsNames.Where((string n) => selected.Any((string f) => f == n));
			}
			DBTable[] array = source.Select((string p) => ConnectionProviderHelper.CreateTable(p, isView)).ToArray();
			if (array.Length != 0)
			{
				if (includeColumns)
				{
					GetStorageTablesColumns(array, tablesList.Length != 0, connectionOptions);
				}
				if (!isView)
				{
					GetStorageTablesForeignKeys(array, tablesList.Length != 0, connectionOptions);
				}
			}
			return array;
		}

		private string GetForeignKeysQueryForNewServerVersion(ICollection<DBTable> tables, bool useTablesFilter)
		{
			string text = "select CASE WHEN n.nspname <> '" + ObjectsOwner + "' or strpos(tc.relname, '.') > 0 then n.nspname || '.' 		{

		private string GetIsAggr(IConnectionOptions connectionOptions)

		DBStoredProcedureResultSet ISupportStoredProc.GetStoredProcedureTableSchema(string procedureName, IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters, IConnectionOptions connectionOptions)
		{
			DBStoredProcedure[] procedures = ((ISupportStoredProc)this).GetStoredProcedures(connectionOptions, new string[1] { procedureName });
			return ColumnarDataLoaderFactory.GetColumnarDataLoader((IDataStore)(object)this).ExecuteDbCommand(connectionOptions, delegate(IDbCommand command)
			{
				command.CommandType = CommandType.StoredProcedure;
				command.CommandText = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).FormatTable(<>n__0(procedureName), <>n__1(procedureName));
				if (procedures.Length > 1)
				{

					{

						command.Parameters.Add(dbDataParameter);

					((ConnectionProviderSql)this).CommandBuilderDeriveParameters(command);
					foreach (IDataParameter parameter2 in command.Parameters)
					{
						parameter2.Value = DBNull.Value;
					}
				}
				return ConnectionProviderHelper.GetResultSetFromCommand((ConnectionProviderSql)(object)this, command);
			});
		}

		string ISupportDefaultSchema.RemoveDefaultSchema(string name)
		{
			string[] array = name.Split('.');
			if (array[0] == ObjectsOwner && array.Length == 2)
			{
				return array[1];
			}
			return name;
		}

		private bool Is3XNpgsql()
		{
			if (((ConnectionProviderSql)this).Connection != null)
			{
				return ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).Connection.GetType().Assembly.GetName().Version.Major >= 3;
			}
			return false;
		}

			}

		private static DBColumnType GetColumnTypeByCode(string typeName, int length)

		protected virtual int GetServerMajorVersion(ConnectionOptions connectionOptions)
		{
			//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0038: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (serverMajorVersion >= 0)
			{
				return serverMajorVersion;
			}
			try
			{
				ColumnarDataLoaderFactory.GetColumnarDataLoader((IDataStore)(object)this).ProcessQuery(CancellationToken.None, new Query("select InfoData from dbc.dbcinfo where InfoKey = 'VERSION';"), delegate(IDataReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
				{
					reader.Read();
					string text = reader.GetString(0);
					serverMajorVersion = int.Parse(text.Split('.')[0]);
				}, connectionOptions);
			}
			catch (SqlExecutionException)
			{
				serverMajorVersion = 13;
			}
			return serverMajorVersion;
		}

		public override string GetParameterName(OperandValue parameter, int index, ref bool createParameter)
		{
			OperandParameter val = (OperandParameter)(object)((parameter is OperandParameter) ? parameter : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				createParameter = true;
				return "?";
			}
			object value = parameter.Value;
			createParameter = false;
			if (value == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (value == DBNull.Value)
			{
				return null;
			}
			switch (DXTypeExtensions.GetTypeCode(value.GetType()))
			{
			case TypeCode.Boolean:
				if (!(bool)value)
				{
					return "false";
				}
				return "true";
			case TypeCode.Char:
				return $"'{value}'";
			case TypeCode.String:
				return "'" + ((string)value).Replace("'", "''").Replace("\\", "\\\\") + "'";
			case TypeCode.DateTime:
				return "TIMESTAMP '" + ((DateTime)value).ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH':'mm':'ss'.'ffffff", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + "'";
			case TypeCode.Single:
			case TypeCode.Double:
			case TypeCode.Decimal:
				return ConnectionProviderHelper.FormatFloatingPointConstant((IConvertible)value);
			default:
				if (value is IConvertible convertible)
				{
					return convertible.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				}
				createParameter = true;
				return "?";
			}
		}

		}

		public string FormatSelectDistinct(string selectedPropertiesSql, string fromSql, string whereSql, string orderBySql, string groupBySql, string havingSql, int topSelectedRecords)
		{
			if (topSelectedRecords > 0)
			{
				string text = ConnectionProviderHelper.ExpandProperty(whereSql, "where");
				string text2 = ConnectionProviderHelper.ExpandProperty(orderBySql, "order by");
				string text3 = ConnectionProviderHelper.ExpandProperty(havingSql, "having");
				string text4 = ConnectionProviderHelper.ExpandProperty(groupBySql, "group by");
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
				{
					string text5 = ((topSelectedRecords != 0) ? string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "top {0} ", new object[1] { topSelectedRecords }) : string.Empty);
					return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "select {0} * from (select {1} from {2}{3}{4}{5}{6}) distselect", text5, selectedPropertiesSql, fromSql, text, text4, text3, text2);
				}
				string text6 = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "rank() over({0}) as rnk", new object[1] { text2 });
				string text7 = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "qualify row_number() over(order by rnk asc) <= {0}", new object[1] { topSelectedRecords });
				return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "select * from (select distinct {0}, {1} from {2}{3}{4}{5}) distSelect {6} order by rnk", selectedPropertiesSql, text6, fromSql, text, text4, text3, text7);
			}
			string sql = ((ConnectionProviderSql)this).FormatSelect(selectedPropertiesSql, fromSql, whereSql, orderBySql, groupBySql, havingSql, topSelectedRecords);
			return ConnectionProviderHelper.ApplyDistinct(sql);
		}

		public string FormatSelectDistinct(string selectedPropertiesSql, string fromSql, string whereSql, string orderBySql, string groupBySql, string havingSql, int skipSelectedRecords, int topSelectedRecords)
		{
			string text = ConnectionProviderHelper.ExpandProperty(whereSql, "where");
			string text2 = ConnectionProviderHelper.ExpandProperty(orderBySql, "order by");
			string text3 = ConnectionProviderHelper.ExpandProperty(havingSql, "having");
			string text4 = ConnectionProviderHelper.ExpandProperty(groupBySql, "group by");
			string text5 = string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "rank() over({0}) as rnk", new object[1] { text2 });
			string text6 = ((topSelectedRecords == 0) ? string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "qualify row_number() over(order by rnk asc) > {0}", new object[1] { skipSelectedRecords }) : string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "qualify row_number() over(order by rnk asc) between {0} and {1}", new object[2]
			{
				skipSelectedRecords + 1,
				skipSelectedRecords + topSelectedRecords
			}));
			return string.Format(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "select * from (select distinct {0}, {1} from {2}{3}{4}{5}) distSelect {6} order by rnk", selectedPropertiesSql, text5, fromSql, text, text4, text3, text6);
		}
	}

			{

			string server = parameters["server"];
			string database = parameters["database"];

			return DataAccessTeradataConnectionProvider.GetConnectionString(server, database, userid, password, int.Parse(parameters["Port"]));
		}

		public string[] GetDatabases(string server, string port, string userid, string password)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(server))
			{
				return new string[0];
			}
			int result;
			string connectionString = (int.TryParse(port, out result) ? DataAccessTeradataConnectionProvider.GetConnectionString(server, string.Empty, userid, password, result) : DataAccessTeradataConnectionProvider.GetConnectionString(server, string.Empty, userid, password));
			DbConnectionStringBuilder dbConnectionStringBuilder = DbConnectionStringBuilderHelper.CreateBuilder(connectionString);
			dbConnectionStringBuilder.Remove("XpoProvider");
			dbConnectionStringBuilder.Remove("Database");
			IDbConnection dbConnection = null;
			try
			{
				dbConnection = DataAccessTeradataConnectionProvider.CreateConnection(dbConnectionStringBuilder.ConnectionString);
				dbConnection.Open();
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				DataConnectionBase.ProcessException(exception);
			}
			using (dbConnection)
			{
				using IDbCommand dbCommand = dbConnection.CreateCommand();
				dbCommand.CommandText = "select distinct trim(DatabaseName) from dbc.tables";
				using IDataReader dataReader = ColumnarDataLoaderHelper.InternalExecuteReader(this, dbCommand);
				List<string> list = new List<string>();
				while (dataReader.Read())
				{
					try
					{
						string text = dataReader.GetString(0);
						if (text != "DBC")
						{
							list.Add(text);
						}
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
				return list.ToArray();
			}
		}

	public class ColumnarDataLoader : IColumnarDataLoader
	{
		protected readonly ISupportColumnarDataLoader provider;

		protected virtual Dictionary<Type, Action<int, IDataReader, IList>> Readers => ReadersHelper.Readers;

		protected virtual bool SupportCommandTimeout => true;

		public Action<IDbCommand> AfterCommandCreated { get; set; }

		private void ExecuteReaderInternal(ISupportColumnarDataLoader connectionProvider, IDbCommand command, CancellationToken cancellationToken, Action<IDataReader, CancellationToken> action)
		{
			CommandBehavior commandBehavior = (connectionProvider as INeedSpecificCommandBehavior)?.GetCommandBehavior(command.CommandType) ?? CommandBehavior.SequentialAccess;
			using IDataReader arg = ColumnarDataLoaderHelper.InternalExecuteReader(connectionProvider, command, commandBehavior, cancellationToken);
			try
			{
				action(arg, cancellationToken);
			}
			catch (OperationCanceledException)
			{
			}
			if (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
			{
				try
				{
					command.Cancel();
					return;
				}
				catch
				{
					return;
				}
			}
		}

		public ColumnarDataLoader(ISupportColumnarDataLoader provider)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)provider, "provider");
			this.provider = provider;
		}

		public virtual ColumnarData SelectData(CancellationToken cancellationToken, Query query, ColumnDescription[] columns, IConnectionOptions connectionOptions)
		{
			return CreateAndExecuteQueryCommand(connectionOptions, query, (IDbCommand command) => ColumnarDataLoaderHelper.GetData(Readers, provider, command, cancellationToken, columns, provider.NativeSkipTakeSupported, query.SkipSelectedRecords));
		}

		public virtual ColumnDescription[] SelectSchema(Query query, string[] columns, IConnectionOptions connectionOptions)
		{
			return CreateAndExecuteQueryCommand(connectionOptions, query, (IDbCommand command) => ColumnarDataLoaderHelper.GetSchema(provider, command, columns));
		}

		public virtual void ProcessQuery(CancellationToken cancellationToken, Query query, Action<IDataReader, CancellationToken> action, IConnectionOptions connectionOptions)
		{
			CreateAndExecuteQueryCommand(connectionOptions, query, delegate(IDbCommand command)
			{
				ExecuteReaderInternal(provider, command, cancellationToken, action);
			});
		}

		public virtual void ProcessStoredProc(CancellationToken cancellationToken, string sprocName, Action<IDataReader, CancellationToken> action, IConnectionOptions connectionOptions, params OperandParameter[] parameters)
		{
			if (!(provider is ISpSupportColumnarDataLoader spSupportColumnarDataLoader))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
			ChangeAfterCommandCreatedHandler(spSupportColumnarDataLoader, sprocName, parameters);
			CreateAndExecuteQueryCommand(connectionOptions, null, delegate(IDbCommand command)
			{
				ExecuteReaderInternal(provider, command, cancellationToken, action);
			});
		}

		public virtual ColumnarData ExecuteStoredProcedure(CancellationToken cancellationToken, string sprocName, IConnectionOptions connectionOptions, params OperandParameter[] parameters)
		{
			if (!(provider is ISpSupportColumnarDataLoader spSupportColumnarDataLoader))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
			ChangeAfterCommandCreatedHandler(spSupportColumnarDataLoader, sprocName, parameters);
			return CreateAndExecuteQueryCommand(connectionOptions, null, (IDbCommand command) => ColumnarDataLoaderHelper.GetData(Readers, provider, command, cancellationToken));
		}

		private void ChangeAfterCommandCreatedHandler(ISpSupportColumnarDataLoader spSupportColumnarDataLoader, string sprocName, params OperandParameter[] parameters)
		{
			if (AfterCommandCreated == null)
			{
				AfterCommandCreated = delegate(IDbCommand command)
				{
					spSupportColumnarDataLoader.PrepareCommandForStoredProc(command, sprocName, parameters);
				};
				return;
			}
			Action<IDbCommand> copy = AfterCommandCreated.Clone() as Action<IDbCommand>;
			AfterCommandCreated = delegate(IDbCommand command)
			{
				spSupportColumnarDataLoader.PrepareCommandForStoredProc(command, sprocName, parameters);
				copy(command);
			};
		}

		public T ExecuteDbCommand<T>(IConnectionOptions connectionOptions, Func<IDbCommand, T> func)
		{
			return CreateAndExecuteQueryCommand(connectionOptions, null, func);
		}

		public void ExecuteDbCommand(IConnectionOptions connectionOptions, Action<IDbCommand> action)
		{
			CreateAndExecuteQueryCommand(connectionOptions, null, action);
		}

		protected void CreateAndExecuteQueryCommand(IConnectionOptions connectionOptions, Query query, Action<IDbCommand> action)
		{
			CreateAndExecuteQueryCommand(connectionOptions, query, delegate(IDbCommand command)
			{
				action(command);
				return (object)null;
			});
		}

		protected T CreateAndExecuteQueryCommand<T>(IConnectionOptions connectionOptions, Query query, Func<IDbCommand, T> func)
		{
			//IL_0005: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			DashboardTelemetry val = new DashboardTelemetry("ColumnarDataLoader.CreateAndExecuteQueryCommand");
			try
			{
				Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)connectionOptions, "connectionOptions");
				lock (provider.SyncRoot)
				{
					IDbCommand dbCommand = ((query == null) ? ((ISpSupportColumnarDataLoader)provider).CreateCommand() : provider.CreateCommand(query));
					if (dbCommand == null)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot execute the specified query because an IDbCommand instance has not been created.");
					}
					try
					{
						if (SupportCommandTimeout && connectionOptions.DbCommandTimeout.HasValue)
						{
							dbCommand.CommandTimeout = connectionOptions.DbCommandTimeout.Value;
						}
						if (connectionOptions.IsolationLevel != SqlIsolationLevel.None)
						{
							IsolationLevel isolationLevel = connectionOptions.IsolationLevel.ToDataIsolationLevel();
							dbCommand.Transaction = ConnectionProviderHelper.BeginDbTransaction(provider.Connection, isolationLevel);
						}
						DashboardTelemetry.TraceInformation((object)("Command: " + dbCommand.CommandText));
						AfterCommandCreated?.Invoke(dbCommand);
						T result = func(dbCommand);
						dbCommand.Transaction?.Commit();
						return result;
					}
					catch (Exception innerException)
					{
						dbCommand.Transaction?.Rollback();
						throw new SqlExecutionException(dbCommand, SqlExecutionException.ConvertIDataParametersCollectionToString(dbCommand.Parameters), innerException);
					}
					finally
					{
						dbCommand.Transaction?.Dispose();
						if (connectionOptions.CloseConnection)
						{
							CloseConnection();
						}
						dbCommand.Dispose();
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private void CloseConnection()
		{
			IDbConnection connection = provider.Connection;
			if (connection != null && connection.State == ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				provider.Connection.Close();
			}
		}
	}

	public class OracleColumnarDataLoader : ColumnarDataLoader
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<Type, Action<int, IDataReader, IList>> readers = new Dictionary<Type, Action<int, IDataReader, IList>>(ReadersHelper.Readers);

		private readonly Type oracleExceptionType;

		private readonly object getValuesHelper;

		private readonly MethodInfo getDecimalMethodInfo;

		protected override Dictionary<Type, Action<int, IDataReader, IList>> Readers => readers;

		public OracleColumnarDataLoader(ISupportColumnarDataLoader provider)
			: base(provider)
		{
			readers[typeof(bool)] = delegate(int i, IDataReader reader, IList list)
			{
				ReadersHelper.ReadStruct(reader, (ChunkedList<bool?>)list, i, (IDataReader dataReader, int index) => Convert.ToBoolean(reader.GetValue(index)));
			};
			readers[typeof(decimal)] = delegate(int i, IDataReader reader, IList list)
			{
				ReadersHelper.ReadStruct(reader, (ChunkedList<decimal?>)list, i, GetDecimal);
			};
			oracleExceptionType = SafeTypeResolver.GetKnownType(provider.Connection.GetType().Assembly, "System.Data.OracleClient.OracleException", false, (bool?)null);
			Type type = provider.GetType();
			Type type2 = null;
			if (typeof(BaseODPConnectionProvider).IsAssignableFrom(type))
			{
				type2 = typeof(BaseODPConnectionProvider);
			}
			else if (typeof(OracleConnectionProvider).IsAssignableFrom(type))
			{
				type2 = typeof(OracleConnectionProvider);
			}
			if (!(type2 != null))
			{
				return;
			}
			PropertyInfo property = type2.GetProperty("GetValuesHelper", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
			if (property != null)
			{
				getValuesHelper = property.GetValue(provider, null);
				if (getValuesHelper != null)
				{
					Type[] genericArguments = getValuesHelper.GetType().GetGenericArguments();
					getDecimalMethodInfo = getValuesHelper.GetType().GetMethod("GetDecimal", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic, null, new Type[2]
					{
						genericArguments[0],
						typeof(int)
					}, null);
				}
			}
		}

		public override ColumnarData SelectData(CancellationToken cancellationToken, Query query, ColumnDescription[] columns, IConnectionOptions connectionOptions)
		{
			return CreateAndExecuteQueryCommand(connectionOptions, query, (IDbCommand command) => ColumnarDataLoaderHelper.GetData(Readers, provider, command, cancellationToken, columns, provider.NativeSkipTakeSupported, query.SkipSelectedRecords, 0));
		}

		private decimal GetDecimal(IDataReader dataReader, int i)
		{
			try
			{
				return dataReader.GetDecimal(i);
			}
			catch (InvalidCastException)
			{
			}
			catch (OverflowException)
			{
			}
			catch (Exception o)
			{
				if (oracleExceptionType == null || !oracleExceptionType.IsInstanceOfType(o))
				{
					throw;
				}
			}
			if (getDecimalMethodInfo != null)
			{
				object value = getDecimalMethodInfo.Invoke(getValuesHelper, new object[2] { dataReader, i });
				return Convert.ToDecimal(value);
			}
			return Convert.ToDecimal(dataReader.GetDouble(i));
		}
	}

	internal class MongoDBSchemaHelper
	{

		private static PropertyInfo BsonValueAsBsonArray { get; }

		public bool DiscoveryLimitApplied { get; private set; }

		static MongoDBSchemaHelper()

			TypeBsonArray = XPTypeActivator.GetType("MongoDB.Bson", "MongoDB.Bson.BsonArray");

			PropertyBsonElementName = TypeBsonElement?.GetProperty("Name");
			PropertyBsonElementValue = TypeBsonElement?.GetProperty("Value");
			TypeBsonElementAttribute = XPTypeActivator.GetType("MongoDB.Bson", "MongoDB.Bson.Serialization.Attributes.BsonElementAttribute");
			TypeBsonTypeMapper = XPTypeActivator.GetType("MongoDB.Bson", "MongoDB.Bson.BsonTypeMapper");

			IgnoreExtraElementsAttributeBuilder = ((TypeBsonIgnoreExtraElementsAttribute != null) ? new CustomAttributeBuilder(TypeBsonIgnoreExtraElementsAttribute.GetConstructor(new Type[0]), new object[0]) : null);
			MethodMapToDotNetValue = TypeBsonTypeMapper?.GetMethods().Single(delegate(MethodInfo m)

				ParameterInfo[] parameters = m.GetParameters();
				return m.Name == "MapToDotNetValue" && parameters.Length == 1 && parameters[0].ParameterType.Name == "BsonValue";

		public static Type CreateMongoDBType(MongoDBSchemaNode schema)
		{
			List<Property> list = new List<Property>();
			foreach (MongoDBSchemaNode child in schema.Children)
			{
				string name = child.Name;
				if (!child.Selected.HasValue || child.Selected.Value)
				{
					switch (child.NodeType)
					{
					case MongoDBNodeType.ObjectID:
						list.Add(new MongoDBProperty(name, child.DisplayName, MongoDBDatabase.TypeObjectId));
						break;
					case MongoDBNodeType.Object:
						list.Add(new MongoDBProperty(name, child.DisplayName, CreateMongoDBType(child)));
						break;
					case MongoDBNodeType.Array:
						list.Add(new MongoDBProperty(name, child.DisplayName, child.Children.Any() ? typeof(List<>).MakeGenericType(CreateMongoDBType(child)) : child.Type));
						break;
					case MongoDBNodeType.Property:
						list.Add(new MongoDBProperty(name, child.DisplayName, child.Type));
						break;
					default:
						throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
					}
				}
			}
			return DynamicTypesHelper.CreateType(DynamicTypesHelper.ModuleBuilder, list, schema.Name, true, IgnoreExtraElementsAttributeBuilder);
		}

		public Type DetectSchema(IEnumerable values, string propertyName, int schemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			MongoDBProperty mongoDBProperty = null;
			IEnumerator enumerator = values.GetEnumerator();
			int num = 0;
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
				MongoDBProperty mongoDBProperty2 = DetectType(enumerator.Current, propertyName, schemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount, cancellationToken);
				if (mongoDBProperty == null)
				{
					mongoDBProperty = mongoDBProperty2;
				}
				else if (mongoDBProperty.Type != mongoDBProperty2.Type)
				{
					mongoDBProperty = MergeProperties(mongoDBProperty, mongoDBProperty2, propertyName);
				}
				if (schemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount > 0 && ++num > schemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount)
				{
					DiscoveryLimitApplied = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			return mongoDBProperty?.Type ?? typeof(object);
		}

		private MongoDBProperty DetectType(object value, string propertyName, int schemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if ((bool)BsonValueIsBsonNull.GetValue(value))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if ((bool)BsonValueIsBsonDocument.GetValue(value))
			{
				object value2 = BsonValueAsBsonDocument.GetValue(value);
				Dictionary<string, MongoDBProperty> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, MongoDBProperty>();
				IEnumerable enumerable = (IEnumerable)PropertyBsonDocumentElements.GetValue(value2);
				IEnumerator enumerator = enumerable.GetEnumerator();
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
					object value3 = PropertyBsonElementValue.GetValue(enumerator.Current);
					string text = (string)PropertyBsonElementName.GetValue(enumerator.Current);
					MongoDBProperty mongoDBProperty = DetectType(value3, text, schemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount, cancellationToken);
					if (mongoDBProperty == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (string.Equals(mongoDBProperty.Name, "id", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
					{
						mongoDBProperty = new MongoDBProperty(propertyName + "_" + mongoDBProperty.Name, mongoDBProperty.Type);
						mongoDBProperty.AddCustomAttribute(TypeBsonElementAttribute, new Type[1] { typeof(string) }, new object[1] { text });
					}
					if (dictionary.TryGetValue(mongoDBProperty.Name, out var value4))
					{
						if (value4.Type != mongoDBProperty.Type)
						{
							dictionary[mongoDBProperty.Name] = MergeProperties(value4, mongoDBProperty, mongoDBProperty.Name);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						dictionary.Add(mongoDBProperty.Name, mongoDBProperty);
					}
				}
				IEnumerable<MongoDBProperty> values = dictionary.Values;
				Type type = DynamicTypesHelper.CreateType(DynamicTypesHelper.ModuleBuilder, values, propertyName, true, IgnoreExtraElementsAttributeBuilder);
				return new MongoDBProperty(propertyName, type);
			}
			if ((bool)BsonValueIsBsonArray.GetValue(value))
			{
				object value5 = BsonValueAsBsonArray.GetValue(value);
				IEnumerable values2 = (IEnumerable)BsonArrayValues.GetValue(value5);
				MongoDBProperty mongoDBProperty2 = new MongoDBProperty(propertyName, DetectSchema(values2, propertyName, schemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount, cancellationToken));
				if (mongoDBProperty2.Type.IsPrimitive)
				{
					return new MongoDBProperty(propertyName, typeof(List<>).MakeGenericType(mongoDBProperty2.Type));
				}
				Type type2 = typeof(List<>).MakeGenericType(mongoDBProperty2.Type);
				return new MongoDBProperty(propertyName, type2);
			}
			Type type3 = MethodMapToDotNetValue.Invoke(null, new object[1] { value }).GetType();
			return new MongoDBProperty(propertyName, type3);
		}

		private MongoDBProperty MergeProperties(MongoDBProperty prop1, MongoDBProperty prop2, string propertyName)
		{
			Type elementType;
			int nestingLevel = GetNestingLevel(prop1.Type, out elementType);
			Type elementType2;
			int nestingLevel2 = GetNestingLevel(prop2.Type, out elementType2);
			if (nestingLevel != nestingLevel2 || elementType == typeof(object) || elementType2 == typeof(object))
			{
				return new MongoDBProperty(propertyName, typeof(object).MakeListType(Math.Min(nestingLevel, nestingLevel2)));
			}
			if (elementType == null || DataContext.IsStandardType(elementType))
			{
				return prop1;
			}
			List<MongoDBProperty> list = new List<MongoDBProperty>();
			PropertyInfo[] properties = elementType.GetProperties();
			PropertyInfo[] array = properties;
			foreach (PropertyInfo propertyInfo in array)
			{
				MongoDBProperty mongoDBProperty = new MongoDBProperty(propertyInfo.Name, propertyInfo.PropertyType);
				foreach (CustomAttributeData customAttribute in propertyInfo.CustomAttributes)
				{
					mongoDBProperty.AddCustomAttribute(customAttribute.Constructor, customAttribute.ConstructorArguments.Select((CustomAttributeTypedArgument a) => a.Value).ToArray());
				}
				list.Add(mongoDBProperty);
			}
			PropertyInfo[] properties2 = elementType2.GetProperties();
			foreach (PropertyInfo prop3 in properties2)
			{
				MongoDBProperty mongoDBProperty2 = list.FirstOrDefault((MongoDBProperty x) => x.Name == prop3.Name);
				if (mongoDBProperty2 == null)
				{
					list.Add(new MongoDBProperty(prop3.Name, prop3.PropertyType));
				}
				else if (mongoDBProperty2.Type != typeof(object))
				{
					if (prop3 == typeof(object))
					{
						ReplaceProperty(list, mongoDBProperty2, new MongoDBProperty(prop3.Name, typeof(object)));
					}
					else if (DataContext.IsStandardType(prop3.PropertyType) && prop3.PropertyType != mongoDBProperty2.Type)
					{
						Type type = ((TypeHelper.IsNumericType(mongoDBProperty2.Type) && TypeHelper.IsNumericType(prop3.PropertyType)) ? typeof(double) : typeof(object));
						ReplaceProperty(list, mongoDBProperty2, new MongoDBProperty(prop3.Name, type));
					}
					else if (prop3.PropertyType != mongoDBProperty2.Type)
					{
						MongoDBProperty prop4 = MergeProperties(new MongoDBProperty(prop3.Name, prop3.PropertyType), mongoDBProperty2, mongoDBProperty2.Name);
						ReplaceProperty(list, mongoDBProperty2, prop4);
					}
				}
			}
			Type type2 = DynamicTypesHelper.CreateType(DynamicTypesHelper.ModuleBuilder, list, propertyName, true, IgnoreExtraElementsAttributeBuilder);
			type2 = type2.MakeListType(nestingLevel);
			return new MongoDBProperty(propertyName, type2);
		}

		private static int GetNestingLevel(Type type, out Type elementType)
		{
			int num = 0;
			elementType = type;
			Type columnItemType;
			while (elementType != MongoDBDatabase.TypeBsonValue && TypeHelper.CanUnfold(elementType, out columnItemType))
			{
				elementType = columnItemType;
				num++;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private static void ReplaceProperty(List<MongoDBProperty> properties, MongoDBProperty existedProp, MongoDBProperty prop)
		{
			int index = properties.IndexOf(existedProp);
			properties.Remove(existedProp);
			properties.Insert(index, prop);
		}
	}

	public static class MongoDBConfigurationHelper
	{
		public const string MongoDBProviderName = "MongoDBProvider";

		public static bool TryCreateMongoDBDataConnection(IConnectionStringInfo connectionsInfo, out MongoDBDataConnection connection)
		{
			connection = null;
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(connectionsInfo.ProviderName) && connectionsInfo.ProviderName != "MongoDBProvider")
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(connectionsInfo.RunTimeConnectionString))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!connectionsInfo.RunTimeConnectionString.StartsWith("mongodb://", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase) && !connectionsInfo.RunTimeConnectionString.StartsWith("mongodb+srv://", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
			{
				return false;
			}
			string url;
			try
			{
				url = new MongoDBUrlBuilder(connectionsInfo.RunTimeConnectionString).Url;
			}
			catch
			{
				return false;
			}
			connection = new MongoDBDataConnection(url)
			{
				Name = connectionsInfo.Name,
				StoreConnectionNameOnly = true
			};
			return true;
		}

		public static List<MongoDBDataConnection> GetConnections(IConnectionStringInfo[] connectionsInfo)
		{
			List<MongoDBDataConnection> list = new List<MongoDBDataConnection>();
			foreach (IConnectionStringInfo connectionsInfo2 in connectionsInfo)
			{
				MongoDBDataConnection connection = null;
				if (TryCreateMongoDBDataConnection(connectionsInfo2, out connection))
				{
					list.Add(connection);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}
	}
	public class QuerySerializer : IDataSerializer
	{
		internal const string XML_Query = "Query";

		private const string XML_DatabaseName = "DatabaseName";

		private const string XML_CollectionName = "CollectionName";

		private const string XML_Alias = "Alias";

		private const string XML_FilterString = "FilterString";

		private const string XML_Schema = "Schema";

		public static MongoDBQuery LoadFromXml(XElement element, IExtensionsProvider extensionProvider)
		{
			if (!string.Equals(element.Name.LocalName, "Query", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Incorrect XML root element: <" + element.Name.LocalName + ">, <Query> is expected.");
			}
			MongoDBQuery mongoDBQuery = new MongoDBQuery();
			XAttribute xAttribute = element.Attribute("DatabaseName");
			if (xAttribute != null)
			{
				mongoDBQuery.DatabaseName = xAttribute.Value;
			}
			XAttribute xAttribute2 = element.Attribute("CollectionName");
			if (xAttribute2 != null)
			{
				mongoDBQuery.CollectionName = xAttribute2.Value;
			}
			XAttribute xAttribute3 = element.Attribute("Alias");
			if (xAttribute3 != null)
			{
				mongoDBQuery.Alias = xAttribute3.Value;
			}
			XAttribute xAttribute4 = element.Attribute("FilterString");
			if (xAttribute4 != null)
			{
				mongoDBQuery.FilterString = xAttribute4.Value;
			}
			XElement xElement = element.Element("Schema");
			if (xElement != null)
			{
				MongoDBSchemaNode mongoDBSchemaNode = new MongoDBSchemaNode();
				mongoDBSchemaNode.LoadFromXml(xElement);
				mongoDBQuery.Schema = mongoDBSchemaNode;
			}
			CultureInfo currentCulture = CultureInfo.CurrentCulture;
			CultureInfoExtensions.SetCurrentCulture(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			try
			{
				foreach (XElement item in element.Elements("Parameter"))
				{
					DevExpress.DataAccess.MongoDB.QueryParameter queryParameter = new DevExpress.DataAccess.MongoDB.QueryParameter();
					ParameterSerializer.DeserializeParameter(queryParameter, item, extensionProvider);
					mongoDBQuery.Parameters.Add(queryParameter);
				}
				return mongoDBQuery;
			}
			finally
			{
				CultureInfoExtensions.SetCurrentCulture(currentCulture);
			}
		}

		public static XElement SaveToXml(object data, IExtensionsProvider extensionProvider)
		{
			return SaveToXml(data, extensionProvider, null);
		}

		internal static XElement SaveToXml(object data, IExtensionsProvider extensionProvider, ISerializableTypesCollector collector)
		{
			if (data == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("data");
			}
			if (!(data is MongoDBQuery mongoDBQuery))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException();
			}
			XElement xElement = new XElement("Query");
			if (mongoDBQuery.DatabaseName != null)
			{
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("DatabaseName", mongoDBQuery.DatabaseName));
			}
			if (mongoDBQuery.CollectionName != null)
			{
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("CollectionName", mongoDBQuery.CollectionName));
			}
			if (mongoDBQuery.Alias != null)
			{
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("Alias", mongoDBQuery.Alias));
			}
			if (mongoDBQuery.FilterString != null)
			{
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("FilterString", mongoDBQuery.FilterString));
			}
			if (mongoDBQuery.Schema != null)
			{
				xElement.Add(mongoDBQuery.Schema.SaveToXml());
			}
			CultureInfo currentCulture = CultureInfo.CurrentCulture;
			CultureInfoExtensions.SetCurrentCulture(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			try
			{
				foreach (DevExpress.DataAccess.MongoDB.QueryParameter parameter in mongoDBQuery.Parameters)
				{
					xElement.Add(ParameterSerializer.SerializeParameter(extensionProvider, parameter, collector));
				}
				return xElement;
			}
			finally
			{
				CultureInfoExtensions.SetCurrentCulture(currentCulture);
			}
		}

		public bool CanSerialize(object data, object extensionProvider)
		{
			return data?.GetType() == typeof(MongoDBQuery);
		}

		public bool CanDeserialize(string value, string typeName, object extensionProvider)
		{
			return typeof(MongoDBQuery).FullName == typeName;
		}

		object IDataSerializer.Deserialize(string value, string typeName, object extensionProvider)
		{
			return LoadFromXml(SafeXml.CreateXElement(value, (Action<XmlReaderSettings>)null), (IExtensionsProvider)((extensionProvider is IExtensionsProvider) ? extensionProvider : null));
		}

		string IDataSerializer.Serialize(object data, object extensionProvider)
		{
			return SaveToXml(data, (IExtensionsProvider)((extensionProvider is IExtensionsProvider) ? extensionProvider : null), null).ToString(SaveOptions.DisableFormatting);
		}
	}
	public class MongoDBDataSourceSerializer
	{
		public const string XML_Name = "Name";

		public const string XML_Connection = "Connection";

		public const string XML_ConnectionName = "ConnectionName";

		public const string XML_Queries = "Queries";

		public const string XML_DataSourceName = "MongoDBDataSource";

		public const string XML_SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount = "SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount";

		public static XElement SaveToXml(MongoDBDataSourceBase dataSource)
		{
			return SaveToXml(dataSource, null);
		}

		public static XElement SaveToXml(MongoDBDataSourceBase dataSource, IExtensionsProvider extensionsProvider)
		{
			XElement xElement = new XElement("MongoDBDataSource");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataSource.Name))
			{
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("Name", dataSource.Name));
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataSource.ConnectionName))
			{
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("ConnectionName", dataSource.ConnectionName));
			}
			if (dataSource.SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount != 100)
			{
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount", dataSource.SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount));
			}
			if (dataSource.ConnectionParameters != null)
			{
				XElement content = dataSource.ConnectionParameters.SaveToXml();
				xElement.Add(content);
			}
			else
			{
				SaveConnection(xElement, dataSource);
			}
			XElement xElement2 = SaveQueriesToXml(dataSource, extensionsProvider);
			if (xElement2 != null)
			{
				xElement.Add(xElement2);
			}
			return xElement;
		}

		private static void SaveConnection(XElement rootEl, MongoDBDataSourceBase dataSource)
		{
			if (dataSource.ConnectionParameters == null && string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataSource.ConnectionName))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (dataSource.ConnectionParameters == null)
			{
				MongoDBDataConnection mongoDBDataConnection = new MongoDBDataConnection
				{
					Name = dataSource.ConnectionName,
					StoreConnectionNameOnly = true
				};
				XElement xElement = new XElement("Connection");
				mongoDBDataConnection.SaveToXml(xElement);
				rootEl.Add(xElement);
			}
			else
			{
				MongoDBDataConnection connection = dataSource.Connection;
				if (connection != null)
				{
					XElement xElement2 = new XElement("Connection");
					connection.SaveToXml(xElement2);
					rootEl.Add(xElement2);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void LoadFromXml(MongoDBDataSourceBase dataSource, XElement element)
		{
			LoadFromXml(dataSource, element, null);
		}

		internal static void LoadFromXml(MongoDBDataSourceBase dataSource, XElement element, IExtensionsProvider extensionsProvider)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)element, "element");
			if (!string.Equals(element.Name.LocalName, "MongoDBDataSource", StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Incorrect XML root element: <" + element.Name.LocalName + ">, <MongoDBDataSource> is expected.");
			}
			dataSource.Name = element.GetAttributeValue("Name");
			dataSource.ConnectionName = element.GetAttributeValue("ConnectionName");
			if (int.TryParse(element.GetAttributeValue("SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount"), out var result))
			{
				dataSource.SchemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount = result;
			}
			dataSource.ConnectionParameters = MongoDBConnectionParametersBase.CreateFromXml(element);
			if (dataSource.ConnectionParameters == null)
			{
				LoadConnection(dataSource, element);
			}
			XElement xElement = element.Element("Queries");
			if (xElement != null)
			{
				LoadQueriesFromXml(dataSource, xElement, extensionsProvider);
			}
		}

		private static void LoadConnection(MongoDBDataSourceBase dataSource, XElement element)
		{
			XElement xElement = element.Element("Connection");
			if (xElement != null)
			{
				MongoDBDataConnection mongoDBDataConnection = new MongoDBDataConnection();
				mongoDBDataConnection.LoadFromXml(xElement);
				dataSource.SetConnectionInfo(mongoDBDataConnection);
			}
		}

		public static void LoadQueriesFromXml(MongoDBDataSourceBase dataSource, XElement element)
		{
			LoadQueriesFromXml(dataSource, element, null);
		}

		internal static void LoadQueriesFromXml(MongoDBDataSourceBase dataSource, XElement element, IExtensionsProvider extensionsProvider)
		{
			dataSource.Queries.Clear();
			foreach (XElement item2 in element.Elements("Query"))
			{
				MongoDBQuery item = QuerySerializer.LoadFromXml(item2, extensionsProvider);
				dataSource.Queries.Add(item);
			}
		}

		public static XElement SaveQueriesToXml(MongoDBDataSourceBase dataSource)
		{
			return SaveQueriesToXml(dataSource, null);
		}

		public static XElement SaveQueriesToXml(MongoDBDataSourceBase dataSource, IExtensionsProvider extensionsProvider)
		{
			if (dataSource.Queries.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			XElement xElement = new XElement("Queries");
			ISerializableTypesCollector collector = dataSource.GetService(typeof(ISerializableTypesCollector)) as ISerializableTypesCollector;
			foreach (MongoDBQuery query in dataSource.Queries)
			{
				xElement.Add(QuerySerializer.SaveToXml(query, extensionsProvider, collector));
			}
			return xElement;
		}
	}

	internal class MongoDBClient : IMongoDBClient
	{
		private readonly object client;

		private static Type TypeIAsyncCursorExtensions { get; }

		private static Type TypeMongoDBClient { get; }

		private static MethodInfo MethodListDatabaseNames { get; }

		private static MethodInfo MethodListDatabaseNamesAsync { get; }

		internal static MethodInfo MethodToList { get; }

		internal static MethodInfo MethodToListAsync { get; }

		static MongoDBClient()
		{
			TypeMongoDBClient = XPTypeActivator.GetType("MongoDB.Driver", "MongoDB.Driver.MongoClient", true);
			TypeIAsyncCursorExtensions = XPTypeActivator.GetType("MongoDB.Driver.Core", "MongoDB.Driver.IAsyncCursorExtensions", true);
			MethodListDatabaseNames = TypeMongoDBClient.GetMethods().Single(delegate(MethodInfo m)
			{
				ParameterInfo[] parameters = m.GetParameters();
				return m.Name == "ListDatabaseNames" && parameters.Length == 1 && parameters[0].Name == "cancellationToken";
			});
			MethodListDatabaseNamesAsync = TypeMongoDBClient.GetMethods().Single(delegate(MethodInfo m)
			{
				ParameterInfo[] parameters = m.GetParameters();
				return m.Name == "ListDatabaseNamesAsync" && parameters.Length == 1 && parameters[0].Name == "cancellationToken";
			});
			MethodToList = TypeIAsyncCursorExtensions.GetMethods().Single(delegate(MethodInfo m)
			{
				ParameterInfo[] parameters = m.GetParameters();
				return m.Name == "ToList" && parameters.Length == 2 && parameters[0].Name == "source" && parameters[1].Name == "cancellationToken";
			}).MakeGenericMethod(typeof(string));
			MethodToListAsync = TypeIAsyncCursorExtensions.GetMethods().Single(delegate(MethodInfo m)
			{
				ParameterInfo[] parameters = m.GetParameters();
				return m.Name == "ToListAsync" && parameters.Length == 2 && parameters[0].Name == "source" && parameters[1].Name == "cancellationToken";
			}).MakeGenericMethod(typeof(string));
		}

		public MongoDBClient(string connectionString)
		{
			client = Activator.CreateInstance(TypeMongoDBClient, connectionString);
		}

		public void CheckConnection(CancellationToken token)
		{
			try
			{
				MethodListDatabaseNames.Invoke(client, new object[1] { token });
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				throw MongoDBDataConnection.ProcessException(null, exception);
			}
		}

		public List<string> ListDatabaseNames(CancellationToken token)
		{
			try
			{
				object obj = MethodListDatabaseNames.Invoke(client, new object[1] { token });
				List<string> list = MethodToList.Invoke(null, new object[2] { obj, null }) as List<string>;
				return ApplyDatabaseNamesFilter(list);
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				throw MongoDBDataConnection.ProcessException(null, exception);
			}
		}

		public async Task<List<string>> ListDatabaseNamesAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			Task getAsyncCursorTask = (Task)MethodListDatabaseNamesAsync.Invoke(client, new object[1] { cancellationToken });
			await getAsyncCursorTask.ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
			PropertyInfo property = getAsyncCursorTask.GetType().GetProperty("Result");
			object value = property.GetValue(getAsyncCursorTask);
			Task<List<string>> task = (Task<List<string>>)MethodToListAsync.Invoke(null, new object[2] { value, cancellationToken });
			return ApplyDatabaseNamesFilter(await task);
		}

		private static List<string> ApplyDatabaseNamesFilter(List<string> list)
		{
			return list?.Where((string s) => !string.Equals(s, "local", StringComparison.InvariantCulture)).ToList();
		}

		public IMongoDBDatabase GetDatabase(string databaseName)
		{
			MethodInfo methodInfo = TypeMongoDBClient.GetMethods().Single(delegate(MethodInfo m)
			{
				ParameterInfo[] parameters = m.GetParameters();
				return m.Name == "GetDatabase" && parameters.Length == 2 && parameters[0].Name == "name" && parameters[1].Name == "settings";
			});
			return new MongoDBDatabase(methodInfo.Invoke(client, new object[2] { databaseName, null }));
		}
	}

	public class MongoDBFilterPresenter : FilterPresenterBase<FilterModel, IFilterView, MongoDBFilterPresenter>, IFilterPresenter
	{
		private readonly Type collectionElementType;

		private readonly string tableName;

		public MongoDBFilterPresenter(FilterModel model, IFilterView view, MongoDBQuery query, Type documentType)
			: base(model, view)
		{
			collectionElementType = documentType;
			tableName = query.CollectionName;
		}

		IParameter IFilterPresenter.CreateParameter(string name, Type type)
		{
			DevExpress.DataAccess.MongoDB.QueryParameter queryParameter = new DevExpress.DataAccess.MongoDB.QueryParameter(name, type, type.IsValueType ? Activator.CreateInstance(type) : null);
			((PresenterBase<FilterModel, IFilterView, MongoDBFilterPresenter>)this).Model.Parameters.Add(queryParameter);
			return (IParameter)(object)queryParameter;
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<FilterViewTableInfo> GetColumnsInfo()
		{
			if (TypeHelper.CanFlatten(collectionElementType, out var properties))
			{
				IEnumerable<FilterViewColumnInfo> columns = from p in properties
					select new FilterViewColumnInfo(p.Name, TypeHelper.ExpandNullable(p.PropertyType)) into p
					where TypeHelper.IsPrimitive(p.ColumnType)
					select p;
				yield return new FilterViewTableInfo(tableName, columns);
			}
		}

		protected override void Commit()
		{
			((PresenterBase<FilterModel, IFilterView, MongoDBFilterPresenter>)this).Model.FilterString = EFFilterHelper.CutOffTableNames(((PresenterBase<FilterModel, IFilterView, MongoDBFilterPresenter>)this).View.FilterString);
		}
	}

			select method).First((MethodInfo method) => method.IsGenericMethodDefinition);

		private static MongoDBSchemaNode DetectSchema(IEnumerable values, string propertyName, int schemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			MongoDBSchemaHelper mongoDBSchemaHelper = new MongoDBSchemaHelper();
