		public static IEnumerable<ResultCollection> ExecuteQueries(MongoDBDataConnection connection, IEnumerable<MongoDBQuery> queriesToFill, IList<IParameter> sourceParameters, int schemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount, bool includeData, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			connection.Open(cancellationToken);
			QueryExecutor queryExecutor = new QueryExecutor(sourceParameters);
			return queriesToFill.Select((MongoDBQuery query) => queryExecutor.Execute(connection, query, includeData, schemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount, cancellationToken));
		}

		public ResultCollection Execute(MongoDBDataConnection connection, MongoDBQuery query, bool includeData, int schemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			connection.Open(cancellationToken);
			List<string> list = connection.Client.ListDatabaseNames(cancellationToken);
			IList innerList = null;
			bool limitApplied = false;
			Type type;
			try
			{
				if (list == null || !list.Any((string n) => query.DatabaseName == n))
				{
					throw new DatabaseNotFoundValidationException(query.DatabaseName);
				}
				IMongoDBDatabase database = connection.Client.GetDatabase(query.DatabaseName);
				List<string> list2 = database.ListCollectionNames();
				if (list2 == null || !list2.Any((string n) => query.CollectionName == n))
				{
					throw new CollectionNotFoundValidationException(query.CollectionName);
				}
				if (query.Schema != null)
				{
					type = MongoDBSchemaHelper.CreateMongoDBType(query.Schema);
				}
				else
				{
					MongoDBSchemaNode collectionElementType = database.GetCollectionElementType(query.CollectionName, schemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount, cancellationToken);
					type = collectionElementType.Type;
					limitApplied = collectionElementType.DiscoveryLimitApplied;
				}
				if (includeData)
				{
					IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters = ParametersEvaluator.EvaluateParameters(SourceParameters, query.Parameters);
					CriteriaOperator filter = null;
					string filterString = query.FilterString;
					if (type != null && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(filterString))
					{
						filter = FilterHelper.GetCriteriaOperator(filterString, parameters);
						filter = filter.Accept<CriteriaOperator>((ICriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>)new ParametersToValuesReplacer());
					}
					IQueryable collection = database.GetCollection(query.CollectionName, type, filter);
					MethodInfo methodInfo = typeof(Enumerable).GetMethods(BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public).Single((MethodInfo m) => m.Name == "ToList" && m.GetParameters().Length == 1 && m.IsGenericMethod).MakeGenericMethod(type);
					object[] parameters2 = new IQueryable[1] { collection };
					innerList = methodInfo.Invoke(null, parameters2) as IList;
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (ex is ValidationException)
				{
					throw;
				}
				throw new DevExpress.DataAccess.MongoDB.QueryExecutionException(query.ActualName, ex);
			}
			return new ResultCollection(query.ActualName, innerList, type, limitApplied);
		}

		public static async Task<IEnumerable<ResultCollection>> ExecuteQueriesAsync(MongoDBDataConnection connection, IEnumerable<MongoDBQuery> queriesToFill, IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters, int schemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount, bool includeData, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			connection.Open(cancellationToken);
			QueryExecutor queryExecutor = new QueryExecutor(sourceParameters);
			List<ResultCollection> result = new List<ResultCollection>();
			foreach (MongoDBQuery item in queriesToFill)
			{
				List<ResultCollection> list = result;
				list.Add(await queryExecutor.ExecuteAsync(connection, item, includeData, schemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount, cancellationToken));
			}
			return result;
		}

		public async Task<ResultCollection> ExecuteAsync(MongoDBDataConnection connection, MongoDBQuery query, bool includeData, int schemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			connection.Open(cancellationToken);
			List<string> list;
			try
			{
				list = await connection.Client.ListDatabaseNamesAsync(cancellationToken);
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				throw MongoDBDataConnection.ProcessException(connection.Name, exception);
			}
			IList data = null;
			Type type;
			try
			{
				if (list == null || !list.Any((string n) => query.DatabaseName == n))
				{
					throw new DatabaseNotFoundValidationException(query.DatabaseName);
				}
				IMongoDBDatabase database = connection.Client.GetDatabase(query.DatabaseName);
				List<string> list2 = await database.ListCollectionNamesAsync(cancellationToken);
				if (list2 == null || !list2.Any((string n) => query.CollectionName == n))
				{
					throw new CollectionNotFoundValidationException(query.CollectionName);
				}
				type = ((query.Schema != null) ? MongoDBSchemaHelper.CreateMongoDBType(query.Schema) : database.GetCollectionElementType(query.CollectionName, schemaDiscoveryMaxItemCount, cancellationToken).Type);
				if (includeData)
				{
					IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters = ParametersEvaluator.EvaluateParameters(SourceParameters, query.Parameters);
					CriteriaOperator filter = null;
					string filterString = query.FilterString;
					if (type != null && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(filterString))
					{
						filter = FilterHelper.GetCriteriaOperator(filterString, parameters);
						filter = filter.Accept<CriteriaOperator>((ICriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>)new ParametersToValuesReplacer());
					}
					IQueryable collection = database.GetCollection(query.CollectionName, type, filter);
					data = ActivatorEx.New<IList>(typeof(List<>), type);
					foreach (object item in collection)
					{
						cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
						data.Add(item);
					}
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (ex is ValidationException)
				{
					throw;
				}
				throw new DevExpress.DataAccess.MongoDB.QueryExecutionException(query.ActualName, ex);
			}
			return new ResultCollection(query.ActualName, data, type);
		}
	}
	public class ResultCollection : ResultTableBase, IBindingList, IList, ICollection, IEnumerable
	{
		private class ResultTableEnumerator : IEnumerator<ResultRow>, IDisposable, IEnumerator
		{
			private int position = -1;

			private readonly ResultCollection owner;

			private readonly int count;

			object IEnumerator.Current => Current;

			public ResultRow Current => new ResultRow(owner, position);

			public ResultTableEnumerator(ResultCollection owner, int count)
			{
				this.count = count;
				this.owner = owner;
			}

			public bool MoveNext()
			{
				return ++position < count;
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				position = -1;
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
			}
		}

		private ResultTypedList typedList;

		private string tableName;

		public override string TableName
		{
			get
			{
				return tableName;
			}
			set
			{
				tableName = value;
			}
		}

		public override List<ResultRelation> Details { get; } = new List<ResultRelation>();

		public override List<ResultColumn> Columns { get; } = new List<ResultColumn>();

		public string Name => TableName;

		public Type ElementType { get; set; }

		public bool IsEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				if (InnerList != null)
				{
					return InnerList.Count == 0;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal IList InnerList { get; set; }

		internal bool DiscoveryLimitApplied { get; private set; }

		public override bool AllowNew => false;

		public override int Count => InnerList?.Count ?? 0;

		public ResultCollection(string name, IList innerList, Type elementType, bool limitApplied)
		{
			tableName = name;
			SetData(innerList, elementType, limitApplied, raiseChanged: false);
		}

		public ResultCollection(string name, IList innerList, Type elementType)
			: this(name, innerList, elementType, limitApplied: false)
		{
		}

		public override IEnumerator<ResultRow> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new ResultTableEnumerator(this, Count);
		}

		public override bool Contains(ResultRow item)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public override void CopyTo(ResultRow[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public override int IndexOf(ResultRow item)
		{
			return item?.Index ?? (-1);
		}

		protected override ResultRow ElementAt(int index)
		{
			return new ResultRow(this, index);
		}

		public override object AddNew()
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public override void CancelNew(int itemIndex)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public override void EndNew(int itemIndex)
		{
		}

		protected override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(PropertyDescriptor[] listAccessors)
		{
			if (listAccessors == null || listAccessors.Length == 0)
			{
				PropertyDescriptor[] properties = Columns.ToArray();
				return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(properties);
			}
			return typedList.GetItemProperties(listAccessors);
		}

		internal void SetData(IList innerList, Type elementType, bool limitApplied, bool raiseChanged)
		{
			DiscoveryLimitApplied = limitApplied;
			InnerList = innerList;
			ElementType = elementType;
			typedList = new ResultTypedList(Name, (innerList != null) ? ObjectDataSourceFillHelper.GetItemProperties(innerList) : ObjectDataSourceFillHelper.GetItemProperties(ElementType), innerList ?? new ArrayList(0));
			PropertyDescriptorCollection source = ((innerList != null) ? ObjectDataSourceFillHelper.GetItemProperties(innerList) : ObjectDataSourceFillHelper.GetItemProperties(elementType));
			Columns.Clear();
			Columns.AddRange(from d in source.OfType<PropertyDescriptor>()
				select new ResultCollectionColumn(d.Name, this, d));
			if (!raiseChanged)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ResultColumn column in Columns)
			{
				OnListChanged(ListChangedType.PropertyDescriptorAdded, column);
			}
			OnListChanged(ListChangedType.Reset, -1);
		}
	}
	public class ResultSet : IList, ICollection, IEnumerable, ITypedList, IBindingList
	{
		private class TypedListPropertyDescriptor : PropertyDescriptor
		{
			public override Type ComponentType { get; }

		}

		private readonly Dictionary<string, ResultCollection> collections = new Dictionary<string, ResultCollection>();

		public ResultCollection this[string name] => collections[name];

		internal IEnumerable<ResultCollection> Collections => collections.Values;

		int ICollection.Count => 1;

		object ICollection.SyncRoot => this;

		bool ICollection.IsSynchronized => false;

		object IList.this[int index]

		public ResultSet(params ResultCollection[] collections)
		{
			foreach (ResultCollection resultCollection in collections)
			{
				this.collections.Add(resultCollection.TableName, resultCollection);
			}
		}

		internal void Add(ResultCollection collection)
		{
			AddSilent(collection);
			RaiseChanged();
		}

		internal void AddSilent(ResultCollection collection)
		{
			collections.Add(collection.TableName, collection);
		}

		internal void ApplyResult(ResultCollection[] result)
		{
			if (result.Length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ResultCollection collection in result)
			{
				ResultCollection resultCollection = Collections.FirstOrDefault((ResultCollection c) => c.TableName == collection.TableName);
				if (resultCollection != null)
				{
					resultCollection.SetData(collection.InnerList, collection.ElementType, collection.DiscoveryLimitApplied, raiseChanged: true);
				}
				else
				{
					collections.Add(collection.TableName, collection);
				}
			}
			RaiseChanged();
		}

		internal void Clear()
		{
			collections.Clear();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return collections.Values.GetEnumerator();
		}

		void ICollection.CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{
			array.SetValue(this, index);
		}

		int IList.Add(object value)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		bool IList.Contains(object value)
		{
			return value == this;
		}

		void IList.Clear()
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		int IList.IndexOf(object value)
		{
			if (!((IList)this).Contains(value))
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		public string GetListName(PropertyDescriptor[] listAccessors)
		{
			return string.Empty;
		}

		public PropertyDescriptorCollection GetItemProperties(PropertyDescriptor[] listAccessors)
		{
			if (listAccessors == null || listAccessors.Length == 0)
			{
				PropertyDescriptor[] properties = ((IEnumerable<ResultCollection>)collections.Values).Select((Func<ResultCollection, PropertyDescriptor>)((ResultCollection t) => new TypedListPropertyDescriptor(GetType(), t.GetType(), t.GetListName(null)))).ToArray();
				return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(properties);
			}
			if (!collections.TryGetValue(listAccessors.First().Name, out var value))
			{
				return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(null);
			}
			return value.GetItemProperties(listAccessors.Skip(1).ToArray());
		}

		private void RaiseChanged()
		{
			this.ListChanged?.Invoke(this, new ListChangedEventArgs(ListChangedType.Reset, -1));
		}

	public class MongoDBQueryCollectionTypeConverter : CollectionTypeConverter
	{
		private class QueryPropertyDescriptor : TypeConverter.SimplePropertyDescriptor
		{
			public class QueryExpandableObjectConverter : ExpandableObjectConverter
			{
				private class QueryAliasPropertyDescriptor : SimplePropertyDescriptor
				{
					private readonly PropertyDescriptor parent;

					private readonly IServiceProvider serviceProvider;

					public QueryAliasPropertyDescriptor(PropertyDescriptor parent, IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
						: base(parent.ComponentType, parent.Name, parent.PropertyType, (System.Attribute[])new ArrayList(parent.Attributes).ToArray(typeof(System.Attribute)))
					{
						this.parent = parent;
						this.serviceProvider = serviceProvider;
					}

					public override object GetValue(object component)
					{
						return parent.GetValue(component);
					}

					public override void SetValue(object component, object value)
					{
						IDesignerHost designerHost = (IDesignerHost)(serviceProvider?.GetService(typeof(IDesignerHost)));
						IComponentChangeService componentChangeService = (IComponentChangeService)(serviceProvider?.GetService(typeof(IComponentChangeService)));
						DesignerTransaction designerTransaction = designerHost?.CreateTransaction();
						MongoDBQuery mongoDBQuery = (MongoDBQuery)component;
						string newQueryName = (string)value;
						string actualName = mongoDBQuery.ActualName;
						componentChangeService?.OnComponentChanging(mongoDBQuery.DataSource, null);
						try
						{
							parent.SetValue(component, value);
							mongoDBQuery.DataSource.RenameResultSchemaPart(actualName, newQueryName);
							componentChangeService?.OnComponentChanged(mongoDBQuery.DataSource, null, null, null);
							designerTransaction?.Commit();
						}
						catch (Exception)
						{
							designerTransaction?.Cancel();
							throw;
						}
					}
				}

				public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value, System.Attribute[] attributes)
				{
					PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = base.GetProperties(context, value, attributes);
					List<PropertyDescriptor> list = new List<PropertyDescriptor>(properties.Count);
					foreach (PropertyDescriptor item2 in properties)
					{
						PropertyDescriptor item;
						switch (item2.Name)
						{
						case "Alias":
							item = new QueryAliasPropertyDescriptor(item2, context);
							break;
						case "DatabaseName":
						case "CollectionName":
							item = new ReadOnlyPropertyDescriptor(item2);
							break;
						default:
							item = item2;
							break;
						}
						list.Add(item);
					}
					return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(list.ToArray(), readOnly: true);
				}
			}

			private readonly int index;

			public QueryPropertyDescriptor(int index, System.Attribute[] attributes)
				: base(typeof(MongoDBQueryCollection), $"[{index}]", typeof(MongoDBQuery), attributes)
			{
				this.index = index;
			}

			public override object GetValue(object component)
			{
				MongoDBQueryCollection mongoDBQueryCollection = (MongoDBQueryCollection)component;
				return mongoDBQueryCollection[index];
			}

			public override void SetValue(object component, object value)
			{
				MongoDBQueryCollection mongoDBQueryCollection = (MongoDBQueryCollection)component;
				mongoDBQueryCollection[index] = (MongoDBQuery)value;
			}
		}

		public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value, System.Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			MongoDBQueryCollection mongoDBQueryCollection = (MongoDBQueryCollection)value;
			PropertyDescriptor[] array = new QueryPropertyDescriptor[mongoDBQueryCollection.Count];
			PropertyDescriptor[] array2 = array;
			for (int i = 0; i < array2.Length; i++)
			{
				array2[i] = new QueryPropertyDescriptor(i, GetQueryPropertyDescriptorAttributes());
			}
			return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(array2);
		}

		protected virtual System.Attribute[] GetQueryPropertyDescriptorAttributes()
		{
			return new System.Attribute[1]
			{
				new TypeConverterAttribute(typeof(QueryPropertyDescriptor.QueryExpandableObjectConverter))
			};
		}

		public override bool GetPropertiesSupported(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return true;
		}
	}
}

				return null;

		}

	public class MongoDBConnectionStrategy : IConnectionParametersStrategy
	{
		internal const int DefaultPort = 27017;

		private static readonly string defaultPort = 27017.ToString();

		public ConnectionParameterEdits Subscriptions => ConnectionParameterEdits.SRVRecordMongo | ConnectionParameterEdits.AuthTypeMongo;

		public string FileNameFilter => null;

		public bool CanGetDatabases => false;

		public ConnectionParameterEdits GetEditsSet(IConnectionParametersControl control)
		{
			ConnectionParameterEdits connectionParameterEdits = ConnectionParameterEdits.Port | ConnectionParameterEdits.Hostname | ConnectionParameterEdits.SRVRecordMongo | ConnectionParameterEdits.AuthTypeMongo;
			switch (control.AuthTypeMongo)
			{
			case MongoDBAuthenticationType.Password:
			case MongoDBAuthenticationType.ScramSHA256:
				connectionParameterEdits |= ConnectionParameterEdits.UserName;
				connectionParameterEdits |= ConnectionParameterEdits.Password;
				connectionParameterEdits |= ConnectionParameterEdits.AuthDataBaseMongo;
				break;
			case MongoDBAuthenticationType.LDAP:
				connectionParameterEdits |= ConnectionParameterEdits.UserName;
				connectionParameterEdits |= ConnectionParameterEdits.Password;
				break;
			case MongoDBAuthenticationType.Kerberos:
				connectionParameterEdits |= ConnectionParameterEdits.Password;
				connectionParameterEdits |= ConnectionParameterEdits.PrincipalMongo;
				connectionParameterEdits |= ConnectionParameterEdits.ServiceNameMongo;
				connectionParameterEdits |= ConnectionParameterEdits.CanonicalizeHostMongo;
				break;
			case MongoDBAuthenticationType.X509:
				connectionParameterEdits |= ConnectionParameterEdits.UserName;
				break;
			default:
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			case MongoDBAuthenticationType.None:
				break;
			}
			return connectionParameterEdits;
		}

		public ConnectionParameterEdits GetDisabledEdits(IConnectionParametersControl control)
		{
			ConnectionParameterEdits connectionParameterEdits = ConnectionParameterEdits.None;
			if (control.IsMongoSRVRecord)
			{
				connectionParameterEdits |= ConnectionParameterEdits.Port;
			}
			return connectionParameterEdits;
		}

		public string GetDefaultText(ConnectionParameterEdits edit)
		{
			return edit switch
			{
				ConnectionParameterEdits.Hostname => "localhost", 
				ConnectionParameterEdits.Port => defaultPort, 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		public int GetDefaultIndex(ConnectionParameterEdits edit)
		{
			return 0;
		}

		public DataConnectionParametersBase GetConnectionParameters(IConnectionParametersControl control)
		{
			int.TryParse(control.Port, out var result);
			MongoDBAuthenticationInfo info = CreateAuthenticationInfo(control);
			return new MongoDBConnectionParameters(control.Hostname, control.IsMongoSRVRecord, result, info);
		}

		private MongoDBAuthenticationInfo CreateAuthenticationInfo(IConnectionParametersControl control)
		{
			MongoDBAuthenticationType authTypeMongo = control.AuthTypeMongo;
			if (authTypeMongo != MongoDBAuthenticationType.Kerberos)
			{
				return MongoDBAuthenticationInfo.New(control.AuthTypeMongo, control.UserName, control.Password, control.AuthDataBaseNameMongo);
			}
			return MongoDBAuthenticationInfo.NewKerberos(control.Principal, control.Password, control.ServiceName, control.CanonicalizeHostName);
		}

		public string GetConnectionName(IConnectionParametersControl control)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(control.Hostname))
			{
				return "MongoDB_" + control.Hostname + "_Connection";
			}
			return "MongoDB_Connection";
		}

		public IEnumerable<string> GetDatabases(IConnectionParametersControl control)
		{
			yield break;
		}

		public void InitializeControl(IConnectionParametersControl control, DataConnectionParametersBase value)
		{
			MongoDBConnectionParameters mongoDBConnectionParameters = (MongoDBConnectionParameters)value;
			control.Hostname = mongoDBConnectionParameters.Hostname;
			control.Port = mongoDBConnectionParameters.Port.ToString();
			control.IsMongoSRVRecord = mongoDBConnectionParameters.IsSRVRecord;
			control.AuthTypeMongo = mongoDBConnectionParameters.AuthenticationInfo?.Type ?? MongoDBAuthenticationType.None;
		}
	}

	internal class CriteriaTypeResolver : CriteriaTypeResolverBase, IClientCriteriaVisitor<CriteriaTypeResolverResult>, ICriteriaVisitor<CriteriaTypeResolverResult>
	{
		private readonly ExpressionEditorContext context;

		private readonly IEnumerable<IBoundProperty> properties;

		public CriteriaTypeResolver(ExpressionEditorContext context, IEnumerable<IBoundProperty> properties)
		{
			this.context = context;
			this.properties = properties;
		}

		protected override Type GetCustomFunctionType(string functionName, params Type[] operands)
		{
			ICustomFunctionOperator val = (from s in context.Functions
				where ((ItemInfoBase)s).Name == functionName
				select s.CustomFunctionOperator).FirstOrDefault();
			return ((val != null) ? val.ResultType(operands) : null) ?? ((CriteriaTypeResolverBase)this).GetCustomFunctionType(functionName, operands);
		}

		CriteriaTypeResolverResult IClientCriteriaVisitor<CriteriaTypeResolverResult>.Visit(AggregateOperand theOperand)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0021: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			//IL_0034: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0044: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00f8: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0051: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0056: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0023: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0087: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0093: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00eb: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Aggregate aggregateType = theOperand.AggregateType;
			switch ((int)aggregateType)
			{
			default:
			{
				if ((int)aggregateType != 7)
				{
					break;
				}
				Type[] array = new Type[((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)theOperand.CustomAggregateOperands).Count];
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					int num = i;
					CriteriaTypeResolverResult val = ((CriteriaTypeResolverBase)this).Process(((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)theOperand.CustomAggregateOperands)[i]);
					array[num] = ((CriteriaTypeResolverResult)(ref val)).Type;
				}
				Type customAggregateType = ((CriteriaTypeResolverBase)this).GetCustomAggregateType(theOperand.CustomAggregateName, array);
				return new CriteriaTypeResolverResult(customAggregateType);
			}
			case 0:
				return new CriteriaTypeResolverResult(typeof(bool));
			case 1:
				return new CriteriaTypeResolverResult(typeof(int));
			case 4:
			{
				CriteriaTypeResolverResult result = ((CriteriaTypeResolverBase)this).Process(theOperand.AggregatedExpression);
				if (((CriteriaTypeResolverResult)(ref result)).Type == typeof(decimal) || ((CriteriaTypeResolverResult)(ref result)).Type == typeof(float))
				{
					return result;
				}
				return new CriteriaTypeResolverResult(typeof(double));
			}
			case 2:
			case 3:
				break;
			}
			return ((CriteriaTypeResolverBase)this).Process(theOperand.AggregatedExpression);
		}

		CriteriaTypeResolverResult IClientCriteriaVisitor<CriteriaTypeResolverResult>.Visit(OperandProperty theOperand)
		{
			//IL_0032: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			IBoundProperty filterPropertyByCaption = BoundColumnsHelper.Instance.GetFilterPropertyByCaption(properties, theOperand.PropertyName, mergeFirstTwoParts: false);
			return new CriteriaTypeResolverResult(((filterPropertyByCaption != null) ? filterPropertyByCaption.Type : null) ?? typeof(object));
		}

		CriteriaTypeResolverResult IClientCriteriaVisitor<CriteriaTypeResolverResult>.Visit(JoinOperand theOperand)
		{
			//IL_000a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return new CriteriaTypeResolverResult(typeof(object));
		}

		protected override CriteriaTypeResolverResult Visit(OperandValue theOperand)
		{
			//IL_0042: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			OperandParameter parameter = default(OperandParameter);
			if (CriteriaProcessingExtensions.Is<OperandParameter>((CriteriaOperator)(object)theOperand, ref parameter))
			{
				ParameterInfo val = context.Parameters.SingleOrDefault((ParameterInfo p) => ((ItemInfoBase)p).Name == parameter.ParameterName);
				if (val != null)
				{
					return new CriteriaTypeResolverResult(val.Type);
				}
			}
			return ((CriteriaTypeResolverBase)this).Visit(theOperand);
		}
	}
	public class ExpressionEditorContextFactoryBase
	{
		private readonly ICriteriaOperatorValidatorProvider criteriaOperatorValidatorProvider;

		private readonly IExpressionEditorColorProvider colorProvider;

		public ExpressionEditorContextFactoryBase(ICriteriaOperatorValidatorProvider criteriaOperatorValidatorProvider, IExpressionEditorColorProvider colorProvider)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)criteriaOperatorValidatorProvider, "criteriaOperatorValidatorProvider");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)colorProvider, "colorProvider");
			this.criteriaOperatorValidatorProvider = criteriaOperatorValidatorProvider;
			this.colorProvider = colorProvider;
		}

		public virtual ExpressionEditorContext Create(ExpressionEditorSettingsBase settings)
		{
			ExpressionEditorContext val = ExpressionEditorContextHelper.CreateContext(ShouldIncludeAggregateFunctions(settings), !settings.UseCustomAggregates, settings.UseCustomAggregates, includeLikeOperator: false, colorProvider);
			val.CriteriaOperatorValidatorProvider = criteriaOperatorValidatorProvider;
			val.OptionsBehavior.AutoSelectFocusedItem = false;
			return val;
		}

		protected static bool ShouldIncludeAggregateFunctions(ExpressionEditorSettingsBase settings)
		{
			if (!settings.Summary)
			{
				return !settings.HideAggregateFunctions;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	internal class WarningsDetector : ClientCriteriaVisitorBase
	{
		private readonly CriteriaTypeResolver resolver;

		public List<CriteriaOperator> Warnings { get; } = new List<CriteriaOperator>();

		public WarningsDetector(CriteriaTypeResolver resolver)
		{
			this.resolver = resolver;
		}

		public void Process(CriteriaOperator theOperator)
		{
			((ClientCriteriaVisitorBase)this).Process(theOperator);
		}

		protected override CriteriaOperator Visit(BinaryOperator theOperator)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0057: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if ((int)theOperator.OperatorType == 10)
			{
				CriteriaTypeResolverResult val = theOperator.LeftOperand.Accept<CriteriaTypeResolverResult>((ICriteriaVisitor<CriteriaTypeResolverResult>)resolver);
				Type type = ((CriteriaTypeResolverResult)(ref val)).Type;
				if (TypeConvertionValidator.CanConvertType(type, typeof(long)) || TypeConvertionValidator.CanConvertType(type, typeof(ulong)))
				{
					val = theOperator.RightOperand.Accept<CriteriaTypeResolverResult>((ICriteriaVisitor<CriteriaTypeResolverResult>)resolver);
					Type type2 = ((CriteriaTypeResolverResult)(ref val)).Type;
					if (TypeConvertionValidator.CanConvertType(type2, typeof(long)) || TypeConvertionValidator.CanConvertType(type2, typeof(ulong)))
					{
						Warnings.Add((CriteriaOperator)(object)theOperator);
					}
				}
			}
			return ((ClientCriteriaVisitorBase)this).Visit(theOperator);
		}
	}

	public class AutoCompleteComparer : IComparer<AutoCompleteItem>
	{
		private readonly string searchString;

		public AutoCompleteComparer(string searchString)
		{
			this.searchString = searchString;
		}

		public int Compare(AutoCompleteItem x, AutoCompleteItem y)
		{
			//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0031: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0037: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(searchString))
			{
				return string.Compare(x.Value, y.Value, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
			}
			if (x.ItemKind > y.ItemKind)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (x.ItemKind < y.ItemKind)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.Value) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(y.Value) && x.Value.StartsWith(searchString, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && y.Value.StartsWith(searchString, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				return string.Compare(x.Value, y.Value, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.Value) && x.Value.StartsWith(searchString, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(y.Value) && y.Value.StartsWith(searchString, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return string.Compare(x.Value, y.Value, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
		}
	}

			if (match.Success)
			{
				string value4 = match.Groups[1].Value;
				return string.Format(ExpressionEditorLocalizer.GetString(ExpressionEditorStringId.Exception_MalformedGuidLiteral), value4);
			}
			match = Regex.Match(message, "^Parser error at line \\d+, character \\d+: Malformed comment: missing closing \"(\\*\\/)\".;.+$");
			if (match.Success)
			{
				string value5 = match.Groups[1].Value;
				return string.Format(ExpressionEditorLocalizer.GetString(ExpressionEditorStringId.Exception_MalformedComment), value5);

				string value6 = match.Groups[1].Value;
				return string.Format(ExpressionEditorLocalizer.GetString(ExpressionEditorStringId.Exception_InvalidCharacter), value6);
			}
			match = Regex.Match(message, "^Parser error at line \\d+, character \\d+: Wrong arguments count \\(\\d+\\). Function - \\'((\\w+)(\\(\\w+\\))*)\\'.;.+$");

	public class FormatStringCustomFunction : ICustomFunctionOperatorBrowsable, ICustomFunctionOperator
	{
		public int MinOperandCount => 1;

		public int MaxOperandCount => -1;

		public string Description => ExpressionEditorLocalizer.GetString(ExpressionEditorStringId.Function_FormatString);

		public FunctionCategory Category => (FunctionCategory)8;

		public string Name => "FormatString";

		public object Evaluate(params object[] operands)
		{
			if (operands.Length == 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			string format = (string)operands[0];
			int num = operands.Length - 1;
			object[] array = new object[num];
			Array.Copy(operands, 1, array, 0, num);
			return string.Format(format, array);
		}

		public bool IsValidOperandCount(int count)
		{
			return count > MinOperandCount;
		}

		public bool IsValidOperandType(int operandIndex, int operandCount, Type type)
		{
			if (operandIndex <= 0)
			{
				return type == typeof(string);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public Type ResultType(params Type[] operands)
		{
			return typeof(string);
		}
	}

		private static string ClearTokenText(CriteriaLexerToken token, string tokenText, TokenType tokenType)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if ((int)tokenType == 0)
			{
				CriteriaOperator criteriaOperator = token.CriteriaOperator;
				OperandProperty val = (OperandProperty)(object)((criteriaOperator is OperandProperty) ? criteriaOperator : null);
				if (val == null)
				{
					return tokenText;
				}
				return val.PropertyName;
			}
			return tokenText.Trim('?');
		}

		protected void InsertTextToRange(DocumentRange range, string text, bool forceReplace)
		{
			RichEdit.BeginUpdate();
			if (range.End.ToInt() >= RichEdit.CaretPosition || forceReplace)
			{
				if (range.Length <= 0)
				{
					((SubDocument)Document).InsertText(range.Start, text);
				}
				else
				{
					((SubDocument)Document).Replace(range, text);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				((SubDocument)Document).InsertText(((SubDocument)Document).CreatePosition(RichEdit.CaretPosition), text);
			}
			RichEdit.EndUpdate();
		}

		public void ParseExpression()
		{

			CriteriaOperator val = null;

			Warnings.Clear();
			errorTimer.Stop();

			{
				return;
			}

			{
				val = CriteriaParse(value);
			}
			catch (CriteriaParserException ex)
			{

				Errors.Add(ex2.Column, ex2.Line, CriteriaParserExceptionHelper.Localize(message));
				OnValidated();
				errorTimer.Start();

			}

			{

			}

					}

							if (list != null)
							{

						catch

						}
					}
				}
			}
			else

			}

			}
		}

				{

					}

		}

		private int GetPositionByTokenText(string text)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return -1;
			}

			{
				string value = match.Groups[1].Value;
				repetitiveNames.TryGetValue(value, out var value2);
				repetitiveNames[value] = value2 + 1;

				if (val != null)
				{
					return val.Position;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		private Func<CriteriaLexerToken, bool> MatchToken(string name, int counter)
		{
			return delegate(CriteriaLexerToken token)
			{

				}

				if (val != null)
				{

					{
						if (counter == 0)
						{
							return true;
						}
						counter--;

					}
				}

				{

				}
				return false;
			};
		}

		public void SetPosition(int line, int position)
		{
			if (position == -1)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (line > 0)
			{
				string[] source = Expression.Split(new string[1] { "\n" }, StringSplitOptions.None);
				int num = source.Take(line).Sum((string s) => s.Length) + "\n".Length * line;
				position = num + position;
			}
			DocumentRange tokenRange = GetTokenRange(position);
			if (tokenRange.Length == 0)
			{
				Document.CaretPosition = ((SubDocument)Document).CreatePosition(position);
			}
			else
			{
				Document.Selection = tokenRange;
			}
			RichEdit.Focus();
			RichEdit.ScrollToCaret();
		}

		private List<SyntaxHighlightToken> GetSyntaxHighlightTokens()
		{
			//IL_006b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0075: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00ae: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b8: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00eb: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00f5: Expected O, but got Unknown
			List<SyntaxHighlightToken> source = BuildHighlightTokens();
			SyntaxHighlightToken[] array = source.OrderBy((SyntaxHighlightToken e) => e.Start).ToArray();
			Paragraph val = ((IEnumerable<Paragraph>)((SubDocument)RichEdit.Document).Paragraphs).Last();
			List<SyntaxHighlightToken> list = new List<SyntaxHighlightToken>();
			if (array.Length != 0)
			{
				int start = array[0].Start;
				if (start > 0)
				{
					list.Add(new SyntaxHighlightToken(0, start, GetSyntaxHighlightProperties()));
				}
				start = val.Range.End.ToInt() - array[array.Length - 1].End;
				if (start > 0)
				{
					list.Add(new SyntaxHighlightToken(array[array.Length - 1].End, start, GetSyntaxHighlightProperties()));
				}
			}
			for (int num = 0; num < array.Length - 1; num++)
			{
				int num2 = array[num + 1].Start - array[num].End;
				if (num2 > 0)
				{
					list.Add(new SyntaxHighlightToken(array[num].End, num2, GetSyntaxHighlightProperties()));
				}
			}
			List<SyntaxHighlightToken> list2 = new List<SyntaxHighlightToken>(array);
			list2.AddRange(list);
			HighlightErrors(list2);
			HighlightConstants(array);
			return list2.OrderBy((SyntaxHighlightToken t) => t.Start).ToList();
		}

		private List<SyntaxHighlightToken> BuildHighlightTokens()
		{

			//IL_0121: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (LexerHelper.TokenList.Count == 0 && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(Expression))
			{
				return new List<SyntaxHighlightToken>
				{
					new SyntaxHighlightToken(0, Expression.Length, GetSyntaxHighlightProperties())
				};
			}
			List<SyntaxHighlightToken> list = new List<SyntaxHighlightToken>();

				switch ((int)tokenType)
				{
				case 1:

					SyntaxHighlightToken val4 = new SyntaxHighlightToken(token.Position, token.Length, GetSyntaxHighlightProperties());

					list.Add(new SyntaxHighlightToken(token.Position, token.Length, GetSyntaxHighlightProperties()));

				}
			}

		}

		private void HighlightErrors(List<SyntaxHighlightToken> tokens)
		{

			{

				if (val != null)
				{
					val.Properties.Underline = (UnderlineType)16;
					val.Properties.ForeColor = errorColor;
				}
			}
		}

		private int[] GetErrorTokenPositions()
		{
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			foreach (ErrorInfo error in Errors)
			{
				if (error.Position != -1)
				{
					int num = ((ISimpleCollection<Paragraph>)((SubDocument)RichEdit.Document).Paragraphs)[error.Line].Range.Start.ToInt();
					int errorPosition = error.Position + num;
					CriteriaLexerToken val = LexerHelper.TokenList.FirstOrDefault((CriteriaLexerToken t) => t.Position == errorPosition) ?? LexerHelper.FindToken(errorPosition) ?? LexerHelper.GetNeighborToken(errorPosition, true);
					if (val != null)
					{
						list.Add(val.Position);
					}
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		protected internal bool IsValidProperty(CriteriaLexerToken token)
		{
			string propertyName = LexerHelper.GetPropertyName(token);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(propertyName))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!PropertyExists(propertyName))
			{
				return GetDynamicColumn(propertyName, token.Position, insertingColumnName: false) != null;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected bool PropertyExists(string propertyName)
		{
			return GetFilterPropertyByCaption(Properties, propertyName) != null;
		}

		protected internal virtual IBoundProperty GetFilterPropertyByCaption(IEnumerable<IBoundProperty> properties, string propertyName)
		{
			return BoundColumnsHelper.Instance.GetFilterPropertyByCaption(properties, propertyName, mergeFirstTwoParts: false);
		}

			IColumnDynamicProvider columnDynamicProvider = Context.ColumnDynamicProvider;

			{
				return null;
			}
			return columnDynamicProvider.GetColumnInfo(new ColumnDynamicArguments(columnName, Expression, caretPosition, insertingColumnName));
		}

		private void errorTimer_Tick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			OnShowErrors();
			errorTimer.Stop();
		}

		private bool CursorOutOfRange(bool movingLeft)
		{
			DocumentRange currentTokenRange = GetCurrentTokenRange();
			if (currentTokenRange.Start.ToInt() == 0 && currentTokenRange.End.ToInt() == 0 && RichEdit.CaretPosition == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (currentTokenRange.Start.ToInt() < RichEdit.CaretPosition && RichEdit.CaretPosition < currentTokenRange.End.ToInt())
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (currentTokenRange.Start.ToInt() == RichEdit.CaretPosition && !movingLeft)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (currentTokenRange.End.ToInt() == RichEdit.CaretPosition && movingLeft)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool CursorIsInLastToken(bool movingLeft)
		{
			CriteriaLexerToken neighborToken = LexerHelper.GetNeighborToken(RichEdit.CaretPosition, movingLeft);
			if (neighborToken != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DocumentRange currentTokenRange = GetCurrentTokenRange();
			if (movingLeft && currentTokenRange.Start.ToInt() > 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!movingLeft && currentTokenRange.End.ToInt() < ((SubDocument)RichEdit.Document).Length - 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void BeforePagePaint(PageCanvas canvas)
		{
			if (RichEdit.Document.Selection.Length <= 1)
			{
				Tuple<int, int> parenthesisTuple = GetParenthesisTuple();
				if (parenthesisTuple != null)
				{
					RichEditBrushBase val = RichEdit.CreateBrush(parenthesisHighlightColor);
					canvas.FillRectangle(val, RichEdit.GetLayoutLogicalBoundsFromPosition(((SubDocument)RichEdit.Document).CreatePosition(parenthesisTuple.Item1)));
					canvas.FillRectangle(val, RichEdit.GetLayoutLogicalBoundsFromPosition(((SubDocument)RichEdit.Document).CreatePosition(parenthesisTuple.Item2)));
				}
			}
		}

		private Tuple<int, int> GetParenthesisTuple()
		{
			//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0077: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007e: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_008f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0096: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0044: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0049: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			CriteriaLexerToken val = GetParenthesisToken();
			if (val == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			CriteriaLexerToken val2 = val;
			Stack<int> stack = new Stack<int>();
			TokenType val3 = (TokenType)(((int)val2.TokenType == 10) ? 9 : 10);
			while ((val = LexerHelper.GetNeighborToken(((int)val2.TokenType == 10) ? val.PositionEnd : val.Position, (int)val2.TokenType == 10)) != null)
			{
				if (val.TokenType == val2.TokenType)
				{
					stack.Push(val.Position);
				}
				else if (val.TokenType == val3)
				{
					if (stack.Count <= 0)
					{
						return new Tuple<int, int>(val2.Position, val.Position);
					}
					stack.Pop();
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private CriteriaLexerToken GetParenthesisToken()
		{
			//IL_0032: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0039: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0045: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			int num = RichEdit.Document.CaretPosition.ToInt();
			foreach (CriteriaLexerToken token in LexerHelper.TokenList)
			{
				if (((int)token.TokenType == 9 && token.Position == num) || ((int)token.TokenType == 10 && token.PositionEnd == num))
				{
					return token;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

		protected override DocumentModel CreateDocumentModelCore()
		{
			DocumentModel val = ((InnerRichEditDocumentServer)this).CreateDocumentModelCore();
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(defaultAppFontName))
			{
				val.UseThemeFonts = false;
				ApplyDefaultAppFont(val);
			}
			return val;
		}

		private void ApplyDefaultAppFont(DocumentModel model)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < ((UniqueItemsCache<MergedCharacterFormattingInfo>)(object)model.Cache.MergedCharacterFormattingInfoCache).Count; i++)
			{
				ApplyDefaultAppFont((CharacterFormattingInfo)(object)((UniqueItemsCache<MergedCharacterFormattingInfo>)(object)model.Cache.MergedCharacterFormattingInfoCache)[i]);
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < ((UniqueItemsCache<CharacterFormattingInfo>)(object)model.Cache.CharacterFormattingInfoCache).Count; j++)
			{
				ApplyDefaultAppFont(((UniqueItemsCache<CharacterFormattingInfo>)(object)model.Cache.CharacterFormattingInfoCache)[j]);
			}
		}

		private void ApplyDefaultAppFont(CharacterFormattingInfo formatingInfo)
		{
			formatingInfo.FontName = defaultAppFontName;
			formatingInfo.FontNameAscii = defaultAppFontName;
			formatingInfo.FontNameComplexScript = defaultAppFontName;
			formatingInfo.FontNameEastAsia = defaultAppFontName;
			formatingInfo.FontNameHighAnsi = defaultAppFontName;
			formatingInfo.FontNameComplexScript = defaultAppFontName;
			formatingInfo.DoubleFontSize = (int)Math.Round(defaultAppFontSize * 2f);
			formatingInfo.DoubleFontSizeComplexScript = formatingInfo.DoubleFontSize;
		}
	}

	internal static class ItemInfoCategoryHelper
	{
		private static readonly string customCategoryName = DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.ExpressionEditor_DocumentationCategory_Custom);

		public static T FixCategory<T>(this T item) where T : ItemInfoBase
		{
			if (item != null && string.IsNullOrEmpty(((ItemInfoBase)item).Category))
			{
				((ItemInfoBase)item).Category = customCategoryName;
			}
			return item;
		}

		public static FunctionInfo FixFunctionCategory(this FunctionInfo function)
		{
			if (function != null && string.IsNullOrEmpty(function.FunctionCategory))
			{
				function.FunctionCategory = customCategoryName;
			}
			return function;
		}
	}

	public class BoundProperty : IBoundProperty
	{
		private readonly ColumnInfo info;

		private readonly string description;

		private List<IBoundProperty> children;

		private bool childrenWereExpanded;

		public string Name { get; }

		public Type Type { get; }

		public List<IBoundProperty> Children
		{
			get
			{
				if (!childrenWereExpanded)
				{
					ExpandChildren();
				}
				return children;
			}
		}

		public IBoundProperty Parent { get; }

		public string DisplayName => Name;

		public bool HasChildren => false;

		public bool IsAggregate => false;

		public bool IsList => false;

		public BoundProperty(string name)
			: this(name, null)
		{
		}

		public BoundProperty(string name, Type type)
			: this(name, type, null)
		{
		}

		public BoundProperty(string name, Type type, string description)
		{
			Name = name;
			Type = type;
			this.description = description;
		}

		public BoundProperty(ColumnInfo info)
		{
			this.info = info;
			Name = ((ItemInfoBase)info).Name;
			Type = info.Type;
			description = ((ItemInfoBase)info).Description;
		}

		public BoundProperty(ColumnInfo info, IBoundProperty parent)
			: this(info)
		{
			Parent = parent;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return ItemDescriptionHelper.FormatDescription(Type, description);
		}

		private void ExpandChildren()
		{
			ColumnInfo obj = info;
			children = ((obj == null) ? null : ((IEnumerable<IBoundProperty>)obj.Children?.Select((ColumnInfo c) => new BoundProperty(c, (IBoundProperty)(object)this))).ToList()) ?? new List<IBoundProperty>();
			childrenWereExpanded = true;
		}
	}
	public static class ItemDescriptionHelper
	{
		public static string FormatItemHtmlTooltip(ItemInfoBase item, Color highlightColor)
		{
			return FormatTooltipCore(item, formatHtml: true, highlightColor);
		}

		public static string FormatItemHtmlDescription(ItemInfoBase item, Color highlightColor)
		{
			return FormatDescriptionCore(item, formatHtml: true, highlightColor);
		}

		public static string FormatItemTooltip(ItemInfoBase item)
		{
			return FormatTooltipCore(item, formatHtml: false, Color.Empty);
		}

		public static string FormatItemDescription(ItemInfoBase item)
		{
			return FormatDescriptionCore(item, formatHtml: false, Color.Empty);
		}

		public static string FormatHtmlTooltip(string originalName, string tooltip, Color highlightColor)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(tooltip))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			string colorBegin = $"<color={highlightColor.R},{highlightColor.G},{highlightColor.B}>";
			return InsertTags(originalName, tooltip, string.Empty, string.Empty, colorBegin, "</color>", Environment.NewLine);
		}

		public static string FormatHtmlDescription(string originalName, string description, Color highlightColor)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(description))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			string colorBegin = $"<font color=rgb({highlightColor.R},{highlightColor.G},{highlightColor.B})>";
			return InsertTags(originalName, description, "<font face=\"Consolas\">", "</font>", colorBegin, "</font>", "</br>");
		}

		public static string FormatDescription(Type type, string description)
		{
			string text = null;
			if (type != null)
			{
				text = FormatType(type);
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(description))
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					return description;
				}
				text = string.Format("{0}{1}{1}{2}", text, Environment.NewLine, description);
			}
			return text;
		}

		private static string FormatTooltipCore(ItemInfoBase item, bool formatHtml, Color highlightColor)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			FunctionInfo val = (FunctionInfo)(object)((item is FunctionInfo) ? item : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				if (!formatHtml)
				{
					return ((ItemInfoBase)val).Description;
				}
				return FormatHtmlTooltip(item.Name, ((ItemInfoBase)val).Description, highlightColor);
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.Description))
			{
				return item.Description;
			}
			string category = item.Category;
			ColumnInfo val2 = (ColumnInfo)(object)((item is ColumnInfo) ? item : null);
			if (val2 != null)
			{
				return FormatTooltip(category, ((ItemInfoBase)val2).Name, val2.Type, ((ItemInfoBase)val2).Description);
			}
			ParameterInfo val3 = (ParameterInfo)(object)((item is ParameterInfo) ? item : null);
			if (val3 != null)
			{
				return FormatTooltip(category, ((ItemInfoBase)val3).Name, val3.Type, ((ItemInfoBase)val3).Description);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static string FormatDescriptionCore(ItemInfoBase item, bool formatHtml, Color highlightColor)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.Description))
			{
				if (!formatHtml)
				{
					return item.Description;
				}
				return FormatHtmlDescription(item.Name, item.Description, highlightColor);
			}
			ColumnInfo val = (ColumnInfo)(object)((item is ColumnInfo) ? item : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				return FormatTooltip(null, ((ItemInfoBase)val).Name, val.Type, null);
			}
			ParameterInfo val2 = (ParameterInfo)(object)((item is ParameterInfo) ? item : null);
			if (val2 != null)
			{
				return FormatTooltip(null, ((ItemInfoBase)val2).Name, val2.Type, null);
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		private static string FormatTooltip(string category, string name, Type type, string description)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			if (type != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(TypeNamesHelper.ShortName(type) + " ");
			}
			stringBuilder.Append(name);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(category))
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(Environment.NewLine + "Category: " + category);
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(description))
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(string.Format("{0}{0}{1}", Environment.NewLine, description));
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		private static string FormatType(Type type)
		{
			return string.Format(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.ExpressionEditor_DocumentationCategory_ColumnDescriptionFormat), TypeNamesHelper.ShortName(type));
		}

		private static string InsertTags(string originalName, string tooltip, string fontBegin, string fontEnd, string colorBegin, string colorEnd, string newLine)
		{
			Func<string, string> colorize = (string s) => colorBegin + s + colorEnd;
			Match match = Regex.Match(tooltip, "^(?<function>[\\p{L}\\w]+\\s?)\\((?<args>([\\p{L}\\w\\s]*)([,、\\s]*[^)]+)*)\\)(?<description>.*)$", RegexOptions.Singleline);
			if (match.Success)
			{
				string text = ((!string.IsNullOrEmpty(originalName)) ? originalName : match.Groups["function"].Value);
				string value = match.Groups["args"].Value;
				string description = match.Groups["description"].Value;
				string[] args = ParseArgs(value);
				value = ColorizeArgsString(value, args, colorize);
				ColorizeDescription(newLine, colorize, args, ref description);
				return string.Format("{0}{1}({2}){3}{4}{4}{5}", fontBegin, text, value, fontEnd, newLine, description);
			}
			match = Regex.Match(tooltip, "^(?:\\[(?<collection>[\\p{L}\\w\\s]+)\\][\\u200b\\s]*\\[(?<condition>[\\p{L}\\w\\s]+)\\]\\.[\\u200b\\s]*(?<function>[\\p{L}\\w\\s]+)[\\u200b\\s]*\\((?<args>(?:[\\p{L}\\w\\s]*)(?:[,、\\s]*[^)]+)*)\\)[\\r\\n]+)+(?<description>.*)$", RegexOptions.Singleline);
			if (match.Success)
			{
				string[] array = (from Capture c in match.Groups["collection"].Captures
					select c.Value).ToArray();
				string[] array2 = (from Capture c in match.Groups["condition"].Captures
					select c.Value).ToArray();
				string text2 = ((!string.IsNullOrEmpty(originalName)) ? originalName : match.Groups["function"].Value);
				HashSet<string> hashSet = new HashSet<string>();
				List<string> list = new List<string>();
				int num = 0;
				foreach (Capture capture in match.Groups["args"].Captures)
				{
					string value2 = capture.Value;
					string[] array3 = ParseArgs(value2);
					hashSet.AddRange(array3);
					value2 = ColorizeArgsString(value2, array3, colorize);
					string item = fontBegin + "[" + colorize(array[num]) + "]\u200b[" + colorize(array2[num]) + "].\u200b" + text2 + "\u200b(" + value2 + ")" + fontEnd;
					list.Add(item);
					num++;
				}
				string description2 = match.Groups["description"].Value;
				ColorizeDescription(newLine, colorize, hashSet.ToList(), ref description2);
				string text3 = array.Union(array2).Aggregate(description2, (string desc, string name) => desc.Replace(name, colorize(name)));
				return string.Join(newLine, list) + newLine + newLine + text3.Replace(Environment.NewLine, newLine);
			}
			return tooltip.Replace(Environment.NewLine, newLine);
		}

		private static string ColorizeArgsString(string argsString, IList<string> args, Func<string, string> colorize)
		{
			if (args.Count > 0)
			{
				argsString = args.Aggregate(argsString, (string seed, string current) => ProcessString(seed, current, colorize));
			}
			return argsString;
		}

		private static void ColorizeDescription(string newLine, Func<string, string> colorize, IList<string> args, ref string description)
		{
			if (args.Count > 0)
			{
				description = args.Aggregate(description, (string seed, string current) => ProcessString(seed, current, colorize));
			}
			description = description.TrimStart(Environment.NewLine.ToArray()).Replace(Environment.NewLine, newLine);
		}

		private static string[] ParseArgs(string args)
		{
			string[] separator = new string[5] { ", ", ",", "、", "[", "]" };
			return args.Replace("'", string.Empty).Split(separator, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
		}

		private static string ProcessString(string seed, string s, Func<string, string> colorize)
		{
			if (s.Contains("%") || s.Contains("(") || s.Contains(")"))
			{
				return seed;
			}
			try
			{
				return Regex.Replace(seed, "[\\?]?\\b" + s.Replace(".", "\\.") + "\\b", colorize(s), RegexOptions.Multiline);
			}
			catch (ArgumentException)
			{
				return seed;
			}
		}
	}
	public static class DocumentationControlHelper
	{
		public class FunctionInfoEqualityComparer : IEqualityComparer<FunctionInfo>
		{
			public bool Equals(FunctionInfo x, FunctionInfo y)
			{
				if (string.Equals((x != null) ? x.FunctionCategory : null, (y != null) ? y.FunctionCategory : null))
				{
					return string.Equals((x != null) ? ((ItemInfoBase)x).Category : null, (y != null) ? ((ItemInfoBase)y).Category : null);
				}
				return false;
			}

			public int GetHashCode(FunctionInfo obj)
			{
				return (((obj.FunctionCategory != null) ? obj.FunctionCategory.GetHashCode() : 0) * 397) ^ ((((ItemInfoBase)obj).Category != null) ? ((ItemInfoBase)obj).Category.GetHashCode() : 0);
			}
		}

		private static readonly Dictionary<string, string> functionCategoriesDisplayNames = new Dictionary<string, string>
		{
			{
				"DateTime",
				DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.ExpressionEditor_FunctionCategory_DateTime)
			},
			{
				"Logical",
				DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.ExpressionEditor_FunctionCategory_Logical)
			},
			{
				"String",
				DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.ExpressionEditor_FunctionCategory_Text)
			},
			{
				"Math",
				DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.ExpressionEditor_FunctionCategory_Math)
			},
			{
				"Aggregate",
				DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.ExpressionEditor_FunctionCategory_Aggregate)
			}
		};

		public static IEnumerable<CategoryNode> BuildRootNodes(IEnumerable<FunctionInfo> functions, ILookup<string, ItemInfoBase> items)
		{
			int i = 0;
			FunctionInfo[] source = (functions as FunctionInfo[]) ?? functions.ToArray();
			List<CategoryNode> list = (from category in items.Select((IGrouping<string, ItemInfoBase> item) => item.Key).Distinct().Union(source.Select((FunctionInfo val) => ((ItemInfoBase)val).Category).Distinct())
				select new CategoryNode
				{
					ID = i++,
					ParentID = -1,
					Category = category,
					DisplayName = IntelliInfoItemCategoryHelper.Localize(category)
				}).ToList();
			foreach (FunctionInfo function in source.Distinct(new FunctionInfoEqualityComparer()))
			{
				CategoryNode categoryNode = list.First((CategoryNode node) => node.Category == ((ItemInfoBase)function).Category);
				list.Add(new CategoryNode
				{
					ID = i++,
					ParentID = categoryNode.ID,
					ParentCategory = categoryNode.Category,
					Category = function.FunctionCategory,
					DisplayName = GetFunctionCategoryDisplayName(function.FunctionCategory)
				});
			}
			return list;
		}

		public static ILookup<string, ItemInfoBase> BuildItems(IEnumerable<FunctionInfo> functions, ILookup<string, ItemInfoBase> items)
		{
			return (from @group in items.Concat((IEnumerable<IGrouping<string, ItemInfoBase>>)functions.ToLookup((FunctionInfo info) => ((ItemInfoBase)info).Category))
				from item in @group
				select new
				{
					Key = @group.Key,
					Item = item
				}).ToLookup(x => x.Key, x => x.Item);
		}

		private static string GetFunctionCategoryDisplayName(string functionsCategory)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(functionsCategory))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (functionCategoriesDisplayNames.ContainsKey(functionsCategory))
			{
				return functionCategoriesDisplayNames[functionsCategory];
			}
			return functionsCategory;
		}
	}
	public class CategoryNode
	{
		public int ID { get; set; }

		public int ParentID { get; set; }

		internal string ParentCategory { get; set; }

		internal string Category { get; set; }

		public string DisplayName { get; set; }
	}

	public abstract class EF6DataAccessDescendantBuilderProvider : EF60DbDescendantBuilderProviderBase
	{
		private readonly DataAccessEntityFrameworkModel model;

		protected abstract string XpoProviderTypeKey { get; }

		{
		}

		{
			this.model = model;
		}

		public override bool Available(Type dbContext, IDXTypeInfo dbDescendant, ISolutionTypesProvider typesProvider)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(model.ConnectionString))
			{
				DbConnectionStringBuilder dbConnectionStringBuilder = DbConnectionStringBuilderHelper.CreateBuilder(model.ConnectionString);
				string byKeyword = dbConnectionStringBuilder.GetByKeyword("XpoProvider");
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(byKeyword))
				{
					bool flag = byKeyword == XpoProviderTypeKey;
					if (flag)
					{
						dbConnectionStringBuilder.Remove("XpoProvider");
						model.ConnectionString = dbConnectionStringBuilder.ConnectionString;
					}
					return flag;
				}
			}
			EdmxResource edmxResource = EdmxResource.GetEdmxResource(dbDescendant);
			bool flag2 = false;
			if (edmxResource != null)
			{
				flag2 = string.IsNullOrEmpty(((EF60DbDescendantBuilderProviderBase)this).ExpectedProviderName) || edmxResource.GetProviderName() == ((EF60DbDescendantBuilderProviderBase)this).ExpectedProviderName;
			}
			else if (ClientAssemblyNames.All((string clientAssemblyName) => TryGetAssembly(typesProvider, clientAssemblyName) != null))
			{
				flag2 = true;
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				return EntityFrameworkModelBase.IsAtLeastEF6(dbContext);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected IDXAssemblyInfo TryGetAssembly(ISolutionTypesProvider typesProvider, string assemblyName)
		{
			try
			{
				return typesProvider.GetAssembly(assemblyName);
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		{

		private static System.Attribute[] GetAttributes(string propertyName)
		{
			return typeof(EFConnectionParameters).GetProperty(propertyName).GetCustomAttributes().Concat(new System.Attribute[1]
			{
				new ReadOnlyAttribute(isReadOnly: true)
			})
				.ToArray();
		}

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)

					typeof(EFConnectionParameters)

			}

				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(eFDataConnection2.ConnectionParameters.ConnectionStringName))

		internal static XElement SaveToXml(EFDataSource dataSource, IExtensionsProvider extensionsProvider)
		{
			XElement xElement = new XElement("EFDataSource");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataSource.Name))
			{
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("Name", dataSource.Name));
			}
			if (dataSource.ConnectionStringName != null)
			{
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("ConnectionStringName", dataSource.ConnectionStringName));
			}
			if (dataSource.ConnectionString != null)
			{

			}
			if (dataSource.ConnectionName != null)
			{
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("ConnectionName", dataSource.ConnectionName));
			}
			if (dataSource.CustomAssemblyPath != null)
			{
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("CustomAssemblyPath", dataSource.CustomAssemblyPath));
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("CustomContextName", dataSource.CustomContextName));
			}
			else if (dataSource.Source != null)
			{
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("Source", dataSource.Source));
			}
			XElement xElement2 = SaveProceduresToXml(dataSource, extensionsProvider);
			if (xElement2 != null)
			{
				xElement.Add(xElement2);
			}
			XElement xElement3 = SaveFiltersToXml(dataSource.Filters, extensionsProvider);
			if (xElement3 != null)
			{
				xElement.Add(xElement3);
			}
			return xElement;
		}

		}

		public static void LoadFromXml(EFDataSource dataSource, XElement element, IExtensionsProvider extensionsProvider)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)element, "element");
			if (!string.Equals(element.Name.LocalName, "EFDataSource", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(string.Format("Incorrect XML root element: <{0}>, <{1}> is expected.", element.Name.LocalName, "EFDataSource"));
			}
			dataSource.Name = element.GetAttributeValue("Name");
			dataSource.ConnectionStringName = element.GetAttributeValue("ConnectionStringName");
			dataSource.ConnectionString = element.GetAttributeValue("ConnectionString");
			dataSource.Source = element.GetAttributeValue("Source");
			dataSource.ConnectionName = element.GetAttributeValue("ConnectionName");
			dataSource.CustomAssemblyPath = element.GetAttributeValue("CustomAssemblyPath");
			dataSource.CustomContextName = element.GetAttributeValue("CustomContextName");
			XElement xElement = element.Element("Procedures");
			if (xElement != null)
			{
				LoadProceduresFromXml(dataSource, xElement, extensionsProvider);
			}
			XElement xElement2 = element.Element("Filters");
			if (xElement2 != null)
			{
				LoadFiltersFromXml(dataSource.Filters, xElement2, extensionsProvider);
			}
		}

		public static void LoadProceduresFromXml(EFDataSource dataSource, XElement element)
		{
			LoadProceduresFromXml(dataSource, element, null);
		}

		internal static void LoadProceduresFromXml(EFDataSource dataSource, XElement element, IExtensionsProvider extensionsProvider)
		{
			dataSource.StoredProcedures.Clear();
			foreach (XElement item in element.Elements("StoredProcInfo"))
			{
				EFStoredProcedureInfo eFStoredProcedureInfo = new EFStoredProcedureInfo();
				eFStoredProcedureInfo.LoadFromXMl(item, extensionsProvider);
				dataSource.StoredProcedures.Add(eFStoredProcedureInfo);
			}
		}

		public static XElement SaveProceduresToXml(EFDataSource dataSource)
		{
			return SaveProceduresToXml(dataSource, null);
		}

		internal static XElement SaveProceduresToXml(EFDataSource dataSource, IExtensionsProvider extensionsProvider)
		{
			if (dataSource.StoredProcedures.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			XElement xElement = new XElement("Procedures");
			ISerializableTypesCollector collector = dataSource.GetService(typeof(ISerializableTypesCollector)) as ISerializableTypesCollector;
			foreach (EFStoredProcedureInfo storedProcedure in dataSource.StoredProcedures)
			{
				xElement.Add(storedProcedure.SaveToXml(extensionsProvider, collector));
			}
			return xElement;
		}

		public static void LoadFiltersFromXml(EFFiltersCollection filters, XElement filtersElement)
		{
			LoadFiltersFromXml(filters, filtersElement, null);
		}

		public static void LoadFiltersFromXml(EFFiltersCollection filters, XElement filtersElement, IExtensionsProvider extensionsProvider)
		{
			filters.Clear();
			foreach (XElement item in filtersElement.Elements("DBSetFilter"))
			{
				DBSetFilter dBSetFilter = (DBSetFilter)Activator.CreateInstance(typeof(DBSetFilter), nonPublic: true);
				dBSetFilter.LoadFromXml(item, extensionsProvider);
				filters.Add(dBSetFilter);
			}
		}

		public static XElement SaveFiltersToXml(EFFiltersCollection filters)
		{
			return SaveFiltersToXml(filters, null);
		}

		public static XElement SaveFiltersToXml(EFFiltersCollection filters, IExtensionsProvider extensionsProvider)
		{
			if (filters.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			XElement xElement = new XElement("Filters");
			ISerializableTypesCollector collector = filters.Owner.GetService(typeof(ISerializableTypesCollector)) as ISerializableTypesCollector;
			foreach (DBSetFilter filter in filters)
			{
				xElement.Add(filter.SaveToXml(collector, extensionsProvider));
			}
			return xElement;
		}
	}

	public class Tree : List<Node<DBSetFilter>>
	{
		public Tree(IEnumerable<DBSetFilter> filters)
		{
			List<DBSetFilter> list = filters.ToList();
			List<DBSetFilter> list2 = list.Where((DBSetFilter f) => !f.DBSetName.Contains('.')).ToList();
			foreach (DBSetFilter item in list2)
			{
				list.Remove(item);
				Node<DBSetFilter> node = new Node<DBSetFilter>(item);
				BuildChilds(node, list);
				Add(node);
			}
			while (list.Count > 0)
			{
				DBSetFilter dBSetFilter = list.First();
				AdoptOrphan(new Node<DBSetFilter>(dBSetFilter));
				list.Remove(dBSetFilter);
			}
		}

		private void AdoptOrphan(Node<DBSetFilter> orphan)
		{
			int num = orphan.Value.DBSetName.LastIndexOf('.');
			if (num < 0)
			{
				Add(orphan);
				return;
			}
			string text = orphan.Value.DBSetName.Substring(0, num);
			Node<DBSetFilter> node = FindNodeByName(text);
			if (node == null)
			{
				node = new Node<DBSetFilter>(new DBSetFilter(text, string.Empty));
				AdoptOrphan(node);
			}
			node.AddChildren(orphan);
		}

		private void BuildChilds(Node<DBSetFilter> node, IList<DBSetFilter> filters)
		{
			string dbSetName = GetDbSetName(node);
			string pattern = $"^{dbSetName}[^.]+$";
			List<DBSetFilter> list = filters.Where((DBSetFilter f) => Regex.Match(f.DBSetName, pattern).Success).ToList();
			foreach (DBSetFilter item in list)
			{
				filters.Remove(item);
				Node<DBSetFilter> node2 = new Node<DBSetFilter>(item);
				BuildChilds(node2, filters);
				node.AddChildren(node2);
			}
		}

		private string GetDbSetName(Node<DBSetFilter> node)
		{
			string text = null;
			while (node != null)
			{
				text = text + node.Value.DBSetName + "\\.";
				node = node.Parent;
			}
			return text;
		}

		public Node<DBSetFilter> FindNodeByName(string name)
		{
			using (Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					Node<DBSetFilter> current = enumerator.Current;
					Node<DBSetFilter> node = FindNodeByNameCore(current, name);
					if (node != null)
					{
						return node;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private Node<DBSetFilter> FindNodeByNameCore(Node<DBSetFilter> node, string name)
		{
			if (node.Value.DBSetName == name)
			{
				return node;
			}
			foreach (Node<DBSetFilter> child in node.Children)
			{
				Node<DBSetFilter> node2 = FindNodeByNameCore(child, name);
				if (node2 != null)
				{
					return node2;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public static class EFFilterHelper
	{
		private class EFFilterVisitorLogic : IFilterVisitorLogic
		{

			public EFFilterVisitorLogic()
				: this(null)
			{
			}

			public EFFilterVisitorLogic(DBSetFilter filter)
			{
				this.filter = filter;
			}

			public CriteriaOperator PrependTableNames(QueryOperand theOperand)
			{
				//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0021: Expected O, but got Unknown
				return (CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty($"{filter.DBSetName}.{theOperand.ColumnName}");
			}

			public CriteriaOperator CutOffTableNames(QueryOperand theOperand)
			{
				//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_002a: Expected O, but got Unknown
				int num = theOperand.ColumnName.IndexOf('.') + 1;
				if (num == -1)
				{
					return (CriteriaOperator)(object)theOperand;
				}
				string text = theOperand.ColumnName.Substring(num);
				return (CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty(text);
			}

			public CriteriaOperator Rename(QueryOperand theOperand, string renameFrom, string renameTo)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}

			public CriteriaOperator Rename(OperandValue theOperand, string renameFrom, string renameTo)
			{
				//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_001f: Expected O, but got Unknown

				if (val != null && val.ParameterName == renameFrom)
				{
					return (CriteriaOperator)new OperandParameter(renameTo);
				}
				return (CriteriaOperator)(object)theOperand;
			}
		}

		public static string CutOffTableNames(string filter)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(filter))
			{
				return null;
			}
			FilterVisitor visitor = new FilterVisitor(FilterVisitorCommand.CutOffTableNames, new EFFilterVisitorLogic());
			return FilterVisitor.Process(visitor, filter, Enumerable.Empty<IParameter>());
		}

		public static string PrependTableNames(DBSetFilter filter)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(filter.FilterString))
			{
				return null;
			}
			FilterVisitor visitor = new FilterVisitor(FilterVisitorCommand.PrependTableNames, new EFFilterVisitorLogic(filter));
			return FilterVisitor.Process(visitor, filter.FilterString, (IEnumerable<IParameter>)(object)filter.Parameters);
		}

		public object GetPropertyValue(string name)
		{
			if (!dataConnection.IsConnected)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (values.ContainsKey(name))
			{
				return values[name];
			}
			object contextInstance = dataConnection.Model.ContextInstance;
			PropertyInfo property = contextInstance.GetType().GetProperty(name);
			if (property == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			object obj = property.GetValue(contextInstance, new object[0]);
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return new object[0];
			}
			if (!EFDataSourceServerModeFilterHelper.HasInterface(obj, typeof(IEnumerable<>)))
			{
				return obj;
			}
			Tree tree = new Tree(filters);
			Node<DBSetFilter> node = tree.FindNodeByName(name);
			if (node != null && !node.Children.Any())
			{
				obj = EFDataSourceServerModeFilterHelper.ApplySingleLevelFilter(obj, node.Value);
			}
			if (!UseLocalStorage)
			{
				return obj;
			}
			if (node != null && node.Children.Any())
			{
				obj = EFDataSourceServerModeFilterHelper.ApplyMultilevelFilter(obj, node);
			}
			IList list = CreateLocalStorageList(obj);
			values.Add(name, list);
			return list;
		}

		public object GetMethodValue(string name)
		{
			if (storedProcedures.All((EFStoredProcedureInfo p) => p.Name != name))
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(string.Format("Only one of the selected data members ({0}) can be used", string.Join(", ", storedProcedures.Select((EFStoredProcedureInfo p) => p.Name))));
			}
			if (!values.ContainsKey(name))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return values[name];
		}

		internal void FillData()
		{
			object contextInstance = dataConnection.Model.ContextInstance;
			if (contextInstance == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				values.Clear();
				foreach (EFStoredProcedureInfo storedProcedure in storedProcedures)
				{
					MethodInfo method = contextInstance.GetType().GetMethod(storedProcedure.Name);
					if (method != null)
					{
						object obj = method.Invoke(contextInstance, storedProcedure.Parameters.Select((EFParameter p) => p.Value).ToArray());
						IList value;
						if (obj is IEnumerable data)
						{
							value = CreateLocalStorageList(data);
						}
						else if (DataContext.IsComplexType(method.ReturnType))
						{
							value = CreateLocalStorageList(new object[1] { obj });
						}
						else
						{
							Type type = typeof(SimpleReturnTypeWrapper<>).MakeGenericType(method.ReturnType);
							value = CreateLocalStorageList(new object[1] { Activator.CreateInstance(type, obj) });
						}
						values.Add(storedProcedure.Name, value);
					}
				}
			}
			catch (TargetInvocationException ex)
			{
				if (ex.InnerException != null)
				{
					StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
					for (Exception innerException = ex.InnerException; innerException != null; innerException = innerException.InnerException)
					{
						stringBuilder.AppendLine(innerException.Message);
					}
					throw new Exception(stringBuilder.ToString());
				}
				throw;
			}
			catch (EntityException ex2)
			{
				if (ex2.InnerException != null)
				{
					throw new Exception($"{ex2.Message}\r\n{ex2.InnerException.Message}");
				}
				throw;
			}
		}

		internal void ClearData()
		{
			values.Clear();
		}

		internal void ClearData(string[] queries)
		{
			foreach (string key in queries)
			{
				if (values.ContainsKey(key))
				{
					values.Remove(key);
				}
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<MethodInfo> GetMethods()
		{
			MethodInfo[] source = ((Type != null) ? Type.GetMethods(BindingFlags.DeclaredOnly | BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public) : new MethodInfo[0]);
			return source.Where((MethodInfo method) => !method.IsSpecialName && storedProcedures.Any((EFStoredProcedureInfo p) => p.Name == method.Name));
		}
	}

				};
			}

				predicate = (Type _) => true;
			}

		}

		public static Type[] GetAssemblyTypesSafe(Assembly asm)
		{
			try
			{
				return asm.GetTypes();
			}
			catch (ReflectionTypeLoadException ex)
			{
				if (ex.Types != null && ex.Types.Length != 0)
				{
					return ex.Types.Where((Type type) => type != null).ToArray();
				}
				return Type.EmptyTypes;
			}
		}

		public static IEnumerable<Type> GetTypes(Assembly assembly, Predicate<Type> predicate)
		{
			if (assembly == null)
			{
				yield break;
			}
			Type[] assemblyTypesSafe = GetAssemblyTypesSafe(assembly);
			for (int i = 0; i < assemblyTypesSafe.Length; i++)
			{
				yield return assemblyTypesSafe[i];
			}
			AssemblyName[] referencedAssemblies = assembly.GetReferencedAssemblies();
			foreach (AssemblyName assemblyName in referencedAssemblies)
			{
				if (assemblyName == null || !TypesFilterHelper.ShouldIncludeTypesFromAssembly(assemblyName.FullName))
				{
					continue;
				}
				Assembly assembly2 = null;
				try
				{
					assembly2 = SafeTypeResolver.GetOrLoadAssembly(assemblyName, false);
				}
				catch
				{
				}
				if (assembly2 == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				assemblyTypesSafe = GetAssemblyTypesSafe(assembly2);
				foreach (Type type in assemblyTypesSafe)
				{
					if (type != null && predicate(type))
					{
						yield return type;
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
