	public static class EFPreviewHelper
	{
		public static object GetPreviewData(EFDataConnection connection, EFStoredProcedureInfo storedProcedure, IEnumerable<IParameter> evaluatedParameters, IExceptionHandler exceptionHandler, IWaitFormActivator waitFormActivator)
		{
			if (storedProcedure == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			CancellationTokenSource cancellationTokenSource = new CancellationTokenSource();
			CancellationTokenHook waitFormObject = new CancellationTokenHook(cancellationTokenSource);
			CancellationToken token = cancellationTokenSource.Token;
			EFDataConnection connectionForPreview = new EFDataConnection(connection.Name, connection.ConnectionParameters)
			{
				SolutionTypesProvider = connection.SolutionTypesProvider,
				ConnectionStringsProvider = connection.ConnectionStringsProvider
			};
			if (!ConnectionHelper.OpenConnection(connectionForPreview, exceptionHandler, waitFormActivator))
			{
				return null;
			}
			waitFormActivator.ShowWaitForm(false, true, true);
			waitFormActivator.SetWaitFormObject((ISupportCancel)(object)waitFormObject);
			waitFormActivator.SetWaitFormCaption(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.LoadingDataPanelText));
			waitFormActivator.SetWaitFormDescription(string.Empty);
			waitFormActivator.EnableCancelButton(true);
			Exception ex2;
			try
			{
				Task<object> task = Task.Factory.StartNew(delegate
				{
					EFContextWrapper eFContextWrapper = new EFContextWrapper(connectionForPreview, storedProcedure.Name, evaluatedParameters);
					eFContextWrapper.FillData();
					return eFContextWrapper.GetMethodValue(storedProcedure.Name);
				}, token);
				task.WithBackgroundService(token);
				task.Wait(token);
				return task.Result;
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				ex2 = ((!(ex is AggregateException ex3)) ? ex : ExceptionHelper.Unwrap(ex3));
			}
			finally
			{
				waitFormActivator.CloseWaitForm();
			}
			if (ex2 != null)
			{
				exceptionHandler.HandleException(ex2);
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

		{

		}

		protected IEnumerable<AutoCompleteItem> GetNestedProperties(string propertyName)
		{
			IBoundProperty filterPropertyByCaption = BoundColumnsHelper.Instance.GetFilterPropertyByCaption(Properties, propertyName, mergeFirstTwoParts: false);
			if (filterPropertyByCaption == null)

			}

		}

		protected virtual IEnumerable<AutoCompleteItem> GetAllFunctions()
		{

				select new
				{
					function = function,
					intelliItemText = (Context.OptionsBehavior.CapitalizeFunctionNames ? function.DisplayName.ToUpperInvariant() : function.DisplayName)
				} into t
				select new AutoCompleteItem(t.intelliItemText, ((ItemInfoBase)t.function).Description, (AutoCompleteItemKind)2);
		}

		internal static FunctionInfo ProcessFunction(FunctionInfo functionInfo)
		{
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_011d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_0143: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			string text = functionInfo.Function.Substring(0, functionInfo.Function.IndexOf('('));
			string text2 = functionInfo.Function;
			int num = functionInfo.CursorOffset;
			string functionCategory = ((object)functionInfo.Category/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).ToString();

			if (match.Success && match.Value.Contains(','))
			{

				text2 = text + "(" + string.Join(",", values) + ")";

			}

	internal abstract class FilterPropertiesHelper<T> where T : class
	{
		private static string GetParentFieldName(ref string name, bool mergeFirstTwoParts)
		{
			name = GetColumnName(name, out var tableAlias, enclose: true, mergeFirstTwoParts);
			return tableAlias;
		}

		private static string GetColumnName(string propertyName, out string tableAlias, bool enclose, bool mergeFirstTwoParts)
		{
			string[] array = ExtractParts(propertyName, enclose).ToArray();
			if (array.Length == 0)
			{
				tableAlias = null;
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (array.Length == 1)
			{
				tableAlias = null;
				return array[0];
			}
			if (mergeFirstTwoParts)
			{
				if (array.Length == 2)
				{
					tableAlias = array[0];
					return array[1];
				}
				tableAlias = string.Join(".", array, 0, 2);
				return string.Join(".", array, 2, array.Length - 2);
			}
			tableAlias = array[0];
			return string.Join(".", array, 1, array.Length - 1);
		}

		internal T GetFilterPropertyByCaption(IEnumerable<T> properties, string propertyName, bool mergeFirstTwoParts)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(propertyName))
			{
				return null;
			}
			do
			{
				IList<T> boundProperties = properties?.ToList() ?? new List<T>();
				T val = FindByName(boundProperties, propertyName);
				if (val != null)
				{
					return val;
				}
				string parentFieldName = GetParentFieldName(ref propertyName, mergeFirstTwoParts);
				T source = FindByName(boundProperties, parentFieldName);
				IEnumerable<T> children = GetChildren(source);
				if (children == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				properties = children;
			}
			while (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(propertyName));
			return null;
		}

		private static IEnumerable<string> ExtractParts(string propertyName, bool enclose)
		{
			IEnumerable<string> enumerable = ColumnNameHelper.ExtractParts(propertyName, "[", "]", enclose: false);
			foreach (string item in enumerable)
			{
				string text = item.Replace("\\]", "]");
				if (enclose && text.Contains("."))
				{
					yield return "[" + text + "]";
				}
				else
				{
					yield return text;
				}
			}
		}

		protected static bool IsEnclosed(string propertyName)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(propertyName) || propertyName.Length < 3)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (propertyName[0] == '[')
			{
				return propertyName[propertyName.Length - 1] == ']';
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected abstract T FindByName(IList<T> boundProperties, string propertyName);

		protected abstract IEnumerable<T> GetChildren(T source);
	}
	internal sealed class BoundColumnsHelper : FilterPropertiesHelper<IBoundProperty>
	{
		internal static readonly BoundColumnsHelper Instance = new BoundColumnsHelper();

		protected override IBoundProperty FindByName(IList<IBoundProperty> boundProperties, string propertyName)
		{
			IBoundProperty val = boundProperties.FirstOrDefault((IBoundProperty p) => p.DisplayName.Replace("\\]", "]") == propertyName);
			if (val == null && FilterPropertiesHelper<IBoundProperty>.IsEnclosed(propertyName))
			{
				propertyName = propertyName.Substring(1, propertyName.Length - 2);
				val = boundProperties.FirstOrDefault((IBoundProperty p) => p.DisplayName.Replace("\\]", "]") == propertyName);
			}
			return val;
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<IBoundProperty> GetChildren(IBoundProperty source)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return source.Children;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class ColumnInfoHelper : FilterPropertiesHelper<ColumnInfo>
	{
		internal static readonly ColumnInfoHelper Instance = new ColumnInfoHelper();

		protected override ColumnInfo FindByName(IList<ColumnInfo> boundProperties, string propertyName)
		{
			ColumnInfo val = boundProperties.FirstOrDefault((ColumnInfo p) => ((ItemInfoBase)p).Name.Replace("\\]", "]") == propertyName);
			if (val == null && FilterPropertiesHelper<ColumnInfo>.IsEnclosed(propertyName))
			{
				propertyName = propertyName.Substring(1, propertyName.Length - 2);
				val = boundProperties.FirstOrDefault((ColumnInfo p) => ((ItemInfoBase)p).Name.Replace("\\]", "]") == propertyName);
			}
			return val;
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<ColumnInfo> GetChildren(ColumnInfo source)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return source.Children;
		}
	}
	public class CriteriaOperatorValidator : ErrorsEvaluatorCriteriaValidator, ICriteriaWarningsValidator
	{

				: base(message)

			}
		}

		protected IEnumerable<IBoundProperty> Parameters { get; }

		protected IEnumerable<ICustomFunctionOperator> CustomFunctions { get; }

		protected bool SupportsAggregates { get; }

		private ExpressionEditorContext Context { get; }

		private DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.ExpressionEditor.CriteriaTypeResolver Resolver { get; }

		protected override string InvalidPropertyMessage => DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.ExpressionEditor_InvalidColumn);

		public CriteriaOperatorValidator(ExpressionEditorContext context, bool supportsAggregates)
			: this(context, null, supportsAggregates)

		}

		internal CriteriaOperatorValidator(ExpressionEditorContext context, IEnumerable<ICustomFunctionOperator> extraCustomFunctions, bool supportsAggregates)
			: this(context.Columns.Select((ColumnInfo c) => (IBoundProperty)(((object)((c is IBoundProperty) ? c : null)) ?? ((object)new BoundProperty(c)))), ((IEnumerable<IBoundProperty>)context.Parameters.Select((ParameterInfo p) => new BoundProperty(((ItemInfoBase)p).Name, p.Type))).ToList(), (from cf in context.Functions

		{
		}

		private CriteriaOperatorValidator(IEnumerable<IBoundProperty> properties, IEnumerable<IBoundProperty> parameters, IEnumerable<ICustomFunctionOperator> customFunctions, bool supportsAggregates, ExpressionEditorContext context)
			: base(properties.ToList())
		{
			SupportsAggregates = supportsAggregates;
			CustomFunctions = customFunctions ?? Enumerable.Empty<ICustomFunctionOperator>();
			Parameters = parameters;
			Context = context;
			Resolver = new DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.ExpressionEditor.CriteriaTypeResolver(context, properties);
		}

		protected override Type GetFilterColumnType(IBoundProperty filterProperty)
		{

			return NullableHelpers.GetBoxedType(filterColumnType);
		}

		private void AddError(CriteriaValidatorError error)
		{
			if (error != null)
			{
				base.errors.Add(error);
			}
		}

		private void OnInvalidCustomFunction(CriteriaOperator criteria, string functionName)
		{
			CriteriaValidatorError error = OnError(criteria, ErrorMessage(DataAccessStringId.ExpressionEditor_InvalidCustomFunction, functionName));
			AddError(error);
		}

		private unsafe void OnNotSupportedAggregateType(CriteriaOperator criteria, Aggregate aggregateType)
		{
			CriteriaValidatorError error = OnError(criteria, ErrorMessage(DataAccessStringId.ExpressionEditor_NotSupportedAggregateFunction, ((object)(*(Aggregate*)(&aggregateType))/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).ToString()));
			AddError(error);
		}

		private void OnInvalidParameter(CriteriaOperator criteria, string parameterName)
		{
			CriteriaValidatorError error = OnError(criteria, ErrorMessage(DataAccessStringId.ExpressionEditor_InvalidParameter, parameterName));
			AddError(error);
		}

		private static string ErrorMessage(DataAccessStringId format, string name)
		{
			return string.Format(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(format), name);
		}

		public override void Visit(BinaryOperator theOperator)
		{
			if (IsNotNumericOperandType(theOperator.LeftOperand) || IsNotNumericOperandType(theOperator.RightOperand))
			{
				try
				{
					((ErrorsEvaluatorCriteriaValidator)this).ValidateOperandType(theOperator.LeftOperand, theOperator.RightOperand);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					AddError((CriteriaValidatorError)(object)new CriteriaValidatorBinaryOperatorError(ex.Message, theOperator.LeftOperand, theOperator.RightOperand));
					return;
				}
			}
			((ErrorsEvaluatorCriteriaValidator)this).Validate(theOperator.LeftOperand);
			((ErrorsEvaluatorCriteriaValidator)this).Validate(theOperator.RightOperand);
		}

		private bool IsNotNumericOperandType(CriteriaOperator operand)
		{
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (CriteriaProcessingExtensions.ReferenceEqualsNull(operand))
			{
				return true;
			}
			try
			{
				CriteriaTypeResolverResult val = operand.Accept<CriteriaTypeResolverResult>((ICriteriaVisitor<CriteriaTypeResolverResult>)Resolver);
				Type type = ((CriteriaTypeResolverResult)(ref val)).Type;
				return !TypeConvertionValidator.CanConvertType(type, typeof(double));
			}
			catch
			{
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnInvalidCriteriaException(CriteriaOperator criteria, string message)
		{
			ExpressionEditorContext context = Context;
			ICriteriaOperatorValidatorProvider obj = ((context != null) ? context.CriteriaOperatorValidatorProvider : null);
			IInvalidCriteriaHandler val = (IInvalidCriteriaHandler)(object)((obj is IInvalidCriteriaHandler) ? obj : null);
			if (val == null || val.RaiseInvalidCriteriaException(criteria))
			{
				throw new InvalidCriteriaException(message);
			}
		}

		protected virtual CriteriaValidatorError OnError(CriteriaOperator criteria, string message)
		{
			//IL_0025: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			ExpressionEditorContext context = Context;
			ICriteriaOperatorValidatorProvider obj = ((context != null) ? context.CriteriaOperatorValidatorProvider : null);
			IInvalidCriteriaHandler val = (IInvalidCriteriaHandler)(object)((obj is IInvalidCriteriaHandler) ? obj : null);
			if (val == null || val.RaiseInvalidCriteriaError(criteria))
			{
				return new CriteriaValidatorError(message);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override void Visit(FunctionOperator theOperator)
		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			((ErrorsEvaluatorCriteriaValidator)this).Visit(theOperator);
			if ((int)theOperator.OperatorType != 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			CriteriaOperator obj = ((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)theOperator.Operands)[0];
			ConstantValue val = (ConstantValue)(object)((obj is ConstantValue) ? obj : null);

				ICustomFunctionOperator val2 = CustomFunctions.FirstOrDefault((ICustomFunctionOperator fo) => string.Equals(fo.Name, functionName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) ?? CriteriaOperator.GetCustomFunction(functionName);
				if (val2 == null)
				{
					OnInvalidCustomFunction((CriteriaOperator)(object)theOperator, functionName);

		}

		public override void Visit(AggregateOperand theOperand)
		{
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!SupportsAggregates)
			{
				OnNotSupportedAggregateType((CriteriaOperator)(object)theOperand, theOperand.AggregateType);
			}
			ValidateNested(theOperand.AggregatedExpression);
		}

		public override void Visit(OperandValue theOperand)
		{
			((ErrorsEvaluatorCriteriaValidator)this).Visit(theOperand);
			OperandParameter operandParameter = (OperandParameter)(object)((theOperand is OperandParameter) ? theOperand : null);
			if (operandParameter != null && !Parameters.Any((IBoundProperty p) => string.Equals(p.Name, operandParameter.ParameterName, StringComparison.Ordinal)))
			{
				OnInvalidParameter((CriteriaOperator)(object)theOperand, operandParameter.ParameterName);

		}

		public override void Visit(OperandProperty theOperand)
		{
			//IL_0057: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0061: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (theOperand != null && GetDynamicColumn(theOperand.PropertyName) != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (theOperand == null)
			{
				OnInvalidCriteriaException((CriteriaOperator)(object)theOperand, "Property is null");
				return;
			}
			string propertyName = theOperand.PropertyName;
			if (propertyName != null && propertyName.StartsWith("Parameters."))
			{
				string text = theOperand.PropertyName.Split(new char[1] { '.' }, 2)[1];
				((ErrorsEvaluatorCriteriaValidator)this).Visit((OperandValue)new OperandParameter(text));
			}
			else
			{
				IBoundProperty filterPropertyByCaption = BoundColumnsHelper.Instance.GetFilterPropertyByCaption(((BoundPropertyList)this).Properties, theOperand.PropertyName, mergeFirstTwoParts: false);
				CheckProperty(theOperand, filterPropertyByCaption);
			}
		}

		internal bool IsPropertyValid(IBoundProperty property)
		{
			if (property != null && !property.IsAggregate)
			{
				return !((ErrorsEvaluatorCriteriaValidator)this).IsListProperty(property);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual void CheckProperty(OperandProperty theOperand, IBoundProperty property)
		{
			if (!IsPropertyValid(property))
			{
				OnInvalidCriteriaException((CriteriaOperator)(object)theOperand, string.Format(((ErrorsEvaluatorCriteriaValidator)this).InvalidPropertyMessage, theOperand.PropertyName));
			}
		}

		private ColumnInfo GetDynamicColumn(string columnName)
		{
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0025: Expected O, but got Unknown
			ExpressionEditorContext context = Context;
			if (context == null)

				return null;
			}
			IColumnDynamicProvider columnDynamicProvider = context.ColumnDynamicProvider;
			if (columnDynamicProvider == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return columnDynamicProvider.GetColumnInfo(new ColumnDynamicArguments(columnName, (string)null, -1, false));
		}

		private void ValidateNested(CriteriaOperator theOperator)
		{
			if (theOperator != null)
			{
				CriteriaOperatorValidator criteriaOperatorValidator = (CriteriaOperatorValidator)(object)Clone();
				((ErrorsEvaluatorCriteriaValidator)criteriaOperatorValidator).Validate(theOperator);
				base.errors.AddRange(((ErrorsEvaluatorCriteriaValidator)criteriaOperatorValidator).errors);
			}
		}

		protected virtual ErrorsEvaluatorCriteriaValidator Clone()
		{
			return (ErrorsEvaluatorCriteriaValidator)(object)new CriteriaOperatorValidator(((BoundPropertyList)this).Properties, Parameters, CustomFunctions, SupportsAggregates, Context);
		}

		ExpressionEditorController.ErrorInfo.List ICriteriaWarningsValidator.Validate(CriteriaOperator criteria)
		{
			ExpressionEditorController.ErrorInfo.List list = new ExpressionEditorController.ErrorInfo.List();
			WarningsDetector warningsDetector = new WarningsDetector(Resolver);
			warningsDetector.Process(CriteriaOperator.Parse(CriteriaOperator.ToString(criteria), new object[0]));
			if (warningsDetector.Warnings.Count > 0)
			{
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
				foreach (CriteriaOperator warning in warningsDetector.Warnings)
				{
					stringBuilder.AppendLine(CriteriaOperator.ToString(warning));
				}
				stringBuilder.AppendLine(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.IntegerDivisionValidationMessage));
				list.Add(-1, stringBuilder.ToString());
			}
			return list;
		}
	}
	internal class CriteriaValidatorBinaryOperatorError : CriteriaValidatorError
	{
		public CriteriaOperator LeftOperand { get; }

		public CriteriaOperator RightOperand { get; }

		public CriteriaValidatorBinaryOperatorError(string text, CriteriaOperator leftOperand, CriteriaOperator rightOperand)
			: base(text)
		{
			LeftOperand = leftOperand;
			RightOperand = rightOperand;
		}
	}

	{
		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)

		}

	public class XPObjectSourceConnectionStringNameTypeConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		private const string NoneString = "(none)";

		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			if (sourceType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
		}

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
		}

		public override StandardValuesCollection GetStandardValues(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			XPObjectSource xPObjectSource = (XPObjectSource)context.Instance;
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			list.Add("(none)");
			if (xPObjectSource.ConnectionStringsProvider != null)
			{
				IConnectionStringInfo[] configFileConnections = xPObjectSource.ConnectionStringsProvider.GetConfigFileConnections();
				IConnectionStringInfo[] array = configFileConnections;
				foreach (IConnectionStringInfo val in array)
				{
					list.Add(val.Name);
				}
			}
			return new StandardValuesCollection(list);
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			if (value is string)
			{
				if ((string)value == "(none)")
				{
					return null;
				}
				return (string)value;
			}
			return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty((string)value))
				{
					return "(none)";
				}
				return (string)value;
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}

		public override bool GetStandardValuesSupported(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return true;
		}

		public override bool GetStandardValuesExclusive(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return false;
		}

	public class QueryNodeCollectionTypeConverter : CollectionTypeConverter
	{
		private class QueryPropertyDescriptor : TypeConverter.SimplePropertyDescriptor
		{
			public class QueryExpandableObjectConverter : ExpandableObjectConverter
			{
				private class QueryAliasPropertyDescriptor : SimplePropertyDescriptor
				{
					private readonly PropertyDescriptor parent;

					private readonly IServiceProvider serviceProvider;

					public QueryAliasPropertyDescriptor(PropertyDescriptor parent, IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
						: base(parent.ComponentType, parent.Name, parent.PropertyType, (System.Attribute[])new ArrayList(parent.Attributes).ToArray(typeof(System.Attribute)))
					{
						this.parent = parent;
						this.serviceProvider = serviceProvider;
					}

					public override object GetValue(object component)
					{
						return parent.GetValue(component);
					}

					public override void SetValue(object component, object value)
					{
						IDesignerHost designerHost = ((serviceProvider != null) ? ((IDesignerHost)serviceProvider.GetService(typeof(IDesignerHost))) : null);
						IComponentChangeService componentChangeService = ((serviceProvider != null) ? ((IComponentChangeService)serviceProvider.GetService(typeof(IComponentChangeService))) : null);
						DesignerTransaction designerTransaction = designerHost?.CreateTransaction();
						QueryNode queryNode = (QueryNode)component;
						string newQueryName = (string)value;
						string alias = queryNode.Alias;
						componentChangeService?.OnComponentChanging(queryNode.Owner.Parent, null);
						try
						{
							parent.SetValue(component, value);
							FederationDataSource federationDataSource = queryNode.Owner.Parent as FederationDataSource;
							federationDataSource?.UpdateRelations(alias, newQueryName);
							FederationResultSet federationResultSet = federationDataSource.RebuildResultSchemaCore();
							FederationResultSet federationResultSet2 = federationDataSource.RebuildResultSchemaCore();
							federationDataSource.Result.SetTables(federationResultSet2.Tables);
							federationDataSource.Result.ApplyRelations(federationDataSource.Relations);
							componentChangeService?.OnComponentChanged(queryNode.Owner.Parent, null, null, null);
							designerTransaction?.Commit();
						}
						catch (Exception)
						{
							designerTransaction?.Cancel();
							throw;
						}
					}
				}

				public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value, System.Attribute[] attributes)
				{
					PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = base.GetProperties(context, value, attributes);
					List<PropertyDescriptor> list = new List<PropertyDescriptor>(properties.Count);
					foreach (PropertyDescriptor item2 in properties)
					{
						string name = item2.Name;
						if (name == "Alias")
						{
							PropertyDescriptor item = new QueryAliasPropertyDescriptor(item2, context);
							list.Add(item);
						}
					}
					return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(list.ToArray(), readOnly: true);
				}
			}

			private readonly int index;

			public QueryPropertyDescriptor(int index, Type type, System.Attribute[] attributes)
				: base(typeof(QueryNodeCollection), $"[{index}]", type, attributes)
			{
				this.index = index;
			}

			public override object GetValue(object component)
			{
				QueryNodeCollection queryNodeCollection = (QueryNodeCollection)component;
				return queryNodeCollection[index];
			}

			public override void SetValue(object component, object value)
			{
				QueryNodeCollection queryNodeCollection = (QueryNodeCollection)component;
				queryNodeCollection[index] = (QueryNode)value;
			}
		}

		public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value, System.Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			QueryNodeCollection queryNodeCollection = (QueryNodeCollection)value;
			PropertyDescriptor[] array = new QueryPropertyDescriptor[queryNodeCollection.Count];
			PropertyDescriptor[] array2 = array;
			for (int i = 0; i < array2.Length; i++)
			{
				array2[i] = new QueryPropertyDescriptor(i, queryNodeCollection[i].GetType(), GetQueryPropertyDescriptorAttributes());
			}
			return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(array2);
		}

		protected virtual System.Attribute[] GetQueryPropertyDescriptorAttributes()
		{
			return new System.Attribute[1]
			{
				new TypeConverterAttribute(typeof(QueryPropertyDescriptor.QueryExpandableObjectConverter))
			};
		}

		public override bool GetPropertiesSupported(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class XPObjectSourceEntityTypeConverter : ReferenceConverter
	{
		private const string NoneString = "(none)";

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object val)
		{
			if (val is string)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty((string)val) || (string)val == "(none)")
				{
					return null;
				}
				try
				{
					XPDictionary dictionary = ((IXPDictionaryProvider)context.Instance).Dictionary;
					if (dictionary != null)
					{
						return dictionary.QueryClassInfo("", (string)val);
					}
				}
				catch (Exception e)
				{
					ShowError(context, e);
				}
			}
			return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, val);
		}

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object val, Type destType)
		{
			if (destType == typeof(string))
			{
				if (val == null)
				{
					return "(none)";
				}
				if (val is XPClassInfo)
				{
					return ((XPClassInfo)val).FullName;
				}
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, val, destType);
		}

		public XPObjectSourceEntityTypeConverter()
			: base(typeof(XPClassInfo))
		{
		}

		public override StandardValuesCollection GetStandardValues(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			SortedList sortedList = new SortedList();
			sortedList.Add("(none)", null);
			try
			{
				XPDictionary dictionary = ((IXPDictionaryProvider)context.Instance).Dictionary;
				Dictionary<Assembly, bool> dictionary2 = new Dictionary<Assembly, bool>();
				if (dictionary != null)
				{
					foreach (XPClassInfo @class in dictionary.Classes)
					{
						if (@class.IsVisibleInDesignTime && !DXAssemblyDetector.IsDevExpressAssembly(@class.ClassType.Assembly))
						{
							sortedList.Add(@class.FullName, @class);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			catch (Exception e)
			{
				ShowError(context, e);
			}
			return new StandardValuesCollection(sortedList.Values);
		}

		public override bool GetStandardValuesExclusive(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return true;
		}

		private void ShowError(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Exception e)
		{
			((IUIService)context.GetService(typeof(IUIService)))?.ShowError(e);
		}
	}

	public class TransformationNode : QueryNode
	{
		internal sealed class EqualityComparer : IEqualityComparer<TransformationNode>
		{
			public static bool Equals(TransformationNode x, TransformationNode y)
			{
				return EqualsHelper.ObjectsEquals(x, y, EqualsCore);
			}

			private static bool EqualsCore(TransformationNode x, TransformationNode y)
			{
				if (!string.Equals(x.Alias, y.Alias, StringComparison.Ordinal))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (x.Rules.Count != y.Rules.Count)
				{
					return false;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < x.Rules.Count; i++)
				{
					if (!x.Rules[i].Equals(y.Rules[i]))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return new JoinNodeEqualityAssistant(x.Root).Process(y.Root);
			}

			bool IEqualityComparer<TransformationNode>.Equals(TransformationNode x, TransformationNode y)
			{
				return Equals(x, y);
			}

			int IEqualityComparer<TransformationNode>.GetHashCode(TransformationNode obj)
			{
				return 0;
			}
		}

		public override string ActualName
		{
			get
			{
				string actualName = base.Alias;
				if (actualName == null)
				{
					IJoinNode root = Root;
					if (root == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					actualName = root.ActualName;
				}
				return actualName;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		public IJoinNode Root { get; set; }

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public TransformationRuleCollection Rules { get; } = new TransformationRuleCollection();

		public TransformationNode()
		{
		}

		public TransformationNode(IJoinNode root)
		{
			Root = root;
		}
	}
	public class TransformationRule : IEquatable<TransformationRule>
	{
		public string ColumnName { get; set; }

		public string Alias { get; set; }

		public string ActualName => Alias ?? ColumnName;

		public bool Unfold { get; set; }

		public bool Flatten { get; set; }

		public TransformationRule()
		{
		}

		public TransformationRule(TransformationRule other)
		{
			ColumnName = other.ColumnName;
			Alias = other.Alias;
			Unfold = other.Unfold;
			Flatten = other.Flatten;
		}

		public bool Equals(TransformationRule other)
		{
			if (other == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (this == other)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ColumnName == other.ColumnName && Alias == other.Alias && Unfold == other.Unfold)
			{
				return Flatten == other.Flatten;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

			}

	public class JoinElement
	{
		internal sealed class EqualityComparer : IEqualityComparer<JoinElement>
		{
			public static bool Equals(JoinElement x, JoinElement y)
			{
				return EqualsHelper.ObjectsEquals(x, y, EqualsCore);
			}

			private static bool EqualsCore(JoinElement x, JoinElement y)
			{
				if (x.Type != y.Type || !string.Equals(x.Condition, y.Condition))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return new JoinNodeEqualityAssistant(x.Node).Process(y.Node);
			}

			bool IEqualityComparer<JoinElement>.Equals(JoinElement x, JoinElement y)
			{
				return Equals(x, y);
			}

			int IEqualityComparer<JoinElement>.GetHashCode(JoinElement obj)
			{
				return 0;
			}
		}

	public class TransformationNodeBuilder
	{
		private readonly TransformationNode current;

		{
			current = new TransformationNode(root);
		}

		public TransformationNodeBuilder TransformColumn(string columnName)

		{

		}

		public TransformationNodeBuilder TransformColumn(string columnName, bool unfold, bool flatten, string alias)
		{
			TransformationRule transformationRule = FindOrCreateRule(columnName);
			transformationRule.Unfold = unfold;
			transformationRule.Flatten = flatten;
			if (alias != null)
			{
				transformationRule.Alias = alias;
			}
			return this;
		}

		public TransformationNode Build()
		{
			return Build(null);
		}

		public TransformationNode Build(string alias)
		{
			current.Alias = alias;
			return current;
		}

		private TransformationRule FindOrCreateRule(string column)
		{
			TransformationRule transformationRule = current.Rules.FirstOrDefault((TransformationRule r) => r.ColumnName == column);
			if (transformationRule == null)
			{
				transformationRule = new TransformationRule
				{
					ColumnName = column
				};
				current.Rules.Add(transformationRule);
			}
			return transformationRule;
		}
	}
	[Editor("DevExpress.DataAccess.UI.Native.DataFederation.QueryNodeEditor, DevExpress.DataAccess.v23.2.UI, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	public abstract class QueryNode : IQueryNode, IAliasedNode, IJoinNode, IQuery
	{
		internal class Validator : JoinNodeVisitor<ValidationError>
		{
			private class FederationDataSourceEqualityComparer : IEqualityComparer<FederationDataSource>
			{
				public bool Equals(FederationDataSource x, FederationDataSource y)
				{
					return x.Name == y.Name;
				}

				public int GetHashCode(FederationDataSource obj)
				{
					return obj.Name.GetHashCode();
				}
			}

			private readonly ValidationTablesExtractor tablesExtractor;

			private readonly string dataSourceName;

			private HashSet<IJoinNode> Nodes { get; } = new HashSet<IJoinNode>();

			public Validator()
				: this(new SourceColumnsProvider())
			{
			}

			public Validator(ISourceColumnsProvider columnsProvider)
			{
				tablesExtractor = new ValidationTablesExtractor(columnsProvider);
			}

			public Validator(ISourceColumnsProvider columnsProvider, string dataSourceName)
				: this(columnsProvider)
			{
				this.dataSourceName = dataSourceName;
			}

			protected override ValidationError Visit(SelectNode selectNode)
			{
				if (selectNode.Root == null)
				{
					return new RootNullValidationError(selectNode);
				}
				ValidationError validationError = AssertNodeIsUnique(selectNode.Root) ?? Process(selectNode.Root);
				if (validationError != null)
				{
					return validationError;
				}
				Dictionary<string, string> tableActualNames = new Dictionary<string, string> { 
				{
					selectNode.Root.ActualName,
					selectNode.Root.ActualName
				} };
				Dictionary<string, IValidationTable> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, IValidationTable>();
				IValidationTable validationTable = tablesExtractor.Process(selectNode.Root);
				dictionary.Add(validationTable.Name, validationTable);
				if (selectNode.Expressions.Count == 0)
				{
					return new NoColumnsValidationError(selectNode);
				}
				return ValidateSubNodes(selectNode, tableActualNames, dictionary) ?? ValidateExpressions(selectNode, tableActualNames, dictionary) ?? ValidateFilterString(selectNode, tableActualNames, dictionary);
			}

			protected override ValidationError Visit(TransformationNode transformationNode)
			{
				if (transformationNode.Root == null)
				{
					return new TransformationNodeRootNullValidationError(transformationNode);
				}
				ValidationError validationError = AssertNodeIsUnique(transformationNode.Root) ?? Process(transformationNode.Root);
				if (validationError != null)
				{
					return validationError;
				}
				if (transformationNode.Rules.Count == 0)
				{
					return new NoRulesValidationError(transformationNode);
				}
				HashSet<string> hashSet = new HashSet<string>();
				IValidationTable validationTable = tablesExtractor.Process(transformationNode.Root);
				string[] source = (from c in validationTable.Columns?.Where((IValidationColumn n) => transformationNode.Rules.All((TransformationRule r) => r.ColumnName != n.Name))
					select c.Name).ToArray() ?? new string[0];
				foreach (TransformationRule rule in transformationNode.Rules)
				{
					if (rule != null)
					{
						if (!hashSet.Add(rule.ActualName))
						{
							return new TwoRulesWithSameActualNameValidationError(transformationNode, rule.ActualName);
						}
						if (rule.ColumnName == null)
						{
							return new TransformationRuleColumnNameNullValidationError(transformationNode, rule);
						}
						if (validationTable.Columns != null && validationTable.Columns.All((IValidationColumn c) => c.Name != rule.ColumnName))
						{
							return new TransformationRuleColumnNotExistValidationError(transformationNode, transformationNode.Root.ActualName, rule.ColumnName);
						}
						if (!rule.Flatten && !rule.Unfold && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(rule.Alias) && source.Contains(rule.Alias))
						{
							return new TwoResultColumnsWithSameNameValidationError(transformationNode, rule.ActualName);
						}
					}
				}
				return null;
			}

			private ValidationError ValidateSubNodes(SelectNode selectNode, Dictionary<string, string> tableActualNames, Dictionary<string, IValidationTable> validationTables)
			{
				foreach (JoinElement subNode in selectNode.SubNodes)
				{
					ValidationError validationError = AssertNodeIsUnique(subNode.Node) ?? Process(subNode.Node);
					if (validationError != null)
					{
						return validationError;
					}
					CriteriaOperator filter;
					try
					{
						filter = FilterHelper.GetFilter(subNode.Condition, Enumerable.Empty<IParameter>(), mergeTableName: true);
					}
					catch (Exception exception)
					{
						return new InvalidConditionStringValidationError(selectNode, subNode.Node, subNode.Condition, exception);
					}
					tableActualNames.Add(subNode.Node.ActualName, subNode.Node.ActualName);
					IValidationTable validationTable = tablesExtractor.Process(subNode.Node);
					validationTables.Add(validationTable.Name, validationTable);
					validationError = new ConditionCriteriaValidatorVisitor(selectNode, subNode.Node, subNode.Condition, tableActualNames, validationTables).Process(filter);
					if (validationError != null)
					{
						return validationError;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}

			private ValidationError ValidateExpressions(SelectNode selectNode, Dictionary<string, string> tableActualNames, Dictionary<string, IValidationTable> validationTables)
			{
				HashSet<string> hashSet = new HashSet<string>();
				foreach (ISelectExpression expression in selectNode.Expressions)
				{
					if (expression is IAliasedSelectExpression aliasedSelectExpression && !hashSet.Add(aliasedSelectExpression.ActualName))
					{
						return new TwoColumnsWithSameActualNameValidationError(selectNode, aliasedSelectExpression.ActualName);
					}
					if (expression is INodeSelectExpression { Node: null } nodeSelectExpression)
					{
						return new ColumnNodeNullValidationError(selectNode, nodeSelectExpression);
					}
					SelectColumnExpression selectColumn = expression as SelectColumnExpression;
					if (selectColumn != null)
					{
						if (selectColumn.Name == null)
						{
							return new ColumnNameNullValidationError(selectNode, selectColumn);
						}
						if (!validationTables.TryGetValue(selectColumn.Node.ActualName, out var value))
						{
							return new ColumnNotExistInTableValidationError(selectNode, selectColumn.Node.ActualName, selectColumn.Name);
						}
						if (value.Columns != null && value.Columns.All((IValidationColumn c) => c.Name != selectColumn.Name))
						{
							return new ColumnTableNotExistValidationError(selectNode, selectColumn.Node.ActualName, selectColumn.Name);
						}
					}
					if (expression is SelectExpression selectExpression && ValidateExpression(selectNode, tableActualNames, validationTables, selectExpression.Expression, out var validationError))
					{
						return validationError;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}

			internal static bool ValidateExpression(SelectNode selectNode, Dictionary<string, string> tableActualNames, Dictionary<string, IValidationTable> validationTables, string expression, out ValidationError validationError)
			{
				CriteriaOperator filter;
				try
				{
					filter = FilterHelper.GetFilter(expression, Enumerable.Empty<IParameter>(), mergeTableName: false);
				}
				catch (Exception exception)
				{
					validationError = new InvalidExpressionStringValidationError(selectNode, expression, exception);
					return true;
				}
				ValidationError validationError2 = new ExpressionCriteriaValidatorVisitor(selectNode, expression, tableActualNames, validationTables).Process(filter);
				if (validationError2 != null)
				{
					validationError = validationError2;
					return true;
				}
				validationError = null;
				return false;
			}

			private ValidationError ValidateFilterString(SelectNode selectNode, Dictionary<string, string> tableActualNames, Dictionary<string, IValidationTable> validationTables)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(selectNode.FilterString))
				{
					return null;
				}
				CriteriaOperator filter;
				try
				{
					filter = FilterHelper.GetFilter(selectNode.FilterString, Enumerable.Empty<IParameter>(), mergeTableName: false);
				}
				catch (Exception exception)
				{
					return new InvalidFilterStringValidationError(selectNode, selectNode.FilterString, exception);
				}
				return new DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.DataFederation.FilterCriteriaValidatorVisitor(selectNode, selectNode.FilterString, tableActualNames, validationTables).Process(filter);
			}

			protected override ValidationError Visit(UnionNode unionNode)
			{
				if (unionNode.Elements.Count == 0)
				{
					return new UnionWithNoElementsValidationError(unionNode);
				}
				foreach (QueryNode element in unionNode.Elements)
				{
					ValidationError validationError = AssertNodeIsUnique(element) ?? Process(element);
					if (validationError != null)
					{
						return validationError;
					}
				}
				IValidationTable validationTable = null;
				for (int i = 0; i < unionNode.Elements.Count; i++)
				{
					QueryNode secondElement = unionNode.Elements[i];
					if (i == 0)
					{
						validationTable = tablesExtractor.Process(unionNode.Elements[0]);
						continue;
					}
					IValidationTable validationTable2 = tablesExtractor.Process(unionNode.Elements[i]);
					if (validationTable.Columns == null || validationTable2.Columns == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (validationTable.Columns.Length != validationTable2.Columns.Length)
					{
						return new UnionWithDifferentColumnCountInElementsValidationError(unionNode, unionNode.Elements[0], secondElement);
					}
					for (int j = 0; j < validationTable.Columns.Length; j++)
					{
						IValidationColumn validationColumn = validationTable.Columns[j];
						if (!(validationColumn?.Type == null))
						{
							IValidationColumn validationColumn2 = validationTable2.Columns[j];
							if (!(validationColumn2?.Type == null) && !UnionHelper.TryGetUnionType(validationColumn.Type, validationColumn2.Type, out var _))
							{
								return new UnionWithDifferentColumnTypesInElementsValidationError(unionNode, unionNode.Elements[0], validationColumn?.Name, secondElement, validationColumn2.Name);
							}
						}
					}
				}
				return null;
			}

			protected override ValidationError Visit(SourceNode sourceNode)
			{
				if (sourceNode.Source?.DataSource == null)
				{
					return new SourceNullValidationError(sourceNode);
				}
				if (sourceNode.Source.DataSource is FederationDataSource)
				{
					ValidationError validationError = DetectObjectCycle(sourceNode);
					if (validationError != null)
					{
						return validationError;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}

			private ValidationError DetectObjectCycle(SourceNode sourceNode)
			{
				ValidationError error = null;
				FederationDataSource federationDataSource = sourceNode.Source.DataSource as FederationDataSource;
				Algorithms.DepthFirstSearch<FederationDataSource>(federationDataSource, (Func<FederationDataSource, IEnumerable<FederationDataSource>>)((FederationDataSource n) => n.Sources.Select((Source x) => x.DataSource).OfType<FederationDataSource>()), (Action<FederationDataSource>)delegate(FederationDataSource n)
				{
					if (n.Name == dataSourceName)
					{
						error = new ObjectCycleValidationError(sourceNode, federationDataSource.Name, n.Name);
					}
				}, (Action<FederationDataSource, FederationDataSource>)delegate(FederationDataSource n1, FederationDataSource n2)
				{
					error = new ObjectCycleValidationError(sourceNode, n1.Name, n2.Name);
				}, (IEqualityComparer<FederationDataSource>)new FederationDataSourceEqualityComparer());
				return error;
			}

			private ValidationError AssertNodeIsUnique(IJoinNode node)
			{
				if (Nodes.Add(node))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return new NodeIsNotUniqueValidationError(node);
			}
		}

		private QueryNodeCollection owner;

		private string alias;

		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.QueryNode.Alias")]
		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.QueryNode.Alias")]
		public string Alias
		{
			get
			{
				return alias;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(alias == value))
				{
					owner?.CheckQueryName(value);
					alias = value;
				}
			}
		}

		string IQuery.Name
		{
			get
			{
				return Alias;
			}
			set
			{
				Alias = value;
			}
		}

			}
			set

				owner = value;
			}
		}

	[TypeConverter(typeof(QueryNodeCollectionTypeConverter))]
	public sealed class QueryNodeCollection : IList<QueryNode>, ICollection<QueryNode>, IEnumerable<QueryNode>, IEnumerable, IList, ICollection, IQueryCollection<QueryNode>
	{
		private readonly Locker locker = new Locker();

		private readonly ChangeCache<QueryNode> changeCache = new ChangeCache<QueryNode>();

		private List<QueryNode> Nodes { get; } = new List<QueryNode>();

		internal FederationDataSourceBase Parent { get; }

		internal IEnumerable<Source> Sources => this.SelectMany(SourceExtractor.Extract).Distinct();

		public QueryNode this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return Nodes[index];
			}
			set
			{
				Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)value, "node");
				QueryNode queryNode = ((index >= 0 && index < Count) ? Nodes[index] : null);
				Nodes[index] = value;
				if (Parent != null)
				{
					value.Owner = this;
				}
				changeCache.AddItem(value);
				if (queryNode != null)
				{
					changeCache.RemoveItem(queryNode);
				}
				OnChanged();
			}
		}

		public QueryNode this[string name]
		{
			get
			{
				QueryNode queryNode = Nodes.Find((QueryNode q) => q.ActualName == name);
				if (queryNode == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("Query \"" + name + "\" does not exist.");
				}
				return queryNode;
			}
			set
			{
				Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)value, "node");
				int num = Nodes.FindIndex((QueryNode q) => q.ActualName == name);
				if (num < 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("Query \"" + name + "\" does not exist.");
				}
				QueryNode queryNode = ((num >= 0 && num < Count) ? Nodes[num] : null);
				Nodes[num] = value;
				if (Parent != null)
				{
					value.Owner = this;
				}
				changeCache.AddItem(value);
				if (queryNode != null)
				{
					changeCache.RemoveItem(queryNode);
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsReadOnly => false;

		public bool IsFixedSize => ((IList)Nodes).IsFixedSize;

		public int Count => Nodes.Count;

		bool IList.IsFixedSize => false;

		bool IList.IsReadOnly => false;

		object IList.this[int index]
		{

				return this[index];
			}
			set

				QueryNode queryNode = value as QueryNode;
				if (queryNode == null && value != null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("Query collection accepts only QueryNode type.");

				this[index] = queryNode;
			}

		internal event EventHandler<CollectionChangedArgs<QueryNode>> CollectionChanged;

		internal static string GenerateUniqueName(QueryNode query, IEnumerable<QueryNode> queries)
		{
			return GenerateUniqueName(query, new HashSet<string>(queries.Select((QueryNode x) => x.ActualName)));
		}

		internal static string GenerateUniqueName(QueryNode query, HashSet<string> reservedNames)
		{
			string text = query.ActualName;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				SelectNode selectNode = query as SelectNode;
				UnionNode unionNode = query as UnionNode;
				if (selectNode?.Root != null)
				{
					text = selectNode.Root.ActualName;
				}
				else if (unionNode != null && unionNode.Elements.Any())
				{
					text = unionNode.Elements.First().ActualName;
				}
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				text = "Query";
			}
			text = CleanQueryName(text);
			return NameGenerator.GenerateUniqueName(text, reservedNames);
		}

		internal static string CleanQueryName(string name)
		{
			return name?.Trim('"').Replace("\".\"", ".").Replace('.', '_');
		}

		internal QueryNodeCollection(FederationDataSourceBase parent)
		{
			Parent = parent;
		}

		public void AddRange(IEnumerable<QueryNode> items)
		{
			BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				foreach (QueryNode item in items)
				{
					Add(item);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		public void AddRange(QueryNode[] nodes)
		{
			AddRange(nodes.AsEnumerable());
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			QueryNode queryNode = ((index >= 0 && index < Nodes.Count) ? Nodes[index] : null);
			Nodes.RemoveAt(index);
			if (queryNode != null)
			{
				changeCache.RemoveItem(queryNode);
				OnChanged();
			}
		}

		public void Insert(int index, QueryNode item)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)item, "item");
			Nodes.Insert(index, item);
			if (Parent != null)
			{
				item.Owner = this;
			}
			changeCache.AddItem(item);
			OnChanged();
		}

		public IEnumerator<QueryNode> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return Nodes.GetEnumerator();
		}

		public int IndexOf(QueryNode item)
		{
			return Nodes.IndexOf(item);
		}

		public bool Remove(QueryNode item)
		{
			if (Nodes.Remove(item))
			{
				changeCache.RemoveItem(item);
				OnChanged();
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Contains(QueryNode item)
		{
			return Nodes.Contains(item);
		}

		public void CopyTo(QueryNode[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			Nodes.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			bool flag = Count > 0;
			using (IEnumerator<QueryNode> enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					QueryNode current = enumerator.Current;
					changeCache.RemoveItem(current);
				}
			}
			Nodes.Clear();
			if (flag)
			{
				OnChanged();
			}
		}

		public void Add(QueryNode item)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)item, "item");
			Nodes.Add(item);
			if (Parent != null)
			{
				item.Owner = this;
			}
			changeCache.AddItem(item);
			OnChanged();
		}

		int IList.Add(object value)
		{
			QueryNode queryNode = value as QueryNode;
			if (queryNode == null && value != null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Query collection accepts only QueryNode type.");
			}
			Add(queryNode);
			return Count - 1;
		}

		void IList.Clear()
		{
			Clear();
		}

		bool IList.Contains(object value)
		{
			QueryNode queryNode = value as QueryNode;
			if (queryNode == null && value != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Contains(queryNode);
		}

		int IList.IndexOf(object value)
		{
			QueryNode queryNode = value as QueryNode;
			if (queryNode == null && value != null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return IndexOf(queryNode);
		}

		void IList.Insert(int index, object value)
		{
			QueryNode queryNode = value as QueryNode;
			if (queryNode == null && value != null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Query collection accepts only QueryNode type.");
			}
			Insert(index, queryNode);
		}

		void IList.Remove(object value)
		{
			QueryNode queryNode = value as QueryNode;
			if (queryNode != null || value == null)
			{
				Remove(queryNode);
			}
		}

		void IList.RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			RemoveAt(index);
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return ((IEnumerable)Nodes).GetEnumerator();
		}

		public void CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{
			((ICollection)Nodes).CopyTo(array, index);
		}

		internal void CheckQueryNode(QueryNode query)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)query, "query");
			string alias = query.Alias;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(alias))
			{
				throw new InvalidNameException(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.MessageEmptyQueryName));
			}
			using (IEnumerator<QueryNode> enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					QueryNode current = enumerator.Current;
					if (current != query && current.Alias == alias)
					{
						throw new InvalidNameException(string.Format(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.MessageDuplicateQueryName), alias));
					}
				}
			}
			Source[] array = SourceExtractor.Extract(query).Distinct().ToArray();
			Source[] array2 = array;
			foreach (Source source in array2)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(source.Name))
				{
					throw new InvalidNameException(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.Federation_EmptySourceNameErrorMessage));
				}
			}
			Source[] source2 = Parent.Sources.ToArray();
			Source[] array3 = array;
			foreach (Source source3 in array3)
			{
				if (source2.Any((Source s) => s != source3 && s.Name == source3.Name))
				{
					throw new InvalidNameException(string.Format(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.Federation_DuplicateSourceNameErrorMessage), source3.Name));
				}
			}
		}

		internal void CheckQueryName(string queryName)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(queryName))
			{
				throw new InvalidNameException(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.Federation_EmptySourceNameErrorMessage));
			}
			if (Nodes.Any((QueryNode s) => s.Alias == queryName))
			{
				throw new InvalidNameException(string.Format(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.Federation_DuplicateSourceNameErrorMessage), queryName));
			}
		}

		private void BeginUpdate()
		{
			locker.Lock();
		}

		private void EndUpdate()
		{
			locker.Unlock();
			OnChanged();
		}

		private void OnChanged()
		{
			if (!locker.IsLocked)
			{
				if (this.CollectionChanged != null)
				{
					changeCache.GetAddedRemovedItems(out var addedItems, out var removedItems);
					changeCache.Clear();
					this.CollectionChanged(this, new CollectionChangedArgs<QueryNode>(addedItems, removedItems));
				}
				else
				{
					changeCache.Clear();
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public class SelectNode : QueryNode
	{
		internal sealed class EqualityComparer : IEqualityComparer<SelectNode>
		{
			public static bool Equals(SelectNode x, SelectNode y)
			{
				return EqualsHelper.ObjectsEquals(x, y, EqualsCore);
			}

			private static bool EqualsCore(SelectNode x, SelectNode y)
			{
				if (!string.Equals(x.Alias, y.Alias, StringComparison.Ordinal))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (x.SubNodes.Count != y.SubNodes.Count || x.Expressions.Count != y.Expressions.Count)
				{
					return false;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < x.SubNodes.Count; i++)
				{
					if (!JoinElement.EqualityComparer.Equals(x.SubNodes[i], y.SubNodes[i]))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < x.Expressions.Count; j++)
				{
					if (!SelectColumnEqualityComparer.Equals(x.Expressions[j], y.Expressions[j]))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				if (!string.Equals(x.FilterString, y.FilterString, StringComparison.Ordinal))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return new JoinNodeEqualityAssistant(x.Root).Process(y.Root);
			}

			bool IEqualityComparer<SelectNode>.Equals(SelectNode x, SelectNode y)
			{
				return Equals(x, y);
			}

			int IEqualityComparer<SelectNode>.GetHashCode(SelectNode obj)
			{
				return 0;
			}
		}

		public override string ActualName
		{
			get
			{
				string actualName = base.Alias;
				if (actualName == null)
				{
					IJoinNode root = Root;
					if (root == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					actualName = root.ActualName;
				}
				return actualName;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		public IJoinNode Root { get; set; }

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public JoinElementCollection SubNodes { get; } = new JoinElementCollection();

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public SelectExpressionCollection Expressions { get; } = new SelectExpressionCollection();

		[DefaultValue(null)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public string FilterString { get; set; }

		public SelectNode()
		{
		}

		public SelectNode(IJoinNode root)
		{
			Root = root;
		}
	}

	public class UnionNode : QueryNode
	{
		internal sealed class EqualityComparer : IEqualityComparer<UnionNode>
		{
			public static bool Equals(UnionNode x, UnionNode y)
			{
				return EqualsHelper.ObjectsEquals(x, y, EqualsCore);
			}

			private static bool EqualsCore(UnionNode x, UnionNode y)
			{
				if (x.Type != y.Type)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!string.Equals(x.Alias, y.Alias, StringComparison.Ordinal))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (x.Elements.Count != y.Elements.Count)
				{
					return false;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < x.Elements.Count; i++)
				{
					if (!new JoinNodeEqualityAssistant(x.Elements[i]).Process(y.Elements[i]))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}

			bool IEqualityComparer<UnionNode>.Equals(UnionNode x, UnionNode y)
			{
				return Equals(x, y);
			}

			int IEqualityComparer<UnionNode>.GetHashCode(UnionNode obj)
			{
				return 0;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		public UnionType Type { get; set; }

		public override string ActualName
		{
			get
			{
				string actualName = base.Alias;
				if (actualName == null)
				{
					QueryNode queryNode = Elements.FirstOrDefault();
					if (queryNode == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					actualName = queryNode.ActualName;
				}
				return actualName;
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public QueryNodeCollection Elements { get; } = new QueryNodeCollection(null);

		public UnionNode()
		{
		}

		public UnionNode(UnionType type)
		{
			Type = type;
		}
	}
	public enum UnionType
	{
		Union,
		UnionAll
	}
	public abstract class FederationDataSourceBase : DataComponentBase
	{
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public IEnumerable<Source> Sources => Queries.Sources;

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[Editor("DevExpress.DataAccess.UI.Native.DataFederation.QueryNodeCollectionEditor, DevExpress.DataAccess.v23.2.UI, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.FederationDataSourceBase.Queries")]
		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.DataFederation.FederationDataSourceBase.Queries")]
		[Category("Data")]
		public QueryNodeCollection Queries { get; }

		internal string DataMember { get; set; }

		protected internal override IEnumerable<DataSourceParameterBase> AllParameters => Enumerable.Empty<DataSourceParameterBase>();

		protected QueryNodeCollection ValidQueries
		{
			get
			{
				QueryNodeCollection queryNodeCollection = new QueryNodeCollection(this);
				IndeterminateSourceColumnsProvider columnsProvider = new IndeterminateSourceColumnsProvider();
				foreach (QueryNode query in Queries)
				{
					ValidationError validationError = new QueryNode.Validator(columnsProvider, Name).Process(query);
					if (validationError == null)
					{
						queryNodeCollection.Add(query);
					}
				}
				return queryNodeCollection;
			}
		}

		protected override bool HasSensitiveInfo => Sources.Select((Source s) => s.DataSource).OfType<ISensitiveInfoContainer>().Any((ISensitiveInfoContainer s) => s.HasSensitiveInfo);

		protected FederationDataSourceBase()
		{
			Queries = new QueryNodeCollection(this);
		}

		protected override string GetDataMember()
		{
			string text = DataMember;
			if (text == null)
			{
				if (Queries.Count <= 0)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				text = Queries[0].ActualName;
			}
			return text;
		}

		public override XElement SaveToXml()
		{
			IFederationDataSourceSerializer federationDataSourceSerializer = CreateDataSourceSerializer();
			return federationDataSourceSerializer.SaveToXml();
		}

		public override void LoadFromXml(XElement element)
		{
			IFederationDataSourceSerializer federationDataSourceSerializer = CreateDataSourceSerializer();
			federationDataSourceSerializer.LoadFromXml(element);
		}

		protected abstract IFederationDataSourceSerializer CreateDataSourceSerializer();

		public override void Fill(IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters)
		{
			Fill(sourceParameters, Queries.Select((QueryNode q) => q.Alias).ToArray());
		}

		public void Fill(IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters, string[] queriesToFill)
		{
			FillInternal(sourceParameters, queriesToFill);
		}

		protected abstract void FillInternal(IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters, string[] queriesToFill);

		protected void ValidateQueries(string[] queries)
		{
			ValidateQueries(queries, new SourceColumnsProvider());
		}

		protected void ValidateQueries(string[] queries, ISourceColumnsProvider columnsProvider)
		{
			List<QueryNodeValidationException> list = new List<QueryNodeValidationException>();
			foreach (QueryNode query2 in Queries)
			{
				if (queries.Contains(query2.ActualName))
				{
					FederationJoinNodeExpandAssistant federationJoinNodeExpandAssistant = new FederationJoinNodeExpandAssistant(this);
					QueryNode query = federationJoinNodeExpandAssistant.Expand(query2);
					ValidationError validationError = new QueryNode.Validator(columnsProvider, Name).Process(query);
					if (validationError != null)
					{
						list.Add(new QueryNodeValidationException(validationError.Message));
					}
				}
			}
			if (list.Count == 1)
			{
				throw list[0];
			}
			if (list.Count > 1)
			{
				throw new AggregateException(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.QueriesFailedToValidate_ExceptionMessage), list);
			}
		}

		internal abstract void RebuildResultSchemaInternal();
	}

	public sealed class FederationMasterDetailInfo : IMasterDetailInfo
	{
		internal class EqualityComparer : IEqualityComparer<FederationMasterDetailInfo>
		{
			public static bool Equals(FederationMasterDetailInfo x, FederationMasterDetailInfo y)
			{
				return EqualsHelper.ObjectsEquals(x, y, EqualsCore);
			}

			private static bool EqualsCore(FederationMasterDetailInfo x, FederationMasterDetailInfo y)
			{
				if (!string.Equals(x.MasterQueryName, y.MasterQueryName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!string.Equals(x.DetailQueryName, y.DetailQueryName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!string.Equals(x.customName, y.customName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!EqualsHelper.ListsEquals(x.KeyColumns, y.KeyColumns, RelationColumnInfoBase.EqualityComparer.Equals))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}

			bool IEqualityComparer<FederationMasterDetailInfo>.Equals(FederationMasterDetailInfo x, FederationMasterDetailInfo y)
			{
				return Equals(x, y);
			}

			int IEqualityComparer<FederationMasterDetailInfo>.GetHashCode(FederationMasterDetailInfo obj)
			{
				return 0;
			}
		}

		private const string STR_Null = "<null>";

		private string customName;

		public string MasterQueryName { get; set; }

		public string DetailQueryName { get; set; }

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[Editor("DevExpress.Utils.UI.CollectionEditor, DevExpress.Utils.v23.2.UI, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
		public List<FederationRelationColumnInfo> KeyColumns { get; }

		IEnumerable<RelationColumnInfoBase> IMasterDetailInfo.KeyColumns => KeyColumns;

		public string Name
		{
			get
			{
				return customName ?? GenerateName();
			}
			set
			{
				customName = value;
			}
		}

		public bool HasCustomName => customName != null;

		public FederationMasterDetailInfo(string master, string detail)
		{
			MasterQueryName = master;
			DetailQueryName = detail;
			KeyColumns = new List<FederationRelationColumnInfo>();
		}

		public FederationMasterDetailInfo()
			: this(null, null)
		{
		}

		public FederationMasterDetailInfo(string masterQueryName, string detailQueryName, IEnumerable<FederationRelationColumnInfo> keyColumns)
			: this(masterQueryName, detailQueryName)
		{
			KeyColumns.AddRange(keyColumns);
		}

		public FederationMasterDetailInfo(string masterQueryName, string detailQueryName, FederationRelationColumnInfo keyColumn)
			: this(masterQueryName, detailQueryName)
		{
			KeyColumns.Add(keyColumn);
		}

		public FederationMasterDetailInfo(string masterQueryName, string detailQueryName, string masterKeyColumn, string detailKeyColumn)
			: this(masterQueryName, detailQueryName, new FederationRelationColumnInfo(masterKeyColumn, detailKeyColumn))
		{
		}

		internal FederationMasterDetailInfo(IMasterDetailInfo other)
			: this(other.MasterQueryName, other.DetailQueryName)
		{
			if (other.HasCustomName)
			{
				customName = other.Name;
			}
			foreach (RelationColumnInfoBase keyColumn in other.KeyColumns)
			{
				KeyColumns.Add(new FederationRelationColumnInfo(keyColumn));
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeName()
		{
			return HasCustomName;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return Name;
		}

		public string GetDetailedDescription()
		{
			int count = KeyColumns.Count;
			string text = DetailQueryName ?? "<null>";
			string text2 = MasterQueryName ?? "<null>";
			string[] array = new string[count];
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				FederationRelationColumnInfo federationRelationColumnInfo = KeyColumns[i];
				array[i] = text + "." + (federationRelationColumnInfo.NestedKeyColumn ?? "<null>") + " = " + text2 + "." + (federationRelationColumnInfo.ParentKeyColumn ?? "<null>");
			}
			return text2 + " master-detailed " + text + " on " + string.Join(" and ", array);
		}

		public string GenerateName()
		{
			return MasterQueryName + DetailQueryName;
		}
	}
	public class SourceNode : IJoinNode, IAliasedNode
	{
		internal sealed class EqualityComparer : IEqualityComparer<SourceNode>
		{
			public static bool Equals(SourceNode x, SourceNode y)
			{
				return EqualsHelper.ObjectsEquals(x, y, EqualsCore);
			}

			private static bool EqualsCore(SourceNode x, SourceNode y)
			{
				if (!string.Equals(x.Alias, y.Alias, StringComparison.Ordinal))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return Source.EqualityComparer.Equals(x.Source, y.Source);
			}

			bool IEqualityComparer<SourceNode>.Equals(SourceNode x, SourceNode y)
			{
				return Equals(x, y);
			}

			int IEqualityComparer<SourceNode>.GetHashCode(SourceNode obj)
			{
				return 0;
			}
		}

		public string Alias { get; set; }

		public string ActualName
		{
			get
			{
				string text = Alias;
				if (text == null)
				{
					Source source = Source;
					if (source == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					text = source.Name;
				}
				return text;
			}
		}

	public sealed class Source

		internal class EqualityComparer : IEqualityComparer<Source>
		{
			public static bool Equals(Source x, Source y)
			{
				return EqualsHelper.ObjectsEquals(x, y, EqualsCore);
			}

			private static bool EqualsCore(Source x, Source y)
			{
				if (!string.Equals(x.Name, y.Name, StringComparison.Ordinal))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (x.DataSource != y.DataSource)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!string.Equals(x.DataMember, y.DataMember, StringComparison.Ordinal))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}

			bool IEqualityComparer<Source>.Equals(Source x, Source y)
			{
				return Equals(x, y);
			}

			int IEqualityComparer<Source>.GetHashCode(Source obj)
			{
				return 0;
			}
		}

		internal class EqualityComparerShort : IEqualityComparer<Source>
		{
			public static bool Equals(Source x, Source y)
			{
				return EqualsHelper.ObjectsEquals(x, y, EqualsCore);
			}

			private static bool EqualsCore(Source x, Source y)
			{
				if (x.DataSource != y.DataSource)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.DataMember) && string.IsNullOrEmpty(y.DataMember))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (!string.Equals(x.DataMember, y.DataMember, StringComparison.Ordinal))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}

			bool IEqualityComparer<Source>.Equals(Source x, Source y)
			{
				return Equals(x, y);
			}

			int IEqualityComparer<Source>.GetHashCode(Source obj)
			{
				return 0;
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateRelations(string oldQueryName, string newQueryName)
		{
			Relations.ForEach(delegate(FederationMasterDetailInfo x)
			{
				if (x.MasterQueryName == oldQueryName)
				{
					x.MasterQueryName = newQueryName;
				}
				if (x.DetailQueryName == oldQueryName)
				{
					x.DetailQueryName = newQueryName;
				}
			});
		}

		internal FederationResultSet RebuildResultSchemaCore(bool skipInvalidQueries = false)

			QueryNodeCollection source = (skipInvalidQueries ? base.ValidQueries : base.Queries);
			return FillCore(source.Select((QueryNode q) => q.ActualName).ToArray(), (IList<IParameter>)(object)new IParameter[0], includeData: false, CancellationToken.None);
		}
