		public Task FillAsync(IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters, string[] queriesToFill, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			Func<FederationResultSet> function = delegate
			{
				//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0029: Expected O, but got Unknown
				List<IParameter> sourceParameters2 = sourceParameters.ToList();
				FillSourcesAsynchronously(sourceParameters2, queriesToFill, (IServiceProvider)new ServiceManager(), cancellationToken);
				return FillCore(queriesToFill, sourceParameters2, includeData: true, cancellationToken);
			};
			return Task<FederationResultSet>.Factory.StartNew(function, cancellationToken).ContinueWith(delegate(Task<FederationResultSet> task)
			{
				ApplyResult(queriesToFill, task.Result);
			}, cancellationToken);
		}

		private bool ShouldRefillAnySource()
		{
			DetectSourcesLoop();
			return base.Sources.Select((Source x) => x.DataSource).OfType<IListAdapter>().Any((IListAdapter x) => x.ShouldRefill);
		}

		private void DetectSourcesLoop()
		{
			Algorithms.DepthFirstSearch<FederationDataSource>(this, (Func<FederationDataSource, IEnumerable<FederationDataSource>>)((FederationDataSource n) => n.Sources.Select((Source x) => x.DataSource).OfType<FederationDataSource>()), (Action<FederationDataSource>)delegate
			{
			}, (Action<FederationDataSource, FederationDataSource>)delegate(FederationDataSource n1, FederationDataSource n2)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(string.Format(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.Federation_ObjectCycleValidationErrorMessage), n1.Name, n2.Name));
			}, (IEqualityComparer<FederationDataSource>)null);
		}

		void IListAdapter.FillList(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
		{
			QueryHelper queryHelper = ((serviceProvider != null) ? ServiceProviderExtensions.GetService<QueryHelper>(serviceProvider) : null);
			string[] queriesToFill = ((queryHelper != null) ? queryHelper.QueryNames : base.Queries.Select((QueryNode q) => q.ActualName).ToArray());
			IList<IParameter> sourceParameters = ParameterSupplierHelper.GetSourceParameters(serviceProvider).ToList();
			FillSources(sourceParameters, queriesToFill, serviceProvider);
			FederationResultSet resultSet = FillCore(queriesToFill, sourceParameters, includeData: true, CancellationToken.None);
			ApplyResult(queriesToFill, resultSet);
		}

		private void ApplyResult(string[] queriesToFill, FederationResultSet resultSet)
		{
			IEnumerable<FederationResultTable> second = from table in Result.Tables.OfType<FederationResultTable>()
				where !queriesToFill.Contains(table.TableName) && base.Queries.Any((QueryNode q) => q.Alias == table.TableName)
				select table;
			Result.SetTables(resultSet.Tables.Union(second));
			Result.ApplyRelations(Relations);
		}

		private IEnumerable<Source> GetSources(string[] queriesToFill)
		{
			HashSet<Source> hashSet = new HashSet<Source>();
			foreach (string queryName in queriesToFill)
			{
				IQueryNode node = base.Queries.FirstOrDefault((QueryNode q) => q.ActualName == queryName);
				FederationJoinNodeExpandAssistant federationJoinNodeExpandAssistant = new FederationJoinNodeExpandAssistant(this);
				node = federationJoinNodeExpandAssistant.Expand(node);
				if (node == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("The " + queryName + " query not found.");
				}
				foreach (Source item in SourceExtractor.Extract((IJoinNode)node))
				{
					hashSet.Add(item);
				}
			}
			return hashSet;
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			base.Dispose(disposing);
			if (disposing)
			{
				Result.Clear();
			}
		}

		private static Dictionary<string, SourceColumnsInfo> GetSourcesAndColumns(IQueryNode query)
		{
			return SourceColumnsExtractor.Extract(query).ToDictionary((KeyValuePair<Source, SourceColumnsInfo> sourceCols) => sourceCols.Key.Name, (KeyValuePair<Source, SourceColumnsInfo> sourceCols) => sourceCols.Value);
		}

		async Task IListAdapterAsync.FillAsync(IServiceProvider serviceProvider, CancellationToken token)
		{
			if (!fillListSemaphore.WaitOne(300))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Data source is busy");
			}
			try
			{
				FederationResultSet federationResultSet = await FillCoreAsync(serviceProvider, token).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				Result.SetTables(federationResultSet.Tables);
				Result.ApplyRelations(Relations);
			}
			catch (OperationCanceledException)
			{
			}
			finally
			{
				fillListSemaphore.Release();
			}
		}

		private Task<FederationResultSet> FillCoreAsync(IServiceProvider serviceProvider, CancellationToken token)
		{
			IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters = ParameterSupplierHelper.GetSourceParameters(serviceProvider);
			return FillAsync(serviceProvider, sourceParameters, token);
		}

		IAsyncResult IListAdapterAsync.BeginFillList(IServiceProvider serviceProvider, CancellationToken token)
		{
			if (!fillListSemaphore.WaitOne(300))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Data source is busy");
			}
			return FillCoreAsync(serviceProvider, token);
		}

		void IListAdapterAsync.EndFillList(IAsyncResult result, CancellationToken token)
		{
			Task<FederationResultSet> task = (Task<FederationResultSet>)result;
			try
			{
				task.Wait(token);
				Result.SetTables(task.Result.Tables);
				Result.ApplyRelations(Relations);
			}
			catch (OperationCanceledException)
			{
			}
			catch (AggregateException ex2)
			{
				if (task.IsFaulted)
				{
					throw ExceptionHelper.Unwrap(ex2);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				fillListSemaphore.Release();
			}
		}

		protected virtual Task<FederationResultSet> FillAsync(IServiceProvider serviceProvider, IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			return FillAsync(serviceProvider, sourceParameters, cancellationToken, base.Queries.Select((QueryNode q) => q.Alias).ToArray());
		}

		protected virtual Task<FederationResultSet> FillAsync(IServiceProvider serviceProvider, IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters, CancellationToken cancellationToken, string[] queriesToFill)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)queriesToFill, "queriesToFill");
			Func<FederationResultSet> function = delegate
			{
				List<IParameter> sourceParameters2 = sourceParameters.ToList();
				FillSourcesAsynchronously(sourceParameters2, queriesToFill, serviceProvider, cancellationToken);
				return FillCore(queriesToFill, sourceParameters2, includeData: true, cancellationToken);
			};
			return Task.Factory.StartNew(function, cancellationToken, TaskCreationOptions.None, TaskScheduler.Default);
		}

		protected override void FillInternal(IEnumerable<IParameter> sourceParameters, string[] queriesToFill)
		{
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0011: Expected O, but got Unknown
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)queriesToFill, "queriesToFill");
			ServiceManager val = new ServiceManager();
			IParameter[] parameters = (IParameter[])(((object)sourceParameters?.ToArray()) ?? ((object)new IParameter[0]));
			val.AddService(typeof(IParameterSupplierBase), (object)new ParameterSupplier(parameters));
			val.AddService(typeof(QueryHelper), (object)new QueryHelper(queriesToFill));
			((IListAdapter)this).FillList((IServiceProvider)val);
		}

		private FederationResultSet FillCore(string[] queriesToFill, IList<IParameter> sourceParameters, bool includeData, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			ISourceColumnsProvider sourceColumnsProvider2;
			if (!includeData)
			{
				ISourceColumnsProvider sourceColumnsProvider = new IndeterminateSourceColumnsProvider();
				sourceColumnsProvider2 = sourceColumnsProvider;
			}
			else
			{
				ISourceColumnsProvider sourceColumnsProvider = new SourceColumnsProvider();
				sourceColumnsProvider2 = sourceColumnsProvider;
			}
			ISourceColumnsProvider columnsProvider = sourceColumnsProvider2;
			ValidateQueries(queriesToFill, columnsProvider);
			FederationResultSet federationResultSet = new FederationResultSet(this);
			FederationJoinNodeExpandAssistant expandAssistant = new FederationJoinNodeExpandAssistant(this);
			QueryNode[] array = base.Queries.Select((QueryNode q) => expandAssistant.Expand(q)).ToArray();
			Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, ITypedColumnarData>> dictionary = new SourceDataProvider(array).RetrieveSourceDataByQuery(queriesToFill, includeData, CancellationToken.None);
			QueryNode[] array2 = array;
			foreach (QueryNode queryNode in array2)
			{
				if (queriesToFill.Contains(queryNode.ActualName))
				{
					federationResultSet.Add(new FederationResultTable(queryNode, FederationResultBuilder.Process(queryNode, dictionary[queryNode.ActualName], sourceParameters, cancellationToken).ToColumnarData()));
				}
			}
			filled = true;
			return federationResultSet;
		}

		private void FillSources(IList<IParameter> sourceParameters, string[] queriesToFill, IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
		{
			DetectSourcesLoop();
			IEnumerable<Source> sources = GetSources(queriesToFill);
			Dictionary<IDataComponent, string[]> dictionary = (from s in sources
				group s by s.DataSource into dataSource
				where dataSource.Key is IDataComponent
				select dataSource).ToDictionary((Func<IGrouping<object, Source>, IDataComponent>)((IGrouping<object, Source> s) => (IDataComponent)s.Key), (Func<IGrouping<object, Source>, string[]>)((IGrouping<object, Source> g) => g.Select((Source s) => s.DataMember).Distinct().ToArray()));
			foreach (KeyValuePair<IDataComponent, string[]> item in dictionary)
			{
				FillDataSource(item.Key, sourceParameters, item.Value, serviceProvider);
			}
		}

		private static void FillDataSource(IDataComponent dataSource, IList<IParameter> sourceParameters, string[] queriesToFill, IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
		{
			if (dataSource is SqlDataSource sqlDataSource)
			{
				IEnumerable<string> second = from r in sqlDataSource.Relations
					where queriesToFill.Contains(r.MasterQueryName)
					select r.DetailQueryName;
				sqlDataSource.Fill(sourceParameters, queriesToFill.Union(second).Distinct().ToArray());
				return;
			}
			IListAdapter val = (IListAdapter)(object)((dataSource is IListAdapter) ? dataSource : null);
			if (val != null && !(val is FederationDataSourceBase))
			{
				val.FillList(serviceProvider);
			}
			else if (dataSource != null)
			{
				dataSource.Fill((IEnumerable<IParameter>)sourceParameters);
			}
		}

		private void FillSourcesAsynchronously(IList<IParameter> sourceParameters, string[] queriesToFill, IServiceProvider serviceProvider, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			DetectSourcesLoop();
			IEnumerable<Source> sources = GetSources(queriesToFill);
			Task[] tasks = (from dataSource in (from s in sources
					group s by s.DataSource into dataSource
					where dataSource.Key is IDataComponent
					select dataSource).ToDictionary((Func<IGrouping<object, Source>, IDataComponent>)((IGrouping<object, Source> s) => (IDataComponent)s.Key), (Func<IGrouping<object, Source>, string[]>)((IGrouping<object, Source> g) => g.Select((Source s) => s.DataMember).Distinct().ToArray()))
				select FillDataSourceAsynchronously(dataSource.Key, sourceParameters, dataSource.Value, serviceProvider, cancellationToken)).ToArray();
			Task.WaitAll(tasks, cancellationToken);
		}

		private Task FillDataSourceAsynchronously(IDataComponent dataSource, IList<IParameter> sourceParameters, string[] queriesToFill, IServiceProvider serviceProvider, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			if (dataSource is SqlDataSource sqlDataSource)
			{
				IEnumerable<string> second = from r in sqlDataSource.Relations
					where queriesToFill.Contains(r.MasterQueryName)
					select r.DetailQueryName;
				return sqlDataSource.FillAsync(sourceParameters, queriesToFill.Union(second).Distinct().ToArray(), cancellationToken);
			}
			IDataComponent obj = dataSource;
			IListAdapterAsync val = (IListAdapterAsync)(object)((obj is IListAdapterAsync) ? obj : null);
			if (val != null && !(val is FederationDataSourceBase))
			{
				return val.FillAsync(serviceProvider, cancellationToken);
			}
			if (dataSource is ISupportFillAsync supportFillAsync)
			{
				return supportFillAsync.FillAsync(sourceParameters, cancellationToken);
			}
			return Task.Factory.StartNew(delegate
			{
				IDataComponent obj2 = dataSource;
				if (obj2 != null)
				{
					obj2.Fill((IEnumerable<IParameter>)sourceParameters);
				}
			}, cancellationToken);
		}

		protected override IFederationDataSourceSerializer CreateDataSourceSerializer()
		{
			return new FederationDataSourceXmlSerializer(this);
		}

		public void BeginInit()
		{
			initCount++;
		}

		public void EndInit()
		{
			if (initCount > 0)
			{
				initCount--;
			}
			RebuildResultSchema(skipInvalidQueries: true);
		}

		void IXtraSerializable.OnStartSerializing()
		{
			BeginInit();
			SerializableSourceMap.Clear();
			foreach (Source source in base.Sources)
			{
				SerializableSourceMap.Add(new SourceMapItem
				{
					DataSource = source.DataSource,
					Name = source.Name
				});
			}
		}

		void IXtraSerializable.OnEndSerializing()
		{
			SerializableSourceMap.Clear();
			EndInit();
		}

		void IXtraSerializable.OnStartDeserializing(LayoutAllowEventArgs e)
		{
			BeginInit();
		}

		void IXtraSerializable.OnEndDeserializing(string restoredVersion)
		{
			foreach (Source source in base.Sources)
			{
				if (SerializableSourceMap.TryGetDataSource(source.Name, out var dataSource))
				{
					source.DataSource = dataSource;
				}
			}
			SerializableSourceMap.Clear();
			EndInit();
		}

		void IXtraSupportDeserializeCollectionItem.SetIndexCollectionItem(string propertyName, XtraSetItemIndexEventArgs e)
		{
			if (propertyName == "SerializableSourceMap")
			{
				SerializableSourceMap.Add((SourceMapItem)((XtraItemEventArgs)e).Item.Value);
			}
		}

		object IXtraSupportDeserializeCollectionItem.CreateCollectionItem(string propertyName, XtraItemEventArgs e)
		{
			if (propertyName == "SerializableSourceMap")
			{
				return new SourceMapItem();
			}
			return null;
		}

		bool IDynamicLookupSettingsDataProvider.CanGetResult(string dataMember)
		{
			return base.Queries.Any((QueryNode q) => q.ActualName == dataMember);
		}

		void IDynamicLookupSettingsDataProvider.Initialize(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
		{
			this.serviceProvider = serviceProvider;
		}

		private async Task<DynamicLookupResult> GetResultAsyncInternal(string dataMember, IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters, string filterString, CancellationToken cancellationToken, bool useAsync)
		{
			IParameter[] sourceParameters = (parameters as IParameter[]) ?? parameters.ToArray();
			QueryNode query = base.Queries.FirstOrDefault((QueryNode q) => q.ActualName == dataMember);
			query = (QueryNode)JoinNodeCloneAssistant.Clone(query);
			IEnumerable<Source> sources = GetSources(new string[1] { query.ActualName });
			Dictionary<IDataComponent, string[]> dictionary = (from s in sources
				group s by s.DataSource into dataSource
				where dataSource.Key is IDataComponent && !(dataSource.Key is IDynamicLookupSettingsDataProvider)
				select dataSource).ToDictionary((Func<IGrouping<object, Source>, IDataComponent>)((IGrouping<object, Source> s) => (IDataComponent)s.Key), (Func<IGrouping<object, Source>, string[]>)((IGrouping<object, Source> g) => g.Select((Source s) => s.DataMember).Distinct().ToArray()));
			foreach (KeyValuePair<IDataComponent, string[]> item in dictionary)
			{
				if (useAsync)
				{
					await FillDataSourceAsynchronously(item.Key, sourceParameters, item.Value, serviceProvider, cancellationToken);
				}
				else
				{
					FillDataSource(item.Key, sourceParameters, item.Value, serviceProvider);
				}
			}
			Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, ITypedColumnarData>> dictionary2 = new LookupSourceDataProvider(query, sourceParameters, serviceProvider).RetrieveSourceDataByQuery(new string[1] { query.ActualName }, includeData: true, CancellationToken.None);
			FederationResultTable result = new FederationResultTable(query, FederationResultBuilder.Process(query, dictionary2[query.ActualName], sourceParameters, cancellationToken).ToColumnarData());
			return new DynamicLookupResult
			{
				FilterApplied = false,
				ActualDataMember = null,
				Result = result
			};
		}

		DynamicLookupResult IDynamicLookupSettingsDataProvider.GetResult(string dataMember, IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters, string filterString, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			return TaskExtensions.Await<DynamicLookupResult>(GetResultAsyncInternal(dataMember, parameters, filterString, cancellationToken, useAsync: false));
		}

		Task<DynamicLookupResult> IDynamicLookupSettingsDataProvider.GetResultAsync(string dataMember, IEnumerable<IParameter> parameters, string filterString, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			return GetResultAsyncInternal(dataMember, parameters, filterString, cancellationToken, useAsync: true);
		}
	}
}

	public class HanaConnectionParameters : SqlServerConnectionParametersBase, IConnectionPagePort
	{
		private ushort port;

		public const int DefaultPortNumber = 40000;

		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.ConnectionParameters.HanaConnectionParameters.PortNumber")]
		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.ConnectionParameters.HanaConnectionParameters.PortNumber")]
		public int PortNumber
		{
			get
			{
				return port;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < 0 || value > 65535)
				{
					throw new OverflowException(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.InvalidPortErrorMessage));
				}
				port = (ushort)value;
			}
		}

		public HanaConnectionParameters()
		{
		}

		public HanaConnectionParameters(string serverName, int port, string userName, string password, string databaseName)
			: base(serverName, databaseName, userName, password)
		{
			PortNumber = port;
		}

		internal override void Assign(IConnectionPage source)
		{
			base.Assign(source);
			PortNumber = (source as IConnectionPagePort)?.PortNumber ?? 40000;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializePortNumber()
		{
			return PortNumber != 40000;
		}
	}

	{
		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.ConnectionParameters.MongoDBCustomConnectionParameters.ConnectionString")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.ConnectionParameters.MongoDBCustomConnectionParameters.ConnectionString")]
		public string ConnectionString { get; set; }

		internal override TargetDataSourceType TargetDataSourceType => TargetDataSourceType.MongoDB;

		internal override bool HasSensitiveInfo => true;

		string IConnectionPage.CustomConStr => ConnectionString;

		public MongoDBCustomConnectionParameters()
		{
		}

		public MongoDBCustomConnectionParameters(string connectionString)
		{
			ConnectionString = connectionString;
		}

		internal override void LoadFromXml(XElement element)
		{
			ConnectionString = element.GetAttributeValue("ConnectionString");
		}

		internal override XElement SaveToXml()
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(ConnectionString))
			{
				return null;
			}
			XElement xElement = new XElement("Parameters");
			xElement.Add(new XAttribute("ConnectionString", ConnectionString));
			return xElement;
		}

		internal override MongoDBUrlBuilder GetUrlBuilder()
		{
			return new MongoDBUrlBuilder(ConnectionString);
		}

		internal override void ClearCredentials(bool keepUserName)
		{
			try
			{
				MongoDBUrlBuilder urlBuilder = GetUrlBuilder();
				if (!keepUserName && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(urlBuilder.Username))
				{
					urlBuilder.Username = "";
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(urlBuilder.Password))
				{
					urlBuilder.Password = "***";
				}
				ConnectionString = urlBuilder.Url;
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		internal override void Assign(IConnectionPage source)
		{
			ConnectionString = (source as MongoDBCustomConnectionParameters)?.ConnectionString;
		}
	}
	public abstract class MongoDBConnectionParametersBase : DataConnectionParametersBase
	{
		protected const string XML_ConnectionString = "ConnectionString";

		public string GetConnectionString()
		{
			return GetUrlBuilder().Url;
		}

		internal static MongoDBConnectionParametersBase CreateFromXml(XElement element)
		{
			XElement xElement = element.Element("Parameters");
			if (xElement == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			MongoDBConnectionParametersBase mongoDBConnectionParametersBase = ((xElement.Attribute("ConnectionString") == null) ? ((MongoDBConnectionParametersBase)new MongoDBConnectionParameters()) : ((MongoDBConnectionParametersBase)new MongoDBCustomConnectionParameters()));
			mongoDBConnectionParametersBase.LoadFromXml(xElement);
			return mongoDBConnectionParametersBase;
		}

		internal abstract void LoadFromXml(XElement element);

		internal abstract XElement SaveToXml();

		internal abstract MongoDBUrlBuilder GetUrlBuilder();

		internal MongoDBConnectionParametersBase Clone()
		{
			MongoDBConnectionParametersBase mongoDBConnectionParametersBase = ((this is MongoDBCustomConnectionParameters) ? ((MongoDBConnectionParametersBase)new MongoDBCustomConnectionParameters()) : ((MongoDBConnectionParametersBase)new MongoDBConnectionParameters()));
			mongoDBConnectionParametersBase.Assign(this);
			return mongoDBConnectionParametersBase;
		}
	}
	public class MongoDBConnectionParameters : MongoDBConnectionParametersBase, IConnectionPageMongoDB, IConnectionPageHostname
	{
		private const string XML_Hostname = "HostName";

		private const string XML_Port = "Port";

		private const string XML_IsSrvRecord = "IsSrvRecord";

		private const string XML_AuthParams = "AuthParameters";

		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.ConnectionParameters.MongoDBConnectionParameters.Hostname")]
		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.ConnectionParameters.MongoDBConnectionParameters.Hostname")]
		public string Hostname { get; set; }

		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.ConnectionParameters.MongoDBConnectionParameters.Port")]
		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.ConnectionParameters.MongoDBConnectionParameters.Port")]
		public int Port { get; set; }

		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.ConnectionParameters.MongoDBConnectionParameters.IsSRVRecord")]
		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.ConnectionParameters.MongoDBConnectionParameters.IsSRVRecord")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(BooleanTypeConverter))]
		public bool IsSRVRecord { get; set; }

		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.ConnectionParameters.MongoDBConnectionParameters.AuthenticationInfo")]
		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.ConnectionParameters.MongoDBConnectionParameters.AuthenticationInfo")]
		public MongoDBAuthenticationInfo AuthenticationInfo { get; set; }

		internal override TargetDataSourceType TargetDataSourceType => TargetDataSourceType.MongoDB;

		internal override bool HasSensitiveInfo => AuthenticationInfo != null;

		public MongoDBConnectionParameters()
		{
		}

		public MongoDBConnectionParameters(string hostName, bool isSRV, int port = 0, MongoDBAuthenticationInfo info = null)
		{
			Hostname = hostName;
			IsSRVRecord = isSRV;
			if (!isSRV)
			{
				Port = port;
			}
			AuthenticationInfo = info;
		}

		internal override void ClearCredentials(bool keepUserName)
		{
			AuthenticationInfo?.ClearCredentials(keepUserName);
		}

		internal override void Assign(IConnectionPage source)
		{
			if (source is MongoDBConnectionParameters mongoDBConnectionParameters)
			{
				Hostname = mongoDBConnectionParameters.Hostname;
				IsSRVRecord = mongoDBConnectionParameters.IsSRVRecord;
				if (!IsSRVRecord)
				{
					Port = mongoDBConnectionParameters.Port;
				}
				AuthenticationInfo = MongoDBAuthenticationInfo.Clone(mongoDBConnectionParameters.AuthenticationInfo);
			}
		}

		internal override void LoadFromXml(XElement parametersElement)
		{
			Hostname = parametersElement.GetAttributeValue("HostName");
			string attributeValue = parametersElement.GetAttributeValue("IsSrvRecord");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(attributeValue) && StringExtensions.CompareInvariantCultureIgnoreCase(attributeValue, bool.TrueString) == 0)
			{
				IsSRVRecord = true;
			}
			else
			{
				string attributeValue2 = parametersElement.GetAttributeValue("Port");
				if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(attributeValue2) && int.TryParse(attributeValue2, out var result))
				{
					Port = result;
				}
			}
			XElement element = parametersElement.Element("AuthParameters");
			AuthenticationInfo = MongoDBAuthenticationInfo.CreateFromXml(element);
		}

		internal override XElement SaveToXml()
		{
			XElement xElement = new XElement("Parameters");
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Hostname))
			{
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("HostName", Hostname));
			}
			if (IsSRVRecord)
			{
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("IsSrvRecord", IsSRVRecord));
			}
			else
			{
				xElement.Add(new XAttribute("Port", Port));
			}
			if (AuthenticationInfo != null)
			{
				XElement xElement2 = new XElement("AuthParameters");
				AuthenticationInfo.SaveToXml(xElement2);
				xElement.Add(xElement2);
			}
			return xElement;
		}

		internal override MongoDBUrlBuilder GetUrlBuilder()
		{
			MongoDBUrlBuilder mongoDBUrlBuilder = new MongoDBUrlBuilder(Hostname, Port, IsSRVRecord);
			AuthenticationInfo?.Apply(mongoDBUrlBuilder);
			return mongoDBUrlBuilder;
		}
	}
	[DXHelpExclude(true)]
	public enum MongoDBAuthenticationType
	{
		None,
		Password,
		ScramSHA256,
		Kerberos,
		X509,
		LDAP
	}
	internal static class MongoAuthTypeHelper
	{
		private static Dictionary<MongoDBAuthenticationType, string> typesToTexts = new Dictionary<MongoDBAuthenticationType, string>
		{
			{
				MongoDBAuthenticationType.None,
				DataAccessUILocalizer.GetString(DataAccessUIStringId.WizardPageConfigureMongoDBConnection_AuthenticationType_None)
			},
			{
				MongoDBAuthenticationType.Password,
				DataAccessUILocalizer.GetString(DataAccessUIStringId.WizardPageConfigureMongoDBConnection_AuthenticationType_NamePassword)
			},
			{
				MongoDBAuthenticationType.ScramSHA256,
				"Scram-Sha-256"
			},
			{
				MongoDBAuthenticationType.X509,
				"X.509"
			}
		};

		public static MongoDBAuthenticationType GetTypeFromString(string s)
		{
			MongoDBAuthenticationType result = MongoDBAuthenticationType.None;
			IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<MongoDBAuthenticationType, string>> source = typesToTexts.Where((KeyValuePair<MongoDBAuthenticationType, string> kvp) => kvp.Value == s);
			if (source.Any())
			{
				return source.Single().Key;
			}
			if (!Enum.TryParse<MongoDBAuthenticationType>(s, out result))
			{
				return MongoDBAuthenticationType.None;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static MongoDBAuthenticationType[] GetSupportedAuthTypes()
		{
			return new MongoDBAuthenticationType[3]
			{
				MongoDBAuthenticationType.None,
				MongoDBAuthenticationType.Password,
				MongoDBAuthenticationType.ScramSHA256
			};
		}

		public static string ToDisplayText(this MongoDBAuthenticationType type)
		{
			if (!typesToTexts.TryGetValue(type, out var value))
			{
				return type.ToString();
			}
			return value;
		}

		public static string ToMechanismName(this MongoDBAuthenticationType type)
		{
			switch (type)
			{
			case MongoDBAuthenticationType.None:
			case MongoDBAuthenticationType.Password:
				return string.Empty;
			case MongoDBAuthenticationType.ScramSHA256:
				return "SCRAM-SHA-256";
			case MongoDBAuthenticationType.Kerberos:
				return "GSSAPI";
			case MongoDBAuthenticationType.X509:
				return "MONGODB-X509";
			case MongoDBAuthenticationType.LDAP:
				return "PLAIN";
			default:
				throw new ArgumentException(GetMechanismNotSupportedText(type));
			}
		}

		public static string GetMechanismNotSupportedText(MongoDBAuthenticationType type)
		{
			return "This mechanism is not supported: " + type;
		}
	}
	public abstract class MongoDBAuthenticationInfo
	{
		internal class MongoDBAuthInfoEqualityComparer : IEqualityComparer<MongoDBAuthenticationInfo>
		{
			public bool Equals(MongoDBAuthenticationInfo x, MongoDBAuthenticationInfo y)
			{
				return EqualsHelper.ObjectsEquals(x, y, (MongoDBAuthenticationInfo cx, MongoDBAuthenticationInfo cy) => cx.EqualsCore(cy));
			}

			public int GetHashCode(MongoDBAuthenticationInfo obj)
			{
				return obj.GetHashCode();
			}
		}

		internal const string XML_Username = "Username";

		internal const string XML_Password = "Password";

		internal const string XML_Type = "Type";

		internal abstract MongoDBAuthenticationType Type { get; }

		internal static MongoDBAuthenticationInfo Clone(MongoDBAuthenticationInfo sourceInfo)
		{
			if (sourceInfo == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (sourceInfo is MongoDBKerberosAuthenticationInfo mongoDBKerberosAuthenticationInfo)
			{
				return NewKerberos(mongoDBKerberosAuthenticationInfo.Principal, mongoDBKerberosAuthenticationInfo.Password, mongoDBKerberosAuthenticationInfo.ServiceName, mongoDBKerberosAuthenticationInfo.CanonicalizeHostName);
			}
			if (sourceInfo is MongoDBPasswordAuthenticationInfo mongoDBPasswordAuthenticationInfo)
			{
				return New(sourceInfo.Type, mongoDBPasswordAuthenticationInfo.Username, mongoDBPasswordAuthenticationInfo.Password, mongoDBPasswordAuthenticationInfo.AuthenticationDatabase);
			}
			if (sourceInfo is MongoDBX509AuthenticationInfo mongoDBX509AuthenticationInfo)
			{
				return New(sourceInfo.Type, mongoDBX509AuthenticationInfo.Username, null, null);
			}
			throw new ArgumentException(MongoAuthTypeHelper.GetMechanismNotSupportedText(sourceInfo.Type));
		}

		internal static MongoDBAuthenticationInfo New(MongoDBAuthenticationType type)
		{
			return type switch
			{
				MongoDBAuthenticationType.None => null, 
				MongoDBAuthenticationType.Password => new MongoDBPasswordAuthenticationInfo(), 
				MongoDBAuthenticationType.ScramSHA256 => new MongoDBScramSHA256AuthenticationInfo(), 
				MongoDBAuthenticationType.LDAP => new MongoDBLdapAuthenticationInfo(), 
				MongoDBAuthenticationType.X509 => new MongoDBX509AuthenticationInfo(), 
				MongoDBAuthenticationType.Kerberos => new MongoDBKerberosAuthenticationInfo(), 
				_ => throw new NotSupportedException(), 
			};
		}

		internal static MongoDBAuthenticationInfo New(MongoDBAuthenticationType type, string userName, string password, string authDataBaseName)
		{
			return type switch
			{
				MongoDBAuthenticationType.None => null, 
				MongoDBAuthenticationType.Password => new MongoDBPasswordAuthenticationInfo(userName, password, authDataBaseName), 
				MongoDBAuthenticationType.ScramSHA256 => new MongoDBScramSHA256AuthenticationInfo(userName, password, authDataBaseName), 
				MongoDBAuthenticationType.LDAP => new MongoDBLdapAuthenticationInfo(userName, password, authDataBaseName), 
				MongoDBAuthenticationType.X509 => new MongoDBX509AuthenticationInfo(userName), 
				MongoDBAuthenticationType.Kerberos => throw new ArgumentException("Use NewKerberos Method instead of this"), 
				_ => throw new NotSupportedException(), 
			};
		}

		internal static MongoDBAuthenticationInfo NewKerberos(string principal, string password, string serviceName, bool canonicalizeHostName)
		{
			return new MongoDBKerberosAuthenticationInfo(principal, password, serviceName, canonicalizeHostName);
		}

		internal virtual void Apply(MongoDBUrlBuilder builder)
		{
			string value = Type.ToMechanismName();
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				builder.AuthenticationMechanism = Type.ToMechanismName();
				IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<string, string>> authMechanismProperties = GetAuthMechanismProperties();
				if (authMechanismProperties != null)
				{
					builder.AuthenticationMechanismProperties = authMechanismProperties;
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<string, string>> GetAuthMechanismProperties()
		{
			return null;
		}

		internal void SaveToXml(XElement element)
		{
			element.Add(new XAttribute("Type", Type));
			SaveToXMLCore(element);
		}

		internal abstract void ClearCredentials(bool keepUserName);

		internal abstract bool EqualsCore(MongoDBAuthenticationInfo other);

		protected abstract void SaveToXMLCore(XElement element);

		internal abstract void LoadFromXml(XElement element);

		public static MongoDBAuthenticationInfo CreateFromXml(XElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			MongoDBAuthenticationType typeFromString = MongoAuthTypeHelper.GetTypeFromString(element.GetAttributeValue("Type"));
			MongoDBAuthenticationInfo mongoDBAuthenticationInfo = New(typeFromString);
			mongoDBAuthenticationInfo.LoadFromXml(element);
			return mongoDBAuthenticationInfo;
		}
	}
	internal class MongoDBKerberosAuthenticationInfo : MongoDBAuthenticationInfo
	{
		private const string XML_Principal = "Principal";

		private const string XML_ServiceName = "ServiceName";

		private const string XML_CanonicalizeHost = "CanonicalizeHost";

		private const string MechanismProperty_ServiceName = "SERVICE_NAME";

		private const string MechanismProperty_CanonicalizeHost = "CANONICALIZE_HOST_NAME";

		internal override MongoDBAuthenticationType Type => MongoDBAuthenticationType.Kerberos;

		public string Principal { get; set; }

		public string Password { get; set; }

		public string ServiceName { get; set; }

		public bool CanonicalizeHostName { get; set; }

		internal MongoDBKerberosAuthenticationInfo()
		{
		}

		public MongoDBKerberosAuthenticationInfo(string principal, string password, string serviceName, bool canonicalizeHostName)
		{
			Principal = principal;
			Password = password;
			ServiceName = serviceName;
			CanonicalizeHostName = canonicalizeHostName;
		}

		internal override bool EqualsCore(MongoDBAuthenticationInfo other)
		{
			if (!(other is MongoDBKerberosAuthenticationInfo mongoDBKerberosAuthenticationInfo))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Principal == mongoDBKerberosAuthenticationInfo.Principal && Password == mongoDBKerberosAuthenticationInfo.Password && ServiceName == mongoDBKerberosAuthenticationInfo.ServiceName)
			{
				return CanonicalizeHostName == mongoDBKerberosAuthenticationInfo.CanonicalizeHostName;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal override void ClearCredentials(bool keepUserName)
		{
			if (!keepUserName)
			{
				Principal = string.Empty;
			}
			Password = string.Empty;
			ServiceName = string.Empty;
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<string, string>> GetAuthMechanismProperties()
		{
			Dictionary<string, string> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, string>();
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ServiceName))
			{
				dictionary.Add("SERVICE_NAME", ServiceName);
			}
			dictionary.Add("CANONICALIZE_HOST_NAME", CanonicalizeHostName.ToString());
			return dictionary;
		}

		protected override void SaveToXMLCore(XElement element)
		{
			element.Add(new XAttribute("Principal", Principal));
			element.Add(new XAttribute("Password", Password));
			element.Add(new XAttribute("ServiceName", ServiceName));
			element.Add(new XAttribute("CanonicalizeHost", CanonicalizeHostName));
		}

		internal override void LoadFromXml(XElement element)
		{
			Principal = element.GetAttributeValue("Principal");
			Password = element.GetAttributeValue("Password");
			ServiceName = element.GetAttributeValue("ServiceName");
			string attributeValue = element.GetAttributeValue("CanonicalizeHost");
			CanonicalizeHostName = StringExtensions.CompareInvariantCultureIgnoreCase(attributeValue, bool.TrueString) == 0;
		}
	}
	internal class MongoDBX509AuthenticationInfo : MongoDBAuthenticationInfo

	public class MongoDBPasswordAuthenticationInfo : MongoDBAuthenticationInfo
	{
		private const string XML_AuthenticationDatabase = "AuthenticationDatabase";

		internal override MongoDBAuthenticationType Type => MongoDBAuthenticationType.Password;

		public string Username { get; set; }

		public string Password { get; set; }

		public string AuthenticationDatabase { get; set; }

		internal MongoDBPasswordAuthenticationInfo()
		{
		}

		public MongoDBPasswordAuthenticationInfo(string username, string password)
			: this(username, password, string.Empty)
		{
		}

		public MongoDBPasswordAuthenticationInfo(string username, string password, string authenticationDatabase)
		{
			Username = username;
			Password = password;
			AuthenticationDatabase = authenticationDatabase;
		}

		internal override bool EqualsCore(MongoDBAuthenticationInfo other)
		{
			if (!(other is MongoDBPasswordAuthenticationInfo mongoDBPasswordAuthenticationInfo))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Username == mongoDBPasswordAuthenticationInfo.Username && Password == mongoDBPasswordAuthenticationInfo.Password)
			{
				return AuthenticationDatabase == mongoDBPasswordAuthenticationInfo.AuthenticationDatabase;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal override void ClearCredentials(bool keepUsername)
		{
			if (!keepUsername)
			{
				Username = string.Empty;
			}
			Password = string.Empty;
			AuthenticationDatabase = string.Empty;
		}

		internal override void Apply(MongoDBUrlBuilder builder)
		{
			base.Apply(builder);
			builder.Username = Username;
			builder.Password = Password;
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(AuthenticationDatabase))
			{
				builder.AuthenticationSource = AuthenticationDatabase;
			}
		}

		protected override void SaveToXMLCore(XElement element)
		{
			element.Add(new XAttribute("Username", Username));
			element.Add(new XAttribute("Password", Password));
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(AuthenticationDatabase))
			{
				element.Add(new XAttribute("AuthenticationDatabase", AuthenticationDatabase));
			}
		}

		internal override void LoadFromXml(XElement element)
		{
			Username = element.GetAttributeValue("Username");
			Password = element.GetAttributeValue("Password");
			AuthenticationDatabase = element.GetAttributeValue("AuthenticationDatabase");
		}
	}

		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.ConnectionParameters.BigQueryConnectionParameters.Dsn")]
		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.ConnectionParameters.BigQueryConnectionParameters.Dsn")]
		public string Dsn { get; set; }

		internal override TargetDataSourceType TargetDataSourceType => TargetDataSourceType.Sql;

		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.ConnectionParameters.BigQueryConnectionParameters.AuthorizationType")]
		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.ConnectionParameters.BigQueryConnectionParameters.AuthorizationType")]
		public BigQueryAuthorizationType AuthorizationType
		{
			get
			{
				if (!((IConnectionPage)this).AuthType)
				{
					return BigQueryAuthorizationType.OAuth;
				}
				return BigQueryAuthorizationType.PrivateKeyFile;
			}
			set
			{
				((IConnectionPage)this).AuthType = value == BigQueryAuthorizationType.PrivateKeyFile;
			}
		}

		public BigQueryConnectionParameters()
		{
		}

		public BigQueryConnectionParameters(string dsn)
		{
			Dsn = dsn;
		}

		public BigQueryConnectionParameters(string projectId, string datasetId, string oAuthClientID, string oAuthClientSecret, string oAuthRefreshToken)
			: this(projectId, datasetId)
		{
			AuthorizationType = BigQueryAuthorizationType.OAuth;
			OAuthClientID = oAuthClientID;
			OAuthClientSecret = oAuthClientSecret;
			OAuthRefreshToken = oAuthRefreshToken;
		}

		public BigQueryConnectionParameters(string projectId, string datasetId, string serviceAccountEmail, string privateKeyFileName)
			: this(projectId, datasetId)
		{
			AuthorizationType = BigQueryAuthorizationType.PrivateKeyFile;
			ServiceAccountEmail = serviceAccountEmail;
			PrivateKeyFileName = privateKeyFileName;
		}

		private BigQueryConnectionParameters(string projectId, string datasetId)
		{
			ProjectID = projectId;
			DataSetID = datasetId;
		}

		internal override void Assign(IConnectionPage source)
		{
			if (source is IConnectionPageBigQuery { AuthorizationType: var authorizationType } connectionPageBigQuery)
			{
				AuthorizationType = authorizationType;
				if (authorizationType == BigQueryAuthorizationType.OAuth)
				{
					OAuthClientID = connectionPageBigQuery.OAuthClientID;
					OAuthClientSecret = connectionPageBigQuery.OAuthClientSecret;
					OAuthRefreshToken = connectionPageBigQuery.OAuthRefreshToken;
				}
				if (authorizationType == BigQueryAuthorizationType.PrivateKeyFile)
				{
					PrivateKeyFileName = connectionPageBigQuery.PrivateKeyFileName;
					ServiceAccountEmail = connectionPageBigQuery.ServiceAccountEmail;
				}
			}
		}

		internal override void ClearCredentials(bool keepUserName)
		{
			if (!keepUserName)
			{
				OAuthClientID = null;
				ServiceAccountEmail = null;
			}
			OAuthClientSecret = null;
			OAuthRefreshToken = null;
			PrivateKeyFileName = null;
		}
	}

	[ResourceFinder(typeof(ResFinder))]
	public enum BigQueryAuthorizationType
	{
		PrivateKeyFile,
		OAuth
	}
	public class TeradataConnectionParameters : SqlServerConnectionParametersBase, IConnectionPagePort
	{
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DXHelpExclude(true)]
		public const string DefaultPort = "1025";

		public const int DefaultPortNumber = 1025;

		private ushort port;

		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.ConnectionParameters.TeradataConnectionParameters.PortNumber")]
		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.ConnectionParameters.TeradataConnectionParameters.PortNumber")]
		public int PortNumber
		{
			get
			{
				return port;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < 0 || value > 65535)
				{
					throw new OverflowException(DataAccessLocalizer.GetString(DataAccessStringId.InvalidPortErrorMessage));
				}
				port = (ushort)value;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DXHelpExclude(true)]
		public string Port
		{
			get
			{
				return port.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			}
			set
			{
				port = ushort.Parse(value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			}
		}

		public TeradataConnectionParameters()
		{
			PortNumber = 1025;
		}

		public TeradataConnectionParameters(string serverName, int port, string databaseName, string userName, string password)
			: base(serverName, databaseName, userName, password)
		{
			PortNumber = port;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DXHelpExclude(true)]
		public TeradataConnectionParameters(string serverName, string port, string databaseName, string userName, string password)
			: base(serverName, databaseName, userName, password)
		{
			Port = port;
		}

		internal override void Assign(IConnectionPage source)
		{
			base.Assign(source);
			PortNumber = (source as IConnectionPagePort)?.PortNumber ?? 1025;
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializePortNumber()
		{
			return PortNumber != 1025;
		}
	}

	[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.DataAccess.ConnectionParameters.DataConnectionParametersBase")]
	public abstract class DataConnectionParametersBase : IConnectionPage
	{
		private ProviderFactory factory;

		bool IConnectionPage.AuthType { get; set; }

		bool IConnectionPage.CeConnectionHelper { get; set; }

		string IConnectionPage.CustomConStr => string.Empty;

		string IConnectionPage.CustomConStrTag => string.Empty;

		string IConnectionPage.DatabaseName { get; set; }

		ProviderFactory IConnectionPage.Factory => factory;

		string IConnectionPage.FileName { get; set; }

		bool IConnectionPage.GenerateConnectionHelper => false;

		bool IConnectionPage.IsServerbased => IsServerBasedInternal;

		string IConnectionPage.LastConStr { get; set; }

		string IConnectionPage.Password { get; set; }

		string IConnectionPage.ServerName { get; set; }

		string IConnectionPage.UserName { get; set; }

		internal abstract TargetDataSourceType TargetDataSourceType { get; }

		internal ProviderFactory Factory
		{
			get
			{
				return factory;
			}
			set
			{
				factory = value;
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool IsServerBasedInternal => true;

		internal virtual bool HasSensitiveInfo
		{
			get
			{
				if (!((IConnectionPage)this).AuthType)
				{
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(((IConnectionPage)this).UserName))
					{
						return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(((IConnectionPage)this).Password);
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		void IConnectionPage.SetProvider(string providerKey)
		{
			factory = DataConnectionHelper.GetProviderFactory(providerKey);
		}

		internal abstract void Assign(IConnectionPage source);

		internal virtual void ClearCredentials(bool keepUserName)
		{
			((IConnectionPage)this).Password = null;
			if (!keepUserName)
			{
				((IConnectionPage)this).UserName = null;
			}
		}
	}

			ServerName = string.Empty;

			UserName = userName;
			Password = password;
			ConnectionType = FireBirdConnectionType.Embedded;
		}

		{
			return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(Password);
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeUserName()
		{
			return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(UserName);
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializePortNumber()
		{
			if (ConnectionType == FireBirdConnectionType.ServerBased)
			{
				return PortNumber != 3050;
			}
			return false;
		}

		{
			UserName = source.UserName;
			FileName = source.FileName;
			ServerName = source.ServerName;
			Password = source.Password;
			DatabaseName = source.DatabaseName;
			PortNumber = (source as IConnectionPagePort)?.PortNumber ?? 3050;
		}
